teaser.en: Its round fruits grow as big as a cannonball, then crack apart into a puzzle of wedge-shaped seeds that the tide carries away.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake ya mviringo hukua makubwa kama gunduli la mzinga, kisha hupasuka na kuwa mbegu zenye umbo la kabari zinazoshikamana kama fumbo, nazo huchukuliwa na maji ya bahari.
teaser.dg: Matundage ga mviringo ganakula hadi kukala makulu dza mpira wa mzinga, chisha ganaahuka na kukala tembe zenye pembe zirizobanana dza vipande vya fumbo, na madzi ga bahari ganazitsukula.

summary.en: The cannonball mangrove is an evergreen tree of the landward mangrove edge, named for its huge, heavy round fruits. Its fine timber has long gone into beds, doors and window frames on the coast, which is one reason it has become scarce.
summary.sw: Mkomafi ni mti usiopukutisha majani unaoota ukingoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu, na umepata jina lake la Kiingereza kutokana na matunda yake makubwa, mazito na ya mviringo. Mbao zake bora zimetumika kwa muda mrefu pwani kutengenezea vitanda, milango na fremu za madirisha, na hiyo ni sababu mojawapo ya kuadimika kwake.
summary.dg: *Cannonball mangrove* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa kanda ya bara ya mikoko, na dzinare ra Chingereza rinalavywa kula matundage makulu, maziho na ga mviringo. Kula kare mbaoze nono zinahumirwa pwani kuhenda vitanda, miryango na vizingiti vya madirisha, na ihi ni sababu mwenga iriyohenda ukale adimu.

about.en:
The cannonball mangrove is an evergreen tree that grows to about 10 metres. Instead of stilt roots or pencil-like breathing roots, it spreads flattened, snake-like roots across the surface of the mud, winding away from the trunk like ribbons. The leaves are compound, with a few pairs of glossy, rounded leaflets, as is typical of the mahogany family it belongs to.

The fruit gives the tree its name. It is a hard, round ball that can reach 25 centimetres across, heavy enough to leave a dent where it falls. When ripe it splits open into a set of angular, wedge-shaped seeds that fit together like the pieces of a puzzle. The seeds float, and many are carried off by the tide to settle on new mud.
about.sw:
Mkomafi ni mti usiopukutisha majani unaofikia urefu wa takriban mita 10. Badala ya mizizi-mihimili au mizizi ya kupumulia iliyochongoka kama penseli, hutandaza mizizi bapa inayofanana na nyoka juu ya tope, ikijipinda mbali na shina kama riboni. Majani yake ni mchanganyiko, yakiwa na jozi chache za vijani vinavyong'aa na vya mviringo, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia ya mkangazi (mahogany) ambayo mti huu ni sehemu yake.

Tunda ndilo lililoupa mti jina lake la Kiingereza. Ni mpira mgumu wa mviringo unaoweza kufikia upana wa sentimita 25, mzito kiasi cha kuacha shimo pale unapoangukia. Likiiva hupasuka na kuwa kundi la mbegu zenye pembe na umbo la kabari zinazoshikamana kama vipande vya fumbo. Mbegu hizo huelea, na nyingi huchukuliwa na maji kupwa na kujaa hadi kutua kwenye tope jipya.
about.dg:
*Cannonball mangrove* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati unaokula hadi phephi mita 10. Badala ya mizi iriyootyoka au mizi dza kalamu ya kuphahira pumuzi, miziye mibapa, dza nyoka, inaenea dzulu ya matope, ichizunguluka kula kpwa kolo dza vitambaa vyembamba. Makodzage ni ga kuungana: chila kodza rina makodza madide machache, airi-airi, ganaala na ni ga mviringo, dza irivyo kawaida kpwa jamiiye, jamii ya *mahogany*.

Tunda ndiro rinaropha muhi uhu dzinare. Ni mpira mgumu wa mviringo unaoweza kufika sentimita 25 kpwa upana, na ni mziho hata unaricha alama photsi phatu unaphogbwa. Richiivwa rinaahuka na kukala tembe zenye pembe, zirizobanana phamwenga dza vipande vya fumbo. Tembe zinaelea, na nyinji nkutsukulwa ni madzi ga bahari hadi kpwenye matope maphya, ambako zinamera.

where.en: Look for it near the high-water mark on the landward side of the mangrove, where the mud is firmer and only the highest tides reach. It is not a common tree: in the Vanga mangroves it makes up only a small share of the forest. Fallen fruits and loose seeds on the mud are often the easiest clue that one is nearby, and the surface roots are best seen at low tide.
where.sw: Utaupata karibu na alama ya maji makuu upande wa nchi kavu wa mikoko, ambapo tope ni gumu zaidi na ni maji makuu tu yanayofika. Si mti wa kawaida: katika mikoko ya Vanga ni sehemu ndogo tu ya msitu. Matunda yaliyoanguka na mbegu zilizotawanyika juu ya tope mara nyingi ndiyo dalili rahisi kwamba mti huu uko karibu, na mizizi yake ya juu huonekana vizuri zaidi wakati wa maji kupwa.
where.dg: Uhendze phephi na phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika, uphande wa bara wa mikoko, ambapho matope ni magumu zaidi na ni madzi makulu sana ga kuodzala tu ganayofika. Si muhi wa kawaida: kpwenye mikoko ya Vanga ni seemu ndide tu ya tsaka. Matunda ganayogbwa na tembe zirizolala dzulu ya matope kpwa kawaida ndizo alama rahisi zaidi kukala muhi uhu u phephi, na mizi ya dzulu ya matope inaonekana vinono zaidi wakati wa madzi ga kala.

uses.en:
The wood is among the best that the mangroves offer. It is valued as high-quality timber for beds and for door and window frames, and it also burns well as firewood and charcoal. Because good trees are taken selectively for timber, the larger specimens have become hard to find.

The fruit has a use of its own: it is crushed and made into ointments.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake ni miongoni mwa bora kabisa zinazopatikana mikokoni. Zinathaminiwa kama mbao za hadhi ya juu za kutengenezea vitanda na fremu za milango na madirisha, na pia huwaka vizuri zikitumika kama kuni na mkaa. Kwa sababu miti mizuri hukatwa kwa kuchaguliwa kwa ajili ya mbao, miti mikubwa imekuwa vigumu kupatikana.

Tunda nalo lina matumizi yake: hupondwa na kutengenezwa marhamu.
uses.dg:
Mbaoze ni kahi ya mbao bora sana zinazolavywa ni mikoko. Zina samani kpwa sababu ni mbao nono za kuhendera vitanda na vizingiti vya miryango na madirisha, na piya zinaaka vinono dza kuni na makala. Kpwa sababu mihi minono nkutsambulwa na kukatwa kpwa mbao, mihi mikulu ikakala vigumu kuiphaha.

Tunda piya rina kaziye: nkusirwa na kuhendwa mafuha ga kupaka.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *mkomafi* or *mtonga*; *mkomafi* is also used for its close relative, the cedar mangrove. In English it is the cannonball mangrove, and botanists know it as *Xylocarpus granatum*. The species name *granatum* compares the fruit to a pomegranate.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mkomafi* au *mtonga*; jina *mkomafi* hutumika pia kwa ndugu yake wa karibu, *mkomafi* mdogo (*cedar mangrove*). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *cannonball mangrove*, na wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Xylocarpus granatum*. Jina la spishi *granatum* linalinganisha tunda lake na komamanga.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkomafi* au *mtonga*; *mkomafi* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa nduguye wa phephi, *cedar mangrove*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *cannonball mangrove*, na asayansi a mimea anaumanya kukala *Xylocarpus granatum*. Dzina ra aina, *granatum*, rinagomba kukala tunda rinahalana na *komamanga* (*pomegranate*).

conservation.en: The tree is scarce on the south coast and is selectively cut for its timber. It is globally Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and community projects at Gazi and Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) and at Vanga, Jimbo and Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) are restoring the forest.
conservation.sw: Mti huu ni adimu katika pwani ya kusini na hukatwa kwa kuchaguliwa kwa ajili ya mbao zake. Kimataifa uko katika hali ya Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati, kwa hiyo uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na miradi ya kijamii huko Gazi na Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) na huko Vanga, Jimbo na Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) inarejesha msitu.
conservation.dg: Muhi uhu ni adimu pwani ya kusini, na nkukatwa kpwa kutsambulwa kpwa sababu ya mbaoze. Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni, kpwa hivyo kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service, na mipango ya jamii ya Gazi na Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) na ya Vanga, Jimbo na Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) inauyiza tsaka.

teaser.en: Dhow builders prized its timber for masts, yet this rare mangrove hides in the thickets at the back of the swamp, away from the sea.
teaser.sw: Mafundi wa majahazi waliuthamini mti huu kwa ajili ya milingoti, lakini mkoko huu adimu hujificha vichakani nyuma ya bwawa, mbali na bahari.
teaser.dg: Afundi a jahazi kala anamendza sana mbaoze kpwa kuhenda milingoti, ela mkoko uhu adimu unadzifwitsa kahi ya vitsaka vya nyuma ya mikoko, kure na bahari.

summary.en: The cedar mangrove is a shrub or small tree that grows in coral thickets and bushland at the back of the mangroves. It is rare on the Kenyan coast, and its timber was used for dhow masts and furniture.
summary.sw: Mkomafi huu ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaoota katika vichaka vya matumbawe na misitu ya vichaka nyuma ya mikoko. Ni adimu katika pwani ya Kenya, na mbao zake zilitumika kutengenezea milingoti ya majahazi na fanicha.
summary.dg: *Cedar mangrove* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaomera kahi ya vitsaka vya sanoo na weruni nyuma ya mikoko. Ni adimu pwani ya Kenya, na mbaoze zahumirwa kuhenda milingoti ya jahazi na fanicha.

about.en:
The cedar mangrove is a shrub or small tree, a smaller and more retiring cousin of the cannonball mangrove. Its leaves are compound, and the leaflets are drier in texture and more pointed than those of the cannonball mangrove. Its fruit is a hard, round capsule like its relative's but noticeably smaller, and it too splits into angular seeds.

In wetter ground the tree may send up breathing roots from the mud, but where it grows among coral rock it can look like an ordinary bush tree, so it is easy to pass by without recognising it as a mangrove at all.
about.sw:
Mkomafi huu ni kichaka au mti mdogo, ndugu mdogo na mwenye haya zaidi wa mkomafi mkubwa (*cannonball mangrove*). Majani yake ni mchanganyiko, na vijani vyake ni vikavu zaidi kwa kuguswa na vimechongoka zaidi kuliko vya mkomafi mkubwa. Tunda lake ni kibuyu kigumu cha mviringo kama cha ndugu yake lakini kidogo zaidi kwa wazi, nalo pia hupasuka na kuwa mbegu zenye pembe.

Katika ardhi yenye unyevu zaidi mti huu unaweza kuchipua mizizi ya kupumulia kutoka kwenye tope, lakini pale unapoota kati ya miamba ya matumbawe unaweza kuonekana kama mti wa kawaida wa porini, hivyo ni rahisi kuupita bila kutambua kwamba ni mkoko kabisa.
about.dg:
*Cedar mangrove* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide; ni nduguye wa *cannonball mangrove*, ela ni mdide na unadzifwitsa zaidi. Makodzage ni ga kuungana, na makodza madide ni makavu zaidi na gana ntsa kuriko ga *cannonball mangrove*. Tundare ni kakaya gumu ra mviringo dza ra nduguye, ela ni ridide kpwa wazi, na piya rinaahuka na kukala tembe zenye pembe.

Kpwenye tsi yenye madzi manji, muhi unaweza kutuluza mizi ya kuphahira pumuzi kula matopeni, ela ambapho unamera kahi ya mawe ga sanoo unaweza kuonekana dza muhi wa kawaida wa weruni, kpwa hivyo ni rahisi kuutsupa usimanye kukala ni mkoko kabisa.

where.en: It grows in coral thickets and bushland at the back of the mangroves, where the tidal swamp gives way to dry land. Unlike the zoned mangroves of the open creek, it is found here and there along the Kenyan coast rather than in stands, and it is rare. The best chance of seeing it is on the landward fringe of a mangrove walk, looking for small round fruits among the coral scrub.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya matumbawe na misitu ya vichaka nyuma ya mikoko, pale ambapo bwawa la maji kupwa na kujaa linaishia na nchi kavu kuanza. Tofauti na mikoko inayoota kwa safu katika hori zilizo wazi, mti huu hupatikana hapa na pale katika pwani ya Kenya badala ya kuota kwa makundi, na ni adimu. Nafasi nzuri zaidi ya kuuona ni pembeni mwa njia ya kutembea mikokoni upande wa nchi kavu, ukitafuta matunda madogo ya mviringo kati ya vichaka vya matumbawe.
where.dg: Unamera kahi ya vitsaka vya sanoo na weruni nyuma ya mikoko, ambapho tsi ya madzi ga bahari inamala na kuandza tsi kavu. Si dza mikoko ya mikpwono ya bahari inayomera kpwa makanda-makanda; uhu unaphahikana hiku na hiku pwani ya Kenya, si kpwa mafungu, na ni adimu. Nafwasi nono ya kuuona ni kanda ya bara ya njira ya kunyendeka kahi ya mikoko, uchihendza matunda madide ga mviringo kahi ya vitsaka vya sanoo.

uses.en: Its timber was used for the masts of dhows and for furniture. Straight, strong poles from the back of the mangrove had a ready use in the coast's boat-building tradition.
uses.sw: Mbao zake zilitumika kutengenezea milingoti ya majahazi na fanicha. Boriti zilizonyooka na imara kutoka nyuma ya mikoko zilikuwa na soko la uhakika katika desturi ya ujenzi wa vyombo vya bahari pwani.
uses.dg: Mbaoze zahumirwa kuhenda milingoti ya jahazi na fanicha. Nguzo za twaa na zenye nguvu kula nyuma ya mikoko kala zina kazi chila wakati kpwa chisomo cha pwani cha kudzenga madau.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it shares the name *mkomafi* with the cannonball mangrove. In English it is the cedar mangrove, and its scientific name is *Xylocarpus moluccensis*, after the Moluccas in Indonesia, a reminder of how widely it grows around the Indian Ocean.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unashiriki jina *mkomafi* na mkomafi mkubwa (*cannonball mangrove*). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *cedar mangrove*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Xylocarpus moluccensis*, kutokana na visiwa vya Moluccas nchini Indonesia, ukumbusho wa jinsi unavyoota kwa upana kuzunguka Bahari ya Hindi.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mkomafi*, dza *cannonball mangrove*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *cedar mangrove*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Xylocarpus moluccensis*, kula visiwa vya Moluccas vya Indonesia, chitu chinachotambukiza kukala unamera phatu phanji kanda-kanda ya Bahari ya Hindi.

conservation.en: It is rare in Kenya. Globally it is Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and communities at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring mangrove forest.
conservation.sw: Ni adimu nchini Kenya. Kimataifa uko katika hali ya Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati, kwa hiyo uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinarejesha misitu ya mikoko.
conservation.dg: Ni adimu Kenya. Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni, kpwa hivyo kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service, na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinauyiza matsaka ga mikoko.

teaser.en: Turn over one of its leaves and you see why it is called the looking-glass mangrove: the underside shines silver-white.
teaser.sw: Geuza moja ya majani yake na utaona kwa nini kwa Kiingereza unaitwa mkoko wa kioo: upande wa chini hung'aa kwa rangi nyeupe ya fedha.
teaser.dg: Galuza kodza rimwenga, na undaona sababu ya kuihwa *looking-glass mangrove*: uphande wa photsi unaala dza feza nyereru.

summary.en: The looking-glass mangrove is a scattered tree of the landward mangrove edge, recognised by leaves that are dark green above and silvery below. It is rare in Kenya, and its wood has gone into boat masts, ships and furniture.
summary.sw: Msikundazi ni mti unaoota kwa kutawanyika ukingoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu, na hutambulika kwa majani yaliyo kijani kibichi juu na meupe kama fedha chini. Ni adimu nchini Kenya, na mbao zake zimetumika kwa milingoti ya vyombo, meli na fanicha.
summary.dg: *Looking-glass mangrove* ni muhi unaomera hiku na hiku kanda ya bara ya mikoko, unaomanyikana kpwa makodzage ga chijani sana dzulu na ga rangi ya feza photsi. Ni adimu Kenya, na mbaoze zikahumirwa kuhenda milingoti ya madau, meli na fanicha.

about.en:
This is a tree rather than a shrub, reaching about 8 metres at Gazi. Its leaves are the easiest way to know it: dark, glossy green on top and a bright silvery white underneath, so the canopy flashes pale when the wind turns the leaves over.

The fruit is a woody nut about 6 centimetres long with a sharp keel along one side, a little like the hull of a small boat. The fruits float and wash up along the shore. Older trees often develop buttresses at the base of the trunk.
about.sw:
Huu ni mti badala ya kichaka, na hufikia takriban mita 8 huko Gazi. Majani yake ndiyo njia rahisi zaidi ya kuutambua: kijani kibichi kinachong'aa upande wa juu na weupe angavu wa fedha upande wa chini, hivyo kilele chake humeta kwa weupe upepo unapoyageuza majani.

Tunda lake ni kokwa la mti lenye urefu wa takriban sentimita 6, na lina mgongo mkali upande mmoja, kidogo kama kiini cha mashua ndogo. Matunda haya huelea na kusukumwa ufuoni. Miti mikongwe mara nyingi huota mizizi-ukuta chini ya shina.
about.dg:
Uhu ni muhi, si chitsaka, na unakula hadi phephi mita 8 iko Gazi. Njira rahisi zaidi ya kuumanya ni makodzage: dzulu ni ga chijani sana ganayoala, na photsi ni ga rangi ya feza nyereru inayoala sana, kpwa hivyo phepho richigaluza makodza, dzulu ya muhi kunaonekana kwereru.

Tundare ni gumu dza muhi, ra urefu wa phephi sentimita 6, na kanda mwenga rina mongo mkali, chidide dza tsini ya dau dide. Matunda ganaelea na ganatsukulwa ni madzi hadi pwani. Mihi mikulu kpwa kawaida inatuluza ngamba photsi ya kolo.

where.en: It grows as scattered single trees on the landward edge of the mangroves, never forming its own band as the red and grey mangroves do. At Gazi Bay it reaches about 8 metres. Look for it where the mangrove meets firmer ground, and watch for the silvery flash of leaves or for its keeled nuts lying on the mud.
where.sw: Huota kama miti mmoja mmoja iliyotawanyika ukingoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu, bila kamwe kuunda safu yake yenyewe kama mkoko na mchu zinavyofanya. Katika Ghuba ya Gazi hufikia takriban mita 8. Utaupata pale mikoko inapokutana na ardhi ngumu zaidi; angalia mng'ao wa fedha wa majani yake au makokwa yake yenye mgongo yaliyolala juu ya tope.
where.dg: Unamera dza mihi mimwenga-mimwenga kanda ya bara ya mikoko, na taukala na kandaye macheye, si dza *mkpwoko* na *mudzwi*. Iko Gazi unakula hadi phephi mita 8. Uhendze phatu mikoko inaphokutana na tsi ngumu, na ulole makodza ganayoala dza feza au matundage genye mongo ganayolala dzulu ya matope.

uses.en:
The straight boles have been used for boat masts, in shipbuilding and for furniture, and the wood is excellent firewood.

In Kenya a decoction of the roots is used to treat mouth infections and toothache.
uses.sw:
Mashina yake yaliyonyooka yametumika kwa milingoti ya vyombo, katika ujenzi wa meli na kwa fanicha, na mbao zake ni kuni bora sana.

Nchini Kenya, mizizi huchemshwa na maji yake hutumika kutibu maambukizi ya mdomo na maumivu ya meno.
uses.dg:
Mihiye ya twaa ikahumirwa kuhenda milingoti ya madau, kudzenga meli na kuhenda fanicha, na mbaoze ni kuni nono sana.

Kenya, madzi ga mizi iriyochemushwa nkuhumirwa kulagula makongo ga mromoni na kulumwa ni meno.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *msikundazi*, and it is also called *mkokoshi* and *mgongongo*. In English it is the looking-glass mangrove, for the mirror-like shine under its leaves, and its scientific name is *Heritiera littoralis*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *msikundazi*, na pia huitwa *mkokoshi* na *mgongongo*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *looking-glass mangrove*, kutokana na mng'ao kama wa kioo chini ya majani yake, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Heritiera littoralis*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *msikundazi*, na piya unaihwa *mkokoshi* na *mgongongo*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *looking-glass mangrove*, kpwa sababu photsi ya makodzage kunaala dza chilolo, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Heritiera littoralis*.

conservation.en: It is rare in Kenya and grows only as scattered trees. Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and communities at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring the forest.
conservation.sw: Ni adimu nchini Kenya na huota tu kama miti iliyotawanyika. Mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati, kwa hiyo uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinarejesha msitu.
conservation.dg: Ni adimu Kenya, na unamera dza mihi mimwenga-mimwenga tu. Mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni, kpwa hivyo kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service, na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinauyiza tsaka.

teaser.en: Its white powder-puff flowers open only at night, and its light breathing roots have long served fishermen as net floats.
teaser.sw: Maua yake meupe yanayofanana na pamba ya poda huchanua usiku tu, na mizizi yake myepesi ya kupumulia imewatumikia wavuvi kwa muda mrefu kama vielelezo vya nyavu.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ga rangi nyereru, dza mafungu ga nyuzi laini, ganavugula usiku tu, na miziye ya kuphahira pumuzi iriyo phepheya avuvi kula kare anaihumira ili vimiya vielee.

summary.en: The mangrove apple is the tree of the outermost mangrove fringe, standing in open seawater on stout cone-shaped roots. Its wood, bark and even its roots have uses, from canoes and paddles to fishing-net floats.
summary.sw: Mlilana ni mti wa ukingo wa nje kabisa wa mikoko, unaosimama katika maji ya bahari yaliyo wazi juu ya mizizi minene yenye umbo la koni. Mbao zake, gome lake na hata mizizi yake vina matumizi, kuanzia mitumbwi na makasia hadi vielelezo vya nyavu za kuvulia.
summary.dg: *Mangrove apple* ni muhi wa kanda ya mikoko iriyo kure zaidi uphande wa bahari, unaoima kahi ya madzi ga bahari dzulu ya mizi miziho yenye ntsa iriyoima chocho. Mbaoze, gophare na hata miziye vina kazi, kula ngarawa na makasiya hadi kuelesa vimiya.

about.en:
The mangrove apple is a tree of about 10 metres with rounded, rather thick leaves. Around its base rises a forest of stout, cone-shaped breathing roots that poke up out of the mud and water, thicker and taller than those of the grey mangrove.

Its flowers are a sight worth staying late for. They are white powder puffs of long stamens that open at night and are visited by bats and moths, then fall by morning. The fruit that follows is a flattened green berry with the old flower parts still attached, which gives the tree its English name.
about.sw:
Mlilana ni mti wa takriban mita 10 wenye majani ya mviringo na kiasi manene. Kuzunguka chini yake huchomoza msitu wa mizizi minene ya kupumulia yenye umbo la koni, ikitoka kwenye tope na maji, minene na mirefu zaidi kuliko ile ya mchu.

Maua yake ni mandhari yanayostahili kuchelewa kuyaona. Ni vishada vyeupe vya stamini ndefu kama pamba ya poda vinavyochanua usiku na kutembelewa na popo na nondo, kisha hupukutika kufikia asubuhi. Tunda linalofuata ni beri bapa ya kijani ambayo bado imeshikilia sehemu za ua la zamani, na hilo ndilo linaloupa mti jina lake la Kiingereza.
about.dg:
*Mangrove apple* ni muhi wa phephi mita 10 wenye makodza ga mviringo na maziho chidide. Kanda-kanda ya kolore kunatuluka mizi minji miziho ya kuphahira pumuzi, yenye umbo dza koni, inayotuluka kula matopeni na madzini; ni miziho na mire kuriko ya *mudzwi*.

Maruwage ni chitu chinono cha kulola hata uchikaa hadi usiku. Ni mafungu ga nyuzi nyereru mire (*stamens*) ganayovugula usiku, na nundu na popho a usiku anaphiya kpwago, chisha ganagbwa kabla ya ligundzu. Tunda rinalotuluka badaye ni bapa, ra chijani, na seemu za ruwa ra kare zichiri dzuluye, na ndiro rinaropha muhi uhu dzina ra Chingereza.

where.en: This is the mangrove that faces the sea. It grows on the outermost seaward fringe in normal seawater, where the tide covers it every day; it fringes Sii Island at Vanga. On a boat trip into Gazi Bay or out from Funzi and Vanga, these are the first trees you pass. The breathing roots are best seen at low tide.
where.sw: Huu ndio mkoko unaoelekea bahari. Huota kwenye ukingo wa nje kabisa upande wa bahari katika maji ya kawaida ya bahari, ambapo maji kujaa huufunika kila siku; huzunguka Kisiwa cha Sii huko Vanga. Ukisafiri kwa mashua kuingia Ghuba ya Gazi au kutoka Funzi na Vanga, hii ndiyo miti ya kwanza utakayoipita. Mizizi ya kupumulia huonekana vizuri zaidi wakati wa maji kupwa.
where.dg: Uhu ndio mkoko unaolola bahari. Unamera kanda ya kure zaidi ya uphande wa bahari, kpwenye madzi ga bahari ga kawaida, ambapho madzi ga kuodzala ganaufwinika chila siku; unazunguluka chisiwa cha Sii, Vanga. Uchiphiya na dau kahi ya Gazi, au kula Funzi na Vanga, hino ndiyo mihi ya mwandzo undayoitsupa. Mizi ya kuphahira pumuzi inaonekana vinono zaidi wakati wa madzi ga kala.

uses.en:
The wood is used for canoes, boat ribs, masts and paddles, as well as door and window frames and charcoal. The breathing roots are light and spongy, and fishermen use them as floats for fishing nets.

The bark yields tannin, and the leaves are fed to camels where they are kept.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake hutumika kwa mitumbwi, mbavu za vyombo, milingoti na makasia, pamoja na fremu za milango na madirisha na mkaa. Mizizi ya kupumulia ni myepesi na kama sponji, na wavuvi huitumia kama vielelezo vya nyavu za kuvulia.

Gome hutoa tanini, na majani hulishwa ngamia pale wanapofugwa.
uses.dg:
Mbao nkuhumirwa kuhenda ngarawa, mbavu za madau, milingoti na makasiya, na piya vizingiti vya miryango na madirisha na makala. Mizi ya kuphahira pumuzi ni phepheya na ni dza sifongo, na avuvi anaihumira ili vimiya vielee.

Gophare rinalavya tanini, na makodza nkurisa ngamia phatu anaphofugbwa.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *mlilana*. In English it is the mangrove apple or white-flowered apple mangrove, and its scientific name is *Sonneratia alba*, where *alba* means white, for the flowers.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mlilana*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *mangrove apple* au *white-flowered apple mangrove*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Sonneratia alba*, ambapo *alba* ina maana ya nyeupe, kwa sababu ya maua yake.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mlilana*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *mangrove apple* au *white-flowered apple mangrove*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Sonneratia alba*; manage ga *alba* ni 'nyereru', kpwa sababu ya maruwage.

conservation.en: It is globally Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel; harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and community projects at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring mangrove forest.
conservation.sw: Kimataifa uko katika hali ya Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati; uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na miradi ya kijamii huko Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga inarejesha misitu ya mikoko.
conservation.dg: Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni, kpwa hivyo kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service; na mipango ya jamii ya Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga inauyiza matsaka ga mikoko.

teaser.en: Its seed sprouts while still hanging on the tree, and its hollow trunks have been turned into drums and beehives.
teaser.sw: Mbegu yake huota ikiwa bado inaning'inia mtini, na mashina yake yenye mvungu yamegeuzwa kuwa ngoma na mizinga ya nyuki.
teaser.dg: Tembeye inamera ichiri inabwadzika kpwa muhi, na makologe mahuphu gakahendwa ngoma na mizinga ya nyuchi.

summary.en: *Mchofi*, the black mangrove, is an evergreen tree of the quieter inner mangroves, with red bell-shaped flowers and knee-like roots. It gives some of the coast's best firewood and charcoal, poles, paddles, dye and dark, salty mangrove honey.
summary.sw: *Mchofi* ni muia, mti wenye majani mwaka mzima wa sehemu tulivu za ndani za mikoko, wenye maua mekundu yenye umbo la kengele na mizizi inayofanana na magoti. Hutoa baadhi ya kuni na makaa bora zaidi ya pwani, nguzo, makasia, rangi na asali ya mikoko iliyokolea yenye ladha ya chumvi.
summary.dg: *Mchofi* ni mkoko wenye makodza chila wakati wa mikoko ya ndani ambako madzi ganatulia, wenye maruwa ga kundu ga umbo ra kengele na mizi dza magoti. Unalavya kuni na makala nono zaidi za pwani, nguzo, makasia, rangi na asali nyiru ya munyu ya mikoko.

about.en:
*Mchofi* is an evergreen mangrove of 5 to 9 metres. Around its base, the roots loop up out of the mud and back down again, forming bent 'knees' that let the tree breathe in waterlogged ground. The leaves are glossy, leathery and pointed.

The flowers are striking: red, bell-shaped and hanging singly, with a many-pointed calyx like a little crown. As in the red mangrove, the seed germinates while it is still on the tree and hangs down as a long green seedling, ready to drop and root in the mud.
about.sw:
*Mchofi* ni mkoko wenye majani mwaka mzima wenye urefu wa mita 5 hadi 9. Kuzunguka kitako chake, mizizi huchomoza juu kutoka matopeni kwa mapindi na kurudi chini tena, ikiunda 'magoti' yaliyopinda yanayouwezesha mti kupumua katika ardhi iliyojaa maji. Majani yanang'aa, ni magumu kama ngozi na yana ncha.

Maua yake yanavutia sana: mekundu, yenye umbo la kengele na yanayoning'inia moja moja, yakiwa na kikombe cha ua chenye ncha nyingi kama taji dogo. Kama ilivyo kwa mkoko, mbegu huota ikiwa bado mtini na huning'inia chini kama mche mrefu wa kijani, tayari kuanguka na kuota mizizi matopeni.
about.dg:
*Mchofi* ni mkoko wenye makodza chila wakati wa mita 5 hadi 9. Kanda-kanda ya kolore, mizi inatuluka dzulu kula matopeni na kuuya photsi tsena, ichihenda 'magoti' ganagootyoka ambago ganaricha muhi uphahe pumuzi kpwa tsi iriyodzala madzi. Makodza ganang'ala, ni mafu dza chingo na gana ntsa.

Maruwa ni ga ajabu: ga kundu, ga umbo ra kengele na ganabwadzika mwenga-mwenga, na ganakala na chikombe cha ntsa nyinji dza tadzi ndide. Dza kpwa mkpwoko, tembe inamera ichiri kpwa muhi na inabwadzika photsi dza mutse mure wa chijani, tayari kugbwa na kumera matopeni.

where.en: It grows in the inner, less exposed parts of the mangrove and along creeks, where the water is calmer and the mud is firm. Around Gazi and Vanga it is scattered among the other mangroves rather than forming wide stands. The red flowers make it easiest to pick out.
where.sw: Hustawi katika sehemu za ndani za mikoko zisizo wazi sana na kando ya hori, ambako maji ni tulivu zaidi na matope ni imara. Kuzunguka Gazi na Vanga umetawanyika kati ya mikoko mingine badala ya kuunda misitu mipana ya aina yake peke yake. Maua mekundu ndiyo yanayourahisisha kutambuliwa.
where.dg: Unamera kpwa seemu za ndani za mikoko zisizo wazi sana na kanda-kanda ya mikpwono ya bahari, ambako madzi ganatulia na matope ni magumu. Kanda-kanda ya Gazi na Vanga ukatawanyika kahi ya mikoko yanjina, si kpwa makundi manji. Maruwage ga kundu ndigo ganahenda ukale rahisi kuumanya.

uses.en:
*Mchofi* is valued above all as fuel: it makes high-quality firewood and charcoal. Its straight stems serve as poles and roof supports, and the wood is shaped into paddles, oars and tool handles.

The bark gives a black dye and tannin. Hollow trunks are made into drums and beehives, and the flowers are good bee forage; mangrove honey from the coast is dark and slightly salty.
uses.sw:
*Mchofi* unathaminiwa zaidi ya yote kama nishati: hutoa kuni na makaa ya ubora wa juu. Mashina yake yaliyonyooka hutumika kama nguzo na viguzo vya paa, na mbao zake huchongwa kuwa makasia, kafi na mipini ya zana.

Gamba hutoa rangi nyeusi na tanini. Mashina yenye mvungu hutengenezwa ngoma na mizinga ya nyuki, na maua ni chakula kizuri cha nyuki; asali ya mikoko ya pwani ni ya rangi iliyokolea na yenye ladha ya chumvi kidogo.
uses.dg:
*Mchofi* nkutogolwa zaidi dza kuni: unalavya kuni na makala nono sana. Mihiye ya twaa nkuhumirwa dza nguzo na boriti za dzulu, na nyama za muhi nkutengezwa makasia, makafi na mipini ya vyombo vya kazi.

Gopha rinalavya rangi nyiru na tanini. Makolo mahuphu nkuhendwa ngoma na mizinga ya nyuchi, na maruwa ni chakurya chinono cha nyuchi; asali ya mikoko ya pwani ni nyiru na ina munyu chidide.

culture.en: The Digo group *mdzago* together with *mutsu* and *mkoko* as *mikoko*, the mangroves, a family of trees that the coast depends on for poles and fuel.
culture.sw: Wadigo huweka *mdzago* pamoja na *mutsu* na *mkoko* kama *mikoko*, familia ya miti ambayo pwani inaitegemea kwa nguzo na nishati.
culture.dg: Adigo anaika *mdzago* phamwenga na *mutsu* na *mkoko* dza *mikoko*, jamii ya mihi ambayo pwani inaikuluphira kpwa nguzo na kuni.

names.en: The name *mchofi* is recorded in the ICRAF tree handbook, while Pakia's study of Digo plant names gives *mdzago*, also counting it among the *mikoko*. The two names need checking with speakers. In Swahili it is *muia* or *msindi*, also *mkoko wimbi*; in Giriama it is *mkoko*. In English it is the black or oriental mangrove, and botanists call it *Bruguiera gymnorrhiza*.
names.sw: Jina *mchofi* limerekodiwa katika kitabu cha mwongozo cha miti cha ICRAF, huku utafiti wa Pakia kuhusu majina ya mimea ya Kidigo ukitoa *mdzago*, na pia kuuhesabu miongoni mwa *mikoko*. Majina haya mawili yanahitaji kuthibitishwa na wazungumzaji. Kwa Kiswahili ni *muia* au *msindi*, pia *mkoko wimbi*; kwa Kigiriama ni *mkoko*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *black mangrove* au *oriental mangrove*, na wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Bruguiera gymnorrhiza*.
names.dg: Dzina *mchofi* rinaphahikana kpwa chitabu cha mihi cha ICRAF, ela utafiti wa Pakia wa madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo unapha *mdzago*, na piya unauolanga kahi ya *mikoko*. Madzina higa mairi ganahitaji kulolwa na atu anaogomba Chidigo. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *muia* au *msindi*, piya *mkoko wimbi*; kpwa Chigiryama ni *mkoko*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *black mangrove* au *oriental mangrove*, na asayansi a mimea anauiha *Bruguiera gymnorrhiza*.

conservation.en: It is globally Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel; harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and communities at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are replanting mangrove forest.
conservation.sw: Kimataifa uko katika kundi la Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya nguzo na nishati; uvunaji hutolewa leseni na Shirika la Huduma za Misitu Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinapanda upya misitu ya mikoko.
conservation.dg: Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni; kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service, na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinaphanda matsaka ga mikoko luphya.

teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linauita mkoko wa bara, lakini Wadigo hawauhesabu kabisa miongoni mwa mikoko.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rinauiha mkoko wa bara, ela Adigo taauolanga kahi ya *mikoko* kabisa.

summary.en: *Mkoko bara*, the white milkwood, is an evergreen tree with milky sap and dark berries that grows in bushland and dune thicket behind the shore. Its name is a small lesson in how Digo plant names work.
summary.sw: *Mkoko bara* (kwa Kiingereza *white milkwood*) ni mti usiopukutisha majani wenye utomvu mweupe kama maziwa na beri za rangi nzito, unaoota katika vichaka na vichaka vya matuta ya mchanga nyuma ya ufuo. Jina lake ni somo dogo kuhusu jinsi majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanavyofanya kazi.
summary.dg: *Mkoko bara* (kpwa Chingereza *white milkwood*) ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye maziya na matunda madide maru, unaomera weruni na kahi ya vitsaka vya vilima vya mtsanga nyuma ya pwani. Dzinare ni fundzo dide ra ivyo madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganavyohenda kazi.

about.en:
*Mkoko bara* is an evergreen coastal tree, often shrubby and dense in exposed places, with thick, leathery dark-green leaves. Break a leaf or twig and it bleeds white, milky latex, which is where the English name milkwood comes from.

Its small flowers are greenish-white and clustered along the stems, and they are followed by round berries that ripen to dark purple or black. The berries are eaten by birds.
about.sw:
*Mkoko bara* ni mti wa pwani usiopukutisha majani, mara nyingi wenye umbo la kichaka na msongamano mahali palipo wazi kwa upepo, na majani manene ya kijani kibichi kama ngozi. Ukivunja jani au kitawi, hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa, na hapo ndipo lilipotoka jina la Kiingereza *milkwood*.

Maua yake madogo ni meupe yenye kijani kidogo na yamejikusanya kando ya vitawi, na hufuatwa na beri za mviringo zinazoiva na kuwa za zambarau nzito au nyeusi. Beri hizo huliwa na ndege.
about.dg:
*Mkoko bara* ni muhi wa pwani wenye makodza chila wakati; phatu phenye phepho kali kpwa kawaida unakala dza chitsaka chirichogbwirana. Una makodza maziho, magumu dza chingo, ga chijani sana. Uchigbwanyula kodza au liphungo, rinalavya maziya, na ndiko dzina ra Chingereza *milkwood* rinakotuluka.

Maruwage madide ni ga rangi nyereru yenye chijani chidide, na ganamera kpwa mafungu kanda-kanda ya pandaze. Badaye kunatuluka matunda ga mviringo ganayoivwa na kukala ga zambarau sana au maru. Matunda higa nkuriwa ni nyuni.

where.en: Despite its name, it does not grow in the tidal mud. Look for it in coastal bushland and dune thicket just behind the shore, where wind and salt spray shape the trees into low, rounded crowns.
where.sw: Licha ya jina lake, hauoti kwenye tope la maji kupwa na kujaa. Utaupata katika vichaka vya pwani na vichaka vya matuta ya mchanga nyuma tu ya ufuo, ambapo upepo na manyunyu ya chumvi huifinyanga miti kuwa na vilele vifupi vya mviringo.
where.dg: Hata dzinare richikala ni mkoko, taumera kpwenye matope ga madzi ga bahari. Uhendze weruni pwani na kahi ya vitsaka vya vilima vya mtsanga nyuma ya pwani, ambapho phepho na munyu wa bahari vinahenda dzulu ya mihi ikale fupi na ya mviringo.

uses.en: No particular uses have been recorded for it among the Digo so far.
uses.sw: Hadi sasa hakuna matumizi maalumu yaliyorekodiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Hadi sambi takuna kazi iriyoandikpwa ya muhi uhu kahi ya Adigo.

culture.en: The name joins *mkoko*, mangrove, with *bara*, the mainland or hinterland: roughly 'the inland mangrove'. Yet the Digo do not count it among the *mikoko*. Pakia uses it as an example of how a shared name does not mean a shared category: the tree borrows the mangrove's name without belonging to the mangrove family of trees.
culture.sw: Jina hili linaunganisha *mkoko*, yaani mkoko wa pwani, na *bara*, yaani nchi kavu au bara: kwa kukadiria 'mkoko wa bara'. Hata hivyo Wadigo hawauhesabu miongoni mwa *mikoko*. Pakia anautumia kama mfano wa jinsi jina la pamoja lisivyomaanisha kundi la pamoja: mti huu unaazima jina la mkoko bila kuwa sehemu ya jamii ya mikoko.
culture.dg: Dzina rina *mkoko*, mkoko, na *bara*, tsi kavu au kanda ya ndani kure na pwani: manage ni dza 'mkoko wa bara'. Ela Adigo taauolanga kahi ya *mikoko*. Pakia anauhumira dza mfwano wa kuonyesa kukala dzina rimwenga tarimaanisha kundi rimwenga: muhi uhu unahala dzina ra mkoko, ela tauri kahi ya kundi ra mikoko.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mkoko bara*, the 'hinterland *mkoko*'. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mkoko* (plural *mikoko*) as mangrove or mangrove pole, used in building. No Swahili name has been recorded. In English it is the white milkwood, and its scientific name is *Sideroxylon inerme*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mkoko bara*, yaani '*mkoko* wa bara'. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mkoko* (wingi *mikoko*) kwa maana ya mkoko au boriti ya mkoko, inayotumika katika ujenzi. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *white milkwood*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Sideroxylon inerme*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mkoko bara*, '*mkoko* wa bara'. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mkoko* (unji *mikoko*) dza mkoko au nguzo ya mkoko ya kudzengera. Dzina ra Chiswahili taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *white milkwood*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Sideroxylon inerme*.

teaser.en: Mangrove poles were once counted in scores, and most of them came from this tree standing on its arching stilt roots.
teaser.sw: Zamani boriti za mikoko zilihesabiwa kwa korija, na nyingi zilitoka kwa mti huu uliosimama juu ya mizizi yake ya mapindi.
teaser.dg: Kare mihi ya mikoko kala inaolangbwa kpwa makorija, na minji kala inalavywa kula muhi uhu unaoima dzulu ya miziye iriyootyoka.

summary.en: *Mkpwoko*, the red mangrove, is the commonest mangrove in Kenya, standing on arching stilt roots in the mud of Gazi, Funzi, Shimoni and Vanga. Its poles built the coral-rag and mud houses of the coast, and it is now at the heart of community mangrove restoration.
summary.sw: *Mkpwoko* ni mkoko, mkoko unaopatikana kwa wingi zaidi nchini Kenya, uliosimama juu ya mizizi ya mapindi katika matope ya Gazi, Funzi, Shimoni na Vanga. Boriti zake zilijenga nyumba za mawe ya matumbawe na za udongo za pwani, na sasa ndio kiini cha urejeshaji wa mikoko unaoendeshwa na jamii.
summary.dg: *Mkpwoko* ni mkoko unaophahikana zaidi Kenya, unaoima dzulu ya mizi iriyootyoka kpwa matope ga Gazi, Funzi, Shimoni na Vanga. Nguzoze zikadzenga nyumba za mawe ga bahari na za tsi za pwani, na sambi ndio chitu cha muhimu kpwa mipango ya jamii ya kuphanda mikoko luphya.

about.en:
*Mkpwoko* grows to about 10 metres and stands on a tangle of arching stilt roots that drop from the trunk and lower branches into the mud, holding the tree above the tide. The leaves are thick, glossy and elliptical, ending in a small sharp point.

Its seed germinates while still attached to the tree. The seedling grows into a long, green, cigar-shaped 'torpedo' that hangs from the branches and then drops, spearing into the mud or floating away to root somewhere new.
about.sw:
*Mkpwoko* hukua hadi takriban mita 10 na husimama juu ya mtandao wa mizizi ya mapindi inayoshuka kutoka shina na matawi ya chini hadi kwenye matope, ikiushikilia mti juu ya maji ya bahari kujaa. Majani ni mazito, yanayong'aa na ya umbo la yai refu, yakiishia kwa ncha ndogo kali.

Mbegu yake huota ikiwa bado imeshikamana na mti. Mche hukua kuwa 'kombora' refu la kijani lenye umbo la sigara linaloning'inia kutoka matawi kisha huanguka, likichoma ndani ya matope au likielea mbali ili kuota mizizi mahali pengine.
about.dg:
*Mkpwoko* unakula hadi phephi mita 10 na unaima dzulu ya mizi minji iriyootyoka inayoshuka kula kpwa kolo na panda za photsi kuinjira matopeni, ichigbwira muhi dzulu ya madzi ga bahari. Makodza ni manene, ganang'ala na ga umbo ra yai, na ganamala na ntsa ndide.

Tembeye inamera ichiri kpwa muhi. Mutse unakula na kukala mure, wa chijani, dza 'torpedo', unaobwadzika kula kpwa panda chisha unagbwa, unadunga matope au unaelea na kuphiya kumera phatu phanjina.

where.en: This is the mangrove most visitors picture. It grows on the seaward and creek-side mud of Gazi Bay, Funzi, Shimoni and Vanga, where the stilt roots are fully visible at low tide. It is also the main tree in the Mikoko Pamoja plantations at Gazi and Makongeni, where boardwalks give an easy view into the forest.
where.sw: Huu ndio mkoko ambao wageni wengi huufikiria. Hustawi kwenye matope ya upande wa bahari na ya kando ya hori katika Ghuba ya Gazi, Funzi, Shimoni na Vanga, ambako mizizi ya mapindi huonekana kikamilifu maji yanapokupwa. Pia ndio mti mkuu katika mashamba ya Mikoko Pamoja huko Gazi na Makongeni, ambako njia za mbao zilizoinuliwa hurahisisha kuutazama msitu.
where.dg: Hino ndio mkoko ambao ajeni anji anauwaza. Unamera kpwa matope ga uphande wa bahari na ga kanda-kanda ya mikpwono ya bahari ya Gazi, Funzi, Shimoni na Vanga, ambapho mizi iriyootyoka inaonekana yosi wakati wa madzi ga kala. Piya ndio muhi mkulu wa minda ya Mikoko Pamoja ya Gazi na Makongeni, ambapho njira za mbao zinaricha atu alole tsaka kpwa rahisi.

uses.en:
*Mkpwoko* is the great building tree of the coast. Its straight stems are cut as poles, known by size in Swahili as *boriti*, *nguzo* and *fito*, for the frames and roofs of coral-rag and mud houses. It also makes high-quality charcoal and firewood.

The bark gives tannin and dye, and the leaves and roots are used in medicine. Fishers make fish traps from the roots, and split branches are woven into baskets.

Mangrove poles have long been a source of income on the south coast, and today the carbon stored by replanted mangroves at Gazi earns money for community projects too.
uses.sw:
*Mkpwoko* ndio mti mkuu wa ujenzi pwani. Mashina yake yaliyonyooka hukatwa kuwa nguzo, zinazojulikana kwa ukubwa wake kwa Kiswahili kama *boriti*, *nguzo* na *fito*, kwa ajili ya fremu na mapaa ya nyumba za mawe ya matumbawe na za udongo. Pia hutoa makaa na kuni za ubora wa juu.

Gamba hutoa dawa ya kutia ngozi (tanini) na rangi, na majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa. Wavuvi hutengeneza mitego ya samaki kwa mizizi, na matawi yaliyopasuliwa husukwa kuwa vikapu.

Boriti za mikoko zimekuwa chanzo cha kipato katika pwani ya kusini tangu zamani, na leo kaboni inayohifadhiwa na mikoko iliyopandwa upya huko Gazi pia huletea miradi ya jamii fedha.
uses.dg:
*Mkpwoko* ndio muhi mkulu wa kudzenga wa pwani. Mihiye ya twaa nkukatwa dza nguzo, zinazomanyikana kpwa ukulu kpwa Chiswahili dza *boriti*, *nguzo* na *fito*, kuhenda mifupa na mapaa ga nyumba za mawe ga bahari na za tsi. Piya unalavya makala na kuni nono sana.

Gopha rinalavya tanini na rangi, na makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa. Avuvi nkuhenda mihambo ya ng'onda kula kpwa mizi, na panda zirizogbwanyulwa nkusukwa kaphu.

Nguzo za mikoko zikakala njira ya mapato pwani ya kusini kula kare, na rero kaboni inayoikpwa ni mikoko iriyophandwa luphya Gazi inaphaha pesa za mipango ya jamii piya.

culture.en: Mangrove poles are counted in scores: the Mgombato dictionary records *korija*, twenty items together, with mangrove poles for building as its example. Pakia notes that the Digo group *mutsu*, *mdzago* and *mkoko* together as *mikoko*, the mangroves.
culture.sw: Boriti za mikoko huhesabiwa kwa korija: kamusi ya Mgombato inarekodi *korija*, vitu ishirini kwa pamoja, ikitoa boriti za mikoko za ujenzi kama mfano. Pakia anabainisha kwamba Wadigo huweka *mutsu*, *mdzago* na *mkoko* pamoja kama *mikoko*.
culture.dg: Nguzo za mikoko nkuolangbwa kpwa makorija: kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *korija*, vitu ishirini phamwenga, na mfwanowe ni nguzo za mikoko za kudzengera. Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaika *mutsu*, *mdzago* na *mkoko* phamwenga dza *mikoko*.

names.en: The Mgombato dictionary gives *mkpwoko* (plural *mikoko*) for the red mangrove and *mkoko* for a mangrove or mangrove pole used in building; the ICRAF handbook also gives *mkpwoko*, while Pakia writes *mkoko*. In Swahili it is *mkoko*, and Mgombato also lists *msinzi*, *msizi* and *mshinzi*. Duruma and Giriama speakers also call it *mkoko*. In English it is the red or loop-root mangrove, and botanists call it *Rhizophora mucronata*.
names.sw: Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mkpwoko* (wingi *mikoko*) kwa mkoko huu na *mkoko* kwa mkoko au boriti ya mkoko inayotumika katika ujenzi; kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF pia kinatoa *mkpwoko*, huku Pakia akiandika *mkoko*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkoko*, na Mgombato pia anaorodhesha *msinzi*, *msizi* na *mshinzi*. Wazungumzaji wa Kiduruma na Kigiriama pia huuita *mkoko*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *red mangrove* au *loop-root mangrove*, na wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Rhizophora mucronata*.
names.dg: Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mkpwoko* (unji *mikoko*) kpwa mkoko uhu na *mkoko* kpwa mkoko au nguzo ya mkoko ya kudzengera; chitabu cha ICRAF piya chinapha *mkpwoko*, ela Pakia anaandika *mkoko*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkoko*, na Mgombato piya inaandika *msinzi*, *msizi* na *mshinzi*. Aduruma na Agiryama piya anauiha *mkoko*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *red mangrove* au *loop-root mangrove*, na asayansi a mimea anauiha *Rhizophora mucronata*.

conservation.en: Globally it is Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service. Community projects at Gazi and Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) and at Vanga, Jimbo and Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) replant this tree and fund local projects from mangrove carbon.
conservation.sw: Kimataifa uko katika kundi la Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na kuni, kwa hivyo uvunaji hutolewa leseni na Shirika la Huduma za Misitu Kenya (Kenya Forest Service). Miradi ya jamii huko Gazi na Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) na huko Vanga, Jimbo na Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) hupanda upya mti huu na hufadhili miradi ya ndani kwa fedha za kaboni ya mikoko.
conservation.dg: Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni, kpwa hivyo kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service. Mipango ya jamii ya Gazi na Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) na ya Vanga, Jimbo na Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) inaphanda muhi uhu luphya na kuriphira mipango ya hipha kula kpwa kaboni ya mikoko.

teaser.en: Its leaves sweat salt you can see and taste, and the bao boards and mortars of the coast are often carved from its wood.
teaser.sw: Majani yake hutoa jasho la chumvi unaloweza kuliona na kulionja, na mbao za bao na vinu vya pwani mara nyingi huchongwa kwa mbao zake.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganalavya munyu unaoweza kuuona na kuuonja, na mabao na vinu vya pwani kpwa kawaida nkutsongbwa kula kpwa nyama za muhi uhu.

summary.en: *Mudzwi*, the grey mangrove, is the toughest of the mangroves, growing from the seaward fringe to the salty, dry landward edge. Its wood becomes furniture legs, mortars and pestles, bao boards, drums and beehives, and its leaves feed fish and goats.
summary.sw: *Mudzwi* ni mchu, mkoko mgumu kuliko mikoko yote, unaostawi kuanzia ukingo wa upande wa bahari hadi ukingo mkavu wenye chumvi wa upande wa nchi kavu. Mbao zake hutengenezwa miguu ya samani, vinu na michi, mbao za bao, ngoma na mizinga ya nyuki, na majani yake hulisha samaki na mbuzi.
summary.dg: *Mudzwi* ni mkoko wenye nguvu kuriko mikoko yosi, unaomera kula uphande wa bahari hadi kanda ya bara yenye munyu na kavu. Nyama za muhi nkuhendwa magulu ga vitanda na vihi, vinu na mitsi, mabao, ngoma na mizinga ya nyuchi, na makodzage ni chakurya cha ng'onda na mbuzi.

about.en:
*Mudzwi* is a grey-barked tree, from a low shrub on harsh ground to a full-sized tree where conditions suit it. The leaves are green above and silvery-grey beneath, and they excrete salt: on a dry day you can often see small crystals on the leaf surface.

Around the tree, the mud is carpeted with thousands of pencil-like breathing roots, called pneumatophores, which stick straight up from cable roots running beneath the surface. Its small yellow-orange flowers are scented and attract bees.
about.sw:
*Mudzwi* ni mti wenye gamba la kijivu, kuanzia kichaka kifupi kwenye ardhi ngumu hadi mti kamili mahali ambapo hali inaufaa. Majani ni ya kijani upande wa juu na kijivu cha fedha upande wa chini, na hutoa chumvi: siku ya ukavu mara nyingi unaweza kuona fuwele ndogo juu ya jani.

Kuzunguka mti, matope yamefunikwa na maelfu ya mizizi ya kupumulia inayofanana na penseli, inayoitwa pneumatofori, inayochomoza wima kutoka mizizi kama kamba inayotambaa chini ya uso wa matope. Maua yake madogo ya rangi ya manjano-machungwa yana harufu nzuri na huvutia nyuki.
about.dg:
*Mudzwi* ni muhi wenye gopha ra rangi ya ivu, kula chitsaka chifupi kpwa tsi ngumu hadi muhi mkulu kamili phatu phanaphoufwaha. Makodza ni ga chijani dzulu na ga rangi ya feza photsi, na ganalavya munyu: siku isiyo na mvula kpwa kawaida unaweza kuona tembe ndide za munyu dzulu ya kodza.

Kanda-kanda ya muhi, matope gakafunikpwa ni maelufu ga mizi dza kalamu ya kuphahira pumuzi, inayoihwa *pneumatophores*, inayoima chocho kula kpwa mizi mire inayotsupa tsini ya matope. Maruwage madide ga rangi ya mandano na chungbwa gana harufu nono na ganamweha nyuchi.

where.en: No mangrove grows in so wide a range of places. *Mudzwi* is found both on the seaward fringe and on the dry landward edge of the mangroves, where it tolerates very high salinity that other species cannot. Along Gazi Bay, Funzi and Vanga, the fields of pencil roots around it are easiest to see at low tide.
where.sw: Hakuna mkoko unaostawi katika mazingira mengi tofauti kama huu. *Mudzwi* hupatikana kwenye ukingo wa upande wa bahari na pia kwenye ukingo mkavu wa upande wa nchi kavu wa mikoko, ambako huvumilia kiwango cha juu sana cha chumvi ambacho spishi nyingine haziwezi. Kando ya Ghuba ya Gazi, Funzi na Vanga, maeneo ya mizizi kama penseli yanayouzunguka huonekana kwa urahisi zaidi maji yanapokupwa.
where.dg: Takuna mkoko unaomera kpwa phatu tafwauti dza mudzwi. *Mudzwi* unaphahikana uphande wa bahari na kanda ya bara iriyo kavu ya mikoko, ambapho unavumirira munyu mnji sana ambao aina zanjina taziweza kuuvumirira. Kanda-kanda ya Gazi, Funzi na Vanga, minda ya mizi dza kalamu iriyouzunguluka ni rahisi zaidi kuiona wakati wa madzi ga kala.

uses.en:
The wood is turned into bed, chair and table legs, fencing posts, mortars and pestles, boat ribs, bao boards for the board game, drums and beehives. It is also burned as charcoal and firewood.

The leaves and roots are used in medicine. The leaves are food for fish in the mangrove and fodder for goats and camels.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake huchongwa kuwa miguu ya vitanda, viti na meza, nguzo za ua, vinu na michi, mbavu za mashua, mbao za mchezo wa bao, ngoma na mizinga ya nyuki. Pia huchomwa kuwa makaa na kuni.

Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa. Majani ni chakula cha samaki ndani ya mikoko na lishe ya mbuzi na ngamia.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi nkuhendwa magulu ga vitanda, vihi na meza, nguzo za uchigo, vinu na mitsi, mbavu za ngarawa, mabao ga mchezo wa bao, ngoma na mizinga ya nyuchi. Piya nkuochwa kuhenda makala na kuni.

Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa. Makodza ni chakurya cha ng'onda kahi ya mikoko na chakurya cha mbuzi na ngamia.

culture.en: The Digo count *mutsu* among the *mikoko*, the mangroves, along with *mdzago* and *mkoko*.
culture.sw: Wadigo huhesabu *mutsu* miongoni mwa *mikoko*, pamoja na *mdzago* na *mkoko*.
culture.dg: Adigo anaolanga *mutsu* kahi ya *mikoko*, phamwenga na *mdzago* na *mkoko*.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name *mudzwi*; Pakia records *mutsu*, also listed under *mkoko*. The two names need checking with speakers. In Swahili it is *mchu* or *mtsu*. Giriama has *mtswi* and *mudzu*, and in Bajun it is *mutu*. In English it is the grey or white mangrove, and botanists call it *Avicennia marina*.
names.sw: Kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo *mudzwi*; Pakia anarekodi *mutsu*, ambalo pia limeorodheshwa chini ya *mkoko*. Majina haya mawili yanahitaji kuthibitishwa na wazungumzaji. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mchu* au *mtsu*. Kigiriama kina *mtswi* na *mudzu*, na kwa Kibajuni ni *mutu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *grey mangrove* au *white mangrove*, na wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Avicennia marina*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha dzina ra Chidigo *mudzwi*; Pakia anaandika *mutsu*, na piya anauandika photsi ya *mkoko*. Madzina higa mairi ganahitaji kulolwa na atu anaogomba Chidigo. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mchu* au *mtsu*. Chigiryama china *mtswi* na *mudzu*, na kpwa Chibajuni ni *mutu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *grey mangrove* au *white mangrove*, na asayansi a mimea anauiha *Avicennia marina*.

conservation.en: Globally Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel; harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and communities at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring mangrove forest.
conservation.sw: Kimataifa uko katika kundi la Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya nguzo na nishati; uvunaji hutolewa leseni na Shirika la Huduma za Misitu Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinarejesha misitu ya mikoko.
conservation.dg: Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni; kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service, na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinauyiza matsaka ga mikoko.

teaser.en: Its Digo name means roughly 'the one that bends towards the sea', and on the coral shore it leans just that way.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya takriban 'unaoinamia bahari', na katika ufuo wa matumbawe huinama hivyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Manage ga dzinare ra Chidigo ni dza 'unaoinamira bahari', na pwani ya mawe ga sanoo unadeguka dza ivyo hasa.

summary.en: *Muinamia bahari* is a small, gnarled shrub of rocky coral shores with tiny grey-green leaves and some of the hardest wood on the coast. It lives where few plants can, on bare coral rock lashed by salt spray.
summary.sw: *Muinamia bahari* ni kichaka kidogo kilichopindika-pindika cha fukwe za miamba ya matumbawe, chenye majani madogo sana ya kijivu-kijani na mojawapo ya mbao ngumu zaidi pwani. Huishi mahali ambapo mimea michache huweza kuishi, juu ya miamba mitupu ya matumbawe inayopigwa na manyunyu ya chumvi.
summary.dg: *Muinamia bahari* ni chitsaka chidide chirichobeta cha pwani za mawe ga sanoo, chenye makodza madide sana ga rangi ya ivu na chijani, na mbao ziri kahi ya mbao ngumu zaidi za pwani. Unamera phatu mimea michache inaphoweza kumera, dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo gasigo na chitu, ganayopigbwa ni munyu wa madzi ga bahari.

about.en:
*Muinamia bahari* is a small shrub, sometimes a little tree, with twisted, knotted stems and very hard wood. Its leaves are tiny, narrow and grey-green, crowded along the twigs, and slightly fleshy, which helps the plant hold water in a salty, sun-baked place. Small white flowers with crinkled petals appear among the leaves.

On exposed shores the wind and spray prune it into low, dense cushions and leaning shapes, so it often looks older than it is.
about.sw:
*Muinamia bahari* ni kichaka kidogo, wakati mwingine mti mdogo, chenye mashina yaliyosokotana na yenye mafundo, na mbao ngumu sana. Majani yake ni madogo sana, membamba na ya kijivu-kijani, yamesongamana kando ya vitawi, na yana unyama kidogo, jambo linalousaidia mmea kuhifadhi maji mahali penye chumvi na jua kali. Maua madogo meupe yenye petali zilizokunjamana huchanua kati ya majani.

Katika fukwe zilizo wazi, upepo na manyunyu huupogoa kuwa na maumbo mafupi yaliyosongamana kama mito na maumbo yanayoinama, hivyo mara nyingi huonekana mkongwe kuliko ulivyo.
about.dg:
*Muinamia bahari* ni chitsaka chidide, wakati wanjina muhi mdide, chenye mihi iriyobeta na yenye mafundo, na mbao ngumu sana. Makodzage ni madide sana, membamba na ga rangi ya ivu na chijani, ganamera phamwenga dzulu ya maphungo, na ni ga madzi-madzi chidide, chitu chinachouterya mmea kuika madzi phatu pha munyu na dzuwa kali. Maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru, genye vipande vyenye makunyanzi, ganatuluka kahi ya makodza.

Pwani za weru, phepho na munyu wa bahari vinauhenda ukale mfupi, wa mafungu ganayogbwirana, na unadeguka, kpwa hivyo kpwa kawaida unaonekana wa kare kuriko urivyo.

where.en: It grows on coral-rock shores and on the landward fringes of the mangroves, rooting in cracks in the rock just above the reach of ordinary tides. Look for it on the old coral platforms along the south coast, where it forms grey-green clumps between the rock pools and the bush behind.
where.sw: Huota katika fukwe za miamba ya matumbawe na kwenye kingo za mikoko upande wa nchi kavu, ukitia mizizi katika nyufa za mwamba juu kidogo ya kufikiwa na maji ya kawaida. Utaupata kwenye majukwaa ya zamani ya matumbawe kando ya pwani ya kusini, ambapo huunda makundi ya kijivu-kijani kati ya vidimbwi vya miambani na vichaka vilivyo nyuma.
where.dg: Unamera pwani za mawe ga sanoo na kanda ya bara ya mikoko, uchimera kahi ya myanya ya mawe, dzulu chidide ya phatu madzi ga kuodzala ga kawaida ganaphofika. Uhendze dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo ga kare pwani ya kusini, ambapho unahenda mafungu ga rangi ya ivu na chijani kahi ya madimbwi ga madzi ga bahari na weruni nyuma.

uses.en: No particular uses have been recorded among the Digo so far, though its wood is known around the Indian Ocean as exceptionally hard and dense.
uses.sw: Hadi sasa hakuna matumizi maalumu yaliyorekodiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo, ingawa mbao zake zinajulikana kuzunguka Bahari ya Hindi kuwa ngumu na nzito kupita kiasi.
uses.dg: Hadi sambi takuna kazi iriyoandikpwa ya chitsaka chichi kahi ya Adigo, ela mbaoze zinamanyikana kanda-kanda ya Bahari ya Hindi kukala ni ngumu na ndziho sana.

culture.en: The name *muinamia bahari* means roughly 'the one that bends towards the sea', a good description of a shrub that leans out over the shore.
culture.sw: Jina *muinamia bahari* lina maana ya takriban 'unaoinamia bahari', maelezo mazuri ya kichaka kinachoinama juu ya ufuo.
culture.dg: Dzina *muinamia bahari* manage ni dza 'unaoinamira bahari', na rinaeleza vinono chitsaka chinachodeguka dzulu ya pwani.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *muinamia bahari*. No Swahili name has been recorded, though the related Swahili name *mwinamia maji* is given for seablite, another shrub of the salty shore. In English it is pemphis, and its scientific name is *Pemphis acidula*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *muinamia bahari*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa, ingawa jina la Kiswahili linalofanana nalo, *mwinamia maji*, hutolewa kwa mwinyonye (*seablite*), kichaka kingine cha ufuo wenye chumvi. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *pemphis*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Pemphis acidula*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *muinamia bahari*. Dzina ra Chiswahili taridzangbweandikpwa, ela dzina ra Chiswahili rinalohalana nare, *mwinamia maji*, nkuhumirwa kpwa *seablite*, chitsaka chanjina cha pwani yenye munyu. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pemphis*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Pemphis acidula*.

teaser.en: Its flowers hang in long strings of pink and white puffs that open at dusk and lie scattered on the water by morning.
teaser.sw: Maua yake huning'inia katika mishororo mirefu ya vishada vya waridi na vyeupe vinavyochanua jioni, na kufikia asubuhi huwa yametapakaa juu ya maji.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ganabwadzika dza kamba nyire za mafungu ga rangi ya pinki na nyereru, ganayovugula dziloni, na kuchicha ganakala ganalala hiku na hiku dzulu ya madzi.

summary.en: *Mworong'ondo*, the powder-puff tree or freshwater mangrove, is a small tree of stream banks and brackish back-swamps. Its long hanging chains of flowers make it one of the prettiest trees of the coastal wetlands.
summary.sw: *Mworong'ondo*, au mtomondo kwa Kiswahili, ni mti mdogo wa kingo za vijito na mabwawa ya maji ya chumvi kidogo yaliyo nyuma ya mikoko. Mishororo yake mirefu ya maua yanayoning'inia huufanya kuwa mojawapo ya miti mizuri zaidi ya maeneo oevu ya pwani.
summary.dg: *Mworong'ondo* (kpwa Chingereza *powder-puff tree* au *freshwater mangrove*) ni muhi mdide wa kanda-kanda ya miho midide na tsi za matope za madzi ga munyu chidide nyuma ya mikoko. Kpwa sababu ya maruwage ganayobwadzika dza kamba nyire, ni kahi ya mihi minono sana ya tsi za madzi za pwani.

about.en:
*Mworong'ondo* is a small tree with large, glossy leaves clustered towards the ends of the branches. Its flowers hang in long strings, sometimes longer than an arm, each flower a soft puff of pink and white stamens.

The flowers open in the evening and drop by the next morning, so the ground or the water beneath is often dotted with fallen puffs. They are followed by four-angled fruits, which hang in the same long strings and can float away on the water.
about.sw:
*Mworong'ondo* ni mti mdogo wenye majani makubwa yanayong'aa, yaliyojikusanya kuelekea ncha za matawi. Maua yake huning'inia katika mishororo mirefu, wakati mwingine mirefu kuliko mkono, na kila ua ni kishada laini cha stamini za waridi na nyeupe.

Maua huchanua jioni na kupukutika kufikia asubuhi inayofuata, hivyo ardhi au maji yaliyo chini mara nyingi huwa yametapakaa vishada vilivyoanguka. Hufuatwa na matunda yenye pembe nne, ambayo huning'inia katika mishororo mirefu ileile na yanaweza kuelea na kuchukuliwa na maji.
about.dg:
*Mworong'ondo* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza makulu ganayoala, ganayokala phamwenga kanda ya ntsa za pandaze. Maruwage ganabwadzika dza kamba nyire, wakati wanjina nyire kuriko mkpwono wa mutu, na chila ruwa ni fungu laini ra nyuzi za rangi ya pinki na nyereru.

Maruwa ganavugula dziloni na kuchicha ganakala gakagbwa, kpwa hivyo tsi au madzi ga photsi kpwa kawaida gana maruwa manji garigogbwa. Badaye kunatuluka matunda genye pembe nne, ganayobwadzika dza kamba nyire dza maruwa, na ganaweza kuelea na kutsukulwa ni madzi.

where.en: Look for it on stream banks and in the brackish back-swamps of the coastal strip, where fresh water from the land meets the reach of the tide. It is a tree of the quiet water behind the mangroves rather than of the open sea.
where.sw: Utaupata kwenye kingo za vijito na katika mabwawa ya maji ya chumvi kidogo ya ukanda wa pwani, ambapo maji baridi kutoka bara yanakutana na kufikiwa na maji kujaa. Ni mti wa maji tulivu yaliyo nyuma ya mikoko badala ya bahari iliyo wazi.
where.dg: Uhendze kanda-kanda ya miho midide na kahi ya tsi za matope za madzi ga munyu chidide za pwani, ambapho madzi gasigo na munyu kula bara ganakutana na madzi ga kuodzala. Ni muhi wa madzi ganayotulia nyuma ya mikoko, si wa bahari kulu.

uses.en: No particular uses have been recorded among the Digo so far.
uses.sw: Hadi sasa hakuna matumizi maalumu yaliyorekodiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Hadi sambi takuna kazi iriyoandikpwa ya muhi uhu kahi ya Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mworong'ondo*, also written *muorong'ondo*. In Swahili it is *mtomondo*. In English it is the powder-puff tree or freshwater mangrove, and its scientific name is *Barringtonia racemosa*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mworong'ondo*, pia huandikwa *muorong'ondo*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtomondo*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *powder-puff tree* au *freshwater mangrove*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Barringtonia racemosa*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mworong'ondo*, na piya rinaandikpwa *muorong'ondo*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtomondo*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *powder-puff tree* au *freshwater mangrove*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Barringtonia racemosa*.

teaser.en: Bite a leaf and you taste the sea: this succulent shrub is so salty that only hardy livestock will browse it.
teaser.sw: Ng'ata jani lake na utaonja bahari: kichaka hiki chenye majani manono kina chumvi nyingi kiasi kwamba ni mifugo hodari tu wanaokila.
teaser.dg: Ng'ata kodza na undaonja bahari: chitsaka chichi cha madzi-madzi china munyu sana hata ni mifugo yenye nguvu tu inayoweza kuchirya.

summary.en: Seablite is a salty, succulent shrub of the landward mangrove edge and the bare saline flats behind it. Where it grows it often takes over, forming low grey-green thickets where little else survives.
summary.sw: Mwinyonye ni kichaka chenye chumvi na majani manono kinachoota ukingoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu na kwenye nyanda tupu za chumvi zilizo nyuma yake. Pale kinapoota mara nyingi hutawala, na kuunda vichaka vifupi vya kijivu-kijani mahali ambapo mimea mingine michache huweza kuishi.
summary.dg: *Seablite* ni chitsaka chenye munyu na cha madzi-madzi cha kanda ya bara ya mikoko na tsi za weru zenye munyu nyuma ya mikoko. Phatu chinaphomera kpwa kawaida chinaenea, chichihenda vitsaka vifupi vya rangi ya ivu na chijani ambapho mimea michache yanjina inaweza kumera.

about.en:
Seablite is a low, much-branched shrub with small, fleshy, almost cylindrical leaves packed along its stems. The leaves store water and salt, which lets the plant survive on ground that would kill most others. Its flowers are tiny and greenish and easy to overlook.

Where conditions suit it, seablite is often the dominant plant, covering patches of the flats in a single dense stand.
about.sw:
Mwinyonye ni kichaka kifupi chenye matawi mengi, na majani madogo, manono, karibu ya umbo la mrija, yaliyosongamana kando ya mashina yake. Majani huhifadhi maji na chumvi, jambo linalouwezesha mmea kuishi katika ardhi ambayo ingeua mimea mingine mingi. Maua yake ni madogo sana na ya rangi ya kijani, na ni rahisi kutoyaona.

Pale hali inapoufaa, mwinyonye mara nyingi ndio mmea unaotawala, ukifunika sehemu za nyanda kama kundi moja lililosongamana.
about.dg:
*Seablite* ni chitsaka chifupi chenye panda nyinji, chenye makodza madide, ga madzi-madzi, ganayokala dza mirija, ganayobanana kanda-kanda ya mihiye. Makodza ganaika madzi na munyu, na chitu hichi chinaricha mmea umere kpwenye tsi ambayo inaolaga mimea minji. Maruwage ni madide sana na ga chijani, na ni rahisi kugatsupa usigaone.

Phatu phanaphochifwaha, *seablite* kpwa kawaida ndio mmea unaozidi phapho, chichifwinika seemu za tsi kpwa fungu rimwenga ririrogbwirana.

where.en: It grows on the landward side of the mangroves and on saline flats, the open, salt-crusted ground that the highest tides flood only now and then. Walk inland from the mangroves at Gazi or Vanga and it is one of the plants that marks the change from mud to dry land.
where.sw: Huota upande wa nchi kavu wa mikoko na kwenye nyanda za chumvi, ardhi iliyo wazi na yenye ukoko wa chumvi ambayo hufurika mara moja moja tu na maji makuu kabisa. Ukitembea kuelekea bara kutoka mikokoni huko Gazi au Vanga, ni mojawapo ya mimea inayoonyesha mpaka kati ya tope na nchi kavu.
where.dg: Chinamera uphande wa bara wa mikoko na kpwenye tsi za weru zenye munyu, tsi yenye munyu dzuluye ambayo madzi ga kuodzala makulu sana ganaifwinika wakati wanjina tu. Uchinyendeka kula mikoko kuphiya bara iko Gazi au Vanga, ni kahi ya mimea inayoonyesa phatu matope ganaphomala na tsi kavu inaphoandza.

uses.en: It is used as fodder, though it is very salty. Inland, pastoralists use it to feed their animals.
uses.sw: Hutumika kama lishe ya mifugo, ingawa kina chumvi nyingi sana. Huko bara, wafugaji hukitumia kulisha wanyama wao.
uses.dg: Chinahumirwa dza chakurya cha mifugo, hata chichikala china munyu sana. Bara, atu anaofuga mifugo anachihumira kurisa mifugo yao.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *mwinyonye*, and it is also called *mwinamia maji*. In English it is seablite, and its scientific name is *Suaeda monoica*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili kinaitwa *mwinyonye*, na pia huitwa *mwinamia maji*. Kwa Kiingereza kinaitwa *seablite*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Suaeda monoica*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mwinyonye*, na piya chinaihwa *mwinamia maji*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *seablite*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Suaeda monoica*.

teaser.en: A mangrove found mainly on Kenya's south coast, more often a shrub than a tree, with neat white flowers at the high-water mark.
teaser.sw: Mkoko unaopatikana hasa katika pwani ya kusini ya Kenya, mara nyingi kichaka kuliko mti, wenye maua meupe maridadi kwenye alama ya maji makuu.
teaser.dg: Mkoko unaophahikana zaidi pwani ya kusini ya Kenya, mara nyinji ni chitsaka kuriko muhi, wenye maruwa madide mereru manono phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika.

summary.en: The white-flowered black mangrove is an evergreen shrub or small tree of the landward high-water edge, found in Kenya mainly on the south coast. It is uncommon, and its wood is used for poles, firewood and charcoal.
summary.sw: Kikandaa ni kichaka au mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani unaoota ukingoni mwa maji makuu upande wa nchi kavu, na nchini Kenya hupatikana hasa katika pwani ya kusini. Si wa kawaida, na mbao zake hutumika kwa boriti, kuni na mkaa.
summary.dg: *White-flowered black mangrove* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, wa kanda ya bara ya mikoko phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika; Kenya unaphahikana zaidi pwani ya kusini. Si wa kawaida, na nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo, kuni na makala.

about.en:
This is a small mangrove, an evergreen shrub or small tree under 4 metres. Its leaves are small, fleshy and slightly notched at the tip, crowded towards the ends of the twigs. Small white flowers grow in short spikes, followed by little woody fruits.

It has no stilt roots and few obvious breathing roots, so it can look more like a coastal bush than a mangrove.
about.sw:
Huu ni mkoko mdogo, kichaka au mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani, wenye urefu wa chini ya mita 4. Majani yake ni madogo, manono na yana kibonyeo kidogo kwenye ncha, yamesongamana kuelekea ncha za vitawi. Maua madogo meupe huota katika mashada mafupi, na hufuatwa na matunda madogo magumu kama mti.

Hauna mizizi-mihimili na una mizizi michache ya kupumulia inayoonekana wazi, hivyo unaweza kuonekana zaidi kama kichaka cha pwani kuliko mkoko.
about.dg:
Uhu ni mkoko mdide, chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, usiofika mita 4. Makodzage ni madide, ga nyama, na gana mwanya mdide kpwenye ntsa; ganabanana kanda za ntsa za maphungo. Maruwa madide mereru ganamera kpwa misitari mifupi, na bada ya maruwa kunatuluka matunda madide magumu dza nyama za muhi.

Tauna mizi iriyootyoka, na mizi ya kuphahira pumuzi inayoonekana ni michache, kpwa hivyo unaweza kuonekana dza chitsaka cha pwani kuriko mkoko.

where.en: It grows at the landward high-water edge of the mangroves, mostly on the Kenyan south coast. It is more often found as a shrub than as a tree. Look for it at the back of the mangroves at Gazi Bay or Vanga, where the tidal mud gives way to firmer ground.
where.sw: Huota ukingoni mwa maji makuu upande wa nchi kavu wa mikoko, zaidi katika pwani ya kusini ya Kenya. Mara nyingi hupatikana kama kichaka kuliko kama mti. Utaupata nyuma ya mikoko katika Ghuba ya Gazi au Vanga, pale tope la maji kupwa na kujaa linapoishia na ardhi ngumu zaidi kuanza.
where.dg: Unamera kanda ya bara ya mikoko, phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika, zaidi pwani ya kusini ya Kenya. Mara nyinji unaphahikana dza chitsaka kuriko dza muhi. Uhendze nyuma ya mikoko ya Gazi Bay au Vanga, phatu matope ga madzi ga bahari ganaphomala na tsi ngumu inaphoandza.

uses.en: Its wood makes medium-quality firewood and charcoal, and its stems are cut for poles.
uses.sw: Mbao zake hutoa kuni na mkaa wa ubora wa wastani, na mashina yake hukatwa kwa ajili ya boriti.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi zinahenda kuni na makala, vyosi vya hali ya kati, na mihiye nkukatwa nguzo.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *kikandaa* or *mkandaa mwitu*, the 'wild *mkandaa*', and it is also called *mkaa pwani*. *Mkandaa* is also the Swahili name for the yellow mangrove. In English it is the white-flowered black mangrove, and its scientific name is *Lumnitzera racemosa*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *kikandaa* au *mkandaa mwitu*, yaani '*mkandaa* wa porini', na pia huitwa *mkaa pwani*. *Mkandaa* pia ni jina la Kiswahili la *yellow mangrove*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *white-flowered black mangrove*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Lumnitzera racemosa*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *kikandaa* au *mkandaa mwitu*, '*mkandaa* wa tsaka', na piya unaihwa *mkaa pwani*. *Mkandaa* piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili ra *yellow mangrove*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *white-flowered black mangrove*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Lumnitzera racemosa*.

conservation.en: It is uncommon in Kenya. Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and community projects at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring the forest.
conservation.sw: Si wa kawaida nchini Kenya. Mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati, kwa hiyo uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na miradi ya kijamii huko Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga inarejesha msitu.
conservation.dg: Si wa kawaida Kenya. Mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni, kpwa hivyo kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service, na mipango ya jamii ya Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga inauyiza matsaka ga mikoko.
