teaser.en: Builders say no mangrove pole lasts longer, and its bark is so rich in tannin that nearly half its weight can go into dye.
teaser.sw: Mafundi wa ujenzi husema hakuna boriti ya mkoko inayodumu kuliko yake, na gome lake lina tanini nyingi kiasi kwamba karibu nusu ya uzito wake unaweza kutumika kwa rangi.
teaser.dg: Atu anaodzenga nyumba anagomba kukala takuna nguzo ya mkoko inayokaa muda mure kuriko ya muhi uhu, na gophare rina tanini nyinji sana, hata phephi nusu ya gopha rosi inaweza kuhendwa rangi.

summary.en: The yellow mangrove is a small mangrove of firmer, saltier mud, and by number of trees the most abundant mangrove at Vanga. Its poles are said to be the most durable of all mangrove timber, and it is cut heavily for house building.
summary.sw: Mkandaa ni mkoko mdogo wa tope gumu zaidi na lenye chumvi zaidi, na kwa idadi ya miti ndio mkoko unaopatikana kwa wingi zaidi huko Vanga. Boriti zake zinasemekana kuwa za kudumu zaidi kuliko mbao zote za mikoko, na hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya ujenzi wa nyumba.
summary.dg: *Yellow mangrove* ni mkoko mdide wa matope magumu zaidi na genye munyu zaidi, na kpwa unji wa mihi ndio mkoko unaophahikana zaidi Vanga. Nguzoze nkugombwa kukala ndizo zinazokaa muda mure kuriko mbao zosi za mikoko, na nkukatwa sana kpwa kudzenga nyumba.

about.en:
The yellow mangrove is a shrub or small tree, rarely taller than 6 metres, standing on small stilt roots. Its leaves are blunt and rounded at the tip, often a yellowish green, which helps to tell it from the larger red mangrove nearby.

Like its relatives, it bears seedlings that sprout on the tree. The hanging propagule is ridged along its length and can reach 25 centimetres. The small flowers grow in tight clusters.
about.sw:
Mkandaa ni kichaka au mti mdogo, mara chache huzidi mita 6 kwa urefu, unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili midogo. Majani yake ni butu na ya mviringo kwenye ncha, mara nyingi ya kijani chenye unjano, jambo linalosaidia kuutofautisha na mkoko mkubwa ulio karibu.

Kama ndugu zake, huzaa miche inayochipua ikiwa bado juu ya mti. Mche unaoning'inia una mifuo kwa urefu wake wote na unaweza kufikia sentimita 25. Maua madogo huota katika vishada vilivyobanana.
about.dg:
*Yellow mangrove* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, ambao kpwa kawaida taupita mita 6, unaoima dzulu ya mizi midide iriyootyoka. Makodzage gana ntsa za mviringo zisizo kali, na mara nyinji ni ga rangi ya chijani na mandano; ichi chinaterya kuutafwautisha na *mkpwoko* mkulu unaomera phephi.

Dza nduguze, tembeye inamera ichiri kpwa muhi. Mutse unaobwadzika una mistari kpwa urefuwe, na unaweza kufika sentimita ishirini na tsano. Maruwa madide ganamera kpwa mafungu ganayobanana.

where.en: It grows on the landward side of the red mangrove, on firmer, saltier mud. At Vanga it is the most abundant mangrove by density and dominates the forest. It can also be found at Gazi and Funzi, where low tide exposes the band of shorter, yellow-green trees behind the taller red mangroves.
where.sw: Huota upande wa nchi kavu wa mkoko, kwenye tope gumu zaidi na lenye chumvi zaidi. Huko Vanga ndio mkoko unaopatikana kwa wingi zaidi kwa msongamano na hutawala msitu. Unaweza pia kupatikana Gazi na Funzi, ambapo maji kupwa hufichua safu ya miti mifupi ya kijani-manjano nyuma ya mikoko mirefu.
where.dg: Unamera uphande wa bara wa *mkpwoko*, kpwenye matope magumu zaidi na genye munyu zaidi. Vanga ndio mkoko unaophahikana zaidi kpwa unji wa mihi phatu phamwenga, na ndio unaozidi tsakani. Piya unaphahikana Gazi na Funzi, ambapho wakati wa madzi ga kala kunaonekana kanda ya mihi mifupi ya rangi ya chijani na mandano nyuma ya mihi mire ya *mkpwoko*.

uses.en:
Its poles are used in house construction and are said to be the most durable of any mangrove timber. The wood is made into paddles and oars and is excellent firewood.

The bark is very rich in tannin, about 45 per cent, and is used for tanning and as a dye. Young stems are used to build fish traps.

Because its poles are in demand for building, cutting it has long been a source of income on the coast.
uses.sw:
Boriti zake hutumika katika ujenzi wa nyumba na zinasemekana kuwa za kudumu zaidi kuliko mbao za mkoko mwingine wowote. Mbao zake hutengenezwa makasia na ni kuni bora sana.

Gome lina tanini nyingi sana, takriban asilimia 45, na hutumika kutengenezea ngozi na kama rangi. Mashina machanga hutumika kujenga madema ya kuvulia samaki.

Kwa sababu boriti zake zinahitajika sana kwa ujenzi, kuukata kwa muda mrefu kumekuwa chanzo cha kipato pwani.
uses.dg:
Nguzoze nkuhumirwa kudzenga nyumba, na nkugombwa kukala ndizo zinazokaa muda mure kuriko mbao zosi za mikoko. Nyama za muhi nkuhendwa makasia na makafi, na ni kuni nono sana.

Gopha rina tanini nyinji sana, phephi asilimia 45, na nkuhumirwa kutengeza ngozi na dza rangi. Mihi midide nkuhumirwa kudzenga migbwono ya ng'onda.

Kpwa sababu nguzoze zinahendzwa sana kpwa kudzenga, kula kare kuukata kukakala njira ya kuphahira pesa pwani.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *mkandaa*, also *mkoko mtune* or *mkoko mwekundu*; these names were recorded from Giriama and Swahili speakers at Mida Creek. *Mkandaa* is shared with the white-flowered black mangrove, known in Swahili as *mkandaa mwitu*. In English it is the yellow or spurred mangrove, and its scientific name is *Ceriops tagal*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mkandaa*, pia *mkoko mtune* au *mkoko mwekundu*; majina haya yalirekodiwa kutoka kwa wazungumzaji wa Kigiriama na Kiswahili huko Mida Creek. Jina *mkandaa* linashirikiwa na *white-flowered black mangrove*, unaojulikana kwa Kiswahili kama *mkandaa mwitu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *yellow mangrove* au *spurred mangrove*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Ceriops tagal*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkandaa*, piya *mkoko mtune* au *mkoko mwekundu*; madzina higa gaandikpwa kula kpwa atu anaogomba Chigiryama na Chiswahili iko Mida Creek. *White-flowered black mangrove* piya unaihwa *mkandaa*; kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mkandaa mwitu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *yellow mangrove* au *spurred mangrove*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Ceriops tagal*.

teaser.en: Its runners stitch the sand dunes together, and each leaf is split at the tip like the print of a goat's hoof.
teaser.sw: Matawi yake yanayotambaa huyashona matuta ya mchanga pamoja, na kila jani limegawanyika kwenye ncha kama alama ya kwato ya mbuzi.
teaser.dg: Mihiye inayoambala inashona vidzango vya mtsanga phamwenga, na chila kodza rina mwanya kpwenye ntsa dza alama ya kpwatsa ra mbuzi.

summary.en: Beach morning glory is a fleshy creeping vine of the upper beach, with pink-purple trumpet flowers and two-lobed leaves. Its long runners bind the loose sand of the dunes at Diani, Tiwi and Funzi.
summary.sw: Mlakasa ni mtambaa wenye unyama wa sehemu ya juu ya ufuo, wenye maua ya waridi-zambarau yenye umbo la tarumbeta na majani yenye ndewe mbili. Matawi yake marefu yanayotambaa hushikilia mchanga mlegevu wa matuta huko Diani, Tiwi na Funzi.
summary.dg: *Beach morning glory* ni mmea wa nyama unaoambala wa dzulu ya ufuwo, wenye maruwa ga pinki na zambarau ga umbo ra ndzumari, na makodza genye mala mairi. Mihiye mire inayoambala inagbwira mtsanga usiogbwirana wa vidzango vya Diani, Tiwi na Funzi.

about.en:
Beach morning glory is a creeping vine that sends long runners across the sand, rooting as it goes. Its leaves are thick and fleshy, and split at the tip into two rounded lobes, like the cloven print of a goat's hoof, which gives it the English name goat's-foot creeper.

The flowers are wide pink to purple trumpets with a darker centre, opening in the morning and closing later in the day, like other morning glories. The seeds are carried in round capsules.
about.sw:
Mlakasa ni mtambaa unaotuma matawi marefu juu ya mchanga, ukitia mizizi unapoendelea. Majani yake ni manene na manono, na yamegawanyika kwenye ncha kuwa ndewe mbili za mviringo, kama alama ya kwato ya mbuzi iliyopasuka, na hiyo ndiyo inayoupa jina la Kiingereza *goat's-foot creeper*.

Maua ni tarumbeta pana za waridi hadi zambarau zenye kitovu cheusi zaidi, huchanua asubuhi na kufunga baadaye mchana, kama mimea mingine ya jamii yake. Mbegu hubebwa ndani ya vibuyu vya mviringo.
about.dg:
*Beach morning glory* ni mmea unaoambala, unaolavya mihi mire inayoambala dzulu ya mtsanga, na inatuluza mizi chila phatu inaphotsupa. Makodzage ni manene na ga nyama, na ganaganyika kpwenye ntsa kukala mala mairi ga mviringo, dza alama ya kpwatsa ra mbuzi; ichi ndicho chinachouphisha dzina ra Chingereza *goat's-foot creeper*.

Maruwa ni mapana, ga pinki hadi zambarau, ga umbo ra ndzumari, na kahi-kahi ni ga rangi nyiru zaidi; ganavuguka ligundzu na ganafunga tsena badaye mutsi, dza maruwa ganjina ga *morning glory*. Tembe zinakala ndani ya makakaya ga mviringo.

where.en: It grows on the upper beach and the fore-dunes along the whole coast, including Diani, Tiwi and Funzi. Look for it on the strip just above the high-tide line, where it spreads in a green net over the sand. It flowers for much of the year.
where.sw: Huota sehemu ya juu ya ufuo na kwenye matuta ya mbele ya mchanga kando ya pwani nzima, ikiwemo Diani, Tiwi na Funzi. Utaupata kwenye ukanda ulio juu kidogo ya mstari wa maji makuu, ambapo hutanda kama wavu wa kijani juu ya mchanga. Huchanua maua kwa sehemu kubwa ya mwaka.
where.dg: Unamera dzulu ya ufuwo na kpwenye vidzango vya mtsanga vya mbere pwani yosi, phamwenga na Diani, Tiwi na Funzi. Uhendze kpwenye kanda iriyo dzulu tu ya phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika, ambapho unaenea dza wavu wa chijani dzulu ya mtsanga. Unalavya maruwa miezi minji ya mwaka.

uses.en:
Its runners bind loose sand, so it helps to hold the dunes together against wind and waves.

It is used in traditional medicine around the Indian Ocean.
uses.sw:
Matawi yake yanayotambaa hushikilia mchanga mlegevu, hivyo husaidia kuyashikilia matuta pamoja dhidi ya upepo na mawimbi.

Hutumika katika tiba za jadi kuzunguka Bahari ya Hindi.
uses.dg:
Mihiye inayoambala inagbwira mtsanga usiogbwirana, kpwa hivyo inaterya kugbwira vidzango vya mtsanga visibanangwe ni phepho na maimbi.

Nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji kanda-kanda ya Bahari ya Hindi.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *majani ya mwaka* or *mlakasa*. In English it is beach morning glory or goat's-foot creeper, and its scientific name, *Ipomoea pes-caprae*, means 'goat's foot'.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *majani ya mwaka* au *mlakasa*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *beach morning glory* au *goat's-foot creeper*, na jina lake la kisayansi, *Ipomoea pes-caprae*, lina maana ya 'mguu wa mbuzi'.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *majani ya mwaka* au *mlakasa*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *beach morning glory* au *goat's-foot creeper*, na dzinare ra chisayansi, *Ipomoea pes-caprae*, rinamaanisha 'chigulu cha mbuzi'.

conservation.en: It is widespread, but beachfront development is clearing it from parts of the coast.
conservation.sw: Umeenea sana, lakini ujenzi wa majengo kando ya ufuo unauondoa katika sehemu za pwani.
conservation.dg: Unaphahikana phatu phanji, ela kudzenga phephi na ufuwo kunauusa phatu phanjina pha pwani.

teaser.sw: Maua yake yanaonekana kama yamechanwa nusu, petali zote zikiwa upande mmoja, kana kwamba mtu amezichuma nyingine.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ganaonekana dza gakpwanyuka nusu, makodza ga ruwa gosi uphande mwenga, dza kukala mutu wagadola ganjina.

summary.en: Beach naupaka is a low succulent shrub of the beach crest and fore-dune, with fleshy leaves, half-flowers and black berries. It helps to hold the sand of Kenya's beaches in place.
summary.sw: *Beach naupaka* ni kichaka kifupi chenye unyama cha kilele cha ufuo na matuta ya mbele ya mchanga, chenye majani manono, nusu-maua na beri nyeusi. Husaidia kuushikilia mchanga wa fukwe za Kenya mahali pake.
summary.dg: *Beach naupaka* ni chitsaka chifupi cha madzi-madzi cha dzulu ya ufuwo na vidzango vya mtsanga vya mbere, chenye makodza ga nyama, nusu za maruwa na matunda madide maru. Chinaterya kugbwira mtsanga wa maufuwo ga Kenya usitsukulwe.

about.en:
Beach naupaka is a low, spreading shrub with thick, fleshy leaves that resist the salt and sun of the beach. Its flowers are its most striking feature: the petals are all on one side, fanned out in a half-circle, so each flower looks like half a flower.

The flowers are followed by round berries that ripen black, which gives the plant its other English name, inkberry.
about.sw:
*Beach naupaka* ni kichaka kifupi kinachotanda, chenye majani manene na manono yanayostahimili chumvi na jua la ufuoni. Maua yake ndiyo sifa yake inayovutia zaidi: petali zote ziko upande mmoja, zimetandazwa kama nusu duara, hivyo kila ua linaonekana kama nusu ya ua.

Maua hufuatwa na beri za mviringo zinazoiva na kuwa nyeusi, na hilo ndilo linaloupa mmea jina lake lingine la Kiingereza, *inkberry*.
about.dg:
*Beach naupaka* ni chitsaka chifupi chinachoenea, chenye makodza manene ga nyama ganayovumirira munyu na dzuwa ra ufuwoni. Maruwage ndigo chitu cha ajabu zaidi: makodza ga ruwa gosi gamo uphande mwenga, ganaenea dza chiphephero cha nusu ya mviringo, kpwa hivyo chila ruwa rinaonekana dza nusu ya ruwa.

Bada ya maruwa kunatuluka matunda madide ga mviringo ganayoivwa na kukala maru, na ichi ndicho chinachochipha dzina ranjina ra Chingereza, *inkberry*.

where.en: It grows on the fore-dune and beach crest of Kenya's sandy shores, the first band of shrubs above the open sand. Look for it in low mounds along the back of the beach, often with beach morning glory spreading at its feet.
where.sw: Huota kwenye matuta ya mbele ya mchanga na kilele cha ufuo katika fukwe za mchanga za Kenya, safu ya kwanza ya vichaka juu ya mchanga ulio wazi. Utakipata kama vilima vifupi kando ya sehemu ya nyuma ya ufuo, mara nyingi mlakasa ukitanda miguuni pake.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye vidzango vya mtsanga vya mbere na dzulu ya ufuwo wa mtsanga wa Kenya, kanda ya kpwandza ya vitsaka dzulu ya mtsanga wazi. Uchihendze dza vidzango vifupi kanda-kanda ya nyuma ya ufuwo, mara nyinji phamwenga na *beach morning glory* unaoenea photsiche.

uses.en: It is valued as a dune stabiliser: its roots and spreading stems hold the sand of the beach crest in place.
uses.sw: Kinathaminiwa kwa kuimarisha matuta ya mchanga: mizizi yake na mashina yake yanayotanda hushikilia mchanga wa kilele cha ufuo mahali pake.
uses.dg: Nkutogolwa kpwa kugbwira vidzango vya mtsanga: miziye na mihiye inayoenea inagbwira mtsanga wa dzulu ya ufuwo usitsukulwe.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet, and no Swahili name either. In English it is beach naupaka or inkberry, and its scientific name is *Scaevola plumieri*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo, wala jina la Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza kinaitwa *beach naupaka* au *inkberry*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Scaevola plumieri*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi, na takuna ra Chiswahili piya. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *beach naupaka* au *inkberry*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Scaevola plumieri*.

reason.en: Also holds the fore-dune together
reason.sw: Nao pia hushikilia matuta ya mbele ya mchanga
reason.dg: Piya unagbwira vidzango vya mtsanga vya mbere

reason.en: Grows on the same sandy shores
reason.sw: Huota katika fukwe zilezile za mchanga
reason.dg: Unamera kpwenye ufuwo wa mtsanga sawa

reason.en: Another shrub of the beach edge
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha ukingo wa ufuo
reason.dg: Chitsaka chanjina cha kanda ya ufuwo

sources: Gillikin, D. A field guide to Kenyan mangroves (Gazi Bay) https://minerva.union.edu/gillikid/mangrove_14May2020/mangroves.htm

teaser.en: Village farmers at Kibuyuni grow it on lines in the shallow sea, then sell it to the makers of toothpaste and ice cream.
teaser.sw: Wakulima wa kijijini huko Kibuyuni huukuza kwenye kamba katika bahari isiyo na kina, kisha huuuzia watengenezaji wa dawa ya meno na aiskrimu.
teaser.dg: Akurima a chidzidzi cha Kibuyuni anaurima kpwenye kamba ndani ya madzi machache ga bahari, chisha anauguza kpwa makampuni ganayohenda mreko na aisikrimu.

summary.en: Cottonii is a fleshy red seaweed farmed in the shallow lagoons of the south coast. It is grown for carrageenan, a thickener used worldwide, and it brings income to villages such as Kibuyuni.
summary.sw: *Cottonii* ni mwani mwekundu wenye unyama unaolimwa katika mahori yasiyo na kina ya pwani ya kusini. Hukuzwa kwa ajili ya *carrageenan*, kiungo cha kuongeza uzito kinachotumika duniani kote, na huleta kipato kwa vijiji kama Kibuyuni.
summary.dg: *Cottonii* ni mwani wa kundu wa nyama, unaorimwa kpwenye madzi machache ga bahari ga pwani ya kusini. Unarimwa kpwa sababu ya *carrageenan*, chitu chinachohumirwa duniani kosi kuhenda vitu vikale viziho, na unareha mapato kpwa vidzidzi dza Kibuyuni.

about.en: Cottonii is a red seaweed with thick, fleshy, branching stems that can be green, brown or reddish depending on the strain and the light. It grows very fast, which makes it well suited to farming. It is rich in carrageenan, a natural gel.
about.sw: *Cottonii* ni mwani mwekundu wenye mashina manene, yenye unyama na matawi, ambayo yanaweza kuwa ya kijani, kahawia au mekundu kutegemea aina na mwanga. Hukua kwa kasi sana, jambo linaloufanya kufaa sana kwa kilimo. Una *carrageenan* nyingi, jeli ya asili.
about.dg: *Cottonii* ni mwani wa kundu wenye mihi minene ya nyama, yenye panda, ambayo inaweza kukala ya chijani, ya rangi ya dongo au ya kundu chidide, kulingana na aina na mwangaza. Unakula upesi sana, na ichi chinahenda ufwahe sana kurimwa. Una *carrageenan* nyinji, chitu cha luhe cha asili.

where.en: It is farmed alongside spinosum seaweed at Kibuyuni and other villages on the south coast. Farms are set in the shallow lagoon behind the reef, where the plots of rope lines are visible at low tide.
where.sw: Hulimwa pamoja na mwani wa *spinosum* huko Kibuyuni na vijiji vingine vya pwani ya kusini. Mashamba huwekwa katika mahori yasiyo na kina nyuma ya miamba ya matumbawe, ambapo vipande vya mistari ya kamba huonekana wakati wa maji kupwa.
where.dg: Unarimwa phamwenga na mwani wa *spinosum* Kibuyuni na kpwenye vidzidzi vyanjina vya pwani ya kusini. Minda iko kpwenye madzi machache ga bahari nyuma ya mwamba, ambapho misitari ya kamba ya minda inaonekana wakati wa madzi ga kala.

uses.en:
Seaweed farmers grow cottonii for income. Pieces are tied to ropes stretched between stakes in the shallows, left to grow, then harvested, dried in the sun and sold. The carrageenan it contains is used as a thickener in foods, toothpaste and cosmetics around the world.

On the coast it is also made into local cosmetics and food products.
uses.sw:
Wakulima wa mwani hulima *cottonii* kwa ajili ya kipato. Vipande hufungwa kwenye kamba zilizonyooshwa kati ya vigingi katika maji yasiyo na kina, huachwa vikue, kisha huvunwa, hukaushwa juani na kuuzwa. *Carrageenan* iliyomo hutumika kama kiungo cha kuongeza uzito katika vyakula, dawa ya meno na vipodozi duniani kote.

Pwani pia hutengenezwa vipodozi na bidhaa za vyakula vya kienyeji.
uses.dg:
Akurima a mwani nkuurima *cottonii* ili kuphaha pesa. Vipande vya mwani nkufungbwa kpwenye kamba zirizofungbwa kahi ya mihi midide iriyodungbwa madzini, nkurichwa ukule, chisha nkuvunwa, nkuanikpwa dzuwani na nkuguzwa. *Carrageenan* iriyomo nkuhumirwa duniani kosi kuhenda vyakurya, mreko na vitu vya kudzipamba vikale viziho.

Pwani piya nkuhendwa vitu vya kudzipamba na vyakurya vinavyohendwa hipha hipha.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili, farmed seaweeds are called *mwani*. In English it is cottonii seaweed, and its scientific name is *Kappaphycus alvarezii*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili, mwani unaolimwa huitwa *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *cottonii seaweed*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Kappaphycus alvarezii*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili, mwani unaorimwa nkuihwa *mwani*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *cottonii seaweed*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Kappaphycus alvarezii*.

conservation.en: It is an introduced cultivar grown on farms, not a wild plant of the coast.
conservation.sw: Ni aina iliyoletwa kutoka nje inayokuzwa mashambani, si mmea wa porini wa pwani hii.
conservation.dg: Ni aina mjeni inayorimwa mindani, si mwani unaomera macheye pwani.

reason.en: The other seaweed farmed for carrageenan, grown alongside it
reason.sw: Mwani mwingine unaolimwa kwa ajili ya carrageenan, unaokuzwa pamoja nao
reason.dg: Mwani wanjina unaorimwa kpwa *carrageenan*, phamwenga na uhu

reason.en: Grows in the same shallow lagoons
reason.sw: Huota katika mahori yaleyale yasiyo na kina
reason.dg: Inamera kpwenye madzi machache ga bahari phamwenga na uhu

reason.en: Another coastal crop grown for income
reason.sw: Zao jingine la pwani linalolimwa kwa ajili ya kipato
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa pwani unaorimwa kpwa kuphahira pesa

sources: Seaweed farming in Kibuyuni, Shimoni (KMFRI model farm): Standard Media https://standardmedia.co.ke/article/2000179926/standard-digital ; ACTS blue economy blog https://blueeconomy.acts-net.org/blog/seaweed-farming-an-economic-breakthrough-for-women-in-kwale-county-kenya ; Panorama 'Mama Fatuma' https://panorama.solutions/en/solution/mama-fatuma-and-seaweed-farming-development-south-coast-kenya

teaser.en: Its flowers are so fragrant that cooks steep them in coconut milk, and its spiny leaves are woven into mats and baskets.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yana harufu nzuri kiasi kwamba wapishi huyaloweka katika tui la nazi, na majani yake yenye miiba husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu.
teaser.dg: Maruwage gana arufu nono sana hata ajiti nkugatiya kpwenye huwi, na makodzage genye miya nkusukpwa kuhenda majamvi na vitsango.

summary.en: *Mkadi*, the screw pine, is a coastal tree on stilt roots with long, spiny strap-shaped leaves and fragrant flowers. It is grown near homes for its weaving leaves, its scented flowers and its shelter from the wind.
summary.sw: *Mkadi* ni mti wa pwani unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili, wenye majani marefu kama utepe yenye miiba, na maua yenye harufu nzuri. Hupandwa karibu na nyumba kwa ajili ya majani yake ya kusuka, maua yake yenye harufu nzuri na kuzuia upepo.
summary.dg: *Mkadi* ni muhi wa pwani unaoima dzulu ya mizi ya kuimirira, wenye makodza mare genye miya, mabapa dza mkanda, na maruwa genye arufu nono. Nkuphandwa phephi na nyumba kpwa sababu ya makodzage ga kusuka, maruwage genye arufu nono na kuzuwiya phepho.

about.en:
*Mkadi* is a tree of 4 to 8 metres that stands on stilt roots, much like a mangrove, propping it up in loose sand and wet ground. The leaves are long, stiff and strap-shaped, edged with small sharp spines, and they spiral around the branch tips in tufts. That spiral arrangement, like the thread of a screw, gives the English name.

The flowers are what people notice first: they are strongly fragrant. Pakia notes that the Digo recognise the plant by its leaves and its aromatic flowers. The fruit is a large, knobbly head made of many woody segments.
about.sw:
*Mkadi* ni mti wa mita 4 hadi 8 unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili, kama mkoko, inayoushikilia katika mchanga laini na ardhi yenye majimaji. Majani yake ni marefu, magumu na yenye umbo la utepe, yenye miiba midogo mikali kwenye kingo, na yanazunguka ncha za matawi kwa mzunguko kama vishungi. Mpangilio huo wa mzunguko, kama mzunguko wa skrubu, ndio uliompa jina lake la Kiingereza.

Maua ndiyo kitu ambacho watu hukiona kwanza: yana harufu kali nzuri. Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua mmea huu kwa majani yake na maua yake yenye harufu nzuri. Tunda lake ni kichwa kikubwa chenye vinundu, kilichoundwa na vipande vingi vigumu kama mbao.
about.dg:
*Mkadi* ni muhi wa mita 4 hadi 8 unaoima dzulu ya mizi ya kuimirira, dza mkoko, inayougbwira kpwenye mtsanga usiokala mgumu na tsi ya mtope. Makodzage ni mare, magumu na mabapa dza mkanda, na kanda-kanda gana miya midide ya ntsa; ganazunguluka ntsa za panda kpwa mafungu. Mpangilio hinyu wa kuzunguluka, dza wa skrubu, ndio unaolavya dzina ra Chingereza.

Atu nkuona maruwa kpwandza: gana arufu nono sana. Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya mmea hinyu kpwa makodzage na maruwage genye arufu nono. Tundare ni kulu, ra mafundo-mafundo, rinarohendwa ni vipande vinji vigumu.

where.en: It grows on coastal sands, along creeks and in swampy places, and it is often planted near homes. On the south coast, look for its stilt roots and spiralling crowns of spiky leaves near villages behind the beach and along the edges of creeks.
where.sw: Hukua kwenye mchanga wa pwani, kando ya hori na mahali penye majimaji, na mara nyingi hupandwa karibu na nyumba. Pwani ya kusini, tafuta mizizi-mihimili yake na mataji yake ya majani yenye miiba yanayozunguka karibu na vijiji vilivyo nyuma ya ufuo na kando ya kingo za hori.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye mtsanga wa pwani, kanda-kanda ya mikono ya bahari na phatu pha madzi-madzi, na mara nyinji nkuphandwa phephi na nyumba. Pwani ya kusini, endza miziye ya kuimirira na vitswavye vya makodza genye miya ganagozunguluka, phephi na vidzidzi virivyo nyuma ya ufuwo na kanda-kanda ya mikono ya bahari.

uses.en:
The leaves are stripped of their spines, split and woven into mats and baskets.

The fragrant flowers are steeped in coconut milk to scent it. The flowers and roots are used in medicine, and the trees are planted as windbreaks.
uses.sw:
Majani huondolewa miiba, hupasuliwa na kusukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu.

Maua yenye harufu nzuri huloweshwa katika tui la nazi ili kulitia harufu. Maua na mizizi hutumika katika dawa, na miti hupandwa kuzuia upepo.
uses.dg:
Makodza nkuuswa miya, nkuahulwa na nkusukpwa kuhenda majamvi na vitsango.

Maruwa genye arufu nono nkutiywa kpwenye huwi ili rikale na arufu nono. Maruwa na mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa, na mihi nkuphandwa kuzuwiya phepho.

culture.en: Pakia notes that the Digo identify *mkadi* by its leaves and its aromatic flowers, the two things that make it useful.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua *mkadi* kwa majani yake na maua yake yenye harufu nzuri, vitu viwili vinavyoufanya kuwa na manufaa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya *mkadi* kpwa makodzage na maruwage genye arufu nono, vitu viiri vinavyoufwahisa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mkadi*, which is also the Swahili and Giriama name. The ICRAF tree handbook gives *mkapu* instead. Since the Mgombato dictionary and Pakia both use *mkapu* (or *kapu*) for the lemon, the ICRAF name needs checking with speakers. In English it is the screw pine, and its scientific name is *Pandanus kirkii*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mkadi*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili na la Kigiriama. Kitabu cha miti cha ICRAF badala yake kinatoa *mkapu*. Kwa kuwa kamusi ya Mgombato na Pakia wote hutumia *mkapu* (au *kapu*) kwa mlimau, jina la ICRAF linahitaji kuthibitishwa na wazungumzaji. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *screw pine*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Pandanus kirkii*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mkadi*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili na ra Chigiriama. Chitabu cha mihi cha ICRAF chinalavya *mkapu* badalaye. Kpwa vira kamusi ya Mgombato na Pakia vyosi viiri vinahumira *mkapu* (au *kapu*) kpwa limau, dzina ra ICRAF rinahitaji kulolwa na atu anaogomba Chidigo. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *screw pine*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Pandanus kirkii*.

reason.en: Same genus: the Rabai screw pine
reason.sw: Jenasi moja: mkadi wa Rabai
reason.dg: Wa jenasi mwenga: *screw pine* ya Rabai

reason.en: Its coconut milk is scented with mkadi flowers
reason.sw: Tui lake la nazi hutiwa harufu kwa maua ya mkadi
reason.dg: Huwire nkutiywa arufu nono kpwa maruwa ga *mkadi*

reason.en: Another plant whose leaves are woven into mats and baskets
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine ambao majani yake husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina ambao makodzage nkusukpwa kuhenda majamvi na vitsango

reason.en: The lemon, which shares the name mkapu in some sources
reason.sw: Mlimau, ambao katika baadhi ya vyanzo una jina hilo hilo, mkapu
reason.dg: Limau, ambaro vitabu vyanjina vinariiha piya *mkapu*

teaser.en: Its white flowers open at night and fall by morning, filling the beach air with scent while most people are asleep.
teaser.sw: Maua yake meupe huchanua usiku na kupukutika kufikia asubuhi, yakijaza hewa ya ufuoni harufu nzuri wakati watu wengi wamelala.
teaser.dg: Maruwage mereru ganavuguka usiku na ganagbwa ichifika ligundzu, ganaodzaza ufuwo arufu nono wakati atu anji ali usingizini.

summary.en: *Mkungu wa pwani*, the beach gardenia, is a small seaside tree with large rounded leaves and fragrant white flowers that open at night. Its Digo name compares it to the Indian almond, the *mkungu*.
summary.sw: *Mkungu wa pwani* (kwa Kiingereza *beach gardenia*) ni mti mdogo wa pwani wenye majani makubwa ya mviringo na maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri yanayochanua usiku. Jina lake la Kidigo linaulinganisha na *mkungu* (*Indian almond*).
summary.dg: *Mkungu wa pwani* (*beach gardenia* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi mdide wa kanda-kanda ya bahari, wenye makodza makulu ga mviringo na maruwa mereru genye arufu nono ganayovuguka usiku. Dzinare ra Chidigo rinaulinganisha na *mkungu*, muhi unaoihwa *Indian almond* kpwa Chingereza.

about.en: *Mkungu wa pwani* is a small tree or large shrub with big, rounded leaves, soft and slightly hairy, clustered at the ends of the branches. Its flowers are white, tubular and very fragrant, opening in the evening and dropping by morning. The fruit is a small, hard, round drupe with a corky layer that lets it float on the sea, which is how the tree has spread to beaches all around the tropics.
about.sw: *Mkungu wa pwani* ni mti mdogo au kichaka kikubwa chenye majani makubwa ya mviringo, laini na yenye malaika kidogo, yaliyojikusanya kwenye ncha za matawi. Maua yake ni meupe, yenye umbo la mrija na harufu nzuri sana; huchanua jioni na kupukutika kufikia asubuhi. Tunda ni kokwa dogo, gumu na la mviringo lenye tabaka la kizibo linaloliwezesha kuelea baharini, na hivyo ndivyo mti huu ulivyoenea hadi fukwe zote za ukanda wa tropiki.
about.dg: *Mkungu wa pwani* ni muhi mdide, au chitsaka chikulu, wenye makodza makulu ga mviringo, malaini na genye nyere chidide, ganayobanana kpwenye ntsa za panda. Maruwage ni mereru, ga umbo ra mrija, na gana arufu nono sana; ganavuguka dziloni na ganagbwa ichifika ligundzu. Tunda ni ridide, gumu na ra mviringo, na rina seemu dza *cork* inayoricha rielee dzulu ya bahari; ndivyo muhi uhu urivyoenea kpwenye maufuwo ga tsi za dzoho kosi duniani.

where.en: It grows on sandy and coral beach tops, at the very back of the beach where the sand meets the bush. Look for its broad leaves among the shrubs above the high-tide line, and for fallen white flowers on the sand early in the morning.
where.sw: Huota juu ya fukwe za mchanga na za matumbawe, nyuma kabisa ya ufuo pale mchanga unapokutana na vichaka. Utayaona majani yake mapana kati ya vichaka vilivyo juu ya mstari wa maji makuu, na maua meupe yaliyoanguka juu ya mchanga alfajiri.
where.dg: Unamera dzulu ya ufuwo wa mtsanga na wa sanoo, nyuma kabisa ya ufuwo, phatu mtsanga unaphomala na vitsaka vinaphoandza. Uhendze makodzage mapana kahi ya vitsaka dzulu ya phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika, na maruwa mereru ganayogbwa dzulu ya mtsanga chiti ligundzu.

uses.en: No particular uses have been recorded among the Digo so far.
uses.sw: Hadi sasa hakuna matumizi maalumu yaliyorekodiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Hadi sambi takuna matumizi ga hasa ga muhi uhu ganayoandikpwa kahi ya Adigo.

culture.en: The Digo named it by comparison with the *mkungu*, the Indian almond, because it grows at the seaside. *Pwani* means the coast or seashore, so the name means 'the *mkungu* of the seaside'.
culture.sw: Wadigo waliupa jina kwa kuulinganisha na *mkungu*, kwa sababu huota pwani. *Pwani* ina maana ya pwani au ufuo wa bahari, hivyo jina lina maana ya '*mkungu* wa pwani'.
culture.dg: Adigo auiha muhi uhu kpwa kuulinganisha na *mkungu* (*Indian almond*), kpwa sababu unamera kanda-kanda ya bahari. *Pwani* ni kanda ya bahari au ufuwo, kpwa hivyo dzina rinamaanisha '*mkungu* wa kanda-kanda ya bahari'.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mkungu wa pwani*. No Swahili name has been recorded. In English it is the beach gardenia, and its scientific name is *Guettarda speciosa*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mkungu wa pwani*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *beach gardenia*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Guettarda speciosa*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mkungu wa pwani*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *beach gardenia*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Guettarda speciosa*.

reason.sw: Mkungu ambao umepewa jina kutokana nao
reason.dg: *Mkungu*, muhi ambao dzina hiri rinalavywa kpwakpwe

reason.en: Another seaside tree with fragrant white flowers
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa pwani wenye maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa kanda-kanda ya bahari wenye maruwa mereru genye arufu nono

reason.en: Shares the beach tops

reason.dg: Unamera dzulu ya ufuwo phamwenga na uhu

reason.dg: Jamii mwenga ya kahawa (Rubiaceae): ni *gardenia* ya vitsakani

teaser.en: Before kerosene reached the coast, the oily seeds of this shady beach tree were pressed to light lamps.
teaser.sw: Kabla mafuta ya taa hayajafika pwani, mbegu zenye mafuta za mti huu wenye kivuli wa ufuoni zilikamuliwa ili kuwasha taa.
teaser.dg: Kabla ya mafuha ga taa kufika pwani, tembe za mafuha za muhi uhu wa pepho wa ufuwoni zaminywa ili kuasa taa.

summary.en: *Mtondoro*, the Alexandrian laurel, is a spreading seaside tree with glossy leaves, fragrant white flowers and round fruits holding an oily seed. It is planted for shade on shores and in villages, and its oil and timber have long been used.
summary.sw: *Mtondoro*, au mtondoo kwa Kiswahili, ni mti wa pwani unaotanda wenye majani yanayong'aa, maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri na matunda ya mviringo yenye mbegu yenye mafuta. Hupandwa kwa ajili ya kivuli fukweni na vijijini, na mafuta yake na mbao zake zimetumika kwa muda mrefu.
summary.dg: *Mtondoro* (*Alexandrian laurel* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi unaoenea wa kanda-kanda ya bahari, wenye makodza ganayong'ala, maruwa mereru genye arufu nono, na matunda ga mviringo genye tembe ya mafuha. Nkuphandwa kpwa sababu ya pephoye kanda-kanda ya ufuwo na vidzidzini, na kula kare mafuhage nkuhumirwa, na mbaoze piya.

about.en:
*Mtondoro* is a broad, spreading tree with a short, often leaning trunk and a dense, shady crown. Its leaves are thick, very glossy and oval, with fine parallel veins running across them from the midrib.

The flowers are white with a yellow centre and smell sweet. They are followed by round green fruits about the size of a golf ball, each holding a single large seed rich in oil.
about.sw:
*Mtondoro* ni mti mpana unaotanda, wenye shina fupi ambalo mara nyingi huinama na kilele kilichosongamana chenye kivuli. Majani yake ni manene, yanang'aa sana na ya umbo la yai, yenye mishipa myembamba inayoenda sambamba kutoka kwenye mshipa wa kati.

Maua ni meupe yenye kitovu cha manjano na harufu tamu. Hufuatwa na matunda ya kijani ya mviringo yenye ukubwa wa takriban mpira wa gofu, kila moja likiwa na mbegu moja kubwa yenye mafuta mengi.
about.dg:
*Mtondoro* ni muhi mpana unaoenea, wenye kolo fupi ambaro mara nyinji rinadeguka, na makodza manji ga dzulu ganayohenda pepho kulu. Makodzage ni manene, ganang'ala sana na ga umbo ra yai, na mishipa midide sambamba inatsupa kula mongo wa kodza hadi kanda.

Maruwa ni mereru, kahi-kahi ni ga rangi ya mandano, na gana arufu nono. Bada ya maruwa kunatuluka matunda ga mviringo ga chijani, makulu dza mpira wa *golf*, na chila rimwenga rina tembe mwenga kulu yenye mafuha manji.

where.en: It grows on sandy shores and in coastal villages, and is often planted. On the south coast, look for it along the backs of beaches and in villages near the shore, where its wide crown makes a cool place to sit.
where.sw: Huota kwenye fukwe za mchanga na katika vijiji vya pwani, na mara nyingi hupandwa. Katika pwani ya kusini, utaupata nyuma ya fukwe na katika vijiji vilivyo karibu na ufuo, ambapo kilele chake kipana hutoa mahali pa baridi pa kuketi.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye ufuwo wa mtsanga na vidzidzi vya pwani, na mara nyinji nkuphandwa. Pwani ya kusini, uhendze kanda-kanda ya nyuma ya ufuwo na vidzidzini phephi na bahari, ambapho makodzage mapana ga dzulu ganahenda pepho ya kusagala.

uses.en:
The oil pressed from the seed has been used as lamp oil, in medicine and in cosmetics.

The tree is planted for shade, and its timber is used to build boats.
uses.sw:
Mafuta yanayokamuliwa kutoka kwenye mbegu yametumika kama mafuta ya taa, katika dawa na katika vipodozi.

Mti hupandwa kwa ajili ya kivuli, na mbao zake hutumika kujenga vyombo vya bahari.
uses.dg:
Mafuha ganayominywa kula kpwa tembe gakahumirwa dza mafuha ga taa, kpwa dawa na kpwa vitu vya kudzipamba.

Muhi nkuphandwa kpwa sababu ya pephoye, na mbaoze nkuhumirwa kudzenga madau.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtondoro*. In Swahili it is *mtondoo*. In English it is the Alexandrian laurel or beauty leaf, and its scientific name is *Calophyllum inophyllum*. Note that *mtondoo* is also the Digo name of a different plant, the snuff-box tree.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtondoro*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtondoo*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *Alexandrian laurel* au *beauty leaf*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Calophyllum inophyllum*. Kumbuka kwamba *mtondoo* pia ni jina la Kidigo la mmea mwingine kabisa, *snuff-box tree*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtondoro*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtondoo*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *Alexandrian laurel* au *beauty leaf*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Calophyllum inophyllum*. Ela manya kukala *mtondoo* piya ni dzina ra Chidigo ra mmea wanjina, *snuff-box tree*.

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa kivuli wa pwani unaotumika kwa mbao za vyombo
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa pepho wa kanda-kanda ya bahari unaohumirwa kudzenga madau

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa pwani wenye maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa kanda-kanda ya bahari wenye maruwa mereru genye arufu nono

reason.en: Shares the beach tops and village shade
reason.sw: Hushiriki sehemu za juu za ufuo na kivuli cha vijijini
reason.dg: Unamera phamwenga na uhu dzulu ya ufuwo, na unalavya pepho vidzidzini

reason.en: Shares its Swahili name with this Digo plant name
reason.sw: Jina lake la Kiswahili ni sawa na jina hili la Kidigo la mmea mwingine
reason.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo ni dzina ra Chiswahili ra *mtondoro*

digo_source: ICRAF Useful Trees ('Digo: Mukungu'); Mgombato ('mkungu ... Indian almond'); Pakia 2005 ('Mkungu')
english: Indian almond, bastard almond, tropical almond

teaser.en: Its giant leaves wrap food, its nuts taste of almond, and before falling the leaves turn a flaming red.
teaser.sw: Majani yake makubwa mno hufungia chakula, kokwa zake zina ladha ya lozi, na kabla ya kupukutika majani hugeuka mekundu kama moto.
teaser.dg: Makodzage makulu sana nkufungira vyakurya, vitsavye vina ladha ya *almond*, na kabla ya kugbwa makodza ganakala ga kundu dza moho.

summary.en: *Mukungu*, the Indian almond, is a tiered shade tree of beaches, village squares and Diani roadsides. Its kernels are eaten, its huge leaves wrap food, and its red wood builds boats.
summary.sw: *Mukungu*, au mkungu, ni mti wa kivuli wenye matawi ya ngazi-ngazi unaopatikana fukweni, viwanjani vya vijiji na kando ya barabara za Diani. Kokwa zake huliwa, majani yake makubwa mno hufungia chakula, na mbao zake nyekundu hujengea vyombo vya bahari.
summary.dg: *Mukungu* (*Indian almond* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi wa pepho wenye panda za ngazi-ngazi, unaophahikana kanda-kanda ya ufuwo, kahi-kahi ya vidzidzi na kanda-kanda ya njira za Diani. Vitsavye nkuriwa, makodzage makulu sana nkufungira vyakurya, na mbaoze za kundu nkuhumirwa kudzenga madau.

about.en:
*Mukungu* grows its branches in flat, horizontal tiers, one above the other like the floors of a pagoda, which makes a wide, layered canopy of shade. Its leaves are huge and broad, wider at the tip than at the base. Before they fall, they turn brilliant red and orange, one of the few touches of autumn colour on the coast.

The fruit is almond-shaped, green and then yellow or reddish as it ripens, with a fibrous husk around a hard shell. Inside is a small kernel that tastes like almond. The fruits float and spread from beach to beach on the sea.
about.sw:
*Mukungu* huotesha matawi yake katika ngazi bapa za mlalo, moja juu ya nyingine kama ghorofa za pagoda, na hivyo kuunda dari pana la kivuli lenye tabaka. Majani yake ni makubwa mno na mapana, mapana zaidi kwenye ncha kuliko kwenye kikonyo. Kabla ya kupukutika hugeuka mekundu na machungwa angavu, mojawapo ya dalili chache za rangi za msimu wa kupukutika majani pwani.

Tunda lina umbo la lozi, la kijani kisha la manjano au jekundu linapoiva, lenye ganda la nyuzi linalozunguka kifuu kigumu. Ndani kuna kokwa dogo lenye ladha ya lozi. Matunda haya huelea na kusambaa kutoka ufuo mmoja hadi mwingine kupitia bahari.
about.dg:
Panda za *mukungu* zinamera sambamba na tsi, ngazi-ngazi, mwenga dzulu ya yanjina dza ghorofa za *pagoda*, na zinahenda pepho pana ya ngazi-ngazi. Makodzage ni makulu sana na mapana, mapana zaidi kpwenye ntsa kuriko kpwenye mlita. Kabla ya kugbwa ganakala ga kundu kali na ga rangi ya chungbwa; ni mwenga wa mihi michache ya pwani inayoonyesa rangi dza za mihi ya tsi za mnyevu wakati wa *autumn*.

Tunda rina umbo ra *almond*, ra chijani, chisha richiivwa rinakala ra rangi ya mandano au ra kundu chidide, na rina gada ra kondze ra nyuzi-nyuzi kuzunguluka gada ra ndani gumu. Ndani kuna chitsa chidide chenye ladha dza ya *almond*. Matunda ganaelea, na ganaenea kula ufuwo mwenga hadi wanjina kpwa bahari.

where.en: It is planted and naturalised along beaches, in village squares and along the roadsides of Diani. Its tiered shape and red leaves make it easy to spot almost anywhere near the shore.
where.sw: Hupandwa na umejiotea kando ya fukwe, katika viwanja vya vijiji na kando ya barabara za Diani. Umbo lake la ngazi-ngazi na majani yake mekundu hurahisisha kuuona karibu popote karibu na ufuo.
where.dg: Ukaphandwa, na sambi unamera wenye kanda-kanda ya ufuwo, kahi-kahi ya vidzidzi na kanda-kanda ya njira za Diani. Umbore ra ngazi-ngazi na makodzage ga kundu ganahenda ukale rahisi kuuona phephi phosi na bahari.

uses.en:
The kernel is eaten raw or roasted and has an almond taste. Cracking the hard shell takes patience, and children often do it with a stone.

The large leaves are used as food wrappers, as the Mgombato dictionary notes. The tree is planted for shade, and its red timber is used for boats. Bark, leaves and fruit husks give tannin and dye, and the tree helps to stabilise dunes.
uses.sw:
Kokwa huliwa mbichi au likiwa limechomwa, na lina ladha ya lozi. Kuvunja kifuu kigumu kunahitaji subira, na mara nyingi watoto hukivunja kwa jiwe.

Majani makubwa hutumika kufungia chakula, kama kamusi ya Mgombato inavyoeleza. Mti hupandwa kwa ajili ya kivuli, na mbao zake nyekundu hutumika kwa vyombo vya bahari. Gome, majani na maganda ya matunda hutoa tanini na rangi, na mti husaidia kuimarisha matuta ya mchanga.
uses.dg:
Chitsa nkuriwa bila kujitwa au nkuochwa, na china ladha ya *almond*. Kuvundza gada gumu kunahitaji subira, na ana mara nyinji nkuhenda hivyo kpwa dziwe.

Makodza makulu nkuhumirwa kufungira vyakurya, dza kamusi ya Mgombato inavyoandika. Muhi nkuphandwa kpwa pepho, na mbaoze za kundu nkuhumirwa kudzenga madau. Gopha, makodza na magada ga matunda vinalavya tanini na rangi, na muhi unaterya kugbwira vidzango vya mtsanga.

culture.en: According to Pakia, the name refers to the pleasant aroma (*kungu*) of the fruit. The tree also lends its name to the beach gardenia, *mkungu wa pwani*, 'the *mkungu* of the seaside'.
culture.sw: Kwa mujibu wa Pakia, jina hili linarejelea harufu nzuri (*kungu*) ya tunda. Mti huu pia umeazimisha jina lake kwa *mkungu wa pwani* (*beach gardenia*), yaani '*mkungu* wa pwani'.
culture.dg: Dza Pakia anavyogomba, dzina rinaonyesa arufu nono (*kungu*) ya tunda. Muhi uhu piya ukapha *beach gardenia* dzinare, *mkungu wa pwani*, '*mkungu* wa kanda-kanda ya bahari'.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook writes the Digo name as *mukungu*; the Mgombato dictionary and Pakia write *mkungu*, which is also the Swahili and Giriama name. In English it is the Indian almond, bastard almond or tropical almond, and its scientific name is *Terminalia catappa*.
names.sw: Kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF kinaandika jina la Kidigo kama *mukungu*; kamusi ya Mgombato na Pakia wanaandika *mkungu*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili na la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *Indian almond*, *bastard almond* au *tropical almond*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Terminalia catappa*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mukungu*; Mgombato na Pakia anaandika *mkungu*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili na ra Chigiryama. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *Indian almond*, *bastard almond* au *tropical almond*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Terminalia catappa*.

digo_source: Pakia 2005 Appendix III and loanword table ('Mvinde' from Swahili mvinje)
english: Whistling pine, beach she-oak, horsetail tree

teaser.en: Stand under one on a windy day at Diani and you will hear why it is called the whistling pine.
teaser.sw: Simama chini yake siku yenye upepo huko Diani na utasikia kwa nini kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *whistling pine*, 'msonobari unaopiga mluzi'.
teaser.dg: Ima photsize siku ya phepho uchikala Diani, nawe undasikira sababu unaoihwa *whistling pine*.

summary.en: *Mvinde*, the whistling pine, is a fast-growing introduced tree with drooping, needle-like twigs, planted on beaches, dunes and in woodlots. It supplies poles, firewood and charcoal, and is promoted as a way to take pressure off the mangroves.
summary.sw: *Mvinde*, au mvinje, ni mti ulioletwa kutoka nje unaokua haraka, wenye vitawi vinavyoning'inia kama sindano, unaopandwa kwenye fukwe, matuta ya mchanga na mashamba ya miti. Hutoa nguzo, kuni na mkaa, na unahimizwa kama njia ya kupunguza shinikizo kwa mikoko.
summary.dg: *Mvinde* ni muhi mjeni unaokula haraka, wenye vigongo vyembamba dza sindano vinavyogbwadzika. Nkuphandwa ufuwoni, kpwenye vilima vya mtsanga na kpwenye mashamba ga mihi. Unalavya nguzo, kuni na makala, na unatogolwa dza njira ya kupunguza mzigo kpwenye mikoko.

about.en:
*Mvinde* looks like a pine but is not one. What seem to be needles are thin, jointed green twigs, drooping in soft tassels; the true leaves are tiny scales at each joint. When the wind blows through the crown, the twigs make a soft whistling or sighing sound.

The tree grows fast, tall and straight. Its small woody cones, the size of a marble, litter the ground beneath it, along with a carpet of fallen twigs.
about.sw:
*Mvinde* unafanana na msonobari lakini si msonobari. Kinachoonekana kuwa sindano ni vitawi vyembamba vya kijani vyenye vifundo, vinavyoning'inia kama vishada laini; majani halisi ni magamba madogo sana kwenye kila kifundo. Upepo unapovuma kupitia taji lake, vitawi hutoa sauti laini ya mluzi au ya kuhema.

Mti huu hukua haraka, mrefu na umenyooka. Koni zake ndogo ngumu kama mbao, za ukubwa wa gololi, hutapakaa ardhini chini yake, pamoja na zulia la vitawi vilivyoanguka.
about.dg:
*Mvinde* unaonekana dza *pine* ela si *pine*. Vira vinavyoonekana dza sindano kpwa kpweli ni vigongo vyembamba vya chijani vyenye viungo, vinavyogbwadzika dza vishada laini; makodza ga kpweli ni magamba madide sana kpwenye chila chiungo. Phepho richitsupa kahi ya dariye, vigongo vinahenda sauti ya pore ya milozi au ya mseho.

Muhi hinyu unakula haraka, mure na wa chocho. Matundage madide ga mbao, sawa na sokota, ganatawanyika photsize phamwenga na vigongo virivyogbwa vinavyofwinika photsi dza jamvi.

where.en: It is an introduced tree, planted on beaches and dunes at places such as Diani and Tiwi, and in woodlots. Its feathery, grey-green silhouette is easy to pick out along the beachfront.
where.sw: Ni mti ulioletwa kutoka nje, unaopandwa kwenye fukwe na matuta ya mchanga katika maeneo kama Diani na Tiwi, na katika mashamba ya miti. Umbo lake la rangi ya kijani-kijivu linalofanana na manyoya ni rahisi kulitambua kando ya ufuo.
where.dg: Ni muhi mjeni, unaophandwa ufuwoni na kpwenye vilima vya mtsanga phatu dza Diani na Tiwi, na kpwenye mashamba ga mihi. Suraye ya rangi ya ivu na chijani, dza nyoya, ni rahisi kuiona kanda-kanda ya ufuwo.

uses.en:
*Mvinde* gives poles for house building, firewood that burns very well, and charcoal. It has also been used for dhow masts. Planted in rows, it serves as a windbreak and holds sand dunes in place.

Because it grows fast and straight, woodlots of *mvinde* have been proposed as a source of poles and fuel to take pressure off the mangroves.
uses.sw:
*Mvinde* hutoa nguzo za kujengea nyumba, kuni zinazowaka vizuri sana, na mkaa. Pia umetumika kwa milingoti ya majahazi. Ukipandwa kwa safu, hutumika kuzuia upepo na kushikilia matuta ya mchanga yasihame.

Kwa sababu hukua haraka na kunyooka, mashamba ya *mvinde* yamependekezwa kama chanzo cha nguzo na nishati ili kupunguza shinikizo kwa mikoko.
uses.dg:
*Mvinde* unalavya nguzo za kudzengera nyumba, kuni zinazoaka vinono sana, na makala. Piya ukahumirwa kuhenda milingoti ya majahazi. Uchiphandwa kpwa mistari, unazuwiya phepho na unagbwira vilima vya mtsanga visiuke.

Kpwa sababu unakula haraka na wa chocho, mashamba ga *mvinde* gakatogolwa dza chanzo cha nguzo na kuni, ili kupunguza mzigo kpwenye mikoko.

culture.en: Its name is borrowed: Pakia lists *mvinde* among the Digo words taken from Swahili, from *mvinje*. Pakia also lists *ruwa*, an ornamental use of the tree.
culture.sw: Jina lake ni la kukopwa: Pakia anaorodhesha *mvinde* miongoni mwa maneno ya Kidigo yaliyochukuliwa kutoka Kiswahili, kutoka *mvinje*. Pakia pia anaorodhesha *ruwa*, matumizi ya mti huu kwa urembo.
culture.dg: Dzinare ni ra kukopwa: Pakia anaandika *mvinde* kahi ya maneno ga Chidigo garigohalwa kula Chiswahili, kula *mvinje*. Pakia piya anaandika *ruwa*, matumizi ga muhi hinyu ga kupamba.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mvinde*, also *mkasuarina*, from the scientific name. *Mvinde* is borrowed from the Swahili *mvinje*. In English it is the whistling pine, beach she-oak or horsetail tree, and its scientific name is *Casuarina equisetifolia*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mvinde*, pia *mkasuarina*, kutokana na jina la kisayansi. *Mvinde* limekopwa kutoka Kiswahili *mvinje*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *whistling pine*, *beach she-oak* au *horsetail tree*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Casuarina equisetifolia*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mvinde*, piya *mkasuarina*, kula dzina ra chisayansi. *Mvinde* rikahalwa kula Chiswahili *mvinje*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *whistling pine*, *beach she-oak* au *horsetail tree*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Casuarina equisetifolia*.

conservation.en: It is an introduced tree. The Vanga Blue Forest plan promotes it as an alternative source of fuel and poles to protect the mangroves.
conservation.sw: Ni mti ulioletwa kutoka nje. Mpango wa Vanga Blue Forest unauhimiza kama chanzo mbadala cha nishati na nguzo ili kulinda mikoko.
conservation.dg: Ni muhi mjeni. Mpango wa Vanga Blue Forest unautogola dza chanzo chanjina cha kuni na nguzo ili kurinda mikoko.

reason.sw: Mashamba ya mvinde yanalenga kuokoa nguzo za mikoko

teaser.en: A flowering plant that lives its whole life underwater, it feeds dugongs and shelters the fish that Digo fishers catch.
teaser.sw: Ni mmea unaotoa maua na kuishi maisha yake yote chini ya maji; huwalisha nguva na kuwahifadhi samaki wanaovuliwa na wavuvi wa Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Ni mmea wenye maruwa unaokala ndani ya madzi maishage gosi; unarisa nguva na unafitsa ng'onda ambao avuvi a Chidigo anaagbwira.

summary.en: Narrowleaf seagrass is a true flowering plant that lives fully submerged in the sea, forming meadows on the intertidal sand flats. These meadows feed dugongs and turtles and shelter the fish, octopus and sea cucumbers on which coastal fishing depends.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari hii yenye majani membamba (*narrowleaf seagrass*) ni mmea halisi unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa baharini, ukiunda mbuga kwenye nyanda za mchanga zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji. Mbuga hizi huwalisha nguva na kasa na huwahifadhi samaki, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao uvuvi wa pwani unawategemea.
summary.dg: *Narrowleaf seagrass* ni mmea wa kpweli wenye maruwa unaokala ndani ya bahari kabisa, unaomera phamwenga phatu phanji kpwenye mtsanga unaofwinikpwa ni madzi wakati wa madzi ga kuodzala na unaosala wazi wakati wa madzi ga kala. Phatu phenye nyasi hizi phanarisa nguva na kasa, na phanafitsa ng'onda, pweza na majongoo ga bahari ambao uvuvi wa pwani unaakuluphira.

about.en:
Despite its name, seagrass is not a seaweed. It is a flowering plant, with roots, leaves and tiny flowers, that has adapted to living completely underwater. Narrowleaf seagrass has very thin, flat, ribbon-like leaves, only a millimetre or two wide, growing from creeping stems buried in the sand.

Where it grows thickly, it forms soft green meadows that sway in the current.
about.sw:
Licha ya jina lake, nyasi bahari si mwani. Ni mmea unaotoa maua, wenye mizizi, majani na maua madogo sana, ambao umejizoesha kuishi ukiwa chini ya maji kabisa. Nyasi bahari hii ina majani membamba sana, bapa na kama riboni, yenye upana wa milimita moja au mbili tu, yanayoota kutoka kwenye mashina yanayotambaa yaliyofukiwa mchangani.

Pale inapoota kwa wingi, huunda mbuga laini za kijani zinazoyumba katika mkondo wa maji.
about.dg:
Hata dzinare rina 'nyasi', nyasi ya bahari si mwani. Ni mmea wenye maruwa, wenye mizi, makodza na maruwa madide sana, unaoweza kukala ndani ya madzi kabisa. *Narrowleaf seagrass* ina makodza membamba sana dza utepe, ga upana wa milimita mwenga au mbiri tu, ganayomera kula kpwa mihi inayoambala iriyozikpwa mtsangani.

Phatu inaphomera nyinji, inahenda phatu phenye nyasi laini za chijani zinazosumba ni madzi ganayotsupa.

where.en: It grows on the intertidal sand flats, where it is often exposed at the lowest tides. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. Walk out across the flats at a spring low tide and you will see it carpeting the sand in shallow pools.
where.sw: Huota kwenye nyanda za mchanga zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji, ambapo mara nyingi huachwa wazi wakati wa maji kupwa kabisa. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Tembea kwenye nyanda wakati wa bamvua la maji kupwa na utaiona ikitandika mchanga katika vidimbwi visivyo na kina.
where.dg: Inamera kpwenye mtsanga unaofwinikpwa ni madzi wakati wa madzi ga kuodzala, ambao mara nyinji unasala wazi wakati wa madzi ga kala sana. Nyasi za bahari zinazunguluka kanda-kanda ya Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Nyendeka kpwenye mtsanga uho wakati wa madzi ga kala sana, na undaiona ichifwinika mtsanga phatu madzi machache ganaphosala.

uses.en: Seagrass meadows are nurseries and feeding grounds for the fish and animals that Digo fishers depend on: rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers. The meadows also trap sediment, keeping the water clear and helping to protect beaches.
uses.sw: Mbuga za nyasi bahari ni malezi na malisho ya samaki na wanyama ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea: tafi, pono, pweza na majongoo bahari. Mbuga hizo pia hunasa mashapo, na hivyo kuweka maji safi na kusaidia kulinda fukwe.
uses.dg: Phatu phenye nyasi hizi ni phatu pha kukulira na pha kurya pha ng'onda na nyama ambao avuvi a Chidigo anaakuluphira: tsafi, phono, pweza na majongoo ga bahari. Piya zinagbwira mtsanga na ulongo unaohalwa ni madzi, zinahenda madzi gasale safi, na zinaterya kurinda ufuwo.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili speakers usually call sea plants in general *mwani*. In English it is narrowleaf seagrass, and its scientific name is *Halodule uninervis*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kwa kawaida huita mimea ya baharini kwa jumla *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *narrowleaf seagrass*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Halodule uninervis*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Atu anaogomba Chiswahili kpwa kawaida anaiha mimea yosi ya bahari *mwani*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *narrowleaf seagrass*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Halodule uninervis*.

conservation.en: The seagrass meadows of Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni are feeding grounds for dugongs, green turtles and rabbitfish, and nurseries for young fish. This is a favoured dugong food.
conservation.sw: Mbuga za nyasi bahari za Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni malisho ya nguva, kasa na tafi, na malezi ya samaki wachanga. Hiki ni chakula kinachopendwa sana na nguva.
conservation.dg: Nyasi za bahari za Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni phatu pha kurya pha nguva, kasa a chijani na tsafi, na ni phatu pha kukulira ng'onda adide. Ni chakurya chinachomendzwa ni nguva.

teaser.en: Its leaves are perfectly round, like strands of spaghetti waving under the sea.
teaser.sw: Majani yake ni ya mviringo kamili, kama nyuzi za tambi zinazopepea chini ya bahari.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ni ga mviringo kamili, dza tambi zinazosumba ndani ya bahari.

summary.en: Noodle seagrass is a flowering plant of shallow subtidal sand, easy to know by its round, spaghetti-like leaves. Like other seagrasses, its meadows shelter the fish and octopus that coastal fishers rely on.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari ya tambi (*noodle seagrass*) ni mmea unaotoa maua wa mchanga usio na kina ulio chini ya maji kupwa, na ni rahisi kuitambua kwa majani yake ya mviringo kama tambi. Kama nyasi bahari nyingine, mbuga zake huwahifadhi samaki na pweza ambao wavuvi wa pwani wanawategemea.
summary.dg: *Noodle seagrass* ni mmea wenye maruwa wa mtsanga wa madzi machache usiosala wazi, na ni rahisi kuimanya kpwa makodzage ga mviringo dza tambi. Dza nyasi zanjina za bahari, phatu inaphomera nyinji phanafitsa ng'onda na pweza ambao avuvi a pwani anaakuluphira.

about.en: Noodle seagrass is a true flowering plant that lives fully submerged in the sea. Unlike most seagrasses, which have flat leaves, its leaves are round in cross-section, thin and smooth like strands of spaghetti or noodles. They grow in tufts from creeping stems in the sand and can form dense, waving meadows.
about.sw: Nyasi bahari ya tambi ni mmea halisi unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa baharini. Tofauti na nyasi bahari nyingi, zenye majani bapa, majani yake ni ya mviringo yakikatwa, membamba na laini kama nyuzi za tambi. Huota kama mashungi kutoka kwenye mashina yanayotambaa mchangani na yanaweza kuunda mbuga zilizosongamana zinazopepea.
about.dg: *Noodle seagrass* ni mmea wa kpweli wenye maruwa unaokala ndani ya bahari kabisa. Nyasi zinji za bahari zina makodza dza utepe, ela makodza ga nyasi hino ni ga mviringo uchigakata, membamba na malaini dza tambi. Ganamera kpwa mafungu kula kpwa mihi inayoambala mtsangani, na inaweza kuhenda phatu phenye nyasi nyinji zirizobanana zinazosumba.

where.en: It grows on shallow subtidal sand, just below the lowest tides, so it is usually covered by water. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. Snorkellers in the lagoons see it best, its noodle-like leaves drifting in the current.
where.sw: Huota kwenye mchanga usio na kina ulio chini kidogo ya maji kupwa kabisa, hivyo kwa kawaida hufunikwa na maji. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Wanaopiga mbizi kwa kutumia mrija katika mahori ndio huiona vizuri zaidi, majani yake kama tambi yakielea katika mkondo.
where.dg: Inamera kpwenye mtsanga wa madzi machache, photsi tu ya madzi ga kala sana, kpwa hivyo kpwa kawaida inafwinikpwa ni madzi. Nyasi za bahari zinazunguluka kanda-kanda ya Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Atu anaoojorera kpwenye madzi machache ga bahari ndio anaoiona vinono zaidi, makodzage dza tambi ganasumba ni madzi ganayotsupa.

uses.en: Its meadows are habitat for the rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers that Digo fishers depend on. The meadows also trap sediment and help to protect beaches.

teaser.en: Its flowers open yellow like a hibiscus in the morning and fade to purple by evening.
teaser.sw: Maua yake huchanua asubuhi yakiwa ya manjano kama ya haibiskasi, na kufikia jioni hufifia kuwa ya zambarau.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ganavuguka ligundzu ga rangi ya mandano dza ga *hibiscus*, na ichifika dziloni ganakala ga zambarau.

summary.en: The portia tree is a small evergreen tree of beach tops and mangrove edges, with heart-shaped leaves and yellow hibiscus flowers that turn purple. It gives timber, fibre and shade.
summary.sw: Mtakawa ni mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani wa sehemu za juu za ufuo na kingo za mikoko, wenye majani yenye umbo la moyo na maua ya manjano kama ya haibiskasi yanayogeuka zambarau. Hutoa mbao, nyuzi na kivuli.
summary.dg: *Portia tree* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati wa dzulu ya ufuwo na kanda-kanda ya mikoko, wenye makodza ga umbo ra moyo na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano dza ga *hibiscus* ganayogaluka zambarau. Unalavya mbao, nyuzi na pepho.

about.en:
The portia tree is a small evergreen tree with a dense crown of glossy, heart-shaped leaves on long stalks. Its flowers look like those of a hibiscus, to which it is related: cup-shaped, pale yellow with a dark red centre. Each flower lasts about a day, turning from yellow to pink and purple as it ages.

The fruit is a round, flattened capsule that dries brown and stays on the tree for a long time.
about.sw:
Mtakawa ni mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani wenye kilele kilichosongamana cha majani yanayong'aa yenye umbo la moyo na vikonyo virefu. Maua yake yanafanana na ya haibiskasi, ambayo ni ndugu yake: yana umbo la kikombe, ni ya manjano hafifu yenye kitovu chekundu kilichokolea. Kila ua hudumu takriban siku moja, likigeuka kutoka manjano hadi waridi na zambarau linapozeeka.

Tunda ni kibuyu cha mviringo kilichobapa ambacho hukauka na kuwa cha kahawia na hubaki juu ya mti kwa muda mrefu.
about.dg:
*Portia tree* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, na makodza manji ga dzulu ganayong'ala, ga umbo ra moyo, dzulu ya milita mire. Maruwage ganahalana na ga *hibiscus*, nduguye: ni ga umbo ra chikombe, ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, na kahi-kahi ni ga kundu sana. Chila ruwa rinakaa siku mwenga hivi, na rinagaluka kula rangi ya mandano hadi pinki na zambarau kadiri siku zinavyotsupa.

Tunda ni kakaya ra mviringo na ribamba, rinarouma na kukala ra rangi ya dongo, na rinakaa dzulu ya muhi muda mure.

where.en: It grows on beach tops and on the edges of mangroves, where it can tolerate salt spray and occasional flooding. Look for its heart-shaped leaves and yellow flowers at the back of the beach or where the mangroves meet dry land.
where.sw: Huota juu ya fukwe na kwenye kingo za mikoko, ambapo unaweza kustahimili manyunyu ya chumvi na mafuriko ya mara moja moja. Utayaona majani yake yenye umbo la moyo na maua ya manjano nyuma ya ufuo au pale mikoko inapokutana na nchi kavu.
where.dg: Unamera dzulu ya ufuwo na kanda-kanda ya mikoko, ambapho unaweza kuvumirira madzi ga bahari ganayotsukulwa ni phepho na madzi ganayoufwinika wakati wanjina. Uhendze makodzage ga umbo ra moyo na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano nyuma ya ufuwo, au phatu mikoko inaphomala na tsi kavu inaphoandza.

names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtakawa*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *portia tree* au *Indian tulip tree*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Thespesia populnea*.

about.en: Round-tipped seagrass is not a seaweed but a true flowering plant, with roots, creeping stems and flat, strap-like leaves. As its name says, the leaf tips are smoothly rounded, which helps to tell it from its neighbours. The leaves grow in small bunches from stems buried in the sand, forming low, dense meadows.

Kama jina lake la Kiingereza linavyosema, ncha za majani ni za mviringo laini, jambo linalosaidia kuitofautisha na nyasi bahari jirani. Majani huota katika mafungu madogo kutoka kwenye mashina yaliyofukiwa mchangani, yakiunda mbuga fupi zilizosongamana.

Dza dzinare rinavyogomba, ntsa za makodza ni za mviringo laini, na ichi chinaterya kuitafwautisha na nyasi zanjina zinazomera phephi nayo. Makodza ganamera kpwa mafungu madide kula kpwa mihi iriyozikpwa mtsangani, na inahenda phatu phenye nyasi fupi zirizobanana.

teaser.en: Unlike most seagrasses, it grows woody stems that rise from the seabed, carrying fans of curved leaves like little underwater palms.
teaser.sw: Tofauti na nyasi bahari nyingi, huotesha mashina magumu kama mti yanayoinuka kutoka sakafu ya bahari, yakibeba mapepeo ya majani yaliyopinda kama minazi midogo chini ya maji.
teaser.dg: Si dza nyasi zinji za bahari, ihi inamera mihi migumu dza ya muhi inayoima kula tsini ya bahari, na dzulu kuna makodza ganayootyoka ganayoenea dza chiphephero, dza mihi midide ya jamii ya minazi ndani ya madzi.

summary.en: Sickle-leaved seagrass is one of the two most common seagrasses in Kenya, forming dense meadows on the sandy and rocky floors of the lagoons. Its meadows shelter the fish and octopus that coastal fishers rely on.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari hii yenye majani kama mundu (*sickle-leaved seagrass*) ni mojawapo ya nyasi bahari mbili zinazopatikana kwa wingi zaidi nchini Kenya, ikiunda mbuga zilizosongamana kwenye sakafu za mchanga na miamba za mahori. Mbuga zake huwahifadhi samaki na pweza ambao wavuvi wa pwani wanawategemea.
summary.dg: *Sickle-leaved seagrass* ni mwenga kahi ya nyasi mbiri za bahari zinazophahikana zaidi Kenya, na inahenda phatu phenye nyasi nyinji zirizobanana kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga na ya mawe ya madzi machache ga bahari. Phatu phenye nyasi hizi phanafitsa ng'onda na pweza ambao avuvi a pwani anaakuluphira.

about.en:
Sickle-leaved seagrass is a flowering plant that lives fully submerged in the sea. It is sturdier than most seagrasses: tough, woody stems rise from the seabed, each topped with a fan of flat, curved leaves shaped like a sickle. A meadow of it looks like a tiny underwater forest of palms.

Its strong roots and creeping rhizomes can grip rock as well as sand, so it can grow where other seagrasses cannot.
about.sw:
Nyasi bahari hii yenye majani kama mundu ni mmea unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa baharini. Ni imara zaidi kuliko nyasi bahari nyingi: mashina magumu kama mti huinuka kutoka sakafu ya bahari, kila moja likiwa na pepeo la majani bapa yaliyopinda kama mundu juu yake. Mbuga yake inaonekana kama msitu mdogo wa mimea ya jamii ya mnazi chini ya maji.

Mizizi yake imara na viazi (mashina ya chini ya ardhi) vyake vinavyotambaa vinaweza kushika mwamba pamoja na mchanga, hivyo inaweza kuota mahali ambapo nyasi bahari nyingine haziwezi.
about.dg:
*Sickle-leaved seagrass* ni mmea wenye maruwa unaokala ndani ya bahari kabisa. Ina nguvu kuriko nyasi zinji za bahari: mihi migumu dza ya muhi inaima kula tsini ya bahari, na kpwenye ntsa ya chila muhi kuna makodza dza utepe ganayootyoka, ganayoenea dza chiphephero, ga umbo ra mundu (*sickle*). Phatu phenye nyasi hino phanaonekana dza tsaka dide ra mihi ya jamii ya minazi ndani ya madzi.

Miziye yenye nguvu na mihi inayoambala tsini ya mtsanga inaweza kugbwira mawe na mtsanga, kpwa hivyo inaweza kumera phatu nyasi zanjina zisiphoweza.

where.en: It forms dense meadows on sandy and rocky lagoon bottoms and is one of the two predominant seagrasses on the Kenyan coast. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. It usually stays under water, so snorkellers in the lagoons see it best.
where.sw: Huunda mbuga zilizosongamana kwenye sakafu za mchanga na miamba za mahori na ni mojawapo ya nyasi bahari mbili zinazotawala katika pwani ya Kenya. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Kwa kawaida hubaki chini ya maji, hivyo wanaopiga mbizi kwa kutumia mrija katika mahori ndio huiona vizuri zaidi.
where.dg: Inahenda phatu phenye nyasi nyinji zirizobanana kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga na ya mawe ya madzi machache ga bahari, na ni mwenga kahi ya nyasi mbiri za bahari zinazophahikana zaidi pwani ya Kenya. Nyasi za bahari zinazunguluka kanda-kanda ya Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Kpwa kawaida inasala ndani ya madzi, kpwa hivyo atu anaoojorera kpwenye madzi machache ga bahari ndio anaoiona vinono zaidi.

uses.en: Its meadows are habitat for the rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers that Digo fishers depend on. They also trap sediment and help to protect beaches.
uses.sw: Mbuga zake ni makazi ya tafi, pono, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea. Pia hunasa mashapo na kusaidia kulinda fukwe.
uses.dg: Phatu phenye nyasi hizi ni makalo ga tsafi, phono, pweza na majongoo ga bahari ambao avuvi a Chidigo anaakuluphira. Piya zinagbwira mtsanga na ulongo unaohalwa ni madzi, na zinaterya kurinda ufuwo.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili speakers usually call sea plants in general *mwani*. In English it is sickle-leaved seagrass, and its scientific name is *Thalassodendron ciliatum*, which means 'sea tree'.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kwa kawaida huita mimea ya baharini kwa jumla *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *sickle-leaved seagrass*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Thalassodendron ciliatum*, lenye maana ya 'mti wa bahari'.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Atu anaogomba Chiswahili kpwa kawaida anaiha mimea yosi ya bahari *mwani*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *sickle-leaved seagrass*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Thalassodendron ciliatum*, rinalomaanisha 'muhi wa bahari'.

teaser.en: At Kibuyuni, women who were traditionally kept from fishing now farm the sea, and turn their seaweed into soap, lotion and juice.
teaser.sw: Huko Kibuyuni, wanawake ambao kwa desturi walizuiwa kuvua samaki sasa hulima bahari, na hugeuza mwani wao kuwa sabuni, losheni na sharubati.
teaser.dg: Kibuyuni, achetu ambao kpwa mila kala taaruhusiwa kuvuwa ng'onda, sambi anarima bahari, na mwani wao anauhenda sabuni, mafuha ga kupaka mwiri na juisi.

summary.en: Spinosum is a spiny red-brown seaweed farmed in the shallow lagoons of the south coast, mostly by women. Dried and sold for carrageenan, or made into soaps and lotions, it has become an important source of income at Kibuyuni near Shimoni.
summary.sw: *Spinosum* ni mwani wenye miba wa rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu unaolimwa katika mahori yasiyo na kina ya pwani ya kusini, hasa na wanawake. Ukikaushwa na kuuzwa kwa ajili ya *carrageenan*, au ukitengenezwa sabuni na losheni, umekuwa chanzo muhimu cha kipato huko Kibuyuni karibu na Shimoni.
summary.dg: *Spinosum* ni mwani wenye miya, wa rangi ya kundu na dongo, unaorimwa zaidi ni achetu kpwenye madzi machache ga bahari, pwani ya kusini. Unaanikpwa na kuguzwa kpwa sababu ya *carrageenan*, au unahendwa sabuni na mafuha ga kupaka mwiri, na ukakala njira muhimu ya kuphahira pesa Kibuyuni, phephi na Shimoni.

about.en: Spinosum is a red alga, not a true plant, with branching stems that are red-brown and covered in short spines. It grows quickly from small cuttings, and a farmer can harvest it about every six weeks. It is rich in carrageenan, a natural gel used to thicken foods and cosmetics.
about.sw: *Spinosum* ni mwani mwekundu, si mmea halisi, wenye mashina yenye matawi ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu yaliyofunikwa na miba mifupi. Hukua haraka kutoka kwenye vipandikizi vidogo, na mkulima anaweza kuuvuna takriban kila wiki sita. Una *carrageenan* nyingi, jeli ya asili inayotumika kuongeza uzito wa vyakula na vipodozi.
about.dg: *Spinosum* ni mwani wa kundu, si mmea wa kpweli. Una panda nyinji za rangi ya kundu na dongo, zenye miya mifupi chila phatu. Unamera upesi kula kpwa vigoda vidide, na mkurima anaweza kuuvuna chila bada ya wiki sita hivi. Una *carrageenan* nyinji, chitu cha luhe cha asili chinachohumirwa kuhenda vyakurya na vitu vya kudzipamba vikale viziho.

where.en: It is farmed on off-bottom lines and stakes in the shallow lagoons at Kibuyuni near Shimoni and in other south-coast villages. The Kenya Marine and Fisheries Research Institute (KMFRI) has run a model farm there since 2012. At low tide, the rows of stakes and ropes are easy to see from the shore.
where.sw: Hulimwa kwenye kamba na vigingi vilivyoinuliwa juu ya sakafu katika mahori yasiyo na kina huko Kibuyuni karibu na Shimoni na katika vijiji vingine vya pwani ya kusini. Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Bahari na Uvuvi ya Kenya (KMFRI) imeendesha shamba la mfano huko tangu 2012. Wakati wa maji kupwa, safu za vigingi na kamba huonekana kwa urahisi kutoka ufuoni.
where.dg: Unarimwa kpwenye kamba zinazofungbwa kpwa mihi midide zisigute tsini ya bahari, kpwenye madzi machache Kibuyuni phephi na Shimoni, na kpwenye vidzidzi vyanjina vya pwani ya kusini. Kenya Marine and Fisheries Research Institute (KMFRI) ina munda wa mfwano phara kula mwaka wa 2012. Wakati wa madzi ga kala, misitari ya mihi midide na kamba ni rahisi kuiona kula ufuwoni.

uses.en:
Farmers tie cuttings to ropes stretched between stakes in the shallows, then harvest the seaweed about six weeks later, dry it and sell it as a source of carrageenan.

The women of Kibuyuni also add value to their harvest themselves, making soap, body lotion, shampoo, juice and hair food from it.
uses.sw:
Wakulima hufunga vipandikizi kwenye kamba zilizonyooshwa kati ya vigingi katika maji yasiyo na kina, kisha huvuna mwani takriban wiki sita baadaye, huukausha na kuuuza kama chanzo cha *carrageenan*.

Wanawake wa Kibuyuni pia huongeza thamani ya mavuno yao wenyewe, wakitengeneza sabuni, losheni ya mwili, shampuu, sharubati na mafuta ya nywele kutokana nao.
uses.dg:
Akurima anafunga vigoda kpwenye kamba zirizofungbwa kahi ya mihi midide madzini, chisha anauvuna mwani bada ya wiki sita hivi, anauanika na anauguza dza chitu cha kuhendera *carrageenan*.

Achetu a Kibuyuni piya anaenjereza samani ya mavuno gao enye, kpwa kuhenda sabuni, mafuha ga kupaka mwiri, sabuni ya nyere, juisi na mafuha ga nyere kula kpwa mwani uhu.

culture.en: Seaweed farming on the south coast is mostly women's work: about three in four farmers are women, who traditionally could not fish. It has given them their own income from the sea. The Kibuyuni farmers' group became a cooperative in 2019.
culture.sw: Kilimo cha mwani katika pwani ya kusini ni kazi ya wanawake zaidi: takriban wakulima watatu kati ya wanne ni wanawake, ambao kwa desturi hawakuweza kuvua samaki. Kimewapa kipato chao wenyewe kutoka baharini. Kikundi cha wakulima wa Kibuyuni kiligeuka kuwa chama cha ushirika mwaka 2019.
culture.dg: Kurima mwani pwani ya kusini zaidi ni kazi ya achetu: kpwa chila akurima ane, ahahu hivi ni achetu, ambao kpwa mila kala taaruhusiwa kuvuwa ng'onda. Kazi hino ikaapha mapato gao enye kula baharini. Kundi ra akurima a Kibuyuni rakala muungano mwaka wa 2019.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili, farmed seaweed is *mwani*. In English it is spinosum seaweed, and its scientific name is *Eucheuma denticulatum*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili, mwani unaolimwa huitwa *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *spinosum seaweed*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Eucheuma denticulatum*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili, mwani unaorimwa ni *mwani*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *spinosum seaweed*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Eucheuma denticulatum*.

conservation.en: It is a farmed crop. Harvests suffer in warm-water die-offs and from 'ice-ice' disease, which bleaches and kills the seaweed.
conservation.sw: Ni zao la shambani. Mavuno huathirika wakati wa vifo vingi vinavyosababishwa na maji ya joto na kutokana na ugonjwa wa 'ice-ice', unaoufifisha rangi mwani na kuuua.
conservation.dg: Ni mmea unaorimwa. Mavuno nkuphunguka wakati madzi ga bahari ganakala na dzoho na mwani unafwa kpwa unji, na kpwa ukongo wa *'ice-ice'*, unaouusa rangi mwani na kuuolaga.
