teaser.en: Its ribbon leaves can grow a metre long, streaming in the tide like green tape in the shallow lagoons.
teaser.sw: Majani yake kama riboni yanaweza kufikia urefu wa mita moja, yakielea na maji kama utepe wa kijani katika mahori yasiyo na kina.
teaser.dg: Makodzage dza utepe ganaweza kukala mare mita mwenga, na ganasumba kpwa madzi ga bahari dza utepe wa chijani, kpwenye madzi machache.

summary.en: Tape seagrass is the largest seagrass on the coast, with long ribbon leaves up to a metre long, and one of the predominant seagrasses in Kenya. Its meadows in sheltered lagoons are nurseries for the fish that Digo fishers catch.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari hii ya utepe (*tape seagrass*) ndiyo nyasi bahari kubwa zaidi pwani, yenye majani marefu kama riboni yanayofikia hadi mita moja, na ni mojawapo ya nyasi bahari zinazotawala nchini Kenya. Mbuga zake katika mahori yaliyokingwa ni malezi ya samaki wanaovuliwa na wavuvi wa Kidigo.
summary.dg: *Tape seagrass* ni nyasi kulu kuriko zosi za bahari pwani, yenye makodza mare dza utepe, hadi mita mwenga, na ni mwenga kahi ya nyasi za bahari zinazophahikana zaidi Kenya. Phatu phenye nyasi hizi kpwenye madzi machache garigo rindwa ni phepho ni phatu pha kukulira ng'onda ambao avuvi a Chidigo anaagbwira.

about.en:
Tape seagrass is a flowering plant that lives fully submerged in the sea. It is the giant among seagrasses: its long, flat ribbon leaves can reach a metre in length, rising from a thick, creeping stem covered in tough black fibres from old leaves.

At low tide the leaves lie flat on the water's surface. Its pollination is unusual: tiny male flowers break free and float on the surface to reach the female flowers.
about.sw:
Nyasi bahari ya utepe ni mmea unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa baharini. Ndiye jitu miongoni mwa nyasi bahari: majani yake marefu, bapa kama riboni yanaweza kufikia urefu wa mita moja, yakiinuka kutoka kwenye shina nene linalotambaa lililofunikwa na nyuzi ngumu nyeusi za majani ya zamani.

Wakati wa maji kupwa, majani hulala bapa juu ya uso wa maji. Uchavushaji wake si wa kawaida: maua madogo sana ya kiume hujinasua na kuelea juu ya uso wa maji ili kuyafikia maua ya kike.
about.dg:
*Tape seagrass* ni mmea wenye maruwa unaokala ndani ya bahari kabisa. Ni nyasi kulu kuriko zosi za bahari: makodzage mare na sambamba dza utepe ganaweza kufika mita mwenga, na ganamera kula kpwa muhi mkulu unaoambala, uriofwinikpwa ni nyuzi ngumu nyiru za makodza makare.

Wakati wa madzi ga kala, makodza ganalala sambamba dzulu ya madzi. Namna inavyophaha tembe ni ya ajabu: maruwa madide ga chilume ganadoka na kuelea dzulu ya madzi hadi ganafika kpwa maruwa ga chichetu.

where.en: It grows in shallow, sheltered lagoons with muddy sand and is one of the predominant seagrasses in Kenya. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. Look for its long ribbons lying on the surface of the lagoon at low tide.
where.sw: Huota katika mahori yasiyo na kina, yaliyokingwa, yenye mchanga wa tope, na ni mojawapo ya nyasi bahari zinazotawala nchini Kenya. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Utaziona riboni zake ndefu zikilala juu ya uso wa maji ya mahori wakati wa maji kupwa.
where.dg: Inamera kpwenye madzi machache garigo rindwa ni phepho, phatu penye matope na mtsanga, na ni mwenga kahi ya nyasi za bahari zinazophahikana zaidi Kenya. Nyasi za bahari zinazunguluka kanda-kanda ya Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Lola makodzage mare dza utepe ganayolala dzulu ya madzi wakati wa madzi ga kala.

uses.en: Its meadows are habitat for the rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers that Digo fishers depend on. They also trap sediment and help to protect beaches.
uses.sw: Mbuga zake ni makazi ya tafi, pono, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea. Pia hunasa mashapo na kusaidia kulinda fukwe.
uses.dg: Phatu phenye nyasi hizi ni makalo ga tsafi, phono, pweza na majongoo ga bahari ambao avuvi a Chidigo anaakuluphira. Piya zinagbwira mtsanga na ulongo unaohalwa ni madzi, na zinaterya kurinda ufuwo.

summary.en: Turtle grass is a flowering plant that forms meadows on the intertidal and shallow sand flats. It feeds green turtles and dugongs and shelters the fish and octopus that coastal fishers rely on.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari ya kasa (*turtle grass*) ni mmea unaotoa maua unaounda mbuga kwenye nyanda za mchanga zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji na zile zisizo na kina. Huwalisha kasa na nguva na huwahifadhi samaki na pweza ambao wavuvi wa pwani wanawategemea.
summary.dg: *Turtle grass* ni mmea wenye maruwa unaomera phamwenga phatu phanji kpwenye mtsanga unaofwinikpwa ni madzi wakati wa madzi ga kuodzala na unaosala wazi wakati wa madzi ga kala, na kpwenye mtsanga wa madzi machache. Inarisa kasa a chijani na nguva, na inafitsa ng'onda na pweza ambao avuvi a pwani anaakuluphira.

about.en:
Turtle grass is a true flowering plant that lives fully submerged in the sea. Its leaves are flat, slightly curved ribbons, rising in small clusters from creeping stems buried in the sand. Seen closely, the leaves are often speckled with tiny red-brown streaks.

In good conditions it forms thick, even meadows, sometimes mixed with other seagrasses.
about.sw:
Nyasi bahari ya kasa ni mmea halisi unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa baharini. Majani yake ni riboni bapa zilizopinda kidogo, zinazoinuka katika mafungu madogo kutoka kwenye mashina yanayotambaa yaliyofukiwa mchangani. Ukiyaangalia kwa karibu, majani mara nyingi huwa na madoa madogo sana ya mistari ya kahawia-nyekundu.

Katika hali nzuri huunda mbuga nene na sawasawa, wakati mwingine zikichanganyika na nyasi bahari nyingine.
about.dg:
*Turtle grass* ni mmea wa kpweli wenye maruwa unaokala ndani ya bahari kabisa. Makodzage ni sambamba dza utepe unaomyoka chidide, na ganamera kpwa makundi madide kula kpwa mihi inayoambala iriyozikpwa mtsangani. Uchigalola phephi, mara nyinji makodza gana mistari midide ya rangi ya kundu na dongo.

Phatu phenye hali nono inamera nyinji na sawa-sawa, wakati wanjina phamwenga na nyasi zanjina za bahari.

where.en: It grows on intertidal and shallow subtidal sand flats. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. At low spring tides, parts of the meadows lie exposed or under a few centimetres of water, which is the easiest time to see it.
where.sw: Huota kwenye nyanda za mchanga zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji na zile zisizo na kina zilizo chini ya maji kupwa. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Wakati wa bamvua la maji kupwa, sehemu za mbuga huachwa wazi au chini ya sentimita chache za maji, na huo ndio wakati rahisi zaidi wa kuiona.
where.dg: Inamera kpwenye mtsanga unaosala wazi wakati wa madzi ga kala, na kpwenye mtsanga wa madzi machache usiosala wazi. Nyasi za bahari zinazunguluka kanda-kanda ya Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Wakati wa madzi ga kala sana, seemu za nyasi hizi zinasala wazi au photsi ya madzi ga sentimita chache tu, kpwa hivyo ni rahisi zaidi kuiona wakati uhu.

uses.en: Its meadows are habitat for the rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers that Digo fishers depend on. They also trap sediment, keep the water clear and help to protect beaches.
uses.sw: Mbuga zake ni makazi ya tafi, pono, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea. Pia hunasa mashapo, huweka maji safi na kusaidia kulinda fukwe.
uses.dg: Phatu phenye nyasi hizi ni makalo ga tsafi, phono, pweza na majongoo ga bahari ambao avuvi a Chidigo anaakuluphira. Piya zinagbwira mtsanga na ulongo unaohalwa ni madzi, zinahenda madzi gakale ereru, na zinaterya kurinda ufuwo.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili speakers usually call sea plants in general *mwani*. In English it is turtle grass, after the green turtles that graze it, and its scientific name is *Thalassia hemprichii*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kwa kawaida huita mimea ya baharini kwa jumla *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *turtle grass*, kutokana na kasa wanaoila, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Thalassia hemprichii*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Atu anaogomba Chiswahili kpwa kawaida anaiha mimea yosi ya bahari *mwani*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *turtle grass*, kpwa sababu ya kasa a chijani anaoirya, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Thalassia hemprichii*.

conservation.en: The seagrass meadows of Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni are feeding grounds for dugongs, green turtles and rabbitfish, and nurseries for young fish.
conservation.sw: Mbuga za nyasi bahari za Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni malisho ya nguva, kasa na tafi, na malezi ya samaki wachanga.
conservation.dg: Nyasi za bahari za Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni phatu pha kurya pha nguva, kasa a chijani na tsafi, na ni phatu pha kukulira ng'onda adide.

teaser.en: A doum palm in miniature, it often grows with no trunk at all, its fan leaves rising straight from the sand.
teaser.sw: Ni mkoma mdogo kabisa; mara nyingi hukua bila shina hata kidogo, na majani yake ya umbo la pepeo huchipuka moja kwa moja kutoka mchangani.
teaser.dg: Ni dza mkoma mdide sana, na mara nyinji tachina kolo kabisa: makodzage dza chiphephero ganamera chocho kula mtsangani.

summary.en: *Chikoko*, the lala or dwarf doum palm, is a small fan palm that grows in colonies on coastal sands near the sea. Like its larger cousin the doum palm, its leaves are woven and its small fruits are eaten.
summary.sw: *Chikoko*, au mkoma wa pwani, ni mmea mdogo wa jamii ya mnazi wenye majani ya umbo la pepeo unaokua kwa makundi kwenye mchanga wa pwani karibu na bahari. Kama ndugu yake mkubwa, mkoma, majani yake husukwa na matunda yake madogo huliwa.
summary.dg: *Chikoko* ni mkoma mdide wa pwani (*lala palm* au *dwarf doum palm* kpwa Chingereza), wenye makodza dza chiphephero, unaomera kpwa makundi kpwenye mtsanga wa pwani phephi na bahari. Dza mkoma, nduguye mkulu, makodza ga chikoko nkusukwa na matundage madide nkuriwa.

about.en:
*Chikoko* is a small palm, often with no trunk to speak of, or with short, leaning trunks of 3 to 4 metres. Its leaves are stiff fans, grey-green, curving down at the tips, on stalks lined with hooked spines.

Its fruits are small and gourd-shaped, with a hard, shiny brown skin over a fibrous pulp and a very hard kernel, like a smaller version of the doum palm's fruit.
about.sw:
*Chikoko* ni mmea mdogo wa jamii ya mnazi, mara nyingi bila shina la kutajwa, au wenye mashina mafupi yaliyoinama ya mita 3 hadi 4. Majani yake ni pepeo ngumu, za rangi ya kijani-kijivu, zinazopinda chini kwenye ncha, juu ya mikono yenye miiba iliyopinda kama ndoano.

Matunda yake ni madogo na yana umbo la kibuyu, yenye ganda gumu la kahawia linalong'aa juu ya nyama yenye nyuzi na kokwa ngumu sana, kama toleo dogo la tunda la mkoma.
about.dg:
*Chikoko* ni mkoma mdide; mara nyinji tachina kolo kabisa, au chikala na makolo mafupi ganayodeguka ga mita 3 hadi 4. Makodzage ni magumu dza chiphephero, ga rangi ya chijani na ivu, ganainama photsi kpwenye ntsa zago, kpwenye milita yenye miya ya kupindika.

Matundage ni madide na ga umbo ra chiburu, na gada gumu rinaroala ra rangi ya dongo, nyama ya nyuzi-nyuzi ndani, na chitsa chigumu sana, dza tunda ra mkoma, ela dide.

where.en: It grows in small colonies on coastal sands near the sea and in coastal bushland. Clumps of *chikoko* are a common sight in the scrub behind the beach on the south coast.
where.sw: Hukua kwa makundi madogo kwenye mchanga wa pwani karibu na bahari na katika vichaka vya pwani. Makundi ya *chikoko* ni jambo la kawaida kuonekana katika vichaka vilivyo nyuma ya ufuo kwenye pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: *Chikoko* chinamera kpwa makundi madide kpwenye mtsanga wa pwani phephi na bahari na weruni pwani. Makundi ga *chikoko* ni ga kawaida kuonekana weruni nyuma ya mtsanga wa pwani, pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: *Chikoko* is used in much the same way as the doum palm. Its leaves are split and woven, and used for thatch, and its fruit is eaten.
uses.sw: *Chikoko* hutumika kwa namna ile ile kama mkoma. Majani yake hupasuliwa na kusukwa, na hutumika kuezekea, na tunda lake huliwa.
uses.dg: *Chikoko* nkuhumirwa sawa na mkoma. Makodzage nkuahulwa na nkusukwa, na nkuhumirwa kuezeka nyumba, na matundage nkuriwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chikoko*. In Swahili it is *mkoma wa pwani*, 'the doum palm of the coast'. The Mgombato dictionary's entry for *mkoma* covers both this dwarf palm and the doum palm. In English it is the lala palm or dwarf doum palm, and its scientific name is *Hyphaene coriacea*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *chikoko*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkoma wa pwani*. Kamusi ya Mgombato, chini ya *mkoma*, inahusu mmea huu mdogo na mkoma wenyewe. Kwa Kiingereza ni *lala palm* au *dwarf doum palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Hyphaene coriacea*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chikoko*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkoma wa pwani*. Mgombato unahumira neno *mkoma* kpwa mkoma uhu mdide na kpwa mkoma mkulu. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lala palm* au *dwarf doum palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Hyphaene coriacea*.

definition.en: The leaves of a young fan palm (doum or borassus). The name depends on the palm's age because only young plants' leaves are useful.
definition.sw: Majani ya mmea mchanga wa jamii ya mnazi wenye majani ya pepeo (mkoma au mvumo). Jina hutegemea umri wa mmea kwa sababu ni majani ya mimea michanga tu yanayofaa.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi mtsanga wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza dza chiphephero (mkoma au mvumo). Neno hiri ni ra makodza ga mimea midide tu, kpwa sababu ndigo genye kazi.

use.en: Woven into mats, baskets, hats and other items.
use.sw: Husukwa kuwa mikeka, vikapu, kofia na vitu vingine.
use.dg: Nkusukwa kuhenda micheka, vikapu, kofiya na vitu vyanjina.

teaser.en: Unusually for a palm, it branches, and its leaf strips are behind one of the best-known Digo plant names: *mlala*.
teaser.sw: Jambo lisilo la kawaida kwa mchikichi, mti huu hutoa matawi, na vipande vya majani yake ndivyo chanzo cha mojawapo ya majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayojulikana zaidi: *mlala*.
teaser.dg: Si dza mihi yanjina ya jamii ya minazi, uhu una panda, na vipande vya makodzage ndivyo vinavyoreha dzina ra mmea ririromanyikana zaidi kpwa Chidigo: *mlala*.

summary.en: *Mkoma*, the doum palm, is a tall fan palm that branches again and again, and its hard, shiny fruits are called *koma*. Its leaves, *mlala*, are the coast's great weaving material, and its fruit has saved lives in famine.
summary.sw: *Mkoma* ni mchikichi mrefu wenye majani kama kipepeo unaotoa matawi tena na tena, na matunda yake magumu yanayong'aa huitwa *koma*. Majani yake, *mlala*, ndiyo malighafi kuu ya kusuka pwani, na tunda lake limeokoa maisha wakati wa njaa.
summary.dg: *Mkoma* ni muhi mure wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero unaoganyika panda chila mara, na matundage magumu ganagong'ala ganaihwa *koma*. Makodzage, *mlala*, ndigo vitu vikulu vya kusukira pwani, na tundare rikaokola maisha wakati wa ndzala.

about.en:
*Mkoma* is one of very few palms that branch. Its trunk forks into two, and each branch may fork again, so an old tree can reach 25 metres with several crowns. Each crown carries stiff fan leaves on stalks edged with sharp spines.

The fruits hang in heavy clusters. They are hard, shiny and orange-brown, somewhat flattened, with a fibrous, sweetish pulp around a very hard kernel. The Digo call the fruit *koma*.
about.sw:
*Mkoma* ni mojawapo ya michikichi michache sana inayotoa matawi. Shina lake hugawanyika mara mbili, na kila tawi linaweza kugawanyika tena, kwa hivyo mti mzee unaweza kufikia mita 25 ukiwa na mataji kadhaa. Kila taji hubeba majani magumu kama kipepeo juu ya vikonyo vyenye miiba mikali pembeni.

Matunda huning'inia kwa vishada vizito. Ni magumu, yanayong'aa na ya rangi ya kahawia-machungwa, yaliyobapa kidogo, yenye nyama ya nyuzinyuzi tamu kiasi inayozunguka kiini kigumu sana. Wadigo huliita tunda hili *koma*.
about.dg:
*Mkoma* ni mwenga wa mihi michache sana ya jamii ya minazi inayoganyika panda. Kolore rinaganyika mairi, na chila panda inaweza kuganyika tsena, ndiyo mana muhi wa kare unaweza kufika mita 25 na chitswa zaidi ya chimwenga. Chila chitswa chinatsukula makodza mafu ga chiphephero kpwa milita yenye miya ya ntsa kanda-kanda.

Matunda ganabwadzika kpwa mabunda mazito. Ni magumu, ganang'ala na ga rangi ya chungbwa na dongo, ga kubanika chidide, na genye nyama ya nyuzi-nyuzi ya mtswano chidide kuzunguluka chitsa gumu sana. Adigo anaiha tunda hiri *koma*.

where.en: It grows in hot lowlands, along river courses and on the coastal plain: in coastal grassland, bushland and on sandy plains. On the drive inland from the south coast, its branched silhouettes stand out above the bush.
where.sw: Hustawi katika nyanda za chini zenye joto, kando ya mito na katika nyanda za pwani: katika nyika za nyasi za pwani, vichakani na kwenye nyanda za mchanga. Ukisafiri kuelekea bara kutoka pwani ya kusini, maumbo yake yenye matawi hujitokeza juu ya kichaka.
where.dg: Unamera kpwa tsi za photsi zenye dzoho, kanda-kanda ya miho na kpwa tsi ya photsi ya pwani: nyasini, weruni na kpwa herera za mtsanga. Uchiphiya na gari kula pwani ya kusini kuphiya bara, maumbo ga pandaze ganaonekana dzulu ya weruni.

uses.en:
The leaves, called *mlala*, are the coast's great weaving material. They are split into strips and woven into mats, baskets, hats and other handicrafts, and used for roofing.

The fruit pulp and the kernel are eaten, and in hard times the fruit is an important famine food. The stem is tapped for palm wine. Trunks serve as poles and are hollowed into beehives.
uses.sw:
Majani, yanayoitwa *mlala*, ndiyo malighafi kuu ya kusuka pwani. Hupasuliwa kuwa vipande na kusukwa kuwa mikeka, vikapu, kofia na kazi nyingine za mikono, na hutumika kuezekea.

Nyama ya tunda na kiini huliwa, na nyakati ngumu tunda hili ni chakula muhimu cha njaa. Shina hugemwa ili kupata tembo. Mashina hutumika kama nguzo na huchongwa kuwa mizinga ya nyuki.
uses.dg:
Makodza, ganagoihwa *mlala*, ndigo vitu vikulu vya kusukira pwani. Nkugbwanyulwa vipande na kusukwa majamvi, kaphu, kofiya na kazi zanjina za mikpwono, na piya nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba.

Nyama ya tunda na chitsa nkuriwa, na wakati wa shida tunda ni chakurya cha muhimu cha ndzala. Kolo nkujemwa kpwa uchi. Makolo nkuhumirwa dza nguzo na nkutsimbwa ndani kuhenda mizinga ya nyuchi.

culture.en: *Mlala*, the leaf and the weaving material, is one of the most widely known Digo plant names, as Pakia found. Mats and baskets of *mlala* have long been part of everyday life in Digo homes.
culture.sw: *Mlala*, jani na malighafi ya kusuka, ni mojawapo ya majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayojulikana na watu wengi zaidi, kama Pakia alivyogundua. Mikeka na vikapu vya *mlala* vimekuwa sehemu ya maisha ya kila siku katika nyumba za Wadigo tangu zamani.
culture.dg: *Mlala*, kodza na chitu cha kusukira, ni mwenga wa madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganagomanyikana zaidi, dza Pakia arivyoona. Majamvi na kaphu za *mlala* zikakala seemu ya maisha ga chila siku kpwa midzi ya Adigo kula kare.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mkoma*, also *mkoma lume*, and lists *mlala* among the weaving plants. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mkoma* for both the doum palm and the dwarf doum palm, and *mlala* as 'raffia', so speakers may use *mlala* for the leaf material more broadly. In Swahili it is *mkoma*, *mkoche* or *mlala*. In Giriama it is *mkoma* or *mlala*, and in Chonyi *mkoma*. In English it is the doum palm, and its scientific name is *Hyphaene compressa*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mkoma*, pia *mkoma lume*, na anaorodhesha *mlala* miongoni mwa mimea ya kusuka. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mkoma* kwa mkoma na pia kwa mkoma mfupi, na *mlala* kama 'raffia', kwa hivyo huenda wazungumzaji hutumia *mlala* kwa malighafi ya majani kwa upana zaidi. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkoma*, *mkoche* au *mlala*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mkoma* au *mlala*, na kwa Kichonyi *mkoma*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *doum palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Hyphaene compressa*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mkoma*, piya *mkoma lume*, na anataja *mlala* kahi ya mimea ya kusukira. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mkoma* kpwa mkoma na mkoma mdide, na *mlala* dza 'raffia', kpwa hivyo atu anaweza kuhumira *mlala* kpwa makodza ga kusukira kpwa ujumla. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mkoma*, *mkoche* au *mlala*. Kpwa Chigiryama *mkoma* au *mlala*, na kpwa Chichonyi *mkoma*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *doum palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Hyphaene compressa*.

definition.en: The leaves of a young fan palm (doum or borassus). The name depends on the palm's age because only young plants' leaves are useful.
definition.sw: Majani ya mchikichi mchanga wenye majani kama kipepeo (mkoma au mvumo). Jina hutegemea umri wa mchikichi kwa sababu ni majani ya mimea michanga tu yanayofaa.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi mtsanga wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero (mkoma au mvumo). Dzina rinakuluphira umri wa muhi kpwa sababu ni makodza ga mihi mitsanga bahi ganagofwaha.

use.en: Woven into mats, baskets, hats and other items.
use.sw: Husukwa kuwa mikeka, vikapu, kofia na vitu vingine.
use.dg: Nkusukwa majamvi, kaphu, kofiya na vitu vyanjina.

meaning.en: From an older word meaning 'dwarf palm'. Mgombato glosses mlala as 'raffia', the weaving fibre.
meaning.sw: Kutoka neno la zamani lenye maana ya 'mchikichi mfupi'. Mgombato anaeleza mlala kama 'raffia', nyuzi za kusuka.
meaning.dg: Kula kpwa neno ra kare ririrokala na mana ya 'muhi mdide wa jamii ya mnazi'. Mgombato inaandika *mlala* dza 'raffia', nyuzi za kusukira.

definition.en: The leaves of a mature fan palm (doum or borassus), which are not used for weaving.
definition.sw: Majani ya mchikichi uliokomaa wenye majani kama kipepeo (mkoma au mvumo), ambayo hayatumiki kusuka.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero (mkoma au mvumo) uriokula, ambago tagahumirwa kusukira.

definition.en: The fruit of the doum palm.
definition.sw: Tunda la mkoma.
definition.dg: Tunda ra mkoma.

definition.en: A strip of raffia (mlala) about 5 mm wide.
definition.sw: Kipande cha ukindu (mlala) chenye upana wa takriban milimita 5.
definition.dg: Chipande cha mlala cha upana wa phephi milimita 5.

definition.en: Pieces of raffia (mlala) ready for weaving. The Swahili gloss, minyaa, refers to strips of doum palm leaf.
definition.sw: Vipande vya ukindu (mlala) vilivyo tayari kusukwa. Maana ya Kiswahili, minyaa, inahusu vipande vya jani la mkoma.
definition.dg: Vipande vya mlala viriviotayarishwa kusukwa. Neno ra Chiswahili, *minyaa*, ni vipande vya makodza ga mkoma.

definition.en: The hard edges of raffia (mlala) leaves, made into very fine thread for sewing plaits together into a mat or basket.
definition.sw: Kingo ngumu za majani ya ukindu (mlala), zinazotengenezwa kuwa uzi mwembamba sana wa kushonea misuko pamoja kuwa mkeka au kikapu.
definition.dg: Kanda ngumu za makodza ga mlala, zinazohendwa nyuzi nyembamba sana za kushonera misuko phamwenga kuhenda jamvi au kaphu.

definition.en: The tender, edible part between the stem and the leaves. Mgombato gives it for the coconut palm and for 'raffia' (mlala), which here is probably the doum palm.
definition.sw: Sehemu laini inayolika iliyo kati ya shina na majani. Mgombato analitoa kwa mnazi na kwa 'raffia' (mlala), ambayo hapa huenda ni mkoma.
definition.dg: Seemu ya yuya inayoriwa iriyo kahi ya kolo na makodza. Mgombato inaipha kpwa mnazi na kpwa 'raffia' (*mlala*), ambayo hipha labuda ni mkoma.

digo_source: Mgombato ('mnazi coconut tree'; 'nazi coconut'); ICRAF ('Digo: Mnazi'); Pakia 2005

teaser.en: The Digo have a name for every stage of a coconut, from the tiny *kolokotsi* to the overripe *nguta*: seven in all.
teaser.sw: Wadigo wana jina kwa kila hatua ya nazi, kuanzia *kolokotsi* ndogo hadi *nguta* iliyoiva kupita kiasi: saba kwa jumla (jaribio).
teaser.dg: Adigo ana dzina kpwa chila hatua ya kukula kpwa nazi, kula *kolokotsi* ndide hadi *nguta* iriyoivwa kutsupa chiasi: madzina sabaa gosi.

summary.en: *Mnazi*, the coconut palm, grows on almost every Digo homestead and is the backbone of coastal cooking, building and income. Kwale and Kilifi hold most of Kenya's coconut trees, and from milk to thatch to palm wine, few plants matter more to Digo life.
summary.sw: *Mnazi* hustawi karibu katika kila boma la Wadigo, na ndio uti wa mgongo wa mapishi, ujenzi na kipato cha pwani. Kaunti za Kwale na Kilifi zina minazi mingi zaidi nchini Kenya, na kuanzia tui hadi makuti hadi tembo, ni mimea michache yenye umuhimu zaidi katika maisha ya Wadigo.
summary.dg: *Mnazi* ni muhi wa nazi. Unamera phephi kpwa chila mudzi wa Adigo, na ndio msingi wa kujita, kudzenga na mapato ga pwani. Kaunti za Kwale na Kilifi ndizo zenye unji wa minazi ya Kenya, na kula huwi hadi makuti hadi uchi, ni mimea michache iriyo na samani zaidi kpwa maisha ga Adigo.

about.en:
*Mnazi* is a tall, slender palm, up to 20 metres, with a single trunk that often leans or curves, topped by a crown of long feathery fronds. The fruits hang in bunches below the leaves, and the Digo have a name for each stage of their growth. Pakia records seven: *kolokotsi*, *tale*, *daka*, *dafu* (the young drinking nut), *koroma*, *nazi* (the mature nut) and *nguta* (overripe).

Pakia also records three Digo kinds of coconut palm, told apart by the colour of their nuts: *mnazi mwiru*, dark green; *mnazi wa kundu*, orange; and *mnazi wa chisamli*, yellow.
about.sw:
*Mnazi* ni mchikichi mrefu na mwembamba, unaofikia hadi mita 20, wenye shina moja ambalo mara nyingi huinama au kupinda, na juu yake kuna taji la makuti marefu yanayofanana na manyoya. Matunda huning'inia kwa vishada chini ya majani, na Wadigo wana jina kwa kila hatua ya ukuaji wake. Pakia anaorodhesha saba: *kolokotsi*, *tale*, *daka*, *dafu* (nazi changa ya kunywa), *koroma*, *nazi* (nazi iliyokomaa) na *nguta* (iliyokomaa kupita kiasi).

Pakia pia anaorodhesha aina tatu za minazi kwa Kidigo, zinazotofautishwa kwa rangi ya nazi zake: *mnazi mwiru*, wa kijani kibichi kilichokolea; *mnazi wa kundu*, wa rangi ya machungwa; na *mnazi wa chisamli*, wa manjano.
about.dg:
*Mnazi* ni muhi mure na mwembamba, unaofika hadi mita 20. Una kolo rimwenga ambaro kpwa kawaida rinabeduka au rinaotyoka, na dzulu ya kolo kuna chitswa cha makuti mare ganagoonekana dza manyoya. Matunda ganabwadzika kpwa mabunda photsi ya makuti, na Adigo ana dzina kpwa chila hatua ya kukula kpwa nazi. Pakia anaandika madzina sabaa: *kolokotsi*, *tale*, *daka*, *dafu* (nazi tsanga ya kunwa), *koroma*, *nazi* (nazi iriyoivwa) na *nguta* (iriyoivwa kutsupa chiasi).

Pakia piya anaandika aina hahu za Chidigo za mnazi, zinazotafwautishwa kpwa rangi ya nazi zao: *mnazi mwiru*, wa chijani iriyo phephi na nyiru; *mnazi wa kundu*, wa rangi ya chungbwa; na *mnazi wa chisamli*, wa rangi ya mandano.

where.en: Coconut palms grow on almost every Digo homestead and in groves inland of Diani and Msambweni. Kwale and Kilifi counties hold most of Kenya's coconut trees, and the palm-lined coast is the signature of Digo country.
where.sw: Minazi hustawi karibu katika kila boma la Wadigo na katika mashamba ya minazi yaliyo bara kutoka Diani na Msambweni. Kaunti za Kwale na Kilifi zina minazi mingi zaidi nchini Kenya, na pwani iliyopambwa kwa minazi ndiyo alama kuu ya nchi ya Wadigo.
where.dg: Minazi inamera phephi kpwa chila mudzi wa Adigo, na kpwenye virirwa vya minazi uphande wa bara wa Diani na Msambweni. Kaunti za Kwale na Kilifi ndizo zenye unji wa minazi ya Kenya, na pwani iriyodzala minazi ndiyo alama ya tsi ya Adigo.

uses.en:
Coconut is in nearly everything the Digo cook. Grated *nazi* is squeezed through the *chifumbu*, a woven basket strainer, to give *huwi* or *uwi*, coconut milk, which goes into rice, cassava, fish, beans and greens. The leftover dregs are *dindiya*, and grated coconut also makes *kashata*, a coconut sweet. The young *dafu* is drunk straight from the nut.

The palm is also tapped for palm wine, *uchi* or *tembo*. The tapper, the *mjema*, climbs to the crown and taps the *phalanga* to collect the sap.

Almost nothing goes to waste. Fronds (*kuti*, plural *makuti*) are used for thatch, and woven fronds are *makandza*. Leaves are made into *hundu* baskets, strips of *mkpwuna* serve as twine, coir is twisted into *ndifu* rope, and the shells, *chivo*, become ladles and fuel. The trunk is used as timber. Coconuts and their products are a major source of income on the coast.
uses.sw:
Nazi imo karibu katika kila chakula kinachopikwa na Wadigo. *Nazi* iliyokunwa hukamuliwa kupitia *chifumbu*, kichujio cha kikapu kilichofumwa, ili kupata *huwi* au *uwi*, yaani tui, linalotiwa katika wali, muhogo, samaki, maharagwe na mboga za majani. Machicha yanayobaki huitwa *dindiya*, na nazi iliyokunwa pia hutengeneza *kashata*, peremende ya nazi. *Dafu* changa hunywewa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye nazi.

Mnazi pia hugemwa ili kupata tembo, *uchi* au *tembo*. Mgemaji, *mjema*, hupanda hadi kileleni na kugema *phalanga* ili kukusanya utomvu.

Karibu hakuna kinachopotea bure. Makuti (*kuti*, wingi *makuti*) hutumika kuezekea, na makuti yaliyosukwa huitwa *makandza*. Majani hutengenezwa vikapu vya *hundu*, vipande vya *mkpwuna* hutumika kama kamba nyembamba, makumbi husokotwa kuwa kamba ya *ndifu*, na vifuu, *chivo*, huwa kata na kuni. Shina hutumika kama mbao. Nazi na bidhaa zake ni chanzo kikubwa cha kipato pwani.
uses.dg:
Nazi inainjira phephi kpwa chila chakurya Adigo anachojita. *Nazi* iriyokunwa nkutsudzwa kpwa *chifumbu*, kaphu iriyosukwa ya kutsudzira, ili kuphaha *huwi* au *uwi*, maziya ga nazi. Huwi nkutiywa kpwa wari, manga, ng'onda, maharagbwe na mtsunga. Garigosala ni *dindiya*, na nazi iriyokunwa piya nkuhendwa *kashata*, peremende ya nazi. *Dafu*, nazi tsanga, nkunwewa kula ndani ya nazi yenye.

Mnazi piya nkujemwa ili kuphaha uchi wa mnazi, *uchi* au *tembo*. Mutu anayejema, *mjema*, anafyombera hadi dzulu ya mnazi na kujema *phalanga* ili kuphaha utomvu wa mnazi.

Phephi takuna chitu chinachotsuphwa. Makuti (*kuti*, unji *makuti*) nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba, na makuti garigosukwa ni *makandza*. Makodza nkuhendwa kaphu za *hundu*, vipande vya *mkpwuna* nkuhumirwa dza lugbwe, *ndifu* nkusokotwa kukala kamba, na vivo, *chivo*, nkuhendwa maliphazi na kuni. Kolo nkuhumirwa dza mbao. Nazi na vitu vinavyohendwa kula kpwa nazi ni njira kulu ya mapato pwani.

culture.en: The Mgombato dictionary records two proverbs. *Mnazi mmwenga una uchi wani?* asks 'How much palm wine can you get from one palm tree?' *Mnazi wa mchetu taujemwa na ndaro* says 'Your wife's coconut palm is not tapped joyfully', because it still belongs to her. Palm wine is woven into coastal social life, and in a mostly Muslim community it is also a lived tension.
culture.sw: Kamusi ya Mgombato inarekodi methali mbili. *Mnazi mmwenga una uchi wani?* inauliza 'Mnazi mmoja una tembo kiasi gani?' *Mnazi wa mchetu taujemwa na ndaro* inasema 'Mnazi wa mkeo haugemwi kwa furaha', kwa sababu bado ni mali yake. Tembo limefungamana na maisha ya kijamii ya pwani, na katika jamii ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa ni ya Waislamu, pia ni mvutano unaoishi ndani ya maisha ya kila siku.
culture.dg: Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika ndarira mbiri. *Mnazi mmwenga una uchi wani?* inauza: 'Mnazi mmwenga unaweza kulavya uchi unji wani?' *Mnazi wa mchetu taujemwa na ndaro* inagomba kukala mnazi wa mcheo taujemwa kpwa raha, kpwa sababu bado ni wakpwe. Uchi wa mnazi ni seemu ya maisha ga atu a pwani, na kpwa jamii ambayo unji wa atu ni Aislamu, piya ni dzambo ra mvwehano wa chila siku.

names.en: The Digo name is *mnazi*, and the nut is *nazi*; both are shared with Swahili and Giriama. The names are recorded in the Mgombato dictionary, the ICRAF handbook and Pakia. In English it is the coconut palm, and its scientific name is *Cocos nucifera*, from *nucifera*, 'nut-bearing'.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mnazi*, na tunda ni *nazi*; majina yote mawili yanatumika pia katika Kiswahili na Kigiriama. Majina haya yamerekodiwa katika kamusi ya Mgombato, kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF na Pakia. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *coconut palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Cocos nucifera*, kutoka *nucifera*, 'unaozaa kokwa'.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mnazi*, na tunda ni *nazi*; madzina gosi mairi ni sawa na ga Chiswahili na Chigiryama. Madzina higa ganaphahikana kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, chitabu cha ICRAF na Pakia. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *coconut palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Cocos nucifera*, kula *nucifera*, 'unaolavya nazi'.

conservation.en: Groves have been lost to titanium mining, and many trees are ageing; replanting programmes aim to renew them.
conservation.sw: Mashamba ya minazi yamepotea kutokana na uchimbaji wa titani, na minazi mingi imezeeka; miradi ya kupanda upya inalenga kuifufua.
conservation.dg: Virirwa vya minazi vikaangamika kpwa sababu ya kutsimba madini ga titanium, na minazi minji ikakala ya kare; mipango ya kuphanda minazi miphya inalonda kuika uphya virirwa vino.

digo_proposals.name: mnazi (fruit nazi)
digo_proposals.source: Mgombato ('mnazi coconut tree'; 'nazi coconut'); ICRAF ('Digo: Mnazi'); Pakia 2005

definition.en: The leaf of the coconut palm. Leaves in general are makodza, but the coconut leaf has its own name; kuti is used less for other feather-leaved palms (Phoenix, Raphia) and never for cycads. Mgombato also uses kuti for roofing thatch made from palm leaves.
definition.sw: Jani la mnazi. Majani kwa jumla huitwa makodza, lakini jani la mnazi lina jina lake maalum; kuti halitumiki sana kwa michikichi mingine yenye majani kama manyoya (Phoenix, Raphia) na kamwe halitumiki kwa mimea ya jamii ya cycad. Mgombato pia hutumia kuti kwa makuti ya kuezekea yanayotengenezwa kwa majani ya michikichi.
definition.dg: Kodza ra mnazi. Makodza kpwa ujumla ni *makodza*, ela kodza ra mnazi rina dzina ra chipekee; *kuti* nkuhumirwa chidide kpwa mihi yanjina ya jamii ya minazi yenye makodza dza manyoya (*Phoenix*, *Raphia*), na tarihumirwa kabisa kpwa cycads. Mgombato piya inahumira *kuti* kpwa makuti ga kuezekera garigohendwa kula makodza ga mihi ya jamii ya minazi.

use.en: Plaited roofing (vyungo), woven mats (kandza) and brooms (liphyero) are made from it; Pakia says those made from other palms are of poorer quality.
use.sw: Hutengenezwa makuti ya kuezekea yaliyosukwa (vyungo), mikeka iliyofumwa (kandza) na fagio (liphyero); Pakia anasema vile vinavyotengenezwa kwa michikichi mingine huwa duni zaidi.
use.dg: Kuti nkusukwa kuhenda *vyungo* vya kuezekera, *kandza* (majamvi) na *liphyero*; Pakia anagomba kukala vitu vinavyohendwa kula mihi yanjina ya jamii ya minazi si vinono dza vino.

definition.en: The woody midrib that runs the length of the coconut leaf. Mgombato spells it bati (class ma): 'wooden stem of palm leaf'.
definition.sw: Ubavu mgumu wa mbao unaopita urefu wote wa jani la mnazi. Mgombato anaiandika bati (ngeli ya ma): 'shina la mbao la jani la mchikichi'.
definition.dg: Mongo mufu wa kodza ra mnazi, unaotsupa kula mwandzo hadi mwisho wa kodza. Mgombato inauandika *bati* (*ma*): 'mongo wa muhi wa kodza ra mnazi'.

use.en: Used to make vyungo (fronds are tied back onto it to make thatch) and mbano, sticks for smoking fish.
use.sw: Hutumika kutengeneza vyungo (majani hufungwa tena juu yake ili kutengeneza makuti) na mbano, vijiti vya kubanikia samaki.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa kuhenda *vyungo* (makodza nkufungwa luphya dzuluye kuhenda makuti ga kuezekera) na *mbano*, mihi midide ya kuwadira ng'onda.

definition.en: The thick stalk at the base of the coconut leaf, where it joins the trunk. Mgombato describes it as the part of the branch nearest the trunk.
definition.sw: Kitako kinene cha kikonyo cha jani la mnazi, mahali kinapoungana na shina. Mgombato hukieleza kuwa sehemu ya tawi iliyo karibu zaidi na shina.
definition.dg: Photsi ndziho ya mlita wa kodza ra mnazi, phatu unaphogbwirana na kolo. Mgombato anaieleza dza seemu ya panda iriyo phephi zaidi na kolo.

use.en: Burned as firewood, especially by commercial food vendors; Mgombato adds that it is often used as an improvised seat.
use.sw: Huchomwa kama kuni, hasa na wauzaji wa vyakula; Mgombato huongeza kuwa mara nyingi hutumika kama kiti cha muda.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa dza kuni, zaidi ni aguza vyakurya; Mgombato anaongeza kukala mara nyinji nkusagalirwa dza chihi.

shared_with: kumbi: the outer skin of the coconut fruit

definition.en: The leaflets of the coconut leaf, the long narrow blades along the midrib. Pakia says makalala and mikalala are interchangeable.
definition.sw: Vijani vya jani la mnazi, yaani vipande virefu vyembamba vilivyo kando ya ubavu. Pakia anasema makalala na mikalala hutumika kwa kubadilishana.
definition.dg: Makodza madide ga kodza ra mnazi, vipande virefu vyembamba vinavyokala kanda-kanda ya mongo wa kodza. Pakia anagomba kukala *makalala* na *mikalala* ni dzambo mwenga.

meaning.en: Probably named after the rustling noise the leaflets make in the wind.
meaning.sw: Huenda yameitwa hivyo kutokana na mchakacho unaotolewa na vijani hivyo upepo unapovuma.
meaning.dg: Labuda ganaihwa kpwa kululu ganarohenda makodza iga ganaphopigwa ni phepho.

definition.en: The thin midrib of each coconut leaflet. When the word is used for another palm a phrase is added, as in ukuti wa uchindu, which shows the coconut is the model for these names.
definition.sw: Ubavu mwembamba wa kila kijani cha jani la mnazi. Neno hili linapotumika kwa mchikichi mwingine huongezewa maneno, kama katika ukuti wa uchindu, jambo linaloonyesha kwamba mnazi ndio kielelezo cha majina haya.
definition.dg: Mongo mwembamba wa chila kodza dide ra mnazi. Neno hiri richihumirwa kpwa muhi wanjina wa jamii ya mnazi nkuenjerezwa neno, dza *ukuti wa uchindu*, na hino inaonyesa kukala mnazi ndio chielelezo cha madzina higa.

use.en: Bundled into brooms (liphyero) and made into fish traps (tsatsa).
use.sw: Hufungwa pamoja kutengeneza fagio (liphyero) na hutengenezwa mitego ya samaki (tsatsa).
use.dg: Nkufungwa phamwenga kuhenda maliphyero (*liphyero*) na nkuhendwa mihambo ya ng'onda (*tsatsa*).

definition.en: One frond (leaflet) of a palm leaf. Mgombato gives its plural as kuti and its Swahili as ukuti; it may be related to Pakia's ukuti, which Pakia defines as the leaflet's midrib.
definition.sw: Kijani kimoja cha jani la mchikichi. Mgombato anatoa wingi wake kuwa kuti na Kiswahili chake kuwa ukuti; huenda linahusiana na ukuti wa Pakia, ambao Pakia anaufafanua kama ubavu wa kijani.
definition.dg: Kodza dide rimwenga ra kodza ra muhi wa jamii ya mnazi. Mgombato inapha wingiwe dza *kuti* na Chiswahili *ukuti*; labuda rinahusiana na *ukuti* wa Pakia, ambaye anaugomba kukala ni mongo wa kodza dide.

definition.en: The fibrous material on the coconut leaf stalk; Mgombato describes it as the fibres that hold a frond to the palm. The same word names the coir of the fruit.
definition.sw: Nyuzi zilizo kwenye kikonyo cha jani la mnazi; Mgombato huzieleza kuwa nyuzi zinazoshikilia kuti kwenye mnazi. Neno hilohilo hutaja makumbi ya tunda.
definition.dg: Nyuzi ziriphokala kpwa mlita wa kodza ra mnazi; Mgombato anazieleza dza nyuzi zinazogbwira kuti kpwa mnazi. Dzina hiri piya ni ra nyuzi za rifu ra nazi.

use.en: Used as a sieve, especially when tapping palm sap.
use.sw: Hutumika kama chujio, hasa wakati wa kugema tembo.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa dza chifumbu, zaidi wakati wa kujema uchi.

shared_with: ndifu: the coir (fibrous husk) of the coconut fruit

definition.en: A coconut frond, and a mat woven from one. Mgombato also lists likandza (plural makandza), a woven palm frond used as a mat.
definition.sw: Jani la mnazi, na pia mkeka uliofumwa kwa jani hilo. Mgombato pia anaorodhesha likandza (wingi makandza), jani la mchikichi lililofumwa linalotumika kama mkeka.
definition.dg: Kodza ra mnazi, na jamvi rinarosukwa kula kpwa kodza hiro. Mgombato piya inaandika *likandza* (unji *makandza*), kodza ra mnazi rirorosukwa rinarohumirwa dza jamvi.

use.en: Woven into mats.
use.sw: Hufumwa kuwa mikeka.
use.dg: Nkusukwa kuhenda majamvi.

definition.en: The tender, edible part at the top of the coconut palm (or raffia palm) between the stem and the leaves.
definition.sw: Sehemu laini inayolika iliyo juu ya mnazi (au mwale) kati ya shina na majani.
definition.dg: Seemu ya yuya inayoriwa iriyo dzulu ya mnazi (au ya mtsikitsi), kahi ya kolo na makodza.

use.en: Eaten.
use.sw: Huliwa.
use.dg: Nkuriwa.

definition.en: The flowering branch of the coconut palm, the part that develops into coconuts.
definition.sw: Tawi la maua la mnazi, sehemu inayokua na kuwa nazi.
definition.dg: Panda ya maruwa ya mnazi, seemu inayokula hadi ikakala nazi.

meaning.en: The word also means 'to sow'; Pakia found no clear link between the two.
meaning.sw: Neno hili pia lina maana ya 'kupanda mbegu'; Pakia hakupata uhusiano wa wazi kati ya maana hizi mbili.
meaning.dg: Neno hiri piya ni 'kuphanda' (mbeyu); Pakia kaphaha uhusiano wazi kahi ya mana mairi higa.

definition.en: The small flowers (florets) on the coconut flower branch. In Pakia's sequence the fruit develops from punga, before the kolokotsi stage.
definition.sw: Maua madogo (vijua) yaliyo kwenye tawi la maua la mnazi. Katika mfuatano wa Pakia, tunda hukua kutoka punga, kabla ya hatua ya kolokotsi.
definition.dg: Maruwa madide ganagokala kpwa panda ya maruwa ya mnazi. Kpwa mpangilio wa Pakia, tunda rinakula kula kpwa *punga*, kabla ya hatua ya *kolokotsi*.

meaning.en: Named for their likeness to the rice panicle, mphunga.
meaning.sw: Yameitwa hivyo kwa kufanana na shuke la mpunga, mphunga.
meaning.dg: Ganaihwa hivyo kpwa sababu ganahalana na punga ra *mphunga*.

shared_with: punga: the male tassel of maize
punga: the flowering panicles of grasses and sugarcane

definition.en: The stalks of the coconut flower branch that carry the fruits. Mgombato: the part of the palm that holds the coconuts.
definition.sw: Vikonyo vya tawi la maua la mnazi vinavyobeba matunda. Mgombato: sehemu ya mnazi inayoshikilia nazi.
definition.dg: Milita ya panda ya maruwa ya mnazi inayotsukula nazi. Mgombato: seemu ya mnazi inayogbwira nazi.

use.en: Used as a broom.
use.sw: Hutumika kama fagio.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa dza liphyero.

definition.en: The cover that wraps the coconut flower branch. Mgombato adds that palm wine is tapped from this part.
definition.sw: Ganda linalofunika tawi la maua la mnazi. Mgombato anaongeza kwamba tembo hugemwa kutoka sehemu hii.
definition.dg: Gada rinarofunika panda ya maruwa ya mnazi. Mgombato inaenjereza kukala uchi nkujemwa kula seemu hino.

use.en: Burned as firewood; tapped for palm wine.
use.sw: Huchomwa kama kuni; hugemwa ili kupata tembo.
use.dg: Nkuochwa dza kuni; nkujemwa kpwa uchi.

definition.en: The first stage of the coconut, very small, with no water or flesh inside. Mgombato: little more than a bud and not yet edible.
definition.sw: Hatua ya kwanza ya nazi, ndogo sana, isiyo na maji wala nyama ndani. Mgombato: si zaidi ya kichipukizi na bado hailiki.
definition.dg: Hatua ya kpwanza ya nazi: ndide sana, taina madzi wala nyama ndani. Mgombato: ni dza chimea bahi, na taidzangbwerika.

use.en: Used only for magic-related purposes.
use.sw: Hutumika kwa shughuli zinazohusiana na uchawi tu.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa tu kpwa mambo ga utsai.

definition.en: The second stage: still immature and small, but larger than kolokotsi, with hardly any water or flesh.
definition.sw: Hatua ya pili: bado changa na ndogo, lakini kubwa kuliko kolokotsi, na karibu haina maji wala nyama.
definition.dg: Hatua ya phiri: bado taidzangbwekomala na ni ndide, ela ni kulu kuriko *kolokotsi*, na phephi taina madzi wala nyama.

use.en: Also used only for magic-related purposes.
use.sw: Nayo pia hutumika kwa shughuli zinazohusiana na uchawi tu.
use.dg: Piya nkuhumirwa tu kpwa mambo ga utsai.

definition.en: The third stage: still immature but now large, with some water that is not yet sweet and no flesh.
definition.sw: Hatua ya tatu: bado changa lakini sasa ni kubwa, ina maji kiasi ambayo bado si matamu, na haina nyama.
definition.dg: Hatua ya hahu: bado taidzangbweivwa ela sambi ni kulu, ina madzi chidide ambago bado taganadzangbwekala ga mtswano, na taina nyama.

definition.en: The middle stage: the water is sweet and there is a thin layer of soft flesh.
definition.sw: Hatua ya kati: maji ni matamu na kuna tabaka jembamba la nyama laini.
definition.dg: Hatua ya kahi: madzi ni ga mtswano na kuna nyama nyembamba ya yuya.

use.en: Drunk for refreshment.
use.sw: Hunywewa ili kuburudisha.
use.dg: Nkunwewa kpwa kudzipha baridi.

definition.en: The stage between dafu and nazi: the water is no longer sweet and the flesh is too hard to enjoy fresh, but still too soft to make coconut milk (uwi).
definition.sw: Hatua iliyo kati ya dafu na nazi: maji si matamu tena na nyama ni ngumu mno kufurahiwa ikiwa mbichi, lakini bado ni laini mno kutengeneza tui (uwi).
definition.dg: Hatua iriyo kahi ya *dafu* na *nazi*: madzi tagana mtswano tsena, na nyama ni ngumu kuriwa dza irivyo, ela bado ni ya yuya sana kuhenda huwi (*uwi*).

definition.en: The mature coconut, the most useful stage. Nazi is also the everyday word for any coconut, but strictly it means this stage.
definition.sw: Nazi iliyokomaa, hatua yenye manufaa zaidi. Nazi pia ni neno la kila siku kwa nazi yoyote, lakini kwa usahihi linamaanisha hatua hii.
definition.dg: Nazi iriyoivwa, hatua yenye fwaida zaidi. Nazi piya ni dzina ra chila siku ra nazi yoyosi, ela kpwa kpweli rina mana ya hatua ihi.

use.en: Grated to make coconut milk (uwi) for cooking and for making coconut oil; the Digo grow coconut palms mainly for the nazi.
use.sw: Hukunwa ili kupata tui la kupikia na la kutengenezea mafuta ya nazi; Wadigo hupanda minazi hasa kwa ajili ya nazi.
use.dg: Nkukunwa kuhenda huwi kpwa kujita na kuhenda mafuha ga nazi; Adigo nkuphanda minazi zaidi kpwa sababu ya nazi.

definition.en: A late, over-mature stage that farmers mostly avoid.
definition.sw: Hatua ya mwisho ya nazi iliyokomaa kupita kiasi, ambayo wakulima kwa kawaida huiepuka.
definition.dg: Hatua ya mwisho, nazi iriyoivwa kutsupa chiasi, ambayo akurima anji anaihepa.

use.en: The flesh is chewed and is believed to be an aphrodisiac; it can also be sold as copra for oil.
use.sw: Nyama yake hutafunwa na inaaminika kuongeza nguvu za kiume; pia inaweza kuuzwa kama mbata kwa ajili ya mafuta.
use.dg: Nyamaye nkuafunwa, na nkuaminika kukala inaenjereza hamu ya kulala na mchetu; piya inaweza kuguzwa dza mbata ya kuhenda mafuha.

definition.en: The outer skin of the coconut fruit. The same word names the base of the leaf stalk.
definition.sw: Ngozi ya nje ya tunda la nazi. Neno hilohilo hutaja kitako cha kikonyo cha jani.
definition.dg: Gada ra kondze ra nazi. Neno hiri piya ni dzina ra kolo ra mlita wa kodza.

shared_with: kumbi: the base of the coconut leaf stalk

definition.en: The coir, the fibrous layer of the coconut husk. The same word names the fibres on the leaf stalk.
definition.sw: Makumbi, yaani tabaka la nyuzinyuzi la ganda la nazi. Neno hilohilo hutaja nyuzi zilizo kwenye kikonyo cha jani.
definition.dg: Nyuzi za rifu ra nazi. Neno hiri piya ni dzina ra nyuzi ziriphokala kpwa mlita wa kodza.

use.en: The coir husk is used for scrubbing utensils, like steel wool; more recently it is made into floor rags and processed into coco-peat for potting soil.
use.sw: Kumbi hutumika kusugulia vyombo, kama sufu ya chuma; hivi karibuni zaidi hutengenezwa vitambaa vya kusafishia sakafu na husindikwa kuwa coco-peat kwa udongo wa kupandia mimea vyunguni.
use.dg: Ndifu nkuhumirwa kusingira vyombo, dza sufu ya chuma; sambi piya nkuhendwa vitambara vya kusingira photsi na nkuhendwa coco-peat ya kuphandira mimea kpwa vyombo.

shared_with: ndifu: the fibres on the coconut leaf stalk

definition.en: The husk, the whole outer covering of the coconut.
definition.sw: Ganda, yaani kifuniko chote cha nje cha nazi.
definition.dg: Rifu ra nazi, gada rosi ra kondze rinarofunika nazi.

use.en: Used for firewood, for stuffing mattresses and for making rope.
use.sw: Hutumika kama kuni, kujaza magodoro na kutengeneza kamba.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa dza kuni, kudzaza magodoro na kuhenda kamba.

definition.en: The hard inner shell of the coconut.
definition.sw: Kifuu kigumu cha ndani cha nazi.
definition.dg: Gada gumu ra ndani ra nazi.

use.en: Used as fuel; Mgombato adds ladles, and Pakia notes it is now also made into bracelets.
use.sw: Hutumika kama nishati ya kuni; Mgombato anaongeza kata, na Pakia anabainisha kwamba sasa pia hutengenezwa bangili.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa dza kuni; Mgombato inaenjereza maliphazi, na Pakia anagomba kukala sambi piya nkuhendwa bangili.

definition.en: The empty shell of a young coconut (dafu).
definition.sw: Kifuu kitupu cha nazi changa (dafu).
definition.dg: Chivo chitupu cha nazi tsanga (*dafu*).

definition.en: The clear liquid inside the coconut. Pakia stresses that this, not uwi, is what English calls 'coconut water' or sometimes 'coconut milk'.
definition.sw: Kiowevu angavu kilicho ndani ya nazi. Pakia anasisitiza kwamba hiki, wala si uwi, ndicho Kiingereza kinachokiita 'coconut water' au wakati mwingine 'coconut milk'.
definition.dg: Madzi meru ganagokala ndani ya nazi. Pakia anatiya mkazo kukala higa, si *uwi*, ndigo Chingereza ganaihwa 'coconut water' au wakati wanjina 'coconut milk'.

definition.en: The white flesh of the coconut, the part grated for coconut milk.
definition.sw: Nyama nyeupe ya nazi, sehemu inayokunwa ili kupata tui.
definition.dg: Nyama nyereru ya nazi, seemu inayokunwa kuhenda huwi.

shared_with: nazi: the mature stage of the fruit, and the coconut in general

definition.en: The soft, edible flesh of a young drinking coconut (dafu).
definition.sw: Nyama laini inayolika ya nazi changa ya kunywa (dafu).
definition.dg: Nyama ya yuya inayoriwa ya nazi tsanga ya kunwa (*dafu*).

definition.en: The embryo inside the coconut, from which the new palm grows.
definition.sw: Kiinitete kilicho ndani ya nazi, ambacho mnazi mpya huota kutoka kwake.
definition.dg: Chitsa chiriphokala ndani ya nazi, ambacho mnazi muphya unamera kula kpwacho.

meaning.en: Moon; Pakia suggests the round embryo looks like a full moon.
meaning.sw: Mwezi; Pakia anapendekeza kwamba kiinitete hicho cha mviringo kinafanana na mwezi mpevu.
meaning.dg: Mwezi wa dzulu; Pakia anaona kukala chitsa chiri dza mviringo chinahalana na mwezi mzima.

shared_with: mwezi: the cotyledon of the mango seed

definition.en: The three 'eyes' (scars) on the coconut shell; the same word is used for a bean's hilum and a potato's eye buds.
definition.sw: 'Macho' matatu (makovu) yaliyo kwenye kifuu cha nazi; neno hilohilo hutumika kwa kitovu cha harage na vichipukizi vya kiazi.
definition.dg: 'Matso' mahahu (alama) ganagokala kpwa chivo cha nazi; neno hiri piya nkuhumirwa kpwa alama ya tembe ya haragbwe na matso ga chiazi.

definition.en: Coconuts tied together in a bunch.
definition.sw: Nazi zilizofungwa pamoja kwa kishada.
definition.dg: Nazi zirizofungwa phamwenga kpwa bunda.

definition.en: A bunch of coconuts still on their fruit stalks.
definition.sw: Kishada cha nazi ambazo bado ziko kwenye vikonyo vyake.
definition.dg: Bunda ra nazi zichiri kpwa milita yao.

definition.en: Coconut milk: the creamy liquid squeezed from grated mature coconut (nazi). Mgombato spells it huwi and describes straining the grated pulp with water through a chifumbu basket.
definition.sw: Tui: kiowevu kizito kinachokamuliwa kutoka nazi iliyokomaa (nazi) iliyokunwa. Mgombato anaiandika huwi na anaeleza jinsi machicha yaliyokunwa yanavyochujwa pamoja na maji kupitia kikapu cha chifumbu.
definition.dg: Maziya ga nazi: madzi mazito ganagominywa kula nazi iriyoivwa na kukunwa. Mgombato inauandika *huwi* na inaeleza kutsudza nazi iriyokunwa na madzi kpwa kaphu ya *chifumbu*.

use.en: Used for cooking and for making coconut oil.
use.sw: Hutumika kupikia na kutengeneza mafuta ya nazi.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa kujitira na kuhenda mafuha ga nazi.

definition.en: The coconut left in the shell after grating.
definition.sw: Nazi inayobaki kwenye kifuu baada ya kukuna.
definition.dg: Nazi inayosala ndani ya chivo bada ya kukunwa.

definition.en: Palm wine tapped from the coconut palm.
definition.sw: Tembo linalogemwa kutoka mnazi.
definition.dg: Uchi unaojemwa kula kpwa mnazi.

definition.en: Palm wine; also liquor, beer or any alcoholic drink.
definition.sw: Tembo; pia pombe, bia au kinywaji chochote chenye kileo.
definition.dg: Uchi wa mnazi; piya chinwadzi chochosi chinachomuhenda mutu alewe.

definition.en: A section of thatch made from coconut leaves: leaflets are plucked and tied one by one back onto the midrib (mbati), overlapping so that rain cannot get through.
definition.sw: Kipande cha kuti la kuezekea kinachotengenezwa kwa majani ya mnazi: vijani hung'olewa na kufungwa kimoja kimoja tena kwenye ubavu (mbati), vikipishana ili mvua isipenye.
definition.dg: Chipande cha makuti chirichohendwa kula makodza ga mnazi: makodza madide nkumwafulwa na kufungwa mwenga-mwenga luphya kpwa *mbati*, garigolaliana ili mvula isiinjire.

use.en: Roofing. Mgombato: viungo vya mwenga mwenga is a single layer of thatch, viungo vya mairi mairi a double layer.
use.sw: Kuezekea paa. Mgombato: viungo vya mwenga mwenga ni makuti ya tabaka moja, viungo vya mairi mairi ni ya tabaka mbili.
use.dg: Kuezekera nyumba. Mgombato: *viungo vya mwenga mwenga* ni tabaka mwenga ya makuti, *viungo vya mairi mairi* ni tabaka mbiri.

definition.en: A strip of palm leaf, for example for tying leaves onto a stick to make sections of thatch. Mgombato does not name the palm; its plural ng'ongo is also a separate raffia word.
definition.sw: Kipande chembamba cha jani la mchikichi, kwa mfano cha kufungia majani kwenye kijiti ili kutengeneza vipande vya makuti. Mgombato hautaji mchikichi husika; wingi wake ng'ongo pia ni neno tofauti linalohusu mwale.
definition.dg: Chipande chembamba cha kodza ra muhi wa jamii ya mnazi, kpwa mfwano kufungira makodza kpwa muhi kuhenda vipande vya makuti. Mgombato taitaja dzina ra muhi; wingiwe *ng'ongo* piya ni neno ranjina ra mlala.

definition.en: A strip of coconut frond used as string or twine.
definition.sw: Kipande chembamba cha jani la mnazi kinachotumika kama uzi au kamba nyembamba.
definition.dg: Chipande cha kodza ra mnazi chinachohumirwa dza lugbwe au uzi.

definition.en: A broom; Pakia names it among the things made from the leaflet midribs (mikuti).
definition.sw: Fagio; Pakia analitaja miongoni mwa vitu vinavyotengenezwa kwa mbavu za vijani (mikuti).
definition.dg: Phyero; Pakia anaritaja kahi ya vitu vinavyohendwa kula kpwa mingo ya makodza madide (*mikuti*).

definition.en: A fish trap made from the leaflet midribs (mikuti).
definition.sw: Mtego wa samaki unaotengenezwa kwa mbavu za vijani (mikuti).
definition.dg: Muhambo wa ng'onda unaohendwa kula kpwa mingo ya makodza madide (*mikuti*).

definition.en: Sticks for smoking fish, made from the leaf midrib (mbati).
definition.sw: Vijiti vya kubanikia samaki, vinavyotengenezwa kwa ubavu wa jani (mbati).
definition.dg: Mihi midide ya kuwadira ng'onda, inayohendwa kula kpwa mongo wa kodza (*mbati*).

teaser.en: When the sun sets during Ramadan, many Digo households break the fast the traditional way: with a date.
teaser.sw: Jua linapozama wakati wa Ramadhani, kaya nyingi za Wadigo hufuturu kwa njia ya jadi: kwa tende.
teaser.dg: Dzuwa richitswa wakati wa Ramadhani, mbari nyinji za Adigo nkuvugula kpwa njira ya chimila: kpwa tende.

summary.en: *Mtende*, the date palm, is a feather palm that is only occasionally planted on the coast; most dates are imported. Its fruit, *tende*, holds a special place at the table during Ramadan.
summary.sw: *Mtende* ni mchikichi wenye majani kama manyoya ambao hupandwa mara chache tu pwani; tende nyingi huagizwa kutoka nje. Tunda lake, *tende*, lina nafasi maalum mezani wakati wa Ramadhani.
summary.dg: *Mtende* ni muhi wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga manyoya, unaophandwa mara chache bahi pwani; tende nyinji nkurehwa kula tsi za kondze. Tundare, *tende*, rina nafasi ya chipekee kpwa chakurya wakati wa Ramadhani.

about.en:
*Mtende* is a feather palm with a rough trunk patterned by the bases of old leaves and a crown of stiff, grey-green, feather-shaped fronds. The lower leaflets are hardened into sharp spines.

Male and female flowers grow on separate trees, and only the female trees bear fruit: heavy hanging bunches of dates, the *tende*, which ripen from yellow or red to brown.
about.sw:
*Mtende* ni mchikichi wenye majani kama manyoya, wenye shina gumu lililopambwa na vitako vya majani ya zamani na taji la majani magumu, ya kijani-kijivu, yenye umbo la manyoya. Vijani vya chini vimegeuka kuwa miiba mikali.

Maua ya kiume na ya kike huota kwenye miti tofauti, na ni miti ya kike tu inayozaa matunda: vishada vizito vinavyoning'inia vya tende, *tende*, zinazoiva kutoka manjano au nyekundu hadi kahawia.
about.dg:
*Mtende* ni muhi wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga manyoya, wenye kolo ririro na mikpwaruzo ya mlita ya makodza ga kare na chitswa cha makodza mafu ga rangi ya chijani na ivu ga umbo ra manyoya. Makodza madide ga photsi ganakala magumu na kukala miya ya ntsa.

Maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwa mihi tafwauti, na ni mihi ya chichetu tu inayovyala matunda: mabunda mazito ga tende, *tende*, zinazoivwa kula rangi ya mandano au kundu hadi rangi ya dongo.

where.en: It is only occasionally planted on the south coast, and the dates sold in local markets are mostly imported. The humid coast suits it less well than the dry lands where dates are grown commercially.
where.sw: Hupandwa mara chache tu katika pwani ya kusini, na tende zinazouzwa katika masoko ya ndani kwa kiasi kikubwa huagizwa kutoka nje. Pwani yenye unyevu haiufai sana kama nchi kavu ambako tende hulimwa kibiashara.
where.dg: Unaphandwa mara chache bahi pwani ya kusini, na tende zinazoguzwa kpwa soko za hipha kpwa unji nkurehwa kula tsi za kondze. Pwani yenye jeke-jeke taifwaha dza tsi kavu ambako tende nkuphandwa kpwa biashara.

uses.en: Dates are eaten especially when breaking the Ramadan fast, at sunset, before the evening meal.
uses.sw: Tende huliwa hasa wakati wa kufuturu katika Ramadhani, jua linapozama, kabla ya mlo wa jioni.
uses.dg: Tende nkuriwa hasa wakati wa kuvugula Ramadhani, dzuwa richitswa, kabla ya chakurya cha dziloni.

culture.en: In a largely Muslim community, *tende* are closely linked to Ramadan, when it is customary to break the day's fast with a date.
culture.sw: Katika jamii ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa ni ya Waislamu, *tende* zimefungamana sana na Ramadhani, ambapo ni desturi kufungua saumu ya mchana kwa tende.
culture.dg: Kpwa jamii ambayo atu anji ni Aislamu, *tende* zinahusiana sana na Ramadhani, wakati ambapho ni desturi kuvugula kpwa tende.

names.en: The Mgombato dictionary gives *mtende* for the date palm, and Pakia records the fruit as *tende*. The Swahili names are the same: *mtende* for the palm and *tende* for the fruit. In English it is the date palm, and its scientific name is *Phoenix dactylifera*.
names.sw: Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mtende* kwa mchikichi huu, na Pakia anarekodi tunda kama *tende*. Majina ya Kiswahili ni yaleyale: *mtende* kwa mti na *tende* kwa tunda. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *date palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Phoenix dactylifera*.
names.dg: Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mtende* kpwa muhi, na Pakia anaandika tunda dza *tende*. Madzina ga Chiswahili ni higa higa: *mtende* kpwa muhi na *tende* kpwa tunda. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *date palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Phoenix dactylifera*.

reason.en: Same genus: the wild date palm
reason.sw: Jenasi moja: mkindu
reason.dg: Wa jenasi mwenga: uchindu, mtende wa weruni

reason.en: Another palm grown around homes
reason.sw: Mchikichi mwingine unaopandwa kuzunguka nyumba
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya mnazi unaomera kanda-kanda ya midzi

reason.en: Another feather palm
reason.sw: Mchikichi mwingine wenye majani kama manyoya
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga manyoya

teaser.en: In the wet valleys below the Shimba Hills grows a wild relative of the palm that fills supermarket shelves worldwide with oil.
teaser.sw: Katika mabonde yenye maji chini ya Milima ya Shimba huota ndugu wa porini wa mchikichi unaojaza rafu za maduka makubwa duniani kote kwa mafuta.
teaser.dg: Kpwenye madete ga madzi photsi ya Shimba Hills kunamera *mtsikitsi*, nduguye wa tsakani wa muhi wa jamii ya mnazi unaoodzaza maduka ga duniani kosi mafuha.

summary.en: *Mtsikitsi*, the wild oil palm, is a feather palm of wet valley bottoms and stream sides on the south coast. Its orange-red fruits give palm oil, and it is also tapped for palm wine.
summary.sw: *Mtsikitsi*, yaani mchikichi wa porini, ni mmea wa jamii ya mnazi wenye majani kama manyoya unaoota katika mabonde yenye maji na kando ya vijito katika pwani ya kusini. Matunda yake ya rangi ya machungwa-nyekundu hutoa mafuta ya mawese, na pia hugemwa kupata tembo.
summary.dg: *Mtsikitsi*, muhi wa mafuha wa tsakani, ni muhi wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza dza nyoya, unaomera kpwenye madete ga madzi na kanda-kanda ya miho midide pwani ya kusini. Matundage ga rangi ya chungbwa na kundu ganalavya mafuha ga *mchikichi*, na piya nkujemwa kuphaha uchi.

about.en:
*Mtsikitsi* is a single-stemmed feather palm. The trunk is rough with the stubs of old leaf bases, and the leaf stalks are spiny. The crown holds long, arching fronds.

The fruits grow in dense, heavy bunches tucked among the leaf bases. Each fruit is small and plum-shaped, ripening to orange-red, with an oily pulp around a hard kernel.
about.sw:
*Mtsikitsi* ni mmea wa jamii ya mnazi wenye shina moja na majani kama manyoya. Shina lake limekwaruzika kwa visiki vya vikonyo vya majani ya zamani, na vikonyo vya majani vina miiba. Kilele chake kina makuti marefu yaliyopinda.

Matunda huota katika vichala vizito vilivyosongamana, vilivyojificha kati ya vikonyo vya majani. Kila tunda ni dogo na lenye umbo la plamu, huiva na kuwa la rangi ya machungwa-nyekundu, na lina nyama yenye mafuta inayozunguka kokwa gumu.
about.dg:
*Mtsikitsi* ni muhi wa jamii ya mnazi wenye kolo mwenga, na makodzage ni dza nyoya. Kolore rinakaraza kpwa magutu ga misingi ya makodza makare, na milita ya makodza ina miya. Dzulu kuna makodza mare ganayomyoka.

Matunda ganamera kpwa mabunda maziho, ga kubanana, garigofitsika kahi ya misingi ya makodza. Chila tunda ni ridide na ra umbo ra *plum*, rinaivwa kukala ra rangi ya chungbwa na kundu, na rina nyama ya mafuha inayozunguluka chitsa chigumu.

where.en: It grows in wet valley bottoms and along streams on the south coast, such as at the foot of the Shimba Hills and around Msambweni. Look for its feathery crown above the green of a valley floor.
where.sw: Huota katika mabonde yenye maji na kando ya vijito katika pwani ya kusini, kama vile chini ya Milima ya Shimba na kuzunguka Msambweni. Utakiona kilele chake chenye majani kama manyoya juu ya ukijani wa sakafu ya bonde.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye madete ga madzi na kanda-kanda ya miho midide pwani ya kusini, dza photsi ya Shimba Hills na phephi na Msambweni. Lola makodzage dza nyoya ganayoonekana dzulu ya uchijani wa photsi ya dete.

uses.en: Oil is pressed from the fruit. The palm is also tapped for palm wine, and its leaves are used.
uses.sw: Mafuta hukamuliwa kutoka kwenye tunda. Mmea huu pia hugemwa kupata tembo, na majani yake hutumika.
uses.dg: Mafuha nkuhendwa kula kpwa matunda. Muhi uhu piya nkujemwa kuphaha uchi, na makodzage nkuhumirwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtsikitsi* and describes it as the 'wild oil palm'. The Mgombato dictionary also gives *mtsikitsi* for the wild or Guinea oil palm, and notes that the same word is used for cycads. Pakia uses *mtsikitsi* for the raffia palm too, so the name covers more than one plant. In Swahili it is *mchikichi* (Mgombato adds *mchikichi wa bara*) or *mwese*. In English it is the oil palm, and its scientific name is *Elaeis guineensis*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtsikitsi* na kuueleza kama 'mchikichi wa porini'. Kamusi ya Mgombato pia inatoa *mtsikitsi* kwa mchikichi wa porini au wa Guinea, na inaeleza kwamba neno hilohilo hutumika kwa *cycads*. Pakia anatumia *mtsikitsi* kwa mwale (*raffia palm*) pia, hivyo jina hili linahusu zaidi ya mmea mmoja. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mchikichi* (Mgombato anaongeza *mchikichi wa bara*) au *mwese*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *oil palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Elaeis guineensis*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtsikitsi* na anaueleza kukala 'muhi wa mafuha wa tsakani'. Kamusi ya Mgombato piya inapha *mtsikitsi* kpwa muhi wa mafuha wa tsakani au wa Guinea, na inaandika kukala neno hiro nkuhumirwa piya kpwa *cycads*. Pakia anahumira *mtsikitsi* piya kpwa *raffia palm*, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri ni ra mimea zaidi ya mwenga. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mchikichi* (Mgombato inaenjereza *mchikichi wa bara*) au *mwese*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *oil palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Elaeis guineensis*.

teaser.en: Its leaves can reach eight metres, among the longest in the plant world, and its young leaflets give the raffia used for mats and string.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yanaweza kufikia mita nane, miongoni mwa majani marefu zaidi katika ulimwengu wa mimea, na vijani vyake vichanga hutoa nyuzi za raffia zinazotumika kwa mikeka na kamba.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganaweza kufika mita nane, ni kahi ya makodza mare zaidi ga mimea yosi duniani, na makodza madide matsanga ganalavya mlala unaohumirwa kuhenda majamvi na nyugbwe.

summary.en: The raffia palm, also called *mtsikitsi* by the Digo, is a massive clustering palm of freshwater swamp forest and river banks on the south coast. It gives raffia fibre, rafters, chairs and thatch, but it is disappearing as its swamps are cleared.
summary.sw: Mwaale, unaoitwa pia *mtsikitsi* na Wadigo, ni mmea mkubwa sana wa jamii ya mnazi unaokua kwa vichaka katika misitu ya vinamasi vya maji baridi na kingo za mito pwani ya kusini. Hutoa nyuzi za raffia, mataruma ya paa, viti na makuti ya kuezekea, lakini unatoweka kadiri vinamasi vyake vinavyofyekwa.
summary.dg: Muhi hinyu wa mlala, ambao Adigo anauiha piya *mtsikitsi*, ni muhi mkulu sana wa jamii ya mnazi unaomera kpwa mafungu kpwenye matsaka ga madimbwi ga madzi gasigo na munyu na kanda-kanda ya miho pwani ya kusini. Unalavya mlala, maphalu, vihi na makodza ga kuezekera, ela unaangamika kpwa sababu madimbwige ganatsuswa.

about.en:
This is a giant among palms. It grows in clumps, its trunks covered in the old bases of fallen leaves. The leaves stand erect and can reach 8 metres long, with crimson-brown stalks.

The fruits are covered in shiny, overlapping scales like the skin of a reptile or a pine cone, and hang in long, heavy clusters.
about.sw:
Huu ni jitu miongoni mwa mimea ya jamii ya mnazi. Hukua kwa vichaka, na mashina yake yamefunikwa na vitako vya zamani vya majani yaliyoanguka. Majani yake husimama wima na yanaweza kufikia urefu wa mita 8, yakiwa na mikono ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu iliyokolea.

Matunda yake yamefunikwa na magamba yanayong'aa yanayopishana kama ngozi ya mtambaazi au koni ya msonobari, na huning'inia kwa vishada virefu vizito.
about.dg:
Hinyu ni muhi mkulu sana kahi ya mihi ya jamii ya minazi. Unamera kpwa mafungu, na makologe ganafwinikpwa ni masina ga makodza ga kare garigogbwa. Makodza ganaima chocho na ganaweza kufika mita 8 kpwa ure, na militaye ni ya rangi ya kundu na dongo.

Matunda ganafwinikpwa ni mamba ganagong'arira ganagopandana, dza ngozi ya nyoka au tunda ra *pine*, na ganagbwadzika kpwa mafungu mare na maziho.

where.en: It grows in freshwater swamp forest and on river banks in the swampy valleys of the south coast. These wet places are becoming scarce, so the palm is now harder to find than it once was.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya vinamasi vya maji baridi na kwenye kingo za mito katika mabonde yenye vinamasi ya pwani ya kusini. Maeneo haya yenye majimaji yanazidi kuwa adimu, hivyo mmea huu sasa ni vigumu zaidi kuupata kuliko zamani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga madimbwi ga madzi gasigo na munyu na kanda-kanda ya miho kpwenye mabonde ga madimbwi ga pwani ya kusini. Phatu phenye madzi higa phanaphunguka, kpwa hivyo sambi ni vigumu kuuphaha kuriko kare.

uses.en: The young leaflets are stripped to give raffia fibre, which is made into ropes, string, mats and baskets. The strong, light midribs of the leaves serve as rafters and are made into chairs and ladders. The leaves are used for thatch, and oil is taken from the fruit.
uses.sw: Vijani vichanga hubanduliwa kupata nyuzi za raffia, ambazo hutengenezwa kuwa kamba, uzi, mikeka na vikapu. Mbavu za katikati za majani, zilizo imara na nyepesi, hutumika kama mataruma ya paa na hutengenezwa kuwa viti na ngazi. Majani hutumika kuezekea, na mafuta hukamuliwa kutoka kwenye matunda.
uses.dg: Makodza madide matsanga nkuyulwa kulavya mlala, unaohendwa kamba, nyugbwe, majamvi na vitsango. Mabati ga makodza, ambago ni magumu na maphepheya, nkuhumirwa dza maphalu na nkuhendwa vihi na ngazi. Makodza nkuhumirwa kuezekera, na mafuha nkulavywa kula matunda.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtsikitsi* for both the raffia palm and the wild oil palm, so the name needs care. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mtsikitsi* only for the oil palm and cycads. In Swahili, and in Taveta, it is *mwaale*. In English it is the raffia palm, and its scientific name is *Raphia farinifera*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtsikitsi* kwa mwaale na pia kwa mchikichi wa porini, hivyo jina hili linahitaji uangalifu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mtsikitsi* kwa mchikichi na mimea ya jamii ya *cycad* pekee. Kwa Kiswahili, na kwa Kitaveta, ni *mwaale*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *raffia palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Raphia farinifera*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtsikitsi* kpwa muhi hinyu wa mlala na kpwa muhi wa jamii ya mnazi wa mafuha wa weruni, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri ni lazima rihumirwe kpwa uangalifu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inalavya *mtsikitsi* kpwa muhi wa jamii ya mnazi wa mafuha na *cycads* tu. Kpwa Chiswahili, na kpwa Chitaveta, ni *mwaale*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *raffia palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Raphia farinifera*.

conservation.sw: Unatoweka kadiri makazi yake ya vinamasi yanavyoharibiwa.
conservation.dg: Unaangamika kpwa sababu madimbwi ambamo unamera ganabanangwa.

summary.en: *Mvumo*, the borassus or African fan palm, is a tall palm of watercourses on the coastal plain, with a trunk that bulges above the middle. It gives palm wine, fruit, poles, thatch and fibre, but tapping has reduced its numbers.
summary.sw: *Mvumo* ni mchikichi mrefu wa kando ya mikondo ya maji katika nyanda za pwani, wenye shina linalovimba juu ya katikati. Hutoa tembo, matunda, nguzo, makuti na nyuzi, lakini ugemaji umepunguza idadi yake.
summary.dg: *Mvumo* ni muhi mure wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero, unaomera kanda-kanda ya miho kpwa tsi ya photsi ya pwani, na kolore rinavwimba dzulu ya kahi. Unalavya uchi, matunda, nguzo, makuti na nyuzi, ela kujemwa kukaphunguza unjiwe.

about.en:
*Mvumo* is a tall single palm that can reach 25 metres. Its smooth grey trunk swells out above the middle and narrows again beneath the crown, a shape that makes it easy to recognise from far away. The leaves are huge stiff fans on long stalks edged with hard teeth.

The fruits are large, round and orange-brown, growing in heavy clusters on the female trees. The Digo call the fruit *ngolokolo*.
about.sw:
*Mvumo* ni mchikichi mrefu wa shina moja unaoweza kufikia mita 25. Shina lake laini la kijivu huvimba juu ya katikati na kuwa jembamba tena chini ya taji, umbo linalourahisisha kutambuliwa ukiwa mbali. Majani ni makubwa mno, magumu na yenye umbo la kipepeo, juu ya vikonyo virefu vyenye meno magumu pembeni.

Matunda ni makubwa, ya mviringo na ya rangi ya kahawia-machungwa, yakiota kwa vishada vizito kwenye miti ya kike. Wadigo huliita tunda hili *ngolokolo*.
about.dg:
*Mvumo* ni muhi mure wa jamii ya mnazi wa kolo rimwenga, unaoweza kufika mita 25. Kolore laini ra rangi ya ivu rinavwimba dzulu ya kahi na kukala rembamba tsena photsi ya chitswa, umbo ambaro rinahenda muhi uhu umanyikane rahisi kula kure. Makodza ni ga chiphephero makulu sana na mafu kpwa milita mire yenye meno magumu kanda-kanda.

Matunda ni makulu, ga mviringo na ga rangi ya chungbwa na dongo, ganamera kpwa mabunda mazito kpwa mihi ya chichetu. Adigo anaiha tunda *ngolokolo*.

where.en: It grows along watercourses where the water table is high, scattered across the coastal plain and in river valleys. Its swollen trunks stand out above the bush.
where.sw: Hustawi kando ya mikondo ya maji mahali ambapo maji ya ardhini yako karibu na uso, ukiwa umetawanyika katika nyanda za pwani na katika mabonde ya mito. Mashina yake yaliyovimba hujitokeza juu ya kichaka.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya miho phatu ambapho madzi ga tsini ga phephi, ukatawanyika kosi kpwa tsi ya photsi ya pwani na kpwa madete ga miho. Makologe garigovwimba ganaonekana dzulu ya weruni.

uses.en:
The sap is tapped for palm wine. The fruit is eaten, and the young seedlings are dug up and eaten as a vegetable.

The trunk gives poles and timber, and the leaves are used for thatch and woven into mats and baskets, as well as giving fibre.
uses.sw:
Utomvu hugemwa ili kupata tembo. Tunda huliwa, na miche michanga huchimbuliwa na kuliwa kama mboga.

Shina hutoa nguzo na mbao, na majani hutumika kuezekea na husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu, pamoja na kutoa nyuzi.
uses.dg:
Utomvu wa mvumo nkujemwa kpwa uchi. Tunda nkuriwa, na mitse mitsanga nkufukulwa na kujitwa dza mtsunga.

Kolo rinalavya nguzo na mbao, na makodza nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba na nkusukwa majamvi na kaphu, na piya ganalavya nyuzi.

names.en: The Digo name is *mvumo*, also written *muvumo* in the Mgombato dictionary, and the ICRAF handbook and Pakia also give *dzova*; the fruit is *ngolokolo*. In Swahili it is *mvumo*, *mchapa* or *mtapa*. It is *mvumo* in Duruma and *mugumo* in Giriama. In English it is the borassus palm or African fan palm, and its scientific name is *Borassus aethiopum*. Mgombato also lists a second *mvumo* meaning khat (*Catha edulis*), a different plant altogether.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mvumo*, pia huandikwa *muvumo* katika kamusi ya Mgombato, na kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF pamoja na Pakia pia wanatoa *dzova*; tunda ni *ngolokolo*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mvumo*, *mchapa* au *mtapa*. Ni *mvumo* kwa Kiduruma na *mugumo* kwa Kigiriama. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *borassus palm* au *African fan palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Borassus aethiopum*. Mgombato pia anaorodhesha *mvumo* wa pili wenye maana ya mirungi (*Catha edulis*), mmea tofauti kabisa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mvumo*, piya rinaandikpwa *muvumo* kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, na chitabu cha ICRAF na Pakia piya anapha *dzova*; tunda ni *ngolokolo*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mvumo*, *mchapa* au *mtapa*. Kpwa Chiduruma ni *mvumo* na kpwa Chigiryama *mugumo*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *borassus palm* au *African fan palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Borassus aethiopum*. Mgombato piya inaandika *mvumo* wa phiri wenye mana ya miraa (*Catha edulis*), mmea wanjina kabisa.

definition.en: The leaves of a young fan palm (doum or borassus). The name depends on the palm's age because only young plants' leaves are useful.
definition.sw: Majani ya mchikichi mchanga wenye majani kama kipepeo (mkoma au mvumo). Jina hutegemea umri wa mchikichi kwa sababu ni majani ya mimea michanga tu yanayofaa.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi mtsanga wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero (mkoma au mvumo). Dzina rinakuluphira umri wa muhi kpwa sababu ni makodza ga mihi mitsanga bahi ganagofwaha.

use.en: Woven into mats, baskets, hats and other items.
use.sw: Husukwa kuwa mikeka, vikapu, kofia na vitu vingine.
use.dg: Nkusukwa majamvi, kaphu, kofiya na vitu vyanjina.

meaning.en: From an older word meaning 'dwarf palm'. Mgombato glosses mlala as 'raffia', the weaving fibre.
meaning.sw: Kutoka neno la zamani lenye maana ya 'mchikichi mfupi'. Mgombato anaeleza mlala kama 'raffia', nyuzi za kusuka.
meaning.dg: Kula kpwa neno ra kare ririrokala na mana ya 'muhi mdide wa jamii ya mnazi'. Mgombato inaandika *mlala* dza 'raffia', nyuzi za kusukira.

definition.en: The leaves of a mature fan palm (doum or borassus), which are not used for weaving.
definition.sw: Majani ya mchikichi uliokomaa wenye majani kama kipepeo (mkoma au mvumo), ambayo hayatumiki kusuka.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero (mkoma au mvumo) uriokula, ambago tagahumirwa kusukira.
