teaser.en: Its leaves are woven into the mats called *ukuti wa uchindu*, and its little orange dates are a riverside snack.
teaser.sw: Majani yake husukwa kuwa mikeka inayoitwa *ukuti wa uchindu*, na tende zake ndogo za rangi ya machungwa ni kitafunio cha kando ya mto.
teaser.dg: Makodzage nkusukwa majamvi ganagoihwa *ukuti wa uchindu*, na tendeze ndide za rangi ya chungbwa ni chakurya cha kanda-kanda ya miho.

summary.en: *Uchindu*, the wild date palm, is a clumping palm of riverbanks, wet valleys and forest edges, with small orange dates. Its leaves are woven into mats and baskets, so heavily in places that the palm is over-exploited.
summary.sw: *Uchindu* ni mkindu, mchikichi unaoota kwa vichaka wa kingo za mito, mabonde yenye unyevu na pembezoni mwa misitu, wenye tende ndogo za rangi ya machungwa. Majani yake husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu, kwa wingi kiasi kwamba katika baadhi ya maeneo mchikichi huu unatumiwa kupita kiasi.
summary.dg: *Uchindu* ni muhi wa jamii ya mnazi unaomera kpwa vitsaka kanda-kanda ya miho, kpwa madete ga madzi-madzi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, wenye tende ndide za rangi ya chungbwa. Makodzage nkusukwa majamvi na kaphu, na kpwa phatu phanjina kpwa unji hata muhi unahumirwa kutsupa chiasi.

about.en:
*Uchindu* grows in clumps of slender, often leaning trunks up to 15 metres tall. Its arching feather leaves carry sharp spines near their base, so the clumps are hard to push through.

The fruits are small dates, orange-brown when ripe, hanging in bunches from the female trees.
about.sw:
*Uchindu* huota kwa vichaka vya mashina membamba, ambayo mara nyingi huinama, yenye urefu wa hadi mita 15. Majani yake yaliyopinda kama manyoya yana miiba mikali karibu na kitako chake, kwa hivyo ni vigumu kupenya katikati ya vichaka hivyo.

Matunda ni tende ndogo, za rangi ya kahawia-machungwa zikiiva, zinazoning'inia kwa vishada kutoka miti ya kike.
about.dg:
*Uchindu* unamera kpwa makundi ga makolo membamba, ambago kpwa kawaida ganabeduka, ga urefu wa hadi mita 15. Makodzage ga manyoya ganagootyoka gana miya ya ntsa phephi na kolo, kpwa hivyo ni vigumu kuinjira kahi ya makundi iga.

Matunda ni tende ndide, za rangi ya chungbwa na dongo zichiivwa, zinazobwadzika kpwa mabunda kula kpwa mihi ya chichetu.

where.en: It grows on riverbanks, in wet valleys and at forest edges, along stream banks and wet places in the coastal belt. Clumps of leaning trunks by water are a good sign of it.
where.sw: Hustawi kwenye kingo za mito, katika mabonde yenye unyevu na pembezoni mwa misitu, kando ya vijito na mahali penye unyevu katika ukanda wa pwani. Vichaka vya mashina yanayoinama kando ya maji ni ishara nzuri kwamba upo.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya miho, kpwa madete ga madzi-madzi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, kanda-kanda ya miho midide na phatu pha madzi-madzi kpwa uphande wa pwani. Makundi ga makolo ganagobeduka phephi na madzi ni ishara nono kukala uchindu uphapho.

uses.en:
The ripe fruit is eaten, and the palm is tapped for palm wine.

The leaves are woven into mats and baskets; Pakia records the phrase *ukuti wa uchindu*, the *uchindu* frond. They are also used for thatch and for beds. The plant is used in fire-making and has ceremonial uses.
uses.sw:
Tunda lililoiva huliwa, na mchikichi huu hugemwa ili kupata tembo.

Majani husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu; Pakia anarekodi msemo *ukuti wa uchindu*, jani la *uchindu*. Pia hutumika kuezekea na kutengenezea vitanda. Mmea huu hutumika katika kuwasha moto na una matumizi ya kitamaduni ya sherehe.
uses.dg:
Tunda ririroivwa nkuriwa, na muhi nkujemwa kpwa uchi.

Makodza nkusukwa majamvi na kaphu; Pakia anaandika maneno *ukuti wa uchindu*, kodza ra *uchindu*. Piya nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba na kuhenda vitanda. Mmea uhu nkuhumirwa kpwa kuasa moho na una kazi za mambo ga chimila.

culture.en: Pakia records that *uchindu* has ceremonial uses, though the details are not described.
culture.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba *uchindu* una matumizi ya kitamaduni ya sherehe, ingawa undani wake haujaelezwa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala *uchindu* nkuhumirwa kpwa mambo ga chimila, ela kaeleza mambo higo kpwa urefu.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *uchindu*; the ICRAF handbook and Maundu and Tengnäs give *mchindu* and *makindu*. In Swahili it is *mkindu*. In Giriama it is *mkindu* or *mkindwi*, and the fruit is *kindwi*. In English it is the wild date palm, and its scientific name is *Phoenix reclinata*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *uchindu*; kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF na Maundu na Tengnäs wanatoa *mchindu* na *makindu*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkindu*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mkindu* au *mkindwi*, na tunda ni *kindwi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *wild date palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Phoenix reclinata*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *uchindu*; chitabu cha ICRAF na Maundu na Tengnäs anapha *mchindu* na *makindu*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkindu*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mkindu* au *mkindwi*, na tunda ni *kindwi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild date palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Phoenix reclinata*.

conservation.en: It is over-exploited in places for handicrafts.
conservation.sw: Katika baadhi ya maeneo unatumiwa kupita kiasi kwa kazi za mikono.
conservation.dg: Kpwa phatu phanjina unahumirwa kutsupa chiasi kpwa kazi za mikpwono.

reason.sw: Jenasi moja: mtende unaopandwa
reason.dg: Wa jenasi mwenga: mtende unaophandwa

reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya mnazi wa phatu pha madzi-madzi unaohumirwa kusukira

definition.en: The midrib of a wild date palm leaflet. Coconut part names are only occasionally used for other palms, and then with 'of uchindu' added.
definition.sw: Ubavu wa kijani cha jani la mkindu. Majina ya sehemu za mnazi hutumika kwa michikichi mingine mara chache tu, na hapo huongezewa 'wa uchindu'.
definition.dg: Mongo wa kodza dide ra uchindu. Madzina ga seemu za mnazi nkuhumirwa mara chache bahi kpwa mihi yanjina ya jamii ya minazi, na phapho nkuenjerezwa 'wa uchindu'.

meaning.en: Ukuti of the wild date palm.

teaser.en: A tree of rocky coastal places whose white pea-flowers give way to flat woody pods, and whose Digo name depends on whom you ask.
teaser.sw: Mti wa maeneo ya miamba ya pwani ambao maua yake meupe kama ya kunde hufuatwa na maganda bapa magumu, na ambao jina lake la Kidigo hutegemea unamuuliza nani.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa phatu penye mawe pwani, ambao bada ya maruwage mereru dza ga kunde kunatuluka makakaya sambamba na mafu dza muhi, na dzinare ra Chidigo rinagaluka chila uchiuza mutu wanjina.

summary.en: *Chikunguni* is a tree of the coastal belt, often found in rocky places, with leaves of three to five leaflets, white pea-flowers and flat woody pods. It is a source of timber.
summary.sw: *Chikunguni* ni mti wa ukanda wa pwani, mara nyingi hupatikana katika maeneo ya miamba, wenye majani ya vijani vitatu hadi vitano, maua meupe kama ya kunde na maganda bapa magumu kama mti. Ni chanzo cha mbao.
summary.dg: *Chikunguni* ni muhi wa pwani, mara nyinji unaophahikana phatu penye mawe, wenye makodza ganayohendwa ni makodza madide mahahu hadi matsano, maruwa mereru dza ga kunde, na makakaya sambamba na mafu dza muhi. Nkuhumirwa kuphaha mbao.

about.en: *Chikunguni* is a tree of the pea family. Its leaves are compound, each made of three to five leaflets. Its flowers are white and shaped like pea-flowers, and they are followed by flat, woody pods that split open to release the seeds.
about.sw: *Chikunguni* ni mti wa familia ya kunde. Majani yake ni mchanganyiko, kila moja likiwa na vijani vitatu hadi vitano. Maua yake ni meupe na yana umbo la maua ya kunde, na hufuatwa na maganda bapa magumu kama mti yanayopasuka ili kuachilia mbegu.
about.dg: *Chikunguni* ni muhi wa jamii ya kunde. Makodzage ganahendwa ni makodza madide, chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu hadi matsano. Maruwage ni mereru na ga umbo dza maruwa ga kunde, na bada yao kunatuluka makakaya sambamba na mafu dza muhi, ganayoahuka na tembe zinatuluka.

where.en: It grows in the coastal belt, often in rocky places.
where.sw: Huota katika ukanda wa pwani, mara nyingi katika maeneo ya miamba.
where.dg: Unamera pwani, mara nyinji phatu penye mawe.

uses.en: It is a source of timber.
uses.sw: Ni chanzo cha mbao.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa kuphaha mbao.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chikunguni*, while Maundu and Tengnäs give *mfunda* as the Giriama and Digo name. Pakia uses *mfunda* for a different tree, *Cynometra suaheliensis*. In Swahili it is *mfunda mweupe*, the 'white *mfunda*', and in Giriama *mfunda*. No English name is in common use; its scientific name is *Craibia brevicaudata*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *chikunguni*, ilhali Maundu na Tengnäs wanatoa *mfunda* kama jina la Kigiriama na Kidigo. Pakia anatumia *mfunda* kwa mti mwingine, *Cynometra suaheliensis*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mfunda mweupe*, yaani '*mfunda* wa rangi nyeupe', na kwa Kigiriama *mfunda*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalotumika kwa kawaida; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Craibia brevicaudata*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chikunguni*, ela Maundu na Tengnäs analavya *mfunda* kukala dzina ra Chigiryama na ra Chidigo. Pakia anahumira *mfunda* kpwa muhi wanjina, *Cynometra suaheliensis*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mfunda mweupe*, '*mfunda* mwereru', na kpwa Chigiryama *mfunda*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Craibia brevicaudata*.

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa familia ya kunde; Cynometra kama mfunda wa Pakia
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya kunde; ni *Cynometra* dza *mfunda* wa Pakia

teaser.en: A little-known tree of the coastal woodlands, listed as Vulnerable, with lopsided paired leaflets and short warty pods.
teaser.sw: Mti usiojulikana sana wa misitu ya pwani, ulioorodheshwa kuwa Hatarini, wenye vijani vya jozi visivyolingana pande na maganda mafupi yenye vidutu.
teaser.dg: Muhi usiomanyikana sana wa matsaka ga wazi ga pwani, urioandikpwa kukala *Vulnerable*, wenye makodza madide ga mairi-mairi ambago upande mwenga ni mpana kuriko wanjina, na makakaya mafupi genye maugu.

summary.en: *Chikwadzu* is a small to medium tree of evergreen and deciduous woodland near the coast. It is listed as Vulnerable by the IUCN.
summary.sw: *Chikwadzu* ni mti mdogo hadi wa wastani wa misitu isiyopukutisha majani na inayopukutisha majani karibu na pwani. Umeorodheshwa na IUCN kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Chikwadzu* ni muhi mdide hadi wa chiasi wa matsaka ga wazi phephi na pwani, matsaka genye makodza chila wakati na garigo na mihi ambayo makodzage nkugbwa. Ukaandikpwa kukala *Vulnerable* ni IUCN.

about.en: *Chikwadzu* is a small to medium-sized tree of the pea family. Its leaves are made of paired leaflets that are lopsided, with one side wider than the other. Its pods are short, rounded and warty on the surface.
about.sw: *Chikwadzu* ni mti mdogo hadi wa ukubwa wa wastani wa familia ya kunde. Majani yake yanaundwa na vijani vya jozi visivyolingana pande, upande mmoja ukiwa mpana kuliko mwingine. Maganda yake ni mafupi, ya mviringo na yenye vidutu juu yake.
about.dg: *Chikwadzu* ni muhi mdide hadi wa chiasi wa jamii ya kunde. Makodzage ganahendwa ni makodza madide ganayomera mairi-mairi, na chila kodza ridide rina upande mwenga mpana kuriko wanjina. Makakayage ni mafupi, ga mviringo, na genye maugu.

where.en: It grows in evergreen and deciduous woodland near the coast, from sea level to about 150 metres.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu isiyopukutisha majani na inayopukutisha majani karibu na pwani, kuanzia usawa wa bahari hadi takriban mita 150.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga wazi phephi na pwani, genye makodza chila wakati na garigo na mihi ambayo makodzage nkugbwa, kula phephi na bahari hadi mita 150 hivi dzulu ya bahari.

uses.en: No particular uses have been recorded among the Digo so far.
uses.sw: Hadi sasa hakuna matumizi maalumu yaliyorekodiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Hadi sambi takuna matumizi ga muhi uhu kpwa Adigo garigoandikpwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chikwadzu*. No Swahili or English name has been recorded; its scientific name is *Cynometra webberi*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *chikwadzu*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Cynometra webberi*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chikwadzu*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili au ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Cynometra webberi*.

conservation.en: It is listed as Vulnerable by the IUCN.
conservation.sw: Umeorodheshwa na IUCN kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).
conservation.dg: Ukaandikpwa kukala *Vulnerable* ni IUCN.

teaser.en: Its name comes from *uganga*, healing, yet its white sap is so poisonous that a drop in the eye is dangerous.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linatokana na *uganga*, yaani tiba, lakini utomvu wake mweupe una sumu kali kiasi kwamba tone moja jichoni ni hatari.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinalavywa kula *uganga*, ela maziyage mereru ni sumu sana hata tone mwenga dzitsoni ni hatari.

summary.en: *Ganga* is a succulent tree shaped like a candelabra, with ribbed, spiny green branches full of poisonous white latex. It grows in dry bushland and on rocky hills, and is used in healing and for building.
summary.sw: *Ganga* ni mti wenye unyama wenye umbo la kinara cha mishumaa, wenye matawi ya kijani yenye mifuo na miiba yaliyojaa utomvu mweupe wenye sumu. Huota katika vichaka vikavu na kwenye vilima vya miamba, na hutumika katika tiba na ujenzi.
summary.dg: *Ganga* ni muhi wenye madzi manji ndani, wa umbo dza *candelabra*, wenye panda za chijani zenye mbavu na miya, zirizodzala maziya mereru ga sumu. Unamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu na kpwenye miango ya mawe, na nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga na kudzengera.

about.en:
*Ganga* looks more like a giant cactus than a tree. A short trunk divides into many upright, ribbed green branches, curving up like the arms of a candelabra. The ribs are lined with paired spines, and the branches do the work of leaves.

Cut or break any part of it and a thick, white latex pours out. The latex is poisonous and dangerous to the eyes.
about.sw:
*Ganga* inafanana zaidi na mpungate mkubwa kuliko mti. Shina fupi hugawanyika kuwa matawi mengi ya kijani yaliyosimama wima na yenye mifuo, yakipinda juu kama mikono ya kinara cha mishumaa. Mifuo imepangwa miiba ya jozi, na matawi hufanya kazi ya majani.

Ukikata au kuvunja sehemu yoyote yake, utomvu mzito mweupe hutiririka. Utomvu huo una sumu na ni hatari kwa macho.
about.dg:
*Ganga* unaonekana dza *cactus* mkulu kuriko muhi. Kula kpwa kolo fupi kunatuluka panda nyinji za chijani zinazoima chocho, zenye mbavu, zinazomyoka dzulu dza mikono ya *candelabra*. Mbavu zina miya miiri-miiri, na panda hizi ndizo zinazohenda kazi ya makodza.

Uchikata au uchivundza seemu yoyosi ya muhi uhu, maziya maziho mereru ganamwagika. Maziya higa ni ga sumu, na ni hatari kpwa matso.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and on rocky hills, standing out against the sky with its many upright arms.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu na kwenye vilima vya miamba, ikionekana wazi dhidi ya anga kwa mikono yake mingi iliyosimama wima.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu na kpwenye miango ya mawe, na unaonekana wazi mlunguni kpwa pandaze nyinji zinazoima chocho.

uses.en:
Pakia records that *ganga* is used in healing various ailments.

Its wood is used for roofing, doors and beehives. The latex is dangerous to the eyes, so people handle the plant with care.
uses.sw:
Pakia anarekodi kwamba *ganga* hutumika kutibu maradhi mbalimbali.

Mbao zake hutumika kwa paa, milango na mizinga ya nyuki. Utomvu wake ni hatari kwa macho, hivyo watu huushughulikia mmea huu kwa uangalifu.
uses.dg:
Pakia anaandika kukala *ganga* nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga wa makongo tafwauti.

Nyama za muhi uhu nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba, kuhendera miryango na mizinga ya nyuchi. Maziyage ni hatari kpwa matso, kpwa hivyo atu nkuugbwira mmea uhu kpwa kudzirinda.

culture.en: Pakia explains that the name *ganga* comes from *uganga*, healing, reflecting the plant's place in traditional medicine.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba jina *ganga* linatokana na *uganga*, yaani tiba, likionyesha nafasi ya mmea huu katika tiba za jadi.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala dzina *ganga* rinalavywa kula *uganga*, na ihi inaonyesa nafwasi ya mmea uhu kpwenye uganga wa chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *ganga*, which Duruma speakers share. Maundu and Tengnäs give the same Digo name for the related *Euphorbia candelabrum*, known in Giriama as *kithongothongo*. No Swahili or common English name has been recorded for this species; its scientific name is *Euphorbia nyikae*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *ganga*, ambalo wazungumzaji wa Kiduruma pia hulitumia. Maundu na Tengnäs wanatoa jina hilohilo la Kidigo kwa ndugu yake *Euphorbia candelabrum*, unaojulikana kwa Kigiriama kama *kithongothongo*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa kwa spishi hii; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Euphorbia nyikae*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *ganga*, ambaro Aduruma piya anarihumira. Maundu na Tengnäs analavya dzina hiri hiri ra Chidigo kpwa *Euphorbia candelabrum*, mmea wa jamii mwenga, unaoihwa *kithongothongo* kpwa Chigiryama. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili au ra Chingereza ririromanyikana kpwa aina hino; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Euphorbia nyikae*.

teaser.en: Its black seeds wear bright red-orange caps, strung into necklaces, while its termite-proof poles hold up the main frame of a house.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake nyeusi zina vifuniko vyekundu-machungwa vinavyong'aa na hutungwa kuwa mikufu, huku nguzo zake zisizoliwa na mchwa zikishikilia fremu kuu ya nyumba.
teaser.dg: Tembeze nyiru zina kofiya za rangi ya kundu na ya chungbwa inayong'arira, na nkutungwa kuhenda mikufu; nazo nguzoze, ambazo taziriwa ni lutswa, nkuimisa muundo mkulu wa nyumba.

summary.en: *Mbambakofi*, the pod mahogany, is a large spreading tree of dry coastal forest and the Shimba Hills, prized as one of the most important timber trees known to Digo carpenters. Logging has made it rare outside protected areas.
summary.sw: *Mbambakofi* ni mti mkubwa unaotanda wa misitu mikavu ya pwani na Milima ya Shimba, unaothaminiwa kama mojawapo ya miti muhimu zaidi ya mbao inayojulikana na maseremala wa Kidigo. Ukataji miti umeufanya kuwa adimu nje ya maeneo yaliyohifadhiwa.
summary.dg: *Mbambakofi* ni muhi mkulu unaotandazika, wa matsaka makavu ga pwani na ga Shimba Hills, unaothaminiwa ni mafundi a mbao a Chidigo dza mmwenga wa mihi muhimu zaidi ya mbao. Kpwa sababu ya kukatwa sana, sambi ni adimu kondze ya maeneo ga hifadhi.

about.en:
*Mbambakofi* is a large, spreading tree that loses some of its leaves in the dry season. Its leaves are compound, with three to seven pairs of glossy leaflets.

The pods are its best-known feature: thick, flat and woody, splitting open to show shiny black seeds, each topped with a bright red-orange cap called an aril. The seeds stay on the tree and on the ground long after the pods have opened, and children collect them.
about.sw:
*Mbambakofi* ni mti mkubwa unaotanda ambao hupukutisha baadhi ya majani yake wakati wa kiangazi. Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko, yenye jozi tatu hadi saba za vijani vinavyong'aa.

Maganda ndiyo sifa yake inayojulikana zaidi: manene, bapa na magumu kama mbao, yanayopasuka na kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi zinazong'aa, kila moja ikiwa na kifuniko chekundu-machungwa kinachong'aa kiitwacho aril. Mbegu hubaki mtini na ardhini muda mrefu baada ya maganda kufunguka, na watoto huziokota.
about.dg:
*Mbambakofi* ni muhi mkulu unaotandazika, ambao makodza ganjina ganagbwa msimu wa kazikazi. Makodzage ganamera kpwa mafungu: chila fungu rina jozi tahu hadi sabaa za makodza madide ganagong'arira.

Makakayage ndigo ganagomanyikana zaidi: ni maziho, mabapa na ga mbao, na ganaahuka na kuonyesa tembe nyiru zinazong'arira, na chila tembe ina kofiya ya rangi ya kundu na ya chungbwa inayong'arira, inayoihwa *aril*. Tembe zinasala muhini na photsi kpwa muda mure bada ya makakaya kuahuka, na ana nkuzitsola.

where.en: It grows in lowland dry forest, *Brachystegia* woodland and thicket on the coastal plain and in the Shimba Hills. Large trees are now mostly found in protected forests and kayas, where they have been spared from logging.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu mikavu ya nyanda za chini, misitu ya *Brachystegia* na vichaka vizito katika tambarare ya pwani na Milima ya Shimba. Miti mikubwa sasa hupatikana hasa katika misitu iliyohifadhiwa na kaya, ambako imesalimika na ukataji miti.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu ga herera, matsaka ga *Brachystegia* na vitsaka kpwenye herera ya pwani na Shimba Hills. Mihi mikulu sambi inaphahikana zaidi kpwenye matsaka ga hifadhi na makaya, ambako yarichwa bila kukatwa.

uses.en:
The wood is heavy, strong and handsome, used for doors, furniture and building. Its poles are very hard and resist termites, so they are chosen for the main supports of a house. Larger trunks have been used to make canoes and dhows.

The bright seeds are strung as necklaces. The tree gives shade, and it is also used in medicine.
uses.sw:
Mbao yake ni nzito, imara na ya kupendeza, inayotumika kwa milango, samani na ujenzi. Nguzo zake ni ngumu sana na haziliwi na mchwa, hivyo huchaguliwa kwa nguzo kuu za nyumba. Mashina makubwa zaidi yametumika kutengeneza mitumbwi na majahazi.

Mbegu zake zinazong'aa hutungwa kuwa mikufu. Mti huu hutoa kivuli, na pia hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi hinyu ni nziho, zina nguvu na ni nono; nkuhumirwa kuhenda miryango, fanicha na kudzenga. Nguzoze ni ngumu sana na taziriwa ni lutswa, kpwa hivyo nkutsambulwa kukala nguzo kulu za nyumba. Makolo makulu gakahumirwa kuhenda mitumbwi na majahazi.

Tembe zinazong'arira nkutungwa kuhenda mikufu. Muhi hinyu unalavya pepho, na piya nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

culture.en: Pakia lists *mbambakofi* among the most important local sawn-timber trees known to Digo carpenters.
culture.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *mbambakofi* miongoni mwa miti muhimu zaidi ya mbao za kupasuliwa inayojulikana na maseremala wa Kidigo.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika *mbambakofi* kahi ya mihi ya kahi ya tsi inayokereswa mbao, iriyo muhimu zaidi na inayomanyikana ni mafundi a mbao a Chidigo.

names.en: Pakia and Maundu and Tengnäs give the Digo name *mbambakofi*, which is also the Swahili name and the headword in the Mgombato dictionary. Mgombato glosses it as lucky-bean tree, pod mahogany or mahogany tree, and lists many other names from the region, including *mbaria*, *mbarikia*, *mkongo*, *mkola* and *mtame*. In Giriama it is *mwamba*. In English it is the pod mahogany or mahogany bean, and its scientific name is *Afzelia quanzensis*.
names.sw: Pakia, pamoja na Maundu na Tengnäs, wanatoa jina la Kidigo *mbambakofi*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili na kichwa cha neno katika kamusi ya Mgombato. Mgombato inalieleza kama *lucky-bean tree*, *pod mahogany* au *mahogany tree*, na inaorodhesha majina mengine mengi ya eneo hili, yakiwemo *mbaria*, *mbarikia*, *mkongo*, *mkola* na *mtame*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mwamba*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *pod mahogany* au *mahogany bean*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Afzelia quanzensis*.
names.dg: Pakia, na Maundu na Tengnäs, analavya dzina ra Chidigo *mbambakofi*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili na ni neno kulu kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato. Mgombato inaringanisha na *lucky-bean tree*, *pod mahogany* au *mahogany tree*, na inaandika madzina manji ganjina ga kahi ya eneo hiri, dza *mbaria*, *mbarikia*, *mkongo*, *mkola* na *mtame*. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *mwamba*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pod mahogany* au *mahogany bean*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Afzelia quanzensis*.

conservation.en: It is becoming rare outside protected areas because of logging.

conservation.dg: Unakala adimu kondze ya maeneo ga hifadhi kpwa sababu ya kukatwa kpwa ajili ya mbao.

teaser.sw: Tunda lake lililoiva huliwa likiwa bichi, lililokaushwa au likiwa limechachushwa kuwa kinywaji, na mbao zake nyeusi hustahimili kuvu na mchwa.
teaser.dg: Matundage maivu nkuriwa dza garivyo, nkuanikpwa, au nkuikpwa hadi ganaumuka kuhenda chinwadzi, na nyama za muhi uhu nyiru taziola wala taziriwa ni lutswa.

summary.en: *Mbara*, the jackal-berry or African ebony, is a medium to large tree of woodland and riverbanks with a dense, rounded crown. Its fruit is eaten by the Digo, and its hard wood is used for timber and carving.
summary.sw: *Mbara*, au msindi kwa Kiswahili, ni mti wa wastani hadi mkubwa wa misitu na kingo za mito wenye kilele kilichosongamana cha mviringo. Tunda lake huliwa na Wadigo, na mbao zake ngumu hutumika kwa ujenzi na uchongaji.
summary.dg: *Mbara*, *jackal-berry* au *African ebony*, ni muhi wa chiasi hadi mkulu wa matsaka ga wazi na kanda-kanda ya miho, wenye makodza manji ga kubanana dzulu, ga umbo ra mviringo. Matundage nkuriwa ni Adigo, na nyama za muhi uhu, ambazo ni ngumu, nkuhumirwa kpwa mbao na kutsonga vitu.

about.en:
*Mbara* is a medium to large tree with a dense, rounded crown that casts deep shade. The bark is grey to black and cracks into small squares, a good clue for recognising it. The leaves are shiny, dark green and wavy at the edges.

The fruits are round, the size of a large marble, and sit in a cup formed by the calyx. They ripen from yellow to purple.
about.sw:
*Mbara* ni mti wa wastani hadi mkubwa wenye kilele kilichosongamana cha mviringo kinachotoa kivuli kizito. Gome lake ni la kijivu hadi jeusi na hupasuka kuwa miraba midogo, dalili nzuri ya kuutambua. Majani yanang'aa, ni ya kijani kibichi na yana kingo za mawimbi.

Matunda ni ya mviringo, ya ukubwa wa gololi kubwa, na yamekaa ndani ya kikombe kinachoundwa na kikombe cha ua (kaliksi). Huiva kutoka manjano hadi zambarau.
about.dg:
*Mbara* ni muhi wa chiasi hadi mkulu, wenye makodza manji dzulu ga umbo ra mviringo ganayohenda pepho nyinji. Gopha ni ra rangi ya ivu hadi nyiru, na rinaahuka vipande vidide vya mraba; ihi ni dalili nono ya kuumanya. Makodza ganang'ala, ni ga chijani sana, na ganamyoka-myoka kanda-kanda.

Matunda ni ga mviringo, ga chiasi cha gololi kulu, na ganakala ndani ya chikombe chinachohendwa ni *calyx*. Ganaivwa kula rangi ya mandano hadi zambarau.

where.en: It grows in woodland and along riverbanks. Look for its dark crown and chequered bark near water.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu na kando ya kingo za mito. Utakiona kilele chake cheusi na gome lake la miraba karibu na maji.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga wazi na kanda-kanda ya miho. Lola makodzage manji ga chijani sana na gopha ra vipande vya mraba phephi na madzi.

uses.en:
The ripe fruit is eaten raw, and the Digo are among the peoples recorded as eating it. It can also be dried, or fermented into a drink.

The wood is hard and resistant to fungus and termites, valued as timber and for carvings. The tree is also used in medicine.
uses.sw:
Tunda lililoiva huliwa bichi, na Wadigo ni miongoni mwa jamii zilizorekodiwa kulila. Pia linaweza kukaushwa, au kuchachushwa kuwa kinywaji.

Mbao zake ni ngumu na hustahimili kuvu na mchwa, na zinathaminiwa kama mbao za ujenzi na kwa vinyago. Mti huu pia hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg:
Matunda maivu nkuriwa dza garivyo, na Adigo ni kahi ya atu anaoandikpwa kukala anagarya. Piya ganaweza kuanikpwa, au kuikpwa hadi ganaumuka kuhenda chinwadzi.

Nyama za muhi uhu ni ngumu, taziola wala taziriwa ni lutswa, na ni za samani kpwa mbao na kpwa kutsonga vitu. Muhi uhu piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

names.en: Maundu and Tengnäs give the Digo names *mbara* and *mkulu*, and the Mgombato dictionary lists both *m'bara* and *mkulu* as the jackal-berry tree, pointing each to the other. *Mkulu* is also recorded for a different ebony, *Diospyros cornii*, so the names need care. In Swahili it is *msindi*, *mgombe* or *mpweke*. Duruma speakers call it *mpweke* and Giriama speakers *mkulwe*. In English it is the jackal-berry or African ebony, and its scientific name is *Diospyros mespiliformis*.
names.sw: Maundu na Tengnäs wanatoa majina ya Kidigo *mbara* na *mkulu*, na kamusi ya Mgombato inaorodhesha *m'bara* na *mkulu* yote mawili kama mti huu, kila moja likimwelekeza msomaji kwa jingine. *Mkulu* pia limerekodiwa kwa mti mwingine wa jamii ya *ebony*, *Diospyros cornii*, hivyo majina haya yanahitaji uangalifu. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *msindi*, *mgombe* au *mpweke*. Wazungumzaji wa Kiduruma huuita *mpweke* na wa Kigiriama *mkulwe*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *jackal-berry* au *African ebony*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Diospyros mespiliformis*.
names.dg: Maundu na Tengnäs analavya madzina ga Chidigo *mbara* na *mkulu*, na kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *m'bara* na *mkulu* kukala ni *jackal-berry*, na chila dzina rinaonyesa ranjina. *Mkulu* piya rinaandikpwa kpwa *ebony* yanjina, *Diospyros cornii*, kpwa hivyo ni lazima kugahumira madzina higa sawa-sawa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *msindi*, *mgombe* au *mpweke*. Aduruma anauiha *mpweke*, na Agiryama *mkulwe*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *jackal-berry* au *African ebony*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Diospyros mespiliformis*.

teaser.en: One of its Digo names means 'forest breaker', for the way it pushes up through the canopy and towers over the trees around it.
teaser.sw: Mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo lina maana ya 'mvunja msitu', kwa jinsi unavyochomoza katikati ya kilele cha msitu na kuipita miti inayouzunguka.
teaser.dg: Dzina mwenga kahi ya madzinage ga Chidigo rina mana ya 'unaoahula tsaka', kpwa sababu unamera hadi unatsupa dzulu ya mihi ya tsaka, na unakala mre kuriko mihi iriyouzunguluka.

summary.en: *Mchiza tsaka* is a tall tree of dry evergreen coastal forest that rises above the canopy, with shining narrow leaves. It gives house poles, timber and firewood, and its leaves and roots are used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mchiza tsaka* ni mti mrefu wa msitu mkavu wa kijani kibichi wa pwani, unaopanda juu ya kilele cha msitu, wenye majani membamba yanayong'aa. Hutoa nguzo za nyumba, mbao na kuni, na majani na mizizi yake hutumika kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Mchiza tsaka* ni muhi mre wa matsaka ga pwani ga tsi kavu genye makodza chila wakati, unaotsupa dzulu ya mihi yanjina ya tsaka, na una makodza membamba ganayong'ala. Unalavya nguzo za kudzengera nyumba, mbao na kuni, na makodzage na miziye nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mchiza tsaka* is a tall tree, up to 24 metres, with a straight, slightly buttressed trunk and smooth grey bark. Its leaves are narrow and shiny.

The fruits are unusual: clusters of slender, pod-like arms that radiate from a single point, red and green, like a small bunch of fingers. They belong to the custard-apple family, and their seeds are typical of it.
about.sw:
*Mchiza tsaka* ni mti mrefu, unaofikia hadi mita 24, wenye shina lililonyooka lenye mizizi-ukuta midogo, na gome laini la kijivu. Majani yake ni membamba na yanang'aa.

Matunda yake ni ya ajabu: vishada vya mikono myembamba inayofanana na maganda, inayotoka sehemu moja na kuenea pande zote, mekundu na ya kijani, kama kifungu kidogo cha vidole. Ni wa familia ya mitopetope, na mbegu zake ni za kawaida ya familia hiyo.
about.dg:
*Mchiza tsaka* ni muhi mre, hadi mita 24, wenye kolo ra kugoloka renye ngamba chidide, na gopha laini ra rangi ya ivu. Makodzage ni membamba na ganang'ala.

Matundage ni ga ajabu: ganamera makundi ga makakaya membamba ganayotuluka phatu phamwenga, ga rangi ya kundu na chijani, dza vyala vya mkpwono mdide. Muhi uhu ni wa jamii ya *custard apple*, na tembeze ni dza za jamii hino.

where.en: It grows in dry evergreen forest on coral rag and sand, the kind of forest found in the kayas and remnant coastal forests of the south coast. Its crown often stands higher than the trees around it.
where.sw: Hukua katika msitu mkavu wa kijani kibichi juu ya miamba ya matumbawe na mchanga, aina ya msitu unaopatikana katika kaya na mabaki ya misitu ya pwani ya kusini. Mara nyingi kilele chake husimama juu kuliko miti inayouzunguka.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga tsi kavu genye makodza chila wakati, kpwenye masanoo na mtsanga, matsaka dza ga kaya na matsaka ganayosala ga pwani ya kusini. Makodza ga dzuluye mara nyinji ganakala dzulu kuriko mihi iriyouzunguluka.

uses.en: Its straight stems are used as house-building poles, and the wood gives timber and firewood. The leaves and roots are used in medicine.
uses.sw: Mashina yake yaliyonyooka hutumika kama nguzo za kujengea nyumba, na mti wake hutoa mbao na kuni. Majani na mizizi hutumika kama dawa.
uses.dg: Mihiye ya kugoloka nkuhumirwa dza nguzo za kudzengera nyumba, na nyama za muhi uhu nkulavya mbao na kuni. Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

culture.en: Its many Digo names describe it closely. *Mchiza tsaka* means it 'overgrows the forest', and *mwahula tsaka* means 'forest breaker', both for the way it tops the canopy. *Mnyinyi* refers to its shining leaves.
culture.sw: Majina yake mengi ya Kidigo yanaueleza kwa usahihi. *Mchiza tsaka* maana yake ni 'unaouzidi msitu', na *mwahula tsaka* maana yake ni 'mvunja msitu', yote mawili kwa jinsi unavyoupita kilele cha msitu. *Mnyinyi* inahusu majani yake yanayong'aa.
culture.dg: Madzinage manji ga Chidigo ganaueleza sawa-sawa. *Mchiza tsaka* rina mana ya 'unaotsupa tsaka', na *mwahula tsaka* rina mana ya 'unaoahula tsaka'; madzina gosi mairi ganatuluka kpwa namna unavyokala dzulu kuriko mihi ya tsaka. *Mnyinyi* rinaonyesa makodzage ganayong'ala.

names.en: Pakia records four Digo names: *mchiza tsaka*, *mwahula tsaka*, *mngwa nyahi* and *mnyinyi*; Maundu and Tengnäs also give *mchiza tsaka*. In Giriama it is *mbarawa* or *mukuna mbawa*. No Swahili or common English name has been recorded; its scientific name is *Xylopia parviflora*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina manne ya Kidigo: *mchiza tsaka*, *mwahula tsaka*, *mngwa nyahi* na *mnyinyi*; Maundu na Tengnäs pia wanatoa *mchiza tsaka*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mbarawa* au *mukuna mbawa*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Xylopia parviflora*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mane ga Chidigo: *mchiza tsaka*, *mwahula tsaka*, *mngwa nyahi* na *mnyinyi*; Maundu na Tengnäs piya analavya *mchiza tsaka*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mbarawa* au *mukuna mbawa*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili au ra Chingereza ririromanyikana; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Xylopia parviflora*.

teaser.en: Its name and its main use are one and the same: *mdege* is medicine against *dege*. Pakia gives *dege* as the evil eye; the Mgombato dictionary gives it as *nyuni*, a convulsive illness of young children blamed on certain birds.
teaser.sw: Jina lake na matumizi yake makuu ni kitu kimoja: *mdege* ni dawa dhidi ya *dege*. Pakia anaeleza *dege* kuwa jicho baya; kamusi ya Mgombato inaeleza kuwa ni *nyuni*, degedege ya watoto wadogo inayoaminika kuletwa na ndege fulani.
teaser.dg: Dzinare na kaziye kulu ni chitu chimwenga: *mdege* ni dawa ya *dege*. Kpwa Pakia, *dege* ni dzitso ribaya (*evil eye*); kpwa kamusi ya Mgombato ni *nyuni*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa gafula na kukakama, ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni nyuni fulani.

summary.en: *Mdege* is a small resinous tree of coastal bushland and thicket with peeling bark. The Digo use it as medicine against *dege*, which Pakia records as the evil eye and the Mgombato dictionary as *nyuni*, a convulsive illness of young children blamed on certain birds.
summary.sw: *Mdege* ni mti mdogo wenye utomvu wa ubani, wa vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani, wenye gome linalobambuka. Wadigo huutumia kama dawa dhidi ya *dege*: kwa mujibu wa Pakia ni jicho baya, na kwa mujibu wa kamusi ya Mgombato ni *nyuni*, degedege ya watoto wadogo inayoaminika kuletwa na ndege fulani.
summary.dg: *Mdege* ni muhi mdide wenye ulimbo, wa weruni na vitsaka vya pwani, wenye gopha rinarotuluka vipande-vipande. Adigo anauhumira dza dawa ya *dege*: kpwa Pakia ni dzitso ribaya (*evil eye*), na kpwa kamusi ya Mgombato ni *nyuni*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa gafula na kukakama, ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni nyuni fulani.

about.en: *Mdege* is a small tree of the myrrh family, rich in fragrant resin. Its bark peels away in papery flakes, showing fresh, often greenish bark underneath. Like its relatives, it is likely to lose its leaves in the dry season.
about.sw: *Mdege* ni mti mdogo wa familia ya manemane, wenye utomvu mwingi wenye harufu nzuri. Gome lake hubambuka kwa vibanzi vyembamba kama karatasi, na kuonyesha gome jipya chini yake, mara nyingi la rangi ya kijani. Kama jamaa zake, huenda hupukutisha majani wakati wa kiangazi.
about.dg: *Mdege* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya *myrrh*, na una ulimbo wenye arufu nono kpwa unji. Gophare rinatuluka kpwa vipande vyembamba dza karatasi, na photsi kunaonekana gopha riphya, mara nyinji ra chijani. Dza nduguze, inaelekea kukala makodzage ganagbwa wakati wa kazikazi.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and thicket.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na vitsakani vya pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records that *mdege* is used as medicine against *dege*, which he glosses as the evil eye. In the Mgombato dictionary *dege* is another name for *nyuni*, a convulsive illness of young children traditionally blamed on certain birds; Mgombato's word for the evil eye is *dzongo*.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba *mdege* hutumika kama dawa dhidi ya *dege*, ambalo analieleza kuwa jicho baya. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *dege* ni jina jingine la *nyuni*, degedege inayowapata watoto wadogo na inayoaminika tangu zamani kuletwa na ndege fulani; neno la Mgombato la jicho baya ni *dzongo*.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala *mdege* nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya *dege*, na anaeleza kukala *dege* ni dzitso ribaya (*evil eye*). Kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, *dege* ni dzina ranjina ra *nyuni*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa gafula na kukakama, ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni nyuni fulani; neno ra Mgombato ra dzitso ribaya ni *dzongo*.

culture.en: The tree's name comes from its use: *mdege* is the medicine against *dege*. The word has two recorded meanings: Pakia gives the evil eye, while the Mgombato dictionary gives *nyuni*, a convulsive illness of young children blamed on certain birds (its word for the evil eye is *dzongo*). It is a clear example of how Digo plant names often record what a plant is for.
culture.sw: Jina la mti huu linatokana na matumizi yake: *mdege* ni dawa dhidi ya *dege*. Neno hili lina maana mbili zilizorekodiwa: Pakia anatoa jicho baya, na kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *nyuni*, degedege ya watoto wadogo inayoaminika kuletwa na ndege fulani (neno lake la jicho baya ni *dzongo*). Ni mfano mzuri wa jinsi majina ya mimea ya Kidigo mara nyingi yanavyohifadhi kazi ya mmea.
culture.dg: Dzina ra muhi rinalavywa kula kaziye: *mdege* ni dawa ya *dege*. Neno *dege* rina mana mbiri: Pakia anapha dzitso ribaya (*evil eye*), na kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *nyuni*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa gafula na kukakama, ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni nyuni fulani (neno ra Mgombato ra dzitso ribaya ni *dzongo*). Ni mfwano mnono wa vira madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo mara nyinji ganavyoonyesa kazi ya mmea.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mdege*. No Swahili or English name has been recorded; its scientific name is *Commiphora zanzibarica*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mdege*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Commiphora zanzibarica*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mdege*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Commiphora zanzibarica*.

teaser.en: Healers in Diani boil its bark and leaves together for malaria, and its zig-zag young stems make it easy to recognise.
teaser.sw: Waganga wa Diani huchemsha gome na majani yake pamoja kutibu malaria, na vitawi vyake vichanga vinavyopinda-pinda huufanya kuwa rahisi kuutambua.
teaser.dg: Aganga a Diani nkuchemusha gopha na makodza phamwenga kpwa homa (malaria), na mihiye midide inayogaluka uphande chila kodza inahenda ukale rahisi kuumanya.

summary.en: *Mdudu*, the coastal golden-leaf, is a leafy evergreen tree of riverine forest and forest edges. It is one of the most trusted malaria remedies among the Digo of Diani, and is becoming scarce through over-use.
summary.sw: *Mdudu*, au mkarakara, ni mti wa kijani kibichi wenye majani mengi wa misitu ya kando ya mito na pembezoni mwa misitu. Ni mojawapo ya dawa za malaria zinazoaminiwa zaidi na Wadigo wa Diani, na unazidi kuadimika kwa sababu ya kutumiwa kupita kiasi.
summary.dg: *Mdudu* (*coastal golden-leaf* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi wenye makodza manji chila wakati, wa matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na kanda-kanda ya matsaka. Ni mwenga wa madawa ga homa (malaria) ganayoaminika zaidi kahi ya Adigo a Diani, na unakala adimu kpwa sababu ya kuhumirwa sana.

about.en:
*Mdudu* is a leafy evergreen tree up to about 13 metres, often armed with thorns on the trunk and older branches. Its young stems grow in a zig-zag, changing direction at each leaf.

The leaves are glossy, with straight side veins that run in parallel all the way to the edge. Before they fall, some leaves turn golden, which gives it the English name. The small fruits ripen black.
about.sw:
*Mdudu* ni mti wa kijani kibichi wenye majani mengi, unaofikia hadi mita 13 hivi, mara nyingi wenye miiba kwenye shina na matawi yake ya zamani. Vitawi vyake vichanga hukua kwa mpindo wa zigizaga, vikibadilisha mwelekeo katika kila jani.

Majani yake yanang'aa, yakiwa na mishipa ya pembeni iliyonyooka inayokwenda sambamba hadi ukingoni. Kabla ya kupukutika, baadhi ya majani hugeuka rangi ya dhahabu, na hapo ndipo jina lake la Kiingereza linapotoka. Matunda yake madogo huiva yakawa meusi.
about.dg:
*Mdudu* ni muhi wenye makodza manji chila wakati, unaofika mita 13 hivi, na mara nyinji una miya kpwenye kolo na kpwenye panda zirizokula. Mihiye midide inamera ichigaluka uphande chila phatu kodza rinaphomera.

Makodza ganang'ala, na gana mishipa ya kanda-kanda iriyonyooka inayotsupa sambamba hadi kanda ya kodza. Kabla ya kugbwa, makodza ganjina ganakala ga rangi ya zahabu, na ichi ndicho chinachouphisha dzina ra Chingereza. Matunda madide ganaivwa na kukala maru.

where.en: It grows in riverine forest and on forest edges, where its thick, leafy crown stands out.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya kando ya mito na pembezoni mwa misitu, ambapo kilele chake kinene chenye majani mengi huonekana waziwazi.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, ambapho makodzage manji ga dzulu ganaonekana wazi.

uses.en:
The Digo of Diani boil the stem bark and leaves together as a remedy for malaria, and a study of their medicine found it among the most consistently named remedies.

The wood gives poles and timber and is carved into spoons. The bark yields a red dye, and the fruit is edible.
uses.sw:
Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome la shina na majani pamoja kama dawa ya malaria, na utafiti kuhusu dawa zao ulibaini kuwa ni miongoni mwa dawa zilizotajwa mara kwa mara zaidi.

Mti wake hutoa nguzo na mbao, na huchongwa kuwa miiko. Gome hutoa rangi nyekundu, na tunda lake huliwa.
uses.dg:
Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha gopha ra kolo na makodza phamwenga kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria), na utafiti wa madawa gao waona kukala ni kahi ya madawa ganayogombwa mara nyinji ni atu anji.

Nyama za muhi zinalavya nguzo na mbao, na nkutsongbwa vidziko. Gopha rinalavya rangi ya kundu, na matunda ganariwa.

names.en: Pakia and Maundu and Tengnäs record the Digo name *mdudu*. In Swahili it is *mkarakara* or *mtutu*. In English it is the coastal golden-leaf, and its scientific name is *Bridelia micrantha*.
names.sw: Pakia, pamoja na Maundu na Tengnäs, wanarekodi jina la Kidigo *mdudu*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkarakara* au *mtutu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *coastal golden-leaf*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Bridelia micrantha*.
names.dg: Pakia, na Maundu na Tengnäs, anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mdudu*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkarakara* au *mtutu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *coastal golden-leaf*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Bridelia micrantha*.

conservation.en: It is becoming scarce through over-use.
conservation.sw: Unazidi kuadimika kwa sababu ya kutumiwa kupita kiasi.
conservation.dg: Unakala adimu kpwa sababu ya kuhumirwa sana.

teaser.en: Its trunk is studded with corky knobs, each tipped with a prickle, and its crushed leaves smell of lemon.
teaser.sw: Shina lake limejaa vinundu vya gamba laini, kila kimoja kikiwa na mwiba ncha yake, na majani yake yakipondwa hunukia kama limau.
teaser.dg: Kolore rina maugu ga dza gopha, chila rimwenga na mwiya kpwenye ntsa, na makodzage ganaphofikitswa ganalavya arufu ya limau.

summary.en: *Mdungu*, the knobwood, is a spiny tree of dry bushland and coastal thicket with corky, prickle-tipped knobs on its trunk. It is a popular Digo medicine, boiled for malaria, and also gives a spice, a tea and toothbrushes.
summary.sw: *Mdungu*, au mjafari, ni mti wenye miiba wa vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito vya pwani, wenye vinundu vya gamba laini vyenye miiba kwenye shina lake. Ni dawa maarufu ya Kidigo, huchemshwa kutibu malaria, na pia hutoa kiungo, chai na miswaki.
summary.dg: *Mdungu* (*knobwood* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi wenye miya wa weruni kavu na vitsaka vya pwani, wenye maugu kpwenye kolo genye miya kpwenye ntsa. Ni dawa ya Chidigo inayomendzwa, inayochemushwa kpwa homa (malaria), na piya unalavya chitu cha kutiya vyakurya ladha, chai na misuwaki.

about.en:
*Mdungu* is a spiny tree up to about 8 metres. Its trunk carries large corky knobs, each tipped with a sharp prickle, which make it one of the easiest trees in the bush to recognise.

The leaves are compound and smell of lemon when crushed, a sign of the citrus family it belongs to. The small round fruits ripen red and split open to show shiny black seeds.
about.sw:
*Mdungu* ni mti wenye miiba unaofikia hadi mita 8 hivi. Shina lake lina vinundu vikubwa vya gamba laini, kila kimoja kikiwa na mwiba mkali ncha yake, na hivyo kuufanya kuwa mojawapo ya miti rahisi zaidi kutambua porini.

Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko na hunukia kama limau yakipondwa, ishara ya familia ya michungwa ambayo ni yake. Matunda yake madogo ya mviringo huiva yakawa mekundu na kupasuka kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi zinazong'aa.
about.dg:
*Mdungu* ni muhi wenye miya unaofika mita 8 hivi. Kolore rina maugu makulu ga dza gopha, chila rimwenga na mwiya mkali kpwenye ntsa, na ganahenda ukale mwenga wa mihi rahisi zaidi kuimanya weruni.

Makodza ni ga kuungana, na ganaphofikitswa ganalavya arufu ya limau; ino ni ishara kukala ni wa jamii ya michungwa. Matunda madide ga mviringo ganaivwa na kukala ga kundu, na ganaahuka na kuonyesa tembe nyiru zinazong'ala.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and coastal thicket. Look for its knobbly trunk at the edge of bush paths.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito vya pwani. Tafuta shina lake lenye vinundu kando ya njia za porini.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kavu na vitsakani vya pwani. Uhendze kolore renye maugu kanda-kanda ya njira za weruni.

uses.en:
The root bark is boiled as a remedy for malaria, and Pakia records it as a popular general medicine among the Digo.

The fruits and leaves are used as a spice and to make tea, and its twigs are chewed as toothbrushes.
uses.sw:
Gome la mizizi huchemshwa kama dawa ya malaria, na Pakia anarekodi kuwa ni dawa maarufu ya jumla miongoni mwa Wadigo.

Matunda na majani hutumika kama kiungo na kutengenezea chai, na vitawi vyake hutafunwa kama miswaki.
uses.dg:
Gopha ra mizi nkuchemushwa kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria), na Pakia anaandika kukala ni dawa ya makongo manji inayomendzwa kahi ya Adigo.

Matunda na makodza nkuhumirwa kutiya vyakurya ladha na kuhenda chai, na maphungoge nkuafunwa dza misuwaki.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo names *mdungu* and *mjafari*; Maundu and Tengnäs give *mdungu* and *mudhungu*. In Swahili it is *mjafari*. Giriama speakers say *mudhungu* or *mjafari*, and Chonyi speakers *mdungu*. In English it is knobwood, and its scientific name is *Zanthoxylum chalybeum*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina ya Kidigo *mdungu* na *mjafari*; Maundu na Tengnäs wanatoa *mdungu* na *mudhungu*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mjafari*. Wazungumzaji wa Kigiriama husema *mudhungu* au *mjafari*, na wa Kichonyi *mdungu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *knobwood*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Zanthoxylum chalybeum*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina ga Chidigo *mdungu* na *mjafari*; Maundu na Tengnäs anapha *mdungu* na *mudhungu*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mjafari*. Atu anaogomba Chigiryama anauiha *mudhungu* au *mjafari*, na anaogomba Chichonyi anauiha *mdungu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *knobwood*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Zanthoxylum chalybeum*.

teaser.en: Its branches grow in threes, perfect for the three-pronged stick used to stir porridge, and the tree is named after it.
teaser.sw: Matawi yake hukua matatu matatu, kamili kwa mwiko wa ncha tatu wa kusongea uji, na mti huu umepewa jina kutokana nao.
teaser.dg: Pandaze zinamera tahu-tahu, na ni nono sana kuhenda *lifidzo*, chigongo cha ntsa tahu cha kufwidzira uji; na muhi uhewa dzinare kula kpwa chombo hichi.

summary.en: *Mfidzofidzo*, the African mangosteen, is an evergreen tree whose orange fruit is one of the most delicious wild fruits of the coast. Its branches, growing in threes, give the stirring stick that names the tree.
summary.sw: *Mfidzofidzo*, au mpekechu, ni mti wa kijani kibichi ambao tunda lake la rangi ya chungwa ni mojawapo ya matunda ya porini matamu zaidi ya pwani. Matawi yake, yanayokua matatu matatu, hutoa mwiko wa kusongea ambao ndio jina la mti huu.
summary.dg: *Mfidzofidzo* (*African mangosteen* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, ambao tundare ra rangi ya chungbwa ni kahi ya matunda ga weruni ga mtswano zaidi ga pwani. Pandaze zinazomera tahu-tahu zinalavya *lifidzo* ra kufwidzira, na dzina ra muhi rinalavywa kula kpwa chombo hichi.

about.en:
*Mfidzofidzo* is an evergreen tree of 2 to 10 metres with a heavy, cone-shaped crown. Its branches typically grow in threes, all from one point, and its stiff, leathery leaves grow in pairs or threes.

Cut the bark and a yellow-red latex oozes out. The fruits are round and bright orange, with thin skin and juicy, sweet-sour flesh.
about.sw:
*Mfidzofidzo* ni mti wa kijani kibichi wa mita 2 hadi 10 wenye kilele kizito chenye umbo la koni. Kwa kawaida matawi yake hukua matatu matatu, yote kutoka sehemu moja, na majani yake magumu kama ngozi hukua mawili mawili au matatu matatu.

Ukikata gome, utomvu wa rangi ya manjano-nyekundu hutiririka. Matunda yake ni ya mviringo na ya rangi ya chungwa angavu, yenye ganda jembamba na nyama yenye maji mengi, tamu na chachu.
about.dg:
*Mfidzofidzo* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa mita 2 hadi 10, wenye makodza manji ga dzulu maziho ganayohenda umbo ra *cone*. Pandaze kpwa kawaida zinamera tahu-tahu, zosi kula phatu phamwenga, na makodzage magumu dza chingo ganamera airi-airi au mahahu-mahahu.

Uchikata gopha, maziya ga rangi ya mandano na kundu ganatuluka. Matunda ni ga mviringo na ga rangi ya chungbwa inayong'ala, gana gada rembamba na nyama yenye madzi manji, ya mtswano na ngbwadu.

where.en: It grows in riverine forest, in thicket and on rocky outcrops. Look for its dark, conical crown and its branches arranged in threes.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya kando ya mito, katika vichaka vizito na juu ya miamba. Tafuta kilele chake cheusi chenye umbo la koni na matawi yake yaliyopangwa matatu matatu.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho, vitsakani na phatu phenye mawe. Uhendze makodzage ga dzulu ga rangi nyiru ga umbo ra *cone*, na pandaze zinazomera tahu-tahu.

uses.en:
The fruit is one of the most delicious wild fruits of the coast and is eaten fresh.

The three-pronged twigs are made into sticks for stirring porridge. The wood is also used for poles and spoons, the root is used in medicine, and the bark gives a dye.
uses.sw:
Tunda lake ni mojawapo ya matunda ya porini matamu zaidi ya pwani na huliwa likiwa bichi.

Vitawi vyenye ncha tatu hutengenezwa kuwa miiko ya kusongea uji. Mti wake pia hutumika kwa nguzo na miiko, mizizi hutumika kama dawa, na gome hutoa rangi.
uses.dg:
Tunda ni kahi ya matunda ga weruni ga mtswano zaidi ga pwani, na nkuriwa dza ririvyo.

Maphungo genye ntsa tahu nkuhendwa vyombo vya kufwidzira uji (*lifidzo*). Nyama za muhi piya nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo na vidziko, muzi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa, na gopha rinalavya rangi.

culture.en: Pakia explains that the name *mfidzofidzo* comes from *lifidzo*, the three-pronged stirring stick made from its branches. It is a tree named for the kitchen tool it provides.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa jina *mfidzofidzo* linatokana na *lifidzo*, mwiko wa ncha tatu wa kusongea unaotengenezwa kwa matawi yake. Ni mti uliopewa jina kutokana na chombo cha jikoni unachotoa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala dzina *mfidzofidzo* rinalavywa kula *lifidzo*, chigongo cha ntsa tahu cha kufwidzira chinachohendwa kula kpwa pandaze. Ni muhi uriohewa dzina kula kpwa chombo cha dzikoni chinachohendwa kpwakpwe.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo names *mfidzofidzo* and *mfunga sandzu*, also *kisambwe* and *mfunga tanzu*. In Swahili it is *mpekechu*, *mpeketo* or *mtotozi*. In Giriama it is *mufodzohi*. In English it is the African mangosteen or imbe, and its scientific name is *Garcinia livingstonei*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina ya Kidigo *mfidzofidzo* na *mfunga sandzu*, pamoja na *kisambwe* na *mfunga tanzu*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mpekechu*, *mpeketo* au *mtotozi*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mufodzohi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *African mangosteen* au *imbe*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Garcinia livingstonei*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina ga Chidigo *mfidzofidzo* na *mfunga sandzu*, na piya *kisambwe* na *mfunga tanzu*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mpekechu*, *mpeketo* au *mtotozi*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mufodzohi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *African mangosteen* au *imbe*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Garcinia livingstonei*.

teaser.en: Its Digo name adds *madzi*, water, because its fruit is juicier than that of its cousin, the plain *mfudu*.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linaongeza *madzi*, maji, kwa sababu tunda lake lina maji mengi kuliko la binamu yake, *mfudu* wa kawaida.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rinaenjereza *madzi*, kpwa sababu tundare rina madzi manji kuriko ra nduguye, *mfudu* wa kawaida.

summary.en: *Mfudu madzi* is a small tree or shrub of bushland and wooded grassland with rusty-hairy leaves and watery, edible fruit. It grows at Mombasa, in the Shimba Hills and at Gazi.
summary.sw: *Mfudu madzi*, au mfudu maji, ni mti mdogo au kichaka cha vichakani na nyika zenye miti, wenye majani yenye manyoya ya rangi ya kutu na tunda lenye maji linaloliwa. Hukua Mombasa, katika Shimba Hills na Gazi.
summary.dg: *Mfudu madzi* ni muhi mdide au chitsaka cha weruni na phatu phenye nyasi na mihi, wenye makodza genye nyere za rangi ya kundu na dongo na matunda genye madzi manji ganayoriwa. Unamera Mombasa, Shimba Hills na Gazi.

about.en:
*Mfudu madzi* is a small tree or shrub of 3 to 6 metres. Its grey bark is cracked lengthwise into long fissures. The leaves are made of three to five leaflets spread like the fingers of a hand, covered in rusty hairs.

The fruits are small and juicy. Some people find them smelly, which gives the English name, smelly-berry fingerleaf.
about.sw:
*Mfudu madzi* ni mti mdogo au kichaka cha mita 3 hadi 6. Gome lake la kijivu limepasuka kwa urefu kwa mipasuko mirefu. Majani yake yameundwa na vijani vitatu hadi vitano vilivyotandazwa kama vidole vya mkono, vikiwa vimefunikwa na manyoya ya rangi ya kutu.

Matunda yake ni madogo na yenye maji mengi. Watu wengine huyaona yana harufu mbaya, na hapo ndipo jina la Kiingereza, *smelly-berry fingerleaf*, linapotoka.
about.dg:
*Mfudu madzi* ni muhi mdide au chitsaka cha mita 3 hadi 6. Gophare ra rangi ya ivu rina mianya mire kula dzulu hadi photsi. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu hadi matsano ganayoenea dza vyala vya mkpwono, na ganafwinikpwa ni nyere za rangi ya kundu na dongo.

Matunda ni madide na gana madzi manji. Atu anjina anaona gana arufu mbii, na ichi ndicho chinachouphisha dzina ra Chingereza, *smelly-berry fingerleaf*.

where.en: It grows in bushland and wooded grassland at Mombasa, in the Shimba Hills and at Gazi.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka na nyika zenye miti huko Mombasa, katika Shimba Hills na Gazi.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na phatu phenye nyasi na mihi, Mombasa, Shimba Hills na Gazi.

uses.en: The watery fruit is eaten. The wood is used for poles and carved into spoons and pestles, and the flowers are good forage for bees.
uses.sw: Tunda lake lenye maji huliwa. Mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo na huchongwa kuwa miiko na michi, na maua yake ni lishe nzuri kwa nyuki.
uses.dg: Tunda renye madzi manji nkuriwa. Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo, na nkutsongbwa vidziko na mitsi, na maruwa ni chakurya chinono cha nyuchi.

culture.en: Pakia explains that *madzi*, 'water', marks its juicier fruit compared with the plain *mfudu*.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa *madzi*, 'maji', huonyesha kwamba tunda lake lina maji mengi kuliko la *mfudu* wa kawaida.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala neno *madzi* rinaonyesa kukala tundare rina madzi manji kuriko ra *mfudu* wa kawaida.

names.en: Pakia and Maundu and Tengnäs record the Digo name *mfudu madzi*, the 'watery *mfudu*', which Chonyi speakers share. In Swahili it is *mfudu maji*. In English it is the smelly-berry fingerleaf, and its scientific name is *Vitex mombassae*, named after Mombasa.
names.sw: Pakia, pamoja na Maundu na Tengnäs, wanarekodi jina la Kidigo *mfudu madzi*, '*mfudu* wa maji', ambalo wazungumzaji wa Kichonyi pia hulitumia. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mfudu maji*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *smelly-berry fingerleaf*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Vitex mombassae*, lililotokana na Mombasa.
names.dg: Pakia, na Maundu na Tengnäs, anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mfudu madzi*, '*mfudu* wa madzi', ambaro piya rinahumirwa ni atu anaogomba Chichonyi. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mfudu maji*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *smelly-berry fingerleaf*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Vitex mombassae*, rinarolavywa kula kpwa dzina ra Mombasa.

teaser.en: Its Digo name means 'floury *mfudu*', because its purple-black fruit is mealier and starchier than the ordinary kind.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya '*mfudu* wa unga', kwa sababu tunda lake la zambarau-nyeusi lina unga na wanga zaidi kuliko la aina ya kawaida.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rinamaanisha '*mfudu* wa unga', kpwa sababu tundare ra zambarau nyiru rina unga-unga zaidi kuriko ra aina ya kawaida.

summary.en: *Mfudu unga*, the black plum, is a deciduous tree of wooded grassland and forest edges with olive-sized, purple-black fruits. Its name sets it apart from its cousins in the *mfudu* group by the floury texture of its fruit.
summary.sw: *Mfudu unga*, au mfudu, ni mti unaopukutisha majani wa nyika zenye miti na pembezoni mwa misitu, wenye matunda ya zambarau-nyeusi yenye ukubwa wa zeituni. Jina lake linautofautisha na binamu zake katika kundi la *mfudu* kwa unga-unga wa tunda lake.
summary.dg: *Mfudu unga* (*black plum* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wa phatu phenye nyasi na mihi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, wenye matunda ga zambarau nyiru, makulu dza tunda ra *olive*. Dzinare rinautafwautisha na nduguze, mihi ya kundi ra *mfudu*, kpwa unga-unga wa tundare.

about.en:
*Mfudu unga* is a deciduous tree with a rounded crown. Its leaves are made of five leaflets spread like the fingers of a hand.

The fruits are about the size of an olive and ripen to a deep purple-black. Their pulp is mealy and floury rather than juicy, around a single hard stone.
about.sw:
*Mfudu unga* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye kilele cha mviringo. Majani yake yameundwa na vijani vitano vilivyotandazwa kama vidole vya mkono.

Matunda yake ni karibu ukubwa wa zeituni na huiva yakawa ya zambarau-nyeusi iliyokolea. Nyama yake ni ya unga-unga badala ya kuwa na maji, ikizunguka kokwa moja gumu.
about.dg:
*Mfudu unga* ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wenye makodza manji ga dzulu ga umbo ra mviringo. Chila kodza rina makodza madide matsano ganayoenea dza vyala vya mkpwono.

Matunda ni makulu dza tunda ra *olive*, na ganaivwa na kukala ga zambarau nyiru kabisa. Nyama ya tunda ni ya unga-unga, si ya madzi, na inazunguluka tembe mwenga ngumu.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland and on forest edges. Look for its five-fingered leaves, and in season for the dark fruits on the ground beneath.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika zenye miti na pembezoni mwa misitu. Tafuta majani yake yenye vidole vitano, na wakati wa msimu wake, matunda meusi chini yake ardhini.
where.dg: Unamera phatu phenye nyasi na mihi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka. Uhendze makodzage genye vyala vitsano, na wakati wa matunda, uhendze matunda ga rangi nyiru photsi ya muhi.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten.
uses.sw: Tunda lake huliwa.
uses.dg: Tunda nkuriwa.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name *mfudu unga*, 'floury *mfudu*': its fruit is starchier than the ordinary *mfudu*. Together with *mfudu madzi*, the 'watery *mfudu*', the names show how the Digo sort related trees by the feel of their fruit.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jina *mfudu unga*, '*mfudu* wa unga': tunda lake lina wanga zaidi kuliko la *mfudu* wa kawaida. Pamoja na *mfudu madzi*, '*mfudu* wa maji', majina haya yanaonyesha jinsi Wadigo wanavyopanga miti inayohusiana kwa kugusa na kuhisi matunda yake.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza dzina *mfudu unga*, '*mfudu* wa unga': tundare rina unga-unga zaidi kuriko ra *mfudu* wa kawaida. Phamwenga na *mfudu madzi*, '*mfudu* wa madzi', madzina higa ganaonyesa vira Adigo anavyoganya mihi ya ndugu kpwa vira matundage ganavyokala uchigaguta.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mfudu unga*. The shorter *mfudu* is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. Note that Chonyi speakers use *mfudu unga* for a different tree, the chocolate berry (*Vitex payos*). In English it is the black plum, and its scientific name is *Vitex doniana*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mfudu unga*. Jina fupi zaidi *mfudu* linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Ikumbukwe kwamba wazungumzaji wa Kichonyi hutumia *mfudu unga* kwa mti mwingine, *chocolate berry* (*Vitex payos*). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *black plum*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Vitex doniana*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mfudu unga*. Dzina fupi *mfudu* rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Ela manya kukala atu anaogomba Chichonyi anahumira *mfudu unga* kpwa muhi wanjina, *mfudu* (*chocolate berry*, *Vitex payos*). Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *black plum*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Vitex doniana*.

teaser.en: Its black, mealy fruits taste sweet enough to earn it the English name chocolate berry.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake meusi yenye unga-unga ni matamu kiasi cha kuupatia jina la Kiingereza *chocolate berry*.
teaser.dg: Matundage maru ga unga-unga ni ga mtswano sana, hata gakauphisha dzina ra Chingereza *chocolate berry*.

summary.en: *Mfudu*, the chocolate berry, is a small deciduous tree of hot, low wooded grassland in Kwale and Kilifi. Its sweet black fruit is eaten, and its straight stems give poles, spoons and tool handles.
summary.sw: *Mfudu* ni mti mdogo unaopukutisha majani wa nyika za joto za nyanda za chini zenye miti huko Kwale na Kilifi. Tunda lake tamu jeusi huliwa, na mashina yake yaliyonyooka hutoa nguzo, miiko na mipini ya zana.
summary.dg: *Mfudu* (*chocolate berry* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi mdide ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wa phatu phenye nyasi na mihi, pha dzoho na pha photsi, Kwale na Kilifi. Tundare riru ra mtswano nkuriwa, na mihiye iriyoima chocho inalavya nguzo, vidziko na mipini ya vyombo vya kazi.

about.en:
*Mfudu* is a small deciduous tree up to about 8 metres. Its young branchlets are square in cross-section and covered in rusty, woolly hairs. The leaves usually have five leaflets spread like the fingers of a hand.

The fruits ripen black, with a mealy, sweet pulp.
about.sw:
*Mfudu* ni mti mdogo unaopukutisha majani, unaofikia hadi mita 8 hivi. Vitawi vyake vichanga vina umbo la mraba vikikatwa, na vimefunikwa na manyoya ya rangi ya kutu kama sufu. Kwa kawaida majani yake yana vijani vitano vilivyotandazwa kama vidole vya mkono.

Matunda yake huiva yakawa meusi, yakiwa na nyama tamu ya unga-unga.
about.dg:
*Mfudu* ni muhi mdide ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, unaofika mita 8 hivi. Maphungoge maphya gana pembe nne uchigakata, na ganafwinikpwa ni nyere nyinji laini za rangi ya kundu na dongo. Chila kodza kpwa kawaida rina makodza madide matsano ganayoenea dza vyala vya mkpwono.

Matunda ganaivwa na kukala maru, na gana nyama ya unga-unga ya mtswano.

where.en: It grows in the hot, low wooded grassland of Kwale and Kilifi.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika za joto za nyanda za chini zenye miti huko Kwale na Kilifi.
where.dg: Unamera phatu phenye nyasi na mihi, pha dzoho na pha photsi, Kwale na Kilifi.

uses.en: The black, sweet, mealy fruit is eaten. The straight stems are cut for poles, and the wood is carved into spoons and tool handles.
uses.sw: Tunda lake jeusi, tamu na la unga-unga huliwa. Mashina yaliyonyooka hukatwa kuwa nguzo, na mti wake huchongwa kuwa miiko na mipini ya zana.
uses.dg: Tunda riru, ra mtswano na ra unga-unga nkuriwa. Mihi iriyoima chocho nkukatwa nguzo, na nyama za muhi nkutsongbwa vidziko na mipini ya vyombo vya kazi.

culture.en: *Mfudu* is the reference point for its relatives: the Digo name *mfudu madzi*, the 'watery *mfudu*', and *mfudu unga*, the 'floury *mfudu*', by comparing their fruit with this one.
culture.sw: *Mfudu* ndio kipimo cha jamaa zake: Wadigo wanaita *mfudu madzi*, '*mfudu* wa maji', na *mfudu unga*, '*mfudu* wa unga', kwa kulinganisha matunda yao na ya mti huu.
culture.dg: *Mfudu* ndio muhi ambao nduguze nkulinganishwa nao: madzina ga Chidigo *mfudu madzi*, '*mfudu* wa madzi', na *mfudu unga*, '*mfudu* wa unga', ganalavywa kpwa kulinganisha matundage na ga muhi uhu.

names.en: Pakia and Maundu and Tengnäs record the Digo name *mfudu*, which is also the Swahili name. Chonyi speakers call it *mfudu unga*, which in Digo is the name of a different tree, the black plum. In English it is the chocolate berry, and its scientific name is *Vitex payos*.
names.sw: Pakia, pamoja na Maundu na Tengnäs, wanarekodi jina la Kidigo *mfudu*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili. Wazungumzaji wa Kichonyi huuita *mfudu unga*, ambalo kwa Kidigo ni jina la mti mwingine, *black plum*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *chocolate berry*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Vitex payos*.
names.dg: Pakia, na Maundu na Tengnäs, anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mfudu*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili. Atu anaogomba Chichonyi anauiha *mfudu unga*, ambaro kpwa Chidigo ni dzina ra muhi wanjina, *black plum*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *chocolate berry*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Vitex payos*.

teaser.en: Its bark is so smooth and powdery that, people say, even monkeys struggle to climb it.
teaser.sw: Gome lake ni laini na lenye unga-unga kiasi kwamba, watu husema, hata nyani hupata shida kuupanda.
teaser.dg: Gophare ni laini na rina unga-unga, hata nkugombwa kukala tumbiri piya anaona shida kuufyombera.

summary.en: *Mfune* is a tall, straight tree of coastal and riverine forest, reaching 40 metres, with smooth, powdery pale-yellow bark. It is surrounded by many myths and is often left standing when land is cleared for farms.
summary.sw: *Mfune* ni mti mrefu, ulionyooka wa misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito, unaofikia mita 40, wenye gome laini lenye unga-unga la rangi ya manjano iliyofifia. Umezungukwa na hadithi nyingi za kale na mara nyingi huachwa ukiwa umesimama ardhi inaposafishwa kwa ajili ya mashamba.
summary.dg: *Mfune* ni muhi mure na wa twaa wa matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, unaofika mita 40, wenye gopha laini, renye unga-unga, ra rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu. Kuna ngano nyinji kuhusu muhi uhu, na mara nyinji nkurichwa uchiima wakati atu anaphotema tsi kpwa kuhenda minda.

about.en:
*Mfune* is one of the tallest trees of the coast, growing up to 40 metres with a long, straight, clear trunk. Its bark is the thing to remember: smooth, powdery and pale yellow, almost glowing against the darker forest.

The leaves are large and lobed, clustered at the ends of the branches. The fruits are woody pods that split open to show the seeds, which in this family are often surrounded by irritating hairs.
about.sw:
*Mfune* ni mojawapo ya miti mirefu zaidi ya pwani, ukifikia hadi mita 40 na shina refu, lililonyooka lisilo na matawi. Gome lake ndilo la kukumbuka: laini, lenye unga-unga na la manjano iliyofifia, karibu kung'aa dhidi ya msitu wenye giza zaidi.

Majani yake ni makubwa na yenye mapindo, yamejikusanya kwenye ncha za matawi. Matunda yake ni maganda magumu kama mti yanayopasuka kuonyesha mbegu, ambazo katika familia hii mara nyingi huzungukwa na manyoya yanayowasha.
about.dg:
*Mfune* ni mwenga wa mihi mire zaidi ya pwani; unakula hadi mita 40, na kolo mure, ra twaa, ambaro tarina panda photsi. Chitu cha kutambukira ni gophare: ni laini, rina unga-unga, na ni ra rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, hata rinaonekana dza rinaala kahi ya tsaka ririro na jiza.

Makodzage ni makulu na gana mala, na ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za panda. Matundage ni makakaya mafu dza muhi ganagoahuka na kuonyesa tembe; kpwa jamii ihi, tembe mara nyinji zinazungulukpwa ni nyere zinazoawisa.

where.en: It grows in coastal and riverine forest, in coastal bushland and on coral rag. It is often left standing in farmland when the rest of the bush is cleared, so a lone, pale-trunked giant among the fields is very often a *mfune*.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito, katika vichaka vya pwani na juu ya miamba ya matumbawe. Mara nyingi huachwa ukiwa umesimama mashambani wakati vichaka vingine vinaposafishwa, hivyo jitu moja la shina jeupe katikati ya mashamba mara nyingi sana huwa ni *mfune*.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, kpwenye vitsaka vya pwani na dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo. Mara nyinji nkurichwa uchiima mindani wakati vitsaka vyanjina vinaphotemwa, kpwa hivyo muhi mkulu sana uimao macheye kahi ya minda, wenye kolo ra rangi ngushu-ngushu, mara nyinji ni *mfune*.

uses.en: The Digo use its bark and leaves in medicine. Its seeds are eaten. The wood is soft and is used for carving and for walking sticks.
uses.sw: Wadigo hutumia gome na majani yake kama dawa. Mbegu zake huliwa. Mti wake ni laini na hutumika kwa uchongaji na kutengenezea bakora.
uses.dg: Adigo anahumira gophare na makodzage kpwa dawa. Tembeze nkuriwa. Nyama za muhi ni laini, na nkuhumirwa kutsonga vitu na kuhenda bakora.

culture.en: *Mfune* is associated with many myths. Its bark is said to be so smooth that even monkeys struggle to climb it.
culture.sw: *Mfune* unahusishwa na hadithi nyingi za kale. Inasemekana gome lake ni laini kiasi kwamba hata nyani hupata shida kuupanda.
culture.dg: Kuna ngano nyinji kuhusu *mfune*. Nkugombwa kukala gophare ni laini hata tumbiri piya anaona shida kuufyombera.

names.en: Pakia and Maundu and Tengnäs record the Digo name *mfune*, which is shared with Swahili and Giriama. Swahili also has *msefu*. No common English name is in use; its scientific name is *Sterculia appendiculata*.
names.sw: Pakia, pamoja na Maundu na Tengnäs, wanarekodi jina la Kidigo *mfune*, ambalo pia linatumika kwa Kiswahili na Kigiriama. Kiswahili pia kina *msefu*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza linalotumika; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Sterculia appendiculata*.
names.dg: Pakia, na Maundu na Tengnäs, anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mfune*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili na ra Chigiryama. Chiswahili piya china dzina *msefu*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa ni atu; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Sterculia appendiculata*.

teaser.en: Before felling a giant fig like this, tree cutters might first sacrifice a black sheep to the spirits living inside it.
teaser.sw: Kabla ya kuangusha mkuyu mkubwa kama huu, wakataji miti wanaweza kwanza kuchinja kondoo mweusi kama sadaka kwa pepo wanaoishi ndani yake.
teaser.dg: Kabla ya kukata muhi mkulu wa kuyu dza hinyu, akata mihi anaweza kulavya sadaka ya ng'ondzi mwiru kpwa pepho anaokala ndaniwe.

summary.en: *Mgandi*, the sycamore fig, is a massive spreading fig of riverbanks, groundwater sites and kaya forests, with figs clustered right on its trunk. Its fruit, shade and medicine make it useful, but big figs are also among the trees the Digo believe are home to spirits.
summary.sw: *Mgandi*, au mkuyu, ni mtini mkubwa unaotanda wa kingo za mito, maeneo ya maji ya chini ya ardhi na misitu ya kaya, wenye tini zilizosongamana moja kwa moja kwenye shina lake. Matunda, kivuli na dawa zake huufanya kuwa na manufaa, lakini mitini mikubwa pia ni miongoni mwa miti ambayo Wadigo wanaamini ni makazi ya pepo.
summary.dg: *Mgandi* ni muhi mkulu sana wa jamii ya kuyu, unaotandazika kanda-kanda ya miho, phatu phenye madzi ga tsini, na matsaka ga kaya, na matundage ganamera kpwa mafungu kpwenye kolo. Matundage, pephoye na dawaye vinaufwahisa, ela mihi mikulu ya jamii ya kuyu ni kahi ya mihi ambayo Adigo anaamini ni makalo ga pepho.

about.en:
*Mgandi* is a big tree in every sense: a heavy trunk, a broad spreading crown and limbs that can shade a whole gathering. The bark is yellowish and flakes away in patches, and any cut or broken twig bleeds a milky latex, as with all figs. The leaves are rounded and rough to the touch.

The most striking feature is where the fruit grows. Instead of hanging among the leaves, the small figs are borne in clusters directly on the trunk and the main branches, so a fruiting tree looks as if it has been studded with beads. Like all figs, the 'fruit' is really a hollow flower head, pollinated from the inside by tiny fig wasps.
about.sw:
*Mgandi* ni mti mkubwa kwa kila hali: shina zito, taji pana linalotanda na matawi yanayoweza kutoa kivuli kwa mkusanyiko mzima wa watu. Gome lake ni la manjano kidogo na hubanduka kwa mabaka, na kitawi chochote kilichokatwa au kuvunjika hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa, kama ilivyo kwa mitini yote. Majani yake ni ya mviringo na yanakwaruza yakiguswa.

Jambo la kushangaza zaidi ni mahali matunda yanapoota. Badala ya kuning'inia katikati ya majani, tini ndogo huzaliwa kwa vishada moja kwa moja kwenye shina na matawi makuu, hivyo mti unaozaa huonekana kana kwamba umepambwa kwa shanga. Kama tini zote, 'tunda' kwa hakika ni kichwa cha maua chenye uwazi ndani, kinachochavushwa kutoka ndani na nyigu wadogo sana wa tini.
about.dg:
*Mgandi* ni muhi mkulu kpwa chila njira: kolo kulu ziho, dari pana inayotandazika, na panda zinazoweza kulavya pepho kpwa borori zima ra atu. Gophare ni ra rangi ya mandano na rinatuluka vipande-vipande, na chila phatu phanaphokatwa au chigongo chichivundzika phanatuluka maziya, dza kuyu zosi. Makodzage ni ga duara na ganakaraza uchiganguta.

Chitu cha ajabu zaidi ni phatu matunda ganaphomera. Badala ya kugbwadzika kahi ya makodza, kuyu ndide zinamera kpwa mafungu kpwenye kolo na panda kulu, kpwa hivyo muhi wenye matunda unaonekana dza ukatiywa ushanga. Dza kuyu zosi, 'tunda' kpwa kpweli ni chitswa cha maruwa chirichokala na pango ndani, na chinachavushwa kula ndani ni adudu adide sana a kuyu.

where.en: Look for *mgandi* where there is water close to the surface: along rivers and streams, in riverine forest and at groundwater sites on the coastal plain. Large old trees also stand in the kaya forests, where they have been protected along with the rest of the sacred woodland. A fig in fruit is easiest to spot by the birds, bats and monkeys that gather to feed on it.
where.sw: Tafuta *mgandi* mahali ambapo maji yako karibu na uso wa ardhi: kando ya mito na vijito, katika misitu ya kingo za mito na kwenye maeneo ya maji ya chini ya ardhi katika tambarare ya pwani. Miti mikubwa ya zamani pia imesimama katika misitu ya kaya, ambako imelindwa pamoja na msitu mtakatifu wote. Mtini unaozaa ni rahisi zaidi kuutambua kwa ndege, popo na nyani wanaokusanyika kula matunda yake.
where.dg: Uchilonda *mgandi*, endza phatu ambapho madzi ga tsini ganaphahikana phephi na dzulu: kanda-kanda ya miho mikulu na midide, ndani ya matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho, na phatu phenye madzi ga tsini kpwenye herera ya pwani. Mihi mikulu ya kare piya inaima ndani ya matsaka ga kaya, ambamo yarindwa phamwenga na tsakare rosi takatifu. Kuyu yenye matunda ni rahisi kuimanya kpwa nyuni, manundu na tumbiri anaokusanyika kurya matundage.

uses.en:
The figs are edible and are picked straight from the trunk. The tree's wide crown makes it a favourite shade tree, a place to rest or meet out of the midday sun.

Both the latex and the bark are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Tini zake huliwa na huchumwa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina. Taji lake pana huufanya kuwa mti wa kivuli unaopendwa, mahali pa kupumzika au kukutana mbali na jua la mchana.

Utomvu na gome lake vyote hutumika katika dawa za asili.
uses.dg:
Matunda ganariwa, na nkuhundwa kula kolo. Dari pana ya muhi hinyu inaufwahisa kukala muhi unaomendzwa kpwa pepho, phatu pha kuoya au kukutana na kuhepa dzuwa ra namutsi.

Maziya na gopha vyosi viiri nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: Big fig trees are among the trees the Digo believe house spirits. Pakia records that tree cutters may sacrifice a black sheep before felling a large tree, to settle with whatever lives in it. Figs also have a place at the heart of the kaya: the *moroni*, the meeting house in the central clearing, is described as sitting between a fig tree and a baobab.
culture.sw: Mitini mikubwa ni miongoni mwa miti ambayo Wadigo wanaamini ni makazi ya pepo. Pakia anarekodi kwamba wakataji miti wanaweza kuchinja kondoo mweusi kama sadaka kabla ya kuangusha mti mkubwa, ili kupatana na chochote kinachoishi ndani yake. Mitini pia ina nafasi katikati ya kaya: *moroni*, nyumba ya mikutano katika uwanja wa katikati, inaelezwa kuwa iko kati ya mtini na mbuyu.
culture.dg: Mihi mikulu ya jamii ya kuyu ni kahi ya mihi ambayo Adigo anaamini ni makalo ga pepho. Pakia anaandika kukala akata mihi anaweza kulavya sadaka ya ng'ondzi mwiru kabla ya kukata muhi mkulu, ili kupatana na chochosi chinachokala ndaniwe. Kuyu piya zina phatu kahi-kahi ya kaya: *moroni*, nyumba ya mikutano iriyo kahi-kahi ya uwanja wa kaya, nkugombwa kukala i kahi ya muhi wa kuyu na muuyu.

names.en: Pakia gives the Digo name *mgandi* for *Ficus sycomorus*, the sycamore fig. In Swahili it is *mkuyu*. The Mgombato dictionary also lists *mgandi* with the Swahili *mkuyu*, but identifies it as the Cape fig, *Ficus sur*, a related fig that Pakia calls *mkuyu* in Digo. The two sources may be using the name for different fig species, and a speaker's check would settle which tree *mgandi* names today.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa jina la Kidigo *mgandi* kwa *Ficus sycomorus*, yaani *sycamore fig*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkuyu*. Kamusi ya Mgombato pia inaorodhesha *mgandi* pamoja na Kiswahili *mkuyu*, lakini inautambua kama *Cape fig*, *Ficus sur*, mtini wa jamii yake ambao Pakia anauita *mkuyu* kwa Kidigo. Huenda vyanzo hivi viwili vinatumia jina hili kwa spishi tofauti za mitini, na uthibitisho kutoka kwa mzungumzaji ungeamua ni mti upi unaoitwa *mgandi* leo.
names.dg: Pakia analavya dzina ra Chidigo *mgandi* kpwa *Ficus sycomorus*, kuyu ya *sycamore fig*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkuyu*. Kamusi ya Mgombato piya inaandika *mgandi* na Chiswahili *mkuyu*, ela inaamba kukala ni *Cape fig*, *Ficus sur*, kuyu yanjina ya jamii mwenga ambayo Pakia anaiiha *mkuyu* kpwa Chidigo. Vitabu hivi viiri vinaweza kukala vinahumira dzina hiri kpwa aina za tafwauti za kuyu, na mutu anayegomba Chidigo ndiye anayeweza kuamuwa ni muhi wani unaoihwa *mgandi* rero.
