teaser.en: Its pink trumpet flowers hang in fragrant sprays, yet its Swahili name, mti sumu, means 'poison tree'.
teaser.sw: Maua yake ya waridi yenye umbo la tarumbeta huning'inia kwa vishada vyenye harufu nzuri, lakini jina lake la Kiswahili, mti sumu, lina maana ya 'mti wa sumu'.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ga pinki ga umbo dza tarumbeta ganabwadzika kpwa mabunda genye arufu nono, ela dzinare ra Chiswahili, *mti sumu*, mana yakpwe ni 'muhi wa sumu'.

summary.en: *Mgodo*, the pink jacaranda, is a deciduous tree of rocky bushland and wooded grassland with fragrant pink trumpet flowers and long twisted pods. It gives poles, furniture wood and tool handles, and its bark and fruit are used in traditional medicine.
summary.sw: *Mgodo*, au mti sumu, ni mti unaopukutisha majani wa vichaka vya miamba na nyika zenye miti, wenye maua ya waridi yenye harufu nzuri yenye umbo la tarumbeta na maganda marefu yaliyosokotana. Hutoa nguzo, mbao za samani na mipini ya zana, na gome na tunda lake hutumika katika dawa za jadi.
summary.dg: *Mgodo* (kpwa Chingereza *pink jacaranda*) ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wa weruni kpwenye mawe na wa nyasi zenye mihi, wenye maruwa ga pinki ga umbo dza tarumbeta genye arufu nono, na makakaya mare ganagodzisongolosa. Unalavya nguzo, mbao za fanicha na mipini ya vyombo, na gophare na matundage nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji.

about.en:
*Mgodo* is a medium-sized tree, usually 5 to 13 metres tall. Its bark is one of the easiest clues: it flakes off in rounded patches, leaving a mottled trunk. The leaves are compound, made up of several pairs of leaflets.

It is not a true jacaranda but a relative in the same trumpet-flower family, and the English name comes from its flowers. Pink to mauve trumpets, often with darker lines in the throat, hang in drooping sprays and smell sweet. The tree often flowers when it is bare or nearly bare of leaves, which makes the blossom stand out against the dry bush. The flowers are followed by long, thin pods that twist as they dry.
about.sw:
*Mgodo* ni mti wa ukubwa wa wastani, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa mita 5 hadi 13. Gome lake ni mojawapo ya dalili rahisi zaidi za kuutambua: hubambuka kwa mabaka ya mviringo, na kuacha shina lenye madoadoa. Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko, yameundwa na jozi kadhaa za vijani.

Si mjakaranda halisi bali ni jamaa yake katika familia moja ya maua-tarumbeta, na jina la Kiingereza linatokana na maua yake. Tarumbeta za waridi hadi zambarau hafifu, mara nyingi zikiwa na mistari iliyokolea kooni, huning'inia kwa vishada vinavyoinama na zina harufu tamu. Mara nyingi mti huu huchanua ukiwa hauna majani au karibu hauna majani kabisa, jambo linalofanya maua yaonekane wazi dhidi ya vichaka vikavu. Baada ya maua huja maganda marefu, membamba yanayojisokota yanapokauka.
about.dg:
*Mgodo* ni muhi wa chiasi, kawaida wa mita 5 hadi 13. Gophare ni alama mwenga rahisi zaidi ya kuumanya: rinagandulika vipande vya mviringo, na kolo rinasala na mabara ga rangi tafwauti. Makodzage ni ga kuungana, genye makodza madide manji, airi-airi.

Si *jacaranda* ya kpweli, ela ni nduguye wa jamii mwenga ya maruwa ga umbo dza tarumbeta, na dzinare ra Chingereza rinalavywa kula maruwage. Maruwa ga pinki hadi zambarau ngushu-ngushu, mara nyinji genye mistari ya rangi iriyo nyiru zaidi ndani yao, ganabwadzika kpwa mabunda na ganalavya arufu nono. Mara nyinji muhi unalavya maruwa wakati makodzage gakagbwa gosi au phephi gosi, na ihi inahenda maruwa ganaonekana sana kahi ya vitsaka vikavu. Bada ya maruwa kunatuluka makakaya mare na membamba ganagodzisongolosa ganaphouma.

where.en: *Mgodo* grows in rocky bushland and wooded grassland, the drier, more open country away from the wet forests. It is most noticeable in the dry season, when the leafless crowns carry their pink flowers.
where.sw: *Mgodo* hukua katika vichaka vya miamba na nyika zenye miti, maeneo makavu zaidi na ya wazi zaidi mbali na misitu yenye unyevu. Huonekana zaidi wakati wa kiangazi, vilele visivyo na majani vinapobeba maua yake ya waridi.
where.dg: *Mgodo* unamera weruni kpwenye mawe na kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi, tsi kavu zaidi na ya wazi zaidi, kure na matsaka ga mvula nyinji. Unaonekana zaidi wakati wa kazikazi, wakati mihi taina makodza na dzulu yao kuna maruwa ga pinki.

uses.en:
The wood is used for poles, furniture and tool handles.

The bark and the fruit are used in traditional medicine; the fruit in particular is used to treat cough.
uses.sw:
Mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo, samani na mipini ya zana.

Gome na tunda hutumika katika dawa za jadi; hasa tunda hutumika kutibu kikohozi.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda nguzo, fanicha na mipini ya vyombo.

Gopha na matunda nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji; hasa matunda nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa ya kukolola.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mgodo*, with the variant spelling *mgondo*. The ICRAF handbook adds two more Digo names, *ndondu* and *mwagaivu*. In Swahili the tree is called *mti sumu*, 'poison tree'. In English it is the pink jacaranda.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mgodo*, na tahajia nyingine *mgondo*. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinaongeza majina mengine mawili ya Kidigo, *ndondu* na *mwagaivu*. Kwa Kiswahili mti huu unaitwa *mti sumu*, 'mti wa sumu'. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *pink jacaranda*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mgodo*, na piya anauandika *mgondo*. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaenjereza madzina mairi ganjina ga Chidigo, *ndondu* na *mwagaivu*. Kpwa Chiswahili muhi uhu unaihwa *mti sumu*, 'muhi wa sumu'. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pink jacaranda*.

reason.en: Trumpet-flower relative with long twisted pods
reason.sw: Jamaa wa familia ya maua-tarumbeta wenye maganda marefu yaliyosokotana
reason.dg: Ndugu wa jamii ya maruwa dza tarumbeta, mwenye makakaya mare ganagodzisongolosa

reason.en: Showy-flowered member of the same family
reason.sw: Mwanafamilia mmoja mwenye maua ya kuvutia
reason.dg: Muhi wa jamii mwenga wenye maruwa manono ganagoonekana sana

reason.en: The sausage tree, another trumpet-flower relative
reason.sw: Mvungunya, jamaa mwingine wa familia ya maua-tarumbeta
reason.dg: *Mvungunya*, ndugu wanjina wa jamii ya maruwa dza tarumbeta

reason.sw: Pia hutumika kwa ujenzi na mipini ya zana
reason.dg: Piya nkuhumirwa kpwa kudzenga na kuhenda mipini ya vyombo

teaser.en: Its star-shaped fruits look handsome but hide itchy hairs, while its bark gives the rope that ties roofs together.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake yenye umbo la nyota yanapendeza kuyaona lakini yanaficha manyoya yanayowasha, na gome lake hutoa kamba inayofunga mapaa.
teaser.dg: Matundage ga umbo dza nyota ni manono kugalola, ela ganafwitsa nyere zinazoawisa; na gophare rinalavya kamba zinazofunga mapaa ga nyumba.

summary.en: *Mgoza*, the African star-chestnut, is a fat-trunked deciduous tree of hot, rocky hills with shiny peeling bark and woody star-shaped fruits. Its bark gives rope for tying thatch and house poles, and its light wood is used for simple furniture.
summary.sw: *Mgoza* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye shina nene, wa vilima vya joto vyenye miamba, wenye gome linalong'aa na kubambuka, na matunda magumu yenye umbo la nyota. Gome lake hutoa kamba ya kufungia makuti na nguzo za nyumba, na mti wake mwepesi hutumika kwa samani za kawaida.
summary.dg: *Mgoza* (kpwa Chingereza *African star-chestnut*) ni muhi wenye kolo rinaronona, ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wa myango ya mawe yenye dzoho, wenye gopha rinaroala na rinarogandulika, na matunda mafu dza muhi ga umbo dza nyota. Gophare rinalavya kamba za kufunga makuti na nguzo za nyumba, na nyama za muhi, zirizo phepheya, nkuhumirwa kuhenda fanicha za kawaida.

about.en:
*Mgoza* is easy to pick out on a dry hillside. The trunk is thick and fluted, and the bark is pale and shiny, flaking away to leave patches of purple and green. The leaves are broad with three to five lobes, a little like a hand, and the tree drops them in the dry season.

The fruit gives the tree its English name. Woody pods split open in a star of several segments, each holding seeds. Inside, the pods are lined with stiff hairs that irritate the skin, so they are best handled with care.
about.sw:
*Mgoza* ni rahisi kuutambua kwenye mteremko mkavu wa kilima. Shina lake ni nene na lenye mifereji, na gome lake ni jeupe-jeupe na linang'aa, likibambuka na kuacha mabaka ya zambarau na kijani. Majani yake ni mapana yenye mapindo matatu hadi matano, kidogo kama mkono, na mti huyapukutisha wakati wa kiangazi.

Tunda ndilo linalotoa jina la Kiingereza la mti huu. Maganda magumu kama mti hupasuka kwa umbo la nyota ya vipande kadhaa, kila kimoja kikiwa na mbegu. Ndani, maganda yamepangwa manyoya magumu yanayowasha ngozi, hivyo ni bora kuyashika kwa uangalifu.
about.dg:
*Mgoza* ni rahisi kuumanya dzulu ya mwango mkavu. Kolo ni rinono na rina mistari mire ya kuinama ndani, na gopha ni ra rangi ngushu-ngushu na rinaala; rinagandulika na kuricha mabara ga zambarau na ga chijani. Makodzage ni mapana, gana mala mahahu hadi matsano, chidide dza mkpwono, na nkugbwa wakati wa kazikazi.

Tunda ndiro rinaropha muhi uhu dzinare ra Chingereza. Makakaya mafu dza muhi ganaahuka na kukala dza nyota ya vipande kadhaa, na chila chipande china tembe. Ndani, makakaya ganakala na nyere ngumu zinazoawisa ngozi, kpwa hivyo ni lazima kugagbwira pore-pore.

where.en: *Mgoza* likes heat and rock. It grows on hot, dry, rocky hills and along the edges of woodland, often standing out from lower bush around it. In the dry season, bare and pale-barked, it is especially noticeable.
where.sw: *Mgoza* hupenda joto na miamba. Hukua kwenye vilima vya joto, vikavu vyenye miamba na kando ya misitu ya wazi, mara nyingi ukionekana wazi juu ya vichaka vifupi vinavyouzunguka. Wakati wa kiangazi, ukiwa hauna majani na gome lake jeupe-jeupe, huonekana zaidi.
where.dg: *Mgoza* unamendza dzoho na mawe. Unamera dzulu ya myango ya mawe yenye dzoho na mikavu, na kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga wazi, na mara nyinji unaonekana sana kahi ya vitsaka vifupi virivyouzunguluka. Wakati wa kazikazi, uchikala tauna makodza na gophare ni ngushu-ngushu, unaonekana zaidi.

uses.en:
The bark is stripped for rope, which is used to tie thatch and house poles together, an important job in traditional house building. The bark is also used for mats.

The wood is light and is used for local furniture. The tree also yields a gum.
uses.sw:
Gome hubambuliwa kutengeneza kamba, inayotumika kufunga makuti na nguzo za nyumba pamoja, kazi muhimu katika ujenzi wa nyumba za jadi. Gome pia hutumika kwa mikeka.

Mti wake ni mwepesi na hutumika kwa samani za kienyeji. Mti huu pia hutoa ulimbo.
uses.dg:
Gopha nkugandulwa kpwa kuhenda kamba, zinazohumirwa kufunga makuti na nguzo za nyumba phamwenga, kazi muhimu kpwa kudzenga nyumba za chienyeji. Gopha piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda micheka.

Nyama za muhi ni phepheya na nkuhumirwa kuhenda fanicha za chienyeji. Muhi piya unalavya ulimbo.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name *mgoza*. Pakia uses *mgoza* for a related star-chestnut, *Sterculia rhynchocarpa*, so the name may cover more than one species. In Swahili it is *mgoza* or *ngozo*, and in Giriama *muoria*. In English it is the African star-chestnut.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo *mgoza*. Pakia anatumia *mgoza* kwa mti mwingine wa jamii yake, *Sterculia rhynchocarpa*, hivyo huenda jina hili linajumuisha spishi zaidi ya moja. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mgoza* au *ngozo*, na kwa Kigiriama *muoria*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *African star-chestnut*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha dzina ra Chidigo *mgoza*. Pakia anahumira *mgoza* kpwa muhi wanjina wa jenasi mwenga, *Sterculia rhynchocarpa*, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinaweza kukala ni ra aina zaidi ya mwenga. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mgoza* au *ngozo*, na kpwa Chigiryama ni *muoria*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *African star-chestnut*.

reason.en: Another Sterculia of the coastal forests
reason.sw: Sterculia nyingine ya misitu ya pwani
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa *Sterculia* wa matsaka ga pwani

reason.en: Baobab, also in the mallow family and used for bark fibre
reason.sw: Mbuyu, pia wa familia ya mibamia na hutumika kwa nyuzi za gome
reason.dg: *Muuyu*, piya wa jamii ya *mallow*, na gophare nkuhumirwa kuhenda kamba

reason.en: Also gives bark string and baskets
reason.sw: Pia hutoa kamba za gome na vikapu
reason.dg: Piya unalavya nyugbwe za gopha na kaphu

reason.en: Another tree used for bark fibre
reason.sw: Mti mwingine unaotumika kwa nyuzi za gome
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina ambao gophare nkuhumirwa kuhenda kamba

teaser.en: People once wore this tree: its bark was beaten into cloth, which is how it earned one of its Digo names.
teaser.sw: Zamani watu waliuvaa mti huu: gome lake lilipigwa likawa nguo, na hivyo ndivyo lilivyopata mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Kare atu kala anavwala muhi uhu: gophare kala rinapigbwa hadi rinakala nguwo, na ndiyo mana ukaphaha dzina rimwenga kahi ya madzinage ga Chidigo.

summary.en: *Mgua* is a tall forest tree with pale ringed bark that drips cream latex, found in the moist forest remnants of Shimba Hills and the kayas. Its bark was once beaten into barkcloth for clothing, and its soft wood still goes into veneer and canoes.
summary.sw: *Mgua*, au mkunde, ni mti mrefu wa msituni wenye gome jeupe-jeupe lenye pete linalotiririsha utomvu wa rangi ya krimu, unaopatikana katika mabaki ya misitu yenye unyevu ya Shimba Hills na kaya. Zamani gome lake lilipigwa kutengeneza nguo za gome, na mti wake laini bado hutumika kwa mbao nyembamba za kubandika (veneer) na mitumbwi.
summary.dg: *Mgua* ni muhi mure wa tsakani wenye gopha ra rangi ngushu-ngushu renye mistari inayozunguluka kolo, rinarolavya maziya, na unaphahikana kpwenye matsaka ga jeke-jeke garigosala, dza ga Shimba Hills na ga kaya. Kare gophare kala rinapigbwa na kuhendwa nguwo ya gopha ya kuvwala, na nyama za muhi, zirizo laini, hata rero nkuhumirwa kuhenda mbao nyembamba za *veneer* na ngarawa.

about.en:
*Mgua* can reach 40 metres, rising into the forest canopy. Its bark is smooth, pale grey and marked with rings, and a cut releases a creamy latex. The branchlets droop, and the leaves are rough and papery. The fruits are small, red and velvety.

From a distance it can be mistaken for the prized *mvure* (mvule), which is why carpenters call it 'false mvule'.
about.sw:
*Mgua* unaweza kufikia mita 40, ukipanda hadi kilele cha msitu. Gome lake ni laini, la kijivu hafifu na lenye alama za pete, na likikatwa hutoa utomvu wa rangi ya krimu. Vitawi vyake huinama, na majani yake ni machakavu na membamba kama karatasi. Matunda yake ni madogo, mekundu na laini kama mahameli.

Ukiwa mbali unaweza kudhaniwa kuwa ni *mvure* (mvule) unaothaminiwa sana, na ndiyo sababu maseremala huuita 'false mvule', yaani mvule bandia.
about.dg:
*Mgua* unaweza kufika mita 40, na kuphiya dzulu hadi dari ya tsaka. Gophare ni laini, ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu, na rina mistari inayozunguluka kolo; richitemwa, rinalavya maziya. Panda ndide zinainama photsi, na makodza ganakaraza na ni membamba dza karatasi. Matunda ni madide, ga kundu na genye nyere laini.

Uchiulola kula kure, unaweza kuona dza ni *mvure* (*mvule*), muhi unaomendzwa sana, ndiyo mana mafundi a mbao anauiha '*false mvule*'.

where.en: This is a tree of moist forest. On the south coast it survives in forest remnants such as the Shimba Hills and the kaya forests; it also grows at Gede to the north. Look for its pale, ringed trunk among the big trees of the canopy.
where.sw: Huu ni mti wa msitu wenye unyevu. Katika pwani ya kusini umesalia katika mabaki ya misitu kama Shimba Hills na misitu ya kaya; pia hukua Gede upande wa kaskazini. Tafuta shina lake jeupe-jeupe lenye pete miongoni mwa miti mikubwa ya kilele cha msitu.
where.dg: Uhu ni muhi wa matsaka ga jeke-jeke. Pwani ya kusini bado unaphahikana kpwenye matsaka garigosala, dza Shimba Hills na matsaka ga kaya; piya unamera Gede, uphande wa kazikazini. Hendza kolore ra rangi ngushu-ngushu renye mistari inayorizunguluka kahi ya mihi mikulu ya dari ya tsaka.

uses.en:
In the past the bark was stripped and beaten into barkcloth, which was worn as clothing.

Today the wood is used as soft timber, for veneer and for canoes. It is not durable, which is what separates it from *mvure* in a carpenter's eyes. The leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Zamani gome lilibambuliwa na kupigwa kutengeneza nguo za gome, zilizovaliwa kama mavazi.

Leo mti wake hutumika kama mbao laini, kwa mbao nyembamba za kubandika (veneer) na kwa mitumbwi. Haudumu muda mrefu, na hilo ndilo linaloutofautisha na *mvure* machoni mwa seremala. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa za jadi.
uses.dg:
Kare gopha kala rinagandulwa na kupigbwa hadi rinakala nguwo ya gopha, ambayo atu kala anaivwala.

Rero nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa dza mbao laini, kuhenda mbao nyembamba za *veneer* na ngarawa. Taziweza kukala muda mure, na ihi ndiyo tafwauti yao na *mvure* kpwa matso ga fundi wa mbao. Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: Both Digo names tell its story. *Mgua* means 'peeling', from the way the bark comes away. *Mnguonguo* comes from *nguo*, 'cloth', because the bark was once made into clothes.
culture.sw: Majina yote mawili ya Kidigo yanasimulia hadithi yake. *Mgua* maana yake ni 'unaobambuka', kutokana na jinsi gome linavyotoka. *Mnguonguo* linatokana na *nguo*, kwa sababu zamani gome lake lilitengenezwa kuwa mavazi.
culture.dg: Madzina gosi mairi ga Chidigo ganasemurira chisache. Dzina *mgua* rina mana ya 'kuguwa', kpwa sababu ya vira gopha rinavyogandulika. *Mnguonguo* rinalavywa kula *nguo*, 'nguwo', kpwa sababu kare gophare kala rinahendwa nguwo.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mgua* and *mnguonguo*; the ICRAF handbook gives *mnguonguo*, which is also the Giriama name. In Swahili it is *mkunde*. In English it is called false mvule or antiaris. Carpenters use 'false *mvure*' to set it apart from the true *mvure*, *Milicia excelsa*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mgua* na *mnguonguo*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mnguonguo*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkunde*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *false mvule* au *antiaris*. Maseremala hutumia 'false *mvure*' kuutofautisha na *mvure* halisi, *Milicia excelsa*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mgua* na *mnguonguo*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *mnguonguo*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chigiryama. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkunde*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *false mvule* au *antiaris*. Mafundi a mbao anahumira '*false mvure*' ili kuutafwautisha na *mvure* wa kpweli, *Milicia excelsa*.

reason.sw: Mvule halisi unaodhaniwa kuwa ndio
reason.dg: *Mvure* wa kpweli; atu nkuona *mgua* dza ni *mvure*

reason.en: Fig-family relative with milky latex
reason.sw: Jamaa wa familia ya mitini mwenye utomvu kama maziwa
reason.dg: Muhi wa jamii ya kuyu wenye maziya

reason.en: Small latex-bearing relative in the same family
reason.sw: Jamaa mdogo wa familia moja mwenye utomvu
reason.dg: Muhi mdide wa jamii mwenga unaolavya maziya

reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa mbao phepheya zinazohumirwa kuhenda madau

teaser.en: A screw pine that stands on stilts beside creeks, with spiny leaves long enough to weave into mats.
teaser.sw: Mkadi unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili kando ya mikondo ya bahari, wenye majani yenye miiba marefu kiasi cha kusukwa mikeka.
teaser.dg: Muhi dza *mkadi* (*screw pine*) unaoima dzulu ya mizi ya kuimirira kanda-kanda ya mikono ya bahari, wenye makodza genye miya, mare hata ganaweza kusukpwa majamvi.

summary.en: *Mkapu* is the name recorded for the Rabai screw pine, a tree up to 20 metres tall that stands on stilt roots along streams, creeks and swamps of the south coast. Like other screw pines its long leaves are used for weaving, and its fruits are said to be edible.
summary.sw: *Mkapu* ni jina lililorekodiwa kwa msanaka, mti unaofikia urefu wa mita 20 unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili kando ya vijito, mikondo ya bahari na vinamasi vya pwani ya kusini. Kama mikadi mingine, majani yake marefu hutumika kusuka, na inasemekana matunda yake huliwa.
summary.dg: *Mkapu* ni dzina ririroandikpwa kpwa *Rabai screw pine*, muhi wa hadi mita 20 unaoima dzulu ya mizi ya kuimirira kanda-kanda ya miho midide, mikono ya bahari na phatu pha madzi-madzi, pwani ya kusini. Dza mihi yanjina ya aina ya *mkadi*, makodzage mare nkuhumirwa kusuka, na nkugombwa kukala matundage ganariwa.

about.en:
The Rabai screw pine is the tall one of the coast's screw pines, reaching up to 20 metres. It is held up by stilt roots that prop the trunk above wet ground. The leaves are long and strap-like with spiny edges, and they grow in spirals around the branch tips, giving the tree its 'screw' look.

Despite the name, it is not a pine at all but a palm-like plant of the *Pandanus* family.
about.sw:
Msanaka ndio mrefu zaidi kati ya mikadi ya pwani, ukifikia hadi mita 20. Umeshikiliwa na mizizi-mihimili inayoliinua shina juu ya ardhi yenye maji. Majani yake ni marefu kama kanda yenye miiba pembeni, na hukua kwa mzunguko kama skrubu kuzunguka ncha za matawi, na hivyo kuupa mti sura yake ya 'skrubu'.

Ingawa jina lake la Kiingereza linauita msonobari (*pine*), si msonobari hata kidogo bali ni mmea unaofanana na mnazi wa familia ya *Pandanus*.
about.dg:
*Mkapu* ndio muhi mure zaidi kahi ya mihi ya aina ya *mkadi* ya pwani; unafika hadi mita 20. Unagbwirwa ni mizi ya kuimirira, inayoimirira kolo dzulu ya tsi ya madzi-madzi. Makodza ni mare na mabapa dza mkanda, na kanda-kanda gana miya; ganamera kpwa kuzunguluka ntsa za panda, na ndiyo mana muhi unaonekana dza *skrubu* (*screw*).

Hata dzina ra Chingereza richigomba *pine*, muhi uhu si *pine* hata chidide; ni mmea unaoonekana dza muhi wa jamii ya mnazi, wa jamii ya *Pandanus*.

where.en: It grows along streams, near creeks and in swampy places on the south coast near Mombasa. Wherever the ground stays wet, look for its spiralled leaf crowns and stilt roots.
where.sw: Hukua kando ya vijito, karibu na mikondo ya bahari na katika sehemu za vinamasi katika pwani ya kusini karibu na Mombasa. Popote ardhi inapobaki na maji, tafuta vilele vyake vya majani yaliyozunguka kama skrubu na mizizi-mihimili yake.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya miho midide, phephi na mikono ya bahari na phatu pha madzi-madzi pwani ya kusini, phephi na Mombasa. Phophosi tsi inaphosala na madzi, hendza vitswavye vya makodza ganagozunguluka na miziye ya kuimirira.

uses.en: As with other screw pines, the leaves are used for weaving mats and baskets. The fruits are said to be edible.
uses.sw: Kama ilivyo kwa mikadi mingine, majani yake hutumika kusuka mikeka na vikapu. Inasemekana matunda yake huliwa.
uses.dg: Dza mihi yanjina ya aina ya *mkadi*, makodza nkuhumirwa kusuka majamvi na kaphu. Nkugombwa kukala matunda ganariwa.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name *mkapu*, under its entry for *Pandanus kirkii*. This name is doubtful: Pakia calls the screw pine *mkadi*, and both Pakia and the Mgombato dictionary use *kapu* or *mkapu* for the lemon. Other Mijikenda names are Duruma *mukurasa* and Giriama *mkaraza*. In Swahili it is *msanaka*.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo *mkapu*, chini ya maelezo yake ya *Pandanus kirkii*. Jina hili lina shaka: Pakia anauita mkadi *mkadi*, na Pakia pamoja na kamusi ya Mgombato wanatumia *kapu* au *mkapu* kwa mlimau. Majina mengine ya Kimijikenda ni ya Kiduruma *mukurasa* na ya Kigiriama *mkaraza*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *msanaka*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha dzina ra Chidigo *mkapu*, photsi ya *Pandanus kirkii*. Dzina hiri rina shaka: Pakia anauiha *screw pine* *mkadi*, na Pakia na kamusi ya Mgombato osi airi anahumira *kapu* au *mkapu* kpwa limau. Madzina ganjina ga Chimijikenda ni ga Chiduruma, *mukurasa*, na ga Chigiryama, *mkaraza*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *msanaka*.

reason.en: The other screw pine, Pakia's mkadi
reason.sw: Mkadi mwingine, ule anaouita Pakia mkadi
reason.dg: *Mkadi*, *screw pine* wanjina, dzina ririroandikpwa ni Pakia

reason.sw: Mlimau, ambao pia huitwa mkapu
reason.dg: *Mlimau*, ambao piya unaihwa *mkapu*

reason.sw: Mkoma, chanzo kingine cha majani ya kusukia
reason.dg: *Mkoma*, muhi wanjina wenye makodza ga kusukira

reason.dg: *Mtsikitsi*, piya unamera kpwenye tsi ya madzi-madzi

teaser.en: One of its Digo names simply means 'trap', because that is what its sticks become.
teaser.sw: Mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo lina maana ya 'mtego' tu, kwa sababu hivyo ndivyo vijiti vyake vinavyogeuka kuwa.
teaser.dg: Mwenga kahi ya madzinage ga Chidigo rina mana ya 'muhambo' bahi, kpwa sababu vigongovye nkuhendwa mihambo.

summary.en: *Mkete* is a small coastal forest tree of the fig family, with toothed leaves and white latex. Its sticks are made into traps, which gives it its other name, *msusu*.
summary.sw: *Mkete* ni mti mdogo wa msitu wa pwani wa familia ya mitini, wenye majani yenye meno pembeni na utomvu mweupe. Vijiti vyake hutengenezwa kuwa mitego, na hilo ndilo linalompa jina lake jingine, *msusu*.
summary.dg: *Mkete* ni muhi mdide wa matsaka ga pwani, wa jamii ya mkuyu, wenye makodza genye meno kanda-kanda na maziya mereru. Vigongovye nkuhendwa mihambo, ndiyo mana una dzina ranjina, *msusu*.

about.en: *Mkete* is a small tree of the forest understorey. Its leaves have toothed edges, and like its relatives in the fig family it bleeds a white latex when cut.
about.sw: *Mkete* ni mti mdogo wa sehemu ya chini ya msitu. Majani yake yana meno pembeni, na kama jamaa zake wa familia ya mitini, hutoa utomvu mweupe ukikatwa.
about.dg: *Mkete* ni muhi mdide unaomera photsi ya mihi mire ya tsaka. Makodzage gana meno kanda-kanda, na dza nduguze a jamii ya mkuyu, uchikatwa unalavya maziya mereru.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, in the shade of taller trees.
where.sw: Hukua katika msitu wa pwani, kivulini mwa miti mirefu zaidi.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, photsi ya pepho ya mihi mire.

uses.en: The sticks are cut and made into traps, known as *susu*.
uses.sw: Vijiti vyake hukatwa na kutengenezwa kuwa mitego, inayojulikana kama *susu*.
uses.dg: Vigongovye nkukatwa na kuhendwa mihambo, inayoihwa *susu*.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mkete* and *msusu*. *Msusu* means 'trap', after the traps made from its sticks; the same name is used in Swahili. No English name is in common use.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mkete* na *msusu*. *Msusu* maana yake ni 'mtego', kutokana na mitego inayotengenezwa kwa vijiti vyake; jina hilo hilo linatumika kwa Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalotumika kwa kawaida.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mkete* na *msusu*. *Msusu* rina mana ya 'muhambo', kpwa sababu ya mihambo inayohendwa na vigongovye; Chiswahili piya chinahumira dzina hiri. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinaromanyikana sana.

teaser.en: A forest giant with buttresses climbing its trunk, whose big plum-like fruit and oily seeds feed people and livestock alike.
teaser.sw: Jitu la msituni lenye mizizi-ukuta inayopanda juu ya shina lake, ambalo tunda lake kubwa kama plamu na mbegu zake zenye mafuta hulisha watu na mifugo pia.
teaser.dg: Muhi mkulu wa tsaka wenye ngamba zinazofyombera kolo, ambao matundage makulu dza plamu na tembe zenye mafuha ni chakurya cha atu na cha mifugo phamwenga.

summary.en: *Mkonga* is a large coastal forest tree with long buttresses and a fluted trunk, and big plum-like fruits. It gives food, seed oil, fodder and wood for stools, mortars and spoons, and intensive use has left it under threat.
summary.sw: *Mkonga* ni mti mkubwa wa msitu wa pwani wenye mizizi-ukuta mirefu na shina lenye mifereji, na matunda makubwa kama plamu. Hutoa chakula, mafuta ya mbegu, lishe ya mifugo na mbao za vigoda, vinu na miiko, na matumizi makubwa yameuweka hatarini.
summary.dg: *Mkonga* ni muhi mkulu wa matsaka ga pwani wenye ngamba nyire, kolo renye mifumbi mire, na matunda makulu dza plamu. Unalavya chakurya, mafuha ga tembe, chakurya cha mifugo, na nyama za muhi za kuhendera vihi, vinu na vidziko. Kpwa sababu ya kuhumirwa sana, sambi una hatari ya kuangamika.

about.en: *Mkonga* is a big tree. Long buttresses run up from the ground into a deeply fluted trunk, so the base looks like a cluster of walls. Each leaf is made of just two leaflets, a pattern typical of its genus. The fruit is large and plum-like.
about.sw: *Mkonga* ni mti mkubwa. Mizizi-ukuta mirefu hupanda kutoka ardhini hadi kwenye shina lenye mifereji mirefu, hivyo sehemu ya chini huonekana kama kundi la kuta. Kila jani limeundwa na vijani viwili tu, mpangilio wa kawaida wa jenasi yake. Tunda lake ni kubwa na linafanana na plamu.
about.dg: *Mkonga* ni muhi mkulu. Ngamba nyire zinafyombera kula photsi hadi kolo renye mifumbi mire, hata photsi kolo rinaonekana dza kuta nyinji zirizoima phamwenga. Chila kodza ni makodza madide mairi bahi, dza mihi yanjina ya jenasiye. Tunda ni kulu na rinahalana na plamu.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest. Look for the buttressed, fluted trunk, and for fallen fruit beneath it.
where.sw: Hukua katika msitu wa pwani. Tafuta shina lenye mizizi-ukuta na mifereji, na matunda yaliyoanguka chini yake.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani. Hendza kolo renye ngamba na mifumbi, na matunda garigogbwa photsi ya muhi.

uses.en:
The fruit is eaten, and oil is pressed from the seeds. The leaves serve as fodder for livestock.

The wood is used as timber and carved into stools, mortars and spoons.
uses.sw:
Tunda lake huliwa, na mafuta hukamuliwa kutoka kwenye mbegu. Majani hutumika kama lishe ya mifugo.

Mti wake hutumika kama mbao na huchongwa kuwa vigoda, vinu na miiko.
uses.dg:
Matunda nkuriwa, na mafuha nkutuluzwa kula kpwa tembe. Makodza nkuhumirwa dza chakurya cha mifugo.

Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa dza mbao, na nkutsongbwa kuhenda vihi, vinu na vidziko.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook agree on the Digo name *mkonga*, which is also the Giriama name. In Swahili it is *mkonga* or *mguguni*. There is no common English name.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF wanakubaliana juu ya jina la Kidigo *mkonga*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkonga* au *mguguni*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza.
names.dg: Pakia na chitabu cha ICRAF vinakubaliana kukala dzina ra Chidigo ni *mkonga*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chigiryama. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mkonga* au *mguguni*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinaromanyikana sana.

conservation.en: Mkonga is threatened by intensive use for its wood and fruit.
conservation.sw: Mkonga uko hatarini kutokana na matumizi makubwa ya mbao na matunda yake.
conservation.dg: *Mkonga* una hatari ya kuangamika kpwa sababu unahumirwa sana kpwa nyama za muhi na kpwa matundage.

reason.en: Forest tree with edible fruit and wood for mortars
reason.sw: Mti wa msituni wenye tunda linaloliwa na mbao za vinu
reason.dg: Muhi wa tsaka wenye matunda ganagoriwa na nyama za muhi za kuhendera vinu

reason.en: Also carved into mortars and stools
reason.sw: Pia huchongwa kuwa vinu na vigoda
reason.dg: Naye piya nkutsongbwa kuhenda vinu na vihi

reason.en: Another tree valued for seed oil
reason.sw: Mti mwingine unaothaminiwa kwa mafuta ya mbegu
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wenye samani kpwa mafuha ga tembe

reason.sw: Mti wa matunda unaotumika pia kwa vigoda na vinu
reason.dg: Muhi wa matunda ambao piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda vihi na vinu

teaser.en: Termites can't eat its black heartwood, and one of its Digo names says the baboons got there first.
teaser.sw: Mchwa hawawezi kula kiini chake cheusi, na mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo linasema nyani walifika kwanza.
teaser.dg: Malutswa taaweza kurya chiiniche chiru, na mwenga kahi ya madzinage ga Chidigo rinagomba kukala manyani akafika kpwandza.

summary.en: *Mkongolo* is the largest Kenyan *Combretum*, a tall forest tree with peeling bark and very durable black heartwood. Prized for carving, building and tool handles, its big trees have been heavily cut for the carving trade.
summary.sw: *Mkongolo* ndio *Combretum* mkubwa zaidi nchini Kenya, mti mrefu wa msituni wenye gome linalobambuka na kiini cheusi kinachodumu sana. Unathaminiwa kwa uchongaji, ujenzi na mipini ya zana, na miti yake mikubwa imekatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya biashara ya vinyago.
summary.dg: *Mkongolo* ndio *Combretum* kulu kuriko yosi Kenya, muhi mure wa tsaka wenye gopha rinarogandulika na chiini chiru chinachokala muda mrefu sana. Unaonwa wa samani kpwa kutsonga, kudzenga na kuhenda mipini ya vyombo, na mihiye mikulu ikakatwa sana kpwa biashara ya kutsonga.

about.en:
*Mkongolo* can grow to 20 metres, with a narrow crown and a fluted trunk. Its pale brown bark peels away in large patches, leaving a patchwork surface. Like other combretums, it carries fruits with four papery wings, which spin as they fall.

The treasure is inside: the heartwood is black, very hard and resistant to termites.
about.sw:
*Mkongolo* unaweza kufikia mita 20, ukiwa na kilele chembamba na shina lenye mifereji. Gome lake la kahawia hafifu hubambuka kwa mabaka makubwa, na kuacha uso wa viraka-viraka. Kama *Combretum* nyingine, huzaa matunda yenye mabawa manne membamba kama karatasi, yanayozunguka yanapoanguka.

Hazina iko ndani: kiini cha mti ni cheusi, kigumu sana na kinastahimili mchwa.
about.dg:
*Mkongolo* unaweza kukula hadi mita 20, na chitswa chembamba na kolo renye mifumbi. Gophare ra rangi ya dongo ngushu-ngushu rinagandulika kpwa vipande vikulu, na rinaricha kolo na rangi tafwauti-tafwauti. Dza *Combretum* yanjina, una matunda genye mapha manne malaini dza karatasi, ganagozunguluka ganaphogbwa.

Chitu cha samani chi ndani: chiini ni chiru, chigumu sana, na malutswa taachiweza.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, riverine forest and woodland. Big, mature trees are now uncommon outside protected forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika msitu wa pwani, misitu ya kando ya mito na misitu ya wazi. Miti mikubwa iliyokomaa sasa ni adimu nje ya misitu iliyohifadhiwa.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na weruni. Mihi mikulu iriyokula sambi taiphahikana sana kondze ya matsaka ganagohifadhiwa.

uses.en:
The black heartwood is very durable and termite-resistant, which makes it valued for carving, building and tool handles. Pakia lists *mkongolo* among the popular Digo timber species. The wood also goes for firewood and charcoal.

The roots are used in traditional medicine for stomach-ache.
uses.sw:
Kiini cheusi cha mti hudumu sana na kinastahimili mchwa, jambo linalokifanya kithaminiwe kwa uchongaji, ujenzi na mipini ya zana. Pakia anaorodhesha *mkongolo* miongoni mwa spishi maarufu za mbao za Wadigo. Mti wake pia hutumika kwa kuni na makaa.

Mizizi hutumika katika dawa za jadi kutibu maumivu ya tumbo.
uses.dg:
Chiini chiru chinakala muda mrefu sana na malutswa taachiweza, ndiyo mana chinaonwa cha samani kpwa kutsonga, kudzenga na kuhenda mipini ya vyombo. Pakia anaandika *mkongolo* kahi ya mihi ya mbao inayomendzwa sana ni Adigo. Nyama za muhi piya nkuhumirwa dza kuni na kuhenda makala.

Mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa ya chienyeji ya ndani kuluma.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names: *mkongolo* and *mryanyani*, which means 'eaten by baboons'. The ICRAF handbook writes *mgongolo*. Swahili names include *mgongolo*, *mpera mwitu* and *mgurure*, and the Giriama name is *mugurure*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo: *mkongolo* na *mryanyani*, lenye maana ya 'uliolika na nyani'. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinaandika *mgongolo*. Majina ya Kiswahili ni pamoja na *mgongolo*, *mpera mwitu* na *mgurure*, na jina la Kigiriama ni *mugurure*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo: *mkongolo* na *mryanyani*, ambaro rina mana ya 'urioriwa ni manyani'. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika *mgongolo*. Kahi ya madzina ga Chiswahili kuna *mgongolo*, *mpera mwitu* na *mgurure*, na dzina ra Chigiryama ni *mugurure*.

conservation.en: Large trees have been much reduced by the carving trade.
conservation.sw: Miti mikubwa imepungua sana kutokana na biashara ya vinyago.
conservation.dg: Mihi mikulu ikaphunguka sana kpwa sababu ya biashara ya kutsonga.

definition.en: The wings on winged fruits. Pakia could not confirm the term because these trees were uncommon in some study areas.
definition.sw: Mabawa ya matunda yenye mabawa. Pakia hakuweza kuthibitisha neno hili kwa sababu miti hii ilikuwa adimu katika baadhi ya maeneo ya utafiti.
definition.dg: Mapha ga matunda genye mapha. Pakia kaweza kuhakikisha neno hiri kpwa sababu mihi hino kala taiphahikana sana kpwenye phatu phanjina ambapho wahenda utafitiwe.

teaser.en: Cut any part of this tree and it bleeds blood-red sap, and the Digo of Diani boil its bark against malaria.
teaser.sw: Kata sehemu yoyote ya mti huu nao utatoa utomvu mwekundu kama damu, na Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome lake kutibu malaria.
teaser.dg: Uchikata seemu yoyosi ya muhi hinyu, unalavya maziya ga kundu dza mlatso, na Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha gophare kuhenda dawa ya homa.

summary.en: *Mkonotsaka*, the orange-milk tree, is a fast-growing pioneer of forest edges and clearings that bleeds orange to blood-red sap. Its root and stem bark are among the Digo's best-known malaria remedies, and its sap gives a dye.
summary.sw: *Mkonotsaka*, au mbura, ni mti waanzilishi unaokua haraka wa pembezoni mwa misitu na sehemu zilizofyekwa, unaotoa utomvu wa rangi ya chungwa hadi nyekundu kama damu. Gome la mizizi na la shina lake ni miongoni mwa dawa za malaria zinazojulikana zaidi kwa Wadigo, na utomvu wake hutoa rangi.
summary.dg: *Mkonotsaka* (kpwa Chingereza *orange-milk tree*) ni muhi unaokula upesi, mwenga wa mihi ya kpwandza kumera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na phatu phariphokatwa mihi, unaolavya maziya ga rangi ya chungbwa hadi ga kundu dza mlatso. Gopha ra mizi na ra kolo ni kahi ya madawa ga homa ganagomanyikana sana ni Adigo, na maziyage ganalavya rangi.

about.en:
*Mkonotsaka* is a pioneer, one of the first trees to move into a clearing. Its young shoots are covered in orange-brown hairs, and the leaves grow in opposite pairs. The surest sign is the sap: any cut, on twig, leaf or bark, oozes blood-red or orange latex.

The small fruits come in large clusters at the branch ends.
about.sw:
*Mkonotsaka* ni mti waanzilishi, mmojawapo wa miti ya kwanza kuota katika sehemu iliyofyekwa. Machipukizi yake machanga yamefunikwa na manyoya ya rangi ya chungwa-kahawia, na majani hukua kwa jozi zinazoelekeana. Dalili ya uhakika zaidi ni utomvu: kidonda chochote, kwenye kitawi, jani au gome, hutiririsha utomvu mwekundu kama damu au wa rangi ya chungwa.

Matunda yake madogo huja kwa vishada vikubwa kwenye ncha za matawi.
about.dg:
*Mkonotsaka* ni mwenga wa mihi ya kpwandza kumera phatu phariphokatwa mihi. Mapanda madide matsanga gana nyere za rangi ya chungbwa na dongo, na makodza ganamera jozi-jozi, mwenga kpwa chila uphande. Alama ya kpweli zaidi ni maziya: phatu phophosi uchikataho, ichikala ni liphungo, kodza au gopha, ganatuluka maziya ga kundu dza mlatso au ga rangi ya chungbwa.

Matunda madide ganamera kpwa mabunda makulu kpwenye ntsa za panda.

where.en: Look for it at forest edges, in clearings and in moist secondary bush, places where forest is growing back.
where.sw: Utafute pembezoni mwa misitu, katika sehemu zilizofyekwa na katika vichaka vya pili vyenye unyevu, mahali ambapo msitu unaota upya.
where.dg: Hendza kanda-kanda ya matsaka, phatu phariphokatwa mihi, na kpwenye vitsaka vya phatu pha jeke-jeke, ambapho tsaka rinamera tsona.

uses.en:
Among the Digo of Diani, the root and stem bark are boiled as a treatment for malaria. In a study of Digo malaria remedies (Nguta and colleagues, 2011) healers agreed strongly on this use.

The sap is used as a dye, and the wood is used for poles and mortars.
uses.sw:
Miongoni mwa Wadigo wa Diani, gome la mizizi na la shina huchemshwa kama tiba ya malaria. Katika utafiti wa dawa za malaria za Wadigo (Nguta na wenzake, 2011) waganga walikubaliana kwa kiasi kikubwa juu ya matumizi haya.

Utomvu hutumika kama rangi, na mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo na vinu.
uses.dg:
Kpwa Adigo a Diani, gopha ra mizi na ra kolo nkuchemushwa kuhenda dawa ya homa. Kpwenye utafiti wa madawa ga homa ga Adigo (Nguta na anjina, 2011), aganga akakubaliana sana kuhusu kazi hino.

Maziya nkuhumirwa kuhenda rangi, na nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo na vinu.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives two Digo names, *mkonotsaka* and *mbonobono*; *mbonobono* is also recorded for *mpesi* (*Trema orientalis*), another pioneer of clearings. In Swahili it is *mbura*, and in English the orange-milk tree.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mkonotsaka* na *mbonobono*; *mbonobono* pia limerekodiwa kwa *mpesi* (*Trema orientalis*), mti mwingine waanzilishi wa sehemu zilizofyekwa. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mbura*, na kwa Kiingereza *orange-milk tree*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mkonotsaka* na *mbonobono*; *mbonobono* piya rinahumirwa kpwa *mpesi* (*Trema orientalis*), muhi wanjina wa kpwandza kumera phatu phariphokatwa mihi. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mbura*, na kpwa Chingereza *orange-milk tree*.

reason.dg: Naye ni wa kpwandza kumera phatu phariphokatwa mihi, na piya unaihwa mbonobono

teaser.en: Crack its hard round shell and you find sweet orange pulp, one of the bushland's wild treats.
teaser.sw: Vunja ganda lake gumu la mviringo nawe utakuta nyama tamu ya rangi ya chungwa, mojawapo ya vitafunio vya porini vya vichakani.
teaser.dg: Vundza chivoche chigumu cha mviringo, undaphaha nyama ya mtswano ya rangi ya chungbwa, chimwenga cha vitu vya mtswano vya weruni.

summary.en: *Mkpwakpwa*, the black monkey orange, is a thornless shrub or small tree of coastal bushland with hard round fruits full of sweet orange pulp. Pakia lists it among the edible wild fruits of the Digo.
summary.sw: *Mkpwakpwa*, au mkwakwa, ni kichaka au mti mdogo usio na miiba wa vichaka vya pwani, wenye matunda magumu ya mviringo yaliyojaa nyama tamu ya rangi ya chungwa. Pakia anauorodhesha miongoni mwa matunda ya porini yanayoliwa na Wadigo.
summary.dg: *Mkpwakpwa* (kpwa Chingereza *black monkey orange*) ni chitsaka au muhi mdide usio na miya, wa vitsaka vya pwani, wenye matunda magumu ga mviringo genye nyama nyinji ya mtswano ya rangi ya chungbwa. Pakia anaandika *mkpwakpwa* kahi ya matunda ga weruni ganagoriwa ni Adigo.

about.en: *Mkpwakpwa* is a shrub or small tree with no thorns, which separates it from its spiny cousin *muhonga*. The leaves are glossy. The fruits are hard and round, like small cannonballs, and turn from green toward yellow-orange as they ripen. Inside, seeds are packed in a sweet, orange pulp.
about.sw: *Mkpwakpwa* ni kichaka au mti mdogo usio na miiba, jambo linaloutofautisha na binamu yake mwenye miiba, *muhonga*. Majani yake yanang'aa. Matunda yake ni magumu na ya mviringo, kama makombora madogo ya mzinga, na hubadilika kutoka kijani kuelekea manjano-chungwa yanapoiva. Ndani yake, mbegu zimesheheni katika nyama tamu ya rangi ya chungwa.
about.dg: *Mkpwakpwa* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide usio na miya, na kpwa hivyo ni tafwauti na nduguye wa miya, *muhonga*. Makodza ganang'ala. Matunda ni magumu na ga mviringo, dza mipira midide ya chuma, na ganagaluka kula chijani kuphiya rangi ya mandano na chungbwa ganaphoivwa. Ndani, tembe zikabanana kahi ya nyama ya mtswano ya rangi ya chungbwa.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and woodland. Fruiting trees are easiest to find by looking for the round fruits hanging among the leaves.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vya pwani na misitu ya wazi. Miti yenye matunda ni rahisi kuipata kwa kutafuta matunda ya mviringo yanayoning'inia katikati ya majani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka na weruni wa pwani. Mihi yenye matunda ni rahisi kuiphaha uchilola matunda ga mviringo ganagobwadzika kahi ya makodza.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten: the shell is broken open and the sweet orange pulp sucked from around the seeds. Pakia lists *mkpwakpwa* among the edible fruits of the Digo.
uses.sw: Tunda lake huliwa: ganda huvunjwa na nyama tamu ya rangi ya chungwa hufyonzwa kutoka kwenye mbegu. Pakia anaorodhesha *mkpwakpwa* miongoni mwa matunda yanayoliwa na Wadigo.
uses.dg: Tunda nkuriwa: chivo nkuvundzwa, na nyama ya mtswano ya rangi ya chungbwa nkufyondzwa kuzunguluka tembe. Pakia anaandika *mkpwakpwa* kahi ya matunda ganagoriwa ni Adigo.

names.en: Pakia gives the Digo name *mkpwakpwa*, along with *muhonga*, *musikiro* and *mkwakwa*. *Muhonga* is also the name recorded for the spiny monkey orange, *Strychnos spinosa*, so the two may share it. In Swahili it is *mkwakwa*. Giriama names are *mujaje* and *mkwakwa*, and in Chonyi it is *mkwakwa*. The ICRAF handbook lists these names under *Strychnos mitis*.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa jina la Kidigo *mkpwakpwa*, pamoja na *muhonga*, *musikiro* na *mkwakwa*. *Muhonga* pia ni jina lililorekodiwa kwa mkwakwa wenye miiba, *Strychnos spinosa*, hivyo huenda miti hii miwili inashiriki jina hilo. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkwakwa*. Majina ya Kigiriama ni *mujaje* na *mkwakwa*, na kwa Kichonyi ni *mkwakwa*. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinaorodhesha majina haya chini ya *Strychnos mitis*.
names.dg: Pakia analavya dzina ra Chidigo *mkpwakpwa*, phamwenga na *muhonga*, *musikiro* na *mkwakwa*. *Muhonga* piya ni dzina rinaroandikpwa kpwa *Strychnos spinosa*, muhi wa miya, kpwa hivyo labuda yosi miiri inaihwa hivyo. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mkwakwa*. Madzina ga Chigiryama ni *mujaje* na *mkwakwa*, na kpwa Chichonyi ni *mkwakwa*. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika madzina higa kpwa *Strychnos mitis*.

reason.dg: Nduguye wa miya wa jenasi iyo-iyo

teaser.en: A dark-barked ebony cousin of the coastal grasslands, cut for poles and recognised by leaves that are rusty underneath.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa eboni mwenye gome jeusi wa nyika za pwani, unaokatwa kwa nguzo na kutambulika kwa majani yenye rangi ya kutu upande wa chini.
teaser.dg: Ndugu wa *ebony* wa nyasi za pwani, wenye gopha ra rangi ya jiza, unaokatwa kpwa nguzo na unaomanyikana kpwa makodza ga rangi ya kutu uphande wa photsi.

summary.en: *Mkulu* is a small evergreen tree of coastal bushland and grassland, a relative of ebony with greyish-black bark. Its wood is cut for poles.
summary.sw: *Mkulu* ni mti mdogo wa kijani kibichi wa vichaka na nyika za pwani, jamaa wa eboni mwenye gome jeusi-kijivu. Mti wake hukatwa kwa nguzo.
summary.dg: *Mkulu* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, wa vitsaka na nyasi za pwani, ndugu wa *ebony*, na gophare ni ra rangi ya ivu na nyiru. Nyama za muhi nkukatwa kuhenda nguzo.

about.en: *Mkulu* is an evergreen tree up to about 10 metres tall, with greyish-black bark typical of the ebony family. Turn a leaf over and you will see the clue: the underside is covered with rusty hairs. The fruit is small, up to about 2 centimetres across.
about.sw: *Mkulu* ni mti wa kijani kibichi unaofikia urefu wa mita 10 hivi, wenye gome jeusi-kijivu la kawaida ya familia ya abunusi. Geuza jani uone dalili yake: upande wa chini umefunikwa na manyoya ya rangi ya kutu. Tunda lake ni dogo, lenye upana wa hadi sentimita 2 hivi.
about.dg: *Mkulu* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wa hadi phephi mita 10, wenye gopha ra rangi ya ivu na nyiru dza mihi ya jamii ya *ebony*. Uchipendula kodza undaona alama: uphande wa photsi ukafwinikpwa ni nyere za rangi ya kutu. Tunda ni ridide, ra hadi phephi sentimita 2 kuvuka.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and grassland.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka na nyika za pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka na nyasi za pwani.

uses.en: The wood is used for poles.
uses.sw: Mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda nguzo.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *mkulu* for *Diospyros cornii*; it is also the Swahili and Giriama name. The Mgombato dictionary, however, defines *mkulu* as the jackal-berry, *Diospyros mespiliformis*, with the Swahili *mpweke*, and refers to *m'bara*. Pakia calls the jackal-berry *mbara*. The name may be used for more than one ebony.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF wanatoa jina la Kidigo *mkulu* kwa *Diospyros cornii*; pia ni jina la Kiswahili na la Kigiriama. Hata hivyo, kamusi ya Mgombato inafafanua *mkulu* kuwa ni *jackal-berry*, *Diospyros mespiliformis*, yenye jina la Kiswahili *mpweke*, na inarejelea *m'bara*. Pakia anauita *jackal-berry* *mbara*. Huenda jina hili linatumika kwa eboni zaidi ya mmoja.
names.dg: Pakia na chitabu cha ICRAF analavya dzina ra Chidigo *mkulu* kpwa *Diospyros cornii*; piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili na ra Chigiryama. Ela kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *mkulu* kukala ni *jackal-berry*, *Diospyros mespiliformis*, na dzina ra Chiswahili *mpweke*, na inamuambira mutu alole *m'bara*. Pakia anauiha *jackal-berry* *mbara*. Labuda dzina hiri nkuhumirwa kpwa aina zaidi ya mwenga ya *ebony*.

teaser.en: Its flowers and fruit hang in long sprays straight from old wood, and the fruit tastes as good as it looks.
teaser.sw: Maua na matunda yake huning'inia kwa vishada virefu moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye mti mkongwe, na tunda lake ni tamu kama linavyopendeza kuliona.
teaser.dg: Maruwage na matundage ganabwadzika kpwa mabunda mare kula kpwenye panda za kare, na tunda ni ra mtswano dza vira rinavyoonekana.

summary.en: *Mkunguma* is an evergreen tree of coastal and riverine forest, related to the mango, with long hanging sprays of flowers and clusters of fleshy fruit. The fruit is pleasant to eat, and the wood is used for firewood.
summary.sw: *Mkunguma* ni mti wa kijani kibichi wa misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito, jamaa wa mwembe, wenye vishada virefu vya maua vinavyoning'inia na vichala vya matunda yenye nyama. Tunda lake ni zuri kula, na mti wake hutumika kwa kuni.
summary.dg: *Mkunguma* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wa matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, wa jamii ya mwembe, wenye mabunda mare ga maruwa ganagobwadzika na mabunda ga matunda genye nyama. Tunda ni ra mtswano kurya, na nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa dza kuni.

about.en:
*Mkunguma* is an evergreen tree that can reach 20 metres. Its leaves are compound, with up to 15 leaflets. The flowers come in long, hanging sprays that grow directly from older wood rather than from the new shoots, and they are followed by clusters of fleshy fruits.

It belongs to the same family as the mango and the cashew.
about.sw:
*Mkunguma* ni mti wa kijani kibichi unaoweza kufikia mita 20. Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko, yenye hadi vijani 15. Maua yake huja kwa vishada virefu vinavyoning'inia ambavyo huota moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye sehemu kongwe za mti badala ya machipukizi mapya, na baadaye huja vichala vya matunda yenye nyama.

Ni wa familia moja na mwembe na mkorosho.
about.dg:
*Mkunguma* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati unaoweza kufika mita 20. Makodza ni ga kuganyika, na makodza madide hadi 15. Maruwa ganamera kpwa mabunda mare ganagobwadzika kula kpwenye panda za kare, si kpwenye mapanda maphya, na bada ya maruwa ganakpwedza mabunda ga matunda genye nyama.

Una jamii mwenga na mwembe na m'bibo.

where.en: Look for it in coastal forest and riverine vegetation where the groundwater is high.
where.sw: Utafute katika misitu ya pwani na mimea ya kando ya mito mahali ambapo maji ya chini ya ardhi yako juu.
where.dg: Hendza kpwenye matsaka ga pwani na mimea ya kanda-kanda ya miho, phatu ambapho madzi ga tsini ga phephi.

uses.en: The fruit is edible and pleasant-tasting. The wood is used as firewood.
uses.sw: Tunda lake huliwa na lina ladha nzuri. Mti wake hutumika kama kuni.
uses.dg: Tunda nkuriwa na ni ra mtswano. Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa dza kuni.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook agree on the Digo name *mkunguma*, which is also used in Giriama. In Swahili it is *mtunguma* or *mkunguma*, and in Duruma *msanzanza*.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF wanakubaliana juu ya jina la Kidigo *mkunguma*, ambalo pia linatumika kwa Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mtunguma* au *mkunguma*, na kwa Kiduruma *msanzanza*.
names.dg: Pakia na chitabu cha ICRAF vinakubaliana kukala dzina ra Chidigo ni *mkunguma*, ambaro piya nkuhumirwa kpwa Chigiryama. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mtunguma* au *mkunguma*, na kpwa Chiduruma *msanzanza*.

teaser.en: A smooth-barked timber tree common in the coast's forests, with leaflets that are lopsided, one side wider than the other.
teaser.sw: Mti wa mbao wenye gome laini unaopatikana kwa wingi katika misitu ya pwani, wenye vijani vilivyopinda, upande mmoja mpana kuliko mwingine.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa mbao wenye gopha laini, unaophahikana sana kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, wenye makodza madide genye uphande mwenga mpana kuriko wanjina.

summary.en: *Mkuwa* is a buttressed, smooth-barked tree of coastal woodland and forest, and one of the common coastal forest trees used for timber.
summary.sw: *Mkuwa*, au mkue, ni mti wenye mizizi-ukuta na gome laini wa misitu ya wazi na misitu ya pwani, na ni mojawapo ya miti ya kawaida ya msitu wa pwani inayotumika kwa mbao.
summary.dg: *Mkuwa* ni muhi wenye ngamba na gopha laini, wa weruni na matsaka ga pwani, na ni mwenga wa mihi ya matsaka ga pwani inayophahikana sana na inayohumirwa kpwa mbao.

about.en: *Mkuwa* usually has a buttressed trunk and smooth grey bark. The leaves have two or three pairs of leaflets, and each leaflet is asymmetric, with one side wider than the other. The fruits are oblong pods, as in other members of the bean family.
about.sw: Kwa kawaida *mkuwa* una shina lenye mizizi-ukuta na gome laini la kijivu. Majani yake yana jozi mbili au tatu za vijani, na kila kijani hakina ulinganifu, upande mmoja ukiwa mpana kuliko mwingine. Matunda yake ni maganda marefu, kama ilivyo kwa mimea mingine ya jamii ya kunde.
about.dg: Mara nyinji *mkuwa* una kolo renye ngamba na gopha laini ra rangi ya ivu. Makodza gana jozi mbiri au tahu za makodza madide, na chila kodza dide si sawa uphande kpwa uphande: uphande mwenga ni mpana kuriko wanjina. Matunda ni makakaya mare, dza ga mihi yanjina ya jamii ya kunde.

where.en: It grows in *Brachystegia* woodland, along the edges of creeks, and in evergreen and riverine forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya wazi ya *Brachystegia*, kando ya mikondo ya bahari, na katika misitu ya kijani kibichi na ya kando ya mito.
where.dg: Unamera weruni phenye mihi ya *Brachystegia*, kanda-kanda ya mikpwono ya bahari, na kpwenye matsaka genye makodza chila wakati na matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho.

uses.en: *Mkuwa* is one of the common coastal forest trees, and it is used as timber.
uses.sw: *Mkuwa* ni mojawapo ya miti ya kawaida ya msitu wa pwani, na hutumika kwa mbao.
uses.dg: *Mkuwa* ni mwenga wa mihi ya matsaka ga pwani inayophahikana sana, na nkuhumirwa dza mbao.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mkuwa* and *ukwe*; the ICRAF handbook gives *mkue*. In Swahili it is *mkue* or *mukuwa*, and in Giriama *msahe*. The Swahili *mkue* is also used for *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*, which the Digo call *mrihi* or *mukwe*, so these names overlap between trees.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mkuwa* na *ukwe*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mkue*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkue* au *mukuwa*, na kwa Kigiriama *msahe*. Jina la Kiswahili *mkue* pia linatumika kwa *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*, ambao Wadigo huuita *mrihi* au *mukwe*, hivyo majina haya yanaingiliana kati ya miti.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mkuwa* na *ukwe*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *mkue*. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mkue* au *mukuwa*, na kpwa Chigiryama *msahe*. Dzina ra Chiswahili *mkue* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*, ambao Adigo anauiha *mrihi* au *mukwe*, kpwa hivyo madzina higa ganatsanganyika kahi ya mihi.

reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa mbao wa tsaka

teaser.en: Its figs grow in heavy bunches straight from the trunk, turning red when they are ready to eat.
teaser.sw: Tini zake hukua kwa vichala vizito moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina, zikigeuka nyekundu zinapokuwa tayari kuliwa.
teaser.dg: Kuyuze zinamera kpwa mabunda mazito kula kpwenye kolo, na zinagaluka kukala za kundu zinaphokala tayari kuriwa.

summary.en: *Mkuyu*, the broom-cluster or Cape fig, is a fig tree of riverbanks and forest edges with large toothed leaves and heavy clusters of figs on its trunk. It gives edible figs, shade and medicine.
summary.sw: *Mkuyu*, mtini unaojulikana kwa Kiingereza kama *broom-cluster fig* au *Cape fig*, ni mti wa kingo za mito na pembezoni mwa misitu wenye majani makubwa yenye meno pembeni na vichala vizito vya tini kwenye shina lake. Hutoa tini zinazoliwa, kivuli na dawa.
summary.dg: *Mkuyu* (kpwa Chingereza *broom-cluster fig* au *Cape fig*) ni muhi wa kuyu wa kanda-kanda ya miho na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, wenye makodza makulu genye meno kanda-kanda na mabunda mazito ga kuyu kpwenye kolo. Unalavya kuyu zinazoriwa, pepho na dawa.

about.en: *Mkuyu* is a fig tree with large leaves that have toothed edges, unusual among figs. Its figs grow in heavy, branched clusters on the trunk and larger branches, sometimes near the ground. They turn red when ripe. Like all figs, it bleeds a milky latex when cut.
about.sw: *Mkuyu* ni mtini wenye majani makubwa yenye meno pembeni, jambo lisilo la kawaida miongoni mwa mitini. Tini zake hukua kwa vichala vizito vyenye matawi kwenye shina na matawi makubwa, wakati mwingine karibu na ardhi. Hugeuka nyekundu zinapoiva. Kama mitini yote, hutoa utomvu kama maziwa ukikatwa.
about.dg: *Mkuyu* ni muhi wa kuyu wenye makodza makulu genye meno kanda-kanda, chitu chisichophahikana sana kpwa mihi ya kuyu. Kuyuze zinamera kpwa mabunda mazito genye mapanda kpwenye kolo na kpwenye panda kulu, na wakati wanjina phephi na photsi. Zinakala za kundu zichiivwa. Dza mihi yosi ya kuyu, uchikatwa unalavya maziya.

where.en: It grows on riverbanks and at forest edges. Fruiting trees are easy to spot from the red clusters on their trunks, and from the animals that come to feed.
where.sw: Hukua kwenye kingo za mito na pembezoni mwa misitu. Miti yenye matunda ni rahisi kuiona kutokana na vichala vyekundu kwenye mashina yake, na wanyama wanaokuja kula.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya miho na kanda-kanda ya matsaka. Mihi yenye kuyu ni rahisi kuiona kpwa mabunda ga kundu kpwenye kolo, na kpwa nyama anaokpwedza kurya.

uses.en: The figs are eaten. The tree is valued for shade, and, like other figs, it is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Tini zake huliwa. Mti huu unathaminiwa kwa kivuli, na kama mitini mingine, hutumika katika dawa za jadi.
uses.dg: Kuyu nkuriwa. Muhi una samani kpwa pephoye, na dza mihi yanjina ya kuyu, nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa ya chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia gives the Digo name *mkuyu*, which is shared with Swahili. In English it is the broom-cluster fig or Cape fig. The Mgombato dictionary uses the Digo name *mgandi* for the Cape fig, while Pakia gives *mgandi* to the sycamore fig. In Swahili, *mkuyu* is also used for the sycamore fig, so the names cross over between the two trees.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa jina la Kidigo *mkuyu*, ambalo pia linatumika kwa Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *broom-cluster fig* au *Cape fig*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia jina la Kidigo *mgandi* kwa *Cape fig*, ilhali Pakia analipa jina *mgandi* kwa *sycamore fig*. Kwa Kiswahili, *mkuyu* pia hutumika kwa *sycamore fig*, hivyo majina yanavuka kati ya miti hii miwili.
names.dg: Pakia analavya dzina ra Chidigo *mkuyu*, ambaro ni sawa na dzina ra Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *broom-cluster fig* au *Cape fig*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inahumira dzina ra Chidigo *mgandi* kpwa *Cape fig*, ela Pakia analavya *mgandi* kpwa *sycamore fig*. Kpwa Chiswahili, *mkuyu* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa *sycamore fig*, kpwa hivyo madzina ganatsanganyika kahi ya mihi hino miiri.

reason.dg: *Sycamore fig*; madzina gao ganatsanganyika

teaser.en: Its frilly, purple-spotted flowers hang down like orchids, among the showiest in the coastal forest.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yenye mapindo na madoa ya zambarau huning'inia kama okidi, miongoni mwa maua ya kuvutia zaidi katika msitu wa pwani.
teaser.dg: Maruwage genye mapindo na vibara vya zambarau ganabwadzika dza maruwa ga *orchid*, na ni kahi ya maruwa manono zaidi ga matsaka ga pwani.

summary.en: *Mkwele* is a small tree of coastal forest and thicket with spectacular hanging flowers, frilly and yellow with purple spots. It belongs to the custard-apple family and bears round, hard-shelled fruit.
summary.sw: *Mkwele* ni mti mdogo wa misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani wenye maua ya kustaajabisha yanayoning'inia, yenye mapindo na ya manjano yenye madoa ya zambarau. Ni wa familia ya mitopetope na huzaa matunda ya mviringo yenye ganda gumu.
summary.dg: *Mkwele* ni muhi mdide wa matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani, wenye maruwa manono sana ganagobwadzika, ga rangi ya mandano, genye mapindo na vibara vya zambarau. Ni wa jamii ya *m'bokpwe* (*custard apple*), na una matunda ga mviringo genye chivo chigumu.

about.en:
*Mkwele* is a small tree with drooping branches. When it flowers, it is hard to miss: large, showy blooms hang down on long stalks, with frilly petals of yellow spotted with purple. They are followed by round fruits with a hard shell.

Its bark is pale, which gave it one of its Digo names.
about.sw:
*Mkwele* ni mti mdogo wenye matawi yanayoinama. Unapochanua, ni vigumu kuukosa: maua makubwa ya kuvutia huning'inia kwenye vikonyo virefu, yakiwa na petali zenye mapindo za manjano zenye madoa ya zambarau. Baadaye huja matunda ya mviringo yenye ganda gumu.

Gome lake ni jeupe-jeupe, na hilo ndilo lililoupa mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo.
about.dg:
*Mkwele* ni muhi mdide wenye panda zinazobumama. Unapholavya maruwa, kpwa kpweli undauona: maruwa makulu manono ganabwadzika kpwenye milita mire, genye mapindo ga rangi ya mandano na vibara vya zambarau. Bada ya maruwa ganakpwedza matunda ga mviringo genye chivo chigumu.

Gophare ni ngushu-ngushu, ndiyo mana ukaihwa dzina mwenga kahi ya madzinage ga Chidigo.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani.

uses.en: No particular use for *mkwele* has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi maalum ya *mkwele* yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna kazi ya *mkwele* iriyoandikpwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mkwele*, also spelt *mkele*, which is shared with Duruma and Giriama. A second name is *mlala mwereru*, 'white *mlala*', for its pale bark, as opposed to *mlala mwiru*, *Diospyros kabuyeana*. The Mgombato dictionary uses *mlala* for the raffia palm, so the word has more than one meaning. No Swahili or English name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mkwele*, pia huandikwa *mkele*, ambalo linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Jina la pili ni *mlala mwereru*, '*mlala* mweupe', kwa sababu ya gome lake jeupe-jeupe, tofauti na *mlala mwiru*, *Diospyros kabuyeana*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia *mlala* kwa mwale, hivyo neno hili lina maana zaidi ya moja. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mkwele*, ambaro piya rinaandikpwa *mkele*, na ni dzina ra Chiduruma na ra Chigiryama piya. Dzina ra phiri ni *mlala mwereru*, kpwa sababu ya gophare ngushu-ngushu, tafwauti na *mlala mwiru*, *Diospyros kabuyeana*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inahumira *mlala* kpwa *raffia*, muhi wa jamii ya mnazi, kpwa hivyo neno hiri rina mana zaidi ya mwenga. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: Its name means 'whip', and its branches are wielded as magical whips against enemies.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'mjeledi', na matawi yake hutumiwa kama mijeledi ya uchawi dhidi ya maadui.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'chikoto', na pandaze nkuhumirwa dza vikoto vya chiwanga kpwa maadui.

summary.en: *Mlanga* is a tree of coastal forest and thicket with heart-shaped leaves and winged fruits. Its branches are used as magical whips against enemies, and its name means 'whip'.
summary.sw: *Mlanga* ni mti wa misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani wenye majani yenye umbo la moyo na matunda yenye mabawa. Matawi yake hutumika kama mijeledi ya uchawi dhidi ya maadui, na jina lake lina maana ya 'mjeledi'.
summary.dg: *Mlanga* ni muhi wa matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani, wenye makodza ga umbo ra moyo na matunda genye mapha. Pandaze nkuhumirwa dza vikoto vya chiwanga kpwa maadui, na dzinare rina mana ya 'chikoto'.

about.en: *Mlanga* is a tree with heart-shaped leaves and small winged fruits that are carried away by the wind. It belongs to the mallow family, alongside the baobab and the star-chestnuts.
about.sw: *Mlanga* ni mti wenye majani yenye umbo la moyo na matunda madogo yenye mabawa yanayopeperushwa na upepo. Ni wa familia ya mibamia, pamoja na mbuyu na mgoza.
about.dg: *Mlanga* ni muhi wenye makodza ga umbo ra moyo na matunda madide genye mapha ganagohalwa ni phepho. Ni wa jamii ya *mallow*, phamwenga na muuyu na *mgoza* (*star-chestnut*).

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani.

uses.en: Branches of *mlanga* are cut and used as magical whips against enemies.
uses.sw: Matawi ya *mlanga* hukatwa na kutumika kama mijeledi ya uchawi dhidi ya maadui.
uses.dg: Panda za *mlanga* nkukatwa na kuhumirwa dza vikoto vya chiwanga kpwa maadui.

culture.en: The tree's use and its name go together: *mlanga* means 'whip'. It belongs to a group of Digo plants used for magical whipping, alongside *mlangalangazuka*, the 'whip of sacred powers'.
culture.sw: Matumizi ya mti huu na jina lake vinaendana: *mlanga* maana yake ni 'mjeledi'. Ni mmojawapo wa kundi la mimea ya Kidigo inayotumika kwa kuchapa kichawi, pamoja na *mlangalangazuka*, 'mjeledi wa nguvu takatifu'.
culture.dg: Kazi ya muhi na dzinare vinaphiya phamwenga: *mlanga* rina mana ya 'chikoto'. Ni wa kundi ra mimea ya Chidigo inayohumirwa kupiga kpwa chiwanga, phamwenga na *mlangalangazuka*, 'chikoto cha nguvu takatifu'.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mlanga*, meaning 'whip'. No Swahili or English name is recorded; botanists know it as *Carpodiptera africana*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mlanga*, lenye maana ya 'mjeledi'. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Carpodiptera africana*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mlanga*, ambaro rina mana ya 'chikoto'. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anauiha *Carpodiptera africana*.

teaser.en: A 'whip of sacred powers': a stick of this tree is said to punish offenders and open closed homes and graves.
teaser.sw: 'Mjeledi wa nguvu takatifu': inasemekana fimbo ya mti huu huwaadhibu wakosaji na kufungua nyumba na makaburi yaliyofungwa.
teaser.dg: 'Chikoto cha nguvu takatifu': nkugombwa kukala chigongo cha muhi hinyu chinatiya adabu atu ariohenda makosa, na chinavugula nyumba na mbira zirizofungbwa.

summary.en: *Mlangalangazuka* is a tree of coastal thicket and woodland with large orange-red trumpet flowers and long ribbed pods. A stick of it is used as a magical whip, to punish offenders or open closed places.
summary.sw: *Mlangalangazuka* ni mti wa vichaka vizito na misitu ya wazi ya pwani wenye maua makubwa ya rangi ya chungwa-nyekundu yenye umbo la tarumbeta na maganda marefu yenye mistari ya mbavu. Fimbo yake hutumika kama mjeledi wa uchawi, kuwaadhibu wakosaji au kufungua mahali palipofungwa.
summary.dg: *Mlangalangazuka* ni muhi wa vitsaka na weruni wa pwani, wenye maruwa makulu ga rangi ya chungbwa na kundu dza ndzumari, na makakaya mare genye mistari. Chigongo cha muhi hinyu nkuhumirwa dza chikoto cha chiwanga, kutiya adabu atu ariohenda makosa au kuvugula phatu phariphofungbwa.

about.en: *Mlangalangazuka* is a striking tree when in flower. Large, tubular blooms of orange-red stand out against pinnate leaves. Long, ribbed pods follow the flowers. It belongs to the trumpet-flower family, together with the sausage tree.
about.sw: *Mlangalangazuka* ni mti wa kuvutia sana unapochanua. Maua makubwa yenye umbo la mrija ya rangi ya chungwa-nyekundu hujitokeza wazi dhidi ya majani yenye vijani vilivyopangwa kama unyoya. Baada ya maua huja maganda marefu yenye mistari ya mbavu. Ni wa familia ya maua-tarumbeta, pamoja na mvungunya.
about.dg: *Mlangalangazuka* ni muhi unaoonekana sana unapholavya maruwa. Maruwa makulu ga umbo ra mridza, ga rangi ya chungbwa na kundu, ganaonekana sana kahi ya makodza genye makodza madide kanda zosi mbiri za mongo wa kodza. Bada ya maruwa ganakpwedza makakaya mare genye mistari. Ni wa jamii ya mimea yenye maruwa dza ndzumari, phamwenga na *mvungunya*.

where.en: It grows in coastal thicket and woodland.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vizito na misitu ya wazi ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka na weruni wa pwani.

uses.en: A stick of *mlangalangazuka* is used as a magical whip.
uses.sw: Fimbo ya *mlangalangazuka* hutumika kama mjeledi wa uchawi.
uses.dg: Chigongo cha *mlangalangazuka* nkuhumirwa dza chikoto cha chiwanga.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name as 'whip of sacred powers'. The stick is used to punish offenders, and to open closed places, such as homes and graves, by whipping them magically. It is one of a small set of Digo whipping plants, along with *mlanga*, whose name simply means 'whip'.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jina hili kuwa ni 'mjeledi wa nguvu takatifu'. Fimbo hii hutumika kuwaadhibu wakosaji, na kufungua mahali palipofungwa, kama nyumba na makaburi, kwa kupachapa kichawi. Ni mmojawapo wa kundi dogo la mimea ya Kidigo ya kuchapia, pamoja na *mlanga*, ambalo jina lake lina maana ya 'mjeledi' tu.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala dzina rina mana ya 'chikoto cha nguvu takatifu'. Chigongo nkuhumirwa kutiya adabu atu ariohenda makosa, na kuvugula phatu phariphofungbwa, dza nyumba na mbira, kpwa kuphipiga kpwa chiwanga. Ni mwenga wa mimea michache ya Chidigo ya kupigira, phamwenga na *mlanga*, ambao dzinare rina mana ya 'chikoto' bahi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mlangalangazuka*, 'whip of sacred powers'. The Mgombato dictionary lists *mulanga* for this plant, *Fernandoa magnifica*, with the Swahili name *mbomba mweupe*. No English name is in common use.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mlangalangazuka*, 'mjeledi wa nguvu takatifu'. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaorodhesha *mulanga* kwa mmea huu, *Fernandoa magnifica*, pamoja na jina la Kiswahili *mbomba mweupe*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalotumika kwa kawaida.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mlangalangazuka*, 'chikoto cha nguvu takatifu'. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *mulanga* kpwa mmea hinyu, *Fernandoa magnifica*, na dzina ra Chiswahili *mbomba mweupe*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinaromanyikana sana.

teaser.en: A buttressed timber giant of lowland forest whose winged seeds sail out of long flat pods, now officially Vulnerable.
teaser.sw: Jitu la mbao lenye mizizi-ukuta la misitu ya nyanda za chini ambalo mbegu zake zenye mabawa hupeperuka kutoka kwenye maganda marefu bapa, na sasa limeorodheshwa rasmi kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).
teaser.dg: Muhi mkulu wa mbao wenye ngamba, wa matsaka ga tsi za photsi, ambao tembeze zenye mapha zinatuluka kula makakaya mare na mabapa na kuhalwa ni phepho. Sambi ukaandikpwa rasmi kahi ya mihi iriyo hatarini (*Vulnerable*).

summary.en: *Mleha* is a large buttressed tree of lowland and riverine forest, a popular Digo timber species. It is listed by the IUCN as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: *Mleha* ni mti mkubwa wenye mizizi-ukuta wa misitu ya nyanda za chini na ya kando ya mito, na ni spishi maarufu ya mbao kwa Wadigo. IUCN imeuorodhesha kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Mleha* ni muhi mkulu wenye ngamba, wa matsaka ga tsi za photsi na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, na ni mwenga wa mihi ya mbao inayomendzwa ni Adigo. IUCN inauandika kahi ya mihi iriyo hatarini (*Vulnerable*).

about.en: *Mleha* is a big forest tree with buttresses at the base. Its leaves are twice divided, with only a few pairs of leaflets. The pods are long and flat, and they release winged seeds that drift on the wind.
about.sw: *Mleha* ni mti mkubwa wa msituni wenye mizizi-ukuta chini yake. Majani yake yamegawanyika mara mbili, yakiwa na jozi chache tu za vijani. Maganda yake ni marefu na bapa, na huachilia mbegu zenye mabawa zinazopeperushwa na upepo.
about.dg: *Mleha* ni muhi mkulu wa tsaka wenye ngamba photsi. Makodzage ganaganyika mara mbiri, na gana jozi chache bahi za makodza madide. Makakaya ni mare na mabapa, na ganalavya tembe zenye mapha zinazohalwa ni phepho.

where.en: It grows in lowland and riverine forest, between about 75 and 300 metres above sea level.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya nyanda za chini na ya kando ya mito, kati ya mita 75 na 300 hivi juu ya usawa wa bahari.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga tsi za photsi na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, kula phephi mita 75 hadi 300 dzulu ya bahari.

uses.en: Pakia lists *mleha* among the popular timber species of the Digo.
uses.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *mleha* miongoni mwa spishi maarufu za mbao za Wadigo.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika *mleha* kahi ya mihi ya mbao inayomendzwa ni Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mleha*. No Swahili or English name is recorded; botanists know it as *Newtonia paucijuga*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mleha*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Newtonia paucijuga*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mleha*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anauiha *Newtonia paucijuga*.

conservation.en: Mleha is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List.
conservation.sw: Mleha umeorodheshwa kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN.
conservation.dg: *Mleha* ukaandikpwa kahi ya mihi iriyo hatarini (*Vulnerable*) kpwenye *IUCN Red List*.

teaser.en: Its leaves bunch at the tips of stubby side-shoots, and its small berries are a sweet find in dry bush.
teaser.sw: Majani yake hujikusanya kwenye ncha za machipukizi mafupi ya pembeni, na matunda yake madogo ni tunu tamu katika vichaka vikavu.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za mapanda madide mafupi, na matundage madide ni chitu cha mtswano cha kuphaha kpwenye vitsaka vya phatu pha mvula chache.

summary.en: *Mnago*, the lowveld milkberry, is a small tree of dry bushland and woodland with small edible berries. Its wood is used for poles.
summary.sw: *Mnago* ni mti mdogo wa vichaka vikavu na misitu ya wazi wenye matunda madogo yanayoliwa. Mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo.
summary.dg: *Mnago* (kpwa Chingereza *lowveld milkberry*) ni muhi mdide wa vitsaka na weruni wa phatu pha mvula chache, wenye matunda madide ganagoriwa. Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo.

about.en: *Mnago* is a small tree. Its leaves are crowded at the tips of short spur shoots, giving the branches a tufted look. It bears small berries. Like other members of its family, it has milky sap.
about.sw: *Mnago* ni mti mdogo. Majani yake yamesongamana kwenye ncha za machipukizi mafupi ya pembeni, na kuyapa matawi sura ya vishungi. Huzaa matunda madogo. Kama mimea mingine ya familia yake, una utomvu kama maziwa.
about.dg: *Mnago* ni muhi mdide. Makodzage ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za mapanda mafupi, na kpwa hivyo panda zinaonekana dza mabunda-mabunda. Una matunda madide. Dza mihi yanjina ya jamiiye, una maziya.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and woodland.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vikavu na misitu ya wazi.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka na weruni wa phatu pha mvula chache.

uses.en: The berries are edible, as in other *Manilkara* species. The wood is used for poles.
uses.sw: Matunda yake huliwa, kama ilivyo kwa spishi nyingine za *Manilkara*. Mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo.
uses.dg: Matunda nkuriwa, dza ga aina zanjina za *Manilkara*. Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mnago* for *Manilkara mochisia*, and notes that it is shared with Duruma and Giriama. It is also the Swahili name. The Mgombato dictionary also has *mnago*, but identifies it as *Manilkara sulcata*, which Pakia lists as *mtsedzi*. In English it is the lowveld milkberry.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mnago* kwa *Manilkara mochisia*, na anabainisha kuwa linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Pia ni jina la Kiswahili. Kamusi ya Mgombato pia ina *mnago*, lakini inautambulisha kuwa ni *Manilkara sulcata*, ambao Pakia anauorodhesha kama *mtsedzi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *lowveld milkberry*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mnago* kpwa *Manilkara mochisia*, na anagomba kukala ni dzina ra Chiduruma na ra Chigiryama piya. Piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili. Kamusi ya Mgombato nayo ina *mnago*, ela inaandika kukala ni *Manilkara sulcata*, ambao Pakia anauandika dza *mtsedzi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lowveld milkberry*.
