teaser.en: Its timber shrugs off seawater, so it went into dhows, piers and mallets; its name means 'across the river'.
teaser.sw: Mbao zake hazidhuriwi na maji ya bahari, hivyo zilitumika kwa majahazi, gati na nyundo za mbao; jina lake lina maana ya 'ng'ambo ya mto'.
teaser.dg: Nyama za muhi uhu tazibanangika ni madzi ga bahari, ndiyo mana zahumirwa kuhenda majahazi, magati na gongomeha za mbao; dzinare rina mana ya 'ng'ambo ya muho'.

summary.en: *Mng'ambo* is a tall evergreen tree of lowland forest and bushland with rough dark bark and white latex. Its strong, seawater-resistant timber was used for dhows and piers, and its milky sweet fruit is eaten.
summary.sw: *Mng'ambo* ni mti mrefu wa kijani kibichi wa misitu ya nyanda za chini na vichaka, wenye gome jeusi lililokwaruza na utomvu mweupe. Mbao zake imara zisizodhuriwa na maji ya bahari zilitumika kwa majahazi na gati, na tunda lake tamu lenye utomvu kama maziwa huliwa.
summary.dg: *Mng'ambo* ni muhi mure wenye makodza chila wakati, wa matsaka ga tsi za photsi na vitsaka, wenye gopha ra rangi ya jiza rinarokaraza na maziya mereru. Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na tazibanangika ni madzi ga bahari, kpwa hivyo zahumirwa kuhenda majahazi na magati, na tunda renye maziya na ra mtswano nkuriwa.

about.en: *Mng'ambo* is an evergreen tree up to 25 metres tall. The bark is rough and dark, and it bleeds white latex. The leaves are stiff and oblong, clustered at the ends of the twigs, and their side veins run very close and parallel.
about.sw: *Mng'ambo* ni mti wa kijani kibichi unaofikia urefu wa mita 25. Gome lake ni jeusi na lililokwaruza, na hutoa utomvu mweupe. Majani yake ni magumu na marefu kiasi, yamejikusanya kwenye ncha za vitawi, na mishipa yake ya pembeni inakwenda sambamba ikiwa karibu sana.
about.dg: *Mng'ambo* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa hadi mita 25. Gopha rinakaraza na ni ra rangi ya jiza, na rinalavya maziya mereru. Makodza ni magumu na mare, ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za maphungo, na mishipa yao ya kanda-kanda inaphiya phephi sana na sawa-sawa.

where.en: It grows in lowland forest and coastal bushland, and Pakia notes that it grows on riverbanks.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya nyanda za chini na vichaka vya pwani, na Pakia anabainisha kuwa hukua kwenye kingo za mito.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga tsi za photsi na vitsaka vya pwani, na Pakia anagomba kukala unamera kanda-kanda ya miho.

uses.en:
The timber is strong and resists seawater, so it is used for dhows, piers and mallets.

The fruit is milky and sweet, and it is eaten. The bark and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake ni imara na hazidhuriwi na maji ya bahari, hivyo hutumika kwa majahazi, gati na nyundo za mbao.

Tunda lake lina utomvu kama maziwa na ni tamu, na huliwa. Gome na mizizi hutumika katika dawa za jadi.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na tazibanangika ni madzi ga bahari, kpwa hivyo nkuhumirwa kuhenda majahazi, magati na gongomeha za mbao.

Tunda rina maziya na ni ra mtswano, na nkuriwa. Gopha na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa ya chienyeji.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name *mng'ambo* (also *mungambo*). Pakia uses *mng'ambo* for a related species, *Manilkara discolor*, and explains the name as 'across the river', because it grows on riverbanks. In Swahili it is *mngambo* or *mti chuma*, 'iron tree'. The Giriama name is *mng'ambo maziya* and the Chonyi *mngambo*.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo *mng'ambo* (pia *mungambo*). Pakia anatumia *mng'ambo* kwa spishi nyingine ya jamii yake, *Manilkara discolor*, na anaeleza kuwa jina hili lina maana ya 'ng'ambo ya mto', kwa sababu hukua kwenye kingo za mito. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mngambo* au *mti chuma*, 'mti wa chuma'. Jina la Kigiriama ni *mng'ambo maziya* na la Kichonyi *mngambo*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha dzina ra Chidigo *mng'ambo* (piya *mungambo*). Pakia anahumira *mng'ambo* kpwa aina yanjina iriyo ndugu, *Manilkara discolor*, na anagomba kukala dzina rina mana ya 'ng'ambo ya muho', kpwa sababu unamera kanda-kanda ya miho. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mngambo* au *mti chuma*, 'muhi wa chuma'. Dzina ra Chigiryama ni *mng'ambo maziya* na ra Chichonyi ni *mngambo*.

teaser.en: Marula nuts are so hard to open that a whole Digo plant is named for picking them out with its thorns.
teaser.sw: Kokwa za mng'ong'o ni ngumu sana kufungua kiasi kwamba mmea mzima wa Kidigo umepewa jina kwa kuzitoa kwa miiba yake.
teaser.dg: Tembe za *mng'ongo* ni ngumu sana kuvundza, hata mmea mzima wa Chidigo ukaphahwa dzina kpwa kuzitsokola na miyaye.

summary.en: *Mng'ongo* is the marula, a deciduous tree of wooded grassland with round yellow plum-like fruits rich in vitamin C. Both the fruit and the nut kernels are eaten, and the wood goes for timber and firewood.
summary.sw: *Mng'ongo* ni mng'ong'o (marula), mti unaopukutisha majani wa nyika zenye miti wenye matunda ya mviringo ya manjano kama plamu yenye vitamini C kwa wingi. Tunda na viini vya kokwa vyote huliwa, na mti wake hutumika kwa mbao na kuni.
summary.dg: *Mng'ongo* ni *marula*, muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wa nyasi zenye mihi, wenye matunda ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano dza plamu, genye vitamini C nyinji. Matunda na vitsa vya tembe vyosi nkuriwa, na nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa dza mbao na kuni.

about.en:
*Mng'ongo* is a deciduous tree 10 to 18 metres tall. The bark is grey-black and scaly, and where it chips off the inner bark shows pink. The compound leaves are crowded at the tips of the branches.

The fruit is round and plum-like and turns yellow when ripe, often after it has fallen to the ground. Inside is a hard stone holding small, oily kernels.
about.sw:
*Mng'ongo* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye urefu wa mita 10 hadi 18. Gome lake ni jeusi-kijivu na lenye magamba, na mahali linapobambuka, gome la ndani huonekana la rangi ya waridi. Majani yake ya mchanganyiko yamesongamana kwenye ncha za matawi.

Tunda lake ni la mviringo kama plamu na hugeuka manjano linapoiva, mara nyingi baada ya kuanguka chini. Ndani yake kuna kokwa gumu lenye viini vidogo vyenye mafuta.
about.dg:
*Mng'ongo* ni muhi wa mita 10 hadi 18 ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka. Gopha ni ra rangi ya ivu na nyiru, na rinagandulika vipande vidide; phatu ambapho vipande vikagandulika, gopha ra ndani rinaonekana pinki. Makodza ga kuganyika ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za panda.

Tunda ni ra mviringo dza plamu, na rinakala ra rangi ya mandano richiivwa, mara nyinji bada ya kugbwa photsi. Ndani kuna tembe ngumu yenye vitsa vidide vyenye mafuha.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland and bushland. Look for fallen yellow fruit under the trees in season.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika zenye miti na vichakani. Wakati wa msimu wake, tafuta matunda ya manjano yaliyoanguka chini ya miti.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi na vitsaka. Wakati wa matunda, hendza matunda ga rangi ya mandano garigogbwa photsi ya mihi.

uses.en:
The fruit is eaten and is rich in vitamin C. The nut kernels are eaten too, though they have to be picked out of a very hard stone.

The wood is used for firewood and timber.
uses.sw:
Tunda lake huliwa na lina vitamini C kwa wingi. Viini vya kokwa pia huliwa, ingawa lazima vitolewe ndani ya kokwa gumu sana.

Mti wake hutumika kwa kuni na mbao.
uses.dg:
Tunda nkuriwa, na rina vitamini C nyinji. Vitsa vya tembe nkuriwa piya, ela ni lazima vituluzwe kula ndani ya tembe ngumu sana.

Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa dza kuni na mbao.

culture.en: The marula's nut has given a name to another plant. The thorns of *mtsokola ng'ongo* are used to pick out the kernels, and the plant's name means 'extractor of *ng'ongo*', according to Pakia.
culture.sw: Kokwa la mng'ong'o limeupa mmea mwingine jina lake. Miiba ya *mtsokola ng'ongo* hutumika kutoa viini, na jina la mmea huo lina maana ya 'mtoaji wa *ng'ongo*', kwa mujibu wa Pakia.
culture.dg: Tembe ya *mng'ongo* ikapha mmea wanjina dzina. Miya ya *mtsokola ng'ongo* nkuhumirwa kutsokola vitsa, na dza Pakia anavyogomba, dzina ra mmea hinyu rina mana ya 'anayetsokola *ng'ongo*'.

names.en: The Digo name is *mng'ongo*; Pakia's Appendix III spells it *mg'ongo*, and the ICRAF handbook also records it. In Swahili it is *mng'ongo* or *mongo*, and in Giriama and Chonyi *mfula*. In English it is the marula.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mng'ongo*; Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinaliandika *mg'ongo*, na kitabu cha ICRAF pia kinalirekodi. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mng'ongo* au *mongo*, na kwa Kigiriama na Kichonyi *mfula*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *marula*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mng'ongo*; *Appendix III* ya Pakia inariandika *mg'ongo*, na chitabu cha ICRAF piya chinariandika. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mng'ongo* au *mongo*, na kpwa Chigiryama na Chichonyi *mfula*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *marula*.

teaser.en: It looks like a wild pawpaw, and its wood dries so quickly that its name means 'drying'.
teaser.sw: Unafanana na mpapai wa porini, na mbao zake hukauka haraka mno hivi kwamba jina lake linamaanisha 'kukauka'.
teaser.dg: Unaonekana dza mpapali wa weruni, na nyama za muhi zinauma upesi hata dzinare rina mana ya 'kunyala'.

summary.en: *Mnyala* is a tree of coastal forest margins with long-stalked, hand-like leaves crowded at the branch ends, like a wild pawpaw. Its wood goes into coffins, drums and boats, and its leaves and roots are used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mnyala* ni mti wa pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani wenye majani yenye mashina marefu, yaliyogawanyika kama kiganja cha mkono na kusongamana kwenye ncha za matawi, kama mpapai wa porini. Mbao zake hutumika kutengeneza majeneza, ngoma na mashua, na majani na mizizi yake hutumika kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Mnyala* ni muhi wa kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani, wenye makodza genye milita mire, ga umbo dza mkpwono, ganagokala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za panda, dza mpapali wa weruni. Nyama za muhi nkuhendwa masanduku ga maiti, ngoma na madau, na makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

about.en: *Mnyala* has an unusual shape. Its leaves are long-stalked and divided like a hand, and they are crowded together at the ends of thick branches, so the tree looks a little like a pawpaw growing wild. This is a cabbage tree, a member of the ivy family.
about.sw: *Mnyala* una umbo lisilo la kawaida. Majani yake yana mashina marefu na yamegawanyika kama kiganja cha mkono, nayo yamesongamana kwenye ncha za matawi manene, hivyo mti huu unafanana kidogo na mpapai unaoota porini. Ni mti wa jamii ya *cabbage tree*, katika familia ya *ivy*.
about.dg: *Mnyala* una umbo ra tafwauti. Makodzage gana milita mire na ganaganyika dza vyala vya mkpwono, na ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za panda nono, kpwa hivyo muhi unaonekana chidide dza mpapali unaomera weruni. Uhu ni muhi wa aina ya *cabbage tree*, wa jamii ya *ivy*.

where.en: It grows at forest margins and in evergreen bushland at the coast.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka vya kijani mwaka mzima huko pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye vitsaka vya pwani vyenye makodza chila wakati.

uses.en: The wood is used to make coffins, drums and boats. The leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Mbao zake hutumika kutengeneza majeneza, ngoma na mashua. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika tiba ya jadi.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda masanduku ga maiti, ngoma na madau. Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mnyala*, meaning 'drying', because the wood dries quickly once cut. Giriama also uses *mnyala*. In Swahili it is *mbomba maji* or *mpapayi mwitu*, 'wild pawpaw'. The ICRAF handbook lists these names under a related species, *Cussonia holstii*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mnyala*, lenye maana ya 'kukauka', kwa sababu mbao zake hukauka haraka baada ya kukatwa. Wagiriama pia huuita *mnyala*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mbomba maji* au *mpapayi mwitu*, yaani 'mpapai wa porini'. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinaorodhesha majina haya chini ya spishi inayohusiana nao, *Cussonia holstii*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mnyala*, rinarokala na mana ya 'kunyala', kpwa sababu nyama za muhi zinauma upesi zichitemwa. Chigiryama piya chinahumira *mnyala*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mbomba maji* au *mpapayi mwitu*, 'mpapali wa weruni'. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika madzina higa photsi ya aina yanjina ya jenasi mwenga, *Cussonia holstii*.

reason.dg: *Mvungunya*, piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda ngarawa

teaser.en: One of Kenya's rarest trees hides in the Shimba Hills and Kwale kayas, its white flowers on extraordinarily long tubes.
teaser.sw: Mmoja wa miti adimu kabisa nchini Kenya umejificha katika milima ya Shimba Hills na kaya za Kwale, ukiwa na maua meupe yaliyo kwenye mirija mirefu ajabu.
teaser.dg: Mwenga wa mihi adimu zaidi ya Kenya unadzifwitsa Shimba Hills na kpwenye kaya za Kwale, na maruwage mereru ganakala ntsani mwa mabomba mare sana.

summary.en: *Mnyandza* is a rare tree of lowland rainforest, with two-lobed leaves and large white flowers on very long tubes. It is listed as Endangered and survives in only a few coastal forests, including the Shimba Hills and the Kwale kayas.
summary.sw: *Mnyandza* ni mti adimu wa misitu ya mvua ya nyanda za chini, wenye majani yenye pande mbili na maua makubwa meupe yaliyo kwenye mirija mirefu sana. Umeorodheshwa kuwa Hatarini (Endangered) na unapatikana tu katika misitu michache ya pwani, ikiwemo Shimba Hills na kaya za Kwale.
summary.dg: *Mnyandza* ni muhi adimu wa matsaka ga mvula nyinji ga tsi ya photsi, wenye makodza ga mala mairi na maruwa makulu mereru, chila ruwa ntsani mwa bomba nyire sana. Ukaandikpwa kukala *Endangered* (hatarini), na bado unaphahikana kpwenye matsaka machache tu ga pwani, phamwenga na Shimba Hills na kaya za Kwale.

about.en: *Mnyandza* has leaves split into two lobes, like those of the *Bauhinia* or camel's-foot trees it is related to. Its flowers are large and white, sitting at the end of a very long, slender tube, the feature that gives the genus its name, *Gigasiphon*, 'giant tube'.
about.sw: Majani ya *mnyandza* yamegawanyika katika pande mbili, kama ya miti ya *Bauhinia* au *camel's-foot* ambayo ni jamaa zake. Maua yake ni makubwa na meupe, yakiwa mwishoni mwa mrija mrefu na mwembamba sana, sifa iliyoipa jenasi hii jina lake, *Gigasiphon*, yaani 'mrija mkubwa'.
about.dg: Makodza ga *mnyandza* ganaganyika mala mairi, dza ga *Bauhinia* au *mtseketse* (*camel's foot*), mihi ambayo ni nduguze. Maruwage ni makulu na mereru, na ganakala ntsani mwa bomba nyire sana na nyembamba; ihi ndiyo inayopha jenasi dzinare, *Gigasiphon*, 'bomba kulu'.

where.en: It grows in lowland rainforest between about 30 and 600 metres above sea level. On the south coast it is found in the Shimba Hills and the Kwale kaya forests.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya mvua ya nyanda za chini, kati ya takriban mita 30 na 600 juu ya usawa wa bahari. Katika pwani ya kusini hupatikana Shimba Hills na katika misitu ya kaya ya Kwale.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga mvula nyinji ga tsi ya photsi, kula mita 30 hadi 600 hivi dzulu ya bahari. Pwani ya kusini unaphahikana Shimba Hills na kpwenye matsaka ga kaya za Kwale.

uses.en: No particular use for *mnyandza* has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi maalumu ya *mnyandza* yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga *mnyandza* garigoandikpwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mnyandza*. No Swahili or English name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mnyandza*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mnyandza*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

conservation.en: Mnyandza is listed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List and is restricted to a few coastal forests, so the protection of the kayas and the Shimba Hills matters for its survival.
conservation.sw: Mnyandza umeorodheshwa kuwa Hatarini (Endangered) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN na unapatikana tu katika misitu michache ya pwani, kwa hiyo kulindwa kwa kaya na Shimba Hills ni muhimu kwa kuendelea kuwepo kwake.
conservation.dg: *Mnyandza* ukaandikpwa kukala *Endangered* kpwenye *IUCN Red List*, na unaphahikana kpwenye matsaka machache tu ga pwani, kpwa hivyo kurinda kaya na Shimba Hills ni muhimu ili usiangamike.

teaser.en: Red flower balls dangle on long strings below its flat crown, and in hard times its seeds kept people alive.
teaser.sw: Mipira ya maua mekundu huning'inia kwenye kamba ndefu chini ya kilele chake bapa, na nyakati za shida mbegu zake ziliokoa maisha ya watu.
teaser.dg: Maruwa ga kundu ga umbo dza mpira ganabwadzika kpwa milita mire photsi ya dariye bapa, na wakati wa shida tembeze zaokola maisha ga atu.

summary.en: *Mnyendze*, the African locust bean, is a tall flat-crowned tree of moist coastal forest with feathery leaves and red ball-shaped flower heads hanging on long stalks. Its young pods are eaten, its seeds are a famine food, and its wood makes beehives, stools and timber.
summary.sw: *Mnyendze*, au *mnienze*, ni mti mrefu wenye kilele bapa wa misitu yenye unyevu ya pwani, wenye majani kama manyoya na vishada vya maua mekundu vyenye umbo la mpira vinavyoning'inia kwenye mashina marefu. Maganda yake machanga huliwa, mbegu zake ni chakula cha njaa, na mbao zake hutengeneza mizinga ya nyuki, vigoda na mbao za ujenzi.
summary.dg: *Mnyendze* (kpwa Chingereza *African locust bean*) ni muhi mure wenye dari bapa wa matsaka ga jeke-jeke ga pwani, wenye makodza dza manyoya na mabunda ga maruwa ga kundu ga umbo dza mpira ganagobwadzika kpwa milita mire. Makakaya matsanga nkuriwa, tembe ni chakurya cha wakati wa ndzala, na nyama za muhi nkuhendwa mizinga ya nyuchi, vihi na mbao.

about.en:
*Mnyendze* is a deciduous tree that can grow from 8 to 30 metres, with a wide, flat crown. The leaves are feathery and twice divided.

Its flowers are unforgettable: dense, red, ball-shaped heads that dangle on long stalks beneath the crown, like decorations on strings. In many *Parkia* species these hanging flower balls are visited at night by bats. They give way to long pods.
about.sw:
*Mnyendze* ni mti unaopukutisha majani unaoweza kufikia urefu wa mita 8 hadi 30, wenye kilele kipana na bapa. Majani yake ni kama manyoya na yamegawanyika mara mbili.

Maua yake hayasahauliki: vishada vizito, vyekundu, vyenye umbo la mpira vinavyoning'inia kwenye mashina marefu chini ya kilele, kama mapambo yaliyofungwa kwenye kamba. Kwa spishi nyingi za *Parkia*, mipira hii ya maua inayoning'inia hutembelewa na popo usiku. Baadaye huzaa maganda marefu.
about.dg:
*Mnyendze* ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, unaoweza kukula kula mita 8 hadi 30, wenye dari pana na bapa. Makodzage ni dza manyoya na ganaganyika mara mbiri.

Maruwage ni ga kutambukirwa: ni mabunda manji ga maruwa ga kundu ga umbo dza mpira, ganagobwadzika kpwa milita mire photsi ya dari, dza mapambo ganagofungbwa kpwa kamba. Kpwa aina nyinji za *Parkia*, mabunda higa ga maruwa ganagobwadzika nkuphiyirwa usiku ni manundu. Bada yao kunatuluka makakaya mare.

where.en: It grows in moist lowland and riverine forest along the coast. The hanging red flower balls make it easy to recognise when it is in bloom.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu yenye unyevu ya nyanda za chini na misitu ya kando ya mito pwani. Mipira ya maua mekundu inayoning'inia huufanya uwe rahisi kutambulika unapochanua.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga jeke-jeke ga tsi ya photsi na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, pwani. Mabunda ga kundu ga maruwa ganagobwadzika ganahenda ukale rahisi kuumanya wakati una maruwa.

uses.en:
The young pods are eaten. The mature seeds are eaten only in an emergency, as a famine food.

The wood is used to make beehives, stools and water containers, and Pakia lists *mnyendze* among the popular timber trees. The bark yields tannin and dye.
uses.sw:
Maganda machanga huliwa. Mbegu zilizokomaa huliwa tu wakati wa dharura, kama chakula cha njaa.

Mbao hutumika kutengeneza mizinga ya nyuki, vigoda na vyombo vya maji, na Pakia inaorodhesha *mnyendze* miongoni mwa miti maarufu ya mbao. Gome lake hutoa tanini na rangi.
uses.dg:
Makakaya matsanga nkuriwa. Tembe zirizoivwa nkuriwa tu wakati wa shida, dza chakurya cha ndzala.

Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda mizinga ya nyuchi, vihi na vyombo vya kuikira madzi, na Pakia anaandika *mnyendze* kahi ya mihi ya mbao inayomendzwa sana. Gopha rinalavya tanini na rangi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mnyendze*; the ICRAF handbook writes *myenze*. In Swahili it is *mnienze* or *mkunde*. In English it is called the African locust bean.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mnyendze*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinaandika *myenze*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mnienze* au *mkunde*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *African locust bean*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mnyendze*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika *myenze*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mnienze* au *mkunde*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *African locust bean*.

teaser.en: Its inner bark becomes string and baskets, its fruit is a snack, and its trunk becomes mortars and beehives.
teaser.sw: Gome lake la ndani hugeuka kamba na vikapu, tunda lake ni kitafunio, na shina lake hugeuka vinu na mizinga ya nyuki.
teaser.dg: Gopha ra ndani rinahendwa nyugbwe na kaphu, matundage ganariwa dza chakurya chidide, na kolore rinahendwa vinu na mizinga ya nyuchi.

summary.en: *Mnyumbu*, the false marula, is a deciduous tree of wooded grassland and river valleys with flaking bark and small red-purple fruits. Almost every part is put to use, from string and dye to mortars, stools and medicine.
summary.sw: *Mnyumbu* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wa nyika zenye miti na mabonde ya mito, wenye gome linalobambuka na matunda madogo mekundu-zambarau. Karibu kila sehemu yake hutumika, kuanzia kamba na rangi hadi vinu, vigoda na dawa.
summary.dg: *Mnyumbu* (kpwa Chingereza *false marula*) ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wa nyasi zenye mihi na wa myeha ya miho, wenye gopha rinarogandulika na matunda madide ga rangi ya kundu na zambarau. Phephi chila seemuye nkuhumirwa, kula nyugbwe na rangi hadi vinu, vihi na dawa.

about.en:
*Mnyumbu* is a deciduous tree up to 20 metres tall with grey-brown bark that flakes off. The leaves are made of a few shiny leaflets, crowded at the ends of the branches. The fruits are small and red-purple.

It looks something like its cousin the marula, *mng'ongo*, which is why it is called the false marula.
about.sw:
*Mnyumbu* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye urefu wa hadi mita 20 na gome la rangi ya kijivu-kahawia linalobambuka. Majani yake yana vijani vichache vinavyong'aa, vilivyosongamana kwenye ncha za matawi. Matunda yake ni madogo na mekundu-zambarau.

Unafanana kwa kiasi fulani na binamu yake marula, *mng'ongo*, ndiyo sababu kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *false marula*, yaani 'marula bandia'.
about.dg:
*Mnyumbu* ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wa hadi mita 20, wenye gopha ra rangi ya ivu na dongo rinarogandulika. Makodzage ganahendwa ni makodza madide machache ganagoala, na ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za panda. Matunda ni madide na ga rangi ya kundu na zambarau.

Unaonekana chidide dza nduguye *mng'ongo* (*marula*), ndiyo mana unaihwa *false marula*.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland, dry forest and river valleys.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika zenye miti, misitu mikavu na mabonde ya mito.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi, matsaka makavu na myeha ya miho.

uses.en:
The inner bark is stripped for string and woven into baskets, and the bark also gives a brown dye. The fruit is edible.

The wood is carved into mortars, stools and beehives. The bark and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Gome la ndani huchunwa ili kutengeneza kamba na kusukwa vikapu, na gome pia hutoa rangi ya kahawia. Tunda lake huliwa.

Mbao huchongwa kuwa vinu, vigoda na mizinga ya nyuki. Gome na mizizi hutumika katika tiba ya jadi.
uses.dg:
Gopha ra ndani nkugandulwa kuhenda nyugbwe na nkusukpwa kaphu, na gopha piya rinalavya rangi ya dongo. Tunda rinariwa.

Nyama za muhi nkutsongwa kuhenda vinu, vihi na mizinga ya nyuchi. Gopha na mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mnyumbu* and *mchumbu*, and notes that they are interchangeable. Each has a variety with *madzi*, 'water', added: *mnyumbu madzi* and *mchumbu madzi*. The Giriama name is *mjumbu maji*. In Swahili it is *mnyumbu* or *mongo*; *mongo* is also used for the true marula.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mnyumbu* na *mchumbu*, na inaeleza kuwa yanatumika kwa kubadilishana. Kila moja lina aina yenye neno *madzi*, 'maji', lililoongezwa: *mnyumbu madzi* na *mchumbu madzi*. Jina la Kigiriama ni *mjumbu maji*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mnyumbu* au *mongo*; *mongo* pia hutumika kwa marula halisi.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mnyumbu* na *mchumbu*, na anagomba kukala gosi mairi ganahumirwa sawa-sawa. Kpwa chila dzina kuna aina yanjina yenye neno *madzi* dzinani: *mnyumbu madzi* na *mchumbu madzi*. Dzina ra Chigiryama ni *mjumbu maji*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mnyumbu* au *mongo*; *mongo* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa *mng'ongo*, *marula* wa kpweli.

reason.sw: Marula halisi, jamaa yake wa karibu
reason.dg: *Mng'ongo*, *marula* wa kpweli, ndugu wa phephi

teaser.en: Called the wild mango, it is actually a bean-family tree whose yellow fruit is eaten raw or cooked.
teaser.sw: Kwa Kiingereza huitwa embe la porini, lakini kwa kweli ni mti wa jamii ya kunde ambao tunda lake la njano huliwa bichi au likipikwa.
teaser.dg: Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild mango*, ela kpweli ni muhi wa jamii ya kunde, na matundage ga rangi ya mandano nkuriwa maitsi au gachijitwa.

summary.en: *Mnyungwinyungwi*, the wild mango, is a big spreading tree of hot riverine and swamp forest with tasty yellow fruits. Its wood is carved into stools, mortars and drums.
summary.sw: *Mnyungwinyungwi*, au *mroma*, ni mti mkubwa uliotanda wa misitu ya kando ya mito na ya vinamasi katika maeneo ya joto, wenye matunda ya njano yenye ladha nzuri. Mbao zake huchongwa kuwa vigoda, vinu na ngoma.
summary.dg: *Mnyungwinyungwi* (kpwa Chingereza *wild mango*) ni muhi mkulu unaoenea, wa matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na ga phatu pha madzi-madzi, phatu penye dzoho, wenye matunda ga mtswano ga rangi ya mandano. Nyama za muhi nkutsongwa kuhenda vihi, vinu na ngoma.

about.en:
*Mnyungwinyungwi* is a large, spreading deciduous tree. Its leaves are made of many small leaflets dotted with tiny translucent spots, which show when a leaflet is held up to the light. The flowers have no showy petals; instead, bursts of yellow-orange stamens make the colour.

The fruit is yellow and fleshy. Despite the English name, the tree is not a mango but a member of the bean family.
about.sw:
*Mnyungwinyungwi* ni mti mkubwa, uliotanda, unaopukutisha majani. Majani yake yana vijani vingi vidogo vyenye vitone vidogo vinavyopitisha mwanga, vinavyoonekana unapokishikilia kijani hicho dhidi ya mwanga. Maua hayana petali za kuvutia; badala yake, vishada vya stameni za rangi ya njano-machungwa ndivyo vinavyotoa rangi.

Tunda lake ni la njano na lenye nyama. Licha ya jina lake la Kiingereza, mti huu si mwembe bali ni wa jamii ya kunde.
about.dg:
*Mnyungwinyungwi* ni muhi mkulu unaoenea, ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka. Makodzage ganahendwa ni makodza madide manji genye mabara madide sana ambago mwanga unatsupa; ganaonekana uchiunula kodza dide na kurilola kpwa mwanga wa dzuwa. Maruwa tagana *petals* zinazoonekana sana; badalaye, mafungu ga nyuzi za rangi ya mandano na chungbwa (*stamens*) ndigo ganagopha rangi.

Tunda ni ra rangi ya mandano na rina nyama. Hata dzina ra Chingereza richigomba *mango*, muhi uhu si mwembe, ela ni wa jamii ya kunde.

where.en: It grows in riverine and swamp forest in the hot lowlands.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya kando ya mito na ya vinamasi katika nyanda za chini zenye joto.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na ga phatu pha madzi-madzi, kpwenye tsi za photsi zenye dzoho.

uses.en:
The fruit is tasty and is eaten raw or cooked.

The wood is used for stools, mortars and drums.
uses.sw:
Tunda lake lina ladha nzuri na huliwa bichi au likipikwa.

Mbao hutumika kutengeneza vigoda, vinu na ngoma.
uses.dg:
Matunda ni ga mtswano, na nkuriwa maitsi au gachijitwa.

Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda vihi, vinu na ngoma.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name *mnyungwinyungwi*. In Swahili it is *mroma*, *mvoo* or *mtigonzi*. In English it is called the wild mango.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo *mnyungwinyungwi*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mroma*, *mvoo* au *mtigonzi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *wild mango*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha dzina ra Chidigo *mnyungwinyungwi*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mroma*, *mvoo* au *mtigonzi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild mango*.

reason.en: The true mango it is named after
reason.sw: Mwembe halisi ambao umepewa jina kwa kuufuata
reason.dg: *Mwembe* wa kpweli, ambao ndio unaopha muhi uhu dzina ra Chingereza

reason.en: Another riverine tree of the bean family
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa kando ya mito wa jamii ya kunde
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya kunde wa kanda-kanda ya miho

reason.en: Also used for drums
reason.sw: Pia hutumika kutengeneza ngoma
reason.dg: Piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda ngoma

reason.en: Fruit tree also carved into stools and mortars
reason.sw: Mti wa matunda ambao pia huchongwa kuwa vigoda na vinu
reason.dg: Muhi wa matunda ambao piya nkutsongwa kuhenda vihi na vinu

teaser.en: The wooden sandals once worn along the Swahili coast were carved from this tree, and its name remembers them.
teaser.sw: Viatu vya mbao vilivyovaliwa zamani katika pwani ya Waswahili vilichongwa kutoka mti huu, na jina lake linavikumbuka.
teaser.dg: Virahu vya muhi virivyovwalwa kare pwani ya Aswahili vyatsongbwa kula muhi uhu, na dzinare rinavitambukira.

summary.en: *Mpalawanda*, the bell bean tree, is a small tree of dry coastal forest and secondary bush with yellow and maroon trumpet flowers. Its wood was cut into traditional wooden sandals, *mitawanda*, and is still used for poles, bows and tool handles.
summary.sw: *Mpalawanda*, au *mtawanda*, ni mti mdogo wa misitu mikavu ya pwani na vichaka vya pili wenye maua ya umbo la tarumbeta ya rangi ya njano na hudhurungi-nyekundu. Mbao zake zilikatwa kutengeneza viatu vya jadi vya mbao, *mitawanda*, na bado hutumika kwa nguzo, pinde na mipini ya zana.
summary.dg: *Mpalawanda* (kpwa Chingereza *bell bean tree*) ni muhi mdide wa matsaka makavu ga pwani na vitsaka virivyomera tsena, wenye maruwa ga umbo ra tarumbeta ga rangi ya mandano na ga kundu sana. Nyama za muhi zatsongbwa virahu vya muhi vya chienyeji, *mitawanda*, na hata sambi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo, maha na miphini ya vyombo.

about.en: *Mpalawanda* is a small tree or shrub with pinnate leaves. Its trumpet-shaped flowers are yellow, marked with maroon. The pods that follow are long, thin and twisted, typical of its family.
about.sw: *Mpalawanda* ni mti mdogo au kichaka chenye majani yaliyogawanyika kama manyoya. Maua yake yenye umbo la tarumbeta ni ya njano, yenye alama za hudhurungi-nyekundu. Maganda yanayofuata ni marefu, membamba na yaliyosokotwa, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia yake.
about.dg: *Mpalawanda* ni muhi mdide au chitsaka, na chila kodza rina makodza madide manji ganayolungana kanda mbiri za mlita. Maruwage ga umbo ra tarumbeta ni ga rangi ya mandano, genye alama za kundu sana. Makakaya ganagokpwedza bada ya maruwa ni mare, membamba na ganabeta, dza ni kawaida kpwa jamiiye.

where.en: It grows in dry forest and secondary bush along the coast.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu mikavu na vichaka vya pili kando ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu na vitsaka virivyomera tsena kanda-kanda ya pwani.

uses.en:
The wood is cut into traditional Swahili wooden sandals, *mitawanda*.

It is also used for poles and firewood, and for bows, arrows and tool handles.
uses.sw:
Mbao hukatwa kutengeneza viatu vya jadi vya mbao vya Kiswahili, *mitawanda*.

Pia hutumika kwa nguzo na kuni, na kwa pinde, mishale na mipini ya zana.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi nkutsongbwa virahu vya muhi vya chienyeji vya Aswahili, *mitawanda*.

Piya nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo na kuni, na kpwa maha, mahondza na miphini ya vyombo.

culture.en: The tree's Digo name refers to the wooden sandals, *mitawanda*, made from it.
culture.sw: Jina la Kidigo la mti huu linarejelea viatu vya mbao, *mitawanda*, vinavyotengenezwa kutokana nao.
culture.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ra muhi uhu rinatambukiza virahu vya muhi, *mitawanda*, vinavyotsongbwa kula muhi uhu.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mpalawanda*. In Swahili it is *mtawanda*, and in Giriama *muchalanda*. In English it is called the bell bean tree. The ICRAF handbook lists it under the related *Markhamia lutea*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mpalawanda*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtawanda*, na kwa Kigiriama *muchalanda*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *bell bean tree*. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinauorodhesha chini ya spishi inayohusiana nao, *Markhamia lutea*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mpalawanda*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtawanda*, na kpwa Chigiryama *muchalanda*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *bell bean tree*. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinauandika photsi ya nduguye *Markhamia lutea*.

reason.sw: Jamaa yake mwenye maua ya tarumbeta na maganda yaliyosokotwa
reason.dg: Nduguye wenye maruwa ga umbo ra tarumbeta na makakaya ganayobeta

reason.en: Another trumpet-flower family tree
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa familia ya maua ya tarumbeta
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya maruwa ga umbo ra tarumbeta

reason.dg: *Mvungunya*, muhi wa jamii mwenga

teaser.en: Don't burn it: its smoke is said to give you sores in the nose, which is exactly what its name means.
teaser.sw: Usiuchome: inasemekana moshi wake huleta vidonda puani, na hiyo ndiyo hasa maana ya jina lake.
teaser.dg: Usiutsome: nkugombwa mosi wa muhi uhu unalavya vironda pulani, na hiyo ndiyo mana ya dzinare.

summary.en: *Mpamapama* is a coastal forest tree with rough leaves and fleshy fruits. It is avoided as firewood because its smoke is said to cause sores in the nose.
summary.sw: *Mpamapama* ni mti wa misitu ya pwani wenye majani yanayokwaruza na matunda yenye nyama. Huepukwa kama kuni kwa sababu inasemekana moshi wake husababisha vidonda puani.
summary.dg: *Mpamapama* ni muhi wa matsaka ga pwani wenye makodza ganayokaraza na matunda genye nyama. Atu nkuhepa kuutsoma dza kuni kpwa sababu nkugombwa mosi wa muhi uhu unalavya vironda pulani.

about.en: *Mpamapama* is a tree with rough leaves and fleshy fruits. It is a *Cordia*, a genus known for sandpapery leaves and soft, often sticky fruit.
about.sw: *Mpamapama* ni mti wenye majani yanayokwaruza na matunda yenye nyama. Ni *Cordia*, jenasi inayojulikana kwa majani yanayokwaruza kama msasa na matunda laini ambayo mara nyingi yananata.
about.dg: *Mpamapama* ni muhi wenye makodza ganayokaraza na matunda genye nyama. Ni *Cordia*, jenasi inayomanyikana kpwa makodza ganayokaraza dza msasa, na matunda malaini ambago mara nyinji ganayonyata.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani.

uses.en: *Mpamapama* is known mainly for what it is not used for: people avoid burning it as firewood.
uses.sw: *Mpamapama* unajulikana zaidi kwa kile usichotumiwa: watu huepuka kuuchoma kama kuni.
uses.dg: *Mpamapama* unamanyikana zaidi kpwa chitu ambacho tauhumirwa: atu nkuhepa kuutsoma dza kuni.

culture.en: The name, according to Pakia, means 'nose wounds', because its smoke is said to cause sores in the nose. The name carries a warning to anyone gathering firewood.
culture.sw: Kwa mujibu wa Pakia, jina hili linamaanisha 'vidonda vya pua', kwa sababu inasemekana moshi wake husababisha vidonda puani. Jina hilo ni onyo kwa yeyote anayetafuta kuni.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala dzina hiri rina mana ya 'vironda vya pula', kpwa sababu nkugombwa mosi wa muhi uhu unalavya vironda pulani. Dzina hiri rinaonya chila mutu anayehendza kuni.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mpamapama*, 'nose wounds'. No Swahili or English name is recorded; botanists know it as *Cordia goetzei*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mpamapama*, 'vidonda vya pua'. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Cordia goetzei*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mpamapama*, 'vironda vya pula'. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anauiha *Cordia goetzei*.

reason.en: Another Cordia, also with a vivid name
reason.sw: Cordia mwingine, pia mwenye jina la kuvutia
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa *Cordia*, nao piya una dzina ra ajabu

reason.en: A favourite firewood tree
reason.sw: Mti unaopendwa kwa kuni
reason.dg: Muhi unaomendzwa sana kpwa kuni

reason.en: Also named for a property of its wood
reason.sw: Pia umepewa jina kutokana na sifa ya mbao zake
reason.dg: Nao piya dzinare rinakula kpwa tabiya ya nyama za muhi

teaser.en: It grows into thickets so dense that one Digo name means 'closing pile': it shuts the path.
teaser.sw: Huota na kuwa vichaka vizito mno hivi kwamba mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo linamaanisha 'rundo linalofunga': hufunga njia.
teaser.dg: Unamera ukahenda vitsaka vinji sana visivyotsupika, hata dzina mwenga ra Chidigo rina mana ya 'chinachofunga tsumbi': unafunga njira.

summary.en: *Mpande* is a smooth-barked tree of dry evergreen and riverine forest that grows into dense thickets. Its second Digo name, *chifunga sandzu*, describes how it closes forest paths.
summary.sw: *Mpande*, au *mgodoma*, ni mti wenye gome laini wa misitu mikavu ya kijani mwaka mzima na misitu ya kando ya mito, unaoota na kuwa vichaka vizito. Jina lake la pili la Kidigo, *chifunga sandzu*, linaeleza jinsi unavyofunga njia za msituni.
summary.dg: *Mpande* ni muhi wenye gopha laini, wa matsaka makavu genye makodza chila wakati na wa matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho, unaomera ukahenda vitsaka visivyotsupika. Dzinare ra phiri ra Chidigo, *chifunga sandzu*, rinaonyesa vira unavyofunga njira za tsakani.

about.en:
*Mpande* is a tree with a slightly buttressed trunk and smooth grey bark. Each leaf has three to five leaflets arranged alternately along the stalk. The flowers are white, and the pods are short and thick.

The genus name, *Scorodophloeus*, means 'garlic bark'.
about.sw:
*Mpande* ni mti wenye shina lenye mizizi-ukuta midogo na gome laini la kijivu. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu hadi vitano vilivyopangwa kwa kupishana kando ya shina la jani. Maua ni meupe, na maganda ni mafupi na manene.

Jina la jenasi, *Scorodophloeus*, linamaanisha 'gome la kitunguu saumu'.
about.dg:
*Mpande* ni muhi wenye kolo renye ngamba ndide na gopha laini ra rangi ya ivu. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu hadi matsano, ganayolungana kanda-kanda ya mlita, rimwenga uphande mwenga na ranjina uphande wanjina. Maruwa ni mereru, na makakaya ni mafupi na maziho.

Dzina ra jenasi, *Scorodophloeus*, rina mana ya 'gopha ra kitunguu saumu'.

where.en: It grows in lowland dry evergreen forest and riverine forest, where it can form thickets.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu mikavu ya kijani mwaka mzima ya nyanda za chini na katika misitu ya kando ya mito, ambapo unaweza kutengeneza vichaka vizito.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu genye makodza chila wakati ga tsi ya photsi, na kpwenye matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho, ambako unaweza kuhenda vitsaka visivyotsupika.

uses.en: No particular use for *mpande* has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi maalumu ya *mpande* yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga *mpande* garigoandikpwa.

culture.en: Its second name tells you how it grows. *Chifunga sandzu* means 'closing pile', because the tree forms thickets that close the path.
culture.sw: Jina lake la pili linakueleza jinsi unavyokua. *Chifunga sandzu* linamaanisha 'rundo linalofunga', kwa sababu mti huu hutengeneza vichaka vinavyofunga njia.
culture.dg: Dzinare ra phiri rinakuambira vira unavyomera. *Chifunga sandzu* rina mana ya 'chinachofunga tsumbi', kpwa sababu muhi uhu unahenda vitsaka vinavyofunga njira.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mpande* and *chifunga sandzu*. The Duruma name, *kifunga tanzu*, is almost the same. In Swahili it is *mgodoma*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mpande* na *chifunga sandzu*. Jina la Kiduruma, *kifunga tanzu*, linakaribiana sana nalo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mgodoma*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mpande* na *chifunga sandzu*. Dzina ra Chiduruma, *kifunga tanzu*, ni phephi sawa na ra Chidigo. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mgodoma*.

reason.sw: Cynometra, mti mwingine wa jamii ya kunde wa misitu ya pwani
reason.dg: *Cynometra*, muhi wanjina wa jamii ya kunde wa herera za pwani zenye mihi

reason.dg: Muhi wa jamii ya kunde wa matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho

reason.dg: Muhi wa matsaka ga tsi ya photsi na ga kanda-kanda ya miho

teaser.en: Its name comes from upesi, 'quickly', because few trees fill a forest gap faster.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linatokana na upesi, kwa sababu ni miti michache inayojaza pengo la msitu kwa haraka kuliko huu.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinakula kpwa *upesi*, 'haraka', kpwa sababu ni mihi michache inayomera haraka kuriko uwo phatu phereru tsakani.

summary.en: *Mpesi*, the pigeonwood or charcoal tree, is a fast-growing pioneer of forest gaps, clearings and fallow land. It supplies poles, firewood and charcoal, and its bark and leaves are used for deworming and cough.
summary.sw: *Mpesi* ni mti waanzilishi unaokua haraka katika mapengo ya misitu, maeneo yaliyosafishwa na mashamba yaliyoachwa. Hutoa nguzo, kuni na mkaa, na gome na majani yake hutumika kutoa minyoo na kutibu kikohozi.
summary.dg: *Mpesi* (kpwa Chingereza *pigeonwood* au *charcoal tree*) ni muhi unaokula haraka, kahi ya mihi ya kpwandza kumera phatu phereru tsakani, phatu ambapho mihi ikakatwa na minda iriyorichwa. Unalavya nguzo, kuni na makala, na gophare na makodzage nkuhumirwa kuusa minyololo bindoni na kpwa atu anaokolola.

about.en: *Mpesi* is a shrub or tree up to 12 metres tall with drooping branchlets. The leaves are rough, with toothed edges, and their bases are lopsided. The fruits are tiny and black, and birds spread them widely, which helps the tree reach new clearings.
about.sw: *Mpesi* ni kichaka au mti wenye urefu wa hadi mita 12 na vitawi vinavyoinama chini. Majani yake yanakwaruza, yana kingo zenye meno, na sehemu zake za chini hazilingani pande mbili. Matunda ni madogo sana na meusi, na ndege huyasambaza mbali, jambo linalousaidia mti kufika kwenye maeneo mapya yaliyosafishwa.
about.dg: *Mpesi* ni chitsaka au muhi wa hadi mita kumi na mbiri, wenye panda ndide zinazobwadzika. Makodza ganakaraza, genye kanda dza meno ga msumeno, na photsi ya chila kodza uphande mwenga ni mre kuriko wanjina. Matunda ni madide sana na ni maru, na nyuni nkugatawanya kure; kpwa hivyo muhi unaphaha kufika phatu phereru phaphya.

where.en: It is a pioneer: one of the first trees to grow in forest gaps, clearings and fallow fields. Anywhere land has been cleared and left, look for its quick young stands.
where.sw: Ni mti waanzilishi: mmojawapo wa miti ya kwanza kuota katika mapengo ya misitu, maeneo yaliyosafishwa na mashamba yaliyoachwa. Popote ambapo ardhi imesafishwa na kuachwa, tafuta vikundi vyake vichanga vinavyochipuka haraka.
where.dg: Ni muhi wa kpwandza: kahi ya mihi ya kpwandza kumera phatu phereru tsakani, phatu ambapho mihi ikakatwa na minda iriyorichwa. Phophosi ambapho mihi ikakatwa na tsi ikarichwa, endza makundi ga mihiye mitsanga inayomera haraka.

uses.en:
The wood is used for poles, firewood and charcoal, which is where the English name 'charcoal tree' comes from. The tree also gives shade.

The bark and leaves are used in traditional medicine for deworming and for cough.
uses.sw:
Mbao hutumika kwa nguzo, kuni na mkaa, na ndiko jina la Kiingereza *charcoal tree*, yaani 'mti wa mkaa', linakotokea. Mti huu pia hutoa kivuli.

Gome na majani hutumika katika tiba ya jadi kutoa minyoo na kutibu kikohozi.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo, kuni na makala, na ndiko kunakokula dzina ra Chingereza *charcoal tree*. Muhi piya unapha pepho.

Gopha na makodza nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji kuusa minyololo bindoni na kpwa atu anaokolola.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name *mpesi* as coming from *upesi*, 'quickly', because the tree grows so fast.
culture.sw: Pakia inaeleza kuwa jina *mpesi* linatokana na *upesi*, kwa sababu mti huu hukua haraka mno.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala dzina *mpesi* rinakula kpwa *upesi*, 'haraka', kpwa sababu muhi uhu unakula haraka sana.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mpesi* and *mbonobono*; the ICRAF handbook also gives *mbonobono*, a name it uses as well for the orange-milk tree, *mkonotsaka*. In Swahili it is *mpesi*, and in Giriama *mzunguzungu*. In English it is pigeonwood or the charcoal tree.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mpesi* na *mbonobono*; kitabu cha ICRAF pia kinatoa *mbonobono*, jina ambalo kinalitumia pia kwa mti wa utomvu wa rangi ya machungwa, *mkonotsaka*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mpesi*, na kwa Kigiriama *mzunguzungu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *pigeonwood* au *charcoal tree*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mpesi* na *mbonobono*; chitabu cha ICRAF piya chinapha *mbonobono*, dzina ambaro chinarihumira piya kpwa *mkonotsaka*, muhi wenye maziya ga rangi ya chungbwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mpesi*, na kpwa Chigiryama *mzunguzungu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pigeonwood* au *charcoal tree*.

teaser.en: The purple-black wood of this scrubby little tree ends up in clarinets and oboes on the world's concert stages.
teaser.sw: Mbao ya rangi ya zambarau-nyeusi ya mti huu mdogo wa vichakani huishia kuwa klarineti na obo katika majukwaa ya muziki duniani.
teaser.dg: Nyama za muhi hinyu mdide wa chitsaka, za rangi ya zambarau-iru, nkuhumirwa kuhenda *clarinet* na *oboe* zinazochezwa kpwenye majukwaa ga muziki duniani kosi.

summary.en: *Mphingo*, African blackwood, is a spiny, twisted small tree of coastal bushland whose purple-black heartwood is among the most valuable timbers in the world. It is prized for carving and for musical instruments, and heavy harvesting has made it Near Threatened.
summary.sw: *Mphingo*, au mpingo, ni mti mdogo wenye miiba na uliopindapinda wa vichaka vya pwani, ambao kiini chake cha rangi ya zambarau-nyeusi ni miongoni mwa mbao zenye thamani kubwa zaidi duniani. Unathaminiwa kwa uchongaji na kwa kutengeneza ala za muziki, na uvunaji mkubwa umeufanya kuwa Karibu Kuwa Hatarini.
summary.dg: *Mphingo* ni muhi mdide wenye miya na uriodzikunja, wa vitsaka vya pwani, ambao chiinire cha rangi ya zambarau-iru ni kahi ya nyama za muhi za samani zaidi duniani. Nkuthaminiwa kpwa kutsonga na kuhenda vyombo vya muziki, na kukatwa sana kukahenda ukale kahi ya mihi iriyo *Near Threatened*.

about.en:
*Mphingo* does not look like a precious tree. It is a spiny, much-branched shrub or small tree, rarely more than 7 metres tall, with a twisted trunk and pale grey bark that flakes. The leaves are made up of small leaflets clustered at the nodes.

The value is hidden inside: the heartwood is dense and purple-black, the colour the Digo call *rangi ya mphingo*, 'ebony colour'.
about.sw:
*Mphingo* hauonekani kama mti wa thamani. Ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye miiba na matawi mengi, mara chache kuzidi mita 7 kwa urefu, wenye shina lililopindapinda na gome la kijivu hafifu linalobanduka. Majani yake yameundwa na vijani vidogo vilivyosongamana kwenye vifundo.

Thamani yake imefichwa ndani: kiini cha mbao ni kizito na cha rangi ya zambarau-nyeusi, rangi ambayo Wadigo huiita *rangi ya mphingo*, yaani rangi nyeusi ya mpingo.
about.dg:
*Mphingo* tauonekana dza muhi wa samani. Ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye miya na panda nyinji, ambao mara nyinji tauzidi mita 7 kpwa ure, wenye kolo ririrodzikunja na gopha ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu rinarotuluka vipande-vipande. Makodzage ni makodza madide ganagomera kpwa mafungu kpwenye viungo.

Samaniye i ndani: chiini ni chiziho na cha rangi ya zambarau-iru, rangi ambayo Adigo anaiiha *rangi ya mphingo*, 'rangi ya ebony'.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, deciduous woodland and wooded grassland.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vya pwani, misitu inayopukutisha majani na nyika zenye miti.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka vya pwani, matsaka ga mihi ambayo makodza gao ganagbwa, na herera zenye mihi.

uses.en:
The heartwood is among the most valuable timbers known. It is used for carving and walking sticks, and worldwide it is the wood of choice for clarinets and oboes.

The bark, roots and leaves are used in traditional medicine. The tree also gives firewood and fodder, and bees forage on its flowers.
uses.sw:
Kiini cha mbao yake ni miongoni mwa mbao zenye thamani kubwa zaidi zinazojulikana. Hutumika kwa uchongaji na kutengeneza bakora, na kote duniani ndiyo mbao inayopendelewa zaidi kwa klarineti na obo.

Gome, mizizi na majani yake hutumika katika dawa za asili. Mti huu pia hutoa kuni na lishe ya mifugo, na nyuki hutafuta chakula kwenye maua yake.
uses.dg:
Chiini ni kahi ya nyama za muhi za samani zaidi zinazomanyikana. Nkuhumirwa kutsonga na kuhenda ndata za kunyendekera, na duniani kosi ndicho chinachotsambulwa kuhenda *clarinet* na *oboe*.

Gopha, mizi na makodza nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji. Muhi hinyu piya unalavya kuni na chakurya cha kurisa nyama, na nyuchi nkuendza chakurya kpwenye maruwage.

names.en: Pakia and the Mgombato dictionary spell the Digo name *mphingo*; the ICRAF handbook writes *mpingo*, as in Swahili. Mgombato also gives the phrase *rangi ya mphingo* for the colour ebony. Other Mijikenda names are Giriama *muhingo* and Duruma *maringo*. In English it is African blackwood or African ebony. Mgombato also lists *Cyphostemma adenocaulis* under the name, which appears to be an error.
names.sw: Pakia na kamusi ya Mgombato huliandika jina la Kidigo *mphingo*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinaandika *mpingo*, kama ilivyo kwa Kiswahili. Mgombato pia inatoa usemi *rangi ya mphingo* kwa rangi nyeusi ya mpingo (*ebony*). Majina mengine ya Kimijikenda ni Kigiriama *muhingo* na Kiduruma *maringo*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *African blackwood* au *African ebony*. Mgombato pia inaorodhesha *Cyphostemma adenocaulis* chini ya jina hili, jambo linaloonekana kuwa kosa.
names.dg: Pakia na kamusi ya Mgombato anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mphingo*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika *mpingo*, dza kpwa Chiswahili. Mgombato piya inalavya maneno *rangi ya mphingo* kpwa rangi ya ebony. Madzina ganjina ga Amijikenda ni ga Chigiriama *muhingo* na Chiduruma *maringo*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *African blackwood* au *African ebony*. Mgombato piya inaandika *Cyphostemma adenocaulis* photsi ya dzina hiri, chitu chinachoonekana kukala ni kosa.

conservation.en: Mphingo is listed as Near Threatened on the IUCN Red List, and it is heavily harvested for carving.
conservation.sw: Mphingo umeorodheshwa kama Karibu Kuwa Hatarini (Near Threatened) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN, na huvunwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya uchongaji.
conservation.dg: *Mphingo* ukaandikpwa dza *Near Threatened* kpwenye Orodha ya Kundu ya IUCN, na unakatwa sana kpwa kutsonga.

teaser.en: Its very scientific name, anthelmintica, means 'worm-expelling', and that is exactly what its bark is used for.
teaser.sw: Hata jina lake la kisayansi, anthelmintica, linamaanisha 'kinachofukuza minyoo', na hivyo ndivyo hasa gome lake linavyotumika.
teaser.dg: Hata dzinare ra chisayansi, *anthelmintica*, rina mana ya 'chinachousa minyololo', na ndivyo gophare rinavyohumirwa.

summary.en: *Mporojo*, the worm-cure albizia, is a deciduous shrub or small tree of dry bushland. Its bark is a well-known remedy for intestinal worms, and the Digo also use it to treat malaria.
summary.sw: *Mporojo* ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaopukutisha majani wa vichaka vikavu. Gome lake ni dawa inayojulikana sana ya minyoo ya tumboni, na Wadigo pia huutumia kutibu malaria.
summary.dg: *Mporojo* (kpwa Chingereza *worm-cure albizia*) ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa vitsaka vikavu, ambao makodzage ganagbwa kpwa muda. Gophare ni dawa inayomanyikana sana ya minyololo ya bindoni, na Adigo piya nkurihumira kpwa homa ya malaria.

about.en: *Mporojo* is a deciduous shrub or small tree with smooth, pale bark. Its leaves are twice divided, like those of other albizias, but with only a few broad leaflets. The wood is hard and red-brown.
about.sw: *Mporojo* ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaopukutisha majani wenye gome laini lililofifia rangi. Majani yake yamegawanyika mara mbili, kama ya miti mingine ya *Albizia*, lakini yana vijani vichache tu vipana. Mbao zake ni ngumu na za rangi nyekundu-kahawia.
about.dg: *Mporojo* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide ambao makodzage ganagbwa kpwa muda, wenye gopha laini ra rangi ngushu-ngushu. Makodzage ganaganywa mara mbiri, dza ga mihi yanjina ya *Albizia*, ela gana makodza madide machache mapana. Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na za rangi ya dongo ya kundu-kundu.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and scrub.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu na nyika za vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka vikavu na weruni.

uses.en: The bark is best known as a treatment for intestinal worms, especially tapeworm; an extract of it is used to expel them. The stem and root bark are also used to treat malaria, one of the Digo remedies recorded by Nguta and colleagues in 2011.
uses.sw: Gome linajulikana zaidi kama tiba ya minyoo ya tumboni, hasa tegu; dondoo lake hutumika kuitoa. Gome la shina na la mizizi pia hutumika kutibu malaria, mojawapo ya dawa za Kidigo zilizorekodiwa na Nguta na wenzake mwaka 2011.
uses.dg: Gopha rinamanyikana zaidi dza dawa ya minyololo ya bindoni, hasa minyololo mire (*tapeworm*); madzi ga gopha nkuhumirwa kuiusa. Gopha ra kolo na ra mizi piya nkuhumirwa kpwa homa ya malaria; dawa hino ni kahi ya dawa za Adigo zirizoandikpwa ni Nguta na ayae mwaka 2011.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mporojo* and notes that it is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is the worm-cure albizia, a translation of its scientific name, *Albizia anthelmintica*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mporojo* na inaeleza kuwa linatumiwa pia na Waduruma, Wagiriama na Waswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *worm-cure albizia*, tafsiri ya jina lake la kisayansi, *Albizia anthelmintica*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mporojo* na anagomba kukala dzina hiri piya rinahumirwa kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *worm-cure albizia*, ambayo ni tafsiri ya dzinare ra chisayansi, *Albizia anthelmintica*.

teaser.en: Its branches become pestles, and one of its Digo names, mutsi, simply means 'pestle'.
teaser.sw: Matawi yake hugeuka michi, na mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo, mutsi, linamaanisha 'mchi' tu.
teaser.dg: Pandaze nkuhendwa mitsi, na dzina mwenga ra Chidigo ni *mutsi* tu, dzina ra chombo hicho.

summary.en: *Mpweke* is a small relative of ebony found in coastal bushland and dry forest. Its branches are made into pestles for pounding grain.
summary.sw: *Mpweke* ni jamaa mdogo wa abunusi anayepatikana katika vichaka vya pwani na misitu mikavu. Matawi yake hutengenezwa kuwa michi ya kutwangia nafaka.
summary.dg: *Mpweke* ni nduguye mdide wa mihi ya *ebony*, unaophahikana vitsakani pwani na kpwenye matsaka makavu. Pandaze nkuhendwa mitsi ya kubundugira nafaka.

about.en: *Mpweke* is a small tree of the ebony family with dark bark and stiff leaves arranged one after another along the twig. Its small fruits sit in an enlarged calyx, a cup-like collar typical of the *Diospyros* ebonies.
about.sw: *Mpweke* ni mti mdogo wa familia ya abunusi wenye gome jeusi na majani magumu yaliyopangwa moja baada ya jingine kando ya kitawi. Matunda yake madogo hukaa ndani ya kikombe cha maua kilichopanuka, ukosi wenye umbo la kikombe ulio kawaida kwa abunusi za jenasi *Diospyros*.
about.dg: *Mpweke* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya *ebony*, wenye gopha ra rangi nyiru na makodza magumu ganayolungana rimwenga bada ya ranjina kanda-kanda ya chigongo. Matundage madide ganaikala ndani ya chikombe chikulu chinachozunguluka photsi ya tunda (*calyx*), dza ni kawaida kpwa *Diospyros*.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and dry forest.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani na misitu mikavu.
where.dg: Unamera vitsakani pwani na kpwenye matsaka makavu.

uses.en: The branches are made into pestles, the heavy pounding sticks used with a mortar.
uses.sw: Matawi hutengenezwa kuwa michi, vijiti vizito vya kutwangia vinavyotumika pamoja na kinu.
uses.dg: Panda nkuhendwa mitsi, mihi miziho ya kubundugira inayohumirwa phamwenga na chinu.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names: *mpweke*, shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili, and *mutsi*, which means 'pestle'. The Mgombato dictionary gives Swahili *mpweke* under *mkulu*, which it identifies as the jackal-berry, so the name may also be used for other ebonies.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo: *mpweke*, linalotumiwa pia na Waduruma, Wagiriama na Waswahili, na *mutsi*, linalomaanisha 'mchi'. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa jina la Kiswahili *mpweke* chini ya *mkulu*, ambao inautambulisha kuwa *jackal-berry*, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili pia linatumika kwa miti mingine ya abunusi.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo: *mpweke*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili, na *mutsi*, dzina ra chombo cha kubundugira. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha dzina ra Chiswahili *mpweke* photsi ya *mkulu*, ambao inaugomba kukala ni muhi wa *jackal-berry*, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinaweza kuhumirwa piya kpwa mihi yanjina ya jamii ya *ebony*.

teaser.en: Pick up a piece of its wood and you'll understand the name: mremero means 'heavy'.
teaser.sw: Okota kipande cha mbao zake na utaelewa jina lake: mremero linamaanisha 'nzito'.
teaser.dg: Uchihala chipande cha muhi uhu, undamanya mana ya dzinare: *mremero* rina mana ya 'chitu chiziho'.

summary.en: *Mremero* is a small tree of coastal and riverine forest with ash-like leaves and small yellow fruits. It is known for its heavy wood, which gives the tree its name.
summary.sw: *Mremero* ni mti mdogo wa misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito wenye majani yanayofanana na ya mti wa *ash* na matunda madogo ya njano. Unajulikana kwa mbao zake nzito, ambazo ndizo zilizoupa mti huu jina lake.
summary.dg: *Mremero* ni muhi mdide wa matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, wenye makodza ganayoigana na ga muhi wa *ash* na matunda madide ga rangi ya mandano. Unamanyikana kpwa nyama za muhi ndziho, ambazo ndizo zinazoupha dzinare.

about.en: *Mremero* is a small tree with pinnate leaves that look rather like those of an ash tree. It bears small yellow fruits. Its wood is notably heavy.
about.sw: *Mremero* ni mti mdogo wenye majani yaliyogawanyika kama manyoya ambayo yanafanana kiasi na ya mti wa *ash*. Huzaa matunda madogo ya njano. Mbao zake ni nzito kwa namna ya pekee.
about.dg: *Mremero* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza madide manji ganayolungana kanda mbiri za mlita, ganayoigana chidide na ga muhi wa *ash*. Unatsukula matunda madide ga rangi ya mandano. Nyama za muhi ni ndziho sana.

where.en: It grows in coastal and riverine forest.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho.

uses.en: The wood is heavy; no other particular use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Mbao zake ni nzito; hakuna matumizi mengine maalumu yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi ni ndziho; takuna matumizi ganjina garigoandikpwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mremero*, meaning 'heavy', for its wood. No Swahili or English name is recorded; botanists know it as *Lecaniodiscus fraxinifolius*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mremero*, linalomaanisha 'nzito', kwa sababu ya mbao zake. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Lecaniodiscus fraxinifolius*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mremero*, ririro na mana ya 'chiziho', kpwa sababu ya nyama za muhi. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anauiha *Lecaniodiscus fraxinifolius*.

teaser.en: When its new leaves unfold, the woodland blushes pink and scarlet before turning green.
teaser.sw: Majani yake mapya yanapochipuka, pori hugeuka rangi ya waridi na nyekundu iliyokolea kabla ya kuwa kijani.
teaser.dg: Makodzage maphya ganaphotuluka, mihi yosi phara inakala ya rangi ya pinki na ya kundu kabla ya kukala ya chijani.

summary.en: *Mrihi*, the msasa, is the flat-crowned tree that defines *Brachystegia* woodland on the sandy soils of the coastal plain. Pakia lists it among the popular Digo timber species, used for door frames, furniture and canoes.
summary.sw: *Mrihi*, au *myombo*, ni mti wenye kilele bapa unaotambulisha mapori ya *Brachystegia* kwenye udongo wa kichanga wa uwanda wa pwani. Pakia inauorodhesha miongoni mwa spishi maarufu za mbao za Kidigo, zinazotumika kwa fremu za milango, samani na mitumbwi.
summary.dg: *Mrihi* (kpwa Chingereza *msasa*) ni muhi wenye dari sawa-sawa inayotandazika, ambao ndio muhi mkulu wa herera zenye mihi ya *Brachystegia*, kpwa tsi ya mtsanga ya herera ya pwani. Pakia anauolanga kahi ya mihi ya mbao inayomendzwa ni Adigo, inayohumirwa kuhenda miimo ya miryango, vyombo vya nyumba na ngarawa.

about.en:
*Mrihi* is a deciduous tree from 8 to 25 metres tall, with a flat, spreading crown. Its leaves are glossy and dark, with three to five pairs of leaflets.

Its most famous moment is when it comes back into leaf. The new flush is strikingly pink to scarlet, so a stand of *mrihi* can look as if it is in autumn colour, before the leaves turn green.
about.sw:
*Mrihi* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye urefu wa mita 8 hadi 25, na kilele bapa kilichotanda. Majani yake yanang'aa na yana rangi iliyokolea, yakiwa na jozi tatu hadi tano za vijani.

Wakati wake maarufu zaidi ni unapochipua majani upya. Machipukizi mapya yana rangi ya waridi hadi nyekundu iliyokolea inayovutia sana, hivyo kundi la *mrihi* linaweza kuonekana kana kwamba liko katika rangi za majira ya kupukutika, kabla majani hayajageuka kijani.
about.dg:
*Mrihi* ni muhi ambao makodzage ganagbwa kpwa muda, wa mita nane hadi ishirini na tsano kpwa ure, wenye dari sawa-sawa inayotandazika. Makodzage ganang'ala na ni ga chijani sana, na chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu hadi matsano kpwa chila uphande.

Wakati unaomanyikana zaidi ni uchilavya makodza maphya. Makodza higo maphya ni ga pinki hadi kundu sana, kpwa hivyo kundi ra *mrihi* rinaweza kuonekana dza mihi wakati wa *autumn*, kabla makodza kukala ga chijani.

where.en: *Mrihi* grows in *Brachystegia* woodland on the sandy soils of the coastal plain and the foot plateau. Where it grows it is often the main tree, giving the woodland its name. Look for the red flush when the trees put out new leaves.
where.sw: *Mrihi* huota katika mapori ya *Brachystegia* kwenye udongo wa kichanga wa uwanda wa pwani na uwanda wa chini wa miinuko. Mahali unapoota mara nyingi ndio mti mkuu, na huyapa mapori hayo jina lake. Tafuta rangi nyekundu ya machipukizi miti inapotoa majani mapya.
where.dg: *Mrihi* unamera kpwenye herera zenye mihi ya *Brachystegia*, kpwa tsi ya mtsanga ya herera ya pwani na ya photsi ya milima. Phatu unaphomera mara nyinji ndio muhi mkulu, na ndio unaozipha herera hizo dzina. Lola makodza ga kundu wakati mihi inalavya makodza maphya.

uses.en:
The timber is used for door frames, furniture and canoes, and Pakia lists *mrihi* among the popular Digo timber species. It also gives poles, firewood and charcoal.

The bark gives tannin, and the tree is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake hutumika kwa fremu za milango, samani na mitumbwi, na Pakia inaorodhesha *mrihi* miongoni mwa spishi maarufu za mbao za Kidigo. Pia hutoa nguzo, kuni na mkaa.

Gome hutoa tanini, na mti huu hutumika katika tiba ya jadi.
uses.dg:
Mbao nkuhumirwa kuhenda miimo ya miryango, vyombo vya nyumba na ngarawa, na Pakia anaolanga *mrihi* kahi ya mihi ya mbao inayomendzwa ni Adigo. Piya unalavya nguzo, kuni na makala.

Gopha rinalavya tanini, na muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *mrihi*. Pakia also uses *mrihi* for another tree, *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*. In Swahili it is *mrihi* or *myombo*, and in Giriama *mrihi* or *mjombo*. In English it is called msasa.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF vinatoa jina la Kidigo *mrihi*. Pakia pia inatumia *mrihi* kwa mti mwingine, *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mrihi* au *myombo*, na kwa Kigiriama *mrihi* au *mjombo*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *msasa*.
names.dg: Pakia anapha dzina ra Chidigo *mrihi*, na chitabu cha ICRAF piya. Pakia piya anahumira *mrihi* kpwa muhi wanjina, *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mrihi* au *myombo*, na kpwa Chigiryama *mrihi* au *mjombo*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *msasa*.

teaser.en: Blue-to-mauve flowers with one big petal set this tree apart, though it shares its Digo name with the msasa.
teaser.sw: Maua ya rangi ya buluu hadi zambarau hafifu yenye petali moja kubwa huutofautisha mti huu, ingawa unashiriki jina lake la Kidigo na myombo.
teaser.dg: Muhi uhu unamanyikana kpwa maruwage ga samawati hadi zambarau ngushu-ngushu, chila ruwa na chipande chimwenga chikulu, ela dzinare ra Chidigo ni *mrihi*, dza ra *Brachystegia*, *msasa*.

summary.en: This *mrihi* is a spreading, smooth-barked tree common on the south coast, with blue to mauve flowers and large woody pods. Its bark is a source of fibre.
summary.sw: *Mrihi* huu ni mti uliotanda wenye gome laini, unaopatikana kwa wingi katika pwani ya kusini, wenye maua ya buluu hadi zambarau hafifu na maganda makubwa magumu kama mti. Gome lake ni chanzo cha nyuzi.
summary.dg: *Mrihi* uhu ni muhi wenye dari inayotandazika na gopha laini, unaophahikana sana pwani ya kusini, wenye maruwa ga samawati hadi zambarau ngushu-ngushu na makakaya makulu magumu dza mbao. Gophare rinalavya nyuzi.

about.en: This tree has drooping branches, a spreading crown and smooth bark. Each leaf has two to five pairs of leaflets. Its flowers are blue to mauve, each with one large, showy petal. The pods are large and woody.
about.sw: Mti huu una matawi yanayoinama chini, kilele kilichotanda na gome laini. Kila jani lina jozi mbili hadi tano za vijani. Maua yake ni ya buluu hadi zambarau hafifu, kila moja likiwa na petali moja kubwa inayovutia. Maganda ni makubwa na magumu kama mti.
about.dg: Muhi uhu una panda zinazobwadzika, dari pana inayotandazika na gopha laini. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mairi hadi matsano kpwa chila uphande. Maruwage ni ga samawati hadi zambarau ngushu-ngushu, na chila ruwa rina chipande chimwenga chikulu chinachoonekana sana. Makakaya ni makulu na magumu dza mbao.

where.en: It is common on the south coast, especially in *Brachystegia* woodland and lowland forest.
where.sw: Unapatikana kwa wingi katika pwani ya kusini, hasa katika mapori ya *Brachystegia* na misitu ya nyanda za chini.
where.dg: Unaphahikana sana pwani ya kusini, hasa kpwenye herera zenye mihi ya *Brachystegia* na matsaka ga tsi ya photsi.

uses.en: The bark is a source of fibre.
uses.sw: Gome lake ni chanzo cha nyuzi.
uses.dg: Gopha rinalavya nyuzi.

names.en: Pakia gives the Digo name *mrihi*, the same name it uses for *Brachystegia spiciformis*, the msasa. A second name is *mukwe*; the ICRAF handbook gives *mkua* and *mrihi*. In Swahili it is *mkue*, a name also used for *mkuwa*, *Julbernardia magnistipulata*. No English name is in common use.
names.sw: Pakia inatoa jina la Kidigo *mrihi*, jina lile lile inalotumia kwa *Brachystegia spiciformis*, yaani myombo. Jina la pili ni *mukwe*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mkua* na *mrihi*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mkue*, jina linalotumika pia kwa *mkuwa*, *Julbernardia magnistipulata*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalotumika kwa kawaida.
names.dg: Pakia anapha dzina ra Chidigo *mrihi*, dzina ambaro anarihumira piya kpwa *Brachystegia spiciformis*, *msasa*. Dzina ra phiri ni *mukwe*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *mkua* na *mrihi*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkue*, dzina ambaro piya rinahumirwa kpwa *mkuwa*, *Julbernardia magnistipulata*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana.

teaser.en: Its Digo name means 'food of kpwembe', after the bird said to eat its fruit.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linamaanisha 'chakula cha kpwembe', kwa kumfuata ndege anayesemekana kula matunda yake.
teaser.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo rina mana ya 'chakurya cha *kpwembe*', kula kpwa nyuni anayegombwa kurya matundage.

summary.en: *Mryakwembe* is a small tree of bushland and woodland, a relative of myrrh with compound leaves and small fleshy fruits. Its name records the bird that feeds on it.
summary.sw: *Mryakwembe* ni mti mdogo wa vichaka na mapori, jamaa wa mti wa manemane, wenye majani yaliyogawanyika na matunda madogo yenye nyama. Jina lake linamkumbuka ndege anayeula.
summary.dg: *Mryakwembe* ni muhi mdide wa vitsakani na herera zenye mihi, nduguye wa mihi ya *myrrh*, wenye makodza genye makodza madide na matunda madide genye nyama. Dzinare rinatambukiza nyuni anayegarya matundage.

about.en: *Mryakwembe* is a small tree with compound leaves and small, fleshy fruits. It is a *Commiphora*, one of the myrrh trees, many of which have aromatic resin in their bark.
about.sw: *Mryakwembe* ni mti mdogo wenye majani yaliyogawanyika na matunda madogo yenye nyama. Ni *Commiphora*, mojawapo ya miti ya manemane, ambayo mingi yao ina utomvu wenye harufu nzuri ndani ya gome.
about.dg: *Mryakwembe* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza genye makodza madide, na matunda madide genye nyama. Ni *Commiphora*, kahi ya mihi ya *myrrh*, na mihi minji ya jenasi hino ina ulimbo wenye arufu nono kpwenye gopha rao.

where.en: It grows in bushland and woodland.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na mapori.
where.dg: Unamera vitsakani na kpwenye herera zenye mihi.

uses.en: No human use has been recorded for *mryakwembe*, despite its scientific name, *Commiphora edulis*, 'edible'.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi ya binadamu yaliyorekodiwa kwa *mryakwembe*, licha ya jina lake la kisayansi, *Commiphora edulis*, lenye maana ya 'kinacholiwa'.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga atu ga *mryakwembe* garigoandikpwa, ela dzinare ra chisayansi, *Commiphora edulis*, rina mana ya 'chinachoriwa'.

culture.en: The name, according to Pakia, means 'food of *kpwembe*', because its fruits are said to be eaten by the bird *kpwelekpwembe*.
culture.sw: Kwa mujibu wa Pakia, jina hili linamaanisha 'chakula cha *kpwembe*', kwa sababu inasemekana matunda yake huliwa na ndege *kpwelekpwembe*.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala dzina hiri rina mana ya 'chakurya cha *kpwembe*', kpwa sababu nkugombwa matundage ganariwa ni nyuni *kpwelekpwembe*.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mryakwembe* and notes that it is shared with Duruma and Giriama. No Swahili or English name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mryakwembe* na inaeleza kuwa linatumiwa pia na Waduruma na Wagiriama. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mryakwembe* na anagomba kukala dzina hiri piya ni ra Chiduruma na Chigiryama. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: Its leaves are so rough that carvers use them as sandpaper, and its name means just that.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yanakwaruza mno hivi kwamba wachongaji huyatumia kama msasa, na jina lake linamaanisha hivyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganakaraza sana hata atu anaotsonga nkugahumira dza msasa, na hiyo ndiyo mana ya dzinare.

summary.en: *Msasa*, the sandpaper fig, is a small fig tree of forest edges whose leaves are rough enough to smooth wood. Carvers use them to finish their carvings.
summary.sw: *Msasa* ni mtini mdogo wa pembezoni mwa misitu ambao majani yake yanakwaruza kiasi cha kulainisha mbao. Wachongaji huyatumia kumalizia vinyago vyao.
summary.dg: *Msasa* (kpwa Chingereza *sandpaper fig*) ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya kuyu wa kanda za matsaka, ambao makodzage ganakaraza chiasi cha kuweza kulainisha mbao. Atu anaotsonga nkugahumira kulainisha vitu virivyotsongbwa.

about.en: *Msasa* is a small fig tree. Run a hand over its leaves and you will feel why it has its name: the surface is extremely rough, like sandpaper. Like other figs, it has milky sap and small figs.
about.sw: *Msasa* ni mtini mdogo. Pitisha mkono juu ya majani yake na utahisi kwa nini una jina hili: uso wake unakwaruza mno, kama karatasi ya msasa. Kama mitini mingine, una utomvu mweupe kama maziwa na tini ndogo.
about.dg: *Msasa* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya kuyu. Uchiguta makodzage kpwa mkpwono undamanya mana ya dzinare: ganakaraza sana, dza msasa. Dza kuyu zanjina, una maziya na matunda madide ga kuyu.

where.en: It grows at forest edges and in secondary bush.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka vya pili.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye vitsaka virivyomera tsena.

uses.en: The leaves are used as sandpaper to smooth wood carvings.
uses.sw: Majani hutumika kama msasa kulainisha vinyago vya mbao.
uses.dg: Makodza nkuhumirwa dza msasa kulainisha vitu vya mbao virivyotsongbwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *msasa*, meaning 'sandpaper'. It is also the Swahili name. In English it is the sandpaper fig. It should not be confused with the English 'msasa', which is used for *Brachystegia spiciformis*, the tree the Digo call *mrihi*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *msasa*, lenye maana ya 'msasa' (karatasi ya kulainishia). Hili pia ndilo jina la Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *sandpaper fig*. Usichanganye na jina la Kiingereza *msasa*, linalotumika kwa *Brachystegia spiciformis*, mti ambao Wadigo huuita *mrihi*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *msasa*, ambaro ni neno ra Chidigo ra *sandpaper*. Piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sandpaper fig*. Usiutsanganye na *msasa* wa Chingereza, dzina rinarohumirwa kpwa *Brachystegia spiciformis*, muhi ambao Adigo anauiha *mrihi*.

teaser.en: Its gum once lights homes at night and keeps pests out of the maize store.
teaser.sw: Sandarusi yake huwasha mwanga majumbani usiku na kuzuia wadudu ghalani mwa mahindi.
teaser.dg: Kare ulimbowe watsomwa kuphaha mwanga nyumbani usiku, na kuzuwiya adudu asiinjire vitsaga vya pemba.

summary.en: *Mtandarusi*, the gum copal tree, is an evergreen tree of the coastal forests of Kwale and Kilifi with beautifully patterned bark. It produces gum copal, *sandarusi*, prized for varnish and glue and burned for light and to protect stored maize.
summary.sw: *Mtandarusi*, au *msandarusi*, ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima wa misitu ya pwani ya Kwale na Kilifi wenye gome lenye madoa ya kupendeza. Hutoa utomvu mgumu, *sandarusi*, unaothaminiwa kwa varnishi na gundi, na huchomwa kutoa mwanga na kulinda mahindi yaliyohifadhiwa.
summary.dg: *Mtandarusi* (kpwa Chingereza *gum copal tree*) ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa matsaka ga pwani ga Kwale na Kilifi, wenye gopha renye vibara vya rangi tafwauti. Unalavya ulimbo unaoihwa *sandarusi*, unaomendzwa sana kpwa *varnish* na gundi, na nkutsomwa kuphaha mwanga na kurinda pemba ziikpwazo akiba.

about.en: *Mtandarusi* is an evergreen tree from 6 to 25 metres tall. Its bark is smooth and pale grey, patterned with patches of green, pink and cream. Each leaf is just one pair of glossy leaflets, asymmetric in shape. The pods are warty.
about.sw: *Mtandarusi* ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima wenye urefu wa mita 6 hadi 25. Gome lake ni laini na la kijivu hafifu, lenye mabaka ya kijani, waridi na rangi ya krimu. Kila jani lina jozi moja tu ya vijani vinavyong'aa, visivyolingana pande mbili. Maganda yake yana vivimbe.
about.dg: *Mtandarusi* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa mita sita hadi ishirini na tsano kpwa ure. Gophare ni laini na ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu, renye vibara vya chijani, pinki na rangi ya maziya. Chila kodza ni makodza madide mairi tu ganayong'ala, na kanda mbiri za chila kodza dide si sawa-sawa. Makakaya gana vinundu-nundu.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, woodland and evergreen bushland in Kwale and Kilifi.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani, mapori na vichaka vya kijani mwaka mzima huko Kwale na Kilifi.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, herera zenye mihi na vitsaka vyenye makodza chila wakati vya Kwale na Kilifi.

uses.en:
The tree's great product is gum copal, *sandarusi*, collected from the bark and from fallen fruit. It is prized for varnish and glue. The gum is burned to light homes at night, and its smoke keeps storage pests out of maize granaries.

The tree also gives hard timber and canoes, and its fruit is edible.
uses.sw:
Zao kuu la mti huu ni utomvu mgumu, *sandarusi*, unaokusanywa kutoka kwenye gome na kutoka kwenye matunda yaliyoanguka. Unathaminiwa kwa varnishi na gundi. Sandarusi huchomwa kuangaza nyumba usiku, na moshi wake huzuia wadudu waharibifu kwenye maghala ya mahindi.

Mti huu pia hutoa mbao ngumu na mitumbwi, na tunda lake huliwa.
uses.dg:
Chitu chikulu cha muhi uhu ni ulimbo, *sandarusi*, unaohalwa kula kpwa gopha na kula kpwa matunda garigogbwa photsi. Unamendzwa sana kpwa *varnish* na gundi. Ulimbo nkutsomwa kuphaha mwanga nyumbani usiku, na mosi wa ulimbo uhu nkuzuwiya adudu anaobananga pemba asiinjire vitsaga.

Muhi piya unalavya mbao ngumu na ngarawa, na matundage ganariwa.

culture.en: Pakia records that its seeds are called *tembe za mtandarusi*.
culture.sw: Pakia inarekodi kuwa mbegu zake huitwa *tembe za mtandarusi*.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala tembeze zinaihwa *tembe za mtandarusi*.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtandarusi*; the ICRAF handbook gives *msandarusi* and *munyama*. In Swahili it is *mtandarusi* or *msandarusi*, and the gum is *sandarusi*. Giriama names are *mdzongolo* and *msange*. In English it is the gum copal tree or East African copal.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtandarusi*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *msandarusi* na *munyama*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtandarusi* au *msandarusi*, na utomvu wake ni *sandarusi*. Majina ya Kigiriama ni *mdzongolo* na *msange*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *gum copal tree* au *East African copal*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtandarusi*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *msandarusi* na *munyama*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtandarusi* au *msandarusi*, na ulimbowe ni *sandarusi*. Madzina ga Chigiryama ni *mdzongolo* na *msange*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *gum copal tree* au *East African copal*.
