definition.en: The seeds of the copal tree. They have no use, so they are called 'seeds of …'; the useful timber goes by the tree's own name.
definition.sw: Mbegu za mtandarusi. Hazina matumizi, kwa hiyo huitwa 'mbegu za …'; mbao zenye manufaa hujulikana kwa jina la mti wenyewe.
definition.dg: Tembe za *mtandarusi*. Tazina matumizi, kpwa hivyo zinaihwa 'tembe za …'; mbao za fwaida zinaihwa kpwa dzina ra muhi wenye.

teaser.en: Children go looking for its fruit, while carpenters want its hard red-yellow heartwood for pestles and mortars.
teaser.sw: Watoto huenda kutafuta matunda yake, nao maseremala hutaka kiini chake kigumu chekundu-njano kwa michi na vinu.
teaser.dg: Ana nkuhendza matundage, na mafundi a mbao nkumendza chiini chigumu cha muhi uhu, cha rangi ya kundu na mandano, kpwa kuhenda mitsi na vinu.

summary.en: *Mtsamvia* is a tall tree of riverine and groundwater forest with a pillar-like buttressed trunk and edible fruits. Children especially enjoy the fruit pulp, and the hard heartwood makes pestles, mortars and building poles.
summary.sw: *Mtsamvia*, au *msamvia*, ni mti mrefu wa misitu ya kando ya mito na misitu ya maji ya ardhini wenye shina kama nguzo lenye mizizi-ukuta na matunda yanayoliwa. Watoto hasa hufurahia nyama ya tunda lake, na kiini kigumu cha mbao zake hutengeneza michi, vinu na nguzo za ujenzi.
summary.dg: *Mtsamvia* ni muhi mure wa matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na ga madzi ga tsini, wenye kolo ririrogoloka dza nguzo, renye ngamba photsi, na matunda ganayoriwa. Ana hasa nkumendza nyama ya matunda, na chiini chigumu nkuhendwa mitsi, vinu na nguzo za kudzengera.

about.en:
*Mtsamvia* can grow to 25 metres, with a straight, pillar-like bole buttressed at the base. The bark is grey and scaly, and it bleeds white latex when cut. The leaves are long and widest near the tip. The fruits are edible.

Inside, the heartwood is hard and red-yellow.
about.sw:
*Mtsamvia* unaweza kufikia urefu wa mita 25, ukiwa na shina lililonyooka kama nguzo lenye mizizi-ukuta chini. Gome ni la kijivu na lenye magamba, na hutoa utomvu mweupe linapokatwa. Majani ni marefu na mapana zaidi karibu na ncha. Matunda yake huliwa.

Ndani, kiini cha mbao ni kigumu na cha rangi nyekundu-njano.
about.dg:
*Mtsamvia* unaweza kufika mita ishirini na tsano, wenye kolo ririrogoloka dza nguzo, renye ngamba photsi. Gopha ni ra rangi ya ivu na rinatuluka vipande-vipande, na richikatwa rinalavya maziya mereru. Makodza ni mare, na ni mapana zaidi phephi na ntsa.

Ndani, chiini ni chigumu na cha rangi ya kundu na mandano.

where.en: It grows in riverine forest and groundwater forest, where the water table is high.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya kando ya mito na misitu ya maji ya ardhini, mahali ambapo kiwango cha maji chini ya ardhi kiko juu.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na matsaka ga madzi ga tsini, ambapho madzi ga tsini ga phephi na dzulu.

uses.en:
The fruit pulp is eaten, especially by children.

The hard heartwood is used for pestles and mortars and for building poles.
uses.sw:
Nyama ya tunda huliwa, hasa na watoto.

Kiini kigumu cha mbao hutumika kwa michi na vinu na kwa nguzo za ujenzi.
uses.dg:
Nyama ya matunda nkuriwa, hasa ni ana.

Chiini chigumu nkuhumirwa kuhenda mitsi na vinu, na nguzo za kudzengera.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *mtsamvia*, with *msami* as another name. In Swahili it is *msamvia*. There is no common English name.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF vinatoa jina la Kidigo *mtsamvia*, na *msami* kama jina jingine. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *msamvia*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalojulikana sana.
names.dg: Pakia anapha dzina ra Chidigo *mtsamvia*, na chitabu cha ICRAF piya, na *msami* ni dzina ranjina. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *msamvia*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana.

teaser.en: Carpenters can pick out its planks by smell alone, and the Digo call it the 'elephant' of its kind.
teaser.sw: Maseremala wanaweza kuzitambua mbao zake kwa harufu peke yake, na Wadigo huuita 'ndovu' wa aina yake.
teaser.dg: Mafundi a mbao anaweza kumanya mbaoze kpwa arufu tu, na Adigo anauiha 'ndzovu' kahi ya mihi ya *mtsani*.

summary.en: *Mtsani ndzovu*, the large-leaved false-thorn, is a spreading tree of the wooded grassland of the southern Kenya coast. *Mtsani* is one of the main local carpentry woods, and this is its big, durable kind.
summary.sw: *Mtsani ndzovu*, au *mchani ndovu*, ni mti uliotanda wa nyika zenye miti za pwani ya kusini mwa Kenya. *Mtsani* ni mojawapo ya mbao kuu za useremala katika eneo hili, na huu ndio aina yake kubwa na inayodumu.
summary.dg: *Mtsani ndzovu* (kpwa Chingereza *large-leaved false-thorn*) ni muhi unaotandazika wa nyasini zenye mihi pwani ya kusini ya Kenya. *Mtsani* ni kahi ya mbao muhimu za mafundi a hipha, na uhu ni ainaye kulu inayokaa muda mre.

about.en: *Mtsani ndzovu* is a deciduous tree with a spreading crown. Its leaves are large and twice divided, with broad leaflets, much bigger than those of most acacia-like trees. The flowers are cream powder-puffs, and the pods are flat.
about.sw: *Mtsani ndzovu* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye kilele kilichotanda. Majani yake ni makubwa na yamegawanyika mara mbili, yakiwa na vijani vipana, vikubwa zaidi kuliko vya miti mingi inayofanana na mikakaya. Maua ni vishada vya rangi ya krimu vinavyofanana na vifuta-poda, na maganda ni bapa.
about.dg: *Mtsani ndzovu* ni muhi ambao makodzage ganagbwa kpwa muda, wenye dari inayotandazika. Makodzage ni makulu na ganaganywa mara mbiri, genye makodza madide mapana, makulu sana kuriko ga mihi minji ya *acacia*. Maruwa ni mafungu ga nyuzi ga rangi ya maziya, na makakaya ni mapana na membamba.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland of the southern Kenya coast.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika zenye miti za pwani ya kusini mwa Kenya.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye nyasini zenye mihi pwani ya kusini ya Kenya.

uses.en: *Mtsani* is one of the main local carpentry woods, and this species gives durable sawn timber. People who work with the timber identify its planks by their strong smell.
uses.sw: *Mtsani* ni mojawapo ya mbao kuu za useremala katika eneo hili, na spishi hii hutoa mbao za kupasua zinazodumu. Watu wanaofanya kazi na mbao hizi huzitambua mbao zake kwa harufu yake kali.
uses.dg: *Mtsani* ni kahi ya mbao muhimu za mafundi a hipha, na aina hino inalavya mbao zinazokaa muda mre. Atu anaohenda kazi na mbao hizi nkumanya mbaoze kpwa arufuye kali.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtsani ndzovu*, 'elephant *mtsani*', the large one, as against *mtsani tsiye*, the small one. It is shared with Duruma and Giriama. The ICRAF handbook gives *mtsani ndovu* and *mchani ndovu* for Swahili and Digo. The Mgombato dictionary lists *mtsani* for this species, with many Swahili names: *mkarati*, *mtututu*, *mkarakala*, *mhina mwitu*, *mwiza* and *mnembenembe*. In English it is the large-leaved false-thorn.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtsani ndzovu*, yaani '*mtsani* ndovu', aina kubwa, tofauti na *mtsani tsiye*, aina ndogo. Jina hili linatumiwa pia na Waduruma na Wagiriama. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mtsani ndovu* na *mchani ndovu* kwa Kiswahili na Kidigo. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaorodhesha *mtsani* kwa spishi hii, pamoja na majina mengi ya Kiswahili: *mkarati*, *mtututu*, *mkarakala*, *mhina mwitu*, *mwiza* na *mnembenembe*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *large-leaved false-thorn*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtsani ndzovu*, '*mtsani* wa ndzovu', ambao ni mkulu, tafwauti na *mtsani tsiye*, ambao ni mdide. Dzina hiri piya ni ra Chiduruma na Chigiryama. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *mtsani ndovu* na *mchani ndovu* kpwa Chiswahili na Chidigo. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *mtsani* kpwa aina hino, na madzina manji ga Chiswahili: *mkarati*, *mtututu*, *mkarakala*, *mhina mwitu*, *mwiza* na *mnembenembe*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *large-leaved false-thorn*.

teaser.sw: 'Mtsani mdogo' una majani kama ya kangaga na kilele bapa, na maseremala bado huuhesabu miongoni mwa mbao zao.
teaser.dg: *Mtsani* mdide una makodza dza ga *fern* na dari sawa-sawa, na mafundi a mbao hata sambi anauolanga kahi ya mihi yao ya mbao.

summary.en: *Mtsani tsiye*, the flat-crown albizia, is a flat-topped tree of coastal forest edges with fern-like leaves and white-green powder-puff flowers. It belongs to the *mtsani* group of trees used by carpenters.
summary.sw: *Mtsani tsiye*, au *mchani*, ni mti wenye kilele bapa wa pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani wenye majani kama ya kangaga na maua meupe-kijani yanayofanana na vifuta-poda. Ni wa kundi la miti ya *mtsani* inayotumiwa na maseremala.
summary.dg: *Mtsani tsiye* (kpwa Chingereza *flat-crown albizia*) ni muhi wenye dari sawa-sawa wa kanda za matsaka ga pwani, wenye makodza dza ga *fern* na maruwa mereru genye chijani chidide, dza mafungu ga nyuzi. Ni kahi ya mihi ya *mtsani* inayohumirwa ni mafundi a mbao.

about.en: *Mtsani tsiye* has a wide, flat top, often spreading above the trees around it. Its leaves are twice divided into many small leaflets, so they look like fern fronds. The bark is pale grey, and the flowers are white-green powder-puffs.
about.sw: *Mtsani tsiye* una kilele kipana na bapa, ambacho mara nyingi hutanda juu ya miti inayouzunguka. Majani yake yamegawanyika mara mbili katika vijani vingi vidogo, hivyo yanafanana na majani ya kangaga. Gome ni la kijivu hafifu, na maua ni meupe-kijani yanayofanana na vifuta-poda.
about.dg: *Mtsani tsiye* una dari pana sawa-sawa, ambayo mara nyinji inatandazika dzulu ya mihi inayouzunguluka. Makodzage ganaganywa mara mbiri, kuhenda makodza madide manji, kpwa hivyo ganaonekana dza makodza ga *fern*. Gopha ni ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu, na maruwa ni mafungu ga nyuzi mereru genye chijani chidide.

where.en: It grows at coastal forest edges and in secondary forest. The flat crown makes it easy to pick out on a forest margin.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani na katika misitu ya pili. Kilele chake bapa huufanya mti huu uwe rahisi kuutambua pembezoni mwa msitu.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani na kpwenye matsaka garigomera tsena. Dariye sawa-sawa inahenda ukale rahisi kuuona kanda ya tsaka.

uses.en: It is one of the *mtsani* group of trees used for timber by carpenters.
uses.sw: Ni mmojawapo wa kundi la miti ya *mtsani* inayotumiwa na maseremala kwa mbao.
uses.dg: Ni kahi ya mihi ya *mtsani* inayohumirwa ni mafundi a mbao kuhenda mbao.

names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtsani tsiye*, yaani '*mtsani* mdogo', tofauti na *mtsani ndzovu*, aina kubwa. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mchani*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *flat-crown albizia*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtsani tsiye*, '*mtsani* mdide', tafwauti na *mtsani ndzovu*, ambao ni mkulu. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mchani*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *flat-crown albizia*.

teaser.en: Its leaves look like a camel's footprint, its pods lather like soap, and it is used to make a person admired.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yanafanana na unyayo wa ngamia, maganda yake hutoa povu kama sabuni, na hutumika kumfanya mtu apendwe na kusifiwa.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganaigana na alama ya chigulu cha ngamia, makakayage ganalavya fulo dza sabuni, na nkuhumirwa kuhenda mutu atogolwe.

summary.en: *Mtseketse*, the camel's foot, is a rounded tree of sandy wooded grassland with big two-lobed leaves. Its pods and roots serve as soap, its bark gives dye, and it is used in Digo magic to bring success.
summary.sw: *Mtseketse*, au *msegese*, ni mti wenye umbo la duara wa nyika zenye miti kwenye udongo wa kichanga, wenye majani makubwa yaliyogawanyika pande mbili. Maganda na mizizi yake hutumika kama sabuni, gome lake hutoa rangi, na hutumika katika uganga wa Kidigo kuleta mafanikio.
summary.dg: *Mtseketse* (kpwa Chingereza *camel's foot*) ni muhi wa umbo ra mviringo wa nyasini zenye mihi, kpwa tsi ya mtsanga, wenye makodza makulu genye mala mairi. Makakayage na miziye nkuhumirwa dza sabuni, gophare rinalavya rangi, na Adigo nkuuhumira kpwa uganga wa kuhenda mutu afanikiwe.

about.en: *Mtseketse* is a small rounded tree, usually 3 to 5 metres tall. Its leaves are the giveaway: large, leathery and split into two rounded lobes, they look like the print of a camel's foot. The flowers are white, and the pods are thick and woody.
about.sw: *Mtseketse* ni mti mdogo wenye umbo la duara, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa mita 3 hadi 5. Majani yake ndiyo yanayoutambulisha: makubwa, magumu kama ngozi na yamegawanyika katika pande mbili za mviringo, yanafanana na alama ya unyayo wa ngamia. Maua ni meupe, na maganda ni manene na magumu kama mti.
about.dg: *Mtseketse* ni muhi mdide wa umbo ra mviringo, mara nyinji wa mita tahu hadi tsano kpwa ure. Uchilola makodzage undaumanya: ni makulu, magumu dza chingo, na ganaganyika mala mairi ga mviringo, dza alama ya chigulu cha ngamia. Maruwa ni mereru, na makakaya ni maziho na magumu dza mbao.

where.en: It grows in open wooded grassland on sandy soils.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika wazi zenye miti kwenye udongo wa kichanga.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye nyasini za wazi zenye mihi, kpwa tsi ya mtsanga.

uses.en:
The pods and roots are used as soap. The bark and roots give a red-brown dye.

The pulp of the pods is edible. The tree is also used in traditional medicine, and for posts and fibre.
uses.sw:
Maganda na mizizi hutumika kama sabuni. Gome na mizizi hutoa rangi nyekundu-kahawia.

Nyama ya maganda huliwa. Mti huu pia hutumika katika tiba ya jadi, na kwa nguzo na nyuzi.
uses.dg:
Makakaya na mizi nkuhumirwa dza sabuni. Gopha na mizi vinalavya rangi ya dongo ya kundu-kundu.

Nyama ya ndani ya makakaya nkuriwa. Muhi piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji, na kpwa nguzo na nyuzi.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name *mtseketse* as 'tinkle' or 'amusement', and records that the plant is used magically to make a person successful or admired in an institution.
culture.sw: Pakia inaeleza jina *mtseketse* kuwa linamaanisha 'mlio wa kengele ndogo' au 'burudani', na inarekodi kuwa mmea huu hutumika kiuganga kumfanya mtu afanikiwe au apendwe na kusifiwa katika taasisi.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala dzina *mtseketse* rina mana ya 'mlio wa kengele ndide' au 'mzaha', na anaandika kukala mmea uhu nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga ili mutu afanikiwe au atogolwe kahi ya taasisi.

names.en: The Digo name is *mtseketse*, also written *mtsekeshe*; Pakia, the ICRAF handbook and the Mgombato dictionary all record it. In Swahili it is *msegese* or *mchekeche*, and Mgombato adds *mchekecheke*, *mkoma*, *mchekwa*, *mkuungo*, *msabuni* and *mubamba ngoma*. The Giriama name is *mkayamba*. In English it is the camel's foot.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mtseketse*, linaloandikwa pia *mtsekeshe*; Pakia, kitabu cha ICRAF na kamusi ya Mgombato zote zinalirekodi. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *msegese* au *mchekeche*, na Mgombato inaongeza *mchekecheke*, *mkoma*, *mchekwa*, *mkuungo*, *msabuni* na *mubamba ngoma*. Jina la Kigiriama ni *mkayamba*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *camel's foot*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mtseketse*, ambaro piya rinaandikpwa *mtsekeshe*; Pakia, chitabu cha ICRAF na kamusi ya Mgombato vyosi vinariandika. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *msegese* au *mchekeche*, na Mgombato inaenjereza *mchekecheke*, *mkoma*, *mchekwa*, *mkuungo*, *msabuni* na *mubamba ngoma*. Dzina ra Chigiryama ni *mkayamba*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *camel's foot*.

teaser.en: Eat the ripe pulp, never the seeds, then dry the shell and you have a musical rattle.
teaser.sw: Kula nyama ya tunda lililoiva, kamwe si mbegu, kisha kausha ganda lake na utapata kayamba la muziki.
teaser.dg: Rya nyama ya tunda ririroivwa bahi, usirye tembe; chisha anika gada, na undaphaha chombo cha muziki dza kayamba.

summary.en: *Muhonga*, the spiny monkey orange, is a thorny small tree of dry woodland and coastal bush with large round fruits that ripen yellow. The ripe pulp is eaten, the dry shell becomes a rattle, and the roots repel insects.
summary.sw: *Muhonga*, au *mtonga*, ni mti mdogo wenye miiba wa mapori makavu na vichaka vya pwani wenye matunda makubwa ya mviringo yanayogeuka njano yanapoiva. Nyama ya tunda lililoiva huliwa, ganda lililokauka hugeuka kayamba, na mizizi hufukuza wadudu.
summary.dg: *Muhonga* (kpwa Chingereza *spiny monkey orange*) ni muhi mdide wenye miya wa matsaka makavu ga wazi na wa vitsaka vya pwani, wenye matunda makulu ga mviringo ganagokala ga rangi ya mandano gachiivwa. Nyama ya matunda garigoivwa nkuriwa, gada kavu nkuhendwa chombo cha muziki dza kayamba, na mizi nkuhumirwa kuzoresa adudu.

about.en: *Muhonga* is a thorny tree 2 to 5 metres tall. The leaves are round and leathery, with three to five veins running from the base. The fruit is large, round and hard-shelled, about the size of an orange, turning yellow as it ripens.
about.sw: *Muhonga* ni mti wenye miiba wenye urefu wa mita 2 hadi 5. Majani yake ni ya mviringo na magumu kama ngozi, yakiwa na mishipa mitatu hadi mitano inayoanzia kwenye kitako cha jani. Tunda ni kubwa, la mviringo na lenye ganda gumu, karibu ukubwa wa chungwa, na hugeuka njano linapoiva.
about.dg: *Muhonga* ni muhi wenye miya wa mita 2 hadi 5. Makodza ni ga mviringo na magumu dza chingo, na gana mishipa mihahu hadi mitsano inayoandzira photsi ya kodza. Tunda ni kulu, ra mviringo na rina gada gumu, ukulu wa chungbwa hivi, na rinakala ra rangi ya mandano richiivwa.

where.en: It grows in dry woodland and coastal bushland.
where.sw: Huota katika mapori makavu na vichaka vya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu ga wazi na vitsaka vya pwani.

uses.en:
The ripe fruit pulp is eaten. The unripe fruit and the seeds are poisonous, so only the pulp of ripe fruit is eaten.

The dry shell is made into a musical rattle. The roots are used to repel insects, and the plant is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Nyama ya tunda lililoiva huliwa. Tunda bichi na mbegu ni sumu, kwa hiyo ni nyama ya tunda lililoiva tu inayoliwa.

Ganda lililokauka hutengenezwa kuwa kayamba la muziki. Mizizi hutumika kufukuza wadudu, na mmea huu hutumika katika tiba ya jadi.
uses.dg:
Nyama ya matunda garigoivwa nkuriwa. Matunda maitsi na tembe zina sumu, kpwa hivyo nkuriwa nyama ya matunda garigoivwa bahi.

Gada kavu nkuhendwa chombo cha muziki dza kayamba. Mizi nkuhumirwa kuzoresa adudu, na mmea nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *muhonga*, with *mursapungu* as another name. *Muhonga* is also listed as a name for the black monkey orange, *mkpwakpwa*. In Swahili it is *mtonga*, and in Giriama *mujaje*. In English it is the spiny monkey orange.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF vinatoa jina la Kidigo *muhonga*, na *mursapungu* kama jina jingine. *Muhonga* pia limeorodheshwa kama jina la *black monkey orange*, *mkpwakpwa*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtonga*, na kwa Kigiriama *mujaje*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *spiny monkey orange*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *muhonga* rinaphahikana kpwa Pakia na kpwenye chitabu cha ICRAF, na *mursapungu* ni dzina ranjina. *Muhonga* piya rikaandikpwa dza dzina ra *mkpwakpwa* (*black monkey orange*). Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtonga*, na kpwa Chigiryama ni *mujaje*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *spiny monkey orange*.

teaser.en: Second only to African blackwood for carving, this fragrant wood has become so scarce that carvers may cut only a few trees.
teaser.sw: Kwa uchongaji, ni wa pili tu baada ya mpingo; mbao hii yenye harufu nzuri imekuwa adimu kiasi kwamba wachongaji wanaruhusiwa kukata miti michache tu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa kutsonga, mbao zenye arufu nono za muhi uhu zinatsupwa ni mphingo tu, na sambi ni adimu hata atu anaotsonga anaruhusiwa kukata mihi michache tu.

summary.en: *Muhuhu* is an evergreen tree of dry coastal forest whose hard, fragrant wood is second only to African blackwood for carving. Heavy cutting has made it Near Threatened, and mature trees now survive mostly in protected areas.
summary.sw: *Muhuhu* ni mti wa kijani kibichi mwaka mzima unaopatikana katika misitu mikavu ya pwani, na mbao yake ngumu yenye harufu nzuri ni ya pili tu baada ya mpingo kwa uchongaji. Ukataji mwingi umeufanya kuwa Karibu Kuwa Hatarini, na miti iliyokomaa sasa imebaki hasa katika maeneo yaliyohifadhiwa.
summary.dg: *Muhuhu* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa matsaka makavu ga pwani, ambao mbaoze ngumu zenye arufu nono zinatsupwa ni mphingo tu kpwa kutsonga. Kukatwa sana kukahenda ukale *Near Threatened* (phephi na kukala hatarini), na mihi mikulu sambi inasala zaidi kpwenye maeneo ga hifadhi.

about.en: *Muhuhu* is an evergreen tree 8 to 15 metres tall, with branches that climb steeply upward. The leaves are spear-shaped, shiny above and covered in white felt below, so the tree flashes silvery-grey when the wind turns the leaves. The bark is grey and fibrous, peeling away in strips.
about.sw: *Muhuhu* ni mti wa kijani kibichi mwaka mzima wenye urefu wa mita 8 hadi 15, na matawi yanayopanda juu kwa mwinuko mkali. Majani yake yana umbo la mkuki, yanang'aa upande wa juu na yamefunikwa na manyoya meupe upande wa chini, hivyo mti humeta rangi ya kijivu-fedha upepo unapoyageuza majani. Gome lake ni la kijivu na lenye nyuzi, linalobanduka kwa vipande virefu.
about.dg: *Muhuhu* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa mita 8 hadi 15, wenye panda zinazofyombera dzulu chocho. Makodzage ni dza fumo, ganaala dzulu, na photsi gana manyoya meereru, kpwa hivyo muhi unaoneka wa rangi ya feza na ivu phepho richigaluza makodza. Gophare ni ra rangi ya ivu na ra nyuzi-nyuzi, na rinaandula kpwa vipande vire.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal forest and bushland. Mature trees are now scarce and are found mainly in protected areas.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu mikavu ya pwani na vichakani. Miti iliyokomaa sasa ni adimu na hupatikana hasa katika maeneo yaliyohifadhiwa.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu ga pwani na weruni. Mihi mikulu sambi ni michache, na inaphahikana zaidi kpwenye maeneo ga hifadhi.

uses.en:
Muhuhu is a carver's wood, second only to African blackwood. It is also used for flooring, and for poles and posts that resist termites.

A fragrant essential oil is distilled from the wood.
uses.sw:
Muhuhu ni mbao ya wachongaji, ya pili tu baada ya mpingo. Pia hutumika kwa sakafu, na kwa nguzo na milingoti isiyoliwa na mchwa.

Mafuta yenye harufu nzuri hukamuliwa kutoka kwenye mbao yake.
uses.dg:
*Muhuhu* ni mbao za kutsonga, za phiri bada ya mphingo tu. Piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda sakafu, na kuhenda nguzo na mihi isiyoriwa ni lutswa.

Mafuha genye arufu nono nkulavywa kula mbaoze.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *muhuhu*, and Pakia notes it is shared by Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is also called muhuhu. The Mgombato dictionary gives a different Digo name, *mfufu*, 'silver oak', with Swahili *muhuhu*, and notes that woodcarvers use it extensively but are allowed only a limited number of trees.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF wanatoa jina la Kidigo *muhuhu*, na Pakia anaeleza kwamba jina hili linatumika na Wadigo, Waduruma, Wagiriama na Waswahili. Kwa Kiingereza pia unaitwa *muhuhu*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa jina tofauti la Kidigo, *mfufu*, 'silver oak', lenye Kiswahili *muhuhu*, na inaeleza kwamba wachongaji huutumia sana lakini wanaruhusiwa idadi ndogo tu ya miti.
names.dg: Pakia na chitabu cha ICRAF anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *muhuhu*, na Pakia anaandika kukala dzina hiri ni ra Chidigo, Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza piya unaihwa *muhuhu*. Mgombato unalavya dzina ranjina ra Chidigo, *mfufu*, 'silver oak', na Chiswahili *muhuhu*, na unaandika kukala atu anaotsonga nkuuhumira sana ela anaruhusiwa kukata mihi michache tu.

conservation.en: Muhuhu is listed as Near Threatened on the IUCN Red List. Mature trees are now scarce and largely confined to protected areas, and carvers are allowed to use only a limited number.
conservation.sw: Muhuhu umeorodheshwa kama Karibu Kuwa Hatarini (Near Threatened) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN. Miti iliyokomaa sasa ni adimu na kwa kiasi kikubwa imebaki katika maeneo yaliyohifadhiwa, na wachongaji wanaruhusiwa kutumia idadi ndogo tu.
conservation.dg: *Muhuhu* ukaandikpwa *Near Threatened* (phephi na kukala hatarini) kpwenye IUCN Red List. Mihi mikulu sambi ni michache na inaphahikana zaidi kpwenye maeneo ga hifadhi, na atu anaotsonga anaruhusiwa kuhumira mihi michache tu.

summary.en: *Muhumba tsaka*, the long-pod cassia, is a small tree of bushland and forest edges with yellow flower clusters and very long dark pods. Its bark and roots are used in traditional medicine, and its wood for timber and poles.
summary.sw: *Muhumba tsaka*, au *mbaraka*, ni mti mdogo wa vichaka na pembezoni mwa misitu wenye vishada vya maua ya njano na maganda marefu sana yenye rangi nyeusi. Gome na mizizi yake hutumika katika tiba ya jadi, na mbao zake kwa mbao za ujenzi na nguzo.
summary.dg: *Muhumba tsaka* (kpwa Chingereza *long-pod cassia*) ni muhi mdide wa vitsaka na wa kanda-kanda ya matsaka, wenye mabunda ga maruwa ga rangi ya mandano na makakaya mare sana na maru. Gophare na miziye nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji, na nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa dza mbao na nguzo.

about.en: *Muhumba tsaka* is a small tree. It bears clusters of bright yellow flowers, followed by its most distinctive feature: very long, cylindrical, dark pods that hang from the branches.
about.sw: *Muhumba tsaka* ni mti mdogo. Huzaa vishada vya maua ya njano angavu, vinavyofuatwa na sifa yake bainifu zaidi: maganda marefu sana, yenye umbo la mcheduara na rangi nyeusi, yanayoning'inia kutoka matawini.
about.dg: *Muhumba tsaka* ni muhi mdide. Unalavya mabunda ga maruwa ga rangi ya mandano inayoala, na bada yao kunatuluka chitu chinachoutafwautisha zaidi: makakaya mare sana, ga umbo dza bakora na maru, ganagobwadzika kula pandani.

where.en: It grows in bushland and at the edges of coastal forest.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka na kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani.

uses.en: The bark and roots are used in traditional medicine. The wood is used for timber and poles. Among the Giriama, it is used to mark graves.
uses.sw: Gome na mizizi hutumika katika tiba ya jadi. Mbao zake hutumika kwa mbao za ujenzi na nguzo. Miongoni mwa Wagiriama, hutumika kuweka alama kwenye makaburi.
uses.dg: Gopha na mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji. Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa dza mbao na nguzo. Kpwa Agiryama, nkuhumirwa kuika alama kpwenye mbira.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *muhumba tsaka*; the ICRAF handbook gives *muhumba mkulu*, which is also the Giriama name. In Swahili it is *mbaraka*. In English it is the long-pod cassia. The Mgombato dictionary uses *muhumba* for a different plant, *Cassia occidentalis*, and Pakia gives *muhumba* to the winter cassia, *Senna singueana*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *muhumba tsaka*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *muhumba mkulu*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mbaraka*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *long-pod cassia*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia *muhumba* kwa mmea mwingine, *Cassia occidentalis*, na Pakia inalitoa jina *muhumba* kwa *winter cassia*, *Senna singueana*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *muhumba tsaka*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *muhumba mkulu*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chigiryama. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mbaraka*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *long-pod cassia*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inahumira *muhumba* kpwa mmea wanjina, *Cassia occidentalis*, na Pakia anapha dzina *muhumba* kpwa *winter cassia*, *Senna singueana*.

teaser.sw: Majani yake yanayong'aa hugeuka meusi yakikauka, na matunda yake meusi huvaa kofia ndogo nyekundu.

summary.en: *Mungowengowe*, the white pear, is an evergreen tree of coastal forest with shiny leaves and black fruits topped with red. Its hard pink wood is used for building and tool handles.
summary.sw: *Mungowengowe*, au *mlambusi mbage*, ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima wa misitu ya pwani wenye majani yanayong'aa na matunda meusi yenye kofia nyekundu. Mbao zake ngumu za rangi ya waridi hutumika kwa ujenzi na mipini ya zana.
summary.dg: *Mungowengowe* (kpwa Chingereza *white pear*) ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa matsaka ga pwani, wenye makodza ganagoala na matunda maru genye seemu ya kundu dzuluge. Nyama za muhi, zirizo ngumu na za pinki, nkuhumirwa kudzenga na kuhenda mipini ya vyombo.

about.en: *Mungowengowe* is an evergreen tree with shiny leaves that turn black as they dry. The flowers are small and white. The fruits are black, each with a red, fleshy appendage attached, a colour pair that attracts birds.
about.sw: *Mungowengowe* ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima wenye majani yanayong'aa ambayo hugeuka meusi yanapokauka. Maua ni madogo na meupe. Matunda ni meusi, kila moja likiwa na kiambatisho chekundu chenye nyama, jozi ya rangi inayowavutia ndege.
about.dg: *Mungowengowe* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, na makodzage ganagoala ganakala maru ganaphouma. Maruwa ni madide na mereru. Matunda ni maru, na chila tunda rina chipande cha nyama cha kundu chiricho phamwenga naro; rangi hizi mbiri phamwenga zinamweha nyuni.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, and also in highland forest elsewhere in Kenya.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani, na pia katika misitu ya nyanda za juu katika sehemu nyingine za Kenya.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, na piya kpwenye matsaka ga tsi za dzulu phatu phanjina Kenya.

uses.en: The hard, pink wood is used for building and for tool handles. The bark is used in traditional medicine, and bees forage on the flowers.
uses.sw: Mbao ngumu za rangi ya waridi hutumika kwa ujenzi na kwa mipini ya zana. Gome hutumika katika tiba ya jadi, na nyuki hutafuta chakula kwenye maua yake.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi, zirizo ngumu na za pinki, nkuhumirwa kudzenga na kuhenda mipini ya vyombo. Gopha nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji, na nyuchi nkuhendza chakurya kpwenye maruwa.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives two Digo names, *mungowengowe* and *mtsunga mbuzi*; *mtsunga* is the Digo word for leafy vegetables in the Mgombato dictionary, and *mbuzi* means goat. In Swahili it is *mlambusi mbage*. In English it is the white pear.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mungowengowe* na *mtsunga mbuzi*; katika kamusi ya Mgombato *mtsunga* ni neno la Kidigo la mboga za majani, na *mbuzi* ni mbuzi, kama ilivyo kwa Kiswahili. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mlambusi mbage*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *white pear*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mungowengowe* na *mtsunga mbuzi*; kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, *mtsunga* ni neno ra Chidigo ra makodza ganagoriwa dza mboga, na *mbuzi* ni mbuzi wa kufugbwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mlambusi mbage*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *white pear*.

teaser.en: The 'water drinker' keeps its feet by the river, and its scarlet-and-black seeds give a prized oil yet are deadly poisonous.
teaser.sw: 'Mnywa maji' huweka miguu yake kando ya mto, na mbegu zake nyekundu na nyeusi hutoa mafuta yanayothaminiwa, ingawa ni sumu kali.
teaser.dg: *Munwa madzi*, 'muhi unaonwa madzi', unaika maguluge kanda-kanda ya muho, na tembeze za kundu na nyiru zinalavya mafuha ganagomendzwa sana, ela zina sumu inayoolaga.

summary.en: *Munwa madzi*, the Natal mahogany, is a dense, dark-green evergreen tree of riverbanks and moist forest. Its seeds give an oil for skin and for protecting beehives, its wood makes furniture and carvings, and its bark and roots are used as medicine.
summary.sw: *Munwa madzi*, au *mwamaji*, ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima wenye majani mazito ya kijani iliyokolea, wa kingo za mito na misitu yenye unyevu. Mbegu zake hutoa mafuta ya ngozi na ya kulinda mizinga ya nyuki, mbao zake hutengeneza samani na vinyago, na gome na mizizi yake hutumika kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Munwa madzi* (kpwa Chingereza *Natal mahogany*) ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, makodza manji ga chijani sana, wa kanda-kanda ya miho na wa matsaka ga jeke-jeke. Tembeze zinalavya mafuha ga kupaka ngozi na ga kurinda mizinga ya nyuchi, nyama za muhi nkuhendwa fanicha na vitu vya kutsonga, na gophare na miziye nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

about.en:
*Munwa madzi* is an evergreen tree 15 to 30 metres tall, with a dense crown of dark, glossy leaves that casts deep shade. Each compound leaf has four or five pairs of leaflets.

The fruits are round capsules that split open to show black seeds, each partly wrapped in a bright red aril.
about.sw:
*Munwa madzi* ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima wenye urefu wa mita 15 hadi 30, wenye kilele kizito cha majani yanayong'aa ya kijani iliyokolea kinachotoa kivuli kizito. Kila jani lililogawanyika lina jozi nne au tano za vijani.

Matunda ni vifuko vya mviringo vinavyopasuka na kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi, kila moja ikiwa imefunikwa kwa sehemu na ganda-nyama jekundu angavu.
about.dg:
*Munwa madzi* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa mita 15 hadi 30, wenye dari ya makodza manji ga chijani sana ganagoala, inayohenda chivuri chikulu. Chila kodza ra kuungana rina makodza madide manane au kumi, airi-airi.

Matunda ni makakaya ga mviringo ganagoahuka na kuonyesa tembe nyiru, na seemu ya chila tembe inafwinikpwa ni chitu cha nyama cha kundu chinachoala (*aril*).

where.en: It grows on riverbanks and in moist forest, true to its Digo name.
where.sw: Huota kwenye kingo za mito na katika misitu yenye unyevu, kama jina lake la Kidigo linavyoashiria.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya miho na kpwenye matsaka ga jeke-jeke, dza dzinare ra Chidigo rinavyogomba.

uses.en:
Oil from the seeds is used on the skin and to protect beehives. The leaves are soapy.

The wood is used for furniture, poles and carvings. The bark and roots are used in traditional medicine.

The seeds themselves are very poisonous.
uses.sw:
Mafuta ya mbegu hupakwa kwenye ngozi na hutumika kulinda mizinga ya nyuki. Majani hutoa povu kama sabuni.

Mbao hutumika kwa samani, nguzo na vinyago. Gome na mizizi hutumika katika tiba ya jadi.

Mbegu zenyewe ni sumu kali.
uses.dg:
Mafuha ga tembe nkuhumirwa kupaka ngozi na kurinda mizinga ya nyuchi. Makodza ni dza sabuni.

Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda fanicha, nguzo na vitu vya kutsonga. Gopha na mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji.

Ela tembe zina sumu kali sana.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *munwa madzi*, also written *mnwa madzi*, meaning 'water drinker', because it grows by rivers. Giriama names are *munwa madzi* and *mgalana*. In Swahili it is *mwamaji* or *mtimai*. In English it is the Natal mahogany or Cape mahogany.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF vinatoa jina la Kidigo *munwa madzi*, linaloandikwa pia *mnwa madzi*, lenye maana ya 'mnywa maji', kwa sababu huota kando ya mito. Majina ya Kigiriama ni *munwa madzi* na *mgalana*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mwamaji* au *mtimai*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *Natal mahogany* au *Cape mahogany*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *munwa madzi*, ririroandikpwa piya *mnwa madzi*, rinaphahikana kpwa Pakia na kpwenye chitabu cha ICRAF; manaye ni 'unaonwa madzi', kpwa sababu unamera kanda-kanda ya miho. Madzina ga Chigiryama ni *munwa madzi* na *mgalana*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mwamaji* au *mtimai*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *Natal mahogany* au *Cape mahogany*.

teaser.en: Before iron nails came from abroad, there was the 'hinterland nail': pegs cut from this tree's hard wood.
teaser.sw: Kabla misumari ya chuma haijaletwa kutoka ng'ambo, kulikuwa na 'msumari wa bara': vigingi vilivyochongwa kutoka mbao ngumu za mti huu.
teaser.dg: Kabla ya misumari ya chuma kpwedza kula ng'ambo, kala kuna 'msumari wa bara': vipande vya mbao vinavyokatwa kula nyama ngumu za muhi uhu.

summary.en: *Mvamva* is a tree of bushed grassland and coastal forest with purple pea flowers, velvety pods and very hard wood. That wood is made into wooden nails, which gave it the name *msumari bara*, 'hinterland nail'.
summary.sw: *Mvamva* ni mti wa nyika zenye vichaka na misitu ya pwani wenye maua ya zambarau kama ya kunde, maganda yenye manyoya laini kama velvet na mbao ngumu sana. Mbao hizo hutengenezwa kuwa misumari ya mbao, jambo lililoupa jina *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara'.
summary.dg: *Mvamva* ni muhi wa nyasi zenye vitsaka na wa matsaka ga pwani, wenye maruwa ga zambarau dza ga kunde, makakaya genye nyere laini na nyama za muhi ngumu sana. Nyama hizo nkuhendwa misumari ya mbao, na ndiyo mana ukaihwa *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara'.

about.en: *Mvamva* is a tree with pinnate leaves and purple pea-flowers, followed by velvety pods. The wood is hard.
about.sw: *Mvamva* ni mti wenye majani yaliyogawanyika kama manyoya na maua ya zambarau kama ya kunde, yanayofuatwa na maganda yenye manyoya laini kama velvet. Mbao zake ni ngumu.
about.dg: *Mvamva* ni muhi wenye makodza ga kuungana, genye makodza madide airi-airi, na maruwa ga zambarau ga umbo dza maruwa ga kunde, na bada yao kunatuluka makakaya genye nyere laini. Nyama za muhi ni ngumu.

where.en: It grows in bushed grassland and coastal forest.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika zenye vichaka na misitu ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye nyasi zenye vitsaka na kpwenye matsaka ga pwani.

uses.en: The hard wood is made into wooden nails.
uses.sw: Mbao ngumu hutengenezwa kuwa misumari ya mbao.
uses.dg: Nyama ngumu za muhi nkuhendwa misumari ya mbao.

culture.en: Its second name, *msumari bara*, 'hinterland nail', marks the difference between nails made at home from this wood and imported iron nails (Pakia).
culture.sw: Jina lake la pili, *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara', linaonyesha tofauti kati ya misumari iliyotengenezwa nyumbani kwa mbao hizi na misumari ya chuma iliyoletwa kutoka nje (Pakia).
culture.dg: Dzinare ra phiri, *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara', rinaonyesa tafwauti kahi ya misumari iriyohendwa kaya kula nyama za muhi uhu na misumari ya chuma iriyorehwa kula ng'ambo (Pakia).

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mvamva*, which is shared with Duruma, and *msumari bara*, 'hinterland nail', which is also the Swahili name. No English name is in common use.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mvamva*, linalotumiwa pia na Waduruma, na *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara', ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalotumika kwa kawaida.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo: *mvamva*, ambaro piya ni ra Chiduruma, na *msumari bara*, 'msumari wa bara', ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana.

teaser.en: Its giant sausage-shaped fruits hang on rope-like stalks and are used to ferment traditional beer.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake makubwa mno yenye umbo la soseji huning'inia kwenye mashina kama kamba na hutumika kuchachusha pombe ya kienyeji.
teaser.dg: Matundage makulu sana ga umbo dza soseji ganabwadzika kpwa milita mire dza kamba, na nkuhumirwa kuhenda uchi wa chienyeji uumuke.

summary.en: *Mvungunya*, the sausage tree, is a riverine tree with dark red bell flowers on long rope-like stalks and huge sausage-shaped fruits. The fruit is used to ferment traditional beer, the wood makes mortars, canoes and beehives, and the tree is widely revered.
summary.sw: *Mvungunya*, au *mwegea*, ni mti wa kando ya mito wenye maua mekundu iliyokolea yenye umbo la kengele kwenye mashina marefu kama kamba, na matunda makubwa mno yenye umbo la soseji. Tunda hutumika kuchachusha pombe ya kienyeji, mbao hutengeneza vinu, mitumbwi na mizinga ya nyuki, na mti huu unaheshimiwa sana katika maeneo mengi.
summary.dg: *Mvungunya* ni muhi wa kanda-kanda ya miho, wenye maruwa ga kundu sana ga umbo dza kengele ganagobwadzika kpwa milita mire dza kamba, na matunda makulu sana ga umbo dza soseji. Tunda nkuhumirwa kuhenda uchi wa chienyeji uumuke, nyama za muhi nkuhendwa vinu, mitumbwi na mizinga ya nyuchi, na muhi uhu unaishimiwa ni atu anji.

about.en:
*Mvungunya* is impossible to mistake. Its dark red, bell-shaped flowers hang on rope-like stalks two to three metres long. They open at night and are visited by bats.

The fruits that follow are huge, sausage-shaped and heavy, dangling from the same long stalks. The leaves are rough and grow in threes. The tree is semi-deciduous, dropping some of its leaves in the dry season.
about.sw:
*Mvungunya* hauwezi kukosewa. Maua yake mekundu iliyokolea yenye umbo la kengele huning'inia kwenye mashina kama kamba yenye urefu wa mita mbili hadi tatu. Huchanua usiku na hutembelewa na popo.

Matunda yanayofuata ni makubwa mno, yenye umbo la soseji na mazito, yakining'inia kwenye mashina yale yale marefu. Majani yanakwaruza na huota matatu matatu. Mti huu hupukutisha sehemu ya majani yake wakati wa kiangazi.
about.dg:
*Mvungunya* ni rahisi sana kuumanya. Maruwage ga kundu sana, ga umbo dza kengele, ganabwadzika kpwa milita mire dza kamba, ya ure wa mita mbiri hadi tahu. Ganavuguka usiku na nkuedzerwa ni manundu.

Matunda ganagoedza nyuma ni makulu sana, ga umbo dza soseji, na ni maziho, ganabwadzika kpwa milita ihiyo mire. Makodzage ni ga kukaraza na ganamera mahahu-mahahu. Makodzage ganjina nkugbwa wakati wa kazikazi, ela tagagbwa gosi.

where.en: It grows in riverine forest and wooded grassland. The hanging fruits make it easy to spot all year.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya kando ya mito na nyika zenye miti. Matunda yanayoning'inia huufanya uwe rahisi kuuona mwaka mzima.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga kanda-kanda ya miho na kpwenye mavuwe genye mihi. Matundage ganagobwadzika ganahenda uonekane rahisi mwaka wosi.

uses.en:
The fruits are used to ferment traditional beer, and the Digo are among the peoples recorded doing this.

The wood is used for mortars, canoes and beehives. The fruit, bark and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Matunda hutumika kuchachusha pombe ya kienyeji, na Wadigo ni miongoni mwa jamii zilizorekodiwa zikifanya hivyo.

Mbao hutumika kwa vinu, mitumbwi na mizinga ya nyuki. Tunda, gome na mizizi hutumika katika tiba ya jadi.
uses.dg:
Matunda nkuhumirwa kuhenda uchi wa chienyeji uumuke, na Adigo ni kahi ya atu anaoandikpwa kuhenda vivi.

Nyama za muhi nkuhendwa vinu, mitumbwi na mizinga ya nyuchi. Matunda, gopha na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: The sausage tree is widely revered as a ceremonial tree. One of its Digo names, *mratina*, comes from the name of the brew, *muratina*, that its fruit helps make.
culture.sw: Mwegea unaheshimiwa sana katika maeneo mengi kama mti wa sherehe za kimila. Mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo, *mratina*, linatokana na jina la pombe, *muratina*, ambayo tunda lake husaidia kuitengeneza.
culture.dg: *Mvungunya* unaishimiwa sana dza muhi wa chimila. Dzina ranjina ra Chidigo, *mratina*, rinatuluka kpwa dzina ra uchi *muratina*, ambao matundage nkuterya kuuhenda.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mvungunya* and *mratina*, the second borrowed from the name of the beer *muratina*. In Swahili it is *mwegea*, *mwengea* or *mvungunya*, and in Giriama *mobwoka* or *muratina*. In English it is the sausage tree.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mvungunya* na *mratina*, la pili likiwa limetoholewa kutoka jina la pombe *muratina*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mwegea*, *mwengea* au *mvungunya*, na kwa Kigiriama *mobwoka* au *muratina*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *sausage tree*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mvungunya* na *mratina*; ra phiri rikahalwa kula dzina ra uchi *muratina*. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mwegea*, *mwengea* au *mvungunya*, na kpwa Chigiryama *mobwoka* au *muratina*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sausage tree*.

teaser.en: Carpenters know a mvure plank by its smell, and its timber is so prized that the tree is now rare in Kenya.
teaser.sw: Maseremala hutambua ubao wa mvure kwa harufu yake, na mbao zake zinathaminiwa sana kiasi kwamba mti huu sasa ni adimu nchini Kenya.
teaser.dg: Mafundi a mbao nkumanya libao ra *mvure* kpwa arufuye, na mbao za muhi uhu zina samani kulu hata sambi ukakala adimu Kenya.

summary.en: *Mvure* is the mvule or iroko, a giant forest tree with a tall clean trunk and one of the finest timbers in Africa. Prized for furniture, doors and boats, it has been cut so heavily that it is now rare in Kenya.
summary.sw: *Mvure* ni mvule, mti mkubwa mno wa msituni wenye shina refu lisilo na matawi na mojawapo ya mbao bora zaidi barani Afrika. Unathaminiwa kwa samani, milango na mashua, na umekatwa kwa wingi sana kiasi kwamba sasa ni adimu nchini Kenya.
summary.dg: *Mvure* ni muhi mkulu sana wa tsaka, wenye kolo rire risiro na panda, na mbaoze ni kahi ya mbao nono zaidi Afrika. Atu nkumendza mbaoze kpwa kuhenda fanicha, myango na madau, na ukakatwa sana hata sambi ni adimu Kenya.

about.en:
*Mvure* is a giant, reaching 30 metres, with a tall, straight trunk free of branches and a high, umbrella-shaped crown. The bark is pale grey and oozes a milky latex when cut. The leaves are large and oval. It drops its leaves in the dry season.

The heartwood is golden-brown and resists termites.
about.sw:
*Mvure* ni mti mkubwa mno, unaofikia mita 30, wenye shina refu lililonyooka lisilo na matawi na taji la juu lenye umbo la mwavuli. Gamba ni la kijivu hafifu na hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa likikatwa. Majani ni makubwa na ya umbo la yai. Hupukutisha majani wakati wa kiangazi.

Kiini cha mbao ni cha rangi ya kahawia-dhahabu na hakiliwi na mchwa.
about.dg:
*Mvure* ni muhi mkulu sana, unaofika mita 30, wenye kolo rire rinaroima chocho bila panda. Dzulu sana, panda na makodza ganaenea dza mwamvuri. Gophare ni ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu, na richikatwa rinalavya maziya. Makodzage ni makulu na ga umbo ra yai. Makodzage ganagbwa wakati wa kazikazi.

Chiiniche ni cha rangi ya dongo iriyo dza zahabu, na tachiriwa ni lutswa.

where.en: It grows in lowland, riverine and groundwater forest. At the coast it is only occasional, though it is common around Rabai, inland of Mombasa. Remaining big trees stand mostly in forest remnants.
where.sw: Hustawi katika misitu ya nyanda za chini, ya kando ya mito na ya maeneo yenye maji ya ardhini. Pwani hupatikana hapa na pale tu, ingawa ni mwingi kuzunguka Rabai, bara kutoka Mombasa. Miti mikubwa iliyobaki imesimama hasa katika mabaki ya misitu.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga tsi ya photsi, kanda-kanda ya miho na kpwenye matsaka ganayomera kpwa madzi ga tsini. Pwani unaphahikana mara chache tu, ela ni wa kawaida kuzunguluka Rabai, bara ya Mombasa. Mihi mikulu iriyosala minji inaima kpwenye vipande vya matsaka virivyosala.

uses.en:
*Mvure* is a premier timber, used for quality furniture indoors and out, for doors, boats, poles and tool handles. The heartwood resists termites.

The bark is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
*Mvure* ni mbao za daraja la kwanza, zinazotumika kwa samani bora za ndani na nje, kwa milango, mashua, nguzo na mipini ya zana. Kiini cha mbao hakiliwi na mchwa.

Gamba hutumika katika dawa za jadi.
uses.dg:
*Mvure* ni mbao za hali ya dzulu, zinazohumirwa kuhenda fanicha nono za ndani na za kondze, myango, madau, nguzo na mipini ya vilwilo. Chiini cha muhi uhu tachiriwa ni lutswa.

Gophare nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: Digo carpenters recognise *mvure* planks by their strong smell. Its seeds have their own name, *tembe za mvure*. Carpenters also take care to tell it apart from *mnguonguo*, the 'false mvule', whose wood looks similar but does not last.
culture.sw: Maseremala Wadigo hutambua mbao za *mvure* kwa harufu yake kali. Mbegu zake zina jina lake maalum, *tembe za mvure*. Maseremala pia huwa makini kuutofautisha na *mnguonguo*, 'mvule bandia', ambao mbao zake zinafanana lakini hazidumu.
culture.dg: Mafundi a mbao a Chidigo nkumanya mbao za *mvure* kpwa arufu yao kali. Tembeze nazo zina dzina rao: *tembe za mvure*. Mafundi piya nkulola sana kuutafwautisha na *mnguonguo*, 'mvure wa handzo', ambao mbaoze zinaoneka sawa ela tazikaa.

names.en: Pakia, the ICRAF handbook and the Mgombato dictionary all give the Digo name *mvure*, which is also the Giriama name. In Swahili it is *mvule*; the Digo *r* matches the Swahili *l*. Mgombato calls it a hardwood, 'East African teak'. In English it is mvule or iroko.
names.sw: Pakia, kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF na kamusi ya Mgombato wote wanatoa jina la Kidigo *mvure*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mvule*; *r* ya Kidigo inalingana na *l* ya Kiswahili. Mgombato anauita mti wa mbao ngumu, 'mtiki wa Afrika Mashariki'. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *mvule* au *iroko*.
names.dg: Pakia, chitabu cha ICRAF na Mgombato vyosi vinaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mvure*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chigiriama. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mvule*; *r* ya Chidigo i phatu pha *l* ya Chiswahili. Mgombato unauiha muhi mgumu, 'East African teak'. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *mvule* au *iroko*.

conservation.en: Mvure is now rare in Kenya because of over-exploitation for its timber.
conservation.sw: Mvure sasa ni adimu nchini Kenya kwa sababu ya kuvunwa kupita kiasi kwa ajili ya mbao zake.
conservation.dg: *Mvure* sambi ni adimu Kenya kpwa sababu ukakatwa sana kuhendza mbaoze.

reason.en: The 'false mvule' look-alike
reason.sw: Mti unaofanana nao, 'mvule bandia'
reason.dg: 'Mvure wa handzo', unaoonekana sawa naye

reason.en: Another timber known by the smell of its planks
reason.sw: Mbao nyingine inayotambuliwa kwa harufu ya mbao zake
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa mbao unaomanyikana kpwa arufu ya mbaoze

reason.en: Its seeds are also called tembe
reason.sw: Mbegu zake pia huitwa tembe
reason.dg: Tembeze piya nkuihwa *tembe*

reason.en: Another prized timber now scarce
reason.sw: Mbao nyingine inayothaminiwa ambayo sasa ni adimu
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa mbao za samani, ambao sambi ni adimu

reason.en: A giant of the same fig family
reason.sw: Mti mkubwa mno wa familia ileile ya mitini
reason.dg: Muhi mkulu wanjina wa jamii iyo iyo ya makuyu

definition.en: The seeds of the mvule tree. They have no use, so they are called 'seeds of …'; the useful timber goes by the tree's own name.
definition.sw: Mbegu za mvule. Hazina matumizi, kwa hivyo huitwa 'mbegu za …'; mbao zenye manufaa hujulikana kwa jina la mti wenyewe.
definition.dg: Tembe za muhi wa mvure. Tazina kazi, kpwa hivyo nkuihwa 'tembe za …'; mbao zenye kazi zinaihwa kpwa dzina ra muhi wenye.

teaser.en: Its name means 'drum maker': the soft, light trunk of this scarlet-flowered tree is hollowed out to make drum bodies.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linamaanisha 'mtengeneza ngoma': shina laini na jepesi la mti huu wenye maua mekundu angavu hufukuliwa ndani ili kutengeneza viunzi vya ngoma.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinamaanisha 'mutsonga ngoma': kolo laini na ra kuphepheya ra muhi uhu wenye maruwa ga kundu nkutsimbwa ndani kuhenda ngoma.

summary.en: *Mwamba ngoma* is a thorny coral tree of the coastal bush and forest, with three-part leaves and bright scarlet flowers. Its soft, light wood gives the Digo drum bodies, and its name says so.
summary.sw: *Mwamba ngoma* ni mti wenye miiba wa jamii ya *coral tree* wa vichaka na misitu ya pwani, wenye majani ya vijani vitatu na maua mekundu angavu. Mbao zake laini na nyepesi huwapa Wadigo viunzi vya ngoma, na jina lake linasema hivyo.
summary.dg: *Mwamba ngoma* ni muhi wenye miya wa jamii ya *Erythrina* (coral trees), unaomera weruni na matsakani ga pwani. Makodzage ni ga makodza madide mahahu, na maruwage ni ga kundu inayong'ala. Nyama zache laini na za kuphepheya zinapha Adigo ngoma, na dzinare rinagomba vivyo.

about.en:
*Mwamba ngoma* is a thorny tree in the bean family, related to the coral trees found across Africa. Each leaf is made of three broad leaflets, and the branches carry prickles. When it flowers, the tree is hung with clusters of vivid scarlet blooms, shaped like the narrow, curved flowers typical of coral trees, which are a favourite of sunbirds.

The wood is the thing to know about. It is soft and light, easy to cut and carve, which is just what a drum maker wants and what most builders do not.
about.sw:
*Mwamba ngoma* ni mti wenye miiba wa jamii ya kunde, jamaa wa miti ya *coral tree* inayopatikana kote Afrika. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu vipana, na matawi yana miiba midogo. Unapochanua, mti hujaa vishada vya maua mekundu angavu, yenye umbo jembamba lililopinda kama ilivyo kawaida kwa maua ya *coral tree*, ambayo hupendwa sana na ndege chozi.

Mbao ndizo jambo la kujua. Ni laini na nyepesi, rahisi kukata na kuchonga, ndicho hasa anachohitaji mtengeneza ngoma na kile ambacho wajenzi wengi hawakitaki.
about.dg:
*Mwamba ngoma* ni muhi wenye miya wa jamii ya kunde, ndugu wa mihi ya *Erythrina* (coral trees) inayophahikana Afrika kosi. Chila kodza ri na makodza madide mahahu mapana, na pandaze zina miya midide. Uchitsupa maruwa, muhi unabwadzika mabunda ga maruwa ga kundu inayong'ala sana, ga umbo jembamba na ra kumyoka dza maruwa ga mihi ya *Erythrina*, na vitsozi nkugamendza sana.

Nyama za muhi ndizo dzambo ra kumanya. Ni laini na za kuphepheya, rahisi kukatwa na kutsongbwa; vivi ndivyo mutsonga ngoma alondavyo, ela mafundi anji a kudzenga taalonda.

where.en: Look for it in coastal bushland, open woodland and the edges of coastal forest. It is easiest to spot when it is in flower, when the red clusters stand out against the green and grey of the bush.
where.sw: Utafute katika vichaka vya pwani, mapori wazi na pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona unapochanua, wakati vishada vyekundu vinapojitokeza dhidi ya kijani na kijivu cha vichaka.
where.dg: Uhendze weruni wa pwani, kpwenye matsaka ga wazi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani. Ni rahisi kuuona wakati wa maruwa, mabunda ga kundu vichionekana wazi kahi ya chijani na rangi ya ivu ya weruni.

uses.en: The trunk is hollowed out to make drum bodies. Because the wood is light and works easily, a section of stem can be carved and emptied into a shell, ready to be covered with skin.
uses.sw: Shina hufukuliwa ndani ili kutengeneza viunzi vya ngoma. Kwa kuwa mbao ni nyepesi na rahisi kufanyiwa kazi, kipande cha shina kinaweza kuchongwa na kufukuliwa kuwa kiunzi, tayari kufunikwa kwa ngozi.
uses.dg: Kolo nkutsimbwa ndani kuhenda ngoma. Kpwa sababu nyama za muhi ni za kuphepheya na rahisi kutsongbwa, chipande cha kolo chinaweza kutsongbwa na kutuluzwa ndani hadi chikale chituphu, tayari kufwinikpwa ni chingo.

culture.en: The name *mwamba ngoma* is read as 'drum maker' (from *ngoma*, drum), and it ties the tree directly to the music of the coast. Drums are at the heart of Digo dances and gatherings, so this is a tree whose wood has long been heard as well as seen.
culture.sw: Jina *mwamba ngoma* linasomwa kama 'mtengeneza ngoma' (kutoka *ngoma*), na linauhusisha mti huu moja kwa moja na muziki wa pwani. Ngoma ni kiini cha densi na mikusanyiko ya Wadigo, kwa hiyo huu ni mti ambao mbao zake kwa muda mrefu zimesikika na pia kuonekana.
culture.dg: Dzina *mwamba ngoma* nkuelezwa kukala 'mutsonga ngoma' (kula *ngoma*), na rinaufunga muhi uhu wazi-wazi na muziki wa pwani. Ngoma ziri kahi-kahi ya ngoma za kuvwina na mihingo ya Adigo, kpwa hivyo uhu ni muhi ambao nyama zache zikasikirwa tangu kare, sio kuonekana tu.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwamba ngoma*, also written *mbamba ngoma*. The same name is used in Swahili. No English common name is in wide use; botanists call it *Erythrina sacleuxii*. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mwambangoma* as a different tree, the desert date (*Balanites aegyptiaca*), with the Swahili *mchunju*, so the name may cover more than one tree, or the sources may disagree.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwamba ngoma*, linaloandikwa pia *mbamba ngoma*. Jina hilo hilo linatumika kwa Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza linalotumika sana; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Erythrina sacleuxii*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mwambangoma* kama mti mwingine, *desert date* (*Balanites aegyptiaca*), wenye jina la Kiswahili *mchunju*, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili linatumika kwa zaidi ya mti mmoja, au vyanzo vinatofautiana.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mwamba ngoma*, piya rinaandikpwa *mbamba ngoma*. Dzina ihiri ndiro rinalohumirwa kpwa Chiswahili. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinalohumirwa sana; asayansi a mimea anauiha *Erythrina sacleuxii*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mwambangoma* dza muhi wanjina, *desert date* (*Balanites aegyptiaca*), na dzina ra Chiswahili *mchunju*, kpwa hivyo dzina ihiri rinaweza kuhumirwa kpwa mihi zaidi ya mwenga, au vitabu vinaweza kukala taviphahana.

reason.en: Black mangrove whose hollow trunks are also made into drums
reason.sw: Mkoko wa aina ya black mangrove ambao mashina yake yenye uwazi pia hutengenezwa ngoma
reason.dg: *Mchofi*, mkoko ambao makologe mahuphu piya nkuhendwa ngoma.

reason.en: Grey mangrove also used for drums
reason.sw: Mchu (grey mangrove), pia hutumika kwa ngoma
reason.dg: *Mudzwi*, mkoko wanjina unaohumirwa kuhenda ngoma.

reason.en: Another coastal tree used for drums
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa pwani unaotumika kwa ngoma
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa pwani unaohumirwa kuhenda ngoma.

reason.en: A Balanites; the dictionary links the name mwambangoma to that genus
reason.sw: Balanites; kamusi inaliunganisha jina mwambangoma na jenasi hiyo
reason.dg: Ni *Balanites*; kamusi inafunga dzina *mwambangoma* na jenasi ihi.

teaser.en: Termites leave its wood alone, so coastal builders reach for this spiny, layered tree when they need house poles that last.
teaser.sw: Mchwa hawazigusi mbao zake, kwa hiyo wajenzi wa pwani huukimbilia mti huu wenye miiba na matawi ya ngazi wanapohitaji nguzo za nyumba zinazodumu.
teaser.dg: Malutswa tagarya nyama za muhi uhu, kpwa hivyo mafundi a kudzenga a pwani nkuhendza muhi uhu wenye miya na pandaze za ngazi-ngazi achilonda nguzo za nyumba zinazokala muda mure.

summary.en: *Mwanga kululu* is a spiny Terminalia of the coastal bushland, with branches spread in neat horizontal tiers. Its termite-resistant wood is cut for house poles and dhow keels, and the Digo of Diani use its bark against malaria.
summary.sw: *Mwanga kululu* ni Terminalia yenye miiba ya vichaka vya pwani, yenye matawi yaliyotanda kwa ngazi zilizonyooka kwa mlalo. Mbao zake zisizoliwa na mchwa hukatwa kwa nguzo za nyumba na mikuku ya majahazi, na Wadigo wa Diani hutumia gome lake dhidi ya malaria.
summary.dg: *Mwanga kululu* ni *Terminalia* yenye miya ya weruni wa pwani, na pandaze zinakala za kulala, ngazi-ngazi, kpwa mpango. Nyama zache, ambazo taziriwa ni malutswa, nkukatwa kuhenda nguzo za nyumba na mkuku wa madau, na Adigo a Diani nkuhumira gophare kuphoza homa (malaria).

about.en:
*Mwanga kululu* grows into a tree of up to 15 m with a distinctive layered shape: its branches stand out horizontally in tiers, and the young shoots zig-zag from one bud to the next. Stout spines arm the branches. The leaves are small, notched at the tip, and gathered in tight clusters on short side-shoots, which gives the tree a tufted look.

In flower it carries slender spikes of small pink-white blossoms. Like other Terminalias, it then sets small, flattened winged fruits.
about.sw:
*Mwanga kululu* hukua na kuwa mti wa hadi mita 15 wenye umbo bainifu la ngazi: matawi yake hutokeza kwa mlalo katika ngazi, na machipukizi machanga hupinda zigizaga kutoka chipukizi moja hadi jingine. Miiba minene hulinda matawi. Majani ni madogo, yenye kibonyeo kwenye ncha, na yamekusanyika katika vishada vya karibu kwenye vitawi vifupi vya pembeni, jambo linaloupa mti mwonekano wa vishungi.

Unapochanua huzaa vishada vyembamba vya maua madogo meupe-waridi. Kama Terminalia nyingine, baadaye huzaa matunda madogo bapa yenye mabawa.
about.dg:
*Mwanga kululu* unakula hadi ukakala muhi wa ure wa mita kumi na tsano, wenye umbo ra ngazi-ngazi rinalomanyikana rahisi: pandaze zinalala kanda-kanda ngazi-ngazi, na matsipukizi machanga ganagaluka-galuka uphande, kula chimea chimwenga hadi chanjina. Miya mikulu inarinda pandaze. Makodzage ni madide, gana mwanya chidide kpwenye lutsa, na ganakusanyika mabunda-mabunda kpwenye vipanda vifupi vya kanda, vinavyouhenda muhi uonekane dza una vidzundzu.

Wakati wa maruwa unakala na mitsuche myembamba ya maruwa madide ga pinki na mereru. Dza *Terminalia* zanjina, chisha unalavya matunda madide mapana genye mapha.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and wooded grassland, often on rocky ground. Its tiered silhouette makes it one of the easier bush trees to pick out from a distance.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani na nyika zenye miti, mara nyingi kwenye ardhi ya mawe. Umbo lake la ngazi huufanya kuwa mmojawapo wa miti ya vichakani iliyo rahisi kutambua ukiwa mbali.
where.dg: Unamera weruni wa pwani na kpwenye mavuwe genye mihi, mara nyinji phatu phenye mawe. Umbowe wa ngazi-ngazi unauhenda ukale mwenga wa mihi ya weruni iriyo rahisi kuimanya kula kure.

uses.en:
The wood is hard and resistant to termites, and it is increasingly used for house poles at the coast. It is also cut for dhow keels, and carved into stools and household utensils.

The Digo of Diani take a cold-water infusion of the stem bark to treat malaria.
uses.sw:
Mbao ni ngumu na haziliwi na mchwa, na zinazidi kutumika kwa nguzo za nyumba pwani. Pia hukatwa kwa mikuku ya majahazi, na huchongwa kuwa vigoda na vyombo vya nyumbani.

Wadigo wa Diani hunywa gome la shina lililolowekwa katika maji baridi kutibu malaria.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na taziriwa ni malutswa, na sambi nkuhumirwa zaidi na zaidi kuhenda nguzo za nyumba pwani. Piya nkukatwa kuhenda mkuku wa madau, na nkutsongbwa vihi na vyombo vya kaya.

Adigo a Diani nkulweka gopha ra kolo madzini ga mnyevu na kunwa madzige kuphoza homa (malaria).

culture.en: The tree is believed to have magical properties. Its other name, *mwanga*, is shared with the river terminalia, which the Digo connect with a spirit called Mwanga.
culture.sw: Mti huu unaaminika kuwa na nguvu za kiuchawi. Jina lake jingine, *mwanga*, linashirikiwa na *river terminalia*, ambao Wadigo huuhusisha na pepo aitwaye Mwanga.
culture.dg: Atu nkuamini kukala muhi uhu una nguvu za chiwanga. Dzinare ranjina, *mwanga*, ni dzina ra *mwanga* (river terminalia) piya, ambao Adigo nkuufunga na pepho inayoihwa Mwanga.

names.en: In Digo it is *mwanga kululu*, or simply *mwanga*. Swahili speakers call it *mwanga* or *mwangati*, and in Giriama it is *mwanga*. The English name is spiny terminalia. The short form *mwanga* is also the Digo name for the river terminalia (*Terminalia sambesiaca*), so the longer *mwanga kululu* helps tell the two apart.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo unaitwa *mwanga kululu*, au *mwanga* tu. Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili huuita *mwanga* au *mwangati*, na kwa Kigiriama ni *mwanga*. Jina la Kiingereza ni *spiny terminalia*. Umbo fupi *mwanga* pia ni jina la Kidigo la *river terminalia* (*Terminalia sambesiaca*), kwa hiyo jina refu *mwanga kululu* husaidia kuitofautisha miti hii miwili.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mwanga kululu*, au *mwanga* tu. Atu a Chiswahili nkuuiha *mwanga* au *mwangati*, na kpwa Chigiryama ni *mwanga*. Dzina ra Chingereza ni *spiny terminalia*. Dzina fupi *mwanga* piya ni dzina ra Chidigo ra *river terminalia* (*Terminalia sambesiaca*), kpwa hivyo dzina rire *mwanga kululu* rinaterya kutafwautisha mihi miiri ihi.

conservation.en: Rising demand for termite-proof house poles puts more pressure on this tree than it once faced.
conservation.sw: Mahitaji yanayoongezeka ya nguzo za nyumba zisizoliwa na mchwa yanauwekea mti huu shinikizo kubwa kuliko lililokuwepo zamani.
conservation.dg: Kuenjerezeka kpwa haja ya nguzo za nyumba zisizoriwa ni malutswa kunaurehera muhi uhu shida nyinji kuriko kare.

teaser.en: This riverside giant carries the name of a spirit, and healers turn to it for the illnesses that spirit is said to cause.
teaser.sw: Jitu hili la kando ya mito linabeba jina la pepo, na waganga hulitegemea kutibu maradhi yanayosemekana kusababishwa na pepo huyo.
teaser.dg: Muhi uhu mkulu wa kanda-kanda ya miho una dzina ra pepho, na aganga nkuuhumira kuphoza makongo ambago nkugombwa ganarehwa ni pepho iyo.

summary.en: *Mwanga* is the river terminalia, a large tree of the coastal and riverine forests. The Digo name it after the spirit Mwanga and use it to treat the illnesses attributed to that spirit.
summary.sw: *Mwanga* ni mti mkubwa wa jenasi ya *Terminalia* unaoota kando ya mito (kwa Kiingereza *river terminalia*), katika misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito. Wadigo wameupa jina la pepo Mwanga, na huutumia kutibu maradhi yanayohusishwa na pepo huyo.
summary.dg: *Mwanga* ni *river terminalia*, muhi mkulu wa matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho. Adigo anauiha kpwa dzina ra pepho Mwanga, na nkuuhumira kuphoza makongo ganagoaminika kukala ganarehwa ni pepho iyo.

about.en: *Mwanga* is a large forest tree. Its leaves grow bunched together at the ends of the branches, a habit typical of the Terminalia genus. The fruits are flat and papery, with two wings, and they hang in clusters that are easy to spot even when the leaves are high up.
about.sw: *Mwanga* ni mti mkubwa wa msituni. Majani yake huota yakiwa yamejikusanya kwenye ncha za matawi, tabia ya kawaida ya jenasi ya *Terminalia*. Matunda yake ni bapa na membamba kama karatasi, yenye mabawa mawili, na huning'inia kwa vishada ambavyo huonekana kwa urahisi hata majani yakiwa juu sana.
about.dg: *Mwanga* ni muhi mkulu wa tsakani. Makodzage ganamera phamwenga mabunda-mabunda kpwenye ntsa za panda, tabiya ya mihi ya jenasi ya *Terminalia*. Matundage ni mapana na ga kuphepheya dza karatasi, gana mapha mairi, na ganabwadzika mabunda-mabunda ambago ni rahisi kugaona hata makodza gachikala dzulu sana.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and along rivers, where the soil stays moist. Look for it in riverine strips and forest patches inland from the shore.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani na kando ya mito, mahali ambapo udongo hubaki na unyevu. Utautafuta katika vipande vya msitu vilivyo kando ya mito na katika visiwa vya msitu vilivyo bara, mbali kidogo na ufuo.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani na kanda-kanda ya miho, phatu ambapho ulongo unakala na chinemi. Uhendze kpwenye matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na kpwenye matsaka madide ga bara, kure na pwani.

uses.en: Its main recorded use is as medicine. It is used to treat illness that is believed to come from the spirit Mwanga.
uses.sw: Matumizi yake makuu yaliyorekodiwa ni dawa. Hutumika kutibu maradhi yanayoaminika kuletwa na pepo Mwanga.
uses.dg: Matumizige makulu ganagoandikpwa ni dawa. Unahumirwa kuphoza ukongo unaoaminika kurehwa ni pepho Mwanga.

culture.en: The tree is named after Mwanga, a spirit, and its medicine is used against ailments caused by that same spirit: the name and the cure go together. Mwanga also appears in the name of *mwangajine*, a forest tree named after two spirits, Mwanga and Jine, which shows how closely Digo plant names can follow the spirit world.
culture.sw: Mti huu umepewa jina la Mwanga, pepo, na dawa yake hutumika dhidi ya maradhi yanayosababishwa na pepo huyo huyo: jina na tiba vinakwenda pamoja. Mwanga pia anaonekana katika jina la *mwangajine*, mti wa msituni uliopewa jina la pepo wawili, Mwanga na Jine, jambo linaloonyesha jinsi majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanavyoweza kufuata kwa karibu ulimwengu wa pepo.
culture.dg: Muhi uhu ukaihwa kpwa dzina ra Mwanga, pepho, na dawaye nkuhumirwa kuphoza makongo ganagorehwa ni pepho iyo iyo: dzina na dawa vinaphiya phamwenga. Dzina Mwanga piya rinaphahikana ndani ya dzina *mwangajine*, muhi wa tsakani uriohalwa dzina kula kpwa pepho mbiri, Mwanga na Jine, na vivi vinaonyesa ambavyo madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganalunga phephi sana mambo ga pepho.

names.en: The name *mwanga* is shared across Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is the river terminalia. Note that *mwanga* is also used in Digo for the spiny terminalia, which is more fully called *mwanga kululu*.
names.sw: Jina *mwanga* linatumika kwa pamoja katika Kidigo, Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *river terminalia*. Ikumbukwe kwamba katika Kidigo *mwanga* hutumika pia kwa *Terminalia* yenye miiba (*spiny terminalia*), ambayo kwa ukamilifu huitwa *mwanga kululu*.
names.dg: Dzina *mwanga* ni mwenga kpwa Chidigo, Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *river terminalia*. Manya kukala *mwanga* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa Chidigo kpwa *spiny terminalia*, ambao dzinare kamili ni *mwanga kululu*.

reason.sw: *Terminalia* yenye miiba, jenasi moja na jina fupi lilelile
reason.dg: *Mwanga kululu* (spiny terminalia), jenasi mwenga na dzina fupi mwenga.

reason.en: Also named after the spirit Mwanga
reason.sw: Nao umepewa jina la pepo Mwanga
reason.dg: Piya ukaihwa kpwa dzina ra pepho Mwanga.

reason.en: Named after the same spirits
reason.sw: Umepewa jina la pepo hao hao
reason.dg: Ukaihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho ihizo.

reason.en: Indian almond, another Terminalia
reason.sw: Mkungu, *Terminalia* nyingine
reason.dg: *Mkungu* (Indian almond), *Terminalia* yanjina.

teaser.en: It flowers straight from its trunk and is named after two spirits, Mwanga and Jine, whose ailments it is used to treat.
teaser.sw: Hutoa maua moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina lake, na umepewa jina la pepo wawili, Mwanga na Jine, ambao maradhi yao hutibiwa kwa mti huu.
teaser.dg: Unalavya maruwa dzulu ya kolore, na ukaihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho mbiri, Mwanga na Jine; nkuhumirwa kuphoza makongo ganagorehwa ni pepho hizo.

summary.en: *Mwangajine* is a small forest tree that carries its flowers directly on the trunk. Named after two spirits, it is an important Digo medicine for spiritual ailments, and it is listed as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: *Mwangajine* ni mti mdogo wa msituni unaobeba maua yake moja kwa moja kwenye shina. Umepewa jina la pepo wawili, na ni dawa muhimu ya Kidigo kwa maradhi ya kiroho. Umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Mwangajine* ni muhi mdide wa tsakani unaolavya maruwage dzulu ya kolore. Ukaihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho mbiri, na ni dawa muhimu ya Adigo ya makongo ga pepho; ukaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (uri hatarini).

about.en: *Mwangajine* is a small tree of the custard-apple family. Its most unusual feature is that the flowers sprout straight from the trunk and older branches rather than among the leaves, a habit botanists call cauliflory. Finding a bare trunk dotted with flowers is the surest way to know you have found it.
about.sw: *Mwangajine* ni mti mdogo wa familia ya mitopetope. Sifa yake ya ajabu zaidi ni kwamba maua yake huchipua moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina na matawi ya zamani badala ya kuota katikati ya majani, tabia ambayo wataalamu wa mimea huiita *cauliflory*. Ukikuta shina tupu lililotapakaa maua, hiyo ndiyo njia ya uhakika zaidi ya kujua kuwa umeupata.
about.dg: *Mwangajine* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya *mbokwe* (Annonaceae, jamii ya custard apple). Tabiyaye ya ajabu ni kukala maruwa ganatuluka dzulu ya kolo na pandaze za kare, sio kahi ya makodza; asayansi a mimea anaiha tabiya ihi *cauliflory*. Uchiona kolo rikaodzala maruwa bila makodza, ni dalili ya kpweli kukala ukauphaha.

where.en: It grows in moist coastal forest and evergreen bushland. Being small and growing under the canopy, it is easy to walk past unless it is in flower.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani yenye unyevu na vichaka vya kijani mwaka mzima. Kwa kuwa ni mdogo na huota chini ya kivuli cha miti mirefu, ni rahisi kuupita bila kuuona usipokuwa umechanua.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani genye chinemi na kpwenye vitsaka vyenye makodza chila wakati. Kpwa sababu ni mdide na unamera photsi ya mihi mikulu, ni rahisi kuutsupa bila kuuona, ela uchikala na maruwa.

uses.en: It is an important medicine for spiritual ailments, used by healers for illness thought to come from the spirits.
uses.sw: Ni dawa muhimu kwa maradhi ya kiroho, hutumiwa na waganga kwa maradhi yanayodhaniwa kuletwa na pepo.
uses.dg: Ni dawa muhimu ya makongo ga pepho, inayohumirwa ni aganga kuphoza makongo ganagoaminika kurehwa ni pepho.

culture.en: Its name joins two spirits: Mwanga, who also gives his name to the river terminalia (*mwanga*), and Jine. A closely related shrub, *mwangajine mlume*, carries the same name, with *mlume* ('male') added.
culture.sw: Jina lake linaunganisha pepo wawili: Mwanga, ambaye pia ametoa jina lake kwa mti wa *Terminalia* wa kando ya mito (*mwanga*), na Jine. Kichaka kinachohusiana nao kwa karibu, *mwangajine mlume*, kina jina hilo hilo, likiongezwa *mlume* ('dume').
culture.dg: Dzinare rinaunganisha pepho mbiri: Mwanga, ambaye dzinare piya ni ra *mwanga* (river terminalia), na Jine. Chitsaka cha ndugu wa phephi, *mwangajine mlume*, china dzina ihiri, na neno *mlume* ('wa chilume') rikaenjerezwa.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwangajine*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists know it as *Isolona cauliflora*, a name that also points to its trunk-borne flowers.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwangajine*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Isolona cauliflora*, jina ambalo pia linadokeza maua yake yanayoota kwenye shina.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mwangajine*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anaumanya dza *Isolona cauliflora*, dzina ambaro piya rinaonyesa maruwage ganagotuluka kpwenye kolo.

conservation.en: *Mwangajine* is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List. It depends on moist coastal forest, much of which has been cleared.
conservation.sw: *Mwangajine* umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN. Unategemea misitu ya pwani yenye unyevu, ambayo sehemu kubwa yake imekwisha kufyekwa.
conservation.dg: *Mwangajine* ukaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (uri hatarini) kpwenye IUCN Red List. Unakuluphira matsaka ga pwani genye chinemi, na manji ga matsaka higo gakakatwa.

reason.en: The 'male' mwangajine, another Annonaceae named for the same spirits
reason.sw: *Mwangajine* 'dume', mmea mwingine wa familia ya mitopetope (Annonaceae) uliopewa jina la pepo hao hao
reason.dg: *Mwangajine mlume*, ambao ni Annonaceae yanjina iriyoihwa kpwa pepho zizo.

reason.en: River terminalia, named after the spirit Mwanga
reason.sw: *Terminalia* ya kando ya mito, iliyopewa jina la pepo Mwanga
reason.dg: *Mwanga* (river terminalia), uriohalwa dzina kula kpwa pepho Mwanga.

reason.en: Monodora, a close relative in the custard-apple family
reason.sw: *Monodora*, jamaa wa karibu katika familia ya mitopetope
reason.dg: *Monodora*, ndugu wa phephi wa jamii ya mbokwe (custard apple).

reason.en: Xylopia, another forest member of the custard-apple family
reason.sw: *Xylopia*, mmea mwingine wa msituni wa familia ya mitopetope
reason.dg: *Xylopia*, muhi wanjina wa tsakani wa jamii ya mbokwe (custard apple).

teaser.en: A buttressed forest tree with smooth dark bark whose reddish fruits are worth the walk when ripe.
teaser.sw: Mti wa msituni wenye mizizi-ukuta na gome laini jeusi, ambao matunda yake mekundu yanastahili safari ya kuyafuata yakiiva.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa tsakani wenye ngamba na gopha laini dziru, ambao matundage ga kundu, ganaphoivwa, ni ga kuhendzwa hata kure.

summary.en: *Mwawa* is an evergreen tree of the coastal forest, standing on a buttressed base with smooth, dark bark. Its reddish fruit is eaten when ripe.
summary.sw: *Mwawa* ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima wa misitu ya pwani, unaosimama juu ya mizizi-ukuta na wenye gome laini, jeusi. Matunda yake mekundu huliwa yakiiva.
summary.dg: *Mwawa* ni muhi wa matsaka ga pwani wenye makodza chila wakati; unaima dzulu ya ngamba, na gophare ni laini na dziru. Matundage ga kundu nkuriwa ganaphoivwa.

about.en: *Mwawa* is an evergreen tree whose trunk flares into buttresses at the base. The bark is smooth and dark. It belongs to the cocoa-plum family, and it bears small reddish fruits.
about.sw: *Mwawa* ni mti wa kijani mwaka mzima ambao shina lake hupanuka chini na kuwa mizizi-ukuta. Gome lake ni laini na jeusi. Ni wa familia ya *cocoa-plum* (Chrysobalanaceae), na huzaa matunda madogo mekundu.
about.dg: *Mwawa* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, na kolore rinatanuka photsi kukala ngamba. Gophare ni laini na dziru. Ni wa jamii ya *Chrysobalanaceae* (jamii ya *cocoa plum*), na unalavya matunda madide ga kundu.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani.

uses.en: The ripe fruit is edible and eaten as a wild snack.
uses.sw: Matunda yaliyoiva huliwa, kama kitafunio cha porini.
uses.dg: Tunda richiivwa nkuriwa, na atu nkurirya weruni dza chakurya chidide.

names.en: The Digo name *mwawa* is recorded in ICRAF's handbook of useful trees, where it appears under a different but related tree, the mobola plum (*Parinari curatellifolia*). The two may share the name, or one may be a mix-up. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded for *Hirtella zanzibarica*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo *mwawa* limerekodiwa katika kitabu cha ICRAF cha miti yenye manufaa, ambapo linaonekana chini ya mti mwingine tofauti lakini wa jamaa, *mobola plum* (*Parinari curatellifolia*). Huenda miti hiyo miwili inashiriki jina hili, au huenda mmoja ni mchanganyiko wa kimakosa. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa kwa *Hirtella zanzibarica*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *mwawa* rikaandikpwa kpwenye chitabu cha ICRAF cha mihi ya kufwaida, ambaho rinaphahikana kpwa muhi wanjina ela wa ndugu, *mobola plum* (*Parinari curatellifolia*). Mihi miiri ihi inaweza kukala inashirikiana dzina, au kuna kosa kpwa mwenga wao. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa kpwa *Hirtella zanzibarica*.

reason.sw: Tunda jingine la porini la msituni
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina ra weruni ra tsakani.
