teaser.en: The 'forest mango' looks like a mango tree that wandered into the woods, but cut a leaf and white latex appears.
teaser.sw: 'Mwembe wa msituni' unaonekana kama mwembe uliopotea ukaingia porini, lakini ukikata jani, utomvu mweupe hutoka.
teaser.dg: *Mwembe tsaka* unaonekana dza mwembe uriotanga ukainjira tsakani, ela uchikata kodza, maziya mereru ganatuluka.

summary.en: *Mwembe tsaka*, the 'forest mango', is a coastal forest tree whose leaves look like a mango's. It belongs to the milkwood family and bleeds white latex when cut.
summary.sw: *Mwembe tsaka*, yaani 'mwembe wa msituni', ni mti wa misitu ya pwani ambao majani yake yanafanana na ya mwembe. Ni wa familia ya Sapotaceae (familia ya Sapotaceae) na hutoa utomvu mweupe ukikatwa.
summary.dg: *Mwembe tsaka*, 'mwembe wa tsakani', ni muhi wa matsaka ga pwani ambao makodzage ganafanana na ga mwembe. Ni wa jamii ya *Sapotaceae* (milkwood), na uchikatwa unalavya maziya mereru.

about.en: *Mwembe tsaka* is a forest tree with long, glossy leaves much like those of the mango, which is where its Digo name comes from. It is not a mango at all: it belongs to the milkwood family (Sapotaceae), and like its relatives it oozes a white, milky latex when a leaf or the bark is broken. That latex is the quickest way to tell it from a true mango.
about.sw: *Mwembe tsaka* ni mti wa msituni wenye majani marefu yanayong'aa, yanayofanana sana na ya mwembe, na hapo ndipo jina lake la Kidigo linapotoka. Hata hivyo si mwembe hata kidogo: ni wa familia ya Sapotaceae, na kama jamaa zake, hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa jani au gome linapovunjwa. Utomvu huo ndiyo njia ya haraka zaidi ya kuutofautisha na mwembe halisi.
about.dg: *Mwembe tsaka* ni muhi wa tsakani wenye makodza mare ganagong'ala, ganagofanana sana na ga mwembe, na phapho ndipho dzinare ra Chidigo ririphotuluka. Ela si mwembe hata chidide: ni wa jamii ya milkwood (*Sapotaceae*), na dza nduguze, unalavya maziya mereru kodza au gopha richivundzika. Maziya higo ndiyo njira ya upesi zaidi ya kuutafwautisha na mwembe wa kpweli.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani.

culture.en: The name means 'forest mango': *mwembe* is the mango tree and *tsaka* is the bush or forest. It is a good example of how Digo names wild plants by comparing them to familiar ones.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'mwembe wa msituni': *mwembe* ni mti wa embe na *tsaka* ni pori au msitu. Ni mfano mzuri wa jinsi Kidigo kinavyoipa mimea ya porini majina kwa kuilinganisha na mimea inayojulikana.
culture.dg: Dzina rinamaanisha 'mwembe wa tsakani': *mwembe* ni muhi wa maembe, na *tsaka* ni weruni au tsaka. Ni mfwano mnono wa ambavyo Adigo nkuiha mimea ya weruni kpwa kuifananisha na mimea ambayo anaimanya.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwembe tsaka*, 'forest mango'. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Inhambanella henriquesii*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwembe tsaka*, 'mwembe wa msituni'. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Inhambanella henriquesii*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mwembe tsaka*, 'mwembe wa tsakani'. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anauiha *Inhambanella henriquesii*.

reason.sw: Mwembe, ambao umepewa jina lake
reason.dg: Mwembe, ambao muhi uhu ukaihwa kula kpwakpwe.

reason.sw: *Manilkara*, jamaa katika familia ya Sapotaceae
reason.dg: *Manilkara*, ndugu wa jamii ya milkwood.

reason.dg: *Synsepalum*, milkwood yanjina ya tsakani.

reason.dg: *Manilkara*, milkwood yanjina ya tsakani.

teaser.en: Purple-stained fingers give away anyone who has been eating water berries straight from the tree.
teaser.sw: Vidole vilivyotiwa rangi ya zambarau humwumbua yeyote aliyekuwa akila zambarau moja kwa moja kutoka mtini.
teaser.dg: Vyala vya rangi ya zambarau vinamfitsua chila mutu ariyekala achirya matunda ga *mzambarau* kula muhini.

summary.en: *Mzambarau* is the water berry, a dense, leafy tree of moist and riverside forest with clusters of purple-black fruit. It feeds people, and it is one of the sawn-timber trees Digo carpenters know.
summary.sw: *Mzambarau* (*Syzygium guineense*) ni mti mnene wenye majani mengi wa misitu yenye unyevu na ya kando ya mito, wenye vishada vya matunda ya rangi ya zambarau iliyokolea karibu nyeusi. Huwalisha watu, na ni mmoja wa miti ya mbao za kupasua inayojulikana na mafundi seremala wa Kidigo.
summary.dg: *Mzambarau* ni *water berry*, muhi wenye makodza manji sana wa matsaka genye chinemi na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, wenye mabunda ga matunda ga rangi ya zambarau iriyo phephi na nyiru. Unarisa atu, na ni mwenga wa mihi ya mbao ambayo mafundi a mbao a Chidigo anaimanya.

about.en: *Mzambarau* is a dense, leafy tree with drooping branchlets. Its glossy leaves grow in opposite pairs, and new growth flushes a striking purple-red before turning green. After flowering it carries heavy clusters of small, purple-black berries, like a wild cousin of the Java plum grown in gardens.
about.sw: *Mzambarau* ni mti mnene wenye majani mengi na vitawi vinavyoning'inia. Majani yake yanayong'aa huota kwa jozi zinazokabiliana, na machipukizi mapya hutokea yakiwa na rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu ya kuvutia kabla ya kugeuka kijani. Baada ya kuchanua hubeba vishada vizito vya matunda madogo ya rangi ya zambarau iliyokolea karibu nyeusi, kama binamu wa porini wa mzambarau unaopandwa bustanini (*Syzygium cumini*).
about.dg: *Mzambarau* ni muhi wenye makodza manji sana, na maphungo ganagobeduka photsi. Makodzage ganang'ala na ganamera mairi-mairi, kodza rimwenga chila uphande, na makodza maphya nkutuluka ga rangi ya zambarau na kundu kabla ya kukala ga chijani. Uchimala kutuluza maruwa, unakala na mabunda maziho ga matunda madide ga zambarau iriyo phephi na nyiru, dza ndugu wa weruni wa *mzambarau* (Java plum) unaophandwa midzini.

where.en: It grows in moist forest and along rivers and streams, where its roots can reach water, hence the English name water berry.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu yenye unyevu na kando ya mito na vijito, mahali ambapo mizizi yake inaweza kufikia maji; ndiyo sababu kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *water berry*.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani genye chinemi na kanda-kanda ya miho na miho midide, phatu ambapho miziye inaweza kufikira madzi; kpwa hivyo kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *water berry*.

uses.en: The berries are eaten fresh. The wood is one of the local timber species known to Digo carpenters for sawing into planks, and the tree also gives poles. The bark provides tannin and a dye.
uses.sw: Matunda yake huliwa yakiwa mabichi. Mbao zake ni miongoni mwa aina za mbao za kienyeji zinazojulikana na mafundi seremala wa Kidigo kwa kupasuliwa kuwa mbao, na mti huu pia hutoa nguzo. Gome lake hutoa tanini na rangi.
uses.dg: Matunda nkuriwa dza garivyo. Nyama za muhi ni mwenga wa aina za mbao za hipha zinazomanyikana ni mafundi a mbao a Chidigo kpwa kukereswa kukala mbao, na muhi piya unalavya nguzo. Gopha rinalavya tanini na rangi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mzambarau*, the same as the Swahili; ICRAF's handbook gives *muziahi*. Swahili also has *mzuari*. In English it is the water berry. *Mzambarau* is also the name of the Java plum (*Syzygium cumini*), a close relative.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mzambarau*, sawa na la Kiswahili; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *muziahi*. Kiswahili kina pia *mzuari*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *water berry*. *Mzambarau* pia ni jina la *Java plum* (*Syzygium cumini*), jamaa yake wa karibu.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mzambarau*, sawa na ra Chiswahili; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *muziahi*. Kpwa Chiswahili piya unaihwa *mzuari*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *water berry*. *Mzambarau* piya ni dzina ra *Java plum* (*Syzygium cumini*), ndugu wa phephi.

reason.sw: Mzambarau wa bustanini (*Java plum*), jenasi moja na jina lilelile
reason.dg: *Mzambarau* (Java plum), jenasi mwenga na dzina mwenga.

reason.dg: Mpera, wa jamii mwenga ya myrtle.

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa mbao unaothaminiwa
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa mbao wenye samani.

teaser.en: Its violet flowers smell sweet, but it is the roots of this small bush tree that Diani healers dig up for malaria.
teaser.sw: Maua yake ya urujuani yananukia vizuri, lakini ni mizizi ya mti huu mdogo wa porini ambayo waganga wa Diani huichimba kwa ajili ya malaria.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ga zambarau ganalavya arufu nono, ela ni mizi ya muhi uhu mdide wa weruni ambayo aganga a Diani nkuitsimba kpwa dawa ya homa.

summary.en: *Mziji* is the violet tree, a small tree of the coastal bush with pale bark, scented violet flowers and winged fruits. The Digo of Diani boil its roots to treat malaria.
summary.sw: *Mziji* (kwa Kiingereza *violet tree*) ni mti mdogo wa vichaka vya pwani wenye gome jeupe-jeupe, maua ya urujuani yenye harufu nzuri na matunda yenye bawa. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi yake kutibu malaria.
summary.dg: *Mziji* (kpwa Chingereza *violet tree*) ni muhi mdide wa vitsaka vya pwani, wenye gopha ra rangi ngushu-ngushu, maruwa ga zambarau genye arufu nono na matunda genye mapha. Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha miziye kuhenda dawa ya homa.

about.en: *Mziji* is a small tree with pale, smooth bark. In flower it is covered in sprays of violet or purple pea-like blossoms with a sweet scent. These are followed by distinctive winged fruits, each a small nut with a single curved wing that spins as it falls.
about.sw: *Mziji* ni mti mdogo wenye gome laini lililopauka. Unapochanua hufunikwa na vishada vya maua ya urujuani au zambarau yanayofanana na maua ya mbaazi, yenye harufu tamu. Baadaye hufuatwa na matunda ya kipekee yenye bawa, kila moja likiwa kokwa ndogo yenye bawa moja lililopinda, ambalo huzunguka linapoanguka.
about.dg: *Mziji* ni muhi mdide wenye gopha laini ra rangi ngushu-ngushu. Wakati wa maruwa unafwinikpwa ni mabunda ga maruwa ga zambarau ngushu-ngushu au zambarau, ga umbo dza maruwa ga kunde, genye arufu nono. Bada yao kunatuluka matunda ga tafwauti genye mapha: chila tunda ni tembe ndide ngumu yenye phapha rimwenga ririrootyoka, na tunda rinazunguluka richigbwa.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland and bushland. The violet flowers make it easiest to spot when it is in bloom.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika zenye miti na vichakani. Maua yake ya urujuani hufanya iwe rahisi zaidi kuuona unapochanua.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi na vitsaka. Maruwage ga zambarau ganahenda ukale rahisi kuuona wakati una maruwa.

uses.en: The Digo of Diani boil the roots to treat malaria. The violet tree is a well-known medicinal plant across much of Africa, and its roots are also known to be toxic, so it is a plant for experienced healers.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi yake kutibu malaria. Mti huu ni mmea wa dawa unaojulikana sana katika sehemu kubwa ya Afrika, na mizizi yake pia inajulikana kuwa na sumu, kwa hiyo ni mmea wa waganga wenye uzoefu.
uses.dg: Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha mizi kuhenda dawa ya homa. *Mziji* ni mmea wa dawa unaomanyikana sana kpwenye seemu nyinji za Afrika, na piya nkumanyikana kukala miziye ina sumu, kpwa hivyo ni mmea wa aganga ambao akahenda kazi ihi kpwa muda mure.

names.en: The Digo name is *mziji*. In English it is the violet tree; its scientific name is *Securidaca longipedunculata*. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mziji*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *violet tree*; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Securidaca longipedunculata*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mziji*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *violet tree*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Securidaca longipedunculata*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Also used against malaria in Diani
reason.sw: Nao hutumika dhidi ya malaria huko Diani
reason.dg: Piya nkuhumirwa Diani kpwa dawa ya homa

reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa porini (*horsewood*) unaotumika kwa malaria
reason.dg: *Chinyapala* (*horsewood*), mmea wanjina wa weruni unaohumirwa kpwa dawa ya homa

reason.sw: Kichaka ambacho pia hutumika kwa malaria
reason.dg: Chitsaka chinachohumirwa piya kpwa dawa ya homa

teaser.en: Named for the deep shade it throws, this forest tree hides bright red fruits that are best admired and not eaten.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina kutokana na kivuli kizito unachotoa, na mti huu wa msituni huficha matunda mekundu yanayong'aa ambayo ni bora kuyatazama kuliko kuyala.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinalavywa kula chivuri chikulu unachohenda; muhi uhu wa tsakani unafwitsa matunda ga kundu ganagoala, ambago ni ga kulolwa tu, si ga kuriwa.

summary.en: *Nchivuri* is the triangle-tops, a broad shade tree of moist forest with red three-lobed fruits. Its red heartwood is used for building, furniture and canoes, and its roots as medicine.
summary.sw: *Nchivuri* ni mwakamwatu, mti mpana wa kivuli wa misitu yenye unyevu, wenye matunda mekundu yenye pande tatu. Kiini chake chekundu cha mbao hutumika kwa ujenzi, samani na mitumbwi, na mizizi yake kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Nchivuri* (kpwa Chingereza *triangle-tops*) ni muhi wa chivuri wenye dari pana, wa matsaka ga jeke-jeke, wenye matunda ga kundu ga mala mahahu. Chiiniche cha kundu nkuhumirwa kudzenga, kuhenda fanicha na ngarawa, na miziye nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

about.en:
*Nchivuri* is a shady tree with a dense, rounded crown that looks rather like a mango's from a distance. Its compound leaves have one to three pairs of leaflets, and new leaves flush pink-red before hardening to green.

The fruits are the giveaway: bright red, three-lobed capsules that split open to show shiny black seeds. They are striking, but the leaves and fruit are reported to be poisonous.
about.sw:
*Nchivuri* ni mti wa kivuli wenye taji nene la mviringo, linalofanana kidogo na la mwembe ukiliona kwa mbali. Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko yenye jozi moja hadi tatu za vijani, na majani mapya huchipua yakiwa na rangi ya waridi-nyekundu kabla ya kukomaa na kuwa kijani.

Matunda ndiyo yanayoutambulisha: vifuko vyekundu vinavyong'aa, vyenye pande tatu, ambavyo hupasuka na kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi zinazong'aa. Yanavutia macho, lakini majani na matunda yanaripotiwa kuwa na sumu.
about.dg:
*Nchivuri* ni muhi wa chivuri wenye dari ya makodza manji na ya mviringo, inayoonekana chidide dza ya mwembe uchiilola kula kure. Makodzage ga kuungana gana makodza madide airi hadi sita, airi-airi, na makodza maphya ganatuluka ga rangi ya pinki na kundu kabla ya kukala magumu na ga chijani.

Matunda ndigo alamaye kulu: ni makakaya ga kundu ganagoala, ga mala mahahu, ganagoahuka na kuonyesa tembe nyiru zinazoala. Ni manono kulola, ela nkugombwa kukala makodza na matunda gana sumu.

where.en: It grows in moist evergreen forest, and in drier country it keeps to the banks of rivers and streams. Look for it when the red capsules are on the tree, or when a flush of pink new leaves lights up the crown.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu yenye unyevu ya kijani mwaka mzima, na katika maeneo makavu zaidi hushikilia kingo za mito na vijito. Utautafuta wakati vifuko vyekundu vimo mtini, au wakati machipukizi ya majani mapya ya waridi yanapong'arisha taji lake.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga jeke-jeke genye makodza chila wakati, na kpwenye tsi kavu zaidi unamera kanda-kanda ya miho mikulu na midide tu. Uhendze wakati makakaya ga kundu ganaphokala muhini, au wakati makodza maphya ga pinki ganaphoala dzulu ya dari.

uses.en: The red heartwood is used for building and furniture, and the trunks for poles and dugout canoes. The roots are used in traditional medicine, and the plant is also used to make soap.
uses.sw: Kiini chake chekundu cha mbao hutumika kwa ujenzi na samani, na mashina yake kwa nguzo na mitumbwi ya kuchongwa. Mizizi hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji, na mmea huu pia hutumika kutengeneza sabuni.
uses.dg: Chiini cha kundu nkuhumirwa kudzenga na kuhenda fanicha, na makolo nkuhumirwa dza nguzo na kuhenda ngarawa. Mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji, na mmea piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda sabuni.

culture.en: Its name speaks of shade: *nchivuri* comes from *chivurivuri*, 'shade', for its broad canopy. A tree like this is a natural place to rest out of the midday sun.
culture.sw: Jina lake linazungumzia kivuli: *nchivuri* linatokana na *chivurivuri*, 'kivuli', kwa sababu ya taji lake pana. Mti kama huu ni mahali pa kawaida pa kupumzika mbali na jua kali la mchana.
culture.dg: Dzinare rinagomba kuhusu chivuri: *nchivuri* rinalavywa kula *chivurivuri*, neno ra Chidigo ra pepho, kpwa sababu ya dariye pana. Muhi dza uhu ni phatu pha kawaida pha kuoya na kuhepa dzuwa ra namutsi.

names.en: The Digo name is *nchivuri*; it is also called *mpwakapwaka*. In Swahili it is *mwakamwatu*, and in English triangle-tops, after its three-cornered fruits. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mpwakapwaka* for this tree (*Blighia unijugata*) with the Swahili *mkukilemba* and *mwakamwatu*. Note that *mpwakapwaka* is also recorded as the Digo name of a different shrub, *Deinbollia borbonica*, in the same family.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *nchivuri*; pia huitwa *mpwakapwaka*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mwakamwatu*, na kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *triangle-tops*, kutokana na matunda yake yenye pembe tatu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mpwakapwaka* kwa mti huu (*Blighia unijugata*), pamoja na majina ya Kiswahili *mkukilemba* na *mwakamwatu*. Ikumbukwe kwamba *mpwakapwaka* pia limerekodiwa kama jina la Kidigo la kichaka kingine, *Deinbollia borbonica*, cha familia hiyo hiyo.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *nchivuri*; piya unaihwa *mpwakapwaka*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mwakamwatu*, na kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *triangle-tops*, kpwa sababu ya matundage genye pembe tahu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mpwakapwaka* kpwa muhi uhu (*Blighia unijugata*), phamwenga na madzina ga Chiswahili *mkukilemba* na *mwakamwatu*. Manya kukala *mpwakapwaka* piya rikaandikpwa dza dzina ra Chidigo ra chitsaka chanjina, *Deinbollia borbonica*, cha jamii mwenga.

teaser.en: Hunters once used the sticky milk of this hairy fig as glue, fixing feathers onto arrow shafts.
teaser.sw: Zamani wawindaji walitumia utomvu unaonata wa mkuyu huu wenye manyoya kama gundi, kubandika manyoya ya ndege kwenye mishale.
teaser.dg: Kare akala kala anahumira maziya ganagonyata ga kuyu ihi yenye nyere dza gundi, kubandikiza manyoya kpwenye mabura.

summary.en: *Uuzi kaha* is the lowveld fig, a hairy-leaved fig of the bush and forest edge that runs with sticky latex. That latex was used to glue the feathers onto arrows.
summary.sw: *Uuzi kaha* (kwa Kiingereza *lowveld fig*) ni mkuyu wenye majani yenye vinyweleo, wa vichakani na pembezoni mwa misitu, unaotiririka utomvu unaonata. Utomvu huo ulitumika kubandika manyoya kwenye mishale.
summary.dg: *Uuzi kaha* (kpwa Chingereza *lowveld fig*) ni kuyu yenye makodza genye nyere, ya weruni na ya kanda-kanda ya matsaka, inayolavya maziya manji ganagonyata. Maziya higo kala ganahumirwa kubandikiza manyoya kpwenye mahondza.

about.en: *Uuzi kaha* is a fig tree, and like all figs it bleeds a milky latex when a leaf or twig is broken; in this species the latex flows freely. The leaves and young twigs are covered in soft hairs. The small, rounded figs grow in pairs where the leaves join the twigs.
about.sw: *Uuzi kaha* ni mti wa jamii ya mikuyu, na kama mikuyu yote hutoa utomvu kama maziwa jani au kitawi kinapovunjwa; kwa spishi hii utomvu hutiririka kwa wingi. Majani na vitawi vichanga vimefunikwa na vinyweleo laini. Matunda yake madogo ya mviringo huota kwa jozi mahali majani yanapoungana na vitawi.
about.dg: *Uuzi kaha* ni muhi wa kuyu, na dza kuyu zosi, unalavya maziya kodza au liphungo richibondwa; kpwa aina ihi, maziya ganatuluka manji sana. Makodza na maphungo matsanga ganafwinikpwa ni nyere laini. Kuyu ndide za mviringo zinamera airi-airi phatu makodza ganaphoungana na maphungo.

where.en: It grows in bushland and along forest edges. Its paired figs and hairy leaves set it apart from the other wild figs of the coast.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na pembezoni mwa misitu. Matunda yake yanayoota kwa jozi na majani yenye vinyweleo huutofautisha na mikuyu mingine ya porini ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka na kanda-kanda ya matsaka. Kuyuze za airi-airi na makodzage genye nyere vinautafwautisha na kuyu zanjina za weruni za pwani.

uses.en: The sticky latex was used to glue feathers onto arrow shafts, a small but essential job in making arrows that fly straight.
uses.sw: Utomvu wake unaonata ulitumika kubandika manyoya kwenye vijiti vya mishale, kazi ndogo lakini muhimu katika kutengeneza mishale inayokwenda moja kwa moja.
uses.dg: Maziya ganagonyata kala ganahumirwa kubandikiza manyoya kpwenye mabura, kazi ndide ela muhimu sana kpwa kuhenda mahondza ganagouruka sawa-sawa.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names: *uuzi kaha*, and *chiganda ulimbo*, which is shared with Duruma and means 'fig with latex' (*ulimbo* is sticky latex or birdlime). In English it is the lowveld fig. Swahili uses the general fig name *mkuyu*, which in Digo belongs to the Cape fig (*Ficus sur*).
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo: *uuzi kaha*, na *chiganda ulimbo*, ambalo linatumika pia katika Kiduruma na lina maana ya 'mkuyu wenye utomvu' (*ulimbo* ni utomvu unaonata au ulimbo wa kunasia ndege). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *lowveld fig*. Kiswahili kinatumia jina la jumla la mikuyu, *mkuyu*, ambalo katika Kidigo ni la *Ficus sur* (kwa Kiingereza *Cape fig*).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo: *uuzi kaha*, na *chiganda ulimbo*, ambaro piya ni ra Chiduruma na manaye ni 'kuyu yenye maziya' (*ulimbo* ni maziya ganagonyata, au *ukaka* wa kugbwira nyuni). Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lowveld fig*. Chiswahili chinahumira dzina ra jumla ra kuyu, *mkuyu*, ambaro kpwa Chidigo ni dzina ra *Ficus sur* (*Cape fig*).

teaser.en: Corky knobs tipped with spines cover its stems, which makes it a fine living fence and a well-known malaria remedy.
teaser.sw: Vinundu vya gamba laini vyenye ncha za miiba hufunika mashina yake, jambo linaloufanya kuwa ua hai mzuri na dawa inayojulikana ya malaria.
teaser.dg: Mihiye inafwinikpwa ni mafundo ga dza chifundiro genye miya ntsani; kpwa hivyo ni mmea mnono wa kuhenda lichigo, na piya ni dawa ya homa inayomanyikana sana.

summary.en: *Chidori* is a spiny, scrambling shrub of the hot coastal bush, its stems studded with corky, spine-tipped knobs. The Digo boil its root bark against malaria and plant it as a living fence.
summary.sw: *Chidori* ni kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa na kuegemea katika vichaka vya joto vya pwani, chenye mashina yaliyojaa vinundu vya gamba laini vyenye ncha za miiba. Wadigo huchemsha gome la mizizi yake dhidi ya malaria na hukipanda kama ua hai.
summary.dg: *Chidori* ni chitsaka chenye miya chinachoenea na kufyombera dzulu ya vitsaka vyanjina kahi ya weru wa pwani wenye dzoho, na mihiye ina mafundo ga dza chifundiro genye miya ntsani. Adigo nkuchemusha gopha ra miziye dza dawa ya homa, na nkuchiphanda dza lichigo.

about.en: *Chidori* is a scrambling shrub that leans and sprawls through the bush. Its bark is covered in corky bosses, each tipped with a sharp spine, so a stem looks knobbly and is painful to grab. The compound leaves carry many small, lopsided leaflets. The berries ripen from red to black.
about.sw: *Chidori* ni kichaka kinachotambaa, kikiegemea na kujitandaza katikati ya vichaka. Gome lake limefunikwa na vinundu vya gamba laini, kila kimoja kikiwa na ncha ya mwiba mkali, kwa hiyo shina huonekana lenye mabonge na huumiza likishikwa. Majani yake ya mchanganyiko yana vijani vingi vidogo visivyo na ulinganifu. Matunda yake huiva kutoka rangi nyekundu hadi nyeusi.
about.dg: *Chidori* ni chitsaka chinachofyombera na kuenea kahi ya vitsaka vyanjina. Gophare rinafwinikpwa ni mafundo ga dza chifundiro, na chila fundo rina muya mkali ntsani, kpwa hivyo muhi unaonekana una mafundo-mafundo na unalumiza uchiugbwira. Makodzage ga kuungana gana makodza madide manji, na chila kodza dide rina uphande mmwenga mkulu kuriko wanjina. Matunda madide ganaivwa: ganakala ga kundu, chisha maru.

where.en: It grows in bushland and thicket in the hot, humid coastal lowlands, and around homesteads where it has been planted as a hedge.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na katika vichaka vizito vya nyanda za chini za pwani zenye joto na unyevu, na kandokando ya makazi ambako kimepandwa kama ua.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye vitsaka na tsakani kpwenye tsi za photsi za pwani zenye dzoho na jeke-jeke, na kuzunguluka midzi phatu ambapho chikaphandwa dza lichigo.

uses.en: The root bark is boiled and taken for malaria by the Digo of Diani. Its spines and tangled growth also make it a useful live fence around homesteads and fields.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome la mizizi na kulinywa kwa ajili ya malaria. Miiba yake na ukuaji wake uliosokotana pia hukifanya kuwa ua hai wenye manufaa kuzunguka makazi na mashamba.
uses.dg: Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha gopha ra mizi na kurinwa dza dawa ya homa. Miyaye na vira chinavyomera kpwa kutsanganyikana vinachihenda chikale lichigo ririro na fwaida kuzunguluka midzi na minda.

names.en: The Digo name is *chidori*, and the Mgombato dictionary describes it simply as a thorny shrub (Swahili *mti wenye miba*, 'a tree with thorns'). In Swahili it is *mkidori* or *msamburini*, and in Giriama *mkithunga*. No English common name is widely used; botanists call it *Harrisonia abyssinica*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *chidori*, na kamusi ya Mgombato inakieleza tu kama kichaka chenye miiba (kwa Kiswahili *mti wenye miba*, 'mti wenye miiba'). Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkidori* au *msamburini*, na kwa Kigiriama *mkithunga*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza linalotumika sana; wataalamu wa mimea wanakiita *Harrisonia abyssinica*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *chidori*, na kamusi ya Mgombato inachieleza tu dza chitsaka chenye miya (kpwa Chiswahili *mti wenye miba*, 'muhi wenye miya'). Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkidori* au *msamburini*, na kpwa Chigiryama ni *mkithunga*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana; asayansi a mimea anachiiha *Harrisonia abyssinica*.

reason.dg: *Mtseha* (*orange climber*), jamii ya mdimu, nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa ya homa

teaser.en: The Digo call it 'the acacia with claws', and anyone caught in its hooked thorns will understand why.
teaser.sw: Wadigo wanakiita 'mgunga wenye kucha', na yeyote aliyenaswa na miiba yake iliyopinda kama ndoano ataelewa kwa nini.
teaser.dg: Adigo anachiiha 'chikwata chenye kombe', na yeyesi anayegbwirwa ni miyaye iriyootyoka andamanya sababu.

summary.en: *Chikwata kombe* is the hook-thorn, a dry-country acacia armed with pairs of strongly hooked thorns. It gives firewood and fodder, and its cream flowers are rich in nectar for bees.
summary.sw: *Chikwata kombe* (kwa Kiingereza *hook-thorn*) ni mgunga wa maeneo makavu uliojihami kwa jozi za miiba iliyopinda sana kama ndoano. Hutoa kuni na lishe ya mifugo, na maua yake ya rangi ya krimu yana mbochi nyingi kwa nyuki.
summary.dg: *Chikwata kombe* (kpwa Chingereza *hook-thorn*) ni chikwata cha tsi kavu chenye miya airi-airi iriyootyoka sana. Chinalavya kuni na chakurya cha mifugo, na maruwage ga rangi ya maziya gana madzi manji ga mtswano ganagoriwa ni nyuchi.

about.en:
*Chikwata kombe* is a shrub or small tree, often growing as a tangle of stems. Its branches carry pairs of short, strongly hooked thorns, curved like claws, that snag clothing and skin. The leaves are feathery, made of small paired leaflets.

In flower it is covered in creamy, fluffy spikes with a sweet scent, which draw bees from far around.
about.sw:
*Chikwata kombe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, mara nyingi ukiota kama kichaka cha mashina yaliyosokotana. Matawi yake hubeba jozi za miiba mifupi iliyopinda sana kama ndoano, iliyojikunja kama kucha, inayonasa nguo na ngozi. Majani yake ni kama manyoya, yaliyoundwa kwa vijani vidogo vilivyopangwa kwa jozi.

Unapochanua hufunikwa na mashada ya maua ya rangi ya krimu, laini kama pamba, yenye harufu tamu, yanayowavuta nyuki kutoka mbali.
about.dg:
*Chikwata kombe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, na mara nyinji chinamera dza mihi minji iriyotsanganyikana. Pandaze zina miya mifupi airi-airi, iriyootyoka sana dza kombe, inayogbwira nguwo na ngozi. Makodzage ni dza manyoya, ganahendwa ni makodza madide airi-airi.

Wakati wa maruwa chinafwinikpwa ni mafungu mare ga maruwa ga rangi ya maziya, malaini dza pamba, genye arufu nono, ganagomweha nyuchi kula kure.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, in the drier country inland from the coast. It is easiest to notice when flowering, when whole bushes turn cream.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu, katika maeneo makavu zaidi yaliyo bara mbali na pwani. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona unapochanua, wakati vichaka vizima vinapogeuka rangi ya krimu.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye vitsaka vikavu, kpwenye tsi kavu zaidi ya bara, kure na pwani. Ni rahisi kuchiona wakati wa maruwa, wakati vitsaka vizima vinakala vya rangi ya maziya.

uses.en: It is cut for firewood and browsed as fodder. The hook-thorn is famous across East Africa as a honey plant: its flowers give bees plenty of nectar.
uses.sw: Hukatwa kwa kuni na hulishwa na mifugo. Mti huu ni maarufu Afrika Mashariki kote kama mmea wa asali: maua yake huwapa nyuki mbochi kwa wingi.
uses.dg: Nkutemwa kpwa kuni, na mifugo nkurya makodzage. *Chikwata kombe* chinamanyikana sana Afrika ya Mashariki dza mmea wa asali: maruwage ganapha nyuchi madzi manji ga mtswano.

culture.en: The name means 'acacia with claws': *chikwata* is the general Digo name for acacias, and *kombe* refers to the claws, the hooked thorns.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'mgunga wenye kucha': *chikwata* ni jina la jumla la Kidigo la migunga, na *kombe* linarejelea kucha, yaani miiba iliyopinda kama ndoano.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rina mana ya 'chikwata chenye kombe': *chikwata* ni dzina ra jumla ra Chidigo ra mihi ya aina ya *acacia*, na *kombe* ni miya iriyootyoka, iriyo dza kombe za nyama.

names.en: In Digo it is *chikwata kombe*. *Chikwata*, the general name for acacias, is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is called hook-thorn or black-thorn. No specific Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo ni *chikwata kombe*. *Chikwata*, jina la jumla la migunga, linatumika pia katika Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *hook-thorn* au *black-thorn*. Hakuna jina mahususi la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *chikwata kombe*. *Chikwata*, dzina ra jumla ra mihi ya *acacia*, ni dzina ra Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili piya. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *hook-thorn* au *black-thorn*. Takuna dzina hasa ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: Its flowers smell so sweet that they are woven into wedding wreaths and used to make perfume.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yananukia vizuri kiasi kwamba husukwa katika mashada ya maua ya harusi na hutumika kutengeneza manukato.
teaser.dg: Maruwage gana arufu nono sana, hata nkusukwa mashada ga harusi na nkuhumirwa kuhenda marashi.

summary.en: *Chilua* is the mkilua, a small coastal tree famous for its powerfully scented yellow-orange flowers. Found only on the East African coast, it is used for perfume and wedding wreaths and is listed as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: *Chilua* ni mkilua, mti mdogo wa pwani maarufu kwa maua yake ya manjano-machungwa yenye harufu kali. Unapatikana tu katika pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, hutumika kwa manukato na mashada ya maua ya harusi, na umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Chilua* (kpwa Chiswahili *mkilua*) ni muhi mdide wa pwani unaomanyikana sana kpwa maruwage ga rangi ya mandano na chungbwa genye arufu kali. Chinaphahikana pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki bahi; nkuhumirwa kuhenda marashi na mashada ga harusi, na chikaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (hatarini).

about.en:
*Chilua* is a shrub or small tree up to about 8 m. Its large leaves sit on very short stalks along the branches. The flowers are the reason people know it: pale yellow to orange, hanging on long stalks beneath the leaves, with a strong, sweet scent that carries far on a warm evening.

After flowering it bears clusters of red, finger-like fruit segments, typical of the custard-apple family.
about.sw:
*Chilua* ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaofikia urefu wa takriban m 8. Majani yake makubwa hukaa kwenye vikonyo vifupi sana kando ya matawi. Maua ndiyo sababu watu wanaujua: ya manjano hafifu hadi rangi ya machungwa, yakining'inia kwenye vikonyo virefu chini ya majani, yenye harufu kali na tamu inayofika mbali jioni yenye joto.

Baada ya kuchanua huzaa vishada vya vipande vyekundu vya tunda vinavyofanana na vidole, kama ilivyo kawaida ya familia ya mitopetope.
about.dg:
*Chilua* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaokula hadi phephi mita 8. Makodzage makulu ganamera kanda-kanda ya pandaze, dzulu ya milita mifupi sana. Maruwage ndigo ganayohenda atu achimanye: ni ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu hadi rangi ya chungbwa, ganagbwadzika photsi ya makodza dzulu ya milita mire, na gana arufu kali na nono inayophiya kure dziloni kuchikala na dzoho.

Bada ya maruwa chinalavya matunda ga kundu ganayomera phamwenga, genye vipande dza vyala; ndivyo irivyo kpwa mimea ya jamii ya *mbokwe*.

where.en: It grows wild in moist evergreen coastal forest on sandy soil, and is also kept near homes for its scent. It is found only along the East African coast.
where.sw: Huota porini katika misitu ya pwani yenye unyevu ya kijani mwaka mzima, kwenye udongo wa mchanga, na pia hupandwa karibu na nyumba kwa ajili ya harufu yake. Unapatikana tu kando ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Chinamera chenyewe kpwenye matsaka ga pwani genye madzi-madzi na makodza chila wakati, kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga, na piya nkuphandwa phephi na nyumba kpwa sababu ya arufuye. Chinaphahikana pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki bahi.

uses.en: The flowers are used to make perfume and are woven into wreaths for weddings. The roots are used in traditional medicine, and the stems as posts.
uses.sw: Maua yake hutumika kutengeneza manukato na husukwa katika mashada ya maua ya harusi. Mizizi hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji, na mashina kama nguzo.
uses.dg: Maruwa nkuhumirwa kuhenda marashi na nkusukwa mashada ga harusi. Mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji, na makolo nkuhumirwa dza viguzo.

culture.en: Its name comes from *lua*, 'flower', a fitting name for a plant whose blossoms are its whole reputation. Its place in wedding wreaths links it to celebration and beauty on the coast.
culture.sw: Jina lake linatokana na *lua*, 'ua', jina linalofaa kwa mmea ambao umaarufu wake wote unatokana na maua yake. Nafasi yake katika mashada ya maua ya harusi inauhusisha na sherehe na urembo wa pwani.
culture.dg: Dzinare rinalavywa kula *lua*, 'ruwa', dzina rinalofwaha kpwa mmea ambao maruwage ndigo sifwaye yosi. Kpwa kukala ganahumirwa kpwenye mashada ga harusi, chinatambukiza atu sherehe na uzuri pwani.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chilua*; ICRAF's handbook gives *chingade*. In Swahili it is *mkilua* or *mlua*, and in Giriama *mkilua*. The Swahili name has also become its scientific genus name, *Mkilua fragrans*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *chilua*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *chingade*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkilua* au *mlua*, na kwa Kigiriama *mkilua*. Jina la Kiswahili limekuwa pia jina la jenasi yake ya kisayansi, *Mkilua fragrans*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chilua*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *chingade*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkilua* au *mlua*, na kpwa Chigiriama ni *mkilua*. Dzina ra Chiswahili piya rikakala dzina ra jenasi ya chisayansi, *Mkilua fragrans*.

conservation.en: *Chilua* is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List and is endemic to the East African coast, so the remaining wild plants in coastal forest matter.
conservation.sw: *Chilua* umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN na ni mmea wa pekee wa pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, kwa hiyo mimea iliyobaki porini katika misitu ya pwani ina umuhimu mkubwa.
conservation.dg: *Chilua* chikaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (hatarini) kpwenye IUCN Red List, na chinaphahikana pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki bahi, kpwa hivyo mimea iriyosala ya chienyeji kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ina samani sana.

teaser.en: Its name means 'smile', and it is used as a charm to win the warmth and goodwill of friends and workmates.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'tabasamu', na hutumika kama hirizi ya kupata upendo na nia njema ya marafiki na wafanyakazi wenzako.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'kutseka chidide' (*smile*), na nkuhumirwa dza hirizi ya kuphaha mendzwa ni asena na anzie a kazi.

summary.en: *Chimwemwe* is the bushveld gardenia, a twiggy tree with large, fragrant white trumpet flowers. It gives cooking sticks and medicine, and is used magically to win smiles and appreciation.
summary.sw: *Chimwemwe* ni mkimwemwe, mti wenye vitawi vingi na maua makubwa meupe yenye umbo la tarumbeta na harufu nzuri. Hutoa vijiti vya kupikia na dawa, na hutumika kiuchawi kupata tabasamu na kuthaminiwa.
summary.dg: *Chimwemwe* ni muhi wenye panda nyinji nyembamba, wenye maruwa makulu mereru ga umbo ra ndzumari na genye arufu nono. Chinalavya vigongo vya kujitira na dawa, na nkuhumirwa chiwanga ili mutu aphahe kutsekerwa na kuishimiwa.

about.en:
*Chimwemwe* is a twiggy, stiff-branched tree up to about 8 m. Its spoon-shaped leaves grow in whorls of three at the tips of short shoots. The flowers are large white trumpets that fade to yellow and smell sweet, especially in the evening.

The fruits are hard, oval and ribbed, and can stay on the tree for a long time.
about.sw:
*Chimwemwe* ni mti wenye vitawi vingi na matawi magumu, unaofikia urefu wa takriban m 8. Majani yake yenye umbo la kijiko huota matatu matatu kwa mzunguko kwenye ncha za vichipukizi vifupi. Maua yake ni makubwa meupe yenye umbo la tarumbeta, ambayo hufifia kuwa manjano na kunukia vizuri, hasa jioni.

Matunda yake ni magumu, ya umbo la yai na yenye mifereji, na yanaweza kukaa mtini kwa muda mrefu.
about.dg:
*Chimwemwe* ni muhi wenye panda nyinji nyembamba na ngumu, unaokula hadi phephi mita 8. Makodzage ga umbo ra chidziko ganamera matahu-matahu kpwenye ntsa za machipukizi mafupi. Maruwa ni makulu mereru ga umbo ra ndzumari, ganaphiya ganakala ga rangi ya mandano, na gana arufu nono, hasa dziloni.

Matunda ni magumu, ga mviringo, genye mistari, na ganaweza kukala muhini kpwa muda mure.

where.en: It grows in bushland and wooded grassland. It is easiest to find when the white, fragrant flowers are open.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na katika nyika zenye miti. Ni rahisi zaidi kuupata wakati maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri yamechanua.
where.dg: Chinamera vitsakani na weruni wenye nyasi na mihi. Ni rahisi kuchiona wakati maruwage mereru genye arufu nono ganavugulika.

uses.en: The hard wood is shaped into cooking stirrers and sticks. The plant is also used in traditional medicine and in ceremonies.
uses.sw: Mbao zake ngumu huchongwa kuwa miiko ya kusongea na vijiti. Mmea huu pia hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji na katika matambiko.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi ni ngumu, na nkutsongwa kuhenda vifwidzo na vigongo vya kujitira. Mmea piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji na kpwenye shughuli za chienyeji.

culture.en: The name *chimwemwe* means 'smile'. The plant is used magically to win appreciation and smiles from peers and workmates, a charm for goodwill as pleasant as its flowers.
culture.sw: Jina *chimwemwe* lina maana ya 'tabasamu'. Mmea huu hutumika kiuchawi ili kupata kuthaminiwa na tabasamu kutoka kwa wenzako na wafanyakazi wenzako, hirizi ya nia njema inayopendeza kama maua yake.
culture.dg: Dzina *chimwemwe* rina mana ya 'kutseka chidide' (*smile*). Mmea nkuhumirwa chiwanga ili mutu aishimiwe na atsekerwe ni asena na anzie a kazi: hirizi ya kuphaha mendzwa, nono dza maruwage.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chimwemwe*; ICRAF's handbook gives *mchimwemwe*. In Swahili and Giriama it is *mkimwemwe*. In English it is the bushveld gardenia.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *chimwemwe*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mchimwemwe*. Kwa Kiswahili na Kigiriama ni *mkimwemwe*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *bushveld gardenia*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chimwemwe*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *mchimwemwe*. Kpwa Chiswahili na Chigiriama ni *mkimwemwe*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *bushveld gardenia*.

teaser.en: Crush a leaf of horsewood and a strong aniseed-like smell fills the air, which is how healers know they have the right plant.
teaser.sw: Ponda jani la *chinyapala* na harufu kali kama ya binzari tamu (anise) hujaa hewani; hivyo ndivyo waganga wanavyojua kwamba wamepata mmea sahihi.
teaser.dg: Fikitsa kodza ra *chinyapala* na arufu kali dza ya *aniseed* inaenea phosi; ndivyo aganga anavyomanya kukala akaphaha mmea wa kpweli.

summary.en: *Chinyapala* is horsewood, a shrub with strongly aromatic, gland-dotted leaves. The Digo boil its leaves for malaria, chew its twigs as toothbrushes and use its springy wood for posts.
summary.sw: *Chinyapala* (kwa Kiingereza *horsewood*) ni kichaka chenye majani yenye harufu kali, yaliyojaa vitone vya tezi. Wadigo huchemsha majani yake kwa ajili ya malaria, hutafuna vitawi vyake kama miswaki na hutumia mbao zake zinazopindika kwa nguzo.
summary.dg: *Chinyapala* (kpwa Chingereza *horsewood*) ni chitsaka chenye makodza genye arufu kali na vitone vidide vya mafuha. Adigo nkuchemusha makodzage kpwa homa (malaria), nkuafuna vigongove dza misuwaki, na nyama za muhi zinazootyoka nkuhumirwa dza viguzo.

about.en: *Chinyapala* is a shrub or small tree with compound leaves made of many small leaflets. Hold a leaf up to the light and you will see it is dotted with tiny glands, which release a strong, pungent smell when crushed. It belongs to the citrus family, and the scent shows it. Small berries ripen from red to black.
about.sw: *Chinyapala* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani ya mchanganyiko yaliyoundwa kwa vijani vingi vidogo. Ukiliinua jani kuelekea mwangaza utaona kwamba limejaa vitone vya tezi ndogo sana, ambazo hutoa harufu kali, inayochoma puani, linapopondwa. Ni wa familia ya michungwa, na harufu yake inathibitisha hilo. Matunda yake madogo huiva kutoka rangi nyekundu hadi nyeusi.
about.dg: *Chinyapala* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ganayohendwa ni makodza madide manji. Uchirilola kodza kpwenye mwanga, undaona kukala rina vitone vidide sana vya mafuha, ambavyo vichifikitswa vinalavya arufu kali. Ni cha jamii ya michungbwa, na arufuye inaonyesa. Matunda madide ganaivwa kula ga kundu hadi kukala maru.

where.en: It grows on forest edges and in the bush.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu na vichakani.
where.dg: Chinamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na weruni.

uses.en: The Digo of Diani boil the leaves to treat malaria, and the leaves are also brewed as a tea. Twigs are chewed into toothbrushes. The wood is strong and elastic, and it is used for posts.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha majani kutibu malaria, na majani pia hutengenezwa chai. Vitawi hutafunwa kuwa miswaki. Mbao zake ni imara na zinapindika bila kuvunjika, na hutumika kwa nguzo.
uses.dg: Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha makodza kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria), na makodza piya nkuchemuswa dza chai. Vigongo nkuafunwa kuhenda misuwaki. Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na zinaotyoka bila kuvundzika, na nkuhumirwa dza viguzo.

culture.en: *Pala* means gazelle, but what the full name means is unclear.
culture.sw: *Pala* ina maana ya swala, lakini maana ya jina zima haijulikani wazi.
culture.dg: *Pala* ni dzina ra nyama wa tsaka (*gazelle*), ela manage ga dzina rosi tagamanyikana.

names.en: Pakia records *chinyapala*, and ICRAF's handbook gives *mnyapala*. In Giriama it is *kathimi kapala*. In English it is horsewood. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *chinyapala*, na kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mnyapala*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *kathimi kapala*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *horsewood*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chinyapala*, na chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *mnyapala*. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *kathimi kapala*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *horsewood*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Same citrus family, also used for malaria
reason.sw: Wa familia ileile ya michungwa, nao hutumika kwa malaria
reason.dg: *Chidori*, wa jamii mwenga ya michungbwa, piya nkuhumirwa kpwa homa (malaria)

reason.sw: Mtambaa wa familia ya michungwa (*orange climber*), dawa ya malaria
reason.dg: *Mtseha*, mmea unaofyombera wa jamii ya michungbwa, dawa ya homa (malaria)

reason.sw: Mswaki, nao hutafunwa kusafisha meno
reason.dg: *Msuwaki*, navyo vigongove nkuafunwa kpwa meno

reason.sw: Mdungu (*knobwood*), wa familia ya michungwa, hutumika kwa meno na malaria
reason.dg: *Mdungu*, wa jamii ya michungbwa, nkuhumirwa kpwa meno na homa (malaria)

teaser.en: Called the 'crown of honour', this bush legume is used in charms meant to raise a person above their rivals.
teaser.sw: Kikiitwa 'taji la heshima', kichaka hiki cha jamii ya kunde hutumika katika hirizi zinazokusudiwa kumwinua mtu juu ya wapinzani wake.
teaser.dg: Chinaihwa 'chiremba cha hishima', na chitsaka hichi cha jamii ya kunde nkuhumirwa kpwa hirizi za kumhenda mutu akale dzulu ya apindzanie.

summary.en: *Chitadzi* is a dry-country shrub with feathery leaves and large mauve pea flowers. It is used in medicine, for walking sticks and light building, and in magic to crown a person to dominance.
summary.sw: *Chitadzi* ni mkitaji, kichaka cha maeneo makavu chenye majani kama manyoya na maua makubwa ya rangi ya zambarau hafifu yanayofanana na ya mbaazi. Hutumika katika dawa, kwa fimbo za kutembelea na ujenzi mwepesi, na kiuchawi kumvika mtu taji la kutawala wengine.
summary.dg: *Chitadzi* ni chitsaka cha tsi kavu chenye makodza dza nyoya na maruwa makulu ga zambarau dza ga kunde. Nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa, kuhenda fwimbo za kunyendekera na kudzengera vitu vidide, na chiwanga kumvwika mutu chiremba cha utawala.

about.en: *Chitadzi* is a shrub with leaves made of many small, paired leaflets, giving it a fine, feathery look. Its flowers are large for the plant, mauve pea-flowers that stand out against the grey-green bush.
about.sw: *Chitadzi* ni kichaka chenye majani yaliyoundwa kwa vijani vingi vidogo vilivyopangwa kwa jozi, vinavyokipa sura laini kama ya manyoya. Maua yake ni makubwa ukilinganisha na ukubwa wa mmea, maua ya rangi ya zambarau hafifu yanayofanana na ya mbaazi, yanayojitokeza wazi dhidi ya kijani-kijivu cha vichaka.
about.dg: *Chitadzi* ni chitsaka chenye makodza ganayohendwa ni makodza madide manji ganayolengana mairi-mairi, na ichi ndicho chinachochipha umbo ra nyoya. Maruwage ni makulu kpwa ukulu wa mmea, ga zambarau, dza maruwa ga kunde, na ganaonekana sana kahi ya weruni wa rangi ya chijani na ivu.

where.en: It grows in dry lowlands and coastal bushland.
where.sw: Huota katika nyanda za chini zilizo kavu na vichaka vya pwani.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye tsi kavu ya photsi na weruni wa pwani.

uses.en: Roots, leaves and even the ash of the plant are used in traditional medicine. Its straight stems are used in light construction and made into walking sticks.
uses.sw: Mizizi, majani na hata jivu la mmea huu hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji. Mashina yake yaliyonyooka hutumika katika ujenzi mwepesi na hutengenezwa fimbo za kutembelea.
uses.dg: Mizi, makodza na hata ivu ra mmea nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji. Makologe ganayogoloka nkuhumirwa kudzengera vitu vidide, na nkuhenderwa fwimbo za kunyendekera.

culture.en: Its name is explained as 'crown of honour'. It is used magically to crown someone to dominance: a charm for rank and respect.
culture.sw: Jina lake linaelezwa kuwa na maana ya 'taji la heshima'. Hutumika kiuchawi kumvika mtu taji la kutawala wengine: hirizi ya cheo na heshima.
culture.dg: Dzinare nkugombwa kukala rina mana ya 'chiremba cha hishima'. Nkuhumirwa chiwanga kumvwika mutu chiremba ili akale dzulu ya anzie: hirizi ya kuphaha cheo na hishima.

names.en: Pakia records *chitadzi*; ICRAF's handbook gives *mkitaji*, which is also the Swahili name. In Giriama it is *mkitaji* or *kitwadzi*. There is no common English name; botanists call it *Ormocarpum kirkii*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *chitadzi*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mkitaji*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mkitaji* au *kitwadzi*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza; wataalamu wa mimea wanakiita *Ormocarpum kirkii*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chitadzi*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *mkitaji*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *mkitaji* au *kitwadzi*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinaromanyikana; asayansi anachiiha *Ormocarpum kirkii*.

teaser.en: Its name means 'peel off', a warning about the burning white latex that can make skin blister and peel.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'kuchubuka', onyo kuhusu utomvu mweupe unaounguza ambao unaweza kufanya ngozi itoke malengelenge na kuchubuka.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'anduka' (*peel off*), ni onyo kuhusu maziya mereru ganayoocha, ganayoweza kuhenda ngozi ilavye marenje-renje na ianduke.

summary.en: *Chiyuyu* is a succulent bush shrub with fleshy leaves and a burning white latex. Its Digo name is a plain warning of what the sap does to skin.
summary.sw: *Chiyuyu* ni kichaka cha vichakani chenye utomvu mwingi, majani manene yenye majimaji na utomvu mweupe unaounguza. Jina lake la Kidigo ni onyo la wazi kuhusu kile ambacho utomvu huo huifanyia ngozi.
summary.dg: *Chiyuyu* ni chitsaka cha weruni chenye makodza maziho genye madzi na maziya mereru ganayoocha. Dzina ra Chidigo ni onyo ra wazi ra vira maziya higa ganavyohenda ngozi.

about.en: *Chiyuyu* is a succulent shrub in the euphorbia family, with thick, fleshy leaves and soft green stems. Break any part and a white, milky latex runs out. That latex is caustic: it burns the skin and can make it peel, so the plant is best handled with care, and kept well away from the eyes.
about.sw: *Chiyuyu* ni kichaka chenye majimaji cha familia ya mibono (jamii ya *Euphorbia*), chenye majani manene yenye majimaji na mashina laini ya kijani. Ukivunja sehemu yoyote, utomvu mweupe kama maziwa hutiririka. Utomvu huo ni mkali: huunguza ngozi na unaweza kuifanya ichubuke, kwa hiyo ni bora kuushika mmea huu kwa uangalifu, na kuuweka mbali kabisa na macho.
about.dg: *Chiyuyu* ni chitsaka chenye madzi manji ndani, cha jamii ya mwono, chenye makodza maziho genye madzi na makolo ga chijani ganayokala laini. Uchivundza seemu yoyosi, maziya mereru ganatuluka. Maziya higa ni makali: ganaocha ngozi na ganaweza kuhenda ianduke, kpwa hivyo ni bora kuugbwira mmea uhu kpwa makini, na kuuika kure na matso.

where.en: It grows in bushland.
where.sw: Huota vichakani.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni.

culture.en: The name *chiyuyu* means 'peel off', because the latex burns and makes the skin peel. The name works as a lesson in itself: anyone who learns it learns to leave the sap alone.
culture.sw: Jina *chiyuyu* lina maana ya 'kuchubuka', kwa sababu utomvu wake huunguza na kufanya ngozi ichubuke. Jina lenyewe ni somo: yeyote anayejifunza jina hili hujifunza kuuacha utomvu huo.
culture.dg: Dzina *chiyuyu* rina mana ya 'anduka' (*peel off*), kpwa sababu maziyage ganaocha na kuhenda ngozi ianduke. Dzina ra hiri ni fundzo ra macheye: yeyesi anayerimanya, anamanya kuricha maziya higa.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *chiyuyu* and *tupa*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Synadenium pereskiifolium*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *chiyuyu* na *tupa*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanakiita *Synadenium pereskiifolium*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *chiyuyu* na *tupa*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anachiiha *Synadenium pereskiifolium*.

reason.en: Euphorbia, a succulent relative with milky latex
reason.sw: *Euphorbia*, jamaa mwenye majimaji na utomvu kama maziwa
reason.dg: *Ganga*, ndugu wa jamii mwenga, wenye madzi manji ndani na maziya mereru

reason.en: Castor oil plant, same spurge family
reason.sw: Mbarika, wa familia ileile ya mibono
reason.dg: *Mwono*, wa jamii mwenga ya mwono

reason.en: Arrow-poison tree, another plant known for its dangerous sap
reason.sw: Mti wa sumu ya mishale, mmea mwingine unaojulikana kwa utomvu wake hatari
reason.dg: *Utsungu*, mmea wanjina unaomanyikana kpwa maziyage ga hatari

reason.en: Sodom apple, another bush plant to handle with care
reason.sw: Mtunguja (*Sodom apple*), mmea mwingine wa vichakani wa kushika kwa uangalifu
reason.dg: *Mtungudza koma*, mmea wanjina wa weruni wa kugbwirwa kpwa makini

definition.en: A burning, itching latex that harms the skin and eyes, so people avoid it.
definition.sw: Utomvu unaounguza na kuwasha, unaodhuru ngozi na macho, kwa hiyo watu huuepuka.
definition.dg: Maziya ganayoocha na kuawiwa, ganayobananga ngozi na matso, kpwa hivyo atu nkugahepa.

use.en: Some people use it as a fish poison.
use.sw: Baadhi ya watu huutumia kama sumu ya kuvulia samaki.
use.dg: Atu anjina nkugahumira dza sumu ya kuolaga ng'onda.

teaser.en: Its papery green bark peels like old paint, and its fragrant resin is chewed, carved into, and used on arrows.
teaser.sw: Gome lake la kijani kama karatasi hubanduka kama rangi kuukuu, na utomvu wake wenye harufu nzuri hutafunwa, huchongwa, na hutumika kwenye mishale.
teaser.dg: Gophare ra chijani rinaanduka dza karatasi, dza rangi ya kare inavyoanduka, na ulimbowe wenye arufu nono nkuafunwa, nkutsongwa na nkuhumirwa kpwenye mivwi.

summary.en: *Mbambara* is the African myrrh, a spiny dry-bush shrub with peeling bark and fragrant resin. Its resin, fruit, roots and wood all have uses, from chewing and medicine to spoons and toothbrushes.
summary.sw: *Mbambara* (kwa Kiingereza *African myrrh*) ni kichaka chenye miiba cha vichaka vikavu, chenye gome linalobanduka na utomvu wenye harufu nzuri. Utomvu, matunda, mizizi na mbao zake vyote vina matumizi, kuanzia kutafuna na dawa hadi miiko na miswaki.
summary.dg: *Mbambara* (kpwa Chingereza *African myrrh*) ni chitsaka cha weruni mkavu chenye miya, gopha rinaroanduka na ulimbo wenye arufu nono. Ulimbowe, matundage, miziye na nyama za muhi vyosi vina kazi, kula kuafunwa na dawa hadi kuhenda vidziko na misuwaki.

about.en: *Mbambara* is a spiny shrub whose bark peels away in papery flakes to show green beneath. Cut it and a fragrant, resinous sap oozes out, the mark of the myrrh family. Each leaf has three hairy leaflets, and the leaves often drop in the dry season, leaving a grey, spiny skeleton. The small flowers are red.
about.sw: *Mbambara* ni kichaka chenye miiba ambacho gome lake hubanduka kwa vipande vyembamba kama karatasi na kuonyesha rangi ya kijani chini yake. Ukikikata, utomvu wenye harufu nzuri hutoka, alama ya familia ya manemane. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu vyenye vinyweleo, na mara nyingi majani hupukutika wakati wa kiangazi, yakiacha kiunzi cha kijivu chenye miiba. Maua yake madogo ni mekundu.
about.dg: *Mbambara* ni chitsaka chenye miya, ambacho gophare rinaanduka vipande vyembamba dza karatasi na photsi kunaonekana rangi ya chijani. Uchichenya gopha, ulimbo wenye arufu nono unatuluka, ndiyo alama ya jamii ya *myrrh*. Chila kodza rina makodza madide matahu genye nyere. Mara nyinji makodza ganagbwa wakati wa kazikazi, na kunasala mifupha ya rangi ya ivu yenye miya. Maruwage madide ni ga kundu.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, in the drier country away from the moist coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu, katika maeneo makavu zaidi yaliyo mbali na pwani yenye unyevu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni mkavu, kpwenye tsi kavu iriyo kure na pwani yenye jeke-jeke.

uses.en: The resin is chewed and is also used in arrow-making. The fruit and young roots are eaten. The soft wood is carved, notably into spoons, and twigs serve as toothbrushes. The plant is also used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Utomvu wake hutafunwa na pia hutumika katika kutengeneza mishale. Matunda na mizizi michanga huliwa. Mbao zake laini huchongwa, hasa kuwa miiko, na vitawi hutumika kama miswaki. Mmea huu pia hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji.
uses.dg: Ulimbo nkuafunwa na piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda mivwi. Matunda na mizi midide nkuriwa. Nyama za muhi ni laini, na nkutsongwa, hasa kuhenda vidziko, na vigongo nkuhumirwa dza misuwaki. Mmea piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records *mbambara*; ICRAF's handbook and the Mgombato dictionary give *chibambara*. Mgombato calls it the poison-grub commiphora and lists Swahili *mkororo*, *mbambara* and *mlororo*; Swahili also has *mturituri*. In Giriama it is *musishwi*, and in English African myrrh.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *mbambara*; kitabu cha ICRAF na kamusi ya Mgombato vinatoa *chibambara*. Mgombato inauita *poison-grub commiphora* na kuorodhesha majina ya Kiswahili *mkororo*, *mbambara* na *mlororo*; Kiswahili kina pia *mturituri*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *musishwi*, na kwa Kiingereza *African myrrh*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mbambara*; chitabu cha ICRAF na kamusi ya Mgombato vinapha *chibambara*. Mgombato unauiha *poison-grub commiphora* na unaandika madzina ga Chiswahili *mkororo*, *mbambara* na *mlororo*; Chiswahili piya china *mturituri*. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *musishwi*, na kpwa Chingereza *African myrrh*.

teaser.en: The 'big rib plant' is used against convulsions that are said to grip the rib cage.
teaser.sw: 'Mmea mkubwa wa mbavu' hutumika dhidi ya degedege linalosemekana kubana mbavu.
teaser.dg: 'Mmea mkulu wa mbavu' nkuhumirwa kpwa nyuni inayogbwira mbavu, ambayo nkugombwa inagbwira chifuwa.

summary.en: *Mbavubavu mkulu* is a bush shrub of the Grewia family with three-veined leaves and small lobed fruits. Its name, 'rib plant', matches its use against convulsions affecting the ribs.
summary.sw: *Mbavubavu mkulu* ni kichaka cha vichakani cha jenasi ya *Grewia*, chenye majani yenye mishipa mitatu na matunda madogo yenye mapande. Jina lake, 'mmea wa mbavu', linalingana na matumizi yake dhidi ya degedege linaloathiri mbavu.
summary.dg: *Mbavubavu mkulu* ni chitsaka cha weruni cha jenasi ya *Grewia*, chenye makodza genye mishipa mitahu na matunda madide ganayohalana na matunda madide ganayogbwirana. Dzinare, 'mmea wa mbavu', rinalingana na kaziye ya kuphoza nyuni ya mbavu.

about.en: *Mbavubavu mkulu* is a shrub with leaves marked by three main veins running from the base, a typical Grewia feature. Its small fruits are lobed, like a few tiny berries fused together.
about.sw: *Mbavubavu mkulu* ni kichaka chenye majani yaliyo na mishipa mikuu mitatu inayoanzia kwenye kitako cha jani, sifa ya kawaida ya *Grewia*. Matunda yake madogo yana mapande, kama vitunda vidogo vichache vilivyoungana.
about.dg: *Mbavubavu mkulu* ni chitsaka chenye makodza genye mishipa mikulu mitahu inayoandzira photsi ya kodza, chitu cha kawaida kpwa *Grewia*. Matundage madide gana mala, dza matunda madide sana mairi au matahu ganayogbwirana.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and on forest edges.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani na pembezoni mwa misitu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni wa pwani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

uses.en: It is used to treat *nyuni wa mbavu*, convulsions that affect the rib cage.
uses.sw: Hutumika kutibu *nyuni wa mbavu*, degedege linaloathiri mbavu.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa kuphoza *nyuni wa mbavu*, nyuni inayogbwira mbavu.

culture.en: *Mbavubavu* means 'rib plant', a name tied directly to the illness it treats. The Digo distinguish two: this is *mbavubavu mkulu*, the big one, while the small form, *mbavubavu mdide*, is a different plant, *Premna resinosa*.
culture.sw: *Mbavubavu* lina maana ya 'mmea wa mbavu', jina linalohusiana moja kwa moja na ugonjwa unaoutibu. Wadigo wanatofautisha aina mbili: huu ni *mbavubavu mkulu*, mkubwa, wakati aina ndogo, *mbavubavu mdide*, ni mmea mwingine, *Premna resinosa*.
culture.dg: *Mbavubavu* rina mana ya 'mmea wa mbavu', dzina ririrohusiana wazi na ukongo unaouphoza. Adigo anamanya mbavubavu mbiri: hinyu ni *mbavubavu mkulu*, uriwo mkulu, na wa chidide, *mbavubavu mdide*, ni mmea wanjina, *Premna resinosa*.

names.en: The Digo name is *mbavubavu mkulu*, or simply *mbavubavu*, which is shared with Giriama and Duruma. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded. The Mgombato dictionary gives *m'bavu-bavu* for another plant, *Clerodendrum capitatum*, so the name may cover more than one species.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mbavubavu mkulu*, au kwa ufupi *mbavubavu*, ambalo linatumika pia katika Kigiriama na Kiduruma. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *m'bavu-bavu* kwa mmea mwingine, *Clerodendrum capitatum*, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili linajumuisha spishi zaidi ya moja.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mbavubavu mkulu*, au *mbavubavu* bahi, dzina ambaro piya ni ra Chigiriama na Chiduruma. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *m'bavu-bavu* kpwa mmea wanjina, *Clerodendrum capitatum*, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinaweza kukala ra aina zaidi ya mwenga.

teaser.en: A wild cousin of the custard apple, its knobbly yellow fruit is one of the best-loved snacks of the coastal bush.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa porini wa mtopetope, tunda lake la manjano lenye vinundu ni mojawapo ya vitafunio vinavyopendwa zaidi katika vichaka vya pwani.
teaser.dg: Ni ndugu wa weruni wa *custard apple*, na matundage ga rangi ya mandano genye maugu ni mwenga wa vyakurya vya weruni vinavyomendzwa sana pwani.

summary.en: *Mbokwe* is the wild custard apple, a small tree of the lowland grassland whose knobbly fruit ripens yellow-orange. It is one of the wild fruits commonly eaten by the Digo, and its wood makes hoe handles.
summary.sw: *Mbokwe* ni mtomoko mwitu, mti mdogo wa nyika za nyanda za chini ambao tunda lake lenye vinundu huiva likawa la manjano-machungwa. Ni mojawapo ya matunda ya porini yanayoliwa sana na Wadigo, na mbao zake hutengeneza mipini ya majembe.
summary.dg: *Mbokwe* (kpwa Chingereza *wild custard apple*) ni muhi mdide wa weruni wa nyasi wa tsi ya photsi, ambao matundage genye maugu ganaivwa na kukala ga rangi ya mandano na chungbwa. Ni mwenga wa matunda ga weruni ganayoriwa sana ni Adigo, na nyama za muhi nkuhenderwa miphini ya majembe.

about.en: *Mbokwe* is a shrub or small tree up to about 6 m. Its broad leaves are blue-green above and hairy beneath, and they feel thick and leathery. The fruit is round and knobbly, a small version of the custard apple, turning from green to yellow-orange as it ripens.
about.sw: *Mbokwe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaofikia urefu wa takriban m 6. Majani yake mapana ni ya kijani-buluu upande wa juu na yenye vinyweleo upande wa chini, na huhisika manene kama ngozi. Tunda lake ni la mviringo lenye vinundu, kama topetope dogo, na hubadilika kutoka kijani hadi manjano-machungwa linapoiva.
about.dg: *Mbokwe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaokula hadi phephi mita 6. Makodzage mapana ni ga rangi ya samawati na chijani dzulu, na gana nyere photsi, na ganakala maziho na magumu dza chingo. Tunda ni ra mviringo na renye maugu, dza *custard apple* ndide, na rinaivwa kula rangi ya chijani hadi rangi ya mandano na chungbwa.

where.en: It grows in wet lowland savanna and wooded grassland. Look for the ripening yellow-orange fruit among the blue-green leaves.
where.sw: Huota katika savana za nyanda za chini zenye unyevu na nyika zenye miti. Tafuta matunda yanayoiva ya manjano-machungwa katikati ya majani ya kijani-buluu.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye weruni wa nyasi wenye madzi wa tsi ya photsi, na weruni wenye nyasi na mihi. Hendza matunda ganayoivwa ga rangi ya mandano na chungbwa kahi ya makodza ga rangi ya samawati na chijani.

uses.en:
The ripe fruit, with its acid-sweet pulp, is eaten raw and is among the wild fruits Digo people commonly eat. Bark, roots and fruit are used in traditional medicine.

The bark gives a fibre and a brown dye, and the wood is often used for hoe handles.
uses.sw:
Tunda lililoiva, lenye nyama ya uchachu-utamu, huliwa bichi na ni miongoni mwa matunda ya porini yanayoliwa sana na Wadigo. Gome, mizizi na matunda hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji.

Gome hutoa nyuzi na rangi ya kahawia, na mbao zake mara nyingi hutumika kwa mipini ya majembe.
uses.dg:
Tunda ririroivwa, renye nyama ya ngbwadu na mtswano, nkuriwa dza ririvyo, na ni mwenga wa matunda ga weruni ganayoriwa sana ni Adigo. Gopha, mizi na matunda nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

Gopha rinalavya nyuzi na rangi ya dongo ya kutiya nguwo, na nyama za muhi mara nyinji nkuhumirwa kuhenda miphini ya majembe.

names.en: The Digo name is *mbokwe*; the Mgombato dictionary spells it *m'bokpwe* and gives the Swahili *mtopetope*. Other Swahili names are *mtomoko mwitu* ('wild custard apple') and *mkonokono*. In Giriama it is *mutaioma*. In English it is the wild custard apple or wild soursop.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mbokwe*; kamusi ya Mgombato inaliandika *m'bokpwe* na kutoa jina la Kiswahili *mtopetope*. Majina mengine ya Kiswahili ni *mtomoko mwitu* ('mtomoko wa porini') na *mkonokono*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mutaioma*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *wild custard apple* au *wild soursop*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mbokwe*; kamusi ya Mgombato inariandika *m'bokpwe* na inapha dzina ra Chiswahili *mtopetope*. Madzina ganjina ga Chiswahili ni *mtomoko mwitu* ('*custard apple* wa weruni') na *mkonokono*. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *mutaioma*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild custard apple* au *wild soursop*.

teaser.en: Clouds of white flowers cover this small coastal tree, a quiet relative of the hibiscus and cotton.
teaser.sw: Mawingu ya maua meupe hufunika mti huu mdogo wa pwani, jamaa mtulivu wa mbugi (hibiscus) na mpamba.
teaser.dg: Maruwa mereru manji dza maingu ganabwiningiza muhi uhu mdide wa pwani, ndugu asiyemanyikana sana wa *hibiscus* na pamba.

summary.en: *Mbwale* is a small coastal tree or shrub with heart-shaped leaves and clusters of white flowers. Like other Dombeyas it gives fibre and poles.
summary.sw: *Mbwale* ni mti mdogo au kichaka cha pwani chenye majani ya umbo la moyo na vishada vya maua meupe. Kama mimea mingine ya jenasi ya *Dombeya*, hutoa nyuzi na nguzo.
summary.dg: *Mbwale* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa pwani, wenye makodza ga umbo ra moyo na makundi ga maruwa mereru. Dza mihi yanjina ya *Dombeya*, unalavya nyuzi na mihi ya kudzengera.

about.en: *Mbwale* is a small tree or shrub with soft, heart-shaped leaves. It flowers in dense clusters of small white blossoms, which can cover the crown. It belongs to the mallow family, which also includes hibiscus and cotton.
about.sw: *Mbwale* ni mti mdogo au kichaka chenye majani laini ya umbo la moyo. Huchanua vishada vizito vya maua madogo meupe, ambayo yanaweza kufunika taji lote. Ni wa familia ya mibamia, ambayo pia inajumuisha mbugi (hibiscus) na mpamba.
about.dg: *Mbwale* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza laini ga umbo ra moyo. Unalavya maruwa kpwa makundi manji-manji ga maruwa madide mereru, ganayoweza kubwiningiza muhi wosi dzulu. Ni wa jamii ya *mallow*, ambayo piya ina *hibiscus* na pamba.

where.en: It grows on coastal forest edges, in wooded grassland and in bushland. It is most noticeable when flowering.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani, katika nyika zenye miti na vichakani. Huonekana zaidi unapochanua.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani, kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi na weruni. Unaonekana sana wakati una maruwa.

uses.en: Dombeyas are generally used for their tough bark fibre, for tying and rope, and for poles, and *mbwale* is used in similar ways.
uses.sw: Kwa kawaida mimea ya jenasi ya *Dombeya* hutumika kwa nyuzi ngumu za gome lake, kwa kufungia na kusokotea kamba, na kwa nguzo, na *mbwale* hutumika kwa njia hizo hizo.
uses.dg: Mihi ya *Dombeya* kpwa kawaida nkuhumirwa kpwa nyuzi ngumu za gopha, za kufungira na kuhendera kamba, na kpwa mihi ya kudzengera. Na *mbwale* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa njira zizo hizo.

names.en: The Digo and Swahili name is *mbwale*. It is recorded in ICRAF's handbook under a related species, *Dombeya rotundifolia*, so the name may cover more than one Dombeya. No English common name has been recorded for *Dombeya taylorii*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo na la Kiswahili ni *mbwale*. Limerekodiwa katika kitabu cha ICRAF chini ya spishi jamaa, *Dombeya rotundifolia*, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili linajumuisha zaidi ya spishi moja ya *Dombeya*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa kwa *Dombeya taylorii*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo na ra Chiswahili ni *mbwale*. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika dzina hiri kpwa aina ya phephi, *Dombeya rotundifolia*, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinaweza kukala ra aina zaidi ya mwenga za *Dombeya*. Kpwa Chingereza takuna dzina ririroandikpwa ra *Dombeya taylorii*.

teaser.en: Its two-tone flowers hang like little Chinese lanterns, pink above and yellow below.
teaser.sw: Maua yake ya rangi mbili huning'inia kama taa ndogo za karatasi za Kichina, waridi juu na manjano chini.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ga rangi mbiri ganabwadzika dza taa ndide za Chichina: ga pinki dzulu na ga rangi ya mandano photsi.

summary.en: *Mchinjiri* is the sicklebush, a thorny shrub of bush and fallow land with striking two-coloured flower spikes. It is a popular Digo medicine, and its roots are boiled for malaria.
summary.sw: *Mchinjiri* ni kichaka chenye miiba cha vichakani na mashamba yaliyoachwa, chenye mashada ya maua ya rangi mbili yanayovutia. Ni dawa maarufu ya Kidigo, na mizizi yake huchemshwa kwa ajili ya malaria.
summary.dg: *Mchinjiri* ni chitsaka chenye miya cha weruni na cha minda iriyorichwa, chenye maruwa ga rangi mbiri ganayoonekana sana. Ni dawa inayomendzwa ni Adigo, na miziye nkuchemuswa kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria).

about.en: *Mchinjiri* is a thorny shrub with feathery leaves made of many tiny leaflets. Its flowers are unmistakable: hanging spikes that are pink or mauve at the top and yellow below, like small lanterns, which gives it the English name Chinese lantern tree. After flowering it bears clusters of tightly twisted pods.
about.sw: *Mchinjiri* ni kichaka chenye miiba na majani kama manyoya yaliyoundwa kwa vijani vingi vidogo sana. Maua yake hayawezi kukosewa: mashada yanayoning'inia, ya waridi au zambarau hafifu juu na manjano chini, kama taa ndogo, jambo linaloupa jina la Kiingereza *Chinese lantern tree*. Baada ya kuchanua huzaa vishada vya maganda yaliyojisokota kwa nguvu.
about.dg: *Mchinjiri* ni chitsaka chenye miya na makodza dza manyoya, ganayohendwa ni makodza madide sana manji. Maruwage ni rahisi sana kugamanya: ni milita ya maruwa inayobwadzika, ya pinki au zambarau dzulu na ya rangi ya mandano photsi, dza taa ndide. Kpwa sababu hiyo kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *Chinese lantern tree*. Bada ya kulavya maruwa unalavya makundi ga makakaya ganayobeta sana.

where.en: It grows in bushland, wooded grassland and fallow fields, often springing up thickly where land has been cleared and left. Look for the lantern flowers along paths and field edges.
where.sw: Huota vichakani, katika nyika zenye miti na mashamba yaliyoachwa, mara nyingi ukichipuka kwa wingi mahali ambapo ardhi imefyekwa na kuachwa. Tafuta maua yake kama taa kando ya njia na pembezoni mwa mashamba.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi na minda iriyorichwa, mara nyinji uchimera manji-manji phatu ambapho tsi ikatemwa na kurichwa. Lola maruwa higa ga taa kanda-kanda ya njira na maso ga minda.

uses.en: It is a popular medicine. The Digo of Diani boil the roots to treat malaria.
uses.sw: Ni dawa maarufu. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi kutibu malaria.
uses.dg: Ni dawa inayomendzwa sana. Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha mizi kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria).

culture.en: Its second Digo name, *mpingwa*, comes from *pinga*, 'oppose': the plant is said to oppose the effects of disease.
culture.sw: Jina lake la pili la Kidigo, *mpingwa*, linatokana na *pinga*, 'kupinga': mmea huu husemekana kupinga madhara ya magonjwa.
culture.dg: Dzinare ra phiri ra Chidigo, *mpingwa*, rinalavywa kula *pinga*, 'kupinga': mmea uhu nkugombwa unapinga makongo.

names.en: In Digo it is *mchinjiri* or *mpingwa*. *Mchinjiri* is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. The Mgombato dictionary gives Swahili alternatives *mkulajembe* and *mvunjajembe msingino*. In English it is sicklebush or Chinese lantern tree.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo ni *mchinjiri* au *mpingwa*. *Mchinjiri* linatumika pia katika Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa majina mbadala ya Kiswahili *mkulajembe* na *mvunjajembe msingino*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *sicklebush* au *Chinese lantern tree*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mchinjiri* au *mpingwa*. *Mchinjiri* piya ni dzina ra Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili. Mgombato unapha madzina ga Chiswahili *mkulajembe* na *mvunjajembe msingino*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *sicklebush* au *Chinese lantern tree*.

reason.sw: *Chikwata kombe* (*hook-thorn*), kichaka kingine chenye miiba cha jamii ya kunde
reason.dg: Chitsaka chanjina cha weruni cha jamii ya kunde chenye miya

reason.en: Violet tree, whose roots are also boiled for malaria
reason.sw: *Mziji* (*violet tree*), ambao mizizi yake pia huchemshwa kwa ajili ya malaria
reason.dg: Muhi ambao miziye piya nkuchemuswa kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria)

reason.sw: Kichaka chenye miiba ambacho pia hutumika kwa malaria
reason.dg: Chitsaka chenye miya chinachohumirwa piya kpwa homa (malaria)

reason.dg: *Albizia*, mmea wa phephi wa jamii ya kunde wa weruni

teaser.en: Children use the dark juice of its berries as ink, and weaver birds love to settle in its branches.
teaser.sw: Watoto hutumia maji meusi ya matunda yake kama wino, na manyanje (ndege wafumaji) hupenda kutua katika matawi yake.
teaser.dg: Ana nkuhumira madzi maru ga matundage dza wino, na tsongo anamendza kudulama pandaze.

summary.en: *Mdanga tsongo* is the tassel berry, a bush shrub hung with bunches of berries that ripen from red to near black. Its fruit is eaten, its juice used by children as ink, and its leaves and roots as medicine.
summary.sw: *Mdanga tsongo* (kwa Kiingereza *tassel berry*) ni kichaka cha vichakani kilichoning'iniza vishada vya matunda yanayoiva kutoka mekundu hadi karibu meusi. Matunda yake huliwa, maji yake hutumiwa na watoto kama wino, na majani na mizizi yake kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Mdanga tsongo* ni chitsaka cha weruni chenye makundi ga matunda madide ganayoivwa kula ga kundu hadi kukala maru-maru. Matundage nkuriwa, madzige nkuhumirwa ni ana dza wino, na makodzage na miziye nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

about.en: *Mdanga tsongo* is a shrub or small tree with elliptic leaves that are hairy beneath. Its tiny flowers hang in drooping spikes, the 'tassels' of its English name. These become bunches of small berries that ripen unevenly, so a single bunch can show white, red and almost-black fruit at once.
about.sw: *Mdanga tsongo* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani ya umbo la duaradufu yenye vinyweleo upande wa chini. Maua yake madogo sana huning'inia kwa mashada yanayolegea, 'vishada' (*tassels*) vya jina lake la Kiingereza. Hayo hugeuka kuwa vishada vya matunda madogo yanayoiva bila mpangilio, kwa hiyo kishada kimoja kinaweza kuwa na matunda meupe, mekundu na karibu meusi kwa wakati mmoja.
about.dg: *Mdanga tsongo* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ga umbo ra yayi genye nyere photsi. Maruwage madide sana ganabwadzika kpwa milita, ndigo 'tassels' za dzinare ra Chingereza. Higa ganakala makundi ga matunda madide ganayoivwa bila kulingana, kpwa hivyo kundi rimwenga rinaweza kukala na matunda mereru, ga kundu na maru-maru kpwa wakati mmwenga.

where.en: It grows in bushland and on forest edges.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na pembezoni mwa misitu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

uses.en: The ripe berries are eaten, and children use the dark fruit juice as ink. Leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine, and the wood is made into tool handles.
uses.sw: Matunda yaliyoiva huliwa, na watoto hutumia maji meusi ya matunda kama wino. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji, na mbao zake hutengenezwa mipini ya zana.
uses.dg: Matunda maivu nkuriwa, na ana nkuhumira madzi maru ga matunda dza wino. Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji, na nyama za muhi nkutsongwa kuhenda miphini ya vifaa.

culture.en: *Mdanga tsongo* means 'settling place of weaver birds', a name that pictures noisy flocks gathering in the bush.
culture.sw: *Mdanga tsongo* lina maana ya 'mahali pa kutua manyanje', jina linalochora picha ya makundi ya ndege wenye kelele wakikusanyika vichakani.
culture.dg: *Mdanga tsongo* maanaye ni 'phatu pha kudulama tsongo', dzina rinarochora makundi ga tsongo ganayopiga kululu ganayokusanyika weruni.

names.en: This shrub has many Digo names. Pakia records *mdanga tsongo* (also *mdzenga tsongo*) and *muoga ivu*; ICRAF and the Mgombato dictionary give *mzengatsongo* or *mdzengatsongo*, and *chikuro*. Mgombato lists the Swahili as *mziwaziwa*, *msuaga*, *mbuanono* and *karacha*; Swahili also has *msasuzi*. In Giriama it is *mhirondo* or *msimbiji*, and in English tassel berry.
names.sw: Kichaka hiki kina majina mengi ya Kidigo. Pakia anarekodi *mdanga tsongo* (pia *mdzenga tsongo*) na *muoga ivu*; ICRAF na kamusi ya Mgombato vinatoa *mzengatsongo* au *mdzengatsongo*, na *chikuro*. Mgombato inaorodhesha majina ya Kiswahili *mziwaziwa*, *msuaga*, *mbuanono* na *karacha*; Kiswahili kina pia *msasuzi*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mhirondo* au *msimbiji*, na kwa Kiingereza *tassel berry*.
names.dg: Chitsaka chihi china madzina manji ga Chidigo. Pakia anaandika *mdanga tsongo* (piya *mdzenga tsongo*) na *muoga ivu*; chitabu cha ICRAF na Mgombato vinapha *mzengatsongo* au *mdzengatsongo*, na *chikuro*. Mgombato unaandika madzina ga Chiswahili *mziwaziwa*, *msuaga*, *mbuanono* na *karacha*; Chiswahili piya china *msasuzi*. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *mhirondo* au *msimbiji*, na kpwa Chingereza ni *tassel berry*.
