teaser.en: Burn this shrub as firewood, it is said, and the family will quarrel until the homestead breaks apart.
teaser.sw: Inasemekana ukikichoma kichaka hiki kama kuni, familia itagombana hadi boma lisambaratike.
teaser.dg: Nkugombwa kukala uchiocha chitsaka chihi dza kuni, mbari indaheha hadi mudzi uvundzike.

summary.en: *Mfumula ndolwa* is a rare shrub of dry lowland forest, including the Shimba Hills. Its name means 'disperser of the homestead', and people avoid using it for firewood or building.
summary.sw: *Mfumula ndolwa* ni kichaka adimu cha misitu mikavu ya nyanda za chini, ikiwemo Shimba Hills. Jina lake lina maana ya 'mtawanyaji wa boma', na watu huepuka kukitumia kwa kuni au ujenzi.
summary.dg: *Mfumula ndolwa* ni chitsaka adimu cha matsaka makavu ga herera, phamwenga na Shimba Hills. Dzinare maanaye ni 'unaotawanya mudzi', na atu nkuuhepa kuuhumira kpwa kuni au kudzengera.

about.en: *Mfumula ndolwa* is a shrub of the coffee family, with leaves in opposite pairs and small fruits that grow in pairs. It is an unassuming plant to look at, and much easier to recognise by reputation than by sight.
about.sw: *Mfumula ndolwa* ni kichaka cha familia ya mibuni, chenye majani yanayokabiliana kwa jozi na matunda madogo yanayoota kwa jozi. Si mmea wa kuvutia macho, na ni rahisi zaidi kukitambua kwa sifa yake kuliko kwa kukiona.
about.dg: *Mfumula ndolwa* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya kahawa, chenye makodza ganayomera mairi-mairi ganayolengana, na matunda madide ganayomera mairi-mairi. Kpwa kuulola tauna chitu cha ajabu, na ni rahisi zaidi kuumanya kpwa dzinare kuriko kpwa kuuona.

where.en: It grows in dry lowland forest and Brachystegia woodland, at around 30 to 130 m above sea level. It is one of four threatened plants of the Shimba Hills.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu mikavu ya nyanda za chini na mapori ya miombo (*Brachystegia*), kwenye mwinuko wa takriban m 30 hadi 130 juu ya usawa wa bahari. Ni mojawapo ya mimea minne iliyo hatarini ya Shimba Hills.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu ga herera na matsaka ga *Brachystegia*, phephi mita 30 hadi 130 dzulu ya bahari. Ni mwenga wa mimea mine iriyo hatarini ya Shimba Hills.

uses.en: It is deliberately avoided. People do not cut it for firewood or building poles.
uses.sw: Huepukwa kwa makusudi. Watu hawakikati kwa kuni wala kwa nguzo za ujenzi.
uses.dg: Nkuhepwa kpwa makusudi. Atu taaukata kpwa kuni wala kpwa mihi ya kudzengera.

culture.en: The name means 'disperser of the homestead'. It is believed that using the wood for firewood or house poles causes quarrels in the family, until the family splits and the homestead scatters. The belief has a protective effect: a plant no one will burn is a plant left standing.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'mtawanyaji wa boma'. Inaaminika kwamba kutumia mbao zake kwa kuni au nguzo za nyumba husababisha ugomvi katika familia, hadi familia igawanyike na boma litawanyike. Imani hii ina athari ya kukilinda: mmea ambao hakuna atakayeuchoma ni mmea unaoachwa umesimama.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri maanaye ni 'unaotawanya mudzi'. Atu anaamini kukala uchihumira nyama za muhi uhu dza kuni au mihi ya nyumba, kunareha kondo mbarini, hadi mbari ivundzike na mudzi utawanyike. Imani ihi inauhifadhi muhi: muhi ambao takuna anayeuocha ni muhi unaobaki uchiima.

names.en: The Digo name is *mfumula ndolwa*, which Giriama shares. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded. Older sources list it as *Canthium kilifiense*; today it is *Afrocanthium kilifiense*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mfumula ndolwa*, ambalo linatumika pia katika Kigiriama. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Vyanzo vya zamani vinakiorodhesha kama *Canthium kilifiense*; leo ni *Afrocanthium kilifiense*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mfumula ndolwa*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chigiriama. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Vitabu vya kare vinauandika dza *Canthium kilifiense*; rero ni *Afrocanthium kilifiense*.

conservation.en: *Mfumula ndolwa* is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List and is counted among four threatened plants of the Shimba Hills. Its survival depends on the remaining dry lowland forest.
conservation.sw: *Mfumula ndolwa* kimeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN na kinahesabiwa miongoni mwa mimea minne iliyo hatarini ya Shimba Hills. Kuendelea kuwepo kwake kunategemea misitu mikavu ya nyanda za chini iliyobaki.
conservation.dg: *Mfumula ndolwa* ukaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (hatarini) kpwenye IUCN Red List, na ni mwenga wa mimea mine iriyo hatarini ya Shimba Hills. Ili ubaki, unaluphira matsaka makavu ga herera garigobaki.

teaser.en: A modest coastal shrub that does many jobs at once: medicine, firewood, building poles and a patch of shade.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha kawaida cha pwani kinachofanya kazi nyingi kwa wakati mmoja: dawa, kuni, nguzo za ujenzi na kivuli.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha kawaida cha pwani chinachohenda kazi nyinji kpwa wakati mmwenga: dawa, kuni, mihi ya kudzengera na pepho.

summary.en: *Mkalakala* is a shrub or small tree of the coastal bushland with small berries. Its leaves and roots are used as medicine, and its wood for fuel and building poles.
summary.sw: *Mkalakala* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa vichaka vya pwani wenye matunda madogo. Majani na mizizi yake hutumika kama dawa, na mbao zake kwa kuni na nguzo za ujenzi.
summary.dg: *Mkalakala* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa weruni pwani, wenye matunda madide. Makodzage na miziye nkuhumirwa dza dawa, na nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa kuni na mihi ya kudzengera.

about.en: *Mkalakala* is a shrub or small tree with leaves arranged alternately along the stems and small, round berries. It belongs to the same family as the coastal golden-leaf (*mdudu*), and shares that family's neat, simple leaves with clear side veins.
about.sw: *Mkalakala* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani yaliyopangwa kwa kupishana kando ya mashina, na matunda madogo ya mviringo. Ni wa familia moja na *mdudu* (kwa Kiingereza *coastal golden-leaf*), na unashiriki majani nadhifu, sahili ya familia hiyo, yenye mishipa ya pembeni inayoonekana wazi.
about.dg: *Mkalakala* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ganayomera kanda-kanda ya panda, kodza rimwenga uphande uno na ranjina uphande uo, na matunda madide ga mviringo. Ni wa jamii mwenga na *mdudu*, na una makodza ga jamii ihi: makodza mazima manono, genye mishipa ya kanda-kanda inayoonekana wazi.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani.

uses.en: Leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine. The wood is used as firewood and for building poles, and the tree is left standing for its shade.
uses.sw: Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji. Mbao zake hutumika kwa kuni na kwa nguzo za ujenzi, na mti huachwa umesimama kwa ajili ya kivuli chake.
uses.dg: Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji. Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa dza kuni na kpwa mihi ya kudzengera, na muhi nkurichwa uchiima kpwa sababu ya pephoye.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mkalakala* and *mwambeberu*; ICRAF's handbook gives *mkalakala*, which is also the Giriama name. In Swahili it is *mnembenembe* or *mkarati*. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Bridelia cathartica*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mkalakala* na *mwambeberu*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mkalakala*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mnembenembe* au *mkarati*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Bridelia cathartica*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mkalakala* na *mwambeberu*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *mkalakala*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chigiriama. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mnembenembe* au *mkarati*. Kpwa Chingereza takuna dzina ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Bridelia cathartica*.

teaser.en: Small yellow star-shaped flowers mark this bush shrub, one of the most popular medicines among the Digo.
teaser.sw: Maua madogo ya manjano yenye umbo la nyota hukitambulisha kichaka hiki cha vichakani, mojawapo ya dawa maarufu zaidi miongoni mwa Wadigo.
teaser.dg: Maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano ga umbo ra nyota ndigo alama ya chitsaka chihi cha weruni, ambacho ni kahi ya dawa zinazomendzwa sana ni Adigo.

summary.en: *Mkone* is a Grewia shrub of the coastal bushland, with toothed three-veined leaves and small yellow star flowers. It is one of the popular Digo medicines.
summary.sw: *Mkone* ni kichaka cha jenasi ya *Grewia* cha vichaka vya pwani, chenye majani yenye meno na mishipa mitatu, na maua madogo ya manjano kama nyota. Ni mojawapo ya dawa maarufu za Kidigo.
summary.dg: *Mkone* ni chitsaka cha *Grewia* cha weruni pwani, chenye makodza genye meno kanda-kanda na mishipa mihahu, na maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano dza nyota. Ni kahi ya dawa za Adigo zinazomendzwa.

about.en: *Mkone* is a shrub or small tree. Its leaves are toothed along the edges and have three main veins running from the base, a Grewia trademark. The flowers are small yellow stars, and they are followed by small round fruits.
about.sw: *Mkone* ni kichaka au mti mdogo. Majani yake yana meno pembeni na mishipa mikuu mitatu inayoanzia kwenye kitako cha jani, alama ya kipekee ya *Grewia*. Maua yake ni madogo ya manjano kama nyota, na hufuatwa na matunda madogo ya mviringo.
about.dg: *Mkone* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide. Makodzage gana meno kanda-kanda, na gana mishipa mihahu mikulu inayoandzira photsi ya kodza, ambayo ni alama ya kumanyira *Grewia*. Maruwage ni nyota ndide za rangi ya mandano, na bada yao kunatuluka matunda madide ga mviringo.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani.

uses.en: It is a popular Digo medicine. Grewia fruits are also widely eaten as snacks in East Africa.
uses.sw: Ni dawa maarufu ya Kidigo. Matunda ya *Grewia* pia huliwa sana kama vitafunio Afrika Mashariki.
uses.dg: Ni dawa ya Adigo inayomendzwa. Matunda ga *Grewia* piya nkuriwa sana dza vyakurya vidide kosi Afrika ya Mashariki.

names.en: The name *mkone* is shared across Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Grewia plagiophylla*.
names.sw: Jina *mkone* linatumika kwa pamoja katika Kidigo, Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Grewia plagiophylla*.
names.dg: Dzina *mkone* ni ra Chidigo, Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza takuna dzina ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Grewia plagiophylla*.

teaser.en: Children hunt its masses of tiny white berries, while their parents cut its twigs to build granaries and fish traps.
teaser.sw: Watoto huwinda matunda yake madogo meupe yaliyosongamana, huku wazazi wao wakikata vitawi vyake kujenga vihenge na kutengeneza madema ya samaki.
teaser.dg: Ana nkuhendza matunda manji madide mereru ga chitsaka chihi, na avyazi ao nkukata maphungoge kudzengera vitsaga na kuhenda migbwono.

summary.en: *Mkpwamba* is the white-berry bush, a much-branched shrub covered in small white berries. Its fruit feeds children, its twigs build houses, granaries and fish traps, and its root bark is used against malaria.
summary.sw: *Mkpwamba* ni mkwamba, kichaka chenye matawi mengi kilichofunikwa na matunda madogo meupe. Matunda yake huwalisha watoto, vitawi vyake hujenga nyumba, vihenge na madema ya samaki, na gome la mizizi yake hutumika dhidi ya malaria.
summary.dg: *Mkpwamba* ni *white-berry bush* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka chenye panda nyinji chinachobwiningizwa ni matunda madide mereru. Matundage ganarisa ana, maphungoge nkuhumirwa kudzengera nyumba na vitsaga na kuhenda migbwono, na gopha ra miziye nkuhumirwa kpwa homa (malaria).

about.en: *Mkpwamba* is a much-branched shrub, usually 1 to 3 m tall, with red-brown stems and small, neat leaves. In fruit it is covered in masses of small white berries, so many that the bush can look dusted with snow.
about.sw: *Mkpwamba* ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi, kwa kawaida chenye urefu wa m 1 hadi 3, mashina ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu na majani madogo nadhifu. Kinapozaa hufunikwa na matunda madogo meupe yaliyosongamana, mengi kiasi kwamba kichaka kinaweza kuonekana kama kimenyunyiziwa theluji.
about.dg: *Mkpwamba* ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji, kpwa kawaida chire cha mita 1 hadi 3, chenye mihi ya rangi ya kundu na dongo na makodza madide manono. Chichikala na matunda, chinabwiningizwa ni matunda madide mereru manji sana, hata chitsaka chosi chinaonekana dza chikamwagirwa theluji.

where.en: It is common throughout the coast, in bushland, thicket and fallow fields. The white berries make it easy to spot.
where.sw: Ni cha kawaida pwani kote, vichakani, katika vichaka vizito na mashamba yaliyoachwa. Matunda yake meupe hukifanya kiwe rahisi kukiona.
where.dg: Ni chitsaka cha kawaida kosi pwani, weruni, vitsakani na kpwenye minda iriyorichwa. Matunda mereru ganahenda chikale rahisi kuchiona.

uses.en: The white berries are eaten by children. The long, thin twigs are used in building houses and granaries and in making fish traps. The Digo of Diani boil the root bark to treat malaria.
uses.sw: Matunda meupe huliwa na watoto. Vitawi virefu vyembamba hutumika katika ujenzi wa nyumba na vihenge na katika kutengeneza madema ya samaki. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome la mizizi kutibu malaria.
uses.dg: Matunda mereru nkuriwa ni ana. Maphungo mare na membamba nkuhumirwa kudzengera nyumba na vitsaga na kuhenda migbwono. Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha gopha ra mizi kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria).

culture.en: The Digo distinguish a 'female' and a 'male' *mkpwamba*. This white-fruited plant is the female; the male is a related shrub, *Phyllanthus reticulatus*.
culture.sw: Wadigo wanatofautisha *mkpwamba* 'jike' na 'dume'. Mmea huu wenye matunda meupe ndio jike; dume ni kichaka jamaa, *Phyllanthus reticulatus*.
culture.dg: Adigo anatafwautisha *mkpwamba* 'mchetu' na *mkpwamba* 'mlume'. Mmea uhu wa matunda mereru ndio mchetu; mlume ni chitsaka chanjina cha phephi, *Phyllanthus reticulatus*.

names.en: Pakia records *mkpwamba*, with the forms *mkpwamba mchetu* and *mkpwamba vitu*, and also *mkambakamba*. ICRAF's handbook writes *mkwamba*, which is also the Swahili, Giriama and Chonyi name; Swahili also has *mteja*. In English it is the white-berry bush.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *mkpwamba*, pamoja na maumbo *mkpwamba mchetu* na *mkpwamba vitu*, na pia *mkambakamba*. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinaandika *mkwamba*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili, Kigiriama na Kichonyi; Kiswahili kina pia *mteja*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *white-berry bush*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkpwamba*, na madzina *mkpwamba mchetu* na *mkpwamba vitu*, na piya *mkambakamba*. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika *mkwamba*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili, Chigiriama na Chichonyi; Chiswahili piya china *mteja*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *white-berry bush*.

teaser.en: Its name is the sound you make spitting out the seed after sucking its little yellow fruit.
teaser.sw: Jina lake ni sauti unayotoa ukitema mbegu baada ya kufyonza tunda lake dogo la manjano.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ni sauti unayoihenda uchiteha tembe bada ya kufyondza tundare dide ra rangi ya mandano.

summary.en: *Mpwakapwaka* is a shrub of coastal forest and thicket with large leaves crowded at the tip and small round yellow fruits. Its fruit is sucked and spat out, and its names are among the most playful in Digo.
summary.sw: *Mpwakapwaka* ni kichaka cha misitu ya pwani na vichaka vizito, chenye majani makubwa yaliyosongamana kwenye ncha na matunda madogo ya mviringo ya manjano. Tunda lake hufyonzwa na kutemwa, na majina yake ni miongoni mwa majina ya kichezo zaidi katika Kidigo.
summary.dg: *Mpwakapwaka* ni chitsaka cha matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani, chenye makodza makulu ganayokusanyika ntsani na matunda madide ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano. Matundage nkufyondzwa na ganayobaki nkutehwa, na madzinage ni kahi ya madzina ganayotsekeza zaidi kpwa Chidigo.

about.en: *Mpwakapwaka* is a shrub or small tree, often with a single stem crowned by a tuft of large, feathery compound leaves crowded at the tip, which gives it a slightly palm-like look. It bears small, round yellow fruits.
about.sw: *Mpwakapwaka* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, mara nyingi wenye shina moja lililovikwa kishungi cha majani makubwa ya mchanganyiko kama manyoya, yaliyosongamana kwenye ncha, jambo linaloupa sura inayofanana kidogo na mmea wa jamii ya mnazi. Huzaa matunda madogo ya mviringo ya manjano.
about.dg: *Mpwakapwaka* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, mara nyinji wenye muhi mmwenga tu, na dzulu kuna fungu ra makodza makulu dza manyoya genye makodza madide manji, ganayokusanyika ntsani; kpwa hivyo unaonekana chidide dza muhi wa jamii ya mnazi. Unalavya matunda madide ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani na vichaka vizito.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani.

uses.en: The fruits are edible: they are sucked for their pulp and the rest spat out.
uses.sw: Matunda yake huliwa: hufyonzwa ili kupata nyama yake na kinachobaki hutemwa.
uses.dg: Matundage nkuriwa: nkufyondzwa kuphaha nyama zao, na ganayobaki nkutehwa.

culture.en: Both its names tell a story. *Mpwakapwaka* imitates the spitting sound made after sucking the fruit. Its other name, *mtsungurira kuzimu*, 'peeping into the underworld', refers to its very deep roots.
culture.sw: Majina yake yote mawili yanasimulia hadithi. *Mpwakapwaka* linaiga sauti ya kutema baada ya kufyonza tunda. Jina lake jingine, *mtsungurira kuzimu*, 'unaochungulia kuzimu', linarejelea mizizi yake mirefu sana inayokwenda chini kabisa.
culture.dg: Madzina gosi mairi gana chisa. Dzina *mpwakapwaka* rinaiga sauti ya kuteha bada ya kufyondza tunda. Dzinare ranjina, *mtsungurira kuzimu*, 'unaotsungurira kuzimu', ni kpwa sababu ya miziye inayoinjira tsini sana.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mpwakapwaka* and *mtsungurira kuzimu*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Deinbollia borbonica*. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mpwakapwaka* to a different tree in the same family, the triangle-tops (*Blighia unijugata*), with the Swahili *mkukilemba* and *mwakamwatu*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mpwakapwaka* na *mtsungurira kuzimu*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Deinbollia borbonica*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mpwakapwaka* kwa mti mwingine wa familia hiyo hiyo, mwakamwatu (kwa Kiingereza *triangle-tops*, *Blighia unijugata*), pamoja na majina ya Kiswahili *mkukilemba* na *mwakamwatu*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mpwakapwaka* na *mtsungurira kuzimu*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Deinbollia borbonica*. Mgombato unapha dzina *mpwakapwaka* kpwa muhi wanjina wa jamii iyo hiyo, *nchivuri* (*Blighia unijugata*), na madzina ga Chiswahili *mkukilemba* na *mwakamwatu*.

teaser.en: Flip a leaf of this bush tree and it flashes silver, lined with fine veins as neat as ruled paper.
teaser.sw: Geuza jani la mti huu wa vichakani nalo litang'aa kama fedha, likiwa na mishipa membamba iliyopangika kama mistari ya daftari.
teaser.dg: Uchigaluza kodza ra muhi uhu wa weruni, rinang'ala dza feza, na rina mishipa midide minji iriyopangwa sawa-sawa dza mistari ya karatasi.

summary.en: *Msalasanga* is the broad-leaved resin tree, a bush shrub with silvery-backed leaves and a creamy resin. Its dark red wood is durable, and its bark, roots and twigs are used as medicine.
summary.sw: *Msalasanga* ni mwaalika, kichaka cha vichakani chenye majani yenye mgongo wa rangi ya fedha na utomvu wa rangi ya krimu. Mbao zake nyekundu iliyokolea hudumu muda mrefu, na gome, mizizi na vitawi vyake hutumika kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Msalasanga* ni *broad-leaved resin tree* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka cha weruni chenye makodza ga rangi ya feza photsi na ulimbo wa rangi ya maziya. Nyama za muhi uhu ni za kundu sana na zinakala muda mure, na gophare, miziye na maphungoge nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

about.en: *Msalasanga* is a shrub or small tree with leathery leaves in groups of three. The undersides are silvery, crossed by fine, closely spaced parallel veins, so a breeze turning the leaves makes the crown shimmer. Cut the bark and a creamy resin oozes out. The small fruits are black and kidney-shaped.
about.sw: *Msalasanga* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani magumu kama ngozi yanayoota matatu matatu. Upande wa chini wa majani una rangi ya fedha, uliokatizwa na mishipa membamba sambamba iliyokaribiana sana, kwa hiyo upepo unapogeuza majani, taji lote hung'aa na kumetameta. Ukikata gome, utomvu wa rangi ya krimu hutoka. Matunda yake madogo ni meusi na yenye umbo la figo.
about.dg: *Msalasanga* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza magumu dza chingo, ganayomera mahahu-mahahu. Photsi makodza ni ga rangi ya feza, na gana mishipa midide minji iriyopangwa sawa-sawa na phephi-phephi; kpwa hivyo phepho richigaluza makodza, muhi wosi dzulu unang'ala-ng'ala. Uchikata gopha, ulimbo wa rangi ya maziya unatuluka. Matunda madide ni maru na ga umbo ra figo.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and wooded grassland.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani na nyika zenye miti.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani na kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi.

uses.en: The wood is dark red and durable. Bark, roots and twigs are used in traditional medicine, much as for its relative *Ozoroa insignis*.
uses.sw: Mbao zake ni nyekundu iliyokolea na hudumu muda mrefu. Gome, mizizi na vitawi hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji, kama ilivyo kwa jamaa yake *Ozoroa insignis*.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi ni za kundu sana na zinakala muda mure. Gopha, mizi na maphungo nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji, dza vira aina ya phephi, *Ozoroa insignis*, inavyohumirwa.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *msalasanga* and *msangasanga*; the second is shared with Duruma, and ICRAF gives *msalasanga*. In Swahili it is *mwaalika*, and in Giriama *mukuikwaiyu*. In English it is the broad-leaved resin tree.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *msalasanga* na *msangasanga*; la pili linatumika pia katika Kiduruma, na ICRAF inatoa *msalasanga*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mwaalika*, na kwa Kigiriama *mukuikwaiyu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *broad-leaved resin tree*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *msalasanga* na *msangasanga*; dzina ra phiri piya ni ra Chiduruma, na chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *msalasanga*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mwaalika*, na kpwa Chigiriama ni *mukuikwaiyu*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *broad-leaved resin tree*.

teaser.en: One of the rarest plants of the Shimba Hills, this small forest tree grows almost nowhere else.
teaser.sw: Mmojawapo wa mimea adimu zaidi ya Shimba Hills, mti huu mdogo wa msituni hauoti karibu popote pengine.
teaser.dg: Ni kahi ya mimea adimu zaidi ya Shimba Hills; muhi uhu mdide wa tsaka unaphahikana mara chache sana phatu phanjina.

summary.en: *Msambwe* is a small tree of the lowland rainforest of the southern coastal forests, in the Shimba Hills ecosystem. It has a very restricted range and is counted among the area's threatened plants.
summary.sw: *Msambwe* ni mti mdogo wa msitu wa mvua wa nyanda za chini katika misitu ya kusini ya pwani, ndani ya mfumo wa ikolojia wa Shimba Hills. Eneo lake la kuenea ni finyu sana, na unahesabiwa miongoni mwa mimea iliyo hatarini ya eneo hilo.
summary.dg: *Msambwe* ni muhi mdide wa matsaka ga mvula ga herera, kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ya kusini, ndani ya mazingira ga Shimba Hills. Unaphahikana phatu phachache sana, na ni kahi ya mimea iriyo hatarini ya phatu phapho.

about.en: *Msambwe* is a shrub or small tree of the milkwood family. Its leaves grow in near-whorls, bunched in rings around the stem, and like its relatives it bleeds white latex when cut.
about.sw: *Msambwe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya Sapotaceae. Majani yake huota karibu kwa mizunguko, yakiwa yamejikusanya kama pete kuzunguka shina, na kama jamaa zake, hutoa utomvu mweupe ukikatwa.
about.dg: *Msambwe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya *milkwood*. Makodzage ganakusanyika kpwa mviringo kuzunguluka muhi, phephi kukala dza pete, na dza nduguze, uchikatwa unalavya maziya mereru.

where.en: It grows in lowland rainforest in the southern coastal forests, within the Shimba Hills ecosystem, and is found in very few places.
where.sw: Huota katika msitu wa mvua wa nyanda za chini katika misitu ya kusini ya pwani, ndani ya mfumo wa ikolojia wa Shimba Hills, na unapatikana mahali pachache sana.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga mvula ga herera ga pwani ya kusini, ndani ya mazingira ga Shimba Hills, na unaphahikana phatu phachache sana.

names.en: The Digo name is *msambwe*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Synsepalum subverticillatum*, a name that refers to its almost-whorled leaves.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *msambwe*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Synsepalum subverticillatum*, jina linalorejelea majani yake yanayoota karibu kwa mizunguko.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *msambwe*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Synsepalum subverticillatum*, dzina rinalolavywa kula makodzage ganayomera phephi kukala kpwa mviringo.

conservation.en: *Msambwe* has a restricted range and is listed among four threatened plants of the Shimba Hills ecosystem. Protecting the remaining lowland forest is key to its survival.
conservation.sw: *Msambwe* una eneo finyu la kuenea na umeorodheshwa miongoni mwa mimea minne iliyo hatarini ya mfumo wa ikolojia wa Shimba Hills. Kulinda msitu wa nyanda za chini uliobaki ni muhimu kwa kuendelea kuwepo kwake.
conservation.dg: *Msambwe* unaphahikana phatu phachache, na ukaandikpwa kahi ya mimea mine iriyo hatarini ya mazingira ga Shimba Hills. Kurinda matsaka ga herera garigobaki ni dzambo kulu ili ubaki.

teaser.en: Long before toothpaste, coastal people cleaned their teeth with a chewed twig from this tree, and many still do.
teaser.sw: Muda mrefu kabla ya dawa ya meno, watu wa pwani walisafisha meno yao kwa kijiti kilichotafunwa cha mti huu, na wengi bado hufanya hivyo.
teaser.dg: Kare sana kabla ya mreko kuphahikana, atu a pwani anasuwa meno kpwa liphungo ririroafunwa ra muhi uhu, na hata rero anji nkuhenda vivyo.

summary.en: *Msuwaki* is the toothbrush tree, a drooping, pale-leaved shrub of dry bush and riverbanks. Its twigs and roots are the original toothbrush of the coast, and the word *mswaki* now means any toothbrush.
summary.sw: *Msuwaki* ni mswaki, kichaka chenye matawi yanayolegea na majani ya kijani hafifu, cha vichaka vikavu na kingo za mito. Vitawi na mizizi yake ndiyo miswaki ya asili ya pwani, na neno *mswaki* sasa lina maana ya mswaki wa aina yoyote.
summary.dg: *Msuwaki* ni *toothbrush tree* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka chenye panda zinazobwadzika na makodza ga chijani ngushu-ngushu, cha tsi kavu ya weruni na cha kanda-kanda ya miho. Msuwaki wa kare wa pwani ni maphungoge na miziye, na neno *mswaki* sambi rinamaanisha chila msuwaki.

about.en: *Msuwaki* is an evergreen shrub or small tree with drooping, sometimes trailing branches. Its leaves are pale green and slightly fleshy. Small pink-purple berries follow the tiny flowers. The twigs and roots have a sharp, peppery taste.
about.sw: *Msuwaki* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa kijani mwaka mzima wenye matawi yanayolegea, wakati mwingine yakitambaa ardhini. Majani yake ni ya kijani hafifu na yenye majimaji kidogo. Matunda madogo ya rangi ya waridi-zambarau hufuata maua madogo sana. Vitawi na mizizi yake vina ladha kali kama ya pilipili.
about.dg: *Msuwaki* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye panda zinazobwadzika, na wakati wanjina zinaambala photsi. Makodzage ni ga chijani ngushu-ngushu na ganona chidide. Bada ya maruwa madide sana kunatuluka matunda madide ga pinki na zambarau. Maphungo na mizi vina ladha kali dza ya pilipili.

where.en: It grows in coastal and dry lowland bushland and along river banks.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani na vya nyanda za chini zilizo kavu, na kando ya kingo za mito.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani na kpwenye herera kavu, na kanda-kanda ya miho.

uses.en: Twigs and roots are used as toothbrushes: the end is chewed until it frays into bristles, and then rubbed over the teeth. The peppery fruit is eaten, the roots and bark are used in traditional medicine, and the leaves are fodder for livestock.
uses.sw: Vitawi na mizizi hutumika kama miswaki: ncha hutafunwa hadi itawanyike kuwa nyuzi kama brashi, kisha husuguliwa juu ya meno. Matunda yake yenye ladha ya pilipili huliwa, mizizi na gome hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji, na majani ni lishe ya mifugo.
uses.dg: Maphungo na mizi nkuhumirwa dza misuwaki: ntsa nkuafunwa hadi ichigaluka nyuzi-nyuzi dza burashi, chisha nkusirigwa menoni. Matunda genye ladha kali dza ya pilipili nkuriwa, mizi na gopha nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji, na makodza ni chakurya cha mifugo.

culture.en: The tree gave its name to the toothbrush itself: in Swahili, *mswaki* means a toothbrush of any kind, and the chewing stick is still a common sight on the coast.
culture.sw: Mti huu ndio uliotoa jina lake kwa mswaki wenyewe: kwa Kiswahili, *mswaki* ni mswaki wa aina yoyote, na kijiti cha kutafuna bado ni jambo la kawaida kuonekana pwani.
culture.dg: Muhi uhu ndio uriopha msuwaki dzinare: kpwa Chiswahili, *mswaki* ni chila aina ya msuwaki, na liphungo ra kusuwira meno bado ni chitu cha kawaida kuonekana pwani.

names.en: In Digo it is *msuwaki* or *mswaki*. The Swahili, Giriama and Chonyi name is *mswaki*. In English it is the toothbrush tree; it is also known worldwide as miswak. Pakia notes that another tree, *Dobera loranthifolia*, is also called *msuwaki*.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo ni *msuwaki* au *mswaki*. Jina la Kiswahili, Kigiriama na Kichonyi ni *mswaki*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *toothbrush tree*; pia unajulikana duniani kote kama *miswak*. Pakia anabainisha kwamba mti mwingine, *Dobera loranthifolia*, pia huitwa *msuwaki*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *msuwaki* au *mswaki*. Dzina ra Chiswahili, Chigiriama na Chichonyi ni *mswaki*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *toothbrush tree*; kosi duniani piya unamanyikana dza *miswak*. Pakia anaandika kukala muhi wanjina, *Dobera loranthifolia*, piya unaihwa *msuwaki*.

reason.dg: *Chinyapala*, ambacho maphungoge piya nkuhumirwa dza misuwaki

reason.sw: Mdungu (*knobwood*), nao hutumika kwa meno
reason.dg: *Mdungu*, piya nkuhumirwa kpwa meno

teaser.en: Children on the coast know this spiny bush for its small black berries, sweet enough to be worth a scratch or two.
teaser.sw: Watoto wa pwani wanakijua kichaka hiki chenye miiba kwa matunda yake madogo meusi, matamu kiasi cha kustahili mkwaruzo mmoja au miwili.
teaser.dg: Ana a pwani anachimanya chitsaka chihi chenye miya kpwa matundage madide maru, ga mtswano sana hata kukpwaruzwa chidide ni sawa.

summary.en: *Mtambuu* is the carissa or num-num, a spiny shrub of the coastal bush with small, sweet black berries. It is picked as a wild fruit and used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mtambuu* ni mtandamboo (carissa au num-num), kichaka chenye miiba cha vichaka vya pwani, chenye matunda madogo meusi yaliyo matamu. Huchumwa kama tunda la porini na hutumika katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Mtambuu* ni *carissa* au *num-num* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka chenye miya cha weruni pwani, chenye matunda madide maru ga mtswano. Matundage nkudolwa dza matunda ga tsaka, na mmea nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mtambuu* is a dense, spiny shrub. Its branches carry sharp, straight thorns, and the small, glossy leaves sit in opposite pairs. Like its relatives in the family Apocynaceae, it bleeds a white milky sap when broken.

The white, star-shaped flowers are fragrant. They are followed by small round berries that ripen from red to purple-black and are sweet when ripe.
about.sw:
*Mtambuu* ni kichaka kizito chenye miiba. Matawi yake yana miiba mikali iliyonyooka, na majani yake madogo yanayong'aa hukaa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana. Kama jamaa zake wa familia ya Apocynaceae, hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa unapovunjwa.

Maua yake meupe yenye umbo la nyota yana harufu nzuri. Baada yake huja matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva kutoka rangi nyekundu hadi zambarau iliyokolea karibu nyeusi, na huwa matamu yakiiva.
about.dg:
*Mtambuu* ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji phephi-phephi na miya. Pandaze zina miya mikali isiyofyuka, na makodza madide ganayonyiririka ganamera mairi-mairi ganayolengana. Dza nduguze a jamii ya *Apocynaceae*, uchivundzwa unalavya maziya mereru.

Maruwage mereru ga umbo ra nyota gana arufu nono. Bada yao kunatuluka matunda madide ga mviringo ganayoivwa kula ga kundu hadi ga zambarau na maru, na ni ga mtswano gachiivwa.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and thicket across the south coast, often on the edges of farms and along footpaths.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka na misitu minene ya pwani kote pwani ya kusini, mara nyingi pembezoni mwa mashamba na kando ya vijia.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na vitsakani kosi pwani ya kusini, mara nyinji kanda-kanda ya minda na ya njira.

uses.en: The ripe berries are gathered and eaten as a wild fruit. The plant is also used in medicine.
uses.sw: Matunda yaliyoiva huchumwa na kuliwa kama tunda la porini. Mmea huu pia hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg: Matunda maivu nkudolwa na kuriwa dza matunda ga tsaka. Mmea piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

names.en: In Digo the shrub is *mtambuu*. Swahili uses *mtambuu* or *mtandamboo*, and Mgombato also gives *mtantamboo*. In Chonyi it is *mtandamboo*. In English it is carissa or num-num, and its scientific name is given as both *Carissa spinarum* and the older *C. edulis*. The same Digo name, *mtambuu*, is also recorded for the closely related conkerberry.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo kichaka hiki ni *mtambuu*. Kiswahili hutumia *mtambuu* au *mtandamboo*, na Mgombato pia inatoa *mtantamboo*. Kwa Kichonyi ni *mtandamboo*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *carissa* au *num-num*, na jina lake la kisayansi hutolewa kama *Carissa spinarum* na pia jina la zamani *C. edulis*. Jina hilo hilo la Kidigo, *mtambuu*, pia limerekodiwa kwa mmea wa karibu sana uitwao *conkerberry*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo chitsaka chihi ni *mtambuu*. Chiswahili chinahumira *mtambuu* au *mtandamboo*, na Mgombato unapha piya *mtantamboo*. Kpwa Chichonyi ni *mtandamboo*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *carissa* au *num-num*, na dzinare ra chisayansi rinaandikpwa dza *Carissa spinarum* na piya dza ra kare *C. edulis*. Dzina hiri hiri ra Chidigo, *mtambuu*, piya rikaandikpwa kpwa *conkerberry*, aina ya phephi sana.

teaser.en: When a stomach ache is blamed on someone's evil look, this spiny bush shrub is the remedy people reach for.
teaser.sw: Maumivu ya tumbo yanaposhukiwa kusababishwa na jicho baya la mtu, kichaka hiki chenye miiba ndicho dawa ambayo watu hukimbilia.
teaser.dg: Mutu achilumwa ni ndani, na ikagombwa ni kpwa sababu ya dzitso ribaya ra mutu, chitsaka chihi chenye miya cha weruni ndicho dawa ambayo atu nkuhendza.

summary.en: *Mtengedzi* is a spiny bush shrub with small clustered leaves and yellowish round fruits. It is used to treat *dzongo*, a stomach ailment believed to be caused by evil looks.
summary.sw: *Mtengedzi* ni kichaka cha porini chenye miiba, majani madogo yaliyokaa kwa vishada na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya manjano hafifu. Hutumika kutibu *dzongo*, ugonjwa wa tumbo unaoaminika kusababishwa na jicho baya.
summary.dg: *Mtengedzi* ni chitsaka chenye miya cha weruni, chenye makodza madide ganayomera kpwa makundi na matunda ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu. Nkuhumirwa kuphoza *dzongo*, ukongo wa ndani ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni dzitso ribaya.

about.en: *Mtengedzi* is a stiff, spiny shrub of the coffee family. Its small leaves grow in clusters along the stems, often at the base of the spines. The fruits are round and yellowish when ripe.
about.sw: *Mtengedzi* ni kichaka kigumu chenye miiba, cha familia ya mibuni. Majani yake madogo hukua kwa vishada kando ya mashina, mara nyingi chini ya miiba. Matunda yake ni ya mviringo na huwa ya rangi ya manjano hafifu yakiiva.
about.dg: *Mtengedzi* ni chitsaka chigumu chenye miya, cha jamii ya kahawa. Makodzage madide ganamera kpwa makundi kanda-kanda ya panda, mara nyinji photsi ya miya. Matunda ni ga mviringo, na ni ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu gachiivwa.

where.en: It grows in bushland.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera weruni.

uses.en: It is used to treat *dzongo*, a stomach ailment.
uses.sw: Hutumika kutibu *dzongo*, ugonjwa wa tumbo.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa kuphoza *dzongo*, ukongo wa ndani.

culture.en: *Dzongo* is believed to be caused by evil looks, an illness sent by a jealous or ill-wishing glance. Its second Digo name, *mdzongodzongo*, carries the name of the ailment it treats.
culture.sw: *Dzongo* huaminika kusababishwa na jicho baya, yaani ugonjwa unaoletwa na mtazamo wa mtu mwenye wivu au asiyekutakia mema. Jina lake la pili la Kidigo, *mdzongodzongo*, limebeba jina la ugonjwa unaotibiwa nacho.
culture.dg: Atu anaamini *dzongo* inarehwa ni dzitso ribaya, ukongo unaohumwa ni kulolwa ni mutu mwenye wivu au mwenye moyo mui. Dzinare ra phiri ra Chidigo, *mdzongodzongo*, rina dzina ra ukongo unaouphoza.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mtengedzi* and *mdzongodzongo*; the Mgombato dictionary also lists *mdzongodzongo* with *mtengedzi* as its equivalent. *Mtengedzi* is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Catunaregam nilotica*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mtengedzi* na *mdzongodzongo*; kamusi ya Mgombato pia inaorodhesha *mdzongodzongo* ikitoa *mtengedzi* kama kisawe chake. *Mtengedzi* ni jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Catunaregam nilotica*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mtengedzi* na *mdzongodzongo*; Mgombato piya unaandika *mdzongodzongo*, na unapha *mtengedzi* dza dzina ranjina ra muhi uo uo. *Mtengedzi* piya ni dzina ra Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza takuna dzina ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Catunaregam nilotica*.

teaser.en: Its flowers look like single white roses, and its hard, shiny fruits were once hollowed out as snuff boxes.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yanafanana na waridi jeupe la porini, na matunda yake magumu yanayong'aa zamani yalitobolewa kutengeneza vibweta vya tumbaku ya kunusa.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ganaonekana dza maruwa mereru ga *waridi* ga tsaka, na matundage magumu ganayonyiririka kare ganasekulwa kuhenda viko vya tumbaku.

summary.en: *Mtondoo* is the snuff-box tree, a spiny shrub with large white rose-like flowers and hard, round, shiny fruits. The Digo count it as the 'female' *mnyondoya*, linking it to the governor's plum.
summary.sw: *Mtondoo* ni mti uitwao kwa Kiingereza *snuff-box tree*, kichaka chenye miiba, maua makubwa meupe yanayofanana na waridi, na matunda magumu ya mviringo yanayong'aa. Wadigo huuhesabu kuwa *mnyondoya* 'jike', na hivyo kuuhusisha na mgovigovi.
summary.dg: *Mtondoo* ni *snuff-box tree* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka chenye miya chenye maruwa makulu mereru dza ga *waridi*, na matunda magumu ga mviringo ganayonyiririka. Adigo anauona dza *mnyondoya* 'mchetu', na kpwa hivyo anauunganisha na *mnyondoya*.

about.en: *Mtondoo* is a spiny shrub or small tree. Its flowers are its glory: large and white, with a boss of golden stamens at the centre, much like a single wild rose. The fruits are hard, round and shiny, ripening from green to yellow-brown, with a shell tough enough to rattle when the seeds dry inside.
about.sw: *Mtondoo* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye miiba. Fahari yake ni maua yake: makubwa na meupe, yenye kishungi cha stameni za rangi ya dhahabu katikati, kama waridi moja la porini. Matunda yake ni magumu, ya mviringo na yanayong'aa, yakiiva kutoka kijani hadi manjano-hudhurungi, na ganda lake ni gumu kiasi kwamba hutoa mlio mbegu zinapokauka ndani yake.
about.dg: *Mtondoo* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye miya. Maruwage ndigo uzuriwe: ni makulu na mereru, na kahi-kahi kuna kundi ra nyuzi za rangi ya zahabu, dza ruwa ra *waridi* ra tsaka. Matunda ni magumu, ga mviringo na ganayonyiririka, ganayoivwa kula ga chijani hadi ga rangi ya mandano na dongo, na gadare ni gumu, hata tembe zichiuma ndani zinapiga sauti.

where.en: It grows on forest edges and in thicket.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka vizito.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na vitsakani.

culture.en: The Digo consider *mtondoo* the 'female' *mnyondoya*, because, like the governor's plum (*Flacourtia*), it has thorns. Pairing plants as male and female is a common way of grouping related-looking plants in Digo.
culture.sw: Wadigo huuona *mtondoo* kuwa *mnyondoya* 'jike', kwa sababu, kama mgovigovi (*Flacourtia*), una miiba. Kuoanisha mimea kama dume na jike ni njia ya kawaida katika Kidigo ya kupanga pamoja mimea inayofanana kwa sura.
culture.dg: Adigo anauona *mtondoo* kukala *mnyondoya* 'mchetu', kpwa sababu dza *mnyondoya* (*Flacourtia*), una miya. Kuika mimea airi-airi, mlume na mchetu, ni njira ya kawaida ya Chidigo ya kukusanya phamwenga mimea inayoigana.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mtondoo* and *mnyondoya mchetu* ('female *mnyondoya*'). In English it is the snuff-box tree, after the old use of its hollowed fruit shells across Africa. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mtondoo* na *mnyondoya mchetu* ('*mnyondoya* jike'). Kwa Kiingereza ni *snuff-box tree*, kutokana na matumizi ya zamani kote Afrika ya maganda ya matunda yake yaliyotobolewa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mtondoo* na *mnyondoya mchetu*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *snuff-box tree*, kpwa sababu ya kare ya kuhumira magada ga matundage garigosekulwa dza viko vya tumbaku kosi Afrika. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Governor's plum, the plant it is paired with as 'female'
reason.sw: Mgovigovi, mmea unaooanishwa nao kama 'jike'
reason.dg: *Mnyondoya*, muhi ambao *mtondoo* unaikpwa nao dza 'mchetu'

reason.en: Another plant the Digo divide into male and female
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine ambao Wadigo huugawa kuwa dume na jike
reason.dg: *Mkpwamba*, mmea wanjina ambao Adigo anauganya dza mlume na mchetu

reason.en: Another spiny shrub of forest edges and thicket
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine chenye miiba cha pembezoni mwa misitu na vichaka vizito
reason.dg: *Mtambuu*, chitsaka chanjina chenye miya cha kanda-kanda ya matsaka na vitsaka

teaser.en: It looks like a palm but belongs to a plant line older than the dinosaurs, and its seeds once fed people in famine.
teaser.sw: Unafanana na mmea wa jamii ya mnazi, lakini ni wa ukoo wa mimea wa zamani kuliko dinosaria, na mbegu zake ziliwahi kuwalisha watu wakati wa njaa.
teaser.dg: Unaonekana dza muhi wa jamii ya mnazi, ela ni wa kundi ra mimea ra kare zaidi ya *dinosaur*, na tembeze kare zarisa atu wakati wa ndzala.

summary.en: *Mtsapu* is Hildebrandt's cycad, a palm-like plant with a stout trunk and a crown of stiff, spiny leaves. It was a famine food and a weaving plant, and it is now rare and protected from illegal collectors.
summary.sw: *Mtsapu* ni msapo (Hildebrandt's cycad), mmea unaofanana na mnazi wenye shina nene na taji la majani magumu yenye miiba. Ulikuwa chakula cha wakati wa njaa na mmea wa kusuka, na sasa ni adimu na unalindwa dhidi ya wakusanyaji haramu.
summary.dg: *Mtsapu* ni *Hildebrandt's cycad* kpwa Chingereza, mmea unaoonekana dza muhi wa jamii ya mnazi, wenye kolo kulu na makodza magumu genye miya dzulu. Kare wakala chakurya cha wakati wa ndzala na mmea wa kusuka, na sambi ni adimu na unahifadhiwa kula kpwa atu anaouhala bila ruhusa.

about.en: *Mtsapu* looks like a small palm: a stout, unbranched trunk up to 6 m tall, topped with a crown of arching, stiff leaves whose leaflets have spiny teeth. It is not a palm at all but a cycad, from an ancient group of seed plants that bear cones instead of flowers. Its cones are large and heavy, and male and female cones grow on separate plants.
about.sw: *Mtsapu* unafanana na mmea mdogo wa jamii ya mnazi: shina nene lisilo na matawi, lenye urefu wa hadi m 6, likiwa na taji la majani magumu yaliyopinda ambayo vijani vyake vina meno ya miiba. Kwa kweli si wa jamii ya mnazi hata kidogo bali ni *cycad*, kutoka kundi la kale la mimea yenye mbegu ambayo huzaa koni badala ya maua. Koni zake ni kubwa na nzito, na koni za kiume na za kike hukua kwenye mimea tofauti.
about.dg: *Mtsapu* unaonekana dza muhi mdide wa jamii ya mnazi: kolo kulu risiro na panda, rinarofika hadi mita 6 dzulu, na dzulu kuna makodza magumu ganayofyuka, ambayo makodza madide gana meno ga miya. Ela si muhi wa jamii ya mnazi kabisa; ni *cycad*, wa kundi ra kare ra mimea ya tembe inayolavya *cones* badala ya maruwa. *Cones* zake ni kulu na nzito, na *cones* za chilume na za chichetu zinamera kpwa mimea tafwauti.

where.en: It grows in coastal evergreen bushland and lowland forest, in a few places along the coast.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani isiyopukutika majani na katika misitu ya nyanda za chini, sehemu chache kando ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka vya pwani vyenye makodza chila wakati na kpwenye matsaka ga herera, phatu phachache kanda-kanda ya pwani.

uses.en: The soft centre of the stem was eaten. In times of famine, the seeds were boiled and ground into flour, though this is now reputed to be harmful. The leaves are used for thatch and for weaving, and *chitsapu* is counted among Digo weaving plants. The cones have ceremonial uses.
uses.sw: Kiini laini cha shina kililiwa. Nyakati za njaa, mbegu zilichemshwa na kusagwa kuwa unga, ingawa sasa inasemekana kuwa unga huo ni hatari. Majani hutumika kuezekea na kusuka, na *chitsapu* huhesabiwa miongoni mwa mimea ya kusuka ya Wadigo. Koni zake hutumika katika sherehe za kimila.
uses.dg: Kare atu kala anarya kahi-kahi laini ya kolo. Wakati wa ndzala, tembe kala zinachemuswa na kusagbwa kuhenda unga, ela sambi nkugombwa kukala kuhenda hivyo kunaweza kubananga mwiri. Makodza nkuhumirwa kuezeka nyumba na kusuka, na *chitsapu* chinaikpwa kahi ya mimea ya Adigo ya kusuka. *Cones* zinahumirwa kpwa chimila.

culture.en: Its role as a famine food made it a plant people remembered in hard times. The cones are also used in ceremonies.
culture.sw: Kwa kuwa kilikuwa chakula cha wakati wa njaa, ulikuwa mmea ambao watu waliukumbuka nyakati ngumu. Koni zake pia hutumika katika sherehe za kimila.
culture.dg: Kpwa kukala chakurya cha wakati wa ndzala, ukakala mmea ambao atu kala anautambukira wakati wa shida. *Cones* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa chimila.

names.en: Pakia records *mtsapu*, and also *chitsapu*; in Giriama it is *kitsapu*. Swahili names are *msapo*, *mkwanga* and *mgwende*. In English it is Hildebrandt's cycad.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi *mtsapu*, na pia *chitsapu*; kwa Kigiriama ni *kitsapu*. Majina ya Kiswahili ni *msapo*, *mkwanga* na *mgwende*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *Hildebrandt's cycad*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mtsapu*, na piya *chitsapu*; kpwa Chigiriama ni *kitsapu*. Madzina ga Chiswahili ni *msapo*, *mkwanga* na *mgwende*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *Hildebrandt's cycad*.

conservation.en: *Mtsapu* is rare and is collected illegally as an ornamental plant, which removes whole plants from the wild. Cycads grow slowly, so losses are hard to replace.
conservation.sw: *Mtsapu* ni adimu na hukusanywa kinyume cha sheria kama mmea wa mapambo, jambo linaloondoa mimea mizima porini. Mimea ya aina ya *cycad* hukua polepole, kwa hiyo hasara hizi ni vigumu kufidiwa.
conservation.dg: *Mtsapu* ni adimu, na atu nkuuhala bila ruhusa dza mmea wa kupambira, na kpwa njira ihi mimea mizima nkutuluzwa weruni. Mimea ya *cycad* inakula pore-pore, kpwa hivyo ichiangamika ni vigumu kuiuyiza.

reason.sw: Msanaka, mmea mwingine wa msituni unaofanana na mnazi na unaotumika kusuka
reason.dg: *Mkapu*, mmea wanjina wa tsaka unaoonekana dza muhi wa jamii ya mnazi, unaohumirwa kusuka

reason.en: Doum palm, a weaving plant of the coast
reason.sw: Mkoma, mmea wa kusuka wa pwani
reason.dg: *Mkoma*, mmea wa kusuka wa pwani

reason.sw: Mkindu, wenye sura inayofanana na mnazi
reason.dg: *Uchindu*, unaoonekana piya dza muhi wa jamii ya mnazi

reason.en: Polynesian arrowroot, another plant made into flour
reason.sw: Ulanga, mmea mwingine unaosagwa kuwa unga
reason.dg: *Ulanga*, mmea wanjina unaohendwa unga

teaser.en: Its sweet little fruits are a treat, but carvers prize it more for hard wood that becomes combs, spoons and fishing rods.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake madogo matamu ni kitamu, lakini wachongaji huuthamini zaidi kwa mbao zake ngumu zinazogeuzwa kuwa vitana, vijiko na fimbo za kuvulia samaki.
teaser.dg: Matundage madide ga mtswano ni chakurya chinono, ela atsongadzi anaumendza zaidi kpwa sababu ya nyama za muhi ngumu zinazotsongwa kuhenda mashanuwo, vidziko na mihi ya kulowera.

summary.en: *Mtsedzi* is a small evergreen tree of the coastal thicket and forest with shiny notched leaves and sweet fruits. Its hard wood is carved into combs, spoons and fishing rods and used in building.
summary.sw: *Mtsedzi* ni mti mdogo usiopukutika majani wa vichaka vizito na misitu ya pwani, wenye majani yanayong'aa yenye kibonyeo ncani na matunda matamu. Mbao zake ngumu huchongwa kuwa vitana, vijiko na fimbo za kuvulia samaki, na hutumika katika ujenzi.
summary.dg: *Mtsedzi* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, wa vitsaka na matsaka ga pwani, wenye makodza ganayonyiririka genye mwanya ntsani, na matunda ga mtswano. Nyama zakpwe ngumu nkutsongwa kuhenda mashanuwo, vidziko na mihi ya kulowera, na nkuhumirwa kudzengera.

about.en: *Mtsedzi* is an evergreen shrub or small tree, usually 3 to 6 m tall. Its small, shiny leaves cluster at the tips of the branches, each one notched at the tip. Young shoots are covered with rusty hairs. Like other milkwoods it has a milky sap.
about.sw: *Mtsedzi* ni kichaka au mti mdogo usiopukutika majani, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa m 3 hadi 6. Majani yake madogo yanayong'aa hujikusanya kwenye ncha za matawi, na kila jani lina kibonyeo kwenye ncha yake. Machipukizi machanga yamefunikwa na vinyweleo vya rangi ya kutu. Kama jamaa zake wengine wa jamii ya *milkwood*, una utomvu kama maziwa.
about.dg: *Mtsedzi* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, kpwa kawaida wa mita 3 hadi 6 dzulu. Makodzage madide ganayonyiririka ganakusanyika ntsa za panda, na chila kodza rina mwanya ntsani. Maphungo machanga ganabwiningizwa ni nyere za rangi ya kutu. Dza mihi yanjina ya jamii ya *milkwood*, una maziya.

where.en: It grows in Cynometra thicket, coastal bushland, Brachystegia woodland and coastal forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vizito vya Cynometra, nyika ya vichaka ya pwani, misitu ya miombo ya Brachystegia na misitu ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka vya *Cynometra*, weruni pwani, matsaka ga *Brachystegia* na matsaka ga pwani.

uses.en: The sweet fruits are eaten. The hard wood is used in building and carved into combs, spoons and other carvings, and its straight stems make fishing rods. Leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Matunda matamu huliwa. Mbao zake ngumu hutumika katika ujenzi na huchongwa kuwa vitana, vijiko na vinyago vingine, na mashina yake yaliyonyooka hutengeneza fimbo za kuvulia samaki. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg: Matunda ga mtswano nkuriwa. Nyama za muhi ngumu nkuhumirwa kudzengera na nkutsongwa kuhenda mashanuwo, vidziko na vitu vyanjina vya kutsonga, na mihi yakpwe iriyonyoka inahenda mihi ya kulowera. Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtsedzi*; ICRAF's handbook gives *nzezi* and *mtsezi*. In Giriama it is *mtsezi* or *mtsedzi*, and in Swahili *mchambigi* or *mchedi*. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Manilkara sulcata*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtsedzi*; kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF kinatoa *nzezi* na *mtsezi*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mtsezi* au *mtsedzi*, na kwa Kiswahili *mchambigi* au *mchedi*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Manilkara sulcata*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtsedzi*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *nzezi* na *mtsezi*. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *mtsezi* au *mtsedzi*, na kpwa Chiswahili ni *mchambigi* au *mchedi*. Kpwa Chingereza takuna dzina ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Manilkara sulcata*.

teaser.en: Its name means 'to calm', and it is used to settle quarrels between lovers as well as to treat malaria.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'kutuliza', na hutumika kusuluhisha ugomvi kati ya wapenzi pamoja na kutibu malaria.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'kutserera', yani kuphoza, na nkuhumirwa kuphoza kondo kahi ya apendzi, na piya kuphoza homa (malaria).

summary.en: *Mtserere* is an aromatic shrub of the bush and fallow with small orange fruits. The Digo boil its roots for malaria and use it to calm quarrels between lovers.
summary.sw: *Mtserere* ni kichaka chenye harufu nzuri cha porini na mashamba yaliyoachwa, chenye matunda madogo ya rangi ya chungwa. Wadigo huchemsha mizizi yake kwa ajili ya malaria na hukitumia kutuliza ugomvi kati ya wapenzi.
summary.dg: *Mtserere* ni chitsaka chenye arufu cha weruni na cha minda iriyorichwa, chenye matunda madide ga rangi ya chungbwa. Adigo nkuchemusha miziye kpwa homa (malaria), na nkuuhumira kuphoza kondo kahi ya apendzi.

about.en: *Mtserere* is a scented shrub of the mint family, with leaves in opposite pairs that smell when crushed. It carries small, fleshy orange fruits, bright little beads among the leaves.
about.sw: *Mtserere* ni kichaka chenye harufu cha familia ya minanaa, chenye majani yaliyokaa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana ambayo hutoa harufu yakipondwa. Huzaa matunda madogo yenye nyama ya rangi ya chungwa, kama shanga ndogo zinazong'aa katikati ya majani.
about.dg: *Mtserere* ni chitsaka chenye arufu cha jamii ya *mint*, chenye makodza ganayomera mairi-mairi ganayolengana, ganayolavya arufu gachifikitswa. Una matunda madide manono ga rangi ya chungbwa, dza ushanga mdide unaong'ala kahi ya makodza.

where.en: It grows in the bush, on fallow land and on forest edges.
where.sw: Hukua porini, katika mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike na pembezoni mwa misitu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa na kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

uses.en: The Digo of Diani boil the roots to treat malaria. It is also used to calm quarrels between lovers.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi yake kutibu malaria. Pia hutumika kutuliza ugomvi kati ya wapenzi.
uses.dg: Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha mizi kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria). Piya nkuhumirwa kuphoza kondo kahi ya apendzi.

culture.en: The name comes from *tserera*, 'bring down' or 'calm', which matches its use in cooling tempers between lovers.
culture.sw: Jina lake linatokana na *tserera*, 'kushusha' au 'kutuliza', jambo linalolingana na matumizi yake ya kupoza hasira kati ya wapenzi.
culture.dg: Dzina rinalavywa kula *tserera*, 'kutserera' au 'kuphoza', na hiri rinalingana na kaziye ya kuphoza tsukizi kahi ya apendzi.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names. *Mtserere* is shared with Giriama and Swahili, and *mgongolo* with Duruma. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Hoslundia opposita*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo. *Mtserere* ni jina linalotumika pia kwa Kigiriama na Kiswahili, na *mgongolo* kwa Kiduruma. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Hoslundia opposita*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo. *Mtserere* ni dzina ra Chigiriama na Chiswahili piya, na *mgongolo* ni ra Chiduruma piya. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Hoslundia opposita*.

teaser.en: Every Digo kitchen needs a *mwiko* for stirring ugali, and this bush shrub is named as the maker of them.
teaser.sw: Kila jiko la Kidigo linahitaji *mwiko* wa kusongea ugali, na kichaka hiki cha porini kimepewa jina kama mtengenezaji wake.
teaser.dg: Chila nyumba ya Chidigo inahitaji *mwiko* wa kufwidzira sima, na chitsaka hichi cha weruni chinaihwa dza mtsongadzi wa mwiko.

summary.en: *Mtsonga mwiko* is a bush shrub with long-tubed white flowers. Its branches are carved into *mwiko*, the cooking sticks used for stirring.
summary.sw: *Mtsonga mwiko* ni kichaka cha porini chenye maua meupe yenye mirija mirefu. Matawi yake huchongwa kuwa *mwiko*, vijiti vya kupikia vinavyotumika kusongea.
summary.dg: *Mtsonga mwiko* ni chitsaka cha weruni chenye maruwa mereru genye miridza mire. Pandaze nkutsongwa kuhenda *mwiko*, vigongo vya kujitira vya kufwidzira.

about.en: *Mtsonga mwiko* is a shrub with white flowers that have long, slender tubes, opening at the tip into a star of narrow petals. After flowering it forms lobed capsules that split open to release the seeds.
about.sw: *Mtsonga mwiko* ni kichaka chenye maua meupe yenye mirija mirefu myembamba, inayofunguka ncani kuwa nyota ya petali nyembamba. Baada ya kuchanua huunda vifuko vya mbegu vyenye mapande, ambavyo hupasuka kuachia mbegu.
about.dg: *Mtsonga mwiko* ni chitsaka chenye maruwa mereru genye miridza mire na myembamba, inayovugulika ntsani dza nyota ya maruwa membamba. Bada ya maruwa unalavya makakaya genye mala ganayoahuka na kulavya tembe.

where.en: It grows in bushland.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera weruni.

uses.en: Its branches are carved into cooking sticks, *mwiko*, the flat wooden stirrers used in the kitchen.
uses.sw: Matawi yake huchongwa kuwa vijiti vya kupikia, *mwiko*, yaani miiko bapa ya mbao ya kusongea inayotumika jikoni.
uses.dg: Pandaze nkutsongwa kuhenda vigongo vya kujitira, *mwiko*, vigongo vibapa vya mbao vya kufwidzira vyakurya nyunguni.

culture.en: The name means 'maker of cooking sticks', after its main use. It is one of several Digo plant names that describe exactly what the plant is good for.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'mtengenezaji wa miiko', kutokana na matumizi yake makuu. Ni mojawapo ya majina kadhaa ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayoeleza hasa mmea unafaa kwa kazi gani.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya 'mtsongadzi wa *mwiko*', kpwa sababu ya kaziye kulu. Ni mwenga wa madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganayogomba wazi mmea unafwaha kpwa chitu chani.

names.en: The Digo name is *mtsonga mwiko*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Turraea nilotica*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mtsonga mwiko*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Turraea nilotica*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mtsonga mwiko*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Turraea nilotica*.

reason.en: Turraea floribunda, same genus
reason.sw: Turraea floribunda, wa jenasi ile ile
reason.dg: *Turraea floribunda*, wa jenasi mwenga

reason.sw: Mkimwemwe, ambao pia huchongwa kuwa miiko ya kusongea
reason.dg: *Chimwemwe*, naye piya nkutsongwa kuhenda vifwidzo vya kujitira

reason.en: Another plant named after what is made from it
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine uliopewa jina kutokana na kitu kinachotengenezwa kwake
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wenye dzina ra chitu chinachohendwa kula kpwakpwe

reason.en: Natal mahogany, same mahogany family
reason.sw: Mwamaji, wa familia ile ile ya mkangazi
reason.dg: *Munwa madzi*, wa jamii mwenga ya *mahogany*

teaser.en: Its oily orange fruits were once threaded onto sticks and burned as candles.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake yenye mafuta ya rangi ya chungwa zamani yalitungwa kwenye vijiti na kuwashwa kama mishumaa.
teaser.dg: Matundage ga rangi ya chungbwa genye mafuha, kare kala ganadungwa kpwenye vigongo na nkuochwa dza mishumaa.

summary.en: *Mtundukula* is the sour plum, a spiny scrambling shrub of the bush with plum-like orange-red fruits. The fruit is eaten, its seeds give oil, and the oily fruits were even used as candles.
summary.sw: *Mtundukula* (kwa Kiingereza *sour plum*) ni kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa porini, chenye matunda ya rangi ya chungwa-nyekundu yanayofanana na plamu. Tunda lake huliwa, mbegu zake hutoa mafuta, na matunda yenye mafuta hata yalitumika kama mishumaa.
summary.dg: *Mtundukula* (kpwa Chingereza *sour plum*) ni chitsaka cha weruni chenye miya chinachoambala, chenye matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa na kundu ganayohalana na *plum*. Tunda nkuriwa, tembeze zinalavya mafuha, na matunda genye mafuha hata kala ganahumirwa dza mishumaa.

about.en: *Mtundukula* is a spiny, scrambling shrub with blue-green leaves growing in tufts along the stems. Its fruits look like small plums and ripen to orange-red, with a sharp, sour taste and a large stone inside.
about.sw: *Mtundukula* ni kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa, chenye majani ya rangi ya kijani-samawati yanayoota kwa mafungu kando ya mashina. Matunda yake yanafanana na plamu ndogo na huiva kuwa rangi ya chungwa-nyekundu, yakiwa na ladha kali ya uchachu na kokwa kubwa ndani.
about.dg: *Mtundukula* ni chitsaka chenye miya chinachoambala, chenye makodza ga rangi ya samawati na chijani ganayomera mafungu-mafungu kanda-kanda ya makolo. Matundage ganahalana na *plum* madide na ganaivwa kukala ga rangi ya chungbwa na kundu, na gana ladha ngbwadu kali na chitsa chikulu ndani.

where.en: It grows in bushland and wooded grassland.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka na nyasi zenye miti.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na kpwenye weruni wenye nyasi na mihi.

uses.en: The sour fruit is eaten fresh. The seeds give an oil, and the oily fruits were threaded onto sticks and burned as candles. The plant also yields dye and tannin, and it is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Tunda lake chachu huliwa vivi hivi. Mbegu hutoa mafuta, na matunda yenye mafuta yalitungwa kwenye vijiti na kuwashwa kama mishumaa. Mmea huu pia hutoa rangi na tanini, na hutumika katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg: Tunda ngbwadu nkuriwa dza ririvyo. Tembe zinalavya mafuha, na matunda genye mafuha kala ganadungwa kpwenye vigongo na nkuochwa dza mishumaa. Mmea piya unalavya rangi ya kutiya nguwo na *tannin*, na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: The name is probably a loan from Swahili, read as 'eat fruit' with the Swahili *kula*, 'to eat'; the Digo verb for 'eat' is *rya*.
culture.sw: Huenda jina hili limetoholewa kutoka Kiswahili, likisomeka kama 'tunda-kula' kwa neno la Kiswahili *kula*; kitenzi cha Kidigo cha 'kula' ni *rya*.
culture.dg: Chahi dzina hiri rikahalwa kula Chiswahili, na rinasomwa dza 'kula tunda' kpwa neno ra Chiswahili *kula*, 'kurya'; kpwa Chidigo neno ra 'kurya' ni *rya*.

names.en: The name *mtundukula* is shared by Digo, Giriama, Chonyi and Swahili; Swahili also has *mpingi*. In English it is the sour plum or false sandalwood.
names.sw: Jina *mtundukula* linatumika katika Kidigo, Kigiriama, Kichonyi na Kiswahili; Kiswahili pia kina *mpingi*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *sour plum* au *false sandalwood*.
names.dg: Dzina *mtundukula* ni ra Chidigo, Chigiriama, Chichonyi na Chiswahili; Chiswahili piya china *mpingi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sour plum* au *false sandalwood*.

reason.dg: *Mbokwe*, tunda ranjina ra weruni

teaser.en: It looks like the garden egg's wild twin, but its round yellow fruits are not eaten.
teaser.sw: Unafanana na pacha wa porini wa ngogwe, lakini matunda yake ya mviringo ya manjano hayaliwi.
teaser.dg: Unaonekana dza patsa wa weruni wa *tungudza*, ela matundage ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano tagariwa.

summary.en: *Mtungudza koma* is the Sodom apple, a prickly, grey-felted shrub with purple flowers and round yellow fruits. It is the wild, inedible relative of the cultivated garden egg, and its roots and leaves are used for malaria.
summary.sw: *Mtungudza koma* ni kichaka kinachoitwa kwa Kiingereza *Sodom apple*, chenye miiba midogo na manyoya laini ya kijivu, maua ya zambarau na matunda ya mviringo ya manjano. Ni jamaa wa porini asiyelika wa ngogwe inayolimwa, na mizizi na majani yake hutumika kwa malaria.
summary.dg: *Mtungudza koma* (kpwa Chingereza *Sodom apple*) ni chitsaka chenye miya, chenye laika za rangi ya ivu, maruwa ga zambarau na matunda ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano. Ni ndugu wa weruni wa *tungudza* inayophandwa, ambaye matundage tagariwa, na mizi na makodza nkuhumirwa kpwa homa (malaria).

about.en: *Mtungudza koma* is a shrub covered in soft grey felt and armed with sharp prickles on the stems and leaves. Its flowers are purple with a yellow centre, the same shape as tomato and eggplant flowers, to which it is related. The fruits are round, about the size of a marble or larger, and turn yellow when ripe.
about.sw: *Mtungudza koma* ni kichaka kilichofunikwa na manyoya laini ya kijivu na chenye miiba mikali kwenye mashina na majani. Maua yake ni ya zambarau yenye kiini cha manjano, yenye umbo sawa na maua ya nyanya na biringani, ambazo ni jamaa zake. Matunda ni ya mviringo, takriban ukubwa wa gololi au zaidi, na hugeuka manjano yakiiva.
about.dg: *Mtungudza koma* ni chitsaka chenye laika za rangi ya ivu, na chenye miya mikali kpwenye makolo na makodza. Maruwage ni ga zambarau, ga rangi ya mandano kahi-kahi, na gana umbo dza ra maruwa ga nyanya na *bungulia*, ambago ni ndugu zakpwe. Matunda ni ga mviringo, makulu dza gololi au zaidi, na ganakala ga rangi ya mandano ganaphoivwa.

where.en: It grows on disturbed ground, fallow land and in bushland, often along paths and around old fields.
where.sw: Hukua kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa, mashamba yaliyoachwa na katika nyika ya vichaka, mara nyingi kando ya vijia na kuzunguka mashamba ya zamani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye tsi iriyobanangwa, minda iriyorichwa na weruni, mara nyinji kanda-kanda ya njira na phephi na minda ya kare.

uses.en: The Digo of Diani boil the roots and leaves to treat malaria. The fruits are not eaten.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi na majani kutibu malaria. Matunda yake hayaliwi.
uses.dg: Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha mizi na makodza kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria). Matunda tagariwa.

culture.en: The name means 'wild *tungudza*': it is seen as the inedible wild form of the cultivated garden egg.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya '*tungudza* ya porini': huonekana kama aina ya porini isiyolika ya ngogwe inayolimwa.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya '*tungudza* ya weruni': nkuonekana dza aina ya weruni ya *tungudza* inayophandwa, isiyoriwa.

names.en: The Digo name *mtungudza koma* is shared with Duruma and Swahili. In English it is the Sodom apple. The Mgombato dictionary records *koma* as the fruit of the doum palm, a different word, so how *koma* comes to mean 'wild' here is unclear.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo *mtungudza koma* linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza ni *Sodom apple*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inarekodi *koma* kama tunda la mkoma, neno tofauti, kwa hiyo haijulikani wazi jinsi *koma* inavyokuja kumaanisha 'ya porini' hapa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *mtungudza koma* ni ra Chiduruma na Chiswahili piya. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *Sodom apple*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *koma* dza tunda ra mkoma, neno ranjina, kpwa hivyo taimanyikana vira *koma* rinavyokala na mana ya 'weruni' phapha.

teaser.en: Its wood is hard enough for bows, clubs and arrows, and soft enough to spin into fire by friction.
teaser.sw: Mbao zake ni ngumu kiasi cha kutengeneza pinde, marungu na mishale, na laini kiasi cha kupekecha moto kwa msuguano.
teaser.dg: Nyama za muhi uhu ni ngumu chiasi cha kuhenda maha, virungu na mivwi, na laini chiasi cha kuzunguluswa ili kuta moho.

summary.en: *Muhowe* is a coastal shrub or small tree with large yellow hibiscus-like flowers. Its hard, durable wood made bows, arrows, clubs, spoons and bowls, and its fruit and roots are also used.
summary.sw: *Muhowe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa pwani wenye maua makubwa ya manjano yanayofanana na ya hibiscus. Mbao zake ngumu zinazodumu zilitengeneza pinde, mishale, marungu, vijiko na mabakuli, na matunda na mizizi yake pia hutumika.
summary.dg: *Muhowe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa pwani wenye maruwa makulu ga rangi ya mandano dza ga *hibiscus*. Nyama za muhi uhu ni ngumu na zinakaa sana, na kare zahumirwa kuhenda maha, mivwi, virungu, vidziko na mabakuli, na matunda na mizi piya nkuhumirwa.

about.en: *Muhowe* is a shrub or small tree, from 1 to 6 m tall, with broad heart-shaped leaves covered in tiny scales. Its flowers are large and yellow, shaped like a hibiscus, with a dark red centre. It belongs to the mallow family, alongside hibiscus, cotton and the portia tree of the beaches.
about.sw: *Muhowe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, wenye urefu wa m 1 hadi 6, wenye majani mapana yenye umbo la moyo yaliyofunikwa na magamba madogo sana. Maua yake ni makubwa na ya manjano, yenye umbo la ua la hibiscus, na kiini chekundu kilichokolea. Ni wa familia ya mibamia, pamoja na hibiscus, pamba na mtakawa wa fukweni.
about.dg: *Muhowe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, wa ure wa mita 1 hadi 6, wenye makodza mapana ga umbo ra moyo ganayofwinikpwa ni mamba madide sana. Maruwage ni makulu na ga rangi ya mandano, ga umbo dza ra *hibiscus*, na kahi-kahi ni ga kundu sana. Ni wa jamii ya *mallow*, phamwenga na *hibiscus*, pamba na *portia tree* ya pwani.

where.en: It grows in the coastal lowlands, in flood zones, along rivers, on forest margins and in bushland.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyanda za chini za pwani, maeneo yanayofurika maji, kando ya mito, pembezoni mwa misitu na katika nyika ya vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye tsi ya photsi ya pwani, phatu phanaphokala na mafuriko, kanda-kanda ya miho, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na weruni.

uses.en:
The wood is hard and durable. It is used to make clubs, bows and arrows, as well as spoons and bowls. The wood is also used to make fire by friction, spinning one stick against another until the dust smoulders.

The bark gives a fibre, the fruit is eaten, and the roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake ni ngumu na hudumu. Hutumika kutengeneza marungu, pinde na mishale, pamoja na vijiko na mabakuli. Mbao hizi pia hutumika kupekecha moto kwa msuguano, kwa kuzungusha kijiti kimoja dhidi ya kingine hadi unga wake uanze kufuka moshi.

Gamba hutoa nyuzi, tunda huliwa, na mizizi hutumika katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na zinakaa sana. Nkuhumirwa kuhenda virungu, maha na mivwi, na piya vidziko na mabakuli. Nyama za muhi piya nkuhumirwa kuta moho kpwa kuzungulusa chigongo chimwenga dzulu ya chanjina hadi vumbi riandze kulavya mosi.

Gopha rinalavya nyuzi, matunda nkuriwa, na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: The Digo name *muhowe* is shared with Giriama and Swahili; Swahili also has *muhonda*. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Thespesia danis*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo *muhowe* linatumika pia kwa Kigiriama na Kiswahili; Kiswahili pia kina *muhonda*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Thespesia danis*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *muhowe* ni ra Chigiriama na Chiswahili piya; Chiswahili piya china *muhonda*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Thespesia danis*.

teaser.en: Bright yellow flowers light up the dry bush in the cool season, and its roots are one of the best-known Digo remedies.
teaser.sw: Maua ya manjano angavu hung'arisha vichaka vikavu wakati wa baridi, na mizizi yake ni mojawapo ya dawa za Kidigo zinazojulikana zaidi.
teaser.dg: Wakati wa mnyevu, maruwa ga rangi ya mandano ganaala kahi ya vitsaka vikavu, na miziye ni kahi ya dawa za Chidigo zinazomanyikana sana.

summary.en: *Muhumba* is the winter cassia, a shrub of the bush with bright yellow flowers and long pods, often seen on termite mounds. Its roots are among the popular Digo medicines, used for stomach pains and many other ailments.
summary.sw: *Muhumba* ni mbaraka (winter cassia), kichaka cha porini chenye maua ya manjano angavu na maganda marefu, ambacho mara nyingi huonekana juu ya vichuguu. Mizizi yake ni miongoni mwa dawa maarufu za Kidigo, ikitumika kwa maumivu ya tumbo na maradhi mengine mengi.
summary.dg: *Muhumba* ni *winter cassia* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka cha weruni chenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano ganayoala na makakaya mare, na mara nyinji nkuonekana dzulu ya vitsulu. Miziye ni kahi ya dawa za Chidigo zinazomanyikana sana, na nkuhumirwa kpwa kulumwa ni ndani na makongo ganjina manji.

about.en: *Muhumba* is a shrub or small tree. Its bark is red on young stems and turns grey with age. Each leaf carries 4 to 10 pairs of leaflets. In flower it is covered in bright yellow blooms, often while the branches are nearly bare, and these are followed by long, hanging pods.
about.sw: *Muhumba* ni kichaka au mti mdogo. Gamba lake ni jekundu kwenye mashina machanga na hugeuka kijivu kadiri unavyozeeka. Kila jani lina jozi 4 hadi 10 za vijani. Unapochanua hufunikwa na maua ya manjano angavu, mara nyingi wakati matawi yakiwa karibu matupu, na baada ya maua huja maganda marefu yanayoning'inia.
about.dg: *Muhumba* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide. Gophare ni ra kundu kpwenye mihi midide, na richikula rinakala ra rangi ya ivu. Chila kodza rina jozi 4 hadi 10 za makodza madide. Uchikala na maruwa, unafwinikwa ni maruwa ga rangi ya mandano ganayoala, mara nyinji wakati makodza ga pandaze gakagbwa phephi gosi; bada ya maruwa higo kunatuluka makakaya mare ganayogbwadzika.

where.en: It grows in bushland and wooded grassland, and is often found growing on termite mounds. It is easiest to spot when in flower.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka na nyasi zenye miti, na mara nyingi hupatikana ukiota juu ya vichuguu. Ni rahisi zaidi kuutambua unapochanua.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na kpwenye mavuwe genye mihi, na mara nyinji nkuphahikana dzulu ya vitsulu. Ni rahisi kuuona wakati una maruwa.

uses.en: The roots are used for many ailments, for example stomach pains, and it is counted among the popular Digo medicines. The bark is a source of tannin.
uses.sw: Mizizi hutumika kwa maradhi mengi, kwa mfano maumivu ya tumbo, na huhesabiwa miongoni mwa dawa maarufu za Kidigo. Gamba ni chanzo cha tanini.
uses.dg: Miziye nkuhumirwa kpwa makongo manji, kpwa mfwano kulumwa ni ndani, na ni kahi ya dawa za Chidigo zinazomanyikana sana. Gophare rinalavya *tannin*.

names.en: Pakia and ICRAF record the Digo name *muhumba*; in Giriama it is *muhumbu*, in Swahili *mbaraka*, and in English winter cassia. The Mgombato dictionary gives *muhumba* to a different plant, the stinking weed or wild coffee (*Cassia occidentalis*), with the Swahili names *mkengajua*, *mnukauvundo*, *mwingajini* and *mnyafungo*.
names.sw: Pakia na ICRAF zinarekodi jina la Kidigo *muhumba*; kwa Kigiriama ni *muhumbu*, kwa Kiswahili *mbaraka*, na kwa Kiingereza *winter cassia*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inalipa jina *muhumba* mmea mwingine, *stinking weed* au *wild coffee* (*Cassia occidentalis*), wenye majina ya Kiswahili *mkengajua*, *mnukauvundo*, *mwingajini* na *mnyafungo*.
names.dg: Pakia na ICRAF anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *muhumba*; kpwa Chigiryama ni *muhumbu*, kpwa Chiswahili *mbaraka*, na kpwa Chingereza *winter cassia*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha dzina *muhumba* mmea wanjina, *stinking weed* au *wild coffee* (*Cassia occidentalis*), wenye madzina ga Chiswahili *mkengajua*, *mnukauvundo*, *mwingajini* na *mnyafungo*.

reason.en: Long-pod cassia, close relative with a similar name
reason.sw: *Muhumba tsaka* (long-pod cassia), jamaa wa karibu mwenye jina linalofanana
reason.dg: *Muhumba tsaka*, ndugu wa phephi wenye dzina rinalohalana.

reason.en: Camel's foot, another bush legume
reason.sw: Msegese, mmea mwingine wa porini wa jamii ya kunde
reason.dg: *Mtseketse*, mmea wanjina wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde.

reason.en: Sicklebush, another popular Digo medicine
reason.sw: Mchinjiri, dawa nyingine maarufu ya Kidigo
reason.dg: *Mchinjiri*, dawa yanjina ya Chidigo inayomanyikana sana.

reason.en: Another popular Digo medicine of the bush
reason.sw: Dawa nyingine maarufu ya Kidigo ya porini
reason.dg: Dawa yanjina ya Chidigo ya weruni inayomanyikana sana.

teaser.en: The Digo call it the 'chicken killer', a blunt warning about the poison in this fragrant-flowered shrub.
teaser.sw: Wadigo wanauita 'muua kuku', onyo la wazi kuhusu sumu iliyo katika kichaka hiki chenye maua yenye harufu nzuri.
teaser.dg: Adigo anauiha 'muolaga kuku', dzina rinaloonya wazi kukala chitsaka hichi chenye maruwa ga arufu nono china sumu.

summary.en: *Muolaga kuku* is the fever pod, a shrub of woodland and bush with white latex, fragrant white flowers and long paired pods. Its Digo name, 'chicken killer', marks it as poisonous.
summary.sw: *Muolaga kuku* ni kichaka kiitwacho kwa Kiingereza *fever pod*, cha misitu ya wazi na vichaka, chenye utomvu mweupe, maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri na maganda marefu yanayokaa kwa jozi. Jina lake la Kidigo, 'muua kuku', linaonyesha kuwa ni sumu.
summary.dg: *Muolaga kuku* ni *fever pod* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka cha phatu phenye mihi na weruni, chenye maziya mereru, maruwa mereru ga arufu nono na makakaya mare ganayomera mairi-mairi. Dzinare ra Chidigo, 'muolaga kuku', rinaonyesa kukala una sumu.

about.en: *Muolaga kuku* is a shrub or small tree of the oleander family, with white latex in its stems and leaves. Its white flowers are sweetly scented. The fruits are long, thin pods that grow in pairs, splitting to release seeds tufted with silky hairs.
about.sw: *Muolaga kuku* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya oleander, chenye utomvu mweupe kwenye mashina na majani. Maua yake meupe yana harufu tamu. Matunda ni maganda marefu membamba yanayoota kwa jozi, ambayo hupasuka kuachia mbegu zenye vishungi vya nywele laini kama hariri.
about.dg: *Muolaga kuku* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, na ni wa jamii ya *oleander*. Mihiye na makodzage gana maziya mereru. Maruwage mereru gana arufu nono ya mtswano. Matundage ni makakaya mare na membamba ganayomera mairi-mairi; gachiahuka ganalavya tembe zenye vidzundzu vya nyere laini.

where.en: It grows in woodland and bushland.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya wazi na nyika ya vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera phatu phenye mihi na weruni.

culture.en: The name means 'chicken killer'. The plant is considered poisonous, and the name passes that warning on to anyone who learns it.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'muua kuku'. Mmea huu huchukuliwa kuwa na sumu, na jina hilo humpa onyo hilo yeyote anayelijifunza.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya 'unaoolaga kuku'. Atu anaona kukala mmea uhu una sumu, na dzinare rinamuonya chila mutu anayerimanya.

names.en: The Digo name is *muolaga kuku*. In English it is called the fever pod, and botanists know it as *Holarrhena pubescens*. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *muolaga kuku*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *fever pod*, na wataalamu wa mimea huujua kama *Holarrhena pubescens*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *muolaga kuku*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *fever pod*, na asayansi anauiha *Holarrhena pubescens*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Arrow-poison tree, same family and also poisonous
reason.sw: *Utsungu* (arrow-poison tree), wa familia ile ile na pia wenye sumu
reason.dg: *Utsungu*, wa jamii mwenga na piya una sumu.

reason.en: Rauvolfia, a related poisonous shrub
reason.sw: Rauvolfia, kichaka jamaa chenye sumu
reason.dg: *Mzigande*, chitsaka cha sumu chiricho ndugu.

reason.en: Carissa, same oleander family
reason.sw: Mtandamboo, wa familia ile ile ya oleander
reason.dg: *Mtambuu*, wa jamii mwenga ya *oleander*.

reason.en: Another plant whose name warns of harm
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine ambao jina lake linaonya juu ya madhara
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina ambao dzinare rinaonya atu kukala unaweza kuahendera ubaya.
