teaser.en: Traps made from this shrub are said to be so strong that a caught animal rots before it can break free.
teaser.sw: Mitego inayotengenezwa kwa kichaka hiki inasemekana kuwa imara kiasi kwamba mnyama aliyenaswa huoza kabla hajaweza kujinasua.
teaser.dg: Nkugombwa kukala mihambo inayohendwa na chitsaka hichi ni mifu sana, hata nyama ariyegbwirwa anaola kabla ya kuweza kuchimbira.

summary.en: *Muoza nyama* is the wild honeysuckle tree, a shrub of forest edges with clusters of creamy, long-tubed flowers. It is used to make animal traps, and its name reflects their fearsome reputation.
summary.sw: *Muoza nyama* ni kichaka kiitwacho kwa Kiingereza *wild honeysuckle tree*, cha pembezoni mwa misitu, chenye vishada vya maua ya rangi ya krimu yenye mirija mirefu. Hutumika kutengeneza mitego ya wanyama, na jina lake linaakisi sifa ya kutisha ya mitego hiyo.
summary.dg: *Muoza nyama* ni *wild honeysuckle tree* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka cha kanda-kanda ya matsaka chenye mafungu ga maruwa ga rangi ya maziya, chila ruwa rina mrija mure. Nkuhumirwa kuhenda mihambo ya kugbwira nyama, na dzinare rinaonyesa sifwa za kuogofya za mihambo hiyo.

about.en: *Muoza nyama* is a shrub with clusters of creamy flowers, each with a long, slender tube that opens into narrow petals. The flowers resemble honeysuckle, which gives it its English name, and they are often scented in the evening.
about.sw: *Muoza nyama* ni kichaka chenye vishada vya maua ya rangi ya krimu, kila ua likiwa na mrija mrefu mwembamba unaofunguka kuwa petali nyembamba. Maua haya yanafanana na ya *honeysuckle*, ndiyo sababu ya jina lake la Kiingereza, na mara nyingi hutoa harufu nzuri jioni.
about.dg: *Muoza nyama* ni chitsaka chenye mafungu ga maruwa ga rangi ya maziya. Chila ruwa rina mrija mure na mwembamba, unaovuguka kuhenda vipande vyembamba vya ruwa. Maruwa higa ganahalana na *honeysuckle*, ndiyo sababu ya dzinare ra Chingereza, na mara nyinji ganalavya arufu nono dziloni.

where.en: It grows on forest edges and in thicket.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka vizito.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kahi ya vitsaka.

uses.en: It is used to make animal traps.
uses.sw: Hutumika kutengeneza mitego ya wanyama.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa kuhenda mihambo ya kugbwira nyama.

culture.en: The name means 'makes the animal rot'. Its traps are believed to be so strong that a trapped animal rots before it can escape.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'huozesha mnyama'. Mitego yake huaminika kuwa imara kiasi kwamba mnyama aliyenaswa huoza kabla hajaweza kutoroka.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya 'unaooza nyama', yani unaohenda nyama aole. Atu anaamini kukala mihamboye ni mifu sana, hata nyama ariyegbwirwa anaola kabla ya kuweza kuchimbira.

names.en: The Digo name is *muoza nyama*. In English it is the wild honeysuckle tree, and its scientific name is *Turraea floribunda*. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *muoza nyama*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *wild honeysuckle tree*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Turraea floribunda*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *muoza nyama*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild honeysuckle tree*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Turraea floribunda*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Turraea nilotica, same genus
reason.sw: Turraea nilotica, wa jenasi ile ile
reason.dg: *Mtsonga mwiko* (*Turraea nilotica*), jenasi mwenga.

reason.en: Another shrub used for catching animals (octopus)
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine kinachotumika kukamata wanyama (pweza)
reason.dg: *Mvua pweza*, chitsaka chanjina chinachohumirwa kugbwira nyama (pweza).

reason.en: Natal mahogany, same mahogany family
reason.sw: Mwamaji, wa familia ile ile ya mkangazi
reason.dg: *Munwa madzi*, wa jamii mwenga ya *mahogany*.

teaser.en: Convulsions were blamed on a bird called *pungu*, and this aromatic shrub was said to drive it away.
teaser.sw: Degedege ililaumiwa kwa ndege aitwaye *pungu*, na kichaka hiki chenye harufu kilisemekana kumfukuza.
teaser.dg: Atu akala anaamini kukala nyuni inarehwa ni nyama wa mapha aihwaye *pungu*, na chitsaka hichi chenye arufu nono chakala nkugombwa kukala chinamuinga.

summary.en: *Muurusa pungu* is an aromatic shrub of the coastal bushland. It is used to cure convulsions, which are believed to be caused by a bird called *pungu*.
summary.sw: *Muurusa pungu* ni kichaka chenye harufu cha nyika ya vichaka ya pwani. Hutumika kutibu degedege, ambayo huaminika kusababishwa na ndege aitwaye *pungu*.
summary.dg: *Muurusa pungu* ni chitsaka chenye arufu nono chinachomera weruni pwani. Nkuhumirwa kuphoza nyuni, ambayo atu anaamini kukala inarehwa ni nyama wa mapha aihwaye *pungu*.

about.en: *Muurusa pungu* is an aromatic shrub of the mint family, with leaves in opposite pairs that release a scent when crushed.
about.sw: *Muurusa pungu* ni kichaka chenye harufu cha familia ya minanaa, chenye majani yaliyokaa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana ambayo hutoa harufu yakipondwa.
about.dg: *Muurusa pungu* ni chitsaka chenye arufu nono cha jamii ya *mint*. Makodzage ganamera mairi-mairi ganalengana, na gachifikitswa ganalavya arufu.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani.

uses.en: It is used to cure convulsions.
uses.sw: Hutumika kutibu degedege.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa kuphoza nyuni.

culture.en: The name means 'scare off *pungu*'. *Pungu* is a bird believed to cause convulsions, and this plant is believed to drive it away. Convulsions in Digo belief are often tied to birds: the 'rib' convulsions treated by *mbavubavu* are called *nyuni wa mbavu*, *nyuni* meaning bird.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'fukuza *pungu*'. *Pungu* ni ndege anayeaminika kusababisha degedege, na mmea huu huaminika kumfukuza. Katika imani za Kidigo, degedege mara nyingi huhusishwa na ndege: degedege ya 'mbavu' inayotibiwa kwa *mbavubavu* huitwa *nyuni wa mbavu*, *nyuni* likiwa na maana ya ndege.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya 'kuinga *pungu*'. *Pungu* ni nyama wa mapha ambaye atu anaamini kukala anareha nyuni, na mmea uhu nkuaminika kukala unamuinga. Kpwa imani ya Adigo, nyuni mara nyinji zinahusiana na nyama a mapha: nyuni za mbavu zinazophozwa ni *mbavubavu* zinaihwa *nyuni wa mbavu*, na *nyuni* rina mana ya nyama wa mapha.

names.en: The Digo name is *muurusa pungu*, which Duruma shares. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Premna hildebrandtii*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *muurusa pungu*, ambalo linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Premna hildebrandtii*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *muurusa pungu*, na Aduruma piya anarihumira. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Premna hildebrandtii*.

reason.en: Premna chrysoclada, same genus, also used against convulsions
reason.sw: Premna chrysoclada, wa jenasi ile ile, nao pia hutumika dhidi ya degedege
reason.dg: *Mvuma* (*Premna chrysoclada*), jenasi mwenga, na piya nkuhumirwa kpwa nyuni.

reason.en: Also used to treat convulsions
reason.sw: Pia hutumika kutibu degedege
reason.dg: *Mbavubavu mkulu*, piya nkuhumirwa kuphoza nyuni.

reason.en: Aromatic shrub of the same mint family
reason.sw: Kichaka chenye harufu cha familia ile ile ya mnanaa
reason.dg: *Mtserere*, chitsaka chanjina chenye arufu nono cha jamii mwenga ya *mint*.

teaser.en: Its fruit is much loved, yet pole cutters will not build with it, for fear it brings trouble into the home.
teaser.sw: Tunda lake linapendwa sana, lakini wakataji nguzo hawajengi nao, kwa hofu kwamba huleta matatizo nyumbani.
teaser.dg: Matundage nkumendzwa sana, ela atu anaotema nguzo taadzenga nao, kpwa kuogopha kukala unareha shida mudzini.

summary.en: *Mviru* is the wild medlar, a hairy shrub or small tree of the grassland with velvety leaves and round brownish fruit. The fruit is much relished, but people avoid using its stems as building poles.
summary.sw: *Mviru* (kwa Kiingereza *wild medlar*) ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye manyoya wa nyika ya nyasi, wenye majani laini kama mahameli na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya hudhurungi. Tunda lake hupendwa sana, lakini watu huepuka kutumia mashina yake kama nguzo za kujengea.
summary.dg: *Mviru* ni *wild medlar* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka au muhi mdide wa vuwe wenye nyere, makodza malaini sana na matunda ga mviringo ga rangi ya dongo. Matundage nkumendzwa sana, ela atu nkuhepa kuhumira mihiye dza nguzo za kudzengera.

about.en: *Mviru* is a deciduous shrub or small tree up to about 8 m, hairy all over. Its broad leaves feel soft and velvety. The round fruits ripen to a yellowish brown, with a soft, tangy pulp around a few seeds.
about.sw: *Mviru* ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaopukutika majani, wenye urefu wa hadi m 8 hivi, na wenye manyoya mwili mzima. Majani yake mapana ni laini kama mahameli yakiguswa. Matunda ya mviringo huiva kuwa rangi ya hudhurungi ya kimanjano, yakiwa na nyama laini yenye ladha ya kuchachua kidogo inayozunguka mbegu chache.
about.dg: *Mviru* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, na unakula hadi mita 8 hivi; una nyere mwiri wosi. Makodzage ni mapana, na uchigaguta ni malaini sana dza *velvet*. Matundage ga mviringo ganaivwa na kukala ga rangi ya dongo yenye mandano, na gana nyama laini ya ngbwadu kuzunguluka tembe chache.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland and on rocky and sandy ground.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyasi zenye miti na kwenye ardhi ya mawe na ya mchanga.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye mavuwe genye mihi na phatu pha mawe na pha mtsanga.

uses.en: The fruit is much relished and eaten fresh. The stems are used for digging tools, and in some places for house poles, though Digo pole cutters avoid it. Leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Tunda hupendwa sana na huliwa vivi hivi. Mashina hutumika kutengeneza zana za kuchimbia, na katika baadhi ya maeneo hutumika kama nguzo za nyumba, ingawa wakataji nguzo wa Kidigo huuepuka. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg: Matundage nkumendzwa sana na nkuriwa dza garivyo. Mihiye nkuhumirwa kuhenda vyombo vya kutsimbira, na phatu phanjina kuhenda nguzo za nyumba, ela Adigo anaotema nguzo nkuuhepa. Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: Digo pole cutters avoid *mviru* as a building pole, because it is believed to bring domestic problems to the household that lives under it.
culture.sw: Wakataji nguzo wa Kidigo huepuka kutumia *mviru* kama nguzo ya kujengea, kwa sababu huaminika kuleta matatizo ya kifamilia kwa watu wanaoishi katika nyumba hiyo.
culture.dg: Adigo anaotema nguzo nkuhepa kuhumira *mviru* dza nguzo ya kudzengera, kpwa sababu nkuaminika kukala unareha shida za nyumbani kpwa mbari inayokala kpwenye nyumba iriyodzengbwa nao.

names.en: The name *mviru* is shared by Digo, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is the wild medlar; botanists call it *Vangueria infausta*.
names.sw: Jina *mviru* linatumika katika Kidigo, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza ni *wild medlar*; wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Vangueria infausta*.
names.dg: Dzina *mviru* nkuhumirwa kpwa Chidigo, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild medlar*; asayansi anauiha *Vangueria infausta*.

reason.en: Coffee-family shrub also avoided for poles, believed to split families
reason.sw: Kichaka cha familia ya mibuni ambacho pia huepukwa kwa nguzo, kikiaminika kutenganisha familia
reason.dg: *Mfumula ndolwa*, chitsaka cha jamii ya kahawa chinachohepwa piya dza nguzo, kpwa sababu nkuaminika kukala chinaganya mbari.

reason.en: Catunaregam, same coffee family
reason.sw: Catunaregam, wa familia ile ile ya mibuni
reason.dg: *Mtengedzi* (*Catunaregam*), wa jamii mwenga ya kahawa.

reason.en: Wild custard apple, another favourite bush fruit
reason.sw: Mtomoko mwitu, tunda lingine la porini linalopendwa
reason.dg: *Mbokwe*, muhi wanjina wa matunda ga weruni ganayomendzwa sana.

reason.en: Sour plum, another wild bush fruit
reason.sw: Mtundukula, tunda lingine la porini
reason.dg: *Mtundukula*, muhi wanjina wa matunda ga weruni.

teaser.en: Sticks from this shrub catch octopus on the reef, but burn it at home and, it is said, you risk leprosy.
teaser.sw: Vijiti vya kichaka hiki hutumika kukamata pweza kwenye miamba ya matumbawe, lakini ukikichoma nyumbani, inasemekana unajiweka hatarini kupata ukoma.
teaser.dg: Fwimbo za chitsaka hichi nkugbwira pweza mwambani, ela nkugombwa kukala uchiuocha kaya, unaweza kugbwirwa ni mahana.

summary.en: *Mvua pweza*, the 'octopus fisher', is a coastal bush shrub with yellow flowers and black fruits on a bright red base. Its sticks are used to catch octopus, but it must never be burned or built with.
summary.sw: *Mvua pweza*, yaani 'mvuvi wa pweza', ni kichaka cha porini cha pwani chenye maua ya manjano na matunda meusi yaliyokaa juu ya kitako chekundu angavu. Vijiti vyake hutumika kukamata pweza, lakini kamwe hakichomwi wala hakitumiki kujengea.
summary.dg: *Mvua pweza*, 'mgbwira pweza', ni chitsaka cha weruni pwani chenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano na matunda maru ganayokala dzulu ya seemu ya kundu inayoala. Fwimboze nkuhumirwa kugbwira pweza, ela taufwaha kuochwa wala kuhumirwa kudzengera kabisa.

about.en: *Mvua pweza* is a shrub of the Ochna family, the plants often called Mickey Mouse bushes. Its flowers are yellow. After flowering, the sepals and the swollen base of the flower turn bright red, and the black fruits sit on top like eyes, a striking red-and-black display.
about.sw: *Mvua pweza* ni kichaka cha familia ya Ochna, mimea inayojulikana mara nyingi kwa Kiingereza kama *Mickey Mouse bushes*. Maua yake ni ya manjano. Baada ya kuchanua, sepali na kitako kilichovimba cha ua hugeuka rangi nyekundu angavu, na matunda meusi hukaa juu yake kama macho, mandhari ya kuvutia ya rangi nyekundu na nyeusi.
about.dg: *Mvua pweza* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya *Ochna*, mimea ambayo mara nyinji inaihwa *Mickey Mouse bushes*. Maruwage ni ga rangi ya mandano. Bada ya maruwa, *sepals* na seemu ya photsi ya ruwa iriyovwimba vinakala vya kundu inayoala, na matunda maru ganasagala dzulu dza matso. Atu nkuangalala uchiona rangi hizi za kundu na nyiru.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, close enough to the shore for its sticks to be carried down to the reef.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani, karibu vya kutosha na ufukwe kiasi kwamba vijiti vyake vinaweza kubebwa hadi kwenye miamba ya matumbawe.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani, phephi na bahari, hata fwimboze zinaweza kutsukulwa hadi mwambani.

uses.en: Its sticks are used to catch octopus on the reef.
uses.sw: Vijiti vyake hutumika kukamata pweza kwenye miamba ya matumbawe.
uses.dg: Fwimboze nkuhumirwa kugbwira pweza mwambani.

culture.en: Its two names point in opposite directions. *Mvua pweza* means 'octopus fisher', after its use at sea. *Mtsonga mahana* means 'causer of leprosy': using it for firewood or for building is believed to cause leprosy, so it is kept out of the home.
culture.sw: Majina yake mawili yanaelekeza pande mbili zinazopingana. *Mvua pweza* lina maana ya 'mvuvi wa pweza', kutokana na matumizi yake baharini. *Mtsonga mahana* lina maana ya 'msababishaji wa ukoma': kukitumia kama kuni au kwa ujenzi huaminika kusababisha ukoma, kwa hiyo huwekwa mbali na nyumbani.
culture.dg: Madzinage mairi ganagomba mambo ga tafwauti kabisa. *Mvua pweza* rina mana ya 'mgbwira pweza', kpwa sababu nkuhumirwa baharini. *Mtsonga mahana* rina mana ya 'anayereha mahana': atu anaamini kukala kuuhumira dza kuni au kudzengera kunareha mahana, kpwa hivyo taurehwa kaya.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mvua pweza* and *mtsonga mahana*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Ochna thomasiana*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mvua pweza* na *mtsonga mahana*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Ochna thomasiana*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mvua pweza* na *mtsonga mahana*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Ochna thomasiana*.

reason.en: Another shrub never used for firewood because of a belief
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine ambacho kamwe hakitumiki kama kuni kwa sababu ya imani
reason.dg: *Mfumula ndolwa*, chitsaka chanjina chisichohumirwa kabisa dza kuni kpwa sababu ya imani.

reason.en: Also avoided for building because of a belief
reason.sw: Mviru, ambao pia huepukwa katika ujenzi kwa sababu ya imani
reason.dg: *Mviru*, piya nkuhepwa kpwa kudzengera kpwa sababu ya imani.

reason.en: Another shrub used for catching animals
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine kinachotumika kukamata wanyama
reason.dg: *Muoza nyama*, chitsaka chanjina chinachohumirwa kugbwira nyama.

reason.en: Also carries a 'mtsonga' (maker or causer) name
reason.sw: Nao pia una jina la 'mtsonga' (mtengenezaji au msababishaji)
reason.dg: *Mtsonga mwiko*, piya una dzina ra 'mtsonga' (anayehenda au anayereha).

teaser.en: Its name means 'roar', a sign of dominance and success, and it is used against convulsions and spiritual ailments.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'kunguruma', ishara ya utawala na mafanikio, na hutumika dhidi ya degedege na maradhi ya kiroho.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'kuvuma', alama ya ukulu na ushindi, na nkuhumirwa kpwa nyuni na makongo ga pepho.

summary.en: *Mvuma* is a coastal shrub or small tree with dense flower heads and very hard wood. It is used against convulsions and spiritual ailments, and its wood for household items.
summary.sw: *Mvuma* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa pwani wenye vichwa vya maua vilivyosongamana na mbao ngumu sana. Hutumika dhidi ya degedege na maradhi ya kiroho, na mbao zake hutumika kutengeneza vifaa vya nyumbani.
summary.dg: *Mvuma* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa pwani wenye mafungu ga maruwa ganayobanana na nyama za muhi nyifu sana. Nkuhumirwa kpwa nyuni na makongo ga pepho, na nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda vyombo vya nyumbani.

about.en: *Mvuma* is a shrub or small tree of the mint family, with leaves in opposite pairs. Its small flowers are packed into dense heads. The wood is very hard.
about.sw: *Mvuma* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya minanaa, wenye majani yaliyokaa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana. Maua yake madogo yamesongamana katika vichwa. Mbao zake ni ngumu sana.
about.dg: *Mvuma* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya *mint*, wenye makodza ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalengana. Maruwage madide ganabanana phamwenga kuhenda mafungu. Nyama za muhi ni nyifu sana.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani.

uses.en: It is used to treat convulsions and spiritual ailments. The very hard wood is made into household items.
uses.sw: Hutumika kutibu degedege na maradhi ya kiroho. Mbao zake ngumu sana hutengenezwa vifaa vya nyumbani.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa kuphoza nyuni na makongo ga pepho. Nyama za muhi, ambazo ni nyifu sana, nkuhumirwa kuhenda vyombo vya nyumbani.

culture.en: The name *mvuma* means 'roar', a sign of dominance and success, which ties it to the strength people seek against illness and spirits.
culture.sw: Jina *mvuma* lina maana ya 'kunguruma', ishara ya utawala na mafanikio, jambo linalouhusisha na nguvu ambazo watu hutafuta dhidi ya maradhi na pepo.
culture.dg: Dzina *mvuma* rina mana ya 'kuvuma', alama ya ukulu na ushindi, na kpwa hivyo rinahusiana na nguvu ambazo atu anazihendza kupigana na makongo na pepho.

names.en: The Digo name is *mvuma*. In Swahili it is *mvuma nyuki*, and in Giriama *mvuma nyuki* or *mvuma*. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Premna chrysoclada*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mvuma*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mvuma nyuki*, na kwa Kigiriama *mvuma nyuki* au *mvuma*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Premna chrysoclada*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mvuma*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mvuma nyuki*, na kpwa Chigiryama *mvuma nyuki* au *mvuma*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Premna chrysoclada*.

reason.en: Premna hildebrandtii, same genus, also used for convulsions
reason.sw: Premna hildebrandtii, wa jenasi ile ile, nao pia hutumika kwa degedege
reason.dg: *Muurusa pungu* (*Premna hildebrandtii*), jenasi mwenga, na piya nkuhumirwa kpwa nyuni.

reason.en: Also used to treat convulsions
reason.sw: Pia hutumika kutibu degedege
reason.dg: *Mbavubavu mkulu*, piya nkuhumirwa kuphoza nyuni.

reason.en: Another medicine for spiritual ailments
reason.sw: Dawa nyingine ya maradhi ya kiroho
reason.dg: *Mwangajine*, dawa yanjina ya makongo ga pepho.

reason.en: Same mint family
reason.sw: Wa familia ile ile ya mnanaa
reason.dg: *Mtserere*, wa jamii mwenga ya *mint*.

teaser.en: Its name means 'hoe breaker', and it plays a part in rites that bring an end to quarrels in families and villages.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'mvunja jembe', na una nafasi katika matambiko yanayomaliza ugomvi katika familia na vijiji.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'unaovundza jembe', na nkuhumirwa kpwenye vimila vinavyomala kondo za mbari na za vidzidzi.

summary.en: *Mvundza jembe* is a variable bush shrub with three-part toothed leaves and small red berries. It is a ritual medicine for settling disputes, and a medicine to 'end the war with disease in the body'.
summary.sw: *Mvundza jembe* ni kichaka cha porini kinachobadilikabadilika, chenye majani ya vijani vitatu vyenye meno na matunda madogo mekundu. Ni dawa ya kimila ya kusuluhisha migogoro, na dawa ya 'kumaliza vita na ugonjwa mwilini'.
summary.dg: *Mvundza jembe* ni chitsaka cha weruni chinachobadilika sana umbo, chenye makodza ga vipande vihahu vyenye meno na matunda madide ga kundu. Ni dawa ya chimila ya kuhenda atu enye kondo apatane, na dawa ya 'kumala kondo na makongo mwirini'.

about.en: *Mvundza jembe* is a very variable shrub, sometimes upright, sometimes scrambling. Each leaf has three toothed leaflets, a little like a bramble leaf. It bears small berries that ripen red.
about.sw: *Mvundza jembe* ni kichaka kinachobadilikabadilika sana, wakati mwingine kikiwa kimesimama wima, wakati mwingine kikitambaa. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu vyenye meno, kidogo kama jani la *bramble*. Huzaa matunda madogo yanayoiva kuwa mekundu.
about.dg: *Mvundza jembe* ni chitsaka chinachobadilika sana: wakati wanjina chinaima chocho, wakati wanjina chinaambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu genye meno kanda-kanda, dza kodza ra *bramble*. Chinalavya matunda madide ganayoivwa na kukala ga kundu.

where.en: It grows in bushland and on forest edges.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka na pembezoni mwa misitu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

uses.en: It is used as a ritual medicine for settling disputes, and as a medicine 'to end the war with disease in the body'.
uses.sw: Hutumika kama dawa ya kimila ya kusuluhisha migogoro, na kama dawa ya 'kumaliza vita na ugonjwa mwilini'.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya chimila ya kuhenda atu enye kondo apatane, na dza dawa 'ya kumala kondo na makongo mwirini'.

culture.en: *Mvundza jembe* means 'hoe breaker'. It is used in rites that end domestic and community disputes, in which a hoe serves as a symbolic item. Its other name, *mvundza kondo*, means 'breaker of war', and the same idea runs through its medicinal use: ending a war, whether between people or inside the body.
culture.sw: *Mvundza jembe* lina maana ya 'mvunja jembe'. Hutumika katika matambiko yanayomaliza migogoro ya kifamilia na ya kijamii, ambapo jembe hutumika kama kitu cha ishara. Jina lake lingine, *mvundza kondo*, lina maana ya 'mvunja vita', na wazo hilo hilo linapitia matumizi yake ya kitabibu: kumaliza vita, iwe kati ya watu au ndani ya mwili.
culture.dg: *Mvundza jembe* rina mana ya 'unaovundza jembe'. Nkuhumirwa kpwenye vimila vya kumala kondo za nyumbani na za jamii, ambamo jembe ni chitu cha alama. Dzinare ranjina, *mvundza kondo*, rina mana ya 'unaovundza kondo', na mana hiyo hiyo inaphahikana kpwenye kaziye ya dawa: kumala kondo, ikale kahi ya atu au mwirini.

names.en: Pakia records *mvundza jembe* and *mvundza kondo*; other recorded forms are *mbanda tchitswa* and *muvudza kondo*. ICRAF records its names under a related species, *Allophylus africanus*. In Swahili it is *mlishangwa* or *mkona chuma*, and in Giriama *munyanga kitswa*. No English common name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi *mvundza jembe* na *mvundza kondo*; maumbo mengine yaliyorekodiwa ni *mbanda tchitswa* na *muvudza kondo*. ICRAF inarekodi majina yake chini ya spishi jamaa, *Allophylus africanus*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mlishangwa* au *mkona chuma*, na kwa Kigiriama *munyanga kitswa*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mvundza jembe* na *mvundza kondo*; madzina ganjina garigoandikpwa ni *mbanda tchitswa* na *muvudza kondo*. ICRAF anaandika madzinage kpwa aina yanjina iriyo ndugu, *Allophylus africanus*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mlishangwa* au *mkona chuma*, na kpwa Chigiryama *munyanga kitswa*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

reason.dg: *Mtserere*, piya nkuhumirwa kuphoza kondo.

teaser.en: Builders cut poles from it, though its Digo name, 'termite crawler', warns that the termites will soon follow.
teaser.sw: Wajenzi hukata nguzo kutoka kwake, ingawa jina lake la Kidigo, 'kinachotambaliwa na mchwa', linaonya kwamba mchwa watafuata hivi karibuni.
teaser.dg: Atu anaodzenga nkutema nguzo kpwenye muhi uhu, ela dzinare ra Chidigo, *mwambala lutswa*, rinaonya kukala malutswa gandalunga.

summary.en: *Mwambala lutswa* is an understorey shrub of the coastal forest with spiny, holly-like leaves. It is cut for building poles, but its name warns that termites favour them.
summary.sw: *Mwambala lutswa* ni kichaka kinachoota chini ya miti mikubwa ya msitu wa pwani, chenye majani yenye miiba yanayofanana na ya *holly*. Hukatwa kwa ajili ya nguzo za kujengea, lakini jina lake linaonya kwamba mchwa huzipenda nguzo hizo.
summary.dg: *Mwambala lutswa* ni chitsaka chinachomera photsi ya mihi mikulu kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, chenye makodza genye miya dza ga *holly*. Nkutemwa kuhenda nguzo za kudzengera, ela dzinare rinaonya kukala malutswa ganazimendza nguzo hizo.

about.en: *Mwambala lutswa* is a shrub with stiff leaves whose edges carry spiny teeth, much like holly. It belongs to the violet family, though it looks nothing like a garden violet.
about.sw: *Mwambala lutswa* ni kichaka chenye majani magumu ambayo kingo zake zina meno ya miiba, kama ya *holly*. Ni wa familia ya *violet*, ingawa haufanani hata kidogo na *violet* ya bustanini.
about.dg: *Mwambala lutswa* ni chitsaka chenye makodza magumu genye meno ga miya kanda-kanda, dza *holly*. Ni wa jamii ya *violet*, ela tauhalana kabisa na *violet* ya busitani.

where.en: It grows in the shady understorey of coastal forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika kivuli chini ya miti mikubwa ya msitu wa pwani.
where.dg: Unamera photsi ya mihi mikulu, phatu phenye pepho, kpwenye matsaka ga pwani.

uses.en: Its stems are used as building poles.
uses.sw: Mashina yake hutumika kama nguzo za kujengea.
uses.dg: Mihiye nkuhumirwa dza nguzo za kudzengera.

culture.en: The name means 'termite crawler', because termites favour poles made from it. It is a name that carries practical building advice.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'kinachotambaliwa na mchwa', kwa sababu mchwa hupenda nguzo zilizotengenezwa kwa mmea huu. Ni jina lenye ushauri wa vitendo kuhusu ujenzi.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya 'unaoambalwa ni malutswa', kpwa sababu malutswa ganamendza nguzo zinazotemwa kpwenye muhi uhu. Ni dzina renye shauri ra kazi ya kudzenga.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwambala lutswa*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Rinorea ilicifolia*, after its holly-like (*Ilex*) leaves.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwambala lutswa*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Rinorea ilicifolia*, kutokana na majani yake yanayofanana na ya *holly* (*Ilex*).
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mwambala lutswa*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Rinorea ilicifolia*, kpwa sababu makodzage ganahalana na ga *holly* (*Ilex*).

reason.en: Spiny terminalia, valued instead for termite-resistant poles
reason.sw: Mwangati, ambao badala yake huthaminiwa kwa nguzo zisizoliwa na mchwa
reason.dg: *Mwanga kululu*, unaotogolwa badala yakpwe kpwa nguzo zisizoriwa ni malutswa.

reason.en: Another shrub cut for building poles
reason.sw: Mnembenembe, kichaka kingine kinachokatwa kwa nguzo za kujengea
reason.dg: *Mkalakala*, chitsaka chanjina chinachotemwa kuhenda nguzo za kudzengera.

reason.en: Another plant pole cutters think twice about
reason.sw: Mviru, mmea mwingine ambao wakataji nguzo huufikiria mara mbili
reason.dg: *Mviru*, mmea wanjina ambao atu anaotema nguzo nkuuhepa.

teaser.en: The 'male' *mwangajine* has huge leaves and large cream flowers, and like its namesake it is a medicine for spiritual illness.
teaser.sw: *Mwangajine* 'dume' ana majani makubwa mno na maua makubwa ya rangi ya krimu, na kama yule aliyepewa jina lake, ni dawa ya maradhi ya kiroho.
teaser.dg: *Mwangajine* 'mlume' una makodza makulu sana na maruwa makulu ga rangi ya maziya, na dza *mwangajine* uriohalana nao kpwa dzina, ni dawa ya makongo ga pepho.

summary.en: *Mwangajine mlume* is a large-leaved shrub or small tree of evergreen coastal forest, often on coral rock. It is a spiritual medicine, like the *mwangajine* it is named after, and it is listed as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: *Mwangajine mlume* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani makubwa wa msitu wa pwani usiopukutika majani, mara nyingi juu ya mawe ya matumbawe. Ni dawa ya kiroho, kama *mwangajine* ambaye amepewa jina lake, na umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Mwangajine mlume* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza makulu, wa matsaka ga pwani ga mihi yenye makodza chila wakati, na mara nyinji unamera dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo. Ni dawa ya makongo ga pepho, dza *mwangajine* uriohalana nao kpwa dzina, na ukaandikpwa *Vulnerable* (uri hatarini).

about.en: *Mwangajine mlume* is a shrub or small tree with very large leaves, long and broad, which make it stand out in the forest undergrowth. Its flowers are large and cream-coloured, thick-petalled in the way of the custard-apple family.
about.sw: *Mwangajine mlume* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani makubwa sana, marefu na mapana, yanayoufanya uonekane wazi katikati ya mimea ya chini msituni. Maua yake ni makubwa na ya rangi ya krimu, yenye petali nene kama ilivyo kwa familia ya mitopetope.
about.dg: *Mwangajine mlume* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza makulu sana, mare na mapana, ganayouhenda uonekane wazi kahi ya vitsaka vya tsakani. Maruwage ni makulu na ga rangi ya maziya, na vipande vya ruwa ni vinene dza vya mimea ya jamii ya *custard apple*.

where.en: It grows in evergreen coastal forest, often on coral rock.
where.sw: Hukua katika msitu wa pwani usiopukutika majani, mara nyingi juu ya mawe ya matumbawe.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ga mihi yenye makodza chila wakati, mara nyinji dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo.

uses.en: It is used as a spiritual medicine, in the same way as *mwangajine*.
uses.sw: Hutumika kama dawa ya kiroho, kwa namna ile ile kama *mwangajine*.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya makongo ga pepho, dza *mwangajine*.

culture.en: The name is explained as 'male spirit-being': this is the large-leaved *mwangajine*, the male partner to *mwangajine* (*Isolona cauliflora*). Both carry the names of the spirits Mwanga and Jine.
culture.sw: Jina lake hufafanuliwa kama 'kiumbe-roho dume': huyu ni *mwangajine* mwenye majani makubwa, mwenzi wa kiume wa *mwangajine* (*Isolona cauliflora*). Wote wawili wamebeba majina ya pepo Mwanga na Jine.
culture.dg: Dzina nkuelezwa kukala 'pepho mlume': uhu ni *mwangajine* wa makodza makulu, mlume wa *mwangajine* (*Isolona cauliflora*). Mihi yosi miiri ina madzina ga pepho Mwanga na Jine.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mwangajine mlume* and *mzondohera nguluwe*. Duruma shares the name *mwangajine*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Uvariodendron kirkii*. *Mzondohera nguluwe* is also recorded as the Digo name of a different shrub, the sandpaper saucer-berry (*Cordia monoica*).
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mwangajine mlume* na *mzondohera nguluwe*. Kiduruma kinatumia pia jina *mwangajine*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Uvariodendron kirkii*. *Mzondohera nguluwe* pia limerekodiwa kama jina la Kidigo la kichaka kingine, *sandpaper saucer-berry* (*Cordia monoica*).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mwangajine mlume* na *mzondohera nguluwe*. Aduruma piya anahumira dzina *mwangajine*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Uvariodendron kirkii*. *Mzondohera nguluwe* piya ukaandikpwa dza dzina ra Chidigo ra chitsaka chanjina, *sandpaper saucer-berry* (*Cordia monoica*).

conservation.en: *Mwangajine mlume* is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List and depends on the remaining evergreen coastal forest.
conservation.sw: *Mwangajine mlume* umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN, na unategemea misitu ya pwani isiyopukutika majani iliyobaki.
conservation.dg: *Mwangajine mlume* ukaandikpwa *Vulnerable* (uri hatarini) kpwenye IUCN Red List, na unakuluphira matsaka ga pwani ga mihi yenye makodza chila wakati garigosala.

reason.en: The 'female' partner, also a spiritual medicine
reason.sw: Mwenzi 'jike', nao pia ni dawa ya kiroho
reason.dg: *Mwangajine*, 'mchetu' wa mmea uhu, na piya ni dawa ya makongo ga pepho.

reason.en: Named after the same spirit, Mwanga
reason.sw: Umepewa jina la pepo yule yule, Mwanga
reason.dg: *Mwanga*, una dzina ra pepho mwenga, Mwanga.

reason.en: Shares the name mzondohera nguluwe
reason.sw: Unashiriki jina *mzondohera nguluwe*
reason.dg: *Mzondohera nguluwe*, una dzina hiri hiri, *mzondohera nguluwe*.

reason.en: Mkilua, same custard-apple family, also Vulnerable
reason.sw: Mkilua, wa familia ile ile ya mtomoko, nao pia uko Hatarini
reason.dg: *Chilua*, cha jamii mwenga ya *custard apple*, na piya chiri hatarini (*Vulnerable*).

teaser.en: Snap a twig and white latex beads out, which is why one of its Digo names simply means 'the one with latex'.
teaser.sw: Ukivunja kijiti chake, matone ya utomvu mweupe hutokeza, na ndiyo sababu mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo lina maana tu ya 'mwenye utomvu'.
teaser.dg: Vundza chigongo na maziya mereru ganatuluka matone-matone; ndiyo mana dzina rimwenga ra Chidigo ra mmea uhu rina mana ya 'chiricho na ulimbo'.

summary.en: *Mzigande* is a shrub of the coastal forest and thicket, a relative of the periwinkles and oleanders, full of white latex. The Digo of Diani boil the root bark of its genus as a remedy for malaria.
summary.sw: *Mzigande* ni kichaka cha msitu wa pwani na vichaka vizito, jamaa wa *periwinkle* na *oleander*, kilichojaa utomvu mweupe. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gamba la mizizi ya jenasi yake kama dawa ya malaria.
summary.dg: *Mzigande* ni chitsaka cha matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani, ndugu wa *periwinkle* na *oleander*, chenye maziya manji mereru. Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha gopha ra mizi ya mimea ya jenasiye kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria).

about.en:
*Mzigande* is a shrub of the dogbane family, and like most of its relatives it bleeds a milky white latex wherever it is cut. Its leaves grow in whorls, several leaves fanning out from the same point on the stem, which gives the branches a tiered, rosette-like look. The small white flowers come in clusters near the branch tips.

The whorled leaves and the latex together are the best field marks. Many plants in this family are poisonous, and the latex is treated with caution.
about.sw:
*Mzigande* ni kichaka cha familia ya oleander, na kama jamaa zake wengi hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa popote kinapokatwa. Majani yake hukua kwa mizunguko, majani kadhaa yakitawanyika kutoka sehemu moja ya shina, jambo linalofanya matawi yaonekane kwa ngazi-ngazi kama rozeti. Maua madogo meupe huja kwa vishada karibu na ncha za matawi.

Majani yanayokaa kwa mizunguko pamoja na utomvu ndizo alama bora za kukitambua porini. Mimea mingi ya familia hii ina sumu, na utomvu wake hushughulikiwa kwa tahadhari.
about.dg:
*Mzigande* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya *dogbane*, na dza nduguze anjina anji, unalavya maziya mereru phophosi unaphokatwa. Makodzage ganamera manji phatu phamwenga kpwenye kolo, ganatawanyika kpwa mviringo, na ichi chinahenda panda zikale na ngazi-ngazi dza maruwa. Maruwa madide mereru ganamera mafungu-mafungu phephi na ntsa za panda.

Makodza higa ganayomera kpwa mviringo na maziya ndizo alama mbidzo za kuumanya. Mimea minji ya jamii ihi ina sumu, na maziya nkugbwirwa kpwa makini.

where.en: Look for *mzigande* in coastal forest and thicket on the south coast, where it grows in the shaded understorey among other shrubs and climbers.
where.sw: Mtafute *mzigande* katika msitu wa pwani na vichaka vizito vya pwani ya kusini, ambako hukua kwenye kivuli chini ya miti mikubwa pamoja na vichaka na mitambaa mingine.
where.dg: Hendza *mzigande* kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya kusini, ambapho unamera pepho photsi ya mihi mikulu kahi ya vitsaka vyanjina na mimea inayofyombera.

uses.en:
Among the Digo of Diani, the root bark of *Rauvolfia* is boiled to make a remedy for malaria. The practice is recorded for the genus as a whole rather than for this exact species.

*Rauvolfia* is well known to botanists for its strong alkaloids, which is one reason healers treat these plants with respect.
uses.sw:
Miongoni mwa Wadigo wa Diani, gamba la mizizi ya *Rauvolfia* huchemshwa kutengeneza dawa ya malaria. Desturi hii imerekodiwa kwa jenasi nzima badala ya spishi hii mahususi.

*Rauvolfia* inajulikana sana kwa wataalamu wa mimea kwa alkaloidi zake kali, na hiyo ni sababu mojawapo inayowafanya waganga kuishughulikia mimea hii kwa heshima.
uses.dg:
Kahi ya Adigo a Diani, gopha ra mizi ya *Rauvolfia* nkuchemuswa kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria). Desturi ihi ikaandikpwa kpwa jenasi yosi, si kpwa aina ihi bahi.

*Rauvolfia* inamanyikana sana ni asayansi kpwa kemikalize kali, na ihi ni sababu mwenga inayohenda aganga agbwire mimea ihi kpwa hishima.

names.en: The main Digo name is *mzigande*. A second name, *chibombo ulimbo*, means roughly 'the *chibombo* with latex', and probably stresses that its sticky white latex is poisonous. No English or Swahili name has been recorded for this species. Scientists call it *Rauvolfia mombasiana*, after Mombasa.
names.sw: Jina kuu la Kidigo ni *mzigande*. Jina la pili, *chibombo ulimbo*, lina maana ya takriban '*chibombo* mwenye utomvu', na huenda linasisitiza kwamba utomvu wake mweupe unaonata ni sumu. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa kwa spishi hii. Wanasayansi hukiita *Rauvolfia mombasiana*, kutokana na Mombasa.
names.dg: Dzina kulu ra Chidigo ni *mzigande*. Dzina ra phiri, *chibombo ulimbo*, rina mana ya phephi 'chibombo chiricho na ulimbo', na chahi rinaonyesa kukala maziyage mereru ganayonyata gana sumu. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa kpwa aina ihi. Asayansi anauiha *Rauvolfia mombasiana*, kula dzina ra Mombasa.

reason.dg: *Mtseha*, ambao gopha ra miziye piya nkuchemuswa kpwa homa (malaria) Diani

reason.sw: Gamba lingine la mizizi linalotumika dhidi ya malaria
reason.dg: *Chihumbohumbo*, gopha ranjina ra mizi rinarohumirwa kpwa homa (malaria)

teaser.en: Its leaves are as rough as sandpaper, and its Digo name, 'wiper of the pig's buttocks', makes sure nobody forgets it.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yana ukwaru kama msasa, na jina lake la Kidigo, 'mpanguzaji wa makalio ya nguruwe', huhakikisha hakuna anayelisahau.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganakaraza dza msasa, na dzina ra Chidigo, 'cha kuphangusira mahako ga nguluwe', rinahakikisha takuna anayeriyala.

summary.en: *Mzondohera nguluwe* is a bushland shrub with leaves as rough as sandpaper and orange fruits that sit in a little saucer. Its memorable Digo name is one of the best examples of Digo humour in plant naming.
summary.sw: *Mzondohera nguluwe* ni kichaka cha nyika ya vichaka chenye majani yenye ukwaru kama karatasi ya msasa na matunda ya rangi ya chungwa yanayokaa kwenye kisahani kidogo. Jina lake la Kidigo lisilosahaulika ni mojawapo ya mifano bora ya ucheshi wa Kidigo katika kuipa mimea majina.
summary.dg: *Mzondohera nguluwe* ni chitsaka cha weruni chenye makodza ganayokaraza dza msasa na matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa ganayosagala kpwenye sahani ndide. Dzinare ra Chidigo, ambaro ni rahisi kuritambukira, ni mfwano mnono sana wa chimwemwe cha Adigo kpwenye kuiha mimea.

about.en:
*Mzondohera nguluwe* is a shrub or small tree whose leaves are its signature. Run a hand over one and it feels like fine sandpaper, rough on both sides. The leaves are broad and rounded.

The fruits are small, round and orange when ripe, and each one sits in a cup or saucer formed by the old flower calyx. That saucer is what gives it the English name 'sandpaper saucer-berry'. Inside is a sticky, translucent pulp around a hard stone, typical of the *Cordia* genus.
about.sw:
*Mzondohera nguluwe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo ambao majani yake ndiyo alama yake kuu. Ukipitisha mkono juu ya jani moja, unahisi kama karatasi laini ya msasa, lenye ukwaru pande zote mbili. Majani ni mapana na ya mviringo.

Matunda ni madogo, ya mviringo na ya rangi ya chungwa yakiiva, na kila moja hukaa kwenye kikombe au kisahani kilichoundwa na kaliksi ya zamani ya ua. Kisahani hicho ndicho kinachoupa jina la Kiingereza *sandpaper saucer-berry*. Ndani kuna nyama angavu inayonata inayozunguka kokwa gumu, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa jenasi *Cordia*.
about.dg:
*Mzondohera nguluwe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide ambao makodzage ndigo alamaye. Uchiriguta kodza kpwa mkpwono, rinakaraza dza msasa laini, maugu-maugu kpwa mbavu zosi mbiri. Makodza ni mapana na ga mviringo.

Matunda ni madide, ga mviringo, na ga rangi ya chungbwa ganaphoivwa, na chila rimwenga rinasagala kpwenye chikombe au sahani iriyohendwa ni seemu ya photsi ya ruwa ra kare. Sahani ihi ndiyo inayoupha dzina ra Chingereza *sandpaper saucer-berry*. Ndani kuna nyama inayonyata na inayong'ala, inayozunguluka chitsa chigumu, dza irivyo kpwa jenasi ya *Cordia*.

where.en: This is a plant of the coastal bushland, growing among other thorny and rough-leaved shrubs in the dry bush inland from the beaches. It is easiest to spot when the orange fruits are ripe.
where.sw: Huu ni mmea wa nyika ya vichaka ya pwani, unaokua miongoni mwa vichaka vingine vyenye miiba na majani yenye ukwaru katika vichaka vikavu vilivyo bara kutoka fukweni. Ni rahisi zaidi kuutambua matunda yake ya rangi ya chungwa yanapoiva.
where.dg: Uhu ni mmea wa weruni wa pwani, unaomera kahi ya vitsaka vyanjina vyenye miya na makodza ganayokaraza, kpwenye weruni mkavu wa bara, kure na pwani ya mtsanga. Ni rahisi kuuona wakati matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa ganaivwa.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded. Elsewhere in East Africa the ripe fruits of this species are eaten for their sweet, sticky pulp, and the rough leaves are used to smooth wood and scour pots.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Kwingineko Afrika Mashariki, matunda yaliyoiva ya spishi hii huliwa kwa nyama yake tamu inayonata, na majani yenye ukwaru hutumika kulainisha mbao na kusugua vyungu.
uses.dg: Takuna kazi hasa ya Chidigo iriyoandikpwa. Phatu phanjina Afrika ya Mashariki, matunda ganayoivwa ga aina ihi nkuriwa kpwa sababu ya nyamaye ya mtswano inayonyata, na makodza ganayokaraza nkuhumirwa kulainisha mbao na kukpwangula nyungu.

culture.en: The name *mzondohera nguluwe* means 'wiper of the pig's buttocks', a joke that follows naturally from leaves as rough as these. Names like this, built on everyday images, help people remember what a plant feels like.
culture.sw: Jina *mzondohera nguluwe* lina maana ya 'mpanguzaji wa makalio ya nguruwe', utani unaotokana kwa urahisi na majani yenye ukwaru kama haya. Majina kama haya, yaliyojengwa juu ya taswira za kila siku, huwasaidia watu kukumbuka jinsi mmea unavyohisika ukiguswa.
culture.dg: Dzina *mzondohera nguluwe* rina mana ya 'cha kuphangusira mahako ga nguluwe', chitseko chinachozuka chenyewe kpwa makodza ganayokaraza dza higa. Madzina dza iga, ganayodzengbwa dzulu ya vitu vya chila siku, nkuteryera atu kutambukira mmea unavyokala uchiuguta.

names.en: Digo: *mzondohera nguluwe*. The same name is also recorded for a quite different plant, the climber *mkala fisi* (*Tetracera boiviniana*), which also has sandpapery leaves, so the name seems to describe the leaf rather than a single species. English: sandpaper saucer-berry. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mzondohera nguluwe*. Jina hilo hilo pia limerekodiwa kwa mmea tofauti kabisa, mtambaa *mkala fisi* (*Tetracera boiviniana*), ambao pia una majani kama msasa, kwa hiyo jina hili linaonekana kueleza jani badala ya spishi moja. Kiingereza: *sandpaper saucer-berry*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Chidigo: *mzondohera nguluwe*. Dzina hiri piya rikaandikpwa kpwa mmea wanjina tafwauti kabisa, mmea unaofyombera *mkala fisi* (*Tetracera boiviniana*), ambao piya una makodza ganayokaraza dza msasa, kpwa hivyo dzina rinaonekana kuhusu kodza kuriko aina mwenga ya mmea. Chingereza: *sandpaper saucer-berry*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.sw: Cordia nyingine, mti wa msituni
reason.dg: *Mpamapama*, *Cordia* wanjina, muhi wa tsaka

reason.dg: *Mkala fisi*, unaoshiriki dzina *mzondohera nguluwe* kpwa sababu ya makodzage ganayokaraza

reason.dg: *Msasa*, mmea wanjina wenye makodza ganayokaraza

teaser.en: Its Digo name means simply 'bitter', and for generations its sap tipped the arrows of coastal hunters.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'uchungu' tu, na kwa vizazi vingi utomvu wake ulipakwa kwenye ncha za mishale ya wawindaji wa pwani.
teaser.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ra mmea uhu rina mana ya 'utsungu' bahi, na kula kare maziyage gakala nkupakpwa ntsa za mivwi ya akala a pwani.

summary.en: *Utsungu* is the arrow-poison tree, an evergreen shrub with fragrant flowers and deadly sap. It was a source of arrow poison and of straight wood for spear shafts.
summary.sw: *Utsungu* ni mti uitwao kwa Kiingereza *arrow-poison tree*, kichaka kisichopukutika majani chenye maua yenye harufu nzuri na utomvu wa sumu kali ya kuua. Ulikuwa chanzo cha sumu ya mishale na cha mbao zilizonyooka za kutengenezea mipini ya mikuki.
summary.dg: *Utsungu* (kpwa Chingereza *arrow-poison tree*) ni chitsaka chenye makodza chila wakati, chenye maruwa genye arufu nono na maziya ga sumu ya kuolaga. Wakala ni chitsaka cha sumu ya mivwi, na makologe ganayogoloka gahumirwa kuhenda miphini ya mafumo.

about.en:
*Utsungu* is an evergreen shrub or small tree with stiff, glossy, leathery leaves that look almost polished. The flowers are white to pink, tubular and sweetly scented, borne in dense clusters along the stems. They are followed by plum-like berries that ripen purple-black.

It looks like an attractive garden shrub, which is part of the danger: the whole plant is highly poisonous.
about.sw:
*Utsungu* ni kichaka au mti mdogo usiopukutika majani, wenye majani magumu, yanayong'aa na kama ngozi, yanayoonekana karibu kama yamesuguliwa. Maua ni meupe hadi ya waridi, yenye umbo la mrija na harufu tamu, yakiwa yamesongamana kwa vishada kando ya mashina. Baada yake huja matunda kama plamu yanayoiva kuwa zambarau iliyokolea karibu nyeusi.

Unaonekana kama kichaka cha kupendeza cha bustanini, na hiyo ni sehemu ya hatari yake: mmea mzima una sumu kali.
about.dg:
*Utsungu* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, magumu, ganayong'ala na maziho dza chingo, ganayoonekana dza gakasingwa. Maruwa ni mereru hadi ga pinki, ga umbo ra mridza na genye arufu nono, ganayomera mafungu manji kanda-kanda ya makolo. Bada yago kunamera matunda dza *plum* ganayoivwa na kukala maru dza zambarau.

Unaonekana dza chitsaka chinono cha busitani, na ichi ni seemu ya hatariye: mmea wosi una sumu kali sana.

where.en: *Utsungu* grows in rocky bushland, on dry, stony ground in the coastal hinterland. The scented flowers make it easier to notice when it is blooming.
where.sw: *Utsungu* hukua katika nyika ya vichaka yenye mawe, kwenye ardhi kavu ya mawe katika maeneo ya bara ya pwani. Maua yake yenye harufu hurahisisha kuuona unapochanua.
where.dg: *Utsungu* unamera weruni wenye mawe, kpwenye tsi kavu ya mawe ya bara phephi na pwani. Maruwage genye arufu nono ganahenda ukale rahisi kuuona wakati unatuluza maruwa.

uses.en:
*Utsungu* was a source of arrow poison. The plant is rich in cardiac glycosides, compounds that act on the heart, which made poisoned arrows effective for hunting. Its straight stems were also used for spear shafts.

Today hunting with poisoned arrows is rare, but the knowledge of *utsungu* as a poison plant remains.
uses.sw:
*Utsungu* ulikuwa chanzo cha sumu ya mishale. Mmea huu una kiasi kikubwa cha glikosidi za moyo (*cardiac glycosides*), kemikali zinazoathiri moyo, jambo lililoifanya mishale iliyotiwa sumu kufaa katika uwindaji. Mashina yake yaliyonyooka pia yalitumika kutengeneza mipini ya mikuki.

Leo uwindaji kwa mishale yenye sumu ni nadra, lakini maarifa kuhusu *utsungu* kama mmea wa sumu bado yapo.
uses.dg:
*Utsungu* wakala ni chitsaka cha sumu ya mivwi. Mmea una kemikali nyinji za aina ya *cardiac glycosides*, zinazohenda kazi kpwenye moyo, na ndizo zinazohenda mivwi ya sumu iolage nyama a kuindzwa. Makologe ganayogoloka piya gahumirwa kuhenda miphini ya mafumo.

Rero kuindza kpwa mivwi ya sumu ni adimu, ela atu bado anamanya kukala *utsungu* ni mmea wa sumu.

culture.en: The name *utsungu* means 'bitter', and its extract is both bitter and poisonous. The name is a warning built into the language.
culture.sw: Jina *utsungu* lina maana ya 'uchungu', na dondoo lake ni chungu na lina sumu pia. Jina hili ni onyo lililojengwa ndani ya lugha.
culture.dg: Dzina *utsungu* rina mana ya 'utsungu', na madzi ganayolavywa kula kpwakpwe ni ga utsungu na ga sumu. Dzina hiri ni onyo ririrodzengbwa ndani ya luga.

names.en: Digo: *utsungu*, 'bitter'. Giriama: *utungu*. English: arrow-poison tree. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Acokanthera schimperi*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *utsungu*, 'uchungu'. Kigiriama: *utungu*. Kiingereza: *arrow-poison tree*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Acokanthera schimperi*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *utsungu*, 'utsungu'. Chigiriama: *utungu*. Chingereza: *arrow-poison tree*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Asayansi anauiha *Acokanthera schimperi*.

reason.dg: *Mzigande*, chitsaka chanjina cha sumu cha jamii ya *dogbane*

definition.sw: Utomvu wenye sumu kali ya kuua, unaotumika kama sumu ya mishale. Mti huu uliletwa pwani na Wagiriama hivi karibuni kiasi.
definition.dg: Maziya ga sumu kali ya kuolaga, ganayohumirwa dza sumu ya mivwi. Muhi uhu ukarehwa pwani dzuzi-dzuzi ni Agiriama.

teaser.en: One Digo name compares it to coiled intestines, the other to a cat's ear, and both are spot on.
teaser.sw: Jina moja la Kidigo linaufananisha na utumbo uliojikunja, na lingine na sikio la paka, na yote mawili yanapatia barabara.
teaser.dg: Dzina rimwenga ra Chidigo rinachilinganisha na uhumbo uriodzizunguluka, na ranjina na sikiro ra mnyau, na gosi mairi ni ga kpweli kabisa.

summary.en: *Chihumbohumbo* is a slender twining climber with soft, round, velvety leaves, common on forest edges. Its root bark is boiled as a remedy for malaria.
summary.sw: *Chihumbohumbo* ni mtambaa mwembamba unaojizungusha, wenye majani laini ya mviringo kama mahameli, unaopatikana kwa wingi pembezoni mwa misitu. Gamba la mizizi yake huchemshwa kama dawa ya malaria.
summary.dg: *Chihumbohumbo* ni mmea mwembamba unaofyombera na kulinga-linga, wenye makodza laini ga mviringo ga dza *velvet*, unaophahikana sana kanda-kanda ya matsaka. Gopha ra miziye nkuchemuswa kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria).

about.en:
*Chihumbohumbo* is a thin, wiry climber that twists around grass stems and shrubs. Its leaves are the giveaway: round or heart-shaped, soft and velvety, with the leaf stalk joined to the blade a little in from the edge, so the leaf looks like a small shield.

The flowers are tiny and greenish, and male and female flowers grow on separate plants. Small red berries follow on female plants.
about.sw:
*Chihumbohumbo* ni mtambaa mwembamba kama waya unaojizungusha kwenye mashina ya nyasi na vichaka. Majani yake ndiyo yanayoutambulisha: ya mviringo au yenye umbo la moyo, laini kama mahameli, na kikonyo cha jani kimeungana na bapa la jani kidogo ndani kutoka ukingoni, kiasi kwamba jani linaonekana kama ngao ndogo.

Maua ni madogo sana na ya rangi ya kijani hafifu, na maua ya kiume na ya kike hukua kwenye mimea tofauti. Matunda madogo mekundu hufuata kwenye mimea ya kike.
about.dg:
*Chihumbohumbo* ni mmea mwembamba unaofyombera, wenye makolo membamba na magumu dza waya, unaolinga-linga makolo ga nyasi na vitsaka. Makodzage ndigo alamaye: ni ga mviringo au ga umbo ra moyo, laini dza *velvet*, na mlita wa kodza unagbwirana na kodza phatu chidide ndani kula kanda, kpwa hivyo kodza rinaonekana dza ngao ndide.

Maruwa ni madide sana na ga rangi ya chijani, na maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwenye mimea tafwauti. Matunda madide ga kundu ganamera bada yago kpwenye mimea ya chichetu.

where.en: Look along forest edges, in bush and in overgrown field margins, where *chihumbohumbo* threads through other vegetation. It is common and easy to miss until you notice the soft round leaves.
where.sw: Tafuta pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani na kwenye kingo za mashamba zilizomea, ambako *chihumbohumbo* hupenya katikati ya mimea mingine. Ni wa kawaida, na ni rahisi kutouona hadi utakapoyaona majani yake laini ya mviringo.
where.dg: Chihendze kanda-kanda ya matsaka, weruni na kanda-kanda ya minda iriyomera vitsaka, ambapho *chihumbohumbo* chinatsupa kahi ya mimea yanjina. Chinaphahikana sana, na ni rahisi kutsupa bila kuchiona hadi uone makodza laini ga mviringo.

uses.en: The root bark of *Cissampelos* is boiled as a remedy for malaria by Digo healers. The record comes from a closely related species, *C. mucronata*, and *chihumbohumbo* belongs to the same small group of climbers.
uses.sw: Gamba la mizizi ya *Cissampelos* huchemshwa na waganga wa Kidigo kama dawa ya malaria. Rekodi hii inatokana na spishi ya karibu sana, *C. mucronata*, na *chihumbohumbo* ni wa kundi lile lile dogo la mitambaa.
uses.dg: Gopha ra mizi ya *Cissampelos* nkuchemuswa ni aganga a Chidigo kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria). Habari hizi zinalavywa kula aina ya phephi sana, *C. mucronata*, na *chihumbohumbo* ni cha kundi dide ra mimea inayofyombera ra jenasi iyo iyo.

culture.en: Both of its names are pictures. *Chihumbohumbo* means 'intestine', after the way its stems twist and coil. *Chisikio paka*, 'cat's ear', describes the soft, rounded leaf.
culture.sw: Majina yake yote mawili ni picha. *Chihumbohumbo* lina maana ya 'utumbo', kutokana na jinsi mashina yake yanavyojisokota na kujikunja. *Chisikio paka*, 'sikio la paka', linaeleza jani lake laini la mviringo.
culture.dg: Madzinage mairi gosi ni picha. *Chihumbohumbo* rina mana ya 'uhumbo', kpwa sababu ya vira makologe ganavyodzizunguluka na kulinga-linga. *Chisikio paka*, 'sikiro ra mnyau', rinaonyesa kodza laini ra mviringo.

names.en: Digo: *chihumbohumbo* ('intestine') and *chisikio paka* ('cat's ear'). The second is probably a loan from Swahili. English: velvet-leaf. Scientists call it *Cissampelos pareira*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *chihumbohumbo* ('utumbo') na *chisikio paka* ('sikio la paka'). Jina la pili huenda limetoholewa kutoka Kiswahili. Kiingereza: *velvet-leaf*. Wanasayansi huuita *Cissampelos pareira*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *chihumbohumbo* ('uhumbo') na *chisikio paka* ('sikiro ra mnyau'). Dzina ra phiri chahi ra kuhalwa kula Chiswahili. Chingereza: *velvet-leaf*. Asayansi anachiiha *Cissampelos pareira*.

teaser.en: Its name promises that whoever takes it will 'never fall sick' again.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linaahidi kwamba yeyote atakayeutumia 'hataugua kamwe' tena.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinalaga kukala yeyesi anayeuhumira 'kalumwa' tsona.

summary.en: *Kalumwa* is a forest climber with large lobed leaves and thick yellow roots, the calumba root of old pharmacy books. To the Digo it is a medicine for many ailments.
summary.sw: *Kalumwa* ni mtambaa wa msituni wenye majani makubwa yenye mapande na mizizi minene ya manjano, ile mizizi ya *calumba* inayotajwa katika vitabu vya zamani vya famasia. Kwa Wadigo ni dawa ya maradhi mengi.
summary.dg: *Kalumwa* ni mmea wa tsaka unaofyombera, wenye makodza makulu genye mala na mizi maziho ga rangi ya mandano, ambao ni *calumba root* ya vitabu vya kare vya dawa. Kpwa Adigo ni dawa ya makongo manji.

about.en:
*Kalumwa* is a climber with large leaves cut into several deep lobes, like an open hand. Below ground it forms clusters of thick, fleshy, tuberous roots that are bright yellow inside and intensely bitter.

Male and female flowers grow on separate plants, in long hanging sprays of small greenish flowers.
about.sw:
*Kalumwa* ni mtambaa wenye majani makubwa yaliyokatika kuwa mapande kadhaa marefu, kama kiganja kilicho wazi. Chini ya ardhi huunda mafungu ya mizizi minene yenye nyama, kama viazi, iliyo ya manjano angavu ndani na chungu mno.

Maua ya kiume na ya kike hukua kwenye mimea tofauti, katika mashada marefu yanayoning'inia ya maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani hafifu.
about.dg:
*Kalumwa* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye makodza makulu ganayokatika mala manji mare, dza mkpwono uriovugulika. Tsini ya ulongo unahenda mafungu ga mizi miziho, ya nyama nyinji, dza viazi, ambayo ndani ni ya rangi ya mandano inayong'ala na ina utsungu sana.

Maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwenye mimea tafwauti, kpwenye mafungu mare ganayogbwadzika ga maruwa madide ga rangi ya chijani.

where.en: *Kalumwa* grows in coastal forest, climbing into the trees from the forest floor. Its big lobed leaves stand out among the smaller-leaved vines.
where.sw: *Kalumwa* hukua katika msitu wa pwani, ukipanda juu ya miti kutoka sakafu ya msitu. Majani yake makubwa yenye mapande hujitokeza wazi miongoni mwa mitambaa yenye majani madogo.
where.dg: *Kalumwa* unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, unafyombera mihini kula photsi ya tsaka. Makodzage makulu genye mala ganaonekana sana kahi ya mimea yanjina inayofyombera yenye makodza madide.

uses.en:
*Kalumwa* is used as a medicine for many ailments. The yellow roots are the part valued, and they are strongly bitter.

The same root, under the name calumba, was long exported from East Africa and used as a bitter tonic in Europe and India.
uses.sw:
*Kalumwa* hutumika kama dawa ya maradhi mengi. Mizizi ya manjano ndiyo sehemu inayothaminiwa, na ni chungu sana.

Mizizi hiyo hiyo, kwa jina *calumba*, iliuzwa nje kutoka Afrika Mashariki kwa muda mrefu na kutumika kama dawa chungu ya kuongeza nguvu huko Ulaya na India.
uses.dg:
*Kalumwa* nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya makongo manji. Mizi ya rangi ya mandano ndiyo seemu inayotogolwa, na ina utsungu sana.

Mizi iyo iyo, kpwa dzina ra *calumba*, kpwa muda mure yakala inaguzwa kondze ya Afrika ya Mashariki, na Ulaya na India yakala inahumirwa dza dawa ya utsungu ya kuenjereza nguvu.

culture.en: The name *kalumwa* means 'never fall sick'. It is said to be so effective that whoever uses it never falls ill again, a strong statement of the trust placed in this plant.
culture.sw: Jina *kalumwa* lina maana ya 'hataugua kamwe'. Inasemekana kuwa ni dawa yenye nguvu kiasi kwamba yeyote anayeitumia haugui tena, kauli nzito inayoonyesha imani waliyonayo watu kwa mmea huu.
culture.dg: Dzina *kalumwa* rina mana ya 'kalumwa tsona'. Nkugombwa kukala ni dawa yenye nguvu sana hata yeyesi anayeihumira kalumwa tsona, na ihi inaonyesa vira atu anavyouluphira mmea uhu.

names.en: Digo: *kalumwa*, a name shared with Swahili. English: calumba. Scientists call it *Jateorhiza palmata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *kalumwa*, jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiswahili. Kiingereza: *calumba*. Wanasayansi huuita *Jateorhiza palmata*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *kalumwa*, dzina ambaro piya ni ra Chiswahili. Chingereza: *calumba*. Asayansi anauiha *Jateorhiza palmata*.

teaser.en: Its hard grey seeds are cast to 'foretell' what lies ahead, for one person or a whole community.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake ngumu za kijivu hutupwa ili 'kutabiri' yaliyo mbele, kwa mtu mmoja au kwa jamii nzima.
teaser.dg: Tembeze ngumu za rangi ya ivu nkutsuphwa ili 'kutabiri' gadzago, kpwa mutu mmwenga au kpwa atu osi a mudzi.

summary.en: *Mburuga* is a prickly scrambling shrub whose spiny pods hold hard grey seeds like marbles. Its name means 'foretell', and the fruits are used in divination.
summary.sw: *Mburuga* (kwa Kiingereza *grey nicker*) ni kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa, ambacho maganda yake yenye miiba hubeba mbegu ngumu za kijivu kama gololi. Jina lake lina maana ya 'tabiri', na matunda yake hutumika katika uaguzi.
summary.dg: *Mburuga* ni chitsaka chinachoambala chenye miya, ambacho makakayage genye miya ganakala na tembe ngumu za rangi ya ivu dza magololi. Dzinare rina mana ya 'kutabiri', na matundage nkuhumirwa kpwa mlamulo.

about.en:
*Mburuga* is a scrambling, sprawling shrub armed with hooked prickles on its stems and leaves. The leaves are large and twice divided into many oval leaflets. Spikes of small yellow flowers are followed by flat pods covered in stiff spines.

Inside each pod are one or two hard seeds, smooth, grey and round like marbles. The seeds are so hard and buoyant that they can drift on ocean currents and wash up on beaches far away.
about.sw:
*Mburuga* ni kichaka kinachotambaa na kutanda, chenye miiba iliyopinda kama kulabu kwenye mashina na majani. Majani ni makubwa na yamegawanyika mara mbili kuwa vijani vingi vya umbo la yai. Mashada ya maua madogo ya manjano hufuatwa na maganda bapa yaliyofunikwa na miiba migumu.

Ndani ya kila ganda kuna mbegu moja au mbili ngumu, laini, za kijivu na za mviringo kama gololi. Mbegu hizi ni ngumu na huelea vizuri kiasi kwamba zinaweza kuchukuliwa na mikondo ya bahari na kutupwa kwenye fukwe za mbali.
about.dg:
*Mburuga* ni chitsaka chinachoambala na kutawanyika, chenye miya ya kupindika kpwenye makolo na makodza. Makodza ni makulu, na ganaganywa mara mbiri kukala makodza madide manji ga mviringo. Bada ya mafungu mare ga maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano kunamera makakaya mabapa ganayofwinikpwa ni miya migumu.

Ndani ya chila kakaya kuna tembe mwenga au mbiri, ngumu, laini, za rangi ya ivu na za mviringo dza magololi. Tembe hizi ni ngumu sana na zinaelea, hata zinaweza kuelea baharini na kutsukulwa ni madzi hadi pwani za kure.

where.en: *Mburuga* grows in coastal thicket and on forest edges, often forming prickly tangles. Near the shore it scrambles over other bushes. The spiny pods are easiest to spot once they ripen and turn brown.
where.sw: *Mburuga* hukua katika vichaka vizito vya pwani na pembezoni mwa misitu, mara nyingi ukiunda vichaka vilivyosokotana vyenye miiba. Karibu na ufukwe hutambaa juu ya vichaka vingine. Maganda yenye miiba ni rahisi zaidi kuyaona yanapoiva na kugeuka rangi ya hudhurungi.
where.dg: *Mburuga* unamera kahi ya vitsaka vya pwani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, mara nyinji uchihenda mafungu ga miya ganayotsanganyika. Phephi na pwani unaambala dzulu ya vitsaka vyanjina. Makakaya genye miya ni rahisi kugaona ganaphoivwa na kukala ga rangi ya dongo.

uses.en: The seeds of *mburuga* are used in divination. The grey seeds of related *Caesalpinia* are also used as counters in *bao*, the board game played across the coast.
uses.sw: Mbegu za *mburuga* hutumika katika uaguzi. Mbegu za kijivu za *Caesalpinia* jamaa pia hutumika kama kete katika *bao*, mchezo wa ubao unaochezwa kote pwani.
uses.dg: Tembe za *mburuga* nkuhumirwa kpwa mlamulo. Tembe za rangi ya ivu za *Caesalpinia* za phephi piya nkuhumirwa dza tembe za kucheza *bao*, mchezo wa ubao unaochezwa pwani yosi.

culture.en: *Mburuga* means 'foretell'. Its fruits are used to predict events, both for individuals and for whole communities. A seed that is hard to break and travels across the sea is a fitting tool for looking ahead.
culture.sw: *Mburuga* lina maana ya 'tabiri'. Matunda yake hutumika kutabiri matukio, kwa watu binafsi na kwa jamii nzima. Mbegu ambayo ni vigumu kuivunja na inayosafiri kuvuka bahari ni chombo kinachofaa kwa kuangalia yajayo.
culture.dg: *Mburuga* rina mana ya 'kutabiri'. Matundage nkuhumirwa kutabiri gadzago, kpwa mutu mmwenga na kpwa atu osi a mudzi. Tembe isiyovundzika rahisi na inayovuka bahari ni chombo chinachofwaha kulola gadzago.

names.en: Digo: *mburuga*, also *mbate* and *mtera*. Swahili: *mburuga*. The name *mburuga* is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. English: grey nicker or bonduc. Scientists call it *Caesalpinia bonduc*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mburuga*, pia *mbate* na *mtera*. Kiswahili: *mburuga*. Jina *mburuga* linatumika katika Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kiingereza: *grey nicker* au *bonduc*. Wanasayansi huuita *Caesalpinia bonduc*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *mburuga*, piya *mbate* na *mtera*. Chiswahili: *mburuga*. Dzina *mburuga* ni ra Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili piya. Chingereza: *grey nicker* au *bonduc*. Asayansi anauiha *Caesalpinia bonduc*.

reason.en: Another climbing legume with striking seeds

teaser.en: The Digo call this spiny climber 'golden', and one look at its yellow stems shows why.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huuita mtambaa huu wenye miiba 'wa dhahabu', na ukitazama mashina yake ya manjano utaona sababu.
teaser.dg: Adigo anachiiha chitsaka hichi chinachofyombera chenye miya 'cha zahabu', na uchilola makologe ga rangi ya mandano unamanya sababu.

summary.en: *Mdhahabu* is a spiny scrambling shrub of the coastal forest and thicket, named for its golden-yellow stems. It is a wild relative of the figs.
summary.sw: *Mdhahabu* ni kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa cha msitu wa pwani na vichaka vizito, kilichopewa jina kutokana na mashina yake ya rangi ya manjano ya dhahabu. Ni jamaa wa porini wa mitini.
summary.dg: *Mdhahabu* ni chitsaka chinachoambala chenye miya, cha matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani, chinachoihwa kpwa makologe ga rangi ya mandano dza zahabu. Ni ndugu wa weruni wa mikuyu.

about.en:
*Mdhahabu* is a scrambling shrub that leans and climbs through other vegetation, armed with sharp spines. Its most striking feature is the colour of its stems, a clear golden yellow that gives it its name.

It belongs to the fig and mulberry family, and like its relatives it has milky sap.
about.sw:
*Mdhahabu* ni kichaka kinachotambaa ambacho huegemea na kupanda katikati ya mimea mingine, kikiwa na miiba mikali. Sifa yake inayovutia zaidi ni rangi ya mashina yake, manjano ya dhahabu iliyo wazi, inayokipa jina lake.

Ni wa familia ya mitini na mforsadi, na kama jamaa zake kina utomvu kama maziwa.
about.dg:
*Mdhahabu* ni chitsaka chinachoambala, chinachojejemera na kufyombera kahi ya mimea yanjina, chenye miya mikali. Chitu chinachoonekana zaidi ni rangi ya makologe, rangi ya mandano ya wazi dza zahabu, ambayo ndiyo inayochipha dzinare.

Ni cha jamii ya mkuyu na *mulberry*, na dza nduguze, china maziya mereru.

where.en: Look for *mdhahabu* in coastal forest and thicket, where it scrambles through the undergrowth. The yellow stems are easiest to see where the plant has been cut or the bark scraped.
where.sw: Mtafute *mdhahabu* katika msitu wa pwani na vichaka vizito, ambako hutambaa katikati ya mimea ya chini. Mashina ya manjano ni rahisi zaidi kuonekana mahali ambapo mmea umekatwa au gamba limekwanguliwa.
where.dg: Hendza *mdhahabu* kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani, ambapho chinaambala kahi ya vitsaka. Makolo ga rangi ya mandano ni rahisi kuona phatu mmea urihokatwa au gophare ririphokpwangulwa.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna kazi hasa ya Chidigo iriyoandikpwa.

names.en: Digo: *mdhahabu*, meaning 'golden', for its yellow stem. It shares its root with the Swahili word *dhahabu*, gold. No English or Swahili plant name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Maclura africana*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdhahabu*, lenye maana ya 'wa dhahabu', kutokana na shina lake la manjano. Lina mzizi mmoja na neno la Kiswahili *dhahabu*. Hakuna jina la mmea la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi hukiita *Maclura africana*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *mdhahabu*, rina mana ya 'cha zahabu', kpwa sababu ya kolore ra rangi ya mandano. Rina shina mwenga na neno ra Chiswahili *dhahabu*, 'zahabu'. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ra mmea uhu ririroandikpwa. Asayansi anauiha *Maclura africana*.

teaser.en: Its Digo name means 'hyena's residence', a dense tangle of the coastal thicket.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'makazi ya fisi', kichaka kilichosokotana cha vichaka vizito vya pwani.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rina mana ya 'makalo ga fisi'; ni chitsaka chiziho chirichodzilinga-linga kahi ya vitsaka vya pwani.

summary.en: *Mkala fisi* is a scrambling shrub of the coastal thicket with rough, sandpapery leaves. Its name, 'hyena's residence', is shared with Duruma and Swahili.
summary.sw: *Mkala fisi* ni kichaka kinachotambaa cha vichaka vizito vya pwani chenye majani yenye ukwaru kama msasa. Jina lake, 'makazi ya fisi', linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili.
summary.dg: *Mkala fisi* ni chitsaka chinachofyombera cha vitsaka vya pwani, chenye makodza ganayokaraza dza msasa. Dzinare, 'makalo ga fisi', nkuhumirwa piya ni Aduruma na Aswahili.

about.en: *Mkala fisi* is a scrambling shrub that climbs and sprawls through other bushes. Its leaves are rough to the touch, like sandpaper, a trait it shares with several unrelated coastal plants.
about.sw: *Mkala fisi* ni kichaka kinachotambaa ambacho hupanda na kutanda juu ya vichaka vingine. Majani yake yana ukwaru yakiguswa, kama msasa, sifa kinayoshiriki na mimea kadhaa ya pwani isiyo na uhusiano nacho.
about.dg: *Mkala fisi* ni chitsaka chinachofyombera dzulu ya vitsaka vyanjina na kuenea kahi yao. Makodzage ganakaraza uchigaguta, dza msasa, na tabiya hiyo inaphahikana piya kpwa mimea minji ya pwani isiyo ya jamii mwenga nao.

where.en: *Mkala fisi* grows in coastal thicket, the dense tangle of shrubs and climbers that covers much of the coral rag and sandy ground behind the coast.
where.sw: *Mkala fisi* hukua katika vichaka vizito vya pwani, mkusanyiko mzito uliosokotana wa vichaka na mitambaa unaofunika sehemu kubwa ya ardhi ya mawe ya matumbawe na ya mchanga nyuma ya pwani.
where.dg: *Mkala fisi* unamera kahi ya vitsaka vya pwani, phatu ambapho vitsaka na mimea inayofyombera inamera phephi-phephi na kudzilinga-linga, na kubwiningiza tsi nyinji ya sanoo na ya mtsanga nyuma ya pwani.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu.

culture.en: The name *mkala fisi* means 'hyena's residence'.
culture.sw: Jina *mkala fisi* lina maana ya 'makazi ya fisi'.
culture.dg: Dzina *mkala fisi* rina mana ya 'makalo ga fisi'.

names.en: Digo: *mkala fisi*, a name shared with Duruma and Swahili. It is also called *mzondohera nguluwe*, 'wiper of the pig's buttocks', a name more often given to the sandpaper saucer-berry (*Cordia monoica*). Both plants have rough leaves. No English name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Tetracera boiviniana*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mkala fisi*, jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. Pia huitwa *mzondohera nguluwe*, 'mpanguzaji wa makalio ya nguruwe', jina ambalo mara nyingi zaidi hupewa *sandpaper saucer-berry* (*Cordia monoica*). Mimea yote miwili ina majani yenye ukwaru. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi hukiita *Tetracera boiviniana*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mkala fisi*, dzina ambaro Aduruma na Aswahili nao anarihumira. Piya unaihwa *mzondohera nguluwe*, 'chitu cha kuphakusira mahako ga nguluwe', dzina ambaro mara nyinji nkuhewa *Cordia monoica* (kpwa Chingereza *sandpaper saucer-berry*). Mimea yosi miiri ina makodza ganayokaraza. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Tetracera boiviniana*.

reason.en: Shares the name mzondohera nguluwe for its rough leaves
reason.sw: Unashiriki jina *mzondohera nguluwe* kwa sababu ya majani yake yenye ukwaru
reason.dg: Nao unaihwa mzondohera nguluwe kpwa sababu ya makodzage ganayokaraza

teaser.en: When this climber flowers, whole bushes seem to catch fire, and Digo naming linked it to its tree cousin long before botanists did.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa huu unapochanua, vichaka vizima huonekana kama vinawaka moto, na majina ya Kidigo yaliuhusisha na binamu yake wa mti muda mrefu kabla wataalamu wa mimea hawajafanya hivyo.
teaser.dg: Mmea hinyu unaofyombera uchilavya maruwa, vitsaka vizima vinaonekana dza vinatsoma moho; na Adigo, kpwa dzina ambaro akaupha, akauunganisha na muhi nduguye kare sana kabla ya asayansi a mimea.

summary.en: *Mkongolo wa kundu* is a scrambling climber with blazing red flower clusters and four-winged pink fruits. Its Digo name ties it to the tree *mkongolo*, a link that botany confirms, since both are *Combretum*.
summary.sw: *Mkongolo wa kundu* ni mtambaa unaotanda wenye vishada vya maua mekundu yanayowaka na matunda ya waridi yenye mabawa manne. Jina lake la Kidigo linauhusisha na mti *mkongolo*, uhusiano unaothibitishwa na sayansi ya mimea, kwa kuwa wote wawili ni *Combretum*.
summary.dg: *Mkongolo wa kundu* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye mafungu ga maruwa ga kundu ganayong'ala dza moho, na matunda ga pinki genye mapha manne. Dzinare ra Chidigo rinauunganisha na muhi *mkongolo*, na sayansi ya mimea inakubali uhusiano uhu, kpwa sababu yosi miiri ni *Combretum*.

about.en:
*Mkongolo wa kundu* is a woody scrambler that climbs over shrubs and into small trees. In flower it is unmistakable: dense clusters of brilliant scarlet flowers with long red stamens cover the branches, often when the plant has few leaves, so the colour stands out across the bush. The flowers are rich in nectar and attract sunbirds.

The fruits that follow are papery and four-winged, flushed pink, like those of other *Combretum*. The leaves are broad, simple and opposite.
about.sw:
*Mkongolo wa kundu* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu la kimti ambao hupanda juu ya vichaka na kuingia kwenye miti midogo. Unapochanua hauwezi kukosewa: vishada vizito vya maua mekundu angavu yenye stameni ndefu nyekundu hufunika matawi, mara nyingi wakati mmea una majani machache, kwa hiyo rangi hiyo huonekana wazi kote vichakani. Maua yana asali ya maua tele na huvutia chozi.

Matunda yanayofuata ni kama karatasi, yenye mabawa manne na rangi ya waridi, kama yale ya *Combretum* nyingine. Majani ni mapana, sahili na yanakaa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana.
about.dg:
*Mkongolo wa kundu* ni mmea wa nyama za muhi unaofyombera dzulu ya vitsaka na hadi kpwenye mihi midide. Uchikala na maruwa unamanyikana mara mwenga: mafungu maziho ga maruwa ga kundu ganayong'ala sana, genye stameni mare za kundu, ganabwiningiza panda, mara nyinji wakati mmea una makodza machache, kpwa hivyo rangi inaonekana weruni kosi. Maruwa gana madzi ga mtswano manji na ganamweha vitsozi.

Matunda ganayolunga ni makavu dza karatasi, genye mapha manne, na ga pinki, dza ga *Combretum* yanjina. Makodza ni mapana, chila kodza ni zima (tarina makodza madide), na ganamera mairi-mairi ganayolengana.

where.en: Look along forest edges and in riverine thicket, where it climbs over the surrounding vegetation. It is easiest to find in flower, when the red clusters can be seen from far off.
where.sw: Tafuta pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka vizito vya kando ya mito, ambako hupanda juu ya mimea inayouzunguka. Ni rahisi zaidi kuupata unapochanua, wakati vishada vyekundu vinaweza kuonekana kutoka mbali.
where.dg: Hendza kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye vitsaka vya kanda-kanda ya miho, phatu unaphofyombera dzulu ya mimea iriyouzunguluka. Ni rahisi kuuona uchikala na maruwa, mafungu ga kundu ganaphoonekana kula kure.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu.

culture.en: The name *mkongolo wa kundu* means 'red *mkongolo*'. It links the climber to the tree *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*) through their similar flowers. Western botany places both in the same genus, *Combretum*, so this is a neat case where Digo plant naming and scientific classification agree.
culture.sw: Jina *mkongolo wa kundu* lina maana ya '*mkongolo* mwekundu'. Linauhusisha mtambaa huu na mti *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*) kupitia maua yao yanayofanana. Sayansi ya mimea ya Kimagharibi inawaweka wote wawili katika jenasi moja, *Combretum*, kwa hiyo huu ni mfano mzuri ambapo upaji majina wa mimea wa Kidigo na uainishaji wa kisayansi vinakubaliana.
culture.dg: Dzina *mkongolo wa kundu* rina mana ya '*mkongolo* wa rangi ya kundu'. Rinauunganisha mmea hinyu unaofyombera na muhi *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*) kpwa sababu maruwage ganahalana. Sayansi ya mimea ya Azungu inaika mimea yosi miiri kpwenye jenasi mwenga, *Combretum*; kpwa hivyo hinyu ni mfwano mnono wa madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo kukubaliana na mpango wa chisayansi.

names.en: Digo: *mkongolo wa kundu*, 'red *mkongolo*'. English: burning bush. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Combretum paniculatum*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mkongolo wa kundu*, '*mkongolo* mwekundu'. Kiingereza: *burning bush*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Combretum paniculatum*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mkongolo wa kundu*, ambaro manage ni '*mkongolo* wa rangi ya kundu'. Kpwa Chingereza ni *burning bush*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Combretum paniculatum*.

reason.dg: Muhi ambao mmea hinyu ukaihwa kpwa dzinare, nao ni Combretum

reason.dg: Ndugu wa jamii ya Combretum

reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaofyombera kanda-kanda ya matsaka, wenye maruwa ga kundu ganayong'ala

reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaofyombera kanda-kanda ya matsaka phapho phapho
