teaser.en: Long before cotton was planted on the coast, this wild liana was already releasing tufts of white fluff from its fruits.
teaser.sw: Muda mrefu kabla pamba haijaanza kupandwa pwani, mtambaa huu wa porini ulikuwa tayari ukitoa vishada vya manyoya meupe kutoka kwenye matunda yake.
teaser.dg: Kare sana kabla ya pamba kuphandwa pwani, mmea hinyu wa tsaka unaofyombera kala tayari unalavya vidzundzu vyereru dza pamba kula kpwa matundage.

summary.en: *Mngagamwe* is a woody liana whose fruits split to release woolly, cotton-like seeds. It is a wild relative of cultivated cotton, which is why it is also called 'wild cotton'.
summary.sw: *Mngagamwe* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu ambao matunda yake hupasuka na kutoa mbegu zenye manyoya kama pamba. Ni ndugu wa porini wa pamba inayopandwa, na ndiyo sababu pia huitwa 'pamba mwitu'.
summary.dg: *Mngagamwe* ni mmea wa nyama za muhi unaofyombera, ambao matundage ganaahuka kulavya tembe zenye nyuzi laini dza pamba. Ni ndugu wa tsaka wa pamba inayophandwa, na ndiyo mana unaihwa piya 'pamba ya weruni'.

about.en:
*Mngagamwe* is a woody scrambler or liana that climbs through bush and forest. Its fruits are rounded capsules that split open when ripe to release seeds wrapped in woolly fibres, very like a cotton boll.

It belongs to the mallow family, the same family as cultivated cotton and hibiscus, and its flowers have the open, five-petalled form typical of the family.
about.sw:
*Mngagamwe* ni kichaka kitambaacho au mtambaa wenye shina gumu unaopanda katikati ya vichaka na msitu. Matunda yake ni vifuko vya mviringo vinavyopasuka vikiiva na kutoa mbegu zilizofunikwa kwa nyuzi za manyoya, kama kitumba cha pamba hasa.

Ni wa familia ya mibamia, familia moja na pamba inayopandwa na hibiskasi, na maua yake yana umbo lililo wazi lenye petali tano, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia hiyo.
about.dg:
*Mngagamwe* ni mmea wa nyama za muhi unaofyombera kahi ya weruni na matsaka. Matundage ni makakaya ga mviringo ganayoahuka gachiivwa, na kulavya tembe zenye nyuzi laini dza pamba, sawa-sawa na kakaya ra pamba.

Ni wa jamii ya *mallow*, jamii ambayo piya ina pamba inayophandwa na *hibiscus*, na maruwage ganavuguka na gana vipande tsano, dza maruwa ga jamii hiyo.

where.en: *Mngagamwe* grows in bushland, mixed coastal forest and *Brachystegia* woodland. The open fruits, with their tufts of white fluff, are the easiest way to spot it.
where.sw: *Mngagamwe* hukua vichakani, katika misitu mchanganyiko ya pwani na katika mapori ya *Brachystegia*. Matunda yaliyopasuka, yenye vishada vya manyoya meupe, ndiyo njia rahisi zaidi ya kuutambua.
where.dg: *Mngagamwe* unamera weruni, kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ga mihi ya aina tafwauti-tafwauti, na kpwenye matsaka ga *Brachystegia*. Matunda ganayovuguka, genye vidzundzu vyereru, ndigo ganayohenda uonekane rahisi.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu.

names.en: Digo: *mngagamwe*, also *pamba mwitu*, 'wild cotton', for its cotton-like fruit. *Pamba mwitu* is probably a loan from Swahili, where it is also used, and the Duruma share it. *Pamba* is the ordinary word for cotton. Scientists call it *Gossypioides kirkii*, a name that itself means 'cotton-like'.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mngagamwe*, pia *pamba mwitu*, 'pamba ya porini', kwa sababu ya tunda lake linalofanana na pamba. Huenda *pamba mwitu* ni neno lililokopwa kutoka Kiswahili, ambako pia hutumika, na Waduruma nao hulitumia. *Pamba* ni neno la kawaida la pamba. Wanasayansi huuita *Gossypioides kirkii*, jina ambalo lenyewe linamaanisha 'kama pamba'.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mngagamwe*, piya *pamba mwitu*, 'pamba ya weruni', kpwa sababu matundage ganahalana na pamba. *Pamba mwitu* chahi ni neno ririrohalwa kula Chiswahili, ambako piya rinahumirwa, na Aduruma nao anarihumira. *Pamba* ndiro neno ra kawaida ra pamba (kpwa Chingereza *cotton*). Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Gossypioides kirkii*, dzina ambaro naro rina mana ya 'dza pamba'.

teaser.en: People suck its small, sweet orange fruits, and its flexible twigs end up as baskets, traps, bows and walking sticks.
teaser.sw: Watu hufyonza matunda yake madogo matamu ya rangi ya chungwa, na vitawi vyake vinavyopindika huishia kuwa vikapu, mitego, pinde na fimbo za kutembelea.
teaser.dg: Atu nkufyondza matundage madide ga mtswano ga rangi ya chungbwa, na maphungoge ganayofyuka nkuhendwa vikapu, mihambo, maha na bakora.

summary.en: *Mngwene* is a liana of the coastal bush with clusters of small orange fruits and remarkably flexible branches. It feeds, builds and heals: the fruit is eaten, the twigs are woven and the roots are used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mngwene* ni mtambaa wa vichaka vya pwani wenye vishada vya matunda madogo ya rangi ya chungwa na matawi yanayopindika kwa ajabu. Hulisha, hujenga na huponya: tunda huliwa, vitawi husukwa na mizizi hutumika katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Mngwene* ni mmea unaofyombera wa weruni wa pwani, wenye mafungu ga matunda madide ga rangi ya chungbwa na panda zinazofyuka sana. Una fwaida kpwa chakurya, kudzenga na dawa: matunda nkuriwa, maphungo nkusukwa, na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mngwene* is a liana or scrambling shrub that can climb to about 5 m, with long, flexible branches that bend without breaking. The leaves are simple and fairly small.

Its pale yellow flowers have the thick, fleshy petals typical of the custard-apple family. They are followed by small clusters of orange fruit segments, each a little berry spreading from a common point like the fingers of a hand.
about.sw:
*Mngwene* ni mtambaa au kichaka kitambaacho kinachoweza kupanda hadi takriban m 5, chenye matawi marefu yanayopinda bila kuvunjika. Majani yake ni sahili na kwa kiasi ni madogo.

Maua yake ya manjano hafifu yana petali nene zenye nyama, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia ya mitopetope. Hufuatiwa na vishada vidogo vya vipande vya matunda ya rangi ya chungwa, kila kimoja kikiwa beri ndogo inayochipuka kutoka sehemu moja kama vidole vya mkono.
about.dg:
*Mngwene* ni mmea unaofyombera au chitsaka chinachofyombera, unaoweza kufyombera hadi mita 5 hivi, na panda mare zinazofyuka bila kuvundzika. Makodzage ni ga kawaida (chila kodza ni zima) na madide chiasi.

Maruwage ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu gana vipande viziho vya nyama, dza maruwa ga jamii ya *mbokwe*. Bada ya maruwa kunalunga mafungu madide ga matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa; chila tunda ni ridide, na gosi ganatuluka phatu phamwenga dza vyala vya mkpwono.

where.en: Look for *mngwene* in coastal bushland and along forest edges, climbing through other shrubs. The orange fruit clusters make it easiest to find when they ripen.
where.sw: Mtafute *mngwene* katika vichaka vya pwani na kando ya misitu, ukipanda juu ya vichaka vingine. Vishada vya matunda ya rangi ya chungwa huufanya kuwa rahisi zaidi kuupata yanapoiva.
where.dg: Hendza *mngwene* weruni wa pwani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, uchifyombera kahi ya vitsaka vyanjina. Mafungu ga matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa ganahenda uonekane rahisi ganaphoivwa.

uses.en:
The small fruits are sweet, and people suck the pulp from them. The flexible twigs are put to many uses: in house building, for weaving baskets and for making traps. The branches are also made into bows and walking sticks.

The roots are used in medicine.
uses.sw:
Matunda madogo ni matamu, na watu hufyonza nyama yake. Vitawi vinavyopindika hutumika kwa njia nyingi: katika ujenzi wa nyumba, kusuka vikapu na kutengeneza mitego. Matawi pia hutengenezwa pinde na fimbo za kutembelea.

Mizizi hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg:
Matunda madide ni ga mtswano, na atu nkufyondza nyama ya matunda higo. Maphungo ganayofyuka ganahumirwa kpwa kazi nyinji: kudzenga nyumba, kusuka vikapu na kuhenda mihambo. Panda nazo nkuhendwa maha na bakora.

Mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

culture.en: *Mngwene* is considered the 'female' or small *mngweni*, because of its small leaves. Its partner, *mngweni mkulu*, is the 'male' or large one.
culture.sw: *Mngwene* huhesabiwa kuwa *mngweni* 'jike' au mdogo, kwa sababu ya majani yake madogo. Mwenzake, *mngweni mkulu*, ndiye 'dume' au mkubwa.
culture.dg: *Mngwene* nkuonwa dza *mngweni* 'mchetu' au mdide, kpwa sababu makodzage ni madide. Myawe, *mngweni mkulu*, ni 'mlume' au mkulu.

names.en: Digo: *mngwene*, also *mngweni mdide* ('small *mngweni*'). The names *mumbweni* and *mudzala* are also recorded for the Digo in another source. Swahili: *mgweni*, *mwacha* and *mganda simba*. Duruma: *mdzala*. Giriama: *murori*. Note that the headword is spelled both *mngwene* and *mngweni* in the records. Scientists call it *Uvaria acuminata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mngwene*, pia *mngweni mdide* ('*mngweni* mdogo'). Majina *mumbweni* na *mudzala* pia yamerekodiwa kwa Kidigo katika chanzo kingine. Kiswahili: *mgweni*, *mwacha* na *mganda simba*. Kiduruma: *mdzala*. Kigiriama: *murori*. Ifahamike kuwa jina kuu huandikwa *mngwene* na pia *mngweni* katika kumbukumbu. Wanasayansi huuita *Uvaria acuminata*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mngwene*, piya *mngweni mdide* ('*mngweni* mdide'). Chitabu chanjina chinaandika piya madzina *mumbweni* na *mudzala* kpwa Chidigo. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mgweni*, *mwacha* na *mganda simba*. Kpwa Chiduruma ni *mdzala*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *murori*. Manya kukala dzina hiri rinaandikpwa *mngwene* na *mngweni* kpwenye maandiko. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Uvaria acuminata*.

teaser.en: One of its Digo names means 'arrow-shaft maker', and its straight sticks once flew from coastal hunters' bows.
teaser.sw: Mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo linamaanisha 'mtengeneza mipini ya mishale', na vijiti vyake vilivyonyooka zamani vilirushwa kutoka pinde za wawindaji wa pwani.
teaser.dg: Dzina ranjina ra Chidigo ra muhi hinyu, *mtsonga nyomba*, manage ni 'muhi wa kuhenda mabura ga mivi', na kare vigongovye vya kugoloka kala vinapigwa kpwa uha ni aindza a pwani.

summary.en: *Mngweni mkulu* is a liana or shrub of coastal forest with glossy leaves and edible fruits. It is the 'male' or large *mngweni*, valued for fruit, building twigs, arrow shafts and medicine.
summary.sw: *Mngweni mkulu* ni mtambaa au kichaka cha misitu ya pwani chenye majani yanayong'aa na matunda yanayoliwa. Ndiye *mngweni* 'dume' au mkubwa, anayethaminiwa kwa matunda, vitawi vya ujenzi, mipini ya mishale na dawa.
summary.dg: *Mngweni mkulu* ni mmea unaofyombera au chitsaka cha tsakani pwani, wenye makodza ganayong'ala na matunda ganayoriwa. Ni *mngweni* 'mlume' au mkulu, na una samani kpwa matundage, maphungo ga kudzengera, mabura ga mivi na dawa.

about.en:
*Mngweni mkulu* grows either as a liana or as an upright shrub. Its leaves are glossy, and the leaf stalks are covered in rusty-brown hairs, a good feature for telling it apart from its smaller-leaved partner, *mngwene*.

The flowers are yellow-green with the thick petals of the custard-apple family, and the fruits form clusters of small segments.
about.sw:
*Mngweni mkulu* hukua ama kama mtambaa ama kama kichaka kilichosimama wima. Majani yake yanang'aa, na vikonyo vya majani vimefunikwa kwa manyoya ya kahawia kama kutu, sifa nzuri ya kuutofautisha na mwenzake mwenye majani madogo zaidi, *mngwene*.

Maua yake ni ya rangi ya manjano-kijani yenye petali nene za familia ya mitopetope, na matunda hufanya vishada vya vipande vidogo.
about.dg:
*Mngweni mkulu* unamera dza mmea unaofyombera, au unaima chocho dza chitsaka. Makodzage ganang'ala, na milita ya makodza ifwinikpwa ni nyere za rangi ya dongo; ino ni alama nono ya kuutafwautisha na myawe wa makodza madide, *mngwene*.

Maruwage ni ga rangi ya chijani na mandano, na vipande vya maruwa ni viziho dza vira vya jamii ya *mbokwe*, na matundage ganakala mabunda ga vipande vidide.

where.en: *Mngweni mkulu* grows in coastal forest and bushland, climbing into the canopy or standing as a shrub on forest edges.
where.sw: *Mngweni mkulu* hukua katika misitu na vichaka vya pwani, ukipanda hadi kwenye kilele cha miti au ukisimama kama kichaka kando ya misitu.
where.dg: *Mngweni mkulu* unamera tsakani na weruni pwani, uchifyombera hadi dzulu ya mihi, au uchiima dza chitsaka kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

uses.en:
The fruits are eaten. The twigs are used in building, and straight sticks are cut for arrow shafts, which earned it the name *mtsonga nyomba*, 'arrow-shaft maker'.

The leaves are used medicinally.
uses.sw:
Matunda huliwa. Vitawi hutumika katika ujenzi, na vijiti vilivyonyooka hukatwa kuwa mipini ya mishale, jambo lililoupa jina *mtsonga nyomba*, 'mtengeneza mipini ya mishale'.

Majani hutumika kama dawa.
uses.dg:
Matundage nkuriwa. Maphungoge nkuhumirwa kudzengera, na vigongo vya kugoloka nkukatwa kuhenda mabura ga mivi; ndiyo sababu unaihwa *mtsonga nyomba*, 'muhi wa kuhenda mabura ga mivi'.

Makodzage nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

culture.en: This is the 'male' or large *mngweni*, paired with *mngwene*, the 'female' or small one with smaller leaves.
culture.sw: Huyu ndiye *mngweni* 'dume' au mkubwa, akiwa jozi na *mngwene*, 'jike' au mdogo mwenye majani madogo zaidi.
culture.dg: Hinyu ni *mngweni* 'mlume' au mkulu. Myawe ni *mngwene*, *mngweni* 'mchetu' au mdide, ambao makodzage ni madide.

names.en: Digo: *mngweni mkulu* ('large *mngweni*'), also *mngwene mlume* ('male *mngwene*') and *mtsonga nyomba*, 'arrow-shaft maker'. Another source records the Digo name *mungweni*. Swahili: *mganda simba*. Giriama: *mudzala*. Scientists call it *Uvaria lucida*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mngweni mkulu* ('*mngweni* mkubwa'), pia *mngwene mlume* ('*mngwene* dume') na *mtsonga nyomba*, 'mtengeneza mipini ya mishale'. Chanzo kingine kinarekodi jina la Kidigo *mungweni*. Kiswahili: *mganda simba*. Kigiriama: *mudzala*. Wanasayansi huuita *Uvaria lucida*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mngweni mkulu* ('*mngweni* mkulu'), piya *mngwene mlume* ('*mngwene* mlume') na *mtsonga nyomba*, 'muhi wa kuhenda mabura ga mivi'. Chitabu chanjina chinaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mungweni*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mganda simba*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mudzala*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Uvaria lucida*.

teaser.en: The Digo saw a crocodile's backbone in its leaves: 'mongo wa mbulu'.
teaser.sw: Wadigo waliona uti wa mgongo wa mamba katika majani yake: 'mongo wa mbulu'.
teaser.dg: Adigo aona mongo wa mamba kpwenye makodzage: *mongo wa mbulu*.

summary.en: *Mongo wa mbulu* is a woody climber of forest edges with winged leaf stalks and bright red, three-lobed seed capsules. Its name compares the leaf to a crocodile's backbone.
summary.sw: *Mongo wa mbulu* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu wa kando ya misitu, wenye vikonyo vya majani vyenye mabawa na vifuko vya mbegu vyekundu vyenye pande tatu. Jina lake linalinganisha jani na uti wa mgongo wa mamba.
summary.dg: *Mongo wa mbulu* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye muhi mufu, unaomera kanda-kanda ya matsaka. Milita ya makodzage ina mapha, na makakayage ga tembe ni ga kundu sana na gana seemu tahu. Dzinare rinahalanisha kodza na mongo wa mamba.

about.en:
*Mongo wa mbulu* is a woody climber that pulls itself up with coiled tendrils. Its compound leaves have a distinctive winged stalk: the midrib between the leaflets is edged with a flat green flange, so the leaf looks ridged and segmented.

The fruits are red, three-lobed capsules. When they split, they show black seeds partly wrapped in a white fleshy coat, so that they look like small staring eyes.
about.sw:
*Mongo wa mbulu* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu unaojivuta juu kwa vikonyo vilivyojikunja vya kushikilia. Majani yake yenye vijani vingi yana kikonyo cha pekee chenye mabawa: mshipa mkuu kati ya vijani umepakana na ukingo bapa wa kijani, kwa hivyo jani huonekana kuwa na matuta na kugawanyika kwa pingili.

Matunda ni vifuko vyekundu vyenye pande tatu. Vinapopasuka, huonyesha mbegu nyeusi zilizofunikwa kwa sehemu na ganda jeupe lenye nyama, hivi kwamba zinaonekana kama macho madogo yanayokodolea.
about.dg:
*Mongo wa mbulu* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye muhi mufu, unaofyombera dzulu kpwa nyuzi zinazolinga-linga. Makodzage ni makodza madide manji ganayolungana, na mlita wa kodza una alama ya kumanyikira: bati riro kahi ya makodza madide rina mapha ga chijani ga sambamba kanda-kanda zosi mbiri, kpwa hivyo kodza rinaonekana dza rina misitari na rinaganyika vipande-vipande.

Matundage ni makakaya ga kundu genye seemu tahu. Ganaphoahuka, ganaonyesa tembe nyiru zirizofwinikpwa nusu ni nyama nyereru, kpwa hivyo zinaonekana dza matso madide ganayolola.

where.en: Look for *mongo wa mbulu* on forest edges, where it climbs over shrubs and small trees. The red capsules are the easiest feature to spot.
where.sw: Mtafute *mongo wa mbulu* kando ya misitu, ambako hupanda juu ya vichaka na miti midogo. Vifuko vyekundu ndiyo sifa rahisi zaidi kuiona.
where.dg: Hendza *mongo wa mbulu* kanda-kanda ya matsaka, ambapho unafyombera dzulu ya vitsaka na mihi midide. Makakaya ga kundu ndigo ganayoonekana kpwa urahisi.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu.

culture.en: The name *mongo wa mbulu* means 'backbone of the crocodile', after the shape of the leaf, whose winged, segmented midrib recalls a crocodile's ridged back.
culture.sw: Jina *mongo wa mbulu* linamaanisha 'uti wa mgongo wa mamba', kutokana na umbo la jani, ambalo mshipa wake mkuu wenye mabawa na pingili unakumbusha mgongo wa mamba wenye matuta.
culture.dg: Dzina *mongo wa mbulu* manage ni 'mongo wa mamba', kpwa sababu ya umbo ra kodza: bati rakpwe renye mapha na vipande-vipande rinatambukiza mongo wa mamba wenye misitari.

names.en: Digo: *mongo wa mbulu*, 'backbone of the crocodile'. No English or Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Paullinia pinnata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mongo wa mbulu*, 'uti wa mgongo wa mamba'. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Paullinia pinnata*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mongo wa mbulu*, 'mongo wa mamba'. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Paullinia pinnata*.

teaser.en: Its swept-back petals look like flickering flames, and every part of this beautiful lily is deadly poisonous.
teaser.sw: Petali zake zilizopinda nyuma zinaonekana kama miali ya moto inayopepea, na kila sehemu ya yungiyungi huyu mrembo ni sumu kali inayoua.
teaser.dg: Maruwage garigogaluka nyuma ganaonekana dza majimbi ga moho ganayotsezatseza, na chila seemu ya mmea hinyu mnono ina sumu ya kuolaga.

summary.en: *Mpewa* is the flame lily, a climbing lily with wavy red-and-yellow flowers. It is one of the showiest wild flowers of the coast and also one of the most poisonous.
summary.sw: *Mpewa* ni *flame lily*, yungiyungi mtambaa mwenye maua mekundu na manjano yenye kingo za mawimbi. Ni mojawapo ya maua ya porini yanayopendeza zaidi pwani, na pia mojawapo ya mimea yenye sumu kali zaidi.
summary.dg: *Mpewa* ni mmea wa jamii ya *lily* unaofyombera, wenye maruwa ga kundu na mandano genye kanda za kunyonganyonga. Ni mwenga wa maruwa ga weruni ganayong'ala sana pwani, na piya ni mwenga wa mimea yenye sumu kali zaidi.

about.en:
*Mpewa* climbs by tendrils at the very tips of its leaves, which hook onto grass and twigs. The leaves are narrow and glossy.

The flowers are the star: six narrow, wavy-edged petals sweep backwards, yellow at the base and red towards the tips, with long stamens jutting out. As the flowers age they deepen towards crimson. The plant dies back to a fleshy underground tuber in the dry season and reappears with the rains.

All parts of *mpewa*, and especially the tuber, are very poisonous. The plant contains colchicine, and the tuber can be mistaken for an edible yam, so it is a plant worth knowing for safety.
about.sw:
*Mpewa* hupanda kwa vikonyo vya kushikilia vilivyo kwenye ncha kabisa za majani yake, vinavyonasa kwenye nyasi na vitawi. Majani ni membamba na yanang'aa.

Maua ndiyo kivutio kikuu: petali sita nyembamba zenye kingo za mawimbi hupinda kuelekea nyuma, za manjano chini na nyekundu kuelekea ncha, huku stameni ndefu zikijitokeza nje. Kadiri maua yanavyozeeka huzidi kuwa mekundu iliyokolea. Mmea hunyauka na kubaki kiazi chenye nyama chini ya ardhi wakati wa kiangazi, na huchipuka tena mvua zinaponyesha.

Sehemu zote za *mpewa*, na hasa kiazi, zina sumu kali sana. Mmea una kolkisini, na kiazi kinaweza kudhaniwa kuwa kiazi kikuu kinacholiwa, kwa hivyo ni mmea unaofaa kuujua kwa ajili ya usalama.
about.dg:
*Mpewa* unafyombera kpwa nyuzi zirizo kpwenye ntsa za makodzage, zinazonasa nyasi na maphungo. Makodzage ni membamba na ganang'ala.

Maruwage ndigo mazuri zaidi: vipande sita vyembamba, vyenye kanda za kunyonganyonga, vinagaluka nyuma; ni vya rangi ya mandano photsi na vya kundu phephi na ntsa, na stameni nyire zinatuluka kondze. Maruwa ganaphokala ga kare, ganakala ga kundu sana. Wakati wa kazikazi seemu ya dzulu ya mmea inafwa, ichisala chiaziche cha nyama tsini, na unatuluka tsona wakati wa mvula.

Chila seemu ya *mpewa*, na zaidi chiazi, ina sumu kali sana. Mmea una *colchicine*, na chiazi chinaweza kukosekpwa chikaonwa ni chiazi cha kurya, kpwa hivyo ni mmea wa kumanya kpwa usalama.

where.en: Look for *mpewa* in bushland and along forest edges, scrambling through grass and low shrubs. It is easiest to see after the rains, when it is in flower.
where.sw: Mtafute *mpewa* vichakani na kando ya misitu, ukitambaa katikati ya nyasi na vichaka vifupi. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona baada ya mvua, unapochanua.
where.dg: Hendza *mpewa* weruni na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, uchifyombera kahi ya nyasi na vitsaka vifupi. Ni rahisi kuuona bada ya mvula, wakati una maruwa.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu.

names.en: Digo: *mpewa*. English: flame lily or glory lily. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Gloriosa superba*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mpewa*. Kwa Kiingereza: *flame lily* au *glory lily*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Gloriosa superba*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mpewa*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *flame lily* au *glory lily*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Gloriosa superba*.

teaser.en: Crush a leaf and it smells of citrus, a clue that this prickly climber is a cousin of the orange.
teaser.sw: Ponda jani lake na litanuka kama limau, ishara kwamba mtambaa huu wenye miiba ni binamu wa mchungwa.
teaser.dg: Fikitsa kodza na rinalavya arufu ya machungbwa; ino ni ishara kukala mmea hinyu unaofyombera wenye miya ni ndugu wa mchungwa.

summary.en: *Mtseha* is a prickly woody climber of forest edges and thicket, with citrus-scented leaves and small orange berries. The Digo of Diani boil its root bark as a remedy for malaria.
summary.sw: *Mtseha* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu na miiba wa kando ya misitu na vichaka vizito, wenye majani yanayonukia kama limau na beri ndogo za rangi ya chungwa. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome la mizizi yake kama dawa ya malaria.
summary.dg: *Mtseha* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye muhi mufu na miya, unaomera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na vitsakani, wenye makodza genye arufu ya machungbwa na matunda madide ga rangi ya chungbwa. Adigo a Diani anaokoha gopha ra miziye kuhenda dawa ya homa.

about.en:
*Mtseha* is a woody climber armed with hooked prickles on its stems. Each leaf has three glossy leaflets, and when crushed they give off a strong citrus scent, a reminder that it belongs to the same family as oranges and limes.

Its flowers are small and greenish-white, and they are followed by small round berries that ripen orange. The root has a yellow inner bark.
about.sw:
*Mtseha* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu na miiba iliyopinda kama ndoano kwenye mashina yake. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu vinavyong'aa, na vikipondwa hutoa harufu kali ya limau, ukumbusho kwamba ni wa familia moja na michungwa na midimu.

Maua yake ni madogo ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe, na hufuatiwa na beri ndogo za mviringo zinazoiva zikawa za rangi ya chungwa. Mzizi una gome la ndani la manjano.
about.dg:
*Mtseha* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye muhi mufu, na mihiye ina miya ya kugbwira dza chiloo. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu ganayong'ala, na ganaphofikitswa ganalavya arufu kali ya machungbwa; ino inatambukiza kukala ni wa jamii mwenga na michungwa na midimu.

Maruwage ni madide na ga rangi nyereru na chijani, na bada yakpwe kunatuluka matunda madide ga mviringo, ganayokala ga rangi ya chungbwa ganaphokala maivu. Muzi una gopha ra ndani ra rangi ya mandano.

where.en: Look for *mtseha* along forest edges and in thicket, where it scrambles over shrubs and into trees. The smell of the crushed leaves is the quickest way to confirm it.
where.sw: Mtafute *mtseha* kando ya misitu na katika vichaka vizito, ambako hutambaa juu ya vichaka na kupanda mitini. Harufu ya majani yaliyopondwa ndiyo njia ya haraka zaidi ya kuuthibitisha.
where.dg: Hendza *mtseha* kanda-kanda ya matsaka na vitsakani, ambapho unafyombera dzulu ya vitsaka na kuinjira mihini. Arufu ya makodza garigofikitswa ndiyo njira ya upesi ya kuumanya.

uses.en: The Digo of Diani boil the root bark of *mtseha* to make a remedy for malaria.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome la mizizi ya *mtseha* kutengeneza dawa ya malaria.
uses.dg: Adigo a Diani anaokoha gopha ra miziye *mtseha* ili kuhenda dawa ya homa.

names.en: Digo: *mtseha*. English: orange climber. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Toddalia asiatica*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mtseha*. Kwa Kiingereza: *orange climber*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Toddalia asiatica*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mtseha*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *orange climber*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Toddalia asiatica*.

teaser.en: Its glossy scarlet seeds with a single black eye look like beads, and they are among the most poisonous seeds in the world.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake nyekundu zinazong'aa zenye jicho moja jeusi zinafanana na shanga, na ni miongoni mwa mbegu zenye sumu kali zaidi duniani.
teaser.dg: Tembeze za kundu sana zinazong'ala, chila mwenga na chibara chiiru, zinaonekana dza ushanga, na ni mwenga wa tembe zenye sumu kali zaidi duniani.

summary.en: *Mwamsusumbika* is the rosary pea, a slender twining climber with feathery leaves and shiny scarlet-and-black seeds. The seeds are beautiful and highly poisonous.
summary.sw: *Mwamsusumbika* ni *rosary pea*, mtambaa mwembamba unaojizungusha wenye majani kama manyoya na mbegu zinazong'aa za rangi nyekundu na nyeusi. Mbegu zake ni nzuri na zina sumu kali.
summary.dg: *Mwamsusumbika* ni mmea mwembamba unaofyombera kpwa kudzilinga-linga, wenye makodza dza nyoya na tembe zinazong'ala za kundu na nyiru. Tembe hizo ni nono kpwa kulola, ela zina sumu kali sana.

about.en:
*Mwamsusumbika* is a slender, twining climber with feathery leaves made of many small paired leaflets. Its small pink to purple pea flowers grow in short clusters.

The pods curl open when ripe to show the famous seeds: hard, glossy, bright scarlet, each with a black spot at one end. They are so uniform in size that in Asia they were once used as weights for gold. The seeds stay on the open pods for a long time.

The seeds are highly poisonous. They contain abrin, and a chewed or broken seed is dangerous, so this is a plant children should be taught to recognise.
about.sw:
*Mwamsusumbika* ni mtambaa mwembamba unaojizungusha, wenye majani kama manyoya yaliyoundwa kwa vijani vingi vidogo vilivyopangwa kwa jozi. Maua yake madogo ya jamii ya kunde, ya rangi ya waridi hadi zambarau, hukua katika vishada vifupi.

Maganda hujikunja na kufunguka yakiiva kuonyesha mbegu zake mashuhuri: ngumu, zinazong'aa, nyekundu nyangavu, kila moja ikiwa na doa jeusi upande mmoja. Zinalingana ukubwa kiasi kwamba huko Asia ziliwahi kutumika kama vipimo vya uzito wa dhahabu. Mbegu hubaki kwenye maganda yaliyofunguka kwa muda mrefu.

Mbegu zina sumu kali. Zina abrini, na mbegu iliyotafunwa au kuvunjika ni hatari, kwa hivyo watoto wanapaswa kufundishwa kuutambua mmea huu.
about.dg:
*Mwamsusumbika* ni mmea mwembamba unaofyombera kpwa kudzilinga-linga, wenye makodza dza nyoya, ganayoundwa ni makodza madide manji ganayolungana airi airi. Maruwage madide, ga pinki hadi zambarau, ni dza maruwa ga kunde na ganamera mabunda mafupi.

Makakaya ganaphokala maivu ganadzikundza na kuvuguka, ganaonyesa tembe zinazomanyikana sana: ngumu, zinazong'ala, za kundu sana, na chila tembe ina chibara chiiru kpwenye ntsa mwenga. Zina ukulu sawa sana, hata kare kpwenye tsi za Asia zahumirwa dza vipimo vya kupimira zahabu. Tembe zinakala kpwenye makakaya garigovuguka kpwa muda mure.

Tembe zina sumu kali sana. Zina *abrin*, na tembe iriyoafunwa au iriyovundzika ni ya hatari, kpwa hivyo ana nkufundzwa kuumanya mmea hinyu.

where.en: Look for *mwamsusumbika* in bushland and on forest edges, where it twines through shrubs. The open pods with red seeds are easiest to spot in the dry season.
where.sw: Mtafute *mwamsusumbika* vichakani na kando ya misitu, ambako hujizungusha katikati ya vichaka. Maganda yaliyofunguka yenye mbegu nyekundu ni rahisi zaidi kuonekana wakati wa kiangazi.
where.dg: Hendza *mwamsusumbika* weruni na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, ambapho unadzilinga-linga kahi ya vitsaka. Makakaya garigovuguka na tembe za kundu ni rahisi kugaona wakati wa kazikazi.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded. Around the world the seeds are strung as beads and rosaries, which gives the plant its English name.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Kote duniani mbegu hutungwa kuwa shanga na tasbihi, na ndiko jina lake la Kiingereza linakotoka.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu. Duniani kosi tembeze nkutungbwa dza ushanga na tasbihi, na kpwa sababu iyo unaihwa *rosary pea* kpwa Chingereza.

names.en: Digo: *mwamsusumbika*, also *mwangala nyuchi*. The Mgombato dictionary lists it with several other names: *mwangala nyuchi*, *mlangamia*, *mpirikichi*, *mpotopoto* and *mkangauchawi*. English: rosary pea, crab's eye or coral pea. Scientists call it *Abrus precatorius*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mwamsusumbika*, pia *mwangala nyuchi*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inauorodhesha pamoja na majina mengine kadhaa: *mwangala nyuchi*, *mlangamia*, *mpirikichi*, *mpotopoto* na *mkangauchawi*. Kwa Kiingereza: *rosary pea*, *crab's eye* au *coral pea*. Wanasayansi huuita *Abrus precatorius*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mwamsusumbika*, piya *mwangala nyuchi*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inauandika phamwenga na madzina manji ganjina: *mwangala nyuchi*, *mlangamia*, *mpirikichi*, *mpotopoto* na *mkangauchawi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *rosary pea*, *crab's eye* au *coral pea*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Abrus precatorius*.

teaser.en: The Digo say this spiny wild asparagus is strong enough to fell an elephant.
teaser.sw: Wadigo husema asparagasi huu wa porini wenye miiba una nguvu za kuweza kumwangusha tembo.
teaser.dg: Adigo anaamba *mwinika* hinyu wa weruni wenye miya una nguvu za kuhenda ndzovu igbwe photsi.

summary.en: *Mwinika ndzovu* is a spiny woody climber, a wild asparagus with sickle-shaped 'leaves' and small white flowers. It is regarded as a strong medicine.
summary.sw: *Mwinika ndzovu* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu na miiba, asparagasi wa porini mwenye 'majani' yaliyopinda kama mundu na maua madogo meupe. Huhesabiwa kuwa dawa yenye nguvu.
summary.dg: *Mwinika ndzovu* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye muhi mufu na miya, *mwinika* wa weruni wenye 'makodza' ganayotsongbwa dza *sickle* na maruwa madide mereru. Nkuonwa dza dawa ya nguvu.

about.en:
*Mwinika ndzovu* is a woody, spiny climber that can scramble high into trees. What look like leaves are actually flattened green stems, curved like small sickles, which gives it its English name.

The small white flowers are sweetly scented and appear in clusters along the stems. The sharp, hooked spines catch on clothing and make the plant easy to remember.
about.sw:
*Mwinika ndzovu* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu na miiba unaoweza kutambaa juu sana mitini. Kinachoonekana kama majani kwa kweli ni mashina bapa ya kijani, yaliyopinda kama miundu midogo, na ndiko jina lake la Kiingereza linakotoka.

Maua madogo meupe yana harufu tamu na huchanua katika vishada kando ya mashina. Miiba mikali iliyopinda kama ndoano hunasa nguo na kuufanya mmea huu kuwa rahisi kukumbukwa.
about.dg:
*Mwinika ndzovu* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye muhi mufu na miya, unaoweza kufyombera hadi dzulu mihini. Vira vinavyoonekana dza makodza kpwa kpweli ni mihi midide ya chijani iriyotandazika, iriyotsongbwa dza *sickle*, na ndiyo sababu ya dzinare ra Chingereza.

Maruwage madide mereru gana arufu nono na ganamera mabunda kanda-kanda ya mihi. Miya mikali iriyotsongbwa dza chiloo inagbwira nguwo, na ichi chinahenda mmea ukale wa kutambukirwa upesi.

where.en: Look for *mwinika ndzovu* in bushland and on forest edges, climbing over shrubs and trees.
where.sw: Mtafute *mwinika ndzovu* vichakani na kando ya misitu, ukipanda juu ya vichaka na miti.
where.dg: Hendza *mwinika ndzovu* weruni na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, uchifyombera dzulu ya vitsaka na mihi.

uses.en: *Mwinika ndzovu* is regarded as a strong medicine.
uses.sw: *Mwinika ndzovu* huhesabiwa kuwa dawa yenye nguvu.
uses.dg: *Mwinika ndzovu* nkuonwa dza dawa ya nguvu.

culture.en: *Mwinika* is the Digo collective name for all the wild asparagus plants. Adding *ndzovu*, 'elephant', marks this one as strong enough to fell an elephant, a measure of its reputation as medicine.
culture.sw: *Mwinika* ni jina la jumla la Kidigo kwa mimea yote ya asparagasi wa porini. Kuongeza *ndzovu*, 'tembo', kunauonyesha huu kuwa na nguvu za kuweza kumwangusha tembo, kipimo cha sifa yake kama dawa.
culture.dg: *Mwinika* ni dzina ra Chidigo ra mimea yosi ya *asparagus* ya weruni. Kuenjereza *ndzovu*, 'ndzovu', kunaonyesa kukala hinyu una nguvu za kuhenda ndzovu igbwe photsi, chipimo cha sifwaye dza dawa.

names.en: Digo: *mwinika ndzovu*, a name shared with Duruma and Swahili. *Mwinika* is the general name for asparagus plants, and *ndzovu* means 'elephant'. English: sickle-thorn asparagus. Scientists call it *Asparagus falcatus*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mwinika ndzovu*, jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. *Mwinika* ni jina la jumla la mimea ya asparagasi, na *ndzovu* linamaanisha 'tembo'. Kwa Kiingereza: *sickle-thorn asparagus*. Wanasayansi huuita *Asparagus falcatus*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mwinika ndzovu*, dzina rinarohumirwa piya ni Aduruma na kpwa Chiswahili. *Mwinika* ni dzina ra mimea yosi ya *asparagus*, na *ndzovu* manage ni 'ndzovu' (*elephant*). Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sickle-thorn asparagus*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Asparagus falcatus*.

teaser.en: Brush against its pods and you will be scratching for hours: the hairs on this bean cause intense itching.
teaser.sw: Ukigusana na maganda yake utajikuna kwa saa nyingi: manyoya ya kunde hii husababisha mwasho mkali.
teaser.dg: Uchinyenyeza makakayage, undakala uchidzikuna kpwa masaa manji: nyere za kunde hinyu zinahenda mwiri uawiwe sana.

summary.en: *Uphupu* is the velvet bean, a vigorous climber with dark purple flowers and pods coated in stinging hairs. Its pods are best admired from a distance.
summary.sw: *Uphupu* ni upupu (*velvet bean*), mtambaa wenye nguvu wenye maua ya zambarau iliyokolea na maganda yaliyofunikwa kwa manyoya yanayowasha. Maganda yake ni bora kuyatazama ukiwa mbali.
summary.dg: *Uphupu* ni kunde ya weruni inayofyombera kpwa nguvu, yenye maruwa ga zambarau nyiru na makakaya ganayofwinikpwa ni nyere zinazoawisa. Makakayage ni ga kulola kula kure.

about.en:
*Uphupu* is a vigorous climbing bean that can smother shrubs and small trees. Its leaves have three broad leaflets, like most beans.

The flowers are dark purple and hang in long sprays. They are followed by curved pods covered in dense golden-brown or orange hairs. These hairs break off easily and cause intense itching on skin.
about.sw:
*Uphupu* ni mtambaa wa jamii ya kunde wenye nguvu unaoweza kufunika vichaka na miti midogo. Majani yake yana vijani vitatu vipana, kama kunde nyingi.

Maua ni ya zambarau iliyokolea na huning'inia katika mashada marefu. Hufuatiwa na maganda yaliyopinda, yaliyofunikwa kwa manyoya mazito ya rangi ya kahawia-dhahabu au ya chungwa. Manyoya haya hukatika kwa urahisi na kusababisha mwasho mkali kwenye ngozi.
about.dg:
*Uphupu* ni kunde inayofyombera kpwa nguvu, inayoweza kufwinika vitsaka na mihi midide. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu mapana, dza kunde nyinji.

Maruwage ni ga zambarau nyiru na ganabwadzika mabunda marefu. Bada yakpwe kunatuluka makakaya garigotsongbwa, ganayofwinikpwa ni nyere nyinji za rangi ya dongo na zahabu au za rangi ya chungbwa. Nyere hizo zinadoka upesi na zinahenda ngozi iawiwe sana.

where.en: Look for *uphupu* in bush and on forest edges, climbing over other plants. The hairy pods are easiest to see as they ripen after the rains.
where.sw: Mtafute *uphupu* vichakani na kando ya misitu, ukipanda juu ya mimea mingine. Maganda yenye manyoya ni rahisi zaidi kuonekana yanapoiva baada ya mvua.
where.dg: Hendza *uphupu* weruni na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, ichifyombera dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Makakaya genye nyere ni rahisi kugaona ganaphokala maivu bada ya mvula.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded. Elsewhere, cultivated forms of the velvet bean are grown as cover crops and the seeds, after careful processing, are eaten.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Kwingineko, aina zinazopandwa za upupu hulimwa kama mazao ya kufunika udongo, na mbegu, baada ya kutayarishwa kwa uangalifu, huliwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu. Kpwa tsi zanjina, aina za kunde hino zinazophandwa nkurimwa ili kufwinika tsi, na tembeze, bada ya kutengezwa sawa-sawa, nkuriwa.

names.en: Digo: *uphupu*. English: velvet bean, buffalo bean or cowitch. In Swahili it is *upupu*. Scientists call it *Mucuna pruriens*; *pruriens* means 'itching'.
names.sw: Kidigo: *uphupu*. Kwa Kiingereza: *velvet bean*, *buffalo bean* au *cowitch*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *upupu*. Wanasayansi huuita *Mucuna pruriens*; *pruriens* linamaanisha 'kuwasha'.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *uphupu*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *velvet bean*, *buffalo bean* au *cowitch*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *upupu*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Mucuna pruriens*; *pruriens* manage ni 'kuawiwa'.

teaser.en: Taller than a person and topped with feathery seed heads, this grass reclaims every farm left to rest.
teaser.sw: Ni mrefu kuliko mtu na una vishada vya mbegu kama manyoya juu yake; nyasi hii hurudi kutawala kila shamba linaloachwa kupumzika.
teaser.dg: Ni ire kuriko mutu na dzuluye kuna vitswa vya tembe dza nyoya; nyasi hino inamera tsona kpwenye chila munda uriorichwa bila kurimwa.

summary.en: *Bondo* is Guinea grass, a tall tufted grass of grassland, forest edges and resting farmland. It is valued as fodder for livestock.
summary.sw: *Bondo* ni *Guinea grass*, nyasi ndefu inayoota kwa vichaka katika nyika, kando ya misitu na mashamba yaliyoachwa kupumzika. Huthaminiwa kama lishe ya mifugo.
summary.dg: *Bondo* ni nyasi ndefu inayomera mabunda, ya herera, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na minda iriyorichwa bila kurimwa. Ina samani dza chakurya cha mifugo.

about.en:
*Bondo* is a tall, tufted grass that grows in dense clumps up to about 2 m high. Its leaves are broad and long for a grass, and its stems end in large, open, branching seed heads that look feathery and airy, often tinged purple.

It grows fast after the rains and forms thick stands that can hide a person.
about.sw:
*Bondo* ni nyasi ndefu inayoota kwa vichaka vizito hadi urefu wa takriban m 2. Majani yake ni mapana na marefu kwa nyasi, na mashina yake huishia kwa vishada vikubwa vya mbegu vilivyo wazi na vyenye matawi, vinavyoonekana kama manyoya mepesi, mara nyingi vikiwa na rangi ya zambarau.

Hukua haraka baada ya mvua na kufanya vichaka vizito vinavyoweza kumficha mtu.
about.dg:
*Bondo* ni nyasi ndefu inayomera mabunda ga kubanana hadi kufika mita mbiri dzulu. Makodzage ni mapana na marefu kpwa nyasi, na mihiye inamala na vitswa vikulu vya tembe vyenye panda nyinji, vinavyoonekana dza nyoya, na mara nyinji vina rangi ya zambarau.

Inamera upesi bada ya mvula, na inakala mabunda ga kubanana ganayoweza kufwitsa mutu.

where.en: Look for *bondo* in grassland, along forest edges and on fallow land, the fields that farmers leave to rest between crops. It is easiest to recognise when the big open seed heads appear after the rains.
where.sw: Itafute *bondo* katika nyika, kando ya misitu na kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa, yaani mashamba ambayo wakulima huyaacha yapumzike kati ya mazao. Ni rahisi zaidi kuitambua vishada vikubwa vya mbegu vinapotokea baada ya mvua.
where.dg: Hendza *bondo* kpwenye herera, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye minda iriyorichwa, minda ambayo akurima anairicha bila kuirima kahi ya mavuno. Ni rahisi kuimanya vitswa vikulu vya tembe vichituluka bada ya mvula.

uses.en: *Bondo* is used as fodder. Its broad leaves are tender and palatable, and it is one of the most widely grown fodder grasses in the tropics.
uses.sw: *Bondo* hutumika kama lishe ya mifugo. Majani yake mapana ni laini na yanapendwa na mifugo, na ni mojawapo ya nyasi za lishe zinazopandwa kwa wingi zaidi katika nchi za tropiki.
uses.dg: *Bondo* nkuhumirwa dza chakurya cha mifugo. Makodzage mapana ni laini na ga mtswano kpwa mifugo, na ni mwenga wa nyasi za mifugo zinazophandwa sana kpwa tsi za dzoho.

names.en: Digo: *bondo*, also *gogwe*. The name is shared with Duruma and Giriama. English: Guinea grass. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Panicum maximum* (now often placed in *Megathyrsus*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *bondo*, pia *gogwe*. Jina hili linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Kwa Kiingereza: *Guinea grass*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huiita *Panicum maximum* (siku hizi mara nyingi huwekwa katika *Megathyrsus*).
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *bondo*, piya *gogwe*. Dzina hiri rinahumirwa piya ni Aduruma na Agiryama. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *Guinea grass*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Panicum maximum* (sambi kahi-kahi inaikpwa kpwenye *Megathyrsus*).

teaser.en: The Digo call it 'forest sisal', and a Digo proverb reminds us that one cut rope does not mean the sisal is finished.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huiita 'mkonge wa msituni', na methali ya Kidigo inatukumbusha kwamba kamba moja ikikatika haimaanishi mkonge umekwisha.
teaser.dg: Adigo anachiiha 'konje ra tsakani', na ndarira ya Chidigo inahutambukiza kukala lugbwe mwenga uchidoswa, makonje tagamala.

summary.en: *Chongwa* is a wild bowstring hemp with stiff, sword-like leaves full of fibre. It is the forest's own sisal.
summary.sw: *Chongwa* ni mmea wa porini wa aina ya *bowstring hemp* wenye majani magumu kama upanga yaliyojaa nyuzi. Ni mkonge wa msitu wenyewe.
summary.dg: *Chongwa* ni mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya *bowstring hemp*, wenye makodza mafu ga dza upanga, ganayodzala katani. Ni konje ra tsakani.

about.en:
*Chongwa* grows as a cluster of stiff, thick, sword-shaped leaves rising straight from a creeping underground stem. The leaves are tough and fibrous, often mottled or banded in shades of green, and look much like those of sisal.

It spreads slowly by its rhizomes into small colonies. Its flowers, when they appear, are pale and grow on an upright spike.
about.sw:
*Chongwa* hukua kama kichaka cha majani magumu, manene, yenye umbo la upanga yanayochipuka moja kwa moja kutoka shina linalotambaa chini ya ardhi. Majani ni magumu na yana nyuzi, mara nyingi yakiwa na madoa au mistari ya rangi mbalimbali za kijani, na yanafanana sana na ya mkonge.

Huenea polepole kwa viazi (mashina ya chini ya ardhi) na kufanya makundi madogo. Maua yake, yanapotokea, ni ya rangi hafifu na hukua juu ya shada lililosimama wima.
about.dg:
*Chongwa* chinamera dza bunda ra makodza mafu na maziho ga dza upanga, ganayoima chocho kula kpwa muhi unaoambala tsini. Makodza ni mafu na gana katani nyinji, mara nyinji gana vibara au misitari ya chijani ya rangi tafwauti, na ganahalana sana na makodza ga konje.

Chinaenea pore-pore kpwa mizi ya tsini na kuhenda mabunda madide. Maruwage, ganaphotuluka, ni ga rangi ya ngushu-ngushu na ganamera kpwenye mlita uimao chocho.

where.en: *Chongwa* grows on the forest floor and in dry bush, often in shaded patches under trees.
where.sw: *Chongwa* hukua sakafuni mwa msitu na katika vichaka vikavu, mara nyingi katika sehemu zenye kivuli chini ya miti.
where.dg: *Chongwa* chinamera photsi tsakani na weruni kukavu, mara nyinji phatu pha pepho photsi ya mihi.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded. The leaves of bowstring hemps are full of strong fibre, and in many parts of Africa they have been used for cord, rope and bowstrings, which is where the English name comes from.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Majani ya mimea ya aina ya *bowstring hemp* yamejaa nyuzi imara, na katika sehemu nyingi za Afrika yametumika kutengeneza uzi, kamba na kamba za pinde, na ndiko jina lake la Kiingereza linakotoka.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu. Makodza ga mimea ya *bowstring hemp* gana katani ngumu nyinji, na kpwenye seemu nyinji za Afrika gakahumirwa kuhenda lugbwe, kamba na lugbwe za uha; ndiko riphotuluka dzina ra Chingereza.

culture.en: Its Digo name *konje tsaka* means 'forest sisal'. *Konje* is the ordinary word for the sisal plant, and it appears in a Digo proverb: *Chiphala kudosa lugbwe siko kumala makonje*, 'If an antelope cuts a rope, it does not mean the sisal is finished.' A single loss does not exhaust the source.
culture.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo *konje tsaka* linamaanisha 'mkonge wa msituni'. *Konje* ni neno la kawaida la mmea wa mkonge, na linatokea katika methali ya Kidigo: *Chiphala kudosa lugbwe siko kumala makonje*, 'Swala akikata kamba, haimaanishi mkonge umekwisha.' Hasara moja haimalizi chanzo.
culture.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo *konje tsaka* manage ni 'konje ra tsakani'. *Konje* ni dzina ra kawaida ra mmea wa konge, na rinatuluka kpwenye ndarira ya Chidigo: *Chiphala kudosa lugbwe siko kumala makonje*, 'Chiphala chichidosa lugbwe, taimaanisha makonje gakamala.' Hasara mwenga taimaanisha kukala phatu chitu chinaphophahikana phakamala.

names.en: Digo: *chongwa*, also *konje tsaka*, 'forest sisal'. English: bowstring hemp. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Sansevieria kirkii* (now often placed in *Dracaena*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *chongwa*, pia *konje tsaka*, 'mkonge wa msituni'. Kwa Kiingereza: *bowstring hemp*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huiita *Sansevieria kirkii* (siku hizi mara nyingi huwekwa katika *Dracaena*).
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *chongwa*, piya *konje tsaka*, 'konje ra tsakani'. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *bowstring hemp*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Sansevieria kirkii* (sambi kahi-kahi chinaikpwa kpwenye *Dracaena*).

teaser.en: Only when an aloe grows a proper trunk do the Digo count it as a tree; until then it is just a very useful rosette.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huhesabu mshubiri kuwa mti pale tu unapootesha shina halisi; hadi hapo ni kichaka cha majani chenye manufaa makubwa tu.
teaser.dg: *Golonje* richimera kolo kpwa kpweli, ndipho Adigo anariisabu dza muhi; kabla ya phapho ni bunda ra makodza renye fwaida nyinji tu.

summary.en: *Golonje* is the Digo name for the wild aloes, succulent rosettes with spiny leaves and bitter yellow sap. It is one of the most popular Digo medicines.
summary.sw: *Golonje* ni jina la Kidigo la mishubiri ya porini, mimea yenye majani manene yaliyopangwa kama duara, yenye miiba na utomvu mchungu wa manjano. Ni mojawapo ya dawa za Kidigo zinazopendwa zaidi.
summary.dg: *Golonje* ni dzina ra Chidigo ra mimea ya *aloe* ya weruni, mabunda ga makodza ga nyama genye miya, na utomvu wa rangi ya mandano wenye utsungu. Ni mwenga wa madawa ga Chidigo ganayomendzwa zaidi.

about.en:
*Golonje* grows as a rosette of thick, fleshy leaves edged with sharp teeth. Break a leaf and a bitter yellow sap oozes out, while the inside holds a clear gel.

In the dry season tall spikes rise from the centre of the rosette carrying tubular red or orange flowers, which are visited by sunbirds. Some kinds stay low and stemless, while others grow a short trunk.
about.sw:
*Golonje* hukua kama duara la majani manene yenye nyama, yaliyopakana na meno makali. Ukivunja jani, utomvu mchungu wa manjano hutiririka, huku ndani yake kukiwa na jeli safi.

Wakati wa kiangazi, mashada marefu huchipuka kutoka katikati ya duara la majani yakibeba maua mekundu au ya rangi ya chungwa yenye umbo la mrija, ambayo hutembelewa na ndege chozi. Aina nyingine hubaki chini bila shina, huku nyingine zikiotesha shina fupi.
about.dg:
*Golonje* rinamera dza bunda ra makodza maziho ga nyama, genye meno makali kanda-kanda. Vundza kodza, na utomvu wa rangi ya mandano wenye utsungu unatuluka, na ndani mwakpwe muna luhe ra kung'ala.

Wakati wa kazikazi milita mire inatuluka kahi ya bunda, ichihala maruwa ga kundu au ga rangi ya chungbwa ga dza mridza, ganayohendzwa ni vitsozi. Aina zanjina zinasala photsi bila kolo, na zanjina zinamera kolo fupi.

where.en: Look for *golonje* in rocky bushland and on coral rag, the old raised reef rock behind the coast. The flower spikes make it easy to spot from a distance.
where.sw: Mtafute *golonje* katika vichaka vya miamba na kwenye matumbawe, yaani mwamba wa zamani wa matumbawe ulioinuka nyuma ya pwani. Mashada ya maua huufanya kuwa rahisi kuuona ukiwa mbali.
where.dg: Hendza *golonje* weruni kpwenye mawe, na dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo, mawe ga kare ga mwamba wa bahari garigokala nyuma ya pwani. Milita ya maruwa inahenda riwe rahisi kurona kula kure.

uses.en: *Golonje* is among the most popular Digo medicines. The Digo of Diani infuse the leaves of several aloe species as a remedy for malaria.
uses.sw: *Golonje* ni miongoni mwa dawa za Kidigo zinazopendwa zaidi. Wadigo wa Diani hulowesha majani ya aina kadhaa za mishubiri kutengeneza dawa ya malaria.
uses.dg: *Golonje* ni mwenga wa madawa ga Chidigo ganayomendzwa zaidi. Adigo a Diani analweka makodza ga aina chache za *aloe* madzini kuhenda dawa ya homa.

culture.en: The Digo classify plants with care. An aloe is counted among the trees (*mihi*) only once it has grown a stem topped by a rosette; until then it is not considered a tree.
culture.sw: Wadigo huainisha mimea kwa uangalifu. Mshubiri huhesabiwa miongoni mwa miti (*mihi*) pale tu unapootesha shina lenye duara la majani juu yake; hadi hapo hauhesabiwi kuwa mti.
culture.dg: Adigo anaganya mimea sawa-sawa. Anaiisabu *aloe* kahi ya mihi (*mihi*) ichimera kolo renye bunda ra makodza dzulure; kabla ya phapho taionwa kukala muhi.

names.en: Digo: *golonje*, a name shared with Duruma and Giriama. English: aloe. In Swahili it is *mshubiri*. *Golonje* covers several species of *Aloe* rather than a single one.
names.sw: Kidigo: *golonje*, jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Kwa Kiingereza: *aloe*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mshubiri*. *Golonje* hujumuisha aina kadhaa za *Aloe* badala ya aina moja tu.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *golonje*, dzina rinarohumirwa piya ni Aduruma na Agiryama. Kpwa Chingereza ni *aloe*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mshubiri*. *Golonje* ni dzina ra aina nyinji za *Aloe*, si aina mwenga tu.

conservation.en: Many wild aloes are protected under international trade rules because they are collected heavily for medicine and gardens.
conservation.sw: Mishubiri mingi ya porini inalindwa chini ya sheria za kimataifa za biashara kwa sababu huvunwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya dawa na bustani.
conservation.dg: Aina nyinji za *aloe* za weruni zinarindwa ni shariya za biashara ya kahi ya tsi na tsi, kpwa sababu zinakusanywa sana kpwa dawa na kpwa busitani.

teaser.en: The stems of this grass help make the *kayamba*, the shaken rattle that keeps rhythm at coastal dances.
teaser.sw: Mashina ya nyasi hii husaidia kutengeneza *kayamba*, kayamba linalotikiswa kushika mdundo katika ngoma za pwani.
teaser.dg: Mihi ya nyasi hino inahumirwa kuhenda *kayamba*, chombo chinachosukwa ili kulunga mdundo kpwenye ngoma za pwani.

summary.en: *Mchuchi* is the name for the tall thatching grasses of grassland and fallow. It thatches roofs and supplies stems for the *kayamba* rattle.
summary.sw: *Mchuchi* ni jina la nyasi ndefu za kuezekea za nyika na mashamba yaliyoachwa. Huezeka paa na hutoa mashina ya kutengeneza kayamba, *kayamba*.
summary.dg: *Mchuchi* ni dzina ra nyasi ndefu za kuezekera za herera na minda iriyorichwa. Nkuezekera nyumba, na mihiye nkuhumirwa kuhenda *kayamba*.

about.en:
*Mchuchi* is a group of tall, tufted grasses that grow in dense clumps. Their flowering heads are distinctive: the spikelets come in pairs, each pair wrapped in a leaf-like sheath, giving the top of the stem a ragged, layered look.

As they dry, the grasses turn a warm reddish brown, which is where the English name 'red grass' comes from.
about.sw:
*Mchuchi* ni kundi la nyasi ndefu zinazoota kwa vichaka vizito. Vishada vyake vya maua vina sura ya pekee: vichanua huja kwa jozi, kila jozi ikiwa imefungwa ndani ya ala kama jani, na kuipa ncha ya shina sura chakavu yenye matabaka.

Zinapokauka, nyasi hizi hugeuka kuwa za rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu, na ndiko jina la Kiingereza *red grass* linakotoka.
about.dg:
*Mchuchi* ni fungu ra nyasi ndefu zinazomera mabunda ga kubanana. Vitswa vyao vya maruwa vinamanyikana upesi: tembe zinakala airi airi, na chila tembe mbiri zinafwinikpwa ni kodza dide, kpwa hivyo ntsa ya mlita inaonekana dza vipande-vipande na viungo-viungo.

Zichiuma, nyasi zinakala za rangi ya dongo ya kundu, na ndiko riphotuluka dzina ra Chingereza *red grass*.

where.en: Look for *mchuchi* in grassland and on fallow land. It is easiest to recognise late in the season, when the stands turn red-brown.
where.sw: Mtafute *mchuchi* katika nyika na kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa. Ni rahisi zaidi kuutambua mwishoni mwa msimu, vichaka vyake vinapogeuka kahawia-nyekundu.
where.dg: Hendza *mchuchi* kpwenye herera na minda iriyorichwa. Ni rahisi kuumanya wakati nyasi zinauma na kukala za rangi ya dongo ya kundu, phephi na mwisho wa kazikazi.

uses.en:
*Mchuchi* is cut for thatch, the long, tough stems laid in layers on roofs.

Its stems are also used to make the *kayamba*, the flat rattle of reed stems filled with seeds that is shaken to keep rhythm in coastal music.
uses.sw:
*Mchuchi* hukatwa kwa ajili ya kuezekea, mashina yake marefu na magumu yakipangwa kwa matabaka juu ya paa.

Mashina yake pia hutumika kutengeneza *kayamba*, kayamba bapa la mashina ya matete lililojazwa mbegu ambalo hutikiswa kushika mdundo katika muziki wa pwani.
uses.dg:
*Mchuchi* nkukatwa kpwa kuezekera, mihi mire na mifu ichiikpwa viungo-viungo dzulu ya nyumba.

Mihiye piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda *kayamba*, chombo chenye umbo ra sambamba chinachohendwa kpwa mihi ya mridza na chenye tembe ndani, chinachosukwa ili kulunga mdundo kpwenye mawira ga pwani.

names.en: Digo: *mchuchi*, also *mdembe*. Note that *mdembe* is also the name of a different thatching grass (*Hyperthelia dissoluta*). English: thatching grass or red grass. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists place it in the genus *Hyparrhenia*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mchuchi*, pia *mdembe*. Ifahamike kuwa *mdembe* pia ni jina la nyasi nyingine ya kuezekea (*Hyperthelia dissoluta*). Kwa Kiingereza: *thatching grass* au *red grass*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huiweka katika jenasi *Hyparrhenia*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mchuchi*, piya *mdembe*. Manya kukala *mdembe* piya ni dzina ra nyasi yanjina ya kuezekera (*Hyperthelia dissoluta*). Kpwa Chingereza ni *thatching grass* au *red grass*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Asayansi anaiika kpwenye jenasi ya *Hyparrhenia*.

reason.dg: Nyasi yanjina ya kuezekera inayoihwa piya *mdembe*

teaser.en: On the Shimba Hills grasslands, this tall grass turns red-brown in the dry season and has long been cut for roofs.
teaser.sw: Katika nyika za Shimba Hills, nyasi hii ndefu hugeuka kahawia-nyekundu wakati wa kiangazi na tangu zamani imekuwa ikikatwa kwa ajili ya kuezekea paa.
teaser.dg: Kpwenye herera za Shimba Hills, nyasi hino ndefu inakala ya rangi ya dongo ya kundu wakati wa kazikazi, na hangu kare nkukatwa kpwa kuezekera nyumba.

summary.en: *Mdembe* is a tall thatching grass of the Shimba Hills and coastal grassland. Its drooping, bristly heads turn red-brown as it dries.
summary.sw: *Mdembe* ni nyasi ndefu ya kuezekea ya Shimba Hills na nyika za pwani. Vishada vyake vinavyoinama, vyenye nywele ngumu, hugeuka kahawia-nyekundu inapokauka.
summary.dg: *Mdembe* ni nyasi ndefu ya kuezekera ya Shimba Hills na ya herera za pwani. Vitswavye vinavyobwadzika, vyenye nyere ndefu, vinakala vya rangi ya dongo ya kundu ichiuma.

about.en:
*Mdembe* is a tall, tufted grass that can stand well above head height. Its flowering heads droop, and each spikelet carries a long, twisted bristle (an awn), giving the heads a wispy look.

As the dry season comes, the whole plant turns red-brown.
about.sw:
*Mdembe* ni nyasi ndefu inayoota kwa vichaka, inayoweza kusimama juu zaidi ya kimo cha mtu. Vishada vyake vya maua huinama, na kila kichanua kina unywele mrefu mgumu uliojisokota, na kuvipa vishada sura nyepesi kama nywele.

Kiangazi kinapoingia, mmea mzima hugeuka kahawia-nyekundu.
about.dg:
*Mdembe* ni nyasi ndefu inayomera mabunda, inayoweza kuima dzulu kuriko chitswa cha mutu. Vitswavye vya maruwa vinabwadzika, na chila chitembe dide china nyere ndefu iriyosokotwa (*awn* kpwa Chingereza), kpwa hivyo vitswa vinaonekana dza nyuzi-nyuzi.

Wakati wa kazikazi uchifika, mmea wosi unakala wa rangi ya dongo ya kundu.

where.en: Look for *mdembe* in the Shimba Hills and in other coastal grassland. The red-brown stands are most striking in the dry season.
where.sw: Itafute *mdembe* katika Shimba Hills na katika nyika nyingine za pwani. Vichaka vyake vya kahawia-nyekundu huvutia zaidi wakati wa kiangazi.
where.dg: Hendza *mdembe* Shimba Hills na kpwenye herera zanjina za pwani. Mabunda ga rangi ya dongo ya kundu ganaonekana zaidi wakati wa kazikazi.

uses.en: *Mdembe* is used for thatching.
uses.sw: *Mdembe* hutumika kuezekea.
uses.dg: *Mdembe* nkuhumirwa kpwa kuezekera.

names.en: Digo: *mdembe*. The same name is also given as an alternative for *mchuchi* (*Hyparrhenia*), another thatching grass. English: thatching grass. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Hyperthelia dissoluta*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdembe*. Jina hili pia hutolewa kama jina mbadala la *mchuchi* (*Hyparrhenia*), nyasi nyingine ya kuezekea. Kwa Kiingereza: *thatching grass*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huiita *Hyperthelia dissoluta*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdembe*. Dzina hiri piya rinaandikpwa dza dzina ranjina ra *mchuchi* (*Hyparrhenia*), nyasi yanjina ya kuezekera. Kpwa Chingereza ni *thatching grass*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Hyperthelia dissoluta*.

teaser.en: Its spiky seeds hitch a ride on anyone who passes, and its Digo name, 'goat scratcher', says who suffers most.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake zenye miiba hujipandisha kwa kila apitaye, na jina lake la Kidigo, 'mkunaji mbuzi', linaeleza ni nani anayeteseka zaidi.
teaser.dg: Tembeze zenye miya nkugbwira nguwo za chila mutu anayetsupa phephi, na dzinare ra Chidigo, 'unaokpwaruza mbuzi', rinaonyesa ni ani anayegaya zaidi.

summary.en: *Mphulula mbuzi* is a common weedy herb whose bristly seeds cling to clothing and fur. Its Digo name, 'goat scratcher', describes its height and its habits exactly.
summary.sw: *Mphulula mbuzi* ni mmea wa kawaida wa magugu ambao mbegu zake zenye nywele ngumu hunata kwenye nguo na manyoya ya wanyama. Jina lake la Kidigo, 'mkunaji mbuzi', linaeleza kimo chake na tabia zake sawasawa.
summary.dg: *Mphulula mbuzi* ni mbondo ya kawaida, mmea mdide ambao tembeze zenye nyere ngumu zinagbwira nguwo na nyere za nyama. Dzinare ra Chidigo, 'unaokpwaruza mbuzi', rinaeleza sawa-sawa ure unaofika na tabiyaze.

about.en:
*Mphulula mbuzi* is an upright herb, usually about knee high, with soft, rounded leaves in pairs. Its stems end in long, thin spikes of small flowers.

As the flowers fade, each one turns down against the stem and becomes a small seed with stiff, sharp bristles. These hook into clothing, socks and animal fur, which is how the plant spreads.
about.sw:
*Mphulula mbuzi* ni mmea mdogo uliosimama wima, kwa kawaida wa kimo cha goti hivi, wenye majani laini ya mviringo yaliyopangwa kwa jozi. Mashina yake huishia kwa mashada marefu membamba ya maua madogo.

Maua yanaponyauka, kila moja hujigeuza chini kuelekea shina na kuwa mbegu ndogo yenye nywele ngumu na kali. Hizi hunasa kwenye nguo, soksi na manyoya ya wanyama, na ndivyo mmea huu unavyoenea.
about.dg:
*Mphulula mbuzi* ni mmea mdide uimao chocho, mara nyinji unafika hadi gotini, wenye makodza laini ga mviringo ganayomera mairi-mairi. Ntsa za mihiye kuna milita mire na myembamba yenye maruwa madide.

Maruwa gachinyala, chila ruwa rinainama photsi kulola muhi na rinakala tembe ndide yenye nyere ngumu na kali. Nyere hizi zinagbwira nguwo, sokisi na nyere za nyama, na hiyo ndiyo njira mmea hinyu unavyoenea.

where.en: Look for *mphulula mbuzi* on disturbed ground, along paths, around homesteads and on forest edges. You are most likely to notice it when you find its seeds stuck to your clothes.
where.sw: Mtafute *mphulula mbuzi* kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa, kando ya njia, kuzunguka makazi na kando ya misitu. Huenda ukauona zaidi pale unapokuta mbegu zake zimenata kwenye nguo zako.
where.dg: Hendza *mphulula mbuzi* phatu ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa, kanda-kanda ya njira, phephi na midzi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka. Mara nyinji undaumanya uchiona tembeze zikagbwira nguwozo.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu.

culture.en: The name *mphulula mbuzi* means 'goat scratcher'. The plant grows to about knee height, the height of a goat, and its fruits scratch goats and stick to them as they pass.
culture.sw: Jina *mphulula mbuzi* linamaanisha 'mkunaji mbuzi'. Mmea hukua hadi kimo cha goti hivi, ambacho ni kimo cha mbuzi, na matunda yake huwakuna mbuzi na kuwanata wanapopita.
culture.dg: Dzina *mphulula mbuzi* rina mana ya 'unaokpwaruza mbuzi'. Mmea hinyu unakula hadi gotini, ure sawa na wa mbuzi, na matundage ganakpwaruza mbuzi na kuagbwira anaphotsupa.

names.en: Digo: *mphulula mbuzi*, 'goat scratcher', a name shared with Duruma. English: devil's horsewhip or prickly chaff flower. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Achyranthes aspera*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mphulula mbuzi*, 'mkunaji mbuzi', jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma. Kwa Kiingereza: *devil's horsewhip* au *prickly chaff flower*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Achyranthes aspera*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mphulula mbuzi*, 'unaokpwaruza mbuzi', dzina ambaro Aduruma nao anarihumira. Kpwa Chingereza ni *devil's horsewhip* au *prickly chaff flower*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Achyranthes aspera*.

teaser.en: Its Digo name means 'mixer', for its role in blending medicines against stomach-ache.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linamaanisha 'mchanganyaji', kutokana na kazi yake ya kuchanganya dawa za kutibu maumivu ya tumbo.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rina mana ya 'unaotsanganya', kpwa sababu ya kaziye ya kutsanganywa na vitu vyanjina kuhenda dawa ya ndani kuluma.

summary.en: *Mvuga* is a fleshy, aromatic herb of rocky places and bush. It is used in a medicine mixture against stomach-ache.
summary.sw: *Mvuga* ni mmea mdogo wenye majani manene na harufu nzuri wa sehemu za miamba na vichakani. Hutumika katika mchanganyiko wa dawa ya maumivu ya tumbo.
summary.dg: *Mvuga* ni mmea mdide wa madzi-madzi wenye arufu nono, unaomera phatu phenye mawe na weruni. Nkutsanganywa na vitu vyanjina kuhenda dawa ya ndani kuluma.

about.en:
*Mvuga* is a small succulent herb with thick, fleshy leaves edged with teeth. Rub a leaf and it releases a strong aromatic smell, typical of the mint family to which it belongs.

Its small flowers are borne on upright spikes.
about.sw:
*Mvuga* ni mmea mdogo wenye majani manene yenye nyama yaliyopakana na meno. Ukisugua jani hutoa harufu kali nzuri, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia ya minanaa ambayo ni yake.

Maua yake madogo huzaliwa juu ya mashada yaliyosimama wima.
about.dg:
*Mvuga* ni mmea mdide wenye madzi manji ndani, na makodza maziho ga nyama genye meno kanda-kanda. Uchisiriga kodza, rinalavya arufu kali, tabiya ya jamii ya *mint*; na *mvuga* ni wa jamii hiyo.

Maruwage madide ganamera kpwenye milita iimayo chocho.

where.en: Look for *mvuga* in rocky places and in bush, often growing in pockets of soil among stones.
where.sw: Mtafute *mvuga* katika sehemu za miamba na vichakani, mara nyingi ukiota katika vishimo vya udongo katikati ya mawe.
where.dg: Hendza *mvuga* phatu phenye mawe na weruni, mara nyinji uchimera kpwenye mashimo ga ulongo kahi ya mawe.

uses.en: *Mvuga* is used in a medicine mixture against stomach-ache.
uses.sw: *Mvuga* hutumika katika mchanganyiko wa dawa ya maumivu ya tumbo.
uses.dg: *Mvuga* nkuhumirwa kpwenye dawa ya ndani kuluma, ambayo nkutsanganywa na vitu vyanjina.

culture.en: The name *mvuga* means 'mixer', which fits its use as one ingredient in a blended remedy.
culture.sw: Jina *mvuga* linamaanisha 'mchanganyaji', jambo linaloendana na matumizi yake kama kiungo kimoja katika dawa iliyochanganywa.
culture.dg: Dzina *mvuga* rina mana ya 'unaotsanganya', na rinalingana na kaziye dza chitu chimwenga kahi ya vitu vinavyotsanganywa kuhenda dawa.

names.en: Digo: *mvuga*, also *mumbu* and *galagala tsui*. *Mumbu* is shared with Giriama. The Mgombato dictionary uses *mumbu* for a different plant, *Artabotrys* or *Annona uncinata*, so the name may cover more than one species. No English or Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Plectranthus tenuiflorus*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mvuga*, pia *mumbu* na *galagala tsui*. *Mumbu* linatumika pia kwa Kigiriama. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia *mumbu* kwa mmea mwingine, *Artabotrys* au *Annona uncinata*, kwa hivyo huenda jina hili linahusu zaidi ya spishi moja. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Plectranthus tenuiflorus*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mvuga*, piya *mumbu* na *galagala tsui*. *Mumbu* ni dzina ra Chigiryama piya. Kamusi ya Mgombato inahumira *mumbu* kpwa mmea wanjina, *Artabotrys* au *Annona uncinata*, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinaweza kukala ni ra aina zaidi ya mwenga. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Plectranthus tenuiflorus*.

teaser.en: It grows so thick that animals get trapped in it, and its stiff hairs make humans itch too.
teaser.sw: Hukua kwa wingi kiasi kwamba wanyama hunaswa ndani yake, na nywele zake ngumu huwawasha binadamu pia.
teaser.dg: Unamera phephi-phephi sana hata nyama anagbwirwa mwakpwe ndani, na atu nao anaawiwa ni nyereze ngumu.

summary.en: *Mwambanyama* is itch grass, a coarse, tall grass of fallow and disturbed ground with irritating stiff hairs. Its Digo name, 'animal trapper', describes how densely it grows.
summary.sw: *Mwambanyama* ni *itch grass*, nyasi ndefu na ngumu ya mashamba yaliyoachwa na ardhi iliyovurugwa, yenye nywele ngumu zinazowasha. Jina lake la Kidigo, 'mtega wanyama', linaeleza jinsi inavyoota kwa wingi.
summary.dg: *Mwambanyama* ni *itch grass*, nyasi nyire na ngumu ya minda iriyorichwa na tsi iriyobanangwa, yenye nyere ngumu zinazohenda ngozi iawiwe. Dzinare ra Chidigo, 'unaogbwira nyama', rinaeleza vira unavyomera phephi-phephi.

about.en:
*Mwambanyama* is a tall, coarse grass with broad leaves. Its leaf sheaths are covered in stiff, sharp hairs that break off and irritate the skin, which gives it the English name 'itch grass'.

The flowering heads are thin, cylindrical spikes that break apart into segments when ripe.
about.sw:
*Mwambanyama* ni nyasi ndefu na ngumu yenye majani mapana. Ala za majani yake zimefunikwa kwa nywele ngumu na kali zinazokatika na kuwasha ngozi, na ndiko jina la Kiingereza *itch grass* linakotoka.

Vishada vya maua ni mashada membamba ya mviringo yanayovunjika kuwa pingili yakiiva.
about.dg:
*Mwambanyama* ni nyasi nyire na ngumu yenye makodza mapana. Photsi ya makodzage, phatu ganaphozunguluka muhi, phana nyere ngumu na kali zinazovundzika na kuhenda ngozi iawiwe; ndiyo mana kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *itch grass*.

Vitswa vya maruwa ni milita myembamba na ya mviringo inayovundzika vipande-vipande ichiivwa.

where.en: Look for *mwambanyama* on fallow land and disturbed ground, including the edges of farms. It can form dense, almost impassable stands.
where.sw: Itafute *mwambanyama* kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa na ardhi iliyovurugwa, ikiwemo kando ya mashamba. Inaweza kufanya vichaka vizito visivyopitika kwa urahisi.
where.dg: Hendza *mwambanyama* kpwenye minda iriyorichwa na tsi iriyobanangwa, phamwenga na kanda-kanda ya minda. Unaweza kumera phephi-phephi sana hadi ikakala vigumu kutsupa.

uses.en:
The Digo boil the leaves as a remedy for malaria.

On farms it is a troublesome weed, competing hard with crops such as maize.
uses.sw:
Wadigo huchemsha majani yake kama dawa ya malaria.

Mashambani ni gugu sumbufu, linaloshindana vikali na mazao kama mahindi.
uses.dg:
Adigo nkuchemusha makodzage kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria).

Mindani ni mbondo inayosumbua sana, inayotsomana na mimea ya munda dza pemba.

culture.en: *Mwambanyama* means 'animal trapper'. It grows so densely that animals passing through can become trapped in it.
culture.sw: *Mwambanyama* linamaanisha 'mtega wanyama'. Huota kwa wingi kiasi kwamba wanyama wanaopita ndani yake wanaweza kunaswa.
culture.dg: Dzina *mwambanyama* rina mana ya 'unaogbwira nyama'. Unamera phephi-phephi sana hata nyama anaotsupa mwakpwe ndani anaweza kugbwirwa.

names.en: Digo: *mwambanyama*, 'animal trapper'. English: itch grass. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Rottboellia exaltata* (also known as *R. cochinchinensis*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *mwambanyama*, 'mtega wanyama'. Kwa Kiingereza: *itch grass*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huiita *Rottboellia exaltata* (pia hujulikana kama *R. cochinchinensis*).
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mwambanyama*, 'unaogbwira nyama'. Kpwa Chingereza ni *itch grass*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Rottboellia exaltata* (piya unamanyikana dza *R. cochinchinensis*).

reason.sw: Nyasi ndefu ya mashamba yale yale yaliyoachwa
reason.dg: Nyasi nyire inayomera kpwenye minda iriyorichwa phapho phapho

reason.sw: Nyasi nyingine ndefu ya mashamba yaliyoachwa

reason.dg: Nacho nkuchemuswa kuhenda dawa ya homa

teaser.en: In hungry times, this plant's bitter tuber can be washed and washed until it yields a clean white starch.
teaser.sw: Nyakati za njaa, kiazi kichungu cha mmea huu kinaweza kuoshwa na kuoshwa tena hadi kitoe wanga safi mweupe.
teaser.dg: Wakati wa ndzala, atu anaweza kuchisuwa chiazi cha utsungu cha mmea hinyu tsona na tsona, hadi chilavye wanga mwereru na safi.

summary.en: *Ulanga* is Polynesian arrowroot, a herb of sandy coastal bushland with a starchy round tuber. Once the bitterness is washed out, the tuber yields starch and has served as a famine food.
summary.sw: *Ulanga* ni mmea mdogo wa vichaka vya pwani vyenye mchanga, wenye kiazi cha mviringo chenye wanga (kwa Kiingereza *Polynesian arrowroot*). Uchungu ukishaoshwa, kiazi hutoa wanga na kimewahi kutumika kama chakula cha wakati wa njaa.
summary.dg: *Ulanga* ni *Polynesian arrowroot*, mmea mdide wa weruni wa pwani wenye mtsanga, na chiazi cha mviringo chenye wanga. Utsungu uchiuswa kpwa kuchisuwa, chiazi chinalavya wanga, na chikahumirwa dza chakurya cha wakati wa ndzala.

about.en:
*Ulanga* grows from a round underground tuber. Each season it sends up one large leaf, deeply cut into many lobes, on a tall stalk.

The flowers are unusual: they grow in an umbrella-shaped cluster at the top of a separate stalk, with long, thread-like bracts trailing down from them like whiskers. The plant dies back in the dry season.
about.sw:
*Ulanga* huota kutoka kiazi cha mviringo kilicho chini ya ardhi. Kila msimu hutoa jani moja kubwa, lililokatika kwa kina kuwa sehemu nyingi, juu ya kikonyo kirefu.

Maua yake ni ya ajabu: hukua katika kishada chenye umbo la mwavuli juu ya kikonyo kingine, na vikaratasi virefu kama nyuzi vikining'inia kutoka kwake kama sharubu. Mmea hunyauka wakati wa kiangazi.
about.dg:
*Ulanga* unamera kula chiazi cha mviringo chiricho tsini. Chila mwaka wa mvula unatuluza kodza kulu mwenga, ririroganywa kpwa mala manji, dzulu ya mlita mure.

Maruwage ni ga ajabu: ganamera kpwa fungu dza mwamvuri dzulu ya mlita wanjina, na nyuzi mare dza nyere zinazotserera photsi kula kpwa maruwa dza cheru. Seemu ya dzulu ya mmea inauma wakati wa kazikazi.

where.en: Look for *ulanga* in coastal bushland on sandy soils. It is easiest to see in the rains, when the single big leaf and the whiskered flower head appear.
where.sw: Mtafute *ulanga* katika vichaka vya pwani kwenye udongo wa mchanga. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona wakati wa mvua, jani lake moja kubwa na kishada cha maua chenye sharubu vinapotokea.
where.dg: Hendza *ulanga* weruni wa pwani kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga. Ni rahisi kuuona wakati wa mvula, kodza kulu mwenga na chitswa cha maruwa chenye 'cheru' vichizuka.

uses.en: The tuber is bitter when raw and cannot be eaten as it is. Once the bitterness has been washed out, it yields a fine starch, and in times of hunger *ulanga* has been used as a famine food.
uses.sw: Kiazi ni kichungu kikiwa kibichi na hakiwezi kuliwa hivyo hivyo. Uchungu ukishaoshwa, hutoa wanga laini, na nyakati za njaa *ulanga* umewahi kutumika kama chakula cha wakati wa njaa.
uses.dg: Chiazi chichikala chiitsi china utsungu, na tachirika dza chirivyo. Utsungu uchiuswa kpwa kuchisuwa, chinalavya wanga laini, na wakati wa ndzala *ulanga* ukahumirwa dza chakurya.

culture.en: One of its names, *muhi wa nyoka*, means 'snake plant'.
culture.sw: Mojawapo ya majina yake, *muhi wa nyoka*, linamaanisha 'mmea wa nyoka'.
culture.dg: Dzina mwenga kahi ya madzinage, *muhi wa nyoka*, rina mana ya 'mmea wa nyoka'.

names.en: Digo: *ulanga*, also *muhi wa nyoka*, 'snake plant'. Swahili: *ulanga*. English: Polynesian arrowroot. Scientists call it *Tacca leontopetaloides*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *ulanga*, pia *muhi wa nyoka*, 'mmea wa nyoka'. Kiswahili: *ulanga*. Kwa Kiingereza: *Polynesian arrowroot*. Wanasayansi huuita *Tacca leontopetaloides*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *ulanga*, piya *muhi wa nyoka*, 'mmea wa nyoka'. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *ulanga*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *Polynesian arrowroot*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Tacca leontopetaloides*.

reason.en: Bitter yam, another tuber that needs careful preparation
reason.sw: Kiazi kikuu kichungu, kiazi kingine kinachohitaji kutayarishwa kwa uangalifu
reason.dg: Chiazi chanjina cha utsungu (bitter yam) chinachohitaji kutengezwa sawa-sawa kabla ya kuriwa

reason.en: Cassava, the everyday starchy root
reason.sw: Mhogo, kiazi cha wanga cha kila siku
reason.dg: Manga, muzi wenye wanga unaoriwa chila siku

reason.en: Cycad, another famine food
reason.sw: Msapo, chakula kingine cha wakati wa njaa
reason.dg: Chakurya chanjina cha wakati wa ndzala (cycad)

reason.en: Sweet potato, a cultivated tuber
reason.sw: Kiazi kitamu, kiazi kinacholimwa
reason.dg: Muyogbwe, chiazi chinachophandwa

teaser.en: Cotton once earned cash on Kwale farms, and its wild cousin still grows as a liana in the coastal forest.
teaser.sw: Zamani pamba iliwaletea wakulima wa Kwale pesa, na binamu yake wa porini bado hukua kama mtambaa msituni pwani.
teaser.dg: Kare pamba kala inalavya pesa kpwenye minda ya Kwale, na nduguye wa tsaka bado inamera dza mmea unaofyombera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani.

summary.en: Cotton is a shrub grown for the white fibre that bursts from its bolls. On the south coast it was a minor cash crop, grown for fibre and income.
summary.sw: Pamba ni kichaka kinachopandwa kwa ajili ya nyuzi nyeupe zinazopasuka kutoka kwenye matumba yake. Pwani ya kusini lilikuwa zao dogo la biashara, lililopandwa kwa nyuzi na kipato.
summary.dg: Pamba ni chitsaka chinachophandwa kpwa sababu ya nyuzi nyereru zinazotuluka kula makakayage. Pwani ya kusini kala ni mmea mdide wa biashara, unaophandwa kpwa nyuzi na kpwa pesa.

about.en:
Cotton is a bushy shrub with broad, lobed leaves and large, cup-shaped flowers, cream or pale yellow when they open and turning pink as they fade, as in other members of the mallow family.

Each flower is followed by a rounded capsule, the boll, which splits open when ripe to show the seeds wrapped in soft white fibre.
about.sw:
Pamba ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi, majani mapana yenye mapengo, na maua makubwa yenye umbo la kikombe, ya rangi ya krimu au manjano hafifu yanapochanua na yanayogeuka waridi yanaponyauka, kama ilivyo kwa mimea mingine ya familia ya mibamia (*mallow*).

Kila ua hufuatwa na tumba la mviringo, ambalo hupasuka likishaiva na kuonyesha mbegu zilizofunikwa kwa nyuzi laini nyeupe.
about.dg:
Pamba ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji, makodza mapana genye mala, na maruwa makulu ga umbo ra chikombe. Maruwa gachivugulika ni ga rangi ya maziya au ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, na gachinyala ganagaluka kukala ga rangi ya pinki, dza mimea yanjina ya jamii ya *mallow*.

Chila ruwa richimala, kunamera kakaya ra mviringo, ambaro rinaahuka richiivwa na kuonyesa tembe zirizofwinikpwa ni nyuzi nyereru laini.

where.en: Cotton has been grown on farms in Kwale County as a minor cash crop, mostly in the past. Today it is far less common than cashew, coconut or sesame.
where.sw: Pamba imekuwa ikipandwa kwenye mashamba katika Kaunti ya Kwale kama zao dogo la biashara, hasa zamani. Leo si ya kawaida kama mkorosho, mnazi au ufuta.
where.dg: Pamba ikaphandwa kpwenye minda ya Kaunti ya Kwale dza mmea mdide wa biashara, zaidi kare. Sambi taiphahikana sana dza ngorosho, minazi au ufuha.

uses.en: Cotton is grown for its fibre, which is spun into thread and woven into cloth, and for the cash income it brings to farmers who sell the harvest.
uses.sw: Pamba hupandwa kwa nyuzi zake, ambazo husokotwa kuwa uzi na kufumwa kuwa kitambaa, na kwa kipato inachowaletea wakulima wanaouza mavuno.
uses.dg: Pamba inaphandwa kpwa nyuzize, ambazo nkusokotwa kuhenda uzi na nkusukwa kuhenda nguwo, na kpwa pesa inazoreha kpwa akurima anaoguza mavuno.

names.en: In Digo, cotton is *pamba*, the same word as in Swahili; the Mgombato dictionary records it in passing. In English it is cotton, and botanists know the cultivated cottons as species of *Gossypium*.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo, pamba ni *pamba*, neno lile lile la Kiswahili; kamusi ya Mgombato inalitaja kwa kupita. Kwa Kiingereza ni *cotton*, na wataalamu wa mimea huzijua pamba zinazolimwa kama spishi za *Gossypium*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo, pamba ni *pamba*, neno sawa na ra Chiswahili; Mgombato unarilavya tu kpwa kutsupa. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *cotton*, na kpwa chisayansi pamba zinazophandwa ni aina za *Gossypium*.

reason.en: Wild cotton, a liana relative of the coastal forest
reason.sw: Pamba-mwitu, mtambaa wa jamii yake wa misitu ya pwani
reason.dg: Pamba ya tsaka, mmea unaofyombera wa matsaka ga pwani

reason.en: Kapok, another plant grown for fibre
reason.sw: Msufi, mmea mwingine unaopandwa kwa nyuzi
reason.dg: Msufi, mmea wanjina unaophandwa kpwa nyuzi

reason.en: Sesame, another dry-farm cash crop
reason.sw: Ufuta, zao lingine la biashara la mashamba makavu
reason.dg: Ufuha, mmea wanjina wa biashara wa minda mikavu

reason.en: Tobacco, another minor cash crop
reason.sw: Tumbaku, zao lingine dogo la biashara
reason.dg: Tumbaku, mmea wanjina mdide wa biashara
