definition.en: The woolly fruit of cotton, both planted cotton and the wild pamba mwitu. Probably borrowed from Persian through Swahili.
definition.sw: Tunda lenye nyuzi kama sufu la pamba, ya kupandwa na ile ya porini, pamba mwitu. Huenda lilikopwa kutoka Kiajemi kupitia Kiswahili.
definition.dg: Tunda ra pamba renye nyuzi-nyuzi, kpwa pamba inayophandwa na kpwa *pamba mwitu* ya tsaka. Pengine rikalavywa kula Chiajemi kpwa njira ya Chiswahili.

digo_source: Mgombato ('kunde cowpea'; 'mtsafwe cowpea leaves eaten as a vegetable'); Pakia ('Kunde')

teaser.en: On the coast the cowpea is eaten twice: first its tender leaves as *mtsafwe*, then its black-eyed beans cooked in coconut milk.
teaser.sw: Pwani kunde huliwa mara mbili: kwanza majani yake machanga kama *mtsafwe*, kisha punje zake zenye 'jicho' jeusi zikipikwa kwa tui la nazi.
teaser.dg: Pwani, kunde nkuriwa mara mbiri: kpwandza makodzage malaini dza *mtsafwe*, chisha tembeze zenye alama nyiru, zichijitwa na huwi.

summary.en: *Kunde* is the cowpea or black-eyed bean, grown among maize and cassava on Digo farms. Both its seeds and its young leaves, *mtsafwe*, are favourite foods.
summary.sw: *Kunde* ni mmea wa kunde, unaopandwa katikati ya mahindi na mihogo kwenye mashamba ya Wadigo. Mbegu zake na majani yake machanga, *mtsafwe*, ni vyakula vinavyopendwa sana.
summary.dg: *Kunde* ni mmea unaoihwa *cowpea* au *black-eyed bean* kpwa Chingereza, unaophandwa kahi ya matsere na manga kpwenye minda ya Adigo. Tembeze na makodzage malaini, *mtsafwe*, ni vyakurya vinavyomendzwa sana.

about.en:
*Kunde* is a bean plant that grows either as a low bush or as a climber, depending on the variety. Its leaves have three leaflets, and its flowers are pale purple or white. The pods are long and slender, holding a row of kidney-shaped seeds, often cream with a dark 'eye' where the seed was attached.

Digo farmers grow several named cultivars, including *chifumbatele*, *koroboi*, *zonga* and *chimakoko*.
about.sw:
*Kunde* ni mmea wa jamii ya maharagwe unaokua kama kichaka kifupi au kama mtambaa, kutegemea aina yake. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu, na maua yake ni ya zambarau hafifu au meupe. Maganda yake ni marefu na membamba, na ndani yana safu ya mbegu zenye umbo la figo, mara nyingi za rangi ya krimu zenye 'jicho' jeusi mahali mbegu ilipokuwa imeshikamana.

Wakulima wa Kidigo hupanda aina kadhaa zenye majina yake, zikiwemo *chifumbatele*, *koroboi*, *zonga* na *chimakoko*.
about.dg:
*Kunde* ni mmea wa jamii ya kunde. Aina zanjina zinamera photsi dza vitsaka, na zanjina zinafyombera. Makodzage ganamera mahahu-mahahu, na maruwage ni ga rangi ya zambarau ngushu-ngushu au ga rangi nyereru. Makakaya ni mare na membamba, na ndani kuna mstari wa tembe za umbo ra figo, mara nyinji za rangi ya maziya, zenye 'dzitso' ra rangi nyiru phatu tembe iriphokala inagbwirana na kakaya.

Akurima a Adigo anaphanda aina nyinji zenye madzina, phamwenga na *chifumbatele*, *koroboi*, *zonga* na *chimakoko*.

where.en: *Kunde* is a farm crop, usually intercropped with maize and cassava in the same field. Look for it on family farms across Kwale during the rains, scrambling between the maize stalks.
where.sw: *Kunde* ni zao la shambani, kwa kawaida hupandwa pamoja na mahindi na mihogo katika shamba moja. Wakati wa mvua utaiona kwenye mashamba ya familia kote Kwale, ikitambaa katikati ya mabua ya mahindi.
where.dg: *Kunde* ni mmea wa mndani; mara nyinji inaphandwa phamwenga na matsere na manga kpwenye munda mmwenga. Wakati wa mvula, unaweza kuiona kpwenye minda ya mbari kosi Kwale, ichifyombera kahi ya milita ya matsere.

uses.en:
The dried seeds are cooked either plain or with coconut milk, a common coastal dish. Before cooking, they are sometimes ground to remove the skins, a job with its own Digo verb, *paza*.

The young leaves, called *mtsafwe*, are one of the favourite greens. They are picked while the plants are growing and cooked as a vegetable, so the crop feeds the family long before the beans are ready.
uses.sw:
Mbegu zilizokaushwa hupikwa bila kitu au kwa tui la nazi, mlo wa kawaida wa pwani. Kabla ya kupikwa, wakati mwingine husagwa ili kuondoa maganda, kazi yenye kitenzi chake cha Kidigo, *paza*.

Majani machanga, yanayoitwa *mtsafwe*, ni mojawapo ya mboga za majani zinazopendwa zaidi. Huchumwa mimea ikiwa bado inakua na kupikwa kama mboga, hivyo zao hili hulisha familia muda mrefu kabla kunde zenyewe hazijakomaa.
uses.dg:
Tembe zikauma nkujitwa bila huwi au na huwi, chakurya cha kawaida cha pwani. Kabla ya kujitwa, wakati wanjina nkusagbwa kuusa magada, kazi yenye neno rakpwe ra Chidigo, *paza*.

Makodza malaini, ganayoihwa *mtsafwe*, ni kahi ya mboga zinazomendzwa sana. Nkudolwa mimea ichikala bado inakula na nkujitwa dza mboga, kpwa hivyo mmea uhu unarisa mbari muda mure kabla ya tembe kukala tayari.

names.en: Digo: *kunde* for the plant and the beans, and *mtsafwe* for the leaves eaten as a vegetable. Swahili: *kunde*, with the leaves called *majani ya kunde*. English: cowpea or black-eyed bean. Scientists call it *Vigna unguiculata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *kunde* kwa mmea na kwa punje zake, na *mtsafwe* kwa majani yanayoliwa kama mboga. Kiswahili: *kunde*, na majani huitwa *majani ya kunde*. Kwa Kiingereza: *cowpea* au *black-eyed bean*. Wanasayansi huuita *Vigna unguiculata*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *kunde* kpwa mmea na kpwa tembe, na *mtsafwe* kpwa makodza ganayoriwa dza mboga. Kpwa Chiswahili: *kunde*, na makodza nkuihwa *majani ya kunde*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *cowpea* au *black-eyed bean*. Kpwa chisayansi inaihwa *Vigna unguiculata*.

reason.sw: Pojo, jamii nyingine ya Vigna inayopikwa kwa nazi
reason.dg: Podzo, mbeyu yanjina ya *Vigna* inayojitwa na huwi

reason.en: Bambara groundnut, also a Vigna
reason.sw: Njugu mawe, nayo ni jamii ya Vigna
reason.dg: Tendegbwa, piya ni *Vigna*

reason.en: Maize, grown in the same fields
reason.sw: Mahindi, yanayopandwa katika mashamba hayo hayo
reason.dg: Matsere, ganaphandwa kpwenye minda iyo iyo

reason.en: Cassava, its usual intercrop
reason.sw: Muhogo, zao linalopandwa nayo kwa kawaida
reason.dg: Manga, anaophandwa phamwenga na kunde mara nyinji

teaser.en: Breakfast on the coast often means *mbaazi za nazi*, pigeon peas simmered in coconut milk and eaten with *mahamri*.
teaser.sw: Kifungua kinywa cha pwani mara nyingi humaanisha *mbaazi za nazi*, mbaazi zilizopikwa taratibu kwa tui la nazi na kuliwa pamoja na *mahamri*.
teaser.dg: Pwani, chai ya ligundzu mara nyinji ni *mbaazi za nazi*: mbalazi zirizojitwa na huwi na kuriwa phamwenga na *mahamri*.

summary.en: *M'balazi* is the pigeon pea, a hardy shrubby pulse grown on farm edges across the coast. Its peas, cooked in coconut milk, are part of the classic coastal breakfast.
summary.sw: *M'balazi* ni mbaazi, jamii ya kunde inayofanana na kichaka na inayostahimili hali ngumu, inayolimwa pembezoni mwa mashamba kote pwani. Mbaazi zake, zikipikwa kwa tui la nazi, ni sehemu ya kifungua kinywa maarufu cha pwani.
summary.dg: *M'balazi* ni muhi wa mbalazi, chitsaka chigumu cha jamii ya kunde chinachophandwa maso ga minda kosi pwani. Mbalazi, zichijitwa na huwi, ni seemu ya chai ya ligundzu ya kawaida ya pwani.

about.en:
*M'balazi* is a woody shrub 1 to 3 m tall, with leaves of three narrow, soft leaflets and bright yellow flowers, sometimes streaked with red. The flowers are followed by flat, hairy pods with constrictions between the seeds.

The peas come in different colours, and Digo farmers name them by colour: *nyereru*, *mnjindo* and *bombo*.
about.sw:
*M'balazi* ni kichaka chenye shina gumu kama la mti chenye urefu wa mita 1 hadi 3, chenye majani ya vijani vitatu vyembamba na laini na maua ya manjano angavu, wakati mwingine yenye michirizi myekundu. Baada ya maua huja makaka bapa yenye manyoya, yaliyobanwa kati ya mbegu moja na nyingine.

Mbaazi huwa na rangi tofauti, na wakulima Wadigo huzipa majina kulingana na rangi: *nyereru*, *mnjindo* na *bombo*.
about.dg:
*M'balazi* ni chitsaka chigumu cha mita mwenga hadi tahu. Makodzage ganamera mahahu-mahahu, membamba na malaini, na maruwage ni ga rangi ya mandano inayoala, wakati wanjina na mistari ya kundu. Maruwa gachimala, kunamera makakaya ga bapa genye nyere, ganayokala membamba kahi ya tembe na tembe.

Mbalazi zina rangi za tafwauti, na akurima a Adigo anaziiha kpwa rangi zao: *nyereru*, *mnjindo* na *bombo*.

where.en: Look for *m'balazi* on the edges of farms and around homesteads, where it often stands as a living border. It is drought-tolerant and keeps going on dry, sandy ground after other crops have finished.
where.sw: Tafuta *m'balazi* pembezoni mwa mashamba na kuzunguka maboma, ambako mara nyingi husimama kama ua hai. Huvumilia ukame na huendelea kustawi kwenye ardhi kavu ya mchanga baada ya mazao mengine kumaliza msimu wake.
where.dg: Unaweza kuuona *m'balazi* maso ga minda na kuzunguluka midzi, ambapho mara nyinji unaima dza lichigo hai. Unavumirira ukame, na unaenderera kumera kpwenye tsi kavu ya mtsanga bada ya mimea yanjina kumala.

uses.en:
The dried peas are cooked in coconut milk as *mbaazi za nazi*, the classic coast breakfast with *mahamri*, the cardamom-scented fried dough.

Nothing goes to waste. The woody stems are used for firewood once the harvest is over, and the leaves are fed to livestock. Like other legumes, the plant fixes nitrogen and so enriches the soil it grows in.
uses.sw:
Mbaazi zilizokaushwa hupikwa kwa tui la nazi kama *mbaazi za nazi*, kifungua kinywa maarufu cha pwani pamoja na *mahamri*, maandazi yaliyokaangwa yenye harufu ya iliki.

Hakuna kinachopotea bure. Mashina magumu hutumika kama kuni mavuno yakishamalizika, na majani hulishwa mifugo. Kama mimea mingine ya jamii ya mikunde, mmea huu hufunga naitrojeni na hivyo hurutubisha udongo unaoota ndani yake.
uses.dg:
Mbalazi zikauma nkujitwa na huwi zichikala *mbaazi za nazi*, chai ya ligundzu ya kawaida ya pwani phamwenga na *mahamri*, mikahe ya kukalangwa yenye arufu ya iliki.

Takuna chitu chinachoangamika. Mihiye mifu nkuhumirwa dza kuni bada ya mavuno, na makodzage nkuriswa mifugo. Dza mimea yanjina ya jamii ya kunde, *m'balazi* unaika naitrojeni tsini na kpwa hivyo unaenjereza chinemi cha tsi ambamo unamera.

culture.en: The Mgombato dictionary uses this plant to illustrate a feature of Digo sound: *m'balazi*, with a short syllabic *m* before *b*, is the plant, while *mbalazi* is the pea itself.
culture.sw: Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia mmea huu kuonyesha sifa moja ya sauti za Kidigo: *m'balazi*, yenye *m* fupi ya silabi kabla ya *b*, ni mmea, huku *mbalazi* ikiwa ni mbaazi yenyewe.
culture.dg: Mgombato unahumira muhi uhu kuonyesa dzambo ra sauti za Chidigo: *m'balazi*, yenye *m* fupi ya silabi mbere ya *b*, ni muhi, na *mbalazi* ni tembe yenye.

names.en: Digo: *m'balazi* (the plant) and *mbalazi* (the pea). Giriama, Chonyi and Kambe also say *mbalazi*. Swahili: *mbaazi*. English: pigeon pea. Scientists call it *Cajanus cajan*. Mgombato also applies *m'balazi* to the wild pigeon pea, *Eriosema psoraleoides*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *m'balazi* (mmea) na *mbalazi* (mbaazi). Kigiriama, Kichonyi na Kikambe pia husema *mbalazi*. Kiswahili: *mbaazi*. Kiingereza: *pigeon pea*. Wanasayansi huuita *Cajanus cajan*. Mgombato pia hutumia *m'balazi* kwa mbaazi mwitu, *Eriosema psoraleoides*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *m'balazi* (muhi) na *mbalazi* (tembe). Agiriama, Achonyi na Akambe nao anaamba *mbalazi*. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mbaazi*, kpwa Chingereza *pigeon pea*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Cajanus cajan*. Mgombato piya unaiha mbalazi tsaka, *Eriosema psoraleoides*, kukala *m'balazi*.

teaser.en: The cashew grows its nut on the outside, hanging beneath a juicy 'apple' that most harvesters simply leave on the ground.
teaser.sw: Mkorosho huzaa kokwa yake nje, ikining'inia chini ya 'tunda' lenye majimaji ambalo wavunaji wengi hulitelekeza tu ardhini.
teaser.dg: M'bibo unavyala ngorosho kondze, inabwadzika photsi ya *bibo* ra madzi-madzi ambaro anji ario anangobola anariricha photsi bahi.

summary.en: *M'bibo* is the cashew tree, the premier cash crop of Kwale homesteads and farms. Its nuts bring income to thousands of families, and the Digo language has a whole vocabulary for its fruit.
summary.sw: *M'bibo* ni mkorosho, zao kuu la biashara katika maboma na mashamba ya Kwale. Korosho zake huleta kipato kwa maelfu ya familia, na lugha ya Kidigo ina msamiati mzima wa tunda lake.
summary.dg: *M'bibo* ni muhi wa ngorosho, mmea wa kpwanza wa mapato kpwa midzi na minda ya Kwale. Ngoroshoze zinareha mapato kpwa maelufu ga mbari, na luga ya Chidigo ina maneno manji kpwa matundage.

about.en:
*M'bibo* is a spreading evergreen tree with large, leathery, rounded leaves and a low, wide crown. Its small pinkish flowers grow in loose clusters at the branch tips.

The fruit is unusual. What looks like the fruit is a swollen fleshy stalk, the cashew apple or *bibo*, red or yellow when ripe and full of astringent juice. The true fruit, the kidney-shaped nut (*ngorosho*), hangs from its lower end. Green, unripe apples are called *dunje*.
about.sw:
*M'bibo* ni mti unaotandaa wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima, majani makubwa, magumu kama ngozi na ya mviringo, na taji fupi pana. Maua yake madogo ya rangi ya waridi hafifu huota kwa vishada vilivyolegea kwenye ncha za matawi.

Tunda lake ni la ajabu. Kinachoonekana kama tunda ni kikonyo kilichovimba chenye nyama, yaani bibo (*bibo*), chekundu au cha manjano kikiiva na kilichojaa maji yenye ukakasi. Tunda halisi, kokwa yenye umbo la figo (*ngorosho*), huning'inia kutoka ncha yake ya chini. Mabibo mabichi ya kijani huitwa *dunje*.
about.dg:
*M'bibo* ni muhi unaotandazika wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ni makulu, mafu dza chingo na ga mviringo, na chitswache ni cha photsi na chipana. Maruwage madide ga rangi ya pinki ganamera kpwa mabunda ga kutawanyika kpwa ntsa za panda.

Tundare ni ra ajabu. Chinachoonekana dza tunda ni mlita uriovwimba wenye nyama, *bibo*, wa kundu au wa rangi ya mandano uchiivwa na wenye madzi ganagoumisa mromo. Tunda ra kpweli, ngorosho ya umbo ra figo (*ngorosho*), inabwadzika kula ntsaye ya photsi. Mabibo ga chijani gasigoivwa ganaihwa *dunje*.

where.en: Cashew is one of the commonest trees of Kwale homesteads and farms, often planted in rows or scattered among coconuts and mangoes. It is easiest to notice in the harvest season, when the coloured apples hang among the leaves and drop to the ground.
where.sw: Mkorosho ni miongoni mwa miti inayopatikana zaidi katika maboma na mashamba ya Kwale, mara nyingi ukipandwa kwa mistari au ukiwa umetawanyika kati ya minazi na miembe. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona msimu wa mavuno, mabibo yenye rangi yanaponing'inia kati ya majani na kuanguka ardhini.
where.dg: M'bibo ni mwenga wa mihi iriyo minji zaidi kpwa midzi na minda ya Kwale, na kpwa kawaida nkuphandwa kpwa mistari au kutawanyika kahi ya minazi na miembe. Ni rahisi zaidi kuumanya wakati wa mavuno, wakati mabibo ga rangi ganabwadzika kahi ya makodza na kugbwa photsi.

uses.en:
The nuts are the money crop, sold for cash and processed for export and local markets. The shell around the kernel contains a caustic oil that burns the skin, so the nuts are roasted before they are cracked open to free the kernel. The shell oil itself is used as a varnish, and the tree also yields a gum.

The apples are eaten fresh or fermented into a drink, though at harvest many are simply left on the ground.
uses.sw:
Korosho ndizo zao la pesa, huuzwa kwa fedha taslimu na husindikwa kwa ajili ya kuuza nje ya nchi na masoko ya ndani. Ganda linalozunguka kiini lina mafuta yanayounguza ngozi, kwa hivyo korosho hubanikwa kabla ya kuvunjwa ili kutoa kiini. Mafuta hayo ya ganda yenyewe hutumika kama vanishi, na mti pia hutoa utomvu wa gundi.

Mabibo huliwa mabichi au huchachushwa kutengeneza kinywaji, ingawa wakati wa mavuno mengi huachwa tu ardhini.
uses.dg:
Ngorosho ndizo mmea wa pesa: nkuguzwa kpwa pesa na nkutengezwa kpwa soko za tsi za kondze na za hipha. Gada rinarozunguluka nyama ya ndani rina mafuha ganagoocha ngozi, kpwa hivyo ngorosho nkuochwa kabla ya kupapatwa ili kutuluza nyama ya ndani. Mafuha iga ga gada nkuhumirwa dza varnish, na muhi piya unalavya ulimbo (*gamu*).

Mabibo nkuriwa dza garivyo au nkuhendwa chinwadzi cha kuumuka, ela wakati wa mavuno manji nkurichwa photsi bahi.

culture.en: Digo has words for every stage of the cashew. To crack the nuts open is *papata*, and an over-dried nut is *mkpwetse* or *mkeye*. A Mgombato example sentence captures the harvest: *Wakati wa kuendza ngorosho atu nkutsola ngorosho akaricha mabibo*, 'When gathering cashew nuts, people pick up the nut and leave the *bibo*.' The tree was brought to East Africa from Brazil by Portuguese traders centuries ago, and its names *m'bibo* and *mkorosho* are now used by all Digo.
culture.sw: Kidigo kina maneno kwa kila hatua ya korosho. Kuvunja korosho ni *papata*, na korosho iliyokauka kupita kiasi ni *mkpwetse* au *mkeye*. Sentensi ya mfano katika Mgombato inaeleza mavuno: *Wakati wa kuendza ngorosho atu nkutsola ngorosho akaricha mabibo*, 'Wakati wa kuokota korosho, watu huokota korosho na kuacha *bibo*.' Mti huu uliletwa Afrika Mashariki kutoka Brazili na wafanyabiashara Wareno karne nyingi zilizopita, na majina yake *m'bibo* na *mkorosho* sasa yanatumiwa na Wadigo wote.
culture.dg: Chidigo china maneno kpwa chila hatua ya ngorosho. Kuvundza ngorosho ni *papata*, na ngorosho iriyouma kutsupa chiasi ni *mkpwetse* au *mkeye*. Mfwano wa sentensi ya Mgombato unaonyesa mavuno: *Wakati wa kuendza ngorosho atu nkutsola ngorosho akaricha mabibo*, 'Wakati wa kuhendza ngorosho, atu nkutsola ngorosho na kuricha *bibo*.' Muhi uhu ukarehwa Afrika ya Mashiriki kula Brazil ni achuuzi a Chireno karne nyinji zirizotsupa, na madzinage *m'bibo* na *mkorosho* sambi ganahumirwa ni Adigo osi.

names.en: Digo: *m'bibo* (also written *mbibo* or *mbibu*) for the tree, *ngorosho* for the nut, *bibo* for the apple and *dunje* for the unripe apple. *Mkorosho* is also used. Swahili: *mkorosho* or *mkanju*, with the nut called *korosho*. Giriama: *mkanju*. English: cashew. Scientists call it *Anacardium occidentale*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *m'bibo* (pia huandikwa *mbibo* au *mbibu*) kwa mti, *ngorosho* kwa korosho, *bibo* kwa bibo na *dunje* kwa bibo bichi. *Mkorosho* pia hutumika. Kiswahili: *mkorosho* au *mkanju*, na kokwa huitwa *korosho*. Kigiriama: *mkanju*. Kiingereza: *cashew*. Wanasayansi huuita *Anacardium occidentale*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *m'bibo* (piya unaandikpwa *mbibo* au *mbibu*) kpwa muhi, *ngorosho* kpwa tunda ra ngorosho, *bibo* kpwa bibo, na *dunje* kpwa bibo risiroivwa. *Mkorosho* piya unahumirwa. Chiswahili: *mkorosho* au *mkanju*, na ngorosho inaihwa *korosho*. Chigiryama: *mkanju*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *cashew*. Asayansi anauiha *Anacardium occidentale*.

definition.en: The fleshy cashew apple, with the nut growing at its end. Mgombato: when gathering cashew nuts people pick up the nut and leave the apples.
definition.sw: Bibo lenye nyama, ambalo korosho huota mwishoni mwake. Mgombato: wakati wa kuokota korosho watu huokota korosho na kuacha mabibo.
definition.dg: Bibo ra nyama ra ngorosho, ambaro ngorosho inamera kpwa ntsaye. Mgombato: wakati wa kuhendza ngorosho atu nkutsola ngorosho na kuricha mabibo.

definition.en: The cashew fruit while it is green and unripe. Pakia notes that unripe cashew gives off a caustic sap, maronvi.
definition.sw: Tunda la mkorosho likiwa bado bichi la kijani. Pakia anabainisha kwamba korosho changa hutoa utomvu unaounguza, maronvi.
definition.dg: Tunda ra m'bibo richiri ra chijani na risiroivwa. Pakia anagomba kukala ngorosho isiyoivwa inalavya utomvu unaoocha, *maronvi*.

definition.en: The cashew nut.
definition.sw: Korosho (kokwa).
definition.dg: Tunda ra ngorosho rinaroriwa (korosho).

definition.en: A cashew nut that has dried out too much.
definition.sw: Korosho iliyokauka kupita kiasi.
definition.dg: Ngorosho iriyouma kutsupa chiasi.

definition.en: A cashew nut that has dried out too much; the word also means an old, wizened person.
definition.sw: Korosho iliyokauka kupita kiasi; neno hili pia lina maana ya mtu mzee aliyekunjamana.
definition.dg: Ngorosho iriyouma kutsupa chiasi; neno hiri piya ni mutu mzehe sana ariyeuma mwiri.

definition.en: The cotyledons (seed leaves) of the cashew, which rise above the ground when the nut germinates. The Digo see their role as protecting the embryo.
definition.sw: Viini-jani (majani ya mbegu) vya korosho, vinavyochomoza juu ya ardhi korosho inapoota. Wadigo huona kazi yake kuwa ni kulinda kiinitete.
definition.dg: Makodza ga kpwanza ga tembe ya ngorosho, ganagotuluka dzulu ya tsi ngorosho ichimera. Adigo anaona kazi yao ni kurinda chitsa.

definition.en: A caustic, toxic oil from unripe cashew (dunje) and from the shell of mature nuts. Digo children learn early to avoid touching it.
definition.sw: Mafuta yanayounguza na yenye sumu kutoka korosho changa (dunje) na kutoka ganda la korosho zilizokomaa. Watoto wa Wadigo hujifunza mapema kuepuka kuyagusa.
definition.dg: Mafuha ga sumu ganagoocha ganagolavywa ni ngorosho isiyoivwa (*dunje*) na gada ra ngorosho ziriziivwa. Ana a Chidigo nkudzifundza kare kusigaguta.

definition.en: A sticky resin from the bark of the cashew tree.
definition.sw: Utomvu unaonata kutoka gamba la mkorosho.
definition.dg: Ulimbo unaonyata kula kpwa gopha ra m'bibo.

teaser.en: The coast's kidney beans mostly travel down from upcountry before they are simmered in coconut milk.
teaser.sw: Maharagwe ya pwani kwa sehemu kubwa husafiri kutoka bara kabla ya kupikwa taratibu kwa tui la nazi.
teaser.dg: Maharagbwe manji ga pwani nkurehwa kula bara, kabla ya kujitwa pore-pore na huwi.

summary.en: *Maharagbwe* is the common bean, the familiar kidney bean of East African kitchens. On the Digo coast it is mostly bought from upcountry and stewed in coconut milk.
summary.sw: *Maharagbwe* ni maharagwe, yale maharagwe yanayojulikana sana katika jikoni za Afrika Mashariki. Katika pwani ya Kidigo kwa kawaida hununuliwa kutoka bara na kupikwa kwa tui la nazi.
summary.dg: *Maharagbwe* (kpwa Chingereza *common bean* au *kidney bean*) ni maharagbwe ganayomanyikana sana madzikoni ga Afrika ya Mashariki. Pwani ya Adigo manji nkugulwa kula bara, na nkujitwa na huwi.

about.en: *Maharagbwe* is a bean plant that grows as a low bush or a climber. Its leaves have three broad leaflets, and its small flowers are white, pink or purple. The pods are slender and hold several kidney-shaped seeds, which come in many colours: red, speckled, white and brown.
about.sw: *Maharagbwe* ni mmea wa maharagwe unaokua kama kichaka kifupi au kama mmea unaotambaa. Majani yake yana vijani vitatu vipana, na maua yake madogo ni meupe, ya waridi au ya zambarau. Maganda ni membamba na hubeba mbegu kadhaa zenye umbo la figo, zenye rangi nyingi: nyekundu, za madoadoa, nyeupe na kahawia.
about.dg: *Maharagbwe* ni mmea wa maharagbwe ambao unamera mfupi photsi, au unafyombera dzulu ya vitu vyanjina. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu mapana, na maruwage madide ni mereru, ga pinki au ga zambarau. Makakayage ni membamba, na gana tembe chache za umbo ra figo, za rangi nyinji: za kundu, za mabara-mabara, nyereru na za rangi ya dongo.

where.en: Common beans grow best in cooler, higher country, so on the coast most of the supply is bought from upcountry rather than grown locally. You will find them in every market and shop.
where.sw: Maharagwe hustawi vyema katika maeneo ya juu yenye baridi zaidi, kwa hiyo pwani sehemu kubwa ya maharagwe hununuliwa kutoka bara badala ya kulimwa hapo. Utayakuta katika kila soko na duka.
where.dg: Maharagbwe ganamera vinono zaidi phatu pha mnyevu na pha dzulu, kpwa hivyo pwani manji nkugulwa kula bara badala ya kurimwa phapha. Ganaphahikana chila soko na chila duka.

uses.en: The dried beans are soaked and stewed with coconut milk, a staple dish served with rice or *ugali*.
uses.sw: Maharagwe makavu hulowekwa na kupikwa kwa tui la nazi, mlo mkuu unaoliwa pamoja na wali au *ugali*.
uses.dg: Maharagbwe makavu nkulwekwa madzini, chisha nkujitwa na huwi; ni chakurya cha chila siku chinachoriwa na wari au *sima*.

names.en: Digo: *maharagbwe*, also *maragwe*. Swahili: *maharagwe*. English: common bean or kidney bean. Scientists call it *Phaseolus vulgaris*. The plant comes originally from the Americas.
names.sw: Kidigo: *maharagbwe*, pia *maragwe*. Kiswahili: *maharagwe*. Kiingereza: *common bean* au *kidney bean*. Wanasayansi huyaita *Phaseolus vulgaris*. Asili ya mmea huu ni Amerika.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *maharagbwe*, piya *maragwe*. Kpwa Chiswahili: *maharagwe*. Kpwa Chingereza: *common bean* au *kidney bean*. Kpwa sayansi ganaihwa *Phaseolus vulgaris*. Mmea huno asiliye ni tsi za Amerika.

reason.en: Cowpea, the locally grown bean
reason.sw: Kunde, maharagwe yanayolimwa hapa hapa
reason.dg: Kunde, maharagbwe ganayorimwa phapha pwani.

reason.en: Green gram, another pulse cooked in coconut
reason.sw: Pojo (choroko), nafaka nyingine ya jamii ya kunde inayopikwa kwa nazi
reason.dg: Podzo, nafaka yanjina inayojitwa na huwi.

reason.en: Pigeon pea, the classic coastal pulse
reason.sw: Mbaazi, nafaka ya jamii ya kunde maarufu zaidi pwani
reason.dg: Mbalazi, nafaka ya pwani inayomanyikana sana.

reason.en: Coconut, whose milk is used to stew beans
reason.sw: Mnazi, ambao tui lake hutumika kupikia maharagwe
reason.dg: Mnazi; huwi ya nazi nkuhumirwa kujitira maharagbwe.

mgombato: maharagbwe type of bean; maharagwe.

digo_source: Mgombato ('manga cassava'; 'chisamfu / mpeya cassava leaves'; 'makopa dried cassava'; 'jora / bada cassava meal'); Pakia ('Manga')

teaser.en: Digo farmers know about twenty kinds of cassava by name, some sweet, some bitter, each with its own place in the kitchen.
teaser.sw: Wakulima Wadigo wanazijua kwa majina takriban aina ishirini za muhogo, nyingine tamu, nyingine chungu, kila moja na nafasi yake jikoni.
teaser.dg: Akurima a Chidigo anamanya aina phephi ishirini za manga kpwa madzina, zanjina za mtswano, zanjina za utsungu, chila aina na nafasiye jikoni.

summary.en: *Manga* is cassava, the second staple of the Digo coast after rice. Its roots are boiled, fried, dried and ground, and its leaves are cooked as greens.
summary.sw: *Manga* ni muhogo, chakula kikuu cha pili cha pwani ya Wadigo baada ya wali. Mizizi yake huchemshwa, hukaangwa, hukaushwa na kusagwa, na majani yake hupikwa kama mboga za majani.
summary.dg: *Manga* ni chakurya cha phiri cha musingi cha pwani ya Adigo bada ya mtele. Miziye nkutserusiwa, nkukalangwa, nkuumiswa na nkusagwa, na makodzage nkujitwa dza mtsunga.

about.en:
*Manga* is a woody shrub with long, knobbly stems and leaves divided like an open hand into five to seven narrow lobes. It is grown for its swollen, starchy roots, which are brown-skinned and white inside.

Digo farmers recognise about twenty cultivars, among them *boriti*, *chibandameno* (sweet), *chileso* (bitter), *guzo*, *gushe* and *mjiriama*. Sweet kinds can be cooked directly, while bitter kinds need more processing to remove their natural toxins.
about.sw:
*Manga* ni kichaka chenye shina gumu kama la mti, chenye mashina marefu yenye vifundo na majani yaliyogawanyika kama kiganja kilichokunjuliwa kuwa sehemu nyembamba tano hadi saba. Hupandwa kwa ajili ya mizizi yake iliyovimba yenye wanga, yenye ganda la kahawia na nyeupe ndani.

Wakulima Wadigo wanatambua takriban aina ishirini, miongoni mwake *boriti*, *chibandameno* (tamu), *chileso* (chungu), *guzo*, *gushe* na *mjiriama*. Aina tamu zinaweza kupikwa moja kwa moja, huku aina chungu zikihitaji usindikaji zaidi ili kuondoa sumu zake za asili.
about.dg:
*Manga* ni chitsaka cha nyama za muhi chenye mihi mire yenye vinundu na makodza ganagoganyika dza mkpwono uriovuguka kpwa vyala tsano hadi sabaa vyembamba. Nkuphandwa kpwa sababu ya miziye iriyovwimba yenye wanga, ambayo ni ya rangi ya dongo kondze na nyereru ndani.

Akurima a Chidigo anamanya aina phephi ishirini, kahi yao *boriti*, *chibandameno* (ya mtswano), *chileso* (ya utsungu), *guzo*, *gushe* na *mjiriama*. Aina za mtswano zinaweza kujitwa vivyo, ela aina za utsungu zinahitaji kutengezwa zaidi ili kuusa sumu yao ya chiasili.

where.en: Cassava is grown on sandy farms across Kwale, often intercropped with maize and cowpeas. It tolerates poor soil and drought better than most crops, which makes it a reliable food in hard years.
where.sw: Muhogo hulimwa katika mashamba ya mchanga kote Kwale, mara nyingi ukichanganywa na mahindi na kunde. Huvumilia udongo duni na ukame kuliko mazao mengi, jambo linaloufanya kuwa chakula cha kutegemewa katika miaka migumu.
where.dg: Manga anaphandwa kpwa minda ya mtsanga kosi Kwale, kpwa kawaida phamwenga na pemba na kunde. Anavumirira tsi isiyo nono na ukame kuriko mimea minji, na hipho kunahenda akale chakurya cha kuluphirika kpwa miaka ya shida.

uses.en:
The roots are boiled, fried or cooked in coconut milk. They are also peeled and sun-dried as *makopa*, which keep well and are pounded into flour for *jora* or *bada*, a stiff porridge.

The leaves, called *chisamfu* or *mpeya*, are pounded and cooked as a vegetable.
uses.sw:
Mizizi huchemshwa, hukaangwa au hupikwa kwa tui la nazi. Pia humenywa na kukaushwa juani kuwa *makopa*, ambayo hukaa muda mrefu bila kuharibika na hutwangwa kuwa unga wa *jora* au *bada*, ugali mzito.

Majani, yanayoitwa *chisamfu* au *mpeya*, hutwangwa na kupikwa kama mboga.
uses.dg:
Mizi nkutserusiwa, nkukalangwa au nkujitwa kpwa huwi. Piya nkuguwiwa na kuanikpwa dzuwani ikakala *makopa*, ambago ganakaa muda mrefu na nkuphondwa kuhenda unga wa *jora* au *bada*, sima ngumu.

Makodza, ganagoihwa *chisamfu* au *mpeya*, nkuphondwa na kujitwa dza mtsunga.

culture.en: The Digo language has a rich vocabulary for cassava: *gbwindi* is a big tuber, *gbwazo* and *mwachupa* are varieties, and *maugu* are the nodules on the stem. Cassava came to Africa from South America, but on the coast it has become fully at home.
culture.sw: Lugha ya Kidigo ina msamiati mpana wa muhogo: *gbwindi* ni kiazi kikubwa, *gbwazo* na *mwachupa* ni aina, na *maugu* ni vifundo vilivyo kwenye shina. Muhogo ulikuja Afrika kutoka Amerika Kusini, lakini pwani umezoeleka kabisa kama mmea wa nyumbani.
culture.dg: Luga ya Chidigo ina maneno manji ga manga: *gbwindi* ni manga kulu, *gbwazo* na *mwachupa* ni aina, na *maugu* ni vinundu vya muhi. Manga akarehwa Afrika kula Amerika ya Kusini, ela pwani akakala chitu cha hipha kabisa.

names.en: Digo: *manga* for the plant and root, *chisamfu* or *mpeya* for the leaves, and *makopa* for the dried pieces. Swahili: *muhogo*; the leaves are *kisamvu* in Tanzanian Swahili. English: cassava. Scientists call it *Manihot esculenta*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *manga* kwa mmea na mzizi, *chisamfu* au *mpeya* kwa majani, na *makopa* kwa vipande vilivyokaushwa. Kiswahili: *muhogo*; majani ni *kisamvu* katika Kiswahili cha Tanzania. Kiingereza: *cassava*. Wanasayansi huuita *Manihot esculenta*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *manga* kpwa mmea na mizi, *chisamfu* au *mpeya* kpwa makodza, na *makopa* kpwa vipande vikavu. Chiswahili: *muhogo*; makodza ni *kisamvu* kpwa Chiswahili cha Tanzania. Kpwa Chingereza anaihwa *cassava*. Kpwa chisayansi anaihwa *Manihot esculenta*.

definition.en: The cassava tuber. Unusually, the tubers share their name with the plant; Pakia notes that Digo plants often share a name with their useful part.
definition.sw: Kiazi cha muhogo. Jambo lisilo la kawaida ni kwamba viazi hivi vinashiriki jina na mmea; Pakia anabainisha kwamba mara nyingi mimea ya Kidigo hushiriki jina na sehemu yake yenye manufaa.
definition.dg: Chiazi cha manga. Si kawaida, ela viazi vina dzina sawa na mmea; Pakia anagomba kukala mimea ya Chidigo kpwa kawaida ina dzina sawa na seemu yao ya fwaida.

definition.en: A single cassava tuber. The same word names the sections of sugarcane and finger segments; Pakia thinks it is a counting word.
definition.sw: Kiazi kimoja cha muhogo. Neno hilohilo hutaja pingili za muwa na vifundo vya vidole; Pakia anadhani ni neno la kuhesabia.
definition.dg: Chiazi chimwenga cha manga. Neno hiri hiri ni dzina ra vipande vya muwa na vipande vya vyala; Pakia anaona ni neno ra kuolangira.

shared_with: pindi: a section of sugarcane

definition.en: A big cassava tuber.
definition.sw: Kiazi kikubwa cha muhogo.
definition.dg: Chiazi chikulu cha manga.

definition.en: Small pieces: small cassava or potato tubers.
definition.sw: Vipande vidogo: viazi vidogo vya muhogo au vya viazi.
definition.dg: Vipande vidide: viazi vidide vya manga au vya chiazi.

definition.en: The fibrous strands running through the middle of a cassava tuber.
definition.sw: Nyuzi zinazopita katikati ya kiazi cha muhogo.
definition.dg: Nyuzi zinazotsupa kahi-kahi ya chiazi cha manga.

shared_with: mizi: roots in general

definition.en: The lobes of the cassava leaf; Pakia uses cassava as the example of a lobed leaf.
definition.sw: Sehemu za jani la muhogo; Pakia anatumia muhogo kama mfano wa jani lenye sehemu.
definition.dg: Vyala vya kodza ra manga; Pakia anahumira manga dza mfwano wa kodza renye vyala.

definition.en: Cassava leaves eaten as a vegetable. Pakia notes that only the young leaves are eaten.
definition.sw: Majani ya muhogo yanayoliwa kama mboga. Pakia anabainisha kwamba ni majani machanga tu yanayoliwa.
definition.dg: Makodza ga manga ganagoriwa dza mtsunga. Pakia anagomba kukala ni makodza matsanga bahi ganagoriwa.

definition.en: Cassava leaves; another Mgombato word alongside mpeya.
definition.sw: Majani ya muhogo; neno jingine la Mgombato pamoja na mpeya.
definition.dg: Makodza ga manga; neno ranjina ra Mgombato phamwenga na *mpeya*.

definition.en: The small fruit of the cassava plant, which has no known use. This is the older word, given by elderly Digo.
definition.sw: Tunda dogo la mmea wa muhogo, ambalo halina matumizi yanayojulikana. Hili ndilo neno la zamani, linalotolewa na Wadigo wazee.
definition.dg: Tunda dide ra mmea wa manga, ambaro tarina kazi inayomanyikana. Hiri ni neno ra kare, rinarogombwa ni azehe a Chidigo.

definition.en: The cassava fruit, as most younger Digo call it. The pattern 'seed of …' is used for the fruits of plants nobody uses.
definition.sw: Tunda la muhogo, kama Wadigo wengi vijana wanavyoliita. Mtindo wa 'mbegu ya …' hutumika kwa matunda ya mimea ambayo hakuna anayeyatumia.
definition.dg: Tunda ra manga, dza vira Adigo anji a chizazi chiphya anavyoriiha. Mpangilio wa 'tembe ya …' nkuhumirwa kpwa matunda ga mimea isiyohumirwa ni mutu.

definition.en: Cassava peeled and dried in the sun.
definition.sw: Muhogo uliomenywa na kukaushwa juani.
definition.dg: Manga arioguwiwa na kuanikpwa dzuwani.

use.en: Pounded into flour for jora and bada; Pakia notes drying was a way to store food against famine.
use.sw: Hutwangwa kuwa unga wa jora na bada; Pakia anabainisha kwamba kukausha ilikuwa njia ya kuhifadhi chakula kwa ajili ya njaa.
use.dg: Nkuphondwa kuhenda unga wa jora na bada; Pakia anagomba kukala kuanika kala ni njira ya kuika chakurya kpwa wakati wa ndzala.

definition.en: Cassava meal. Jora made only from makopa flour is called jora ra chipitu, 'plain jora'.
definition.sw: Unga wa muhogo. Jora linalotengenezwa kwa unga wa makopa pekee huitwa jora ra chipitu, 'jora tupu'.
definition.dg: Unga wa manga. Jora ririrohendwa kpwa unga wa makopa bahi rinaihwa *jora ra chipitu*, 'jora rihuphu'.

definition.en: A stiff porridge made from dried, ground cassava.
definition.sw: Ugali mzito unaotengenezwa kwa muhogo uliokaushwa na kusagwa.
definition.dg: Sima ngumu inayohendwa kula kpwa manga arioumiswa na kusagwa.

digo: matsere (northern Digo) / pemba, mapemba (southern Digo); cob tsere
digo_source: Mgombato ('matsere corn, maize'; 'pemba maize'; 'tsere maize cob'); Pakia (Matsere N, Mapemba S)

teaser.en: North of the Digo country maize is *matsere*; in the south it is *pemba*, and both are ground into flour for *ugali*.
teaser.sw: Kaskazini mwa nchi ya Wadigo mahindi ni *matsere*; kusini ni *pemba*, na yote mawili husagwa kuwa unga wa *ugali*.
teaser.dg: Adigo a kazikazini nkuiha mahindi *matsere*; a kusini nkugaiha *pemba*, na gosi nkusagbwa unga wa kujitira *sima*.

summary.en: *Matsere* is maize, the main rain-fed cereal of Digo farms. It is ground into flour for *ugali*, roasted on the cob and baked with bananas into *mabumbunda*.
summary.sw: *Matsere* ni mahindi, nafaka kuu inayotegemea mvua katika mashamba ya Wadigo. Husagwa kuwa unga wa *ugali*, gunzi huchomwa motoni na huokwa pamoja na ndizi kuwa *mabumbunda*.
summary.dg: *Matsere* ni nafaka kulu ya mvula kpwenye minda ya Adigo. Nkusagbwa unga wa sima, nkuochwa gachikala bado kpwenye tsere, na nkutsanganywa na mazu kuhenda *mabumbunda*.

about.en:
*Matsere* is a tall cereal grass with broad, strap-shaped leaves and a tassel of male flowers at the top of the stem. The cobs (*tsere*) form lower down, wrapped in husks, each sending out a tuft of silk.

Digo farmers grow both local cultivars and modern hybrids. The local kinds are named by grain colour: *maricheni* (yellow), *chitweka* (black), *mwatsaka* (red), *tsere ra matungo* (mixed) and *mjundo* (striped). Hybrids such as *kosti* and *katumani* are also grown.
about.sw:
*Matsere* ni nyasi ndefu ya nafaka yenye majani mapana yenye umbo la utepe na shada la maua ya kiume juu ya shina. Magunzi (*tsere*) hutokea chini zaidi, yakiwa yamefunikwa na makoba, na kila moja hutoa kishungi cha nywele.

Wakulima Wadigo hupanda aina za kienyeji na mbegu chotara za kisasa. Aina za kienyeji hupewa majina kulingana na rangi ya punje: *maricheni* (manjano), *chitweka* (nyeusi), *mwatsaka* (nyekundu), *tsere ra matungo* (mchanganyiko) na *mjundo* (yenye michirizi). Mbegu chotara kama *kosti* na *katumani* pia hupandwa.
about.dg:
*Matsere* ni nafaka nyire ya jamii ya nyasi, yenye makodza mapana na mare, na *punga* ya maruwa ga chilume dzulu ya mlita. Matsere ganamera photsi zaidi: chila *tsere* rinafwinikpwa ni magada, na rinalavya njiyo.

Akurima a Adigo anaphanda aina za chienyeji na aina za chisasa. Aina za chienyeji nkuihwa kpwa rangi ya tembe: *maricheni* (rangi ya mandano), *chitweka* (rangi nyiru), *mwatsaka* (rangi ya kundu), *tsere ra matungo* (rangi za kutsanganyika) na *mjundo* (mistari-mistari). Aina za chisasa dza *kosti* na *katumani* piya nkuphandwa.

where.en: Maize is the main rain-fed cereal of Kwale farms, planted with the rains and often intercropped with cassava and cowpeas. After harvest the grain is stored in the granary, the *chitsaga*.
where.sw: Mahindi ndiyo nafaka kuu inayotegemea mvua katika mashamba ya Kwale, yakipandwa mvua zinapoanza na mara nyingi yakichanganywa na muhogo na kunde. Baada ya mavuno nafaka huhifadhiwa ghalani, *chitsaga*.
where.dg: *Matsere* ni nafaka kulu ya mvula kpwenye minda ya Kwale. Nkuphandwa mvula zichiandza, na mara nyinji nkuphandwa phamwenga na manga na kunde. Bada ya mavuno, tembe nkuikpwa kpwenye ghala, *chitsaga*.

uses.en:
The dried grain is ground into flour (*sima* or *dona*) for *ugali*, the stiff porridge eaten across East Africa. Fresh cobs are roasted over coals. Maize flour and bananas are combined to make *mabumbunda*, a maize-banana bread.

After harvest the stalks, *buwa*, are left in the field.
uses.sw:
Nafaka iliyokaushwa husagwa kuwa unga (*sima* au *dona*) wa *ugali*, chakula kizito kinacholiwa kote Afrika Mashariki. Magunzi mabichi huchomwa juu ya makaa. Unga wa mahindi na ndizi huchanganywa kutengeneza *mabumbunda*, mkate wa mahindi na ndizi.

Baada ya mavuno mabua, *buwa*, huachwa shambani.
uses.dg:
Tembe zikauma nkusagbwa kuhenda unga (*sima* au *dona*) wa kujitira sima (*ugali*), chakurya chigumu chinachoriwa kosi Afrika ya Mashariki. Matsere maitsi nkuochwa dzulu ya makala. Unga wa matsere na mazu nkutsanganywa kuhenda *mabumbunda*, mkahe wa matsere na mazu.

Bada ya mavuno, milita iriyosala, *buwa*, nkurichwa mndani.

culture.en: Maize farming carries a whole body of Digo know-how, from choosing seed to storing the grain in the *chitsaga*. The red cultivar *mwatsaka* shares its name with the Digo word for chilli pepper.
culture.sw: Kilimo cha mahindi kina hazina nzima ya maarifa ya Kidigo, kuanzia kuchagua mbegu hadi kuhifadhi nafaka katika *chitsaga*. Aina nyekundu *mwatsaka* inashiriki jina na neno la Kidigo la pilipili hoho.
culture.dg: Chirimo cha matsere china marifwa manji ga Chidigo, kula kutsambula mbeyu hadi kuika tembe kpwenye *chitsaga*. Aina ya kundu, *mwatsaka*, ina dzina sawa na *mwatsaka*, pilipili kpwa Chidigo.

names.en: Digo: *matsere* in northern Digo and *pemba* or *mapemba* in southern Digo; the cob is *tsere*. Swahili: *mahindi*. English: maize or corn. Scientists call it *Zea mays*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *matsere* katika Kidigo cha kaskazini na *pemba* au *mapemba* katika Kidigo cha kusini; gunzi ni *tsere*. Kiswahili: *mahindi*. Kiingereza: *maize* au *corn*. Wanasayansi huyaita *Zea mays*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *matsere* kpwa Chidigo cha kazikazini, na *pemba* au *mapemba* kpwa Chidigo cha kusini; *cob* kpwa Chingereza ni *tsere*. Kpwa Chiswahili ganaihwa *mahindi*, kpwa Chingereza *maize* au *corn*. Kpwa chisayansi ganaihwa *Zea mays*.

definition.en: The maize cob; Pakia notes the word is used for the maize plant as well. Matsere (the plural) is the usual word for maize.
definition.sw: Gunzi la mahindi; Pakia anabainisha kwamba neno hili hutumika pia kwa mmea wa mahindi. Matsere (wingi) ndilo neno la kawaida la mahindi.
definition.dg: Seemu ya matsere ambayo tembe zinamera dzuluye (*cob*); Pakia anaandika kukala neno hiri nkuhumirwa piya kpwa muhi wa matsere. Matsere (unji) ndiro neno ra kawaida kpwa mahindi.

meaning.en: From an old Bantu word for 'cleaned grain'; the change to tsere keeps it apart from mtele, cleaned rice.
meaning.sw: Kutoka neno la zamani la Kibantu lenye maana ya 'nafaka iliyosafishwa'; badiliko kuwa tsere linalitofautisha na mtele, mchele uliosafishwa.
meaning.dg: Rinalavywa kula neno ra kare ra Chibantu ra 'tembe zirizoezwa'; kugaluka kukala *tsere* kunaritafwautisha na *mtele*, mphunga urioezwa.

definition.en: The male flower at the top of the maize plant. Farmers watch it as a sign of ripeness: when it dries, the cob is ready to harvest. One respondent also called it thamra, a word other Digo did not know.
definition.sw: Ua la kiume lililo juu ya mmea wa mahindi. Wakulima hulitazama kama ishara ya kukomaa: likikauka, gunzi liko tayari kuvunwa. Mhojiwa mmoja pia aliliita thamra, neno ambalo Wadigo wengine hawakulijua.
definition.dg: Ruwa ra chilume dzulu ya muhi wa matsere. Akurima nkurilola dza alama ya kuivwa: richiuma, tsere ri tayari kuvunwa. Mutu mmwenga ariyeuzwa piya wariiha *thamra*, neno ambaro Adigo anjina kala taarimanya.

meaning.en: Probably from mphunga, rice, which has a similar flower head.
meaning.sw: Huenda kutoka mphunga, mpunga, ambao una shada la maua linalofanana.
meaning.dg: Pengine rinalavywa kula *mphunga*, ambao una maruwa ga dzulu ganayofanana na higa.

shared_with: punga: the florets of the coconut flower
punga: the flowering panicles of grasses and sugarcane

definition.en: The young female flower of maize, the cob in its early growth wrapped in its husk. Unlike the tassel, it counts as a ruwa (flower) because it bears fruit.
definition.sw: Ua changa la kike la mahindi, yaani gunzi katika ukuaji wake wa mwanzo likiwa limefunikwa na koba lake. Tofauti na shada la juu, huhesabiwa kama ruwa (ua) kwa sababu huzaa tunda.
definition.dg: Ruwa ra chichetu ra matsere richikala bado ridide: tsere rinaroandza kumera, ririrofwinikpwa ni gadare. Tafwauti na punga, rinahesabiwa kukala *ruwa* kpwa sababu rinalavya tunda.

meaning.en: Sheath: the husk covers the growing cob as a sheath covers a knife.
meaning.sw: Ala: koba hufunika gunzi linalokua kama ala inavyofunika kisu.
meaning.dg: Ala: gada rinafwinika tsere rinarokula dza chowa chinavyofwinika rumu.

definition.en: The female flower of maize, the part that becomes the cob (labelled in Pakia's Fig. 3.4).
definition.sw: Ua la kike la mahindi, sehemu inayokuwa gunzi (lililoonyeshwa katika Mchoro 3.4 wa Pakia).
definition.dg: Ruwa ra chichetu ra matsere, seemu inayokala tsere (Pakia akarionyesa kpwenye Picha 3.4).

shared_with: mwana: a banana sucker

definition.en: The female flower of maize, known only from the growth-stage phrase ganatuluza-ndamba, 'producing female flowers'.
definition.sw: Ua la kike la mahindi, linalojulikana tu kutoka msemo wa hatua ya ukuaji ganatuluza-ndamba, 'yanatoa maua ya kike'.
definition.dg: Ruwa ra chichetu ra matsere. Rinamanyikana tu kula maneno ga kugomba hatua ya kukula, *ganatuluza-ndamba*, 'ganalavya maruwa ga chichetu'.

definition.en: The silks, the long threads hanging from the tip of the cob. They appear in the sixth month (described as ganasonga, 'plaiting'); when they are lost (matsere ganakata njio) the cob is mature.
definition.sw: Nywele za gunzi, nyuzi ndefu zinazoning'inia kutoka ncha ya gunzi. Hutokea katika mwezi wa sita (hali inayoelezwa kama ganasonga, 'kusuka'); zinapopotea (matsere ganakata njio) gunzi limekomaa.
definition.dg: Nyuzi nyire zirizobwadzika kula ntsa ya tsere. Zinazuka mwezi wa sita (nkugombwa *ganasonga*, 'ganasuka'); zichimala (*matsere ganakata njio*), tsere rikaivwa.

meaning.en: Also the name of a colourful hanging costume worn by traditional dancers.
meaning.sw: Pia ni jina la vazi lenye rangi nyingi linaloning'inia linalovaliwa na wachezaji ngoma za jadi.
meaning.dg: Piya ni dzina ra nguwo ya rangi nyinji iriyobwadzika, inayovwalwa ni atu anaofwiha ngoma za chienyeji.

definition.en: A grain (kernel) of maize.
definition.sw: Punje ya mahindi.
definition.dg: Tembe mwenga ya matsere.

definition.en: The milky juice in maize grains at the milk stage; its presence shows the grain is not yet mature.
definition.sw: Majimaji kama maziwa yaliyo katika punje za mahindi katika hatua ya maziwa; kuwepo kwake huonyesha kwamba punje bado haijakomaa.
definition.dg: Maziya ganayokala ndani ya tembe za matsere zichikala bado mbitsi; gachikalamo, ganaonyesa kukala tembe tazidzangbweivwa.

definition.en: The hard core of the maize cob. Mgombato spells it guguta (class ma): a cob with the grains removed.
definition.sw: Kiini kigumu cha gunzi la mahindi. Mgombato analiandika guguta (ngeli ya ma): gunzi lililotolewa punje.
definition.dg: Kahi ngumu ya tsere. Mgombato unaiandika *guguta* (ma-): tsere risiro na tembe.

definition.en: The stalk left standing after the maize has been harvested.
definition.sw: Bua linalobaki likiwa limesimama baada ya mahindi kuvunwa.
definition.dg: Mlita unaosala mndani bada ya matsere kuvunwa.

teaser.en: To protect a crop, some Digo farmers gently throw sorghum grains onto the growing plants.
teaser.sw: Ili kulinda zao, baadhi ya wakulima wa Kidigo hurusha kwa upole punje za mtama juu ya mimea inayokua.
teaser.dg: Ili kurinda zao, akurima anjina Adigo nkutsuphira tembe za *mhama* pore-pore dzulu ya mimea inayomera.

summary.en: *Mhama* is sorghum, a drought-tolerant grain of the drier inland farms. It is eaten as porridge and *ugali* and also used in a protective farming rite.
summary.sw: *Mhama* ni mtama, nafaka inayostahimili ukame inayolimwa katika mashamba makavu ya bara. Huliwa kama uji na *ugali*, na pia hutumika katika tambiko la kulinda mazao.
summary.dg: *Mhama* ni mtama, nafaka inayovumirira ukame, ya minda ya kahi ya tsi, iriyo kavu zaidi. Nkuriwa dza uji na *sima*, na piya nkuhumirwa kpwenye mila ya chirimo ya kurinda zao.

about.en:
*Mhama* is a tall cereal grass with broad leaves and a stout stem topped by a dense head of rounded grains. It looks a little like maize before it flowers, but bears its grain in a head at the top rather than on cobs.

Digo farmers name several kinds: *muhama mrefu* (tall), *muhama wa bombo* (reddish) and *muhama wa fumbula* (with a large head).
about.sw:
*Mhama* ni nyasi ndefu ya nafaka yenye majani mapana na bua nene lenye kichwa kilichoshonana cha punje za mviringo juu yake. Unafanana kidogo na mhindi kabla ya kutoa maua, lakini huzaa punje zake kwenye kichwa kilicho juu badala ya kwenye magunzi.

Wakulima wa Kidigo hutaja aina kadhaa: *muhama mrefu* (mrefu), *muhama wa bombo* (mwekundu kiasi) na *muhama wa fumbula* (wenye kichwa kikubwa).
about.dg:
*Mhama* ni nyasi ndefu ya nafaka yenye makodza mapana na mlita muziho, wenye chitswa chikulu cha tembe za duara zirizobanana dzuluche. Unaonekana chidide dza pemba kabla ya kulavya maruwa, ela tembeze zinamera kpwenye chitswa dzulu badala ya kpwenye matsere.

Akurima Adigo anaiha aina kadhaa: *muhama mrefu* (mure), *muhama wa bombo* (wa rangi ya kundu-kundu) na *muhama wa fumbula* (wenye chitswa chikulu).

where.en: Sorghum is grown on the drier farms inland, where rainfall is less reliable and maize can fail. It stands up well to drought.
where.sw: Mtama hulimwa katika mashamba makavu ya bara, ambako mvua haitegemewi sana na mahindi yanaweza kukosa kuzaa. Unastahimili ukame vizuri.
where.dg: *Mhama* nkurimwa kpwenye minda iriyo kavu zaidi ya kahi ya tsi, ambako mvula taiaminika na pemba inaweza kukosa kuvyala. Unavumirira ukame vinono.

uses.en: The grain is ground for porridge and for *ugali*.
uses.sw: Punje husagwa kupikia uji na *ugali*.
uses.dg: Tembe nkusagwa kuhenda uji na *sima*.

culture.en: Sorghum also has a ritual role: a protective rite involves gently throwing sorghum grains onto plants.
culture.sw: Mtama pia una nafasi katika matambiko: tambiko moja la kinga huhusisha kurusha kwa upole punje za mtama juu ya mimea.
culture.dg: *Mhama* piya una kazi ya chimila: mila mwenga ya kurinda zao ni kutsuphira tembe za *mhama* pore-pore dzulu ya mimea.

names.en: Digo: *mhama* in Mgombato, *muhama* in Pakia. Mgombato glosses *mhama* as 'millet', with the Swahili *mtama*, but *mtama* normally means sorghum, and Pakia translates *muhama* as sorghum. Swahili: *mtama*. English: sorghum. Scientists call it *Sorghum bicolor*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mhama* katika Mgombato, *muhama* katika Pakia. Mgombato inaeleza *mhama* kuwa 'millet', ikitoa Kiswahili *mtama*, lakini kwa kawaida *mtama* humaanisha *sorghum*, na Pakia anatafsiri *muhama* kuwa *sorghum*. Kiswahili: *mtama*. Kiingereza: *sorghum*. Wanasayansi huuita *Sorghum bicolor*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mhama* kpwenye Mgombato na *muhama* kpwa Pakia. Mgombato inaringanisha *mhama* na 'millet', na Chiswahili *mtama*, ela *mtama* kawaida ni *sorghum*, na Pakia anatafsiri *muhama* dza *sorghum*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtama*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sorghum*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Sorghum bicolor*.

reason.sw: Uwele, nafaka nyingine kama huu ya nchi kavu
reason.dg: *Pearl millet*, nafaka yanjina sawa nao ya tsi kavu

reason.sw: Mahindi, nafaka kuu
reason.dg: Pemba, nafaka kulu

reason.dg: Mphunga, nyasi yanjina inayorimwa kpwa sababu ya tembe

reason.en: Sugar cane, a related tall grass
reason.sw: Muwa, nyasi ndefu ya jamii moja nao
reason.dg: Muwa, nyasi ndefu ya jamii mwenga nao

teaser.en: Coconut flowers are called *punga* because they look like the heads of the rice plant, *mphunga*.
teaser.sw: Maua ya mnazi huitwa *punga* kwa sababu yanafanana na mashuke ya mpunga, *mphunga*.
teaser.dg: Maruwa ga mnazi nkuihwa *punga* kpwa sababu ganaonekana dza masuche ga mphunga, *mphunga*.

summary.en: *Mphunga* is rice, the first staple of the Digo table. Cooked in coconut milk as *wali wa nazi*, it appears at nearly every meal.
summary.sw: *Mphunga* ni mpunga, chakula kikuu cha kwanza mezani kwa Wadigo. Ukipikwa kwa tui la nazi kama *wali wa nazi*, huonekana karibu katika kila mlo.
summary.dg: *Mphunga* ni mtele, chakurya cha kpwandza cha Adigo. Uchijitwa na huwi dza *wali wa nazi*, unaphahikana karibu chila wakati wa kurya.

about.en:
*Mphunga* is a cereal grass with narrow leaves and drooping heads of grain. It is grown in fields that flood seasonally, and the heads turn golden as the grain ripens.

Digo farmers grow several cultivars, including the aromatic *pishori*, *sindano* (also called *lokoli*), *mosi wa sigara*, *gushe* and *kanja*.
about.sw:
*Mphunga* ni nyasi ya nafaka yenye majani membamba na mashuke ya nafaka yanayoinama. Hulimwa katika mashamba yanayofurika maji kwa msimu, na mashuke hugeuka rangi ya dhahabu nafaka inapokomaa.

Wakulima Wadigo hupanda aina kadhaa, zikiwemo *pishori* yenye harufu nzuri, *sindano* (pia huitwa *lokoli*), *mosi wa sigara*, *gushe* na *kanja*.
about.dg:
*Mphunga* ni nafaka ya jamii ya nyasi, yenye makodza membamba na masuche ga tembe ganayoinama. Unaphandwa kpwenye minda inayoodzala madzi wakati wa mvula, na masuche ganakala ga rangi ya zahabu tembe zichiivwa.

Akurima a Adigo anaphanda aina nyinji, phamwenga na *pishori* yenye mzingo, *sindano* (inayoihwa piya *lokoli*), *mosi wa sigara*, *gushe* na *kanja*.

where.en: Rice is grown in low, seasonally flooded paddy fields called *bura*. Preparing a field for planting has its own verb, *siya*. Look for green paddies in low-lying ground during the rains.
where.sw: Mpunga hulimwa katika mashamba ya chini yanayofurika maji kwa msimu yanayoitwa *bura*. Kutayarisha shamba kwa ajili ya kupanda kuna kitenzi chake maalum, *siya*. Tafuta mashamba ya mpunga ya kijani katika ardhi ya chini wakati wa mvua.
where.dg: *Mphunga* unaphandwa kpwenye minda ya photsi inayoodzala madzi wakati wa mvula, inayoihwa *bura*. Kuandaa munda wa kuphanda mphunga kuna neno rakpwe, *siya*. Wakati wa mvula, lola minda ya mphunga ya chijani kpwenye tsi ya photsi.

uses.en:
Rice is the heart of coastal cooking. *Wali wa nazi*, rice cooked in coconut milk, is served at nearly every meal. *Mshombo* is rice cooked with green gram.

Rice is also ground into flour for *vitumbua*, small round rice cakes, and for *mkate wa kumimina*, a rice-flour bread baked with coconut milk.
uses.sw:
Wali ndio kiini cha mapishi ya pwani. *Wali wa nazi*, wali uliopikwa kwa tui la nazi, huandaliwa karibu katika kila mlo. *Mshombo* ni wali uliopikwa pamoja na pojo.

Mchele pia husagwa kuwa unga wa *vitumbua*, keki ndogo za mviringo za mchele, na wa *mkate wa kumimina*, mkate wa unga wa mchele unaookwa kwa tui la nazi.
uses.dg:
*Mphunga* ni moyo wa kujita kpwa pwani. *Wali wa nazi*, mtele uriojitwa na huwi, nkuandazwa karibu chila wakati wa kurya. *Mshombo* ni wari uriojitwa na podzo.

Mtele piya nkusagbwa unga wa kuhenda *vitumbua*, mikahe midide ya mtele, na *mkate wa kumimina*, mkahe wa unga wa mtele unaojitwa na huwi.

culture.en: The rice plant has given its name to other things. Coconut florets are called *punga* because they look like the heads of *mphunga*.
culture.sw: Mmea wa mpunga umetoa jina lake kwa vitu vingine. Vijua vya mnazi huitwa *punga* kwa sababu vinafanana na mashuke ya *mphunga*.
culture.dg: Dzina ra *mphunga* rikahumirwa kpwa vitu vyanjina. Maruwa ga mnazi nkuihwa *punga* kpwa sababu ganaonekana dza masuche ga *mphunga*.

names.en: Digo has separate words for the crop and the grain. *Mphunga* is rice growing in the field. Uncooked rice is *mtele* or *mtsele*; in older Digo *mtele* meant cooked rice, which is now *wari*. Swahili makes the same distinctions: *mpunga* (plant), *mchele* (grain) and *wali* (cooked). English: rice. Scientists call it *Oryza sativa*.
names.sw: Kidigo kina maneno tofauti kwa zao na kwa nafaka. *Mphunga* ni mpunga unaokua shambani. Mchele ambao haujapikwa ni *mtele* au *mtsele*; katika Kidigo cha zamani *mtele* ilimaanisha wali, ambao sasa ni *wari*. Kiswahili kina tofauti zilezile: *mpunga* (mmea), *mchele* (nafaka) na *wali* (uliopikwa). Kiingereza: *rice*. Wanasayansi huuita *Oryza sativa*.
names.dg: Chidigo china maneno ga tafwauti kpwa mmea na kpwa tembe. *Mphunga* ni mmea wa mtele unaomera mndani. Tembe zisizojitwa ni *mtele* au *mtsele*; kpwa Chidigo cha kare *mtele* kala ni mtele uriojitwa, ambao sambi ni *wari*. Chiswahili china tafwauti izo izo: *mpunga* (mmea), *mchele* (tembe) na *wali* (uriojitwa). Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *rice*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Oryza sativa*.

reason.en: Sorghum, another grain crop

definition.en: An ear of cereal such as rice or wheat. Pakia names the rice panicle suche ra mphunga.
definition.sw: Shuke la nafaka kama mpunga au ngano. Pakia analiita shuke la mpunga suche ra mphunga.
definition.dg: Seemu ya dzulu ya nafaka dza mphunga au ngano ambapho tembe zinamera. Pakia anaiha seemu iyo ya mphunga *suche ra mphunga*.

definition.en: Uncooked rice grain.
definition.sw: Mchele ambao haujapikwa.
definition.dg: Tembe za mtele zisizojitwa.

definition.en: Cleaned rice grain. Mgombato gives it as the rice plant or uncooked rice in modern use, and cooked rice in older use.
definition.sw: Mchele uliosafishwa. Mgombato analitoa kama mmea wa mpunga au mchele ambao haujapikwa katika matumizi ya kisasa, na wali katika matumizi ya zamani.
definition.dg: Tembe za mtele zirizoezwa. Mgombato unaandika kukala kpwa matumizi ga sambi ni muhi wa mphunga au mtele usiojitwa, na kpwa matumizi ga kare ni mtele uriojitwa.

meaning.en: From an old Bantu word for 'cleaned grain', which also gave tsere, maize.
meaning.sw: Kutoka neno la zamani la Kibantu lenye maana ya 'nafaka iliyosafishwa', ambalo pia lilizaa tsere, mahindi.
meaning.dg: Rinalavywa kula neno ra kare ra Chibantu ra 'tembe zirizoezwa', ambaro piya rikalavya *tsere*, matsere.

definition.en: Cooked rice. In older usage it meant cooked maize meal.
definition.sw: Wali. Katika matumizi ya zamani lilimaanisha ugali wa mahindi uliopikwa.
definition.dg: Mtele uriojitwa. Kare kala rinamaanisha unga wa matsere uriojitwa.

teaser.en: A climbing bean that covers fences in purple flowers, then feeds the household with its pods, seeds and leaves.
teaser.sw: Mharagwe unaotambaa ambao hufunika ua kwa maua ya zambarau, kisha hulisha familia kwa maganda, mbegu na majani yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa kunde unaofyombera, unaofwinika chigo kpwa maruwa ga zambarau, chisha unarisa atu a nyumba kpwa makakayage, tembeze na makodzage.

summary.en: *Mpupu* is the lablab or hyacinth bean, a vigorous climber with purple flowers and flat pods. Its seeds, pods and leaves are all cooked and eaten.
summary.sw: *Mpupu* ni fiwi, mmea unaotambaa kwa nguvu wenye maua ya zambarau na maganda bapa. Mbegu, maganda na majani yake yote hupikwa na kuliwa.
summary.dg: *Mpupu* ni *lablab bean* au *hyacinth bean*, mmea unaofyombera wenye nguvu, wenye maruwa ga zambarau na makakaya mabapa. Tembeze, makakayage na makodzage vyosi nkujitwa na nkuriwa.

about.en:
*Mpupu* is a vigorous, twining bean that can cover a fence or a small tree in a season. Its leaves have three broad leaflets, and its flowers, usually purple or pinkish-purple, grow on long upright stalks above the leaves.

The pods are flat and broad, often with a purple edge, and hold several rounded seeds, each with a pale, raised scar along one side.
about.sw:
*Mpupu* ni mmea wa jamii ya maharagwe unaojizungusha na kukua kwa nguvu, unaoweza kufunika ua au mti mdogo katika msimu mmoja. Majani yake yana vijani vitatu vipana, na maua yake, kwa kawaida ya zambarau au zambarau-waridi, huota juu ya vikonyo virefu vilivyosimama juu ya majani.

Maganda ni bapa na mapana, mara nyingi yakiwa na ukingo wa zambarau, na hubeba mbegu kadhaa za mviringo, kila moja ikiwa na kovu jeupe lililoinuka upande mmoja.
about.dg:
*Mpupu* ni mmea wa kunde wenye nguvu, unaodzizunguluka, ambao unaweza kufwinika lichigo au muhi mdide kpwa msimu mmwenga. Makodzage ganamera mahahu-mahahu, ni mapana, na maruwage, mara nyinji ga zambarau au ga zambarau-pinki, ganamera kpwa milita mire inayoima chocho dzulu ya makodza.

Makakaya ni mabapa na mapana, mara nyinji genye mphaka wa zambarau, na ganakala na tembe kadhaa za duara, na chila tembe ina alama ya rangi ngushu-ngushu iriyoinuka uphande mmwenga.

where.en: *Mpupu* is grown on farms and trained over fences and around homesteads, where it can climb freely. It is easiest to spot when the purple flower spikes are out.
where.sw: *Mpupu* hupandwa mashambani na huelekezwa kutambaa juu ya nyua na kuzunguka makazi, ambapo unaweza kupanda bila kizuizi. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona wakati vishada vya maua ya zambarau vimechanua.
where.dg: *Mpupu* nkurimwa mindani na nkukpwezwa dzulu ya chigo na kanda-kanda ya midzi, ambako unaweza kufyombera bila chizuwizi. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona wakati maruwage ga zambarau ganatuluka kpwenye milita.

uses.en: The seeds and young pods are cooked, and the leaves are eaten as a vegetable. As with other legumes, the plant also enriches the soil it grows in.
uses.sw: Mbegu na maganda machanga hupikwa, na majani huliwa kama mboga. Kama mimea mingine ya jamii ya kunde, mmea huu pia huongeza rutuba ya udongo unamoota.
uses.dg: Tembe na makakaya matsanga nkujitwa, na makodza nkuriwa dza mtsunga. Dza mimea yanjina ya jamii ya kunde, mmea hinyu piya unahenda ulongo unaomera ukale mnono.

names.en: Digo: *mpupu*. The Mgombato dictionary gives its Swahili equivalent as *mfiwi mafuta*. Swahili: *fiwi*. English: lablab bean or hyacinth bean. Scientists call it *Lablab purpureus* (formerly *Dolichos lablab*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *mpupu*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa kisawe chake cha Kiswahili kuwa *mfiwi mafuta*. Kiswahili: *fiwi*. Kiingereza: *lablab bean* au *hyacinth bean*. Wanasayansi huuita *Lablab purpureus* (zamani *Dolichos lablab*).
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mpupu*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inalavya dzina ra Chiswahili *mfiwi mafuta*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *fiwi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lablab bean* au *hyacinth bean*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Lablab purpureus* (kare *Dolichos lablab*).

teaser.en: Ask for 'pindi sita za muwa' and you will be handed a piece of sugar cane six joints long.
teaser.sw: Ukiomba *pindi sita za muwa*, utapewa kipande cha muwa chenye pingili sita.
teaser.dg: Uchivoya '*pindi sita za muwa*', undahewa chipande cha muwa chenye pindi sita.

summary.en: *Muwa* is sugar cane, a tall jointed grass with sweet, juicy stems. It is grown in garden patches and was once farmed on a large estate at Ramisi.
summary.sw: *Muwa* ni mmea mrefu wa jamii ya nyasi wenye pingili na mashina matamu yenye maji mengi. Hupandwa katika vipande vidogo vya bustani, na zamani ulilimwa katika shamba kubwa huko Ramisi.
summary.dg: *Muwa* ni mmea mure wa jamii ya nyasi wenye pindi, na mihiye ni ya mtswano na ina madzi manji. Unaphandwa kpwenye minda midide ya kaya, na kare kala unarimwa kpwenye munda mkulu sana wa Ramisi.

about.en:
*Muwa* is a tall, thick-stemmed grass that grows in clumps, its stems divided into joints like bamboo. The leaves are long and narrow with sharp edges. The stems can be green, yellow or purple, depending on the variety, and are filled with sweet, juicy fibre.

A single joint-length of cane is a *pindi*.
about.sw:
*Muwa* ni nyasi ndefu yenye mashina manene inayokua kwa vichaka, na mashina yake yamegawanyika kwa pingili kama mianzi. Majani yake ni marefu na membamba yenye kingo kali. Mashina yanaweza kuwa ya kijani, njano au zambarau, kutegemea aina, na yamejaa nyuzi tamu zenye maji mengi.

Urefu wa pingili moja ya muwa huitwa *pindi*.
about.dg:
*Muwa* ni mmea mure wa jamii ya nyasi wenye mihi minene, unaomera kpwa makundi, na mihiye ina mafundo dza mianzi. Makodzage ni mare na membamba, genye kanda zenye makali. Kpwa aina za tafwauti, mihi ni ya chijani, ya rangi ya mandano au ya zambarau, na ina nyuzi za mtswano zenye madzi manji.

Chipande cha muwa kahi ya fundo na fundo ni *pindi*.

where.en: Sugar cane grows in garden patches near homesteads, often on damp ground. On the south coast, the Ramisi area was home to a sugar estate, now closed.
where.sw: Miwa hukua katika vipande vya bustani karibu na makazi, mara nyingi kwenye ardhi yenye unyevunyevu. Pwani ya kusini, eneo la Ramisi lilikuwa na shamba kubwa la miwa, ambalo sasa limefungwa.
where.dg: *Muwa* unamera kpwenye minda midide phephi na midzi, mara nyinji kpwenye tsi yenye chinemi. Pwani ya kusini, eneo ra Ramisi kala rina munda mkulu wa sukari, ambao sambi ukafungbwa.

uses.en: Cane is cut into lengths, peeled with a knife and chewed fresh for its sweet juice. The chewed-out fibres left behind are called *vwanda*.
uses.sw: Muwa hukatwa vipande, humenywa kwa kisu na kutafunwa ukiwa mbichi ili kufyonza maji yake matamu. Makapi yanayobaki baada ya kutafunwa huitwa *vwanda*.
uses.dg: Miwa nkukatwa vipande, nkugandulwa kpwa rumu na nkuafunwa dza irivyo kuphaha madzige ga mtswano. Nyuzi zinazosala bada ya kuafunwa nkuihwa *vwanda*.

culture.en: A Mgombato example sentence shows how the cane is measured: *Nipha pindi sita za muwa*, 'Give me a piece of sugar cane six sections long.'
culture.sw: Sentensi ya mfano katika Mgombato inaonyesha jinsi muwa unavyopimwa: *Nipha pindi sita za muwa*, 'Nipe kipande cha muwa chenye pingili sita.'
culture.dg: Mfwano mmwenga wa Mgombato unaonyesa muwa unavyopimwa: *Nipha pindi sita za muwa*, 'Nipha chipande cha muwa chenye pindi sita.'

names.en: Digo: *muwa*, plural *miwa*. A joint of cane is a *pindi*, and the chewed fibres are *vwanda*. Swahili: *muwa*. English: sugar cane. Scientists call it *Saccharum officinarum*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *muwa*, wingi *miwa*. Pingili moja ya muwa ni *pindi*, na makapi yaliyotafunwa ni *vwanda*. Kiswahili: *muwa*. Kwa Kiingereza: *sugar cane*. Wanasayansi huuita *Saccharum officinarum*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *muwa*, unji *miwa*. Chipande chimwenga cha muwa ni *pindi*, na nyuzi zirizoafunwa ni *vwanda*. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *muwa*, kpwa Chingereza *sugar cane*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Saccharum officinarum*.

definition.en: A section of sugarcane between two joints, about 15 cm long. Mgombato: 'Nipha pindi sita za muwa', 'give me a piece six sections long' (about a metre).

definition.dg: Chipande cha muwa kahi ya fundo na fundo, cha sm 15 hivi. Mgombato: 'Nipha pindi sita za muwa', 'nipha chipande chenye pindi sita' (mita mwenga hivi).

teaser.en: Its leaves are a vegetable in their own right, *bwere*, and a wild bean is even named after the way it spreads.
teaser.sw: Majani yake ni mboga kamili yenyewe, *bwere*, na kuna hata kunde-pori iliyopewa jina kutokana na jinsi inavyotambaa.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ni mboga yenye, *bwere*, na hata mmea mmwenga wa tsaka wa jamii ya kunde ukaihwa dzina ririrolavywa kula muyogbwe, kpwa sababu nao unaenea vivyo.

summary.en: *Muyogbwe* is the sweet potato, a creeping vine grown on ridges on sandy farms. Both its sweet tubers and its leaves, *bwere*, are eaten.
summary.sw: *Muyogbwe* ni kiazi kitamu, mtambaa unaopandwa kwenye matuta katika mashamba ya mchanga. Viazi vyake vitamu na majani yake, *bwere*, vyote huliwa.
summary.dg: *Muyogbwe* ni mmea unaoambala photsi (*sweet potato* kpwa Chingereza), unaophandwa kpwenye matuta kpwenye minda ya mtsanga. Viazivye vya mtswano na makodzage, *bwere*, vyosi nkuriwa.

about.en:
*Muyogbwe* is a creeping vine that spreads across the ground, rooting as it goes. Its leaves are heart-shaped or lobed, and it sometimes bears pale purple, trumpet-shaped flowers like a morning glory, to which it is related.

Below ground it forms swollen tubers with red, purple or cream skins and sweet flesh.
about.sw:
*Muyogbwe* ni mtambaa unaoenea ardhini, ukiota mizizi kadiri unavyosonga. Majani yake yana umbo la moyo au yenye mapengo, na wakati mwingine huzaa maua ya zambarau hafifu yenye umbo la tarumbeta, kama ya *morning glory* (jamii ya Ipomoea), ambayo ni jamaa yake.

Chini ya ardhi hutengeneza viazi vilivyovimba vyenye maganda mekundu, ya zambarau au ya rangi ya krimu, na nyama tamu.
about.dg:
*Muyogbwe* ni mmea unaoambala photsi na kuenea, uchilavya mizi phatu phosi unaphotsupa. Makodzage ni ga umbo ra moyo au genye mala, na wakati wanjina unalavya maruwa ga rangi ya zambarau ngushu-ngushu, ga umbo ra ndzumari, dza ga *morning glory*, ambayo ni ndugu zakpwe.

Tsini unahenda viazi virivyofutuka, vyenye magada ga kundu, ga zambarau au ga rangi ya maziya, na nyama ya mtswano.

where.en: Sweet potatoes are planted on ridges on sandy farms, where the loose soil lets the tubers swell. A sweet-potato patch is easy to spot by its low carpet of vines.
where.sw: Viazi vitamu hupandwa kwenye matuta katika mashamba ya mchanga, ambapo udongo laini huruhusu viazi kuvimba. Shamba la viazi vitamu ni rahisi kulitambua kwa zulia lake fupi la mitambaa.
where.dg: *Muyogbwe* unaphandwa kpwenye matuta kpwenye minda ya mtsanga, ambapho shangasheshe inaricha viazi vifutuke. Munda wa muyogbwe ni rahisi kuuona kpwa sababu mimeaye inafwinika tsi dza mcheka.

uses.en: The tubers are boiled or cooked in coconut milk. The leaves, *bwere*, are cooked as greens.
uses.sw: Viazi huchemshwa au hupikwa kwa tui la nazi. Majani, *bwere*, hupikwa kama mboga za majani.
uses.dg: Viazi nkuchemushwa au nkujitwa na huwi. Makodza, *bwere*, nkujitwa dza mboga.

culture.en: The way sweet potato creeps over the ground is so familiar that a wild legume has been named *yogweyogwe* after it, because it spreads in the same way.
culture.sw: Jinsi kiazi kitamu kinavyotambaa ardhini ni jambo linalojulikana sana kiasi kwamba mmea mmoja wa porini wa jamii ya kunde umepewa jina *yogweyogwe* kutokana nacho, kwa sababu unaenea kwa namna hiyo hiyo.
culture.dg: Namna muyogbwe unavyoambala photsi ni dzambo ra kawaida sana hata mmea mmwenga wa tsaka wa jamii ya kunde ukaihwa *yogweyogwe*, dzina ririrolavywa kula muyogbwe, kpwa sababu nao unaenea vivyo.

names.en: Digo: *muyogbwe* in Mgombato and *myogwe* in Pakia. The leaves are *bwere* or *matamberi*; *matamberi* is close to the Tanzanian Swahili *matembele*. Swahili: *kiazi kitamu*. English: sweet potato. Scientists call it *Ipomoea batatas*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *muyogbwe* katika Mgombato na *myogwe* katika Pakia. Majani ni *bwere* au *matamberi*; *matamberi* linakaribiana na neno la Kiswahili cha Tanzania *matembele*. Kiswahili: *kiazi kitamu*. Kwa Kiingereza: *sweet potato*. Wanasayansi huuita *Ipomoea batatas*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *muyogbwe* kpwenye Mgombato na *myogwe* kpwenye Pakia. Makodza ni *bwere* au *matamberi*; *matamberi* ni phephi na *matembele* ya Chiswahili cha Tanzania. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *kiazi kitamu*, kpwa Chingereza *sweet potato*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Ipomoea batatas*.

teaser.en: Its flowers bloom above ground, then the young pods push down into the soil to ripen in the dark.
teaser.sw: Maua yake huchanua juu ya ardhi, kisha maganda machanga hujipenyeza chini udongoni kuivia gizani.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ganatuluka dzulu ya tsi, chisha makakaya matsanga ganainjira photsi ndani ya ulongo ili kuivwa gizani.

summary.en: *Njugu karanga* is the groundnut or peanut, a low legume whose pods ripen underground. On the coast the nuts are roasted, boiled or ground into sauces.
summary.sw: *Njugu karanga* ni karanga (njugu nyasa), mmea mfupi wa jamii ya kunde ambao maganda yake huivia chini ya ardhi. Pwani karanga hukaangwa, huchemshwa au husagwa kutengeneza michuzi.
summary.dg: *Njugu karanga* ni mmea wa kunde wa tsini-tsini ambao makakayage ganaivwa tsini. Pwani njugu nkuochwa, nkutsemswa au nkusagwa kuhenda mtsuzi.

about.en:
*Njugu karanga* is a low, bushy legume with leaves of four small oval leaflets and small yellow pea flowers. After flowering, the flower stalk lengthens and bends down, pushing the developing pod into the soil, where it ripens.

The pods are pale, wrinkled shells holding one to three seeds in papery red-brown skins.
about.sw:
*Njugu karanga* ni mmea mfupi wenye matawi mengi wa jamii ya kunde, wenye majani ya vijani vinne vidogo vyenye umbo la yai na maua madogo ya manjano kama ya njegere. Baada ya kuchanua, kikonyo cha ua hurefuka na kupinda chini, kikisukuma ganda linalokua ndani ya udongo, ambamo huiva.

Maganda ni makaka meupe yenye makunyanzi yanayobeba mbegu moja hadi tatu zilizofunikwa kwa maganda membamba kama karatasi ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu.
about.dg:
*Njugu karanga* ni mmea mdide wa kunde wenye panda nyinji, wenye makodza madide ga duara-ndefu ganagomera mane-mane, na maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano dza ga kunde. Bada ya kulavya maruwa, mlita wa ruwa unakala mure na kubeduka photsi, uchisukuma kakaya rinarokula ndani ya ulongo, ambamo rinaivwa.

Makakaya ni magada ga rangi ngushu-ngushu ganagokunjamana, na ndani gana tembe mwenga hadi tahu zirizofwinikpwa ni magada membamba dza karatasi, ga rangi ya kundu na dongo.

where.en: Groundnuts are grown on sandy soils, which are loose enough for the pods to form and easy to dig at harvest.
where.sw: Karanga hulimwa kwenye udongo wa mchanga, ambao ni tifutifu kiasi cha kuruhusu maganda kujitengeneza na ni rahisi kuchimba wakati wa mavuno.
where.dg: Njugu nkurimwa kpwenye ulongo wa mtsanga, ambao ni laini chiasi cha makakaya kuweza kumera na ni rahisi kutsimba wakati wa mavuno.

uses.en:
The nuts are roasted or boiled and eaten as snacks, or ground into a paste to thicken sauces and stews.

Harvesting groundnuts has its own Digo verb, *fuka*.
uses.sw:
Karanga hukaangwa au huchemshwa na kuliwa kama vitafunio, au husagwa kuwa rojo la kuongeza uzito kwenye michuzi na mitoweo.

Kuvuna karanga kuna kitenzi chake maalum cha Kidigo, *fuka*.
uses.dg:
Njugu nkuochwa au nkutsemswa na kuriwa dza vitu vya kuafuna, au nkusagwa kuhenda uji-uji wa kuhenda mitsuzi ikale miziho.

Kuvuna njugu kuna nenore ra Chidigo, *fuka*.

names.en: Digo: *njugu karanga* in Mgombato and *njugu nyasa* in Pakia. Swahili: *karanga* or *njugu nyasa*. English: groundnut or peanut. Scientists call it *Arachis hypogaea*. The plant comes originally from South America.
names.sw: Kidigo: *njugu karanga* katika Mgombato na *njugu nyasa* katika Pakia. Kiswahili: *karanga* au *njugu nyasa*. Kiingereza: *groundnut* au *peanut*. Wanasayansi huuita *Arachis hypogaea*. Asili ya mmea huu ni Amerika Kusini.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *njugu karanga* kpwenye Mgombato na *njugu nyasa* kpwa Pakia. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *karanga* au *njugu nyasa*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *groundnut* au *peanut*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Arachis hypogaea*. Mmea hinyu asiliye ni Amerika ya Kusini.

teaser.en: Its grain heads look like long, grey-green candles, and they survive where maize gives up.
teaser.sw: Masuke yake yanafanana na mishumaa mirefu ya rangi ya kijivu-kijani, na huweza kustahimili pale ambapo mahindi hushindwa.
teaser.dg: Vitswavye vya tembe vinaonekana dza mishumaa mire ya rangi ya ivu na chijani, na unamera hata phatu ambapho pemba taiweza.

summary.en: Pearl millet is a hardy cereal with long cylindrical grain heads. On the Digo coast it is a minor grain of the dry inland farms, ground for porridge and *ugali*.
summary.sw: Mwele ni nafaka ngumu yenye masuke marefu ya mviringo. Katika pwani ya Wadigo ni nafaka ndogo ya mashamba makavu ya bara, inayosagwa kwa ajili ya uji na *ugali*.
summary.dg: *Pearl millet* ni nafaka ngumu yenye vitswa vire vya mviringo. Pwani ya Adigo ni nafaka inayophandwa chidide kpwenye minda kavu ya bara, na tembe nkusagbwa kuhenda uji na *sima*.

about.en:
Pearl millet is a tall cereal grass with broad leaves and stems ending in a long, dense, cylindrical head packed with small, round, pearl-grey grains. The heads can be as long as a forearm.

It is one of the most drought-tolerant cereals in the world.
about.sw:
Mwele ni nyasi ndefu ya nafaka yenye majani mapana na mashina yanayoishia kwa suke refu, zito la mviringo lililojaa punje ndogo za mviringo za rangi ya kijivu kama lulu. Masuke yanaweza kuwa marefu kama mkono kutoka kiwiko hadi kiganja.

Ni mojawapo ya nafaka zinazostahimili ukame zaidi duniani.
about.dg:
*Pearl millet* ni nyasi nyire ya nafaka yenye makodza mapana. Mihiye inamala na chitswa chire, chiziho na cha mviringo, chirichodzala tembe ndide za mviringo za rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu dza lulu. Vitswa vinaweza kukala vire dza mkpwono wa mutu kula chisuku-suku hadi vyalani.

Ni kahi ya nafaka za dunia zinazovumirira ukame kuriko zanjina zosi.

where.en: Pearl millet is a minor grain grown on dry inland farms, where rain is too uncertain for maize.
where.sw: Mwele ni nafaka ndogo inayolimwa katika mashamba makavu ya bara, ambako mvua haitabiriki kiasi cha kutofaa kwa mahindi.
where.dg: *Pearl millet* ni nafaka inayophandwa chidide kpwenye minda kavu ya bara, phatu ambapho mvula taina uhakika na pemba taiweza kumera sawa-sawa.

uses.en: The grain is ground into flour for porridge and *ugali*.
uses.sw: Punje husagwa kuwa unga kwa ajili ya uji na *ugali*.
uses.dg: Tembe nkusagbwa kuhenda unga wa uji na wa *sima*.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. The Mgombato dictionary glosses *mhama* as 'millet', but gives the Swahili *mtama*, which normally means sorghum, so it probably does not refer to this plant. Swahili: *mwele* or *uwele*. English: pearl millet. Scientists call it *Pennisetum glaucum* (now also *Cenchrus americanus*).
names.sw: Bado hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatafsiri *mhama* kama 'millet', lakini inatoa neno la Kiswahili *mtama*, ambalo kwa kawaida lina maana ya mtama (sorghum), kwa hivyo huenda halimaanishi mmea huu. Kiswahili: *mwele* au *uwele*. Kwa Kiingereza: *pearl millet*. Wanasayansi huuita *Pennisetum glaucum* (sasa pia *Cenchrus americanus*).
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaeleza *mhama* kukala 'millet', ela inalavya neno ra Chiswahili *mtama*, ambaro kpwa kawaida rina mana ya *sorghum*, kpwa hivyo chahi tarimaanisha mmea hinyu. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mwele* au *uwele*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *pearl millet*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Pennisetum glaucum* (sambi piya *Cenchrus americanus*).

reason.en: Sorghum, the other dry-land cereal
reason.sw: Mtama, nafaka nyingine ya maeneo makavu
reason.dg: Mhama (sorghum), nafaka yanjina ya tsi kavu

reason.en: Maize, the main cereal for ugali
reason.sw: Mahindi, nafaka kuu ya ugali
reason.dg: Matsere, nafaka kulu ya kuhenda sima

reason.en: A wild grass relative
reason.sw: Ndugu wa porini wa jamii ya nyasi
reason.dg: Nyasi ya weruni iriyo nduguye

reason.en: Rice, another grain crop
reason.sw: Mpunga, zao jingine la nafaka
reason.dg: Mphunga, nafaka yanjina inayophandwa
