digo_source: Mgombato ('podzo mung bean, green gram'; 'choroko mung bean'); Pakia ('Podzo', light and dark varieties)

teaser.en: Cook these little green beans with rice and you have *mshombo*, a comforting coastal favourite.
teaser.sw: Pika punje hizi ndogo za kijani pamoja na mchele upate *mshombo*, chakula cha pwani kinachopendwa na kinachoburudisha.
teaser.dg: Jita tembe hizi ndide za chijani phamwenga na mtele, nawe undaphaha *mshombo*, chakurya cha pwani chinachomendzwa ni anji na chinachotuliza moyo.

summary.en: *Podzo* is green gram or mung bean, a small bushy pulse that grows quickly in a short season. It is cooked in coconut milk or with rice as *mshombo*.
summary.sw: *Podzo* ni pojo au choroko, mmea mdogo wa jamii ya kunde wenye matawi mengi unaokua haraka katika msimu mfupi. Hupikwa kwa tui la nazi au pamoja na mchele kama *mshombo*.
summary.dg: *Podzo* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde wenye panda nyinji, unaokula haraka kpwa msimu mfupi. Nkujitwa kpwa huwi, au ichijitwa phamwenga na mtele inakala *mshombo*.

about.en:
*Podzo* is a small, bushy bean plant with leaves of three leaflets and small yellow flowers. Its slender, hairy pods hold rows of small, round, olive-green seeds.

Digo farmers distinguish light and dark varieties.
about.sw:
*Podzo* ni mmea mdogo wa jamii ya maharagwe wenye matawi mengi, wenye majani ya vijani vitatu na maua madogo ya manjano. Maganda yake membamba yenye manyoya yana safu za mbegu ndogo, za mviringo, za rangi ya kijani-zeituni.

Wakulima wa Kidigo hutofautisha aina zenye rangi hafifu na zenye rangi iliyokolea.
about.dg:
*Podzo* ni mmea mdide wa kunde wenye panda nyinji. Makodzage ganamera mahahu-mahahu, na maruwage ni madide, ga rangi ya mandano. Makakayage ni membamba na gana nyere, na ndani gana mistari ya tembe ndide za duara, za rangi ya chijani cha kufifia.

Akurima Adigo anatafwautisha aina za rangi ya kufifia na aina za rangi ya giza.

where.en: *Podzo* is a short-season pulse, planted to make the most of short rains and harvested quickly. It is grown on family farms and sold dried in every market.
where.sw: *Podzo* ni zao la mikunde la msimu mfupi, linalopandwa ili kutumia vyema mvua za vuli na kuvunwa haraka. Hupandwa kwenye mashamba ya familia na huuzwa likiwa limekaushwa katika kila soko.
where.dg: *Podzo* ni zao ra msimu mfupi: nkuphandwa ili kuhumira vinono mvula za vuri, na nkuvunwa haraka. Nkurimwa kpwenye minda ya mbari, na nkuguzwa ichikala kavu chila sokoni.

uses.en: The seeds are cooked in coconut milk. Cooked with rice, they make *mshombo*.
uses.sw: Mbegu hupikwa kwa tui la nazi. Zikipikwa pamoja na mchele, hutengeneza *mshombo*.
uses.dg: Tembe nkujitwa kpwa huwi. Zichijitwa phamwenga na mtele, zinakala *mshombo*.

names.en: Digo: *podzo*, also *choroko*. Swahili: *pojo* or *choroko*. English: green gram or mung bean. Scientists call it *Vigna radiata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *podzo*, pia *choroko*. Kiswahili: *pojo* au *choroko*. Kwa Kiingereza: *green gram* au *mung bean*. Wanasayansi huuita *Vigna radiata*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *podzo*, piya *choroko*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *pojo* au *choroko*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *green gram* au *mung bean*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Vigna radiata*.

reason.en: Cowpea, another Vigna cooked in coconut
reason.sw: Kunde, Vigna nyingine inayopikwa kwa nazi
reason.dg: *Kunde*, *Vigna* yanjina inayojitwa kpwa huwi

reason.en: Bambara groundnut, also a Vigna
reason.sw: Njugu mawe, nayo ni jamii ya Vigna
reason.dg: *Tendegbwa*, nayo piya ni *Vigna*

reason.sw: Mpunga, mchele wake hupikwa pamoja na pojo kuwa mshombo
reason.dg: Mtele, unaojitwa phamwenga na *podzo* kuhenda *mshombo*

reason.en: Pigeon pea, another coastal pulse
reason.sw: Mbaazi, jamii nyingine ya mikunde ya pwani
reason.dg: *Mbalazi*, zao ranjina ra jamii ya kunde ra pwani

definition.en: Mung bean; Mgombato's other word alongside podzo. Mgombato's only gloss is 'mung bean', so it is unclear whether choroko names the beans or the plant.
definition.sw: Pojo; neno lingine la Mgombato pamoja na podzo. Maana pekee inayotolewa na Mgombato ni 'mung bean', hivyo haijulikani wazi kama choroko ni jina la punje au la mmea.
definition.dg: *Podzo*; ni neno ranjina ra Mgombato phamwenga na *podzo*. Mgombato inalavya mana mwenga tu, 'mung bean', kpwa hivyo tagamanyikana kukala *choroko* ni dzina ra tembe au ra mmea.

digo: tendegbwa (Mgombato, glossed 'groundnut; njugu mawe'); tendegwa mawe / njugu mawe (Pakia)

teaser.en: Its seeds are so hard that Swahili calls them 'stone nuts', and they ripen underground like peanuts.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake ni ngumu kiasi kwamba Kiswahili huziita 'njugu mawe', na huiva chini ya ardhi kama karanga.
teaser.dg: Tembeze ni ngumu sana hata Aswahili anaziiha *njugu mawe*, 'njugu za mawe', na zinaivwa tsini dza njugu karanga.

summary.en: *Tendegbwa* is the Bambara groundnut, a low legume whose hard, round seeds ripen underground. It is a minor crop of sandy soils, eaten boiled.
summary.sw: *Tendegbwa* ni njugu mawe, mmea mfupi wa jamii ya kunde ambao mbegu zake ngumu za mviringo huiva chini ya ardhi. Ni zao dogo la udongo wa mchanga, huliwa likiwa limechemshwa.
summary.dg: *Tendegbwa* ni *Bambara groundnut*, mmea wa jamii ya kunde unaomera photsi photsi, ambao tembeze ngumu za mviringo zinaivwa tsini. Ni mmea unaophandwa chidide kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga, na tembe nkuriwa zichichemuswa.

about.en:
*Tendegbwa* is a low, creeping legume with leaves of three leaflets, growing in a tight rosette close to the ground. Like the peanut, it buries its developing pods in the soil.

Each small, round pod holds one or two very hard, round seeds, cream, red, brown or speckled.
about.sw:
*Tendegbwa* ni mmea mfupi unaotambaa wa jamii ya kunde, wenye majani ya vijani vitatu, unaokua kama duara lililoshikamana karibu na ardhi. Kama karanga, huzika maganda yake yanayokua ndani ya udongo.

Kila ganda dogo la mviringo lina mbegu moja au mbili ngumu sana za mviringo, za rangi ya krimu, nyekundu, kahawia au zenye madoadoa.
about.dg:
*Tendegbwa* ni mmea wa jamii ya kunde unaoambala photsi. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu, na makodza ganamera kpwa fungu ririrogbwirana phephi na tsi. Dza njugu karanga, unazika makakayage ganayokula tsini mwa ulongo.

Chila kakaya ridide ra mviringo rina tembe mwenga au mbiri ngumu sana za mviringo, za rangi ya maziya, za kundu, za rangi ya dongo au za mabara-mabara.

where.en: *Tendegbwa* is a minor crop on sandy soils, where the pods can develop easily underground.
where.sw: *Tendegbwa* ni zao dogo kwenye udongo wa mchanga, ambako maganda yanaweza kukua kwa urahisi chini ya ardhi.
where.dg: *Tendegbwa* ni mmea unaophandwa chidide kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga, phatu ambapho makakaya ganaweza kukula tsini bila shida.

uses.en: The seeds are boiled until soft and eaten.
uses.sw: Mbegu huchemshwa hadi zilainike kisha huliwa.
uses.dg: Tembe nkuchemuswa hadi zikale laini, chisha nkuriwa.

names.en: Digo: *tendegbwa* in Mgombato, which glosses it as 'groundnut'; Pakia gives *tendegwa mawe* or *njugu mawe*. Swahili: *njugu mawe*, 'stone nuts', for their hardness. English: Bambara groundnut. Scientists call it *Vigna subterranea*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *tendegbwa* katika Mgombato, inayolitafsiri kama 'groundnut'; Pakia inatoa *tendegwa mawe* au *njugu mawe*. Kiswahili: *njugu mawe*, kwa sababu ya ugumu wake. Kwa Kiingereza: *Bambara groundnut*. Wanasayansi huuita *Vigna subterranea*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *tendegbwa* kpwenye Mgombato, ambayo inarieleza kukala 'groundnut'; Pakia analavya *tendegwa mawe* au *njugu mawe*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *njugu mawe*, 'njugu za mawe', kpwa sababu tembeze ni ngumu. Kpwa Chingereza ni *Bambara groundnut*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Vigna subterranea*.

reason.dg: Njugu karanga, nazo zinaivwa tsini

teaser.en: A pod of sesame holds dozens of tiny seeds, and together they bring both cooking oil and cash to dry farms.
teaser.sw: Ganda moja la ufuta hubeba mbegu ndogo nyingi, na kwa pamoja huleta mafuta ya kupikia na pesa katika mashamba makavu.
teaser.dg: Kakaya mwenga ra *ufuha* rina tembe ndide nyinji sana, na phamwenga zinareha mafuha ga kujitira na pesa kpwa minda ya tsi kavu.

summary.en: *Ufuha* is sesame or simsim, an upright herb grown for its small oily seeds. It is a cash crop of the drier farms and a source of cooking oil.
summary.sw: *Ufuha* ni ufuta, mmea mdogo uliosimama unaolimwa kwa ajili ya mbegu zake ndogo zenye mafuta. Ni zao la biashara la mashamba makavu na chanzo cha mafuta ya kupikia.
summary.dg: *Ufuha* (kpwa Chingereza *sesame* au *simsim*) ni mmea uimao chocho, unaorimwa kpwa sababu ya tembeze ndide zenye mafuha. Ni mmea wa kuguza ili kuphaha pesa kpwenye minda ya tsi kavu, na nkulavya mafuha ga kujitira.

about.en:
*Ufuha* is an upright herb that grows to about head height, with soft leaves and tubular, bell-shaped flowers in white or pale pink along the stem.

The flowers are followed by upright, four-sided pods packed with tiny, flat seeds. When ripe and dry, the pods split open, so the crop must be cut at the right time.

Digo farmers grow two named varieties, *ufuha mwiru* and *ufuha mwereru*.
about.sw:
*Ufuha* ni mmea mdogo uliosimama unaokua hadi karibu kimo cha kichwa cha mtu, wenye majani laini na maua yenye umbo la neli na kengele, meupe au ya waridi hafifu, kando ya shina.

Baada ya maua huja maganda yaliyosimama yenye pande nne, yaliyojaa mbegu ndogo bapa. Yakiiva na kukauka, maganda hupasuka, kwa hiyo zao lazima livunwe kwa wakati unaofaa.

Wakulima wa Kidigo hulima aina mbili zenye majina, *ufuha mwiru* na *ufuha mwereru*.
about.dg:
*Ufuha* ni mmea uimao chocho, na unakula hadi kufika chiasi cha chitswa cha mutu. Una makodza laini, na maruwa ga umbo ra kengele, ganayohalana na mridza, mereru au ga pinki ngushu-ngushu, ganayomera kanda-kanda ya mlitawe.

Bada ya maruwa kunatuluka makakaya ganayoima chocho, ga pembe nne, ganayoodzala tembe ndide sambamba. Gachiivwa na kuuma, makakaya higa ganaahuka, kpwa hivyo ni lazima ufuha ukatwe kpwa wakati unaofwaha.

Akurima Adigo nkurima aina mbiri zenye madzina: *ufuha mwiru* na *ufuha mwereru*.

where.en: Sesame is grown as a cash crop on dry farms, and it copes with heat and little rain.
where.sw: Ufuta hulimwa kama zao la biashara katika mashamba makavu, na huvumilia joto na mvua chache.
where.dg: *Ufuha* nkurimwa kpwa kuguzwa kpwenye minda ya tsi kavu, na unavumirira dzoho na mvula chache.

uses.en: The seeds are pressed for cooking oil and used in sweets and snacks. Sesame is also sold for cash income.
uses.sw: Mbegu hukamuliwa mafuta ya kupikia na hutumika katika peremende na vitafunio. Ufuta pia huuzwa ili kupata mapato.
uses.dg: Tembeze nkubanwa ili zilavye mafuha ga kujitira, na nkuhumirwa kpwenye peremende na vyakurya vidide. *Ufuha* piya nkuguzwa ili kuphaha pesa.

names.en: Digo: *ufuha*. Swahili: *ufuta*. English: sesame or simsim. Scientists call it *Sesamum orientale* (also known as *S. indicum*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *ufuha*. Kiswahili: *ufuta*. Kiingereza: *sesame* au *simsim*. Wanasayansi huuita *Sesamum orientale* (pia hujulikana kama *S. indicum*).
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *ufuha*. Kpwa Chiswahili: *ufuta*. Kpwa Chingereza: *sesame* au *simsim*. Kpwa sayansi unaihwa *Sesamum orientale* (piya unamanyikana kpwa dzina *S. indicum*).

reason.en: Wild sesame, a close relative eaten as a leafy vegetable
reason.sw: Ufuta pori, jamaa wa karibu anayeliwa kama mboga ya majani
reason.dg: *Mrenda* wa weruni, ndugu wa phephi wa *ufuha*; makodzage nkuriwa dza mboga.

reason.en: Groundnut, another oily seed of sandy farms
reason.sw: Karanga, mbegu nyingine yenye mafuta ya mashamba ya mchanga
reason.dg: Njugu karanga, tembe yanjina yenye mafuha ya minda ya mtsanga.

reason.en: Cashew, the main crop sold for income
reason.sw: Mkorosho, zao kuu linalouzwa kupata mapato
reason.dg: Ngorosho, mmea mkulu unaoguzwa ili kuphaha pesa.

reason.en: Another dry-farm cash crop
reason.sw: Zao lingine la biashara la mashamba makavu
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa kuguza wa minda ya tsi kavu.

teaser.en: A single breadfruit, roasted or simmered in coconut milk, can feed a family, and it grows on a tree.
teaser.sw: Shelisheli moja, likichomwa au kupikwa kwa tui la nazi, linaweza kulisha familia nzima, na linaota juu ya mti.
teaser.dg: Tunda mwenga ra *breadfruit*, richiochwa au richijitwa pore-pore na huwi, rinaweza kurisa mbari yosi; na rinamera dzulu ya muhi.

summary.en: Breadfruit is a handsome tree with huge lobed leaves and round, starchy fruits, planted at the coast. The fruit is baked or boiled, often in coconut milk, and eaten like a vegetable.
summary.sw: Mshelisheli ni mti mzuri wenye majani makubwa yaliyokatika na matunda ya mviringo yenye wanga, unaopandwa pwani. Tunda huokwa au huchemshwa, mara nyingi kwa tui la nazi, na huliwa kama mboga.
summary.dg: *Breadfruit* ni muhi mnono wenye makodza makulu sana genye mala, na matunda ga mviringo genye wanga, unaophandwa pwani. Tunda nkuochwa au nkuchemuswa, mara nyinji na huwi, na nkuriwa dza mboga.

about.en:
Breadfruit is a tall, spreading evergreen tree with very large, glossy leaves deeply cut into lobes, which make it easy to recognise even from a distance. Cut any part of it and a sticky white latex flows.

The fruits are round to oval, about the size of a large grapefruit, with a green skin patterned in small bumps or plates. Inside is pale, starchy flesh that becomes soft and bread-like when cooked.
about.sw:
Mshelisheli ni mti mrefu wa kijani kibichi daima unaotanda, wenye majani makubwa sana yanayong'aa yaliyokatika kwa kina, ambayo huufanya kuwa rahisi kuutambua hata ukiwa mbali. Ukikata sehemu yoyote yake, utomvu mweupe unaonata hutiririka.

Matunda ni ya mviringo hadi umbo la yai, kwa ukubwa wa balungi kubwa, yenye ganda la kijani lenye vivimbe vidogo au vibapa. Ndani kuna nyama hafifu yenye wanga inayokuwa laini kama mkate ikipikwa.
about.dg:
*Breadfruit* ni muhi mure unaoenea, wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ni makulu sana, ganang'ala, na gana mala mare, kpwa hivyo ni rahisi kuumanya hata kula kure. Uchikata phatu phophosi pha muhi, kunatuluka maziya mereru ganayonyata.

Matunda ni ga mviringo au ga umbo ra tumbi, makulu dza *grapefruit* kulu, na gada ra chijani renye vinundu au vipande vidide. Ndani kuna nyama ngushu-ngushu yenye wanga, inayokala laini na dza mkahe ichijitwa.

where.en: Breadfruit is planted at the coast, usually near homes and in old town gardens, where a single tree can shade a whole yard.
where.sw: Mshelisheli hupandwa pwani, kwa kawaida karibu na nyumba na katika bustani za miji ya zamani, ambako mti mmoja unaweza kutia kivuli uwanja mzima.
where.dg: *Breadfruit* nkuphandwa pwani, mara nyinji phephi na nyumba na kpwenye busitani za kare za mudzini, phatu muhi mmwenga unaphoweza kuika pepho mhala wosi.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten while still firm and starchy, before it turns sweet. It is baked or boiled, and often cooked in coconut milk, much like cassava or green bananas.
uses.sw: Tunda huliwa likiwa bado gumu na lenye wanga, kabla halijawa tamu. Huokwa au huchemshwa, na mara nyingi hupikwa kwa tui la nazi, kama vile mhogo au ndizi mbichi.
uses.dg: Tunda nkuriwa richikala bado ni gumu na renye wanga, kabla ya kukala ra mtswano. Nkuochwa au nkuchemuswa, na mara nyinji nkujitwa na huwi, dza manga au ndizi mbitsi.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili: *mshelisheli*, with the fruit called *shelisheli*. English: breadfruit. Scientists call it *Artocarpus altilis*. It is a close relative of the jackfruit.
names.sw: Bado hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa. Kiswahili: *mshelisheli*, na tunda huitwa *shelisheli*. Kwa Kiingereza: *breadfruit*. Wanasayansi huuita *Artocarpus altilis*. Ni ndugu wa karibu wa mfenesi.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mshelisheli*, na tunda nkuihwa *shelisheli*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *breadfruit*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Artocarpus altilis*. Ni ndugu wa phephi wa *mfenesi*.

reason.sw: Mfenesi, katika jenasi moja

teaser.en: Break open its knobbly green fruit and you find sweet white custard studded with black seeds.
teaser.sw: Pasua tunda lake la kijani lenye vivimbe na utakuta krimu tamu nyeupe iliyojaa mbegu nyeusi.
teaser.dg: Uchivundza tundare ra chijani renye vinundu, undaona ndani nyama nyereru ya mtswano, laini dza *custard*, yenye tembe nyiru.

summary.en: The custard apple is a small homestead tree with scaly, knobbly fruits full of sweet, creamy flesh. It is grown for its fruit, eaten fresh.
summary.sw: Mtomoko ni mti mdogo wa nyumbani wenye matunda ya magamba na vivimbe yaliyojaa nyama tamu kama krimu. Hupandwa kwa ajili ya matunda yake, yanayoliwa mabichi.
summary.dg: *Custard apple* ni muhi mdide wa mudzini wenye matunda genye vinundu dza mamba, ganayodzala nyama laini ya mtswano. Unaphandwa kpwa sababu ya matundage, ganayoriwa dza garivyo.

about.en:
The custard apple is a small, open tree with thin, alternate leaves that smell faintly aromatic when crushed. Its greenish-yellow flowers have thick, fleshy petals and often hang half-hidden among the leaves.

The fruit is round to heart-shaped and covered in rounded, scale-like segments. When ripe, it softens and the segments begin to separate. Inside is sweet, white, custard-like flesh around many shiny black seeds.
about.sw:
Mtomoko ni mti mdogo ulio wazi wenye majani membamba yanayopishana, yanayotoa harufu nzuri hafifu yakipondwa. Maua yake ya rangi ya kijani-manjano yana petali nene zenye nyama, na mara nyingi huning'inia yakiwa yamejificha nusu katikati ya majani.

Tunda ni la mviringo hadi umbo la moyo na limefunikwa kwa vipande vya mviringo kama magamba. Likiiva hulainika na vipande huanza kuachana. Ndani kuna nyama tamu nyeupe kama krimu inayozunguka mbegu nyingi nyeusi zinazong'aa.
about.dg:
*Custard apple* ni muhi mdide, uriovuguka, wenye makodza membamba ganayomera kodza mwenga mwenga, si mairi-mairi. Uchigasiriga, ganalavya arufu nono chidide. Maruwage ga rangi ya chijani na mandano gana vipande viziho vya nyama, na mara nyinji ganabwadzika ganafwitsika nusu kahi ya makodza.

Tunda ni ra mviringo au ra umbo ra moyo, na rina vipande vya mviringo dza mamba. Richiivwa rinakala laini na vipande vinaandza kuganyika. Ndani kuna nyama nyereru ya mtswano, dza *custard*, inayozunguluka tembe nyinji nyiru zinazong'ala.

where.en: The custard apple is a homestead tree, planted near houses for its fruit.
where.sw: Mtomoko ni mti wa nyumbani, unaopandwa karibu na nyumba kwa ajili ya matunda yake.
where.dg: *Custard apple* ni muhi wa mudzini, unaophandwa phephi na nyumba kpwa sababu ya matundage.

uses.en: The ripe fruit is eaten fresh, the flesh scooped out and the seeds spat out. The seeds should not be eaten, since in this family they are toxic.
uses.sw: Tunda lililoiva huliwa bichi; nyama huchotwa na mbegu hutemwa. Mbegu hazipaswi kuliwa, kwa kuwa katika familia hii zina sumu.
uses.dg: Tunda ririroivwa nkuriwa dza ririvyo: nyama nkusokolwa na tembe nkutehwa. Tembe tazifwaha kuriwa, kpwa sababu kpwa jamii ihi tembe zina sumu.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili: *mtopetope* or *mtomoko*. English: custard apple or sweetsop. Scientists call it *Annona squamosa*. In the Mgombato dictionary, *mtopetope* is also listed as an equivalent for the wild custard apple, *mbokwe*.
names.sw: Bado hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa. Kiswahili: *mtopetope* au *mtomoko*. Kwa Kiingereza: *custard apple* au *sweetsop*. Wanasayansi huuita *Annona squamosa*. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *mtopetope* pia umeorodheshwa kama kisawe cha mtomoko mwitu, *mbokwe*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtopetope* au *mtomoko*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *custard apple* au *sweetsop*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Annona squamosa*. Kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, *mtopetope* piya rinaandikpwa dza dzina ra Chiswahili ra *mbokwe*, *custard apple* wa tsaka.

teaser.en: Its sour little fruits sprout straight from the trunk, like green cucumbers hung on the bark.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake madogo machachu huchipuka moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina, kama matango ya kijani yaliyotundikwa kwenye gome.
teaser.dg: Matundage madide ga ngbwadu ganamera phapho phapho kpwenye kolo, dza matango ga chijani ganayobwadzika kpwenye gopha.

summary.en: *Mbirimbi* is the bilimbi or cucumber tree, a small homestead tree whose very sour fruits grow straight from the trunk. They are used for pickles, chutney and souring food.
summary.sw: *Mbirimbi* ni mbirimbi, mti mdogo wa nyumbani ambao matunda yake machachu sana hukua moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina. Hutumika kutengeneza achari, chatini na kutia uchachu kwenye chakula.
summary.dg: *Mbirimbi* ni *bilimbi* au *cucumber tree*, muhi mdide wa mudzini ambao matundage ga ngbwadu sana ganamera kpwenye kolo. Nkuhumirwa kuhenda achari na *chutney*, na kuika ngbwadu chakuryani.

about.en:
*Mbirimbi* is a small tree with leaves made of many paired leaflets, clustered towards the branch tips. Its small, dark red, scented flowers grow in clusters straight from the trunk and older branches.

The fruits follow in the same places: smooth, green, cylindrical and about finger length, like small cucumbers. They are juicy and very sour, and ripen to a yellowish green.
about.sw:
*Mbirimbi* ni mti mdogo wenye majani yaliyoundwa kwa vijani vingi vilivyopangwa kwa jozi, vilivyojikusanya kuelekea ncha za matawi. Maua yake madogo mekundu iliyokolea yenye harufu nzuri hukua kwa vishada moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina na matawi ya zamani.

Matunda hufuata mahali pale pale: laini, ya kijani, ya mviringo mrefu na kwa urefu wa kidole hivi, kama matango madogo. Yana maji mengi na ni machachu sana, na huiva yakawa ya rangi ya kijani-manjano.
about.dg:
*Mbirimbi* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza genye makodza madide manji mairi-mairi, ganayokusanyika phephi na ntsa za panda. Maruwage madide, ga kundu sana na genye arufu nono, ganamera kpwa mafungu kpwenye kolo na kpwenye panda za kare.

Matunda ganamera phatu phapho phapho: ni laini, ga chijani, mare na ga mviringo, mare dza chala, dza matango madide. Gana madzi manji na ni ga ngbwadu sana, na gachiivwa ganakala ga rangi ya chijani na mandano.

where.en: *Mbirimbi* is a homestead tree, planted near houses where the fruit can be picked as it is needed.
where.sw: *Mbirimbi* ni mti wa nyumbani, unaopandwa karibu na nyumba ambako matunda yanaweza kuchumwa kadiri yanavyohitajika.
where.dg: *Mbirimbi* ni muhi wa mudzini, unaophandwa phephi na nyumba phatu matunda ganaphoweza kudolwa wakati ganaphohitajika.

uses.en: The fruit is too sour to eat fresh. It is used to make pickles and chutney, and to sour food as it cooks, much as lime or tamarind would be used.
uses.sw: Tunda ni chachu mno kuliwa bichi. Hutumika kutengeneza achari na chatini, na kutia uchachu kwenye chakula kinapopikwa, kama vile ndimu au ukwaju ungetumika.
uses.dg: Matunda ni ga ngbwadu sana hata taganaweza kuriwa dza garivyo. Nkuhumirwa kuhenda achari na *chutney*, na kuika ngbwadu chakuryani wakati chinaphojitwa, dza vira ndimu au makpwadzu ganavyohumirwa.

names.en: Digo: *mbirimbi* or *m'birimbi*. Giriama: *mbirimbi*. Swahili: *mbirimbi*, also spelled *mbilimbi*. English: bilimbi or cucumber tree. Scientists call it *Averrhoa bilimbi*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbirimbi* au *m'birimbi*. Kigiriama: *mbirimbi*. Kiswahili: *mbirimbi*, pia huandikwa *mbilimbi*. Kwa Kiingereza: *bilimbi* au *cucumber tree*. Wanasayansi huuita *Averrhoa bilimbi*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mbirimbi* au *m'birimbi*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mbirimbi*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mbirimbi*, ambaro piya rinaandikpwa *mbilimbi*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *bilimbi* au *cucumber tree*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Averrhoa bilimbi*.

teaser.en: The easiest citrus to peel: the tangerine's loose skin slips off in one piece.
teaser.sw: Ni rahisi kumenya kuliko machungwa yote: ganda legevu la chenza hutoka kwa kipande kimoja.
teaser.dg: Kahi ya matunda ga jamii ya machungbwa, *chendza* ndiyo rahisi zaidi kuguwa: gadare ririrolegea rinauka rosi kpwa chipande chimwenga.

summary.en: *Mchendza* is the tangerine or mandarin, a small citrus tree with sweet, easy-peeling fruit. It is grown on farms and around homesteads for fresh fruit.
summary.sw: *Mchendza* ni mchenza, mti mdogo wa jamii ya machungwa wenye matunda matamu yanayomenyeka kwa urahisi. Hupandwa mashambani na kuzunguka makazi kwa ajili ya matunda.
summary.dg: *Mchendza* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya machungbwa, wenye matunda ga mtswano ganagoguwika kpwa urahisi. Nkuphandwa mindani na kanda-kanda ya midzi ili kuphaha matunda ga kurya dza garivyo.

about.en:
*Mchendza* is a small, evergreen citrus tree, sometimes thorny, with glossy, fragrant leaves and white, sweet-scented flowers.

The fruits are smaller and flatter than oranges, with a thin, loose skin that peels away easily. Inside, the segments separate cleanly and are sweet and juicy.
about.sw:
*Mchendza* ni mti mdogo wa jamii ya machungwa, wa kijani kibichi mwaka mzima, wakati mwingine wenye miiba, wenye majani yanayong'aa yenye harufu nzuri na maua meupe yenye harufu tamu.

Matunda yake ni madogo na bapa zaidi kuliko machungwa, yenye ganda jembamba na legevu linalomenyeka kwa urahisi. Ndani, vipande vyake hutengana vizuri na ni vitamu vyenye maji mengi.
about.dg:
*Mchendza* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya machungbwa wenye makodza chila wakati. Wakati wanjina una miya. Makodzage ganang'arira na gana arufu nono, na maruwage ni mereru, genye arufu nono.

Matunda ni madide na mabapa kuriko machungbwa, na gadare ni dzembamba na rinalegea, kpwa hivyo rinaguwika kpwa urahisi. Ndani, vipande vinatengana sawa-sawa na ni vya mtswano na vina madzi manji.

where.en: *Mchendza* grows on farms and around homesteads, often alongside oranges and limes.
where.sw: *Mchendza* hukua mashambani na kuzunguka makazi, mara nyingi pamoja na michungwa na midimu.
where.dg: *Mchendza* unamera mindani na kanda-kanda ya midzi, mara nyinji phamwenga na michungbwa na mindimu.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten fresh.
uses.sw: Tunda lake huliwa kama lilivyo.
uses.dg: Matunda ganariwa dza garivyo.

names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mchendza*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mchenza*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *tangerine* au *mandarin*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Citrus reticulata*.

teaser.en: Drive the south coast road in season and you will see piles of green-skinned oranges for sale at the roadside.
teaser.sw: Ukiendesha gari kwenye barabara ya pwani ya kusini msimu ukifika, utaona marundo ya machungwa yenye maganda ya kijani yakiuzwa kando ya barabara.
teaser.dg: Uchiphiya na gari kpwenye njira ya pwani ya kusini wakati wa machungbwa, undaona vifungu vya machungbwa ga chijani ganaguzwa kanda-kanda ya njira.

summary.en: *Mchungwa* is the sweet orange, an evergreen citrus tree grown on farms and around homesteads. South coast oranges are sold at roadsides and eaten fresh or as juice.
summary.sw: *Mchungwa* ni mti wa kijani kibichi mwaka mzima wa jamii ya machungwa unaopandwa mashambani na kuzunguka makazi. Machungwa ya pwani ya kusini huuzwa kando ya barabara na kuliwa kama yalivyo au kukamuliwa sharubati.
summary.dg: *Mchungwa* ni muhi wa machungbwa ga mtswano, muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa jamii ya ndimu, unaophandwa minda na kuzunguluka midzi. Machungbwa ga pwani ya kusini nkuguzwa kanda-kanda ya njira, na nkuriwa dza garivyo au nkuminywa madzige.

about.en:
*Mchungwa* is an evergreen tree with a rounded crown, glossy dark green leaves and sometimes small thorns. Its white flowers are strongly scented.

The fruits, *chungbwa*, are round, with a thick, fragrant skin. In the warm coastal climate, the skin often stays green or greenish-yellow even when the fruit inside is ripe and sweet.
about.sw:
*Mchungwa* ni mti wa kijani kibichi mwaka mzima wenye taji la mviringo, majani ya kijani kibichi kilichokolea yanayong'aa, na wakati mwingine miiba midogo. Maua yake meupe yana harufu kali nzuri.

Matunda, *chungbwa*, ni ya mviringo, yenye ganda nene lenye harufu nzuri. Katika hali ya joto ya pwani, mara nyingi ganda hubaki la kijani au kijani-manjano hata tunda likiwa limeiva na tamu ndani.
about.dg:
*Mchungwa* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye chitswa cha mviringo, makodza ganaala ga rangi ya chijani iriyokola, na wakati wanjina miya midide. Maruwage ga rangi nyereru gana arufu nono kali.

Matundage, *chungbwa*, ni ga mviringo, na gada nene renye arufu nono. Kpwa sababu ya dzoho ra pwani, mara nyinji gada rinasala ra chijani au ra chijani na rangi ya mandano, ela tunda ndani rikaivwa na ri ra mtswano.

where.en: Orange trees grow on farms and around homesteads along the south coast. In season, the fruit is sold at roadside stalls.
where.sw: Michungwa hukua mashambani na kuzunguka makazi kando ya pwani ya kusini. Wakati wa msimu, matunda huuzwa kwenye vibanda kando ya barabara.
where.dg: Michungwa inamera kpwenye minda na kuzunguluka midzi kanda-kanda ya pwani ya kusini. Wakati wa machungbwa, matunda nkuguzwa kpwenye vibanda kanda-kanda ya njira.

uses.en: Oranges are eaten fresh and squeezed for juice. They are also sold for cash, often at roadsides.
uses.sw: Machungwa huliwa kama yalivyo na hukamuliwa kupata sharubati. Pia huuzwa kwa pesa, mara nyingi kando ya barabara.
uses.dg: Machungbwa nkuriwa dza garivyo na nkuminywa kuphaha madzige. Piya nkuguzwa kuphaha pesa, mara nyinji kanda-kanda ya njira.

names.en: Digo: *mchungwa* for the tree and *chungbwa* for the fruit. Swahili: *mchungwa*, with the fruit called *chungwa*. English: sweet orange. Scientists call it *Citrus sinensis*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mchungwa* kwa mti na *chungbwa* kwa tunda. Kiswahili: *mchungwa*, na tunda huitwa *chungwa*. Kwa Kiingereza: *sweet orange*. Wanasayansi huuita *Citrus sinensis*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *mchungwa* kpwa muhi na *chungbwa* kpwa tunda. Kpwa Chiswahili: *mchungwa*, na tunda nkuihwa *chungwa*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sweet orange*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Citrus sinensis*.

teaser.en: Too bitter and sour to eat fresh, the Seville orange earns its place in the kitchen and in home medicine.
teaser.sw: Ni mchungu na mchachu mno kuliwa bichi, lakini mdanzi umejipatia nafasi jikoni na katika dawa za nyumbani.
teaser.dg: Matundage ni ga utsungu na ngbwadu sana hata tagariwa dza garivyo, ela *mdandzi* una nafasiye dzikoni na kpwenye dawa za kaya.

summary.en: *Mdandzi* is the sour or Seville orange, a citrus tree with bitter-sour fruit grown around homesteads. Its juice is used in cooking and in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mdandzi* ni mdanzi, mti wa jamii ya michungwa wenye matunda machungu na machachu unaopandwa kuzunguka makazi. Maji ya matunda yake hutumika katika upishi na katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Mdandzi* ni *sour orange* au *Seville orange*, muhi wa jamii ya machungbwa wenye matunda ga utsungu na ngbwadu, unaophandwa phephi na midzi. Madzi ga matundage nkuhumirwa kujitira na kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mdandzi* is an evergreen citrus tree with glossy leaves on winged leaf stalks, often thorny, with very fragrant white flowers.

The fruit looks like an orange, with a rough, thick skin, but its pulp is sour and bitter rather than sweet.
about.sw:
*Mdandzi* ni mti wa familia ya michungwa wa kijani kibichi daima, wenye majani yanayong'aa juu ya vikonyo vyenye mabawa, mara nyingi wenye miiba, na maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri sana.

Tunda linafanana na chungwa, lenye ganda gumu na nene, lakini nyama yake ni chachu na chungu badala ya kuwa tamu.
about.dg:
*Mdandzi* ni muhi wa jamii ya machungbwa wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganang'ala na ganamera dzulu ya milita yenye mapha; mara nyinji muhi una miya, na maruwage mereru gana arufu nono sana.

Tunda rinaonekana dza chungbwa, na gada ziho ririrokaraza, ela nyamaye ni ya ngbwadu na utsungu, si ya mtswano.

where.en: *Mdandzi* is a homestead tree, grown near houses where its fruit is on hand.
where.sw: *Mdandzi* ni mti wa nyumbani, unaopandwa karibu na nyumba ili matunda yake yapatikane kwa urahisi.
where.dg: *Mdandzi* ni muhi wa mudzini, unaophandwa phephi na nyumba phatu matundage ganaphokala phephi.

uses.en: The juice is used in cooking, to add a sharp, sour flavour to food. It is also used in medicine.
uses.sw: Maji ya tunda hutumika katika upishi, kuongeza ladha kali ya uchachu kwenye chakula. Pia hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg: Madzi ga tunda nkuhumirwa kujitira, kuika ladha kali ya ngbwadu chakuryani. Piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdandzi*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mdanzi*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *sour orange* au *Seville orange*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Citrus aurantium*.

teaser.en: No *samaki wa kupaka* is complete without a squeeze of lime, the small green fruit of the homestead *mdimu*.
teaser.sw: Hakuna *samaki wa kupaka* kamili bila kukamuliwa ndimu, tunda dogo la kijani la *mdimu* wa nyumbani.
teaser.dg: *Samaki wa kupaka* tauna ladha kamili bila kuminyirwa ndimu, tunda dide ra chijani ra *mdimu* wa mudzini.

summary.en: *Mdimu* is the lime, a small thorny tree with sharp green fruit found at nearly every homestead. Its juice brightens coastal food, from grilled fish to *kachumbari*, and is used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mdimu* ni mti mdogo wenye miiba na matunda ya kijani yenye ukali, unaopatikana karibu kila boma. Maji yake huchangamsha vyakula vya pwani, kuanzia samaki wa kuchoma hadi *kachumbari*, na hutumika katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Mdimu* ni muhi mdide wenye miya, wenye matunda ga chijani ga ngbwadu, unaophahikana karibu chila mudzi. Madzige ganaenjereza ladha kpwa vyakurya vya pwani, kula ng'onda wa kuwadwa hadi *kachumbari*, na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mdimu* is a small, bushy, thorny tree with small, glossy, fragrant leaves and white flowers.

Its fruits, *ndimu*, are small and round, with a thin green skin that turns yellowish when fully ripe. They are full of sharp, acid juice and have a strong citrus scent.
about.sw:
*Mdimu* ni mti mdogo wenye matawi mengi na miiba, wenye majani madogo yanayong'aa na yenye harufu nzuri, na maua meupe.

Matunda yake, *ndimu*, ni madogo na ya mviringo, yenye ganda jembamba la kijani linalogeuka manjano kidogo yakishaiva kabisa. Yamejaa maji makali yenye uchachu na yana harufu kali ya machungwa.
about.dg:
*Mdimu* ni muhi mdide wenye panda nyinji na miya, wenye makodza madide ganaala genye arufu nono, na maruwa ga rangi nyereru.

Matundage, *ndimu*, ni madide na ga mviringo, na gada rembamba ra chijani rinarogaluka kukala ra rangi ya mandano tunda richiivwa kabisa. Ganaodzala madzi ga ngbwadu kali, na gana arufu kali ya jamii ya ndimu.

where.en: *Mdimu* is a homestead tree, grown close to the kitchen where the fruit is needed every day.
where.sw: *Mdimu* ni mti wa nyumbani, unaopandwa karibu na jiko ambapo matunda yake yanahitajika kila siku.
where.dg: *Mdimu* ni muhi wa mudzini, unaophandwa phephi na dziko, ambapho matundage ganahitajika chila siku.

uses.en:
Lime juice is squeezed over fish and into *kachumbari*, the fresh onion and tomato salad. It is one of the key flavours of *samaki wa kupaka*, the grilled fish painted with a sauce of coconut milk, turmeric, lime and chilli.

The lime is also used in medicine.
uses.sw:
Maji ya ndimu hukamuliwa juu ya samaki na ndani ya *kachumbari*, saladi ya vitunguu na nyanya mbichi. Ni mojawapo ya ladha kuu za *samaki wa kupaka*, samaki wa kuchoma anayepakwa mchuzi wa tui la nazi, manjano, ndimu na pilipili.

Ndimu pia hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg:
Madzi ga ndimu nkuminywa dzulu ya ng'onda na kpwenye *kachumbari*, saladi ya vitunguu na nyanya mbitsi. Ni kahi ya ladha kulu za *samaki wa kupaka*, ng'onda wa kuwadwa anayepakwa mtsuzi wa huwi, chikatsu, ndimu na pilipili.

*Mdimu* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

culture.en: The Digo see the lime's family in the forest too: a wild relative, *Toddaliopsis*, is called *chidimu tsaka*, 'little forest lime'.
culture.sw: Wadigo huiona familia ya ndimu hata msituni: jamaa yake wa porini, *Toddaliopsis*, huitwa *chidimu tsaka*, 'kidimu cha msituni'.
culture.dg: Adigo nkuona jamii ya mdimu hata tsakani: nduguye wa tsaka, *Toddaliopsis*, nkuihwa *chidimu tsaka*, 'mdimu mdide wa tsaka'.

names.en: Digo: *mdimu* for the tree and *ndimu* for the fruit. Swahili: *mdimu*, with the fruit called *ndimu*. English: lime. Scientists call it *Citrus aurantiifolia*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdimu* kwa mti na *ndimu* kwa tunda. Kiswahili: *mdimu*, na tunda huitwa *ndimu*. Kwa Kiingereza: *lime*. Wanasayansi huuita *Citrus aurantiifolia*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *mdimu* kpwa muhi na *ndimu* kpwa tunda. Kpwa Chiswahili: *mdimu*, na tunda nkuihwa *ndimu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lime*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Citrus aurantiifolia*.

teaser.en: A single jackfruit can outweigh a small child, and it grows straight out of the trunk rather than from the branches.
teaser.sw: Fenesi moja linaweza kuwa zito kuliko mtoto mdogo, na huota moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina badala ya matawi.
teaser.dg: Fenesi rimwenga rinaweza kukala rizito kuriko mwana mdide, na rinamera kula kpwa kolo moja kpwa moja, si kula kpwa panda.

summary.en: The *mfenesi* is the jackfruit tree, a big shade tree of coastal homesteads that carries the largest fruit of any tree. Its sweet pulp, starchy seeds and cookable green fruit have long helped Digo households through the hungry months.
summary.sw: *Mfenesi* ni mti mkubwa wa kivuli katika maboma ya pwani unaobeba tunda kubwa kuliko la mti mwingine wowote. Nyama yake tamu, mbegu zake zenye wanga na tunda bichi linaloweza kupikwa vimesaidia kaya za Wadigo kwa muda mrefu kuvuka miezi ya njaa.
summary.dg: *Mfenesi* ni muhi wa fenesi, muhi mkulu wa pepho wa midzi ya pwani unaotsukula tunda kulu kuriko muhi wowosi. Nyamaye ya mtswano, tembeze zenye wanga na tundare ra chijani rinarojitwa vikaterya mbari za Adigo kpwa muda mrefu kutsupa miezi ya ndzala.

about.en:
*Mfenesi* is a large evergreen tree with a dense, dark crown and thick, glossy, leathery leaves. Cut any part of it and it bleeds a sticky white latex, a trait it shares with its fig and breadfruit relatives in the family Moraceae.

The fruit is what stops people in their tracks. It hangs on short stalks straight from the trunk and the thickest branches, and it can grow to the size of a sack of grain. The skin is green to yellowish and covered in blunt knobs. Inside, dozens of golden, fleshy bulbs each wrap a smooth seed, and a ripe fruit fills the yard with a heavy, sweet smell.
about.sw:
*Mfenesi* ni mti mkubwa wenye majani mwaka mzima, taji nene la kijani kilichokolea na majani mazito, yanayong'aa na magumu kama ngozi. Ukikata sehemu yoyote yake hutoa utomvu mweupe unaonata, sifa inayoshirikiana na jamaa zake mitini na mshelisheli katika familia ya Moraceae.

Tunda ndilo linalowashangaza watu. Huning'inia kwenye vikonyo vifupi moja kwa moja kutoka shina na matawi manene zaidi, na linaweza kukua hadi kufikia ukubwa wa gunia la nafaka. Ngozi yake ni ya kijani hadi manjano hafifu na imefunikwa na vinundu butu. Ndani, makumi ya vipande vya nyama vya rangi ya dhahabu kila kimoja kimefunika mbegu laini, na tunda lililoiva hujaza uwanja harufu nzito tamu.
about.dg:
*Mfenesi* ni muhi mkulu wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye chitswa chizito cha rangi chiru na makodza manene ganagong'ala na mafu dza chingo. Uchikata seemu yoyosi ya muhi, inalavya maziya nyereru ganagonyata, tabiya ambayo inafwanana na ndugue a mkuyu na mfenesi-bata kpwa jamii ya Moraceae.

Tunda ndiro rinaroima atu na kulola. Rinabwadzika kpwa milita mifupi kula kpwa kolo moja kpwa moja na kpwa panda kulu zaidi, na rinaweza kukula hadi kufika ukulu wa gunia ra nafaka. Gada ra kondze ni ra chijani hadi rangi ya mandano chidide na rina vinundu. Ndani, kuna vipande dazeni za nyama ya rangi ya dhahabu, chila chimwenga chinazunguluka tembe laini, na fenesi ririroivwa rinadzaza mhala harufu nzito ya mtswano.

where.en: Look for *mfenesi* around homesteads, where it is kept as a shade tree as much as for its fruit. It is a planted tree rather than a wild one, so it turns up near houses, compounds and small farms along the south coast rather than in the bush or forest.
where.sw: Tafuta *mfenesi* kuzunguka maboma, ambako huhifadhiwa kama mti wa kivuli sawa na kwa ajili ya matunda yake. Ni mti wa kupandwa wala si wa porini, kwa hivyo hupatikana karibu na nyumba, nyua na mashamba madogo katika pwani ya kusini badala ya vichakani au msituni.
where.dg: Hendza *mfenesi* kanda-kanda ya midzi, ambapho nkurindwa dza muhi wa pepho dza vira unavyorindwa kpwa matundage. Ni muhi wa kuphandwa, si wa weruni, kpwa hivyo unaonekana phephi na nyumba, mihala na minda midide kanda-kanda ya pwani ya kusini, si weruni wala tsakani.

uses.en:
The ripe pulp is eaten fresh. The seeds are not wasted: they are boiled or roasted and eaten like nuts, and unripe fruit is cooked as a vegetable. Because one tree can give so much starchy food, jackfruit is an important standby in the hungry season before the next harvest.

The timber is also valued and is used for making doors.
uses.sw:
Nyama iliyoiva huliwa mbichi. Mbegu hazipotei bure: huchemshwa au kubanikwa na kuliwa kama karanga, na tunda bichi hupikwa kama mboga. Kwa kuwa mti mmoja unaweza kutoa chakula kingi chenye wanga, fenesi ni akiba muhimu wakati wa msimu wa njaa kabla ya mavuno yanayofuata.

Mbao zake pia zinathaminiwa na hutumika kutengeneza milango.
uses.dg:
Nyama ya fenesi ririroivwa nkuriwa dza irivyo. Tembe tazitsuphwa: nkutserusiwa au nkuochwa na kuriwa dza njugu, na fenesi risiroivwa nkujitwa dza mtsunga. Kpwa sababu muhi mmwenga unaweza kulavya chakurya chinji cha wanga, fenesi ni chakurya cha muhimu cha kuikirwa wakati wa ndzala kabla ya mavuno ganagolunga.

Mbaoze piya zina samani na nkuhumirwa kuhenda maluvwi.

names.en: In Digo the tree is *mfenesi*, the same word as in Swahili, where the fruit is called *fenesi*. Giriama also uses *mfenesi*. In English it is jackfruit.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo mti ni *mfenesi*, neno lilelile la Kiswahili, ambapo tunda huitwa *fenesi*. Kigiriama pia hutumia *mfenesi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *jackfruit*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo muhi ni *mfenesi*, neno ra sawa na Chiswahili, ambapho tunda rinaihwa *fenesi*. Chigiryama piya chinahumira *mfenesi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *jackfruit*.

teaser.en: Found only on the coasts of Kenya and Tanzania, this wild tree drops good fruit for anyone who knows where to look.
teaser.sw: Unapatikana tu katika pwani za Kenya na Tanzania, mti huu wa porini huangusha matunda mazuri kwa yeyote anayejua mahali pa kutafuta.
teaser.dg: Unaphahikana pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania tu; matunda manono ga muhi hinyu wa tsaka ganagbwa photsi kpwa yeyesi anayemanya phatu pha kugahendza.

summary.en: *Mgama* is the coast mimusops, a medium-sized wild tree of the coastal forest and bush with edible fruit. It grows nowhere else in the world but coastal Kenya and Tanzania.
summary.sw: *Mgama* ni *coast mimusops*, mti wa porini wa ukubwa wa wastani wa misitu na vichaka vya pwani wenye matunda yanayoliwa. Haupatikani mahali pengine popote duniani isipokuwa pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
summary.dg: *Mgama* ni *coast mimusops*, muhi wa tsaka wa ukulu wa kahi-kahi wa matsaka na weruni wa pwani, wenye matunda ganayoriwa. Unamera pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania tu, na takuna phatu phanjina duniani.

about.en: *Mgama* is a medium-sized tree. Its leaves are bunched in tight clusters at the ends of the shoots, which gives the crown a tufted look. Like other members of the Sapotaceae, the family of the sapodilla and the shea tree, it has milky sap and small, star-like flowers, and it bears small fleshy fruits.
about.sw: *Mgama* ni mti wa ukubwa wa wastani. Majani yake yamejikusanya katika vishada vilivyobanana kwenye ncha za machipukizi, jambo linalokipa kilele chake sura ya vishungi. Kama wanafamilia wengine wa Sapotaceae, familia ya *sapodilla* na mti wa shea, una utomvu kama maziwa na maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota, na huzaa matunda madogo yenye nyama.
about.dg: *Mgama* ni muhi wa ukulu wa kahi-kahi. Makodzage ganakusanyika kpwa mafungu ganayogbwirana kpwenye ntsa za maphungo, kpwa hivyo chitswa cha muhi chinaonekana dza mafungu-mafungu. Dza mihi yanjina ya jamii ya *Sapotaceae*, jamii ya *sapodilla* na *shea tree*, una maziya na maruwa madide dza nyota, na unalavya matunda madide genye nyama.

where.en: *Mgama* grows in coastal forest and bushland, and only along the coasts of Kenya and Tanzania. On the south coast it belongs to the wild woodland rather than to farms and gardens.
where.sw: *Mgama* hukua katika misitu na vichaka vya pwani, na tu kando ya pwani za Kenya na Tanzania. Katika pwani ya kusini ni mti wa mapori ya asili badala ya mashamba na bustani.
where.dg: *Mgama* unamera kpwenye matsaka na weruni wa pwani, na pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania tu. Pwani ya kusini ni muhi wa weruni na matsaka, si wa minda wala busitani.

uses.en: The fruits are good to eat and are gathered from the wild. The tree also gives timber and firewood, and its roots are used in veterinary medicine to treat livestock.
uses.sw: Matunda ni mazuri kuliwa na huchumwa porini. Mti pia hutoa mbao na kuni, na mizizi yake hutumika katika dawa za mifugo kutibu wanyama.
uses.dg: Matunda ni manono kuriwa, na nkukusanywa weruni. Muhi piya unalavya mbao na kuni, na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa ya makongo ga mifugo.

names.en: The Digo name is *mgama*. No Swahili or other Mijikenda name has been recorded for this species, and it has no well-known English name beyond 'coast mimusops'. One reference lists *mgama* under a related species, *Mimusops obtusifolia*, so the name may cover more than one coastal mimusops.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mgama*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la lugha nyingine ya Kimijikenda lililorekodiwa kwa spishi hii, na hauna jina la Kiingereza linalojulikana sana zaidi ya *coast mimusops*. Chanzo kimoja kinaorodhesha *mgama* chini ya spishi inayohusiana nayo, *Mimusops obtusifolia*, kwa hivyo huenda jina hili linahusu zaidi ya aina moja ya *mimusops* ya pwani.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mgama*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra luga yanjina ya Chimijikenda ririroandikpwa kpwa aina ihi, na takuna dzina ra Chingereza rinaromanyikana sana, ela *coast mimusops* bahi. Chitabu chimwenga chinaandika *mgama* kpwa aina yanjina iriyo nduguye, *Mimusops obtusifolia*, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinaweza kukala ni ra aina zaidi ya mwenga ya *mimusops* ya pwani.

conservation.en: It is a coastal East African endemic, found nowhere else, so the survival of the coastal forest and bush matters for its future.
conservation.sw: Ni mmea wa asili wa pwani ya Afrika Mashariki pekee, usiopatikana mahali pengine popote, kwa hivyo kudumu kwa misitu na vichaka vya pwani ni muhimu kwa mustakabali wake.
conservation.dg: Ni muhi wa pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki tu, usiophahikana phatu phanjina, kpwa hivyo matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani vichisala, nao undasala.

teaser.en: Digo farmers grow some twenty-five kinds of banana, with names like 'elephant's hand' and 'arrow'.
teaser.sw: Wakulima Wadigo hupanda takriban aina ishirini na tano za ndizi, zenye majina kama 'mkono wa tembo' na 'mshale'.
teaser.dg: Akurima a Chidigo anarima aina phephi ishirini na tsano za ndizi, zenye madzina dza 'mkpwono wa ndzovu' na 'mshale'.

summary.en: *Mgomba* or *mndizi* is the banana plant, grown in wet hollows and homestead gardens all over Digo country. It feeds families both as cooking banana stewed in coconut milk and as sweet ripe fruit.
summary.sw: *Mgomba* au *mndizi* ni mmea wa ndizi, unaopandwa katika mabonde yenye unyevu na bustani za maboma kote katika nchi ya Wadigo. Hulisha familia kama ndizi za kupika zilizopikwa kwa tui la nazi na pia kama tunda tamu lililoiva.
summary.dg: *Mgomba* au *mndizi* ni mmea wa ndizi, unaophandwa kpwa madete ga madzi-madzi na kpwa minda ya midzi kosi kpwa tsi ya Adigo. Unarisa mbari dza ndizi za kujita zinazojitwa kpwa huwi, na dza matunda ga mtswano gachiivwa.

about.en:
Although it can be taller than a house, the banana is not a tree but a giant herb. What looks like a trunk is a tight roll of leaf bases, and from the top spring huge, paddle-shaped leaves that the wind tears into ribbons. Each plant flowers once: a long stalk pushes out of the centre and hangs down, carrying hands of fruit above a big purplish-red bud.

Digo has words for these parts: *humba* is the flower stalk and *tsupha* the red bud. The plant comes in many forms, and Digo farmers name around twenty-five cultivars, among them *chisukari*, *gojozi*, *mkono wa tembo*, *mshale*, *matoke*, *bokoboko* and *chibungale*.
about.sw:
Ingawa unaweza kuwa mrefu kuliko nyumba, mgomba si mti bali ni mmea mkubwa mno usio na shina la mbao. Kinachoonekana kama shina ni mkunjo mkaza wa vitako vya majani, na juu yake huchipuka majani makubwa mno yenye umbo la kasia ambayo upepo huyararua kuwa vipande. Kila mmea huchanua mara moja tu: kikonyo kirefu huchomoza kutoka katikati na kuning'inia chini, kikibeba matana ya ndizi juu ya ua kubwa la rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu.

Kidigo kina maneno kwa sehemu hizi: *humba* ni kikonyo cha maua na *tsupha* ni ua jekundu. Mmea huu una aina nyingi, na wakulima Wadigo hutaja takriban aina ishirini na tano, miongoni mwake *chisukari*, *gojozi*, *mkono wa tembo*, *mshale*, *matoke*, *bokoboko* na *chibungale*.
about.dg:
Hata kala unaweza kukala mure kuriko nyumba, mgomba si muhi ela ni mmea mkulu usio na nyama za muhi. Chinachoonekana dza kolo ni milita ya makodza iriyozunguluka phamwenga kpwa kubanana, na kula dzulu kunatuluka makodza makulu sana ga umbo ra kasia, ambago phepho inagaahula vipande-vipande. Chila mmea unatuluza maruwa mara mwenga bahi: mlita mure unatuluka kula kahi na kubwadzika photsi, uchitsukula matana ga ndizi dzulu ya chimea chikulu cha rangi ya kundu na zambarau.

Chidigo china maneno ga seemu hizi: *humba* ni mlita wa maruwa na *tsupha* ni chimea cha kundu. Mmea uhu una maumbo manji, na akurima a Chidigo anataja aina phephi ishirini na tsano, kahi yao *chisukari*, *gojozi*, *mkono wa tembo*, *mshale*, *matoke*, *bokoboko* na *chibungale*.

where.en: Bananas need water, so on the south coast they are planted in wet hollows and in homestead gardens close to the house, where they are tended and watered. A clump of *migomba* is one of the surest signs of a lived-in compound.
where.sw: Migomba huhitaji maji, kwa hivyo katika pwani ya kusini hupandwa katika mabonde yenye unyevu na katika bustani za maboma karibu na nyumba, ambako hutunzwa na kumwagiliwa. Kichaka cha *migomba* ni mojawapo ya ishara za uhakika zaidi za boma linalokaliwa.
where.dg: Migomba inahitaji madzi, kpwa hivyo kpwa pwani ya kusini nkuphandwa kpwa madete ga madzi-madzi na kpwa minda ya midzi phephi na nyumba, ambako nkutundzwa na kutiywa madzi. Chitsaka cha *migomba* ni mwenga wa ishara za kpweli kabisa kukala mudzi una atu.

uses.en:
Cooking bananas are stewed in coconut milk, one of the everyday dishes of the coast, while dessert varieties are eaten ripe. Bananas are also used to make *mabumbunda*, a banana bread.

Nothing is wasted. The broad leaves serve as wrappers for food.
uses.sw:
Ndizi za kupika hupikwa kwa tui la nazi, mojawapo ya vyakula vya kila siku vya pwani, huku aina za kitindamlo huliwa zikiwa zimeiva. Ndizi pia hutumika kutengeneza *mabumbunda*, mkate wa ndizi.

Hakuna kinachopotea bure. Majani mapana hutumika kufungia chakula.
uses.dg:
Ndizi za kujita nkujitwa kpwa huwi, mwenga wa vyakurya vya chila siku vya pwani, na aina za mtswano nkuriwa zichiivwa. Ndizi piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda *mabumbunda*, mkahe wa ndizi.

Takuna chinachotsuphwa. Makodza mapana nkuhumirwa kufungira chakurya.

culture.en: The banana's name divides the Digo: northern speakers call the plant *mgomba*, while southern speakers call it *mkoo*. It is one of the clearest north and south differences in the Digo plant vocabulary.
culture.sw: Jina la mgomba huwagawa Wadigo: wazungumzaji wa kaskazini huuita mmea huu *mgomba*, huku wazungumzaji wa kusini wakiuita *mkoo*. Hii ni mojawapo ya tofauti zilizo wazi zaidi kati ya kaskazini na kusini katika msamiati wa mimea wa Kidigo.
culture.dg: Dzina ra mgomba rinaganya Adigo: ario kazikazini anauiha mmea *mgomba*, ela ario kusini anauiha *mkoo*. Hino ni mwenga wa tafwauti zinazoonekana wazi zaidi kahi ya kazikazini na kusini kpwa maneno ga mimea ga Chidigo.

names.en: The plant is *mgomba* or *mndizi*; one source gives *mgomba* for the north and *mkoo* for the south. The fruit is *izu* (plural *mazu*) or *ndizi*. Swahili uses *mgomba* or *mndizi* for the plant and *ndizi* for the fruit. In English it is the banana, or plantain for the cooking kinds.
names.sw: Mmea ni *mgomba* au *mndizi*; chanzo kimoja kinatoa *mgomba* kwa kaskazini na *mkoo* kwa kusini. Tunda ni *izu* (wingi *mazu*) au *ndizi*. Kiswahili hutumia *mgomba* au *mndizi* kwa mmea na *ndizi* kwa tunda. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *banana*, au *plantain* kwa aina za kupika.
names.dg: Mmea ni *mgomba* au *mndizi*; chandzo chimwenga chinapha *mgomba* kpwa kazikazini na *mkoo* kpwa kusini. Tunda ni *izu* (unji *mazu*) au *ndizi*. Chiswahili chinahumira *mgomba* au *mndizi* kpwa mmea na *ndizi* kpwa tunda. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *banana*, au *plantain* kpwa aina za kujita.

reason.en: Its milk is what cooking bananas are stewed in
reason.sw: Tui lake ndilo linalotumika kupika ndizi
reason.dg: Huwire ndiro ndizi za kujita nkujitwa naro

reason.en: Another starchy staple cooked in coconut milk
reason.sw: Chakula kingine kikuu chenye wanga kinachopikwa kwa tui la nazi
reason.dg: Chakurya chanjina cha wanga chinachojitwa kpwa huwi

reason.en: Another homestead food plant important in lean times
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa chakula wa bomani ulio muhimu nyakati za uhaba
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa chakurya wa midzi wa muhimu wakati wa shida

reason.en: Grown in the same moist homestead plots
reason.sw: Hupandwa katika vipande vilevile vya bomani vyenye unyevu
reason.dg: Unaphandwa kpwa minda ya madzi-madzi ya midzi

mgomba (mi) banana plant; mgomba.
mndizi (mi) banana plant; mgomba, mndizi.
ndizi (-) banana; ndizi. (See: izu)

definition.en: The trunk-like stem of the banana plant, made of tightly rolled leaf bases. The same word is used for the banana leaf and for the flower bud.
definition.sw: Shina la mgomba linalofanana na shina la mti, linalotokana na vitako vya majani vilivyokunjwa kwa kubana. Neno hilohilo hutumika kwa jani la mgomba na kwa ua.
definition.dg: Kolo ra mgomba, rinarohendwa ni milita ya makodza iriyozunguluka phamwenga kpwa kubanana. Neno hiri hiri nkuhumirwa kpwa kodza ra mgomba na kpwa chimea cha maruwa.

meaning.en: Gomba also means 'to speak', and there is a clan called Achina-gomba, but Pakia found no link to the plant.
meaning.sw: Gomba pia lina maana ya 'kusema', na kuna ukoo unaoitwa Achina-gomba, lakini Pakia hakupata uhusiano na mmea huu.
meaning.dg: *Gomba* piya rina mana ya 'kugomba', na kuna mbari inayoihwa Achina-gomba, ela Pakia kaphaha uhusiano na mmea.

parts.english: pseudo-stem; also leaf and flower bud

definition.en: A young banana leaf. Its pale colour gives a Digo colour term for pale green.
definition.sw: Jani changa la mgomba. Rangi yake hafifu inatoa neno la Kidigo la rangi ya kijani hafifu.
definition.dg: Kodza tsanga ra mgomba. Rangiye ya chijani-ereru ndiyo inayopha Chidigo neno ra rangi ya chijani chereru.

definition.en: The stalk that sticks out from the plant and carries the developing bananas.
definition.sw: Kikonyo kinachochomoza kutoka mmea na kubeba ndizi zinazokua.
definition.dg: Mlita unaotuluka kula kpwa mmea na kutsukula ndizi zinazokula.

definition.en: The red cone that hangs from the stalk below the bananas and produces small flowers. Pakia notes that gomba is also used for the flower bud.
definition.sw: Koni nyekundu inayoning'inia kutoka kikonyo chini ya ndizi na kutoa maua madogo. Pakia anabainisha kwamba gomba pia hutumika kwa ua hilo.
definition.dg: Tsupha ra kundu rinarobwadzika kula kpwa mlita photsi ya ndizi na rinalavya maruwa madide. Pakia anagomba kukala *gomba* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa chimea cha maruwa.

definition.en: Bananas, the fruit of the plant.
definition.sw: Ndizi, tunda la mmea huu.
definition.dg: Ndizi, matunda ga mgomba.

definition.en: Banana; another Mgombato word for the fruit, alongside ndizi.
definition.sw: Ndizi; neno jingine la Mgombato kwa tunda hili, pamoja na ndizi.
definition.dg: Ndizi; neno ranjina ra Mgombato ra tunda hiri, phamwenga na *ndizi*.

definition.en: A single banana. Bananas are counted as 'fingers' (mala ga ndizi), as leaf lobes are; the same is said of similar-looking fruits of wild Uvaria species.
definition.sw: Ndizi moja. Ndizi huhesabiwa kama 'vidole' (mala ga ndizi), kama ilivyo kwa sehemu za jani; vivyo hivyo husemwa kuhusu matunda yanayofanana nayo ya spishi za porini za Uvaria.
definition.dg: Ndizi mwenga. Ndizi nkuolangbwa dza 'vyala' (*mala ga ndizi*), dza vira vyala vya kodza; vivyo hivyo nkugombwa kpwa matunda ganagohalana nago ga aina za weruni za *Uvaria*.

definition.en: A hand of bananas, one cluster of fingers on the stalk.
definition.sw: Tana la ndizi, kishada kimoja cha vidole kwenye kikonyo.
definition.dg: Tana ra ndizi, bunda rimwenga ra vyala kpwa mlita.

meaning.en: Tsana also means 'comb'; Pakia could not tell whether this is one word used for both or two words that sound alike.
meaning.sw: Tsana pia lina maana ya 'kitana'; Pakia hakuweza kubaini kama ni neno moja linalotumika kwa yote mawili au ni maneno mawili yanayosikika sawa.
meaning.dg: *Tsana* piya ni 'chitana' (cha kutsanira nyere); Pakia kaweza kumanya ichikala ni neno rimwenga ririro na mana mairi au ni maneno mairi ganagogombwa sawa.

definition.en: The whole bunch of bananas, all the hands on one stalk.
definition.sw: Mkungu mzima wa ndizi, matana yote kwenye kikonyo kimoja.
definition.dg: Bunda rosi ra ndizi, matana gosi kpwa mlita mmwenga.

definition.en: A banana sucker, the young shoot from the base used to plant a new banana. Pakia lists it among the named kinds of planting material (mbeyu).
definition.sw: Chipukizi la mgomba, mche mchanga kutoka kitakoni unaotumika kupanda mgomba mpya. Pakia analiorodhesha miongoni mwa aina za mbegu za kupanda zenye majina (mbeyu).
definition.dg: Mwana wa mgomba, mutse unaotuluka kula photsi unaohumirwa kuphanda mgomba muphya. Pakia anauandika kahi ya aina za mbeyu zirizo na madzina.

shared_with: mwana: the female flower (young cob) of maize

teaser.en: The sticky brown pulp of the tamarind pod sours porridge, fish sauce and cold drinks right across the coast.
teaser.sw: Unga wa kahawia unaonata wa kaka la ukwaju huongeza uchachu kwenye uji, mchuzi wa samaki na vinywaji baridi kote pwani.
teaser.dg: Unga wa rangi ya dongo unaonyata wa kpwadzu unahenda uji, mtsuzi wa ng'onda na vinwadzi vya mnyevu vikale vya ngbwadu kosi pwani.

summary.en: *Mkpwadzu* is the tamarind, a long-lived tree of villages and bush whose pods hold a sour, sticky pulp. The Digo use it for food and drink, carve its hard wood into mortars and pestles, and use it in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mkpwadzu* ni mkwaju, mti unaoishi muda mrefu wa vijijini na vichakani ambao makaka yake yana nyama ya uchachu inayonata. Wadigo huutumia kwa chakula na vinywaji, huchonga mbao zake ngumu kuwa vinu na michi, na huutumia katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Mkpwadzu* ni muhi unaokala na moyo kpwa muda mrefu, wa vidzidzi na weruni, ambao makakayage gana unga wa ngbwadu unaonyata. Adigo anauhumira kpwa chakurya na vinwadzi, anatsonga nyama za muhi uhu, ambazo ni ngumu, kuhenda vinu na mitsi, na anauhumira kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mkpwadzu* is a large, slow-growing evergreen tree with a dense, rounded crown that casts deep shade. Its leaves are feathery, made of ten to eighteen pairs of small leaflets that fold together at night.

The fruit is a curved brown pod with a thin, brittle shell. Inside, a sticky, sour brown pulp clings to hard, shiny seeds. Big old trees can live for a very long time and become landmarks in a village.
about.sw:
*Mkpwadzu* ni mti mkubwa unaokua polepole, wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima na taji nene la mviringo linaloweka kivuli kizito. Majani yake ni kama manyoya, yakiwa na jozi kumi hadi kumi na nane za vijani vidogo vinavyojikunja pamoja usiku.

Tunda ni kaka la kahawia lililopinda lenye ganda jembamba linalovunjika kwa urahisi. Ndani yake, nyama ya kahawia inayonata yenye uchachu hushikamana na mbegu ngumu zinazong'aa. Miti mikubwa mizee inaweza kuishi muda mrefu sana na kuwa alama mashuhuri kijijini.
about.dg:
*Mkpwadzu* ni muhi mkulu unaokula pore-pore na wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye chitswa chizito cha mviringo chinachoreha pepho kulu. Makodzage ni dza manyoya, ga jozi kumi hadi kumi na nane za makodza madide ganagokundzana usiku.

Tunda ni kakaya ririrootyoka ra rangi ya dongo, renye chivo chembamba chinachovundzika rahisi. Ndani, unga wa ngbwadu unaonyata wa rangi ya dongo unagbwirira tembe ngumu zinazong'ala. Mikpwadzu mikulu ya kare inaweza kukala na moyo kpwa muda mrefu sana na kukala alama ya chidzidzi.

where.en: Tamarind grows in bushland, wooded grassland and around village sites. On the south coast the large trees are easiest to spot standing in villages and along the edges of the bush, where people have kept them for generations.
where.sw: Mkwaju hustawi vichakani, katika nyika zenye miti na kuzunguka maeneo ya vijiji. Katika pwani ya kusini miti mikubwa ni rahisi zaidi kuiona ikiwa imesimama vijijini na pembezoni mwa vichaka, ambako watu wameihifadhi kwa vizazi.
where.dg: Mkpwadzu unamera weruni, kpwa nyasi zenye mihi na kanda-kanda ya vidzidzi. Kpwa pwani ya kusini, mihi mikulu ni rahisi zaidi kuiona ichiima kpwa vidzidzi na kanda-kanda ya weruni, phatu ambapho atu akairinda kpwa vizazi na vizazi.

uses.en:
The pulp is the prize. It is used to sour porridge, made into juice and drinks, and stirred into chutneys and fish sauces. The seeds are fried and eaten.

The wood is hard and is carved into mortars and pestles. The tree is also used in medicine: the Digo of Diani boil the roots and leaves as a remedy for malaria.
uses.sw:
Nyama ndiyo hazina. Hutumika kuongeza uchachu kwenye uji, hutengenezwa sharubati na vinywaji, na huchanganywa katika chatini na michuzi ya samaki. Mbegu hukaangwa na kuliwa.

Mbao zake ni ngumu na huchongwa kuwa vinu na michi. Mti huu pia hutumika katika dawa: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi na majani kama tiba ya malaria.
uses.dg:
Unga ndio chitu cha samani zaidi. Nkuhumirwa kuhenda uji ukale wa ngbwadu, nkuhendwa juisi na vinwadzi, na nkutsanganywa kpwa chatini na mitsuzi ya ng'onda. Tembe nkukalangwa na kuriwa.

Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na nkutsongbwa kuhenda vinu na mitsi. Muhi piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa: Adigo a Diani nkujita mizi na makodza dza dawa ya homa (malaria).

culture.en: The name *mkpwadzu* is shared with the Duruma, Giriama and Swahili neighbours, and its *kpw* spelling captures the Digo pronunciation. The word *mkpwadzu* has a second meaning too: a walking stick.
culture.sw: Jina *mkpwadzu* linashirikiwa na majirani Waduruma, Wagiriama na Waswahili, na maandishi yake ya *kpw* yanaonyesha matamshi ya Kidigo. Neno *mkpwadzu* lina maana ya pili pia: bakora.
culture.dg: Dzina *mkpwadzu* ni sawa na ra Aduruma, Agiryama na Aswahili, ambao ni majirani a Adigo, na maandikoge ga *kpw* ganaonyesa vira Adigo anavyorigomba. Neno *mkpwadzu* rina mana ya phiri piya: mseche.

names.en: The tree is *mkpwadzu*, also written *mkwadzu*; the fruit is *kpwadzu* or *likpwadzu* (plural *makpwadzu*). The ICRAF handbook writes *mkwadzu*, while Pakia and Mgombato use the Digo spelling with *kpw*. Swahili calls the tree *mkwaju* and the fruit *ukwaju*, and Giriama also uses *mkwaju*. In English it is tamarind.
names.sw: Mti ni *mkpwadzu*, pia huandikwa *mkwadzu*; tunda ni *kpwadzu* au *likpwadzu* (wingi *makpwadzu*). Kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF kinaandika *mkwadzu*, huku Pakia na Mgombato wakitumia maandishi ya Kidigo yenye *kpw*. Kiswahili huuita mti *mkwaju* na tunda *ukwaju*, na Kigiriama pia hutumia *mkwaju*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *tamarind*.
names.dg: Muhi ni *mkpwadzu*, piya unaandikpwa *mkwadzu*; tunda ni *kpwadzu* au *likpwadzu* (unji *makpwadzu*). Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika *mkwadzu*, ela Pakia na Mgombato anahumira maandiko ga Chidigo ga *kpw*. Chiswahili chinauiha muhi *mkwaju* na tunda *ukwaju*, na Chigiryama piya chinahumira *mkwaju*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *tamarind*.

definition.en: The tamarind pod. Mgombato also lists it as likpwadzu (plural makpwadzu).
definition.sw: Kaka la ukwaju. Mgombato pia analiorodhesha kama likpwadzu (wingi makpwadzu).
definition.dg: Kakaya ra mkpwadzu. Mgombato piya inariandika dza *likpwadzu* (unji *makpwadzu*).

digo_source: Mgombato ('kapu lemon', 'limau lemon'); Pakia ('Mlimau / Mkapu' shared by all Digo)

teaser.en: Digo has two words for the lemon, *limau* and *kapu*, and both are understood by Digo speakers everywhere.
teaser.sw: Kidigo kina maneno mawili ya limau, *limau* na *kapu*, na yote mawili yanaeleweka na wazungumzaji wa Kidigo kila mahali.
teaser.dg: Chidigo china maneno mairi ga limau, *limau* na *kapu*, na gosi mairi ganamanyikana ni atu osi anaogomba Chidigo kosi.

summary.en: *Mlimau* or *mkapu* is the lemon tree, grown beside homesteads for its large yellow fruit. Its juice goes into drinks and into everyday cooking.
summary.sw: *Mlimau* au *mkapu* ni mlimau, unaopandwa kando ya makazi kwa ajili ya matunda yake makubwa ya manjano. Maji yake hutiwa katika vinywaji na katika mapishi ya kila siku.
summary.dg: *Mlimau* au *mkapu* ni muhi wa malimau, unaophandwa kanda-kanda ya midzi kpwa sababu ya matundage makulu ga rangi ya mandano. Madzige ganahumirwa kpwenye vinwadzi na kpwenye kujita kpwa chila siku.

about.en: The lemon is a small citrus tree with glossy, pointed leaves and, often, a few sharp thorns on the twigs. Its white flowers are sweetly scented. The fruit is larger than a lime and ripens to bright yellow, with a sour, juicy flesh and an aromatic skin.
about.sw: Mlimau ni mti mdogo wa jamii ya machungwa wenye majani yanayong'aa na yenye ncha kali, na mara nyingi miiba michache mikali kwenye vitawi. Maua yake meupe yana harufu tamu. Tunda lake ni kubwa kuliko ndimu na huiva kuwa la manjano angavu, lenye nyama chachu yenye maji mengi na ganda lenye harufu nzuri.
about.dg: *Mlimau* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya ndimu, wenye makodza ganaala genye ntsa, na mara nyinji miya michache mikali kpwenye panda ndide. Maruwage ga rangi nyereru gana arufu nono ya mtswano. Tunda ni kulu kuriko ndimu na rinaivwa kukala ra rangi ya mandano rinaroala, na nyama ya ngbwadu yenye madzi manji na gada renye arufu nono.

where.en: Lemon trees are kept close to the house, in homesteads and home gardens along the south coast, alongside limes and oranges.
where.sw: Milimau hupandwa karibu na nyumba, katika makazi na bustani za nyumbani kando ya pwani ya kusini, pamoja na midimu na michungwa.
where.dg: Milimau inaphandwa phephi na nyumba, midzini na kpwenye busitani za kaya kanda-kanda ya pwani ya kusini, phamwenga na midimu na michungwa.

uses.en: The juice is squeezed into drinks and used in cooking.
uses.sw: Maji yake hukamuliwa ndani ya vinywaji na hutumika katika mapishi.
uses.dg: Madzige nkuminywa kpwenye vinwadzi na nkuhumirwa kujitira.

names.en: The tree is *mlimau* or *mkapu*, and the fruit *limau* or *kapu*. Both names are shared by all Digo speakers. Swahili uses *mlimau* for the tree and *limau* for the fruit. In English it is lemon.
names.sw: Mti ni *mlimau* au *mkapu*, na tunda ni *limau* au *kapu*. Majina yote mawili yanatumiwa na wazungumzaji wote wa Kidigo. Kiswahili hutumia *mlimau* kwa mti na *limau* kwa tunda. Kwa Kiingereza ni *lemon*.
names.dg: Muhi ni *mlimau* au *mkapu*, na tunda ni *limau* au *kapu*. Madzina gosi mairi nkuhumirwa ni atu osi anaogomba Chidigo. Kpwa Chiswahili muhi ni *mlimau* na tunda ni *limau*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lemon*.

teaser.en: Its trunk bristles with long thorns, which is why farmers plant it as a living fence that also bears sweet fruit.
teaser.sw: Shina lake limejaa miiba mirefu, na ndiyo sababu wakulima huupanda kama uzio hai unaozaa pia matunda matamu.
teaser.dg: Kolore rinadzala miya mire, na ndiyo mana akurima nkuuphanda dza lichigo ra mihi inayomera, ririrolavya piya matunda ga mtswano.

summary.en: *Mnyondoya* is the governor's plum, a thorny shrub or small tree of the coastal bush with sweet dark red fruits. It feeds passers-by, guards farms as a live fence and is used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mnyondoya* ni mgovigovi, kichaka chenye miiba au mti mdogo wa vichaka vya pwani wenye matunda matamu mekundu iliyokolea. Huwalisha wapita njia, hulinda mashamba kama uzio hai na hutumika katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Mnyondoya* ni *governor's plum*, chitsaka chenye miya au muhi mdide wa weruni wa pwani, wenye matunda ga mtswano ga kundu sana. Unarisa atu anaotsupa, unarinda minda dza lichigo ra mihi inayomera, na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mnyondoya* is a spiny shrub or small tree. Long, straight spines grow out of the trunk and older branches, a handy way to recognise it. The leaves are oval with toothed edges.

The fruits are round berries, about the size of a cherry, that ripen from red to a deep red-purple, almost black. They are sweet when fully ripe.
about.sw:
*Mnyondoya* ni kichaka chenye miiba au mti mdogo. Miiba mirefu iliyonyooka huchipuka kutoka kwenye shina na matawi ya zamani, njia rahisi ya kuutambua. Majani ni ya umbo la yai yenye kingo zenye meno.

Matunda ni beri za mviringo, kwa ukubwa wa cheri hivi, zinazoiva kutoka nyekundu hadi nyekundu-zambarau iliyokolea, karibu nyeusi. Huwa tamu zikiiva kabisa.
about.dg:
*Mnyondoya* ni chitsaka chenye miya au muhi mdide. Miya mire na ya kugoloka inamera kula kpwenye kolo na panda za kare, na hiyo ni alama nono ya kuumanya. Makodza ni ga umbo ra tumbi na gana meno kanda-kanda.

Matunda ni ga mviringo, makulu dza *cherry*, ganayoivwa kula kundu hadi kundu-zambarau sana, phephi na maru. Ganakala ga mtswano gachiivwa sawa-sawa.

where.en: Look for it in the bushland and thickets of the coastal plain, and along farm boundaries where it has been planted as a hedge.
where.sw: Utafute katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya uwanda wa pwani, na kando ya mipaka ya mashamba ambako umepandwa kama ua.
where.dg: Hendza kpwenye weruni na vitsaka vya herera ya pwani, na kanda-kanda ya minda phatu unaphokala ukaphandwa dza lichigo.

uses.en:
The ripe fruit is eaten fresh as a wild snack. The straight stems are cut for poles and tool handles, and because of its thorns the shrub makes a good live fence around farms and homesteads.

It is also used in medicine: the Digo of Diani boil the roots as a remedy for malaria.
uses.sw:
Tunda lililoiva huliwa bichi kama kitafunio cha porini. Mashina yaliyonyooka hukatwa kwa ajili ya nguzo na mipini ya zana, na kwa sababu ya miiba yake kichaka hiki hufanya uzio hai mzuri kuzunguka mashamba na makazi.

Pia hutumika katika dawa: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi yake kama dawa ya malaria.
uses.dg:
Matunda ganayoivwa nkuriwa dza garivyo, dza chakurya chidide cha weruni. Mihi iriyogoloka nkukatwa kuhenda nguzo na mipini ya vyombo, na kpwa sababu ya miyaye, chitsaka hichi ni lichigo nono ra mihi kuzunguluka minda na midzi.

Piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa: Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha mizi kuhenda dawa ya homa.

names.en: The Digo name is *mnyondoya*, also written *mnyondoiya* in Mgombato. Swahili calls it *mgovigovi* or *mchongoma*. Among other Mijikenda, Giriama say *mdungatundu* and Duruma *madungatundu*. In English it is governor's plum or Indian plum.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mnyondoya*, pia huandikwa *mnyondoiya* katika Mgombato. Kiswahili huuita *mgovigovi* au *mchongoma*. Miongoni mwa Wamijikenda wengine, Wagiriama husema *mdungatundu* na Waduruma *madungatundu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *governor's plum* au *Indian plum*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mnyondoya*, ambaro kpwenye Mgombato rinaandikpwa piya *mnyondoiya*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mgovigovi* au *mchongoma*. Kahi ya Amijikenda anjina, Agiryama anagomba *mdungatundu* na Aduruma *madungatundu*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *governor's plum* au *Indian plum*.

teaser.en: The Digo call one red-fleshed pawpaw *moyo wa simba*, 'lion's heart'.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huita aina moja ya papai lenye nyama nyekundu *moyo wa simba*.
teaser.dg: Adigo nkuiha aina mwenga ya papali yenye nyama ya kundu *moyo wa simba*.

summary.en: *Mpapali* is the pawpaw or papaya, a fast-growing garden plant found in homesteads all over the coast. It gives ripe fruit to eat, green fruit to cook and a natural meat tenderiser.
summary.sw: *Mpapali* ni mpapai, mmea wa bustanini unaokua haraka na unaopatikana katika makazi kote pwani. Hutoa matunda mabivu ya kula, mabichi ya kupika, na kilainishi asilia cha nyama.
summary.dg: *Mpapali* ni muhi wa papali (*pawpaw* au *papaya* kpwa Chingereza), mmea wa busitani unaokula upesi, unaophahikana midzini kosi pwani. Unalavya matunda maivu ga kurya, matunda maitsi ga kujita, na chitu cha chienyeji cha kuhenda nyama ikale yuya.

about.en:
*Mpapali* looks like a small tree but has a soft, hollow, unbranched stem marked with leaf scars. At the top sits a crown of large, deeply lobed leaves on long stalks, and the fruits hang in a cluster just below them, pressed against the stem.

The fruit turns from green to yellow or orange as it ripens. Inside, the flesh is orange or red around a hollow filled with small black seeds. Cut the green fruit and a white milky sap runs out.
about.sw:
*Mpapali* huonekana kama mti mdogo lakini una shina laini, lenye uwazi ndani na lisilo na matawi, lenye alama za mahali majani yalipodondoka. Juu kabisa kuna taji la majani makubwa yenye mapengo marefu juu ya mikono mirefu, na matunda huning'inia kwa kishada chini yake kidogo, yakiwa yamegandamana na shina.

Tunda hubadilika kutoka kijani hadi njano au rangi ya chungwa linapoiva. Ndani, nyama yake ni ya rangi ya chungwa au nyekundu ikizunguka uwazi uliojaa mbegu ndogo nyeusi. Ukikata tunda bichi, utomvu mweupe kama maziwa hutiririka.
about.dg:
*Mpapali* unaoneka dza muhi mdide, ela una kolo laini, risiro na chitu ndani na risiro na panda, renye alama za makodza garigogbwa. Dzulu kuna chitswa cha makodza makulu genye mala manji, kpwenye milita mire, na matunda ganabwadzika phamwenga photsi yago, ganagandamana na kolo.

Tunda rinagaluka kula rangi ya chijani kukala ya rangi ya mandano au ya chungbwa richiivwa. Ndani, nyama ni ya rangi ya chungbwa au ya kundu, na kahi kuna utupu uriodzala tembe didide nyiru. Uchikata tunda ritsi, maziya ga rangi nyereru ganatuluka.

where.en: Pawpaw is grown in homestead gardens across the south coast. It springs up easily from seed and fruits within a year or so, so plants of every size are often seen around a single compound.
where.sw: Mpapai hupandwa katika bustani za nyumbani kote pwani ya kusini. Huota kwa urahisi kutokana na mbegu na huzaa ndani ya takriban mwaka mmoja, hivyo mara nyingi huonekana mipapai ya kila ukubwa kuzunguka boma moja.
where.dg: *Mpapali* unaphandwa kpwenye busitani za midzi kosi pwani ya kusini. Unamera upesi kula tembe na unalavya matunda bada ya mwaka mmwenga hivi, kpwa hivyo mara nyinji mipapali midide na mikulu inaonekana kuzunguluka mudzi mmwenga.

uses.en: The ripe fruit is eaten fresh. Green fruit is cooked as a vegetable. The plant is also used as a meat tenderiser, thanks to the enzyme in its milky sap, which softens meat.
uses.sw: Tunda bivu huliwa likiwa freshi. Tunda bichi hupikwa kama mboga. Mmea huu pia hutumika kulainisha nyama, kutokana na kimeng'enya kilichomo kwenye utomvu wake mweupe, kinacholainisha nyama.
uses.dg: Matunda maivu nkuriwa dza garivyo. Matunda maitsi nkujitwa dza mboga. Mmea uhu piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda nyama ikale yuya, kpwa sababu ya kemikali (*enzyme*) iriyo kpwenye maziyage.

names.en: The plant is *mpapali* and the fruit *papali*. Digo growers distinguish varieties: *moyo wa simba*, with red flesh, and *moyo mwereru*. Swahili says *mpapai* for the plant and *papai* for the fruit. In English it is pawpaw or papaya.
names.sw: Mmea ni *mpapali* na tunda ni *papali*. Wakulima wa Kidigo hutofautisha aina zake: *moyo wa simba*, yenye nyama nyekundu, na *moyo mwereru*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mpapai* kwa mmea na *papai* kwa tunda. Kwa Kiingereza ni *pawpaw* au *papaya*.
names.dg: Mmea ni *mpapali* na tunda ni *papali*. Adigo anaophanda anatafwautisha aina: *moyo wa simba*, yenye nyama ya kundu, na *moyo mwereru*. Kpwa Chiswahili mmea ni *mpapai* na tunda ni *papai*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pawpaw* au *papaya*.

teaser.dg: Gopha ra kolore laini rinatuluka vipande-vipande dza rangi ya kare, na kuonyesa mabaka ga rangi ya shaba na ya chijani photsize.

summary.en: *Mpera* is the guava, a small fruit tree planted around homesteads that has also run wild in the coastal bush. Its fruit is eaten fresh or made into juice and jam.
summary.sw: *Mpera* ni mpera, mti mdogo wa matunda unaopandwa kuzunguka makazi ambao pia umejiotea porini pwani. Mapera huliwa yakiwa mabichi au hutengenezwa sharubati na jamu.
summary.dg: *Mpera* ni muhi mdide wa matunda unaophandwa kanda-kanda ya midzi, na piya ukaenea weruni pwani. Matundage nkuriwa dza garivyo au nkuhendwa madzi ga matunda na jamu.

about.en:
*Mpera* is a small tree with a smooth trunk whose thin bark flakes away in patches, leaving a mottled pattern. The leaves are opposite, oval and stiff, with clear raised veins, and give off a spicy smell when crushed.

The white flowers have a brush of many stamens. The round or pear-shaped fruit ripens yellow, with pale or pink flesh full of small hard seeds and a strong sweet scent.
about.sw:
*Mpera* ni mti mdogo wenye shina laini ambalo gome lake jembamba hubanduka kwa mabaka, likiacha mchoro wa madoadoa. Majani yake huota yakitazamana, yana umbo la yai na ni magumu, yakiwa na mishipa iliyoinuka inayoonekana wazi, na hutoa harufu ya kiungo yanapopondwa.

Maua meupe yana kishada cha stameni nyingi kama brashi. Tunda la mviringo au lenye umbo la peari huiva likawa la manjano, likiwa na nyama nyeupe au ya waridi iliyojaa mbegu ndogo ngumu, na lina harufu kali tamu.
about.dg:
*Mpera* ni muhi mdide wenye kolo laini, ambaro gophare dzembamba rinatuluka mabaka-mabaka, na kuricha alama za rangi tafwauti. Makodza ganamera ganalengana, ni ga duara-ndefu na magumu, gana mishipa yenye kuonekana sawa-sawa, na gachihopezwa ganalavya arufu dza ya viungo.

Maruwa mereru gana mafungu ga nyuzi nyinji. Tunda ra duara au renye umbo ra peya rinaivwa richikala ra rangi ya mandano, na nyamaze ni za rangi ngushu-ngushu au za rangi ya pinki, zenye tembe ndide ngumu nyinji na arufu nono ya mtswano.

where.en: Guava is grown around homesteads, and it has naturalised in the bush, where birds and people spread its seeds. Wild-growing guavas are a common sight along paths and old farms on the south coast.
where.sw: Mpera hupandwa kuzunguka makazi, na umejiotea porini, ambapo ndege na watu hueneza mbegu zake. Mipera inayojiotea yenyewe huonekana mara nyingi kando ya njia na kwenye mashamba ya zamani katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Mpera unaphandwa kanda-kanda ya midzi, na ukaenea weruni, ambako nyuni na atu anatawanya tembeze. Mipera ya weruni ni kawaida kuiona kanda-kanda ya njira na kpwenye minda ya kare pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten fresh, pressed for juice and boiled into jam. The hard wood is used for tool handles, and the plant is used in medicine.
uses.sw: Matunda huliwa yakiwa mabichi, hukamuliwa sharubati na huchemshwa kutengeneza jamu. Mbao zake ngumu hutumika kutengenezea mipini ya zana, na mmea huu hutumika kama dawa.
uses.dg: Matunda ganariwa dza garivyo, nkuminywa kuhenda madzi ga matunda na nkutsemswa kuhenda jamu. Mbao ngumu nkuhumirwa kuhenda miphini ya vyombo, na mmea hinyu piya nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

names.en: The Digo name is *mpera*, the same as in Swahili, where the fruit is *pera*. In English it is guava.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mpera*, sawa na la Kiswahili, ambapo tunda huitwa *pera*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *guava*.
names.dg: Dzinare kpwa Chidigo ni *mpera*, sawa na kpwa Chiswahili, ambamo tunda ni *pera*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *guava*.
