teaser.en: The Digo word for rubber, *mpira*, comes from this forest vine, which was once tapped for its sticky white latex.
teaser.sw: Neno la Kidigo la mpira, *mpira*, linatokana na mtambaa huu wa msituni, ambao zamani uligemwa kwa utomvu wake mweupe unaonata.
teaser.dg: Neno *mpira*, ambaro kpwa Chidigo rina mana ya *rubber*, rinalavywa kula mmea hinyu wa tsaka unaofyombera, ambao kare kala unatuluzwa maziyage mereru ganayonyata.

summary.en: *Mpira* is the rubber vine, a strong woody climber of the coastal forest and woodland with round orange fruits. Its sweet-sour fruit is sold in coast towns, and its latex was once tapped for rubber.
summary.sw: *Mpira* ni mtambaa imara wenye shina gumu wa misitu na mapori ya pwani, wenye matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya chungwa (kwa Kiingereza *rubber vine*). Tunda lake tamu-chachu huuzwa katika miji ya pwani, na utomvu wake zamani uligemwa kutengeneza mpira.
summary.dg: *Mpira* ni *rubber vine*, mmea unaofyombera wenye nguvu na nyama za muhi, wa matsaka na weruni wa pwani, wenye matunda ga mviringo ga rangi ya chungbwa. Matundage ga mtswano na ngbwadu nkuguzwa midzi ya pwani, na kare maziyage kala ganatuluzwa kuhenda mpira.

about.en:
*Mpira* is a tough, woody climber that hauls itself into the canopy with coiling tendrils. The leaves are small and arranged in opposite pairs. Break a stem or leaf and a sticky white latex oozes out, the feature that made the plant famous.

The fruits are round and orange, with a hard rind around soft, sweet-sour pulp that clings to the seeds. Like many members of the dogbane family (Apocynaceae), it has fragrant tubular flowers.
about.sw:
*Mpira* ni mtambaa mgumu wenye shina gumu unaojivuta hadi kileleni mwa miti kwa vikonyo vilivyojikunja vya kushikilia. Majani ni madogo na yamepangwa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana. Ukivunja shina au jani, utomvu mweupe unaonata hutiririka, sifa iliyoufanya mmea huu kuwa maarufu.

Matunda ni ya mviringo na ya rangi ya chungwa, yenye ganda gumu linalozunguka nyama laini tamu-chachu inayoshikamana na mbegu. Kama wanafamilia wengi wa familia ya Apocynaceae, una maua yenye harufu nzuri na umbo la mrija.
about.dg:
*Mpira* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye nguvu na nyama za muhi, unaofyombera hadi dzulu kabisa ya mihi kpwa nyuzi zinazolinga-linga. Makodzage ni madide na ganamera mairi-mairi ganayolengana. Uchivundza muhi au kodza, kunatuluka maziya mereru ganayonyata, na hicho ndicho chikahenda mmea hinyu umanyikane sana.

Matunda ni ga mviringo na ga rangi ya chungbwa, na gada gumu rinarozunguluka nyama laini ya mtswano na ngbwadu inayogbwirana na tembe. Dza mimea minji ya jamii ya *dogbane* (*Apocynaceae*), una maruwa genye arufu nono, ganayokala dza mrija.

where.en: Look for *mpira* along forest edges and in the *Brachystegia* woodland of the coastal belt, and in the thickets of the kaya forests. In fruit, the orange balls hanging in tangled vines make it easier to find.
where.sw: Mtafute *mpira* kando ya misitu na katika mapori ya *Brachystegia* ya ukanda wa pwani, na katika vichaka vizito vya misitu ya kaya. Wakati wa matunda, mipira ya rangi ya chungwa inayoning'inia katika mitambaa iliyosokotana huufanya kuwa rahisi kuupata.
where.dg: Hendza *mpira* kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye matsaka ga *Brachystegia* ga pwani, na kpwenye vitsaka vya matsaka ga kaya. Uchikala na matunda, matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa dza mipira, ganayobwadzika kahi ya mbugu zirizodzilinga-linga, ganahenda uonekane rahisi.

uses.en:
The fruit is eaten fresh, and its sweet-sour taste makes it a seller's item in coastal towns. The latex was once tapped as rubber and is used as bird-lime, a sticky paste for catching birds.

The leaves and roots are used in medicine.
uses.sw:
Tunda huliwa bichi, na ladha yake tamu-chachu huifanya kuwa bidhaa ya kuuzwa katika miji ya pwani. Utomvu wake zamani uligemwa kama mpira na hutumika kama ulimbo, ute unaonata wa kunasa ndege.

Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg:
Tunda nkuriwa dza ririvyo, na kpwa sababu ya ladhaye ya mtswano na ngbwadu, nkuguzwa midzi ya pwani. Kare maziyage kala ganatuluzwa kuhenda mpira, na nkuhumirwa dza *ukaka*, ulimbo unaonyata wa kugbwira nyuni.

Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

culture.en: The name tells the plant's history: *mpira* means rubber, and this vine was once tapped for it.
culture.sw: Jina linasimulia historia ya mmea: *mpira* linamaanisha mpira (*rubber*), na mtambaa huu zamani uligemwa ili kuupata.
culture.dg: Dzina rinaeleza historia ya mmea: *mpira* rina mana ya *rubber*, na kare mmea hinyu kala unatuluzwa maziya kuhenda mpira.

names.en: The Digo names for the vine are *mpira* and *libugu* (plural *mbugu*), and the fruit is *kitoria*. Swahili names include *mpira*, *ulimbo* and *mbungo*. In Giriama it is *mutongazi* or *mtoria*. In English it is rubber vine. Note that Swahili *mbungo* is also used for the related rubber vine *Saba comorensis*.
names.sw: Majina ya Kidigo ya mtambaa ni *mpira* na *libugu* (wingi *mbugu*), na tunda ni *kitoria*. Majina ya Kiswahili ni pamoja na *mpira*, *ulimbo* na *mbungo*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mutongazi* au *mtoria*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *rubber vine*. Ifahamike kuwa *mbungo* ya Kiswahili pia hutumika kwa mtambaa mwingine wa mpira unaohusiana nao, *Saba comorensis*.
names.dg: Madzina ga Chidigo ga mmea hinyu ni *mpira* na *libugu* (unji *mbugu*), na tunda nkuihwa *kitoria*. Madzina ga Chiswahili ni *mpira*, *ulimbo* na *mbungo*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mutongazi* au *mtoria*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *rubber vine*. Manya kukala kpwa Chiswahili *mbungo* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa *Saba comorensis*, mmea wanjina wa mpira ambao ni nduguye.

summary.en: *Mukunazi* or *mkunazi* is the Indian jujube, a thorny shrub or small tree of villages and bush with small sweet-sour fruits. It also gives firewood, medicine and timber for the ribs of dhows.
summary.sw: *Mukunazi* au *mkunazi* ni mkunazi, kichaka au mti mdogo wenye miiba unaopatikana vijijini na porini, wenye matunda madogo yenye ladha ya utamu na uchachu. Pia hutoa kuni, dawa na mbao za kutengenezea mbavu za majahazi.
summary.dg: *Mukunazi* au *mkunazi* ni muhi wa *Indian jujube*, chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye miya wa vidzidzini na weruni, wenye matunda madide ga mtswano na ngbwadu. Piya unalavya kuni, dawa na mbao za kuhenda mbavu za majahazi.

about.en:
*Mukunazi* is a thorny shrub or small tree with drooping, zigzag branches. The leaves are oval, shiny green above and paler and hairy beneath, with three clear veins running from the base. Pairs of small hooked thorns sit where the leaves join the twig.

The small flowers are greenish-yellow. The fruits are round and fleshy, turning from green to yellow or reddish-brown, with a sweet-sour taste around a hard stone.
about.sw:
*Mukunazi* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye miiba, wenye matawi yanayoning'inia na kupinda kwa mtindo wa zigizaga. Majani yake yana umbo la yai, ni ya kijani kinachong'aa upande wa juu, na upande wa chini ni meupe kidogo na yenye vinyweleo, yakiwa na mishipa mitatu iliyo wazi inayoanzia kwenye kitako cha jani. Jozi za miiba midogo iliyopinda kama ndoano huota mahali majani yanapoungana na kitawi.

Maua yake madogo ni ya rangi ya kijani-manjano. Matunda ni ya mviringo na yenye nyama, hubadilika kutoka kijani hadi manjano au kahawia-nyekundu, na huwa na ladha ya utamu na uchachu inayozunguka kokwa gumu.
about.dg:
*Mukunazi* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye miya, wenye panda zinazogbwadzika na zinazogaluka-galuka uphande. Makodza ni ga duara-ndefu, ga chijani ganang'arira dzulu, na photsi ni ga rangi ngushu-ngushu na genye nyere, na gana mishipa mihahu inayotuluka sawa-sawa kula kotsi. Miya midide yenye umbo ra chiloo inamera jozi-jozi phatu kodza rinaphogbwirana na chigongo.

Maruwa madide ni ga chijani na rangi ya mandano. Matunda ni ga duara na genye nyama, ganagaluka kula chijani hadi rangi ya mandano au rangi ya kundu na dongo, na ganakala na ladha ya mtswano na ngbwadu iriyozunguluka tembe ngumu.

where.en: It is found around villages and in the bush, often near homes where its fruit can be picked.
where.sw: Hupatikana karibu na vijiji na porini, mara nyingi karibu na makazi ambapo matunda yake yanaweza kuchumwa.
where.dg: Unaphahikana kanda-kanda ya vidzidzi na weruni, mara nyinji phephi na nyumba ambapho matundage ganaweza kuhundwa.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten. The wood is used for the ribs of dhows, the traditional sailing boats of the coast, and for firewood. The plant is also used in medicine.
uses.sw: Matunda huliwa. Mbao zake hutumika kutengenezea mbavu za majahazi, yaani vyombo vya jadi vya tanga vya pwani, na pia kama kuni. Mmea huu pia hutumika kama dawa.
uses.dg: Matunda ganariwa. Mbao nkuhumirwa kuhenda mbavu za majahazi, madau ga tanga ga chienyeji ga pwani, na kuni. Mmea hinyu piya nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name as *mukunazi*; Pakia writes *mkunazi*. Giriama and Chonyi say *mukunazi*. Swahili calls the tree *mkunazi* and the fruit *kunazi*. In English it is jujube or Indian jujube.
names.sw: Kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo kuwa *mukunazi*; Pakia anaandika *mkunazi*. Wagiriama na Wachonyi husema *mukunazi*. Kwa Kiswahili mti huitwa *mkunazi* na tunda lake *kunazi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *jujube* au *Indian jujube*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinalavya dzina ra Chidigo *mukunazi*; Pakia anaandika *mkunazi*. Kpwa Chigiriama na Chichonyi ni *mukunazi*. Kpwa Chiswahili muhi unaihwa *mkunazi* na tunda *kunazi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *jujube* au *Indian jujube*.

teaser.en: This giant forest vine climbs to the treetops and drops big orange fruits whose tangy pulp is sucked straight off the seeds.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa huu mkubwa wa msituni hupanda hadi vilele vya miti na kuangusha matunda makubwa ya rangi ya chungwa ambayo nyama yake chachu hufyonzwa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye mbegu.
teaser.dg: Mmea hinyu mkulu wa tsaka unaofyombera unafika dzulu kabisa ya mihi, na matundage makulu ga rangi ya chungbwa ganagbwa photsi; atu nkufyondza nyama ya ngbwadu ya matunda higo kula kpwenye tembe.

summary.en: *Muungo* is a huge rubber vine of the coastal and riverine forests with large orange fruits. Its sour pulp is one of the wild fruits commonly eaten by the Digo, and its stems are woven into granaries.
summary.sw: *Muungo* ni mtambaa mkubwa sana wa mpira wa misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito, wenye matunda makubwa ya rangi ya chungwa. Nyama yake chachu ni mojawapo ya matunda ya porini yanayoliwa sana na Wadigo, na mashina yake husukwa kutengeneza vihenge.
summary.dg: *Muungo* ni mmea mkulu sana wa mpira wa matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, wenye matunda makulu ga rangi ya chungbwa. Nyamaye ya ngbwadu ni kahi ya matunda ga tsaka ganayoriwa sana ni Adigo, na mihiye nkusukwa kuhenda vitsaga.

about.en:
*Muungo* is a massive liana that climbs right into the forest canopy. It has milky latex, large glossy leaves and fragrant white flowers.

The fruits are big, round and orange. Inside, the seeds are packed in a sweet-acid pulp that is pleasant to suck.
about.sw:
*Muungo* ni mtambaa mkubwa mno wenye shina gumu unaopanda hadi kileleni kabisa mwa msitu. Una utomvu kama maziwa, majani makubwa yanayong'aa na maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri.

Matunda ni makubwa, ya mviringo na ya rangi ya chungwa. Ndani, mbegu zimesongamana katika nyama tamu-chachu inayopendeza kufyonza.
about.dg:
*Muungo* ni mmea mkulu sana unaofyombera hadi dzulu kabisa ya matsaka. Una maziya, makodza makulu ganayong'ala na maruwa mereru genye arufu nono.

Matunda ni makulu, ga mviringo na ga rangi ya chungbwa. Ndani, tembe zinagbwirana kahi ya nyama ya mtswano na ngbwadu, nono kpwa kufyondza.

where.en: It grows in forest and thicket, especially riverine and coastal forest. Look up into the canopy near streams, or watch for the orange fruits on the forest floor.
where.sw: Hukua msituni na katika vichaka vizito, hasa misitu ya kando ya mito na ya pwani. Tazama juu kileleni mwa miti karibu na vijito, au angalia matunda ya rangi ya chungwa sakafuni mwa msitu.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka, hasa matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na ga pwani. Lola dzulu kabisa ya mihi phephi na miho midide, au lola matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa photsi tsakani.

uses.en: The pulp is sucked off the seeds or used to make a sour juice, and it is listed among the wild fruits the Digo commonly eat. The tough stems are used to weave granaries, and the plant also gives a gum.
uses.sw: Nyama hufyonzwa kutoka kwenye mbegu au hutumika kutengeneza sharubati chachu, na imeorodheshwa miongoni mwa matunda ya porini ambayo Wadigo huyala mara kwa mara. Mashina magumu hutumika kusuka vihenge, na mmea pia hutoa gundi.
uses.dg: Nyama nkufyondzwa kula kpwenye tembe au nkuhumirwa kuhenda chinwadzi cha ngbwadu, na *muungo* unaandikpwa kahi ya matunda ga tsaka ganayoriwa sana ni Adigo. Mihiye migumu nkusukwa kuhenda vitsaga, na mmea piya unalavya ulimbo.

names.en: The Digo names are *muungo* and *mbungo*. Swahili uses *mbungo*, and *muungo* is also used in Pokomo. In English it is called a rubber vine. Swahili *mbungo* is also given for the related rubber vine *Landolphia kirkii*, so the names overlap.
names.sw: Majina ya Kidigo ni *muungo* na *mbungo*. Kiswahili hutumia *mbungo*, na *muungo* pia hutumika kwa Kipokomo. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *rubber vine*. *Mbungo* ya Kiswahili pia hutolewa kwa mtambaa mwingine wa mpira unaohusiana nao, *Landolphia kirkii*, kwa hivyo majina yanaingiliana.
names.dg: Madzina ga Chidigo ni *muungo* na *mbungo*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mbungo*, na *muungo* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa Chipokomo. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *rubber vine*. Kpwa Chiswahili *mbungo* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa *Landolphia kirkii*, mmea wanjina wa mpira ambao ni nduguye, kpwa hivyo madzina higa ganahumirwa kpwa mimea yosi miiri.

conservation.en: It has become much scarcer as its forest habitat has been cleared.
conservation.sw: Umepungua sana kadiri misitu unamoishi inavyofyekwa.
conservation.dg: Ukakala adimu sana kpwa sababu matsaka ganagokala makaloge gakatemwa.

teaser.dg: Aganga anauiha muuyu 'mkulu kazingwa', mkulu ambaye kasalatwa, kpwa sababu nkugombwa kukala dza dawa taushindwa kabisa.

summary.en: *Muuyu* is the baobab, the great swollen-trunked tree of the coastal plain that can live for thousands of years. It feeds, heals and shelters the Digo, and stands beside the sacred meeting place at the heart of the kaya.
summary.sw: *Muuyu* ni mbuyu, mti mkubwa wenye shina lililovimba wa nyanda za pwani unaoweza kuishi kwa maelfu ya miaka. Huwalisha, huwaponya na huwapa Wadigo kivuli, na husimama kando ya mahali patakatifu pa mikutano katikati ya kaya.
summary.dg: *Muuyu* ni muhi mkulu wa tsi ya photsi ya pwani wenye kolo ririrovwimba, na unaweza kukala na moyo kpwa maelufu ga miaka. Unarisa Adigo, unaaphoza na unaapha pepho, na unaima kanda-kanda ya phatu takatifu pha kuonana kahi ya kaya.

about.en:
Nothing else on the coast looks like *muuyu*. Its grey trunk swells to as much as six metres across, and for much of the year the tree stands bare, its stubby branches spread like roots in the air.

The leaves, when they come, are divided like an open hand. The large white flowers hang on long stalks and open at night. They give way to velvety, oval pods filled with chalky, dry white pulp around hard seeds.
about.sw:
Hakuna kitu kingine pwani kinachofanana na *muuyu*. Shina lake la kijivu huvimba hadi kufikia upana wa mita sita, na kwa muda mrefu wa mwaka mti husimama bila majani, matawi yake mafupi na manene yakiwa yametandaa kama mizizi angani.

Majani yanapochipuka, hugawanyika kama kiganja kilichokunjuliwa. Maua makubwa meupe huning'inia kwenye vikonyo virefu na huchanua usiku. Baadaye huzaa makaka ya mviringo yenye ngozi kama ya mahameli, yaliyojaa unga mkavu mweupe kama chaki unaozunguka mbegu ngumu.
about.dg:
Takuna chitu chanjina pwani chinachohalana na *muuyu*. Kolore ra rangi ya ivu rinavwimba hadi kufika upana wa mita sita, na kpwa unji wa mwaka muhi unaima bila makodza, na pandaze fupi zinatandazika dza mizi iriyo dzulu hewani.

Makodza, ganaphokpwedza, ganaganyika dza mkpwono uriovuguka. Maruwa makulu mereru ganabwadzika kpwa milita mire na ganavuguka usiku. Bada ya maruwa kuna makakaya ga mviringo-mrefu genye manyoya-nyoya, ganagodzala unga mkavu wa rangi nyereru dza chokaa kuzunguluka tembe ngumu.

where.en: Baobabs grow throughout the coastal plain in bushland, on farmland and around the edges of the kayas, and they are common in Kwale. They also stand in villages, often far older than the settlements around them. They are easiest to pick out in the dry season, when the bare grey giants stand out against the bush.
where.sw: Mibuyu hustawi katika nyanda zote za pwani, vichakani, mashambani na pembezoni mwa kaya, na ni mingi Kwale. Pia husimama vijijini, mara nyingi ikiwa ya zamani sana kuliko makazi yanayoizunguka. Ni rahisi zaidi kuitambua wakati wa kiangazi, majitu hayo ya kijivu yasiyo na majani yanapojitokeza dhidi ya kichaka.
where.dg: Miuyu inamera kosi kpwa tsi ya photsi ya pwani, weruni, mindani na kanda-kanda ya makaya, na ni minji Kwale. Piya inaima kpwa vidzidzi, na kpwa kawaida ni ya kare sana kuriko midzi iriyo kanda-kanda yao. Ni rahisi zaidi kuimanya wakati wa kazikazi, wakati mihi mikulu ya rangi ya ivu isiyo na makodza inaonekana wazi kahi ya weruni.

uses.en:
The dry pulp is eaten raw or dissolved in water to make a sour drink or sauce. The seeds are fried, and coloured, sugar-coated seeds, *mabuyu*, are sold as sweets. Young leaves are cooked as a vegetable.

The inner bark gives fibre for rope, baskets and string, and hollow trunks are used to store water.

Bark, roots, leaves and fruit are all used in medicine. The Digo of Diani boil the leaves as a remedy for malaria, and healers use the tree to 'cool down' problems.
uses.sw:
Unga mkavu huliwa mbichi au huyeyushwa katika maji kutengeneza kinywaji au mchuzi wenye ukali wa uchachu. Mbegu hukaangwa, na mbegu zilizotiwa rangi na kupakwa sukari, *mabuyu*, huuzwa kama peremende. Majani machanga hupikwa kama mboga.

Gamba la ndani hutoa nyuzi za kutengenezea kamba, vikapu na uzi, na mashina yenye mvungu hutumika kuhifadhia maji.

Gamba, mizizi, majani na matunda yote hutumika katika dawa. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha majani kama tiba ya malaria, na waganga hutumia mti huu 'kupoza' matatizo.
uses.dg:
Unga mkavu nkuriwa vivyo au nkuyeyuswa madzini kuhenda chinwadzi cha ngbwadu au mtsuzi. Tembe nkukalangwa, na tembe zirizotiywa rangi na sukari, *mabuyu*, nkuguzwa dza peremende. Makodza matsanga nkujitwa dza mtsunga.

Gopha ra ndani rinalavya nyuzi za kuhendera kamba, kaphu na lugbwe, na makolo ga ndani matupu nkuhumirwa kuikira madzi.

Gopha, mizi, makodza na matunda gosi nkuhumirwa dza dawa. Adigo a Diani nkujita makodza dza dawa ya homa (malaria), na aganga nkuhumira muhi uhu 'kuphoza' matatizo.

culture.en: Healers know the baobab as *mkulu kazingwa*, 'the great one is never betrayed': as a medicine, it never fails. In the Digo kayas, the *moroni*, the elders' meeting place, is described as lying between a fig tree and a baobab. A Digo proverb runs: *Mlume wangu waochera muuyu arye vidogavye*, 'My husband has roasted for a baobab so that he can eat its mushrooms', meaning that both the man and the tree gain from the deal.
culture.sw: Waganga huujua mbuyu kama *mkulu kazingwa*, 'mkubwa hasalitiwi': kama dawa, haushindwi kamwe. Katika kaya za Wadigo, *moroni*, mahali pa mikutano ya wazee, panaelezwa kuwa kati ya mkuyu (mti wa jamii ya mtini) na mbuyu. Methali moja ya Kidigo inasema: *Mlume wangu waochera muuyu arye vidogavye*, 'Mume wangu amechoma moto kwa ajili ya mbuyu ili ale uyoga wake', ikimaanisha kwamba mwanamume na mti wote wawili wananufaika na mapatano hayo.
culture.dg: Aganga anaumanya muuyu dza *mkulu kazingwa*, 'mkulu kasalatwa': dza dawa, taushindwa kabisa. Kpwa makaya ga Adigo, *moroni*, phatu pha kuonana pha azehe, nkugombwa kukala phakala kahi ya mkuyu (mgandi) na muuyu. Ndarira ya Chidigo inagomba: *Mlume wangu waochera muuyu arye vidogavye*, 'Mlume wangu waochera muuyu ili arye wogawe', manage ni kukala mlume na muhi gosi mairi anaphaha fwaida.

names.en: The tree is *muuyu*, the fruit *uyu* (plural *mauyu*), and a seed or seed pod *mbuyu* (plural *mauyu*). Healers use the name *mkulu kazingwa*. Swahili calls the tree *mbuyu* and the seeds *ubuyu* or *mabuyu*. Giriama also says *muuyu* (fruit *mauyu*), while Chonyi says *muyu*. In English it is baobab.
names.sw: Mti ni *muuyu*, tunda ni *uyu* (wingi *mauyu*), na mbegu au kaka la mbegu ni *mbuyu* (wingi *mauyu*). Waganga hutumia jina *mkulu kazingwa*. Kiswahili huuita mti *mbuyu* na mbegu *ubuyu* au *mabuyu*. Kigiriama pia husema *muuyu* (tunda *mauyu*), huku Kichonyi kikisema *muyu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *baobab*.
names.dg: Muhi ni *muuyu*, tunda ni *uyu* (unji *mauyu*), na tembe au kakayare ni *mbuyu* (unji *mauyu*). Aganga anahumira dzina *mkulu kazingwa*. Kpwa Chiswahili muhi unaihwa *mbuyu* na tembe *ubuyu* au *mabuyu*. Kpwa Chigiryama piya unaihwa *muuyu* (tunda *mauyu*), na kpwa Chichonyi *muyu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *baobab*.

conservation.en: The baobab is not threatened, and individual trees can live for around 3,000 years.
conservation.sw: Mbuyu hauko hatarini, na mti mmoja mmoja unaweza kuishi kwa takriban miaka 3,000.
conservation.dg: Muuyu tauri hatarini, na muhi mmwenga-mmwenga unaweza kukala na moyo kpwa miaka phephi 3,000.

teaser.en: Digo farmers name at least eighteen kinds of mango, from *dodo* and *ngoe* to *shikio punda*, 'donkey's ear'.
teaser.sw: Wakulima Wadigo hutaja angalau aina kumi na nane za maembe, kuanzia *dodo* na *ngoe* hadi *shikio punda*, 'sikio la punda'.
teaser.dg: Akurima a Chidigo anataja aina za embe zisizophungukira kumi na nane, kula *dodo* na *ngoe* hadi *shikio punda*, 'sikiro ra punda'.

summary.en: *Mwembe* is the mango tree, a great evergreen that shades almost every homestead and market on the coast. Its fruit is eaten ripe or green, pickled and sold, and its trunk was once carved into dugout canoes.
summary.sw: *Mwembe* ni mti mkubwa wenye majani mwaka mzima unaotoa kivuli karibu kwa kila boma na soko pwani. Tunda lake huliwa likiwa limeiva au bichi, hutengenezwa achari na huuzwa, na shina lake zamani lilichongwa kuwa mitumbwi.
summary.dg: *Mwembe* ni muhi wa embe, muhi mkulu wenye makodza chila wakati unaopha pepho phephi kpwa chila mudzi na soko ra pwani. Matundage nkuriwa gachiivwa au gachiri ga chijani, nkuhendwa achari na kuguzwa, na kare kolore kala rinatsongbwa kuhenda mitumbwi.

about.en:
*Mwembe* is a big, long-lived evergreen tree with a dense, rounded crown. The leaves are long, narrow and leathery; new flushes come out a reddish-copper colour before turning dark green. Small cream flowers appear in branched sprays at the tips of the twigs.

The fruit hangs on long stalks and ripens from green to yellow, orange or red depending on the variety, around a large flat stone. Digo distinguishes many cultivars, among them *boribo*, *ngoe*, *dodo*, *batawi*, *chimaji*, *chisukari*, *epoli*, *zafarani*, *shikio punda* and *embe ra chidigo*.
about.sw:
*Mwembe* ni mti mkubwa unaoishi muda mrefu wenye majani mwaka mzima na taji nene la mviringo. Majani ni marefu, membamba na magumu kama ngozi; machipukizi mapya hutoka yakiwa na rangi ya shaba nyekundu kabla ya kugeuka kijani kibichi kilichokolea. Maua madogo ya rangi ya krimu hutokea kwa vishada vyenye matawi kwenye ncha za vitawi.

Tunda huning'inia kwenye vikonyo virefu na huiva kutoka kijani hadi manjano, machungwa au nyekundu kulingana na aina, likizunguka kokwa kubwa bapa. Kidigo kinatofautisha aina nyingi, miongoni mwake *boribo*, *ngoe*, *dodo*, *batawi*, *chimaji*, *chisukari*, *epoli*, *zafarani*, *shikio punda* na *embe ra chidigo*.
about.dg:
*Mwembe* ni muhi mkulu unaokala na moyo kpwa muda mrefu, wenye makodza chila wakati, na wenye chitswa chizito cha mviringo. Makodza ni marefu, membamba na mafu dza chingo; makodza maphya ganatuluka ga rangi ya kundu-shaba kabla ya kukala ga chijani chiru. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya maziya ganatuluka kpwa mabunda ganagoganyika kpwa ntsa za panda ndide.

Tunda rinabwadzika kpwa milita mire na rinaivwa kula chijani hadi rangi ya mandano, ya chungbwa au ya kundu, kulingana na aina, kuzunguluka koko kulu ra kubanika. Chidigo chinatafwautisha aina nyinji, kahi yao *boribo*, *ngoe*, *dodo*, *batawi*, *chimaji*, *chisukari*, *epoli*, *zafarani*, *shikio punda* na *embe ra chidigo*.

where.en: Large mango trees stand around nearly every homestead and market on the south coast, often as the main shade for meeting and selling. The fruiting season ends around July, and in the weeks before that the trees are heavy with fruit.
where.sw: Miembe mikubwa husimama karibu kila boma na soko katika pwani ya kusini, mara nyingi ikiwa ndio kivuli kikuu cha kukutania na kuuzia. Msimu wa matunda huisha karibu Julai, na katika wiki zinazotangulia miti hulemewa na matunda.
where.dg: Miembe mikulu inaima kanda-kanda ya phephi chila mudzi na soko kpwa pwani ya kusini, na kpwa kawaida ndiyo pepho kulu ya kuonana na kuguza. Msimu wa matunda unamala phephi Julai, na kpwa wiki za kabla ya hipho mihi inakala mizito kpwa matunda.

uses.en:
Mangoes are eaten ripe, or green with chilli and salt, and are made into pickles. Fruit is also sold, both locally and further afield.

The trunk has been carved into dugout canoes, and the tree also gives timber and firewood. Goats eat the leaves.
uses.sw:
Maembe huliwa yakiwa yameiva, au mabichi pamoja na pilipili na chumvi, na hutengenezwa achari. Matunda pia huuzwa, ndani ya eneo na hata mbali.

Shina limechongwa kuwa mitumbwi, na mti pia hutoa mbao na kuni. Mbuzi hula majani yake.
uses.dg:
Maembe nkuriwa gachiivwa, au ga chijani na pilipili na munyu, na nkuhendwa achari. Matunda piya nkuguzwa, hipha na kure.

Kolo rikatsongbwa kuhenda mitumbwi, na muhi piya unalavya mbao na kuni. Mbuzi nkurya makodza.

culture.en: Digo has a rich vocabulary for mangoes. A very ripe mango is *chinabo* or *chidobezo*, and the juice of a ripe mango is *ujinji*. The mango is so familiar that a forest tree, *Inhambanella henriquesii*, is called *mwembe tsaka*, 'forest mango'.
culture.sw: Kidigo kina msamiati mpana wa maembe. Embe lililoiva sana ni *chinabo* au *chidobezo*, na maji ya embe lililoiva ni *ujinji*. Embe linajulikana sana kiasi kwamba mti mmoja wa msituni, *Inhambanella henriquesii*, unaitwa *mwembe tsaka*, 'mwembe wa msituni'.
culture.dg: Chidigo china maneno manji ga maembe. Embe ririroivwa sana ni *chinabo* au *chidobezo*, na madzi ga embe ririroivwa ni *ujinji*. Embe ni chitu cha kawaida sana hata muhi wa tsaka, *Inhambanella henriquesii*, unaihwa *mwembe tsaka*, 'mwembe wa tsaka'.

names.en: The tree is *mwembe* (Pakia writes *muembe*) and the fruit *embe*. Swahili uses the same words. In English it is mango.
names.sw: Mti ni *mwembe* (Pakia anaandika *muembe*) na tunda ni *embe*. Kiswahili hutumia maneno hayohayo. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *mango*.
names.dg: Muhi ni *mwembe* (Pakia anaandika *muembe*) na tunda ni *embe*. Chiswahili chinahumira maneno higa higa. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *mango*.

teaser.en: Eat a handful of these dark berries and your tongue turns purple for the rest of the afternoon.
teaser.sw: Ukila konzi moja ya matunda haya meusi, ulimi wako hubaki wa zambarau mchana wote.
teaser.dg: Uchirya matunda iga maru mkpwono mmwenga, lilimiro rindagaluka rangi ya zambarau hadi dziloni.

summary.en: *Mzambarau* is the Java plum or jambolan, an evergreen tree of homesteads and wet places with purple-black fruits. The fruit is eaten fresh, and stains the tongue a deep purple.
summary.sw: *Mzambarau* ni mzambarau, mti usiopukutisha majani unaoota kuzunguka makazi na sehemu zenye unyevu, wenye matunda ya rangi ya zambarau-nyeusi. Tunda huliwa likiwa bichi, na hutia ulimi rangi ya zambarau iliyokolea.
summary.dg: *Mzambarau* ni *Java plum* au *jambolan* kpwa Chingereza, muhi wenye makodza chila wakati umerao midzini na phatu phenye madzi, na una matunda ga zambarau-nyiru. Matundage nkuriwa dza garivyo, na ganahenda lilimi rikale zambarau sana.

about.en:
*Mzambarau* is an evergreen tree with smooth, glossy, leathery leaves that smell faintly of turpentine when crushed. The small, fluffy white flowers are mostly stamens, as in other members of the myrtle family.

The fruits are oval berries that ripen from green through pink to a glossy purple-black. They are juicy and astringent, with a single seed inside.
about.sw:
*Mzambarau* ni mti usiopukutisha majani, wenye majani laini, yanayong'aa na magumu kama ngozi, ambayo hutoa harufu hafifu ya tapentaini yanapopondwa. Maua yake madogo meupe yanayofanana na pamba kwa sehemu kubwa ni stameni, kama ilivyo kwa mimea mingine ya familia ya mihadasi.

Matunda ni beri zenye umbo la yai ambazo huiva kutoka kijani, kupitia waridi, hadi zambarau-nyeusi inayong'aa. Yana maji mengi na ladha ya kukwaruza kinywani, na mbegu moja ndani.
about.dg:
*Mzambarau* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ni laini, ganang'ala, na ni mafu dza chingo; gachifikitswa ganalavya arufu chidide ya tapentaini. Maruwage ni madide, mereru na laini dza pamba; manji ni stameni, dza irivyo kpwa mimea yanjina ya jamii ya *myrtle*.

Matundage ni madide na ganahalana na tumbi kpwa sura. Ganaivwa kula chijani, chisha pinki, hadi zambarau-nyiru inayong'ala. Gana madzi manji na ganakaraza mromoni, na chila tunda rina tembe mwenga ndani.

where.en: It grows around homesteads and in wet places, such as along streams and in low-lying ground.
where.sw: Huota kuzunguka makazi na katika sehemu zenye unyevu, kama vile kando ya vijito na kwenye maeneo ya chini.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya midzi na phatu phenye madzi, dza kanda-kanda ya miho midide na phatu pha photsi.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten fresh, and its dark juice stains the tongue purple.
uses.sw: Tunda huliwa likiwa bichi, na maji yake meusi hutia ulimi rangi ya zambarau.
uses.dg: Matundage nkuriwa dza garivyo, na madzige maru ganahenda lilimi rikale zambarau.

names.en: The Digo name is *mzambarau*, the same as in Swahili and Giriama; the Swahili word for the fruit is *zambarau*. In English it is Java plum or jambolan. The name *mzambarau* is also used for the native water berry, *Syzygium guineense*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mzambarau*, sawa na la Kiswahili na Kigiriama; neno la Kiswahili kwa tunda ni *zambarau*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *Java plum* au *jambolan*. Jina *mzambarau* pia hutumika kwa mzambarau wa asili wa maeneo yenye maji, *Syzygium guineense*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mzambarau*, sawa na kpwa Chiswahili na Chigiryama; kpwa Chiswahili tundare ni *zambarau*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *Java plum* au *jambolan*. Dzina *mzambarau* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa muhi wa chienyeji wa *water berry*, *Syzygium guineense*.

teaser.en: Each pineapple plant puts all its effort into a single fruit, perched on top of a rosette of spiny leaves.
teaser.sw: Kila mmea wa nanasi huweka nguvu zake zote katika tunda moja, lililokaa juu ya shada la majani yenye miiba.
teaser.dg: Chila mmea wa nanasi unaika nguvuze zosi kpwenye tunda mwenga, ambaro ri dzulu ya makodza genye miya ganayozunguluka phamwenga.

summary.en: *Nanasi* is the pineapple, grown on farms along the south coast for its sweet, juicy fruit. Digo growers distinguish a local variety from others.
summary.sw: *Nanasi* ni nanasi, linalolimwa mashambani katika pwani ya kusini kwa ajili ya tunda lake tamu lenye maji mengi. Wakulima wa Kidigo hutofautisha aina ya kienyeji na aina nyingine.
summary.dg: *Nanasi* (kpwa Chingereza *pineapple*) nkurimwa minda ya pwani ya kusini kpwa sababu ya tundare ra mtswano renye madzi manji. Akurima Adigo anatafwautisha aina ya chienyeji na aina zanjina.

about.en:
The pineapple is a low, spiny rosette of stiff, sword-shaped leaves, often edged with small sharp teeth. From the centre a single stalk rises carrying a cone of purple flowers, which fuse together into one fruit topped by a tuft of leaves.

Each plant bears one main fruit at a time. When ripe, the fruit is golden and fragrant.
about.sw:
Mnanasi ni shada fupi lenye miiba la majani magumu yenye umbo la upanga, ambayo mara nyingi huwa na meno madogo makali pembeni. Kutoka katikati huchipuka kikonyo kimoja kinachobeba koni ya maua ya zambarau, ambayo huungana kuwa tunda moja lenye kishungi cha majani juu yake.

Kila mmea huzaa tunda moja kuu kwa wakati mmoja. Likiiva, tunda huwa la rangi ya dhahabu na lenye harufu nzuri.
about.dg:
*Nanasi* ni mmea mfupi wenye miya, wa makodza mafu ganayozunguluka phamwenga. Makodza higa ni dza upanga, na manji gana meno madide makali kanda-kanda. Kula kahi-kahi mlita mmwenga unakpweza dzulu, na una maruwa ga zambarau ganayokala phamwenga dza koni. Maruwa higa ganagbwirana na kukala tunda mwenga, na dzulu ya tunda hiro kuna kundi ra makodza madide.

Chila mmea nkulavya tunda mwenga dzikulu kpwa wakati mmwenga. Richiivwa, tunda rinakala ra rangi ya zahabu, na rina mzingo.

where.en: Pineapples are grown on farms on the south coast.
where.sw: Mananasi hulimwa mashambani katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Manasi nkurimwa minda ya pwani ya kusini.

uses.sw: Tunda huliwa likiwa bichi na hukamuliwa sharubati.
uses.dg: Tunda nkuriwa dza ririvyo, na nkubanwa ili kulavya madzi ga kunwa.

names.en: The Digo name is *nanasi*, the same as in Swahili. Growers distinguish *nanasi ra baka* from *nanasi ra chidigo*, the Digo pineapple. In English it is pineapple. Mgombato records it under the older scientific name *Ananas sativus*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *nanasi*, sawa na la Kiswahili. Wakulima hutofautisha *nanasi ra baka* na *nanasi ra chidigo*, nanasi la Kidigo. Kwa Kiingereza linaitwa *pineapple*. Mgombato inaliorodhesha kwa jina la kisayansi la zamani *Ananas sativus*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *nanasi*, sawa na Chiswahili. Akurima anatafwautisha *nanasi ra baka* na *nanasi ra chidigo*, nanasi ra Chidigo. Kpwa Chingereza rinaihwa *pineapple*. Mgombato anariandika kpwa dzina ra kare ra sayansi, *Ananas sativus*.

teaser.en: Digo simply borrowed the name of this newcomer fruit: the avocado is *ovakado*.
teaser.sw: Kidigo kiliazima tu jina la tunda hili lililofika karibuni: parachichi ni *ovakado*.
teaser.dg: Tunda hiri ni mjeni pwani, na Chidigo chahala tu dzinare: *avocado* ni *ovakado*.

summary.en: *Ovakado* is the avocado, an evergreen tree with oily, buttery fruit grown at some homesteads on the coast. Its Digo name is a borrowing.
summary.sw: *Ovakado* ni mparachichi, mti usiopukutisha majani wenye matunda yenye mafuta na laini kama siagi, unaopandwa katika baadhi ya makazi pwani. Jina lake la Kidigo ni la kuazima.
summary.dg: *Ovakado* (kpwa Chingereza *avocado*) ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye matunda genye mafuha na laini dza siagi, unaomera midzi yanjina ya pwani. Dzinare ra Chidigo ni ra kuhala kula luga yanjina.

about.en: The avocado is an evergreen tree with large, leathery, oval leaves and clusters of small greenish-yellow flowers. The fruit is pear-shaped or round, with green or purplish-black skin around soft, oily, pale green flesh and a single large seed.
about.sw: Mparachichi ni mti usiopukutisha majani, wenye majani makubwa, magumu kama ngozi, yenye umbo la yai, na vishada vya maua madogo ya kijani-manjano. Tunda lina umbo la peari au la mviringo, likiwa na ganda la kijani au la zambarau-nyeusi linalozunguka nyama laini, yenye mafuta, ya kijani hafifu, na mbegu moja kubwa.
about.dg: *Ovakado* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye makodza makulu, mafu dza chingo, ganayohalana na tumbi kpwa sura, na maruwa madide ga rangi ya chijani na mandano ganayokala makundi-makundi. Tunda rina umbo dza ra pea (*pear*) au ra mviringo; gadare ni ra chijani au ra zambarau-nyiru, na ndani kuna nyama laini zenye mafuha, za chijani ngushu-ngushu, na tembe mwenga dzikulu.

where.en: Avocado trees grow at some homesteads on the south coast.
where.sw: Miparachichi huota katika baadhi ya makazi katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Mihi ya ovakado inamera midzi yanjina ya pwani ya kusini.

teaser.en: Under its spiny green skin, the soursop hides soft white pulp that tastes like pineapple and strawberry with a sour twist.
teaser.sw: Chini ya ganda lake la kijani lenye miiba, mstafeli huficha nyama laini nyeupe yenye ladha ya nanasi na stroberi pamoja na uchachu kidogo.
teaser.dg: Ndani ya gadare ra chijani renye miya, *soursop* unafwitsa nyama nyereru laini, yenye ladha dza nanasi na *strawberry* na ngbwadu chidide.

summary.en: Soursop is a small homestead tree with spiny green fruit and white, tangy pulp. It is grown for fruit and juice and used in medicine.
summary.sw: Mstafeli ni mti mdogo wa nyumbani wenye matunda ya kijani yenye miiba na nyama nyeupe yenye ladha chachu. Hupandwa kwa ajili ya matunda na sharubati na hutumika katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Soursop* ni muhi mdide wa mudzini wenye matunda ga chijani genye miya na nyama nyereru ya ngbwadu chidide. Unaphandwa kpwa matundage na kuhenda vinwadzi, na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en: Soursop is a small evergreen tree with glossy, dark green leaves. The fruit is large and heart- or oval-shaped, with a green skin covered in soft, curved spines. Inside, the white pulp is soft and fibrous, with a sweet-sour taste, and holds many shiny black seeds.
about.sw: Mstafeli ni mti mdogo wa kijani kibichi daima wenye majani yanayong'aa ya kijani iliyokolea. Tunda ni kubwa, la umbo la moyo au la yai, lenye ganda la kijani lililofunikwa kwa miiba laini iliyopinda. Ndani, nyama nyeupe ni laini yenye nyuzi, yenye ladha tamu-chachu, na ina mbegu nyingi nyeusi zinazong'aa.
about.dg: *Soursop* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, ganayong'ala na ga chijani sana. Tunda ni kulu, ra umbo ra moyo au ra tumbi, na gada ra chijani renye miya laini iriyofyuka. Ndani, nyama nyereru ni laini na ya nyuzi-nyuzi, ya mtswano na ngbwadu, na ina tembe nyinji nyiru zinazong'ala.

where.en: It is grown as a homestead tree.
where.sw: Hupandwa kama mti wa nyumbani.
where.dg: Unaphandwa dza muhi wa mudzini.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten and made into juice. The plant is also used in medicine.
uses.sw: Tunda huliwa na hutengenezwa sharubati. Mmea pia hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg: Tunda nkuriwa na nkuhendwa vinwadzi. Mmea piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili calls it *mstafeli*. In English it is soursop.
names.sw: Bado hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa. Kiswahili huuita *mstafeli*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *soursop*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mstafeli*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *soursop*.

teaser.en: Digo has two names for the watermelon, and one of them, *renje-madzi*, seems to carry the word for water inside it.
teaser.sw: Kidigo kina majina mawili ya tikiti, na moja wapo, *renje-madzi*, linaonekana kubeba ndani yake neno la maji.
teaser.dg: Chidigo china madzina mairi ga *tigiti*, na rimwenga kahi yao, *renje-madzi*, rinaonekana kukala na neno *madzi* ndani.

summary.en: *Tigiti* is the watermelon, a trailing vine grown on sandy coastal farms. Its big, juicy fruit is a welcome sight in the heat.
summary.sw: *Tigiti* ni tikiti, mmea unaotambaa ardhini unaolimwa katika mashamba ya mchanga ya pwani. Tunda lake kubwa lenye maji mengi hufurahisha sana wakati wa joto.
summary.dg: *Tigiti* (kpwa Chingereza *watermelon*) ni mmea unaoambala photsi, unaorimwa minda ya mtsanga ya pwani. Tundare dzikulu renye madzi manji ni dzambo ra kufurahisha wakati wa dzoho.

about.en: Watermelon is a trailing vine that sprawls across the ground on long, hairy stems, with deeply lobed leaves and small yellow flowers. The fruits are large and round to oval, with a hard green rind that is often striped or mottled. Inside, the flesh is sweet and watery, usually red, and dotted with flat seeds.
about.sw: Tikiti ni mmea unaotambaa na kutanda ardhini kwa mashina marefu yenye vinyweleo, wenye majani yaliyokatika kwa ndani na maua madogo ya manjano. Matunda ni makubwa, ya mviringo hadi umbo la yai, yenye ganda gumu la kijani ambalo mara nyingi lina mistari au madoadoa. Ndani, nyama ni tamu na yenye maji mengi, kwa kawaida nyekundu, na imetawanyika mbegu bapa.
about.dg: *Tigiti* ni mmea unaoambala na kuenea photsi kpwa milita mirefu yenye nyere. Makodzage gana mala marefu, na maruwage ni madide ga rangi ya mandano. Matundage ni makulu, ga mviringo au ganayohalana na tumbi kpwa sura, na gana gada ra chijani renye ufu, ambaro kpwa kawaida ni ra mistari-mistari au ra mabara-mabara. Nyama za ndani ni za mtswano na za madzi manji, kpwa kawaida ni za kundu, na zina tembe sambamba.

where.en: It is grown on sandy farms, where the vines can spread out over the open ground.
where.sw: Hulimwa katika mashamba ya mchanga, ambapo mashina yanaweza kutanda juu ya ardhi wazi.
where.dg: Nkurimwa minda ya mtsanga, ambapho mmea unaweza kuenea photsi phatu phenye nafwasi.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten fresh.
uses.sw: Tunda huliwa likiwa bichi.
uses.dg: Tunda nkuriwa dza ririvyo.

names.en: Digo has two names for the watermelon: *tigiti* and *renje-madzi*. Swahili calls it *tikiti*. In English it is watermelon.
names.sw: Kidigo kina majina mawili ya tikiti: *tigiti* na *renje-madzi*. Kwa Kiswahili linaitwa *tikiti*. Kwa Kiingereza linaitwa *watermelon*.
names.dg: Chidigo china madzina mairi ga tigiti: *tigiti* na *renje-madzi*. Chiswahili chinariiha *tikiti*. Kpwa Chingereza rinaihwa *watermelon*.

teaser.en: Slice a green okra pod and it turns silky in the pot, thickening coconut stews the way cooks on the coast like.
teaser.sw: Katakata ganda bichi la bamia na huwa laini kama hariri chunguni, likiufanya mchuzi wa nazi kuwa mzito kama wapendavyo wapishi wa pwani.
teaser.dg: Checha benda ra chijani, na nyunguni rinakala laini na ra luhe, rinahenda mtsuzi wa huwi ukale mzito dza vira ajiti a pwani anavyomendza.

summary.en: *Benda* is okra, an upright garden herb grown for its green ribbed pods. The pods are cooked in stews and with coconut.
summary.sw: *Benda* ni bamia, mmea mdogo uliosimama wa bustanini unaolimwa kwa ajili ya maganda yake ya kijani yenye mifereji. Maganda hupikwa katika michuzi na kwa nazi.
summary.dg: *Benda* (kpwa Chingereza *okra*) ni mmea uimao chocho wa busitani, unaorimwa kpwa sababu ya makakayage ga chijani genye mistari. Makakaya higa nkujitwa kpwenye mtsuzi na phamwenga na nazi.

about.en: *Benda* is an upright, leafy herb with large, lobed, slightly rough leaves. Its flowers are big and pale yellow with a dark red centre, like those of its relatives the hibiscus and cotton. Each flower gives way to a long, green, ribbed pod that tapers to a point. The pods are picked young and tender, and they release a slippery sap when cooked.
about.sw: *Benda* ni mmea mdogo uliosimama wenye majani mengi, majani yake ni makubwa, yaliyokatika kwa ndani na yanakwaruza kidogo. Maua yake ni makubwa, ya manjano hafifu yenye kiini chekundu kilichokolea, kama ya jamaa zake mbawaridi na pamba. Kila ua hufuatwa na ganda refu la kijani lenye mifereji linalochongoka kuelekea ncha. Maganda huchumwa yakiwa machanga na laini, na hutoa utomvu unaoteleza yanapopikwa.
about.dg: *Benda* ni mmea uimao chocho wenye makodza manji; makodzage ni makulu, gana mala, na ganakaraza chidide. Maruwage ni makulu, ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, na kahi-kahi ni ga kundu sana, dza maruwa ga nduguze, *hibiscus* na pamba. Bada ya chila ruwa kunatuluka kakaya dzire ra chijani, renye mistari na ntsa. Makakaya nkungobolwa wakati ni maitsi na laini, na gachijitwa ganalavya luhe.

where.en: Okra is grown in home gardens on the south coast.
where.sw: Bamia hulimwa katika bustani za nyumbani katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Benda nkurimwa busitani za kaya pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The pods are cooked in stews and with coconut.
uses.sw: Maganda hupikwa katika michuzi na kwa nazi.
uses.dg: Makakaya nkujitwa kpwenye mtsuzi na phamwenga na nazi.

names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *benda* (wingi *mabenda*). Kwa Kiswahili inaitwa *bamia* au *binda*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *okra* au *lady's fingers*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *benda* (unji: *mabenda*). Chiswahili chinariiha *bamia* au *binda*. Kpwa Chingereza rinaihwa *okra* au *lady's fingers*.

teaser.en: Digo gardeners call the big hybrid eggplant *bungulia ra chizungu*, setting it apart from the older local kinds.
teaser.sw: Wakulima wa Kidigo huita biringani kubwa ya mbegu chotara *bungulia ra chizungu*, ili kuitofautisha na aina za zamani za kienyeji.
teaser.dg: Adigo anaorima busitani nkuiha bungulia kulu ra *hybrid* *bungulia ra chizungu*, kuritafwautisha na aina za chienyeji za kare.

summary.en: *Bungulia* is the eggplant or brinjal, a garden vegetable cooked in curries. Digo growers keep several varieties, including a newer hybrid.
summary.sw: *Bungulia* ni biringani au bilingani, mboga ya bustanini inayopikwa kwenye mchuzi. Wakulima wa Kidigo hupanda aina kadhaa, ikiwemo aina mpya chotara.
summary.dg: *Bungulia* ni *eggplant* au *brinjal*, mboga ya busitani inayojitwa mtsuzini. Adigo anaorima bungulia nkuphanda aina tafwauti-tafwauti, phamwenga na aina nyiphya ya *hybrid*.

about.en: *Bungulia* is a bushy plant with large, soft, slightly fuzzy leaves and purple star-shaped flowers, typical of the nightshade family. The fruits are glossy and smooth, and depending on the variety may be long or round, deep purple, white or striped. The flesh is pale and spongy.
about.sw: *Bungulia* ni mmea wenye matawi mengi, majani makubwa, laini na yenye vinyweleo kidogo, na maua ya zambarau yenye umbo la nyota, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia ya mnavu. Matunda yake yanang'aa na ni laini; kutegemea aina, yanaweza kuwa marefu au ya mviringo, ya zambarau iliyokolea, meupe au yenye mistari. Nyama yake ni nyeupe-nyeupe na kama sifongo.
about.dg: *Bungulia* ni mmea unaoenea dza chitsaka, wenye makodza makulu na laini genye nyere chidide, na maruwa ga zambarau ga umbo ra nyota, dza mimea ya jamii ya *nightshade*. Matunda ganang'ala na ni laini, na kulingana na aina ganaweza kukala mare au ga mviringo, ga zambarau sana, mereru au ga mistari-mistari. Nyama ni ngushu-ngushu na ni dza sifongo.

where.en: It is grown in home gardens on the south coast.
where.sw: Hupandwa katika bustani za nyumbani pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Rinarimwa kpwenye busitani za midzini pwani ya kusini.

uses.dg: Matunda nkujitwa mtsuzini.

names.en: The Digo name is *bungulia* (plural *mabungulia*). Varieties include *bungulia ra chizungu*, a hybrid. Swahili calls it *biringani* or *bilingani*. In English it is eggplant, brinjal or aubergine.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *bungulia* (wingi *mabungulia*). Aina zake ni pamoja na *bungulia ra chizungu*, aina chotara. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *biringani* au *bilingani*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *eggplant*, *brinjal* au *aubergine*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *bungulia* (unji *mabungulia*). Kahi ya ainaze kuna *bungulia ra chizungu*, ambaro ni *hybrid*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *biringani* au *bilingani*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *eggplant*, *brinjal* au *aubergine*.

teaser.en: Nobody needs to plant this amaranth: it simply turns up in the farm, and ends up in the pot with coconut milk.
teaser.sw: Hakuna haja ya kupanda mchicha huu: huota wenyewe shambani, na mwishowe huishia chunguni na tui la nazi.
teaser.dg: Takuna mutu anayehitaji kuchiphanda *chiswenya*: chinazuka tu mundani, chisha chinaphiya nyunguni phamwenga na huwi.

summary.en: *Chiswenya* is a wild amaranth, a soft green herb that springs up in farms and gardens. Its leaves are a favourite everyday vegetable, cooked with coconut milk.
summary.sw: *Chiswenya* ni mchicha wa porini, mmea laini wa kijani unaoota wenyewe mashambani na bustanini. Majani yake ni mboga pendwa ya kila siku, hupikwa kwa tui la nazi.
summary.dg: *Chiswenya* ni aina ya mtsunga wa tsaka, mmea laini wa chijani unaomera bila kuphandwa mindani na busitanini. Makodzage ni mboga inayomendzwa sana ya chila siku, inayojitwa na huwi.

about.en: *Chiswenya* is a soft, leafy herb with oval to diamond-shaped leaves on long stalks and small green flowers packed into spikes. It grows quickly and can be picked within weeks of springing up.
about.sw: *Chiswenya* ni mmea laini wenye majani mengi, yenye umbo la yai hadi la almasi juu ya vikonyo virefu, na maua madogo ya kijani yaliyosongamana kwenye vishada virefu. Hukua haraka na unaweza kuchumwa wiki chache tu baada ya kuota.
about.dg: *Chiswenya* ni mmea laini wenye makodza manji. Makodzage ni ga mviringo au ga umbo ra almasi, ganakala dzulu ya milita mire, na maruwage madide ga chijani ganabanana kpwenye milita ya maruwa. Chinamera upesi, na makodza ganaweza kuhundwa bada ya majumwa machache tu chichimera.

where.en: It comes up by itself as a weed in farms and gardens, and is also planted. After the rains it is easy to find on almost any cultivated plot.
where.sw: Huota wenyewe kama gugu mashambani na bustanini, na pia hupandwa. Baada ya mvua ni rahisi kuupata karibu katika kila shamba lililolimwa.
where.dg: Chinamera bila kuphandwa dza mbondo mindani na busitanini, na piya nkuphandwa. Bada ya mvula ni rahisi kuchiphaha karibu chila munda uriorimwa.

uses.en: The leaves are sauteed or cooked with coconut milk, as in *mchicha wa nazi*.
uses.sw: Majani yake hukaangwa au hupikwa kwa tui la nazi, kama katika *mchicha wa nazi*.
uses.dg: Makodza nkukalangwa au nkujitwa na huwi, dza *mchicha wa nazi*.

names.en: In Digo it is *chiswenya*. Mgombato applies the name to two species, *Amaranthus dubius* and *A. graecizans*, while Pakia uses it for *A. graecizans*. Digo also has broader words for greens: *mtsunga* for vegetables, especially amaranths, and *makaya* for greens or spinach. Swahili calls it *mchicha*. In English it is amaranth or wild amaranth.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo huitwa *chiswenya*. Mgombato inalitumia jina hili kwa spishi mbili, *Amaranthus dubius* na *A. graecizans*, ilhali Pakia inalitumia kwa *A. graecizans*. Kidigo pia kina maneno mapana zaidi ya mboga za majani: *mtsunga* kwa mboga, hasa michicha, na *makaya* kwa mboga za majani au spinachi. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mchicha*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *amaranth* au *wild amaranth*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *chiswenya*. Mgombato anarihumira dzina hiri kpwa aina mbiri, *Amaranthus dubius* na *A. graecizans*, na Pakia anarihumira kpwa *A. graecizans*. Chidigo piya china maneno mapana ga mboga: *mtsunga* kpwa mboga, hasa aina za mchicha (*amaranths*), na *makaya* kpwa mboga za makodza au *spinach*. Kpwa Chiswahili chinaihwa *mchicha*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *amaranth* au *wild amaranth*.

teaser.en: Pumpkins on the coast often sprout from rubbish heaps, where a few thrown-out seeds turn into a sprawling vine.
teaser.sw: Pwani, maboga mara nyingi huota kwenye majaa, ambapo mbegu chache zilizotupwa hugeuka kuwa mtambaa unaoenea kila upande.
teaser.dg: Pwani, mara nyinji madzungu ganamera madzalani, phatu tembe chache zirizotsuphwa zinakala mmea mure unaoambala na kuenea.

summary.en: *Dzungu* is the pumpkin, a trailing vine with large fruits grown on farms and around homes. Both the fruit and the leaves are eaten.
summary.sw: *Dzungu* ni boga, mmea unaotambaa wenye matunda makubwa, unaopandwa mashambani na kuzunguka nyumba. Tunda na majani yake huliwa.
summary.dg: *Dzungu* ni mmea unaoambala photsi wenye matunda makulu, unaorimwa mindani na kanda-kanda ya midzi. Tunda na makodza, vyosi viiri nkuriwa.

about.en: The pumpkin is a vigorous trailing vine with large, rough, lobed leaves, coiling tendrils and big yellow trumpet-shaped flowers. The fruits are large and vary in shape and colour, with thick, orange flesh around a hollow full of flat seeds.
about.sw: Boga ni mtambaa wenye nguvu, wenye majani makubwa, makwaruzu na yenye pindo, mikonyo inayojisokota, na maua makubwa ya manjano yenye umbo la tarumbeta. Matunda yake ni makubwa na hutofautiana kwa umbo na rangi, yakiwa na nyama nene ya rangi ya chungwa inayozunguka uwazi uliojaa mbegu bapa.
about.dg: *Dzungu* ni mmea wenye nguvu unaoambala photsi, wenye makodza makulu ganayokaraza na ganayoganywa seemu-seemu, milita midide inayolinga-linga, na maruwa makulu ga rangi ya mandano ga umbo ra tarumbeta. Matunda ni makulu, ga maumbo na rangi za tafwauti, na nyama ndziho ya rangi ya chungbwa inazunguluka phatu phahuphu kahi-kahi phenye tembe nyinji za bapa.

where.en: Pumpkins grow on farms and on rubbish heaps, where the rich soil suits them.
where.sw: Maboga hukua mashambani na kwenye majaa, ambapo udongo wenye rutuba huyafaa.
where.dg: Madzungu ganamera mindani na madzalani, phatu ulongo unono unaphogafwaha.

uses.en: The fruit is cooked with coconut milk, and the leaves are eaten as a vegetable.
uses.sw: Tunda lake hupikwa kwa tui la nazi, na majani yake huliwa kama mboga.
uses.dg: Tunda nkujitwa na huwi, na makodza nkuriwa dza mboga.

names.en: Mgombato gives *dzungu* for the pumpkin, while Pakia records the plant as *mrenje*. Swahili calls it *boga*; Mgombato's own Swahili gloss is *tango pepeta*. In English it is pumpkin.
names.sw: Mgombato inatoa *dzungu* kwa boga, ilhali Pakia inaurekodi mmea huu kama *mrenje*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *boga*; tafsiri ya Kiswahili ya Mgombato yenyewe ni *tango pepeta*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *pumpkin*.
names.dg: Mgombato anapha dzina *dzungu* kpwa tunda hiri, na Pakia anauandika mmea dza *mrenje*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *boga*, ela Mgombato anaandika neno ra Chiswahili *tango pepeta*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *pumpkin*.

teaser.en: This creeping weed with pale bell-shaped flowers has three Digo names, and its leaves go into the cooking pot.
teaser.sw: Gugu hili linalotambaa, lenye maua mepesi ya umbo la kengele, lina majina matatu ya Kidigo, na majani yake huingia chunguni.
teaser.dg: Mbondo hino inayoambala, yenye maruwa ga ngushu-ngushu ga umbo ra kengele, ina madzina mahahu ga Chidigo, na makodzage ganaphiya nyunguni.

summary.en: *Futswe*, also called *futsure* or *tsalakushe*, is the Chinese violet, a spreading herb of shady farm edges. Its leaves are eaten as a vegetable.
summary.sw: *Futswe*, pia huitwa *futsure* au *tsalakushe*, ni kichwamangwo, mmea unaoenea katika pembezoni mwa mashamba zenye kivuli. Majani yake huliwa kama mboga.
summary.dg: *Futswe*, ambayo piya inaihwa *futsure* au *tsalakushe*, ni *Chinese violet*, mmea unaoenea wa kanda-kanda ya minda yenye chivuri. Makodzage nkuriwa dza mboga.

about.en: *Futswe* is a spreading, scrambling herb that roots along its stems and forms a loose mat. The leaves are oval and soft, in opposite pairs. The flowers are pale and bell-shaped, opening along one side of a short spike.
about.sw: *Futswe* ni mmea unaoenea na kutambaa, ambao hutoa mizizi kwenye mashina yake na kutengeneza zulia lililolegea. Majani yake ni ya umbo la yai na laini, yakiwa jozi zinazotazamana. Maua yake ni ya rangi nyepesi na ya umbo la kengele, yakichanua upande mmoja wa kishada kifupi.
about.dg: *Futswe* ni mmea unaoenea na kufyombera dzulu ya mimea yanjina, unaotuluza mizi kanda-kanda ya militaye na kuhenda chitanda chisichobana. Makodza ni ga mviringo na laini, ganamera mairi-mairi ganalengana. Maruwa ni ga ngushu-ngushu na ga umbo ra kengele, ganavugukira uphande mmwenga wa mlita mfupi.

where.en: It grows on shady farm edges and in the bush, where it can scramble over other low plants.
where.sw: Huota kwenye pembezoni mwa mashamba zenye kivuli na vichakani, ambapo unaweza kutambaa juu ya mimea mingine mifupi.
where.dg: Inamera kanda-kanda ya minda yenye chivuri na weruni, phatu inaphoweza kufyombera dzulu ya mimea yanjina mifupi.

uses.en: The leaves are eaten as a vegetable.

names.en: Digo has three names for this plant: *futswe*, *futsure* and *tsalakushe*. Pakia records *futswe*. Swahili calls it *kichwamangwo*. In English it is Chinese violet or creeping foxglove.
names.sw: Kidigo kina majina matatu ya mmea huu: *futswe*, *futsure* na *tsalakushe*. Pakia inarekodi *futswe*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *kichwamangwo*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *Chinese violet* au *creeping foxglove*.
names.dg: Chidigo china madzina mahahu ga mmea uhu: *futswe*, *futsure* na *tsalakushe*. Pakia anaandika *futswe*. Kpwa Chiswahili inaihwa *kichwamangwo*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *Chinese violet* au *creeping foxglove*.

teaser.en: When palm-wine tappers climb down a coconut palm, the gourd hanging at their side once grew on this vine.
teaser.sw: Wagemaji wa tembo wanaposhuka kutoka kwenye mnazi, kibuyu kinachoning'inia ubavuni mwao kiliwahi kuota kwenye mtambaa huu.
teaser.dg: Ajema achitserera kula dzulu ya mnazi, buru rinarogbwadzika kanda-kanda yao kala rinamera kpwenye mmea huno.

summary.en: *Mchiburu* is the bottle gourd or calabash, a climbing vine grown on farms. Its young fruits are cooked, and its dried shells become containers, including the gourd used to bring palm wine down from the tree.
summary.sw: *Mchiburu* ni mung'unye au kibuyu, mtambaa unaopanda unaolimwa mashambani. Matunda yake machanga hupikwa, na maganda yake yaliyokauka hugeuzwa kuwa vyombo, kikiwemo kibuyu kinachotumika kushusha tembo kutoka mtini.
summary.dg: *Mchiburu* (kpwa Chingereza *bottle gourd* au *calabash*) ni mmea unaofyombera, unaorimwa minda. Matundage maitsi nkujitwa, na mabebe makavu nkugaluka vyombo, phamwenga na buru ambaro ajema nkurihumira kuhala uchi kula dzulu ya muhi.

about.en: *Mchiburu* is a vigorous climbing or trailing vine with soft, hairy, rounded leaves and large white flowers that open in the evening. The fruits vary a great deal in shape, from round to bottle-shaped or long and curved. Young fruits are pale green and tender; left on the vine, they dry into a hard, light, woody shell.
about.sw: *Mchiburu* ni mtambaa unaokua kwa nguvu, unaopanda au kutambaa ardhini, wenye majani laini ya mviringo yenye vinyweleo na maua makubwa meupe yanayochanua jioni. Matunda yake hutofautiana sana kwa umbo, kuanzia ya mviringo hadi yenye umbo la chupa au marefu yaliyopinda. Matunda machanga ni ya kijani hafifu na laini; yakiachwa kwenye mtambaa, hukauka na kuwa ganda gumu, jepesi, kama mti.
about.dg: *Mchiburu* ni mmea wenye nguvu unaofyombera au unaoambala photsi. Una makodza laini, genye nyere na ga mviringo, na maruwa makulu mereru ganayovugula dziloni. Matundage gana maumbo tafwauti sana: ga mviringo, ga umbo dza ra tupa, au marefu na ganayomyoka. Matunda maitsi ni ga chijani ngushu-ngushu na ni laini; gachirichwa kpwenye mmea, ganauma na kukala mabebe genye ufu, maphepheya dza nyama za muhi.

where.en: It is grown on farms, where it is left to sprawl or climb over supports.
where.sw: Hulimwa mashambani, ambapo huachwa kutanda ardhini au kupanda juu ya viegemezo.
where.dg: Nkurimwa minda, ambapho nkurichwa uambale photsi au ukpwere dzulu ya mihi au vitu vyanjina vya kuugbwiriza.

uses.en:
Young fruits are cooked as a vegetable. Dried shells are hollowed out and used as containers.

One such container has its own Digo name: *para* is the gourd that palm-wine tappers use to bring palm wine down from the tree.
uses.sw:
Matunda machanga hupikwa kama mboga. Maganda yaliyokauka hutobolewa ndani na kutumika kama vyombo.

Chombo kimoja kama hicho kina jina lake maalum la Kidigo: *para* ni kibuyu ambacho wagemaji wa tembo hutumia kushusha tembo kutoka mtini.
uses.dg:
Matunda maitsi nkujitwa dza mboga. Mabebe makavu nkuuswa vya ndani na nkuhumirwa dza vyombo.

Chombo chimwenga cha aina hino china dzinare ra Chidigo: *para* ni buru ambaro ajema nkurihumira kuhala uchi kula dzulu ya muhi hadi photsi.

names.en: The Digo name is *mchiburu*. Swahili calls it *mung'unye* or *kibuyu*. In English it is bottle gourd or calabash.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mchiburu*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mung'unye* au *kibuyu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *bottle gourd* au *calabash*.

teaser.en: Swahili speakers everywhere know *mchicha*, but this tall amaranth goes by the same name in Digo gardens.
teaser.sw: Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kila mahali wanaujua *mchicha*, na mchicha huu mrefu huitwa kwa jina hilo hilo katika bustani za Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Atu anaogomba Chiswahili chila phatu anamanya *mchicha*, ela *mchicha* huno mrefu piya unaihwa vivyo busitani za Adigo.

summary.en: *Mchicha* is a tall amaranth grown in gardens and farms. Its leaves are cooked as greens, one of the most common vegetables of the coast.
summary.sw: *Mchicha* ni mchicha mrefu unaolimwa bustanini na mashambani. Majani yake hupikwa kama mboga ya majani, mojawapo ya mboga za kawaida zaidi pwani.
summary.dg: *Mchicha* (kpwa Chingereza *amaranth*) ni mmea mrefu unaorimwa busitani na minda. Makodzage nkujitwa dza mboga, na ni kahi ya mboga zinazoriwa sana pwani.

about.en: *Mchicha* is a tall, leafy herb with oval leaves on long stalks and dense spikes of tiny green or reddish flowers at the tips. It grows fast and can be harvested by picking leaves again and again.
about.sw: *Mchicha* ni mmea mrefu wenye majani mengi, wenye majani yenye umbo la yai juu ya vikonyo virefu na vishada vilivyoshonana vya maua madogo sana ya kijani au mekundu kiasi kwenye ncha. Hukua haraka na unaweza kuvunwa kwa kuchuma majani tena na tena.
about.dg: *Mchicha* ni mmea mrefu wenye makodza manji, ganayohalana na tumbi kpwa sura, kpwenye milita mirefu. Kpwenye ntsaze kuna punga zirizogbwirana za maruwa madide sana, ga chijani au ga kundu chidide. Unamera upesi, na unaweza kuvunwa kpwa kungobola makodza tsona na tsona.

where.en: It is grown in gardens and on farms across the south coast.
where.sw: Hulimwa bustanini na mashambani kote katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unarimwa busitani na minda pwani yosi ya kusini.

uses.sw: Majani hupikwa kama mboga ya majani.
uses.dg: Makodzage nkujitwa dza mboga.

names.en: The Digo name is *mchicha*, the same as in Swahili. In English it is amaranth or pigweed. Digo also uses *mtsunga* for vegetables, especially amaranths.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mchicha*, sawa na la Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *amaranth* au *pigweed*. Kidigo pia hutumia *mtsunga* kwa mboga za majani, hasa michicha.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mchicha*, sawa na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *amaranth* au *pigweed*. Chidigo piya china neno *mtsunga* kpwa mboga, hasa mchicha.

teaser.en: Cooks pick *mnavu* by the look and the taste of its leaves, which carry a gentle bitterness that coconut milk softens.
teaser.sw: Wapishi huchagua *mnavu* kwa kuangalia sura na ladha ya majani yake, ambayo yana uchungu kidogo unaolainishwa na tui la nazi.
teaser.dg: Ajiti nkutsambula *mnavu* kpwa kulola sura na ladha ya makodzage, ambago gana utsungu chidide unaophunguzwa ni huwi.

summary.en: *Mnavu* is African nightshade, a garden herb with small white flowers and black berries. Its slightly bitter leaves are boiled as a vegetable, often with coconut.
summary.sw: *Mnavu* ni mnavu, mmea mdogo wa bustanini wenye maua madogo meupe na matunda madogo meusi. Majani yake yenye uchungu kidogo huchemshwa kama mboga, mara nyingi kwa nazi.
summary.dg: *Mnavu* (kpwa Chingereza *African nightshade*) ni mmea wa busitani wenye maruwa madide mereru na matunda maru. Makodzage gana utsungu chidide na nkuokohwa dza mboga, mara nyinji na nazi.

about.en:
*Mnavu* is a soft, branching herb with oval, dark green leaves. Its small white flowers have a yellow centre, like tiny tomato flowers, and they are followed by clusters of small round berries that ripen black or purple-black.

Several closely related nightshades share the name, and people tell them apart by the look and the taste of the leaves.
about.sw:
*Mnavu* ni mmea laini wenye matawi mengi, wenye majani yenye umbo la yai ya kijani kilichokolea. Maua yake madogo meupe yana kiini cha manjano, kama maua madogo ya nyanya, na baada yake huja vishada vya matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva kuwa meusi au zambarau-nyeusi.

Mimea kadhaa ya jamii ya karibu sana hushiriki jina hili, na watu huitofautisha kwa sura na ladha ya majani.
about.dg:
*Mnavu* ni mmea laini wenye panda nyinji, na makodza ga chijani sana ganayohalana na tumbi kpwa sura. Maruwage madide mereru gana kahi-kahi ya rangi ya mandano, dza maruwa madide sana ga nyanya, na bada yao kunatuluka makundi ga matunda madide ga mviringo, ganayoivwa gakakala maru au zambarau-nyiru.

Mimea minji ya aina za phephi-phephi inaihwa kpwa dzina hiri, na atu nkuitafwautisha kpwa kulola sura na ladha ya makodza.

where.en: It comes up by itself in gardens, often where the soil is rich, and is left to grow for its leaves.
where.sw: Huota wenyewe bustanini, mara nyingi pale udongo una rutuba, na huachwa ukue kwa ajili ya majani yake.
where.dg: Unamera macheye busitani, mara nyinji phatu phenye mtsanga wa mbolea, na nkurichwa ukule kpwa sababu ya makodzage.

uses.en: The leaves are boiled as a vegetable. They are slightly bitter and are often cooked with coconut.
uses.sw: Majani huchemshwa kama mboga. Yana uchungu kidogo na mara nyingi hupikwa kwa nazi.
uses.dg: Makodzage nkuokohwa dza mboga. Gana utsungu chidide, na mara nyinji nkujitwa na nazi.

names.en: The Digo name is *mnavu*, the same as in Swahili, Duruma and Giriama. In English it is African nightshade or black nightshade. Scientifically it belongs to a group of closely related species around *Solanum nigrum* and *S. scabrum*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mnavu*, sawa na la Kiswahili, Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *African nightshade* au *black nightshade*. Kisayansi ni wa kundi la spishi za karibu sana zinazozunguka *Solanum nigrum* na *S. scabrum*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mnavu*, sawa na Chiswahili, Chiduruma na Chigiryama. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *African nightshade* au *black nightshade*. Kpwa sayansi ni wa kundi ra aina za phephi-phephi kanda-kanda ya *Solanum nigrum* na *S. scabrum*.

teaser.en: Crushed moringa seeds can clear muddy water, and the same tree gives leaves and long drumstick pods for the pot.
teaser.sw: Mbegu za mronge zilizopondwa zinaweza kusafisha maji ya matope, na mti huo huo hutoa majani na maganda marefu kama vijiti vya ngoma kwa ajili ya chungu.
teaser.dg: Tembe za *moringa* zichitwangbwa zinaweza kueza madzi ga matope, na muhi uho uho unapha makodza na makakaya mare dza fwimbo za kupigira ngoma, kpwa nyungu.

summary.en: Moringa, or the drumstick tree, is a fast-growing small tree planted around homesteads. Its leaves and pods are cooked as vegetables, its seed powder is used to clear water, and its seeds give oil.
summary.sw: Mronge, au mzunze, ni mti mdogo unaokua haraka, unaopandwa kuzunguka makazi. Majani na maganda yake hupikwa kama mboga, unga wa mbegu zake hutumika kusafisha maji, na mbegu zake hutoa mafuta.
summary.dg: *Moringa*, au *drumstick tree*, ni muhi mdide unaomera upesi, unaophandwa kanda-kanda ya midzi. Makodzage na makakayage nkujitwa dza mboga, unga wa tembeze nkuhumirwa kueza madzi, na tembeze zinalavya mafuha.

about.en: Moringa is a slender, fast-growing tree with pale, soft wood and drooping, feathery leaves divided into many small, rounded leaflets. Its creamy white flowers are fragrant. The pods are long, thin and ridged, hanging down like drumsticks, and hold winged seeds.
about.sw: Mronge ni mti mwembamba unaokua haraka, wenye mbao nyepesi za rangi hafifu na laini, na majani yanayoning'inia kama manyoya, yaliyogawanyika katika vijani vingi vidogo vya mviringo. Maua yake meupe kama krimu yana harufu nzuri. Maganda yake ni marefu, membamba na yenye mifereji, yakining'inia kama vijiti vya ngoma, na huwa na mbegu zenye mabawa.
about.dg: *Moringa* ni muhi mwembamba unaomera upesi, wenye nyama za muhi laini na ngushu-ngushu, na makodza ganayobwadzika dza nyoya, ganayoganywa kpwa makodza madide manji ga mviringo. Maruwage ga rangi ya maziya gana arufu nono. Makakaya ni mare, membamba na genye mistari, ganabwadzika dza fwimbo za kupigira ngoma, na ganakala na tembe zenye mapha.

where.en: It is planted around homesteads.
where.sw: Hupandwa kuzunguka makazi.
where.dg: Unaphandwa kanda-kanda ya midzi.

uses.en: The leaves and pods are cooked as vegetables. Powder from the seeds is used to purify water, and the seeds also give an oil.
uses.sw: Majani na maganda yake hupikwa kama mboga. Unga wa mbegu zake hutumika kusafisha maji, na mbegu hizo pia hutoa mafuta.
uses.dg: Makodza na makakaya nkujitwa dza mboga. Unga wa tembe nkuhumirwa kueza madzi, na tembe piya zinalavya mafuha.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili calls it *mronge* or *mzunze*. In Giriama, Chonyi and Kambe it is *muzungwi*. In English it is moringa or drumstick tree.
names.sw: Hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa bado. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mronge* au *mzunze*. Kwa Kigiriama, Kichonyi na Kikambe huitwa *muzungwi*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *moringa* au *drumstick tree*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mronge* au *mzunze*. Kpwa Chigiryama, Chichonyi na Chikambe ni *muzungwi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *moringa* au *drumstick tree*.

teaser.dg: Makodza higa ganakala ga luhe nyunguni, na ndiyo sababu ni mboga inayomendzwa sana, inayoriwa na sima.

summary.en: *Mrenda*, also *mwatsaka wa bara*, is jute mallow, an upright herb grown in farms and gardens in the rains. Its leaves cook down into a slimy relish eaten with ugali.
summary.sw: *Mrenda*, pia *mwatsaka wa bara*, ni mrenda, mmea mdogo uliosimama unaolimwa mashambani na bustanini wakati wa mvua. Majani yake hupikwa kuwa mboga inayoteleza inayoliwa kwa ugali.
summary.dg: *Mrenda*, piya *mwatsaka wa bara* (kpwa Chingereza *jute mallow*), ni mmea uimao chocho unaorimwa minda na busitani wakati wa mvula. Makodzage nkujitwa gakakala mboga ya luhe inayoriwa na sima.

about.en: *Mrenda* is an upright, branching herb with oval leaves that have finely toothed edges, often with two thin bristles at the base. Small yellow flowers sit where the leaves join the stem, and they are followed by long, narrow, ridged seed pods. When the leaves are cooked they turn slimy, which is the whole point.
about.sw: *Mrenda* ni mmea mdogo uliosimama wenye matawi, wenye majani yenye umbo la yai yenye meno madogo pembeni, mara nyingi yakiwa na vinyweleo viwili vyembamba kama singa kwenye kitako. Maua madogo ya manjano huota mahali majani yanapoungana na shina, na hufuatwa na maganda marefu, membamba, yenye mistari iliyoinuka. Majani yakipikwa huteleza, na hiyo ndiyo hasa sababu ya kuyapika.
about.dg: *Mrenda* ni mmea uimao chocho wenye panda nyinji, na makodza ganayohalana na tumbi kpwa sura, genye meno madide sana kanda-kanda, na mara nyinji gana nyere mbiri nyembamba photsi ya kodza. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano ganakala phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na mlita, na bada yao kunatuluka makakaya marefu, membamba, genye mistari. Makodza gachijitwa ganakala ga luhe, na hicho ndicho chinachohendzwa.

where.en: It is grown on farms and in gardens during the rains, when the young plants are picked for their leaves.
where.sw: Hulimwa mashambani na bustanini wakati wa mvua, ambapo mimea michanga huchumwa kwa ajili ya majani yake.
where.dg: Nkurimwa minda na busitani wakati wa mvula, wakati mitse nkungobolwa kpwa sababu ya makodzage.

uses.en: The leaves are cooked into a slimy vegetable relish eaten with ugali.

uses.dg: Makodza nkujitwa gakakala mboga ya luhe inayoriwa na sima.

names.en: Mgombato gives two Digo names for jute mallow: *mrenda* and *mwatsaka wa bara*. Pakia calls it *phombo* and uses *mrenda* for a different plant, a wild sesame that is also cooked as a slimy vegetable. Swahili calls jute mallow *mrenda* or *mlenda*, and Mgombato also gives *kala*. In English it is jute mallow, Jew's mallow or bush okra. Note that on its own, *mwatsaka* is the Digo word for the chilli pepper plant.
names.sw: Mgombato inatoa majina mawili ya Kidigo ya mrenda: *mrenda* na *mwatsaka wa bara*. Pakia anauita *phombo* na anatumia *mrenda* kwa mmea mwingine, ufuta pori ambao pia hupikwa kama mboga inayoteleza. Kwa Kiswahili mrenda huitwa *mrenda* au *mlenda*, na Mgombato pia inatoa *kala*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *jute mallow*, *Jew's mallow* au *bush okra*. Kumbuka kwamba likiwa peke yake, *mwatsaka* ni neno la Kidigo la mmea wa pilipili.
names.dg: Mgombato anapha madzina mairi ga Chidigo ga *jute mallow*: *mrenda* na *mwatsaka wa bara*. Pakia anauiha *phombo*, na anahumira *mrenda* kpwa mmea wanjina, ufuha wa weruni (*wild sesame*), ambao piya nkujitwa ukakala mboga ya luhe. Chiswahili chinauiha *mrenda* au *mlenda*, na Mgombato anapha piya *kala*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *jute mallow*, *Jew's mallow* au *bush okra*. Manya kukala *mwatsaka* macheye ni dzina ra Chidigo ra mmea wa pilipili (*chilli pepper*).

teaser.en: A wild cousin of sesame that grows on resting farmland, its leaves cook into a slippery green relish.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa porini wa ufuta anayeota kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike; majani yake hupikwa kuwa mboga ya kijani inayoteleza.
teaser.dg: *Mrenda* ni nduguye wa tsaka wa ufuha, unaomera kpwenye minda iriyorichwa ioye, na makodzage gachijitwa ganakala mboga ya chijani ya luhe.

summary.en: *Mrenda* here is a wild sesame, a herb of farm fallows whose mucilaginous leaves are cooked as a slimy vegetable. It shares its name, and its use in the pot, with jute mallow.
summary.sw: *Mrenda* hapa ni ufuta pori, mmea wa mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike, ambao majani yake yenye ute hupikwa kuwa mboga inayoteleza. Unashiriki jina lake, na matumizi yake chunguni, na mlenda (*jute mallow*).
summary.dg: *Mrenda* hipha ni ufuha wa tsaka, mmea wa minda iriyorichwa ioye, ambao makodzage genye luhe nkujitwa dza mboga ya luhe. Una dzina mwenga na *mrenda / mwatsaka wa bara* (*jute mallow*), na nao nkujitwa nyunguni vivyo hivyo.

about.en: This wild relative of sesame is an upright herb. Its leaves are rich in mucilage, which makes them slippery when cooked. Like cultivated sesame, it has tubular, foxglove-like flowers and narrow seed capsules.
about.sw: Jamaa huyu wa porini wa ufuta ni mmea uliosimama wima. Majani yake yana ute mwingi, unaoyafanya yateleze yakipikwa. Kama ufuta unaolimwa, una maua ya umbo la mrija yanayofanana na ya *foxglove*, na vibuyu vyembamba vya mbegu.
about.dg: Ndugu uhu wa tsaka wa ufuha ni mmea uimao chocho. Makodzage gana luhe nyinji, na ndiyo inayogahenda gakale ga luhe gachijitwa. Dza ufuha unaorimwa, una maruwa ga dza mridza, ganayohalana na ga *foxglove*, na makakaya membamba ga tembe.

where.en: It grows on farm fallows, the plots left to rest between crops.
where.sw: Huota kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa, yaani vipande vya ardhi vinavyoachwa vipumzike kati ya mazao.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye minda iriyorichwa ioye, minda inayorichwa bila kurimwa bada ya kuvuna, kabla ya kurimwa tsona.

uses.en: The leaves are cooked as a slimy vegetable.
uses.sw: Majani yake hupikwa kama mboga inayoteleza.
uses.dg: Makodza nkujitwa dza mboga ya luhe.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mrenda* for this wild sesame. Mgombato, however, gives *mrenda* for jute mallow (*Corchorus olitorius*), another slimy leaf vegetable, so the name may cover both. Swahili also uses *mrenda*. In English it is called wild sesame.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mrenda* kwa ufuta pori huu. Hata hivyo, Mgombato inatoa *mrenda* kwa mlenda (*Corchorus olitorius*), mboga nyingine ya majani inayoteleza, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili linawahusu wote wawili. Kiswahili pia hutumia *mrenda*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *wild sesame*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mrenda* kpwa ufuha uhu wa tsaka. Ela Mgombato anapha *mrenda* kpwa *jute mallow* (*Corchorus olitorius*), mboga yanjina ya makodza ya luhe, kpwa hivyo dzina rinaweza kukala ra mimea yosi miiri. Chiswahili nacho chinahumira *mrenda*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild sesame*.

teaser.en: Raw *mriga* tubers are poisonous, and a look-alike vine is never eaten at all, so knowing this yam is real knowledge.
teaser.sw: Viazi vibichi vya *mriga* vina sumu, na mtambaa unaofanana nao hauliwi kabisa, kwa hiyo kuujua mmea huu wa kiazi kikuu ni elimu ya kweli.
teaser.dg: Viazi vya *mriga* vichikala viitsi vina sumu, na mmea unaohalana nao taurika kabisa, kpwa hivyo kuumanya *mriga* ni marifwa ga kpweli.

summary.en: *Mriga* is the bitter or three-leaved yam, a twining climber of forest edges with large edible tubers. It is eaten only after careful preparation, and the Digo distinguish it from a look-alike that is not eaten.
summary.sw: *Mriga* ni kiazi kikuu chungu, chenye majani matatu, mtambaa unaojizungusha unaoota pembezoni mwa misitu na wenye viazi vikubwa vinavyoliwa. Huliwa tu baada ya kutayarishwa kwa uangalifu, na Wadigo huutofautisha na mmea unaofanana nao usioliwa.
summary.dg: *Mriga* ni *bitter yam* au *three-leaved yam*, mmea unaofyombera na kudzizunguluka wa kanda-kanda ya matsaka, wenye viazi vikulu vinavyoriwa. Nkuriwa bada ya kutengezwa kpwa makini tu, na Adigo anautafwautisha na mmea unaohalana nao ambao taurika.

about.en: *Mriga* is a twining climber that winds up shrubs and small trees. Its leaves are made of three leaflets, which, together with the twining stem, is the easiest way to recognise it. Below ground it forms large tubers.
about.sw: *Mriga* ni mtambaa unaojizungusha juu ya vichaka na miti midogo. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu, na hilo, pamoja na shina linalojizungusha, ndiyo njia rahisi zaidi ya kuutambua. Chini ya ardhi hutengeneza viazi vikubwa.
about.dg: *Mriga* ni mmea unaofyombera na kudzizunguluka, unaodzizunguluka vitsaka na mihi midide. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu, na hino, phamwenga na mlitawe unaodzizunguluka, ndiyo njira rahisi zaidi ya kuumanya. Tsini ya ulongo unahenda viazi vikulu.

where.en: It grows on forest edges and in the bush, often semi-wild.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu na vichakani, mara nyingi ukiwa nusu-pori.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na weruni, na mara nyinji ni nusu wa tsaka.

uses.en:
The tubers are eaten after careful processing; raw tubers are toxic.

A related look-alike, *mriga yere*, is not eaten.
uses.sw:
Viazi vyake huliwa baada ya kutayarishwa kwa uangalifu; viazi vibichi vina sumu.

Jamaa wake anayefanana naye, *mriga yere*, hauliwi.
uses.dg:
Viazi nkuriwa bada ya kutengezwa kpwa makini; vichikala viitsi vina sumu.

Mmea unaohalana nao, *mriga yere*, taurika.

culture.en: The Digo distinguish true *mriga* from *mriga yere*, 'false *mriga*', a look-alike that is not eaten.
culture.sw: Wadigo hutofautisha *mriga* halisi na *mriga yere*, yaani '*mriga* bandia', mmea unaofanana nao usioliwa.
culture.dg: Adigo anatafwautisha *mriga* wa kpweli na *mriga yere*, '*mriga* wa handzo', mmea unaohalana nao ambao taurika.

names.en: The Digo name *mriga* is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. The general Swahili word for yam is *kiazi kikuu*. In English it is bitter yam or three-leaved yam.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo *mriga* linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Neno la jumla la Kiswahili kwa viazi vya aina hii ni *kiazi kikuu*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *bitter yam* au *three-leaved yam*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *mriga* rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Neno ra Chiswahili ra viazi vikulu vyosi ni *kiazi kikuu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *bitter yam* au *three-leaved yam*.
