teaser.en: Its Digo name means simply 'bitter vegetable', and that bitterness is part of why it ends up both in the pot and in medicine.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana tu ya 'mboga chungu', na uchungu huo ni sehemu ya sababu ya kuishia chunguni na pia kwenye dawa.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rina mana ya 'mboga ya utsungu' tu, na utsungu uho ni seemu ya sababu unaphiya nyunguni na piya kpwenye dawa.

summary.en: *Mtsunga wa utsungu* is wild lettuce, a milky-sapped herb of farmland and grassland. Its bitter leaves are cooked as greens and used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mtsunga wa utsungu* ni mchunga, mmea wenye utomvu mweupe kama maziwa unaoota mashambani na mbugani. Majani yake machungu hupikwa kama mboga na hutumika kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Mtsunga wa utsungu* ni *wild lettuce*, mmea wenye maziya wa mindani na vuwe. Makodzage ga utsungu nkujitwa dza mboga na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en: *Mtsunga wa utsungu* is a herb with long, deeply lobed leaves. Break a leaf and a milky sap runs out. The small yellow flower heads look like dandelions, to which it is related.
about.sw: *Mtsunga wa utsungu* ni mmea wenye majani marefu yenye pindo za kina. Ukivunja jani, utomvu mweupe kama maziwa hutoka. Vichwa vyake vidogo vya maua ya manjano vinafanana na vya *dandelion*, ambaye ni jamaa yake.
about.dg: *Mtsunga wa utsungu* ni mmea wenye makodza mare ganayoganywa seemu-seemu sana. Uchivundza kodza, maziya ganatuluka. Maruwage madide ga rangi ya mandano ganahalana na ga *dandelion*, ambayo ni nduguye.

where.en: It grows on farmland, fallows and grassland, and is common as a farm weed.
where.sw: Huota mashambani, kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike na mbugani, na ni gugu la kawaida shambani.
where.dg: Unamera mindani, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa ioye na vuwe, na ni mbondo ya kawaida mindani.

uses.en: The bitter leaves are cooked as greens. The leaves are also used medicinally: the Digo of Diani boil them as a remedy for malaria.
uses.sw: Majani yake machungu hupikwa kama mboga. Majani hayo pia hutumika kama dawa: Wadigo wa Diani huyachemsha kutibu malaria.
uses.dg: Makodzage ga utsungu nkujitwa dza mboga. Makodza piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa: Adigo a Diani nkugachemusha kuhenda dawa ya homa (*malaria*).

names.en: The Digo name *mtsunga wa utsungu* means 'bitter vegetable': *mtsunga* is the Digo word for vegetables, especially amaranths. The name is shared with Duruma and Giriama. Swahili calls it *mchunga*. In English it is wild lettuce or bitter lettuce.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo *mtsunga wa utsungu* lina maana ya 'mboga chungu': *mtsunga* ni neno la Kidigo kwa mboga, hasa michicha. Jina hili linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mchunga*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *wild lettuce* au *bitter lettuce*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *mtsunga wa utsungu* rina mana ya 'mboga ya utsungu': *mtsunga* ni neno ra Chidigo ra mboga, hasa aina za mchicha. Dzina hiri rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma na Chigiryama. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mchunga*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild lettuce* au *bitter lettuce*.

teaser.en: Long before the big market tomato, Digo gardens had their own small 'bush tomato', called *tindi*.
teaser.sw: Muda mrefu kabla ya nyanya kubwa za sokoni, bustani za Kidigo zilikuwa na 'nyanya ya porini' yao ndogo, iitwayo *tindi*.
teaser.dg: Kare sana, kabla ya nyanya kulu za sokoni, busitani za Adigo kala zina nyanya yao ndide ya chienyeji, inayoihwa *tindi*.

summary.en: *Nyanya* is the tomato, grown in gardens and used in kachumbari salad and stews. Digo also has its own words for a traditional, smaller tomato.
summary.sw: *Nyanya* ni nyanya, inayolimwa bustanini na kutumika katika kachumbari na michuzi. Kidigo pia kina maneno yake kwa nyanya ndogo ya jadi.
summary.dg: *Nyanya* (kpwa Chingereza *tomato*) nkurimwa busitani na nkuhumirwa kpwenye *kachumbari* na mtsuzi. Chidigo piya china manenoge kpwa nyanya ya chienyeji, iriyo ndide zaidi.

about.en: The tomato is a sprawling, hairy herb with strong-smelling, divided leaves and small yellow star-shaped flowers. The fruit is juicy and usually red when ripe. Traditional tomatoes are smaller than the large market kinds.
about.sw: Mnyanya ni mmea mdogo unaotanda na wenye vinyweleo, wenye majani yaliyogawanyika yenye harufu kali na maua madogo ya manjano yenye umbo la nyota. Tunda lina maji mengi na kwa kawaida huwa jekundu likiiva. Nyanya za jadi ni ndogo kuliko aina kubwa za sokoni.
about.dg: *Nyanya* ni mmea unaoenea photsi, wenye nyere, na makodza garigoganywa ganayolavya arufu kali, na maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano dza nyota. Nyanya ina madzi manji, na kpwa kawaida ni ya kundu ichiivwa. Nyanya za chienyeji ni ndide kuriko aina kulu za sokoni.

where.en: Tomatoes are grown in home gardens on the south coast.
where.sw: Nyanya hulimwa katika bustani za nyumbani katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Nyanya nkurimwa busitani za kaya pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: Tomatoes go into *kachumbari*, the fresh onion and tomato salad served with many coastal meals, and into stews.
uses.sw: Nyanya hutiwa katika *kachumbari*, saladi mbichi ya vitunguu na nyanya inayoliwa pamoja na milo mingi ya pwani, na katika michuzi.
uses.dg: Nyanya nkutiywa *kachumbari*, chakurya cha chitunguu na nyanya zisizojitwa chinachoriwa na vyakurya vinji vya pwani, na nkutiywa mtsuzi.

names.en: The Digo word is *nyanya*, the same as in Swahili, and Pakia records *mtamata*. The traditional tomato plant is *mtindi*, and its fruit, the bush tomato, is *tindi*. In English it is tomato.
names.sw: Neno la Kidigo ni *nyanya*, sawa na la Kiswahili, na Pakia anaandika *mtamata*. Mmea wa nyanya ya jadi ni *mtindi*, na tunda lake, nyanya ya porini, ni *tindi*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *tomato*.
names.dg: Neno ra Chidigo ni *nyanya*, sawa na Chiswahili, na Pakia anaandika *mtamata*. Mmea wa nyanya ya chienyeji ni *mtindi*, na tundare, nyanya ya chienyeji (*bush tomato*), ni *tindi*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *tomato*.

reason.dg: Chitunguu, chinachotiywa phamwenga na nyanya kpwenye *kachumbari*.

teaser.en: The garden *tungudza* has a wild cousin, *mtungudza koma*, that is used in medicine instead of the cooking pot.
teaser.sw: *Tungudza* wa bustanini ana jamaa wa porini, *mtungudza koma*, ambaye hutumika kama dawa badala ya kuingia chunguni.
teaser.dg: *Tungudza* ra busitanini rina nduguye wa tsaka, *mtungudza koma*, unaohumirwa kpwa dawa badala ya kuphiya nyunguni.

summary.en: *Tungudza* is the African eggplant or garden egg, a bushy plant with small round fruits. Both the fruit and the leaves are cooked.
summary.sw: *Tungudza* ni ngogwe, mmea wenye matawi mengi na matunda madogo ya mviringo. Tunda na majani yake hupikwa.
summary.dg: *Tungudza* ni *African eggplant* au *garden egg*, mmea wenye panda nyinji na matunda madide ga mviringo. Matunda na makodza gosi nkujitwa.

about.en: *Tungudza* is a bushy plant with broad leaves and small star-shaped flowers, white or pale purple. The fruits are small and round, like little eggs, and may be green, white, yellow or orange-red.
about.sw: *Tungudza* ni mmea wenye matawi mengi, majani mapana na maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota, meupe au ya zambarau hafifu. Matunda yake ni madogo na ya mviringo, kama mayai madogo, na yanaweza kuwa ya kijani, meupe, ya manjano au mekundu ya chungwa.
about.dg: *Tungudza* ni mmea wenye panda nyinji, makodza mapana na maruwa madide ga umbo ra nyota, mereru au ga zambarau ngushu-ngushu. Matunda ni madide na ga mviringo, dza matumbi madide, na ganaweza kukala ga chijani, mereru, ga rangi ya mandano au ga rangi ya chungbwa na kundu.

where.en: It is grown in home gardens on the south coast.
where.sw: Hupandwa katika bustani za nyumbani pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Nkurimwa busitani za midzini pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: Both the fruit and the leaves are cooked.
uses.sw: Tunda na majani yake hupikwa.
uses.dg: Matunda na makodza gosi nkujitwa.

names.en: The fruit is *tungudza* and the plant *mtungudza*. The wild *Solanum incanum* is called *mtungudza koma*, the wild *tungudza*, and is used in medicine. Swahili calls the garden kind *ngogwe* or *tungudza*. In English it is African eggplant or garden egg. The name covers two species, *Solanum macrocarpon* and *S. aethiopicum*.
names.sw: Tunda huitwa *tungudza* na mmea *mtungudza*. Mmea wa porini *Solanum incanum* huitwa *mtungudza koma*, yaani *tungudza* wa porini, na hutumika kama dawa. Kwa Kiswahili aina ya bustanini huitwa *ngogwe* au *tungudza*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *African eggplant* au *garden egg*. Jina hili linahusu spishi mbili, *Solanum macrocarpon* na *S. aethiopicum*.
names.dg: Tunda ni *tungudza* na mmea ni *mtungudza*. *Solanum incanum*, ambao ni wa tsaka, unaihwa *mtungudza koma*, *tungudza* ra tsaka, na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa. Kpwa Chiswahili aina ya busitanini inaihwa *ngogwe* au *tungudza*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *African eggplant* au *garden egg*. Dzina hiri ni ra aina mbiri, *Solanum macrocarpon* na *S. aethiopicum*.

teaser.en: The warm scent of a coast kitchen at breakfast, when *mahamri* are frying, comes largely from cardamom.
teaser.sw: Harufu tamu na ya joto ya jikoni pwani wakati wa kifungua kinywa, mahamri yanapokaangwa, kwa kiasi kikubwa hutokana na iliki.
teaser.dg: Arufu nono ya dzoho ya dzikoni pwani wakati wa chai ya ligundzu, *mahamri* gachikalangwa, inalavywa zaidi ni *cardamom*.

summary.en: Cardamom is an imported spice whose aromatic seed pods flavour many of the coast's best-loved foods. It goes into *mahamri*, *kashata*, *mkate wa kumimina* and spiced tea.
summary.sw: Iliki ni kiungo kinachoagizwa kutoka nje, ambacho maganda yake ya mbegu yenye harufu nzuri hukoleza vyakula vingi vinavyopendwa sana pwani. Hutiwa katika *mahamri*, *kashata*, *mkate wa kumimina* na chai ya viungo.
summary.dg: *Cardamom* ni chitu chinachorehwa kula tsi za kondze, chinachotiywa vyakurya, na makakayage ga tembe genye arufu nono ganapha ladha vyakurya vinji vinavyomendzwa sana pwani. Nkutiywa *mahamri*, *kashata*, *mkate wa kumimina* na chai yenye viungo.

about.en: Cardamom comes from a tall, leafy plant of the ginger family. What reaches the kitchen are the small, pale green, three-sided pods, each holding a cluster of tiny dark, sticky seeds with a strong, sweet, slightly resinous scent.
about.sw: Iliki hutoka kwa mmea mrefu wenye majani mengi wa familia ya tangawizi. Kinachofika jikoni ni maganda madogo ya kijani hafifu yenye pande tatu, kila moja likiwa na kifungu cha mbegu ndogo nyeusi zinazonata, zenye harufu kali, tamu na ya utomvu kidogo.
about.dg: *Cardamom* inalavywa ni mmea mure wenye makodza manji wa jamii ya tangawizi. Chinachofika dzikoni ni makakaya madide ga chijani ngushu-ngushu genye pembe tahu, na chila kakaya rina tembe nyinji ndide nyiru, zinazonyata, zenye arufu kali, ya mtswano na chidide dza ya ulimbo.

where.en: Cardamom is not grown on the south coast; it is imported and bought in markets and shops.
where.sw: Iliki haipandwi pwani ya kusini; huagizwa kutoka nje na kununuliwa sokoni na madukani.
where.dg: *Cardamom* tairimwa pwani ya kusini; nkurehwa kula tsi za kondze na nkugulwa cheteni na madukani.

uses.en: It flavours *mahamri*, the fried breakfast dough; *kashata*, the sweet of coconut, sugar and cardamom; and *mkate wa kumimina*, the poured rice-flour bread. It is also added to tea.
uses.sw: Hukoleza *mahamri*, maandazi ya kukaanga ya kifungua kinywa; *kashata*, peremende ya nazi, sukari na iliki; na *mkate wa kumimina*, mkate wa unga wa mchele unaomiminwa. Pia hutiwa kwenye chai.
uses.dg: Inapha ladha *mahamri*, unga wa kukalangwa wa chai ya ligundzu; *kashata*, chitu cha mtswano cha nazi, sukari na *cardamom*; na *mkate wa kumimina*, mkahe wa unga wa mtele unaomwagwa. Piya nkutiywa chai.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili calls it *iliki*. In English it is cardamom.
names.sw: Hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa bado. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *iliki*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *cardamom*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *iliki*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *cardamom*.

digo_source: Mgombato ('chikatsu turmeric'; 'mandano turmeric'; 'rangi ya mandano' = yellow)

teaser.en: In Digo, the word for turmeric, *mandano*, is also the word for the colour yellow.
teaser.sw: Kwa Kidigo, neno la manjano (kiungo), *mandano*, ndilo pia neno la rangi ya manjano.
teaser.dg: Kpwa Chidigo, *mandano* ni chikatsu, na piya ni neno ra rangi: *rangi ya mandano*, ambayo kpwa Chingereza ni *yellow*.

summary.en: *Chikatsu* or *mandano* is turmeric, a root spice that gives coastal dishes their golden colour. It is cooked with pigeon peas, potatoes and fish in coconut sauce, and used in cosmetics and medicine.
summary.sw: *Chikatsu* au *mandano* ni manjano, kiungo cha kiazi kinachoipa milo ya pwani rangi yake ya dhahabu. Hupikwa pamoja na mbaazi, viazi na samaki katika mchuzi wa nazi, na hutumika katika vipodozi na dawa.
summary.dg: *Chikatsu* au *mandano* (kpwa Chingereza *turmeric*) ni muzi unaotiywa vyakurya, unaopha vyakurya vya pwani rangi ya zahabu. Chinajitwa na mbalazi, viazi na ng'onda wa mtsuzi wa nazi, na chinahumirwa kpwa vitu vya kudzipamba na kpwa dawa.

about.en: Turmeric is a leafy plant of the ginger family with large, broad leaves. The part used is the rhizome, an underground stem that is knobbly and brown outside and a bright orange-yellow inside. It stains fingers, cloth and food alike.
about.sw: Manjano ni mmea wenye majani mengi wa familia ya tangawizi, wenye majani makubwa mapana. Sehemu inayotumika ni kiazi chake, shina la chini ya ardhi lenye vifundo, la kahawia kwa nje na la rangi ya machungwa-manjano inayong'aa kwa ndani. Huacha madoa kwenye vidole, nguo na chakula vilevile.
about.dg: *Chikatsu* ni mmea wenye makodza manji wa jamii ya tangawizi, wenye makodza makulu mapana. Seemu inayohumirwa ni *rhizome*, muhi urio tsini ya ulongo; kondze una maugu na ni wa rangi ya dongo, na ndani ni wa rangi ya chungbwa na mandano inayong'ala. Chikatsu chinaika rangiye kpwenye vyala, nguwo na vyakurya.

where.en: Most turmeric used on the south coast is bought rather than grown.
where.sw: Sehemu kubwa ya manjano yanayotumika katika pwani ya kusini hununuliwa badala ya kupandwa.
where.dg: Chikatsu chinachohumirwa pwani ya kusini, chinji nkugulwa, si kurimwa.

uses.en: Turmeric goes into pigeon peas, potatoes and fish cooked in coconut sauce, giving them their colour. It is also used in cosmetics and in medicine.
uses.sw: Manjano hutiwa katika mbaazi, viazi na samaki wanaopikwa kwa mchuzi wa nazi, na kuwapa rangi yao. Pia hutumika katika vipodozi na kama dawa.
uses.dg: Chikatsu nkutiywa mbalazi, viazi na ng'onda anaojitwa kpwa mtsuzi wa nazi, na ndicho chinachovipha rangi. Piya nkuhumirwa kpwa vitu vya kudzipamba na kpwa dawa.

culture.en: Turmeric gave its name to a colour: *rangi ya mandano*, 'the colour of turmeric', means yellow. The word *mandano* also names yellow fever.
culture.sw: Manjano yalitoa jina lake kwa rangi: *rangi ya mandano*, 'rangi ya manjano (kiungo)', maana yake ni rangi ya manjano. Neno *mandano* pia hutaja homa ya manjano.
culture.dg: Dzina ra chikatsu rakala dzina ra rangi: *rangi ya mandano*, 'rangi ya chikatsu', ni rangi ya *yellow*. Neno *mandano* piya ni dzina ra homa ya *yellow fever*.

names.en: Digo has two words for turmeric: *chikatsu* and *mandano*. Swahili calls it *manjano*, which also means yellow. In English it is turmeric.
names.sw: Kidigo kina maneno mawili ya manjano (kiungo): *chikatsu* na *mandano*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *manjano*, ambalo pia lina maana ya rangi ya manjano. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *turmeric*.
names.dg: Chidigo china maneno mairi ga mmea huno: *chikatsu* na *mandano*. Chiswahili chinachiiha *manjano*, neno ambaro piya ni ra rangi ya *yellow*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *turmeric*.

reason.en: Same family; ginger
reason.sw: Wa familia moja; tangawizi
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga; tangawizi.

reason.en: Same family; another coastal spice
reason.sw: Wa familia moja; iliki, kiungo kingine cha pwani
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga; iliki, chitu chanjina cha kujitira cha pwani.

reason.en: Pigeon peas, cooked with turmeric
reason.sw: Mbaazi, zinazopikwa kwa manjano
reason.dg: Mbalazi, zinazojitwa na chikatsu.

reason.en: Another plant used to colour and for cosmetics
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaotumika kutia rangi na katika vipodozi
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaohumirwa kutiya rangi na kpwa vitu vya kudzipamba.

teaser.en: Its Digo name comes from *ruhani*, a spirit, and healers use this clove-scented basil against illnesses blamed on it.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linatokana na *ruhani*, pepo, na waganga hutumia mrihani huu wenye harufu ya karafuu dhidi ya magonjwa yanayohusishwa na pepo huyo.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rinalavywa kula *ruhani*, pepho, na aganga nkuhumira *chirahani* hichi, chenye arufu ya karafuu, kuphoza makongo ganayoaminika kurehwa ni pepho iyo.

summary.en: *Chirahani* is African basil, an aromatic woody herb with clove-scented leaves found in bush, farm edges and homesteads. It is used for scent, flavouring and medicine, including treatment of ailments attributed to spirits.
summary.sw: *Chirahani* ni mrihani, mmea wenye harufu nzuri na shina gumu, wenye majani yanayonukia karafuu, unaopatikana vichakani, pembezoni mwa mashamba na kuzunguka makazi. Hutumika kwa harufu yake, kukoleza chakula na kama dawa, ikiwemo kutibu maradhi yanayohusishwa na pepo.
summary.dg: *Chirahani* ni *African basil*, mmea mgumu dza muhi wenye arufu nono, wenye makodza ga arufu ya karafuu, unaophahikana weruni, kanda-kanda ya minda na midzini. Nkuhumirwa kpwa arufu, kupha vyakurya ladha na kpwa dawa, hata kuphoza makongo ganayoaminika kurehwa ni pepho.

about.en: *Chirahani* is a woody herb or small shrub with square stems typical of the mint family. The leaves are soft, toothed and strongly aromatic, smelling of cloves when crushed. Small pale flowers grow in upright spikes at the tips of the branches.
about.sw: *Chirahani* ni mmea wenye shina gumu au kichaka kidogo, chenye mashina ya pembe nne kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia ya minanaa. Majani yake ni laini, yenye meno pembezoni na harufu kali, yakinukia karafuu yakipondwa. Maua madogo ya rangi hafifu huota kwenye vishada vilivyosimama wima kwenye ncha za matawi.
about.dg: *Chirahani* ni mmea mgumu dza muhi au chitsaka chidide, chenye milita ya pembe nne dza ya mimea ya jamii ya *mint*. Makodza ni laini, genye meno kanda-kanda, na gana arufu kali; gachifikitswa ganakala na arufu ya karafuu. Maruwa madide ngushu-ngushu ganamera kpwenye milita iriyoima chocho kpwenye ntsa za panda.

where.en: It grows in the bush and on farm edges, and is often kept around homesteads where its leaves are close at hand.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na pembezoni mwa mashamba, na mara nyingi hupandwa kuzunguka makazi ili majani yake yawe karibu.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni na kanda-kanda ya minda, na mara nyinji nkurichwa midzini, phatu makodzage ganaphahikana phephi.

uses.en: The leaves are used for their scent and as a flavouring. In medicine, the Digo of Diani boil the leaves as a remedy for malaria, and healers use it to treat ailments attributed to the spirit *ruhani*.
uses.sw: Majani yake hutumika kwa harufu yake na kukoleza chakula. Katika tiba, Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha majani kutibu malaria, na waganga huutumia kutibu maradhi yanayohusishwa na pepo *ruhani*.
uses.dg: Makodza nkuhumirwa kpwa arufu na kupha vyakurya ladha. Kpwa dawa, Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha makodza kuhenda dawa ya homa (*malaria*), na aganga nkuchihumira kuphoza makongo ganayoaminika kurehwa ni pepho *ruhani*.

culture.en: The name *chirahani* comes from *ruhani*, a spirit, and reflects the plant's place in healing illnesses blamed on spirits. Its other Digo name, *vumbamanga*, links its spiritual uses to Vumba in Tanzania.
culture.sw: Jina *chirahani* linatokana na *ruhani*, pepo, na linaonyesha nafasi ya mmea huu katika kuponya magonjwa yanayohusishwa na pepo. Jina lake jingine la Kidigo, *vumbamanga*, linahusisha matumizi yake ya kiroho na Vumba nchini Tanzania.
culture.dg: Dzina *chirahani* rinalavywa kula *ruhani*, pepho, na rinaonyesa nafwasi ya mmea uhu kpwenye kuphoza makongo ganayoaminika kurehwa ni pepho. Dzinare ranjina ra Chidigo, *vumbamanga*, rinahusisha kazize za chiroho na Vumba, Tanzania.

names.en: Digo has two names: *chirahani* and *vumbamanga*. Swahili calls it *mrihani* or *kivumbani*. In English it is African basil or clove basil.
names.sw: Kidigo kina majina mawili: *chirahani* na *vumbamanga*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mrihani* au *kivumbani*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *African basil* au *clove basil*.
names.dg: Chidigo china madzina mairi: *chirahani* na *vumbamanga*. Kpwa Chiswahili chinaihwa *mrihani* au *kivumbani*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *African basil* au *clove basil*.

reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaochemuswa kpwa dawa ya homa iko Diani

teaser.en: Almost every Digo pot starts the same way: with *chitunguu madzi* sizzling at the bottom.
teaser.sw: Karibu kila chungu cha Kidigo huanza kwa njia ileile: *chitunguu madzi* kikichacharika chini yake.
teaser.dg: Karibu chila nyungu ya Adigo inaandza vivyo hivyo: *chitunguu madzi* chichikalangwa photsi.

summary.en: *Chitunguu madzi* is the onion, the base for most cooking on the coast. It is mostly bought, though some people grow it in small gardens.
summary.sw: *Chitunguu madzi* ni kitunguu, msingi wa mapishi mengi pwani. Mara nyingi hununuliwa, ingawa watu wengine hukipanda katika bustani ndogo.
summary.dg: *Chitunguu madzi* (kpwa Chingereza *onion*) ndicho msingi wa kujita vyakurya vinji pwani. Vitunguu madzi vinji nkugulwa, ela atu anjina nkuvirima kpwenye busitani ndide.

about.en: The onion is a bulb with hollow, tubular leaves. The bulb is made of tightly layered, fleshy leaf bases wrapped in papery skin, which may be red, brown or white. Cut it and the sharp, eye-watering smell is unmistakable.
about.sw: Kitunguu ni tunguu lenye majani yenye uwazi ndani, kama mirija. Tunguu hilo limeundwa kwa matabaka yaliyobanana ya vitako vya majani vyenye nyama, yaliyofunikwa na ganda jembamba kama karatasi, ambalo linaweza kuwa jekundu, la kahawia au jeupe. Ukikikata, harufu yake kali inayotoa machozi haikosei.
about.dg: *Chitunguu madzi* ni *bulb* yenye makodza ganayokala mahuphu ndani dza mridza. *Bulb* inahendwa ni seemu za photsi za makodza, nene na zenye madzi, zirizobanana tabaka kpwa tabaka, na zinafwinikpwa ni gada dzembamba dza karatasi, ririroweza kukala ra kundu, ra rangi ya dongo au rereru. Uchichikata, arufuye kali inayolavya matsozi ni rahisi sana kuimanya.

where.en: Onions are mostly bought in markets, though some are grown in small home gardens.
where.sw: Vitunguu mara nyingi hununuliwa sokoni, ingawa vingine hupandwa katika bustani ndogo za nyumbani.
where.dg: Vitunguu madzi vinji nkugulwa cheteni, ela vinjina nkurimwa kpwenye busitani ndide za midzini.

uses.en: The onion is the base for most cooking. It is also the main ingredient, with tomato, of *kachumbari*, the fresh salad served with many coastal meals.
uses.sw: Kitunguu ndicho msingi wa mapishi mengi. Pia ni kiambato kikuu, pamoja na nyanya, cha *kachumbari*, saladi mbichi inayoliwa na milo mingi ya pwani.
uses.dg: *Chitunguu madzi* ndicho msingi wa kujita vyakurya vinji. Piya ni chitu chikulu, phamwenga na nyanya, cha *kachumbari*, saladi ya vitu dza virivyo inayoandazwa na vyakurya vinji vya pwani.

names.en: The Digo name is *chitunguu madzi*. Swahili calls it *kitunguu*. In English it is onion. Garlic is *chitunguu saumu*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *chitunguu madzi*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *kitunguu*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *onion*. Kitunguu saumu ni *chitunguu saumu*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *chitunguu madzi*. Kpwa Chiswahili chinaihwa *kitunguu*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *onion*. *Garlic* kpwa Chidigo ni *chitunguu saumu*.

summary.en: *Chitunguu saumu* is garlic, a bulb spice bought in markets. It is used in cooking and in medicine.
summary.sw: *Chitunguu saumu* ni kitunguu saumu, kiungo cha tunguu kinachonunuliwa sokoni. Hutumika katika mapishi na kama dawa.

about.en: Garlic is a bulb made up of several cloves, each wrapped in a thin papery skin, sitting under a clump of flat leaves. Its pungent smell comes out strongly when the cloves are crushed.
about.sw: Kitunguu saumu ni tunguu lililoundwa kwa punje kadhaa, kila moja ikiwa imefunikwa na ganda jembamba kama karatasi, chini ya kichaka cha majani bapa. Harufu yake kali hutoka kwa nguvu punje zinapopondwa.
about.dg: *Chitunguu saumu* ni *bulb* yenye vipande vinji, na chila chipande chinafwinikpwa ni gada dzembamba dza karatasi; *bulb* inakala photsi ya fungu ra makodza ga bapa. Arufuye kali inatuluka sana vipande vichitigbwa.

where.en: Garlic is bought in markets rather than grown locally.
where.sw: Kitunguu saumu hununuliwa sokoni badala ya kupandwa hapa.
where.dg: *Chitunguu saumu* nkugulwa cheteni, si kurimwa phapha.

uses.en: Garlic is used in cooking and in medicine.
uses.sw: Kitunguu saumu hutumika katika mapishi na kama dawa.
uses.dg: *Chitunguu saumu* nkuhumirwa kujitira vyakurya na kpwa dawa.

teaser.en: In Diani, the most common Digo way to keep mosquitoes off is to burn the leaves of this fragrant bush.
teaser.sw: Huko Diani, njia ya kawaida zaidi kwa Wadigo kufukuza mbu ni kuchoma majani ya kichaka hiki chenye harufu nzuri.
teaser.dg: Iko Diani, njira ya Adigo ya kawaida zaidi ya kuzuwiya imbu ni kufukiza makodza ga chitsaka hichi chenye arufu nono.

summary.en: *Chivumbani* is tree basil, an aromatic shrubby herb of bushland and fallow. Its leaves are burned to drive away mosquitoes and used in medicine and spiritual healing.
summary.sw: *Chivumbani* ni kivumbani, mmea wenye harufu nzuri kama kichaka unaoota vichakani na kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike. Majani yake huchomwa kufukuza mbu, na hutumika kama dawa na katika uponyaji wa kiroho.
summary.dg: *Chivumbani* ni *tree basil*, mmea wenye arufu nono dza chitsaka, wa weruni na minda iriyorichwa ioye. Makodzage nkufukizwa kuzuwiya imbu, na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa na kuphoza kpwa njira za chiroho.

about.en: *Chivumbani* is an aromatic, shrubby herb with soft, hairy leaves and the square stems of the mint family. Crushed leaves give off a strong, pleasant smell. Small pale flowers grow in spikes at the tips of the stems.
about.sw: *Chivumbani* ni mmea wenye harufu nzuri kama kichaka, wenye majani laini yenye vinyweleo na mashina ya pembe nne ya familia ya minanaa. Majani yaliyopondwa hutoa harufu kali na nzuri. Maua madogo ya rangi hafifu huota kwenye vishada kwenye ncha za mashina.
about.dg: *Chivumbani* ni mmea wenye arufu nono dza chitsaka, wenye makodza laini genye nyere, na milita ya pembe nne dza ya jamii ya *mint*. Makodza gachifikitswa ganalavya arufu kali na nono. Maruwa madide ngushu-ngushu ganamera kpwenye milita kpwenye ntsa za milita.

where.en: It grows in bushland and on fallow land.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa yapumzike.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni na kpwenye minda iriyorichwa ioye.

uses.en:
The leaves are burned to repel mosquitoes. Among the Digo of Diani this is the most common way of keeping them off, reported by more than half of the people asked in one survey.

The leaves are also boiled as a remedy for malaria, inhaled for colds, and used in spiritual healing.
uses.sw:
Majani yake huchomwa kufukuza mbu. Miongoni mwa Wadigo wa Diani hii ndiyo njia ya kawaida zaidi ya kuwaepusha, kama walivyoripoti zaidi ya nusu ya watu waliohojiwa katika utafiti mmoja.

Majani hayo pia huchemshwa kutibu malaria, mvuke wake huvutwa kwa mafua, na hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.
uses.dg:
Makodza nkufukizwa kuzuwiya imbu. Kahi ya Adigo a Diani, hino ndiyo njira ya kawaida zaidi ya kuazuwiya, na zaidi ya nusu ya atu ariouzwa kpwenye utafiti mmwenga akagomba vivyo.

Makodza piya nkuchemuswa kuhenda dawa ya homa (*malaria*), arufu yago nkuvutwa kpwa pumuzi wakati wa mafuwa, na nkuhumirwa kuphoza kpwa njira za chiroho.

names.en: The Digo name is *chivumbani*. Swahili calls it *kivumbani*. In English it is tree basil.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *chivumbani*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *kivumbani*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *tree basil*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *chivumbani*. Kpwa Chiswahili chinaihwa *kivumbani*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *tree basil*.

teaser.en: The sweet warmth in a coastal pilau or biriani often comes from curls of bark peeled from a tree that grows far away.
teaser.sw: Ladha tamu ya joto katika pilau au biriani ya pwani mara nyingi hutoka kwenye maganda yaliyojikunja ya gome la mti unaoota mbali sana.
teaser.dg: Dzoho-dzoho ya mtswano kpwenye *pilau* au *biriani* ya pwani mara nyinji inalavywa ni vipande vya gopha vinavyodzikundza, vinavyouswa kula muhi unaomera kure.

summary.en: Cinnamon is an imported spice made from dried tree bark. On the coast it flavours pilau, biriani and tea.
summary.sw: Mdalasini ni kiungo kinachoagizwa kutoka nje, kinachotokana na gome la mti lililokaushwa. Pwani hukoleza pilau, biriani na chai.
summary.dg: *Cinnamon* ni chitu cha kupha vyakurya ladha chinachorehwa kula tsi za kondze, chinachohendwa kula gopha ra muhi ririroanikpwa. Pwani nkutiywa *pilau*, *biriani* na chai.

about.en: Cinnamon is the dried inner bark of a tropical evergreen tree in the laurel family. Peeled and dried, the thin bark curls into brown quills or sticks with a sweet, warm scent.
about.sw: Mdalasini ni gome la ndani lililokaushwa la mti wa kitropiki usiopukutika wa familia ya *laurel*. Likishabanduliwa na kukaushwa, gome hilo jembamba hujikunja kuwa vijiti vya kahawia vyenye harufu tamu ya joto.
about.dg: *Cinnamon* ni gopha ra ndani ririroanikpwa ra muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa tsi za dzoho, wa jamii ya *laurel*. Richiuswa na kuanikpwa, gopha dzembamba rinadzikundza na kukala dza fwimbo ndide za rangi ya dongo, zenye arufu ya mtswano na ya dzoho.

where.en: Cinnamon is imported and bought in markets and shops.
where.sw: Mdalasini huagizwa kutoka nje na kununuliwa sokoni na madukani.
where.dg: *Cinnamon* nkurehwa kula tsi za kondze na nkugulwa cheteni na madukani.

uses.en: It flavours pilau, biriani and tea.
uses.sw: Hukoleza pilau, biriani na chai.
uses.dg: Nkutiywa *pilau*, *biriani* na chai.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili calls it *mdalasini*. In English it is cinnamon.
names.sw: Hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa bado. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mdalasini*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *cinnamon*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mdalasini*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *cinnamon*.

reason.dg: *Karafuu*, chitu chanjina chinachorehwa kula kondze kpwa *pilau* na chai

reason.en: Another imported spice for tea
reason.sw: Kiungo kingine kinachoagizwa kutoka nje kwa chai
reason.dg: *Cardamom*, chitu chanjina chinachorehwa kula kondze kpwa chai

reason.sw: Familia moja, Lauraceae; parachichi
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga, Lauraceae; *ovakado*

teaser.en: Each clove is a flower bud picked before it could open, dried and shipped from the islands of Zanzibar and Pemba.
teaser.sw: Kila karafuu ni kichipukizi cha ua kilichochumwa kabla hakijachanua, kikakaushwa na kusafirishwa kutoka visiwa vya Zanzibar na Pemba.
teaser.dg: Chila karafuu ni chimea cha ruwa chirichohundwa kabla ya kuvuguka, chikaanikpwa na kurehwa kpwa meli kula visiwa vya Zanzibar na Pemba.

summary.en: *Karafuu* is the clove, the dried flower bud of a tropical tree, imported from Zanzibar and Pemba. It spices pilau, tea and coffee.
summary.sw: *Karafuu* ni karafuu, kichipukizi cha ua kilichokaushwa cha mti wa kitropiki, kinachoagizwa kutoka Zanzibar na Pemba. Hukoleza pilau, chai na kahawa.
summary.dg: *Karafuu* ni chimea cha ruwa chirichoanikpwa cha muhi wa tsi za dzoho, chinachorehwa kula Zanzibar na Pemba. Nkutiywa *pilau*, chai na kahawa.

about.en: Cloves are the dried, unopened flower buds of an evergreen tree in the myrtle family. Each looks like a small brown nail, with a round head and a slender stem, and has a strong, warm, pungent scent.
about.sw: Karafuu ni vichipukizi vya maua vilivyokaushwa kabla ya kuchanua, vya mti usiopukutika wa familia ya mihadasi. Kila kimoja kinafanana na msumari mdogo wa kahawia, chenye kichwa cha mviringo na shina jembamba, na kina harufu kali ya joto na inayochoma.
about.dg: *Karafuu* ni vimea vya maruwa virivyoanikpwa, visivyovuguka, vya muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa jamii ya *myrtle*. Chila karafuu inahalana na msumari mdide wa rangi ya dongo, wenye chitswa cha mviringo na mlita mwembamba, na ina arufu kali na ya dzoho.

where.en: Cloves are not grown on the south coast; they are imported from Zanzibar and Pemba and sold in markets.
where.sw: Karafuu haipandwi pwani ya kusini; huagizwa kutoka Zanzibar na Pemba na kuuzwa sokoni.
where.dg: *Karafuu* tazirimwa pwani ya kusini; nkurehwa kula Zanzibar na Pemba na nkuguzwa cheteni.

uses.en: Cloves spice pilau, tea and coffee.
uses.sw: Karafuu hukoleza pilau, chai na kahawa.
uses.dg: *Karafuu* nkutiywa *pilau*, chai na kahawa.

names.en: The Digo name is *karafuu*, the same as in Swahili. In English it is clove.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *karafuu*, sawa na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *clove*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *karafuu*, dza ra Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza ni *clove*.

reason.sw: Jenasi moja; mzambarau (*Java plum*)
reason.dg: Jenasi mwenga; *mzambarau* (*Java plum*)

reason.en: Same genus; the water berry
reason.sw: Jenasi moja; mzambarau wa majini (*water berry*)
reason.dg: Jenasi mwenga; *mzambarau* (*water berry*)

reason.sw: Kiungo kingine kinachoagizwa kutoka nje kwa pilau
reason.dg: *Cinnamon*, chitu chanjina chinachorehwa kula kondze kpwa *pilau*

reason.sw: Kahawa, ambayo karafuu husaidia kuikoleza
reason.dg: *M'buni*, muhi wa kahawa, ambayo karafuu nkuipha ladha

teaser.en: Digo gardeners name at least six kinds of chilli, from the tiny, fiery *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* to *mwatsaka wa masala*.
teaser.sw: Wakulima wa bustani wa Kidigo hutaja angalau aina sita za pilipili, kuanzia *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe*, ndogo na kali mno, hadi *mwatsaka wa masala*.
teaser.dg: Akurima a busitani a Chidigo anamanya aina sita za mwatsaka au zaidi, kula *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* mdide na mkali sana, hadi *mwatsaka wa masala*.

summary.en: *Mwatsaka* is the chilli pepper, a small shrub grown in almost every homestead garden. Its hot fruits go into sauces and pickles, onto green mango, and into the sauce of *samaki wa kupaka*.
summary.sw: *Mwatsaka* ni pilipili, kichaka kidogo kinachopandwa karibu katika kila bustani ya nyumbani. Matunda yake makali hutiwa katika michuzi na achari, juu ya embe bichi, na katika mchuzi wa *samaki wa kupaka*.
summary.dg: *Mwatsaka* (kpwa Chingereza *chilli pepper*) ni chitsaka chidide chinachorimwa karibu busitani zosi za midzini. Matundage makali nkutiywa mtsuzi na achari, nkuriwa na maembe maitsi, na nkutiywa mtsuzi wa *samaki wa kupaka*.

about.en:
*Mwatsaka* is a small, bushy shrub with glossy leaves and small white star-shaped flowers. The fruits hang or point upwards and ripen from green to red, orange or yellow.

Digo growers distinguish several varieties, including *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* (tiny and very hot), *ng'ondzi*, *mbuzi*, *manga*, *wa masala* and *wa vipuli*.
about.sw:
*Mwatsaka* ni kichaka kidogo chenye matawi mengi, majani yanayong'aa na maua madogo meupe yenye umbo la nyota. Matunda huning'inia au huelekea juu, na huiva kutoka kijani kuwa mekundu, ya machungwa au ya manjano.

Wakulima wa Kidigo hutofautisha aina kadhaa, zikiwemo *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* (ndogo sana na kali mno), *ng'ondzi*, *mbuzi*, *manga*, *wa masala* na *wa vipuli*.
about.dg:
*Mwatsaka* ni chitsaka chidide chenye panda nyinji, makodza ganayong'ala na maruwa madide mereru dza nyota. Matundage ganagbwadzika au ganalola dzulu, na ganaivwa kula chijani hadi kundu, rangi ya chungbwa au rangi ya mandano.

Akurima Adigo anatafwautisha aina nyinji, kahi yao *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* (mdide na mkali sana), *ng'ondzi*, *mbuzi*, *manga*, *wa masala* na *wa vipuli*.

where.en: Chilli grows in almost every homestead garden on the south coast, usually a plant or two close to the kitchen.
where.sw: Pilipili huota karibu katika kila bustani ya nyumbani katika pwani ya kusini, kwa kawaida mche mmoja au miwili karibu na jiko.
where.dg: Mwatsaka unamera karibu busitani zosi za midzini pwani ya kusini, kpwa kawaida mmea mmwenga au miiri phephi na dziko.

uses.en: Chillies are used fresh and dried in sauces and pickles, and eaten with green mango and salt. They are also part of the sauce painted onto grilled fish in *samaki wa kupaka*, the signature fish dish of the coast.
uses.sw: Pilipili hutumika zikiwa mbichi au zilizokaushwa katika michuzi na achari, na huliwa pamoja na embe bichi na chumvi. Pia ni sehemu ya mchuzi unaopakwa juu ya samaki wa kuchoma katika *samaki wa kupaka*, mlo maarufu wa samaki wa pwani.
uses.dg: Matunda ga mwatsaka nkuhumirwa dza garivyo na makavu kpwenye mtsuzi na achari, na nkuriwa na maembe maitsi na munyu. Piya ni seemu ya mtsuzi unaopakpwa ng'onda wa kuochwa kpwenye *samaki wa kupaka*, chakurya cha ng'onda chinachomanyikana zaidi pwani.

culture.en: The name *mwatsaka* is also given to a red variety of maize.
culture.sw: Jina *mwatsaka* pia hupewa aina moja nyekundu ya mahindi.
culture.dg: Dzina *mwatsaka* piya nkuihwa aina ya pemba ya kundu.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwatsaka*. Swahili calls it *pilipili* or *pilipili hoho*. In English it is chilli pepper. Do not confuse it with *mwatsaka wa bara*, a Digo name for jute mallow.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwatsaka*. Kwa Kiswahili inaitwa *pilipili* au *pilipili hoho*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *chilli pepper*. Usiichanganye na *mwatsaka wa bara*, jina la Kidigo la mrenda.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mwatsaka*. Chiswahili chinauiha *pilipili* au *pilipili hoho*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *chilli pepper*. Usiutsanganye na *mwatsaka wa bara*, dzina ra Chidigo ra mrenda (*jute mallow*).

reason.en: Green mango is eaten with chilli and salt
reason.sw: Embe bichi huliwa kwa pilipili na chumvi
reason.dg: Maembe maitsi nkuriwa na mwatsaka na munyu.

reason.en: Jute mallow, which shares part of its name
reason.sw: Mrenda, unaoshiriki sehemu ya jina lake
reason.dg: Mrenda, ambao dzinare ranjina rina neno *mwatsaka*.

reason.en: Same family; the tomato
reason.sw: Wa familia moja; nyanya
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga; nyanya.

reason.en: Maize, one red variety of which is also called mwatsaka
reason.sw: Mahindi, ambayo aina moja nyekundu pia huitwa mwatsaka
reason.dg: Pemba; aina mwenga ya kundu piya inaihwa *mwatsaka*.

reason.en: Turmeric, another spice for samaki wa kupaka
reason.sw: Manjano, kiungo kingine cha samaki wa kupaka
reason.dg: Chikatsu, chitu chanjina chinachotiywa mtsuzi wa *samaki wa kupaka*.

teaser.en: Brush past a clump of *mzumaa* by the house and the air fills with the clean scent of lemons.
teaser.sw: Ukipita karibu na kichaka cha *mzumaa* kando ya nyumba, hewa hujaa harufu safi ya malimau.
teaser.dg: Uchitsupa phephi na fungu ra *mzumaa* kanda-kanda ya nyumba, hewa inaodzala arufu safi ya malimau.

summary.en: *Mzumaa* is lemongrass, an aromatic tufted grass kept in clumps around homesteads. Its leaves make a fragrant tea and are used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mzumaa* ni mchaichai, nyasi yenye harufu nzuri inayoota kwa vichaka, inayopandwa kuzunguka makazi. Majani yake hutengeneza chai yenye harufu nzuri na hutumika kama dawa.
summary.dg: *Mzumaa* ni *lemongrass*, nyasi yenye arufu nono inayomera dza mafungu kanda-kanda ya midzi. Makodzage nkuhendwa chai yenye arufu nono na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en: *Mzumaa* grows as a dense clump of long, narrow, blue-green leaves that arch over at the tips, with thick, pale stalks at the base. Crush or cut a leaf and it gives off a strong lemon scent. It rarely flowers in gardens.
about.sw: *Mzumaa* huota kama kichaka kizito cha majani marefu, membamba, ya kijani-buluu yanayopinda kwenye ncha zake, yenye mashina manene ya rangi hafifu chini. Ukiponda au kukata jani, hutoa harufu kali ya limau. Bustanini ni nadra kutoa maua.
about.dg: *Mzumaa* unamera dza fungu ribanabana ra makodza mare na membamba, ga chijani na samawati, ganayoinama kpwenye ntsa zago, na milita miziho ngushu-ngushu photsi. Uchifikitsa au kukata kodza, rinalavya arufu kali ya malimau. Mara chache unalavya maruwa busitanini.

where.en: It is grown in clumps around homesteads, usually close to the kitchen.
where.sw: Hupandwa kwa vichaka kuzunguka makazi, kwa kawaida karibu na jiko.
where.dg: Unaphandwa dza mafungu kanda-kanda ya midzi, mara nyinji phephi na phatu pha kujitira vyakurya.

uses.en: The leaves are made into tea and used in medicine.
uses.sw: Majani yake hutengenezwa chai na hutumika kama dawa.
uses.dg: Makodza nkuhendwa chai na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

names.en: The Digo name is *mzumaa*. Swahili calls it *mchaichai*. In English it is lemongrass.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mzumaa*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mchaichai*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *lemongrass*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mzumaa*. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mchaichai*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lemongrass*.

teaser.en: Coffee with ginger after an operation: on the coast this spicy root is trusted to help people back on their feet.
teaser.sw: Kahawa yenye tangawizi baada ya upasuaji: pwani, mzizi huu wenye ukali huaminiwa kumsaidia mtu kurudia hali yake.
teaser.dg: Kahawa na tangawizi bada ya kupasuliwa: pwani, muzi huno mkali nkuluphirwa kuterya atu apone.

summary.en: *Tangawizi* is ginger, a spicy root used in tea, coffee, cooking and medicine. Some is grown in gardens, but most is bought.
summary.sw: *Tangawizi* ni tangawizi, mzizi wenye ukali unaotumika katika chai, kahawa, mapishi na dawa. Kiasi fulani hupandwa bustanini, lakini sehemu kubwa hununuliwa.
summary.dg: *Tangawizi* (kpwa Chingereza *ginger*) ni muzi mkali unaohumirwa kpwenye chai, kahawa, vyakurya na dawa. Tangawizi yanjina nkurimwa busitani, ela nyinji nkugulwa.

about.en: Ginger is a leafy plant with tall, reed-like stems carrying narrow, pointed leaves in two rows. The part used is the rhizome, an underground stem that is knobbly and pale brown outside, with a fibrous, pale yellow, hot and fragrant flesh.
about.sw: Tangawizi ni mmea wenye majani mengi, wenye mashina marefu kama matete yanayobeba majani membamba yenye ncha kali katika safu mbili. Sehemu inayotumika ni kiazi chake, shina la chini ya ardhi lenye vifundo, la rangi ya kahawia hafifu kwa nje, na nyama yenye nyuzinyuzi, ya manjano hafifu, kali na yenye harufu nzuri.
about.dg: *Tangawizi* ni mmea wenye makodza manji, na milita mirefu dza mridza yenye makodza membamba genye ntsa, ganayokala mistari miiri. Seemu inayohumirwa ni *rhizome*, muhi urio tsini ya ulongo; kondze una maugu na ni wa rangi ya dongo ngushu-ngushu, na nyamaze ni za nyuzi-nyuzi, za rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, kali na zenye mzingo.

where.en: Ginger is grown in some gardens on the south coast, but most is bought.
where.sw: Tangawizi hupandwa katika baadhi ya bustani katika pwani ya kusini, lakini sehemu kubwa hununuliwa.
where.dg: Tangawizi inarimwa busitani zanjina za pwani ya kusini, ela nyinji nkugulwa.

uses.en: Ginger goes into tea, as *chai ya tangawizi*, and into the strong black coffee of the coast. It is used in cooking and in medicine.
uses.sw: Tangawizi hutiwa katika chai, kama *chai ya tangawizi*, na katika kahawa chungu nzito ya pwani. Hutumika katika mapishi na kama dawa.
uses.dg: Tangawizi nkutiywa chai, dza *chai ya tangawizi*, na kahawa nyiru na kali ya pwani. Inahumirwa kujitira vyakurya na kpwenye dawa.

culture.en: Ginger coffee is thought of as a restorative; in Digo, coffee with ginger is the drink recommended after an operation.
culture.sw: Kahawa ya tangawizi huchukuliwa kuwa kinywaji cha kurejesha nguvu; kwa Wadigo, kahawa yenye tangawizi ndicho kinywaji kinachopendekezwa baada ya upasuaji.
culture.dg: Kahawa ya tangawizi nkuonwa dza chinwadzi cha kuuyiza nguvu; kpwa Adigo, kahawa na tangawizi ni chinwadzi ambacho mutu nkuambirwa anwe bada ya kupasuliwa.

names.en: The Digo name is *tangawizi*, the same as in Swahili. In English it is ginger.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *tangawizi*, sawa na la Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *ginger*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *tangawizi*, sawa na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *ginger*.

reason.en: Coffee, often spiced with ginger
reason.sw: Kahawa, ambayo mara nyingi hutiwa tangawizi
reason.dg: Kahawa, ambayo mara nyinji nkutiywa tangawizi.

reason.en: Same family; turmeric
reason.sw: Wa familia moja; manjano
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga; chikatsu.

reason.en: Same family; another tea spice
reason.sw: Wa familia moja; iliki, kiungo kingine cha chai
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga; iliki, chitu chanjina chinachotiywa chai.

reason.en: Another kitchen spice used in medicine
reason.sw: Kiungo kingine cha jikoni kinachotumika kama dawa
reason.dg: Chitu chanjina cha kujitira chinachohumirwa piya kpwenye dawa.

teaser.en: Before a wedding or at Eid, hands and feet across the coast are painted orange-red with the crushed leaves of this shrub.
teaser.sw: Kabla ya harusi au wakati wa Idi, mikono na miguu kote pwani hupakwa rangi nyekundu ya chungwa kwa majani yaliyopondwa ya kichaka hiki.
teaser.dg: Kabla ya arusi au wakati wa Idi, mikono na magulu kosi pwani nkupakpwa rangi ya chungbwa na kundu kpwa makodza ga chitsaka hichi ganayosirwa.

summary.en: *Hina* is henna, a shrub planted around homes whose dried leaves give an orange-red dye. It decorates hands, feet and hair for weddings and Eid, and is also used for perfume, medicine and love charms.
summary.sw: *Hina* ni mhina, kichaka kinachopandwa kuzunguka nyumba ambacho majani yake yaliyokaushwa hutoa rangi nyekundu ya chungwa. Hupamba mikono, miguu na nywele wakati wa harusi na Idi, na pia hutumika kwa manukato, dawa na hirizi za mapenzi.
summary.dg: *Hina* ni chitsaka chinachophandwa kanda-kanda ya nyumba, ambacho makodzage garigoanikpwa ganalavya rangi ya chungbwa na kundu. Nkuhumirwa kupamba mikono, magulu na nyere kpwa arusi na Idi, na piya kpwa marashi, dawa na livuho ra mahaba.

about.en:
*Hina* is a much-branched shrub or small tree with small, smooth, oval leaves in opposite pairs. Its small flowers, white to pinkish, grow in loose sprays and are strongly fragrant. The fruits are small round capsules.

The colour is hidden in the leaves: dried and ground into a green powder, then mixed into a paste, they stain skin and hair a lasting orange-red.
about.sw:
*Hina* ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi au mti mdogo, wenye majani madogo, laini, ya umbo la yai, yaliyo jozi zinazotazamana. Maua yake madogo, meupe hadi ya waridi, huota kwa mashada yaliyolegea na yana harufu kali nzuri. Matunda yake ni vibuyu vidogo vya mviringo.

Rangi imejificha kwenye majani: yakikaushwa na kusagwa kuwa unga wa kijani, kisha kuchanganywa kuwa uji mzito, hupaka ngozi na nywele rangi nyekundu ya chungwa inayodumu.
about.dg:
*Hina* ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji au muhi mdide, chenye makodza madide, laini na ga mviringo, ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalengana. Maruwage madide, mereru hadi ga pinki, ganamera dza mafungu ganayolegea na gana arufu nono sana. Matundage ni makakaya madide ga mviringo.

Rangi i ndani ya makodza: gachianikpwa na kuphondwa kukala unga wa chijani, na unga uchikandwa, unaika kpwenye ngozi na nyere rangi ya chungbwa na kundu inayokaa muda mure.

where.en: Henna is planted around homes on the south coast.
where.sw: Mhina hupandwa kuzunguka nyumba pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: *Hina* nkuphandwa kanda-kanda ya nyumba pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The leaves are made into a dye for hands, feet and hair, especially for weddings and Eid. The fragrant flowers are used to make perfume, and the plant is also used in medicine.
uses.sw: Majani yake hutengenezwa rangi ya kupaka mikono, miguu na nywele, hasa wakati wa harusi na Idi. Maua yake yenye harufu nzuri hutumika kutengeneza manukato, na mmea huu pia hutumika kama dawa.
uses.dg: Makodza nkuhendwa rangi ya kupaka mikono, magulu na nyere, hasa kpwa arusi na Idi. Maruwa genye arufu nono nkuhumirwa kuhenda marashi, na mmea piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

culture.en: Henna is part of celebration on the coast, worn at weddings and at Eid. It is also used in love magic: henna extract is used for romantic attraction, a practice known as *maruwa*.
culture.sw: Hina ni sehemu ya sherehe pwani, hupakwa wakati wa harusi na Idi. Pia hutumika katika uchawi wa mapenzi: dondoo la hina hutumika kuvuta mapenzi, desturi inayojulikana kama *maruwa*.
culture.dg: *Hina* ni seemu ya sherehe pwani, na nkupakpwa kpwenye arusi na Idi. Piya nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga wa mahaba: madzi ga hina nkuhumirwa kpwa livuho ra mahaba, mazoea ganayoihwa *maruwa*.

names.en: The Digo name is *hina*. Swahili calls the plant *mhina* or *mkokoa*, and the powder *hina*. In Bajun it is *mvuma nyuki*. In English it is henna.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *hina*. Kwa Kiswahili mmea huitwa *mhina* au *mkokoa*, na unga wake huitwa *hina*. Kwa Kibajuni huitwa *mvuma nyuki*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *henna*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *hina*. Kpwa Chiswahili mmea unaihwa *mhina* au *mkokoa*, na unga unaihwa *hina*. Kpwa Chibajuni ni *mvuma nyuki*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *henna*.

reason.en: Turmeric, another plant used for colour and cosmetics
reason.sw: Manjano, mmea mwingine unaotumika kwa rangi na urembo
reason.dg: *Chikatsu*, mmea wanjina unaohumirwa kpwa rangi na kudzipamba

reason.en: Same family, Lythraceae
reason.sw: Familia moja, Lythraceae
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga, Lythraceae

reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa nyumbani wenye matumizi ya kiroho
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa midzini unaohumirwa kpwa mambo ga chiroho

teaser.en: On the coast, coffee comes strong, black and in tiny cups, often with a kick of ginger.
teaser.sw: Pwani, kahawa huja kali, nyeusi na katika vikombe vidogo, mara nyingi ikiwa na ukali wa tangawizi.
teaser.dg: Pwani, kahawa nkunwewa ndziho na nyiru, kpwa vikombe vidide sana, na mara nyinji ina ukali wa tangawizi.

summary.en: *M'buni* or *mkahawa* is the coffee shrub, occasionally planted on the coast. Most coffee is bought, then brewed into *kahawa*, the strong black coffee served in small cups.
summary.sw: *M'buni* au *mkahawa* ni mbuni, kichaka cha kahawa kinachopandwa mara chache pwani. Kahawa nyingi hununuliwa, kisha hupikwa kuwa *kahawa*, kahawa kali nyeusi inayonywewa katika vikombe vidogo.
summary.dg: *M'buni* au *mkahawa* ni chitsaka cha kahawa, chinachophandwa mara chache pwani. Kahawa nyinji nkugulwa, chisha nkujitwa ikakala *kahawa*, kahawa ndziho nyiru inayonwewa kpwa vikombe vidide.

about.en: Coffee is an evergreen shrub with glossy, dark green leaves in opposite pairs. Its white, star-shaped flowers have a jasmine-like scent. The fruits, called cherries, ripen from green to bright red, each holding two beans.
about.sw: Mbuni ni kichaka kisichopukutika chenye majani yanayong'aa ya kijani kibichi kilichokolea, yaliyo jozi zinazotazamana. Maua yake meupe yenye umbo la nyota yana harufu kama ya asumini. Matunda yake huiva kutoka kijani hadi mekundu angavu, na kila moja huwa na punje mbili.
about.dg: *M'buni* ni chitsaka chenye makodza chila wakati, makodza ganayong'ala ga chijani sana, ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalengana. Maruwage mereru ga umbo ra nyota gana arufu dza ya *jasmine*. Matundage, ganayoihwa *cherries* kpwa Chingereza, ganaivwa kula chijani hadi kundu sana, na chila tunda rina tembe mbiri.

where.en: Coffee is occasionally planted at homesteads on the south coast, but most coffee is bought.
where.sw: Mbuni hupandwa mara chache kwenye makazi pwani ya kusini, lakini kahawa nyingi hununuliwa.
where.dg: *M'buni* nkuphandwa mara chache midzini pwani ya kusini, ela kahawa nyinji nkugulwa.

uses.en: Coffee is brewed into *kahawa*, a strong black coffee served in small cups and often spiced with ginger.
uses.sw: Kahawa hupikwa kuwa *kahawa*, kahawa kali nyeusi inayonywewa katika vikombe vidogo na mara nyingi hukolezwa kwa tangawizi.
uses.dg: Kahawa nkujitwa ikakala *kahawa*, kahawa ndziho nyiru inayonwewa kpwa vikombe vidide, na mara nyinji nkutiywa tangawizi.

names.en: Digo has two names for the coffee tree: *m'buni* and *mkahawa*. Swahili uses *mbuni* or *mkahawa*. In English it is coffee.
names.sw: Kidigo kina majina mawili ya mti wa kahawa: *m'buni* na *mkahawa*. Kiswahili hutumia *mbuni* au *mkahawa*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *coffee*.
names.dg: Chidigo china madzina mairi ga muhi wa kahawa: *m'buni* na *mkahawa*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mbuni* au *mkahawa*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *coffee*.

reason.en: Ginger, used to spice coffee
reason.sw: Tangawizi, inayotumika kukoleza kahawa
reason.dg: *Tangawizi*, inayotiywa kahawa

reason.en: Cloves, also used to spice coffee
reason.sw: Karafuu, nazo hutumika kukoleza kahawa
reason.dg: *Karafuu*, nazo piya nkutiywa kahawa

reason.en: Another flavouring of coastal drinks
reason.sw: Kikolezo kingine cha vinywaji vya pwani
reason.dg: *Cardamom*, chitu chanjina cha kupha ladha vinwadzi vya pwani

definition.en: Coffee.
definition.sw: Kahawa.
definition.dg: Chinwadzi cha kahawa.

teaser.en: When its pods split, this tall tree releases clouds of silky fluff, which was used to stuff mattresses and pillows.
teaser.sw: Maganda yake yanapopasuka, mti huu mrefu hutoa mawingu ya pamba laini kama hariri, iliyotumika kujaza magodoro na mito.
teaser.dg: Makakayage gachiahuka, muhi hinyu mure unatuluza sufi nyinji laini dza maingu, iriyokala ichihumirwa kuodzaza magodoro na mito.

summary.en: *Msufi* is the kapok or silk-cotton tree, a tall, buttressed tree found in villages. Its pods hold silky fibre used to stuff mattresses and pillows.
summary.sw: *Msufi* ni mti mrefu wenye mizizi-ukuta kwenye shina, unaopatikana vijijini. Maganda yake yana nyuzi laini kama hariri zinazotumika kujaza magodoro na mito.
summary.dg: *Msufi* ni muhi wa sufi, muhi mure wenye ngamba, unaophahikana vidzidzini. Makakayage gana sufi laini inayohumirwa kuodzaza magodoro na mito.

about.en:
*Msufi* is a tall tree with a straight trunk, broad buttresses at the base and branches that spread out in near-horizontal tiers. Young trunks are often studded with thorns. The leaves are divided like an open hand into several leaflets.

The pods are long and pointed. When they ripen and split, they release a mass of light, silky fibre wrapped around the seeds.
about.sw:
*Msufi* ni mti mrefu wenye shina lililonyooka, mizizi-ukuta mipana chini yake, na matawi yanayotanda kwa ngazi zinazokaribia kuwa mlalo. Mashina machanga mara nyingi yamejaa miiba. Majani yamegawanyika kama kiganja kilichofunguliwa kuwa vijani kadhaa.

Maganda yake ni marefu na yenye ncha. Yanapoiva na kupasuka, hutoa wingi wa nyuzi nyepesi laini kama hariri zilizozunguka mbegu.
about.dg:
*Msufi* ni muhi mure wenye kolo rinaroima chocho, na photsi una ngamba kulu. Pandaze zinaenea kpwa tabaka, karibu sawa-sawa na photsi. Makolo ga mihi mitsanga mara nyinji gana miya. Makodzage ni dza mkpwono uriovugulwa: chila rimwenga rina makodza madide kadhaa.

Makakayage ni mare na gana ntsa. Gachiivwa na kuahuka, ganatuluza sufi nyinji laini na phepheya, iriyozunguluka tembe.

where.en: It grows as a village tree on the south coast.
where.sw: Hukua kama mti wa vijijini pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unamera dza muhi wa vidzidzini pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The silky fibre, kapok, is used to stuff mattresses and pillows.
uses.sw: Nyuzi hizo laini, sufi, hutumika kujaza magodoro na mito.
uses.dg: Sufi, iriyo laini, inahumirwa kuodzaza magodoro na mito.

names.en: The Digo name is *msufi*, the same as in Swahili. In English it is kapok tree or silk-cotton tree.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *msufi*, sawa na la Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *kapok tree* au *silk-cotton tree*.
names.dg: Dzinare kpwa Chidigo ni *msufi*, sawa na kpwa Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *kapok tree* au *silk-cotton tree*.

reason.en: Close relative in the same family, the baobab
reason.sw: Jamaa wa karibu katika familia moja, mbuyu
reason.dg: Ndugu wa phephi wa jamii mwenga, *muuyu*

reason.en: Another plant grown for its soft seed fibre
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaopandwa kwa nyuzi laini za mbegu zake
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaophandwa kpwa sababu ya sufi laini ya tembeze

reason.sw: Pamba-mwitu, mmea mwingine wa nyuzi wa familia ya mibamia (*mallow*)
reason.dg: Pamba ya weruni, mmea wanjina wa sufi wa jamii ya *mallow*

definition.en: The woolly fruit of kapok trees, both the planted kapok and the wild msufi mwitu. Probably borrowed from Arabic through Swahili.
definition.sw: Tunda lenye nyuzi kama sufu la misufi, ya kupandwa na ile ya porini, msufi mwitu. Huenda lilikopwa kutoka Kiarabu kupitia Kiswahili.
definition.dg: Tunda renye sufi ra mihi ya msufi, ya kuphandwa na ya weruni (*msufi mwitu*). Anji phahi neno hiri rikakopwa kula Chiarabu kpwa njira ya Chiswahili.

digo_source: Mgombato ('mkilifi', 'mwarobaini neem tree'); ICRAF ('Digo: Muarubaini, Mwarobaini, Mkilifi')

teaser.en: Its name comes from the Swahili word for forty, after the forty diseases this bitter tree is said to cure.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linatokana na neno la Kiswahili la arobaini, kwa sababu ya magonjwa arobaini ambayo mti huu mchungu husemekana kuyatibu.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinalavywa kula neno ra Chiswahili ra 'arubaini', kpwa sababu ya makongo arubaini ambago nkugombwa muhi uhu wa utsungu unagaphoza.

summary.en: *Mwarobaini* is the neem, a fast-growing evergreen tree with bitter leaves, planted in villages along the coast. It is known above all as a medicine for fevers and malaria, and also gives shade, poles, firewood and insecticide.
summary.sw: *Mwarobaini* ni mwarubaini, mti unaokua haraka usiopukutika wenye majani machungu, unaopandwa vijijini kando ya pwani. Unajulikana zaidi kama dawa ya homa na malaria, na pia hutoa kivuli, nguzo, kuni na dawa ya kuua wadudu.
summary.dg: *Mwarobaini* ni *neem*, muhi wenye makodza chila wakati unaomera upesi, wenye makodza ga utsungu, unaophandwa vidzidzini kanda-kanda ya pwani. Unamanyikana zaidi dza dawa ya homa na *malaria*, na piya unapha chivuri, nguzo, kuni na dawa ya adudu.

about.en: *Mwarobaini* is a fast-growing evergreen tree with a dense, rounded crown. Its leaves are divided into many narrow, toothed, slightly curved leaflets, and they taste intensely bitter. Small, white, honey-scented flowers come in loose sprays, followed by small olive-like fruits that ripen yellow.
about.sw: *Mwarobaini* ni mti unaokua haraka usiopukutika, wenye taji nzito ya mviringo. Majani yake yamegawanyika katika vijani vingi vyembamba, vyenye meno pembezoni na vilivyopinda kidogo, na ladha yake ni chungu mno. Maua madogo meupe yenye harufu ya asali huota kwa mashada yaliyolegea, na hufuatwa na matunda madogo kama zeituni yanayoiva yakawa ya manjano.
about.dg: *Mwarobaini* ni muhi unaomera upesi, wenye makodza chila wakati na makodza manji ganayobanana dzulu kpwa mviringo. Makodzage ganaganywa kpwa makodza madide manji membamba, genye meno na ganainama chidide, na gana utsungu sana. Maruwa madide mereru, genye arufu ya asali, ganamera dza mafungu ganayolegea, na bada yao kunatuluka matunda madide dza zeituni, ganayoivwa na kukala ga rangi ya mandano.

where.en: It is planted in villages along the coast and has spread on its own. It is common around Vanga, in the far south of Kwale.
where.sw: Hupandwa vijijini kando ya pwani na umeenea wenyewe. Ni wa kawaida karibu na Vanga, kusini kabisa mwa Kwale.
where.dg: Unaphandwa vidzidzini kanda-kanda ya pwani, na ukaenea hata phatu usiphophandwa. Ni wa kawaida kanda-kanda ya Vanga, kusini kabisa ya Kwale.

uses.en: Neem is widely used in medicine for fevers and malaria, and is said to 'cure forty diseases'. It also gives shade, poles and firewood, and is used as an insecticide.
uses.sw: Mwarubaini hutumika sana kama dawa ya homa na malaria, na husemekana 'kutibu magonjwa arobaini'. Pia hutoa kivuli, nguzo na kuni, na hutumika kama dawa ya kuua wadudu.
uses.dg: *Mwarobaini* nkuhumirwa sana kpwa dawa ya homa na *malaria*, na nkugombwa 'unaphoza makongo arubaini'. Piya unapha chivuri, nguzo na kuni, na nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya adudu.

culture.en: Its bitterness, *utsungu* in Digo, is one of the features people use to recognise it.
culture.sw: Uchungu wake, *utsungu* kwa Kidigo, ni mojawapo ya sifa ambazo watu hutumia kuutambua.
culture.dg: Utsunguwe, *utsungu* kpwa Chidigo, ni kahi ya alama ambazo atu anazihumira kuumanya.

names.en: The Digo names are *mwarobaini*, *muarubaini* and *mkilifi*. Swahili calls it *mwarubaini*, and Mgombato also gives the Swahili *mkilifi* and *mzamba*. In Giriama it is *mkilifi*. In English it is neem or margosa. The name *mwarobaini* comes from *arobaini*, 'forty', for the forty diseases it is said to cure.
names.sw: Majina ya Kidigo ni *mwarobaini*, *muarubaini* na *mkilifi*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mwarubaini*, na Mgombato pia inatoa majina ya Kiswahili *mkilifi* na *mzamba*. Kwa Kigiriama huitwa *mkilifi*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *neem* au *margosa*. Jina *mwarobaini* linatokana na neno *arobaini* (40), kwa magonjwa arobaini ambayo husemekana kuyatibu.
names.dg: Madzina ga Chidigo ni *mwarobaini*, *muarubaini* na *mkilifi*. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mwarubaini*, na Mgombato anapha piya madzina ga Chiswahili *mkilifi* na *mzamba*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mkilifi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *neem* au *margosa*. Dzina *mwarobaini* rinalavywa kula *arobaini*, 'arubaini', kpwa sababu ya makongo arubaini ambago nkugombwa unagaphoza.

conservation.en: Neem is an introduced tree that has naturalised on the coast.
conservation.sw: Mwarubaini ni mti wa kigeni ulioletwa ambao umejizoesha na kuenea wenyewe pwani.
conservation.dg: *Mwarobaini* ni muhi mjeni, ambao sambi unamera pwani bila kuphandwa.

reason.en: Another plant used against malaria and insects
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaotumika dhidi ya malaria na wadudu
reason.dg: *Chivumbani*, mmea wanjina unaohumirwa kpwa homa (*malaria*) na kuzuwiya adudu

reason.en: Another bitter plant used for malaria
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine mchungu unaotumika kwa malaria
reason.dg: *Mtsunga wa utsungu*, mmea wanjina wa utsungu unaohumirwa kpwa homa (*malaria*)

reason.en: Same family, Meliaceae
reason.sw: Familia moja, Meliaceae
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga, Meliaceae; *munwa madzi*

teaser.en: Castor oil is among the offerings a man must bring to become an elder of Kaya Kinondo.
teaser.sw: Mafuta ya mbono ni miongoni mwa matoleo ambayo mwanamume lazima alete ili kuwa mzee wa Kaya Kinondo.
teaser.dg: Mafuha ga *mwono* ni kahi ya sadaka ambazo mlume ni lazima arehe ili akale mzehe wa Kaya Kinondo.

summary.en: *Mwono* is the castor oil plant, a large-leaved shrub of farm edges and waste ground. Its seeds give an oil for lamps and medicine, though the seeds themselves are poisonous.
summary.sw: *Mwono* ni mbono, kichaka chenye majani makubwa kinachoota pembezoni mwa mashamba na kwenye ardhi isiyotumika. Mbegu zake hutoa mafuta ya taa na dawa, ingawa mbegu zenyewe zina sumu.
summary.dg: *Mwono* ni *castor oil plant*, chitsaka chenye makodza makulu cha kanda-kanda ya minda na tsi isiyorimwa. Tembeze zinalavya mafuha ga taa na ga dawa, ingawa tembe zina sumu.

about.en: *Mwono* is a fast-growing shrub, sometimes reaching small-tree size, with large leaves shaped like a hand with deep, pointed lobes. The leaves and stems are often tinged red or purple. The flowers grow in upright spikes and give way to spiny round capsules, each holding three glossy, mottled seeds.
about.sw: *Mwono* ni kichaka kinachokua haraka, wakati mwingine hufikia ukubwa wa mti mdogo, chenye majani makubwa yenye umbo la kiganja chenye pindo za kina zilizochongoka. Majani na mashina mara nyingi huwa na rangi ya wekundu au zambarau. Maua yake huota kwenye vishada vilivyosimama wima na hufuatwa na vibuyu vya mviringo vyenye miiba, kila kimoja kikiwa na mbegu tatu zinazong'aa zenye madoadoa.
about.dg: *Mwono* ni chitsaka chinachomera upesi, ambacho wakati wanjina chinakula hadi kukala muhi mdide, chenye makodza makulu ga umbo ra mkpwono, genye vyala vire vyenye ntsa. Makodza na milita mara nyinji gana rangi ya kundu au zambarau chidide. Maruwa ganamera kpwenye milita iriyoima chocho, na bada yao kunatuluka makakaya ga mviringo genye miya, na chila kakaya rina tembe tahu zinazong'ala, zenye vidoti-doti.

where.en: It grows on farm edges and waste ground across the south coast.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa mashamba na kwenye ardhi isiyotumika kote pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya minda na tsi isiyorimwa kosi pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The seeds are pressed for oil, which is used in lamps and in medicine. The seeds themselves are poisonous.
uses.sw: Mbegu zake hukamuliwa kupata mafuta, ambayo hutumika kwenye taa na kama dawa. Mbegu zenyewe zina sumu.
uses.dg: Tembe nkugandamizwa kulavya mafuha, ganayohumirwa kpwenye taa na kpwa dawa. Ela tembe zina sumu.

culture.en: Castor oil has a place in kaya tradition. To become an elder of Kaya Kinondo, the main Digo kaya near Diani, a candidate must offer castor oil along with a black he-goat, a black hen and black cloth.
culture.sw: Mafuta ya mbono yana nafasi katika mila za kaya. Ili kuwa mzee wa Kaya Kinondo, kaya kuu ya Wadigo karibu na Diani, mgombea lazima atoe mafuta ya mbono pamoja na beberu mweusi, kuku mweusi na kitambaa cheusi.
culture.dg: Mafuha ga *mwono* gana nafwasi kpwenye mila za kaya. Ili akale mzehe wa Kaya Kinondo, kaya kulu ya Adigo phephi na Diani, mutu anayelonda ni lazima alavye mafuha ga *mwono* phamwenga na mbuzi mlume mwiru, kuku mche mwiru na nguwo nyiru.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwono*. Swahili calls it *mbono*, and Giriama *m'bono*. In English it is castor oil plant.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwono*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mbono*, na kwa Kigiriama *m'bono*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *castor oil plant*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mwono*. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mbono*, na kpwa Chigiryama *m'bono*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *castor oil plant*.

teaser.en: A Digo proverb holds that *chiko chaajira ndilo*: a pipe suits an honourable person.
teaser.sw: Methali ya Kidigo inasema *chiko chaajira ndilo*: kiko humfaa mtu mwenye heshima.
teaser.dg: Ndarira ya Chidigo inagomba *chiko chaajira ndilo*: chiko chinamfwaha mutu wa hishima.

summary.en: *Tumbaku* is tobacco, a minor leaf crop on the coast. It is used as snuff and for smoking.
summary.sw: *Tumbaku* ni tumbaku, zao dogo la majani pwani. Hutumika kama ugoro na kwa kuvuta.
summary.dg: *Tumbaku* ni mmea wa makodza unaorimwa chidide pwani. Nkuhumirwa kpwa kunusa na kpwa kuvuta.

about.en: Tobacco is a tall, leafy plant with large, broad, sticky-hairy leaves and clusters of pink or white trumpet-shaped flowers. The leaves are harvested and dried before use.
about.sw: Tumbaku ni mmea mrefu wenye majani mengi, makubwa, mapana yenye vinyweleo vinavyonata, na mashada ya maua ya waridi au meupe yenye umbo la tarumbeta. Majani yake huvunwa na kukaushwa kabla ya kutumika.
about.dg: *Tumbaku* ni mmea mure wenye makodza manji. Makodzage ni makulu na mapana, genye nyere ndide zinazonyata, na maruwage ni ga pinki au mereru, ga umbo ra ndzumari, ganamera kpwa mafungu. Makodza nkunyotolwa na nkuumiswa kabla ya kuhumirwa.

where.en: Tobacco is a minor crop on the south coast.
where.sw: Tumbaku ni zao dogo pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Pwani ya kusini, *tumbaku* inarimwa chidide.

uses.en: Dried tobacco is used as snuff and for smoking.
uses.sw: Tumbaku iliyokaushwa hutumika kama ugoro na kwa kuvuta.
uses.dg: *Tumbaku* iriyoumiswa nkuhumirwa kpwa kunusa na kpwa kuvuta.

culture.en: Snuff and the pipe carried respect. The *chiko*, a snuff container or pipe, appears in the proverb *Chiko chaajira ndilo*, 'a pipe suits an honourable person'.
culture.sw: Ugoro na kiko viliheshimiwa. *Chiko*, chombo cha ugoro au kiko, kinatajwa katika methali *Chiko chaajira ndilo*, 'kiko humfaa mtu mwenye heshima'.
culture.dg: Kare, tumbaku ya kunusa na chiko kala ni vitu vya hishima. *Chiko*, chombo cha kuikira tumbaku ya kunusa au chiko cha kuvutira, chinaphahikana kpwenye ndarira *Chiko chaajira ndilo*, 'chiko chinamfwaha mutu wa hishima'.

names.en: The Digo word *tumbaku* means both tobacco and snuff, and is the same as in Swahili, where snuff is also *ugoro*. In English it is tobacco.
names.sw: Neno la Kidigo *tumbaku* lina maana ya tumbaku na pia tumbaku ya kunusa, na ni sawa na la Kiswahili, ambapo tumbaku ya kunusa pia huitwa *ugoro*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *tobacco*.
names.dg: Neno ra Chidigo *tumbaku* rina mana mbiri: mmea wa tumbaku, na tumbaku ya kunusa. Chiswahili piya china dzina *tumbaku*, na kpwa Chiswahili tumbaku ya kunusa piya inaihwa *ugoro*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *tobacco*.

teaser.en: A thin, hairy creeper above ground, and below it a buried tuber that can grow as heavy as a sack of maize.
teaser.sw: Juu ya ardhi ni mtambaa mwembamba wenye vinyweleo, na chini yake kiazi kilichozikwa kinachoweza kufikia uzito wa gunia la mahindi.
teaser.dg: Dzulu ya tsi kuna mmea mwembamba unaofyombera, wenye nyere, na tsini ya tsi kuna chiazi chikulu chinachoweza kukala chizito dza gunia ra pemba.

summary.en: *Bundi* is a twining climber with deeply lobed, bristly leaves that grows from a large underground tuber. Digo recognise it by its leaves and that tuber.
summary.sw: *Bundi* ni mtambaa unaojizungusha, wenye majani yenye pindo za kina na manyoya magumu, unaoota kutoka kwenye kiazi kikubwa chini ya ardhi. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na kiazi hicho.
summary.dg: *Bundi* ni mmea unaofyombera na kulinga-linga, wenye makodza genye mala mahahu na nyere ngumu, unaomera kula kpwa chiazi chikulu tsini ya tsi. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na chiazi hicho.

about.en: *Bundi* is a climbing or trailing plant whose stems die back in the dry season and sprout again from a big buried tuber. The tuber is round to sausage-shaped with smooth brown skin, and can be very large. The leaves are soft but covered in stiff hairs, and are usually cut into three to five deep lobes. Male and female flowers grow on separate plants; they are small and yellow-orange.
about.sw: *Bundi* ni mmea unaopanda au kutambaa, ambao mashina yake hukauka wakati wa kiangazi na kuchipua tena kutoka kwenye kiazi kikubwa kilichozikwa. Kiazi hicho ni cha mviringo hadi umbo la soseji, chenye ngozi laini ya kahawia, na kinaweza kuwa kikubwa sana. Majani yake ni laini lakini yamefunikwa na vinyweleo vigumu, na kwa kawaida yamekatika kuwa pindo tatu hadi tano za kina. Maua ya kiume na ya kike huota kwenye mimea tofauti; ni madogo na ya manjano-chungwa.
about.dg: *Bundi* ni mmea unaofyombera au unaoambala photsi. Mihiye inauma wakati wa kazikazi, na chisha inatondomera tsona kula kpwa chiazi chikulu chiricho tsini ya tsi. Chiazi ni cha mviringo, au chire dza mkpwahe, chenye gada laini ra rangi ya dongo, na chinaweza kukala chikulu sana. Makodza ni laini, ela gana nyere ngumu, na mara nyinji gana mala mahahu hadi matsano ganayofika ndani sana. Maruwa ga chilume na maruwa ga chichetu ganamera kpwa mimea mbali-mbali; ni madide, ga rangi ya mandano na ya chungbwa.

where.en: It grows in dry scrub, bushland and woodland, often among rocks or on termite mounds, from Ethiopia and Somalia south through Kenya and Tanzania to southern Africa.
where.sw: Huota kwenye vichaka vikavu, vichakani na misituni, mara nyingi katikati ya mawe au juu ya vichuguu, kuanzia Ethiopia na Somalia kusini kupitia Kenya na Tanzania hadi kusini mwa Afrika.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka vya tsi kavu, weruni na matsakani, mara nyinji kahi ya mawe au dzulu ya vidzulu vya lutswa, kula Ethiopia na Somalia, kutsupa Kenya na Tanzania, hadi kusini mwa Afrika.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *bundi* for this climber, and lists it among the names whose meaning cannot be worked out. When identifying it, Digo look at the leaves and the tuber. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *bundi* kwa mtambaa huu, na inaliorodhesha miongoni mwa majina ambayo maana yake haiwezi kufahamika. Wanapoutambua, Wadigo huangalia majani na kiazi. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *bundi* kpwa mmea huno unaofyombera, na anariika kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage. Adigo achiumanya, analola makodzage na chiaziche. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaofyombera, unaomera kula kpwa chiazi tsini ya tsi

reason.sw: Kiazi kikuu chungu, mtambaa wenye kiazi
reason.dg: Mmea unaofyombera wenye chiazi cha utsungu

reason.dg: Mmea wenye chiazi wa vitsaka vya pwani

teaser.en: A small orchid perched on a branch like a hen brooding on her eggs, which is exactly what its Digo name says.
teaser.sw: Okidi mdogo aliyekaa juu ya tawi kama kuku anayeatamia mayai yake, na hivyo ndivyo hasa jina lake la Kidigo linavyosema.
teaser.dg: *Orchid* ndide iriyosagala dzulu ya panda dza kuku asagalaye dzulu ya matumbige; ndivyo dzinare ra Chidigo rinavyogomba.

summary.en: *Chiahira* is the Digo word for epiphytes, plants that sit on other plants, and Pakia records it for this small coastal orchid. Mgombato records the leaves being used for earache.
summary.sw: *Chiahira* ni neno la Kidigo kwa vimelea, mimea inayokaa juu ya mimea mingine, na Pakia inalirekodi kwa okidi huyu mdogo wa pwani. Mgombato inarekodi kwamba majani yake hutumika kwa maumivu ya sikio.
summary.dg: *Chiahira* ni neno ra Chidigo ra mimea inayosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, na Pakia anariandika kpwa *orchid* hino ndide ya pwani. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika kukala makodzage nkuhumirwa kpwa kulumwa ni sikiro.

about.en: *Angraecum dives* is a small epiphytic orchid. It does not root in the soil but clings to the bark of trees and shrubs with its roots exposed to the air. It has short stems with two rows of narrow, leathery leaves and bears small pale flowers with a spur at the back. Digo identify it by the look of the whole plant.
about.sw: *Angraecum dives* ni okidi mdogo anayeishi juu ya mimea mingine. Haoti mizizi udongoni bali hushikamana na magome ya miti na vichaka, mizizi yake ikiwa wazi hewani. Ana mashina mafupi yenye safu mbili za majani membamba magumu kama ngozi, na hutoa maua madogo ya rangi hafifu yenye mrija mfupi nyuma. Wadigo humtambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg: *Angraecum dives* ni *orchid* ndide inayosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Taimera mizi tsini ya tsi, ela inagbwira gopha ra mihi na ra vitsaka, na miziye inakala wazi hewani. Ina mihi mifupi yenye misitari miiri ya makodza membamba na magumu dza chingo, na inalavya maruwa madide ga ngushu-ngushu, genye mchira mdide nyuma. Adigo anaimanya kpwa kulola umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows on the branches of trees and bushes in the coastal forests and thickets of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota kwenye matawi ya miti na vichaka katika misitu na vichaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Inamera dzulu ya panda za mihi na za vitsaka, kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

uses.en: Mgombato describes *chiahira* as a plant whose leaves are bruised and twisted into small plugs, which are put in the ear as a medicine for earache. Mgombato uses the word for this kind of plant in general and doesn't name a species.
uses.sw: Mgombato inaeleza *chiahira* kama mmea ambao majani yake huchubuliwa na kusokotwa kuwa vizibo vidogo, ambavyo hutiwa sikioni kama dawa ya maumivu ya sikio. Mgombato hulitumia neno hili kwa aina hii ya mimea kwa jumla na haitaji spishi.
uses.dg: Kamusi ya Mgombato inaeleza *chiahira* kukala ni mmea ambao makodzage nkuhopezwa na kusongoloswa, kuhenda vitu vidide vinavyoikpwa sikironi dza dawa ya kulumwa ni sikiro. Mgombato inahumira neno hiri kpwa mimea yosi ya aina hino, na taiandika aina mwenga hasa.

culture.en: Pakia explains that the name means 'sitting on'. *Ahira* is the word used for a hen sitting on her eggs, so the orchid is pictured brooding on its host tree. The prefix *chi-* marks its small size.
culture.sw: Pakia inaeleza kwamba jina hili lina maana ya 'kukaa juu ya'. *Ahira* ni neno linalotumika kwa kuku anayeatamia mayai yake, kwa hiyo okidi huyu anaonekana kama anaatamia mti unaombeba. Kiambishi *chi-* kinaonyesha udogo wake.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala dzina hiri rina mana ya 'kusagala dzulu'. *Ahira* ni neno ra kuku anayesagala dzulu ya matumbige, kpwa hivyo *orchid* hino inaonekana dza kuku anayeahira dzulu ya muhi inaoumera. Mwandzo *chi-* unaonyesa kukala ni ndide.

names.en: *Chiahira* is not the name of one species but a group name. Digo call all epiphytic plants *chiahira* and do not give the different species their own names, even though they can see the differences. Pakia records it for two orchids, this one and the leopard orchid (*Ansellia africana*). Mgombato glosses it in Swahili as *kimelea*, a general word for plants that grow on other plants.
names.sw: *Chiahira* si jina la spishi moja bali ni jina la kundi. Wadigo huita mimea yote inayoishi juu ya mimea mingine *chiahira* na hawazipi spishi tofauti majina yao wenyewe, ingawa wanaweza kuona tofauti zao. Pakia inalirekodi kwa okidi wawili, huyu na okidi chui (*Ansellia africana*). Mgombato inalitafsiri kwa Kiswahili kama *kimelea*, neno la jumla kwa mimea inayoota juu ya mimea mingine.
names.dg: *Chiahira* si dzina ra aina mwenga, ela ni dzina ra fungu. Adigo anaiha mimea yosi inayosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina *chiahira*, na taaipha chila aina dzinare, hata kala anaona tafwauti zao. Pakia anariandika kpwa *orchid* mbiri: hino, na *leopard orchid* (*Ansellia africana*). Kpwa Chiswahili, Mgombato inarieleza kukala ni *kimelea*, neno ra mimea yosi inayomera dzulu ya mimea yanjina.

conservation.en: Wild orchids of the Kenya coast depend on old trees in the coastal forests, and like all orchids they are listed under CITES Appendix II.
conservation.sw: Okidi wa porini wa pwani ya Kenya hutegemea miti mikongwe katika misitu ya pwani, na kama okidi wote, wameorodheshwa katika Kiambatisho II cha CITES.
conservation.dg: *Orchid* za weruni za pwani ya Kenya zinakuluphira mihi mikulu ya kare iriyo matsakani ga pwani, na dza *orchid* zosi, zikaandikpwa kpwenye CITES Appendix II.

reason.dg: *Leopard orchid*, ambayo piya inaihwa *chiahira*
