teaser.en: Africa's leopard orchid: big clumps of cane-like stems high in a tree, and sprays of yellow flowers spotted brown.
teaser.sw: Okidi chui wa Afrika: makundi makubwa ya mashina kama miwa juu ya mti, na mashada ya maua ya manjano yenye madoa ya kahawia.
teaser.dg: *Chiahira* hino ni *leopard orchid* ya Afrika: mafungu makulu ga mihi dza miwa dzulu ya muhi, na milita mire ya maruwa ga rangi ya mandano genye mabara ga rangi ya dongo.

summary.en: The leopard orchid is a large epiphyte that grows in big clumps on tree trunks and branches. Digo include it under *chiahira*, their single name for every plant that 'sits on' another.
summary.sw: Okidi chui (*leopard orchid*) ni mmea mkubwa unaoishi juu ya mimea mingine, unaoota kwa makundi makubwa kwenye vigogo na matawi ya miti. Wadigo humweka chini ya *chiahira*, jina lao moja kwa kila mmea 'unaokaa juu' ya mwingine.
summary.dg: *Chiahira* hino (*leopard orchid*) ni mmea mkulu unaosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, na inamera kpwa mafungu makulu dzulu ya makolo na panda za mihi. Adigo anaiika kahi ya *chiahira*, dzina rao rimwenga ra chila mmea 'unaosagala dzulu' ya mimea yanjina.

about.en: The leopard orchid is one of Africa's largest orchids. It forms dense clumps of tall, cane-like stems with leathery leaves. Beneath the clump grows a tangle of upright, spiky roots that catch falling leaves and debris. Its long sprays of flowers are yellow with brown leopard-like spots, which is where the English name comes from.
about.sw: Okidi chui ni mmoja wa okidi wakubwa zaidi barani Afrika. Hutengeneza makundi mazito ya mashina marefu kama miwa yenye majani magumu kama ngozi. Chini ya kundi hilo huota mizizi iliyosongamana, iliyosimama wima na yenye ncha kama miiba, inayonasa majani yanayoanguka na takataka. Mashada yake marefu ya maua ni ya manjano yenye madoa ya kahawia kama ya chui, na hapo ndipo jina lake la Kiingereza linapotoka.
about.dg: *Chiahira* hino ni mwenga wa *orchid* kulu zaidi za Afrika. Inahenda mafungu ga mihi mire minji phamwenga, dza miwa, yenye makodza magumu dza chingo. Photsi ya fungu kunamera mizi minji iimayo chocho, yenye ntsa dza miya, iriyotsanganyikana, na inagbwira makodza ganayogbwa na vifusi. Maruwage ganamera kpwa milita mire, ni ga rangi ya mandano genye mabara ga rangi ya dongo dza ga tsui, na ndiko dzina ra Chingereza rinakotuluka.

where.en: It grows on trees in woodland, coastal forest and bush across tropical and southern Africa, often high in the crown of large trees.
where.sw: Huota juu ya miti katika misitu, misitu ya pwani na vichaka kote katika Afrika ya kitropiki na kusini mwa Afrika, mara nyingi juu kabisa katika taji za miti mikubwa.
where.dg: Inamera dzulu ya mihi weruni, matsakani ga pwani na vitsakani, kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho na kusini mwa Afrika, mara nyinji dzulu sana ya mihi mikulu.

culture.en: *Chiahira* means 'sitting on', from *ahira*, the word for a hen sitting on her eggs. The orchid perches on its host tree like a brooding hen. The *chi-* prefix is a diminutive, since most epiphytes are small.
culture.sw: *Chiahira* lina maana ya 'kukaa juu ya', kutokana na *ahira*, neno la kuku anayeatamia mayai yake. Okidi huyu hukaa juu ya mti unaombeba kama kuku anayeatamia. Kiambishi *chi-* ni cha udogo, kwa kuwa mimea mingi ya aina hii ni midogo.
culture.dg: *Chiahira* rina mana ya 'kusagala dzulu', kula kpwa *ahira*, neno ra kuku anayesagala dzulu ya matumbige. *Orchid* hino inasagala dzulu ya muhi inaoumera dza kuku anayeahira. Mwandzo *chi-* unaonyesa kukala chitu ni chidide, kpwa sababu mimea minji inayosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina ni midide.

names.en: Pakia records the name *chiahira* for this orchid and for the smaller *Angraecum dives*. The Digo use *chiahira* for all epiphytes as one group and do not separate the species by name. Mgombato's Swahili gloss for *chiahira* is *kimelea*, a general term for such plants.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina *chiahira* kwa okidi huyu na kwa *Angraecum dives* aliye mdogo zaidi. Wadigo hutumia *chiahira* kwa mimea yote inayoishi juu ya mimea mingine kama kundi moja na hawazitenganishi spishi kwa majina. Tafsiri ya Kiswahili ya Mgombato kwa *chiahira* ni *kimelea*, neno la jumla kwa mimea kama hii.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina *chiahira* kpwa *orchid* hino na kpwa *Angraecum dives*, iriyo ndide zaidi. Adigo anahumira *chiahira* kpwa mimea yosi inayosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina dza fungu rimwenga, na taaganya aina zao kpwa madzina. Kpwa Chiswahili, Mgombato inaeleza *chiahira* kukala ni *kimelea*, neno ra mimea yosi ya aina hino.

conservation.en: Elsewhere in Africa the leopard orchid is heavily collected for the medicinal plant trade and for gardens, and it has declined in many places. Like all orchids it is listed on CITES Appendix II.
conservation.sw: Kwingineko barani Afrika, okidi chui huvunwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya biashara ya mimea ya dawa na kwa bustani, na amepungua katika maeneo mengi. Kama okidi wote, ameorodheshwa katika Kiambatisho II cha CITES.
conservation.dg: Phatu phanjina Afrika, *chiahira* hino nkutsolwa sana kpwa biashara ya mimea ya dawa na kpwa kuphandwa busitanini, na phatu phanji ikasala chidide. Dza *orchid* zosi, ikaandikpwa kpwenye CITES Appendix II.

teaser.en: A wild pigeon pea that nobody planted: Digo call it God's pigeon pea, or the pigeon pea from outside.
teaser.sw: Mbaazi pori ambayo hakuna aliyeipanda: Wadigo huiita mbaazi ya Mungu, au mbaazi ya nje.
teaser.dg: Mbalazi ya weruni ambayo takuna ariyeiphanda: Adigo anaiiha mbalazi ya Mlungu, au mbalazi ya kondze.

summary.en: *Chibalazi chanze* is a hairy wild legume whose leaves look like those of the cultivated pigeon pea. Both its Digo names say that it grows wild, without anyone planting it.
summary.sw: *Chibalazi chanze* ni mmea wa porini wa jamii ya kunde wenye vinyweleo, ambao majani yake yanafanana na ya mbaazi inayolimwa. Majina yake yote mawili ya Kidigo yanasema kuwa huota porini, bila mtu yeyote kuupanda.
summary.dg: *Chibalazi chanze* ni mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde, wenye nyere ndide, na makodzage ganahalana na makodza ga m'balazi unaorimwa. Madzinage mairi ga Chidigo ganagomba kukala chinamera weruni, bila mutu kuchiphanda.

about.en: *Tephrosia villosa* is a low, bushy herb or small shrub of the pea family, covered in soft grey hairs. Its leaves are divided into several pairs of narrow leaflets, rather like a pigeon pea's. It has small pink to purple pea flowers and narrow, hairy pods. Digo pick it out by its leaves.
about.sw: *Tephrosia villosa* ni mmea mfupi wenye matawi mengi au kichaka kidogo cha jamii ya kunde, uliofunikwa na vinyweleo laini vya kijivu. Majani yake yamegawanyika katika jozi kadhaa za vijani vyembamba, kama ya mbaazi. Una maua madogo ya jamii ya kunde, ya waridi hadi zambarau, na maganda membamba yenye vinyweleo. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Tephrosia villosa* ni mmea mdide, au chitsaka chidide, wa jamii ya kunde, chenye nyere ndide laini za rangi ya ivu. Makodzage ganagbwanyika kuhenda jozi kadhaa za makodza madide membamba, phephi dza ga m'balazi. Chinalavya maruwa madide ga pinki hadi zambarau, dza ga kunde, na makakaya membamba genye nyere. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in grassland, bush, and on roadsides and old farmland across tropical Africa and Asia.
where.sw: Huota mbugani, vichakani, na kando ya barabara na kwenye mashamba ya zamani kote katika Afrika na Asia ya kitropiki.
where.dg: Chinamera phatu pha nyasi, weruni, kanda-kanda ya njira na kpwenye minda iriyorichwa, kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho na Asia.

culture.en: Both names compare the plant to *mbalazi*, the pigeon pea that farmers grow, and say it is the wild one. *Chibalazi mlungu* means 'pigeon pea of God': it grows under God's care rather than a farmer's. *Chibalazi cha nze* means 'pigeon pea of outside', because it grows out there and not in the field. *Chi-* marks it as smaller than the real crop. Pakia draws a wider point from names like these: Digo often name a wild plant after the crop it resembles, as with *mtungudza* (African eggplant) and its wild relative *mtungudza koma*.
culture.sw: Majina yote mawili yanaulinganisha mmea huu na *mbalazi*, mbaazi wanayolima wakulima, na yanasema kuwa huu ni wa porini. *Chibalazi mlungu* lina maana ya 'mbaazi ya Mungu': huota chini ya uangalizi wa Mungu badala ya mkulima. *Chibalazi cha nze* lina maana ya 'mbaazi ya nje', kwa sababu huota huko nje na si shambani. *Chi-* huonyesha kuwa ni mdogo kuliko zao halisi. Pakia inatoa hoja pana zaidi kutokana na majina kama haya: mara nyingi Wadigo huupa mmea wa porini jina la zao unalofanana nalo, kama ilivyo kwa *mtungudza* (ngogwe) na jamaa wake wa porini *mtungudza koma*.
culture.dg: Madzina gosi mairi ganalinganisha mmea huno na *mbalazi*, mbalazi inayorimwa ni akurima, na ganagomba kukala huno ni wa weruni. *Chibalazi mlungu* rina mana ya 'mbalazi ya Mlungu': Mlungu ndiye anayechitundza, si mkurima. *Chibalazi cha nze* rina mana ya 'mbalazi ya kondze', kpwa sababu chinamera kure kondze, si mundani. Mwandzo *chi-* unaonyesa kukala ni chidide kuriko mbalazi inayorimwa. Pakia anahala fundzo kulu kula kpwa madzina dza higa: Adigo mara nyinji anaiha mmea wa weruni kpwa dzina ra mmea wa kurima unaohalana nao, dza *mtungudza* (*African eggplant*) na nduguye wa weruni, *mtungudza koma*.

names.en: Pakia records *chibalazi chanze* (written in full as *chibalazi cha nze*) and *chibalazi mlungu*. The second is shared with Duruma. Mgombato also lists *chibalazi mlungu*, but identifies it as a different legume, *Desmodium velutinum*, and glosses it in Swahili as *mpacha* or *nfungamwitu*. The name may cover more than one wild pea-like plant.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi *chibalazi chanze* (kikiandikwa kamili *chibalazi cha nze*) na *chibalazi mlungu*. Jina la pili linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma. Mgombato pia inaorodhesha *chibalazi mlungu*, lakini inalitambua kama mmea mwingine wa jamii ya kunde, *Desmodium velutinum*, na inalitafsiri kwa Kiswahili kama *mpacha* au *nfungamwitu*. Huenda jina hili linahusu zaidi ya mmea mmoja wa porini unaofanana na kunde.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chibalazi chanze* (richiandikpwa kpwa ukamilifu *chibalazi cha nze*) na *chibalazi mlungu*. Dzina ra phiri ni sawa na ra Chiduruma. Kamusi ya Mgombato piya inaandika *chibalazi mlungu*, ela inagomba ni mmea wanjina wa jamii ya kunde, *Desmodium velutinum*, na kpwa Chiswahili inaupha madzina *mpacha* au *nfungamwitu*. Dzina hiri rinaweza kukala ra mimea zaidi ya mwenga ya weruni inayohalana na kunde.

teaser.sw: Mmea mwembamba usio na makuu, ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na vibuyu vyake vidogo vya matunda.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide mwembamba usio na makuu, ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na makakaya madide ga matundage.

summary.en: *Chibaruti* is a small herb of the acanthus family with small two-lipped flowers held between leafy bracts. Pakia records the name, but its meaning is unknown.
summary.sw: *Chibaruti* ni mmea mdogo wa familia ya *acanthus* wenye maua madogo ya midomo miwili yaliyoshikiliwa kati ya vigamba vya majani. Pakia inarekodi jina hili, lakini maana yake haijulikani.
summary.dg: *Chibaruti* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya *acanthus*, wenye maruwa madide genye miromo miiri, ganayokala kahi ya makodza madide. Pakia anaandika dzinare, ela takuna amanyaye mana ya dzina hiri.

about.en: *Hypoestes forskaolei* is an upright, often branching herb with soft, oval, opposite leaves. Its small flowers are white to pale pink-mauve, two-lipped, and held in clusters of narrow bracts at the leaf joints and stem tips. The fruit is a small capsule that splits open to throw out its seeds. Digo identify it from its leaves and fruits.
about.sw: *Hypoestes forskaolei* ni mmea uliosimama wima, mara nyingi wenye matawi, wenye majani laini ya umbo la yai yaliyo jozi zinazotazamana. Maua yake madogo ni meupe hadi ya waridi-zambarau hafifu, yenye midomo miwili, na hushikiliwa katika vifungu vya vigamba vyembamba kwenye vifundo vya majani na ncha za mashina. Tunda lake ni kibuyu kidogo kinachopasuka na kurusha mbegu zake. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg: *Hypoestes forskaolei* ni mmea mdide uimao chocho, mara nyinji wenye panda nyinji, na makodza laini ga umbo ra tumbi, ganayolengana mairi mairi. Maruwage ni madide, mereru hadi ga pinki na zambarau ngushu-ngushu, genye miromo miiri, na ganamera kpwa mafungu kahi ya makodza madide membamba phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na muhi na kpwenye ntsa za mihi. Tunda ni kakaya dide rinaroahuka na kubwaga tembe. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na matundage.

where.en: It is common at forest edges, in bushland, thickets and shady disturbed ground across Africa and Arabia.
where.sw: Ni wa kawaida pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani, kwenye vichaka vizito na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa yenye kivuli kote Afrika na Arabia.
where.dg: Unaphahikana sana kanda-kanda ya matsaka, weruni, vitsakani, na phatu pha chivuri ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa, kosi Afrika na Uarabuni.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chibaruti* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded. A relative, *Hypoestes aristata*, is the plant Digo call *jirimata futswe*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *chibaruti* na inaliorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Jamaa wake, *Hypoestes aristata*, ndio mmea ambao Wadigo huuita *jirimata futswe*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chibaruti* na anariika kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Nduguye, *Hypoestes aristata*, ndio mmea ambao Adigo anauiha *jirimata futswe*.

teaser.en: Snap a leaf and white milk runs out; look up and you may see its warty green fruits hanging in pairs.
teaser.sw: Vunja jani na maziwa meupe hutiririka; tazama juu na huenda ukaona matunda yake ya kijani yenye vigwaru yakining'inia wawili wawili.
teaser.dg: Gbwanyula kodza na maziya mereru ganatuluka; lola dzulu na unaweza kuona matundage ga chijani genye maugu ganalengela mairi mairi.

summary.en: *Chibombo* is a small tree with milky sap, glossy leaves, fragrant white flowers and paired, warty fruits. Digo tell it apart by its leaves and its latex.
summary.sw: *Chibombo* ni mti mdogo wenye utomvu mweupe kama maziwa, majani yanayong'aa, maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri na matunda yenye vigwaru yanayoota wawili wawili. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na utomvu wake.
summary.dg: *Chibombo* ni muhi mdide wenye maziya, makodza ganayong'ala, maruwa mereru genye arufu nono, na matunda genye maugu ganayomera mairi mairi. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage na maziyage.

about.en: The toad tree is a small tree with a rounded crown and glossy, dark green leaves in opposite pairs. Every part bleeds white milky latex when cut. Its fragrant white flowers are star-shaped with twisted petals. The fruits are its most noticeable feature: large, rough, warty green balls, usually in pairs, which split to show seeds in bright orange flesh. The warty skin gives the English name. Digo recognise it by its leaves and its latex.
about.sw: *Toad tree* ni mti mdogo wenye taji ya mviringo na majani yanayong'aa ya kijani kilichokolea, yaliyo jozi zinazotazamana. Kila sehemu yake hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa ikikatwa. Maua yake meupe yenye harufu nzuri yana umbo la nyota na petali zilizojisokota. Matunda ndiyo sifa yake inayoonekana zaidi: mipira mikubwa ya kijani, mikwaruzu na yenye vigwaru, kwa kawaida wawili wawili, inayopasuka kuonyesha mbegu ndani ya nyama ya rangi ya chungwa angavu. Ngozi hiyo yenye vigwaru ndiyo inayoupa jina lake la Kiingereza (*toad*, chura). Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na utomvu wake.
about.dg: *Chibombo* ni muhi mdide wenye dzulu ra mviringo, na makodza ganayong'ala ga chijani chiru, ganayolengana mairi mairi. Chila seemu ichikatwa inalavya maziya mereru. Maruwage mereru genye arufu nono ni ga umbo ra nyota, na makodza ga ruwa ganasongoloka. Matundage ndigo ganayoonekana zaidi: ni madonge makulu ga chijani, ganayokaraza na genye maugu, mara nyinji mairi mairi, ganayoahuka kuonyesa tembe ndani ya nyama ya rangi ya chungbwa inayong'ala. Gada renye maugu ndiro rinaropha dzina ra Chingereza, *toad tree* ('muhi wa gula'). Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage na maziyage.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, riverine forest and thicket from Kenya south to South Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani, misitu ya kando ya mito na vichaka vizito kuanzia Kenya kusini hadi Afrika Kusini.
where.dg: Chinamera matsakani ga pwani, matsakani ga kanda-kanda ya miho, na vitsakani, kula Kenya hadi kusini kpwa South Africa.

culture.en: Although its name starts with *chi-*, Pakia points out that here the prefix doesn't mean 'small': *chibombo* is a tree. A related shrub is called *chibombo ulimbo*, 'chibombo with latex'. That is *Rauvolfia mombasiana* (*mzigande*), which looks similar but has a more dangerous, poisonous latex.
culture.sw: Ingawa jina lake linaanza na *chi-*, Pakia inaeleza kuwa hapa kiambishi hicho hakimaanishi 'mdogo': *chibombo* ni mti. Kichaka kimoja kinachohusiana nao huitwa *chibombo ulimbo*, '*chibombo* chenye utomvu'. Huo ni *Rauvolfia mombasiana* (*mzigande*), unaofanana nao lakini una utomvu wenye sumu na hatari zaidi.
culture.dg: Hata kala dzinare rinaandza na *chi-*, Pakia anaonyesa kukala phapha mwandzo uho tauna mana ya 'chidide': *chibombo* ni muhi. Chitsaka cha ndugu chinaihwa *chibombo ulimbo*, '*chibombo* chenye ulimbo'. Hicho ni *Rauvolfia mombasiana* (*mzigande*), chinachohalana na *chibombo*, ela chenye maziya ga sumu ambago ni ga hatari zaidi.

names.en: Pakia records *chibombo* for *Tabernaemontana elegans* and lists it among the names whose meaning cannot be analysed. 'Toad tree' is a common English name for the species. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi *chibombo* kwa *Tabernaemontana elegans* na inaliorodhesha miongoni mwa majina ambayo maana yake haiwezi kuchambuliwa. '*Toad tree*' ni jina la kawaida la Kiingereza la spishi hii. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chibombo* kpwa *Tabernaemontana elegans* na anariika kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage. *Toad tree* ni dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana kpwa aina hino. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: Its name simply means 'little climber', and Digo think of it as the female half of a pair.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana tu ya 'mtambaa mdogo', na Wadigo humwona kama nusu ya kike ya jozi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'mbugu dide' tu, na Adigo anachiona dza nusu ya chichetu ya jozi.

summary.en: *Chibugu* is a small twining legume with soft, velvety leaves divided in three. The name means 'little climber', and Pakia notes that Digo see it as the female partner of *chibugu chilume*.
summary.sw: *Chibugu* ni mtambaa mdogo unaojizungusha wa jamii ya kunde, wenye majani laini kama mahameli yaliyogawanyika mara tatu. Jina lake lina maana ya 'mtambaa mdogo', na Pakia inaeleza kuwa Wadigo humwona kama mwenzi wa kike wa *chibugu chilume*.
summary.dg: *Chibugu* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde unaolinga-linga, wenye makodza laini dza nguwo ya *velvet*, ganayogbwanyika kuhenda makodza madide mahahu. Dzina rina mana ya 'mbugu dide', na Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anachiona dza mchetu wa *chibugu chilume*.

about.en: *Rhynchosia velutina* is a twining herb of the pea family. It has leaves divided into three broad leaflets, velvety with soft hairs, small yellow pea flowers and short, flat pods. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Rhynchosia velutina* ni mmea unaojizungusha wa jamii ya kunde. Una majani yaliyogawanyika katika vijani vitatu vipana, laini kama mahameli kwa vinyweleo laini, maua madogo ya manjano ya jamii ya kunde, na maganda mafupi bapa. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Rhynchosia velutina* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde unaolinga-linga. Makodzage ganagbwanyika kuhenda makodza madide mahahu mapana, genye nyere ndide laini dza *velvet*. Una maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano, dza ga kunde, na makakaya mafupi ga kubapa. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It twines over grass and shrubs in bushland and grassland.
where.sw: Hujizungusha juu ya nyasi na vichaka vichakani na mbugani.
where.dg: Unalinga-linga dzulu ya nyasi na vitsaka, weruni na phatu pha nyasi.

culture.en: *Chibugu* is the small form of *mbugu*, 'climber', and Digo use the stem *-bugu* across many climbing plants. Pakia records this species as the female form, *chibugu chichetu* ('female climber'). Because it is the female, it also takes the plain name *chibugu*. *Indigofera trita* is called *chibugu chilume*, 'male climber', though nobody could explain to Pakia why that one counts as the male.
culture.sw: *Chibugu* ni umbo dogo la *mbugu*, 'mtambaa', na Wadigo hutumia shina la neno *-bugu* kwa mimea mingi inayotambaa. Pakia inarekodi spishi hii kama umbo la kike, *chibugu chichetu* ('mtambaa wa kike'). Kwa sababu ni wa kike, pia huchukua jina la kawaida *chibugu*. *Indigofera trita* huitwa *chibugu chilume*, 'mtambaa wa kiume', ingawa hakuna aliyeweza kumweleza Pakia kwa nini huo ndio huhesabiwa wa kiume.
culture.dg: *Chibugu* ni dzina ra udide ra *mbugu*, 'mmea unaofyombera', na Adigo anahumira shina *-bugu* kpwa mimea minji inayofyombera. Pakia anaandika aina hino kukala ni ya chichetu, *chibugu chichetu* ('mbugu ya chichetu'). Kpwa sababu ni ya chichetu, piya inahala dzina bahi *chibugu*. *Indigofera trita* inaihwa *chibugu chilume*, 'mbugu ya chilume', ela takuna mutu ariyeweza kumuelezera Pakia kpwa nini hiyo ndiyo ya chilume.

names.en: Pakia records both *chibugu* and *chibugu chichetu* for this species. The climber stem also turns up in *mbugubugu* (*Cissus*), *libugu pamba* and *mkone chibugu*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi *chibugu* na *chibugu chichetu* kwa spishi hii. Shina hili la 'mtambaa' linajitokeza pia katika *mbugubugu* (*Cissus*), *libugu pamba* na *mkone chibugu*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chibugu* na *chibugu chichetu* kpwa aina hino. Shina ra 'mbugu' piya rinaphahikana kpwenye *mbugubugu* (*Cissus*), *libugu pamba* na *mkone chibugu*.

summary.en: *Chibugu chilume* is a small wild indigo that Digo count as the male partner of the climber *chibugu*. Even the people who use the name couldn't explain why.
summary.sw: *Chibugu chilume* ni mmea mdogo wa porini wa jamii ya nili ambao Wadigo huuhesabu kuwa mwenzi dume wa mtambaaji *chibugu*. Hata wanaotumia jina hilo hawakuweza kueleza sababu yake.
summary.dg: *Chibugu chilume* ni *indigo* ndide ya weruni ambayo Adigo anaiona dza mlume wa *chibugu*, mmea unaofyombera. Hata atu anaohumira dzina hiri taaweza kueleza kpwa nini.

about.en: *Indigofera trita* is a small herb or sub-shrub of the pea family with pinnate leaves of three to five small leaflets, flattened grey hairs, and short spikes of small red to pink flowers. Its pods are slender, straight and pointed. Pakia classes it as a herb. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Indigofera trita* ni mmea mdogo au kichaka kidogo cha jamii ya kunde, chenye majani yaliyogawanyika kuwa vijani vidogo vitatu hadi vitano, manyoya bapa ya rangi ya kijivu, na vishada vifupi vya maua madogo mekundu hadi ya waridi. Maganda yake ni membamba, yaliyonyooka na yenye ncha. Pakia anauainisha kuwa mmea mdogo (herb). Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Indigofera trita* ni mmea mdide, au chitsaka chidide, wa jamii ya kunde. Makodzage ganagbwanyika kuhenda makodza madide mahahu hadi matsano, na una nyere ndide za rangi ya ivu zirizolala dzulu ya makodza, na milita mifupi ya maruwa madide ga kundu hadi ga pinki. Makakayage ni membamba, gasigofyuka, na genye ntsa. Pakia anauika kahi ya mimea midide laini. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It is widespread in grassland, bushland and old cultivation across tropical Africa and Asia.
where.sw: Unapatikana kwa wingi katika nyika za nyasi, vichakani na mashamba ya zamani kote katika maeneo ya tropiki ya Afrika na Asia.
where.dg: Unaphahikana sana phatu pha nyasi, weruni na kpwenye minda iriyorichwa, kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho na Asia.

culture.en: *Chilume* means 'male'. Digo often name plants in male and female pairs, and this species is the male form of *chibugu* (*Rhynchosia velutina*). Pakia notes that the reason it is thought of as male is not clear.
culture.sw: *Chilume* maana yake ni 'dume'. Mara nyingi Wadigo hupa mimea majina kwa jozi za dume na jike, na spishi hii ndiyo umbo la dume la *chibugu* (*Rhynchosia velutina*). Pakia anaeleza kwamba sababu ya kuuona kuwa dume haiko wazi.
culture.dg: *Chilume* manage ni 'mlume'. Adigo mara nyinji anaiha mimea kpwa jozi za mlume na mchetu, na aina hino ni ya chilume ya *chibugu* (*Rhynchosia velutina*). Pakia anaandika kukala sababu ya kuonwa kukala ni mlume taimanyikana.

names.en: Pakia records *chibugu chilume*, 'male climber'. *Chibugu* is the small form of *mbugu*, 'climber'. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded.

names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chibugu chilume*, 'mbugu ya chilume'. *Chibugu* ni dzina ra udide ra *mbugu*, 'mmea unaofyombera'. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: A climber that seems to grow out of nowhere: Digo named it the plant with no stem base, and they were right.
teaser.sw: Mtambaaji unaoonekana kuota bila chanzo: Wadigo waliuita mmea usio na kitako cha shina, na walikuwa sahihi.
teaser.dg: Mbugu inayoonekana kumera bila kula phatu phosi: Adigo anaiiha mmea usio na kolo, na ni kpweli.

summary.en: *Chibugu sicho kolo* is a mistletoe, growing on the branches of other trees with no roots in the ground. Its name says exactly that: 'climber without a stem base'.
summary.sw: *Chibugu sicho kolo* ni kidusia (mistletoe), kinachoota juu ya matawi ya miti mingine bila mizizi ardhini. Jina lake linasema hivyo hasa: 'mtambaaji usio na kitako cha shina'.
summary.dg: *Chibugu sicho kolo* ni *mistletoe*, mmea unaomera dzulu ya panda za mihi yanjina, bila mizi tsini ya tsi. Dzinare rinagomba hivyo hivyo: 'mbugu dide isiyo na kolo'.

about.en: *Plicosepalus curviflorus* is a woody mistletoe. It grows on the branches of host trees, especially acacias, and taps into them for water and minerals while making its own food with its green leaves. It has thick, grey-green, rather fleshy leaves and clusters of long, curved, tubular red-and-orange flowers that sunbirds visit and pollinate. Its berries are spread by birds, which wipe the sticky seeds onto branches where new plants start. Digo recognise it by the look of the whole plant.
about.sw: *Plicosepalus curviflorus* ni kidusia chenye miti. Huota juu ya matawi ya miti mwenyeji, hasa migunga, na hufyonza maji na madini kutoka kwayo huku kikijitengenezea chakula chake kwa majani yake ya kijani. Kina majani manene, ya kijani-kijivu na yenye nyama kiasi, na vishada vya maua marefu, yaliyopinda, yenye umbo la mrija, mekundu na ya machungwa, ambayo hutembelewa na kuchavushwa na chozi (sunbirds). Matunda yake husambazwa na ndege, ambao hupangusa mbegu zinazonata kwenye matawi, na hapo mimea mipya huanza kuota. Wadigo hukitambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg: *Plicosepalus curviflorus* ni *mistletoe* yenye nyama za muhi. Inamera dzulu ya panda za mihi, hasa *acacia*, na inafyondza madzi na madini kula kpwa mihi hiyo, ela piya inadzihendera chakurya kpwa makodzage ga chijani. Makodzage ganayonona, ga rangi ya chijani na ivu, na gana madzi chidide. Maruwage ni mare, ganayofyuka, dza mabomba madide, ga kundu na ga rangi ya chungbwa, ganamera kpwa mafungu; vitsozi nkugakpwedzera na kugaterya kuhenda tembe. Matundage nkuenezwa ni ndege, ambao nkuphangusa tembe zinazonyata dzulu ya panda, phapho mimea miphya inaphoandza kumera. Adigo anaimanya kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows on trees in dry bushland and wooded grassland, from north-east Africa and Arabia south through Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota juu ya miti katika vichaka vikavu na nyika zenye miti, kuanzia kaskazini-mashariki mwa Afrika na Uarabuni kuelekea kusini hadi Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Inamera dzulu ya mihi, kpwenye vitsaka vya tsi kavu na kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi, kula kazikazini na mlairo wa dzuwa wa Afrika na Uarabuni, kutsupa Kenya na Tanzania kuelekea kusini.

culture.en: Pakia records that the plant is believed to grow without a stem base or any roots. That is a sharp observation: a mistletoe really does have no root in the soil, because it grows straight out of its host's branch.
culture.sw: Pakia ameandika kwamba mmea huu unaaminika kuota bila kitako cha shina wala mizizi yoyote. Huo ni uchunguzi makini: kidusia kwa kweli hakina mzizi ardhini, kwa sababu huota moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye tawi la mti mwenyeji.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala atu anaamini mmea huno unamera bila kolo wala mizi. Hiri ni dzambo ririroonwa sawa-sawa: *mistletoe* kpwa kpweli taina muzi tsini ya tsi, kpwa sababu inamera kula kpwenye panda ya muhi unaoimera dzuluye.

names.en: *Chibugu sicho kolo* means 'climber without a stem base': *chibugu*, small climber, and *kolo*, the base of a stem. *Chisikolo*, 'no stem', is a shortened form, and Pakia gives it as an example of a Digo name whose origin speakers can easily explain. Pakia also records a third name, *mlangamia*, without a meaning. In his naming notes he writes the species as *Plicosepalus parviflorus*. Digo use a separate name, *mnazi wa tsozi*, for parasitic plants in general.
names.sw: *Chibugu sicho kolo* maana yake ni 'mtambaaji usio na kitako cha shina': *chibugu*, mtambaaji mdogo, na *kolo*, kitako cha shina. *Chisikolo*, 'bila shina', ni umbo fupi, na Pakia analitoa kama mfano wa jina la Kidigo ambalo wazungumzaji wanaweza kueleza asili yake kwa urahisi. Pakia pia ameandika jina la tatu, *mlangamia*, bila maana yake. Katika maelezo yake kuhusu majina anaiandika spishi hii kama *Plicosepalus parviflorus*. Wadigo hutumia jina tofauti, *mnazi wa tsozi*, kwa mimea vimelea kwa ujumla.
names.dg: *Chibugu sicho kolo* rina mana ya 'mbugu isiyo na kolo': *chibugu*, mbugu dide, na *kolo*, photsi ya muhi. *Chisikolo*, 'chisicho na kolo', ni dzina rifupi ra hiro, na Pakia anarihumira dza mfwano wa dzina ra Chidigo ambaro atu anaogomba Chidigo anaweza kueleza upesi kula ririphotuluka. Pakia piya anaandika dzina ra hahu, *mlangamia*, bila kulavya manage. Kpwenye maelezoge ga madzina, anaandika aina hino kukala ni *Plicosepalus parviflorus*. Adigo anahumira dzina ranjina, *mnazi wa tsozi*, kpwa mimea yosi inayoishi kpwa kufyondza mihi yanjina.

summary.en: *Chiburu madzi* is a slender twining plant of the milkweed group. Its name means 'water gourd', but Pakia couldn't confirm what the name refers to.
summary.sw: *Chiburu madzi* ni mmea mwembamba unaojizungusha, wa kundi la milkweed. Jina lake maana yake ni 'kibuyu cha maji', lakini Pakia hakuweza kuthibitisha jina hilo linarejelea nini.
summary.dg: *Chiburu madzi* ni mmea mwembamba unaolinga-linga, wa jamii ya *milkweed*. Dzinare rina mana ya 'chiburu cha madzi', ela Pakia kaweza kuhakikisha dzina hiri rinamaanisha nini.

about.en: *Secamone retusa* is a slender, twining climber of the milkweed group, with small opposite leaves notched at the tip and tiny flowers. Like its relatives, its fruits are paired pods that split to release seeds with tufts of silky hair. Pakia records it as a herb and notes that Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Secamone retusa* ni mtambaaji mwembamba unaojizungusha, wa kundi la milkweed, wenye majani madogo yanayoelekeana, yaliyo na kibonyeo kwenye ncha, na maua madogo sana. Kama ilivyo kwa jamaa zake, matunda yake ni maganda ya jozi ambayo hupasuka na kutoa mbegu zenye vishungi vya nywele laini kama hariri. Pakia anauandika kuwa mmea mdogo (herb) na anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Secamone retusa* ni mmea mwembamba unaofyombera na kulinga-linga, wa jamii ya *milkweed*, wenye makodza madide ganayolengana mairi mairi, ganayokatika chidide kpwenye ntsa, na maruwa madide sana. Dza nduguze, matundage ni makakaya mairi mairi ganayoahuka kulavya tembe zenye nyere laini dza hariri. Pakia anauandika dza mmea mdide laini, na anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It twines through bush and thicket on the East African coast.
where.sw: Hujizungusha katika vichaka na vichaka vizito kwenye pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Unalinga-linga kahi ya weruni na vitsaka vya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.

names.en: *Chiburu madzi* means 'water gourd': *chiburu* is a small gourd, which Mgombato describes as a gourd used to store seeds, milk or flour, and *madzi* is water. Pakia suggests the plant might produce gourds that were used to keep or carry water, but says this still needs to be confirmed. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chiburu madzi* maana yake ni 'kibuyu cha maji': *chiburu* ni kibuyu kidogo, ambacho Mgombato anakieleza kuwa kibuyu kinachotumiwa kuhifadhi mbegu, maziwa au unga, na *madzi* ni maji. Pakia anapendekeza kwamba huenda mmea huu hutoa vibuyu vilivyotumiwa kuwekea au kubebea maji, lakini anasema jambo hili bado linahitaji kuthibitishwa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: *Chiburu madzi* rina mana ya 'chiburu cha madzi': *chiburu* ni chiburu chidide, ambacho Mgombato inachieleza kukala ni chiburu cha kuikira mbeyu, maziya au unga, na *madzi* ni madzi. Pakia anagomba chahi mmea huno kala unalavya viburu vyakala vinahumirwa kuikira au kuhala madzi, ela anagomba dzambo hiri taridzangbwehakikishwa. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

summary.en: *Chidimu tsaka* is an aromatic forest shrub of the citrus family. Digo see it as a small, wild, forest form of the lime tree.
summary.sw: *Chidimu tsaka* ni kichaka chenye harufu nzuri cha msituni, cha familia ya michungwa. Wadigo hukiona kuwa umbo dogo la porini la msituni la mdimu.
summary.dg: *Chidimu tsaka* ni chitsaka cha tsakani chenye arufu nono, cha jamii ya mdimu. Adigo anachiona dza mdimu mdide wa weruni, wa tsakani.

about.en: *Toddaliopsis sansibarensis* is a shrub or small tree of the citrus family. Its leaves are divided into three leaflets dotted with tiny oil glands, and they give off a citrus-like scent when crushed. It bears small flowers and small fruits. Digo identify it by its leaves and its smell.
about.sw: *Toddaliopsis sansibarensis* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya michungwa. Majani yake yamegawanyika kuwa vijani vitatu vyenye vitone vidogo vya tezi za mafuta, na hutoa harufu kama ya limau yanapopondwa. Huzaa maua madogo na matunda madogo. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake na harufu yake.
about.dg: *Toddaliopsis sansibarensis* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya mdimu. Makodzage ganagbwanyika kuhenda makodza madide mahahu genye vitoni vidide vya mafuha, na ganalavya arufu dza ya ndimu ganaphohopezwa. Chinalavya maruwa madide na matunda madide. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage na arufuye.

where.en: It grows in the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania, including Zanzibar.

names.en: *Chidimu tsaka* means 'small lime plant of the forest'. It is named after *mdimu*, the lime tree, but grows wild in the forest (*tsaka*), and Pakia notes it has smaller fruits, hence the diminutive *chi-*. It is also smaller than the plants Digo call *mdimu tsaka*, 'forest lime'. Giriama shares the name.
names.sw: *Chidimu tsaka* maana yake ni 'mdimu mdogo wa msituni'. Kimepewa jina la *mdimu*, mti wa ndimu, lakini huota porini msituni (*tsaka*), na Pakia anaeleza kwamba kina matunda madogo zaidi, ndiyo maana kina kiambishi cha udogo *chi-*. Pia ni kidogo kuliko mimea ambayo Wadigo huiita *mdimu tsaka*, 'mdimu wa msituni'. Kigiriama kinashiriki jina hili.
names.dg: *Chidimu tsaka* rina mana ya 'mdimu mdide wa tsakani'. Dzinare rinatuluka kpwa *mdimu*, muhi wa ndimu, ela chinamera weruni, tsakani (*tsaka*), na Pakia anaandika kukala matundage ni madide, ndiyo mana chinahala mwandzo wa udide *chi-*. Piya ni chidide kuriko mimea ambayo Adigo anaiiha *mdimu tsaka*, 'mdimu wa tsakani'. Chigiryama piya china dzina hiri.

teaser.en: Its name means 'piercing', and anyone who brushes against it barefoot learns why.
teaser.sw: Jina lake maana yake ni 'kuchoma', na yeyote anayekigusa bila viatu hujua kwa nini.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'kudunga-dunga', na yeyesi anayechiguta bila virahu anamanya kpwa nini.

summary.en: *Chidungadunga* is a small, spiny shrub of the acanthus family. Its name comes from the way its thorns pierce.
summary.sw: *Chidungadunga* ni kichaka kidogo chenye miiba, cha familia ya acanthus. Jina lake linatokana na jinsi miiba yake inavyochoma.
summary.dg: *Chidungadunga* ni chitsaka chidide cha jamii ya *acanthus*, chenye miya. Dzinare rinatuluka kpwa vira miyaye inavyodunga.

about.en: *Barleria setigera* is a low, much-branched shrub armed with spines. As in many *Barleria*, it has spines at the leaf joints and spiny-edged bracts around the flowers. The flowers are tubular and two-lipped. Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Barleria setigera* ni kichaka kifupi chenye matawi mengi na kilichojaa miiba. Kama ilivyo kwa *Barleria* nyingi, kina miiba kwenye vifundo vya majani na vikonyo-jani (bracts) vyenye kingo za miiba kuzunguka maua. Maua yake ni ya umbo la mrija na yenye midomo miwili. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Barleria setigera* ni chitsaka chifupi chenye panda nyinji na miya. Dza *Barleria* nyinji, china miya phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na muhi, na makodza madide genye miya kanda-kanda ganazunguluka maruwa. Maruwage ni dza mabomba madide, na gana miromo miiri. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and thicket in East Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito vya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni na vitsakani kpwenye tsi kavu ya Afrika Mashariki.

names.en: *Chidungadunga* means 'piercing', from *dunga*, to pierce: the plant has thorns that pierce dangerously. Pakia notes that Digo use the doubled stem *-dungadunga* for thorny plants in general, and this one gets *chi-* because it is a small form. He also gives it as an example of a name built by repeating a word. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chidungadunga* maana yake ni 'kuchoma', kutoka *dunga*, kuchoma: mmea huu una miiba inayochoma vibaya. Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo hutumia shina la neno lililorudiwa *-dungadunga* kwa mimea yenye miiba kwa ujumla, na huu hupewa *chi-* kwa sababu ni umbo dogo. Pia analitoa kama mfano wa jina lililoundwa kwa kurudia neno. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: *Chidungadunga* rina mana ya 'kudunga-dunga', kula kpwa *dunga*, kulumiza kpwa chitu chenye ntsa: mmea huno una miya inayodunga vibaya. Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anahumira shina ra kuuyirwa *-dungadunga* kpwa mimea yosi yenye miya, na huno unahala *chi-* kpwa sababu ni mdide. Piya anauhumira dza mfwano wa dzina ririrohendwa kpwa kuuyira neno. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: The 'female' dayflower: Digo pick it out from its male partner by its larger, deeper blue flowers.
teaser.sw: Mmea 'jike' wa jamii ya kongwe: Wadigo huutofautisha na mwenzi wake dume kwa maua yake makubwa zaidi ya buluu iliyokolea.
teaser.dg: *Chidzedza* ni mmea wa 'chichetu': Adigo anachitafwautisha na mlumewe kpwa maruwage makulu, ga samawati sana.

summary.en: *Chidzedza*, also called *kongwe chetu*, is a creeping dayflower with bright blue flowers. Digo count it as the female form because its flowers are larger and a deeper blue than the 'male' species.
summary.sw: *Chidzedza*, unaoitwa pia *kongwe chetu*, ni mmea wa jamii ya kongwe (dayflower) unaotambaa, wenye maua ya buluu angavu. Wadigo huuhesabu kuwa umbo la jike kwa sababu maua yake ni makubwa zaidi na ya buluu iliyokolea kuliko ya spishi 'dume'.
summary.dg: *Chidzedza*, ambacho piya chinaihwa *kongwe chetu*, ni mmea unaoambala photsi wenye maruwa ga samawati inayong'ala. Adigo anachiona kukala ni cha chichetu kpwa sababu maruwage ni makulu na ga samawati sana kuriko ga aina ya 'chilume'.

about.en: *Commelina bracteosa* is a trailing, somewhat succulent herb that roots at its joints. Its leaves have sheathing bases, and its flowers come out of folded, boat-shaped bracts. Each flower has three petals, usually two large blue ones and a smaller one, and lasts for a single morning. Pakia classes it with the grasses (*nyasi*) and notes that Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Commelina bracteosa* ni mmea mdogo unaotambaa, wenye majimaji kiasi, ambao hutoa mizizi kwenye vifundo vyake. Majani yake yana vitako vinavyozunguka shina kama ala, na maua yake hutokea ndani ya vikonyo-jani (bracts) vilivyokunjwa kama mashua. Kila ua lina petali tatu, kwa kawaida mbili kubwa za buluu na moja ndogo zaidi, na hudumu asubuhi moja tu. Pakia anauweka pamoja na nyasi (*nyasi*) na anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Commelina bracteosa* ni mmea laini unaoambala photsi, wenye madzi chidide, na unamera mizi phatu mafundoge ganaphoguta tsi. Photsi ya chila kodza inazunguluka muhi dza mfuko, na maruwa ganatuluka ndani ya makodza madide ganayokundzwa, ga umbo dza dau. Chila ruwa rina makodza ga ruwa mahahu: mara nyinji mairi makulu ga samawati na rimwenga ridide, na rinavuguka ligundzu rimwenga tu. Pakia anachiika kahi ya *nyasi* na anaandika kukala Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in grassland, along paths, in field margins and damp places in tropical Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika za nyasi, kando ya njia, pembezoni mwa mashamba na mahali penye unyevu katika maeneo ya tropiki ya Afrika.
where.dg: Chinamera phatu pha nyasi, kanda-kanda ya njira na ya minda, na phatu phasiphouma, kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho.

culture.en: *Kongwe chetu* means 'female *kongwe*'. Digo count this species as the female because it has large, deep blue flowers, while *kongwe lume* (*Commelina forskaolii*), the male, has smaller and less colourful ones. Pakia uses the pair to show how Digo male and female names follow visible differences.
culture.sw: *Kongwe chetu* maana yake ni '*kongwe* jike'. Wadigo huihesabu spishi hii kuwa jike kwa sababu ina maua makubwa ya buluu iliyokolea, ilhali *kongwe lume* (*Commelina forskaolii*), dume, ina maua madogo zaidi yasiyo na rangi nyingi. Pakia anatumia jozi hii kuonyesha jinsi majina ya Kidigo ya dume na jike yanavyofuata tofauti zinazoonekana.
culture.dg: *Kongwe chetu* rina mana ya '*kongwe* wa chichetu'. Adigo anaiona aina hino kukala ni ya chichetu kpwa sababu ina maruwa makulu ga samawati sana, ela *kongwe lume* (*Commelina forskaolii*), ambayo ni ya chilume, ina maruwa madide zaidi, ga rangi isiyong'ala sana. Pakia anahumira jozi hino kuonyesa vira madzina ga Chidigo ga chilume na ga chichetu ganavyolunga tafwauti zinazoonekana na matso.

names.en: Pakia records *chidzedza* and *kongwe chetu* for this species, and in his notes on names also gives *dzedza*. *Dzedza* is the name usually given to the common wandering Jew, *Commelina benghalensis*, so the name is shared within the genus. *Dzedza* is shared with Duruma and Swahili, and *kongwe chetu* with Swahili. The meaning of *dzedza* is not recorded.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika *chidzedza* na *kongwe chetu* kwa spishi hii, na katika maelezo yake kuhusu majina pia anatoa *dzedza*. *Dzedza* ni jina ambalo kwa kawaida hupewa mmea wa kawaida unaoitwa kwa Kiingereza *wandering Jew*, *Commelina benghalensis*, kwa hiyo jina hili linashirikiwa ndani ya jenasi. *Dzedza* linashirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kiswahili, na *kongwe chetu* na Kiswahili. Maana ya *dzedza* haijarekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chidzedza* na *kongwe chetu* kpwa aina hino, na kpwenye maelezoge ga madzina piya anaandika *dzedza*. *Dzedza* ni dzina rinarohumirwa sana kpwa *Commelina benghalensis* (*wandering Jew*), kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinahumirwa kpwa aina zaidi ya mwenga za jenasi hino. Chiduruma na Chiswahili piya vina dzina *dzedza*, na Chiswahili piya china *kongwe chetu*. Mana ya *dzedza* taiandikpwa.

teaser.dg: *Chifumai* ni ndugu wa weruni wa mmea wa *coca*: chinamera matsakani ga pwani bila kumanyikana sana, na makodzage ganakatika chidide kpwenye ntsa.

summary.en: *Chifumai* is a shrub or small tree of the coastal forest, from the same genus as the South American coca plant. Its leaves have a characteristic small notch at the tip.
summary.sw: *Chifumai* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa msitu wa pwani, wa jenasi ile ile ya mmea wa koka wa Amerika Kusini. Majani yake yana kibonyeo kidogo cha kipekee kwenye ncha.
summary.dg: *Chifumai* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa matsaka ga pwani, wa jenasi mwenga na mmea wa *coca* wa Amerika ya Kusini. Alama ya makodzage ni kukatika chidide kpwenye ntsa.

about.en: *Erythroxylum emarginatum* is a shrub or small tree with smooth bark and alternate, oval leaves. The leaf tips are usually rounded and slightly notched, which gives the species its name *emarginatum*. The flowers are small and white, and the small oval fruits ripen red.
about.sw: *Erythroxylum emarginatum* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye gome laini na majani ya umbo la yai yanayopishana. Ncha za majani kwa kawaida ni za mviringo na zenye kibonyeo kidogo, na hilo ndilo linaloipa spishi hii jina lake *emarginatum*. Maua ni madogo na meupe, na matunda madogo ya umbo la yai huiva yakawa mekundu.
about.dg: *Erythroxylum emarginatum* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye gopha laini na makodza ga umbo ra tumbi, ganayomera kpwa kuphisana. Ntsa za makodza mara nyinji ni za mviringo na zinakatika chidide, na ndiko aina hino inakophahira dzinare *emarginatum*. Maruwa ni madide na mereru, na matunda madide ga umbo ra tumbi ganaivwa na kukala ga kundu.

about.en: *Chazaliella abrupta* is a small shrub or treelet of the coffee family with opposite, glossy leaves and small flowers in clusters, followed by small fleshy fruits.
about.sw: *Chazaliella abrupta* ni kichaka kidogo au kimti cha familia ya mibuni, chenye majani yanayoelekeana na yanayong'aa, na maua madogo yaliyo katika vishada, yanayofuatwa na matunda madogo yenye nyama.
about.dg: *Chazaliella abrupta* ni chitsaka chidide au muhi mdide wa jamii ya kahawa. Makodzage ganamera jozi-jozi ganalengana, na ganang'ala; maruwage ni madide na ganamera kpwa mafungu, na bada yao kunatuluka matunda madide genye nyama.

teaser.en: An acacia with powdery green-white or orange bark, and on some trees, swollen ant galls that whistle in the wind.
teaser.sw: Mgunga wenye gome la unga-unga la kijani-nyeupe au la machungwa, na kwenye miti mingine, vivimbe vya sisimizi vinavyopiga mluzi upepo unapovuma.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa miya (*acacia*) wenye gopha renye unga, ra rangi ya chijani na nyereru au ya chungbwa. Kpwa mihi yanjina, miya iriyofutuka ambamo nkukala sisimizi inapiga milozi phepho richivuma.

summary.en: *Chigundi* is a thorny, flat-topped savanna acacia known for its powdery, coloured bark and fluffy yellow flowers. Across East Africa it gives firewood, fodder and an edible gum.
summary.sw: *Chigundi* ni mgunga wa nyika wenye miiba na kilele bapa, unaojulikana kwa gome lake la unga-unga lenye rangi na maua yake ya manjano yaliyo kama pamba. Kote Afrika Mashariki hutoa kuni, lishe ya mifugo na ulimbo unaoliwa.
summary.dg: *Chigundi* ni muhi wa miya wa herera, wa jenasi ya *Acacia*, wenye chitswa chibapa dzulu. Chinamanyikana kpwa gophare renye unga na rangi, na kpwa maruwage laini dza pamba ga rangi ya mandano. Kpwenye Afrika ya Mashariki yosi chinalavya kuni, chakurya cha mifugo na ulimbo unaoriwa.

about.en: *Acacia seyal* (now often called *Vachellia seyal*) is a thorny tree up to about 10 m tall with an open, flat crown when mature. Its bark is distinctive: powdery, greenish-white to pale green or orange-red. The straight white thorns grow in pairs and can reach 8 cm. In one variety some thorns swell at the base into hollow galls lived in by ants, and wind blowing across the holes makes them whistle. The fluffy flower balls are bright yellow and fragrant, and the pods are narrow, curved and light brown.
about.sw: *Acacia seyal* (ambao sasa mara nyingi huitwa *Vachellia seyal*) ni mti wenye miiba unaofikia urefu wa takriban m 10, wenye taji wazi na bapa unapokomaa. Gome lake ni la kipekee: la unga-unga, rangi ya kijani-nyeupe hadi kijani hafifu au machungwa-nyekundu. Miiba yake myeupe iliyonyooka huota kwa jozi na inaweza kufikia sm 8. Katika aina moja, baadhi ya miiba huvimba kwenye kitako na kuwa vivimbe vyenye uwazi ndani vinavyokaliwa na sisimizi, na upepo unapovuma kupita kwenye matundu yake hupiga mluzi. Vishada vya maua vilivyo kama mipira ya pamba ni vya manjano angavu na vyenye harufu nzuri, na maganda ni membamba, yaliyopinda na ya rangi ya hudhurungi hafifu.
about.dg: *Acacia seyal* (sambi mara nyinji unaihwa *Vachellia seyal*) ni muhi wa miya wa hadi mita 10 phephi, na uchikula unakala na chitswa chibapa na chiwazi. Gophare ni ra tafwauti: rina unga, na rangiye ni ya chijani na nyereru hadi chijani ngushu-ngushu, au ya chungbwa na kundu. Miyaye nyereru isiyomyoka inamera jozi-jozi na inaweza kufika sentimita 8. Kpwa aina mwenga, miya yanjina inafutuka kotsini na kukala na pango ndani, ambamo nkukala sisimizi; phepho richitsupa dzulu ya matundu iga, miya inapiga milozi. Maruwage ni ga duara, laini dza pamba, ga rangi ya mandano inayong'ala na genye arufu nono, na makakayage ni membamba, ganamyoka na ni ga rangi ya dongo ngushu-ngushu.

where.en: It is a typical savanna acacia, found widely from West Africa to Egypt and south to Zimbabwe. In Kenya it grows in bushed grassland and woodland, especially on seasonally flooded plains and black-cotton soils.
where.sw: Ni mgunga wa kawaida wa nyika, unaopatikana kwa wingi kuanzia Afrika Magharibi hadi Misri na kusini hadi Zimbabwe. Nchini Kenya huota katika nyika za nyasi zenye vichaka na misitu ya wazi, hasa kwenye tambarare zinazofurika kwa msimu na udongo wa pamba nyeusi (black-cotton).
where.dg: Ni muhi wa miya wa kawaida wa herera, unaophahikana hadi kure, kula Afrika ya Magharibi hadi Misiri, na kusini hadi Zimbabwe. Kpwa Kenya chinamera kpwenye nyasi zenye vitsaka na weruni wenye mihi, zaidi kpwenye herera zinazodzala madzi wakati wa mvula na kpwenye ulongo mwiru.

uses.en: ICRAF records that across Kenya the tree is used for firewood, charcoal, poles and posts, and its leaves, pods and flowers feed goats and camels. It produces a clear, edible gum that is sold, and its thorny branches make dead fences. Its bark has been used for medicine, tea, tannin and dye. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: ICRAF inaeleza kwamba kote Kenya mti huu hutumika kwa kuni, makaa, nguzo na milingoti, na majani, maganda na maua yake hulisha mbuzi na ngamia. Hutoa ulimbo safi unaoliwa ambao huuzwa, na matawi yake yenye miiba hutumika kutengenezea uzio wa matawi makavu. Gome lake limetumika kwa dawa, chai, utomvu wa kutia rangi ngozi (tannin) na rangi. Pakia hakuandika matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo.
uses.dg: ICRAF inaandika kukala kpwenye Kenya yosi muhi uhu nkuhumirwa kpwa kuni, makala, viguzo na nguzo, na makodzage, makakayage na maruwage nkurisa mbuzi na ngamia. Unalavya ulimbo wa kung'ala unaoriwa, ambao nkuguzwa, na pandaze zenye miya nkuhenda lichigo. Gophare rahumirwa kpwa dawa, chai, tanini na rangi. Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records *chigundi*, with the English names 'white galled acacia' and 'whistling thorn tree'. ICRAF gives the Swahili name *mgunga* and the English 'white-thorn acacia'. *Mgunga* is also the Digo name Pakia gives to another acacia, *Acacia stuhlmannii*. Mgombato has a similar name, *chigundi-gundi*, but for a different tree, the Egyptian thorn (*Acacia nilotica*).
names.sw: Pakia ameandika *chigundi*, pamoja na majina ya Kiingereza *white galled acacia* na *whistling thorn tree*. ICRAF inatoa jina la Kiswahili *mgunga* na la Kiingereza *white-thorn acacia*. *Mgunga* pia ni jina la Kidigo ambalo Pakia analitoa kwa mgunga mwingine, *Acacia stuhlmannii*. Mgombato ina jina linalofanana, *chigundi-gundi*, lakini kwa mti tofauti, *Egyptian thorn* (*Acacia nilotica*).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chigundi*, phamwenga na madzina ga Chingereza 'white galled acacia' na 'whistling thorn tree'. ICRAF inalavya dzina ra Chiswahili *mgunga* na ra Chingereza 'white-thorn acacia'. *Mgunga* piya ni dzina ra Chidigo ambaro Pakia anarihumira kpwa *acacia* yanjina, *Acacia stuhlmannii*. Mgombato ina dzina rinalohalana, *chigundi-gundi*, ela ni ra muhi wanjina, *Egyptian thorn* (*Acacia nilotica*).

teaser.en: Named after the gall bladder because it is so bitter, and its seeds hang in a neat row under each leaf.

summary.en: *Chihumbo utsungu* is a tiny, bitter weed whose fruits line up beneath its leafy branchlets. Both its Digo names come from things you can see or taste.
summary.sw: *Chihumbo utsungu* ni gugu dogo sana na chungu, ambalo matunda yake hupangana chini ya vitawi vyake vyenye majani. Majina yake yote mawili ya Kidigo yanatokana na mambo yanayoonekana au kuonjwa.
summary.dg: *Chihumbo utsungu* ni mbondo mdide sana wa utsungu, ambao matundage ganakala mstari photsi ya panda ndide zenye makodza. Madzinage mairi ga Chidigo ganalavywa kula vitu vinavyoonekana kpwa matso au vinavyomanyikana kpwa lilimi.

about.en: *Phyllanthus amarus* is a small, upright annual herb, usually under 50 cm tall. Its side branches carry two neat rows of tiny oval leaves, so each one looks like a single feathery compound leaf. Tiny greenish flowers and then small round fruits hang in a row underneath, along the branchlet. The whole plant tastes very bitter, and *amarus* means bitter in Latin. Digo identify it by the look of the whole plant.
about.sw: *Phyllanthus amarus* ni mmea mdogo wa msimu mmoja unaosimama wima, kwa kawaida chini ya sm 50 kwa urefu. Matawi yake ya pembeni hubeba safu mbili nadhifu za majani madogo sana ya umbo la yai, kwa hiyo kila tawi huonekana kama jani moja la mchanganyiko lililo kama unyoya. Maua madogo sana ya rangi ya kijani, na baadaye matunda madogo ya mviringo, huning'inia kwa mstari upande wa chini, kufuata kitawi. Mmea mzima una ladha chungu sana, na *amarus* maana yake ni chungu kwa Kilatini. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg: *Phyllanthus amarus* ni mmea mdide unaoima chocho, unaokala na moyo kpwa mwaka mmwenga tu, na mara nyinji tauzidi sentimita 50. Pandaze za kanda-kanda zina mistari miiri sawa-sawa ya makodza madide sana ga umbo ra tumbi, kpwa hivyo chila panda inaonekana dza kodza rimwenga renye makodza madide manji dza nyoya. Maruwa madide sana ga rangi ya chijani, na bada yao matunda madide ga duara, ganabwadzika mstari photsi ya panda ndide, kulunga urewe. Mmea wosi una utsungu sana, na *amarus* manage ni 'utsungu' kpwa Chilatini. Adigo anaumanya kpwa kulola umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It is a common weed of farms, gardens, roadsides and waste ground throughout the tropics.
where.sw: Ni gugu la kawaida la mashambani, bustanini, kando ya barabara na kwenye ardhi isiyotumika kote katika maeneo ya tropiki.
where.dg: Ni mbondo wa kawaida wa minda, busitani, kanda-kanda ya njira na phatu phasiporimwa, kpwenye tsi zosi za dzoho.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere in the tropics the plant is widely used in herbal medicine, especially for liver complaints, fevers and kidney stones; the English name 'stonebreaker' comes from that.
uses.sw: Pakia hakuandika matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Kwingineko katika maeneo ya tropiki mmea huu hutumika sana katika tiba ya mitishamba, hasa kwa matatizo ya ini, homa na mawe ya figo; jina la Kiingereza *stonebreaker* ('mvunja mawe') linatokana na hilo.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Kpwenye tsi zanjina za dzoho mmea uhu nkuhumirwa sana kpwa dawa za chienyeji, zaidi kpwa makongo ga ini, homa na mawe ga figo; dzina ra Chingereza 'stonebreaker' ('chivundza mawe') rinalavywa kula phapho.

names.en: *Chihumbo utsungu* is the Digo word for the gall bladder. Mgombato glosses it in Swahili as *mfuko wa nyongo*. Pakia explains that the plant is named after the gall bladder because of its bitter taste (*utsungu*, bitterness), much as *mtsunga wa utsungu*, the bitter vegetable, is named for its taste. The second name, *mvyarira nyuma*, means 'producing from behind': the plant bears (*vyala*) its fruits at the back (*nyuma*) of the leaves. Its relative *Phyllanthus reticulatus* is called *mkpwamba lungo*.
names.sw: *Chihumbo utsungu* ni neno la Kidigo la mfuko wa nyongo. Mgombato analieleza kwa Kiswahili kama *mfuko wa nyongo*. Pakia anaeleza kwamba mmea huu umepewa jina la mfuko wa nyongo kwa sababu ya ladha yake chungu (*utsungu*, uchungu), kama vile *mtsunga wa utsungu*, mboga chungu, ulivyopewa jina kutokana na ladha yake. Jina la pili, *mvyarira nyuma*, maana yake ni 'unaozaa kwa nyuma': mmea huzaa (*vyala*) matunda yake upande wa nyuma (*nyuma*) wa majani. Jamaa yake *Phyllanthus reticulatus* huitwa *mkpwamba lungo*.
names.dg: *Chihumbo utsungu* ni neno ra Chidigo ra chifuko cha nyongo. Mgombato inarielezera kpwa Chiswahili dza *mfuko wa nyongo*. Pakia anaeleza kukala mmea uhu ukaihwa dzina ra chifuko cha nyongo kpwa sababu ya utsunguwe (*utsungu*), dza vira *mtsunga wa utsungu*, mboga ya utsungu, ulivyoihwa kpwa ladhaye. Dzina ra phiri, *mvyarira nyuma*, maneno kpwa maneno ni 'unaovyala kula nyuma': mmea unavyala (*vyala*) matundage nyuma (*nyuma*) ya makodza. Nduguye *Phyllanthus reticulatus* unaihwa *mkpwamba lungo*.

teaser.en: Hooked thorns that grab like a leopard's claws: Digo named this scrambling acacia for exactly that.
teaser.sw: Miiba iliyopinda kama ndoano inayonasa kama makucha ya chui: Wadigo waliupa mgunga huu unaotambaa jina kwa sababu hiyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Miya iriyomyoka inayogbwira dza kombe za tsui: kpwa sababu hiyo hiyo Adigo akachiiha chitsaka hichi cha *acacia* chinachoambala dzina hiri.

summary.en: *Chikombe tsui*, 'leopard's claws', is a scrambling, prickly acacia of the coastal bush. Digo give the same name to a thorny caper bush because the two share the same claw-like thorns.
summary.sw: *Chikombe tsui*, 'makucha ya chui', ni mgunga unaotambaa wenye miiba, wa vichaka vya pwani. Wadigo hukipa kichaka cha jamii ya caper chenye miiba jina hilo hilo kwa sababu vyote viwili vina miiba ile ile kama makucha.
summary.dg: *Chikombe tsui*, 'kombe za tsui', ni chitsaka cha *acacia* chenye miya chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina kpwenye vitsaka vya pwani. Adigo anachiiha dzina hiro hiro chitsaka cha *caper* chenye miya, kpwa sababu viiri vina miya iriyomyoka sawa na kombe.

about.en: *Acacia adenocalyx* (now *Senegalia adenocalyx*) is a climbing or scrambling shrub armed with small, sharply hooked prickles that catch on skin and clothing. Like other acacias it has feathery, twice-divided leaves, small flowers in spikes or heads, and flat pods. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Acacia adenocalyx* (sasa *Senegalia adenocalyx*) ni kichaka kinachopanda au kutambaa, kilichojaa miiba midogo iliyopinda kama ndoano kwa ukali, inayonasa ngozi na nguo. Kama migunga mingine, kina majani yaliyo kama manyoya yaliyogawanyika mara mbili, maua madogo katika vishada virefu au vichwa, na maganda bapa. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Acacia adenocalyx* (sambi *Senegalia adenocalyx*) ni chitsaka chinachofyombera au chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, chenye miya midide yenye ntsa kali iriyomyoka, inayogbwira ngozi na nguwo. Dza *acacia* zanjina, china makodza ga dza nyoya ganayoganyika mara mbiri, maruwa madide ganamera kpwa milita au kpwa mafungu ga duara, na makakaya mabapa. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and thicket in Kenya, Tanzania and Mozambique.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani nchini Kenya, Tanzania na Msumbiji.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye vitsaka na matsaka mafupi ga pwani kpwa Kenya, Tanzania na Msumbiji.

culture.en: Pakia uses *chikombe tsui* as an example of how Digo group plants. A single folk name covers two quite different plants, this acacia and the caper bush *Capparis viminea*, because both have the same claw-like thorns. Unlike plants grouped because they share a use, the two are not used in the same way. Digo also put it among the *miya*, their general category for thorny plants.
culture.sw: Pakia anatumia *chikombe tsui* kama mfano wa jinsi Wadigo wanavyopanga mimea katika makundi. Jina moja la kienyeji linajumuisha mimea miwili tofauti kabisa, mgunga huu na kichaka cha jamii ya caper *Capparis viminea*, kwa sababu yote miwili ina miiba ile ile kama makucha. Tofauti na mimea inayowekwa pamoja kwa sababu ya matumizi yanayofanana, mimea hii miwili haitumiki kwa njia moja. Wadigo pia huuweka miongoni mwa *miya*, kundi lao la jumla la mimea yenye miiba.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira *chikombe tsui* dza mfwano wa namna Adigo anavyoganya mimea kpwa makundi. Dzina mwenga ra chienyeji rinahusu mimea miiri tafwauti sana, *acacia* ihi na chitsaka cha *caper*, *Capparis viminea*, kpwa sababu yosi miiri ina miya ya kuhalana dza kombe. Tafwauti na mimea inayoikpwa phamwenga kpwa sababu ya matumizi ga kuhalana, mimea hino miiri taihumirwa kpwa njira mwenga. Adigo piya anachiika kahi ya *miya*, kundi rao kulu ra mimea yosi yenye miya.

names.en: *Chikombe tsui* means 'claws of a leopard': its thorns are likened to the claws (*kombe*) of a leopard (*tsui*). The name is shared with Swahili. Pakia also records *chinyakore*, pronounced *chinyakole* by southern Digo, as an example of how names differ between northern and southern Digo. One passage in his text links *chikombe tsui* to *Acacia mellifera*, a different tree that the existing reference calls *chikwata kombe*.
names.sw: *Chikombe tsui* maana yake ni 'makucha ya chui': miiba yake inafananishwa na makucha (*kombe*) ya chui (*tsui*). Jina hili linashirikiwa na Kiswahili. Pakia pia ameandika *chinyakore*, linalotamkwa *chinyakole* na Wadigo wa kusini, kama mfano wa jinsi majina yanavyotofautiana kati ya Wadigo wa kaskazini na wa kusini. Kifungu kimoja katika maandishi yake kinahusisha *chikombe tsui* na *Acacia mellifera*, mti tofauti ambao marejeo yaliyopo yanauita *chikwata kombe*.
names.dg: *Chikombe tsui* manage ni 'kombe za tsui': miyaye ni dza kombe (*kombe*) za tsui (*tsui*). Dzina hiri ni sawa na ra Chiswahili. Pakia piya anaandika *chinyakore*, ambaro Adigo a kusini anarigomba *chinyakole*, dza mfwano wa namna madzina ganavyotafwautiana kahi ya Adigo a kaskazini na a kusini. Phatu phamwenga kpwenye chitabuche, Pakia anahusisha *chikombe tsui* na *Acacia mellifera*, muhi wanjina ambao kpwenye maelezo garigokalapho unaihwa *chikwata kombe*.

teaser.en: A caper bush that Digo lump with an acacia under one name, simply because both claw at you the same way.

teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha *caper* ambacho Adigo anachiika phamwenga na *acacia* kpwa dzina mwenga, kpwa sababu tu viiri vinakugbwira kpwa miya dza kombe.

summary.en: This scrambling caper bush shares the name *chikombe tsui*, 'leopard's claws', with a thorny acacia. The two are grouped for their hooked thorns, not because they are related or used the same way.
summary.sw: Kichaka hiki kinachotambaa cha jamii ya caper kinashiriki jina *chikombe tsui*, 'makucha ya chui', na mgunga wenye miiba. Viwili hivi vimewekwa pamoja kwa sababu ya miiba yao iliyopinda kama ndoano, si kwa sababu vina uhusiano wala vinatumika kwa njia moja.
summary.dg: Chitsaka hichi cha *caper* chinachoambala chinaihwa *chikombe tsui*, 'kombe za tsui', sawa na *acacia* yenye miya. Viiri vinaikpwa phamwenga kpwa sababu ya miya yao iriyomyoka, si kpwa sababu ni ndugu wala kpwa sababu vinahumirwa kpwa njira mwenga.

about.en: *Capparis viminea* is a scrambling or climbing shrub of the caper family. It has pairs of short, hooked spines at the base of the leaf stalks and simple, leathery leaves. Its white flowers have a showy brush of long stamens, and its fruits are small, round berries. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Capparis viminea* ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda, cha familia ya caper. Kina jozi za miiba mifupi iliyopinda kama ndoano kwenye kitako cha vikonyo vya majani, na majani sahili yaliyo magumu kama ngozi. Maua yake meupe yana kishungi cha kuvutia cha stameni ndefu, na matunda yake ni beri ndogo za mviringo. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Capparis viminea* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya *caper* chinachoambala au chinachofyombera dzulu ya mimea yanjina. China miya mifupi iriyomyoka, jozi-jozi, kotsi ya mlita wa chila kodza, na makodza ga kawaida mafu dza chingo. Maruwage mereru gana stameni nyire nyinji zinazoonekana sana dza chifungu cha nyuzi, na matundage ni madide, ga duara na genye nyama. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and thicket in East Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye vitsaka na matsaka mafupi ga pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki.

culture.en: Pakia explains that Digo sometimes group plants from completely different families under one name. *Chikombe tsui* covers this caper bush and the acacia *Acacia adenocalyx* because both carry claw-like thorns. Plants grouped by shape like this are not used in the same way, unlike groups based on a shared use.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba wakati mwingine Wadigo huweka mimea ya familia tofauti kabisa chini ya jina moja. *Chikombe tsui* linajumuisha kichaka hiki cha jamii ya caper na mgunga *Acacia adenocalyx* kwa sababu vyote viwili vina miiba kama makucha. Mimea inayowekwa pamoja kwa umbo kama hivi haitumiki kwa njia moja, tofauti na makundi yanayotokana na matumizi yanayofanana.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala wakati wanjina Adigo anaika mimea ya jamii tafwauti kabisa phamwenga kpwa dzina mwenga. *Chikombe tsui* rinahumirwa kpwa chitsaka hichi cha *caper* na kpwa *acacia*, *Acacia adenocalyx*, kpwa sababu viiri vina miya dza kombe. Mimea inayoikpwa phamwenga kpwa sababu ya umbo dza hivi taihumirwa kpwa njira mwenga, tafwauti na makundi ganagoikpwa phamwenga kpwa sababu ya matumizi mamwenga.

teaser.en: A 'little sisal' that is really an arum, sending its leaves straight up from a buried rhizome.
teaser.sw: 'Mkonge mdogo' ambao kwa kweli ni wa familia ya majimbi, unaochipua majani yake moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye kiazi (shina la chini ya ardhi) kilichozikwa.
teaser.dg: 'Konje dide' ambaro kpwa kpweli ni mmea wa jamii ya *arum*: makodzage ganatuluka chocho dzulu kula kpwa *rhizome* iriyo tsini ya ulongo.

summary.en: *Chikonje* is a small arum whose leaves rise straight from the ground. Digo named it after sisal, which it resembles in a small way.
summary.sw: *Chikonje* ni mmea mdogo wa familia ya majimbi ambao majani yake huchipua moja kwa moja kutoka ardhini. Wadigo waliupa jina la mkonge, ambao unafanana nao kwa udogo.
summary.dg: *Chikonje* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya *arum*, ambao makodzage ganatuluka chocho kula photsi. Adigo akauiha dzina kula *konje*, kpwa sababu unahalana naro, ela ni mdide.

about.en: *Stylochaeton salaamicus* is a perennial herb of the arum family. It grows from an underground rhizome, and its arrow-shaped leaves come straight up out of the soil on long stalks. Its flowers are packed onto a short spike inside a hooded spathe that sits at or just below ground level, often hidden among the leaf bases.
about.sw: *Stylochaeton salaamicus* ni mmea mdogo wa kudumu wa familia ya majimbi. Huota kutoka kwenye kiazi (shina la chini ya ardhi), na majani yake ya umbo la mshale huchipua moja kwa moja kutoka udongoni juu ya vikonyo virefu. Maua yake yamesongamana kwenye kishada kifupi ndani ya ganda la ua lenye umbo la kofia (spathe) lililo kwenye usawa wa ardhi au chini kidogo yake, mara nyingi likiwa limejificha kati ya vitako vya majani.
about.dg: *Stylochaeton salaamicus* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya *arum* unaokala na moyo kpwa miaka minji. Unamera kula kpwa *rhizome*, muhi uriokala tsini ya ulongo, na makodzage ga umbo ra hondza ganatuluka chocho kula ulongoni kpwa milita mire. Maruwage ganakala phamwenga kpwenye mlita mfupi, ndani ya chifwiniko (*spathe*) dza kofiya, chinachokala sawa na photsi au tsini chidide, na mara nyinji chinafitsika kahi ya kotsi za makodza.

where.en: It is found in Kenya and Tanzania, in coastal bush and thicket.
where.sw: Unapatikana nchini Kenya na Tanzania, katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani.
where.dg: Chinaphahikana Kenya na Tanzania, kpwenye vitsaka na matsaka mafupi ga pwani.

names.en: *Chikonje* means 'small sisal'. Pakia explains that the plant resembles *konje*, sisal (*Agave sisalana*), and the prefix *chi-* marks its smaller size. He also records a second name, *nyaa*, which he writes *chinyaa* in his naming notes, and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. Another plant named after sisal is *konje tsaka*, 'forest sisal' (*Sansevieria kirkii*).
names.sw: *Chikonje* maana yake ni 'mkonge mdogo'. Pakia anaeleza kwamba mmea huu unafanana na *konje*, mkonge (*Agave sisalana*), na kiambishi *chi-* kinaonyesha udogo wake. Pia ameandika jina la pili, *nyaa*, ambalo katika maelezo yake kuhusu majina analiandika *chinyaa*, na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Mmea mwingine uliopewa jina la mkonge ni *konje tsaka*, 'mkonge wa msituni' (*Sansevieria kirkii*).
names.dg: *Chikonje* manage ni 'konje dide'. Pakia anaeleza kukala mmea uhu unahalana na *konje* (*Agave sisalana*), na *chi-* iriyo mwandzo wa dzina inaonyesa kukala ni mdide kuriko konje. Piya anaandika dzina ranjina, *nyaa*, ambaro anariandika *chinyaa* kpwenye maelezoge ga madzina, na anariika kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage. Mmea wanjina uriohewa dzina kula *konje* ni *konje tsaka*, 'konje ra tsaka' (*Sansevieria kirkii*).

reason.dg: *Sansevieria*, mmea wanjina unaohalana na konje

teaser.en: The 'male' chikunguni, a tree paired by name with a quite different forest tree.
teaser.sw: *Chikunguni* 'dume', mti uliounganishwa kwa jina na mti tofauti kabisa wa msituni.
teaser.dg: *Chikunguni* 'chilume', muhi unaoikpwa phamwenga kpwa dzina na muhi wanjina wa tsaka tafwauti kabisa.

summary.en: *Chikunguni chilume* is a tree of the spike-thorn family that Digo count as the male form of *chikunguni*. Pakia says the reason for the pairing isn't clear.
summary.sw: *Chikunguni chilume* ni mti wa familia ya spike-thorn (Celastraceae) ambao Wadigo huuhesabu kuwa umbo la dume la *chikunguni*. Pakia anasema sababu ya kuiunganisha hivyo haiko wazi.
summary.dg: *Chikunguni chilume* ni muhi wa jamii ya *spike-thorn* ambao Adigo anauona kukala ni mlume wa *chikunguni*. Pakia anagomba kukala sababu ya kuviika phamwenga taimanyikana.

about.en: *Elaeodendron schweinfurthianum* is a shrub or tree with smooth, leathery, often toothed leaves, small greenish flowers in clusters and fleshy, olive-like fruits with a hard stone.
about.sw: *Elaeodendron schweinfurthianum* ni kichaka au mti wenye majani laini, magumu kama ngozi, ambayo mara nyingi yana meno kwenye kingo, maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani katika vishada, na matunda yenye nyama yanayofanana na zeituni, yenye kokwa ngumu.
about.dg: *Elaeodendron schweinfurthianum* ni chitsaka au muhi wenye makodza laini, mafu dza chingo, na mara nyinji genye meno kanda-kanda; maruwa madide ga rangi ya chijani ganamera kpwa mafungu, na matunda genye nyama ganayohalana na zeituni, ambago chila rimwenga rina tembe ngumu ndani.

where.en: It grows in bushland, woodland and forest edges in East Africa, including the coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka, misitu ya wazi na pembezoni mwa misitu katika Afrika Mashariki, ikiwemo pwani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka, weruni wenye mihi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka kpwa Afrika ya Mashariki, hata pwani.

names.en: *Chikunguni chilume* means 'male chikunguni'. Digo count it as the male form of *chikunguni*, the forest tree *Craibia brevicaudata*. Pakia notes that *kunguni* means bedbug, but neither the link with the bedbug nor the reason this species counts as male is clear. Pakia's main text also gives *chikunguni* for a third tree, *Ludia mauritiana*.
names.sw: *Chikunguni chilume* maana yake ni '*chikunguni* dume'. Wadigo huuhesabu kuwa umbo la dume la *chikunguni*, mti wa msituni *Craibia brevicaudata*. Pakia anaeleza kwamba *kunguni* maana yake ni kunguni (mdudu wa kitandani), lakini uhusiano na kunguni wala sababu ya spishi hii kuhesabiwa kuwa dume haviko wazi. Maandishi makuu ya Pakia pia yanatoa *chikunguni* kwa mti wa tatu, *Ludia mauritiana*.
names.dg: *Chikunguni chilume* manage ni '*chikunguni* cha chilume'. Adigo anauona kukala ni mlume wa *chikunguni*, muhi wa tsaka *Craibia brevicaudata*. Pakia anaandika kukala *kunguni* ni dzina ra mdudu *kunguni*, ela taimanyikana sababu ya kuuhusisha muhi uhu na kunguni, wala sababu ya muhi uhu kuonekana ni mlume. Kpwenye maelezo makulu ga chitabuche, Pakia piya analavya dzina *chikunguni* kpwa muhi wa hahu, *Ludia mauritiana*.

teaser.en: On a dewy morning walk, a branch of this plant was used to knock the wet off the grass ahead.
teaser.sw: Katika matembezi ya asubuhi yenye umande, tawi la mmea huu lilitumiwa kupiga nyasi zilizo mbele ili kuondoa unyevu.
teaser.dg: Atu achiphiya ligundzu na nyasi zina manena, panda ya mmea uhu yahumirwa kupiga nyasi za mbere ili kuusa manena.

summary.en: *Chikuta manena* is a climbing shrub whose name records an everyday habit: people beat the grass with its branches to knock off the morning dew.
summary.sw: *Chikuta manena* ni kichaka kinachopanda ambacho jina lake linahifadhi desturi ya kila siku: watu hupiga nyasi kwa matawi yake ili kukung'uta umande wa asubuhi.
summary.dg: *Chikuta manena* ni chitsaka chinachofyombera, ambacho dzinare rinaonyesa dzambo ra chila siku: atu nkupiga nyasi kpwa pandaze ili kuusa manena ga ligundzu.

about.en: *Rourea orientalis* is a scrambling or climbing shrub with pinnate leaves of several pairs of leaflets. Its new growth is often reddish. Its small, fragrant flowers grow in clusters, and its fruits are small pods that split to show a seed with a fleshy coat.
about.sw: *Rourea orientalis* ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda, chenye majani yaliyogawanyika kuwa jozi kadhaa za vijani. Machipukizi yake mapya mara nyingi huwa na rangi nyekundu. Maua yake madogo yenye harufu nzuri huota katika vishada, na matunda yake ni maganda madogo yanayopasuka na kuonyesha mbegu yenye ganda lenye nyama.
about.dg: *Rourea orientalis* ni chitsaka chinachoambala au chinachofyombera dzulu ya mimea yanjina, chenye makodza ganayoganyika dza nyoya kpwa jozi chache za makodza madide. Makodza maphya mara nyinji ni ga kundu chidide. Maruwage madide genye arufu nono ganamera kpwa mafungu, na matundage ni makakaya madide ganayoahuka na kuonyesa tembe yenye chifwiniko cha nyama.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in East Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki.

uses.en: Pakia records that its branches are used to beat the grass along a path, to clear off the dew before walking through on morning errands.
uses.sw: Pakia ameandika kwamba matawi yake hutumika kupiga nyasi kando ya njia, ili kuondoa umande kabla ya kupita katika shughuli za asubuhi.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala pandaze nkuhumirwa kupiga nyasi kanda-kanda ya njira, ili kuusa manena kabla ya kutsupa phapho mutu achiphiya kazi za ligundzu.

names.en: *Chikuta manena* means 'clears the dew': its branches are used to hit (*kuta*) the grass and knock off the dew (*manena*). A different plant, *Synaptolepis kirkii*, is called *mkuta manena*. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chikuta manena* maana yake ni 'kinachoondoa umande': matawi yake hutumika kupiga (*kuta*) nyasi na kukung'uta umande (*manena*). Mmea tofauti, *Synaptolepis kirkii*, huitwa *mkuta manena*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: *Chikuta manena* manage ni 'chinachousa manena': pandaze nkuhumirwa kupiga (*kuta*) nyasi na kuusa manena (*manena*). Mmea wanjina, *Synaptolepis kirkii*, unaihwa *mkuta manena*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: A climbing relative of the monkey oranges, from the same genus that gives strychnine.
teaser.sw: Jamaa anayepanda wa mikwakwa (monkey oranges), kutoka jenasi ile ile inayotoa sumu ya strychnine.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaofyombera, ndugu wa mihi ya *monkey orange*, wa jenasi ihi ihi inayolavya sumu ya *strychnine*.

summary.en: *Chikwakwa* is a climbing *Strychnos* of the coastal forests, related to the monkey oranges. Pakia records the name but no uses.
summary.sw: *Chikwakwa* ni *Strychnos* inayopanda ya misitu ya pwani, jamaa wa mikwakwa. Pakia ameandika jina lake lakini si matumizi yoyote.
summary.dg: *Chikwakwa* ni mmea wa jenasi ya *Strychnos* unaofyombera, wa matsaka ga pwani, ndugu wa mihi ya *monkey orange*. Pakia anaandika dzinare, ela kaandika matumizige.

about.en: *Strychnos panganensis* is a woody climber or scrambling shrub of the genus that includes the monkey oranges. Like many climbing *Strychnos*, it has opposite leaves with three to five veins running from the base, and it may climb using hooked tendrils. Its fruits are round berries. Many *Strychnos* species contain poisonous alkaloids.
about.sw: *Strychnos panganensis* ni mtambaaji wenye miti au kichaka kinachotambaa, wa jenasi inayojumuisha mikwakwa. Kama *Strychnos* nyingi zinazopanda, ina majani yanayoelekeana yenye mishipa mitatu hadi mitano inayoanzia kwenye kitako, na huenda ikapanda kwa kutumia vikamba vilivyopinda kama ndoano. Matunda yake ni beri za mviringo. Spishi nyingi za *Strychnos* zina alkaloidi zenye sumu.
about.dg: *Strychnos panganensis* ni mmea wa nyama za muhi unaofyombera, au chitsaka chinachoambala, wa jenasi ambayo ina mihi ya *monkey orange*. Dza *Strychnos* nyinji zinazofyombera, makodzage ganalengana na gana mishipa mihahu hadi mitsano inayotuluka kula kotsi ya kodza, na unaweza kufyombera kpwa kuhumira vigongo vyembamba vyenye ntsa iriyomyoka. Matundage ni ga duara genye nyama. Aina nyinji za *Strychnos* zina kemikali za sumu (*alkaloids*).

where.en: It grows in the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ga Kenya na Tanzania.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chikwakwa*, writing the species as *Strychnos pangenesis*. The name looks like a small form of *mkwakwa*, the Swahili name for the black monkey orange (*mkpwakpwa* in Digo), which is in the same genus. Pakia doesn't explain the name, so that link is a guess.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chikwakwa*, akiiandika spishi hii kama *Strychnos pangenesis*. Jina hili linaonekana kuwa umbo dogo la *mkwakwa*, jina la Kiswahili la mkwakwa mweusi (black monkey orange; *mkpwakpwa* kwa Kidigo), ulio katika jenasi ile ile. Pakia haelezi jina hili, kwa hiyo uhusiano huo ni wa kukisia tu.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chikwakwa*, na anaandika aina ihi dza *Strychnos pangenesis*. Dzina rinaonekana dza *mkwakwa* mdide; *mkwakwa* ni dzina ra Chiswahili ra *black monkey orange* (kpwa Chidigo *mkpwakpwa*), ambao ni wa jenasi ihi ihi. Pakia kaeleza manage ga dzina hiri, kpwa hivyo uhusiano uho ni wa kukisiya tu.
