teaser.en: A leathery-leaved climbing shrub found only on the coast of Kenya and Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kinachopanda chenye majani magumu kama ngozi, kinachopatikana tu kwenye pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chinachofyombera, chenye makodza mafu dza chingo, chinachophahikana pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania tu.

summary.en: *Chikwalakwala* is a climbing shrub of the coastal belt with tough, leathery leaves. Pakia records its name but no uses or meaning.
summary.sw: *Chikwalakwala* ni kichaka kinachopanda cha ukanda wa pwani, chenye majani magumu kama ngozi. Pakia ameandika jina lake lakini si matumizi wala maana yake.
summary.dg: *Chikwalakwala* ni chitsaka chinachofyombera cha seemu ya pwani, chenye makodza magumu, mafu dza chingo. Pakia anaandika dzinare, ela kaandika matumizige wala manage.

about.en: *Dichapetalum arenarium* is a climbing shrub or liana with leathery, elliptic to oval leaves 6 to 11 cm long. Its flowers are small and its fruits are small, hairy drupes, as in other *Dichapetalum*. Several *Dichapetalum* species are highly poisonous to livestock, but there is no such record for this one.
about.sw: *Dichapetalum arenarium* ni kichaka kinachopanda au mtambaaji mkubwa wenye majani magumu kama ngozi, ya umbo la duaradufu hadi yai, yenye urefu wa sm 6 hadi 11. Maua yake ni madogo na matunda yake ni matunda madogo yenye kokwa na manyoya, kama ilivyo kwa *Dichapetalum* nyingine. Spishi kadhaa za *Dichapetalum* ni sumu kali kwa mifugo, lakini hakuna kumbukumbu kama hiyo kwa spishi hii.
about.dg: *Dichapetalum arenarium* ni chitsaka chinachofyombera, au mmea mure wa nyama za muhi unaofyombera mihi, wenye makodza mafu dza chingo ga umbo ra tumbi, garigo marefu chidide au ga duara, ga sentimita 6 hadi 11 kpwa ure. Maruwage ni madide, na matundage ni madide, genye nyere, genye nyama na tembe ngumu ndani, dza ga *Dichapetalum* zanjina. Aina chache za *Dichapetalum* zina sumu kali kpwa mifugo, ela takuna habari dza hiyo kpwa aina ihi.

where.en: It is found only from south-east Kenya to eastern Tanzania and Zanzibar, in the seasonally dry coastal belt. *Arenarium* means 'of sand', suggesting it grows in sandy places.
where.sw: Hupatikana tu kuanzia kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya hadi mashariki mwa Tanzania na Zanzibar, katika ukanda wa pwani wenye ukame wa msimu. *Arenarium* maana yake ni 'wa mchanga', jambo linaloashiria kwamba huota mahali penye mchanga.
where.dg: Chinaphahikana tu kula kusini-mashariki ya Kenya hadi mashariki ya Tanzania na Zanzibar, kpwenye seemu ya pwani inayouma wakati wa kazikazi. *Arenarium* manage ni 'wa mtsanga', na vino vinaonyesa kukala chinamera phatu phenye mtsanga.

teaser.en: The tough, flat-stemmed grass in every footpath and compound, and the wild cousin of finger millet.
teaser.sw: Nyasi ngumu yenye mashina bapa iliyo katika kila njia na kila uwanja, na binamu wa porini wa wimbi.
teaser.dg: Nyasi ngumu zenye milita mibapa, zinazomera kpwenye chila njira na chila mhala, na ni ndugu wa tsaka wa *wimbi*.

summary.en: *Chimbikaya* is goosegrass, a tough, tufted weed of paths, compounds and fields. It is a wild relative of finger millet.
summary.sw: *Chimbikaya* ni nyasi inayoitwa kwa Kiingereza *goosegrass*, gugu gumu linaloota kwa mafungu kwenye njia, viwanja na mashamba. Ni jamaa wa porini wa wimbi.
summary.dg: *Chimbikaya* ni nyasi ngumu zinazomera fungu-fungu, mbondo wa njira, mhala na minda. Ni ndugu wa tsaka wa *wimbi*.

about.en: Goosegrass is a low, tufted annual grass with flattened, pale-whitish stems at the base, so tough they are hard to pull up. Its flower head is a set of two to seven narrow spikes spreading like the fingers of a hand from the top of the stem, much like a small, loose finger-millet head. The seeds are tiny and the root system is dense and fibrous, so the plant survives being trampled.
about.sw: Nyasi hii ni nyasi fupi ya msimu mmoja inayoota kwa mafungu, yenye mashina bapa ya rangi hafifu nyeupe-nyeupe kwenye kitako, magumu kiasi kwamba ni vigumu kuyang'oa. Kichwa chake cha maua ni seti ya vishada virefu vyembamba viwili hadi saba vinavyotawanyika kama vidole vya mkono kutoka juu ya shina, kama kichwa kidogo cha wimbi kilicholegea. Mbegu ni ndogo sana na mfumo wa mizizi ni mnene na wa nyuzi nyuzi, kwa hiyo mmea huu hustahimili kukanyagwa.
about.dg: *Chimbikaya* ni nyasi fupi zinazomera fungu-fungu, zinazokala na moyo kpwa mwaka mmwenga tu. Militaye ni mibapa na ya rangi nyereru ngushu-ngushu kotsini, na ni migumu sana hata ni vigumu kuing'ola. Chitswa cha maruwa ni milita miiri hadi sabaa myembamba inayotawanyika dza vyala vya mkpwono kula dzulu ya mlita, dza chitswa chidide cha *wimbi* chisichokala chizito. Tembe ni ndide sana, na mizi ni minji, mizito na ya nyuzi-nyuzi, kpwa hivyo mmea unasala na moyo hata uchikanyagbwa ni atu.

where.en: It grows almost everywhere in the tropics, on trodden ground: paths, compounds, roadsides, and in farms as a weed.
where.sw: Huota karibu kila mahali katika maeneo ya tropiki, kwenye ardhi inayokanyagwa: njia, viwanja, kando ya barabara, na mashambani kama gugu.
where.dg: Chinamera phephi chila phatu kpwenye tsi za dzoho, phatu atu anaphokanyaga: njira, mhala, kanda-kanda ya barabara, na mindani dza mbondo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chimbikaya* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. The English names are goosegrass or Indian goosegrass. Cultivated finger millet (*Eleusine coracana*) belongs to the same genus.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chimbikaya* na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *goosegrass* au *Indian goosegrass*. Wimbi linalolimwa (*Eleusine coracana*) ni wa jenasi ile ile.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chimbikaya* na anariika kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage. Madzina ga Chingereza ni *goosegrass* au *Indian goosegrass*. *Wimbi* inayorimwa (*Eleusine coracana*) ni ya jenasi ihi ihi.

teaser.sw: Gugu dogo ambalo wakulima hufurahi kuliona: linapoota, mavuno yatakuwa mazuri.
teaser.dg: Mbondo mdide ambao akurima nkuhererwa kuuona: phatu unaphomera, mavuno gandakala manono.

summary.en: *Chimvuno* is a *Leucas*, a small mint-family herb. Digo farmers read it as a sign that their crop will do well.
summary.sw: *Chimvuno* ni *Leucas*, mmea mdogo wa familia ya minanaa. Wakulima wa Kidigo hukiona kuwa ishara kwamba mazao yao yatastawi.
summary.dg: *Chimvuno* ni *Leucas*, mmea mdide wa jamii ya *mint*. Akurima Adigo anauona dza dalili kukala mimea yao indamera vinono.

about.en: *Leucas* species are herbs of the mint family with square stems, opposite leaves and white, two-lipped flowers whose upper lip is densely hairy. The flowers grow in round whorls spaced along the stem. Pakia identified *chimvuno* only to the genus, so the exact species isn't known.
about.sw: Spishi za *Leucas* ni mimea midogo ya familia ya minanaa yenye mashina ya pembe nne, majani yanayoelekeana na maua meupe yenye midomo miwili, ambayo mdomo wake wa juu una manyoya mengi. Maua huota katika duara za mviringo zilizoachana kando ya shina. Pakia alikitambua *chimvuno* hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, kwa hiyo spishi yake kamili haijulikani.
about.dg: Aina za *Leucas* ni mimea midide ya jamii ya *mint*, yenye milita ya pembe nne, makodza ganayolengana, na maruwa mereru genye miromo miiri, ambago mromo wa dzulu una nyere nyinji sana. Maruwa ganamera kpwa mafungu ga duara ganayozunguluka mlita, ganayotengana kulunga mlita. Pakia akamanya *chimvuno* hadi jenasi tu, kpwa hivyo aina kamili taimanyikana.

where.en: *Leucas* species are common in farmland, fallow fields and grassland across East Africa.
where.sw: Spishi za *Leucas* ni za kawaida mashambani, katika mashamba yaliyoachwa kupumzika na nyika za nyasi kote Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Aina za *Leucas* ni za kawaida mindani, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa bila kurimwa, na kpwenye nyasi kpwa Afrika ya Mashariki yosi.

culture.en: Pakia records that when this plant appears, it shows that the crop will do well and there will be plenty to eat. It is one of the weeds that Digo farmers read as a sign of how fertile the land is. By contrast, *chitsai* (witchweed) and *luswi* are taken as signs of poor harvests.
culture.sw: Pakia ameandika kwamba mmea huu unapotokea, unaonyesha kwamba mazao yatastawi na kutakuwa na chakula tele. Ni mojawapo ya magugu ambayo wakulima wa Kidigo huyasoma kama ishara ya rutuba ya ardhi. Kinyume chake, *chitsai* (kiduha) na *luswi* huchukuliwa kuwa ishara za mavuno duni.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala mmea uhu uchizuka, unaonyesa kukala mimea indamera vinono na kundakala na chakurya chinji. Ni mwenga wa mbondo ambazo akurima Adigo anazilola dza dalili ya chinemi cha tsi. Tafwauti na hivyo, *chitsai* (kpwa Chingereza *witchweed*) na *luswi* nkuonekana dza dalili za mavuno machache.

names.en: *Chimvuno* refers to a full stomach: Pakia translates it as 'stomach full', linking it to *mvuno*, the satisfaction of having enough food. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chimvuno* linarejelea tumbo lililoshiba: Pakia analitafsiri kama 'tumbo limejaa', akilihusisha na *mvuno*, kuridhika kwa kuwa na chakula cha kutosha. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: *Chimvuno* rinahusu tumbo ririrodzala: Pakia anaeleza manage dza 'tumbo ririrodzala', na anarihusisha na *mvuno*, kumvuna kpwa kuphaha chakurya cha kukola. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: A sprawling farm weed with spiny little fruits that stab bare feet, and a name meaning 'tough'.
teaser.sw: Gugu la shambani linalotambaa, lenye matunda madogo ya miiba yanayochoma miguu mitupu, na jina linalomaanisha 'gumu'.
teaser.dg: Kpwekpwe ya mindani inayoenea photsi, yenye matunda madide genye miya ganayodunga magulu gasigo na virahu, na dzina renye mana ya 'ngumu'.

summary.en: *Chindiri*, double thorn, is a sprawling weed with spiny fruits that hurt to step on. Its Digo name probably comes from how tough it is to get rid of.
summary.sw: *Chindiri*, unaoitwa kwa Kiingereza *double thorn*, ni gugu linalotambaa lenye matunda ya miiba yanayoumiza yakikanyagwa. Huenda jina lake la Kidigo linatokana na jinsi lilivyo gumu kuliondoa.
summary.dg: *Chindiri* (*double thorn*) ni kpwekpwe inayoenea photsi, yenye matunda genye miya ganayolumiza mutu achigavyoga. Dzinare ra Chidigo chahi rinatuluka kpwa vira irivyo ngumu kuiusa.

about.en: *Oxygonum sinuatum* is an annual herb of the dock family that sprawls along the ground or grows upright. It has lobed, wavy-edged leaves and slender spikes of small white to pink flowers. Its hard little fruits carry sharp spines that stick into bare feet. Pakia gives it as an example of a herb that Digo recognise from its injurious fruits.
about.sw: *Oxygonum sinuatum* ni mmea mdogo wa msimu mmoja wa familia ya dock (Polygonaceae) unaotambaa ardhini au kusimama wima. Una majani yenye ndewe na kingo za mawimbi, na vishada virefu vyembamba vya maua madogo meupe hadi ya waridi. Matunda yake madogo magumu yana miiba mikali inayochoma miguu mitupu. Pakia anautoa kama mfano wa mmea mdogo ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa matunda yake yanayodhuru.
about.dg: *Oxygonum sinuatum* ni mmea mdide laini wa jamii ya *dock*, unaomera na kufwa ndani ya mwaka mmwenga, unaoenea photsi au uimao chocho. Makodzage gana mala, na kanda-kanda zao zinagaluka-galuka, na una milita myembamba ya maruwa madide mereru hadi ga pinki. Matundage madide magumu gana miya mikali inayodunga magulu gasigo na virahu. Pakia anauhumira dza mfwano wa mmea mdide laini ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa matundage ganayolumiza.

where.en: It is a common weed of cultivated land, roadsides and disturbed ground in East Africa.
where.sw: Ni gugu la kawaida katika ardhi inayolimwa, kando ya barabara na ardhi iliyovurugwa katika Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Ni kpwekpwe ya kawaida mindani, kanda-kanda ya njira na phatu ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa, Afrika Mashariki.

names.en: Pakia explains that *ndiri* refers to 'tough' meat, and the plant probably got its name for being a tough weed to deal with. The English name is double thorn. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba *ndiri* linarejelea nyama 'ngumu', na huenda mmea huu ulipata jina lake kwa kuwa gugu gumu kulikabili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *double thorn*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala *ndiri* inamaanisha nyama 'ngumu', na chahi mmea huno waphaha dzina hiri kpwa sababu ni kpwekpwe ngumu kuiusa. Dzina ra Chingereza ni *double thorn*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

teaser.sw: Ponda jani lake na utaelewa majina yake yote matatu: mawili kati yake yanahusu harufu yake mbaya.
teaser.dg: Hopeza kodza na undamanya mana ya madzinage gosi mahahu: mairi kahi yao ni ga arufuye mbii.

summary.en: *Chinuka cha m'masai* is a shrub or small tree whose crushed leaves smell unpleasant. Two of its Digo names are about that smell, and one draws on an old rivalry.
summary.sw: *Chinuka cha m'masai* ni kichaka au mti mdogo ambao majani yake yakipondwa hutoa harufu mbaya. Majina yake mawili ya Kidigo yanahusu harufu hiyo, na moja linatokana na uhasama wa zamani.
summary.dg: *Chinuka cha m'masai* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide ambao makodzage ganaphohopezwa ganalavya arufu mbii. Madzinage mairi ga Chidigo ni ga arufu hiyo, na rimwenga rinatuluka kpwa kondo za kare.

about.en: *Clerodendrum glabrum* is a shrub or small tree with smooth, glossy leaves, often in whorls of three, that give off a strong, unpleasant smell when crushed. It bears dense, rounded heads of small, sweet-scented white to pinkish flowers with long stamens, followed by round, whitish-yellow fruits. Digo identify it by the look of its leaves and their smell.
about.sw: *Clerodendrum glabrum* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani laini yanayong'aa, mara nyingi katika duara za matatu, ambayo hutoa harufu kali mbaya yanapopondwa. Huzaa vichwa vizito vya mviringo vya maua madogo meupe hadi ya waridi hafifu yenye harufu tamu na stameni ndefu, yanayofuatwa na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi nyeupe-manjano. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya majani yake na harufu yake.
about.dg: *Clerodendrum glabrum* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza laini ganayong'ala, mara nyinji mahahu mahahu phatu phamwenga, ganayolavya arufu kali mbii ganaphohopezwa. Chinalavya mafungu ga mviringo ga maruwa madide manji phamwenga, genye arufu nono, mereru hadi ga pinki, na *stamens* zenye ure mkulu, na badaye matunda ga mviringo, ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu. Adigo anachimanya kpwa umbo ra makodzage na arufu yao.

where.en: It is widespread in bushland, thicket, woodland and coastal forest margins from East Africa to southern Africa.
where.sw: Unapatikana kwa wingi katika vichaka, vichaka vizito, misitu ya wazi na pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani kuanzia Afrika Mashariki hadi kusini mwa Afrika.
where.dg: Chinaphahikana sana weruni, vitsakani, matsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani, kula Afrika Mashariki hadi kusini mwa Afrika.

culture.en: Pakia records that the name *chinuka cha m'masai*, 'the Maasai-smelling plant', ties the plant's bad smell to the Maasai. He suggests this comes from the belief that the Maasai were 'not good', having been enemies of the Digo in historical fights.
culture.sw: Pakia ameandika kwamba jina *chinuka cha m'masai*, 'mmea unaonuka kama Mmaasai', linahusisha harufu mbaya ya mmea huu na Wamaasai. Anapendekeza kwamba hili linatokana na imani kwamba Wamaasai 'hawakuwa wema', kwa kuwa walikuwa maadui wa Wadigo katika vita vya kihistoria.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala dzina *chinuka cha m'masai*, 'chinachonuka Mmasai', rinaunganisha arufu mbii ya mmea huno na Amasai. Anaona kukala hiri rinatuluka kpwa vira Adigo kare kala anaamini kukala Amasai 'si atu anono', kpwa sababu kala ni maadui a Adigo kpwenye vihani vya kare.

names.en: The plant has three Digo names. *Mnuka lovu* means 'bad smell', from *nuka*, to smell, and *lovu*, unpleasant. *Chinuka cha m'masai* is the smell of the Maasai. *Mtsatsa*, which Pakia could not analyse, is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. Pakia records *mtsatsa* for two other plants as well: its relative *Clerodendrum incisum* and the shrub *Acalypha fruticosa*. Mgombato uses *mtsatsa* only in the sense of 'seedling'.
names.sw: Mmea huu una majina matatu ya Kidigo. *Mnuka lovu* maana yake ni 'harufu mbaya', kutoka *nuka*, kunuka, na *lovu*, mbaya. *Chinuka cha m'masai* ni harufu ya Mmaasai. *Mtsatsa*, ambalo Pakia hakuweza kulichambua, linashirikiwa na Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Pakia ameandika *mtsatsa* kwa mimea mingine miwili pia: jamaa yake *Clerodendrum incisum* na kichaka *Acalypha fruticosa*. Mgombato inatumia *mtsatsa* kwa maana ya 'mche' tu.
names.dg: Mmea huno una madzina mahahu ga Chidigo. *Mnuka lovu* rina mana ya 'arufu mbii', kula kpwa *nuka*, kulavya arufu, na *lovu*, arufu mbii. *Chinuka cha m'masai* ni arufu ya Mmasai. *Mtsatsa*, ambaro Pakia kaweza kurieleza mana, ni dzina ambaro Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili piya vinaro. Pakia anaandika *mtsatsa* kpwa mimea yanjina miiri piya: nduguye *Clerodendrum incisum*, na chitsaka *Acalypha fruticosa*. Mgombato inahumira *mtsatsa* kpwa mana ya 'mmea mdide uriodzangbwe kukula' (*seedling*) bahi.

teaser.en: 'The smelly one': a shrub whose long white flowers hang like notes on a stave, and whose leaves have a strong smell.
teaser.sw: 'Kinachonuka': kichaka ambacho maua yake marefu meupe huning'inia kama noti za muziki kwenye mistari ya nota, na majani yake yana harufu kali.
teaser.dg: 'Chinachonuka': chitsaka ambacho maruwage mare mereru ganaonekana dza alama za muziki dzulu ya misitari, na makodzage gana arufu kali.

summary.en: *Chinuka* is a small shrub with long, slender white flowers and a strong smell. Both its Digo and its scientific names come from that smell.
summary.sw: *Chinuka* ni kichaka kidogo chenye maua marefu, membamba na meupe, na harufu kali. Jina lake la Kidigo na la kisayansi yote yanatokana na harufu hiyo.
summary.dg: *Chinuka* ni chitsaka chidide chenye maruwa mare membamba mereru na arufu kali. Madzinage mairi, ra Chidigo na ra chisayansi, ganatuluka kpwa arufu hiyo.

about.en: *Clerodendrum incisum* (now often called *Rotheca incisa*) is a small shrub with toothed or deeply cut leaves. Its flowers are its showpiece: long, slender white tubes, swollen at the tip in bud, with very long, curved stamens. The buds look like musical notes, which is where the English name comes from. The leaves have a strong smell.
about.sw: *Clerodendrum incisum* (ambacho sasa mara nyingi huitwa *Rotheca incisa*) ni kichaka kidogo chenye majani yenye meno au yaliyokatwa kwa kina. Maua yake ndiyo fahari yake: mirija mirefu, myembamba, myeupe, iliyovimba kwenye ncha yakiwa bado matumba, yenye stameni ndefu sana zilizopinda. Matumba yanafanana na noti za muziki, na hapo ndipo jina la Kiingereza (*musical notes*) linapotoka. Majani yana harufu kali.
about.dg: *Clerodendrum incisum* (sambi mara nyinji unaihwa *Rotheca incisa*) ni chitsaka chidide chenye makodza genye meno kanda-kanda au ganayokatika ndani sana. Maruwage ndigo ganayoajira zaidi: ni mabomba mare membamba mereru, ganayofutuka kpwenye ntsa wakati ni vimea, na genye *stamens* zenye ure mkulu sana zinazofyuka. Vimea vinaonekana dza alama za muziki, na ndiko dzina ra Chingereza rinakotuluka. Makodza gana arufu kali.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and thicket in Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani nchini Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni na vitsakani vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

names.en: *Chinuka* means 'smell', from *nuka*, to smell. Pakia explains that the plant is named after its strong smell. He also notes that *nuka* is the plain Digo word for any smell. Its relative *Clerodendrum glabrum* has names that specify an unpleasant smell: *mnuka lovu*, 'bad smell', and *chinuka cha m'masai*. Pakia believed the scientific epithet *incisum* also referred to smell, but it actually means 'deeply cut', describing the leaves. *Mtsatsa*, also recorded for this species, is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili, and Pakia records it for *C. glabrum* and *Acalypha fruticosa* too.
names.sw: *Chinuka* maana yake ni 'harufu', kutoka *nuka*, kunuka. Pakia anaeleza kwamba mmea huu umepewa jina kutokana na harufu yake kali. Pia anaeleza kwamba *nuka* ni neno la kawaida la Kidigo kwa harufu yoyote. Jamaa yake *Clerodendrum glabrum* ana majina yanayobainisha harufu mbaya: *mnuka lovu*, 'harufu mbaya', na *chinuka cha m'masai*. Pakia aliamini kwamba jina la kisayansi *incisum* pia lilirejelea harufu, lakini kwa kweli maana yake ni 'kilichokatwa kwa kina', likieleza majani. *Mtsatsa*, ambalo pia limerekodiwa kwa spishi hii, linashirikiwa na Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili, na Pakia analiandika kwa *C. glabrum* na *Acalypha fruticosa* pia.
names.dg: *Chinuka* rina mana ya 'arufu', kula kpwa *nuka*, kulavya arufu. Pakia anaeleza kukala mmea huno ukaihwa hivyo kpwa sababu ya arufuye kali. Piya anaandika kukala *nuka* ni neno ra kawaida ra Chidigo ra arufu yoyosi. Nduguye *Clerodendrum glabrum* una madzina ganayogomba kukala arufuye ni mbii: *mnuka lovu*, 'arufu mbii', na *chinuka cha m'masai*. Pakia kala anaamini kukala neno *incisum* kpwenye dzina ra chisayansi piya rinamaanisha arufu, ela kpwa kpweli rina mana ya 'ririrokatwa ndani sana', na rinaeleza makodza. *Mtsatsa*, dzina ririroandikpwa piya kpwa aina hino, ni dzina ambaro Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili piya vinaro, na Pakia anariandika kpwa *C. glabrum* na *Acalypha fruticosa* piya.

teaser.en: A hooked-thorn scrambler whose small berries turn from red to purple-black, and birds strip them fast.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kinachotambaa chenye miiba ya ndoano, ambacho beri zake ndogo hubadilika kutoka nyekundu hadi zambarau-nyeusi, na ndege huzimaliza haraka.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, chenye miya ya kufyuka, na matunda madide ganayogaluka kula ga kundu hadi ga zambarau na maru; ndege nkugarya gosi upesi.

summary.en: *Chinyokola* is a spiny scrambling shrub with glossy leaves and small berries that ripen purple-black. The ripe fruit is edible.
summary.sw: *Chinyokola* ni kichaka kinachotambaa chenye miiba, majani yanayong'aa na beri ndogo zinazoiva zikawa za zambarau-nyeusi. Tunda lililoiva huliwa.
summary.dg: *Chinyokola* ni chitsaka chenye miya chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, chenye makodza ganayong'ala na matunda madide ganayoivwa na kukala ga zambarau na maru. Matunda maivu nkuriwa.

about.en: *Scutia myrtina* is a spiny, often scrambling shrub up to about 6 m. Its spreading branches carry recurved thorns, usually in pairs, grey with shiny brown tips. The leaves are glossy mid-green, oval and up to 6 cm long. The small, creamy-green, bell-shaped flowers grow in clusters, and the berries, up to 1 cm across, turn from green to red and then purple-black when ripe.
about.sw: *Scutia myrtina* ni kichaka chenye miiba, ambacho mara nyingi hutambaa, kinachofikia takriban m 6. Matawi yake yanayotawanyika yana miiba iliyopinda nyuma, kwa kawaida kwa jozi, ya rangi ya kijivu yenye ncha za kahawia zinazong'aa. Majani yanang'aa, ya kijani cha wastani, ya umbo la yai na yenye urefu wa hadi sm 6. Maua madogo ya rangi ya krimu-kijani, yenye umbo la kengele, huota katika vishada, na beri, zenye upana wa hadi sm 1, hubadilika kutoka kijani hadi nyekundu kisha zambarau-nyeusi zinapoiva.
about.dg: *Scutia myrtina* ni chitsaka chenye miya, mara nyinji chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, cha ure wa hadi mita 6 hivi. Pandaze zinazoenea zina miya iriyofyuka nyuma, mara nyinji mairi mairi, ya rangi ya ivu na ntsa za rangi ya dongo zinazong'ala. Makodza ganang'ala, ga chijani cha kawaida, ga umbo ra tumbi, na ga ure wa hadi sentimita 6. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya maziya na chijani, ga umbo ra kengele, ganamera kpwa mafungu, na matunda, ga upana wa hadi sentimita 1, ganagaluka kula chijani hadi ga kundu, na chisha ga zambarau na maru ganaphoivwa.

where.en: It is widespread from Kenya to South Africa and Madagascar, and east to India and Vietnam. ICRAF notes that in the dry lowlands it is confined to riverine vegetation, places near pools and swamps, and the seashore, often on coral soils and termite mounds. At the coast it fruits from January to April.
where.sw: Kinapatikana kwa wingi kuanzia Kenya hadi Afrika Kusini na Madagaska, na mashariki hadi India na Vietnam. ICRAF inaeleza kwamba katika nyanda kavu za chini hupatikana tu katika mimea ya kando ya mito, mahali karibu na madimbwi na vinamasi, na ufuoni mwa bahari, mara nyingi kwenye udongo wa matumbawe na vichuguu. Pwani huzaa matunda kuanzia Januari hadi Aprili.
where.dg: Chinaphahikana sana kula Kenya hadi South Africa na Madagascar, na uphande wa mlairo wa dzuwa hadi India na Vietnam. ICRAF inaandika kukala kpwenye tsi kavu za photsi chinaphahikana tu kanda-kanda ya miho, phephi na madimbwi na magugu, na kanda-kanda ya bahari, mara nyinji kpwenye tsi ya sanoo na dzulu ya vidzulu vya lutswa. Pwani, chinalavya matunda kula Januari hadi Aprili.

uses.en: ICRAF records that the ripe fruit is eaten, and that the roots and leaves are used as medicine. The shrub also gives fodder and shade. Birds and squirrels eat the fruit so readily that seed is hard to collect. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: ICRAF inaeleza kwamba tunda lililoiva huliwa, na kwamba mizizi na majani hutumika kama dawa. Kichaka hiki pia hutoa lishe ya mifugo na kivuli. Ndege na kindi hula matunda kwa hamu kiasi kwamba ni vigumu kukusanya mbegu. Pakia hakuandika matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo.
uses.dg: ICRAF inaandika kukala matunda maivu nkuriwa, na mizi na makodza nkuhumirwa dza dawa. Chitsaka hichi piya chinapha mifugo chakurya na chivuri. Ndege na tuhe anarya matunda upesi sana hata tembe ni ngumu kutsolwa. Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chinyokola* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. ICRAF gives the Giriama name *munyahi*. 'Cat-thorn' is a common English name for the species.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chinyokola* na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. ICRAF inatoa jina la Kigiriama *munyahi*. Kwa Kiingereza spishi hii huitwa kwa kawaida *cat-thorn*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chinyokola* na anariika kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage. ICRAF inalavya dzina ra Chigiryama *munyahi*. *Cat-thorn* ni dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana kpwa aina hino.

teaser.en: A guinea-fowl name nobody can fully explain, and a place in the peace-making rites of Digo homesteads.
teaser.sw: Jina la kanga ambalo hakuna anayeweza kulieleza kikamilifu, na nafasi katika mila za upatanishi za makazi ya Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Dzina ra kanga ambaro takuna awezaye kurieleza sawa-sawa, na nafwasi kpwenye vimila vya kupatanisha atu midzini mwa Adigo.

summary.en: *Chiphala kanga* is a forest shrub of the spurge family. Under its other name, *mvundza jembe*, it is one of several shrubs used in rites to settle disputes.
summary.sw: *Chiphala kanga* ni kichaka cha msituni cha familia ya mibono. Kwa jina lake jingine, *mvundza jembe*, ni mojawapo ya vichaka kadhaa vinavyotumika katika mila za kusuluhisha migogoro.
summary.dg: *Chiphala kanga* ni chitsaka cha tsakani cha jamii ya *spurge*. Kpwa dzinare ranjina, *mvundza jembe*, ni chimwenga kahi ya vitsaka vinji vinavyohumirwa kpwenye vimila vya kumala kondo.

about.en: *Alchornea laxiflora* is a shrub or small tree of the forest understorey and margins. It has thin, toothed, oval leaves on long stalks, and its young leaves are often reddish. Male and female flowers are borne in slender spikes, and the fruits are small, hairy, two- or three-lobed capsules.
about.sw: *Alchornea laxiflora* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa sehemu ya chini na pembezoni mwa msitu. Kina majani membamba, yenye meno, ya umbo la yai juu ya vikonyo virefu, na majani yake machanga mara nyingi huwa na rangi nyekundu. Maua ya kiume na ya kike huota katika vishada virefu vyembamba, na matunda ni vifuko vidogo vyenye manyoya, vyenye ndewe mbili au tatu.
about.dg: *Alchornea laxiflora* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaomera photsi ya mihi mire ya tsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka. Makodzage ni membamba, ga umbo ra tumbi, genye meno kanda-kanda na milita mire, na makodza matsanga mara nyinji ni ga kundu chidide. Maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwa milita myembamba, na matunda ni makakaya madide genye nyere, ga mala mairi au mahahu.

where.en: It grows in forest, forest edges and thicket in tropical Africa, including the East African coast.
where.sw: Huota msituni, pembezoni mwa misitu na vichaka vizito katika maeneo ya tropiki ya Afrika, ikiwemo pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Chinamera matsakani, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na vitsakani, Afrika ya tsi za dzoho, phamwenga na pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.

culture.en: Pakia also records this shrub as *mvundza jembe*, 'hoe breaker'. That name covers several shrubs, including *Allophylus rubifolius*, *Acalypha neptunica* and *Mallotus oppositifolius*. Any of them can be used in the spiritual work of ending (*vundza*) quarrels and bringing peace. In the rites for settling domestic and community disputes, the hand hoe (*jembe*) is a symbolic object. Read literally, the name could also warn a farmer that the stumps of these shrubs can damage a hoe.
culture.sw: Pakia pia ameandika kichaka hiki kama *mvundza jembe*, 'mvunja jembe'. Jina hilo linajumuisha vichaka kadhaa, vikiwemo *Allophylus rubifolius*, *Acalypha neptunica* na *Mallotus oppositifolius*. Chochote kati yake kinaweza kutumika katika kazi ya kiroho ya kumaliza (*vundza*) ugomvi na kuleta amani. Katika mila za kusuluhisha migogoro ya nyumbani na ya jamii, jembe la mkono (*jembe*) ni kitu cha ishara. Likisomwa kwa maana yake halisi, jina hili linaweza pia kumwonya mkulima kwamba visiki vya vichaka hivi vinaweza kuharibu jembe.
culture.dg: Pakia piya anaandika chitsaka hichi kukala ni *mvundza jembe*, 'chinachovundza jembe'. Dzina hiri rinahumirwa kpwa vitsaka vinji, phamwenga na *Allophylus rubifolius*, *Acalypha neptunica* na *Mallotus oppositifolius*. Chochosi kahi ya vitsaka hivi chinaweza kuhumirwa kpwenye kazi ya chiroho ya kuvundza (*vundza*) kondo na kureha amani. Kpwenye vimila vya kumala kondo za nyumbani na za jamii, jembe ni chitu cha alama. Dzina hiri richisomwa maneno kpwa maneno, rinaweza piya kumuonya mkurima kukala magutu ga vitsaka hivi ganaweza kubananga jembe.

names.en: *Chiphala kanga* refers to *kanga*, the guinea fowl, but Pakia says the meaning of *chiphala* is unknown. *Mvundza jembe* is shared with Duruma. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chiphala kanga* linarejelea *kanga*, ndege kanga, lakini Pakia anasema maana ya *chiphala* haijulikani. *Mvundza jembe* linashirikiwa na Kiduruma. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: *Chiphala kanga* rina neno *kanga*, ndege (*guinea fowl*), ela Pakia anagomba mana ya *chiphala* taimanyikana. Chiduruma piya china dzina *mvundza jembe*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: A wild, aromatic lantana that Digo count as the 'male' partner of a ground-covering vernonia.
teaser.sw: Lantana ya porini yenye harufu, ambayo Wadigo huihesabu kuwa mwenzi 'dume' wa vernonia inayofunika ardhi.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha weruni chenye arufu nono, cha jenasi ya *Lantana*, ambacho Adigo anachiona dza 'mlume' wa *vernonia* inayofwinika tsi.

summary.en: *Chiphatsa chilume* is an aromatic wild lantana of dry bushland. Digo pair it with the vernonia called *chiphatsa*, as its male form.
summary.sw: *Chiphatsa chilume* ni lantana ya porini yenye harufu, ya vichaka vikavu. Wadigo huiunganisha na vernonia inayoitwa *chiphatsa*, kama umbo lake la dume.
summary.dg: *Chiphatsa chilume* ni chitsaka cha weruni chenye arufu nono, cha jenasi ya *Lantana*, chinachomera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu. Adigo anachiika phamwenga na *vernonia* inayoihwa *chiphatsa*, na anachiona kukala ni *chiphatsa* cha chilume.

about.en: *Lantana viburnoides* is a much-branched, aromatic shrub with rough, toothed leaves that smell when crushed. Its small white, pink or lilac flowers grow in tight, rounded heads, and its small fleshy fruits ripen purple. Unlike the invasive *Lantana camara*, it has no prickles and is native to Africa. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Lantana viburnoides* ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi na harufu, chenye majani yenye kukwaruza na meno, yanayonukia yanapopondwa. Maua yake madogo meupe, ya waridi au ya zambarau hafifu huota katika vichwa vilivyobanana vya mviringo, na matunda yake madogo yenye nyama huiva yakawa ya zambarau. Tofauti na *Lantana camara* inayovamia, haina miiba na ni ya asili ya Afrika. Wadigo huitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Lantana viburnoides* ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji na arufu nono. Makodzage ganakaraza, gana meno kanda-kanda, na ganalavya arufu gachihopezwa. Maruwage madide, ga rangi nyereru, ga pinki au ga zambarau ngushu-ngushu, ganamera phamwenga ganabanana kukala vitswa vya mviringo, na matundage madide genye nyama ganakala ga zambarau ganaphoivwa. Tafwauti na *Lantana camara*, inayoenea kpwa nguvu, chitsaka hichi tachina miya, na ni cha chienyeji cha Afrika. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, thicket and wooded grassland in East Africa and Arabia.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu, vichaka vizito na nyika za nyasi zenye miti katika Afrika Mashariki na Uarabuni.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu, vitsakani na kpwenye mavuwe genye mihi, Afrika ya Mashariki na Uarabuni.

names.en: *Chiphatsa chilume* means 'male chiphatsa'. *Chiphatsa* or *phatsa* is *Vernonia hildebrandtii*, named because it covers the ground like a roof (*kuphatsa*, to roof). Digo count this lantana as the male form of the unmarked *chiphatsa*. Its relative, the invasive *Lantana camara*, is *mjasasa* in northern Digo and *mtsambala* in southern Digo, and *mshomoro* is shared by all Digo.
names.sw: *Chiphatsa chilume* maana yake ni '*chiphatsa* dume'. *Chiphatsa* au *phatsa* ni *Vernonia hildebrandtii*, iliyopewa jina hilo kwa sababu hufunika ardhi kama paa (*kuphatsa*, kuezeka). Wadigo huihesabu lantana hii kuwa umbo la dume la *chiphatsa* isiyo na kiambishi cha jinsia. Jamaa yake, *Lantana camara* inayovamia, ni *mjasasa* kwa Kidigo cha kaskazini na *mtsambala* kwa Kidigo cha kusini, na *mshomoro* linatumiwa na Wadigo wote.
names.dg: *Chiphatsa chilume* manage ni '*chiphatsa* cha chilume'. *Chiphatsa* au *phatsa* ni *Vernonia hildebrandtii*, na yaihwa vivyo kpwa sababu inafwinika tsi dza nyumba iriyoezekpwa (*kuphatsa*, 'kuezeka'). Adigo anaiona *lantana* hino kukala ni aina ya chilume ya *chiphatsa*, ambacho dzinare tarina neno ranjina. Nduguye, *Lantana camara* inayoenea kpwa nguvu, inaihwa *mjasasa* ni Adigo a kazikazini na *mtsambala* ni Adigo a kusini, na dzina *mshomoro* ni ra Adigo osi.

summary.en: *Chitambuu* is a shrub or small tree of the forest understorey with stiff, leathery leaves. Pakia records the name but no uses.
summary.sw: *Chitambuu* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa sehemu ya chini ya msitu, wenye majani magumu kama ngozi yasiyopinda kwa urahisi. Pakia ameandika jina lake lakini si matumizi yoyote.
summary.dg: *Chitambuu* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaomera photsi ya mihi mikulu tsakani, na makodzage ni magumu dza chingo. Pakia anaandika dzinare, ela kaandika matumizige.

about.en: *Memecylon amaniense* (also placed in *Warneckea*, as *W. amaniensis*) is an evergreen shrub or small tree. It has stiff, smooth, leathery leaves in opposite pairs, small bluish-purple or white flowers in clusters, and small fleshy berries. Members of this group are typical of the shaded understorey of East African coastal and lowland forests.
about.sw: *Memecylon amaniense* (ambao pia huwekwa katika *Warneckea*, kama *W. amaniensis*) ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa kijani mwaka mzima. Una majani magumu, laini, kama ngozi, katika jozi zinazoelekeana, maua madogo ya rangi ya buluu-zambarau au meupe katika vishada, na beri ndogo zenye nyama. Mimea ya kundi hili ni ya kawaida katika sehemu ya chini yenye kivuli ya misitu ya pwani na ya nyanda za chini ya Afrika Mashariki.
about.dg: *Memecylon amaniense* (piya unaikpwa kahi ya *Warneckea*, dza *W. amaniensis*) ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ni magumu, laini na dza chingo, na ganamera jozi-jozi ganalengana. Maruwage ni madide, ga zambarau na samawati au ga rangi nyereru, ganamera kpwa makundi, na matundage ni madide genye nyama. Mimea ya kundi hiri ni ya kawaida photsi ya mihi mikulu, kpwenye chivuri cha matsaka ga pwani na ga tsi ya photsi ga Afrika ya Mashariki.

where.en: It grows in forest in eastern Africa. The species is named after Amani in Tanzania's East Usambara mountains.

where.dg: Unamera tsakani Afrika ya Mashariki. Aina ihi yaihwa kpwa dzina ra Amani, phatu kpwenye myango ya East Usambara, Tanzania.

names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chitambuu*, na anariika kahi ya madzina ambago manage taganaweza kumanyikana. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Nduguye *Memecylon sansibaricum* unaihwa *mvamva wa tsakani*.

teaser.en: Its name means 'little witch', and Digo, English, German, Italian and Swahili all independently accuse it of witchcraft.
teaser.sw: Jina lake maana yake ni 'mchawi mdogo', na Kidigo, Kiingereza, Kijerumani, Kiitaliano na Kiswahili, kila kimoja kwa njia yake, kinaushutumu kwa uchawi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'mtsai mdide', na Chidigo, Chingereza, Chijerumani, Chitaliana na Chiswahili, chila luga kpwa njiraye, bila kuiga luga yanjina, zinachiona kukala ni mtsai.

summary.en: *Chitsai*, witchweed, is a small, pretty weed that steals from the roots of maize and ruins the harvest. To Digo farmers it bewitches the crop, and remarkably, many other languages give it a witch's name too.
summary.sw: *Chitsai*, kichawi (kiduha), ni gugu dogo zuri linaloiba kutoka kwenye mizizi ya mahindi na kuharibu mavuno. Kwa wakulima wa Kidigo hulaga mazao, na cha kushangaza, lugha nyingine nyingi pia zinaupa jina la mchawi.
summary.dg: *Chitsai* (kpwa Chingereza *witchweed*) ni mbondo mdide wenye maruwa manono, unaoiya chakurya kula kpwa mizi ya pemba na kubananga mavuno. Kpwa Adigo akurima, chitsai chinaanga mimea ya munda; na dzambo ra ajabu ni kukala luga nyinji zanjina piya zinachiiha kpwa dzina ra mtsai.

about.en: Witchweed is a small, upright herb, usually 15 to 30 cm tall, with rough, narrow leaves and small, bright flowers, typically red or scarlet with a yellow eye. It looks harmless, but it is a parasite. Its roots fasten onto the roots of maize, sorghum, rice and other grasses and draw water and nutrients from them. Much of the damage is done underground before the weed even appears, leaving the crop stunted and yellow. Each plant sets huge numbers of dust-like seeds that can wait in the soil for years.
about.sw: Kichawi ni mmea mdogo unaosimama wima, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa sm 15 hadi 30, wenye majani membamba yanayokwaruza na maua madogo angavu, kwa kawaida mekundu au mekundu iliyokolea yenye jicho la manjano. Huonekana kuwa usio na madhara, lakini ni kimelea. Mizizi yake hujifunga kwenye mizizi ya mahindi, mtama, mpunga na nyasi nyingine na kufyonza maji na virutubisho kutoka kwayo. Sehemu kubwa ya uharibifu hufanyika chini ya ardhi hata kabla gugu halijatokea, na kuacha mazao yamedumaa na kugeuka manjano. Kila mmea huzaa idadi kubwa mno ya mbegu zilizo kama vumbi ambazo zinaweza kungoja udongoni kwa miaka.
about.dg: *Chitsai* ni mmea mdide uimao, mara nyinji wa sentimita 15 hadi 30, wenye makodza membamba ganayokaraza na maruwa madide ganayong'ala, mara nyinji ga kundu, na kahi-kahi ga rangi ya mandano. Chinaonekana dza tachina ubaya, ela chinaishi kpwa kuiya chakurya cha mimea yanjina. Miziye inagbwira mizi ya pemba, mhama, mphunga na nyasi zanjina, na inaiya madzi na chakurya cha mimea hiyo. Ubaya unji unahendwa tsini, hata kabla chitsai chidzangbweonekana, na mimea ya munda inasala inarunda na ya rangi ya mandano. Chila mmea unalavya tembe nyinji sana dza vumbi, ambazo zinaweza kusala ulongoni kpwa myaka minji.

where.en: It grows in farms, especially maize fields on poor, worn-out soils, across Africa and tropical Asia.
where.sw: Huota mashambani, hasa katika mashamba ya mahindi yenye udongo duni uliochoka, kote Afrika na maeneo ya tropiki ya Asia.
where.dg: Chinamera mindani, hasa minda ya pemba yenye ulongo wa chitsapi uriochoka, kpwenye tsi za Afrika na za Asia za dzoho.

culture.en: Pakia records that Digo farmers read *chitsai* as a sign of low fertility and poor harvests. To them it does more than signal bad soil: it bewitches the crops and magically spoils the yield. Science explains the same loss as parasitism. The plant's name warns the farmer that it prevents a good harvest, especially of maize. Mgombato has a verb, *tsorera*, for bewitching someone's farm and ruining their crops through witchcraft.
culture.sw: Pakia ameandika kwamba wakulima wa Kidigo husoma *chitsai* kama ishara ya rutuba duni na mavuno mabaya. Kwao, haionyeshi tu udongo mbaya: hulaga mazao na kuharibu mavuno kwa uchawi. Sayansi inaeleza hasara hiyo hiyo kama ukimelea. Jina la mmea linamwonya mkulima kwamba unazuia mavuno mazuri, hasa ya mahindi. Mgombato ina kitenzi, *tsorera*, cha kulaga shamba la mtu na kuharibu mazao yake kwa uchawi.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala akurima a Chidigo anachiona *chitsai* dza alama ya ulongo wa chitsapi na mavuno machache. Kpwao, chitsai si alama tu ya ulongo usio mnono: chinaanga mimea ya munda na kubananga mavuno kpwa utsai. Sayansi inaonyesa hasara iyo kukala ni kpwa sababu chitsai chinaiya chakurya cha mimea yanjina (*parasitism*). Dzina ra mmea hinyu rinamuonya mkurima kukala chinazuwiya mavuno manono, hasa ga pemba. Mgombato ina neno *tsorera*, renye mana ya kuanga munda wa mutu na kubananga mimeaye kpwa utsai.

names.en: *Chitsai* comes from *mtsai*, witch; Mgombato glosses *mtsai* as 'witch, magician, sorcerer'. The prefix *chi-* marks the plant's small size. Pakia points out a striking coincidence. The plant is 'witchweed' in English, *Teufelszwirn* ('devil's thread') in German and *strega* ('witch') in Italian. In Swahili it is *kichawi*, 'witch', and the Latin genus name *Striga* refers to a witch-like woman with magical powers. These languages share the idea, not the word, and none of them borrowed it from another.
names.sw: *Chitsai* linatokana na *mtsai*, mchawi; Mgombato analieleza *mtsai* kama 'mchawi, mganga wa mazingaombwe, mlozi'. Kiambishi *chi-* kinaonyesha udogo wa mmea. Pakia anaonyesha mfanano wa kushangaza. Kwa Kiingereza mmea huu ni *witchweed* ('gugu la mchawi'), kwa Kijerumani *Teufelszwirn* ('uzi wa shetani') na kwa Kiitaliano *strega* ('mchawi'). Kwa Kiswahili ni *kichawi*, 'mchawi', na jina la jenasi la Kilatini *Striga* linarejelea mwanamke kama mchawi mwenye nguvu za kimiujiza. Lugha hizi zinashiriki wazo, si neno, na hakuna hata moja iliyoliazima kutoka kwa nyingine.
names.dg: *Chitsai* rinalavywa kula *mtsai*; Mgombato inaandika *mtsai* kukala ni mutu wa utsai (*witch, magician, sorcerer*). Mwandzo wa neno, *chi-*, unaonyesa kukala mmea ni mdide. Pakia anaonyesa dzambo ra ajabu. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *witchweed*, kpwa Chijerumani *Teufelszwirn* ('uzi wa shetani'), na kpwa Chitaliana *strega* ('mtsai'). Kpwa Chiswahili ni *kichawi*, 'mtsai', na dzina ra jenasi ra Chilatini, *Striga*, rina mana ya mchetu dza mtsai mwenye nguvu za utsai. Luga hizi zinahalana kpwa mana, si kpwa neno, na takuna luga iriyoazima neno hiri kula kpwa yanjina.

teaser.en: A small wild cola tree found only in the forests of south-east Kenya and north-east Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Mkola mdogo wa porini unaopatikana tu katika misitu ya kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na kaskazini-mashariki mwa Tanzania.
teaser.dg: Muhi mdide wa kola ya weruni, unaophahikana tu kpwenye matsaka ga kusini-mashariki ya Kenya na ga kazikazini-mashariki ya Tanzania.

summary.en: *Chitsamvia* is a small wild cola tree of the coastal forests, first described from Marenje forest in Kwale. Digo named it as a smaller version of *mtsamvia*.
summary.sw: *Chitsamvia* ni mkola mdogo wa porini wa misitu ya pwani, ulioelezwa kwa mara ya kwanza kutoka msitu wa Marenje huko Kwale. Wadigo waliupa jina kama umbo dogo la *mtsamvia*.
summary.dg: *Chitsamvia* ni muhi mdide wa kola ya weruni wa matsaka ga pwani, ambao waandikpwa kpwa mara ya kpwandza kula tsaka ra Marenje, Kwale. Dzinare ra Chidigo rinauonyesa dza *mtsamvia* mdide.

about.en: *Cola minor* is a shrub or small tree, a wild relative of the cola nut tree. Like other wild colas it has simple leathery leaves, small star-shaped flowers without petals, and fruits made of several pod-like segments holding large seeds. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Cola minor* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, jamaa wa porini wa mkola (mti wa kola). Kama mikola mingine ya porini, una majani sahili magumu kama ngozi, maua madogo ya umbo la nyota yasiyo na petali, na matunda yaliyoundwa kwa sehemu kadhaa zilizo kama maganda zinazobeba mbegu kubwa. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Cola minor* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, ndugu wa weruni wa muhi wa kola. Dza kola zanjina za weruni, una makodza magumu dza chingo gasigoganywa, maruwa madide ga umbo ra nyota gasigokala na vibapa, na matunda ganayohendwa ni seemu nyinji dza makakaya, zenye tembe kulu. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It is found only from south-east Kenya to north-east Tanzania, in lowland coastal forest. The specimen that defined the species was collected in Marenje (Marenji) Forest in Kwale.
where.sw: Unapatikana tu kuanzia kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya hadi kaskazini-mashariki mwa Tanzania, katika misitu ya pwani ya nyanda za chini. Sampuli iliyotumika kuifafanua spishi hii ilikusanywa katika Msitu wa Marenje (Marenji) huko Kwale.
where.dg: Unaphahikana tu kula kusini-mashariki ya Kenya hadi kazikazini-mashariki ya Tanzania, kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ga tsi ya photsi. Chipande cha mmea chirichohumirwa kuionyesa aina ihi kpwa mara ya kpwandza chahalwa kula tsaka ra Marenje (Marenji), Kwale.

names.en: Pakia explains that *chitsamvia* is named after *mtsamvia*, the forest tree *Synsepalum*, but is relatively smaller, hence the prefix *chi-*. He lists it among the names that cannot be fully analysed. No Swahili or English name has been recorded. A related forest cola, *Cola uloloma*, is *mnapu*.
names.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba *chitsamvia* umepewa jina la *mtsamvia*, mti wa msituni *Synsepalum*, lakini ni mdogo kiasi, ndiyo maana una kiambishi *chi-*. Anauorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa kikamilifu. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Mkola mwingine wa msituni unaohusiana nao, *Cola uloloma*, ni *mnapu*.
names.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala *chitsamvia* chaihwa kpwa dzina ra *mtsamvia*, muhi wa tsakani (*Synsepalum*), ela ni chidide kuriko uo, kpwa hivyo dzinare rina *chi-*. Anariika kahi ya madzina ambago manage taganaweza kumanyikana gosi. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Kola yanjina ya tsakani, *Cola uloloma*, ni *mnapu*.

conservation.en: *Cola minor* is assessed as Near Threatened on the IUCN Red List. Its small range overlaps with the fragmented coastal forests of Kwale, which are under pressure from clearing.
conservation.sw: *Cola minor* imetathminiwa kuwa Karibu Kuwa Hatarini (Near Threatened) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN. Eneo lake dogo linaingiliana na misitu ya pwani ya Kwale iliyogawanyika vipande vipande, ambayo iko chini ya shinikizo la ukataji.
conservation.dg: Kpwenye *Red List* ya IUCN, *Cola minor* inaikpwa kahi ya mimea iriyo phephi na kukala hatarini (*Near Threatened*). Phatu unaphomera ni phadide, na phanaphahikana phamwenga na matsaka ga pwani ga Kwale garigo vipande-vipande, ambago ganatemwa sana.

reason.dg: *Mtsamvia* (*Synsepalum*), muhi ambao *chitsamvia* chinaihwa kpwa dzinare

teaser.en: A dry-country cordia shrub, a cousin of the sandpaper saucer-berry.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha cordia cha nchi kavu, binamu wa sandpaper saucer-berry.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha jenasi ya *Cordia* cha tsi kavu, nduguye *mzondohera nguluwe*.

summary.en: *Chitundo* is a shrub of the borage family that grows in the dry bush of north-east Africa and Kenya. Pakia records only its name and how it is identified.
summary.sw: *Chitundo* ni kichaka cha familia ya borage (Boraginaceae) kinachoota katika vichaka vikavu vya kaskazini-mashariki mwa Afrika na Kenya. Pakia ameandika jina lake tu na jinsi kinavyotambuliwa.
summary.dg: *Chitundo* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya *borage* chinachomera weruni kpwa tsi kavu za Afrika ya kazikazini-mashariki na Kenya. Pakia anaandika dzinare tu na vira chinavyomanyikana.

about.en: *Cordia somaliensis* is a shrub with simple, roughish leaves. Like its relatives it has small whitish flowers and small, fleshy, often sticky fruits sitting in a cup-like calyx. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Cordia somaliensis* ni kichaka chenye majani sahili yanayokwaruza kiasi. Kama jamaa zake, kina maua madogo meupe-meupe na matunda madogo yenye nyama, ambayo mara nyingi yanata, yaliyokaa ndani ya kikombe cha sepali. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Cordia somaliensis* ni chitsaka chenye makodza mazima ganayokaraza chidide. Dza nduguze, china maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru ngushu-ngushu, na matunda madide genye nyama, ambago mara nyinji gananyata, na ganakala ndani ya chikombe cha ruwa (*calyx*). Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland in Somalia, Ethiopia and Kenya.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu nchini Somalia, Ethiopia na Kenya.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni kpwa tsi kavu za Somalia, Ethiopia na Kenya.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chitundo* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chitundo* na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chitundo*, na anariika kahi ya madzina ambago mana gao taganaweza kuelezwa. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: A fig with leaves as big as dinner plates, often starting life high in another tree.
teaser.sw: Mkuyu wenye majani makubwa kama sahani za chakula, ambao mara nyingi huanza maisha yake juu ya mti mwingine.
teaser.dg: Kuyu yenye makodza makulu dza sahani za chakurya, ambayo mara nyinji inaandza kumera dzulu, kpwenye muhi wanjina.

summary.en: *Chiuzi* is the giant-leaved fig, a large tree with huge leathery leaves and clusters of small yellowish figs. Digo also call it *mkuyu*, a name they share with the Cape fig.
summary.sw: *Chiuzi* ni mkuyu wenye majani makubwa (giant-leaved fig), mti mkubwa wenye majani makubwa mno yaliyo magumu kama ngozi, na vishada vya tini ndogo za rangi ya manjano hafifu. Wadigo pia huuita *mkuyu*, jina wanalolitumia pia kwa *Ficus sur* (Cape fig).
summary.dg: *Chiuzi* ni muhi mkulu wa kuyu (kpwa Chingereza *giant-leaved fig*), wenye makodza makulu sana, magumu dza chingo, na mafungu ga kuyu ndide za rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu. Adigo piya anauiha *mkuyu*, dzina ambaro piya ni ra *Ficus sur* (*Cape fig*).

about.en: *Ficus lutea* is a large, spreading fig tree with milky latex and very large, thick, leathery leaves, up to about 30 cm long. It often begins life as an epiphyte or strangler in the crown of another tree, sending roots down to the ground. The small figs are yellowish to orange-brown and grow in dense clusters along the twigs behind the leaves, where birds, bats and monkeys feed on them. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Ficus lutea* ni mkuyu mkubwa unaotanda, wenye utomvu mweupe kama maziwa na majani makubwa sana, manene na magumu kama ngozi, yenye urefu wa hadi takriban sentimita 30. Mara nyingi huanza maisha kama mmea-tegemezi au mnyongaji katika taji la mti mwingine, na kushusha mizizi hadi ardhini. Tini zake ndogo ni za manjano hadi hudhurungi-machungwa, na huota kwa vishada vizito kando ya vitawi nyuma ya majani, ambapo ndege, popo na tumbili huja kuzila. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Ficus lutea* ni muhi mkulu wa kuyu wenye panda zinazoenea, wenye maziya, na makodza makulu sana, maziho na magumu dza chingo, mare hadi sentimita 30 hivi. Mara nyinji unaandza kumera chitswani mwa muhi wanjina, uchimera dzuluye au uchiunyonga, na unatsereza miziye hadi photsi. Kuyuze ndide ni za rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu hadi rangi ya chungbwa na dongo, na zinamera kpwa mafungu ganayogbwirana kanda-kanda ya vigongo, nyuma ya makodza, ambapho nyuni, manundu na tumbiri anazirya. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in forest, riverine woodland and coastal bush across tropical Africa, from West Africa to Kenya and south to South Africa.
where.sw: Hukua msituni, katika misitu ya kando ya mito na vichakani pwani katika Afrika yote ya kitropiki, kuanzia Afrika Magharibi hadi Kenya na kusini hadi Afrika Kusini.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani, kpwenye mihi ya kanda-kanda ya miho na vitsaka vya pwani, kpwenye tsi za dzoho za Afrika, kula Afrika ya Magharibi hadi Kenya, na kusini hadi South Africa.

uses.en: Pakia records that Digo use the latex of fig trees (*Ficus*) to fix feathers onto arrow shafts; he doesn't name this species.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo hutumia utomvu wa mikuyu (*Ficus*) kubandika manyoya kwenye vijiti vya mishale; hata hivyo hataji spishi hii kwa jina.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo nkuhumira maziya ga mihi ya kuyu (*Ficus*) kubandikiza nyoya kpwenye mabura ga mahondza; ela kaandika kukala ni muhi uhu hasa.

names.en: Pakia records two names: *chiuzi*, and *mkuyu*, which he also gives for the Cape fig (*Ficus sur*). *Mkuyu* is shared with Swahili, where it is a general name for wild figs. The existing reference also has a fig called *uuzi kaha*, *Ficus stuhlmannii*, so *chiuzi* may be a small form of *uuzi*, but Pakia doesn't explain it.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili: *chiuzi*, na *mkuyu*, ambalo pia analitoa kwa *Ficus sur* (*Cape fig*). *Mkuyu* ni jina la pamoja na Kiswahili, ambapo ni jina la jumla la mikuyu ya porini. Marejeo yaliyopo pia yana mkuyu unaoitwa *uuzi kaha*, *Ficus stuhlmannii*, kwa hivyo huenda *chiuzi* ni umbo la udogo la *uuzi*, lakini Pakia hafafanui hilo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi: *chiuzi*, na *mkuyu*, ambaro piya anarilavya kpwa *Ficus sur* (*Cape fig*). *Mkuyu* ni dzina ra Chiswahili piya, ambako ni dzina ra kawaida ra kuyu za weruni. Hipha piya kuna kuyu yanjina inayoihwa *uuzi kaha*, *Ficus stuhlmannii*, kpwa hivyo *chiuzi* chinaweza kukala ni *uuzi* chidide, ela Pakia kaeleza dzambo hiri.

teaser.en: When it flowers, the bees come buzzing; and when you have a dispute, people say it can end the case in your favour.
teaser.sw: Ukichanua, nyuki huja wakivuma; na ukiwa na ugomvi, watu husema unaweza kumaliza kesi kwa faida yako.
teaser.dg: Chichituluza maruwa, nyuchi anakpwedza achivuma; na uchikala na kesi, atu anagomba kukala chinaweza kumala kesi kpwa fwaidayo.

summary.en: *Chivuma nyuchi* is a small herb whose flowers draw buzzing bees. Under its other name, *chivundza kesi*, it is used to end a dispute in the user's favour.
summary.sw: *Chivuma nyuchi* ni mmea mdogo ambao maua yake huvutia nyuki wanaovuma. Kwa jina lake jingine, *chivundza kesi*, hutumika kumaliza ugomvi kwa faida ya anayeutumia.
summary.dg: *Chivuma nyuchi* ni mmea mdide laini wenye maruwa ganayomweha nyuchi anaovuma. Kpwa dzinare ranjina, *chivundza kesi*, nkuhumirwa kumala kondo kpwa fwaida ya iye anayeuhumira.

about.en: *Agathisanthemum bojeri* is a small herb or sub-shrub of the coffee family. It has narrow, opposite leaves and dense, rounded heads of tiny white to pink or mauve tubular flowers at the tips of the stems. Pakia classes it as a herb and notes that Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Agathisanthemum bojeri* ni mmea mdogo au kichaka kidogo cha familia ya mibuni (mkahawa). Una majani membamba yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, na vichwa vizito vya mviringo vya maua madogo sana ya umbo la mrija, meupe hadi waridi au zambarau hafifu, kwenye ncha za mashina. Pakia anauweka katika kundi la mimea midogo (herbs) na anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Agathisanthemum bojeri* ni mmea mdide laini wa jamii ya kahawa, au chitsaka chidide. Una makodza membamba ganayolengana, na kpwenye ntsa za mihiye kuna mafungu ga mviringo ganayogbwirana ga maruwa madide sana, ga umbo ra mridza, kula mereru hadi ga pinki au ga zambarau ngushu-ngushu. Pakia anauika kahi ya mimea midide laini, na anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in grassland, bushland and open sandy places in East Africa, including the coast.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika za majani, vichakani na sehemu wazi za mchanga Afrika Mashariki, ikiwemo pwani.
where.dg: Unamera nyasini, weruni na phatu phenye mtsanga ambapho takuna mihi minji, Afrika ya Mashariki, phamwenga na pwani.

culture.en: Pakia records that the plant is used to end (*vundza*) a dispute in favour of the user, hence the name *chivundza kesi*, 'case terminator'. Other Digo plants are also named for settling or stirring disputes, such as *mvundza jembe* and *mtsimbi kaya*. Mgombato adds that *chivuma nyuchi* is also the name of a dance.
culture.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba mmea huu hutumika kumaliza (*vundza*) ugomvi kwa faida ya anayeutumia, ndiyo sababu unaitwa *chivundza kesi*, 'kimaliza kesi'. Mimea mingine ya Kidigo pia imepewa majina kwa kusuluhisha au kuchochea ugomvi, kama *mvundza jembe* na *mtsimbi kaya*. Mgombato inaongeza kwamba *chivuma nyuchi* pia ni jina la ngoma.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala mmea uhu nkuhumirwa kumala (*vundza*) kesi kpwa fwaida ya iye anayeuhumira, ndiyo mana unaihwa *chivundza kesi*, 'chitu chinachomala kesi'. Mimea yanjina ya Chidigo piya ina madzina ga kumala kondo au ga kutsokoza kondo, dza *mvundza jembe* na *mtsimbi kaya*. Mgombato unaenjereza kukala *chivuma nyuchi* piya ni dzina ra ngoma.

names.en: *Chivuma nyuchi* means 'buzzing bees': when it flowers, bees visit it often. *Chivundza kesi* means 'case terminator', from *vundza*, to end, and *kesi*, a legal case. Duruma, Giriama and Swahili share that name. Mgombato gives two Swahili names, *kivunjahakumu* ('judgement breaker') and *mcheka na mbingu*.
names.sw: *Chivuma nyuchi* maana yake 'nyuki wanaovuma': unapochanua, nyuki huutembelea mara kwa mara. *Chivundza kesi* maana yake 'kimaliza kesi', kutoka *vundza*, kumaliza, na *kesi*, shauri la mahakamani. Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili vinashiriki jina hilo. Mgombato inatoa majina mawili ya Kiswahili, *kivunjahakumu* ('kivunja hukumu') na *mcheka na mbingu*.
names.dg: *Chivuma nyuchi* manage ni 'nyuchi anaovuma': chichituluza maruwa, nyuchi nkuchiphiyira mara nyinji. *Chivundza kesi* manage ni 'chitu chinachomala kesi', kula *vundza*, 'kumala', na *kesi*, 'kesi ya shariya'. Dzina hiri ni sawa kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Mgombato unalavya madzina mairi ga Chiswahili, *kivunjahakumu* ('chivundza hukumu') na *mcheka na mbingu*.

teaser.en: Its leaves turn slippery when crushed, and they were used to polish beads clean.
teaser.sw: Majani yake huteleza yakipondwa, na yalitumika kusafisha shanga.
teaser.dg: Makodzage gachihopezwa ganakala ga uhereza, na nkuhumirwa kutsusa tsalu.

summary.en: *Chivumbani cha chigala* is a weedy herb with yellow flowers and burr fruits that stick to clothes. Its other names describe how its crushed leaves turn slippery and are used to clean beads.
summary.sw: *Chivumbani cha chigala* ni gugu dogo lenye maua ya manjano na matunda yenye miiba-ndoano yanayonasa kwenye nguo. Majina yake mengine yanaeleza jinsi majani yake yanavyoteleza yakipondwa na jinsi yanavyotumika kusafisha shanga.
summary.dg: *Chivumbani cha chigala* ni kpwekpwe laini yenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano na matunda genye miya ganayogbwira nguwo. Madzinage ganjina ganaeleza vira makodzage gachihopezwa ganavyokala ga uhereza, na vira ganavyohumirwa kutsusa tsalu.

about.en: *Triumfetta rhomboidea* is an upright herb or small sub-shrub with hairy stems and roughly diamond-shaped, toothed leaves. Its small yellow flowers grow in clusters along the stems. The small round fruits are covered in hooked bristles and catch on fur and clothing. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Triumfetta rhomboidea* ni mmea mdogo au kichaka kidogo kinachosimama wima, chenye mashina yenye manyoya na majani yenye meno kingoni na umbo linalokaribia almasi. Maua yake madogo ya manjano huota kwa vishada kando ya mashina. Matunda yake madogo ya mviringo yamefunikwa kwa vinywele vigumu vyenye ndoano, na hunasa kwenye manyoya ya wanyama na nguo. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Triumfetta rhomboidea* ni mmea laini uimao chocho, au chitsaka chidide, wenye mihi yenye nyere na makodza ga umbo ra pembe nne, genye meno kanda-kanda. Maruwage madide ga rangi ya mandano ganamera kpwa mafungu kanda-kanda ya mihi. Matundage madide ga mviringo gana nyere ngumu zenye ntsa dza chiloo, ganayogbwira nyere za nyama na nguwo. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It is a common weed of farmland, roadsides, fallow and disturbed ground throughout the tropics.
where.sw: Ni gugu la kawaida mashambani, kando ya barabara, kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa na ardhi iliyovurugwa katika nchi zote za tropiki.
where.dg: Ni kpwekpwe ya kawaida mindani, kanda-kanda ya njira, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa na phatu ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa, kpwenye tsi zosi za dzoho.

uses.en: Pakia records that the leaves are crushed and used as a medicine; when crushed they give a slippery extract. The leaves are also used to clean beads, which gives the name *mtsusa tsalu*.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba majani hupondwa na kutumika kama dawa; yakipondwa hutoa ute unaoteleza. Majani pia hutumika kusafisha shanga, na ndiko jina *mtsusa tsalu* linakotoka.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala makodzage nkuhopezwa na nkuhumirwa dza dawa; gachihopezwa ganalavya madzi ga uhereza. Makodza piya nkuhumirwa kutsusa tsalu, na kpwa hivyo mmea uhu unaihwa *mtsusa tsalu*.

names.en: The plant has three Digo names. *Mnyururika* means 'slippery extract', from *nyururika*, to be slippery. *Mtsusa tsalu* means 'bead cleaner', from *tsusa*, to clean, and *tsalu*, beads. Pakia gives it as an example of a name describing a general use. Both names are shared with *Waltheria indica*, and *mtsusa tsalu* also with *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. Pakia gives no meaning for *chivumbani cha chigala*. Its first word is the Digo name of tree basil, *chivumbani* (*Ocimum suave*).
names.sw: Mmea huu una majina matatu ya Kidigo. *Mnyururika* maana yake 'ute unaoteleza', kutoka *nyururika*, kuteleza. *Mtsusa tsalu* maana yake 'kisafisha shanga', kutoka *tsusa*, kusafisha, na *tsalu*, shanga. Pakia analitoa kama mfano wa jina linaloeleza matumizi ya jumla. Majina yote mawili yanashirikiwa na *Waltheria indica*, na *mtsusa tsalu* pia na *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. Pakia hatoi maana ya *chivumbani cha chigala*. Neno lake la kwanza ni jina la Kidigo la kivumbasi, *chivumbani* (*Ocimum suave*).
names.dg: Mmea uhu una madzina mahahu ga Chidigo. *Mnyururika* manage ni 'madzi ga uhereza', kula *nyururika*, 'kukala na uhereza'. *Mtsusa tsalu* manage ni 'chitu cha kutsusa tsalu', kula *tsusa*, 'kueza', na *tsalu*, 'ushanga'. Pakia anarilavya dzina hiri dza mfwano wa dzina rinaroeleza kazi ya kawaida ya mmea. Madzina gosi mairi ni sawa na ga *Waltheria indica*, na *mtsusa tsalu* piya ni dzina ra *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. Pakia kalavya mana ga *chivumbani cha chigala*. Neno ra kpwandza ra dzina hiri ni dzina ra Chidigo ra *tree basil*, *chivumbani* (*Ocimum suave*).

teaser.sw: Vunja shina na 'maziwa' meupe hububujika; jina la Kidigo lina maana hiyo hasa.

summary.en: *Chiziyaziya*, asthma weed, is a small hairy weed that oozes white latex when broken. Pakia records its latex as medicinal.
summary.sw: *Chiziyaziya* (asthma weed) ni gugu dogo lenye manyoya linalotoa utomvu mweupe likivunjwa. Pakia anaripoti kwamba utomvu wake ni dawa.
summary.dg: *Chiziyaziya* (kpwa Chingereza *asthma weed*) ni kpwekpwe ndide yenye nyere, inayolavya maziya mereru ichivundzwa. Pakia anaandika kukala maziyage ni dawa.

about.en: Asthma weed is a small, hairy annual herb, usually sprawling or rising to about 40 cm, with reddish stems. Its opposite, oval, toothed leaves are often blotched with purple. Tiny greenish to reddish flowers are packed into dense round clusters at the leaf joints. Every part contains white milky latex. Digo identify it by its leaves and its latex.
about.sw: *Euphorbia hirta* ni mmea mdogo wa msimu mmoja wenye manyoya, ambao kwa kawaida hutambaa au hukua hadi takriban sentimita 40, na una mashina ya rangi nyekundu. Majani yake ya umbo la yai, yenye meno kingoni na yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, mara nyingi huwa na madoa ya zambarau. Maua madogo sana ya kijani hadi mekundu hujazana katika vishada vizito vya mviringo kwenye vifundo vya majani. Kila sehemu ina utomvu mweupe kama maziwa. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na utomvu wake.
about.dg: *Chiziyaziya* ni mmea mdide laini unaokala mwaka mmwenga tu, wenye nyere; mara nyinji unaambala photsi au unaima hadi sentimita 40 hivi, na mihiye ni ya kundu chidide. Makodzage ganalengana, ni ga mviringo, gana meno kanda-kanda, na mara nyinji gana mabara-mabara ga zambarau. Maruwa madide sana, ga chijani hadi ga kundu chidide, ganakala kpwa mafungu ga mviringo ganayogbwirana, phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na muhi. Chila seemu ya mmea ina maziya mereru. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na maziyage.

where.en: It is one of the commonest weeds of the tropics, growing on paths, compounds, farms and roadsides.
where.sw: Ni mojawapo ya magugu yaliyoenea zaidi katika tropiki, yakiota njiani, viamboni, mashambani na kando ya barabara.
where.dg: Ni kahi ya kpwekpwe za kawaida zaidi za tsi za dzoho, na inamera njirani, mihalani, mindani na kanda-kanda ya barabara.

uses.en: Pakia notes that its latex is medicinal, but doesn't say what it is used for. Across the tropics the plant is widely used in folk medicine, notably for asthma and other breathing complaints (hence the English name), for diarrhoea, and with the latex applied to warts and sores.
uses.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba utomvu wake ni dawa, lakini hasemi hutumika kutibu nini. Katika nchi za tropiki mmea huu hutumika sana katika tiba asilia, hasa kwa pumu na matatizo mengine ya kupumua (ndiyo asili ya jina lake la Kiingereza), kwa kuhara, na utomvu wake hupakwa kwenye chunjua na vidonda.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala maziyage ni dawa, ela kagomba ganahumirwa kpwa ukongo wani. Kpwenye tsi zosi za dzoho mmea uhu nkuhumirwa sana kpwa dawa za chienyeji, hasa kpwa pumu na makongo ganjina ga pumuzi (ndiyo mana kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *asthma weed*), kpwa fyokpwa, na maziyage nkuikpwa dzulu ya vinundu vya ngozi (*warts*) na vironda.

culture.en: Pakia explains that its milky latex is called *maziya*, a word that goes back to 'milk'. *Maziya* is a harmless, milk-like sap, unlike the burning *ulimbo* of the tree euphorbias. Digo group plants with milky latex under the label *m/chiziya* ('milk'), together with the tree *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*) and the milk-cap mushroom *nimaziya*.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba utomvu wake mweupe huitwa *maziya*, neno linalotokana na 'maziwa'. *Maziya* ni utomvu usio na madhara unaofanana na maziwa, tofauti na *ulimbo* unaounguza wa mitupa mikubwa. Wadigo huweka mimea yenye utomvu mweupe katika kundi la *m/chiziya* ('maziwa'), pamoja na mti *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*) na uyoga wa maziwa *nimaziya*.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala maziya ga mmea uhu nkuihwa *maziya*, neno ririro sawa na ra maziya ga kunwa. *Maziya* ni madzi ga mmea ganayohalana na maziya, ambago tagalumiza mutu, tafwauti na *ulimbo* unaolumiza dza moho wa mihi ya *Euphorbia*. Adigo anaika mimea yenye maziya kahi ya fungu mwenga, *m/chiziya* ('maziya'), phamwenga na muhi *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*) na uoga *nimaziya* (*milk-cap*).

names.en: *Chiziyaziya* means 'milk', after the latex (*maziya*). The doubled stem *-ziyaziya* is shared by latex-producing plants, and *chi-* marks this one as small. Pakia also records the name *mbatata* but gives no meaning for it. The English name is asthma weed.
names.sw: *Chiziyaziya* maana yake 'maziwa', kutokana na utomvu wake (*maziya*). Shina lililorudiwa *-ziyaziya* hushirikiwa na mimea inayotoa utomvu, na *chi-* huonyesha kwamba huu ni mdogo. Pakia pia anarekodi jina *mbatata* lakini hatoi maana yake. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *asthma weed*.
names.dg: *Chiziyaziya* manage ni 'maziya', kpwa sababu ya maziya ga mmea uhu (*maziya*). Neno *-ziyaziya*, ririro na *-ziya* mara mbiri, ni ra mimea yosi inayolavya maziya, na *chi-* inaonyesa kukala mmea uhu ni mdide. Pakia piya anaandika dzina *mbatata*, ela kalavya manage. Dzina ra Chingereza ni *asthma weed*.

teaser.en: A silky-leaved wild relative of the amaranths, and one of the Digo's most common leafy vegetables.
teaser.sw: Ndugu wa porini wa mchicha mwenye majani laini kama hariri, na mojawapo ya mboga za majani zinazotumika zaidi na Wadigo.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya *mchicha*, wenye makodza ga nyere laini dza hariri, na ni kahi ya mboga za Chidigo za kawaida zaidi.

summary.en: *Demu* is a small, silky-haired herb of the amaranth family. Pakia names it among the most common and widely used Digo vegetables.
summary.sw: *Demu* ni mmea mdogo wa familia ya michicha wenye manyoya laini kama hariri. Pakia anautaja miongoni mwa mboga za Kidigo zinazojulikana na kutumika zaidi.
summary.dg: *Demu* ni mmea mdide laini wa jamii ya *mchicha* (*amaranth*), wenye nyere laini dza hariri. Pakia anauika kahi ya mboga za Chidigo za kawaida zaidi, zinazohumirwa ni atu anji.

about.en: *Psilotrichum sericeum* is a herb of the amaranth family with opposite leaves covered in fine, silky hairs, which gives the species its name. Its small, papery, whitish to greenish flowers are packed into short spikes or heads. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Psilotrichum sericeum* ni mmea mdogo wa familia ya michicha, wenye majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana na yaliyofunikwa kwa manyoya membamba laini kama hariri; ndiyo yaliyoipa spishi hii jina lake. Maua yake madogo, makavu kama karatasi, meupe hadi ya kijani, hujazana katika masuke mafupi au vichwa. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Psilotrichum sericeum* ni mmea laini wa jamii ya *mchicha*, wenye makodza ganayolengana, genye nyere laini sana dza hariri, na ndizo zinazopha aina ihi dzinare (*sericeum*, 'dza hariri'). Maruwage madide, makavu dza karatasi, ga rangi nyereru hadi ya chijani, ganakala phamwenga kpwa punga fupi au mafungu. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in tropical Africa and Asia, in bushland, field edges and disturbed ground.
where.sw: Hukua katika Afrika na Asia ya kitropiki, vichakani, pembezoni mwa mashamba na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye tsi za dzoho za Afrika na Asia, weruni, kanda-kanda ya minda na phatu ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa.

uses.en: Its leaves are cooked and eaten. Pakia lists *demu* with *futswe*, *mnavu* and *mrenda* as among the most common and widely used Digo vegetables. The species was once named *Psilotrichum edule*, 'the edible psilotrichum'.
uses.sw: Majani yake hupikwa na kuliwa. Pakia anaorodhesha *demu* pamoja na *futswe*, *mnavu* na *mrenda* miongoni mwa mboga za Kidigo zinazojulikana na kutumika zaidi. Spishi hii iliwahi kuitwa *Psilotrichum edule*, yaani 'psilotrichum inayolika'.
uses.dg: Makodzage nkujitwa na nkuriwa. Pakia anaandika *demu* phamwenga na *futswe*, *mnavu* na *mrenda* kahi ya mboga za Chidigo za kawaida zaidi na zinazohumirwa sana. Kare aina ihi yaihwa *Psilotrichum edule*, '*psilotrichum* inayoriwa'.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *demu* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. He notes, with some surprise, that this group includes some of the most widely known plants. In Mgombato *demu* is a different word, meaning a rag or cloth. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *demu* na kuliorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Anaeleza, kwa mshangao kiasi, kwamba kundi hili lina baadhi ya mimea inayojulikana zaidi. Katika Mgombato, *demu* ni neno tofauti lenye maana ya tambara au kitambaa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *demu*, na anariika kahi ya madzina ambago mana gao taganaweza kuelezwa. Anaandika, achiangalala chidide, kukala fungu hiri rina baadhi ya mimea inayomanyikana zaidi. Kpwa Mgombato, *demu* ni neno ranjina, rinaromaanisha nguwo iriyotsakala au nguwo. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

summary.en: Dokadoka is a thin, twining climber of the genus Tylophora, not identified to species. Its name means 'breaking', because the stem breaks so easily.
summary.sw: Dokadoka ni mtambaa mwembamba unaojizungusha, wa jenasi Tylophora, ambao spishi yake haijatambuliwa. Jina lake maana yake 'kukatika', kwa sababu shina lake hukatika kwa urahisi sana.
summary.dg: *Dokadoka* ni mmea mwembamba unaofyombera uchilinga-linga mimea yanjina, wa jenasi ya *Tylophora*, ambao ainaye hasa taidzangbwemanyikana. Dzinare manage ni 'kudoka', kpwa sababu muhiwe unadoka upesi sana.

about.en: Dokadoka is a slender twining climber of the milkweed group. Plants in its genus, *Tylophora*, wind their thin stems around other vegetation and have simple leaves in opposite pairs. They bear small, star-shaped flowers and later narrow paired pods that split to release seeds tufted with silky hairs. Pakia collected it only to genus, so its exact species is not known. The feature Digo people notice is how fragile the stem is. It snaps when pulled, unlike the tough, rope-like stems of woody lianas.
about.sw: Dokadoka ni mtambaa mwembamba unaojizungusha, wa kundi la milkweed. Mimea ya jenasi yake, *Tylophora*, huzungusha mashina yao membamba kwenye mimea mingine, na ina majani sahili yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana. Huzaa maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota, na baadaye maganda membamba yaliyo kwa jozi ambayo hupasuka kutoa mbegu zenye vishungi vya nywele laini kama hariri. Pakia aliukusanya hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, kwa hivyo spishi yake hasa haijulikani. Sifa wanayoiona Wadigo ni jinsi shina lake lilivyo dhaifu. Hukatika likivutwa, tofauti na mashina magumu kama kamba ya mitambaa yenye miti.
about.dg: *Dokadoka* ni mmea mwembamba unaofyombera uchilinga-linga, wa jamii ya *milkweed*. Mimea ya jenasiye, *Tylophora*, inadzizunguluka dzulu ya mimea yanjina: chila mmea unalinga-linga muhiwe mwembamba kpwenye mimea iyo, na una makodza mazima ganayolengana mairi-mairi. Inatuluza maruwa madide ga umbo ra nyota, na badaye makakaya membamba ganayokala mairi-mairi, ganayoahuka na kulavya tembe zenye nyere laini dza hariri. Pakia akaumanya mmea uhu hadi jenasi tu, kpwa hivyo ainaye hasa taimanyikana. Chitu Adigo anachochiona ni vira muhiwe unavyodoka upesi. Unadoka uchimwehwa, tafwauti na mihi migumu dza kamba ya mbugu zenye nyama za muhi.

where.en: Plants of this genus twine through bush, thicket and forest edges, climbing over shrubs rather than reaching the canopy.
where.sw: Mimea ya jenasi hii hujizungusha vichakani, kwenye vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, ikipanda juu ya vichaka badala ya kufika kwenye kilele cha msitu.
where.dg: Mimea ya jenasi ihi inalinga-linga weruni, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, ichifyombera dzulu ya vitsaka, ela taifika dzulu kabisa ya mihi mire.

culture.en: The name comes from the verb *doka*, which Mgombato glosses as 'to tear, to break off, to come apart (e.g. a piece of rope)'. Pakia gives *dokadoka* as an example of a reduplicated name. In Digo plant names, repeating the stem adds emphasis to the feature named, here the brittleness.
culture.sw: Jina linatokana na kitenzi *doka*, ambacho Mgombato inakieleza kama 'kuchanika, kukatika, kutengana (k.m. kipande cha kamba)'. Pakia anatoa *dokadoka* kama mfano wa jina lililorudiwa. Katika majina ya mimea ya Kidigo, kurudia shina huongeza msisitizo kwa sifa inayotajwa, hapa ikiwa ni udhaifu wa shina.
culture.dg: Dzina rinatuluka kula *doka*, ambaro Mgombato unarieleza kukala 'kuahuka, kuvundzika, kugbwanyuka (dza chipande cha kamba)'. Pakia analavya *dokadoka* dza mfwano wa dzina ririro na neno mara mbiri. Kpwa madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo, kuuyira neno kunatiya nguvu kpwenye chitu chinachoihwa, hipha ni vira mmea unavyodoka upesi.

names.en: Digo: *dokadoka*, 'breaking'. Pakia notes that the same name with an *m-* prefix, *mdokadoka*, is used for several *Cissus* climbers whose stems also break easily. He says dropping the *m-* does not seem to change the meaning, so the two names may not mark a clear difference between species. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *dokadoka*, 'kukatika'. Pakia anaeleza kwamba jina hilohilo likiwa na kiambishi *m-*, *mdokadoka*, hutumika kwa mitambaa kadhaa ya *Cissus* ambayo mashina yake pia hukatika kwa urahisi. Anasema kuondoa *m-* hakuonekani kubadilisha maana, kwa hivyo huenda majina haya mawili hayatofautishi spishi waziwazi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Chidigo: *dokadoka*, 'kudoka'. Pakia anaandika kukala dzina hiri hiri, richienjerezwa *m-* mwandzoni, *mdokadoka*, nkuhumirwa kpwa mbugu nyinji za *Cissus*, ambazo mihi yao piya inadoka upesi. Anagomba kukala kuusa *m-* takuonekana kugaluza mana, kpwa hivyo madzina iga mairi ganaweza kukala tagaonyesa tafwauti ya kpweli kahi ya aina. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Mdokadoka, the same 'breaking' name for a Cissus climber
reason.sw: Mdokadoka, jina lilelile la 'kukatika' kwa mtambaa wa Cissus
reason.dg: *Mdokadoka*, dzina hiri hiri ra 'kudoka' kpwa libugu ra *Cissus*

reason.sw: Cissus mwingine wenye shina dhaifu unaoitwa mdokadoka
reason.dg: *Cissus* yanjina yenye muhi unaodoka upesi, inayoihwa *mdokadoka*

reason.sw: Mtambaa wa familia ileile ya milkweed, wenye maganda ya mbegu za hariri
reason.dg: *Libugu pamba*, libugu ra jamii ya *milkweed*, renye makakaya na tembe zenye nyere laini

reason.en: Secamone, another small climber of the milkweed family
reason.sw: Secamone, mtambaa mwingine mdogo wa familia ya milkweed
reason.dg: *Secamone*, mmea mdide wanjina unaofyombera wa jamii ya *milkweed*
