teaser.en: A creeping weed with sky-blue flowers that open for a morning, then hide away in a folded green hood.
teaser.sw: Gugu linalotambaa lenye maua ya buluu kama anga, yanayofunguka kwa asubuhi moja tu kisha kujificha ndani ya kofia ya kijani iliyokunjwa.
teaser.dg: Kpwekpwe inayoambala yenye maruwa ga samawati, ganayovuguka ligundzu mwenga tu, chisha ganadzifwitsa ndani ya kodza dide ra chijani ririrokundzwa.

summary.en: Dzedza is a creeping dayflower with fleshy stems and small blue flowers, common in fields and disturbed ground. Digo people class it with the soft herbs and grasses, not with the climbers, because its stem never becomes woody.
summary.sw: Dzedza ni mmea unaotambaa wenye mashina manono na maua madogo ya buluu, unaopatikana sana mashambani na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa. Wadigo huuweka pamoja na mimea laini na majani ya nyasi, si pamoja na mitambaa, kwa sababu shina lake halibadiliki kuwa la mti.
summary.dg: *Dzedza* ni mmea unaoambala photsi wa jenasi ya *Commelina* (*dayflower*), wenye mihi yenye madzi manji na maruwa madide ga samawati, unaophahikana sana mindani na phatu ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa. Adigo anauika phamwenga na mimea laini na nyasi, si phamwenga na mbugu, kpwa sababu muhiwe taukala mgumu dza wa muhi.

about.en: Dzedza is a low, sprawling herb whose soft, fleshy stems trail along the ground and root where they touch it. The oval leaves have sheathing bases, often fringed with reddish hairs. The flowers come out of a small folded green bract shaped like a funnel. Each has two rounded sky-blue petals and a third, much smaller one, and opens for only a few hours. The plant can also flower and set seed underground, which helps make it a stubborn weed.
about.sw: Dzedza ni mmea mdogo unaotanda chini, ambao mashina yake laini na manono hutambaa ardhini na kutoa mizizi pale yanapogusa udongo. Majani yake ya umbo la yai yana vitako vinavyozunguka shina, mara nyingi vyenye pindo la manyoya mekundu. Maua hutoka ndani ya kibrakti kidogo cha kijani kilichokunjwa kama faneli. Kila ua lina petali mbili za mviringo za buluu kama anga na ya tatu ndogo zaidi, na hufunguka kwa saa chache tu. Mmea huu pia unaweza kuchanua na kuzaa mbegu chini ya ardhi, jambo linalouwezesha kuwa gugu sugu.
about.dg: *Dzedza* ni mmea laini wa photsi unaoenea, ambao mihiye laini yenye madzi inaambala photsi na kumera mizi phatu inaphoguta tsi. Makodzage ni ga mviringo, na photsi ya chila kodza inazunguluka muhi dza mfuko, mara nyinji ichikala na nyere za kundu chidide kanda-kanda. Maruwa ganatuluka ndani ya kodza dide ra chijani ririrokundzwa, renye umbo dza ra chifumbu. Chila ruwa rina makodza mairi ga ruwa ga mviringo ga samawati, na ra hahu dide sana, na rinavuguka kpwa saa chache tu. Mmea uhu piya unaweza kutuluza maruwa na tembe tsini ya tsi, na hiri rinauhenda ukale kpwekpwe ngumu kuiusa.

where.en: It grows in cultivated fields, gardens, roadsides and other disturbed ground. It spreads in the rains, and pieces of stem left after weeding often take root again.
where.sw: Hukua mashambani, bustanini, kando ya barabara na kwenye ardhi nyingine iliyovurugwa. Huenea wakati wa mvua, na vipande vya shina vinavyobaki baada ya kupalilia mara nyingi huota mizizi tena.
where.dg: Unamera mindani, busitanini, kanda-kanda ya njira na phatu phanjina ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa. Unaenea wakati wa mvula, na vipande vya muhi vinavyosala bada ya kuusa kpwekpwe mara nyinji vinamera mizi tsona.

uses.en: Pakia records no use for it among the Digo. Elsewhere in tropical Africa and Asia the young leaves are cooked as a vegetable and the plant is cut for livestock fodder.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Kwingineko katika Afrika na Asia ya kitropiki, majani machanga hupikwa kama mboga na mmea hukatwa kuwa lishe ya mifugo.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika kukala Adigo anauhumira kpwa chitu chochosi. Kpwenye tsi zanjina za dzoho za Afrika na Asia, makodza malaini nkujitwa dza mboga, na mmea nkukatwa kuhenda chakurya cha mifugo.

culture.en: Pakia uses *Commelina benghalensis* to show where the Digo draw the line between life forms. Although it trails and scrambles, it is not *mbugu*, a climber, because a climber must have a woody stem. Instead it belongs with *nyasi*, the herbaceous layer of grasses, herbs and creepers.
culture.sw: Pakia anatumia *Commelina benghalensis* kuonyesha mahali Wadigo wanapoweka mpaka kati ya maumbo ya mimea. Ingawa hutambaa na kujivuta juu ya mimea mingine, si *mbugu*, yaani mtambaa, kwa sababu mtambaa lazima uwe na shina la mti. Badala yake ni wa kundi la *nyasi*, tabaka la chini la majani ya nyasi, mimea midogo laini na mimea inayotambaa.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira *Commelina benghalensis* kuonyesa vira Adigo anavyoganya mimea kpwa mafungu kulengana na umbo rao. Hata kala unaambala na kufyombera, si *mbugu*, mmea unaofyombera, kpwa sababu libugu ni lazima rikale na muhi wa nyama za muhi. Badalaye, ni wa *nyasi*, fungu ra mimea laini ya photsi: nyasi, mimea midide laini na mimea inayoambala.

names.en: Digo: *dzedza*. Pakia's list gives the English name Wandering Jew; botanists also call it Benghal dayflower or tropical spiderwort. Pakia's name lists are not consistent. Appendix III gives *dzedza* for *C. benghalensis* and *chidzedza* for its larger-flowered relative *C. bracteosa*, but Appendix VI pairs *dzedza* with *C. bracteosa* and says the name is shared with Duruma and Swahili.
names.sw: Kidigo: *dzedza*. Orodha ya Pakia inatoa jina la Kiingereza *Wandering Jew*; wataalamu wa mimea pia huuita *Benghal dayflower* au *tropical spiderwort*. Orodha za majina za Pakia hazilingani. Kiambatisho III kinatoa *dzedza* kwa *C. benghalensis* na *chidzedza* kwa ndugu yake mwenye maua makubwa zaidi, *C. bracteosa*, lakini Kiambatisho VI kinaunganisha *dzedza* na *C. bracteosa* na kusema jina hilo linashirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kiswahili.
names.dg: Chidigo: *dzedza*. Madzina ga Pakia ganalavya dzina ra Chingereza *Wandering Jew*; asayansi piya anauiha *Benghal dayflower* au *tropical spiderwort*. Madzina ga Pakia tagalengana. *Appendix III* inalavya *dzedza* kpwa *C. benghalensis* na *chidzedza* kpwa nduguye mwenye maruwa makulu, *C. bracteosa*, ela *Appendix VI* inaika *dzedza* phamwenga na *C. bracteosa* na inagomba kukala dzina hiri ni sawa kpwa Chiduruma na Chiswahili.

reason.sw: Chidzedza, yaani Commelina bracteosa, ndugu yake wa karibu
reason.dg: *Chidzedza*, *Commelina bracteosa*, iriyo nduguye phephi

reason.sw: Kongwe lume, Commelina mwingine
reason.dg: *Kongwe lume*, *Commelina* yanjina

reason.dg: Kpwekpwe yanjina laini inayoambala mindani na busitanini

reason.sw: Mfano mwingine wa Pakia wa mmea unaotambaa uliowekwa katika nyasi
reason.dg: Mfwano wanjina wa Pakia wa mmea unaoambala unaoikpwa kahi ya *nyasi*

teaser.en: Named 'to smoke up', because its flowers seem to rise from the ground all at once, like smoke.
teaser.sw: Unaitwa 'kufuka', kwa sababu maua yake huonekana kuchipuka ardhini yote kwa mara moja, kama moshi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ni 'kufuka', kpwa sababu maruwage ganaonekana dza ganatuluka photsi phamwenga gosi, dza mosi unavyofuka.

summary.en: Fuka is a soft, creeping herb of the mint family, a relative of mvuga. Its name compares the sudden flush of its small flowers to smoke rising.
summary.sw: Fuka ni mmea mdogo laini unaotambaa wa familia ya minanaa, ndugu wa mvuga. Jina lake linalinganisha kuchanua kwa ghafla kwa maua yake madogo na moshi unaopanda.
summary.dg: *Fuka* ni mmea laini unaoambala photsi, wa jamii ya *mint*, ndugu wa *mvuga*. Dzinare rinaonyesa kukala maruwage madide, ganayozuka phamwenga gosi, ni dza mosi unaofuka.

about.en: Fuka is a weak-stemmed, sprawling herb that creeps over the ground. *Flaccidus* means 'limp', a fair description of its stems. Like most of the mint family it has square stems and leaves in opposite pairs, and the leaves are faintly aromatic when crushed. Its small two-lipped flowers, pale blue to mauve, are borne on slender upright spikes. Digo people recognise it by the look of its leaves.
about.sw: Fuka ni mmea mdogo wenye mashina dhaifu unaotanda na kutambaa ardhini. *Flaccidus* maana yake 'legevu', maelezo yanayofaa mashina yake. Kama mimea mingi ya familia ya minanaa, una mashina ya pembe nne na majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, na majani hutoa harufu hafifu yakipondwa. Maua yake madogo yenye midomo miwili, ya buluu hafifu hadi zambarau hafifu, huota kwenye masuke membamba yaliyosimama. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya majani yake.
about.dg: *Fuka* ni mmea laini wenye mihi isiyo na nguvu, unaotandazika na kuambala photsi. *Flaccidus* rina mana ya 'chisicho na nguvu', na neno hiri rinafwaha mihiye. Dza mimea minji ya jamii ya *mint*, mihiye ina pembe nne, na makodzage ganamera jozi-jozi ganalengana; makodza gachihopezwa ganalavya arufu nono chidide. Maruwage madide, genye miromo miiri, ni ga samawati ngushu-ngushu hadi zambarau ngushu-ngushu, na ganamera dzulu ya milita myembamba inayoima. Adigo anaumanya kpwa umbo ra makodzage.

where.en: It grows as a ground creeper in the herb layer of bush and woodland, often in shade or among rocks.
where.sw: Hukua kama mmea unaotambaa ardhini katika tabaka la mimea midogo vichakani na misituni, mara nyingi kivulini au katikati ya miamba.
where.dg: Unamera photsi dza mmea unaoambala, kahi ya mimea midide ya weruni na ya matsaka ga mihi, mara nyinji phatu phenye chivuri au kahi ya mawe.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name as 'to smoke up': the flowers appear so quickly that they seem to rise like smoke. Mgombato glosses the verb *fuka* as 'to rise up (of smoke), to evaporate'. Pakia lists *fuka* among the ground creepers that Digo people class as *nyasi*, the soft herbaceous layer.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jina hili kama 'kufuka': maua hutokea haraka sana hivi kwamba huonekana kupanda kama moshi. Mgombato inaeleza kitenzi *fuka* kama 'kupanda juu (moshi), kuvukiza'. Pakia anaorodhesha *fuka* miongoni mwa mimea inayotambaa ardhini ambayo Wadigo huiweka katika *nyasi*, tabaka la mimea laini.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala dzina hiri rina mana ya 'kufuka': maruwa ganazuka upesi sana hata ganaonekana dza mosi unaofuka. Mgombato inaandika kukala *fuka* rina mana ya mosi kuambuka dzulu, au madzi kumala kpwa dzoho. Pakia anaika *fuka* kahi ya mimea inayoambala photsi ambayo Adigo anaiika kahi ya *nyasi*, mimea laini ya photsi.

names.en: Digo: *fuka*, 'to smoke up'. Pakia records it only for Digo and gives no English or Swahili name. Scientists call it *Plectranthus flaccidus*. Its relative *Plectranthus tenuiflorus* is the medicinal *mvuga*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *fuka*, 'kufuka'. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu na hatoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili. Wanasayansi huuita *Plectranthus flaccidus*. Ndugu yake *Plectranthus tenuiflorus* ni *mvuga*, mmea wa dawa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *fuka*, 'kufuka'. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, na kaandika dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Plectranthus flaccidus*. Nduguye *Plectranthus tenuiflorus* ni *mvuga*, unaohumirwa dza dawa.

reason.dg: *Mvuga*, *Plectranthus* yanjina, inayohumirwa dza dawa

teaser.en: The seaside futswe: a rough-leaved, yellow-flowered daisy that sprawls over the sand just above the tide.
teaser.sw: Futswe wa pwani: ua la jamii ya alizeti lenye majani makwaruzo na maua ya manjano, linalotanda mchangani juu kidogo ya mpaka wa maji kujaa.
teaser.dg: *Futswe ra pwani*: mmea wenye makodza ganayokaraza na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano dza ga *daisy*, unaotandazika dzulu ya mtsanga, dzulu tu ya phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika.

summary.en: Futswe ra pwani is a sprawling yellow daisy of the beach and coastal scrub. Digo people name it after the farm weed futswe and add 'of the seaside' for where it grows.
summary.sw: Futswe ra pwani ni mmea wa jamii ya alizeti (daisy) wenye maua ya manjano unaotanda ufukweni na vichakani pwani. Wadigo wameupa jina la gugu la shambani futswe na kuongeza 'wa pwani' kwa sababu ya mahali unapoota.
summary.dg: *Futswe ra pwani* ni mmea unaotandazika wenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano dza ga *daisy*, wa mtsanga wa pwani na wa vitsaka vya pwani. Adigo anauiha kpwa dzina ra *futswe*, mbondo ya mindani, na anaenjereza 'ra pwani' kpwa sababu ya phatu unaphomera.

about.en: Futswe ra pwani is a scrambling, somewhat woody perennial herb that spreads over sand and low scrub. Its opposite leaves are rough to the touch, like fine sandpaper, with toothed edges. Small yellow daisy heads stand on stalks, often in pairs, which is what *biflora* ('two-flowered') refers to. The small fruits are hard and can float, which helps the plant spread along coastlines.
about.sw: Futswe ra pwani ni mmea mdogo wa kudumu, wenye ugumu kiasi kama wa mti, unaojivuta na kutanda juu ya mchanga na vichaka vifupi. Majani yake yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana ni makwaruzo yakiguswa, kama msasa laini, na yana meno kingoni. Vichwa vidogo vya maua ya manjano husimama juu ya vikonyo, mara nyingi viwili viwili, na hiyo ndiyo maana ya *biflora* ('maua mawili'). Matunda yake madogo ni magumu na yanaweza kuelea, jambo linalousaidia mmea kuenea kando ya pwani.
about.dg: *Futswe ra pwani* ni mmea unaoambala, wenye mihi migumu chidide, unaokala kpwa myaka minji, na unatandazika dzulu ya mtsanga na dzulu ya vitsaka vifupi. Makodzage ganamera jozi-jozi ganalengana, ganakaraza uchigaguta, dza msasa wa tembe ndide, na gana meno kanda-kanda. Vitswa vidide vya maruwa ga rangi ya mandano, dza vya *daisy*, vinaima dzulu ya milita, mara nyinji viiri-viiri; ndiyo mana ya *biflora* ('maruwa mairi'). Matundage madide ni magumu na ganaweza kuelea madzini, na kpwa njira ihi mmea unaenea kanda-kanda ya pwani.

where.en: It grows on the seashore: on sandy beach crests, at the edge of coastal bushland and among rocks just above the high-water mark. It is found along coasts across the Indian and Pacific Oceans.
where.sw: Hukua ufukweni: kwenye vilele vya fukwe za mchanga, pembezoni mwa vichaka vya pwani na katikati ya miamba juu kidogo ya mpaka wa maji kujaa. Hupatikana kando ya pwani za Bahari ya Hindi na Bahari ya Pasifiki.
where.dg: Unamera pwani: dzulu ya vidzulu vya mtsanga wa pwani, kanda-kanda ya vitsaka vya pwani na kahi ya mawe, dzulu tu ya phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika. Unaphahikana kanda-kanda ya pwani za Bahari ya Hindi na za Bahari ya Pasifiki.

culture.en: The name follows a common Digo pattern. *Futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*) is a familiar creeping herb of farms, and this plant is seen as its seaside counterpart. Pakia notes that adding *pwani*, 'sea', marks plants that grow on the shore, or at least nearer the coast than a related plant, as in *mkungu wa pwani*.
culture.sw: Jina hili linafuata mtindo wa kawaida wa Kidigo. *Futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*) ni mmea mdogo unaotambaa unaojulikana sana mashambani, na mmea huu unaonekana kuwa mwenzake wa pwani. Pakia anaeleza kwamba kuongeza *pwani*, 'bahari', huonyesha mimea inayoota ufukweni, au angalau karibu zaidi na pwani kuliko mmea unaohusiana nao, kama katika *mkungu wa pwani*.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinalunga njira ya kawaida ya Adigo ya kuiha mimea. *Futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*) ni mmea unaoambala unaomanyikana sana mindani, na Adigo anauona mmea uhu kukala ni *futswe* wa pwani. Pakia anaandika kukala kuenjereza *pwani*, 'bahari', kunaonyesa mimea inayomera pwani, au dzagbwe phephi na pwani kuriko mmea wanjina wa jamii mwenga, dza *mkungu wa pwani*.

names.en: Digo: *futswe ra pwani*, 'futswe of the seaside', and *nchidoka*. Pakia cites *nchidoka* among plant names whose *n-* prefix seems to mark the female gender, but he gives no meaning for the rest of the word. Mgombato records *futswe* itself as *Asystasia gangetica*, Swahili *kichwamangwo*. Elsewhere this plant is called sea daisy; Pakia gives no English name.
names.sw: Kidigo: *futswe ra pwani*, 'futswe wa pwani', na *nchidoka*. Pakia anataja *nchidoka* miongoni mwa majina ya mimea ambayo kiambishi chake *n-* kinaonekana kuashiria jinsi ya kike, lakini hatoi maana ya sehemu iliyobaki ya neno. Mgombato inarekodi *futswe* yenyewe kama *Asystasia gangetica*, kwa Kiswahili *kichwamangwo*. Kwingineko mmea huu unaitwa *sea daisy*; Pakia hatoi jina la Kiingereza.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *futswe ra pwani*, '*futswe* ra pwani', na *nchidoka*. Pakia anaandika *nchidoka* kahi ya madzina ga mimea ambago mwandzo wa *n-* unaonekana kuonyesa kukala mmea ni wa chichetu, ela kaandika mana ya seemu yosi yanjina ya neno. Mgombato inaandika kukala *futswe* ni *Asystasia gangetica*, kpwa Chiswahili *kichwamangwo*. Kpwenye vitabu vyanjina mmea uhu unaihwa *sea daisy*; Pakia kaandika dzina ra Chingereza.

teaser.en: A climber with thick, smooth, bright green stems that stay green for years, and that has a reputation as a poisonous plant.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye mashina manene, laini, ya kijani angavu yanayobaki kijani kwa miaka mingi, na unaojulikana kuwa mmea wenye sumu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa kufyombera wenye mihi minono, laini na ya chijani inayong'ala, inayosala ya chijani kpwa myaka minji, na unamanyikana kukala ni mmea wa sumu.

summary.en: Gore is a big climber of the passion-flower family, recognised by its smooth green stems and lobed leaves. The name is shared with Duruma and Giriama.
summary.sw: Gore ni mtambaa mkubwa wa familia ya mkarakara (passion-flower), unaotambulika kwa mashina yake laini ya kijani na majani yenye mapande. Jina hili linashirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kigiriama.
summary.dg: *Gore* ni mmea mkulu wa kufyombera wa jamii ya mtunda, unaomanyikana kpwa mihiye laini ya chijani na makodzage genye mala. Aduruma na Agiryama piya anauiha vivyo.

about.en: Gore is a vigorous climber that clambers over trees and thicket with the help of tendrils. Its most striking feature is the stem, which stays smooth and green, often with a bluish bloom, even when it is as thick as an arm. The leaves are usually three-lobed. The small greenish flowers are followed by round capsules that split open to show the seeds. Digo people identify it by its leaves and stem together.
about.sw: Gore ni mtambaa wenye nguvu unaopanda juu ya miti na vichaka vizito kwa msaada wa vitete-shikizi (tendrils). Sifa yake inayovutia zaidi ni shina, ambalo hubaki laini na la kijani, mara nyingi likiwa na weupe wa samawati juu yake, hata likiwa nene kama mkono. Majani kwa kawaida yana mapande matatu. Maua madogo ya kijani hufuatwa na vibuyu vya mviringo vinavyopasuka kuonyesha mbegu. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na shina lake kwa pamoja.
about.dg: *Gore* ni mmea wa kufyombera wenye nguvu, unaofyombera dzulu ya mihi na vitsaka kpwa kuterywa ni nyuzi zinazodzizunguluka. Chitu chinachoonekana zaidi ni muhiwe, ambao unasala laini na wa chijani, mara nyinji na vumbi ra samawati dzuluye, hata uchinona dza mkpwono. Kpwa kawaida makodzage gana mala mahahu. Bada ya maruwage madide ga chijani ngushu-ngushu kunazuka matunda makavu ga mviringo, ganayoahuka na kuonyesa tembe. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na muhiwe phamwenga.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, forest edges and thicket, climbing high into the trees.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani, pembezoni mwa misitu na vichakani, ukipanda juu sana mitini.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na vitsakani, uchifyombera dzulu sana kpwenye mihi.

uses.en: Pakia records no use for it among the Digo. Across eastern and southern Africa, *Adenia gummifera* is known as a strongly poisonous plant, even though healers there use small amounts of it in traditional remedies.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Katika Afrika Mashariki na Kusini, *Adenia gummifera* unajulikana kuwa mmea wenye sumu kali, ingawa waganga huko hutumia kiasi kidogo chake katika dawa za jadi.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga Adigo. Kpwenye tsi za Afrika ya Mashariki na ya kusini, *Adenia gummifera* inamanyikana kukala ni mmea wa sumu kali, ela aganga a iko nkuuhumira chidide kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Digo: *gore*. Pakia records the same name in Duruma and Giriama and gives no meaning for it. In southern Africa it is called snake climber or green-stem. Scientists call it *Adenia gummifera*. Its relative *Adenia kirkii* is *mtsotsone*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *gore*. Pakia anarekodi jina hilohilo kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama na hatoi maana yake. Kusini mwa Afrika unaitwa *snake climber* au *green-stem*. Wanasayansi huuita *Adenia gummifera*. Ndugu yake *Adenia kirkii* ni *mtsotsone*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *gore*. Pakia anaandika kukala Aduruma na Agiryama piya anauiha vivyo, na kaandika manage. Kusini ya Afrika unaihwa *snake climber* au *green-stem*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Adenia gummifera*. Nduguye *Adenia kirkii* ni *mtsotsone*.

teaser.en: 'Stomach of the pig': a bush legume whose twisting stems reminded someone of a pig's coiled insides.
teaser.sw: 'Tumbo la nguruwe': mmea wa jamii ya kunde wa vichakani ambao mashina yake yanayojisokota yalimkumbusha mtu matumbo ya nguruwe yaliyojiviringa.
teaser.dg: 'Humbo ra nguluwe': chitsaka cha jamii ya kunde, ambacho mihiye inayobeta yamtambukiza mutu mahumbo ga nguluwe ganayodzizunguluka.

summary.en: Humbo ra nguluwe is a shrubby legume of the coastal bush with yellow pea-flowers and jointed pods. Its name, 'the pig's stomach', describes how its stems twist.
summary.sw: Humbo ra nguluwe ni kichaka cha jamii ya kunde kinachoota vichakani pwani, chenye maua ya manjano ya umbo la ua la njegere na maganda yenye viungo. Jina lake, 'tumbo la nguruwe', linaeleza jinsi mashina yake yanavyojisokota.
summary.dg: *Humbo ra nguluwe* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya kunde cha weruni wa pwani, chenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano dza ga kunde na makakaya genye mafundo. Dzinare, 'humbo ra nguluwe', rinaonyesa vira mihiye inavyobeta.

about.en: Humbo ra nguluwe is a shrub, sometimes small and tree-like, of the pea family. Its leaves are pinnate, with many small rounded leaflets along a central stalk. The flowers are yellow pea-flowers, often streaked with red. Like other *Ormocarpum*, the pods are jointed, breaking into one-seeded segments that are often warty or bristly. Pakia's explanation of the name points to the stems, which twist and wind.
about.sw: Humbo ra nguluwe ni kichaka, wakati mwingine mti mdogo, wa familia ya kunde. Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko, yenye vijani vingi vidogo vya mviringo kando ya kikonyo cha kati. Maua ni ya manjano, ya umbo la ua la njegere, mara nyingi yenye michirizi myekundu. Kama *Ormocarpum* wengine, maganda yake yana viungo, na hukatika kuwa vipande vyenye mbegu moja moja ambavyo mara nyingi vina vinundu au vinywele vigumu. Maelezo ya Pakia kuhusu jina yanaelekeza kwenye mashina, ambayo hujisokota na kujipinda.
about.dg: *Humbo ra nguluwe* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya kunde, na wakati wanjina ni muhi mdide. Makodzage ganaganywa kukala makodza madide manji ga mviringo kanda-kanda ya mongo wa kodza. Maruwage ni ga rangi ya mandano dza ga kunde, mara nyinji genye mistari ya kundu. Dza *Ormocarpum* zanjina, makakaya gana mafundo, na ganavundzika kukala vipande vya tembe mwenga mwenga, ambavyo mara nyinji vina vifundo au nyere ngumu. Pakia anagomba kukala dzina hiri rinaonyesa mihiye, ambayo inabeta na kudzizunguluka.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal bushland and thicket and in forest margins.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vikavu vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu ya pwani, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

culture.en: Pakia gives this as an example of a Digo plant name built like a phrase with a linking word: *humbo ra nguluwe*, 'stomach of pig'. In Mgombato, *nguluwe* is the bush pig and *mahumbo* means innards, stomach and intestines. Pakia records that the same name is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili.
culture.sw: Pakia analitoa hili kama mfano wa jina la mmea wa Kidigo lililoundwa kama kirai chenye neno la kuunganisha: *humbo ra nguluwe*, 'tumbo la nguruwe'. Katika Mgombato, *nguluwe* ni nguruwe-mwitu na *mahumbo* maana yake matumbo, yaani tumbo na utumbo. Pakia anarekodi kwamba jina hilohilo linashirikiwa na Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira dzina hiri dza mfwano wa madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganayodzengbwa dza maneno manji ganayoungwa ni neno dza *ra*: *humbo ra nguluwe*. Kpwenye Mgombato, *nguluwe* ni nguluwe wa weruni (*bush pig*), na *mahumbo* ni vitu vya ndani ya mwiri wa nyama, dza ndani na mahumbo ganjina. Pakia anaandika kukala Aduruma, Agiryama na Aswahili piya anachiiha vivyo.

names.en: Digo: *humbo ra nguluwe*, 'stomach of the pig'. Pakia's Appendix III also lists *mpingwa* for this species, but the same name is given there to the sicklebush *Dichrostachys cinerea* (*mchinjiri*). No English name is recorded. Pakia writes the genus as '*Ormocapum*'; the correct spelling is *Ormocarpum*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *humbo ra nguluwe*, 'tumbo la nguruwe'. Kiambatisho III cha Pakia pia kinaorodhesha *mpingwa* kwa spishi hii, lakini jina hilohilo limetolewa humo kwa mpangwa (*Dichrostachys cinerea*, *mchinjiri*). Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Pakia anaandika jenasi kama '*Ormocapum*'; tahajia sahihi ni *Ormocarpum*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *humbo ra nguluwe*, 'humbo (ndani) ra nguluwe'. Kpwenye *Appendix III* ya Pakia, aina ihi piya inaihwa *mpingwa*, ela phapho phapho dzina hiro rinahewa *mchinjiri* (*Dichrostachys cinerea*). Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Pakia anaandika jenasi kukala '*Ormocapum*'; maandiko ga kpweli ni *Ormocarpum*.

teaser.en: A plant that looks like a burr-weed but has no burrs, so the Digo named it half jirimata, half futswe.
teaser.sw: Mmea unaofanana na gugu lenye miiba-ndoano lakini hauna miiba hiyo, kwa hivyo Wadigo waliupa jina nusu jirimata, nusu futswe.
teaser.dg: Unaonekana dza mbondo wenye matunda ga miya, ela tauna miya, kpwa hivyo Adigo anauiha *jirimata futswe*: seemu mwenga *jirimata*, seemu yanjina *futswe*.

summary.en: Jirimata futswe is a soft, purple-flowered herb of the acanthus family. Its double name says that it has the shape of the burr-bearing jirimata but the harmless fruits of futswe.
summary.sw: Jirimata futswe ni mmea mdogo laini wenye maua ya zambarau wa familia ya acanthus. Jina lake la sehemu mbili linasema kwamba una umbo la jirimata lenye miiba-ndoano lakini matunda yasiyo na madhara ya futswe.
summary.dg: *Jirimata futswe* ni mmea laini wenye maruwa ga zambarau, wa jamii ya *acanthus*. Dzinare ra maneno mairi rinaonyesa kukala una umbo ra *jirimata*, ambayo matundage gana miya, ela matundage tagana ubaya, dza ga *futswe*.

about.en: Jirimata futswe is a soft-stemmed perennial herb or small shrub, usually under a metre tall. It has hairy leaves in opposite pairs. The flowers sit in clusters along the upper stems: small and two-lipped, mauve-pink to purple, often marked with darker lines, with a showy upper lip. Plants in flower can look like a purple haze, which is where the English name comes from. Digo people identify it by its fruits.
about.sw: Jirimata futswe ni mmea mdogo wa kudumu au kichaka kidogo chenye mashina laini, kwa kawaida chini ya mita moja kwa urefu. Una majani yenye manyoya yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana. Maua hukaa kwa vishada kando ya sehemu za juu za mashina: ni madogo na yenye midomo miwili, ya waridi-zambarau hafifu hadi zambarau, mara nyingi yenye mistari mieusi zaidi, na mdomo wa juu unaovutia. Mimea ikichanua inaweza kuonekana kama ukungu wa zambarau, na hapo ndipo jina la Kiingereza linapotoka. Wadigo huutambua kwa matunda yake.
about.dg: *Jirimata futswe* ni mmea laini unaokala kpwa myaka minji, au chitsaka chidide, na mara nyinji tauphiya dzulu kuriko mita mwenga. Makodzage gana nyere na ganamera jozi-jozi ganalengana. Maruwa ganamera kpwa makundi kanda-kanda ya seemu ya dzulu ya mihi: ni madide genye miromo miiri, ga zambarau ngushu-ngushu na pinki hadi zambarau, mara nyinji genye mistari ya rangi nzito zaidi, na mromo wa dzulu unaoonekana sana. Mimea ichikala na maruwa inaweza kuonekana dza mosi wa zambarau, na ndiko dzina ra Chingereza rinakolavywa. Adigo anaumanya kpwa matundage.

where.en: It grows at forest edges, in shady bush and on grassy slopes, often in groups.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani kivulini na kwenye miteremko yenye nyasi, mara nyingi kwa makundi.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka, vitsakani phatu phenye chivuri na kanda-kanda ya myango yenye nyasi, mara nyinji uchimera manji-manji.

culture.en: The name shows how Digo people place a plant between two familiar ones. According to Pakia, it 'takes the form' of *jirimata*, the burr-grass *Cenchrus mitis*. It lacks the thorny fruits, though, and so resembles *futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*), the soft creeping herb.
culture.sw: Jina hili linaonyesha jinsi Wadigo wanavyoweka mmea kati ya mimea miwili inayojulikana. Kwa mujibu wa Pakia, 'unachukua umbo' la *jirimata*, nyasi yenye miiba-ndoano *Cenchrus mitis*. Hata hivyo hauna matunda yenye miiba, na kwa hivyo unafanana na *futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*), mmea mdogo laini unaotambaa.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinaonyesa vira Adigo anavyoika mmea kahi ya mimea miiri inayomanyikana. Pakia anagomba kukala 'unahala umbo' ra *jirimata*, nyasi ya matunda ga miya *Cenchrus mitis*. Ela tauna matunda genye miya, na kpwa hivyo unahalana na *futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*), mmea laini unaoambala.

names.en: Digo: *jirimata futswe*. Pakia gives the English name Purple Haze; it is also called ribbon bush. No Swahili name is recorded. Its relative *Hypoestes forskaolei* is *chibaruti*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *jirimata futswe*. Pakia anatoa jina la Kiingereza *Purple Haze*; pia unaitwa *ribbon bush*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Ndugu yake *Hypoestes forskaolei* ni *chibaruti*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *jirimata futswe*. Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chingereza *Purple Haze*; piya unaihwa *ribbon bush*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Nduguye *Hypoestes forskaolei* ni *chibaruti*.

teaser.en: The 'female' burr-weed, whose hooked fruit-clusters cling to clothes and fur but are gentler than its 'male' partner's.
teaser.sw: Jirimata 'jike', ambaye vishada vya matunda yake vyenye ndoano hunasa kwenye nguo na manyoya ya wanyama, lakini si vikali kama vya mwenzake 'dume'.
teaser.dg: *Jirimata* ya 'chichetu': makundi ga matundage, genye ntsa dza viloo, ganagbwirira nguwo na nyere za nyama, ela tagalumiza dza ga *jirimata* ya 'chilume'.

summary.en: Jirimata kulu is a straggling weed whose fruits form hooked burrs that catch on clothing and animals. Pakia records it as the 'female' jirimata, because its burrs are less sharp than those of the 'male', Cenchrus mitis.
summary.sw: Jirimata kulu ni gugu linalotanda ovyoovyo ambalo matunda yake hufanya vishada vyenye ndoano vinavyonasa kwenye nguo na wanyama. Pakia anaurekodi kama jirimata 'jike', kwa sababu miiba yake si mikali kama ya 'dume', Cenchrus mitis.
summary.dg: *Jirimata kulu* ni mbondo inayotandazika, ambayo matundage ganakala vitswa vya miya genye ntsa dza viloo, vinavyogbwirira nguwo na nyama. Pakia anaandika kukala ni *jirimata* ya 'chichetu', kpwa sababu miyaye si mikali dza ya 'chilume', *Cenchrus mitis*.

about.en: This is a straggling or sprawling herb with leaves in opposite pairs and spikes of small flowers. As the fruits ripen, the flower clusters turn into round burrs armed with hooked bristles. The burrs come off easily and stick to clothing, sacks and the coats of goats and dogs, which is how the plant spreads.
about.sw: Huu ni mmea mdogo unaotanda ovyoovyo, wenye majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana na masuke ya maua madogo. Matunda yanapokomaa, vishada vya maua hugeuka kuwa vishada vya mviringo vilivyojaa vinywele vigumu vyenye ndoano. Vishada hivi hutoka kwa urahisi na kunata kwenye nguo, magunia na manyoya ya mbuzi na mbwa, na hivyo ndivyo mmea huenea.
about.dg: Uhu ni mmea unaotandazika na kuambala, wenye makodza ganayomera jozi-jozi ganalengana, na milita ya maruwa madide. Matunda gachiivwa, makundi ga maruwa ganagaluka kukala vitswa vya mviringo vya miya, vyenye nyere zenye ntsa dza viloo. Vitswa vira vinagbwa upesi na kugbwirira nguwo, magunia na nyere za mbuzi na za madiya, na kpwa njira ihi mmea unaenea.

where.en: It is a weed of farms, field edges, paths and bush, especially where animals and people pass.
where.sw: Ni gugu la mashambani, pembezoni mwa mashamba, njiani na vichakani, hasa mahali wanyama na watu wanapopita.
where.dg: Ni mbondo ya mindani, ya kanda-kanda ya minda, ya njirani na ya weruni, hasa phatu nyama na atu anaphotsupa.

culture.en: *Jirimata* works almost like a genus label for plants with thorny fruits, and Pakia lists it within *miya*, the wider class of prickly plants. Within the group, Digo people sort species by sex. Sharp, dangerous features are counted as male and gentle, harmless ones as female. *Cenchrus mitis*, with fiercer spines, is *jirimata lume* ('male'). This plant, whose burrs are not very sharp, is *jirimata chetu* ('female').
culture.sw: *Jirimata* hutumika karibu kama jina la jenasi kwa mimea yenye matunda ya miiba, na Pakia anaiorodhesha ndani ya *miya*, kundi pana la mimea yenye miiba. Ndani ya kundi hili, Wadigo hupanga spishi kwa jinsi. Sifa kali na hatari huhesabiwa kuwa za kiume, na zile za upole zisizo na madhara huhesabiwa kuwa za kike. *Cenchrus mitis*, mwenye miiba mikali zaidi, ni *jirimata lume* ('dume'). Mmea huu, ambao miiba yake si mikali sana, ni *jirimata chetu* ('jike').
culture.dg: *Jirimata* ni karibu dza dzina ra jenasi ra mimea yenye matunda ga miya, na Pakia anariika kahi ya *miya*, kundi kulu ra mimea yosi yenye miya. Kahi ya kundi hiri, Adigo anaganya aina kpwa chilume na chichetu. Adigo anaona vitu vikali na vya hatari kukala ni vya chilume, na vitu laini visivyo na ubaya kukala ni vya chichetu. *Cenchrus mitis*, yenye miya mikali zaidi, ni *jirimata lume* ('chilume'). Mmea uhu, ambao miyaye si mikali sana, ni *jirimata chetu* ('chichetu').

names.en: Digo: *jirimata kulu* in Pakia's Appendix III. Elsewhere in the thesis it appears as *jirimata chetu*, 'female jirimata', a name shared with Duruma and Swahili. Pakia gives no meaning for *kulu* here. In Mgombato, *-kulu* means large or important. No English name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *jirimata kulu* katika Kiambatisho III cha Pakia. Kwingineko katika tasnifu yake unaonekana kama *jirimata chetu*, 'jirimata jike', jina linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kiswahili. Pakia hatoi maana ya *kulu* hapa. Katika Mgombato, *-kulu* maana yake kubwa au muhimu. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *jirimata kulu* kpwenye *Appendix III* ya Pakia. Kpwenye seemu zanjina za kaziye dzina hiro ni *jirimata chetu*, '*jirimata* ya chichetu', dzina ambaro Aduruma na Aswahili piya nkurihumira. Pakia kaandika mana ya *kulu* phapha. Kpwenye Mgombato, *-kulu* rina mana ya 'kulu' au 'ra muhimu'. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

reason.dg: *Jirimata lume*, ya 'chilume', yenye miya mikali zaidi

teaser.en: The 'male' jirimata: a grass whose spiny burrs are sharp enough to earn a place among the thorny plants.
teaser.sw: Jirimata 'dume': nyasi ambayo miiba ya vishada vyake ni mikali kiasi cha kuiweka miongoni mwa mimea ya miiba.
teaser.dg: *Jirimata* ya 'chilume': nyasi ambayo miya ya vitswavye ni mikali sana, hata ikaikpwa kahi ya mimea ya miya.

summary.en: Jirimata lume is a burr-grass whose seed-heads break up into small, sharply spined burrs. Digo people count it as the 'male' jirimata because its spines are sharper and fiercer than those of the 'female', Pupalia lappacea.
summary.sw: Jirimata lume ni nyasi ambayo vichwa vyake vya mbegu hugawanyika kuwa vishada vidogo vyenye miiba mikali. Wadigo huihesabu kuwa jirimata 'dume' kwa sababu miiba yake ni mikali na hatari zaidi kuliko ya 'jike', Pupalia lappacea.
summary.dg: *Jirimata lume* ni nyasi ambayo vitswa vya tembe vinavundzika kukala vitswa vidide vyenye miya mikali. Adigo anaiona kukala ni *jirimata* ya 'chilume' kpwa sababu miyaye ni mikali na ya hatari kuriko ya 'chichetu', *Pupalia lappacea*.

about.en: Jirimata lume is a grass with slender stems and narrow leaves. Its flower-heads are dense spikes of small burrs. Each burr is a cluster of spikelets enclosed in a ring of bristles and spines, and when ripe it falls away whole. The spines catch in skin, cloth and fur. Digo people identify the plant by these fruits.
about.sw: Jirimata lume ni nyasi yenye mashina membamba na majani membamba. Vichwa vyake vya maua ni masuke mazito ya vishada vidogo vya miiba. Kila kishada ni kikundi cha vishuke kilichozungukwa na duara la vinywele vigumu na miiba, na kikikomaa hudondoka kizima. Miiba hunasa kwenye ngozi, nguo na manyoya ya wanyama. Wadigo huitambua nyasi hii kwa matunda haya.
about.dg: *Jirimata lume* ni nyasi yenye mihi myembamba na makodza membamba. Maruwage ganamera dzulu ya milita, na chila mlita una vitswa vidide vya miya vinavyobanana. Chila chitswa ni kundi ra *spikelets* (seemu ndide za maruwa ga nyasi), na chinazungulukpwa ni pete ya nyere na miya; chichiivwa, chinagbwa chizima. Miya ihi inagbwirira ngozi, nguwo na nyere za nyama. Adigo anaumanya mmea uhu kpwa matunda higa.

where.en: It grows in open, sandy or disturbed ground, in grassland and bush, on paths and around homesteads.
where.sw: Hukua kwenye ardhi wazi, yenye mchanga au iliyovurugwa, katika nyika za nyasi na vichakani, njiani na kuzunguka makazi.
where.dg: Inamera phatu wazi, phenye mtsanga au phatu tsi iriphobanangwa, kpwenye mavuwe na weruni, njirani na kanda-kanda ya kaya.

culture.en: Digo people use male and female labels to pair similar plants. Pakia found that sharp, dangerous features are thought of as male and gentle, harmless ones as female. The spikes of *Cenchrus mitis* are sharper than those of *Pupalia lappacea*, so this grass is *jirimata lume*, 'male jirimata', and *Pupalia* is the female. Pakia also lists *jirimata* with *chikombe tsui* and *mnyondoya* under *miya*, 'thorns', a cover term for all prickly plants.
culture.sw: Wadigo hutumia lebo za dume na jike kuoanisha mimea inayofanana. Pakia aligundua kwamba sifa kali na hatari huchukuliwa kuwa za kiume, na zile za upole zisizo na madhara kuwa za kike. Miiba ya *Cenchrus mitis* ni mikali kuliko ya *Pupalia lappacea*, kwa hivyo nyasi hii ni *jirimata lume*, 'jirimata dume', na *Pupalia* ndiye jike. Pakia pia anaorodhesha *jirimata* pamoja na *chikombe tsui* na *mnyondoya* chini ya *miya*, 'miiba', jina la jumla la mimea yote yenye miiba.
culture.dg: Adigo nkuhumira madzina ga chilume na chichetu kuika phamwenga mimea miiri inayohalana. Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaona vitu vikali na vya hatari kukala ni vya chilume, na vitu laini visivyo na ubaya kukala ni vya chichetu. Miya ya *Cenchrus mitis* ni mikali kuriko ya *Pupalia lappacea*, kpwa hivyo nyasi hino ni *jirimata lume*, '*jirimata* ya chilume', na *Pupalia* ni ya chichetu. Pakia piya anaika *jirimata* phamwenga na *chikombe tsui* na *mnyondoya* kahi ya *miya*, dzina ra jumla ra mimea yosi yenye miya.

names.en: Digo: *jirimata lume*, 'male jirimata'. Pakia records it only for Digo, with no English or Swahili name. Plants of this genus are known elsewhere as burr-grasses or sandburs.
names.sw: Kidigo: *jirimata lume*, 'jirimata dume'. Pakia anairekodi kwa Kidigo tu, bila jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili. Kwingineko, mimea ya jenasi hii hujulikana kama *burr-grasses* au *sandburs*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *jirimata lume*, '*jirimata* ya chilume'. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, bila dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili. Kpwenye tsi zanjina, mimea ya jenasi ihi inamanyikana dza *burr-grasses* au *sandburs*.

reason.dg: *Jirimata kulu* (*Pupalia lappacea*), ya 'chichetu', yenye miya isiyo mikali

reason.dg: *Mnyondoya*, mmea wanjina wa kundi ra *miya*

reason.dg: *Bondo*, nyasi yanjina ya kawaida ya weruni

digo: Kabichi; Sukumawiki (kale, Brassica oleracea var. acephala)

teaser.en: An English word that has settled into Digo: kabichi, the cabbage, and its leafy cousin that 'pushes the week'.
teaser.sw: Neno la Kiingereza lililotulia katika Kidigo: kabichi, na binamu yake wa majani 'anayesukuma wiki'.
teaser.dg: Neno ra Chingereza rikakala ra Chidigo: *kabichi*, na nduguye wa makodza, *sukuma wiki*, 'kusukuma jumwa'.

summary.en: Kabichi is cabbage, a modern vegetable whose Digo name is borrowed from English. Pakia also lists sukumawiki, kale, the leafy non-heading form of the same species.
summary.sw: Kabichi ni mboga ya kisasa ambayo jina lake la Kidigo limeazimwa kutoka Kiingereza. Pakia pia anaorodhesha sukumawiki, aina ya spishi hiyohiyo yenye majani isiyofanya kichwa.
summary.dg: *Kabichi* ni mboga ya chisasa, na dzinare ra Chidigo rikaazimwa kula Chingereza. Pakia piya anaandika *sukumawiki* (*kale*), mmea wa aina mwenga na kabichi, ela wa makodza tu, usiohenda chitswa.

about.en: Cabbage is a leafy vegetable grown as an annual for its head of tightly wrapped, waxy, blue-green or pale green leaves. Sukuma wiki (kale or collards) is the same species but forms no head. Instead it grows a stem from which the large leaves are picked a few at a time over many weeks. Both belong to the mustard family and have a slightly peppery, cabbage smell when cut.
about.sw: Kabichi ni mboga ya majani inayopandwa kama mmea wa msimu mmoja kwa ajili ya kichwa chake cha majani yaliyofungamana sana, yenye nta, ya rangi ya kijani-samawati au kijani hafifu. Sukuma wiki ni spishi hiyohiyo lakini haifanyi kichwa. Badala yake hukuza shina ambalo majani yake makubwa huchumwa machache kwa wakati mmoja kwa wiki nyingi. Zote mbili ni za familia ya haradali, na hutoa harufu ya kabichi yenye ukali kidogo kama pilipili zinapokatwa.
about.dg: *Kabichi* ni mboga ya makodza inayophandwa chila mwaka, kpwa sababu ya chitswache cha makodza ganayozungulukana na kubanana sana, genye nta, ga rangi ya chijani na samawati au ga chijani ngushu-ngushu. *Sukuma wiki* (*kale* au *collards*) ni aina iyo iyo ya mmea, ela taihenda chitswa. Badalaye inamera muhi, na makodzage makulu nkungobolwa machache machache kpwa majumwa manji. Zosi mbiri ni za jamii ya *mustard*, na zichikatwa zinalavya arufu ya kabichi, yenye ukali chidide dza wa mwatsaka.

where.en: Cabbage and kale grow best in cool weather and are major crops of the Kenyan highlands. On the hot coast they are grown in some gardens and sold in markets.
where.sw: Kabichi na sukuma wiki hustawi zaidi katika hali ya baridi na ni mazao makuu ya nyanda za juu za Kenya. Katika pwani yenye joto hupandwa katika baadhi ya bustani na huuzwa sokoni.
where.dg: *Kabichi* na *sukuma wiki* zinamera vinono zaidi wakati wa mnyevu, na ni mimea mikulu ya munda ya tsi za myango za Kenya. Pwani kuna dzoho, ela zinaphandwa kpwenye busitani zanjina, na nkuguzwa sokoni.

uses.en: The leaves are cooked as a relish (*mboga*) to eat with stiff maize porridge, or used raw in salads. *Sukuma wiki* is among the most common everyday greens in Kenya.
uses.sw: Majani hupikwa kama kitoweo (*mboga*) cha kulia na ugali, au hutumika mabichi katika saladi. *Sukuma wiki* ni mojawapo ya mboga za majani zinazoliwa zaidi kila siku nchini Kenya.
uses.dg: Makodza nkujitwa dza mboga ya kuriwa na sima, au nkuriwa maitsi kpwenye saladi. *Sukuma wiki* ni kahi ya mboga za makodza zinazoriwa sana chila siku Kenya.

culture.en: Pakia uses *kabichi* as an example of a loanword. He lists it in his table of borrowed plant names, with English 'cabbage' as the source. He argues that names for introduced plants that are part of daily life, such as *kabichi*, *karoti* and *mtiki* (teak), are likely to stay and become settled in Digo. By contrast, scientific terms learnt at school tend to be forgotten.
culture.sw: Pakia anatumia *kabichi* kama mfano wa neno la mkopo. Analiorodhesha katika jedwali lake la majina ya mimea yaliyoazimwa, chanzo chake kikiwa neno la Kiingereza 'cabbage'. Anahoji kwamba majina ya mimea iliyoletwa ambayo ni sehemu ya maisha ya kila siku, kama *kabichi*, *karoti* na *mtiki* (msaji), yana uwezekano wa kubaki na kutulia katika Kidigo. Kinyume chake, istilahi za kisayansi zinazofunzwa shuleni huelekea kusahaulika.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira *kabichi* dza mfwano wa neno ra kuazima. Anariandika kahi ya madzina ga mimea garigoazimwa, na neno ra Chingereza *cabbage* ndiro chandzoche. Anagomba kukala madzina ga mimea mijeni inayohumirwa chila siku, dza *kabichi*, *karoti* na *mtiki* (*teak*), ganaweza kusala na kukala ga Chidigo kabisa. Ela maneno ga chisayansi ambago atu anadzifundza sukuli, mara nyinji nkugayala.

names.en: Digo: *kabichi*, from English 'cabbage', the same word as Swahili *kabichi*. Pakia lists *sukumawiki* separately for kale (*B. oleracea* var. *acephala*). The Swahili name *sukuma wiki* is usually explained as 'push the week', because the cheap greens stretch the household budget to the end of the week. Mgombato records *sukuma* as 'to push'.
names.sw: Kidigo: *kabichi*, kutoka Kiingereza 'cabbage', neno lilelile na *kabichi* ya Kiswahili. Pakia anaorodhesha *sukumawiki* kando kwa ajili ya *B. oleracea* var. *acephala*. Jina la Kiswahili *sukuma wiki* kwa kawaida hufafanuliwa kama 'kusukuma wiki', kwa sababu mboga hii ya bei nafuu huwezesha bajeti ya nyumbani kufika mwisho wa wiki. Mgombato inarekodi *sukuma* kama 'kusukuma'.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *kabichi*, kula neno ra Chingereza *cabbage*, na ni dzina riro riro dza ra Chiswahili *kabichi*. Pakia anaandika *sukumawiki* dza dzina ranjina, ra *kale* (*B. oleracea* var. *acephala*). Dzina ra Chiswahili *sukuma wiki* nkugombwa rina mana ya 'kusukuma jumwa', kpwa sababu mboga hizi za bei ndide zinaterya pesa za kaya kufika mwisho wa jumwa. Mgombato ina neno *sukuma*, 'to push'.

teaser.en: A crunchy orange root from far away, whose English name came along with it into Digo.
teaser.sw: Mzizi wa rangi ya machungwa unaokatika kwa mkwaruzo, kutoka mbali, ambao jina lake la Kiingereza liliingia nao katika Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Muzi wa rangi ya chungbwa unaobebenwa, wa kula tsi za kure, na dzinare ra Chingereza redza nao hadi Chidigo.

summary.en: Karoti is the carrot, an introduced root vegetable whose Digo name comes from English. Pakia gives it as an example of a borrowed plant name that is likely to stay in the language.
summary.sw: Karoti ni mboga ya mzizi iliyoletwa ambayo jina lake la Kidigo linatokana na Kiingereza. Pakia anaitoa kama mfano wa jina la mmea lililoazimwa ambalo lina uwezekano wa kubaki katika lugha.
summary.dg: *Karoti* ni muzi wa mboga mjeni, na dzinare ra Chidigo rinalavywa kula Chingereza. Pakia anarihumira dza mfwano wa dzina ra mmea ra kuazima ambaro rinaweza kusala kpwenye luga.

about.en: The carrot is grown for its thick orange taproot. Above ground it has a rosette of finely divided, feathery leaves. If left to grow into a second season, it sends up a tall stalk with flat umbrella-shaped clusters of tiny white flowers, typical of its family, which also includes coriander and parsley.
about.sw: Karoti hupandwa kwa ajili ya mzizi wake mnene wa rangi ya machungwa. Juu ya ardhi ina shada la majani yaliyogawanyika kwa wembamba kama manyoya. Ikiachwa kukua hadi msimu wa pili, hutoa shina refu lenye vishada bapa vya umbo la mwavuli vya maua madogo sana meupe, jambo la kawaida kwa familia yake, ambayo pia inajumuisha giligilani na parsley.
about.dg: *Karoti* inaphandwa kpwa sababu ya muziwe mkulu wa rangi ya chungbwa. Dzulu ya tsi ina makodza ganayozunguluka phamwenga, ganayoganywa kukala vipande vidide sana dza nyoya. Uchiiricha ikamera hadi mwaka wa phiri, inalavya mlita mure, na dzuluye kuna makundi ga maruwa madide sana ga rangi nyereru, ganayotandazika sambamba dza mwamvuri, dza mimea yanjina ya jamiiye, ambayo piya ina *coriander* na *parsley*.

where.en: Carrots prefer cool weather and loose, deep soil, and most of Kenya's crop is grown in the highlands. At the coast they are mostly found in markets and shops, along with some home gardens.
where.sw: Karoti hupenda hali ya baridi na udongo usioshikamana na wenye kina, na sehemu kubwa ya zao la Kenya hupandwa nyanda za juu. Pwani hupatikana zaidi sokoni na madukani, pamoja na baadhi ya bustani za nyumbani.
where.dg: *Karoti* zinamendza mnyevu na ulongo laini unaoinjira tsini sana, na karoti nyinji za Kenya nkurimwa tsi za myango. Pwani mara nyinji zinaphahikana sokoni na madukani, na piya kpwenye busitani zanjina za kaya.

uses.en: The root is eaten raw or cooked in stews, rice dishes and salads, and is valued as a source of vitamin A.
uses.sw: Mzizi huliwa mbichi au hupikwa katika mchuzi, vyakula vya wali na saladi, na huthaminiwa kama chanzo cha vitamini A.
uses.dg: Muzi nkuriwa maitsi, au nkujitwa kpwenye mtsuzi, kpwenye vyakurya vya wari na kpwenye saladi, na una samani kpwa sababu unapha *vitamin A*.

culture.en: Pakia lists *karoti* among the names of introduced plants that are part of daily life and so are 'likely to stay and be stabilised' in Digo.
culture.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *karoti* miongoni mwa majina ya mimea iliyoletwa ambayo ni sehemu ya maisha ya kila siku, na kwa hivyo 'yana uwezekano wa kubaki na kutulia' katika Kidigo.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika *karoti* kahi ya madzina ga mimea mijeni inayohumirwa chila siku, na kpwa hivyo madzina higo 'ganaweza kusala na kukala ga Chidigo kabisa'.

names.en: Digo: *karoti*. In Pakia's table of loaned plant names it is spelt *Karuti* and traced to English 'carrot'. The Swahili name is also *karoti*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *karoti*. Katika jedwali la Pakia la majina ya mimea yaliyoazimwa, limeandikwa *Karuti* na kufuatiliwa hadi Kiingereza 'carrot'. Jina la Kiswahili pia ni *karoti*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *karoti*. Kahi ya madzina ga mimea garigoazimwa ambago Pakia anaganandika, dzina hiri rinaandikpwa *Karuti*, na rinalavywa kula neno ra Chingereza *carrot*. Kpwa Chiswahili piya ni *karoti*.

teaser.en: The 'male' kongwe: a dayflower judged male because its little flowers are smaller and duller than its partner's.
teaser.sw: Kongwe 'dume': mmea wa jenasi Commelina unaohesabiwa kuwa dume kwa sababu maua yake madogo ni madogo zaidi na yasiyong'aa kama ya mwenzake.
teaser.dg: *Kongwe* ya 'chilume': mmea wa *Commelina* (*dayflower*) ambao Adigo anauona ni wa chilume kpwa sababu maruwage madide ni madide zaidi, na rangiye tainang'ala dza ya maruwa ga myawe.

summary.en: Kongwe lume is a small creeping dayflower with pale bluish flowers. In Digo it is the 'male' of a pair, set against the larger, deep-blue-flowered kongwe chetu.
summary.sw: Kongwe lume ni mmea mdogo unaotambaa wa jenasi Commelina wenye maua ya buluu hafifu. Kwa Kidigo ni 'dume' wa jozi, akilinganishwa na kongwe chetu mwenye maua makubwa zaidi ya buluu iliyokolea.
summary.dg: *Kongwe lume* ni mmea mdide unaoambala wa *Commelina*, wenye maruwa ga samawati ngushu-ngushu. Kpwa Chidigo ni 'chilume' kahi ya mimea miiri, na myawe ni *kongwe chetu*, yenye maruwa makulu ga samawati nzito.

about.en: Kongwe lume is a low, creeping herb with jointed stems that root at the nodes. Its leaves are narrow and often have wavy edges. Each small flower comes out of a folded leafy bract. The flowers are pale blue to greyish and less glossy than those of related dayflowers, and they last only part of a day. Digo people identify it by the look of its leaves; Pakia lists it as a grass-like plant.
about.sw: Kongwe lume ni mmea mdogo unaotambaa chini, wenye mashina yenye vifundo yanayotoa mizizi kwenye vifundo hivyo. Majani yake ni membamba na mara nyingi yana kingo za mawimbi. Kila ua dogo hutoka ndani ya kibrakti cha jani kilichokunjwa. Maua ni ya buluu hafifu hadi kijivu, hayang'ai kama ya mimea mingine ya jenasi hii, na hudumu sehemu tu ya siku. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya majani yake; Pakia anauorodhesha kama mmea unaofanana na nyasi.
about.dg: *Kongwe lume* ni mmea mdide unaoambala photsi, wenye mihi ya mafundo inayolavya mizi phatu pha mafundo. Makodzage ni membamba, na mara nyinji gana maimbi kanda-kanda. Chila ruwa ridide rinatuluka ndani ya kodza ridide rinalokundzika. Maruwa ni ga samawati ngushu-ngushu hadi rangi ya ivu, tagang'ala dza ga *Commelina* zanjina, na ganakala kpwa seemu tu ya siku. Adigo anaumanya kpwa umbo ra makodzage; Pakia anauika kahi ya mimea inayohalana na nyasi.

where.en: It grows in open grassland, sandy places, farms and disturbed ground, spreading low among other herbs.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika wazi za nyasi, sehemu za mchanga, mashambani na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa, ukitanda chini katikati ya mimea mingine midogo.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye mavuwe, phatu phenye mtsanga, mindani na phatu tsi iriphobanangwa, uchitandazika photsi kahi ya mimea midide yanjina.

culture.en: This is one of Pakia's clearest examples of the Digo male-and-female naming of plant pairs. *Kongwe chetu*, 'female kongwe' (*Commelina bracteosa*), has large, deep blue flowers. *Kongwe lume*, 'male kongwe', is so called because its flowers are smaller and less shiny, closer to grey. Usually, Pakia notes, sharp and dangerous features make a plant 'male'. Here a plainer, smaller flower does.
culture.sw: Huu ni mojawapo ya mifano iliyo wazi zaidi ya Pakia ya utaratibu wa Kidigo wa kuipa jozi za mimea majina ya dume na jike. *Kongwe chetu*, 'kongwe jike' (*Commelina bracteosa*), ana maua makubwa ya buluu iliyokolea. *Kongwe lume*, 'kongwe dume', anaitwa hivyo kwa sababu maua yake ni madogo zaidi na hayang'ai sana, yakikaribia kijivu. Kwa kawaida, Pakia anaeleza, sifa kali na hatari ndizo humfanya mmea kuwa 'dume'. Hapa ni ua jepesi na dogo zaidi.
culture.dg: Uhu ni mwenga wa mifwano ya wazi zaidi ya Pakia ya vira Adigo anavyoiha mimea miiri kpwa chilume na chichetu. *Kongwe chetu*, '*kongwe* ya chichetu' (*Commelina bracteosa*), ina maruwa makulu ga samawati nzito. *Kongwe lume*, '*kongwe* ya chilume', inaihwa vivyo kpwa sababu maruwage ni madide zaidi na tagang'ala sana, ga rangi iriyo phephi na ya ivu. Pakia anagomba kukala kpwa kawaida vitu vikali na vya hatari ndivyo vinavyohenda mmea ukale 'mlume'. Phapha, ruwa ridide zaidi, risiro na rangi ya kung'ala, ndiro rinalouhenda ukale vivyo.

names.en: Digo: *kongwe lume*, 'male kongwe'. Its partner *kongwe chetu* is shared with Swahili, according to Pakia. In Pakia's Appendix III, *Commelina bracteosa* is also called *chidzedza*. No English or Swahili name is recorded for this species.
names.sw: Kidigo: *kongwe lume*, 'kongwe dume'. Mwenzake *kongwe chetu* ni jina linaloshirikiwa na Kiswahili, kwa mujibu wa Pakia. Katika Kiambatisho III cha Pakia, *Commelina bracteosa* pia huitwa *chidzedza*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa kwa spishi hii.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *kongwe lume*, '*kongwe* ya chilume'. Pakia anagomba kukala dzina ra myawe, *kongwe chetu*, ni ra Chidigo na ra Chiswahili. Kpwenye *Appendix III* ya Pakia, *Commelina bracteosa* piya inaihwa *chidzedza*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa kpwa aina ihi.

teaser.en: One huge, lacy leaf on a mottled stalk with a 'knee', rising from a buried tuber on the forest floor.
teaser.sw: Jani moja kubwa lenye mapambo kama lasi juu ya kikonyo chenye madoadoa na 'goti', likichipuka kutoka kiazi kilichozikwa ardhini msituni.
teaser.dg: Kodza mwenga kulu, rinaloganyika vipande vinji, dzulu ya mlita wenye madowa na 'goti', rinalomera kula chiazi chiricho tsini tsakani.

summary.en: Kundzwi is a forest-floor aroid that grows from an underground tuber and puts up a single large, much-divided leaf. Pakia also lists the name ulanga for it, a name the Digo give to Polynesian arrowroot too.
summary.sw: Kundzwi ni mmea wa familia ya mayugwa unaoota sakafuni mwa msitu kutoka kiazi cha chini ya ardhi, na kutoa jani moja kubwa lililogawanyika sana. Pakia pia anaorodhesha jina ulanga kwa mmea huu, jina ambalo Wadigo pia hulitoa kwa Polynesian arrowroot.
summary.dg: *Kundzwi* ni mmea wa jamii ya *arum* wa photsi tsakani, unaomera kula chiazi cha tsini, na unalavya kodza mwenga kulu rinaloganyika vipande vinji. Pakia piya anaandika dzina *ulanga* kpwa mmea uhu, dzina ambaro Adigo nkurihumira piya kpwa *Polynesian arrowroot*.

about.en: Kundzwi is a tuberous herb of the arum family. In the rainy season it puts up one large leaf on a tall stalk, often mottled. The blade is divided again and again into many leaflets, so it looks lacy and fern-like. The genus name *Gonatopus* means 'knee-foot', after a joint or swelling on the leaf stalk. The flowers are borne low down, on a spike inside a hooded bract, and are followed by fleshy berries. In the dry season the leaf dies back and the plant survives as its buried tuber.
about.sw: Kundzwi ni mmea mdogo wenye kiazi, wa familia ya mayugwa. Wakati wa mvua hutoa jani moja kubwa juu ya kikonyo kirefu, mara nyingi chenye madoadoa. Bapa la jani limegawanyika tena na tena kuwa vijani vingi, kwa hivyo huonekana kama lasi au kama jani la kangaga. Jina la jenasi *Gonatopus* maana yake 'mguu wenye goti', kutokana na kiungo au uvimbe kwenye kikonyo cha jani. Maua huota chini kabisa, kwenye suke lililo ndani ya brakti yenye umbo la kofia, na hufuatwa na matunda yenye nyama. Wakati wa kiangazi jani hunyauka na mmea huishi kama kiazi chake kilichozikwa.
about.dg: *Kundzwi* ni mmea wa chiazi wa jamii ya *arum*. Wakati wa mvula unalavya kodza mwenga kulu dzulu ya mlita mure, ambao mara nyinji una madowa. Kodza riro rinaganywa tsona na tsona kukala makodza madide manji, kpwa hivyo rinaonekana dza nyuzi-nyuzi, dza kodza ra *fern*. Dzina ra jenasi *Gonatopus* rina mana ya 'goti-gulu', kpwa sababu ya fundo au phatu phanaphovwimba kpwenye mlita wa kodza. Maruwa ganamera photsi, dzulu ya mlita uriofunikpwa ni kodza dza kofiya, na badaye kunazuka matunda madide genye nyama. Wakati wa kazikazi kodza rinafwa, na mmea unasala dza chiazi chiricho tsini.

where.en: It grows in the shade of coastal forest, thicket and woodland, on the forest floor.
where.sw: Hukua kivulini katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka vizito na misitu ya miti iliyotawanyika, sakafuni mwa msitu.
where.dg: Unamera chivurini, photsi tsakani: kpwenye matsaka ga pwani, vitsakani na kpwenye matsaka ga mihi.

names.en: Digo: *kundzwi*, shared with Duruma and Giriama according to Pakia, who gives no meaning. His Appendix III also lists *ulanga* for this plant. *Ulanga* is the Digo name for Polynesian arrowroot (*Tacca leontopetaloides*), another tuberous forest herb with a single, deeply divided leaf, which may explain the shared name. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *kundzwi*, jina linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kigiriama kwa mujibu wa Pakia, ambaye hatoi maana yake. Kiambatisho III chake pia kinaorodhesha *ulanga* kwa mmea huu. *Ulanga* ni jina la Kidigo la *Tacca leontopetaloides* (Polynesian arrowroot), mmea mwingine wa msituni wenye kiazi na jani moja lililogawanyika sana, jambo ambalo huenda linaeleza kwa nini wanashiriki jina. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *kundzwi*. Pakia anagomba kukala Aduruma na Agiryama piya anauiha vivyo, na kaandika manage. Kpwenye *Appendix III* ya Pakia, mmea uhu piya unaihwa *ulanga*. *Ulanga* ni dzina ra Chidigo ra *Polynesian arrowroot* (*Tacca leontopetaloides*), mmea wanjina wa chiazi wa tsakani, wenye kodza mwenga rinaloganyika sana, na hiyo inaweza kukala ndiyo sababu ya dzina riro kuhumirwa kpwa mimea yosi miiri. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: 'Climbing cotton': a milky-sapped liana whose pods burst into tufts of silky white floss.
teaser.sw: 'Pamba inayotambaa': mtambaa wenye utomvu mweupe ambao maganda yake hupasuka na kutoa vishungi vya pamba nyeupe laini kama hariri.
teaser.dg: 'Pamba ya kufyombera': libugu renye maziya, ambaro makakayage ganaahuka na kulavya nyuzi-nyuzi nyereru, laini dza hariri.

summary.en: Libugu pamba is a twining liana with milky latex whose pods release seeds tufted with silky white hairs. Its name, 'climbing cotton', describes both its habit and its woolly fruit.
summary.sw: Libugu pamba ni mtambaa unaojizungusha wenye utomvu mweupe, ambao maganda yake hutoa mbegu zenye vishungi vya nywele nyeupe laini kama hariri. Jina lake, 'pamba inayotambaa', linaeleza namna unavyokua na matunda yake yenye sufu.
summary.dg: *Libugu pamba* ni libugu rinalodzizunguluka, renye maziya, na makakayage ganalavya tembe zenye nyere nyereru laini dza hariri. Dzinare, 'pamba ya kufyombera', rinaonyesa vira rinavyofyombera na vira matundage ganavyohalana na pamba.

about.en: Libugu pamba is a woody twining climber that bleeds white milky latex when cut. Its leaves are in opposite pairs, glossy and often heart-shaped at the base. The small flowers are dark red to purplish inside, with a ring of slender appendages in the centre. The fruits are long, paired pods that spread apart like horns. When ripe they split to release many flat seeds, each with a tuft of silky white hairs, which give the plant its name. Digo people identify it by its leaves and fruits.
about.sw: Libugu pamba ni mtambaa wenye shina la mti unaojizungusha, ambao hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa ukikatwa. Majani yake huota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, yanang'aa na mara nyingi yana umbo la moyo kwenye kitako. Maua madogo ni mekundu-meusi hadi zambarau ndani, yakiwa na duara la vitokeo vyembamba katikati. Matunda ni maganda marefu yaliyo kwa jozi, yanayoachana kama pembe. Yakikomaa hupasuka kutoa mbegu nyingi bapa, kila moja ikiwa na kishungi cha nywele nyeupe laini kama hariri, ambazo ndizo zilizoupa mmea jina lake. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg: *Libugu pamba* ni libugu ra mihi migumu rinalodzizunguluka, na richikatwa rinalavya maziya ga rangi nyereru. Makodzage ganamera jozi-jozi ganalengana, ganang'ala, na mara nyinji photsi gana umbo ra moyo. Maruwage madide ni ga kundu sana hadi ga zambarau ndani, na kahi-kahi kuna pete ya vitu vidide vyembamba. Matundage ni makakaya mare ganayomera phairi-phairi, ganayotawanyika dza pembe. Gachiivwa ganaahuka na kulavya tembe nyinji bapa, chila mwenga na nyere nyereru laini dza hariri, ndizo zinazopha mmea dzinare. Adigo anarimanya kpwa makodzage na matundage.

where.en: It climbs in forest, forest edges and thicket, twining up into the trees.
where.sw: Hupanda msituni, pembezoni mwa misitu na vichakani, ukijizungusha hadi juu mitini.
where.dg: Rinafyombera tsakani, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na vitsakani, richidzizunguluka dzulu ya mihi.

uses.en: Pakia records no use for it among the Digo. In West Africa, where it is widespread, it is an important plant of traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Afrika Magharibi, ambako umeenea sana, ni mmea muhimu katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga Adigo. Afrika ya Magharibi, ambapho rinamera phatu phanji, ni mmea muhimu wa dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: The name is a clear description of the plant. *-bugu* is the Digo root for a climber, and *pamba* is cotton, here referring to the woolly fruits. Pakia gives *libugu pamba* as an example of a name built from a noun and a describing word.
culture.sw: Jina hili linaeleza mmea waziwazi. *-bugu* ni shina la Kidigo la mtambaa, na *pamba* ni pamba, hapa likirejelea matunda yake yenye sufu. Pakia anatoa *libugu pamba* kama mfano wa jina lililoundwa kwa nomino na neno la kueleza.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinaonyesa mmea wazi-wazi. *-bugu* ni seemu ya neno ra Chidigo inayomaanisha mmea wa kufyombera, na *pamba* ni pamba; phapha neno hiri rina mana ya matundage ganayohalana na pamba. Pakia anapha *libugu pamba* dza mfwano wa dzina rinalodzengbwa kula dzina na neno ra kuonyesa sifa.

names.en: Digo: *libugu pamba*, 'climbing cotton'. Mgombato gives *pamba* as cotton (Swahili *pamba*). Pakia records it only for Digo, with no English or Swahili name.
names.sw: Kidigo: *libugu pamba*, 'pamba inayotambaa'. Mgombato inatoa *pamba* kama pamba (Kiswahili *pamba*). Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu, bila jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *libugu pamba*, 'pamba ya kufyombera'. Mgombato inaandika *pamba* kukala ni *cotton* (Chiswahili *pamba*). Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, bila dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: A small wild legume of the indigo genus, known to Digo people by the look of its leaves.
teaser.sw: Mmea mdogo wa porini wa jamii ya kunde, wa jenasi ya mnili, unaojulikana na Wadigo kwa sura ya majani yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde, wa jenasi ya *Indigofera*, unaomanyikana ni Adigo kpwa umbo ra makodzage.

summary.en: Lihago is a herb of the genus Indigofera, the indigo plants, which Pakia identified only to genus. Digo people recognise it by its leaves.
summary.sw: Lihago ni mmea mdogo wa jenasi Indigofera, jenasi ya mnili, ambao Pakia aliutambua hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
summary.dg: *Lihago* ni mmea mdide wa jenasi ya *Indigofera*, mimea ya *indigo*, na Pakia anaandika jenasiye tu. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

about.en: Lihago is a herbaceous member of the pea family in the genus *Indigofera*. Plants of this genus usually have pinnate or three-parted leaves. Their stems and leaves carry fine hairs attached at the middle, lying flat like tiny staples. The small pea-flowers are pink to brick-red, in slender spikes, and are followed by narrow straight or slightly curved pods. Pakia collected lihago only to genus, so its species is not known. Digo people pick it out by the look of its leaves.
about.sw: Lihago ni mmea mdogo laini wa familia ya kunde katika jenasi *Indigofera*. Mimea ya jenasi hii kwa kawaida ina majani ya mchanganyiko au yenye sehemu tatu. Mashina na majani yake yana vinywele vyembamba vilivyoshikizwa katikati, vilivyolala bapa kama pini ndogo za stapla. Maua madogo ya umbo la ua la njegere ni ya waridi hadi rangi ya tofali, katika masuke membamba, na hufuatwa na maganda membamba yaliyonyooka au yaliyopinda kidogo. Pakia aliukusanya lihago hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, kwa hivyo spishi yake haijulikani. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya majani yake.
about.dg: *Lihago* ni mmea laini wa jamii ya kunde, wa jenasi ya *Indigofera*. Mimea ya jenasi ihi kpwa kawaida ina makodza ganayoganywa kukala makodza madide manji, au mahahu. Mihi na makodza gana nyere ndide sana zirizogbwirira kahi-kahi, zinazolala sambamba dza visumari vidide (*staples*). Maruwa madide dza ga kunde ni ga pinki hadi ga kundu dza tofali, ganamera dzulu ya milita myembamba, na badaye kunazuka makakaya membamba, ganayokala sawa au ganayofyuka chidide. Pakia wahala *lihago* na kumanya jenasiye tu, kpwa hivyo ainaye taimanyikana. Adigo anaumanya kpwa umbo ra makodzage.

where.en: *Indigofera* herbs are common in grassland, bush, fallow fields and roadsides along the coast.
where.sw: Mimea midogo ya *Indigofera* hupatikana sana katika nyika za nyasi, vichakani, mashamba yaliyoachwa na kando ya barabara pwani.
where.dg: Mimea midide ya *Indigofera* ni ya kawaida kpwenye mavuwe, weruni, minda iriyorichwa na kanda-kanda ya njira, pwani yosi.

names.en: Digo: *lihago*. Pakia records it only for Digo and gives no meaning or English or Swahili name. The genus takes its name from indigo, the blue dye obtained from *Indigofera tinctoria*. Another *Indigofera*, *I. trita*, is *chibugu chilume*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *lihago*. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu na hatoi maana yake wala jina la Kiingereza au la Kiswahili. Jenasi hii imepata jina lake kutokana na nili (indigo), rangi ya buluu inayopatikana kutoka *Indigofera tinctoria*. *Indigofera* mwingine, *I. trita*, ni *chibugu chilume*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *lihago*. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, na kaandika manage wala dzina ra Chingereza au ra Chiswahili. Dzina ra jenasi rinalavywa kula *indigo*, rangi ya samawati inayolavywa kula *Indigofera tinctoria*. *Indigofera* yanjina, *I. trita*, ni *chibugu chilume*.

teaser.en: 'The cat's testicles': a frank Digo name for a shrub whose paired, rounded fruits leave little to the imagination.
teaser.sw: 'Mapumbu ya paka': jina la Kidigo lisilo na kificho kwa kichaka ambacho matunda yake ya mviringo yaliyo kwa jozi hayaachi mengi ya kukisia.
teaser.dg: *Machende ga mnyau*: dzina ra Chidigo risirofitsa chitu, ra chitsaka ambacho matundage ga mviringo ganamera mairi-mairi.

summary.en: Machende ga mnyau is a shrub or small tree with wavy-edged leaves and small, rounded capsules. The name compares the fruits to a cat's testicles.
summary.sw: Machende ga mnyau ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani ya kingo za mawimbi na vibuyu vidogo vya mviringo. Jina linalinganisha matunda yake na korodani ya paka.
summary.dg: *Machende ga mnyau* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza genye mikanda dza maimbi, na matunda madide ga mviringo. Dzinare rinafwananisha matunda higo na machende ga mnyau.

about.en: Machende ga mnyau is a spineless shrub or small tree. Its leaves are elliptic with finely toothed edges that are often wavy (*undata* means 'wavy'), and they are paler underneath. Small greenish-yellow flowers grow in clusters in the leaf axils. They are followed by small, rounded capsules, yellowish to reddish, that split to show seeds partly covered by a fleshy coat. It is now often placed in the genus *Gymnosporia*.
about.sw: Machende ga mnyau ni kichaka au mti mdogo usio na miiba. Majani yake ni ya umbo la duaradufu, yenye meno madogo kingoni ambayo mara nyingi ni ya mawimbi (*undata* maana yake 'ya mawimbi'), na yana rangi hafifu zaidi upande wa chini. Maua madogo ya kijani-manjano huota kwa vishada kwenye makwapa ya majani. Hufuatwa na vibuyu vidogo vya mviringo, vya manjano hadi mekundu, vinavyopasuka kuonyesha mbegu zilizofunikwa kwa sehemu na ganda lenye nyama. Siku hizi mara nyingi huwekwa katika jenasi *Gymnosporia*.
about.dg: *Machende ga mnyau* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide bila miya. Makodzage ni ga mviringo mure, genye meno madide sana kanda-kanda, na mara nyinji mikanda yao ni dza maimbi (*undata* manage ni 'dza maimbi'). Photsi makodza ni ngushu-ngushu kuriko dzulu. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya chijani na mandano ganamera makundi-makundi kahi ya mlita wa kodza na panda. Badaye kunatuluka matunda madide ga mviringo, ga rangi ya mandano hadi ya kundu, ganayoahuka na kuonyesa tembe ambazo seemu yao inafwinikwa ni gada ra nyama. Sambi aina ihi mara nyinji inaikpwa kahi ya jenasi *Gymnosporia*.

where.en: It grows in forest margins, thicket and rocky bushland.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani na katika vichaka vya miamba.
where.dg: Chinamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka, vitsakani, na weruni phenye mawe.

culture.en: Many Digo plant names describe a part of the plant by comparison with an animal. Pakia explains this one as 'testis of cat'. The fruits are thought to resemble the testicles (*machende*) of a cat (*mnyau*).
culture.sw: Majina mengi ya mimea ya Kidigo yanaeleza sehemu ya mmea kwa kuilinganisha na mnyama. Pakia analieleza hili kama 'korodani la paka'. Matunda yanadhaniwa kufanana na korodani (*machende*) ya paka (*mnyau*).
culture.dg: Madzina manji ga Chidigo ga mimea ganaeleza seemu ya mmea kpwa kuifwananisha na nyama. Pakia anaeleza dzina hiri kpwa Chingereza dza 'testis of cat', 'chende cha mnyau'. Atu anaona kukala matunda ganahalana na *machende* ga *mnyau*.

names.en: Digo: *machende ga mnyau*, 'testis of cat'. In Mgombato, *chende* (plural *machende*) is scrotum or testicle (Swahili *kende*), and *mnyau* is cat. Pakia records it only for Digo. In southern Africa it is known as the koko tree. Its relative *Maytenus heterophylla* is *mtsokola ng'ongo*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *machende ga mnyau*, 'korodani la paka'. Katika Mgombato, *chende* (wingi *machende*) ni korodani au korodani (Kiswahili *kende*), na *mnyau* ni paka. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu. Kusini mwa Afrika unajulikana kama *koko tree*. Ndugu yake *Maytenus heterophylla* ni *mtsokola ng'ongo*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *machende ga mnyau*, 'testis of cat' kpwa Pakia. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *chende* (unji *machende*), kpwa Chiswahili *kende*, na *mnyau*, kpwa Chiswahili *paka*. Pakia anariandika kpwa Chidigo tu. Kusini ya Afrika unaihwa *koko tree*. Nduguye, *Maytenus heterophylla*, ni *mtsokola ng'ongo*.

teaser.en: A wild yam that hangs purple 'potatoes' from its twining stems as well as growing one underground.
teaser.sw: Kiazi-pori kinachoning'iniza 'viazi' vya zambarau kwenye mashina yake yanayojizungusha, na pia kukuza kimoja chini ya ardhi.
teaser.dg: Chiazi tsaka chinachofyombera, chinacholavya 'viazi' vya zambarau dzulu ya mihiye, na piya chiazi chimwenga tsini.

summary.en: Mani is a wild yam, a twining climber with heart-shaped leaves and a round tuber. It also bears purple aerial tubers on the stem.
summary.sw: Mani ni kiazi-pori, mtambaa unaojizungusha wenye majani ya umbo la moyo na kiazi cha mviringo. Pia huzaa viazi vya zambarau vinavyoota juu ya shina.
summary.dg: *Mani* ni chiazi tsaka, mmea unaofyombera kpwa kudzizunguluka, wenye makodza ga umbo ra moyo na chiazi cha mviringo tsini. Piya unalavya viazi vya zambarau dzulu, kpwenye mihiye.

about.en: Mani is a twining climber with smooth stems up to about three metres long. It grows from a round tuber that is renewed each year. Its leaves are alternate and heart-shaped, narrowing to a long point. Like several yams, it also forms small tubers, called bulbils, in the leaf axils on the stem. In this species they are irregularly round, up to 5 cm across, and deep purple. The stems die back in the dry season.
about.sw: Mani ni mtambaa unaojizungusha wenye mashina laini yenye urefu wa hadi takriban mita tatu. Huota kutoka kiazi cha mviringo kinachojifanya upya kila mwaka. Majani yake huota kwa kupishana, yana umbo la moyo na huishia kwenye ncha ndefu. Kama viazi vikuu kadhaa, pia hufanya viazi vidogo, viitwavyo bulbili, kwenye makwapa ya majani juu ya shina. Kwa spishi hii, viazi hivyo vina mviringo usio sawa, upana wa hadi sentimita 5, na rangi ya zambarau iliyokolea. Mashina hunyauka wakati wa kiangazi.
about.dg: *Mani* ni mmea unaofyombera kpwa kudzizunguluka, wenye mihi laini ya ure wa phephi na mita tahu. Unamera kula chiazi cha mviringo, na chila mwaka chiazi chiphya chinamera. Makodzage ganamera rimwenga-rimwenga, si mairi-mairi, na ni ga umbo ra moyo genye ntsa nyire. Dza viazi tsaka vinji, piya unalavya viazi vidide, vinavyoihwa *bulbils*, kahi ya mlita wa kodza na muhi. Kpwa aina ihi, viazi hivi ni vya mviringo usio sawa-sawa, vinafika sentimita 5, na ni vya zambarau sana. Mihiye inauma wakati wa kazikazi.

where.en: It is a plant of seasonally dry bush and woodland, found from Kenya south to Namibia, climbing over shrubs.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa vichaka na misitu ya miti iliyotawanyika ambayo hukauka kwa msimu, unaopatikana kuanzia Kenya kusini hadi Namibia, ukipanda juu ya vichaka.
where.dg: Ni mmea wa weruni na matsaka ganayouma chila kazikazi. Unaphahikana kula Kenya hadi Namibia kusini, na unafyombera dzulu ya vitsaka.

names.en: Digo: *mani*. Pakia records it only for Digo and gives no meaning. He writes the species name '*astericus*'; the correct form is *Dioscorea asteriscus*. Several other yams have Digo names. *Mriga* (*D. dumetorum*) is the edible bitter yam and *mriga yere* its 'false' look-alike, while *vwivwi koma* is a wild yam that may be poisonous. Many wild yams are bitter or toxic unless specially prepared, and Pakia records no food use for *mani*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mani*. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu na hatoi maana yake. Anaandika jina la spishi '*astericus*'; umbo sahihi ni *Dioscorea asteriscus*. Viazi-pori vingine kadhaa vina majina ya Kidigo. *Mriga* (*D. dumetorum*) ni kiazi-pori kichungu kinacholiwa na *mriga yere* ni mfanano wake 'bandia', huku *vwivwi koma* ni kiazi-pori kinachoweza kuwa na sumu. Viazi-pori vingi ni vichungu au vina sumu visipotayarishwa kwa njia maalumu, na Pakia haripoti matumizi ya *mani* kama chakula.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *mani*. Pakia anariandika kpwa Chidigo tu, na kalavya manage. Dzina ra aina anariandika '*astericus*'; dzina ra kpweli ni *Dioscorea asteriscus*. Viazi tsaka vyanjina vinji piya vina madzina ga Chidigo. *Mriga* (*D. dumetorum*) ni chiazi tsaka chenye utsungu chinachoriwa, na *mriga yere* ni chiazi 'cha handzo' chinachohalana nacho, na *vwivwi koma* ni chiazi tsaka chinachoweza kukala na sumu. Viazi tsaka vinji vina utsungu au sumu, na ni lazima viandaliwe kpwa njira maalumu kabla ya kuriwa. Pakia kaandika kukala *mani* nkuriwa.
