teaser.en: The bush's toilet paper: a shrub whose soft, velvety leaves gave it a very practical Digo name.
teaser.sw: Karatasi ya chooni ya porini: kichaka ambacho majani yake laini kama mahameli yameupa jina la Kidigo lenye manufaa ya moja kwa moja.
teaser.dg: Karatasi ya choo ya weruni: chitsaka ambacho makodzage laini dza nguwo ganachipha dzina ra Chidigo rinaroeleza kaziye.

summary.en: Mbangula mavi is a soft-leaved Abutilon shrub with yellow flowers. Its name, 'faeces cleaner', records that its velvety leaves are used as toilet paper.
summary.sw: Mbangula mavi ni kichaka cha Abutilon chenye majani laini na maua ya manjano. Jina lake, 'kisafisha mavi', linaonyesha kwamba majani yake laini kama mahameli hutumika kama karatasi ya chooni.
summary.dg: *Mbangula mavi* ni chitsaka cha *Abutilon* chenye makodza laini na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano. Dzinare, 'cha kubangula mavi', rinaonyesa kukala makodzage laini nkuhumirwa dza karatasi ya choo.

about.en: Mbangula mavi is a soft-wooded shrub up to about two metres tall. It is covered in fine velvety hairs. The leaves are broad and heart-shaped with toothed edges, and soft as felt to the touch. The yellow to orange-yellow flowers look like small hibiscus flowers. The fruit is a ring of hairy, pointed segments arranged like a small crown or wheel, which split apart when dry.
about.sw: Mbangula mavi ni kichaka chenye mbao laini, chenye urefu wa hadi takriban mita mbili. Kimefunikwa kwa vinywele vyembamba laini kama mahameli. Majani ni mapana, yenye umbo la moyo na meno kingoni, na laini kama kitambaa cha fulana yakiguswa. Maua ya manjano hadi manjano-machungwa yanafanana na maua madogo ya hibiscus. Tunda ni duara la vipande vyenye manyoya na ncha kali, vilivyopangwa kama taji dogo au gurudumu, ambavyo huachana vikikauka.
about.dg: *Mbangula mavi* ni chitsaka chenye nyama za muhi laini, chinachofika ure wa hadi mita mbiri. Chosi chinafwinikwa ni nyere ndide laini. Makodzage ni mapana, ga umbo ra moyo, genye meno kanda-kanda, na uchigaguta ni laini dza nguwo. Maruwage ni ga rangi ya mandano hadi rangi ya chungbwa na mandano, na ganahalana na maruwa madide ga *hibiscus*. Tundare ni vipande vyenye nyere na ntsa, vinavyopangwa mviringo dza tadzi ndide au gurudumo dide, na vinatengana vichiuma.

where.en: It grows in bushland, forest edges, old farms and disturbed ground.
where.sw: Hukua vichakani, pembezoni mwa misitu, kwenye mashamba ya zamani na ardhi iliyovurugwa.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni, kanda-kanda ya matsaka, kpwenye minda ya kare, na phatu phenye tsi iriyobanangwa.

uses.en: As the name says, the soft leaves are used as toilet paper in the bush. Pakia notes that the plants named for a domestic use, like *mbangula mavi*, 'are used as their names indicate'.
uses.sw: Kama jina linavyosema, majani laini hutumika kama karatasi ya chooni porini. Pakia anaeleza kwamba mimea iliyopewa majina kutokana na matumizi ya nyumbani, kama *mbangula mavi*, 'hutumika kama majina yake yanavyoonyesha'.
uses.dg: Dza dzinare rinavyoamba, makodzage laini nkuhumirwa dza karatasi ya choo weruni. Pakia anaandika kukala mimea yenye madzina ga kazi za kaya, dza *mbangula mavi*, 'inahumirwa dza madzina gao ganavyoonyesa'.

culture.en: Pakia gives the name as an example of naming by everyday household use, alongside *msasa* ('sandpaper') and *mtsusa tsalu* ('bead cleaner'). He explains *mbangula mavi* as 'clear human waste': the leaves are used to clean (*bangula*) oneself of waste (*mavi*).
culture.sw: Pakia analitoa jina hili kama mfano wa kuipa mimea majina kutokana na matumizi ya kila siku ya nyumbani, pamoja na *msasa* ('msasa') na *mtsusa tsalu* ('kisafisha shanga'). Anaeleza *mbangula mavi* kama 'kusafisha uchafu wa binadamu': majani hutumika kujisafisha (*bangula*) baada ya kwenda haja (*mavi*).
culture.dg: Pakia analavya dzina hiri dza mfwano wa madzina ga kazi za chila siku za kaya, phamwenga na *msasa* (karatasi ya msasa) na *mtsusa tsalu* ('cha kutsusa tsalu'). Anaeleza *mbangula mavi* dza 'kueza mavi ga mutu': makodza nkuhumirwa kudzieza (*bangula*) mavi (*mavi*).

names.en: Digo: *mbangula mavi*, 'faeces cleaner'. The same name is used for the closely related *Abutilon zanzibaricum*, and it is for that species that Pakia gives the meaning and notes that the name is shared with Duruma. Mgombato gives *mavi* as excrement. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbangula mavi*, 'kisafisha mavi'. Jina hilohilo hutumika kwa ndugu yake wa karibu *Abutilon zanzibaricum*, na ni kwa spishi hiyo ambapo Pakia anatoa maana na kueleza kwamba jina linashirikiwa na Kiduruma. Mgombato inatoa *mavi* kama kinyesi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *mbangula mavi*, 'cha kubangula mavi'. Dzina hiri hiri nkuhumirwa piya kpwa nduguye wa phephi, *Abutilon zanzibaricum*, na ni kpwa aina iyo ndipho Pakia analavya manage na anaandika kukala dzina hiri piya ni ra Chiduruma. Mgombato inaandika *mavi* dza neno ra Chidigo, sawa na Chiswahili *mavi*. Dzina ra Chingereza au ra Chiswahili tarimanyikana.

teaser.en: One shrub, two household jobs: its soft leaves serve as toilet paper, and also polish beads.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kimoja, kazi mbili za nyumbani: majani yake laini hutumika kama karatasi ya chooni, na pia kung'arisha shanga.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chimwenga, kazi mbiri za kaya: makodzage laini nkuhumirwa dza karatasi ya choo, na piya kutsusa tsalu.

summary.en: This yellow-flowered Abutilon has two Digo names, both for its uses: mbangula mavi, 'faeces cleaner', and mtsusa tsalu, 'bead cleaner'. Both depend on its soft, hairy leaves.
summary.sw: Abutilon hii yenye maua ya manjano ina majina mawili ya Kidigo, yote yakitokana na matumizi yake: mbangula mavi, 'kisafisha mavi', na mtsusa tsalu, 'kisafisha shanga'. Yote mawili yanategemea majani yake laini yenye manyoya.
summary.dg: Chitsaka hichi cha *Abutilon*, chenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano, china madzina mairi ga Chidigo, na gosi ganatuluka kpwa kazize: *mbangula mavi*, 'cha kubangula mavi', na *mtsusa tsalu*, 'cha kutsusa tsalu'. Madzina gosi mairi ganatuluka kpwa makodzage laini genye nyere.

about.en: This *Abutilon* is a soft-wooded shrub of the mallow family. Its heart-shaped, toothed leaves are covered in fine soft hairs. It has yellow, hibiscus-like flowers and a fruit made of a ring of hairy segments that split apart when dry. It looks very like its relative *Abutilon mauritianum*, which shares the name *mbangula mavi*. Digo people identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Abutilon* hii ni kichaka chenye mbao laini cha familia ya Malvaceae. Majani yake yenye umbo la moyo na meno kingoni yamefunikwa kwa vinywele vyembamba laini. Ina maua ya manjano yanayofanana na ya hibiscus, na tunda lililoundwa kwa duara la vipande vyenye manyoya vinavyoachana vikikauka. Inafanana sana na ndugu yake *Abutilon mauritianum*, unaoshiriki jina *mbangula mavi*. Wadigo huitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: Hichi ni chitsaka cha *Abutilon*, chenye nyama za muhi laini, cha jamii ya *mallow*. Makodzage ni ga umbo ra moyo, genye meno kanda-kanda, na ganafwinikwa ni nyere ndide laini. China maruwa ga rangi ya mandano ganayohalana na ga *hibiscus*, na tunda ra vipande vyenye nyere, vinavyopangwa mviringo, ambavyo vinatengana vichiuma. Chinahalana sana na nduguye *Abutilon mauritianum*, ambaye piya anaihwa *mbangula mavi*. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and forest margins, and on old farmland.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, na kwenye mashamba ya zamani.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni pwani, vitsakani, kanda-kanda ya matsaka, na kpwenye minda ya kare.

uses.en: Pakia records two household uses, each preserved in a name. The leaves are used as toilet paper, and they are used to clean beads (*tsalu*), the beadwork that decorates the edges of cloth.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti matumizi mawili ya nyumbani, kila moja likihifadhiwa katika jina. Majani hutumika kama karatasi ya chooni, na pia hutumika kusafisha shanga (*tsalu*), zile shanga zinazopamba kingo za nguo.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kazi mbiri za kaya, na chila kazi ina dzinare. Makodza nkuhumirwa dza karatasi ya choo, na piya nkuhumirwa kutsusa *tsalu*, ushanga unaopamba kanda-kanda za nguwo.

culture.en: Pakia gives *mbangula mavi* and *mtsusa tsalu* as examples of Digo names based on domestic use, and says that the plants are 'used as their names indicate'.
culture.sw: Pakia anatoa *mbangula mavi* na *mtsusa tsalu* kama mifano ya majina ya Kidigo yanayotokana na matumizi ya nyumbani, na anasema kwamba mimea hii 'hutumika kama majina yake yanavyoonyesha'.
culture.dg: Pakia analavya *mbangula mavi* na *mtsusa tsalu* dza mifwano ya madzina ga Chidigo ga kazi za kaya, na anaamba kukala mimea iyo 'inahumirwa dza madzina gao ganavyoonyesa'.

names.en: Digo: *mbangula mavi*, 'clear human waste' (from *bangula*, to clean oneself, and *mavi*, waste), shared with Duruma. Also *mtsusa tsalu*, 'cleaning beads'. Mgombato gives *tsusa* as 'to clean something' and *tsalu* as 'beads decorating the edge of a piece of cloth'. Both names are shared with other plants. *Mbangula mavi* is also *Abutilon mauritianum*. *Mtsusa tsalu* is also *Triumfetta rhomboidea* and *Waltheria indica*, small herbs whose leaves are presumably used the same way. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbangula mavi*, 'kusafisha uchafu wa binadamu' (kutoka *bangula*, kujisafisha, na *mavi*, kinyesi), linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma. Pia *mtsusa tsalu*, 'kusafisha shanga'. Mgombato inatoa *tsusa* kama 'kusafisha kitu' na *tsalu* kama 'shanga zinazopamba ukingo wa kipande cha nguo'. Majina yote mawili yanashirikiwa na mimea mingine. *Mbangula mavi* pia ni *Abutilon mauritianum*. *Mtsusa tsalu* pia ni *Triumfetta rhomboidea* na *Waltheria indica*, mimea midogo ambayo huenda majani yake hutumika kwa njia hiyohiyo. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *mbangula mavi*, 'kueza mavi ga mutu' (kula *bangula*, kudzieza, na *mavi*, mavi), dzina ambaro piya ni ra Chiduruma. Piya *mtsusa tsalu*, 'kutsusa tsalu'. Mgombato inaandika *tsusa* dza 'kueza chitu' na *tsalu* dza 'ushanga unaopamba kanda-kanda ya nguwo'. Madzina gosi mairi piya ni ga mimea yanjina. *Mbangula mavi* piya ni *Abutilon mauritianum*. *Mtsusa tsalu* piya ni *Triumfetta rhomboidea* na *Waltheria indica*, mimea midide ambayo chahi makodzage nkuhumirwa kpwa kazi iyo iyo. Dzina ra Chingereza au ra Chiswahili tarimanyikana.

teaser.en: The 'small rib plant', linked by name and use to nyuni wa mbavu, the convulsions that Digo belief ties to certain birds.
teaser.sw: 'Mmea mdogo wa mbavu', unaohusishwa kwa jina na matumizi na nyuni wa mbavu, degedege ambalo imani ya Kidigo inalihusisha na ndege fulani.
teaser.dg: 'Mmea mdide wa mbavu', unaoungwa kpwa dzina na kpwa matumizi na *nyuni wa mbavu*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa na kukakama ambao Adigo anaamini unarehwa ni ndege anjina.

summary.en: Mbavubavu mdide is an aromatic, much-branched shrub of dry bush. It is paired by name with the 'large' mbavubavu, Grewia forbesii, because both are used against the convulsions called nyuni wa mbavu.
summary.sw: Mbavubavu mdide ni kichaka chenye harufu nzuri na matawi mengi kinachoota vichakani mahali pakavu. Kimeoanishwa kwa jina na mbavubavu 'mkubwa', Grewia forbesii, kwa sababu vyote viwili hutumika dhidi ya degedege liitwalo nyuni wa mbavu.
summary.dg: *Mbavubavu mdide* ni chitsaka chenye arufu nono na panda nyinji, cha weruni kpwenye tsi kavu. Kpwa dzina unaikpwa phamwenga na *mbavubavu mkulu*, *Grewia forbesii*, kpwa sababu yosi miiri nkuhumirwa kuhenda dawa ya ukongo wa *nyuni* unaoihwa *nyuni wa mbavu*.

about.en: Mbavubavu mdide is a much-branched shrub one to four metres tall. Its older stems are square in section, and its thin whitish-brown bark peels in strips. The leaves grow in opposite pairs, sometimes in fours of two large and two small. They are oval, up to 7 cm long, dotted with glands on both sides, and give off a spicy smell when crushed. Small greenish-white flowers are borne in loose heads at the branch tips. They are followed by pea-sized red-purple to black fruits, each sitting in the enlarged green cup of the calyx.
about.sw: Mbavubavu mdide ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi, chenye urefu wa mita moja hadi nne. Mashina yake ya zamani yana pembe nne yakikatwa, na gome lake jembamba la rangi ya hudhurungi-nyeupe hubambuka kwa vipande virefu. Majani huota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, wakati mwingine manne pamoja, mawili makubwa na mawili madogo. Yana umbo la yai, urefu wa hadi sentimita 7, yana vitone vya tezi pande zote mbili, na hutoa harufu ya viungo yakipondwa. Maua madogo meupe-kijani huota katika vichwa vilivyolegea kwenye ncha za matawi. Hufuatwa na matunda ya ukubwa wa njegere, mekundu-zambarau hadi meusi, kila moja likikaa ndani ya kikombe cha kijani cha kalisi kilichopanuka.
about.dg: *Mbavubavu mdide* ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji, chinachofika mita mwenga hadi nne dzulu. Mihiye ya kare ina pembe nne, na gophare rembamba ra rangi nyereru na ya dongo rinabambandzuka kpwa vipande vire. Makodzage ganamera jozi-jozi ganalengana, na wakati wanjina manne-manne: mairi makulu na mairi madide. Gana umbo ra mviringo, ni mare hadi sentimita 7, gana madowa madide ga *glands* dzulu na photsi, na gachihopezwa ganalavya arufu kali na nono. Maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru na chijani chidide ganamera kpwa makundi gasigobanana, kpwenye ntsa za panda. Badaye kunazuka matunda ga ukulu wa tembe ya mbalazi, ga kundu na zambarau hadi maru, na chila tunda rinakala ndani ya chikombe cha chijani cha *calyx*, chiricho chikakula.

where.en: It is a common shrub of the drier lowlands, in dry bushland and thicket on the coast and further inland.
where.sw: Ni kichaka cha kawaida cha nyanda za chini zilizo kavu zaidi, katika vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito pwani na ndani zaidi bara.
where.dg: Ni chitsaka cha kawaida cha tsi za photsi kavu, chinachomera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu na vitsakani, pwani na bara.

uses.en: According to ICRAF, the shrub is used across Kenya for firewood, tool handles and arrows. The leaves and roots are used in medicine, the fruit is eaten in small amounts, the leaves are browsed by goats and camels, and the flowers are good for bees. Its Digo name points to a medicinal use against *nyuni wa mbavu*, a form of convulsion.
uses.sw: Kwa mujibu wa ICRAF, kichaka hiki hutumika kote Kenya kwa kuni, mipini ya zana na mishale. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa, tunda huliwa kwa kiasi kidogo, majani huliwa na mbuzi na ngamia, na maua ni mazuri kwa nyuki. Jina lake la Kidigo linaashiria matumizi ya dawa dhidi ya *nyuni wa mbavu*, aina ya degedege.
uses.dg: ICRAF inagomba kukala chitsaka hichi nkuhumirwa Kenya yosi kpwa kuni, miphini ya vyombo na mivi. Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa, matunda nkuriwa chidide, makodza nkuriwa ni mbuzi na ngamia, na maruwa ni manono kpwa nyuchi. Dzinare ra Chidigo rinaonyesa kukala nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya *nyuni wa mbavu*, aina ya ukongo wa kugbwa na kukakama.

culture.en: Pakia explains the 'rib' (*mbavu*) in the name through its use. This shrub and *Grewia forbesii* (*mbavubavu mkulu*) are both used to treat the convulsions known as *nyuni wa mbavu*. Mgombato describes *nyuni* as a convulsion affecting young children, believed to be caused by the appearance of certain birds. Its relatives *Premna chrysoclada* (*mvuma*) and *P. hildebrandtii* (*muurusa pungu*) are also Digo remedies against convulsions.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza 'mbavu' (*mbavu*) katika jina kupitia matumizi yake. Kichaka hiki na *Grewia forbesii* (*mbavubavu mkulu*) vyote hutumika kutibu degedege linalojulikana kama *nyuni wa mbavu*. Mgombato inaeleza *nyuni* kama degedege linalowapata watoto wadogo, linaloaminiwa kusababishwa na kutokea kwa ndege fulani. Ndugu zake *Premna chrysoclada* (*mvuma*) na *P. hildebrandtii* (*muurusa pungu*) pia ni dawa za Kidigo dhidi ya degedege.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala neno 'mbavu' (*mbavu*) kpwenye dzina hiri rinalavywa kula matumiziye. Chitsaka hichi na *Grewia forbesii* (*mbavubavu mkulu*) vyosi nkuhumirwa kuhenda dawa ya ukongo unaoihwa *nyuni wa mbavu*. Mgombato inaandika *nyuni* kukala ni ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa na kukakama, ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni kuonekana kpwa ndege anjina. Nduguze *Premna chrysoclada* (*mvuma*) na *P. hildebrandtii* (*muurusa pungu*) piya ni dawa za Chidigo za ukongo wa kugbwa na kukakama.

names.en: Digo: *mbavubavu mdide*, 'small rib plant'. It is 'small' (*-dide*) compared with *mbavubavu mkulu*, because its leaves are smaller. ICRAF gives different Digo names for this species, *mursapungu* and *mvuma*. Pakia uses those names for two other *Premna* species. Mgombato uses *m'bavu-bavu* for yet another plant, *Clerodendrum capitatum*. Swahili: *mvumba ngombe* (ICRAF).
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbavubavu mdide*, 'mmea mdogo wa mbavu'. Ni 'mdogo' (*-dide*) ukilinganishwa na *mbavubavu mkulu*, kwa sababu majani yake ni madogo zaidi. ICRAF inatoa majina tofauti ya Kidigo kwa spishi hii, *mursapungu* na *mvuma*. Pakia anatumia majina hayo kwa spishi nyingine mbili za *Premna*. Mgombato inatumia *m'bavu-bavu* kwa mmea mwingine kabisa, *Clerodendrum capitatum*. Kiswahili: *mvumba ngombe* (ICRAF).
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mbavubavu mdide*, 'mmea mdide wa mbavu'. Ni 'mdide' (*-dide*) kuriko *mbavubavu mkulu*, kpwa sababu makodzage ni madide zaidi. ICRAF inapha madzina ganjina ga Chidigo kpwa aina ihi, *mursapungu* na *mvuma*. Pakia anahumira madzina higo kpwa aina mbiri zanjina za *Premna*. Mgombato inahumira *m'bavu-bavu* kpwa mmea wanjina tsona, *Clerodendrum capitatum*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mvumba ngombe* (ICRAF).

teaser.en: A wild grapevine with a 'chewable' stem, as its Digo name says.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu pori wenye shina 'linalotafunika', kama jina lake la Kidigo linavyosema.
teaser.dg: Mzabibu wa weruni wenye muhi 'unaobebeneka', dza dzinare ra Chidigo rinavyogomba.

summary.en: Mbebeneka is a wild grapevine that climbs by tendrils and bears bunches of small dark berries. Its name means 'chewable', after its stem.
summary.sw: Mbebeneka ni mzabibu pori unaopanda kwa vitete-shikizi na kuzaa vishada vya matunda madogo meusi. Jina lake maana yake 'linalotafunika', kutokana na shina lake.
summary.dg: *Mbebeneka* ni mzabibu wa weruni unaofyombera kpwa nyuzi zinazodzizunguluka, na unalavya makundi ga matunda madide ga rangi nzito. Dzinare rina mana ya 'unaobebeneka', kpwa sababu ya muhiwe.

about.en: Mbebeneka is a climber of the grape family. It grows from a woody rootstock and climbs by tendrils, which grow opposite the leaves. The leaves are large and lobed, like grape leaves, and are often covered with rusty hairs underneath. Small reddish flowers in branched clusters are followed by bunches of round berries that turn dark purple-black when ripe, much like small grapes.
about.sw: Mbebeneka ni mtambaa wa familia ya mizabibu. Huota kutoka shina-mzizi gumu kama mti na hupanda kwa vitete-shikizi, vinavyoota mkabala na majani. Majani ni makubwa na yenye mapande, kama majani ya mzabibu, na mara nyingi yamefunikwa kwa manyoya ya rangi ya kutu upande wa chini. Maua madogo mekundu katika vishada vyenye matawi hufuatwa na vishada vya matunda ya mviringo yanayogeuka zambarau-nyeusi yakikomaa, kama zabibu ndogo.
about.dg: *Mbebeneka* ni mmea wa kufyombera wa jamii ya mzabibu. Unamera kula muzi mgumu dza wa muhi, na unafyombera kpwa nyuzi zinazodzizunguluka, zinazomera zichilengana na makodza. Makodza ni makulu na gana mala, dza makodza ga mzabibu, na mara nyinji photsi gana nyere ndide za rangi ya dongo. Maruwa madide ga kundu chidide ganamera kpwa makundi genye panda, na badaye kunazuka makundi ga matunda ga mviringo, ganayokala ga zambarau nzito na maru ganaphoivwa, dza zabibu ndide.

where.en: It climbs over shrubs and small trees in bush, thicket and at forest edges, and is common in coastal bushland.
where.sw: Hupanda juu ya vichaka na miti midogo vichakani, katika vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, na hupatikana sana katika vichaka vya pwani.
where.dg: Unafyombera dzulu ya vitsaka na mihi midide weruni, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, na ni wa kawaida weruni wa pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records no use apart from what the name suggests. Elsewhere in East and southern Africa the ripe berries are eaten as a sour wild fruit.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi yoyote isipokuwa yale ambayo jina linadokeza. Kwingineko Afrika Mashariki na Kusini, matunda yaliyokomaa huliwa kama tunda la porini lenye uchachu.
uses.dg: Kahi ya matumizi, Pakia anaandika tu higo ganagoonyeswa ni dzinare. Kpwenye seemu zanjina za Afrika ya Mashariki na ya kusini, matunda gachiivwa nkuriwa dza matunda ga weruni ga ngbwadu.

culture.en: The name records an everyday experience of the plant. Pakia explains *mbebeneka* as 'chewable': the stem can be chewed (*bebeneka*). Mgombato has the related verb *bebena*, 'to chew, to crunch'.
culture.sw: Jina hili linahifadhi uzoefu wa kila siku wa mmea huu. Pakia anaeleza *mbebeneka* kama 'linalotafunika': shina linaweza kutafunwa (*bebeneka*). Mgombato ina kitenzi kinachohusiana, *bebena*, 'kutafuna, kuchakacha'.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinaonyesa dzambo ra chila siku ra mmea uhu. Pakia anagomba kukala *mbebeneka* rina mana ya 'unaobebeneka': muhiwe unaweza kubebenwa (*bebeneka*). Mgombato ina neno *bebena*, renye mana ya kuafuna kpwa sauti (*to chew, to crunch*).

names.en: Digo: *mbebeneka*, 'chewable'. Pakia records it only for Digo, and no Swahili name is recorded. In English, *Ampelocissus* species are often called wild grapes.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbebeneka*, 'linalotafunika'. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu, na hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza, spishi za *Ampelocissus* mara nyingi huitwa *wild grapes*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mbebeneka*, 'unaobebeneka'. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, na takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Kpwa Chingereza, aina za *Ampelocissus* mara nyinji nkuihwa *wild grapes*.

teaser.en: Touch a leaf and it folds shut and droops; Digo people recognise it by exactly this habit.
teaser.sw: Gusa jani nalo hujifunga na kulegea; Wadigo huutambua mmea huu kwa tabia hiyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Uchiguta kodza, rinadzikundza na kugbwadzika photsi; Adigo anaumanya mmea uhu kpwa tabiya ihi hasa.

summary.en: Mbodzebodze is the sensitive plant, a prickly weed whose leaves fold up and droop at a touch. Digo people group it with Biophytum, another 'resurrection plant' with the same habit.
summary.sw: Mbodzebodze ni kifauongo, gugu lenye miiba ambalo majani yake hujikunja na kulegea likiguswa. Wadigo huuweka pamoja na Biophytum, 'mmea mwingine wa kufufuka' wenye tabia hiyohiyo.
summary.dg: *Mbodzebodze* ni mbondo yenye miya, ambayo makodzage ganadzikundza na kugbwadzika uchigaguta. Adigo anauika phamwenga na *Biophytum*, mmea wanjina 'unaofufuka' wenye tabiya iyo iyo.

about.en: Mbodzebodze is a sprawling, prickly herb or low shrub. Its leaves are divided into many pairs of tiny leaflets. When touched, shaken or warmed, the leaflets fold together in pairs and the whole leaf droops. A few minutes later it slowly opens again. The leaves also close at night. The flowers are fluffy pink pom-poms about the size of a marble. They are followed by small, flat, bristly pods that break into one-seeded segments.
about.sw: Mbodzebodze ni mmea mdogo au kichaka kifupi chenye miiba kinachotanda. Majani yake yamegawanyika kuwa jozi nyingi za vijani vidogo sana. Yakiguswa, yakitikiswa au yakipata joto, vijani hujikunja jozi kwa jozi na jani zima hulegea. Baada ya dakika chache hufunguka tena polepole. Majani pia hujifunga usiku. Maua ni vishungi laini vya waridi vya mviringo, vyenye ukubwa wa gololi. Hufuatwa na maganda madogo bapa yenye vinywele vigumu, yanayokatika kuwa vipande vyenye mbegu moja moja.
about.dg: *Mbodzebodze* ni mmea au chitsaka chifupi chinachotandazika, chenye miya. Makodzage ganaganywa kukala jozi nyinji za makodza madide sana. Uchigaguta, gachisumba au gachiphaha dzoho, makodza madide ganadzikundza jozi-jozi, na kodza rosi rinagbwadzika. Bada ya dakika chache, rinavuguka tsona pore-pore. Makodza piya ganadzikundza usiku. Maruwa ni ga pinki, ga nyere-nyere dza mipira midide, ga ukulu wa gololi. Badaye kunazuka makakaya madide, bapa, genye nyere ngumu, ganayovundzika kukala vipande vya tembe mwenga mwenga.

where.en: Originally from tropical America, it is now a common weed in warm countries, growing in fallow fields, lawns, roadsides and disturbed ground.
where.sw: Asili yake ni Amerika ya kitropiki, lakini sasa ni gugu la kawaida katika nchi zenye joto, likiota kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa, nyasi za bustani, kando ya barabara na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa.
where.dg: Kare waphahikana Amerika ya tsi za dzoho tu, ela sambi ni mbondo ya kawaida kpwenye tsi za dzoho, inayomera kpwenye minda iriyorichwa, nyasi za kaya, kanda-kanda ya njira na phatu tsi iriphobanangwa.

culture.en: Pakia notes that the Digo identify this plant mainly by its behaviour: its leaves close on touch. He found touch to be one of the main ways people confirm the identity of plants with leaves like these. *Mbodzembodze* is a collective term for such 'resurrection plants', covering both *Biophytum petersianum* and *Mimosa pudica*. Elsewhere Pakia records the Digo expression *kuvwala nguo*, 'to dress', for a plant closing its leaves when touched.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua mmea huu hasa kwa tabia yake: majani yake hujifunga yakiguswa. Aligundua kwamba kugusa ni mojawapo ya njia kuu ambazo watu huthibitisha utambulisho wa mimea yenye majani kama haya. *Mbodzembodze* ni jina la jumla la 'mimea ya kufufuka' kama hii, likijumuisha *Biophytum petersianum* na *Mimosa pudica*. Kwingineko Pakia anarekodi msemo wa Kidigo *kuvwala nguo*, 'kuvaa nguo', kwa mmea unaojifunga majani ukiguswa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya mmea uhu hasa kpwa tabiyaye: makodzage ganadzikundza uchigaguta. Pakia waona kukala kuguta ni kahi ya njira kulu ambazo atu nkuhumira kumanya sawa-sawa mimea yenye makodza dza higa. *Mbodzembodze* ni dzina ra jumla ra mimea hino 'inayofufuka', na rinahumirwa kpwa *Biophytum petersianum* na *Mimosa pudica* zosi mbiri. Phatu phanjina Pakia anaandika maneno ga Chidigo *kuvwala nguo*, 'kuvwala nguwo', kpwa mmea unaodzikundza makodzage uchigutwa.

names.en: Digo: *mbodzebodze*. Pakia's list spells it slightly differently from *mbodzembodze* (*Biophytum*), but in his main text he treats the two as one name for leaf-folding plants. No meaning is given. In English it is the sensitive plant or touch-me-not.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbodzebodze*. Orodha ya Pakia inaliandika tofauti kidogo na *mbodzembodze* (*Biophytum*), lakini katika maandishi yake makuu analichukulia kuwa jina moja la mimea inayojikunja majani. Hakuna maana iliyotolewa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *sensitive plant* au *touch-me-not*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mbodzebodze*. Kahi ya madzina Pakia anayoganandika, dzina hiri rinaandikpwa tafwauti chidide na *mbodzembodze* (*Biophytum*), ela kpwenye kaziye Pakia anagaona dza dzina mwenga ra mimea inayokundza makodza. Kaandika manage. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sensitive plant* au *touch-me-not*.

teaser.en: A miniature 'palm' a hand's breadth tall whose leaflets fold down when touched.
teaser.sw: 'Mnazi' mdogo mno wenye urefu wa kiganja, ambao vijani vyake hujikunja chini ukiviguswa.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide dza 'muhi wa jamii ya mnazi', urewe ni dza upana wa fumba, na makodzage madide ganadzikundza photsi uchiuguta.

summary.en: Mbodzembodze is a tiny herb with a rosette of feathery leaves that fold down when touched. Digo people give the same name to the sensitive plant, Mimosa pudica.
summary.sw: Mbodzembodze ni mmea mdogo sana wenye shada la majani kama manyoya yanayojikunja chini yakiguswa. Wadigo hulitoa jina hilohilo kwa kifauongo, Mimosa pudica.
summary.dg: *Mbodzembodze* ni mmea mdide sana wenye fungu ra makodza dza manyoya, ganayodzikundza photsi uchiuguta. Adigo anapha dzina hiri hiri mmea wanjina, *Mimosa pudica*, unaoihwa kpwa Chingereza *sensitive plant*.

about.en: Mbodzembodze is a small annual herb, often only 5 to 15 cm tall. A single slender stem carries a crown of pinnate leaves at the top, so the plant looks like a tiny palm tree. Each leaf has many pairs of small leaflets. When touched, the leaflets fold downwards, and they open again after a while. Small yellow to orange flowers sit on thin stalks among the leaves. They are followed by small capsules.
about.sw: Mbodzembodze ni mmea mdogo wa msimu mmoja, mara nyingi wenye urefu wa sentimita 5 hadi 15 tu. Shina moja jembamba hubeba taji la majani ya mchanganyiko juu kabisa, kwa hivyo mmea huonekana kama mnazi mdogo sana. Kila jani lina jozi nyingi za vijani vidogo. Vikiguswa, vijani hujikunja kuelekea chini, na hufunguka tena baada ya muda. Maua madogo ya manjano hadi machungwa hukaa juu ya vikonyo vyembamba katikati ya majani. Hufuatwa na vibuyu vidogo.
about.dg: *Mbodzembodze* ni mmea mdide unaokala na moyo kpwa mwaka mmwenga tu, na mara nyinji urewe ni sentimita 5 hadi 15 tu. Kolo rimwenga rembamba rinatsukula fungu ra makodza dzulu, na chila kodza rina makodza madide kanda mbiri za mongo wa kodza, kpwa hivyo mmea unaonekana dza muhi mdide sana wa jamii ya mnazi. Chila kodza rina makodza madide manji mairi-mairi. Uchigaguta, makodza madide ganadzikundza photsi, na bada ya muda ganadzivugula tsona. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano hadi rangi ya chungbwa ganakala dzulu ya milita myembamba kahi ya makodza. Maruwa higo ganalavya makakaya madide.

where.en: It grows in shady, damp places: forest floors and edges, shaded bush, and among grass in the rainy season.
where.sw: Hukua mahali penye kivuli na unyevu: sakafuni na pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani kivulini, na katikati ya nyasi wakati wa mvua.
where.dg: Unamera phatu pha pepho na phenye chinemi: photsi tsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, weruni phenye pepho, na kahi ya nyasi wakati wa mvula.

culture.en: Pakia describes how Digo people identify this herb by its 'desiccation habit', the closing of its leaves on touch, confirmed by touching the plant. He uses it to illustrate the Digo expression *kuvwala nguo*, 'to dress', for a plant that closes its leaves when touched. *Mbodzembodze* is one of the few Digo names that brings together species scientists keep apart. It covers both this plant and *Mimosa pudica*.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jinsi Wadigo wanavyoutambua mmea huu mdogo kwa 'tabia yake ya kujikunja', yaani kufunga majani yake ukiguswa, jambo linalothibitishwa kwa kuugusa. Anautumia kufafanua msemo wa Kidigo *kuvwala nguo*, 'kuvaa nguo', kwa mmea unaofunga majani yake ukiguswa. *Mbodzembodze* ni mojawapo ya majina machache ya Kidigo yanayounganisha spishi ambazo wanasayansi huzitenganisha. Linajumuisha mmea huu na *Mimosa pudica*.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza vira Adigo anavyoumanya mmea hinyu kpwa chitu anachochiiha *desiccation habit*, yani makodzage kudzikundza uchiuguta; atu nkuhakikisha kpwa kuuguta mmea. Anauhumira kuonyesa maneno ga Chidigo *kuvwala nguo*, 'kuvwala nguwo', ganayohumirwa kpwa mmea unaokundza makodzage uchigutwa. *Mbodzembodze* ni mwenga kahi ya madzina machache ga Chidigo ganayoika phamwenga aina ambazo asayansi anaziganya. Dzina hiri rinahumirwa kpwa mmea hinyu na piya kpwa *Mimosa pudica*.

names.en: Digo: *mbodzembodze*, shared with Duruma according to Pakia, who gives no meaning. Pakia lists *Mimosa pudica* as *mbodzebodze*, and in his main text he treats this as the same name for all leaf-folding plants. No English or Swahili name is recorded. Related species are sometimes called little tree plants.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbodzembodze*, jina linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma kwa mujibu wa Pakia, ambaye hatoi maana yake. Pakia anaorodhesha *Mimosa pudica* kama *mbodzebodze*, na katika maandishi yake makuu analichukulia hili kuwa jina lilelile kwa mimea yote inayojikunja majani. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Spishi zinazohusiana wakati mwingine huitwa *little tree plants*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mbodzembodze*. Pakia anagomba kukala Aduruma nao anahumira dzina hiri, ela kapha manage. Pakia anaandika *Mimosa pudica* dza *mbodzebodze*, na mwakpwe chitabuni anarihumira dzina hiri kpwa mimea yosi inayokundza makodzage. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Aina zanjina za phephi wakati wanjina nkuihwa *little tree plants*.

teaser.en: A glossy forest shrub that, to Digo eyes, grows like a garden vegetable.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha msituni chenye majani yanayong'aa ambacho, machoni mwa Wadigo, hukua kama mboga ya bustanini.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha tsakani chenye makodza ganayong'ala, ambacho kpwa matso ga Adigo chinamera dza mboga ya mundani.

summary.en: Mbogaboga is a smooth-leaved forest shrub of the coffee family with sweet-scented flowers. Its name, 'vegetable', refers to the way it grows.
summary.sw: Mbogaboga ni kichaka cha msituni chenye majani laini, cha familia ya mibuni (mkahawa), chenye maua yenye harufu tamu. Jina lake, 'mboga', linarejelea namna unavyokua.
summary.dg: *Mbogaboga* ni chitsaka cha tsakani cha jamii ya kahawa, chenye makodza laini na maruwa ga arufu nono. Dzinare, 'mboga', rinagomba vira unavyomera.

about.en: Mbogaboga is a shrub, occasionally a small tree, usually 1 to 6 metres tall, with smooth, hairless stems and leaves. The leaves are opposite, elliptic to oblong and up to 19 cm long. They often dry grey-green or reddish brown. Small sweet-scented white flowers are borne in large, branched, roughly pyramid-shaped clusters, followed by small fleshy fruits. Like coffee, it belongs to the family Rubiaceae.
about.sw: Mbogaboga ni kichaka, mara chache mti mdogo, kwa kawaida chenye urefu wa mita 1 hadi 6, chenye mashina na majani laini yasiyo na manyoya. Majani huota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, yana umbo la duaradufu hadi mstatili, na urefu wa hadi sentimita 19. Mara nyingi hukauka yakiwa na rangi ya kijivu-kijani au hudhurungi-nyekundu. Maua madogo meupe yenye harufu tamu huota katika vishada vikubwa vyenye matawi, vinavyokaribia umbo la piramidi, na hufuatwa na matunda madogo yenye nyama. Kama mbuni, ni wa familia ya Rubiaceae.
about.dg: *Mbogaboga* ni chitsaka, wakati wanjina muhi mdide, na mara nyinji urewe ni mita 1 hadi 6. Militaye na makodzage ni laini, bila nyere. Makodza ganamera mairi-mairi ganalengana, ni ga mviringo mure, na ure wa hadi sentimita 19. Mara nyinji ganauma na kukala rangi ya ivu na chijani, au rangi ya dongo ya kundu. Maruwa madide mereru ga arufu nono ganakala kpwa mabunda makulu genye panda, ganayohalana chidide na piramidi, na badaye ganalavya matunda madide genye nyama. Dza kahawa, ni wa jamii ya *Rubiaceae*.

where.en: It grows in the understorey of forest and thicket. Its range runs across tropical Africa from Cameroon to Kenya and Zambia.
where.sw: Hukua chini ya miti mikubwa msituni na katika vichaka vizito. Eneo lake linaenea katika Afrika ya kitropiki kutoka Kamerun hadi Kenya na Zambia.
where.dg: Unamera photsi ya mihi mikulu tsakani na vitsakani. Unaphahikana kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho, kula Cameroon hadi Kenya na Zambia.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name as 'vegetable': the plant 'grows like a vegetable [*boga*]'. He does not say how, but the reduplicated form *mboga-boga* suggests 'in the manner of a vegetable'.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jina hili kama 'mboga': mmea 'hukua kama mboga [*boga*]'. Haelezi kwa namna gani, lakini umbo lililorudiwa *mboga-boga* linadokeza 'kwa namna ya mboga'.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza dzina hiri kukala ni 'mboga': mmea hinyu 'unamera dza mboga [*boga*]'. Kaeleza vira unavyomera, ela dzina ra kurudiywa *mboga-boga* rinaonyesa mana ya 'dza vira mboga inavyomera'.

names.en: Digo: *mbogaboga*, 'vegetable'. Pakia records it only for Digo, with no English or Swahili name. Compare Swahili *mboga*, 'vegetable' or 'relish'.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbogaboga*, 'mboga'. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu, bila jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili. Linganisha na Kiswahili *mboga*, 'mboga' au 'kitoweo'.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mbogaboga*, 'mboga'. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, na kaandika dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza. Lola Chiswahili *mboga*, 'mboga' au 'chitoweo'.

teaser.en: Its brilliant 'flowers' are really leaves, yet Digo people count them as flowers, and Pakia used it to show why.
teaser.sw: 'Maua' yake yenye rangi angavu kwa kweli ni majani, lakini Wadigo huyahesabu kuwa maua, na Pakia aliutumia mmea huu kueleza sababu.
teaser.dg: 'Maruwage' ganayong'ala kpwa kpweli ni makodza, ela Adigo anagatala dza maruwa, na Pakia wauhumira kuonyesa sababu.

summary.en: Mboganvila is bougainvillea, the thorny climbing shrub from South America with brilliant papery bracts. Pakia uses it to show how the Digo define a flower by colour and function.
summary.sw: Mboganvila ni mbogenvilia (bougainvillea), kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa, kutoka Amerika Kusini, chenye vikombe-jani vyembamba kama karatasi na vya rangi angavu. Pakia anautumia kuonyesha jinsi Wadigo wanavyolifafanua ua kwa rangi yake na kazi yake.
summary.dg: *Mboganvila* ni *bougainvillea*, chitsaka chenye miya chinachofyombera, chirichorehwa kula Amerika ya Kusini, chenye *bracts* za rangi zinazong'ala dza karatasi. Pakia anauhumira kuonyesa vira Adigo anavyomanya ruwa kpwa rangiye na kaziye.

about.en: Bougainvillea is a vigorous, thorny climbing shrub. What look like its petals are in fact bracts: papery, brightly coloured leaves, in magenta, purple, red, orange, pink or white, grouped in threes. Each group surrounds three small, tubular, creamy-white true flowers. The ordinary leaves are green, oval and pointed. With pruning it can be kept as a hedge or bush. Left alone, it climbs high over walls and trees.
about.sw: Mbogenvilia ni kichaka kinachotambaa kwa nguvu na chenye miiba. Kinachoonekana kama petali zake kwa kweli ni vikombe-jani (bracts): majani membamba kama karatasi yenye rangi angavu, ya zambarau iliyokolea, zambarau, nyekundu, machungwa, waridi au nyeupe, yaliyopangwa matatu matatu. Kila kundi huzunguka maua halisi matatu madogo, yenye umbo la mrija na rangi nyeupe ya krimu. Majani ya kawaida ni ya kijani, mviringo na yenye ncha. Kikipunguzwa matawi kinaweza kutunzwa kama ua wa mimea au kichaka. Kikiachwa, hupanda juu sana kwenye kuta na miti.
about.dg: *Mboganvila* ni chitsaka chenye miya chinachofyombera na kumera haraka. Vira vinavyoonekana dza vipande vya maruwa kpwa kpweli ni *bracts*: makodza ga rangi zinazong'ala, ganayohalana na karatasi, ga zambarau, ga kundu, ga rangi ya chungbwa, pinki au mereru, ganayokala mahahu-mahahu. Chila fungu rinazunguluka maruwa mahahu madide ga kpweli, ga dza mridza na ga rangi ya maziya. Makodza ga kawaida ni ga chijani, ga mviringo na genye ntsa. Uchiutsatsula, unaweza kuuika dza lichigo au chitsaka. Uchiuricha, unafyombera dzulu sana ya kuta na mihi.

where.en: It is native to South America and is planted throughout the tropics in gardens, hedges and along walls. It does well in the heat and dry spells of the coast.
where.sw: Asili yake ni Amerika Kusini, na hupandwa kila mahali katika nchi za tropiki bustanini, kama ua wa mimea na kando ya kuta. Hustawi vizuri katika joto na vipindi vya ukame vya pwani.
where.dg: Asiliye ni Amerika ya Kusini, na unaphandwa kosi tsi za dzoho mindani, dza lichigo, na kanda-kanda ya kuta. Unamera chinono kpwa dzoho na wakati wa ukame wa pwani.

uses.en: It is grown as an ornamental and for hedges.
uses.sw: Hupandwa kama mmea wa mapambo na kwa kutengeneza ua wa mimea.
uses.dg: Unaphandwa dza mmea wa kupambira na kuhenda lichigo.

culture.en: Pakia uses bougainvillea to explain two Digo plant-part terms. *Kodza*, 'leaf', does not include its coloured bracts, because they are too unlike an ordinary leaf. *Ruwa*, 'flower', does include them, because a *ruwa* is understood by its colour and its role in producing fruit. Scientifically, the bracts are leaves. The Digo category follows how they look and what they do.
culture.sw: Pakia anautumia mbogenvilia kueleza istilahi mbili za Kidigo za sehemu za mmea. *Kodza*, 'jani', haijumuishi vikombe-jani vyake vya rangi, kwa sababu vinatofautiana mno na jani la kawaida. *Ruwa*, 'ua', inavijumuisha, kwa sababu *ruwa* hutambuliwa kwa rangi yake na kazi yake katika kuzaa tunda. Kisayansi, vikombe-jani hivyo ni majani. Kundi la Kidigo linafuata jinsi vinavyoonekana na kazi vinayofanya.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira *mboganvila* kueleza maneno mairi ga Chidigo ga seemu za mmea. *Kodza*, 'kodza', tarihusu *bracts* za rangi za mmea hinyu, kpwa sababu tazihalana na kodza ra kawaida. *Ruwa*, 'ruwa', rinazihusu, kpwa sababu *ruwa* nkumanyikana kpwa rangiye na kaziye ya kulavya matunda. Kpwa sayansi, *bracts* ni makodza. Kpwa Adigo, zinatalwa kulengana na vira zinavyoonekana na kazi zinazohenda.

names.en: Digo: *mboganvila*, an adaptation of the international name *bougainvillea*, after the French navigator Louis-Antoine de Bougainville. English: bougainvillea.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mboganvila*, jina lililotoholewa kutoka jina la kimataifa *bougainvillea*, kwa heshima ya baharia Mfaransa Louis-Antoine de Bougainville. Kiingereza: *bougainvillea*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mboganvila*, dzina ririrohalwa kula dzina ra kosi duniani *bougainvillea*, ririrolavywa kula dzina ra msafiri wa bahari wa Ufaransa, Louis-Antoine de Bougainville. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *bougainvillea*.

definition.en: The colourful bracts of bougainvillea are counted as ruwa (flower), not kodza (leaf), because of their colour.
definition.sw: Vikombe-jani vya rangi vya mbogenvilia huhesabiwa kuwa ruwa (ua), si kodza (jani), kwa sababu ya rangi yake.
definition.dg: *Bracts* za rangi za *mboganvila* nkutalwa dza *ruwa* (ruwa), sio *kodza* (kodza), kpwa sababu ya rangi zao.

teaser.en: A milky-sapped liana with hook-like tendrils, whose flexible but strong stems go into furniture.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye utomvu mweupe kama maziwa na vikonyo vyenye umbo la kulabu, ambao mashina yake yanayopindika lakini imara hutumika kutengeneza samani.
teaser.dg: *Libugu* renye maziya na nyuzi za kugbwirira dza viloo, ambaro militaye ya kundzika ela yenye nguvu nkuhenderwa vyombo vya nyumba.

summary.en: Mbohoya is a woody liana related to the rubber vines, with white latex, hooked tendrils and round orange fruits. Pakia names it among the climbers whose flexible but strong stems are used for crafts, mostly furniture.
summary.sw: Mbohoya ni mtambaa wenye shina la mti, wa jamii moja na mipira (rubber vines), wenye utomvu mweupe, vikonyo vyenye umbo la kulabu na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya machungwa. Pakia anautaja miongoni mwa mitambaa ambayo mashina yake yanayopindika lakini imara hutumika katika ufundi, hasa samani.
summary.dg: *Mbohoya* ni libugu renye kolo ra muhi, ra jamii mwenga na *mpira* na mbugu zanjina za mpira, renye maziya mereru, nyuzi za kugbwirira dza viloo, na matunda ga duara ga rangi ya chungbwa. Pakia anauhadza kahi ya mimea inayofyombera ambayo militaye ya kundzika ela yenye nguvu nkuhumirwa kpwa kazi za mafundi, hasa kuhenda vyombo vya nyumba.

about.en: Mbohoya is a woody climber that runs with white milky latex when cut. Its leaves are glossy and opposite. It climbs by curled, hook-like tendrils, which are modified flower stalks. Clusters of small, fragrant white flowers are followed by round fruits that ripen yellow to orange. Like its relatives, the rubber vines, the fruit has a juicy pulp around the seeds. Digo people identify it by its leaves, fruits and stem together.
about.sw: Mbohoya ni mtambaa wenye shina la mti ambao hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa ukikatwa. Majani yake yanang'aa na hukaa kwa jozi zinazotazamana. Hupanda kwa kutumia vikonyo vilivyojikunja kama kulabu, ambavyo ni vikonyo vya maua vilivyobadilika umbo. Vishada vya maua madogo meupe yenye harufu nzuri hufuatwa na matunda ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa ya manjano hadi machungwa. Kama ilivyo kwa jamaa zake, mipira, tunda lake lina nyama yenye maji mengi inayozunguka mbegu. Wadigo huutambua kwa kuangalia majani, matunda na shina lake kwa pamoja.
about.dg: *Mbohoya* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye kolo ra muhi, ambao uchikatwa unalavya maziya mereru manji. Makodzage ganang'ala na ganamera mairi-mairi ganalengana. Unafyombera kpwa nyuzi za kugbwirira zirizodzikundza dza viloo, ambazo kpwa kpweli ni milita ya maruwa iriyogaluka. Mabunda ga maruwa madide mereru ga arufu nono ganalavya matunda ga duara, ganayoiva na kukala rangi ya mandano hadi rangi ya chungbwa. Dza nduguze, mbugu za mpira, tunda rina nyama ya madzi-madzi inayozunguluka tembe. Adigo anaumanya kpwa kulola makodzage, matundage na kolore phamwenga.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, thicket and bushland, climbing into shrubs and trees.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka na nyika ya vichaka, ukipanda juu ya vichaka na miti.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani, vitsakani na weruni, uchifyombera dzulu ya vitsaka na mihi.

uses.en: Pakia names *mbohoya* with *muungo* (*Saba comorensis*) and *mpira* (*Landolphia kirkii*) as typical *mbugu*, lianas, whose wood is 'flexible but strong' and therefore used in crafts, mostly furniture. Elsewhere in East and southern Africa its ripe fruits are eaten.
uses.sw: Pakia anautaja *mbohoya* pamoja na *muungo* (*Saba comorensis*) na *mpira* (*Landolphia kirkii*) kama mifano ya *mbugu*, yaani mitambaa, ambayo mbao zake 'zinapindika lakini ni imara' na kwa hiyo hutumika katika ufundi, hasa samani. Kwingineko Afrika Mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika matunda yake yaliyoiva huliwa.
uses.dg: Pakia anauhadza *mbohoya* phamwenga na *muungo* (*Saba comorensis*) na *mpira* (*Landolphia kirkii*) dza mifwano minono ya *mbugu*, mimea inayofyombera yenye nyama za muhi 'za kundzika ela zenye nguvu', na kpwa hivyo nkuhumirwa kpwa kazi za mafundi, hasa kuhenda vyombo vya nyumba. Phatu phanjina Afrika ya Mashariki na kusini ya Afrika, matundage maivu nkuriwa.

culture.en: In Pakia's account of Digo life forms, *mbugu* are lianas and climbers that twine or scramble and must have a woody stem. *Mbohoya* is one of his model examples.
culture.sw: Katika maelezo ya Pakia kuhusu maumbo ya maisha ya mimea kwa Kidigo, *mbugu* ni mitambaa na mimea inayojiviringa au kutambaa na ni lazima iwe na shina la mti. *Mbohoya* ni mojawapo ya mifano yake ya kielelezo.
culture.dg: Pakia achieleza vira Adigo anavyoganya mimea kulengana na maumbo, *mbugu* ni mimea inayofyombera kpwa kulinga-linga au kuambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, na ni lazima ikale na kolo ra muhi. *Mbohoya* ni mwenga wa mifwanoye mikulu.

names.en: Digo: *mbohoya*. Pakia records it only for Digo, gives no meaning, and records no English or Swahili name.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbohoya*. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu, hatoi maana yake, wala harekodi jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mbohoya*. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, kapha manage, na kaandika dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza.

reason.en: Saba comorensis, named with it for furniture-making
reason.sw: Saba comorensis (mbungo), unaotajwa pamoja nao kwa kutengeneza samani
reason.dg: *Saba comorensis*, unaohadzwa phamwenga nao kpwa kuhenda vyombo vya nyumba

reason.sw: Landolphia kirkii (mpira), mtambaa wa mpira unaotumika kwa namna hiyo hiyo
reason.dg: *Landolphia kirkii*, libugu ra mpira rinarohumirwa vivyo

reason.dg: *Hunteria*, mmea wanjina wa jamii iyo hiyo unaolavya maziya

teaser.en: The 'gun' shrub: Digo children load its small round fruits as bullets in their toy guns.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha 'bunduki': watoto wa Kidigo hutumia matunda yake madogo ya mviringo kama risasi za bunduki zao za kuchezea.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha 'bunduchi': ana a Chidigo nkuhumira matunda madide ga duara dza risasi za bunduchi zao za kuchezera.

summary.en: Mbunduchi is a shrub with clusters of small white flowers and round fruits. Children use the fruits as ammunition in toy guns, which gave it its name.
summary.sw: Mbunduchi ni kichaka chenye vishada vya maua madogo meupe na matunda ya mviringo. Watoto hutumia matunda yake kama risasi za bunduki za kuchezea, na ndiyo asili ya jina lake.
summary.dg: *Mbunduchi* ni chitsaka chenye mabunda ga maruwa madide mereru na matunda ga duara. Ana nkuhumira matundage dza risasi za bunduchi za kuchezera, na kpwa hivyo mmea hinyu ukaphaha dzinare.

about.en: Mbunduchi is a shrub or small tree with alternate, simple leaves. Small, white, often fragrant flowers grow in loose clusters at the ends of the shoots. They are followed by small, round, fleshy fruits that ripen orange to red, each about the size of a pea. Digo people identify it by its leaves and fruits.
about.sw: Mbunduchi ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani sahili yanayopishana. Maua madogo meupe, mara nyingi yenye harufu nzuri, huota katika vishada vilivyolegea kwenye ncha za machipukizi. Hufuatwa na matunda madogo ya mviringo yenye nyama, yanayoiva yakawa ya machungwa hadi mekundu, kila moja likiwa na ukubwa wa punje ya njegere. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg: *Mbunduchi* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ga kawaida, ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana. Maruwa madide mereru, mara nyinji ga arufu nono, ganamera kpwa mabunda ga kutawanyika kpwenye ntsa za maphungo. Badaye ganalavya matunda madide ga duara genye nyama, ganayoiva na kukala rangi ya chungbwa hadi ya kundu; chila rimwenga ni dza tembe ya mbalazi. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na matundage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and dry forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani, vichaka na misitu mikavu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani, vitsakani na matsakani makavu.

uses.en: The fruits are used by children as 'bullets' in toy guns.
uses.sw: Matunda yake hutumiwa na watoto kama 'risasi' katika bunduki za kuchezea.
uses.dg: Ana nkuhumira matundage dza 'risasi' za bunduchi zao za kuchezera.

culture.en: This is one of the few Digo plant names that comes from children's play. Pakia explains *mbunduchi* as 'gun', because the fruits are used as bullets in toy guns (*bunduchi*). Mgombato gives *bunduchi* as gun (Swahili *bunduki*). Pakia records that the name is shared with Duruma and Swahili.
culture.sw: Hili ni mojawapo ya majina machache ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayotokana na michezo ya watoto. Pakia anaeleza *mbunduchi* kuwa 'bunduki', kwa sababu matunda yake hutumika kama risasi katika bunduki za kuchezea (*bunduchi*). Mgombato anatoa *bunduchi* kwa maana ya bunduki (Kiswahili *bunduki*). Pakia anarekodi kwamba jina hili linashirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kiswahili.
culture.dg: Hiri ni dzina mwenga kahi ya madzina machache ga mimea ga Chidigo garigolavywa kula michezo ya ana. Pakia anaeleza *mbunduchi* kukala ni 'bunduchi', kpwa sababu matundage nkuhumirwa dza risasi za bunduchi za kuchezera (*bunduchi*). Mgombato unapha *bunduchi* dza mana ya bunduchi (Chiswahili *bunduki*). Pakia anaandika kukala dzina hiri ni ra Chiduruma na Chiswahili piya.

names.en: Digo: *mbunduchi*, 'gun'. Pakia's Appendix III also gives *mfyofyo* for this species. That name is also used for two shrubs of the coffee family, *Feretia apodanthera* and *Heinsia crinita*. A related species, *Bourreria teitensis*, is called *mvundza jembe*. No English name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbunduchi*, 'bunduki'. Kiambatisho III cha Pakia pia kinatoa *mfyofyo* kwa spishi hii. Jina hilo pia hutumika kwa vichaka viwili vya familia ya mibuni (kahawa), *Feretia apodanthera* na *Heinsia crinita*. Spishi jamaa yake, *Bourreria teitensis*, huitwa *mvundza jembe*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mbunduchi*, 'bunduchi'. Chitabu cha Pakia, *Appendix III*, chinapha piya *mfyofyo* kpwa aina hino. Dzina hiro piya nkuhumirwa kpwa vitsaka viiri vya jamii ya kahawa, *Feretia apodanthera* na *Heinsia crinita*. Aina ya phephi, *Bourreria teitensis*, inaihwa *mvundza jembe*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: A wiry roadside weed whose name means 'extra strength', the strength that healers add to a person by unseen means.
teaser.sw: Gugu gumu kama waya la kando ya barabara ambalo jina lake linamaanisha 'nguvu za ziada', nguvu ambazo waganga humwongezea mtu kwa njia zisizoonekana.
teaser.dg: Mbondo nyifu ya kanda-kanda ya njira, ambayo dzinare rinagomba 'nguvu za kuenjerezwa', nguvu ambazo aganga nkumuenjereza mutu kpwa njira zisizoonekana.

summary.en: Mbundugo is a tough, small-flowered weed of the mallow family. It is used to give a person bundugo, the supplementary strength that Digo belief says can be added by a healer.
summary.sw: Mbundugo ni gugu gumu lenye maua madogo, la familia ya mibamia (mallow). Hutumika kumpa mtu *bundugo*, nguvu za nyongeza ambazo, kwa imani ya Kidigo, mganga anaweza kumwongezea.
summary.dg: *Mbundugo* ni mbondo ngumu ya jamii ya *mallow*, yenye maruwa madide. Nkuhumirwa kumpha mutu *bundugo*, nguvu za kuenjerezwa ambazo Adigo anaamini mganga anaweza kumuenjereza mutu.

about.en: Mbundugo is an erect, much-branched herb or small shrub, usually under a metre tall, with tough, fibrous, wiry stems. The leaves are narrow, lance-shaped, with toothed edges and short stalks. Small pale yellow flowers grow singly or in pairs in the leaf axils and open around midday. The fruit splits into several small segments, each tipped with two short beaks.
about.sw: Mbundugo ni mmea-shina laini uliosimama wima au kichaka kidogo chenye matawi mengi, kwa kawaida chini ya mita moja kwa urefu, wenye mashina magumu, yenye nyuzi na kama waya. Majani ni membamba, yenye umbo la mkuki, kingo zenye meno na vikonyo vifupi. Maua madogo ya manjano hafifu huota moja moja au mawili mawili kwenye kwapa za majani na huchanua karibu na adhuhuri. Tunda hupasuka kuwa vipande vidogo kadhaa, kila kimoja kikiwa na midomo miwili mifupi kwenye ncha.
about.dg: *Mbundugo* ni mmea mdide au chitsaka chidide, unaoima chocho na wenye panda nyinji, na mara nyinji taufika ure wa mita mwenga. Militaye ni migumu, ya nyuzi-nyuzi na mifu dza waya. Makodza ni membamba, ga umbo ra fumo, genye meno kanda-kanda na milita mifupi. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu ganamera mwenga-mwenga au mairi-mairi phatu kodza rinaphogbwirana na panda, na ganadzivugula namutsi. Tunda rinaganyika vipande vidide vinji, na chila chipande china ntsa mbiri fupi.

where.en: It is a common weed of roadsides, paths, compounds, fallow land and pasture throughout the tropics.
where.sw: Ni gugu la kawaida kando ya barabara, njia, viwanja vya nyumba, mashamba yaliyoachwa na malisho katika nchi zote za tropiki.
where.dg: Ni mbondo inayophahikana sana kosi tsi za dzoho, kanda-kanda ya njira, njira ndide, mihalani, minda iriyorichwa na phatu pha kurisira mifugo.

uses.en: Pakia records that it is used to give *bundugo*, extra strength added to a person by supernatural means. Elsewhere in the tropics the tough stems are tied into brooms.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba hutumika kumpa mtu *bundugo*, nguvu za ziada zinazoongezwa kwa mtu kwa njia zisizo za kawaida. Kwingineko katika nchi za tropiki mashina yake magumu hufungwa kutengeneza mafagio.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala nkuhumirwa kumpha mutu *bundugo*, nguvu za kuenjerezwa mutu kpwa njira zisizo za kawaida. Phatu phanjina kosi tsi za dzoho, militaye migumu nkufungbwa phamwenga kuhenda pyero.

culture.en: Pakia places *mbundugo* among names that announce the medicinal-magical result of using a plant, with *chimwemwe* ('smile'), *mvundza kondo* ('war terminator'), *phoza* ('heal') and *reza* ('neutralizer'). He explains *bundugo* as 'supplementary strength magically added to an individual'. Mgombato defines it as 'artificial strength given through witchcraft' and gives the expression *kurya bundugo*, 'to gain artificial strength'.
culture.sw: Pakia anaweka *mbundugo* miongoni mwa majina yanayotangaza matokeo ya kitiba na kiuchawi ya kutumia mmea, pamoja na *chimwemwe* ('tabasamu'), *mvundza kondo* ('mkomesha vita'), *phoza* ('ponya') na *reza* ('kiondoa nguvu'). Anaeleza *bundugo* kuwa 'nguvu za nyongeza zinazoongezwa kwa mtu kwa uchawi'. Mgombato analifafanua kuwa 'nguvu bandia zinazotolewa kwa uchawi' na anatoa msemo *kurya bundugo*, 'kupata nguvu bandia'.
culture.dg: Pakia anaika *mbundugo* kahi ya madzina ganayotangaza vira mmea unavyohenda uchihumirwa dza dawa au uganga, phamwenga na *chimwemwe* ('kutseka'), *mvundza kondo* ('chinachovundza kondo'), *phoza* ('phoza') na *reza* ('chinachousa nguvu'). Anaeleza *bundugo* kukala ni 'nguvu za kuenjerezwa mutu kpwa uganga'. Mgombato unaeleza dza 'nguvu za kuhewa kpwa utsai', na unapha maneno *kurya bundugo*, 'kuphaha nguvu za kuhewa kpwa utsai'.

names.en: Digo: *mbundugo*, 'spiritual strength'. Pakia records it only for Digo. In English it is known as common wireweed or broomweed.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbundugo*, 'nguvu za kiroho'. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu. Kwa Kiingereza unajulikana kama *common wireweed* au *broomweed*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mbundugo*, 'nguvu za chiroho'. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *common wireweed* au *broomweed*.

reason.sw: Abutilon, jamaa yake katika familia ya mibamia (mallow)
reason.dg: *Abutilon*, mmea wa phephi wa jamii ya *mallow*

teaser.en: Its fruits have two long wings and spin to the ground like helicopter blades.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake yana mabawa mawili marefu na huzunguka yakishuka chini kama rafu za helikopta.
teaser.dg: Matundage gana mapha mairi mare, na ganazunguluka uchigbwa photsi dza mapanga ga *helikopta*.

summary.en: Mchusa is a pale-barked, soft-wooded tree of the dry coast whose fruits carry two long wings. Pakia uses it to illustrate the Digo word for fruit wings.
summary.sw: Mchusa ni mti wa pwani kavu wenye gome jeupe-jeupe na mbao laini, ambao matunda yake yana mabawa mawili marefu. Pakia anautumia kuonyesha neno la Kidigo la mabawa ya matunda.
summary.dg: *Mchusa* ni muhi wa pwani kavu, wenye gopha ngushu-ngushu na nyama za muhi laini, na matundage gana mapha mairi mare. Pakia anauhumira kuonyesa neno ra Chidigo ra mapha ga matunda.

about.en: Mchusa is a deciduous tree, usually 10 to 20 metres tall, with smooth, pale grey to silvery bark and soft, light wood. The large leaves are heart-shaped to three-lobed, crowded towards the ends of the branches. It flowers when leafless, producing clusters of tiny greenish flowers. The fruit is its best-known feature: a small nut carrying two long, narrow, papery wings. When it falls it spins like a helicopter rotor and can travel some distance on the wind.
about.sw: Mchusa ni mti unaopukutisha majani, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa mita 10 hadi 20, gome lake laini la kijivu hafifu hadi la rangi ya fedha, na mbao laini na nyepesi. Majani yake makubwa yana umbo la moyo hadi kuwa na pembe tatu, na yamesongamana kuelekea ncha za matawi. Huchanua ukiwa hauna majani, ukitoa vishada vya maua madogo sana ya rangi ya kijani-kijani. Tunda ndilo sifa yake inayojulikana zaidi: kokwa ndogo yenye mabawa mawili marefu, membamba kama karatasi. Linapoanguka huzunguka kama rafu za helikopta na linaweza kusafiri umbali fulani likipeperushwa na upepo.
about.dg: *Mchusa* ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, na mara nyinji urewe ni mita 10 hadi 20. Gophare ni laini, ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu hadi rangi ya feza, na nyama za muhi ni laini, si ndziho. Makodza makulu ni ga umbo ra moyo hadi genye mala mahahu, na ganakala manji phamwenga kanda za ntsa za panda. Unalavya maruwa wakati makodza gakagbwa, mabunda ga maruwa madide sana ga chijani-chijani. Tunda ndiro chitu chinachomanyikana sana: tembe ndide ngumu yenye mapha mairi mare, membamba dza karatasi. Richigbwa, rinazunguluka dza mapanga ga *helikopta*, na rinaweza kuhalwa ni phepho hadi kure chidide.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal forest, woodland and bushland, often on coral rag and rocky ground. It is found in dry tropical regions around the world.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu mikavu ya pwani, mapori na nyika ya vichaka, mara nyingi kwenye ardhi ya matumbawe na yenye mawe. Hupatikana katika maeneo makavu ya tropiki duniani kote.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani makavu ga pwani, phatu pha mihi na weruni, mara nyinji dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo na tsi ya mawe. Unaphahikana kosi tsi kavu za dzoho duniani.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. Elsewhere in its range the light, soft wood is carved into items such as bowls and small canoes.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Kwingineko katika eneo unakopatikana, mbao zake nyepesi na laini huchongwa kutengeneza vitu kama bakuli na mitumbwi midogo.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika kazi yoyosi ya muhi hinyu. Phatu phanjina unaphomera, nyamaze za muhi, laini na zisizo ndziho, nkutsongwa kuhenda vitu dza mabakuli na ngarawa ndide.

culture.en: Pakia illustrates the winged fruit of *Gyrocarpus americanus* in his chapter on plant parts (Fig. 3.5). The Digo call such winged structures *mapha*, 'wings', as also in *Combretum schumannii* (*mkongolo*).
culture.sw: Pakia anaonyesha kwa mchoro tunda lenye mabawa la *Gyrocarpus americanus* katika sura yake kuhusu sehemu za mimea (Mchoro 3.5). Wadigo huviita viungo hivyo vyenye mabawa *mapha*, 'mabawa', kama ilivyo pia kwa *Combretum schumannii* (*mkongolo*).
culture.dg: Pakia anaonyesa mchoro wa tunda renye mapha ra *Gyrocarpus americanus* mwakpwe surani ya seemu za mimea (*Fig. 3.5*). Adigo nkuiha vitu dza ivyo vyenye mapha *mapha*, 'mapha', dza vira piya kpwa *Combretum schumannii* (*mkongolo*).

names.en: Digo: *mchusa*. Pakia records it only for Digo and gives no meaning. In English it is called the helicopter tree or propeller tree, after its fruit.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mchusa*. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu na hatoi maana yake. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *helicopter tree* au *propeller tree*, kutokana na tunda lake.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mchusa*. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, na kapha manage. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *helicopter tree* au *propeller tree*, kpwa sababu ya tundare.

teaser.en: A spiny, papery-barked myrrh relative that Digo people recognise by its three-part leaves and its stem.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa manemane mwenye miiba na gome kama karatasi, ambaye Wadigo humtambua kwa majani yake ya vipande vitatu na shina lake.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha jamii mwenga na *mbambara*, chenye miya na gopha dza karatasi, ambacho Adigo nkuchimanya kpwa makodzage genye makodza madide mahahu, na kpwa kolore.

summary.en: Mdandachindi is a straggling, spiny Commiphora shrub with papery bark and leaves in threes. It is a relative of mbambara and the other myrrhs of the dry coast.
summary.sw: Mdandachindi ni kichaka cha *Commiphora* kinachotawanyika ovyo, chenye miiba, gome kama karatasi na majani ya vijani vitatu vitatu. Ni jamaa wa mbambara na mimea mingine ya manemane ya pwani kavu.
summary.dg: *Mdandachindi* ni chitsaka cha *Commiphora* chinachotawanyika, chenye miya, gopha dza karatasi na makodza genye makodza madide mahahu. Ni ndugu wa *mbambara* na mihi yanjina ya *Commiphora* ya pwani kavu.

about.en: Mdandachindi is a straggling shrub or small tree up to about 7 metres tall, smooth and hairless. Its spine-tipped branches carry smooth, dark green or grey bark that is thin and papery. The leaves are divided into three leaflets on a stalk up to 6 cm long. Like other *Commiphora*, it has resinous tissues and small fruits that split to show a stone partly wrapped in a coloured fleshy cup. Digo people identify it by its leaves and stem.
about.sw: Mdandachindi ni kichaka kinachotawanyika ovyo au mti mdogo wenye urefu wa hadi mita 7 hivi, laini na usio na manyoya. Matawi yake yenye ncha za miiba yana gome laini la kijani kilichokolea au kijivu, jembamba na kama karatasi. Majani yamegawanyika kuwa vijani vitatu juu ya kikonyo chenye urefu wa hadi sm 6. Kama *Commiphora* nyingine, una tishu zenye utomvu wa ubani na matunda madogo yanayopasuka kuonyesha kokwa iliyofunikwa kwa sehemu na kikombe cha nyama chenye rangi. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na shina lake.
about.dg: *Mdandachindi* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaotawanyika, wa ure wa hadi mita 7 hivi, laini na bila nyere. Pandaze zina miya ntsani, na gophare ni laini, ra chijani chiru au ra rangi ya ivu, rembamba dza karatasi. Makodza ganaganyika makodza madide mahahu dzulu ya mlita wa ure wa hadi sentimita 6. Dza *Commiphora* zanjina, una ulimbo ndani, na matunda madide ganayoahuka na kuonyesa tembe ngumu iriyofwinikpwa chidide ni chikombe cha nyama cha rangi. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na kolore.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and thicket, in the seasonally dry country from south-east Congo to south-east Kenya and northern Mozambique.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka na vichaka vikavu, katika nchi yenye ukame wa majira kuanzia kusini-mashariki mwa Kongo hadi kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na kaskazini mwa Msumbiji.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kavu na vitsakani, kpwenye tsi ambazo nkuuma wakati wa kazikazi, kula kusini-mashariki ya Congo hadi kusini-mashariki ya Kenya na kazikazini ya Mozambique.

culture.en: Pakia notes that the peeling bark (*guwika*) of *Commiphora* is one of the few bark features distinctive enough for Digo people to use in identifying plants.
culture.sw: Pakia anabainisha kwamba gome linalobambuka (*guwika*) la *Commiphora* ni mojawapo ya sifa chache za gome zilizo wazi kiasi cha Wadigo kuzitumia katika kutambua mimea.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala gopha rinaroguwika (*guwika*) ra *Commiphora* ni mwenga wa alama chache za gopha zinazotafwautika vya kutosha hata Adigo anazihumira kumanya mimea.

names.en: Digo: *mdandachindi*. Pakia records it only for Digo, gives no meaning, and records no English or Swahili name. Other Digo *Commiphora* include *mbambara* (*C. africana*), *mdege* (*C. zanzibarica*) and *mryakwembe* (*C. edulis*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdandachindi*. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu, hatoi maana yake, wala harekodi jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili. *Commiphora* nyingine za Kidigo ni pamoja na *mbambara* (*C. africana*), *mdege* (*C. zanzibarica*) na *mryakwembe* (*C. edulis*).
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdandachindi*. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, kapha manage, na kaandika dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza. *Commiphora* zanjina za Chidigo ni *mbambara* (*C. africana*), *mdege* (*C. zanzibarica*) na *mryakwembe* (*C. edulis*).

teaser.en: The 'forest lime' that bleeds milk: a glossy-leaved forest tree with two names, one for its look and one for its latex.
teaser.sw: 'Mdimu wa msituni' unaotoa maziwa: mti wa msituni wenye majani yanayong'aa na majina mawili, moja kwa sura yake na jingine kwa utomvu wake.
teaser.dg: 'Mdimu wa tsakani' unaolavya maziya: muhi wa tsakani wenye makodza ganayong'ala, na madzina mairi, rimwenga kpwa vira unavyoonekana na ranjina kpwa maziyage.

summary.en: Mdimu tsaka is a forest tree with glossy leaves and white latex. Digo people see it as a wild, forest form of the lime tree, and also call it mziyaziya, 'milk'.
summary.sw: Mdimu tsaka ni mti wa msituni wenye majani yanayong'aa na utomvu mweupe. Wadigo huuona kuwa aina ya mwituni, ya msituni, ya mdimu, na pia huuita *mziyaziya*, 'maziwa'.
summary.dg: *Mdimu tsaka* ni muhi wa tsakani wenye makodza ganayong'ala na maziya mereru. Adigo anauona dza aina ya weruni, ya tsakani, ya *mdimu*, na piya anauiha *mziyaziya*, 'maziya'.

about.en: Mdimu tsaka is an evergreen shrub or tree with smooth bark and copious white latex. Its leaves are opposite, glossy and leathery, rather like those of a citrus tree. Small, fragrant white flowers grow in clusters, followed by smooth, rounded fruits that ripen yellow to orange, often in pairs. Digo people identify it by the look and smell of its leaves.
about.sw: Mdimu tsaka ni kichaka au mti usiopukutisha majani, wenye gome laini na utomvu mweupe mwingi. Majani yake hukaa kwa jozi zinazotazamana, yanang'aa na ni magumu kama ngozi, yanafanana kiasi na yale ya mti wa jamii ya michungwa. Maua madogo meupe yenye harufu nzuri huota katika vishada, yakifuatwa na matunda laini ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa ya manjano hadi machungwa, mara nyingi mawili mawili. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura na harufu ya majani yake.
about.dg: *Mdimu tsaka* ni chitsaka au muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye gopha laini na maziya mereru manji sana. Makodzage ganamera mairi-mairi ganalengana, ganang'ala na ni magumu dza chingo, chidide dza ga muhi wa jamii ya mdimu. Maruwa madide mereru ga arufu nono ganamera kpwa mabunda, na badaye ganalavya matunda laini ga duara, ganayoiva na kukala rangi ya mandano hadi rangi ya chungbwa, mara nyinji mairi-mairi. Adigo anaumanya kpwa vira makodzage ganavyoonekana na arufu yago.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket, including kaya forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani na vichaka, zikiwemo misitu ya kaya.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani na vitsakani, phamwenga na matsaka ga kaya.

uses.en: Pakia records that its latex has no known use.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba utomvu wake hauna matumizi yanayojulikana.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala maziyage tagana kazi inayomanyikana.

culture.en: Pakia discusses the word *maziya*, 'milk', which goes back to an old Bantu root. Today it also covers plant latex. He gives this tree and *Suregada zanzibariensis* as examples of plants with *maziya* that 'has no known use', unlike the medicinal latex of *Euphorbia hirta*. *Maziya* is a milk-like exudate that may or may not be useful, but is generally not harmful.
culture.sw: Pakia anajadili neno *maziya*, 'maziwa', ambalo asili yake ni mzizi wa zamani wa Kibantu. Siku hizi linajumuisha pia utomvu wa mimea. Anatoa mti huu na *Suregada zanzibariensis* kama mifano ya mimea yenye *maziya* 'yasiyo na matumizi yanayojulikana', tofauti na utomvu wa kitiba wa *Euphorbia hirta*. *Maziya* ni majimaji kama maziwa yanayotoka kwenye mmea, ambayo yanaweza kuwa na manufaa au yasiwe nayo, lakini kwa kawaida hayana madhara.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza neno *maziya*, 'maziya', ririrolavywa kula muzi wa kare sana wa luga za Chibantu. Rero piya rinahusu maziya ga mimea. Anapha muhi hinyu na *Suregada zanzibariensis* dza mifwano ya mimea yenye *maziya* 'gasigo na kazi inayomanyikana', tafwauti na maziya ga dawa ga *Euphorbia hirta*. *Maziya* ni madzi dza maziya ganayotuluka kpwa mmea, ambago ganaweza kukala na fwaida au gasikale nayo, ela kpwa kawaida tagalumiza mutu.

names.en: Digo: *mdimu tsaka*, 'lime plant in the forest', because it is considered the forest form of *mdimu*, the lime. Also *mziyaziya*, 'milk', which Pakia calls the basic name for latex-producing plants, shared with Duruma. Both names are shared with other plants. *Mdimu tsaka* is also *Suregada zanzibariensis*. *Mziyaziya* is also the white milkwood, *Sideroxylon inerme* (*mkoko bara*). Mgombato gives *tsaka* as 'forest; wild', *maziya* as milk and *ndimu* as lime.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdimu tsaka*, 'mdimu wa msituni', kwa sababu unachukuliwa kuwa aina ya msituni ya *mdimu*. Pia *mziyaziya*, 'maziwa', ambalo Pakia analiita jina la msingi la mimea inayotoa utomvu, linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma. Majina yote mawili yanashirikiwa na mimea mingine. *Mdimu tsaka* pia ni *Suregada zanzibariensis*. *Mziyaziya* pia ni *white milkwood*, *Sideroxylon inerme* (*mkoko bara*). Mgombato anatoa *tsaka* kwa maana ya 'msitu; -a porini', *maziya* kwa maana ya maziwa na *ndimu* kwa maana ya ndimu.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdimu tsaka*, 'mdimu wa tsakani', kpwa sababu unaonwa kukala ni aina ya tsakani ya *mdimu*, muhi wa ndimu. Piya ni *mziyaziya*, 'maziya', dzina ambaro Pakia anagomba ni dzina ra msingi ra mimea inayolavya maziya, na ni ra Chiduruma piya. Madzina gosi mairi ganahumirwa piya kpwa mimea yanjina. *Mdimu tsaka* piya ni *Suregada zanzibariensis*. *Mziyaziya* piya ni *white milkwood*, *Sideroxylon inerme* (*mkoko bara*). Mgombato unapha *tsaka* mana ya 'msitu; -a mwitu', *maziya* mana ya 'maziwa', na *ndimu* mana ya 'ndimu'.

teaser.en: Another 'forest lime': a glossy, aromatic-leaved tree that Digo people link to the lime by sight and smell.
teaser.sw: 'Mdimu wa msituni' mwingine: mti wenye majani yanayong'aa na yenye harufu, ambao Wadigo huuhusisha na mdimu kwa sura na harufu.
teaser.dg: 'Mdimu wa tsakani' wanjina: muhi wenye makodza ganayong'ala na ga arufu nono, ambao Adigo anauona kukala ni ndugu wa mdimu kpwa matso na kpwa arufu.

summary.en: This mdimu tsaka is a small forest tree with glossy, aromatic leaves and a little milky sap. Digo people give it the same name as Hunteria zeylanica: the forest form of the lime.
summary.sw: Mdimu tsaka huu ni mti mdogo wa msituni wenye majani yanayong'aa, yenye harufu nzuri, na utomvu kidogo kama maziwa. Wadigo huupa jina lile lile la *Hunteria zeylanica*: aina ya msituni ya mdimu.
summary.dg: *Mdimu tsaka* hinyu ni muhi mdide wa tsakani wenye makodza ganayong'ala ga arufu nono, na maziya machache. Adigo anaupha dzina ra *Hunteria zeylanica*: aina ya tsakani ya mdimu.

about.en: This *mdimu tsaka* is a shrub or small tree with smooth bark and glossy, leathery leaves. Held up to the light, the leaves show tiny translucent dots, and they are aromatic. The small greenish-yellow flowers grow in clusters, and male and female flowers are on separate plants. The fruit is a three-lobed capsule. When cut, the plant gives a little milky sap. Digo people identify it by the look and smell of its leaves.
about.sw: *Mdimu tsaka* huu ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye gome laini na majani yanayong'aa, magumu kama ngozi. Ukiyainua kuelekea mwangaza, majani huonyesha vitone vidogo sana vinavyopitisha mwanga, na yana harufu nzuri. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-manjano huota katika vishada, na maua ya kiume na ya kike huwa kwenye mimea tofauti. Tunda ni kibumba chenye pande tatu. Ukikatwa, mmea hutoa utomvu kidogo kama maziwa. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura na harufu ya majani yake.
about.dg: *Mdimu tsaka* hinyu ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye gopha laini na makodza ganayong'ala, magumu dza chingo. Uchigaika mwangani, makodza ganaonyesa vidoni vidide sana ambavyo mwanga unatsupa, na gana arufu nono. Maruwa madide ga chijani na mandano ganamera kpwa mabunda, na maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwa mimea tafwauti. Tunda ni kakaya renye seemu tahu. Uchiukata, mmea unalavya maziya machache. Adigo anaumanya kpwa vira makodzage ganavyoonekana na arufu yago.

culture.en: Pakia gives *Suregada zanzibariensis* with *Hunteria zeylanica* as plants whose *maziya*, 'milk', has no known use. Its glossy, scented leaves explain why it is thought of as a forest relative of the lime.
culture.sw: Pakia anatoa *Suregada zanzibariensis* pamoja na *Hunteria zeylanica* kama mimea ambayo *maziya*, 'maziwa', yake hayana matumizi yanayojulikana. Majani yake yanayong'aa na yenye harufu yanaeleza kwa nini unadhaniwa kuwa jamaa wa msituni wa mdimu.
culture.dg: Pakia anapha *Suregada zanzibariensis* phamwenga na *Hunteria zeylanica* dza mimea ambayo maziyage, *maziya*, 'maziya', tagana kazi inayomanyikana. Makodzage ganayong'ala na ga arufu nono ndiyo sababu unaonwa kukala ni ndugu wa tsakani wa mdimu.

names.en: Digo: *mdimu tsaka*, 'lime plant in the forest'. Pakia gives this name, with its meaning, for both *Suregada zanzibariensis* and *Hunteria zeylanica*. Two unrelated forest trees with glossy, citrus-like leaves therefore share it. *Chidimu tsaka* (*Toddaliopsis*), the 'small forest lime', is a true member of the citrus family. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdimu tsaka*, 'mdimu wa msituni'. Pakia anatoa jina hili, pamoja na maana yake, kwa *Suregada zanzibariensis* na *Hunteria zeylanica*. Kwa hiyo miti miwili ya msituni isiyo na uhusiano, yenye majani yanayong'aa kama ya michungwa, inashiriki jina hili. *Chidimu tsaka* (*Toddaliopsis*), 'mdimu mdogo wa msituni', ni mwanafamilia halisi wa familia ya michungwa. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdimu tsaka*, 'mdimu wa tsakani'. Pakia anapha dzina hiri, phamwenga na manage, kpwa *Suregada zanzibariensis* na kpwa *Hunteria zeylanica*. Kpwa hivyo mihi miiri ya tsakani isiyo ya jamii mwenga, yenye makodza ganayong'ala dza ga mdimu, inashiriki dzina hiri. *Chidimu tsaka* (*Toddaliopsis*), 'mdimu mdide wa tsakani', kpwa kpweli ni wa jamii ya mdimu. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.
