teaser.en: A succulent vine whose fleshy stems snap at a touch, so the Digo call it 'breaking'.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye mashina yenye maji mengi yanayokatika ukiyagusa tu, ndiyo maana Wadigo huuita 'kukatika'.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaofyombera wenye madzi manji ndani, ambao militaye ya nyama inadoka uchiiguta tu, kpwa hivyo Adigo anauiha 'kudoka'.

summary.en: Mdokadoka is a succulent climber of the grape family with thick, rounded leaves and brittle stems. Digo people share the name among three Cissus species and also call them mbugubugu, 'the climber'.
summary.sw: Mdokadoka ni mtambaa wenye maji mengi wa familia ya mizabibu, mwenye majani manene ya mviringo na mashina yanayovunjika kwa urahisi. Wadigo hulitumia jina hili kwa spishi tatu za *Cissus* na pia huziita *mbugubugu*, 'mtambaa'.
summary.dg: *Mdokadoka* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye madzi manji ndani, wa jamii ya mzabibu, wenye makodza maziho ga duara na milita inayodoka upesi. Adigo anahumira dzina hiri kpwa aina tahu za *Cissus*, na piya anaziiha *mbugubugu*, 'mmea unaofyombera'.

about.en: Mdokadoka is a succulent climber that scrambles over bushes with tendrils. Its stems are fleshy and somewhat angled, and they snap easily. The leaves are thick, almost round, waxy and bluish-green, with small teeth along the edge. Small greenish flowers in flat clusters are followed by round berries that ripen red. Pakia notes that *Cissus* species are among the few plants Digo people cannot tell apart by their leaves alone. They identify *mdokadoka* by its stem.
about.sw: Mdokadoka ni mtambaa wenye maji mengi unaotambaa juu ya vichaka kwa kutumia vikonyo. Mashina yake yana nyama na yana pembe kiasi, na hukatika kwa urahisi. Majani ni manene, karibu ya mviringo kamili, yenye nta na rangi ya kijani-samawati, yenye meno madogo pembeni. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-kijani katika vishada bapa hufuatwa na matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa mekundu. Pakia anabainisha kwamba spishi za *Cissus* ni miongoni mwa mimea michache ambayo Wadigo hawawezi kuitofautisha kwa majani peke yake. Huutambua *mdokadoka* kwa shina lake.
about.dg: *Mdokadoka* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye madzi manji ndani, unaoambala dzulu ya vitsaka kpwa nyuzi za kugbwirira. Militaye ni ya nyama, ina pembe chidide, na inadoka upesi. Makodza ni maziho, karibu ga duara, dza ga nta, ga rangi ya chijani na samawati, na gana meno madide kanda-kanda. Maruwa madide ga chijani ganamera kpwa mabunda sambamba, na badaye ganalavya matunda madide ga duara ganayoiva na kukala ga kundu. Pakia anaandika kukala aina za *Cissus* ni kahi ya mimea michache ambayo Adigo taaweza kuitafwautisha kpwa makodza tu. Adigo anaumanya *mdokadoka* kpwa kolore.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal bushland and thicket, often on coral rag or rocky ground, scrambling over shrubs.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika kavu ya vichaka ya pwani na vichaka, mara nyingi kwenye ardhi ya matumbawe au yenye mawe, ukitambaa juu ya vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kavu pwani na vitsakani, mara nyinji dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo au tsi ya mawe, uchiambala dzulu ya vitsaka.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. In Arabia and the Horn of Africa the leaves of this species are cooked and eaten.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Huko Uarabuni na Pembe ya Afrika majani ya spishi hii hupikwa na kuliwa.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika kazi yoyosi ya mmea hinyu. Uarabuni na Pembe ya Afrika, makodza ga aina hino nkujitwa na kuriwa.

culture.en: Pakia explains *mdokadoka* as 'breaking': the stem breaks (*doka*) easily. Mgombato glosses *doka* as 'to tear, to break off, to come apart'. The second name, *mbugubugu*, is the basic Digo word for a climber, built on the root *-bugu*. Doubling it stresses that the plant is the climber form.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza *mdokadoka* kuwa 'kukatika': shina hukatika (*doka*) kwa urahisi. Mgombato anaeleza *doka* kuwa 'kuchanika, kukatika, kutengana'. Jina la pili, *mbugubugu*, ni neno la msingi la Kidigo la mtambaa, lililojengwa juu ya mzizi *-bugu*. Kulirudia kunasisitiza kwamba mmea huu ni wa umbo la mtambaa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza *mdokadoka* kukala ni 'kudoka': kolo nkudoka (*doka*) upesi. Mgombato unaeleza *doka* kukala ni 'kukatika' (*to tear, to break off, to come apart*). Dzina ra phiri, *mbugubugu*, ni neno ra msingi ra Chidigo ra mmea unaofyombera, ririrodzengbwa kula muzi *-bugu*. Kurudiya muzi hinyu kunaonyesa hasa kukala mmea hinyu ni wa aina ya kufyombera.

names.en: Digo: *mdokadoka*, 'breaking', and *mbugubugu*, 'climber', shared with Duruma and Giriama. Pakia gives both names to three species: *Cissus rotundifolia*, *C. sylvicola* and *C. quinquangularis*. The name *dokadoka*, without the *m-*, belongs to a *Tylophora* climber. No English or Swahili name is recorded by Pakia.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdokadoka*, 'kukatika', na *mbugubugu*, 'mtambaa', linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Pakia anatoa majina yote mawili kwa spishi tatu: *Cissus rotundifolia*, *C. sylvicola* na *C. quinquangularis*. Jina *dokadoka*, bila *m-*, ni la mtambaa wa *Tylophora*. Pakia harekodi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdokadoka*, 'kudoka', na *mbugubugu*, 'mmea unaofyombera'; madzina higa ni ga Chiduruma na Chigiriama piya. Pakia anapha madzina gosi mairi kpwa aina tahu: *Cissus rotundifolia*, *C. sylvicola* na *C. quinquangularis*. Dzina *dokadoka*, bila *m-*, ni ra mmea unaofyombera wa *Tylophora*. Pakia kaandika dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza.

teaser.en: A forest Cissus, named by science only in 1993, whose young leaves come up crimson-purple.
teaser.sw: *Cissus* wa msituni, aliyepewa jina la kisayansi mwaka 1993 tu, ambaye majani yake machanga huchipuka yakiwa na rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu.
teaser.dg: *Cissus* wa tsakani, ambao asayansi akaupha dzina mwaka 1993 tu, na makodzage maphya ganatuluka ga kundu-zambarau.

summary.en: This mdokadoka is a forest liana of the grape family, found only on the coast of south-east Kenya and eastern Tanzania. Like its relatives it has fleshy leaves and brittle stems.
summary.sw: Mdokadoka huu ni mtambaa wa msituni wa familia ya mizabibu, unaopatikana tu katika pwani ya kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na mashariki mwa Tanzania. Kama jamaa zake, una majani yenye nyama na mashina yanayovunjika kwa urahisi.
summary.dg: *Mdokadoka* hinyu ni mmea unaofyombera wa tsakani, wa jamii ya mzabibu, unaophahikana pwani ya kusini-mashariki ya Kenya na mashariki ya Tanzania tu. Dza nduguze, una makodza ga nyama na milita inayodoka upesi.

about.en: *Cissus sylvicola* is a liana that can climb to about 12 metres. It has tendrils and lateral roots that are often swollen into tubers. Its leaves are slightly to markedly fleshy and hairless, varying from diamond-shaped to oval or round, sometimes shallowly lobed. Young leaves are usually crimson-purple and turn green as they mature. Like other *mdokadoka*, its stem breaks easily, and Digo people identify it by the stem rather than the leaves.
about.sw: *Cissus sylvicola* ni mtambaa unaoweza kupanda hadi mita 12 hivi. Una vikonyo na mizizi ya pembeni ambayo mara nyingi huvimba ikawa viazi. Majani yake yana nyama kidogo hadi nyingi na hayana manyoya, umbo lake likitofautiana kutoka la almasi hadi yai au mviringo, wakati mwingine yakiwa na pembe za kina kifupi. Majani machanga kwa kawaida huwa na rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu na hugeuka kijani yanapokomaa. Kama *mdokadoka* wengine, shina lake hukatika kwa urahisi, na Wadigo huutambua kwa shina badala ya majani.
about.dg: *Cissus sylvicola* ni mmea unaofyombera ambao unaweza kufika ure wa mita 12 hivi. Una nyuzi za kugbwirira na mizi ya kanda ambayo mara nyinji inafutuka na kukala viazi. Makodzage gana nyama chidide hadi sana, bila nyere, na umbo rago ni tafwauti: ga pembe nne, ga mviringo au ga duara, na wakati wanjina gana mala madide. Makodza maphya mara nyinji ni ga kundu-zambarau, na ganagaluka chijani ganavyokula. Dza *mdokadoka* wanjina, kolore nkudoka upesi, na Adigo anaumanya kpwa kolore, sio kpwa makodza.

where.en: It grows in evergreen forest, forest on rocky hills and coral limestone thicket, from near sea level to about 500 metres. Its range runs from south-east Kenya to eastern Tanzania. *Sylvicola* means 'forest-dweller'.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu isiyopukutisha majani, misitu ya vilima vyenye mawe na vichaka vya chokaa ya matumbawe, kutoka karibu na usawa wa bahari hadi mita 500 hivi. Eneo lake huanzia kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya hadi mashariki mwa Tanzania. *Sylvicola* maana yake ni 'mkaaji wa msituni'.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga mihi yenye makodza chila wakati, matsakani dzulu ya miango ya mawe na vitsakani vya mawe ga sanoo, kula phephi na bahari hadi mita 500 dzulu ya bahari hivi. Unaphahikana kula kusini-mashariki ya Kenya hadi mashariki ya Tanzania. Mana ya *sylvicola* ni 'mwenyezi wa tsakani'.

culture.en: Pakia explains *mdokadoka* as 'breaking', because the stem breaks (*doka*) easily, and *mbugubugu* as the basic Digo name for a climber.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza *mdokadoka* kuwa 'kukatika', kwa sababu shina hukatika (*doka*) kwa urahisi, na *mbugubugu* kuwa jina la msingi la Kidigo la mtambaa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza *mdokadoka* kukala ni 'kudoka', kpwa sababu kolo nkudoka (*doka*) upesi, na *mbugubugu* kukala ni dzina ra msingi ra Chidigo ra mmea unaofyombera.

names.en: Digo: *mdokadoka*, 'breaking', and *mbugubugu*, 'climber', shared with Duruma and Giriama. Pakia gives the same two names to *Cissus rotundifolia* and *C. quinquangularis*, so the Digo do not separate these three species by name. No English or Swahili name is recorded. Botanists described the species in the *Flora of Tropical East Africa* in 1993.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdokadoka*, 'kukatika', na *mbugubugu*, 'mtambaa', linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Pakia anatoa majina hayo hayo mawili kwa *Cissus rotundifolia* na *C. quinquangularis*, kwa hiyo Wadigo hawazitenganishi spishi hizi tatu kwa majina. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wataalamu wa mimea waliieleza spishi hii katika *Flora of Tropical East Africa* mwaka 1993.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdokadoka*, 'kudoka', na *mbugubugu*, 'mmea unaofyombera'; madzina higa ni ga Chiduruma na Chigiriama piya. Pakia anapha madzina higo mairi kpwa *Cissus rotundifolia* na *C. quinquangularis*, kpwa hivyo Adigo taaganya aina hizi tahu kpwa madzina. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Asayansi a mimea akaieleza aina hino mwaka 1993, chitabuni *Flora of Tropical East Africa*.

conservation.en: It has a small range, limited to coastal forest and thicket in Kenya and Tanzania. These are habitats under pressure from clearing, although the species has not been formally assessed as threatened.
conservation.sw: Eneo lake ni dogo, likiwa limedhibitiwa kwenye misitu ya pwani na vichaka nchini Kenya na Tanzania. Haya ni makazi yanayokabiliwa na shinikizo la ukataji, ingawa spishi hii haijatathminiwa rasmi kuwa iko hatarini.
conservation.dg: Unaphahikana phatu phachache tu, matsakani na vitsakani vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania. Phatu hipho phanaangamizwa kpwa sababu atu anatema mihi na kusafisha tsi, ela aina hino taidzangbwelolwa rasmi kuona dza iri hatarini.

teaser.en: A climber with fleshy, five-angled stems that snap easily, the third Cissus that Digo people call 'breaking'.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye mashina ya nyama yenye pembe tano yanayokatika kwa urahisi, *Cissus* wa tatu ambaye Wadigo humwita 'kukatika'.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaofyombera wenye milita ya nyama ya pembe tsano inayodoka upesi; ni *Cissus* wa hahu ambao Adigo anauiha 'kudoka'.

summary.en: This mdokadoka is a succulent Cissus with five-angled stems. It shares its two Digo names with two other Cissus species.
summary.sw: Mdokadoka huu ni *Cissus* wenye maji mengi na mashina yenye pembe tano. Unashiriki majina yake mawili ya Kidigo na spishi nyingine mbili za *Cissus*.
summary.dg: *Mdokadoka* hinyu ni *Cissus* wenye madzi manji ndani na milita ya pembe tsano. Unashiriki madzinage mairi ga Chidigo na aina mbiri zanjina za *Cissus*.

about.en: *Cissus quinquangularis* is a succulent climber with tendrils. Its name means 'five-angled', describing the fleshy green stems, which are ridged along their length. The leaves are small, fleshy and often short-lived, so the green stems do much of the plant's work. Small greenish flowers are followed by small berries. As with the other *mdokadoka*, the jointed stem breaks easily, and Digo people recognise the plant by its stem.
about.sw: *Cissus quinquangularis* ni mtambaa wenye maji mengi na vikonyo. Jina lake linamaanisha 'wenye pembe tano', likieleza mashina yake ya kijani yenye nyama, yenye mifereji kwa urefu wake wote. Majani ni madogo, yenye nyama na mara nyingi hayadumu muda mrefu, kwa hiyo mashina ya kijani ndiyo hufanya sehemu kubwa ya kazi ya mmea. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-kijani hufuatwa na matunda madogo. Kama ilivyo kwa *mdokadoka* wengine, shina lenye viungo hukatika kwa urahisi, na Wadigo huutambua mmea huu kwa shina lake.
about.dg: *Cissus quinquangularis* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye madzi manji ndani, na una nyuzi za kugbwirira. Dzinare rina mana ya 'renye pembe tsano', kpwa sababu ya militaye ya nyama ya chijani, yenye mistari mire ya kufutuka kpwa urewe wosi. Makodza ni madide, ga nyama, na mara nyinji tagakala kpwa muda mure, kpwa hivyo milita ya chijani ndiyo inayohenda kazi nyinji ya mmea. Maruwa madide ga chijani ganalavya matunda madide. Dza *mdokadoka* wanjina, kolo renye vitengu nkudoka upesi, na Adigo anaumanya mmea kpwa kolore.

culture.dg: Madzina mairi ga Chidigo ganaeleza kolo na vira mmea unavyomera. *Mdokadoka*, 'kudoka', rinalavywa kula *doka*, kudoka, kpwa sababu kolo nkudoka upesi. *Mbugubugu*, 'mmea unaofyombera', ni dzina ra msingi ra mimea inayofyombera, na kurudiya muzi *-bugu* kunaonyesa hasa kukala mmea hinyu ni wa aina ya kufyombera.

summary.en: Mdoma, also called mwambaro, is a scrambling shrub or liana of the Celastraceae family. It has leathery leaves and round orange fruits.
summary.sw: Mdoma, unaoitwa pia *mwambaro*, ni kichaka kinachotambaa au mtambaa wa familia ya Celastraceae. Una majani magumu kama ngozi na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya machungwa.
summary.dg: *Mdoma*, unaoihwa piya *mwambaro*, ni chitsaka chinachoambala au mmea unaofyombera wa jamii ya *Celastraceae*. Una makodza magumu dza chingo na matunda ga duara ga rangi ya chungbwa.

about.en: Mdoma is a scrambling shrub or woody climber that leans on and twines through other vegetation. Its leaves are opposite, leathery and glossy, often with slightly toothed edges. Small greenish-yellow flowers grow in clusters in the leaf axils. They are followed by round fruits that ripen orange to red, with a few seeds in a soft, sweet pulp.
about.sw: Mdoma ni kichaka kinachotambaa au mtambaa wenye shina la mti unaoegemea na kujiviringa katikati ya mimea mingine. Majani yake hukaa kwa jozi zinazotazamana, ni magumu kama ngozi na yanang'aa, mara nyingi yakiwa na meno madogo pembeni. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-manjano huota katika vishada kwenye kwapa za majani. Hufuatwa na matunda ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa ya machungwa hadi mekundu, yenye mbegu chache ndani ya nyama laini na tamu.
about.dg: *Mdoma* ni chitsaka chinachoambala au mmea unaofyombera wenye kolo ra muhi, unaojejemera na kulinga-linga kahi ya mimea yanjina. Makodzage ganamera mairi-mairi ganalengana, ni magumu dza chingo na ganang'ala, na mara nyinji gana meno madide kanda-kanda. Maruwa madide ga chijani na mandano ganamera kpwa mabunda phatu kodza rinaphogbwirana na panda. Badaye ganalavya matunda ga duara ganayoiva na kukala rangi ya chungbwa hadi ya kundu, genye tembe chache ndani ya nyama laini ya mtswano.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, thicket and bushland in eastern Africa and Madagascar.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka na nyika ya vichaka mashariki mwa Afrika na Madagaska.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani, vitsakani na weruni, Afrika ya Mashariki na Madagascar.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. In eastern and southern Africa the pulp of *Salacia* fruits is eaten as a wild snack.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika nyama ya matunda ya *Salacia* huliwa kama kitafunio cha porini.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika kazi yoyosi. Afrika ya Mashariki na kusini ya Afrika, nyama ya matunda ga *Salacia* nkuriwa dza chakurya chidide cha weruni.

teaser.en: A rare forest relative of the 'miracle berry', found only in a handful of coastal forests in Kenya and Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Jamaa adimu wa msituni wa 'tunda la ajabu' (miracle berry), anayepatikana tu katika misitu michache ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
teaser.dg: *Mdulu* ni muhi adimu wa tsakani, nduguye 'miracle berry', na unaphahikana kpwenye matsaka machache tu ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

summary.en: Mdulu is a rare shrub or small tree of lowland coastal forest, a relative of the West African miracle berry. It is listed as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: Mdulu ni kichaka au mti mdogo adimu wa misitu ya pwani ya nyanda za chini, jamaa wa *miracle berry* ya Afrika Magharibi. Umeorodheshwa kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Mdulu* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide adimu wa matsaka ga herera ya pwani, nduguye *miracle berry*, muhi wa Afrika ya Magharibi. Ukaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (uri hatarini).

about.en: Mdulu is a shrub or small tree with simple, broad, leathery leaves crowded towards the ends of the branches. The small flowers grow in clusters directly on the stems, and the berries are fleshy. Pakia notes that *Synsepalum* species are recognised partly by their fluted stems (*mialo*), which have ridges and grooves running up the trunk. It is one of the few bark features Digo people use for identification.
about.sw: Mdulu ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani sahili, mapana na magumu kama ngozi, yaliyosongamana kuelekea ncha za matawi. Maua madogo huota katika vishada moja kwa moja kwenye mashina, na matunda yake ni beri zenye nyama. Pakia anabainisha kwamba spishi za *Synsepalum* hutambuliwa kwa sehemu kwa mashina yao yenye mifereji (*mialo*), yenye matuta na mitaro inayopanda juu ya shina. Hii ni mojawapo ya sifa chache za gome ambazo Wadigo huzitumia kutambua mimea.
about.dg: *Mdulu* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza gasiyoganywa, mapana na magumu dza chingo, ganayokusanyika phephi na ntsa za pandaze. Maruwage madide ganamera kpwa makundi phapho phapho kpwenye kolo na pandaze, na matundage madide gana nyama. Pakia anaandika kukala aina za *Synsepalum* nkumanyikana, kpwa seemu, kpwa makologe genye *mialo*: mistari ya kuinuka na mitaru inayofyombera kolo kula photsi hadi dzulu. Hino ni mwenga wa alama chache za gopha ambazo atu a Chidigo nkuzihumira kumanya mihi.

where.en: It is a rare species of lowland forest in coastal Kenya and Tanzania, extending into the Eastern Arc foothills. It is also recorded from Mozambique and Zimbabwe.
where.sw: Ni spishi adimu ya misitu ya nyanda za chini katika pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, ikienea hadi kwenye vilima vya chini vya Eastern Arc. Imerekodiwa pia Msumbiji na Zimbabwe.
where.dg: Ni aina adimu ya matsaka ga herera ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, na inaenea hadi photsi ya myango ya Eastern Arc. Piya ikaandikpwa Mozambique na Zimbabwe.

names.en: Digo: *mdulu*. Pakia records it only for Digo and gives no meaning. No Swahili name is recorded. In English it has been called the stalkless miraculous berry, after its relative *Synsepalum dulcificum*, whose berries make sour food taste sweet. Other Digo *Synsepalum* are *mtsamvia* (*S. brevipes*) and *msambwe* (*S. subverticillatum*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdulu*. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu na hatoi maana yake. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza umeitwa *stalkless miraculous berry*, kutokana na jamaa yake *Synsepalum dulcificum*, ambaye matunda yake hufanya chakula chenye uchachu kionje kitamu. *Synsepalum* nyingine za Kidigo ni *mtsamvia* (*S. brevipes*) na *msambwe* (*S. subverticillatum*).
names.dg: Chidigo: *mdulu*. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu, na kalavya manage. Dzina ra Chiswahili tariphahikana. Kpwa Chingereza ukaihwa *stalkless miraculous berry*, kpwa sababu ya nduguye *Synsepalum dulcificum*, ambao matundage ganahenda vyakurya vya ngbwadu vikale vya mtswano. Aina zanjina za *Synsepalum* zenye madzina ga Chidigo ni *mtsamvia* (*S. brevipes*) na *msambwe* (*S. subverticillatum*).

conservation.en: It is listed as Vulnerable by IUCN, because it grows only in scattered patches of lowland forest that continue to shrink through clearing.
conservation.sw: Umeorodheshwa na IUCN kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable), kwa sababu hukua tu katika vipande vilivyotawanyika vya misitu ya nyanda za chini, ambavyo vinaendelea kupungua kutokana na ukataji.
conservation.dg: IUCN ikauandika dza *Vulnerable* (uri hatarini), kpwa sababu unamera tu kpwenye vipande vidide-vidide vya matsaka ga herera, na matsaka higa ganaenderera kuphungula kpwa sababu ya kutemwa.

teaser.en: 'It ties up animals': a twining forest climber that grows so tangled it is said to snare any animal walking through.
teaser.sw: 'Hufunga wanyama': mtambaa wa msituni unaojiviringa na kusokotana kiasi kwamba husemekana kumnasa mnyama yeyote anayepita ndani yake.
teaser.dg: 'Unafunga nyama': mmea wa tsakani wa kufyombera, unaodzizunguluka sana hata nkugombwa unagbwira chila nyama anayetsupa kahi yakpwe.

summary.en: Mfunga nyama is a forest liana of the passion-flower family that twines so thickly it is said to tie up passing animals. It is also hard to identify, because its leaves change shape as it grows.
summary.sw: Mfunga nyama ni mtambaa wa msituni wa familia ya mkarakara (passion flower) unaojiviringa kwa wingi kiasi kwamba husemekana kuwafunga wanyama wanaopita. Pia ni mgumu kuutambua, kwa sababu majani yake hubadilika umbo unavyokua.
summary.dg: *Mfunga nyama* ni mmea wa tsakani wa kufyombera wenye kolo ra muhi, wa jamii ya mtunda, unaodzizunguluka sana hata nkugombwa unafunga nyama anaotsupa. Piya ni vigumu kuumanya, kpwa sababu makodzage nkugaluka umbo uchikula.

about.en: Mfunga nyama is a slender shrub that becomes a small liana up to about three metres, climbing with tendrils from the upper leaf axils. It is hairless and grows from a perennial rootstock. The leaves change a great deal with age. Seedlings and young plants have small, deeply cut leaves, while mature plants have larger leaves with toothed edges. The flowers grow in short clusters near the branch tips. Each has a ring of many slender, tapering filaments (a corona), as in a passion flower. The fruit is a three- or four-valved capsule.
about.sw: Mfunga nyama ni kichaka chembamba kinachogeuka kuwa mtambaa mdogo wa hadi mita tatu hivi, kikipanda kwa vikonyo vinavyotoka kwenye kwapa za majani ya juu. Hakina manyoya na huota kutoka kwenye shina-mzizi linalodumu miaka mingi. Majani hubadilika sana kadiri unavyozeeka. Miche na mimea michanga ina majani madogo yaliyokatwa kwa kina, wakati mimea iliyokomaa ina majani makubwa zaidi yenye meno pembeni. Maua huota katika vishada vifupi karibu na ncha za matawi. Kila ua lina duara la nyuzi nyingi nyembamba zinazochongoka (taji, corona), kama ilivyo kwa ua la pasheni. Tunda ni kibumba chenye vipande vitatu au vinne.
about.dg: *Mfunga nyama* ni chitsaka chembamba chinachokala mmea mdide wa kufyombera wa hadi mita tahu hivi, unaofyombera kpwa nyuzi za kugbwirira zinazomera phatu makodza ga dzulu ganaphogbwirana na panda. Tauna nyere, na unamera kula kpwa muzi wa tsini unaokala na moyo kpwa miaka minji. Makodzage ganagaluka sana uchikula. Mitse na mimea midide ina makodza madide garigokatwa-katwa sana, ela mimea iriyokula ina makodza makulu zaidi genye meno kanda-kanda. Maruwa ganamera kpwa makundi mafupi phephi na ntsa za panda. Chila ruwa rina pete ya nyuzi nyinji nyembamba zenye ntsa (*corona*), dza ruwa ra mtunda. Tundare ni kakaya rinaroweza kuvuguka kpwa seemu tahu au nne.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in Kenya, Tanzania, Mozambique and KwaZulu-Natal.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani na vichaka nchini Kenya, Tanzania, Msumbiji na KwaZulu-Natal.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Kenya, Tanzania, Mozambique na KwaZulu-Natal.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name as 'ties animal'. The plant is said to grow in such a twining tangle that it ties up (*funga*) an animal (*nyama*) crossing through it. He groups it with other names describing vigorous growth, such as *mfunga sandzu*, and *mwambanyama*, the 'animal trapper' grass. He also notes that it is hard to identify, because its young and mature leaves look so different.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jina hili kuwa 'hufunga mnyama'. Inasemekana mmea huu hukua ukijiviringa na kusokotana kiasi kwamba humfunga (*funga*) mnyama (*nyama*) anayepita ndani yake. Anaupanga pamoja na majina mengine yanayoeleza ukuaji wa nguvu, kama *mfunga sandzu*, na *mwambanyama*, nyasi 'mtega wanyama'. Anabainisha pia kwamba ni mgumu kuutambua, kwa sababu majani yake machanga na yaliyokomaa yanatofautiana sana.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza dzina hiri kukala ni 'unafunga nyama'. Nkugombwa mmea uhu unamera kpwa kudzizunguluka sana hata unafunga (*funga*) nyama (*nyama*) anayetsupa kahi yakpwe. Anauika phamwenga na madzina ganjina ganayoonyesa kumera kpwa nguvu, dza *mfunga sandzu*, na *mwambanyama*, nyasi za 'kuhega nyama'. Piya anaandika kukala ni vigumu kuumanya, kpwa sababu makodzage machanga na ga mmea uriokula ganaonekana tafwauti sana.

names.en: Digo: *mfunga nyama*, 'ties animal'. Mgombato gives *funga* as 'to close, to tie'. Pakia records it only for Digo, with no English or Swahili name. It is the only species in the genus *Schlechterina*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mfunga nyama*, 'hufunga mnyama'. Mgombato anatoa *funga* kwa maana ya 'kufunga'. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu, bila jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili. Ndiyo spishi pekee katika jenasi *Schlechterina*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *mfunga nyama*, 'unafunga nyama'. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *funga* mana ya 'kufunga' (dza mryango) na 'kufunga kpwa kamba'. Pakia anauandika kpwa Chidigo tu, bila dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili. Ni aina mwenga tu iriyo kpwenye jenasi ya *Schlechterina*.

teaser.en: A giant liana with pods longer than a person is tall; its big, shiny seeds float across oceans and wash up on beaches.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa mkubwa sana wenye maganda marefu kuliko kimo cha mtu; mbegu zake kubwa zinazong'aa huelea kuvuka bahari na kusukumwa ufuoni.
teaser.dg: Mmea mkulu sana wa kufyombera wenye makakaya mare kuriko mutu ariyeima; tembeze kulu zinazong'ala nkuelea kutsupa bahari na kufika ufuwoni.

summary.en: Mfwihi is a huge woody liana of the pea family, known for its enormous pods and large floating seeds. The seeds are carried by rivers and the sea and wash up on tropical beaches far away.
summary.sw: Mfwihi ni mtambaa mkubwa sana wenye shina la mti wa jamii ya kunde, unaojulikana kwa maganda yake makubwa mno na mbegu kubwa zinazoelea. Mbegu hizo husafirishwa na mito na bahari na hufika kwenye fuo za tropiki zilizo mbali sana.
summary.dg: *Mfwihi* ni mmea mkulu sana wa kufyombera wenye kolo ra muhi, wa jamii ya kunde, unaomanyikana kpwa makakayage makulu sana na tembeze kulu zinazoelea. Tembe nkutsukulwa ni miho na bahari hadi kpwenye ufuwo za tsi za dzoho za kure sana.

about.en: Mfwihi is a giant woody climber whose stems can be thick and twisted like cables, climbing high into the forest canopy. Its leaves are divided twice, and the tip of each leaf is often modified into a tendril. Small, creamy-yellow, fragrant flowers grow in long, slender spikes. The pods are its most famous feature. They are woody, flattened and jointed, and can reach well over a metre in length, with each segment holding one seed. The seeds are large, about 5 cm across, flat, round and shiny dark brown, and they float.
about.sw: Mfwihi ni mtambaa mkubwa sana wenye shina la mti, ambao mashina yake yanaweza kuwa manene na kusokotana kama kamba kubwa, ukipanda juu hadi kwenye dari la msitu. Majani yake yamegawanyika mara mbili, na ncha ya kila jani mara nyingi hubadilika ikawa kikonyo. Maua madogo ya rangi ya krimu-manjano yenye harufu nzuri huota katika visuke virefu vyembamba. Maganda ndiyo sifa yake maarufu zaidi. Ni magumu kama mti, bapa na yenye viungo, na yanaweza kufikia urefu wa zaidi ya mita moja, kila kipande kikiwa na mbegu moja. Mbegu ni kubwa, karibu sm 5 kwa upana, bapa, za mviringo na za rangi ya hudhurungi iliyokolea inayong'aa, na huelea.
about.dg: *Mfwihi* ni mmea mkulu sana wa kufyombera, wenye makolo ganayoweza kukala maziho na kudzisongolosa dza kamba, na unafyombera dzulu sana hadi kpwenye makodza ga mihi mire ya tsakani. Makodzage nkuganywa mara mbiri, na ntsa ya chila kodza mara nyinji nkugaluka ikakala uzi wa kugbwirira. Maruwa madide, ga rangi ya maziya na mandano, genye arufu nono, ganamera kpwenye milita mire na myembamba. Makakaya ndigo ganayomanyikana zaidi. Ni magumu dza muhi, ga sambamba na genye viungo, na ganaweza kukala mare kuriko mita mwenga, na chila seemu ina tembe mwenga. Tembe ni kulu, upana wa sentimita 5 hivi, za sambamba, za mviringo na za rangi ya dongo iriyo phephi na nyiru inayong'ala, na nkuelea.

where.en: It grows in riverine and coastal forest, often near streams and estuaries. Its seeds drift down rivers to the sea, and the species is found on tropical coasts of Africa, Asia and Australia.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya kando ya mito na misitu ya pwani, mara nyingi karibu na vijito na hori. Mbegu zake huchukuliwa na mito hadi baharini, na spishi hii hupatikana katika pwani za tropiki za Afrika, Asia na Australia.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho na ga pwani, mara nyinji phephi na miho midide na phatu miho inaphoinjira baharini. Tembeze nkutsukulwa ni miho hadi baharini, na aina hino inaphahikana kpwenye pwani za tsi za dzoho za Afrika, Asia na Australia.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. Across its range the hard seeds are hollowed out as snuff boxes, carried as charms and used in traditional medicine. The raw seeds are toxic.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Katika maeneo yote unakopatikana, mbegu ngumu hutobolewa ndani zikawa vibweta vya tumbaku ya kunusa, hubebwa kama hirizi na hutumika katika tiba za jadi. Mbegu mbichi zina sumu.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga mmea uhu. Kpwenye phatu phanjina unaphomera, tembe ngumu nkutuluzwa ndani zikahendwa viko vya tumbaku, nkutsukulwa dza hirizi na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji. Tembe mbitsi zina sumu.

names.en: Digo: *mfwihi*. Pakia records it in his list only, with no meaning and no English or Swahili name. In English the seeds are known as sea beans, or snuff-box sea beans.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mfwihi*. Pakia analirekodi katika orodha yake tu, bila maana na bila jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza mbegu zake hujulikana kama *sea beans*, au *snuff-box sea beans*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *mfwihi*. Pakia anauandika kpwenye orodhaye tu, bila manage na bila dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza tembeze nkuihwa *sea beans*, au *snuff-box sea beans*.

teaser.sw: Kichaka cha nchi kavu kinachofunika vijiti vyake vitupu kwa maua meupe-waridi kabla majani yake hayajachipuka.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha tsi kavu chinachofwinika pandaze zisizo na makodza kpwa maruwa ga pinki na nyereru kabla ya makodza kuzuka.

summary.en: Mfyofyo is a deciduous shrub of the coffee family that flowers on bare branches, its flowers sitting tight against the twigs. Pakia gives the same name to Heinsia crinita and Bourreria nemoralis.
summary.sw: Mfyofyo ni kichaka kinachopukutisha majani cha familia ya mibuni (kahawa), kinachochanua kwenye matawi matupu, maua yake yakiwa yamekaa kubana kwenye vijiti. Pakia anatoa jina hilo hilo kwa *Heinsia crinita* na *Bourreria nemoralis*.
summary.dg: *Mfyofyo* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya m'buni chinachogbwa makodza, na chinavyala maruwa kpwenye panda zisizo na makodza; maruwage ganagbwirana na panda. Pakia anapha dzina hiri hiri *Heinsia crinita* na *Bourreria nemoralis*.

about.en: Mfyofyo is a deciduous shrub or small tree with stiff, often short side shoots. Its leaves are small, opposite and elliptic, often clustered on the short shoots. The flowers come at the end of the dry season, often before the new leaves. They are white to pink, star-shaped and fragrant, and they sit almost without stalks on the twigs. *Apodanthera* means 'stalkless flower'. The small round fruits darken when ripe.
about.sw: Mfyofyo ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaopukutisha majani, wenye machipukizi ya pembeni magumu na mara nyingi mafupi. Majani yake ni madogo, hukaa kwa jozi zinazotazamana na yana umbo la duaradufu, mara nyingi yakiwa yamejikusanya kwenye machipukizi mafupi. Maua hutokea mwishoni mwa kiangazi, mara nyingi kabla ya majani mapya. Ni meupe hadi waridi, yenye umbo la nyota na harufu nzuri, na hukaa karibu bila vikonyo juu ya vijiti. *Apodanthera* maana yake ni 'ua lisilo na kikonyo'. Matunda madogo ya mviringo hubadilika rangi yakawa meusi zaidi yanapoiva.
about.dg: *Mfyofyo* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaogbwa makodza, wenye maphungo magumu, mara nyinji mafupi. Makodzage ni madide, ganamera mairi-mairi ganalengana, ga mviringo mrefu, na mara nyinji ganakusanyika kpwenye maphungo higo mafupi. Maruwa ganazuka mwisho wa kazikazi, mara nyinji kabla ya makodza maphya. Ni ga nyereru hadi pinki, ga umbo ra nyota, genye arufu nono, na ganagbwirana na panda karibu bila mlita. *Apodanthera* manage ni 'ruwa risiro na mlita'. Matunda madide ga mviringo ganakala ga jiza ganaphoivwa.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, thicket and wooded grassland, across tropical Africa.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika kavu ya vichaka, vichaka na nyasi zenye miti, kote katika Afrika ya tropiki.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kukavu, vitsakani na kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi, kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. In West Africa the plant is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Afrika Magharibi mmea huu hutumika katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga mmea uhu. Afrika ya Magharibi mmea uhu nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Digo: *mfyofyo*, shared with Duruma according to Pakia, who gives no meaning. The name is used for three unrelated shrubs in Pakia's lists: this species, *Heinsia crinita*, and *Bourreria nemoralis* (otherwise *mbunduchi*). No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mfyofyo*, linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma kwa mujibu wa Pakia, ambaye hatoi maana yake. Jina hili linatumika kwa vichaka vitatu visivyo na uhusiano katika orodha za Pakia: spishi hii, *Heinsia crinita*, na *Bourreria nemoralis* (kwa jina jingine *mbunduchi*). Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Chidigo: *mfyofyo*. Pakia anaamba Aduruma nao anahumira dzina hiri, ela kalavya manage. Kpwenye orodha za Pakia, dzina hiri rinahumirwa kpwa vitsaka vitahu visivyo na uhusiano: aina hino, *Heinsia crinita*, na *Bourreria nemoralis* (ambayo piya inaihwa *mbunduchi*). Dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili tariphahikana.

teaser.en: A shrub whose white star-flowers have hairy, fringed petals, as if each one were edged with fine lace.
teaser.sw: Kichaka ambacho maua yake meupe yenye umbo la nyota yana petali zenye manyoya na pindo, kana kwamba kila moja limepambwa kwa lesi nyembamba.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chenye maruwa ga nyereru ga umbo ra nyota, ambago malage gana nyere kanda-kanda, dza kukala chila ruwa rikashonwa kanda-kanda kpwa nyuzi nyembamba.

summary.en: This mfyofyo is a shrub of the coffee family with white flowers whose petals are fringed with hairs. It shares its Digo name with Feretia apodanthera and Bourreria nemoralis.
summary.sw: Mfyofyo huu ni kichaka cha familia ya mibuni (kahawa) chenye maua meupe ambayo petali zake zina pindo la manyoya. Unashiriki jina lake la Kidigo na *Feretia apodanthera* na *Bourreria nemoralis*.
summary.dg: *Mfyofyo* uhu ni chitsaka cha jamii ya m'buni chenye maruwa ga nyereru, ambago malage gana nyere kanda-kanda. Unashiriki dzina ra Chidigo na *Feretia apodanthera* na *Bourreria nemoralis*.

about.en: *Heinsia crinita* is a shrub or small tree with leaves in opposite pairs. Its flowers are white and star-shaped, with five spreading lobes, and the upper surface of each lobe is covered with long, soft hairs. *Crinita* means 'long-haired'. The fruits are small, round and yellowish, crowned by the remains of the calyx. Digo people identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Heinsia crinita* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani yanayokaa kwa jozi zinazotazamana. Maua yake ni meupe na yenye umbo la nyota, yenye ndewe tano zilizotandazwa, na upande wa juu wa kila ndewe umefunikwa kwa manyoya marefu laini. *Crinita* maana yake ni 'mwenye nywele ndefu'. Matunda ni madogo, ya mviringo na ya rangi ya manjano-manjano, yakiwa na mabaki ya kikombe cha ua (calyx) juu yake. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Heinsia crinita* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalengana. Maruwage ni ga nyereru na ga umbo ra nyota, genye mala matsano ganayotandazika, na uphande wa dzulu wa chila chala una nyere nyire na laini. *Crinita* manage ni 'wenye nyere nyire'. Matunda ni madide, ga mviringo na ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, na dzulu yakpwe kuna masaza ga *calyx*. Atu a Chidigo nkuumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in forest margins, thicket and bushland, across tropical Africa from West Africa to the East African coast.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani na katika nyika ya vichaka, kote katika Afrika ya tropiki kutoka Afrika Magharibi hadi pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka, vitsakani na weruni, kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho, kula Afrika ya Magharibi hadi pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. In West Africa the fruits are eaten and the young leaves are cooked as a vegetable, which is why it is called 'bush apple' there.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Afrika Magharibi matunda yake huliwa na majani machanga hupikwa kama mboga, ndiyo maana huko huitwa *bush apple*.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga mmea uhu. Afrika ya Magharibi matundage nkuriwa na makodza maphya nkujitwa dza mboga, na ndiyo mana hiko unaihwa 'bush apple'.

names.en: Digo: *mfyofyo*, shared with Duruma according to Pakia, who gives no meaning. The same name covers *Feretia apodanthera* and *Bourreria nemoralis* (*mbunduchi*). No Swahili name is recorded. 'Bush apple' is a West African English name.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mfyofyo*, linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma kwa mujibu wa Pakia, ambaye hatoi maana yake. Jina hilo hilo linajumuisha *Feretia apodanthera* na *Bourreria nemoralis* (*mbunduchi*). Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. *Bush apple* ni jina la Kiingereza la Afrika Magharibi.
names.dg: Chidigo: *mfyofyo*. Pakia anaamba Aduruma nao anahumira dzina hiri, ela kalavya manage. Dzina hiri hiri rinahumirwa kpwa *Feretia apodanthera* na *Bourreria nemoralis* (*mbunduchi*). Dzina ra Chiswahili tariphahikana. 'Bush apple' ni dzina ra Chingereza ra Afrika ya Magharibi.

teaser.en: A climber of the grape family that Digo speakers can name by taste alone: its leaves are sour.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wa familia ya mizabibu ambao wasemaji wa Kidigo wanaweza kuutaja kwa ladha peke yake: majani yake ni machachu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa kufyombera wa jamii ya mzabibu, ambao atu anaogomba Chidigo anaweza kuumanya kpwa ladha tu: makodzage ni ga ngbwadu.

summary.en: Mgongolo mlume, also called mwenjere, is a wild climber of the grape family with sour-tasting leaves. Its first name casts it as the 'male' of another plant, mgongolo.
summary.sw: Mgongolo mlume, unaoitwa pia *mwenjere*, ni mtambaa wa porini wa familia ya mizabibu wenye majani yenye ladha ya uchachu. Jina lake la kwanza linauweka kama 'dume' la mmea mwingine, *mgongolo*.
summary.dg: *Mgongolo mlume*, piya unaihwa *mwenjere*, ni mmea wa weruni wa kufyombera wa jamii ya mzabibu, wenye makodza ga ngbwadu. Dzinare ra kpwandza rinauonyesa dza 'mlume' wa mmea wanjina, *mgongolo*.

about.en:
*Mgongolo mlume* is a climbing or scrambling plant of the grape family. Like its relatives it holds on with coiled tendrils that grow opposite the leaves. The leaves are divided into several leaflets with toothed edges, and the young stems and leaves often carry sticky glandular hairs. Small greenish flowers grow in flat-topped clusters, and they are followed by small, juicy berries that turn red as they ripen.

Pakia notes that Digo speakers identify it by the look of the whole plant and by the taste of its leaves, which are *kakasi*, sour. It is one of the few wild plants that people recognise mainly by taste.
about.sw:
*Mgongolo mlume* ni mmea unaopanda au kutambaa wa familia ya mizabibu. Kama jamaa zake, hujishikilia kwa vikonyo vilivyojikunja vinavyoota upande wa pili wa majani. Majani yamegawanyika kuwa vijani kadhaa vyenye meno pembeni, na mashina machanga na majani mara nyingi huwa na manyoya ya tezi yanayonata. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-kijani huota katika vishada vyenye vilele bapa, na hufuatwa na matunda madogo yenye maji mengi yanayogeuka mekundu yanapoiva.

Pakia anabainisha kwamba wasemaji wa Kidigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima na kwa ladha ya majani yake, ambayo ni *kakasi*, machachu. Ni mojawapo ya mimea michache ya porini ambayo watu huitambua hasa kwa ladha.
about.dg:
*Mgongolo mlume* ni mmea wa kufyombera, au wa kuambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, wa jamii ya mzabibu. Dza nduguze, unagbwirira kpwa nyuzi zinazodzizunguluka, zinazomera zichilengana na makodza. Makodzage ganaganywa kukala makodza madide machache genye meno kanda-kanda, na maphungo maphya na makodza mara nyinji gana nyere zinazolavya ukaka unaogbwira. Maruwa madide ga chijani ngushu-ngushu ganamera kpwa makundi genye dzulu sambamba, na bada yakpwe kunazuka matunda madide genye madzi manji ganayogaluka kukala ga kundu ganaphoivwa.

Pakia anaandika kukala atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuumanya kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi na kpwa ladha ya makodzage, ambago ni *kakasi*, ngbwadu. Ni mwenga wa mimea michache ya weruni ambayo atu nkuimanya zaidi kpwa ladha.

where.en: It grows over bushes and along thicket and forest edges, scrambling up into other vegetation. The species is widespread in tropical Africa and is common in the coastal bush of Kwale.
where.sw: Hukua juu ya vichaka na kando ya vichaka na pembezoni mwa misitu, ukitambaa na kupanda juu ya mimea mingine. Spishi hii imeenea katika Afrika ya tropiki na ni ya kawaida katika vichaka vya pwani vya Kwale.
where.dg: Unamera dzulu ya vitsaka na kanda-kanda ya vitsaka na matsaka, uchifyombera dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Aina hino inaphahikana sana Afrika ya tsi za dzoho, na ni ya kawaida weruni wa pwani wa Kwale.

culture.en: Pakia uses this plant as his example of the sour taste (*kakasi*) in Digo plant identification. Bitter (*utsungu*) and sweet (*mtswano*) are the other two taste words people use.
culture.sw: Pakia anautumia mmea huu kama mfano wake wa ladha ya uchachu (*kakasi*) katika utambuzi wa mimea kwa Kidigo. Uchungu (*utsungu*) na utamu (*mtswano*) ni maneno mengine mawili ya ladha ambayo watu huyatumia.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira mmea uhu dza mfwano wa ladha ya ngbwadu (*kakasi*) kpwenye kumanya mimea kpwa Chidigo. Maneno ganjina mairi ga ladha ambago atu anahumira ni *utsungu* na *mtswano*.

names.en: *Mgongolo mlume* means 'male mgongolo'. Pakia records that people see it as the male form of *mgongolo* (*Hoslundia opposita*), though he adds that neither plant has any clear link with *gongolo*, the millipede. Its other name, *mwenjere*, is shared with Swahili, and the Mgombato dictionary lists *mwenjere* as 'type of plant (Cyphostemma adenocaulis)', with Swahili *mwengele*. No English name is recorded.
names.sw: *Mgongolo mlume* maana yake ni '*mgongolo* dume'. Pakia anarekodi kwamba watu huuona kuwa umbo la kiume la *mgongolo* (*Hoslundia opposita*), ingawa anaongeza kwamba hakuna kati ya mimea hii miwili yenye uhusiano wa wazi na *gongolo*, jongoo. Jina lake jingine, *mwenjere*, linashirikiwa na Kiswahili, na kamusi ya Mgombato inaorodhesha *mwenjere* kama 'aina ya mmea (Cyphostemma adenocaulis)', kwa Kiswahili *mwengele*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: *Mgongolo mlume* manage ni '*mgongolo* mlume'. Pakia anaandika kukala atu nkuuona dza mlume wa *mgongolo* (*Hoslundia opposita*), ela anaenjereza kukala takuna kahi ya mimea hino miiri uriokala na uhusiano wazi na *gongolo* (Chiswahili *jongoo*). Dzinare ranjina, *mwenjere*, rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiswahili, na kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *mwenjere* dza 'aina ya mmea (Cyphostemma adenocaulis)', na Chiswahili *mwengele*. Dzina ra Chingereza tariphahikana.

teaser.en: A thorny acacia whose name is shared by Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili alike.
teaser.sw: Mgunga wenye miiba ambao jina lake linashirikiwa na Kidigo, Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili kwa pamoja.
teaser.dg: *Mgunga* ni *acacia* yenye miya, na dzinare ni sawa kpwa Chidigo, Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili.

summary.en: Mgunga is a small thorny acacia of dry bushland, recognised by Digo speakers from its feathery leaves. Its name is one of the few that Digo shares with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili.
summary.sw: Mgunga ni mgunga mdogo wenye miiba wa nyika kavu ya vichaka, unaotambuliwa na wasemaji wa Kidigo kwa majani yake kama manyoya. Jina lake ni mojawapo ya machache ambayo Kidigo linashiriki na Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili.
summary.dg: *Mgunga* ni *acacia* ndide yenye miya ya weruni kukavu, na atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuimanya kpwa makodzage ganayohalana na manyoya. Dzinare ni mwenga wa madzina machache ambago Chidigo chinahumira sawa na Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili.

about.en:
*Mgunga* is a small acacia, a shrub or low tree with a spreading crown. Its branches carry pairs of straight, sharp spines at the base of the leaves, and the leaves are finely divided into many small leaflets, like feathers. Small round heads of cream or white flowers appear before or with the new leaves, and they ripen into flat pods.

Pakia's informants identified it from the look of its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mgunga* ni mgunga (acacia) mdogo, kichaka au mti mfupi wenye taji lililotandaa. Matawi yake yana jozi za miiba iliyonyooka na mikali kwenye vitako vya majani, na majani yamegawanyika kuwa vijani vingi vidogo, kama manyoya. Vichwa vidogo vya mviringo vya maua ya rangi ya krimu au meupe huchipuka kabla ya majani mapya au pamoja nayo, na hukomaa yakawa maganda bapa.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa sura ya majani yake.
about.dg:
*Mgunga* ni *acacia* ndide, chitsaka au muhi mfupi wenye chitswa chinachotandazika. Pandaze zina miya miiri-miiri iriyogoloka na yenye ntsa, phatu makodza ganapholungana na panda, na makodza ganaganywa sana kukala makodza madide manji, dza manyoya. Vitswa vidide vya mviringo vya maruwa ga rangi ya maziya au ga nyereru vinazuka kabla ya makodza maphya au phamwenga nago, na bada yakpwe kunazuka makakaya sambamba.

Atu ariouzwa ni Pakia akaumanya kpwa umbo ra makodzage.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and wooded grassland. On the south coast it belongs with the other acacias of the drier bush away from the shore and forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika kavu ya vichaka na nyasi zenye miti. Katika pwani ya kusini uko pamoja na migunga mingine ya vichaka vikavu zaidi vilivyo mbali na ufuo na misitu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kukavu na kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi. Kpwa pwani ya kusini unamera phamwenga na *acacia* zanjina za weruni kukavu zaidi, kure na ufuwo na matsaka.

culture.en: Digo speakers treat the acacias as a loose group of related plants, even though there is no single word for them. Pakia calls this a 'covert category'. *Chikwata* is the general name for acacia species.
culture.sw: Wasemaji wa Kidigo huichukulia migunga kuwa kundi lisilo rasmi la mimea inayohusiana, ingawa hakuna neno moja la kuiita. Pakia analiita hili 'kundi lililojificha' (covert category). *Chikwata* ni jina la jumla la spishi za migunga.
culture.dg: Atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuona *acacia* dza kundi ra mimea ya kuhalana, hata kukala takuna neno mwenga ra kuziiha zosi. Pakia anaiha kundi hiri 'covert category', maana kundi risiro na dzina. *Chikwata* ni dzina ra kawaida ra aina za *acacia*.

names.en: Pakia gives *mgunga* as the Digo name and notes that Duruma, Giriama and Swahili use the same word. In Swahili, *mgunga* is also a general word for acacias. Pakia gives the English name as 'fever tree', but that name usually belongs to a different species, *Acacia xanthophloea*. Botanists now often place this species in the genus *Vachellia*.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa *mgunga* kama jina la Kidigo na anabainisha kwamba Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili hutumia neno hilo hilo. Kwa Kiswahili, *mgunga* pia ni neno la jumla la migunga yote. Pakia anatoa jina la Kiingereza kuwa *fever tree*, lakini jina hilo kwa kawaida ni la spishi nyingine, *Acacia xanthophloea*. Siku hizi wataalamu wa mimea mara nyingi huiweka spishi hii katika jenasi *Vachellia*.
names.dg: Pakia analavya *mgunga* dza dzina ra Chidigo na anaandika kukala Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili vinahumira neno hiri hiri. Kpwa Chiswahili, *mgunga* piya ni neno ra kuiha *acacia* zosi. Pakia anapha dzina ra Chingereza dza 'fever tree', ela dzina hiro mara nyinji ni ra aina yanjina, *Acacia xanthophloea*. Asayansi a mimea sambi mara nyinji anaika aina hino kpwenye jenasi ya *Vachellia*.

teaser.en: Every leaf joint carries two thorns, one straight and one hooked: easy to catch on, hard to get free from.
teaser.sw: Kila kiungo cha jani kina miiba miwili, mmoja ulionyooka na mwingine wenye ndoano: ni rahisi kunaswa, ni vigumu kujinasua.
teaser.dg: Chila phatu kodza rinaphogbwirana na panda phana miya miiri, mmwenga uriogoloka na wanjina uriopindika dza chiloo: ni rahisi kugbwirwa nayo, ni vigumu kudziusa.

summary.en: Mgungune, the buffalo thorn, is a thorny bush tree related to the jujube, with zigzag twigs, glossy leaves and small red-brown fruits. It is widespread across Africa.
summary.sw: Mgungune, *buffalo thorn*, ni mti wa porini wenye miiba, jamaa wa mkunazi, wenye vijiti vinavyopinda kwa zigzag, majani yanayong'aa na matunda madogo ya rangi ya hudhurungi-nyekundu. Umeenea kote barani Afrika.
summary.dg: *Mgungune*, kpwa Chingereza *buffalo thorn*, ni muhi wa weruni wenye miya, nduguye *mkunazi*, wenye maphungo ganayosongoloka, makodza ganayong'ala na matunda madide ga rangi ya dongo iriyo na kundu. Unaphahikana kosi Afrika.

about.en:
*Mgungune* is a small to medium tree, often with a rounded crown and drooping branches. The twigs grow in a zigzag, and at each bend there are two thorns, one straight and pointing forward, the other short and hooked back. Once caught on them, it is hard to pull free.

The leaves are shiny, oval and slightly toothed, with three veins running from the base. Small yellow-green flowers cluster at the leaf bases, and the round fruits ripen from green to a reddish brown. The fruit has thin, mealy flesh around a hard stone.
about.sw:
*Mgungune* ni mti mdogo hadi wa wastani, mara nyingi wenye taji la mviringo na matawi yanayoning'inia. Vijiti vyake hukua kwa mtindo wa zigzag, na kwenye kila kona kuna miiba miwili, mmoja ulionyooka na unaoelekea mbele, na mwingine mfupi wenye ndoano unaoelekea nyuma. Ukishanaswa nayo, ni vigumu kujinasua.

Majani yanang'aa, yana umbo la yai na meno madogo pembeni, na mishipa mitatu inayotoka kwenye kitako. Maua madogo ya rangi ya manjano-kijani hujikusanya kwenye vitako vya majani, na matunda ya mviringo huiva kutoka kijani hadi hudhurungi-nyekundu. Tunda lina nyama nyembamba kama unga inayozunguka kokwa ngumu.
about.dg:
*Mgungune* ni muhi mdide hadi wa chiasi, mara nyinji wenye chitswa cha mviringo na pandaze zinazogbwadzika photsi. Maphungoge ganamera kpwa kusongoloka, na chila phatu ganaphopinda kuna miya miiri: mmwenga uriogoloka na unalola mbere, na wanjina ni mfupi na uriopindika nyuma dza chiloo. Mutu achigbwirwa ni miya hino, ni vigumu kudziusa.

Makodza ganang'ala, ga mviringo mrefu, genye meno madide kanda-kanda, na mishipa mitahu ya kodza inayoandza photsi ya kodza. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano na chijani ganakusanyika phatu makodza ganapholungana na panda, na matunda ga mviringo ganaivwa kula chijani hadi rangi ya dongo iriyo na kundu. Tunda rina nyama nyembamba ya unga-unga kuzunguluka tembe ngumu.

where.en: It grows in bushland, wooded grassland and along rivers and gullies, and it does well on dry and poor soils. It is found right across eastern and southern Africa, including the bush of the Kenya coast.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka, nyasi zenye miti na kando ya mito na makorongo, na hustawi vizuri kwenye udongo mkavu na usio na rutuba. Hupatikana kote mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika, ikiwemo misitu ya vichaka ya pwani ya Kenya.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi na kanda-kanda ya miho na makorongo, na unamera vinono hata kpwenye tsi kavu na tsi chitsapi. Unaphahikana kosi Afrika ya Mashariki na ya Kusini, phamwenga na weruni wa pwani ya Kenya.

uses.en: In many parts of Africa the fruit is eaten fresh or dried and ground into meal, and the leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine. Pakia records no specific Digo use.
uses.sw: Katika sehemu nyingi za Afrika tunda lake huliwa likiwa bichi au hukaushwa na kusagwa kuwa unga, na majani na mizizi hutumika katika tiba za jadi. Pakia harekodi matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo.
uses.dg: Kpwenye seemu nyinji za Afrika matunda nkuriwa dza garivyo, au nkuumiswa na kusagbwa kukala unga, na makodza na miziye nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji. Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga Chidigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mgungune* as the Digo name, with the English name 'buffalo thorn'. It belongs to the same genus as *mkunazi*, the Indian jujube, and as *Ziziphus robertsoniana*, which Pakia lists under the name *mng'ambo*. No Swahili name is given in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *mgungune* kama jina la Kidigo, pamoja na jina la Kiingereza *buffalo thorn*. Uko katika jenasi moja na *mkunazi*, mkunazi wa Kihindi, na *Ziziphus robertsoniana*, ambao Pakia anauorodhesha kwa jina *mng'ambo*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili linalotolewa katika vyanzo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mgungune* dza dzina ra Chidigo, na dzina ra Chingereza 'buffalo thorn'. Ni wa jenasi mwenga na *mkunazi*, *Indian jujube*, na *Ziziphus robertsoniana*, ambao Pakia anauandika kpwa dzina *mng'ambo*. Dzina ra Chiswahili tariphahikana kpwenye vitabu.

teaser.en: Fresh twigs travel by lorry from the highlands to coast towns every day, to be chewed as a stimulant.
teaser.sw: Vijiti vibichi husafirishwa kwa malori kila siku kutoka nyanda za juu hadi miji ya pwani, ili kutafunwa kama kichangamshi.
teaser.dg: Chila siku maphungo dza garivyo nkutsukulwa kpwa malori kula tsi za dzulu za bara hadi midzi ya pwani, ili gaafunwe dza chitu cha kumpha mutu nguvu.

summary.en: Miraa, khat, is a shrub whose fresh leaves and shoots are chewed as a stimulant. It is grown inland and brought to the coast as a trade crop.
summary.sw: Miraa ni kichaka ambacho majani na machipukizi yake mabichi hutafunwa kama kichangamshi. Hulimwa bara na kuletwa pwani kama zao la biashara.
summary.dg: *Miraa*, *khat*, ni chitsaka ambacho makodzage na maphungoge dza garivyo nkuafunwa dza chitu cha kumpha mutu nguvu. Nkuphandwa bara na kurehwa pwani dza mmea wa biashara.

about.en: *Miraa* is an evergreen shrub or small tree with glossy, toothed leaves, often tinged red, on reddish young stems. The flowers are tiny and whitish. What matters to people is the tender young shoots and leaves, which are cut and sold in bundles while still fresh.
about.sw: *Miraa* ni kichaka au mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani, wenye majani yanayong'aa yenye meno pembeni, mara nyingi yenye rangi ya wekundu, juu ya mashina machanga mekundu-mekundu. Maua ni madogo sana na meupe-meupe. Kinachowajali watu ni machipukizi machanga laini na majani, ambayo hukatwa na kuuzwa kwa mafungu yangali mabichi.
about.dg: *Miraa* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganang'ala, gana meno kanda-kanda, na mara nyinji gana kundu chidide, dzulu ya milita miphya ya kundu chidide. Maruwa ni madide sana na mereru chidide. Chitu chenye samani kpwa atu ni maphungo maphya laini na makodza, ambago nkukatwa na kuguzwa kpwa mabunda wakati bado ni dza garivyo.

where.en: Khat is not a plant of the coastal bush. In Kenya it is grown mainly in the highlands east of Mount Kenya, especially around Meru, and it is carried to markets across the country, including the towns of the south coast.
where.sw: Miraa si mmea wa vichaka vya pwani. Nchini Kenya hulimwa hasa katika nyanda za juu mashariki mwa Mlima Kenya, hasa karibu na Meru, na husafirishwa hadi masoko kote nchini, ikiwemo miji ya pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: *Miraa* si mmea wa weruni wa pwani. Kenya nkuphandwa sana tsi za dzulu za mashariki ya Mount Kenya, hasa phephi na Meru, na nkutsukulwa hadi masoko ga kosi tsi, phamwenga na midzi ya pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The fresh leaves and shoots are chewed for their stimulant effect, often in long social sessions. The active substances fade within a day or two of cutting, so the trade depends on fast transport. Heavy use is linked to health and social problems, and khat is banned in a number of countries.
uses.sw: Majani na machipukizi mabichi hutafunwa kwa sababu ya athari yake ya kuchangamsha, mara nyingi katika vikao virefu vya kijamii. Viambato vyake hai hupotea ndani ya siku moja au mbili baada ya kukatwa, kwa hiyo biashara yake hutegemea usafiri wa haraka. Matumizi ya kupita kiasi yanahusishwa na matatizo ya kiafya na kijamii, na miraa imepigwa marufuku katika nchi kadhaa.
uses.dg: Makodza na maphungo dza garivyo nkuafunwa kpwa sababu ganampha mutu nguvu, mara nyinji kpwa saa nyinji atu achisagala phamwenga. Kemikali zinazohenda kazi ndani ya makodza nkumala nguvu kahi ya siku mwenga au mbiri bada ya kukatwa, kpwa hivyo biashara ya *miraa* inakuluphira kuhalwa haraka. Kuhumira sana nkulungana na shida za uzima na shida za atu phamwenga, na *miraa* ikazuwiywa kpwa shariya kpwenye tsi nyinji.

names.en: Pakia lists *miraa*, the same word as in Swahili, with the English names khat and Abyssinian tea. The Mgombato dictionary has a separate entry, *mvumo*, for khat, with the Swahili glosses *miraa* and *mwandama*. In Pakia's list, *mvumo* is the name of the borassus palm.
names.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *miraa*, neno lile lile kama la Kiswahili, pamoja na majina ya Kiingereza *khat* na *Abyssinian tea*. Kamusi ya Mgombato ina kidahizo tofauti, *mvumo*, kwa miraa, ikitoa maelezo ya Kiswahili *miraa* na *mwandama*. Katika orodha ya Pakia, *mvumo* ni jina la mvumo (borassus palm).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *miraa*, neno hiro hiro dza ra Chiswahili, phamwenga na madzina ga Chingereza *khat* na *Abyssinian tea*. Kamusi ya Mgombato ina neno ranjina, *mvumo*, ra *khat*, renye madzina ga Chiswahili *miraa* na *mwandama*. Kpwenye orodha ya Pakia, *mvumo* ni dzina ra muhi wa jamii ya mnazi unaoihwa *borassus palm*.

teaser.en: A garden flower from the Americas that escaped and now covers the coast; northern and southern Digo even call it different names.
teaser.sw: Ua la bustanini kutoka Amerika lililotoroka na sasa limeenea pwani nzima; Wadigo wa kaskazini na wa kusini hata huliita kwa majina tofauti.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa maruwa wa mindani uriorehwa kula Amerika, urioenea kondze ya mindani na sambi unafwinika pwani; Adigo a kazikazini na a kusini hata anauiha kpwa madzina tafwauti.

summary.en: Mjasasa is lantana, a scrambling shrub from tropical America with bright, multicoloured flower heads that has become one of East Africa's worst weeds. Digo has three names for it, which vary between north and south.
summary.sw: Mjasasa ni *lantana*, kichaka kinachotambaa kutoka Amerika ya tropiki chenye vichwa vya maua angavu vya rangi nyingi, ambacho kimekuwa mojawapo ya magugu mabaya zaidi Afrika Mashariki. Kidigo kina majina matatu ya mmea huu, yanayotofautiana kati ya kaskazini na kusini.
summary.dg: *Mjasasa* ni *lantana*, chitsaka chinachoambala chirichorehwa kula Amerika ya tsi za dzoho, chenye mabunda ga maruwa ganayong'ala ga rangi nyinji, ambacho chikakala kahi ya mbondo mbii kabisa za Afrika ya Mashariki. Chidigo china madzina mahahu ga mmea hinyu, ganayokala tafwauti kazikazini na kusini.

about.en:
*Mjasasa* is a dense, scrambling shrub with square, rough stems that often carry small hooked prickles. The leaves are rough to the touch, toothed, and smell strongly when crushed. The flowers grow in small flat heads, and each head changes colour as it ages, from yellow to orange, pink or red, so one bush shows several colours at once. The small berries are green at first and turn shiny black.

Pakia's informants identified it by its leaves, flowers and fruits. It is one of the few wild plants that Digo speakers recognise from its flowers, because the flowers are valued for decoration.
about.sw:
*Mjasasa* ni kichaka kinachotambaa na kusongamana, chenye mashina ya pembe nne yanayokwaruza, mara nyingi yenye miiba midogo yenye ndoano. Majani yanakwaruza ukiyagusa, yana meno pembeni, na hutoa harufu kali yakifinywa. Maua huota katika vichwa vidogo bapa, na kila kichwa hubadilika rangi kadiri kinavyozeeka, kutoka manjano hadi machungwa, waridi au nyekundu, kwa hiyo kichaka kimoja huonyesha rangi kadhaa kwa wakati mmoja. Matunda madogo huwa ya kijani mwanzoni na hugeuka meusi yanayong'aa.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia walikitambua kwa majani, maua na matunda yake. Ni mojawapo ya mimea michache ya porini ambayo wasemaji wa Kidigo huitambua kwa maua yake, kwa sababu maua hayo huthaminiwa kwa mapambo.
about.dg:
*Mjasasa* ni chitsaka chinachoambala, chenye panda nyinji sana, na milita ya pembe nne inayokaraza, ambayo mara nyinji ina miya midide dza viloo. Makodza ganakaraza uchigaguta, gana meno kanda-kanda, na uchigasira ganalavya arufu kali. Maruwa ganamera kpwa mabunda madide sambamba, na chila bunda rinagaluza rangi rinavyokula, kula rangi ya mandano hadi rangi ya chungbwa, pinki au ya kundu, kpwa hivyo chitsaka chimwenga chinaonyesa rangi nyinji phamwenga. Matunda madide ni ga chijani kpwandza, chisha ganagaluka maru na ganang'ala.

Atu ariouzwa ni Pakia aumanya kpwa makodzage, maruwage na matundage. Ni mwenga wa mimea michache ya weruni ambayo Adigo anaimanya kpwa maruwa, kpwa sababu maruwage ganaonwa kukala na samani ya kupambira.

where.en: It grows along roadsides, field edges, fallow land and forest margins, and forms thickets that crowd out other plants. Originally from tropical America, it is now found throughout the Kenya coast.
where.sw: Hukua kando ya barabara, pembezoni mwa mashamba, kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa na pembezoni mwa misitu, na hutengeneza vichaka vinavyosonga na kuisukuma nje mimea mingine. Asili yake ni Amerika ya tropiki, na sasa hupatikana kote katika pwani ya Kenya.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya njira, kanda za minda, minda iriyorichwa na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, na unahenda vitsaka vinavyozuwiya mimea yanjina kumera. Asiliye ni Amerika ya tsi za dzoho, ela sambi unaphahikana kosi pwani ya Kenya.

uses.en: The Mgombato dictionary describes it as a plant with medicinal leaves. Pakia counts it among the ornamental plants valued for their flowers. The leaves and unripe berries are poisonous to livestock, and the plant is widely treated as an invasive weed.
uses.sw: Kamusi ya Mgombato inaueleza kuwa mmea wenye majani ya dawa. Pakia anauhesabu miongoni mwa mimea ya mapambo inayothaminiwa kwa maua yake. Majani na matunda mabichi yana sumu kwa mifugo, na kwa kiasi kikubwa mmea huu huchukuliwa kuwa gugu vamizi.
uses.dg: Kamusi ya Mgombato inaueleza dza mmea wenye makodza ga dawa. Pakia anautala kahi ya mimea ya kupambira yenye samani kpwa sababu ya maruwa. Makodza na matunda madide maitsi gana sumu kpwa mifugo, na mmea hinyu phatu phanji nkuonwa dza mbondo inayoenea na kubananga mimea yanjina.

names.en: Lantana shows how Digo names vary within Digo country. Pakia records *mjasasa* in the north and *mtsambala* in the south, while *mshomoro* is known to all Digo speakers. *Mjasasa* is shared with Swahili, and *mshomoro* with Duruma and Giriama. Mgombato spells it *njasasa*. The English names are lantana, devil's weed and tick berry.
names.sw: Mjasasa unaonyesha jinsi majina ya Kidigo yanavyotofautiana ndani ya nchi ya Wadigo. Pakia anarekodi *mjasasa* kaskazini na *mtsambala* kusini, wakati *mshomoro* linajulikana na wasemaji wote wa Kidigo. *Mjasasa* linashirikiwa na Kiswahili, na *mshomoro* na Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Mgombato analiandika *njasasa*. Majina ya Kiingereza ni *lantana*, *devil's weed* na *tick berry*.
names.dg: *Mjasasa* unaonyesa vira madzina ga Chidigo ganavyokala tafwauti kahi ya tsi ya Adigo. Pakia anaandika *mjasasa* kazikazini na *mtsambala* kusini, ela *mshomoro* nkumanyikana ni Adigo osi. *Mjasasa* ni dzina ra Chiswahili piya, na *mshomoro* ni ra Chiduruma na Chigiriama piya. Mgombato unariandika *njasasa*. Madzina ga Chingereza ni *lantana*, *devil's weed* na *tick berry*.

conservation.en: Lantana is a declared invasive species in Kenya and much of the tropics. It spreads quickly because birds eat the berries and drop the seeds.
conservation.sw: Mjasasa umetangazwa rasmi kuwa spishi vamizi nchini Kenya na katika sehemu kubwa ya nchi za tropiki. Huenea haraka kwa sababu ndege hula matunda yake na kudondosha mbegu.
conservation.dg: Kenya na kosi tsi nyinji za dzoho, *mjasasa* ukatangazwa rasmi kukala ni aina ya mmea unaoenea na kubananga. Unaenea haraka kpwa sababu nyama a mapha nkurya matunda madide na kugbwaga tembe.

teaser.en: A small rattlepod of the pea family: shake a dry pod and the seeds rattle inside.
teaser.sw: Mmea mdogo wa njuga (rattlepod) wa jamii ya kunde: tikisa ganda lililokauka na mbegu hulia ndani yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde wenye makakaya ganayopiga kululu: uchidindirisa kakaya kavu, tembe zinapiga kululu ndani.

summary.en: Mkelekele is a small herb of the pea family, a rattlepod with yellow flowers. Pakia's informants recognised it by its leaves.
summary.sw: Mkelekele ni mmea-shina laini mdogo wa jamii ya kunde, wa aina ya njuga (rattlepod), wenye maua ya manjano. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake.
summary.dg: *Mkelekele* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde, mmea wa makakaya ganayopiga kululu (*rattlepod*), wenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano. Atu ariouzwa ni Pakia aumanya kpwa makodzage.

about.en: *Mkelekele* is a low herb of the pea family. Its leaves are small, and the yellow pea-shaped flowers grow on short stalks. Like other rattlepods, its pods are inflated, and when they dry the loose seeds rattle inside. Pakia's informants identified it from the look of its leaves.
about.sw: *Mkelekele* ni mmea-shina laini mfupi wa jamii ya kunde. Majani yake ni madogo, na maua ya manjano yenye umbo la ua la kunde huota juu ya vikonyo vifupi. Kama mimea mingine ya njuga, maganda yake yamevimba, na yanapokauka mbegu zilizolegea hulia ndani yake. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa sura ya majani yake.
about.dg: *Mkelekele* ni mmea mdide mfupi wa jamii ya kunde. Makodzage ni madide, na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano, ga umbo dza ga maruwa ga kunde, ganamera dzulu ya milita mifupi. Dza mimea yanjina ya *rattlepod*, makakayage ganafutuka, na ganavyouma, tembe zirizo ndani, ambazo tazigbwirirwa ni chitu, zinapiga kululu.

where.en: Rattlepods grow in grassland, fallow fields and open sandy places. This species is known from the coasts of East Africa and Madagascar.
where.sw: Mimea ya njuga hukua katika nyasi, mashamba yaliyoachwa na maeneo ya wazi yenye mchanga. Spishi hii inajulikana katika pwani za Afrika Mashariki na Madagaska.
where.dg: Mimea ya *rattlepod* inamera mavuweni, minda iriyorichwa na phatu pha wazi phenye mtsanga. Aina hino inamanyikana kula pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki na Madagascar.

names.en: Pakia records *mkelekele* with no English name and no meaning for the name. The Mgombato dictionary has a related entry, *mkelekele wa nyika*, for 'type of plant (Crotalaria sp.)', which suggests that *mkelekele* is a name for rattlepods more generally.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *mkelekele* bila jina la Kiingereza na bila maana ya jina. Kamusi ya Mgombato ina kidahizo kinachohusiana, *mkelekele wa nyika*, kwa maana ya 'aina ya mmea (Crotalaria sp.)', jambo linaloashiria kwamba *mkelekele* ni jina la mimea ya njuga kwa ujumla zaidi.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkelekele* bila dzina ra Chingereza na bila mana ya dzina. Kamusi ya Mgombato ina neno rinarohusiana nare, *mkelekele wa nyika*, ra 'aina ya mmea (*Crotalaria sp.*)', na hino inaonyesa kukala *mkelekele* rinaweza kukala ni dzina ra mimea yosi ya *rattlepod*.

reason.dg: *Tephrosia*, mmea wanjina mdide wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde

teaser.en: A milky-sapped relative of the shea tree, hidden in the coastal thickets of Kenya and Tanzania.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa mti wa shea mwenye utomvu kama maziwa, aliyejificha katika vichaka vya pwani vya Kenya na Tanzania.
teaser.dg: Muhi wenye maziya wa jamii mwenga na *shea tree*, uriofwitsika vitsakani vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

summary.en: Mkilishangwe is a shrub or small tree of the milkwood family, found in coastal thicket and forest. Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves and stem.
summary.sw: Mkilishangwe ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya Sapotaceae (milkwood), unaopatikana katika vichaka na misitu ya pwani. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani na shina lake.
summary.dg: *Mkilishangwe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya *milkwood*, unaophahikana vitsakani na matsakani ga pwani. Atu ariouzwa ni Pakia aumanya kpwa makodzage na kolore.

about.en:
*Mkilishangwe* is a shrub or small tree of the Sapotaceae, the family of the shea tree and the milkwoods. Like its relatives it has white, milky latex in its bark and leaves. The leaves are simple, leathery and clustered towards the ends of the twigs.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves and stem.
about.sw:
*Mkilishangwe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya Sapotaceae, familia ya mti wa shea na ya *milkwoods*. Kama jamaa zake, una utomvu mweupe kama maziwa katika gome na majani yake. Majani ni sahili, magumu kama ngozi na yamejikusanya kuelekea ncha za vijiti.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani na shina lake.
about.dg:
*Mkilishangwe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa *Sapotaceae*, jamii ya *shea tree* na ya mihi ya *milkwood*. Dza nduguze, una maziya mereru kpwenye gophare na makodzage. Makodza ni ga kawaida, magumu dza chingo, na ganakala manji phamwenga kanda za ntsa za maphungo.

Atu ariouzwa ni Pakia aumanya kpwa makodzage na kolore.

where.en: It is a plant of the coastal forests and thickets of Kenya and Tanzania, part of the band of dry coastal forest that includes the kaya forests of Kwale.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa misitu na vichaka vya pwani vya Kenya na Tanzania, sehemu ya ukanda wa misitu mikavu ya pwani unaojumuisha misitu ya kaya ya Kwale.
where.dg: Ni mmea wa matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, seemu ya mstari wa matsaka makavu ga pwani ambao una matsaka ga kaya ga Kwale.

names.en: Pakia's word list gives *mkilishangwe*, while his notes on name meanings give *chilishangwe*, and say that Duruma and Swahili share the name. No meaning is given, and there is no English name.
names.sw: Orodha ya maneno ya Pakia inatoa *mkilishangwe*, wakati maelezo yake kuhusu maana za majina yanatoa *chilishangwe*, na kusema kwamba Kiduruma na Kiswahili hushiriki jina hilo. Hakuna maana inayotolewa, na hakuna jina la Kiingereza.
names.dg: Kpwenye orodha ya maneno ya Pakia kuna *mkilishangwe*, ela kpwenye maelezoge ga mana za madzina kuna *chilishangwe*, na maelezo higo ganagomba kukala Aduruma na Aswahili anahumira dzina hiro piya. Takuna mana ya dzina iriyoandikpwa, na takuna dzina ra Chingereza.

conservation.en: It grows only in the East African coastal forests, which are shrinking as land is cleared.
conservation.sw: Hukua tu katika misitu ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, ambayo inapungua kadiri ardhi inavyosafishwa.
conservation.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki tu, na matsaka higo ganapunguka kpwa sababu atu anatema mihi na kusafisha tsi.

reason.sw: Inhambanella, Sapotaceae ya misitu ya pwani
reason.dg: *Inhambanella*, muhi wa *Sapotaceae* wa matsaka ga pwani

reason.sw: Manilkara (mnago), mti wa familia ya Sapotaceae
reason.dg: *Manilkara*, muhi wa jamii ya *milkwood*

teaser.en: A bright hedge flower that even goats won't touch: every part of the plant is poisonous.
teaser.sw: Ua angavu la ua wa nyumba ambalo hata mbuzi hawaligusi: kila sehemu ya mmea huu ina sumu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa lichigo wenye maruwa ganayoala, ambao hata mbuzi taauguta: chila seemu ya mmea hinyu ina sumu.

summary.en: Mkode is yellow oleander, an ornamental shrub from tropical America grown as a hedge for its trumpet-shaped yellow flowers. Every part of the plant is highly poisonous.
summary.sw: Mkode ni oleanda ya manjano (yellow oleander), kichaka cha mapambo kutoka Amerika ya tropiki kinachopandwa kama ua wa nyumba kwa ajili ya maua yake ya manjano yenye umbo la tarumbeta. Kila sehemu ya mmea ina sumu kali.
summary.dg: *Mkode* ni *yellow oleander*, chitsaka cha kupambira chirichorehwa kula Amerika ya tsi za dzoho, chinachophandwa dza lichigo kpwa sababu ya maruwage ga rangi ya mandano ga umbo ra ndzumari. Chila seemu ya mmea hinyu ina sumu kali sana.

about.en:
*Mkode* is a shrub or small tree, up to about 4 metres, with many stems. Its shiny, narrow leaves are about 10 cm long and grow in spirals around the stem. The flowers are narrow trumpets, usually yellow but sometimes white or salmon, with petals that are twisted in the bud. The fruit is fleshy and four-angled, about 3 cm across, with a flat triangular nut inside.

Pakia counts it among the few plants that Digo speakers identify by their flowers, because they are valued as ornamentals.
about.sw:
*Mkode* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, wenye urefu wa hadi mita 4 hivi, wenye mashina mengi. Majani yake membamba yanayong'aa yana urefu wa karibu sm 10 na huota kwa mzunguko kuzunguka shina. Maua ni tarumbeta nyembamba, kwa kawaida ya manjano lakini wakati mwingine meupe au ya rangi ya samoni, yenye petali zilizosokotwa yakiwa bado matumba. Tunda lina nyama na pembe nne, upana wa karibu sm 3, na ndani yake kuna kokwa bapa yenye pembe tatu.

Pakia anauhesabu miongoni mwa mimea michache ambayo wasemaji wa Kidigo huitambua kwa maua yake, kwa sababu huthaminiwa kama mimea ya mapambo.
about.dg:
*Mkode* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa ure wa hadi mita 4 hivi, wenye milita minji. Makodzage ganang'ala, ni membamba, na ure wa sentimita 10 hivi, na ganamera kpwa kuzunguluka kolo. Maruwa ni ndzumari nyembamba, mara nyinji ga rangi ya mandano ela wakati wanjina mereru au ga pinki ya rangi ya chungbwa, na vipande vya maruwa vinabeta ndani ya chimea. Tunda ni ra nyama, ra pembe nne, ra upana wa sentimita 3 hivi, na ndani rina tembe ngumu sambamba ya pembe tahu.

Pakia anautala kahi ya mimea michache ambayo Adigo anaimanya kpwa maruwa, kpwa sababu maruwage ganaonwa kukala na samani ya kupambira.

where.en: It came from Central and South America and is planted across the tropics as a hedge and ornamental bush. It does best on sandy soils, which suits it to the coastal lowlands, where it is a common hedge plant.
where.sw: Ulitoka Amerika ya Kati na Kusini na hupandwa kote katika nchi za tropiki kama ua wa nyumba na kichaka cha mapambo. Hustawi zaidi kwenye udongo wa mchanga, jambo linaloufanya ufae nyanda za chini za pwani, ambako ni mmea wa kawaida wa ua wa nyumba.
where.dg: Asiliye ni Amerika ya Kahi na Amerika ya Kusini, na unaphandwa kosi tsi za dzoho dza lichigo na chitsaka cha kupambira. Unamera chinono sana kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga, kpwa hivyo unafwaha tsi za photsi za pwani, ambapho ni mmea wa lichigo unaophahikana sana.

uses.en: It is grown for its flowers, for shade and as a live fence. ICRAF records medicinal use of the seed, and a heart drug has been extracted from its nuts commercially. But all parts of the plant are poisonous, livestock will not eat it, and ICRAF warns people to take care with children around it.
uses.sw: Hupandwa kwa ajili ya maua yake, kivuli na kama uzio hai. ICRAF inarekodi matumizi ya kitiba ya mbegu, na dawa ya moyo imewahi kutolewa kibiashara kutoka kwenye kokwa zake. Lakini sehemu zote za mmea zina sumu, mifugo haiuli, na ICRAF inaonya watu wawe waangalifu na watoto karibu nao.
uses.dg: Unaphandwa kpwa sababu ya maruwage, kpwa pepho, na dza lichigo ra mihi mizima. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika kukala tembeze nkuhumirwa dza dawa, na dawa ya moyo ikatuluzwa kula kpwa tembeze ngumu kpwa biashara. Ela seemu zosi za mmea zina sumu, mifugo taiurya, na ICRAF chinaonya atu arinde ana phephi na mmea hinyu.

names.en: Pakia records *mkode*, with the English names yellow oleander and lucky nut. No Swahili name is given in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *mkode*, pamoja na majina ya Kiingereza *yellow oleander* na *lucky nut*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili linalotolewa katika vyanzo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkode*, phamwenga na madzina ga Chingereza *yellow oleander* na *lucky nut*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa vitabuni.

reason.dg: *Mjasasa*, ambao piya maruwage ganaonwa kukala na samani
