teaser.en: The climbing cousin of mkone: same kind of leaves, but it reaches up into the bush instead of standing on its own.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa mkone anayetambaa: majani ya aina moja, lakini hupanda juu ya vichaka badala ya kusimama peke yake.
teaser.dg: *Mkone* unaofyombera: makodzage ni ga aina mwenga na ga *mkone*, ela unafyombera dzulu vitsakani badala ya kuima macheye.

summary.en: Mkone chibugu is a scrambling Grewia that Digo speakers see as the climbing form of mkone. Pakia's informants told the two apart by their leaves and habit.
summary.sw: Mkone chibugu ni *Grewia* anayetambaa ambaye wasemaji wa Kidigo humwona kuwa umbo la kutambaa la *mkone*. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliwatofautisha wawili hao kwa majani na mtindo wa ukuaji wao.
summary.dg: *Mkone chibugu* ni *Grewia* unaoambala, ambao Adigo anauona dza aina ya *mkone* inayofyombera. Atu ariouzwa ni Pakia aitafwautisha mimea hino miiri kpwa makodza na vira inavyomera.

about.en:
*Mkone chibugu* is a scrambling or climbing shrub of the genus *Grewia*. Its leaves look like those of *mkone* (*Grewia plagiophylla*), but instead of standing up as a shrub or small tree it leans and climbs through other vegetation. Like other grewias, it has simple, toothed leaves with three main veins from the base, small star-shaped flowers, and small round fruits that split into lobes.

Pakia's informants identified it by its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mkone chibugu* ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda wa jenasi *Grewia*. Majani yake yanafanana na ya *mkone* (*Grewia plagiophylla*), lakini badala ya kusimama wima kama kichaka au mti mdogo, huegemea na kupanda katikati ya mimea mingine. Kama *Grewia* wengine, una majani sahili yenye meno pembeni na mishipa mikuu mitatu kutoka kwenye kitako, maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota, na matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayogawanyika kuwa sehemu kadhaa.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Mkone chibugu* ni chitsaka chinachoambala au chinachofyombera cha jenasi ya *Grewia*. Makodzage ganahalana na ga *mkone* (*Grewia plagiophylla*), ela badala ya kuima chocho dza chitsaka au muhi mdide, unajejemera na kufyombera kahi ya mimea yanjina. Dza *Grewia* zanjina, una makodza ga kawaida genye meno kanda-kanda na mishipa mikulu mihahu inayoandzira photsi ya kodza, maruwa madide ga umbo ra nyota, na matunda madide ga duara ganayoganyika kpwa seemu.

Atu ariouzwa ni Pakia aumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and thicket, where grewias are among the commonest shrubs.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani na vichaka, ambako *Grewia* ni miongoni mwa vichaka vinavyopatikana kwa wingi zaidi.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na vitsakani vya pwani, ambapho *Grewia* ni kahi ya vitsaka vinavyophahikana sana kuriko vyosi.

names.en: The name means 'climbing *mkone*': Pakia explains that the species has a climbing form (*-bugu*, as in *chibugu*, a climber) but resembles *mkone*. Duruma shares the name. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Jina hili maana yake ni '*mkone* anayetambaa': Pakia anaeleza kwamba spishi hii ina umbo la kutambaa (*-bugu*, kama katika *chibugu*, mtambaa) lakini inafanana na *mkone*. Kiduruma kinashiriki jina hili. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili katika vyanzo.
names.dg: Dzina rina mana ya '*mkone* unaofyombera': Pakia anaeleza kukala aina hino ina umbo ra kufyombera (*-bugu*, dza vira kpwa *chibugu*, mmea unaofyombera) ela inahalana na *mkone*. Dzina hiri ni ra Chiduruma piya. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza vitabuni.

teaser.en: The 'black mkongolo': named not for any relationship, but because its dark bark matches the inner bark of another tree.
teaser.sw: 'Mkongolo mweusi': umepewa jina hili si kwa sababu ya uhusiano wowote, bali kwa sababu gome lake jeusi linalingana na gome la ndani la mti mwingine.
teaser.dg: *Mkongolo* 'mwiru': tauihwa hivyo kpwa sababu ni ndugu na muhi wanjina, ela kpwa sababu gophare riru rinahalana na gopha ra ndani ra muhi wanjina.

summary.en: Mkongolo mwiru is a forest tree of the Connaraceae that Digo speakers name after the colour of its bark. Its name pairs it with mkongolo (Combretum schumannii).
summary.sw: Mkongolo mwiru ni mti wa msituni wa familia ya Connaraceae ambao wasemaji wa Kidigo huupa jina kutokana na rangi ya gome lake. Jina lake linauoanisha na *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*).
summary.dg: *Mkongolo mwiru* ni muhi wa tsakani wa jamii ya Connaraceae, ambao atu anaogomba Chidigo anauiha kpwa rangi ya gophare. Dzinare rinauika phamwenga na *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*).

about.en:
*Mkongolo mwiru* is a tree of the coastal forest, in the small family Connaraceae. Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves, but its name comes from its dark bark.

The genus *Ellipanthus* has simple, alternate, leathery leaves and small flowers, and its fruits are small capsules that split to show a seed.
about.sw:
*Mkongolo mwiru* ni mti wa misitu ya pwani, katika familia ndogo ya Connaraceae. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake, lakini jina lake linatokana na gome lake jeusi.

Jenasi *Ellipanthus* ina majani sahili yanayopishana na magumu kama ngozi, maua madogo, na matunda yake ni vibumba vidogo vinavyopasuka kuonyesha mbegu.
about.dg:
*Mkongolo mwiru* ni muhi wa matsaka ga pwani, wa jamii ndide ya Connaraceae. Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaumanya kpwa makodzage, ela dzinare rinatuluka kpwa rangi nyiru ya gophare.

Mihi ya jenasi ya *Ellipanthus* ina makodza mazima gasigoganyika, ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana, magumu dza chingo, na maruwa madide. Matundage ni makakaya madide ganayoahuka na kuonyesa tembe.

where.en: It grows in the dry coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania, the same kind of forest as the Kwale kayas.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu mikavu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, aina ile ile ya misitu kama kaya za Kwale.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, matsaka ga aina mwenga na ga makaya ga Kwale.

culture.en: Stem colour is one of the features Digo speakers use to tell related trees apart. Pakia gives this name as an example: the plain *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*) is set against *mkongolo mwiru*, 'black mkongolo', and *mkongolo wa kundu*, 'red mkongolo'.
culture.sw: Rangi ya shina ni mojawapo ya sifa ambazo wasemaji wa Kidigo huzitumia kutofautisha miti inayohusiana. Pakia anatoa jina hili kama mfano: *mkongolo* wa kawaida (*Combretum schumannii*) unalinganishwa na *mkongolo mwiru*, 'mkongolo mweusi', na *mkongolo wa kundu*, 'mkongolo mwekundu'.
culture.dg: Rangi ya kolo ni kahi ya alama ambazo atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuzihumira kutafwautisha mihi iriyo ndugu. Pakia analavya dzina hiri dza mfwano: *mkongolo* wa kawaida (*Combretum schumannii*) unatafwautishwa na *mkongolo mwiru*, '*mkongolo* mwiru', na *mkongolo wa kundu*, '*mkongolo* wa kundu'.

names.en: *Mkongolo mwiru* means 'black mkongolo'. Pakia explains that the plain *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*) has brownish bark that peels off to show a paler bark underneath, and the bark of this species is compared with it and described as black (*mwiru*). The two trees belong to different families. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mkongolo mwiru* maana yake ni 'mkongolo mweusi'. Pakia anaeleza kwamba *mkongolo* wa kawaida (*Combretum schumannii*) una gome la rangi ya hudhurungi linalobambuka kuonyesha gome jeupe zaidi chini yake, na gome la spishi hii hulinganishwa nalo na kuelezwa kuwa jeusi (*mwiru*). Miti hii miwili ni ya familia tofauti. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili katika vyanzo.
names.dg: Mana ya *mkongolo mwiru* ni '*mkongolo* mwiru'. Pakia anaeleza kukala *mkongolo* wa kawaida (*Combretum schumannii*) una gopha ra rangi ya dongo rinaroandulika na kuonyesa gopha ra ndani ra rangi ngushu-ngushu; gopha ra muhi hinyu rinalinganishwa naro na rinaelezwa kukala dziru (*mwiru*). Mihi hino miri ni ya jamii tafwauti. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: A wild grape vine of the coastal forest edge, climbing by tendrils and hanging with dark berries.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu mwitu wa pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani, unaopanda kwa vikonyo na kuning'iniza matunda meusi.

summary.en: Mkororoi is a wild climber of the grape family, with three-part leaves and dark berries. Pakia records only its name.
summary.sw: Mkororoi ni mtambaa wa porini wa familia ya mizabibu, wenye majani ya vipande vitatu na matunda meusi. Pakia anarekodi jina lake tu.
summary.dg: *Mkororoi* ni mmea wa weruni wa kufyombera, wa jamii ya mzabibu, wenye makodza ga seemu tahu na matunda madide maru. Pakia anaandika dzinare tu.

about.en: *Mkororoi* is a woody climber of the grape family. It climbs with tendrils, and its leaves are divided into three leaflets. The small greenish flowers are followed by round berries that ripen to dark purple or black, in loose bunches like small wild grapes.
about.sw: *Mkororoi* ni mtambaa wenye shina la mti wa familia ya mizabibu. Hupanda kwa vikonyo, na majani yake yamegawanyika kuwa vijani vitatu. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-kijani hufuatwa na matunda ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa ya zambarau iliyokolea au meusi, katika vishada vilivyolegea kama zabibu ndogo za porini.
about.dg: *Mkororoi* ni mmea wa kufyombera wenye nyama za muhi, wa jamii ya mzabibu. Unafyombera kpwa nyuzi za kugbwirira, na chila kodza rinaganyika kuhenda makodza madide mahahu. Maruwa madide ga chijani ngushu-ngushu gachimala kunamera matunda madide ga mviringo, ganayoivwa na kukala ga zambarau iriyo phephi na nyiru au maru, kpwa mabunda gasigobanana dza zabibu ndide za weruni.

where.en: It grows on forest edges, in thickets and in riverine bush, and is widespread in eastern and southern Africa.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani na katika vichaka vya kando ya mito, na umeenea mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka, vitsakani na weruni kanda-kanda ya miho, na unaphahikana phatu phanji kpwenye seemu za mashariki na za kusini za Afrika.

names.en: Pakia lists *mkororoi* with no meaning, no English name and no other language sharing it. Its relatives in the grape family on this coast include *mgongolo mlume* (*mwenjere*), *mbebeneka* and the *Cissus* climbers called *mdokadoka*.
names.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *mkororoi* bila maana, bila jina la Kiingereza na bila lugha nyingine inayoshiriki jina hilo. Jamaa zake katika familia ya mizabibu katika pwani hii ni pamoja na *mgongolo mlume* (*mwenjere*), *mbebeneka* na mitambaa ya *Cissus* inayoitwa *mdokadoka*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkororoi* bila mana, bila dzina ra Chingereza, na bila luga yanjina inayorihumira dzina hiri. Mimea yanjina ya jamii ya mzabibu ya pwani ihi ni phamwenga na *mgongolo mlume* (*mwenjere*), *mbebeneka* na mimea ya kufyombera ya *Cissus* inayoihwa *mdokadoka*.

teaser.dg: Hopeza kodza na urinuse: arufuye ni kali sana hata dzinare rinagomba 'inakota wongo'.

summary.en: Mkota wongo is a coastal forest shrub whose crushed leaves give off a strong, pungent smell. Its name says the smell 'smacks the brain'.
summary.sw: Mkota wongo ni kichaka cha misitu ya pwani ambacho majani yake yakifinywa hutoa harufu kali inayochoma puani. Jina lake linasema kwamba harufu hiyo 'hupiga ubongo'.
summary.dg: *Mkota wongo* ni chitsaka cha matsaka ga pwani, ambacho makodzage gachihopezwa ganalavya arufu kali sana. Dzinare rinagomba kukala arufu iyo 'inakota wongo'.

about.en:
*Mkota wongo* is a shrub or small tree of the coastal forest. Its most distinctive feature is the leaves, which give off a strong, pungent smell when they are crushed and sniffed. Pakia's informants identified it by the look and the smell of the leaves.

*Grevea* is a small genus found only in eastern Africa and Madagascar. Male and female flowers grow on separate plants.
about.sw:
*Mkota wongo* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa misitu ya pwani. Sifa yake iliyo wazi zaidi ni majani, ambayo hutoa harufu kali inayochoma puani yanapofinywa na kunuswa. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa sura na harufu ya majani.

*Grevea* ni jenasi ndogo inayopatikana tu mashariki mwa Afrika na Madagaska. Maua ya kiume na ya kike huota kwenye mimea tofauti.
about.dg:
*Mkota wongo* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa matsaka ga pwani. Alamaye kulu zaidi ni makodzage: gachihopezwa na kunuswa, ganalavya arufu kali sana. Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaumanya kpwa sura na arufu ya makodzage.

*Grevea* ni jenasi ndide inayophahikana Afrika Mashariki na Madagascar bahi. Maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwa mimea tafwauti.

where.en: It is a plant of the East African coastal forests and thickets, including those of the south Kenya coast.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa misitu na vichaka vya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, ikiwemo ile ya pwani ya kusini mwa Kenya.
where.dg: Ni mmea wa matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, phamwenga na matsaka ga pwani ya kusini ya Kenya.

culture.en: Smell is one of the senses Digo speakers use to identify plants, and this name records it directly. Pakia lists it with *chinuka*, the 'smelly' plants, as examples of plant names based on smell.
culture.sw: Harufu ni mojawapo ya hisi ambazo wasemaji wa Kidigo huzitumia kutambua mimea, na jina hili linairekodi moja kwa moja. Pakia analiorodhesha pamoja na *chinuka*, mimea 'inayonuka', kama mifano ya majina ya mimea yanayotokana na harufu.
culture.dg: Arufu ni kahi ya njira ambazo atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuzihumira kumanya mimea, na dzina hiri rinaonyesa dzambo hiro waziwazi. Pakia anauandika phamwenga na *chinuka*, mimea 'inayonuka', dza mifwano ya madzina ga mimea ganayotuluka kpwa arufu.

names.en: *Mkota wongo* means 'smacking the brain': the smell of the leaves is said to hit (*kota*) the brain (*wongo*). In the main text Pakia glosses it as 'stimulating the brain'. No other language shares the name, and there is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mkota wongo* maana yake ni 'kupiga ubongo': harufu ya majani husemekana kuupiga (*kota*) ubongo (*wongo*). Katika matini kuu Pakia analieleza kuwa 'kuchangamsha ubongo'. Hakuna lugha nyingine inayoshiriki jina hili, na hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili katika vyanzo.
names.dg: Mana ya *mkota wongo* ni 'unaokota wongo': nkugombwa kukala arufu ya makodza inakota (*kota*) bongo (*wongo*). Kpwenye maandikoge makulu, Pakia anarieleza kukala 'unaolamusa wongo'. Takuna luga yanjina inayohumira dzina hiri, na maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: A forest shrub believed to do its growing at night, when no one is watching.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha msituni kinachoaminika kukua usiku, wakati hakuna anayekiona.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha tsakani ambacho atu anaamini kukala chinakula usiku, wakati takuna mutu anayelola.

summary.en: Mkula usiku is a forest shrub of the acanthus family with white tubular flowers. Its name, 'grow by night', records a belief about how it grows.
summary.sw: Mkula usiku ni kichaka cha msituni cha familia ya Acanthaceae chenye maua meupe yenye umbo la mrija. Jina lake, 'kua usiku', linahifadhi imani kuhusu jinsi kinavyokua.
summary.dg: *Mkula usiku* ni chitsaka cha tsakani cha jamii ya *acanthus*, chenye maruwa mereru ga umbo ra mrija. Dzinare, 'unakula usiku', rinaonyesa imani ya atu kuhusu vira unavyokula.

about.en: *Mkula usiku* is a shrub of the forest understorey, in the acanthus family. *Whitfieldia* species have opposite, smooth leaves and clusters of white tubular flowers, each held in a large, papery, often pale calyx.
about.sw: *Mkula usiku* ni kichaka kinachoota chini ya miti mikubwa msituni, katika familia ya Acanthaceae. Spishi za *Whitfieldia* zina majani laini yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, na vishada vya maua meupe yenye umbo la mrija, kila ua likiwa ndani ya kikombe kikubwa cha ua (kaliksi) kilicho kama karatasi na mara nyingi chenye rangi hafifu.
about.dg: *Mkula usiku* ni chitsaka cha photsi ya tsaka, photsi ya mihi mire, cha jamii ya *acanthus*. Aina za *Whitfieldia* zina makodza laini ganayomera mairi-mairi ganayolengana, na mabunda ga maruwa mereru ga umbo ra mrija. Chila ruwa rinakala ndani ya makodza ga kondze ga ruwa (*calyx*) makulu, membamba dza karatasi, na mara nyinji ga rangi ngushu-ngushu.

where.en: It grows in the shade of moist and coastal forest. The species is found in both West and East Africa.
where.sw: Kinaota kivulini katika misitu yenye unyevu na misitu ya pwani. Spishi hii inapatikana Afrika Magharibi na Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Unamera pephoni kahi ya matsaka ga jeke-jeke na ga pwani. Aina ihi inaphahikana Afrika Magharibi na Afrika Mashariki.

culture.en: Pakia records the belief that this plant grows at night, which is where its name comes from.
culture.sw: Pakia anaandika imani kwamba mmea huu hukua usiku, na hapo ndipo jina lake lilipotoka.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika imani ya kukala mmea uhu unakula usiku, na dzinare rinatuluka phapho.

names.en: *Mkula usiku* means 'grow by night': the plant is believed to grow (*kula*) at night (*usiku*). No other language shares the name, and there is no English or Swahili name in the sources. Pakia spells the species name *Whitfieldia elongate*.
names.sw: *Mkula usiku* maana yake ni 'kua usiku': mmea huu unaaminika kukua (*kula*) usiku (*usiku*). Hakuna lugha nyingine inayotumia jina hili, na vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili. Pakia anaandika jina la spishi kama *Whitfieldia elongate*.
names.dg: Mana ya *mkula usiku* ni 'unakula usiku': atu anaamini kukala mmea uhu unakula (*kula*) wakati wa usiku (*usiku*). Takuna luga yanjina inayohumira dzina hiri, na maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili. Pakia anaandika dzina ra aina ihi *Whitfieldia elongate*.

teaser.en: A citrus-family tree whose three-part leaves smell of lemon when crushed, with wood hard enough to be called ironwood.
teaser.sw: Mti wa familia ya michungwa ambao majani yake ya sehemu tatu hunukia limau yakipondwa, na mbao zake ni ngumu kiasi cha kuitwa 'mti-chuma'.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa jamii ya michungbwa, ambao makodzage ga seemu tahu ganalavya arufu dza ya ndimu gachihopezwa, na nyama za muhi uhu ni ngumu hata kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *ironwood*, 'muhi wa chuma'.

summary.en: Mkumba mbega is white ironwood, a coastal forest tree of the citrus family with aromatic three-part leaves and very hard wood.
summary.sw: Mkumba mbega ni *white ironwood*, mti wa misitu ya pwani wa familia ya michungwa wenye majani ya sehemu tatu yenye harufu nzuri na mbao ngumu sana.
summary.dg: *Mkumba mbega* ni *white ironwood*, muhi wa matsaka ga pwani wa jamii ya michungbwa, wenye makodza ga seemu tahu genye arufu nono, na nyama za muhi ngumu sana.

about.en:
*Mkumba mbega* is an evergreen tree, from a shrub up to about 20 metres. Its leaves are divided into three narrow leaflets with wavy edges, and they smell of citrus when crushed, as many plants in the citrus family do. Small greenish-white flowers grow in clusters at the ends of the branches, and the small round fruits ripen to purplish black.

The bark is pale grey and smooth, and the wood is pale, hard and heavy, which is where the English name white ironwood comes from.
about.sw:
*Mkumba mbega* ni mti usiopukutisha majani, kuanzia ukubwa wa kichaka hadi urefu wa takriban mita 20. Kila jani limegawanyika katika vijani vitatu vyembamba vyenye kingo za mawimbi, na yakipondwa hunukia kama michungwa, kama ilivyo kwa mimea mingi ya familia ya michungwa. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe huota kwa vishada kwenye ncha za matawi, na matunda madogo ya mviringo huiva na kuwa ya zambarau iliyokolea hadi nyeusi.

Gome ni la kijivu hafifu na laini, na mbao zake ni nyeupe-nyeupe, ngumu na nzito; hapo ndipo jina la Kiingereza *white ironwood* ('mti-chuma mweupe') lilipotoka.
about.dg:
*Mkumba mbega* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati; unaweza kukala chitsaka, au muhi wa ure wa hadi mita ishirini hivi. Chila kodza rinaganyika kuhenda makodza madide mahahu membamba, genye kanda-kanda dza mambi, na gachihopezwa ganalavya arufu dza ya michungbwa, dza vira mimea minji ya jamii ya michungbwa inavyohenda. Maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru iriyo na chijani ganamera kpwa mabunda kpwenye ntsa za panda, na matunda madide ga mviringo ganaivwa na kukala ga rangi nyiru iriyo na zambarau.

Gopha ni ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu, na ni laini. Nyama za muhi ni za rangi ngushu-ngushu, ngumu na ndziho; ndiyo sababu kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *white ironwood*.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and dune bush and is found from East Africa south to South Africa.
where.sw: Unaota katika misitu ya pwani na vichaka vya kwenye matuta ya mchanga, na unapatikana kuanzia Afrika Mashariki kusini hadi Afrika Kusini.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani na weruni wa mafungu ga mtsanga ga pwani, na unaphahikana kula Afrika Mashariki hadi Afrika Kusini.

uses.en: Elsewhere in its range the hard wood is used for tool handles, poles and implements, and the leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: Katika maeneo mengine unakopatikana, mbao zake ngumu hutumika kutengeneza mipini ya zana, nguzo na vifaa mbalimbali, na majani na mizizi yake hutumika katika dawa za asili. Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Phatu phanjina unaphophahikana, nyama ngumu za muhi uhu nkuhumirwa kuhenda miphini ya vifaa, maphungo na vifaa vyanjina, na makodza na miziye nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji. Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia lists *mkumba mbega* among the names he could not analyse, so its meaning is unknown. No other language shares it. 'White ironwood' is the usual English name for the species, but it is not given by Pakia.
names.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *mkumba mbega* miongoni mwa majina ambayo hakuweza kuyachambua, kwa hiyo maana yake haijulikani. Hakuna lugha nyingine inayotumia jina hili. Kwa Kiingereza spishi hii kwa kawaida huitwa *white ironwood*, lakini Pakia hatoi jina hilo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkumba mbega* kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage, kpwa hivyo manage tagamanyikana. Takuna luga yanjina inayorihumira. *White ironwood* ni dzina ra Chingereza ra kawaida ra aina ihi, ela Pakia kariandika.

teaser.en: A creeping finger grass whose seed heads spread out like the fingers of a hand.
teaser.sw: Nyasi inayotambaa ambayo vishada vyake vya mbegu hutawanyika kama vidole vya mkono.
teaser.dg: Nyasi inayoambala photsi, ambayo vitswavye vya tembe vinatawanyika dza vyala vya mkpwono.

summary.en: Mkuse is a finger grass, a perennial grass with slender, finger-like seed heads, recognised by Digo speakers from the look of the whole plant.
summary.sw: Mkuse ni nyasi ya jenasi *Digitaria* (*finger grass*), nyasi ya kudumu yenye vishada vyembamba vya mbegu vilivyo kama vidole; Wadigo huitambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
summary.dg: *Mkuse* ni nyasi ya aina inayoihwa kpwa Chingereza *finger grass*: nyasi inayokala na moyo kpwa miaka minji, yenye vitswa vyembamba vya tembe vinavyohalana na vyala. Atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuimanya kpwa sura ya mmea wosi.

about.en:
*Mkuse* is a perennial grass, often spreading by runners along the ground, with tufts of upright stems. Its flowering heads are made of several slender spikes that spread from near the top of the stem like fingers, which is why grasses of this genus are called finger grasses.

Pakia's informants identified it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Mkuse* ni nyasi ya kudumu, ambayo mara nyingi husambaa kwa vitawi vinavyotambaa ardhini, na yenye vichala vya mashina yaliyosimama wima. Vishada vyake vya maua vimeundwa na masuke kadhaa membamba yanayotawanyika kutoka karibu na ncha ya shina kama vidole; ndiyo sababu nyasi za jenasi hii huitwa kwa Kiingereza *finger grasses* ('nyasi-vidole').

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliitambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg:
*Mkuse* ni nyasi inayokala na moyo kpwa miaka minji. Mara nyinji inaenea kpwa milita mire inayoambala photsi, na ina mabunda ga visinde vinavyoima chocho. Vitswavye vya maruwa vina seemu chache nyembamba, zinazotawanyika kula phephi na dzulu ya chisinde dza vyala; ndiyo sababu nyasi za jenasi ihi kpwa Chingereza zinaihwa *finger grasses*.

Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaimanya kpwa sura ya mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows in grassland, open bushland and fallow land, often on sandy soils. The species is widespread in eastern and southern Africa.
where.sw: Inaota katika nyika za nyasi, vichaka vilivyo wazi na mashamba yaliyoachwa, mara nyingi kwenye udongo wa mchanga. Spishi hii imeenea sana mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika.
where.dg: Inamera kpwenye herera za nyasi, weruni wa wazi na minda iriyorichwa, mara nyinji kpwenye ulongo wa mtsanga. Aina ihi inaphahikana phatu phanji kpwenye seemu za mashariki na za kusini za Afrika.

uses.en: Elsewhere in Africa this species, known in English as Milanje finger grass, is valued as a pasture grass and is grown for grazing and hay. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: Katika sehemu nyingine za Afrika, spishi hii, inayojulikana kwa Kiingereza kama *Milanje finger grass*, inathaminiwa kama nyasi ya malisho na hupandwa kwa ajili ya malisho na nyasi kavu za lishe. Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Phatu phanjina Afrika, aina ihi, inayoihwa kpwa Chingereza *Milanje finger grass*, ina samani dza nyasi ya marisa, na nkuphandwa kpwa kurisa mifugo na kuphaha nyasi kavu za kurisa. Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mkuse* with no meaning. The Mgombato dictionary lists *Mkuse* only as the name of a Digo spirit, and the link, if any, between the grass and the spirit is unknown. There is no English or Swahili name in Pakia.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mkuse* bila kutoa maana yake. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaorodhesha *Mkuse* tu kama jina la pepo wa Kidigo, na uhusiano, kama upo, kati ya nyasi hii na pepo huyo haujulikani. Pakia hatoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkuse* bila mana. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *Mkuse* tu dza dzina ra pepho ya Chidigo, na taimanyikana kukala kuna uhusiano kahi ya nyasi ihi na pepho iyo. Pakia kaandika dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: Every branch forks into exactly two, so regularly that Digo speakers identify it by its branching alone.
teaser.sw: Kila tawi hugawanyika kuwa mawili hasa, kwa utaratibu kiasi kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa mpangilio wa matawi yake peke yake.
teaser.dg: Chila panda inaganyika kukala panda mbiri tu, sawa-sawa sana, hata atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuumanya kpwa vira pandaze zinavyoganyika bahi.

summary.en: Mkuta manena, also called njira mbiri, is a shrub or scrambler with a strictly regular, forking branching pattern. Digo speakers recognise it by that pattern, and one of its names means 'two ways'.
summary.sw: Mkuta manena, unaoitwa pia njira mbiri, ni kichaka au mmea unaotambaa juu ya mingine wenye mpangilio wa matawi unaogawanyika kwa utaratibu kamili. Wadigo huutambua kwa mpangilio huo, na mojawapo ya majina yake maana yake ni 'njia mbili'.
summary.dg: *Mkuta manena*, unaoihwa piya *njira mbiri*, ni chitsaka au mmea unaoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, ambao pandaze zinaganyika kukala mbiri-mbiri sawa-sawa chila wakati. Atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuumanya kpwa mpangilio uho, na dzina rimwenga kahi ya madzinage rina mana ya 'njira mbiri'.

about.en: *Mkuta manena* is a shrub or woody scrambler. Its most distinctive feature is its branching: at each point the stem divides into two, very regularly, so the whole plant forks again and again. Pakia gives it as an example of a plant identified by its 'habit', and says that people recognise it from its leaves and stem. The leaves are opposite and smooth, and the plant has small yellowish tubular flowers.
about.sw: *Mkuta manena* ni kichaka au mmea wa mbao unaotambaa juu ya mimea mingine. Sifa yake kuu ni jinsi matawi yake yanavyoota: kila mahali shina hugawanyika kuwa mawili, kwa utaratibu kamili, kwa hiyo mmea mzima hujigawa tena na tena. Pakia anautaja kama mfano wa mmea unaotambuliwa kwa 'umbo lake la ukuaji', na anasema watu huutambua kwa majani na shina lake. Majani yake huota kwa jozi zinazotazamana na ni laini, na mmea una maua madogo ya rangi ya manjano hafifu yenye umbo la mrija.
about.dg: *Mkuta manena* ni chitsaka, au mmea wenye nyama za muhi unaoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Alamaye kulu zaidi ni vira pandaze zinavyoganyika: chila phatu kolo rinaganyika kukala seemu mbiri, sawa-sawa sana, kpwa hivyo mmea wosi unaganyika kukala mbiri tsona na tsona. Pakia anaulavya dza mfwano wa mmea unaomanyikana kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi (*habit*), na anagomba kukala atu nkuumanya kpwa makodzage na kolore. Makodza ganamera mairi-mairi ganayolengana na ni laini, na mmea una maruwa madide ga umbo ra mrija ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and forest edges in East Africa and further south.
where.sw: Unaota katika vichaka vya pwani na pembezoni mwa misitu Afrika Mashariki na kuelekea kusini.
where.dg: Unamera weruni wa pwani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka Afrika Mashariki, na kusini zaidi.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere in southern Africa its roots are used in traditional medicine, and the plant is known to contain toxic compounds.
uses.sw: Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Katika sehemu nyingine za kusini mwa Afrika mizizi yake hutumika katika dawa za asili, na mmea huu unajulikana kuwa na kemikali zenye sumu.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Phatu phanjina kpwenye seemu za kusini za Afrika, miziye nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji, na inamanyikana kukala mmea uhu una kemikali za sumu.

culture.en: Pakia sets *njira mbiri* beside *mfidzofidzo* (*Garcinia livingstonei*), which branches in threes. Both are identified by their fixed branching pattern.
culture.sw: Pakia anaiweka *njira mbiri* sambamba na *mfidzofidzo* (*Garcinia livingstonei*), ambao matawi yake hugawanyika matatu matatu. Mimea yote miwili hutambuliwa kwa mpangilio wake maalum wa matawi.
culture.dg: Pakia anauika *njira mbiri* kanda-kanda ya *mfidzofidzo* (*Garcinia livingstonei*), ambao pandaze zinaganyika kukala tahu-tahu. Mimea yosi miri nkumanyikana kpwa mpangilio wa panda zao usiogaluka.

names.en: Pakia records three names. *Njira mbiri* means 'two ways': the plant branches twice (*mbiri*) at each point, and the branches are the *njira*, 'ways' or 'paths'. *Mlunga njira* and *mkuta manena* are given without explanation. *Mkuta manena* is close to *chikuta manena*, the name of *Rourea orientalis*. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika majina matatu. *Njira mbiri* maana yake ni 'njia mbili': mmea hugawanyika mara mbili (*mbiri*) kila mahali, na matawi ndiyo *njira*, yaani 'njia'. *Mlunga njira* na *mkuta manena* yametolewa bila maelezo. *Mkuta manena* linakaribiana na *chikuta manena*, jina la *Rourea orientalis*. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mahahu. Mana ya *njira mbiri* ni 'njira mbiri': chila phatu mmea unaganyika kukala panda mbiri (*mbiri*), na panda izo ndizo *njira*, 'njira'. *Mlunga njira* na *mkuta manena* ganaandikpwa bila kuelezwa. *Mkuta manena* rinahalana na *chikuta manena*, dzina ra *Rourea orientalis*. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: Seen as the 'male' of the white-berry bush, and known in English for smelling like boiled potatoes at dusk.
teaser.sw: Huonwa kama 'dume' wa kichaka cha matunda meupe, na kwa Kiingereza hujulikana kwa kunukia kama viazi vilivyochemshwa wakati wa magharibi.
teaser.dg: Adigo nkuuona dza 'mlume' wa *mkpwamba*, chitsaka cha matunda mereru; kpwa Chingereza unamanyikana kpwa sababu dziloni unalavya arufu dza ya viazi virivyookohwa.

summary.en: Mkpwamba lungo is a scrambling shrub with small leaves and black berries, seen by Digo speakers as the male counterpart of mkpwamba, the white-berry bush.
summary.sw: Mkpwamba lungo ni kichaka kinachotambaa chenye majani madogo na matunda meusi, ambacho Wadigo hukiona kama dume wa mkpwamba, kichaka cha matunda meupe.
summary.dg: *Mkpwamba lungo* ni chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, chenye makodza madide na matunda madide maru. Adigo nkuuona dza mlume wa *mkpwamba*, chitsaka cha matunda mereru.

about.en:
*Mkpwamba lungo* is a shrub, often scrambling or leaning on other plants, with slender, arching branches. The small oval leaves sit in two neat rows along the side shoots, so each shoot looks like a single feathery leaf. The flowers are tiny and reddish. They are followed by small round berries that turn dark purple to black, unlike the white berries of its 'female' counterpart.

In the evening the flowers give off a smell often compared to boiled potatoes, which is where the English name potato bush comes from. Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mkpwamba lungo* ni kichaka, ambacho mara nyingi hutambaa au huegemea mimea mingine, chenye matawi membamba yaliyopinda kama tao. Majani madogo ya mviringo hukaa kwa safu mbili nadhifu kando ya vitawi vya pembeni, kwa hiyo kila kitawi huonekana kama jani moja lenye umbo la unyoya. Maua ni madogo sana na ya rangi ya wekundu. Baada yake huja matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayogeuka zambarau iliyokolea hadi meusi, tofauti na matunda meupe ya mwenzake wa 'kike'.

Jioni maua yake hutoa harufu ambayo mara nyingi hulinganishwa na ya viazi vilivyochemshwa; hapo ndipo jina la Kiingereza *potato bush* ('kichaka-viazi') lilipotoka. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia walikitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Mkpwamba lungo* ni chitsaka, ambacho mara nyinji chinaambala au chinajejemera mimea yanjina, na china panda nyembamba zinazogbwadzika. Makodzage madide ga mviringo ganamera chila uphande wa panda ndide, hata chila panda ndide inaonekana dza kodza mwenga rinalofanana na linyoya. Maruwage ni madide sana na ga kundu. Chisha kunamera matunda madide ga mviringo ganayogaluka rangi kula zambarau hadi kukala maru, tafwauti na matunda mereru ga *mkpwamba*, ambao ni wa 'chichetu'.

Dziloni maruwa ganalavya arufu ambayo mara nyinji nkufananiswa na arufu ya viazi virivyookohwa, na ndiyo sababu kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *potato bush*. Atu ariomterya Pakia anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in thickets, along riverbanks and in wet bush, and is widespread in tropical Africa and Asia.
where.sw: Kinaota katika vichaka vizito, kando ya mito na katika vichaka vyenye unyevu, na kimeenea sana katika Afrika ya kitropiki na Asia.
where.dg: Unamera vitsakani, kanda-kanda ya miho na weruni phatu phenye madzi, na unaphahikana phatu phanji kpwenye tsi za dzoho za Afrika na Asia.

culture.en: Digo speakers pair it with *mkpwamba* (*Flueggea virosa*). Pakia explains that the 'female' *mkambavitu* is named for its fruits (*vitu*), which are white and easy to see, while this plant, the male, has less conspicuous fruits.
culture.sw: Wadigo hukiweka jozi moja na *mkpwamba* (*Flueggea virosa*). Pakia anaeleza kwamba *mkambavitu* wa 'kike' amepewa jina kutokana na matunda yake (*vitu*), ambayo ni meupe na huonekana kwa urahisi, ilhali mmea huu, ambao ni dume, una matunda yasiyoonekana kwa urahisi.
culture.dg: Adigo nkuuika phamwenga na *mkpwamba* (*Flueggea virosa*). Pakia anaeleza kukala *mkambavitu*, ambao ni wa 'chichetu', dzinare rinatuluka kpwa matundage (*vitu*), ambago ni mereru na ganaonekana upesi; ela uhu, ambao ni 'mlume', una matunda gasigoonekana upesi dza higo.

names.en: *Mkpwamba lungo* means 'basket *mkpwamba*'. Pakia records it as the male counterpart of *Flueggea virosa*, but says the link with *lungo*, a basket, is unclear. Pakia also lists the species under *mkambakamba*, *mkpwamba* and *chikwamba*, names he mainly uses for *Flueggea virosa*. Duruma shares the names. 'Potato bush' is a common English name for the species, but it is not given by Pakia.
names.sw: *Mkpwamba lungo* maana yake ni '*mkpwamba* wa kikapu'. Pakia anaandika kuwa ni dume wa *Flueggea virosa*, lakini anasema uhusiano wake na *lungo*, yaani kikapu, hauko wazi. Pakia pia anaorodhesha spishi hii chini ya *mkambakamba*, *mkpwamba* na *chikwamba*, majina ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa anayatumia kwa *Flueggea virosa*. Kiduruma kinatumia majina hayo hayo. Kwa Kiingereza spishi hii huitwa kwa kawaida *potato bush*, lakini Pakia hatoi jina hilo.
names.dg: Dzina *mkpwamba lungo* rina mana ya '*mkpwamba* wa lungo'. Pakia anauandika dza mlume wa *Flueggea virosa*, ela anagomba kukala uhusiano wa dzina hiri na *lungo*, yani lungo ra kuphehera, taumanyikana. Pakia piya anaandika aina ihi photsi ya madzina *mkambakamba*, *mkpwamba* na *chikwamba*, madzina ambago sana sana anagahumira kpwa *Flueggea virosa*. Aduruma piya anahumira madzina higa. *Potato bush* ni dzina ra Chingereza rinalohumirwa sana kpwa aina ihi, ela Pakia kariandika.

teaser.en: The 'black mlala', told apart from its relatives by the darkness of its bark.
teaser.sw: 'Mlala mweusi', unaotofautishwa na jamaa zake kwa weusi wa gome lake.
teaser.dg: '*Mlala* mwiru', unaotafwautishwa na nduguze kpwa gophare riru zaidi.

summary.en: Mlala mwiru is an ebony-family tree of the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania, named for its dark bark.
summary.sw: Mlala mwiru ni mti wa familia ya Ebenaceae (jamii ya *ebony*) wa misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, uliopewa jina kutokana na gome lake jeusi.
summary.dg: *Mlala mwiru* ni muhi wa jamii ya *ebony* wa matsaka ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, uriohewa dzinare kpwa sababu ya gophare riru.

about.en: *Mlala mwiru* is a tree of the ebony family, *Diospyros*. Like its relatives it has simple, alternate, leathery leaves, small bell-shaped flowers and round fruits held in a persistent calyx. Pakia's informants identified it by its leaves, and its name comes from its comparatively dark bark.
about.sw: *Mlala mwiru* ni mti wa familia ya Ebenaceae, ile ya miti ya *ebony*, jenasi *Diospyros*. Kama jamaa zake, una majani sahili yanayopishana na magumu kama ngozi, maua madogo yenye umbo la kengele na matunda ya mviringo yanayoshikiliwa na kikombe cha ua (kaliksi) kisichodondoka. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake, na jina lake linatokana na gome lake lililo jeusi kiasi kuliko la jamaa zake.
about.dg: *Mlala mwiru* ni muhi wa jamii ya *ebony*, yani *Diospyros*. Dza nduguze, una makodza gasigoganyika, ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana, na magumu dza chingo; maruwa madide ga umbo ra kengele; na matunda ga mviringo ganayokala ndani ya chikombe cha ruwa chisichogbwa. Atu ariomterya Pakia anaumanya kpwa makodzage, na dzinare rinatuluka kpwa gophare, ambaro ni riru zaidi ya ra mihi yanjina ya jamiiye.

where.en: It is native to south-eastern Kenya and Tanzania, in the dry coastal forests.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa asili wa kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na Tanzania, katika misitu mikavu ya pwani.
where.dg: Ni muhi wa chienyeji wa kusini-mashariki ya Kenya na Tanzania, kpwenye matsaka makavu ga pwani.

culture.en: Stem colour is one of the ways Digo speakers tell apart plants they see as related. Pakia sets *mlala mwiru* against *mlala mwereru* (*Monodora grandidieri*), which is the white form.
culture.sw: Rangi ya shina ni mojawapo ya njia ambazo Wadigo hutumia kutofautisha mimea wanayoiona kuwa ya jamaa moja. Pakia anaulinganisha *mlala mwiru* na *mlala mwereru* (*Monodora grandidieri*), ambao ndio aina nyeupe.
culture.dg: Rangi ya kolo ni njira mwenga ambayo Adigo anaihumira kutafwautisha mimea ambayo anaiona kukala ni ndugu. Pakia anatafwautisha *mlala mwiru* na *mlala mwereru* (*Monodora grandidieri*), ambao ni aina nyereru.

names.en: *Mlala mwiru* means 'black *mlala*', the black form of *mlala* (Pakia gives *mlala* as *Diospyros greenwayi*) because its bark is darker. At one point in his main text Pakia glosses the name as 'white mlala', which seems to be a slip, because his name notes and the colour words agree it is black (*mwiru*). The Mgombato dictionary gives *mlala* only as raffia, which is a different plant. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mlala mwiru* maana yake ni '*mlala* mweusi', aina nyeusi ya *mlala* (Pakia anatoa *mlala* kuwa *Diospyros greenwayi*) kwa sababu gome lake ni jeusi zaidi. Mahali pamoja katika maandishi yake makuu Pakia analieleza jina hili kuwa 'mlala mweupe', jambo linaloonekana kuwa kosa la kalamu, kwa sababu maelezo yake kuhusu majina na maneno ya rangi yanakubaliana kuwa ni mweusi (*mwiru*). Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mlala* kuwa mwale (raffia) tu, ambao ni mmea tofauti. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Dzina *mlala mwiru* rina mana ya '*mlala* mwiru', yani aina iru ya *mlala* (Pakia anaandika kukala *mlala* ni *Diospyros greenwayi*), kpwa sababu gophare ni riru zaidi. Phatu phamwenga kpwenye maandikoge makulu Pakia analavya mana ya dzina hiri kukala ni '*mlala* mwereru'; hiri rinaonekana kukala ni kosa, kpwa sababu maelezoge ga madzina na maneno ga rangi ganakubaliana kukala ni mwiru (*mwiru*). Kamusi ya Mgombato inalavya *mlala* kukala ni *raffia* tu, ambao ni mmea wanjina. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: Its scent is famous in perfume; at the coast its flowers are worn on clothes and in hair, and scattered on beds.
teaser.sw: Harufu yake ni maarufu katika manukato; huku pwani maua yake huvaliwa kwenye nguo na nywele, na hutawanywa vitandani.
teaser.dg: Arufuye inamanyikana sana kpwenye marashi; pwani maruwage nkuvwalwa nguwoni na nyereni, na nkumwagwa vitandani.

summary.en: Mlangilangi is the ylang-ylang tree, an introduced perfume tree whose fragrant, drooping yellow flowers Digo people use as decoration. Its Digo name comes from the English name.
summary.sw: Mlangilangi ni mti wa *ylang-ylang*, mti wa manukato ulioletwa kutoka nje, ambao maua yake ya manjano yenye harufu nzuri na yanayoning'inia hutumiwa na Wadigo kama mapambo. Jina lake la Kidigo limetokana na jina la Kiingereza.
summary.dg: *Mlangilangi* ni muhi wa *ylang-ylang*, muhi mjeni wa marashi; Adigo nkuhumira maruwage ga rangi ya mandano, genye arufu nono na ganayogbwadzika, kudzipamba. Dzinare ra Chidigo rinatuluka kpwa dzina ra Chingereza.

about.en:
*Mlangilangi* is a fast-growing tree with drooping branches and large, glossy, pointed leaves. Its flowers hang in clusters and have six long, narrow, twisted petals that start green and turn yellow as they ripen, when they give off a strong, sweet scent. The fruits are clusters of small dark berries.

Pakia counts it among the plants that Digo speakers can identify from their flowers, because the flowers are valued as perfume.
about.sw:
*Mlangilangi* ni mti unaokua haraka wenye matawi yanayoinama na majani makubwa, yanayong'aa na yenye ncha. Maua yake huning'inia kwa vishada na yana petali sita ndefu, nyembamba na zilizojisokota, ambazo mwanzoni ni za kijani na hugeuka manjano yanapokomaa, na hapo hutoa harufu kali tamu. Matunda yake ni vishada vya beri ndogo nyeusi.

Pakia anauhesabu miongoni mwa mimea ambayo Wadigo wanaweza kuitambua kwa maua yake, kwa sababu maua hayo yanathaminiwa kama manukato.
about.dg:
*Mlangilangi* ni muhi unaokula upesi, wenye panda zinazogbwadzika na makodza makulu, ganayong'ala na genye ntsa. Maruwage ganagbwadzika mafungu-mafungu, na chila ruwa rina vibapa sita vire, vyembamba na virivyodzikunja; vinaandza kukala vya chijani na vinagaluka kukala vya rangi ya mandano vichiivwa, na wakati uho ganalavya arufu kali ya mtswano. Matundage ni mafungu ga matunda madide maru.

Pakia anauandika kahi ya mimea ambayo Adigo anaweza kuimanya kpwa maruwage, kpwa sababu maruwage nkuhumirwa dza marashi.

where.en: It is native to South-East Asia and was brought to the Kenya coast for cultivation. Pakia, following Beentje, says it has since gone wild there. Look for it in gardens and around homes.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa asili wa Kusini-Mashariki mwa Asia na uliletwa pwani ya Kenya kwa ajili ya kupandwa. Pakia, akimfuata Beentje, anasema tangu hapo umeanza kuota wenyewe porini huko. Utautafuta bustanini na kuzunguka nyumba.
where.dg: Ni muhi wa chienyeji wa Asia ya kusini-mashariki, na ukarehwa pwani ya Kenya kuphandwa. Pakia, achilunga Beentje, anagomba kukala sambi ukamera weruni macheye hiko. Unaweza kuuona busitanini na kanda-kanda ya midzi.

uses.en: The flowers are best known worldwide as the source of ylang-ylang oil for perfume. On the Digo coast, the flowers are made into rosettes and worn on clothes and in the hair, or placed on beds, for their beauty and scent.
uses.sw: Duniani kote maua yake yanajulikana zaidi kama chanzo cha mafuta ya *ylang-ylang* yanayotumika katika manukato. Katika pwani ya Wadigo, maua hutengenezwa kuwa vishada vya mapambo vinavyovaliwa kwenye nguo na nywele, au huwekwa vitandani, kwa ajili ya uzuri na harufu yake.
uses.dg: Duniani kosi maruwage ganamanyikana sana kpwa sababu nkuhenderwa mafuha ga *ylang-ylang* ga kuhenda marashi. Pwani ya Adigo, maruwa nkuhendwa maua madide ga kupambira, ambago nkuvwalwa nguwoni na nyereni, au nkuikpwa vitandani, kpwa sababu ya uzuriwe na arufuye.

culture.en: Pakia describes how flowers are used for beauty and romance among the Digo. Rosettes of *mlangilangi*, *chiluwa* (*Mkilua fragrans*) and jasmine are worn or laid on beds. Together with henna patterns and flower-pattern fabrics, these beautifications are called *maruwa*, from *ruwa*, a word for beauty.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jinsi maua yanavyotumika kwa urembo na mapenzi miongoni mwa Wadigo. Vishada vya maua ya *mlangilangi*, *chiluwa* (*Mkilua fragrans*) na yasmini huvaliwa au hutandikwa vitandani. Pamoja na michoro ya hina na vitambaa vyenye michoro ya maua, mapambo haya huitwa *maruwa*, kutokana na *ruwa*, neno la uzuri.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza vira maruwa nkuhumirwa kpwa uzuri na mahaba kahi ya Adigo. Maua madide ga kupambira ga *mlangilangi*, *chiluwa* (*Mkilua fragrans*) na asmini nkuvwalwa au nkuikpwa vitandani. Phamwenga na mitindo ya hina na nguwo zenye mitindo ya maruwa, mapambo higa gosi nkuihwa *maruwa*, kula kpwa *ruwa*, neno ra uzuri.

names.en: Pakia gives *mlangilangi* as one of three Digo plant names that agree with scientific or Western names. It was adopted from the English *ylang-ylang* when the tree was introduced. No Swahili name is given in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa *mlangilangi* kama mojawapo ya majina matatu ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayokubaliana na majina ya kisayansi au ya Kimagharibi. Lilichukuliwa kutoka kwa jina la Kiingereza *ylang-ylang* mti ulipoletwa. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia analavya *mlangilangi* dza dzina mwenga kahi ya madzina mahahu ga mimea ga Chidigo ganayokubaliana na madzina ga chisayansi au ga Chizungu. Dzina hiri rahalwa kula kpwa dzina ra Chingereza *ylang-ylang* wakati muhi uhu urihorehwa. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili kpwenye vitabu.

reason.dg: *Mkilua*, ruwa ranjina ra marashi rinalovwalwa dza *maruwa*

teaser.en: Named for laying the spirits of the dead to rest in peace.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina kwa kuzilaza roho za wafu zipumzike kwa amani.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rinatuluka kpwa kuzilaza koma za akufwa zioye kpwa amani.

summary.en: Mlazakoma is a slender twining climber of the milkweed group. Its name records its use in appeasing the spirits of dead relatives.
summary.sw: Mlazakoma ni mmea mwembamba unaojizungusha na kupanda juu ya mingine, wa kundi la *milkweed*. Jina lake linahifadhi matumizi yake katika kutuliza roho za ndugu waliokufa.
summary.dg: *Mlazakoma* ni mmea mwembamba unaolinga-linga, wa kundi ra *milkweed*. Dzinare rinaonyesa kukala nkuhumirwa kuzitulidza koma za ndugu ariofwa.

about.en: *Mlazakoma* is a slender twining climber in the milkweed group of the dogbane family. Plants of this group have milky sap, opposite leaves, and small star-shaped flowers, and their seeds are carried on tufts of silky hairs.
about.sw: *Mlazakoma* ni mmea mwembamba unaopanda kwa kujizungusha, katika kundi la *milkweed* la familia ya Apocynaceae. Mimea ya kundi hili ina utomvu mweupe kama maziwa, majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, na maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota, na mbegu zake hupeperushwa na vishungi vya nywele laini kama hariri.
about.dg: *Mlazakoma* ni mmea mwembamba unaolinga-linga, wa kundi ra *milkweed* kahi ya jamii ya *dogbane*. Mimea ya kundi hiri ina maziya, makodza ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalengana, na maruwa madide ga umbo ra nyota, na tembe zayo nkuhalwa ni mafungu ga nyere laini dza hariri.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and thicket in eastern Africa.
where.sw: Unaota katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani mashariki mwa Afrika.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na vitsakani pha pwani ya Afrika ya mashariki.

culture.en: Pakia records that the plant is used to appease the *koma*, the spirits of dead relatives, and to put them to sleep (*laza*) in peace. The *koma* are an important part of Digo belief about the dead.
culture.sw: Pakia anaandika kwamba mmea huu hutumika kutuliza *koma*, yaani roho za ndugu waliokufa, na kuzilaza (*laza*) kwa amani. *Koma* ni sehemu muhimu ya imani ya Wadigo kuhusu wafu.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala mmea uhu nkuhumirwa kuzitulidza *koma*, yani roho za ndugu ariofwa, na kuzilaza (*laza*) kpwa amani. *Koma* ni seemu muhimu ya imani ya Adigo kuhusu akufwa.

names.en: *Mlaza koma* means 'layer of spirits', the one that lays the spirits (*koma*) of dead relatives to rest (*laza*). Pakia spells it both as one word and as two. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mlaza koma* maana yake ni 'mlaza roho', yule anayezilaza roho (*koma*) za ndugu waliokufa (*laza*) zipumzike. Pakia analiandika kama neno moja na pia kama maneno mawili. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: *Mlaza koma* rina mana ya 'mlaza koma', ambaye nkuzilaza *koma* za ndugu ariofwa (*laza*) zioye. Pakia anariandika dza neno mwenga na piya dza maneno mairi. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

reason.dg: Nao una dzina kpwa sababu ya kazi ya utsai (fwimbo dzulu ya maadui)

teaser.en: A coastal shrub that shares one name with a neighbour and another with the plants used for arrow shafts.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha pwani kinachoshiriki jina moja na jirani yake, na jina lingine na mimea inayotumiwa kutengeneza mipini ya mishale.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha pwani chinachokala na dzina mwenga na jiraniye, na dzina ranjina sawa na mimea inayohumirwa kutsonga *nyomba*.

summary.en: Mmangwi is a coastal shrub of the coffee family with clusters of small white flowers. Pakia also lists it among the plants called mtsonga nyomba, 'make arrow shaft'.
summary.sw: Mmangwi ni kichaka cha pwani cha familia ya mibuni chenye vishada vya maua madogo meupe. Pakia pia anakiorodhesha miongoni mwa mimea inayoitwa mtsonga nyomba, 'tengeneza mpini wa mshale'.
summary.dg: *Mmangwi* ni chitsaka cha pwani cha jamii ya kahawa, chenye mafungu ga maruwa madide mereru. Pakia piya anauandika kahi ya mimea inayoihwa *mtsonga nyomba*, 'mtsonga nyomba' (mutu anayetsonga *nyomba*).

about.en:
*Mmangwi* is a shrub or small tree of the coffee family (Rubiaceae). It has opposite, glossy leaves with small pointed stipules between the leaf stalks, and many small white, often fragrant flowers in dense clusters at the leaf bases. They are followed by small round berries.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mmangwi* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya mibuni (Rubiaceae). Una majani yanayong'aa yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, yenye vikanzu vidogo vyenye ncha (stipuli) katikati ya vikonyo vya majani, na maua mengi madogo meupe, mara nyingi yenye harufu nzuri, katika vishada vizito kwenye vishina vya majani. Baada yake huja beri ndogo za mviringo.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia walikitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Mmangwi* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya kahawa (*Rubiaceae*). Una makodza ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalengana, ganayong'ala, na vikodza vidide vyenye ntsa kahi ya milita ya makodza (*stipules*). Una maruwa manji madide mereru, mara nyinji genye arufu nono, ganayomera mafungu-mafungu phatu milita ya makodza inaphoandzira. Chisha kunamera matunda madide ga mviringo.

Atu ariomterya Pakia anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Kinaota katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani nchini Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

uses.en: Pakia lists the species under *mtsonga nyomba*, a name for plants whose straight sticks are used to make arrow shafts.
uses.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha spishi hii chini ya *mtsonga nyomba*, jina la mimea ambayo vijiti vyake vilivyonyooka hutumika kutengeneza mipini ya mishale.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika aina ihi photsi ya dzina *mtsonga nyomba*, dzina ra mimea ambayo fwimbo zayo zigololokazo nkuhumirwa kutsonga *nyomba*.

names.en: Pakia gives two names. *Mmangwi* is shared with *Tricalysia ovalifolia*, and Duruma and Giriama share it too. *Mtsonga nyomba* means 'make arrow shaft', from *tsonga*, to make, and *nyomba*, arrow shafts. That name also covers *Polysphaeria parvifolia*, *Dichapetalum zenkeri*, *Mildbraedia carpinifolia* and *Uvaria lucida*. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa majina mawili. *Mmangwi* linashirikiwa na *Tricalysia ovalifolia*, na Kiduruma na Kigiriama pia hulitumia. *Mtsonga nyomba* maana yake ni 'tengeneza mpini wa mshale', kutokana na *tsonga*, kutengeneza, na *nyomba*, mipini ya mishale. Jina hilo pia linajumuisha *Polysphaeria parvifolia*, *Dichapetalum zenkeri*, *Mildbraedia carpinifolia* na *Uvaria lucida*. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia analavya madzina mairi. *Mmangwi* ni dzina ra *Tricalysia ovalifolia* piya, na Aduruma na Agiryama piya anarihumira. *Mtsonga nyomba* rina mana ya 'kutsonga *nyomba*', kula kpwa *tsonga*, kuhenda (kutsonga), na *nyomba*, fwimbo za mivwi. Dzina hiri piya ni ra *Polysphaeria parvifolia*, *Dichapetalum zenkeri*, *Mildbraedia carpinifolia* na *Uvaria lucida*. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

summary.sw: Mmangwi huu ni kichaka cha pwani cha familia ya mibuni chenye maua madogo meupe na beri ndogo. Pakia anaandika maumbo kadhaa ya jina lake.

about.en: This *mmangwi* is a shrub or small tree of the coffee family. It has opposite, oval, glossy leaves, small white or cream flowers clustered at the leaf bases, and small round fruits that ripen to red or orange.
about.sw: *Mmangwi* huu ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya mibuni. Una majani ya duaradufu yanayong'aa yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, maua madogo meupe au ya rangi ya krimu yaliyokusanyika kwenye vishina vya majani, na matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva na kuwa mekundu au ya rangi ya chungwa.
about.dg: *Mmangwi* uhu ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya kahawa. Una makodza ga mviringo ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalengana na ganayong'ala, maruwa madide mereru au ga rangi ya maziya ganayomera mafungu-mafungu phatu milita ya makodza inaphoandzira, na matunda madide ga mviringo ganayoivwa kukala ga kundu au ga rangi ya chungbwa.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and forest of eastern Africa, including the Kenya coast.
where.sw: Unaota katika vichaka na misitu ya pwani mashariki mwa Afrika, ikiwemo pwani ya Kenya.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ya Afrika ya mashariki, phamwenga na pwani ya Kenya.

names.en: Pakia records this plant under *mmangwi*, a name shared with *Polysphaeria multiflora*, and also as *mmangitovu* or *mmangi tovu* and *mmangwimangwi*. Duruma and Giriama share *mmangwi*, and Duruma shares the other two forms. Pakia does not explain the names. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources: the 'Mmangitovu' that appears in the English column of Pakia's list is another Digo name.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika mmea huu chini ya *mmangwi*, jina linaloshirikiwa na *Polysphaeria multiflora*, na pia kama *mmangitovu* au *mmangi tovu* na *mmangwimangwi*. Kiduruma na Kigiriama hutumia *mmangwi*, na Kiduruma hutumia pia maumbo yale mengine mawili. Pakia hayaelezi majina haya. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili: 'Mmangitovu' linaloonekana katika safu ya Kiingereza ya orodha ya Pakia ni jina lingine la Kidigo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika mmea uhu photsi ya *mmangwi*, dzina ambaro piya ni ra *Polysphaeria multiflora*, na piya dza *mmangitovu* au *mmangi tovu* na *mmangwimangwi*. Aduruma na Agiryama piya anahumira *mmangwi*, na Aduruma anahumira madzina higa mairi ganjina piya. Pakia kaeleza mana ya madzina higa. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili: dzina 'Mmangitovu' rinaroonekana kpwenye mstari wa Chingereza wa madzina ga Pakia ni dzina ranjina ra Chidigo.

teaser.en: A rare wild cola tree known from only a few coastal forest patches, mostly the kayas.
teaser.sw: Mkola pori adimu unaojulikana katika vipande vichache tu vya misitu ya pwani, hasa kaya.
teaser.dg: Muhi adimu wa kola ya weruni unaomanyikana kpwenye vipande vichache tu vya matsaka ga pwani, sana sana kaya.

summary.en: Mnapu is a rare wild cola, a small evergreen tree found in only a few coastal forest fragments, mostly the kaya forests. It is assessed as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: Mnapu ni mkola pori adimu, mti mdogo usiopukutisha majani unaopatikana katika vipande vichache tu vya misitu ya pwani, hasa misitu ya kaya. Umetathminiwa kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Mnapu* ni kola adimu ya weruni, muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati unaophahikana kpwenye vipande vichache tu vya matsaka ga pwani, sana sana matsaka ga kaya. Unaikpwa kahi ya mimea iriyo na hatari ya kuangamika (*Vulnerable*).

about.en: *Mnapu* is an evergreen tree, usually small but sometimes up to 25 metres, with a clean trunk and a dense, rounded crown. Like other wild colas it has leathery leaves, small star-shaped flowers without petals, and fruits made of several pod-like parts that hold large seeds.
about.sw: *Mnapu* ni mti usiopukutisha majani, kwa kawaida mdogo lakini wakati mwingine hufikia urefu wa mita 25, wenye shina safi lisilo na matawi chini na taji zito la mviringo. Kama mikola pori mingine, una majani magumu kama ngozi, maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota yasiyo na petali, na matunda yaliyoundwa na sehemu kadhaa zilizo kama maganda zinazobeba mbegu kubwa.
about.dg: *Mnapu* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, kpwa kawaida mdide ela wakati wanjina unafika mita ishirini na tsano, wenye kolo rire risiro na panda na makodza manji ga mviringo dzuluye. Dza kola zanjina za weruni, una makodza magumu dza chingo, maruwa madide ga umbo ra nyota gasigokala na vibapa, na matunda ganayohendwa ni seemu nyinji dza makakaya zenye tembe kulu.

where.en: It is restricted to a few small coastal forest fragments, mostly the kaya forests of Kenya, where the forest is declining in several places.
where.sw: Unapatikana tu katika vipande vichache vidogo vya misitu ya pwani, hasa misitu ya kaya ya Kenya, ambako msitu unapungua katika maeneo kadhaa.
where.dg: Unaphahikana kpwenye vipande vichache vidide vya matsaka ga pwani tu, sana sana matsaka ga kaya ga Kenya, ambapho tsaka rinaphungula phatu phanji.

uses.en: The wood is used for poles, tool handles, firewood and charcoal, and the tree is used for shade. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: Mbao zake hutumika kwa nguzo, mipini ya zana, kuni na mkaa, na mti hutumika kwa kivuli. Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo, miphini ya vyombo, kuni na makala, na muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa chivuri. Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mnapu* with no meaning, and no other language sharing it. A smaller relative, *Cola minor*, is called *chitsamvia* in Digo. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mnapu* bila maana yake, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayotumia jina hili. Jamaa yake mdogo, *Cola minor*, huitwa *chitsamvia* kwa Kidigo. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mnapu* bila mana, na takuna luga yanjina inayorihumira. Nduguye mdide, *Cola minor*, kpwa Chidigo unaihwa *chitsamvia*. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

conservation.en: *Cola uloloma* is poorly known and has fewer than ten known locations. Its range is under 20,000 km², and it is assessed as Vulnerable. Protecting the kayas protects this tree.
conservation.sw: *Cola uloloma* haijulikani vizuri na ina maeneo yasiyozidi kumi yanayojulikana. Eneo lake la usambaaji ni chini ya km² 20,000, na imetathminiwa kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable). Kulinda kaya ni kuulinda mti huu.
conservation.dg: *Cola uloloma* taumanyikana sana, na phatu ambapho unamanyikana kukala unaphahikana ni chini ya kumi. Seemu yosi unamophahikana ni chini ya kilomita za mraba elufu ishirini, na unaikpwa kahi ya mimea iriyo na hatari ya kuangamika (*Vulnerable*). Kurinda kaya ni kuurinda muhi uhu.

teaser.en: A ball of scarlet flowers on a single stem, and a name that warns it is as dangerous as a snake.
teaser.sw: Mpira wa maua mekundu kama damu juu ya shina moja, na jina linaloonya kuwa ni hatari kama nyoka.
teaser.dg: Chitswa cha maruwa ga kundu dzulu ya mlita mmwenga, na dzina rinaloonya kukala ni wa hatari dza nyoka.

summary.en: Mnazi wa nyoka is the blood lily, a bulb plant with a striking red ball of flowers. Its name, 'snake's coconut tree', is a warning that the plant is poisonous.
summary.sw: Mnazi wa nyoka ni *blood lily*, mmea wa kitunguu-mzizi (tunguu) wenye mpira wa maua mekundu unaovutia macho. Jina lake, 'mnazi wa nyoka', ni onyo kwamba mmea huu una sumu.
summary.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* ni *blood lily*, mmea wa chiazi wenye chitswa cha maruwa ga kundu chinachoonekana sana. Dzinare, 'mnazi wa nyoka', rinaonya kukala mmea uhu ni wa sumu.

about.en: *Mnazi wa nyoka* is a bulb plant. Before or with the rains it puts up a single fleshy stalk topped by a round head of many red flowers, often as wide as a hand or wider, with long stamens that give it the look of a fireball. The leaves are broad, with wavy edges, and they grow on a false stem that is often spotted with purple at the base, like a small palm trunk. The flowers are followed by small red berries.
about.sw: *Mnazi wa nyoka* ni mmea unaoota kutoka kwenye tunguu (kitunguu-mzizi). Kabla ya mvua au pamoja nazo, hutoa kikonyo kimoja chenye nyama, ambacho juu yake kuna kichwa cha mviringo cha maua mengi mekundu, mara nyingi chenye upana wa kiganja au zaidi, na stameni ndefu zinazokipa sura ya mpira wa moto. Majani ni mapana, yenye kingo za mawimbi, na huota juu ya shina bandia ambalo mara nyingi lina madoa ya zambarau chini, kama shina dogo la mnazi. Baada ya maua huja beri ndogo nyekundu.
about.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* ni mmea wa chiazi. Kabla ya mvula au phamwenga na mvula unalavya mlita mmwenga wenye madzi manji, na dzuluye kuna chitswa cha mviringo cha maruwa manji ga kundu, mara nyinji upanawe ni sawa na mkpwono au zaidi, na stameni ndire zinazouhenda uonekane dza mpira wa moho. Makodzage ni mapana, ga kanda-kanda zenye maimbi, na ganamera dzulu ya kolo ra handzo ambaro mara nyinji rina madowa ga zambarau photsi, dza kolo ridide ra muhi wa jamii ya mnazi. Maruwa gachimala kunamera matunda madide ga kundu.

where.en: It grows in shady forest, thicket and bushland, and comes up with the rains. The species is widespread in tropical and southern Africa.
where.sw: Unaota kivulini msituni, katika vichaka vizito na vichaka, na huchipuka mvua zinaponyesha. Spishi hii imeenea sana katika Afrika ya kitropiki na kusini mwa Afrika.

culture.en: Pakia uses this name as an example of animal names that act as warnings in plant naming. The snake (*nyoka*) signals that the plant is poisonous.
culture.sw: Pakia analitumia jina hili kama mfano wa majina ya wanyama yanayotumika kama maonyo katika kuipa mimea majina. Nyoka (*nyoka*) huashiria kwamba mmea una sumu.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira dzina hiri dza mfwano wa madzina ga nyama ganayohumirwa kuonya kpwenye kuiha mimea. Nyoka (*nyoka*) inaonyesa kukala mmea uhu ni wa sumu.

names.en: *Mnazi wa nyoka* means 'coconut tree of the snake'. It grows like a small coconut palm (*mnazi*), and the snake signals that it is poisonous. Pakia stresses that it is not related to the coconut, despite the name. The same name is used for *Siphonochilus brachystemon*, a forest ginger. 'Blood lily' is a common English name for the species, but it is not given by Pakia.
names.sw: *Mnazi wa nyoka* maana yake ni 'mnazi wa nyoka'. Unakua kama mnazi mdogo (*mnazi*), na nyoka huashiria kwamba una sumu. Pakia anasisitiza kwamba hauna uhusiano na mnazi, licha ya jina lake. Jina hilo hilo hutumika kwa *Siphonochilus brachystemon*, mmea wa msituni wa jamii ya tangawizi. Kwa Kiingereza spishi hii huitwa kwa kawaida *blood lily*, lakini Pakia hatoi jina hilo.
names.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* rina mana ya 'mnazi wa nyoka'. Unamera dza mnazi mdide (*mnazi*), na nyoka inaonyesa kukala ni wa sumu. Pakia anagomba kpwa nguvu kukala mmea uhu tauhusiana na mnazi, hata dzinare richikala vivyo. Dzina hiri piya nkuhumirwa kpwa *Siphonochilus brachystemon*, tangawizi ya tsakani. *Blood lily* ni dzina ra Chingereza rinalohumirwa sana kpwa aina ihi, ela Pakia kariandika.

about.en: This *mnazi wa nyoka* is a wild ginger. It grows from fleshy underground rhizomes and puts up leafy shoots in the rainy season, with broad leaves on a short false stem. The flowers appear close to the ground, often before the leaves, and are delicate and short-lived, as in other *Siphonochilus*. In the dry season the shoots die back and the plant waits underground.
about.sw: *Mnazi wa nyoka* huu ni tangawizi pori. Unaota kutoka kwenye viazi (mashina ya chini ya ardhi) vyenye nyama, na hutoa machipukizi yenye majani wakati wa mvua, yenye majani mapana juu ya shina bandia fupi. Maua huchanua karibu na ardhi, mara nyingi kabla ya majani, na ni laini na hudumu kwa muda mfupi, kama ilivyo kwa *Siphonochilus* wengine. Wakati wa kiangazi machipukizi hunyauka na mmea husubiri chini ya ardhi.
about.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* uhu ni tangawizi ya weruni. Unamera kula kpwa mizi minono ya tsini ganayokala dza viazi (*rhizomes*), na wakati wa mwaka unalavya mihi michache yenye makodza, yenye makodza mapana dzulu ya kolo ra handzo rifupi. Maruwa ganatuluka phephi na photsi, mara nyinji kabla ya makodza, na ni malaini na gasigokala muda mure, dza kpwa *Siphonochilus* wanjina. Wakati wa kazikazi mihi ichi inanyala, na mmea unagodza tsini.

culture.dg: Pakia analavya dzina hiri dza mfwano wa madzina ga nyama ganayohumirwa kuonya. Nyoka inaonyesa kukala mmea uhu ni wa sumu, dza nyoka.

names.en: *Mnazi wa nyoka* means 'coconut tree of the snake'. The leafy shoot grows like a small coconut palm, and *nyoka*, snake, warns of poison. Pakia records the same name for *Scadoxus multiflorus*, the blood lily. It is not related to the coconut. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mnazi wa nyoka* maana yake ni 'mnazi wa nyoka'. Chipukizi lenye majani hukua kama mnazi mdogo, na *nyoka* huonya juu ya sumu. Pakia anaandika jina hilo hilo kwa *Scadoxus multiflorus*, yaani *blood lily*. Hauna uhusiano na mnazi. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* rina mana ya 'mnazi wa nyoka'. Mihi yenye makodza inamera dza mnazi mdide, na *nyoka*, yani nyoka, inaonya kukala ni wa sumu. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri hiri kpwa *Scadoxus multiflorus*, *blood lily*. Tauhusiana na mnazi. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: To a sunbird, this mistletoe is as precious as a coconut palm is to people.
teaser.sw: Kwa chozi, kimelea hiki ni cha thamani kama mnazi ulivyo kwa binadamu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa tsozi, mmea uhu una samani dza mnazi kpwa atu.

summary.en: Mnazi wa tsozi is a mistletoe that grows high on the branches of other trees. Its name, 'the sunbird's coconut tree', comes from the sunbirds that visit its flowers.
summary.sw: Mnazi wa tsozi ni kimelea (*mistletoe*) kinachoota juu kwenye matawi ya miti mingine. Jina lake, 'mnazi wa chozi', linatokana na ndege aina ya chozi wanaotembelea maua yake.
summary.dg: *Mnazi wa tsozi* ni mmea unaomera dzulu ya panda za mihi yanjina (*mistletoe*). Dzinare, 'mnazi wa tsozi', rinatuluka kpwa tsozi anaokpwedza kpwenye maruwage.

about.en:
*Mnazi wa tsozi* is a mistletoe, a shrubby plant that grows on the branches of trees and draws water and nutrients from its host. It forms clumps of thick, leathery leaves high in the crown. Its tubular flowers are rich in nectar and are visited by sunbirds, which also spread the sticky seeds from branch to branch.

Pakia's informants identified it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Mnazi wa tsozi* ni kimelea (*mistletoe*), mmea wa kichaka unaoota kwenye matawi ya miti na kufyonza maji na virutubisho kutoka kwa mti mwenyeji wake. Hufanya mafungu ya majani mazito, magumu kama ngozi, juu kwenye taji la mti. Maua yake yenye umbo la mrija yana asali tele na hutembelewa na chozi, ambao pia hueneza mbegu zake zinazonata kutoka tawi moja hadi jingine.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia walikitambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg:
*Mnazi wa tsozi* ni *mistletoe*, mmea dza chitsaka unaomera dzulu ya panda za mihi na kufyondza madzi na chakurya kula kpwa muhi unaoukala. Unahenda mafungu ga makodza magumu dza chingo dzulu sana kpwenye muhi. Maruwage ni dza mabomba madide, gana madzi ga mtswano manji, na ganakpwedzerwa ni tsozi, ambao piya nkuhala tembe zinazonyata kula panda mwenga hadi yanjina.

Atu ariomterya Pakia anaumanya kpwa kuulola mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows on trees in coastal bushland and woodland, wherever there are suitable hosts.
where.sw: Kinaota juu ya miti katika vichaka na mapori ya miti ya pwani, popote palipo na miti mwenyeji inayofaa.
where.dg: Unamera dzulu ya mihi weruni na matsakani ga pwani, phatu phosi phenye mihi inayoufwaha.

culture.en: Pakia records that *mnazi wa tsozi* is also used as a name for parasitic plants in general, as *chiahira* is for epiphytes.
culture.sw: Pakia anaandika kwamba *mnazi wa tsozi* pia hutumika kama jina la mimea vimelea kwa ujumla, kama vile *chiahira* lilivyo kwa mimea inayoota juu ya mimea mingine bila kuinyonya (*epiphytes*).
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala *mnazi wa tsozi* piya nkuhumirwa dza dzina ra mimea yosi inayoishi kpwa kufyondza mihi yanjina, dza *chiahira* irivyo kpwa mimea inayomera dzulu ya mihi yanjina bila kuifyondza.

names.en: *Mnazi wa tsozi* means 'coconut tree of the sunbird'. Sunbirds visit the flowers so often that the plant is thought of as being as important to them as the coconut palm is to people. The Mgombato dictionary defines *tsozi* as 'sunbird; one of a number of small birds with slender curved bills and bright plumage'. Pakia notes that the name is not related to *mnazi*, the coconut, in any other way. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mnazi wa tsozi* maana yake ni 'mnazi wa chozi'. Chozi hutembelea maua yake mara nyingi kiasi kwamba mmea huu unachukuliwa kuwa muhimu kwao kama mnazi ulivyo kwa binadamu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inafasili *tsozi* kuwa 'chozi; mmoja wa ndege wadogo kadhaa wenye midomo myembamba iliyopinda na manyoya yenye rangi angavu'. Pakia anabainisha kwamba jina hili halina uhusiano mwingine wowote na *mnazi*, mnazi wa nazi. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: *Mnazi wa tsozi* rina mana ya 'mnazi wa tsozi'. Tsozi anakpwedza kpwenye maruwage mara nyinji sana hata mmea uhu nkuonwa kukala ni muhimu kpwao dza mnazi urivyo muhimu kpwa atu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaeleza *tsozi* kukala ni 'tsozi; mwenga wa ndege adide anji enye miromo myembamba iriyopindika na nyoya za rangi zinazong'ala'. Pakia anaandika kukala dzina hiri tarihusiana na *mnazi*, mnazi, kpwa njira yoyosi yanjina. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: A small tree with bright yellow inner bark, and one of two quite different trees that share one Digo name.
teaser.sw: Mti mdogo wenye gome la ndani la manjano angavu, na mmoja kati ya miti miwili tofauti kabisa inayoshiriki jina moja la Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Muhi mdide wenye gopha ra ndani ra rangi ya mandano inayong'ala, na mwenga wa mihi miiri tafwauti sana ambayo ina dzina mwenga ra Chidigo.

summary.en: Mng'andu is a small tree of the Ochna family with bright yellow inner bark. Digo speakers use the same name for Crossopteryx febrifuga.
summary.sw: Mng'andu ni mti mdogo wa familia ya Ochnaceae wenye gome la ndani la manjano angavu. Wadigo hutumia jina hilo hilo kwa Crossopteryx febrifuga.
summary.dg: *Mng'andu* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya *Ochna* wenye gopha ra ndani ra rangi ya mandano inayong'ala. Adigo anahumira dzina hiri hiri kpwa *Crossopteryx febrifuga*.

about.en:
*Mng'andu* is a small deciduous tree or shrub of the Ochna family. Its leaves are simple, glossy and finely toothed, with many fine parallel side veins. The small flowers are white to cream, and they are followed by small fleshy fruits that ripen from red to black on a red base, as in other members of the family. The inner bark and roots are a bright yellow.

Pakia's informants identified the plants named *mng'andu* from their leaves and stem.
about.sw:
*Mng'andu* ni mti mdogo au kichaka kinachopukutisha majani, wa familia ya Ochnaceae. Majani yake ni sahili, yanayong'aa na yenye meno madogo kwenye kingo, yenye mishipa mingi myembamba ya pembeni iliyo sambamba. Maua madogo ni meupe hadi ya rangi ya krimu, na baada yake huja matunda madogo yenye nyama yanayoiva kutoka mekundu hadi meusi juu ya kitako chekundu, kama ilivyo kwa mimea mingine ya familia hii. Gome la ndani na mizizi ni ya manjano angavu.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliitambua mimea inayoitwa *mng'andu* kwa majani na shina lake.
about.dg:
*Mng'andu* ni muhi mdide au chitsaka cha jamii ya *Ochna* ambacho makodzage ganagbwa chila mwaka. Makodzage ni gasigoganyika, ganayong'ala na genye meno madide kanda-kanda, na gana mishipa minji midide ya uphande inayolungana sawa-sawa. Maruwa madide ni mereru hadi ga rangi ya maziya, na chisha kunamera matunda madide genye nyama ganayoivwa kula kundu hadi maru, dzulu ya chitsako cha kundu, dza kpwa mimea yanjina ya jamii ihi. Gopha ra ndani na mizi ni ga rangi ya mandano inayong'ala.

Atu ariomterya Pakia anaimanya mimea inayoihwa *mng'andu* kpwa makodza na kolo.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and dry forest and is found from East Africa south to Mozambique and South Africa.
where.sw: Unaota katika vichaka vya pwani na misitu mikavu, na unapatikana kuanzia Afrika Mashariki kusini hadi Msumbiji na Afrika Kusini.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pha pwani na kpwenye matsaka makavu, na unaphahikana kula Afrika ya mashariki hadi Msumbiji na Afrika ya Kusini.

uses.en: Elsewhere, in southern Africa, the yellow bark and roots are used as a dye and in traditional medicine and magic. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: Kwingineko, kusini mwa Afrika, gome na mizizi yake ya manjano hutumika kama rangi ya kutia na katika dawa za asili na uganga. Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Kpwenye tsi zanjina, kusini ya Afrika, gopha ra rangi ya mandano na mizi nkuhumirwa kuhendera rangi na dza muhaso wa chienyeji na wa uganga. Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mng'andu* for two quite different trees: this one and *Crossopteryx febrifuga* of the coffee family. He gives no meaning for the name, and no other language shares it. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mng'andu* kwa miti miwili tofauti kabisa: huu na *Crossopteryx febrifuga* wa familia ya mibuni. Hatoi maana ya jina hili, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayolitumia. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mng'andu* kpwa mihi miiri tafwauti sana: uhu na *Crossopteryx febrifuga* wa jamii ya kahawa. Kalavya mana ya dzina hiri, na takuna luga yanjina inayorihumira. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

conservation.en: In South Africa, where it is very rare, it has been heavily harvested for traditional medicine.
conservation.sw: Nchini Afrika Kusini, ambako ni adimu sana, umevunwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya dawa za asili.
conservation.dg: Afrika ya Kusini, ambako ni adimu sana, ukakatwa sana kpwa ajili ya muhaso wa chienyeji.
