summary.en: This mng'andu is Crossopteryx febrifuga, a small savanna tree of the coffee family whose bark is used across Africa against fever. Digo speakers give it the same name as Brackenridgea zanguebarica.
summary.sw: Mng'andu huu ni Crossopteryx febrifuga, mti mdogo wa nyika wa familia ya mibuni ambao gome lake hutumika kote Afrika dhidi ya homa. Wadigo huupa jina lilelile la Brackenridgea zanguebarica.
summary.dg: *Mng'andu* uhu ni *Crossopteryx febrifuga*, muhi mdide wa herera wa jamii ya kahawa ambao gophare nkuhumirwa Afrika yosi kuphoza homa. Adigo anaupha dzina mwenga na *Brackenridgea zanguebarica*.

about.en:
This *mng'andu* is a small, often crooked tree of the coffee family. Its leaves are opposite and oval, often softly hairy underneath. Small, sweet-scented white or cream flowers grow in dense rounded clusters at the ends of the branches. They are followed by clusters of small round capsules that split to release tiny winged seeds.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves and stem. App. V lists it as a shrub.
about.sw:
*Mng'andu* huu ni mti mdogo, mara nyingi uliopindapinda, wa familia ya mibuni. Majani yake huota kwa jozi zinazotazamana na ni ya duaradufu, mara nyingi yenye manyoya laini upande wa chini. Maua madogo meupe au ya rangi ya krimu yenye harufu tamu huota katika vishada vizito vya mviringo kwenye ncha za matawi. Baada yake huja vishada vya vifuko vidogo vya mviringo vinavyopasuka na kuachia mbegu ndogo sana zenye mabawa.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani na shina lake. Kiambatisho V kinauorodhesha kama kichaka.
about.dg:
*Mng'andu* uhu ni muhi mdide, mara nyinji unaosongoloka, wa jamii ya kahawa. Makodzage ganamera mairi-mairi ganalengana, ni ga mviringo, na mara nyinji gana nyere laini photsi. Maruwa madide mereru au ga rangi ya maziya, genye arufu nono, ganamera mafungu manji ga mviringo kpwenye ntsa za panda. Chisha kunamera mafungu ga makakaya madide ga mviringo ganayoahuka na kutuluza tembe ndide sana zenye mapha.

Atu ariomterya Pakia anaumanya kpwa makodza na kolo. Kpwenye *App. V* ya Pakia unaandikpwa dza chitsaka.

where.en: It is a tree of savanna and dry woodland across tropical Africa, from West Africa to Kenya and south to Mozambique.
where.sw: Ni mti wa nyika na mapori makavu ya miti kote katika Afrika ya kitropiki, kuanzia Afrika Magharibi hadi Kenya na kusini hadi Msumbiji.
where.dg: Ni muhi wa herera na matsaka makavu Afrika yosi ya dzoho, kula Afrika ya magharibi hadi Kenya na kusini hadi Msumbiji.

uses.en: Across its range the bark is used in traditional medicine, especially against fever, which is what *febrifuga*, 'fever-chaser', refers to. Pakia records no specific Digo use.
uses.sw: Kote unakopatikana, gome lake hutumika katika dawa za asili, hasa kutibu homa, ndiyo maana ya *febrifuga*, 'mfukuza homa'. Pakia haandiki matumizi mahususi ya Wadigo.
uses.dg: Phatu phosi unaphophahikana, gopha nkuhumirwa kpwa muhaso wa chienyeji, sana sana kuphoza homa, na ndiyo mana ya *febrifuga*, 'mwinga homa'. Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi hasa ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mng'andu* for this tree and also for *Brackenridgea zanguebarica*. He gives no meaning, and no other language is recorded as sharing the name. 'Crystal-bark' is an English name used in southern Africa, but it is not given by Pakia.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mng'andu* kwa mti huu na pia kwa *Brackenridgea zanguebarica*. Hatoi maana yake, na hakuna lugha nyingine iliyorekodiwa kutumia jina hili. Kwa Kiingereza kusini mwa Afrika huitwa *crystal-bark*, lakini Pakia hatoi jina hilo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mng'andu* kpwa muhi uhu na piya kpwa *Brackenridgea zanguebarica*. Kalavya mana, na takuna luga yanjina iriyoandikpwa kukala inarihumira dzina hiri. *Crystal-bark* ni dzina ra Chingereza rinalohumirwa kusini ya Afrika, ela Pakia kariandika.

teaser.en: Digo speakers call it the 'hairy' and 'male' mngweni, though botanists put it in a different genus altogether.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huuita mngweni 'mwenye manyoya' na 'dume', ingawa wataalamu wa mimea wanauweka katika jenasi tofauti kabisa.
teaser.dg: Atu anaogomba Chidigo anauiha *mngweni* 'wenye nyere' na *mngweni* 'mlume', ela asayansi a mimea anauika kpwenye jenasi yanjina kabisa.

summary.en: Mngweni madevu is a scrambling shrub of the custard-apple family. Digo speakers group it with the Uvaria climbers called mngweni and see it as their hairy, male form.
summary.sw: Mngweni madevu ni kichaka kinachotambaa cha familia ya Annonaceae (ya mitomoko). Wadigo huuweka pamoja na mimea inayopanda ya Uvaria inayoitwa mngweni, na huuona kuwa umbo lao lenye manyoya, la kiume.
summary.dg: *Mngweni madevu* ni chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, cha jamii ya *mbokwe*. Atu anaogomba Chidigo anauika phamwenga na mimea ya kufyombera ya *Uvaria* inayoihwa *mngweni*, na anauona dza *mngweni* mlume wenye nyere.

about.en:
*Mngweni madevu* is a scrambling shrub or climber of the custard-apple family (Annonaceae). Plants of the genus *Monanthotaxis* have simple, alternate leaves and small flowers, and their fruits are clusters of small berries that often turn red or orange.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves, which are broad compared with those of the female *mngweni*.
about.sw:
*Mngweni madevu* ni kichaka kinachotambaa au mmea unaopanda wa familia ya mitopetope (Annonaceae). Mimea ya jenasi *Monanthotaxis* ina majani sahili yanayopishana na maua madogo, na matunda yake ni vishada vya beri ndogo ambazo mara nyingi hugeuka nyekundu au rangi ya chungwa.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake, ambayo ni mapana ukilinganisha na yale ya *mngweni* jike.
about.dg:
*Mngweni madevu* ni chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, au mmea wa kufyombera, wa jamii ya *mbokwe* (Annonaceae). Mimea ya jenasi ya *Monanthotaxis* ina makodza mazima gasigoganyika, ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana, na maruwa madide. Matunda gao ni mabunda ga matunda madide genye madzi manji, ambago mara nyinji ganagaluka kukala ga kundu au ga rangi ya chungbwa.

Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaumanya kpwa makodzage, ambago ni mapana kuriko makodza ga *mngweni* mchetu.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Unaota katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani nchini Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

culture.en: *Mngweni* is a Digo folk genus that spans two botanical genera, *Uvaria* and *Monanthotaxis*. Pakia gives it as an example of how a Digo plant group can cut across scientific ones. He notes that Digo speakers see hairiness in plants as a male feature.
culture.sw: *Mngweni* ni jenasi ya kienyeji ya Kidigo inayojumuisha jenasi mbili za kibotania, *Uvaria* na *Monanthotaxis*. Pakia anaitoa kama mfano wa jinsi kundi la mimea la Kidigo linavyoweza kuvuka mipaka ya makundi ya kisayansi. Anabainisha kwamba Wadigo huona manyoya katika mimea kuwa sifa ya kiume.
culture.dg: *Mngweni* ni kundi ra mimea kpwa Chidigo rinaroinjira jenasi mbiri za chisayansi, *Uvaria* na *Monanthotaxis*. Pakia anarilavya dza mfwano wa vira kundi ra mimea ra Chidigo rinavyoweza kutsupa miphaka ya makundi ga chisayansi. Anaandika kukala atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuona nyere kpwa mimea ni alama ya chilume.

names.en: Pakia records two names. *Mngweni madevu* means 'hairy *mngweni*': the plant is linked with *Uvaria acuminata* and *U. lucida* (the *mngweni*) but seen as hairy, a view Pakia notes does not agree with the botanical description. *Mngweni mlume* means 'male *mngweni*', because its leaves are broader than those of the female form. In Pakia's list, *mngwene mlume* is also given for *Uvaria lucida*. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika majina mawili. *Mngweni madevu* maana yake ni '*mngweni* mwenye manyoya': mmea huu unahusishwa na *Uvaria acuminata* na *U. lucida* (yaani *mngweni*) lakini unaonekana kuwa na manyoya, mtazamo ambao Pakia anabainisha haukubaliani na maelezo ya kibotania. *Mngweni mlume* maana yake ni '*mngweni* dume', kwa sababu majani yake ni mapana kuliko ya umbo la kike. Katika orodha ya Pakia, *mngwene mlume* pia limetolewa kwa *Uvaria lucida*. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi. Mana ya *mngweni madevu* ni '*mngweni* wenye nyere': mmea uhu unaikpwa phamwenga na *Uvaria acuminata* na *U. lucida* (*mngweni*), ela unaonekana kukala una nyere, na Pakia anaandika kukala maono higa tagapatana na maelezo ga asayansi a mimea. Mana ya *mngweni mlume* ni '*mngweni* mlume', kpwa sababu makodzage ni mapana kuriko ga *mngweni* mchetu. Pakia piya analavya *mngwene mlume* kpwa *Uvaria lucida*. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: A creeping coastal grass that knits the sand together into a soft green mat.
teaser.sw: Nyasi ya pwani inayotambaa na kuushikanisha mchanga kuwa zulia laini la kijani.
teaser.dg: Nyasi ya pwani inayoambala photsi, inayogbwira mtsanga phamwenga na kukala dza mcheka laini wa chijani.

summary.en: Mnyumbwe is a creeping, mat-forming grass of the coast, a relative of the St Augustine lawn grass.
summary.sw: Mnyumbwe ni nyasi ya pwani inayotambaa na kutanda kama zulia, jamaa wa nyasi ya bustani inayoitwa kwa Kiingereza *St Augustine grass*.
summary.dg: *Mnyumbwe* ni nyasi ya pwani inayoambala photsi na kutandazika dza mcheka. Ni ndugu na nyasi inayophandwa kanda-kanda ya nyumba, inayoihwa kpwa Chingereza *St Augustine grass*.

about.en: *Mnyumbwe* is a low, creeping perennial grass. It spreads by long runners that root at the joints, forming a dense mat. The leaf blades are short, broad and blunt, and the flowering spikes are flattened, with the small spikelets sunk into one side of a thick, corky stalk.
about.sw: *Mnyumbwe* ni nyasi fupi ya kudumu inayotambaa. Husambaa kwa vitawi virefu vinavyotambaa na kutoa mizizi kwenye vifundo, na hivyo kutengeneza zulia zito. Majani yake ni mafupi, mapana na yenye ncha butu, na masuke ya maua ni bapa, na visuke vidogo vimezama upande mmoja wa kikonyo kinene kilicho kama gamba.
about.dg: *Mnyumbwe* ni nyasi fupi inayoambala photsi na inayokala na moyo kpwa miaka minji. Inaenea kpwa milita mire inayoambala photsi na kulavya mizi kpwenye mafundo, na inakala dza mcheka wa kubanana. Makodza ni mafupi, mapana, na ntsa zao ni butu. Vitswa vya maruwa ni vya bapa, na vitswa vidide vya maruwa vinainjira ndani ya uphande mmwenga wa mlita mziho, uriwo laini dza chifundiro.

where.en: It grows on sandy soils near the coast, in open places, under coconut palms and around homesteads. The species is found along the coasts of the Indian Ocean.
where.sw: Inaota kwenye udongo wa mchanga karibu na pwani, mahali palipo wazi, chini ya minazi na kuzunguka makazi. Spishi hii inapatikana kando ya pwani za Bahari ya Hindi.
where.dg: Inamera kpwenye ulongo wa mtsanga phephi na pwani, phatu pha wazi, photsi ya minazi na kuzunguluka midzi ya atu. Aina ihi inaphahikana kanda-kanda ya pwani za Bahari ya Hindi.

uses.en: Grasses of this genus are widely used as lawns and as ground cover against erosion. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: Nyasi za jenasi hii hutumika sana kama nyasi za bustani na kufunika ardhi ili kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo. Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Nyasi za jenasi ihi nkuhumirwa phatu phanji dza nyasi za kuphandwa kanda-kanda ya nyumba (*lawns*), na kufwinika tsi ili ulongo usihalwe ni mvula na phepho. Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mnyumbwe* with no meaning, and no other language sharing it. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mnyumbwe* bila maana yake, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayotumia jina hili. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mnyumbwe* bila mana, na takuna luga yanjina inayorihumira. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: A rare climbing shrub of the southern Kenya coast, one of three Keetia species that share the name mnyundzu.
teaser.sw: Kichaka adimu kinachopanda cha pwani ya kusini mwa Kenya, mojawapo ya spishi tatu za Keetia zinazoshiriki jina mnyundzu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka adimu chinachofyombera cha pwani ya kusini ya Kenya; ni aina mwenga kahi ya aina tahu za Keetia zinazoihwa *mnyundzu*.

summary.en: This mnyundzu is Keetia lukei, a shrub of the coffee family. Pakia records one Digo name, mnyundzu, for three species of Keetia.
summary.sw: Mnyundzu huu ni Keetia lukei, kichaka cha familia ya mibuni. Pakia anaandika jina moja la Kidigo, mnyundzu, kwa spishi tatu za Keetia.
summary.dg: *Mnyundzu* uhu ni Keetia lukei, chitsaka cha jamii ya kahawa. Pakia anaandika dzina mwenga ra Chidigo, *mnyundzu*, kpwa aina tahu za Keetia.

about.en:
*Keetia lukei* was described by botanists only in 1994. It is a climbing shrub or liana.

Like other plants of the genus, it has opposite leaves with small stipules between the leaf stalks, small greenish-white flowers in clusters at the leaf bases, and small fleshy fruits that are often two-lobed and ripen to black. Pakia's informants identified the *mnyundzu* plants by their leaves and fruits.
about.sw:
*Keetia lukei* ilielezwa na wataalamu wa mimea mwaka 1994 tu. Ni kichaka kinachopanda au mtambaa mkubwa wa mbao (liana).

Kama mimea mingine ya jenasi hii, ina majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana yenye vikanzu vidogo (stipuli) katikati ya vikonyo vya majani, maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe katika vishada kwenye vishina vya majani, na matunda madogo yenye nyama ambayo mara nyingi yana pande mbili na huiva kuwa meusi. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliitambua mimea ya *mnyundzu* kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg:
Asayansi a mimea akaeleza *Keetia lukei* mwaka 1994 tu. Ni chitsaka chinachofyombera, au mmea mure wa nyama za muhi unaofyombera mihi.

Dza mimea yanjina ya jenasi ihi, una makodza ganayolengana mairi-mairi, genye makodza madide sana (*stipules*) kahi ya milita ya makodza; maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru iriyo na chijani, ganayomera kpwa mabunda phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda; na matunda madide genye nyama, ambago mara nyinji gana seemu mbiri na ganaivwa na kukala maru. Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaimanya mimea ya *mnyundzu* kpwa makodza na matunda gao.

where.en: It is native to southern Kenya, where it grows in dry coastal bush and thicket.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa asili wa kusini mwa Kenya, unaoota katika vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito vya pwani.
where.dg: Ni mmea wa asili wa kusini ya Kenya, ambapho unamera weruni kavu na vitsakani vya pwani.

names.en: Pakia gives *mnyundzu* for three *Keetia* species: *K. lukei*, *K. venosa* and *K. zanzibarica*. To Digo speakers they are one kind of plant. He gives no meaning for the name, and no other language shares it. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa *mnyundzu* kwa spishi tatu za *Keetia*: *K. lukei*, *K. venosa* na *K. zanzibarica*. Kwa Wadigo, hizi ni aina moja ya mmea. Hatoi maana ya jina hili, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayolitumia. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia analavya *mnyundzu* kpwa aina tahu za *Keetia*: *K. lukei*, *K. venosa* na *K. zanzibarica*. Kpwa atu anaogomba Chidigo, ni aina mwenga ya mmea. Kalavya mana ya dzina hiri, na takuna luga yanjina inayorihumira. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.dg: Chimwenga kahi ya vitsaka vihahu vya Keetia ambavyo atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuviika phamwenga kpwa dzina mwenga.

summary.en: This mnyundzu is Keetia venosa, a shrub of the coffee family. Pakia records one Digo name, mnyundzu, for three species of Keetia.
summary.sw: Mnyundzu huu ni Keetia venosa, kichaka cha familia ya mibuni. Pakia anaandika jina moja la Kidigo, mnyundzu, kwa spishi tatu za Keetia.
summary.dg: *Mnyundzu* uhu ni Keetia venosa, chitsaka cha jamii ya kahawa. Pakia anaandika dzina mwenga ra Chidigo, *mnyundzu*, kpwa aina tahu za Keetia.

about.en:
*Keetia venosa* is a shrub, small tree or scrambler. Its leaves often have a conspicuous network of veins, which is what *venosa* refers to.

Like other plants of the genus, it has opposite leaves with small stipules between the leaf stalks, small greenish-white flowers in clusters at the leaf bases, and small fleshy fruits that are often two-lobed and ripen to black. Pakia's informants identified the *mnyundzu* plants by their leaves and fruits.
about.sw:
*Keetia venosa* ni kichaka, mti mdogo au mmea unaotambaa juu ya mingine. Mara nyingi majani yake yana mtandao wa mishipa unaoonekana wazi, na hiyo ndiyo maana ya *venosa*.

Kama mimea mingine ya jenasi hii, ina majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana yenye vikanzu vidogo (stipuli) katikati ya vikonyo vya majani, maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe katika vishada kwenye vishina vya majani, na matunda madogo yenye nyama ambayo mara nyingi yana pande mbili na huiva kuwa meusi. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliitambua mimea ya *mnyundzu* kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg:
*Keetia venosa* ni chitsaka, muhi mdide, au mmea unaoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Mara nyinji makodzage gana mishipa inayotsanganyika dza chimiya na inayoonekana waziwazi, na ndiyo mana ya neno *venosa*.

Dza mimea yanjina ya jenasi ihi, una makodza ganayolengana mairi-mairi, genye makodza madide sana (*stipules*) kahi ya milita ya makodza; maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru iriyo na chijani, ganayomera kpwa mabunda phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda; na matunda madide genye nyama, ambago mara nyinji gana seemu mbiri na ganaivwa na kukala maru. Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaimanya mimea ya *mnyundzu* kpwa makodza na matunda gao.

where.en: It is widespread in tropical Africa and grows in forest, thicket and bushland, including on the Kenya coast.
where.sw: Imeenea sana katika Afrika ya kitropiki na inaota misituni, katika vichaka vizito na vichaka, ikiwemo pwani ya Kenya.
where.dg: Unaphahikana phatu phanji kpwenye tsi za dzoho za Afrika, na unamera tsakani, vitsakani na weruni, phamwenga na pwani ya Kenya.

teaser.en: A scrambling shrub of the Zanzibar and Kenya coast, one of three plants that share the name mnyundzu.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kinachotambaa cha pwani ya Zanzibar na Kenya, mojawapo ya mimea mitatu inayoshiriki jina mnyundzu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina cha pwani ya Zanzibar na Kenya; ni mmea mmwenga kahi ya mimea mihahu inayoihwa *mnyundzu*.

summary.en: This mnyundzu is Keetia zanzibarica, a shrub of the coffee family. Pakia records one Digo name, mnyundzu, for three species of Keetia.
summary.sw: Mnyundzu huu ni Keetia zanzibarica, kichaka cha familia ya mibuni. Pakia anaandika jina moja la Kidigo, mnyundzu, kwa spishi tatu za Keetia.
summary.dg: *Mnyundzu* uhu ni Keetia zanzibarica, chitsaka cha jamii ya kahawa. Pakia anaandika dzina mwenga ra Chidigo, *mnyundzu*, kpwa aina tahu za Keetia.

about.en:
*Keetia zanzibarica* is a scrambling shrub or climber of the East African coast.

Like other plants of the genus, it has opposite leaves with small stipules between the leaf stalks, small greenish-white flowers in clusters at the leaf bases, and small fleshy fruits that are often two-lobed and ripen to black. Pakia's informants identified the *mnyundzu* plants by their leaves and fruits.
about.sw:
*Keetia zanzibarica* ni kichaka kinachotambaa juu ya mingine au mmea unaopanda wa pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.

Kama mimea mingine ya jenasi hii, ina majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana yenye vikanzu vidogo (stipuli) katikati ya vikonyo vya majani, maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe katika vishada kwenye vishina vya majani, na matunda madogo yenye nyama ambayo mara nyingi yana pande mbili na huiva kuwa meusi. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliitambua mimea ya *mnyundzu* kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg:
*Keetia zanzibarica* ni chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, au mmea wa kufyombera, wa pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.

Dza mimea yanjina ya jenasi ihi, una makodza ganayolengana mairi-mairi, genye makodza madide sana (*stipules*) kahi ya milita ya makodza; maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru iriyo na chijani, ganayomera kpwa mabunda phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda; na matunda madide genye nyama, ambago mara nyinji gana seemu mbiri na ganaivwa na kukala maru. Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaimanya mimea ya *mnyundzu* kpwa makodza na matunda gao.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, thicket and bushland along the East African coast, from Kenya to Mozambique, including Zanzibar.
where.sw: Inaota katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka vizito na vichaka kando ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, kuanzia Kenya hadi Msumbiji, ikiwemo Zanzibar.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka, vitsaka na weruni wa pwani, kanda-kanda ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, kula Kenya hadi Mozambique, phamwenga na Zanzibar.

teaser.en: Its leaves go slippery when crushed, and they are rubbed on beads to clean them.
teaser.sw: Majani yake huteleza yakipondwa, na husuguliwa kwenye shanga ili kuzisafisha.
teaser.dg: Makodzage gachihopezwa ganakala na uhereza, na ushanga nkusingwa kpwa makodza higa ili kuutsusa.

summary.en: Mnyururika is a small, velvety, grey-leaved herb with dense clusters of tiny yellow flowers. Its leaves are crushed for medicine and used to clean beads.
summary.sw: Mnyururika ni mmea mdogo wa majani ya kijivu yenye manyoya laini kama mahameli, wenye vishada vizito vya maua madogo sana ya manjano. Majani yake hupondwa kwa ajili ya dawa na hutumika kusafisha shanga.
summary.dg: *Mnyururika* ni mmea mdide wenye makodza ga rangi ya ivu genye nyere laini, na mabunda ga kubanana ga maruwa madide sana ga rangi ya mandano. Makodzage nkuhopezwa kpwa dawa, na nkuhumirwa kutsusa ushanga.

about.en:
*Mnyururika* is a small, much-branched herb or low shrub, usually knee-high or less. Its stems and leaves are covered in soft, greyish, velvety hairs. The leaves are oval, toothed and pleated along their veins. Tiny bright yellow flowers grow in dense, rounded clusters at the leaf bases.

When the leaves are crushed they give a slippery juice, which is behind one of its Digo names.
about.sw:
*Mnyururika* ni mmea mdogo wenye matawi mengi au kichaka kifupi, kwa kawaida chenye urefu wa goti au chini ya hapo. Mashina na majani yake yamefunikwa na manyoya laini ya rangi ya kijivu yaliyo kama mahameli. Majani ni ya duaradufu, yenye meno kwenye kingo na yenye mikunjo kufuata mishipa yake. Maua madogo sana ya manjano angavu huota katika vishada vizito vya mviringo kwenye vishina vya majani.

Majani yakipondwa hutoa ute unaoteleza, na hilo ndilo chanzo cha mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo.
about.dg:
*Mnyururika* ni mmea mdide wenye panda nyinji, au chitsaka chifupi, na kpwa kawaida tautsupa ure wa goti. Pandaze na makodzage vinafwinikpwa ni nyere laini za rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu. Makodza ni ga umbo ra tumbi, gana meno kanda-kanda, na ganakala na mikunjo kulunga mishipaye. Maruwa madide sana ga rangi ya mandano inayong'ala ganamera kpwa mabunda ga kubanana ga mviringo, phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda.

Makodza gachihopezwa ganalavya madzi genye uhereza, na hiro ndiro dzambo ririrolavya dzina mwenga kahi ya madzinage ga Chidigo.

where.en: It is a weed of roadsides, fallow land, grassland and disturbed sandy ground. It is found throughout the tropics, and is common along the coast.
where.sw: Ni gugu la kando ya barabara, mashamba yaliyoachwa, nyika za nyasi na ardhi ya mchanga iliyochimbuliwa. Unapatikana kote katika nchi za tropiki, na ni wa kawaida kando ya pwani.
where.dg: Ni mbondo inayomera kanda-kanda ya njira, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa, herera za nyasi na tsi ya mtsanga iriyobanangwa. Inaphahikana kpwenye tsi zosi za dzoho, na ni ya kawaida pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records that the leaves are squashed and used as medicine. They are also used to clean beads (*tsalu*). The plant is a well-known medicinal herb in many tropical countries.
uses.sw: Pakia anaandika kwamba majani hupondwa na kutumika kama dawa. Pia hutumika kusafisha shanga (*tsalu*). Mmea huu ni dawa ya mitishamba inayojulikana sana katika nchi nyingi za tropiki.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala makodza nkuhopezwa na kuhumirwa dza dawa. Piya nkuhumirwa kutsusa ushanga (*tsalu*). Kpwenye tsi nyinji za dzoho, mmea uhu ni dawa ya chienyeji inayomanyikana sana.

names.en: Pakia gives two names. *Mnyururika* means 'slippery extract': the crushed leaves give a slippery (*nyururika*) juice. *Mtsusa tsalu* means 'cleaning beads': the leaves are used for cleaning (*tsusa*) beads (*tsalu*). The Mgombato dictionary defines *tsalu* as 'beads decorating the edge of a piece of cloth'. Pakia uses both names for *Triumfetta rhomboidea* as well, and *mtsusa tsalu* also for *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. 'Sleepy morning' is an English name for the species, but it is not given by Pakia.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa majina mawili. *Mnyururika* maana yake ni 'ute unaoteleza': majani yaliyopondwa hutoa ute unaoteleza (*nyururika*). *Mtsusa tsalu* maana yake ni 'kusafisha shanga': majani hutumika kusafisha (*tsusa*) shanga (*tsalu*). Kamusi ya Mgombato inafasili *tsalu* kuwa 'shanga zinazopamba ukingo wa kipande cha nguo'. Pakia hutumia majina yote mawili pia kwa *Triumfetta rhomboidea*, na *mtsusa tsalu* pia kwa *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. Kwa Kiingereza spishi hii huitwa *sleepy morning*, lakini Pakia hatoi jina hilo.
names.dg: Pakia analavya madzina mairi. Mana ya *mnyururika* ni 'madzi genye uhereza': makodza gachihopezwa ganalavya madzi ga uhereza (*nyururika*). Mana ya *mtsusa tsalu* ni 'unaotsusa ushanga': makodza nkuhumirwa kutsusa (*tsusa*) ushanga (*tsalu*). Kamusi ya Mgombato inaeleza *tsalu* kukala ni 'ushanga unaoikpwa kanda-kanda ya chipande cha nguwo'. Pakia anahumira madzina higa mairi piya kpwa *Triumfetta rhomboidea*, na *mtsusa tsalu* piya kpwa *Abutilon zanzibaricum*. Kpwa Chingereza aina ihi inaihwa *sleepy morning*, ela dzina hiri Pakia kariandika.

teaser.en: Its Digo name says the wood cracks easily; its seeds shine like blue-black metal.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linasema mbao zake hupasuka kwa urahisi; mbegu zake hung'aa kama chuma cha rangi ya buluu-nyeusi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rinagomba kukala nyama za muhi uhu nkupalika upesi; tembeze zinang'ala dza chuma cha rangi nyiru iriyo na samawati.

summary.en: Mpalika is a widespread African forest tree whose small capsules open to show shiny, metallic blue-black seeds. The Digo name says its wood cracks easily.
summary.sw: Mpalika ni mti wa misitu ulioenea kote Afrika ambao vifuko vyake vidogo hufunguka na kuonyesha mbegu zinazong'aa za rangi ya buluu-nyeusi kama chuma. Jina la Kidigo linasema mbao zake hupasuka kwa urahisi.
summary.dg: *Mpalika* ni muhi wa tsakani unaophahikana phatu phanji Afrika, ambao makakayage madide ganavuguka na kuonyesa tembe zinazong'ala dza chuma, za rangi nyiru iriyo na samawati. Dzina ra Chidigo rinagomba kukala nyama za muhi uhu nkupalika upesi.

about.en:
*Mpalika* is a deciduous tree that can reach 25 metres, though in some places it grows as a shrub. Its branches droop, and on young trees they stand out at right angles to the trunk. The bark is thin and grey-brown, and becomes rough and flaking with age. The leaves are simple, thin and oval, about 10 cm long. Held up to the light, each leaf shows a clear, see-through edge.

Male and female flowers grow on separate trees. They are tiny, green-yellow and fragrant, and appear while the tree is bare. The fruit is a small three-part capsule that splits to release three shiny, metallic blue-black seeds.
about.sw:
*Mpalika* ni mti unaopukutisha majani unaoweza kufikia urefu wa mita 25, ingawa katika maeneo mengine hukua kama kichaka. Matawi yake huinama, na kwenye miti michanga hutokeza kwa pembe mraba kutoka kwenye shina. Gome ni jembamba na la rangi ya kijivu-hudhurungi, na huwa gumu na kubanduka kadiri mti unavyozeeka. Majani ni sahili, membamba na ya duaradufu, yenye urefu wa takriban sm 10. Ukiliinua jani kuelekea mwangaza, kila jani huonyesha ukingo ulio wazi unaopenyeza mwanga.

Maua ya kiume na ya kike huota kwenye miti tofauti. Ni madogo sana, ya rangi ya kijani-manjano na yenye harufu nzuri, na huchanua wakati mti hauna majani. Tunda ni kifuko kidogo chenye sehemu tatu kinachopasuka na kuachia mbegu tatu zinazong'aa za rangi ya buluu-nyeusi kama chuma.
about.dg:
*Mpalika* ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa kpwa wakati fulani wa mwaka. Unaweza kufika mita ishirini na tsano, ela phatu phanjina unamera dza chitsaka. Pandaze zinaelekeya photsi, na kpwa mihi midide zinatuluka kula kolo sawa-sawa kanda-kanda, dza herufi T. Gopha ni ra rangi ya ivu iriyo na rangi ya dongo, na tarina uziho; muhi uchikula, gopha rinakala gumu na kuandulika vipande-vipande. Makodza ni mazima gasigoganyika, membamba, ga umbo ra tumbi, ga ure wa sentimita 10 hivi. Uchirilola kodza dzulu kpwenye mwanga, unaona kanda-kanda ya kodza iriyo wazi, inayotsupwa ni mwanga.

Maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwa mihi tafwauti. Ni madide sana, ga rangi ya chijani na mandano, genye arufu nono, na ganatuluka wakati muhi tauna makodza. Tunda ni kakaya dide ra seemu tahu rinaroahuka na kulavya tembe tahu zinazong'ala dza chuma, za rangi nyiru iriyo na samawati.

where.en: It is found across Africa, from Senegal to Sudan and south to South Africa. In Kenya it grows from the coast to the west of the country, in moist and dry forest margins and forest remnants, and is often an early coloniser of lowland forest.
where.sw: Unapatikana kote Afrika, kuanzia Senegal hadi Sudan na kusini hadi Afrika Kusini. Nchini Kenya unaota kuanzia pwani hadi magharibi mwa nchi, pembezoni mwa misitu yenye unyevu na mikavu na katika mabaki ya misitu, na mara nyingi ni miongoni mwa miti ya kwanza kuota katika misitu ya nyanda za chini.
where.dg: Unaphahikana kosi Afrika, kula Senegal hadi Sudan, na kusini hadi Afrika Kusini. Kpwa Kenya unamera kula pwani hadi magharibi ya tsi, kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga jeke-jeke na ga kavu, na kpwenye vipande vya matsaka virivyosala. Mara nyinji ni mwenga wa mihi ya kpwandza kumera phatu tsaka ra tsi ya photsi rinaphoandza kumera tsona.

uses.en: ICRAF records it as firewood, charcoal, poles, timber for cabinet work and root medicine. Coppice shoots make good building poles.
uses.sw: ICRAF inaandika kuwa hutumika kwa kuni, mkaa, nguzo, mbao za kutengenezea kabati na samani, na dawa ya mizizi. Machipukizi yanayoota baada ya kukatwa hufanya nguzo nzuri za ujenzi.
uses.dg: ICRAF inaandika kukala unahumirwa kpwa kuni, makala, maphungo, mbao za kutengeza vyombo vya nyumba, na miziye kpwa dawa. Machipukizi ganayomera kula gutu ra muhi uriotemwa ni maphungo manono ga kudzengera.

names.en: *Mpalika* means 'cracks': Pakia records that the wood is said to crack (*palika*) easily. ICRAF, by contrast, describes the timber as hard and heavy. In Swahili it is *mjangari*, and in Giriama *mukololo*. Pakia gives no English name.
names.sw: *Mpalika* maana yake ni 'hupasuka': Pakia anaandika kwamba inasemekana mbao zake hupasuka (*palika*) kwa urahisi. ICRAF, kinyume chake, inaeleza mbao zake kuwa ngumu na nzito. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mjangari*, na kwa Kigiriama *mukololo*. Pakia hatoi jina la Kiingereza.
names.dg: Mana ya *mpalika* ni 'unaopalika': Pakia anaandika kukala nkugombwa nyama za muhi uhu nkupalika (*palika*) upesi. Ela ICRAF inaeleza mbaoze kukala ngumu na ndziho. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mjangari*, na kpwa Chigiryama ni *mukololo*. Pakia kalavya dzina ra Chingereza.

teaser.en: The 'guava of the forest': not a guava at all, but a forest shrub that reminds people of one.
teaser.sw: 'Mpera wa msituni': si mpera hata kidogo, bali ni kichaka cha msituni kinachowakumbusha watu mpera.
teaser.dg: 'Mpera wa tsakani': si mpera hata chidide, ela ni chitsaka cha tsakani chinachotambukiza atu mpera.

summary.en: Mpera wa tsakani is a shrub or small tree of the coffee family, seen by Digo speakers as the forest form of the guava. It shares its name with Vismia orientalis.
summary.sw: Mpera wa tsakani ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya mibuni, ambao Wadigo huuona kuwa aina ya msituni ya mpera. Unashiriki jina lake na Vismia orientalis.
summary.dg: *Mpera wa tsakani* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya kahawa, ambao atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuuona dza aina ya tsakani ya mpera. Dzina hiri ra Chidigo rinahumirwa piya kpwa Vismia orientalis.

about.en:
*Mpera wa tsakani* is a shrub or small tree of the coffee family. It has large, broad, opposite leaves, which is what *platyphylla*, 'broad-leaved', refers to. Like other *Leptactina*, it has showy white flowers with long, slender tubes and narrow, spreading lobes, often fragrant.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves, which explains the comparison with the guava.
about.sw:
*Mpera wa tsakani* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya mibuni. Una majani makubwa, mapana yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, na hiyo ndiyo maana ya *platyphylla*, 'wenye majani mapana'. Kama *Leptactina* wengine, una maua meupe ya kuvutia yenye mirija mirefu myembamba na ncha nyembamba za petali zinazotandaa, mara nyingi yenye harufu nzuri.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake, jambo linaloeleza kwa nini unalinganishwa na mpera.
about.dg:
*Mpera wa tsakani* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya kahawa. Una makodza makulu na mapana ganayolengana mairi-mairi, na ndiyo mana ya *platyphylla*, 'wenye makodza mapana'. Dza *Leptactina* zanjina, una maruwa mereru ganayoonekana sana, genye mirija mire na myembamba na seemu nyembamba zinazotawanyika, na mara nyinji genye arufu nono.

Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaumanya kpwa makodzage, na ndiyo sababu unalinganishwa na mpera.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in East Africa.
where.sw: Unaota katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani Afrika Mashariki.

culture.en: This is one of several Digo names built with *wa tsakani*, 'of the forest', which mark a wild forest form of a familiar planted or common plant. *Muasmini wa tsakani* is another example: it is the forest form of jasmine.
culture.sw: Hili ni mojawapo ya majina kadhaa ya Kidigo yaliyoundwa kwa *wa tsakani*, 'wa msituni', ambayo huashiria aina pori ya msituni ya mmea unaojulikana, unaopandwa au wa kawaida. *Muasmini wa tsakani* ni mfano mwingine: ni aina ya msituni ya yasmini.
culture.dg: Hiri ni dzina mwenga kahi ya madzina manji ga Chidigo ganayodzengbwa kpwa maneno *wa tsakani*, ganayoonyesa aina ya tsakani ya mmea unaomanyikana, uwe wa kuphandwa au wa kawaida. *Muasmini wa tsakani* ni mfwano wanjina: ni aina ya tsakani ya *muasmini*.

names.en: *Mpera wa tsakani* means '*mpera* in the forest'. Pakia records that the species is seen as the forest type of *mpera*, the guava (*Psidium guajava*). It is not related to the guava. Pakia uses the same name for *Vismia orientalis*. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mpera wa tsakani* maana yake ni '*mpera* wa msituni'. Pakia anaandika kwamba spishi hii inaonwa kuwa aina ya msituni ya *mpera*, yaani mpera (*Psidium guajava*). Hauna uhusiano na mpera. Pakia hutumia jina hilo hilo kwa *Vismia orientalis*. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Mana ya *mpera wa tsakani* ni '*mpera* wa tsakani'. Pakia anaandika kukala aina ihi inaonekana dza aina ya tsakani ya *mpera* (*Psidium guajava*). Si ndugu wa mpera. Pakia anahumira dzina hiri piya kpwa *Vismia orientalis*. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: Snap a twig and orange sap oozes out; Digo speakers liken this small tree to a forest guava.
teaser.sw: Vunja kitawi na utomvu wa rangi ya chungwa hutiririka; Wadigo huufananisha mti huu mdogo na mpera wa msituni.
teaser.dg: Vundza liphungo, na utomvu wa rangi ya chungbwa unatuluka chidide-chidide; atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuulinganisha muhi uhu mdide na mpera wa tsakani.

summary.en: This mpera wa tsakani is Vismia orientalis, a small forest tree with orange sap. It shares its Digo name, 'forest guava', with Leptactina platyphylla.
summary.sw: Mpera wa tsakani huu ni Vismia orientalis, mti mdogo wa msituni wenye utomvu wa rangi ya chungwa. Unashiriki jina lake la Kidigo, 'mpera wa msituni', na Leptactina platyphylla.
summary.dg: *Mpera wa tsakani* uhu ni Vismia orientalis, muhi mdide wa tsakani wenye utomvu wa rangi ya chungbwa. Dzinare ra Chidigo, 'mpera wa tsakani', rinahumirwa piya kpwa Leptactina platyphylla.

about.en:
This *mpera wa tsakani* is a shrub or small tree of the St John's wort family. Its opposite leaves are often rusty-hairy underneath and dotted with tiny glands, and broken twigs and bark bleed a yellow to orange sap. The flowers are small, with five petals, and the fruits are small berries.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mpera wa tsakani* huu ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya Hypericaceae (*St John's wort*). Majani yake yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana mara nyingi yana manyoya ya rangi ya kutu upande wa chini na yana madoa ya tezi ndogo sana, na vitawi na gome vilivyovunjika hutoa utomvu wa rangi ya manjano hadi chungwa. Maua ni madogo, yenye petali tano, na matunda ni beri ndogo.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Mpera wa tsakani* uhu ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya *St John's wort*. Makodzage ganayolengana mara nyinji gana nyere za rangi ya dongo kpwa uphande wa photsi, na gana vibara vidide sana. Maphungo na gopha vichivundzika vinalavya utomvu wa rangi ya mandano hadi rangi ya chungbwa. Maruwa ni madide, genye makodza ga ruwa tsano, na matunda ni madide na genye madzi manji.

Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows on forest edges and in coastal forest and thicket in Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Unaota pembezoni mwa misitu na katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani nchini Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka, na kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

culture.en: Like other *wa tsakani* names, it marks a forest plant that resembles a familiar one, in this case the guava.
culture.sw: Kama majina mengine ya *wa tsakani*, jina hili huashiria mmea wa msituni unaofanana na mmea unaojulikana, katika hali hii mpera.
culture.dg: Dza madzina ganjina ga *wa tsakani*, dzina hiri rinaonyesa mmea wa tsakani unaohalana na mmea unaomanyikana, na kpwa hiri ni mpera.

names.en: *Mpera wa tsakani* means '*mpera* in the forest', the forest type of *mpera*, the guava (*Psidium guajava*). Pakia uses the same name for *Leptactina platyphylla* of the coffee family. Neither is related to the guava. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mpera wa tsakani* maana yake ni '*mpera* wa msituni', aina ya msituni ya *mpera*, yaani mpera (*Psidium guajava*). Pakia hutumia jina hilo hilo kwa *Leptactina platyphylla* wa familia ya mibuni. Hakuna kati yake yenye uhusiano na mpera. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Mana ya *mpera wa tsakani* ni '*mpera* wa tsakani', aina ya tsakani ya *mpera* (*Psidium guajava*). Pakia anahumira dzina hiri piya kpwa *Leptactina platyphylla* wa jamii ya kahawa. Kahi ya mimea hino miri, takuna ambao ni ndugu wa mpera. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: An aromatic bush shrub with catkin-like spikes, and a Digo name it shares with two other plants.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha porini chenye harufu nzuri na masuke yaliyo kama vishungi, na jina la Kidigo kinachoshiriki na mimea mingine miwili.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha weruni chenye arufu, chenye milita mifupi ya maruwa madide, na dzina ra Chidigo rinarohumirwa piya kpwa mimea miiri yanjina.

summary.en: Mphatsa, also called mtsatsa, is a small aromatic shrub of the spurge family, common in dry bushland. Digo speakers also give the name mtsatsa to two Clerodendrum shrubs.
summary.sw: Mphatsa, unaoitwa pia mtsatsa, ni kichaka kidogo chenye harufu nzuri cha familia ya mibono, kinachopatikana kwa wingi katika vichaka vikavu. Wadigo pia huupa jina mtsatsa vichaka viwili vya Clerodendrum.
summary.dg: Mphatsa, unaoihwa piya mtsatsa, ni chitsaka chidide chenye arufu cha jamii ya mwono, chinachophahikana sana weruni kpwenye tsi kavu. Adigo anahumira dzina mtsatsa piya kpwa vitsaka viiri vya Clerodendrum.

about.en:
*Mphatsa* is a small, much-branched shrub of the spurge family. Its leaves are oval, toothed and softly hairy, and they smell when crushed. The tiny flowers grow in short, catkin-like spikes at the leaf bases, and the female flowers are wrapped in small leafy bracts.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mphatsa* ni kichaka kidogo chenye matawi mengi cha familia ya mibono. Majani yake ni ya duaradufu, yenye meno kwenye kingo na manyoya laini, na hutoa harufu yakipondwa. Maua madogo sana huota katika masuke mafupi yaliyo kama vishungi kwenye vishina vya majani, na maua ya kike yamefunikwa na vijani vidogo vya kukinga ua (brakti).

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia walikitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Mphatsa* ni chitsaka chidide cha jamii ya mwono, chenye panda nyinji. Makodzage ni ga umbo ra tumbi, gana meno madide kanda-kanda na nyere ndide, na ganalavya arufu ganaphohopezwa. Maruwa madide sana ganamera kpwa milita mifupi phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda, na maruwa ga chichetu ganafunikpwa ni makodza madide.

Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, thicket and rocky places in East Africa and further east, into Arabia and India.
where.sw: Kinaota katika vichaka vikavu, vichaka vizito na maeneo yenye mawe Afrika Mashariki na kuelekea mashariki zaidi, hadi Uarabuni na India.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu, kpwenye vitsaka na phatu pha mawe, Afrika Mashariki na kure zaidi uphande wa mlairo wa dzuwa, hadi Uarabuni na India.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere in East Africa and India the leaves are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Kwingineko Afrika Mashariki na India majani yake hutumika katika dawa za asili.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Phatu phanjina Afrika Mashariki na India, makodzage nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records *mphatsa*, *mtsatsa* and, in his name notes, *chitsatsa*, which he says is shared by Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. He gives no meaning. *Mtsatsa* is also Pakia's name for *Clerodendrum glabrum* and *C. incisum*, and the Mgombato dictionary gives *mtsatsa* as 'seedling'. There is no English name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mphatsa*, *mtsatsa* na, katika maelezo yake ya majina, *chitsatsa*, ambalo anasema linatumika pia katika Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Hatoi maana yake. *Mtsatsa* pia ni jina ambalo Pakia analitumia kwa *Clerodendrum glabrum* na *C. incisum*, na Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mtsatsa* kuwa 'mche'. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mphatsa*, *mtsatsa* na, kpwenye maelezoge ga madzina, *chitsatsa*, ambaro anagomba ni dzina ra Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili piya. Kalavya mana ya dzina hiri. *Mtsatsa* piya ni dzina ambaro Pakia anarihumira kpwa *Clerodendrum glabrum* na *C. incisum*, na kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *mtsatsa* kukala ni mmea mdide uriodzangbwe kukula ('seedling'). Takuna dzina ra Chingereza kpwenye maandiko.

teaser.en: A forest shrub with coffee-like leaves, studied for compounds that fight skin fungi.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha msituni chenye majani yanayofanana na ya mbuni, kinachochunguzwa kwa kemikali zake zinazopambana na fangasi wa ngozi.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha tsakani chenye makodza dza ga kahawa, ambacho kemikalize zinahenderwa utafiti kpwa kuolaga fangasi za ngozi.

summary.en: Mpukuse is an understorey shrub of the East African coastal forests, with glossy, coffee-like leaves. It belongs to the dogbane family.
summary.sw: Mpukuse ni kichaka kinachoota chini ya miti mikubwa katika misitu ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, chenye majani yanayong'aa yanayofanana na ya mbuni. Ni wa familia ya Apocynaceae.
summary.dg: Mpukuse ni chitsaka chinachomera photsi ya mihi mire kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, chenye makodza ganang'ala dza ga kahawa. Ni mmea wa jamii ya mkode.

about.en: *Mpukuse* is a shrub or small tree of the forest understorey. Its glossy, opposite leaves look like coffee leaves, which is what *coffaeoides* means. The flowers are small, white to yellowish and tubular, and the fruits are paired pods. Like many plants of the family, it is rich in alkaloids.
about.sw: *Mpukuse* ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaoota chini ya miti mikubwa msituni. Majani yake yanayong'aa, yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, yanafanana na majani ya mbuni, na hiyo ndiyo maana ya *coffaeoides*. Maua ni madogo, meupe hadi ya manjano hafifu na yenye umbo la mrija, na matunda ni maganda yaliyo kwa jozi. Kama mimea mingi ya familia hii, una alkaloidi kwa wingi.
about.dg: *Mpukuse* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaomera photsi ya mihi mire tsakani. Makodzage ganang'ala, ganamera jozi-jozi, na ganahalana na makodza ga kahawa; ndivyo *coffaeoides* inavyomaanisha. Maruwa ni madide, ga rangi nyereru hadi rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, na ni dza mrija; matunda ni makakaya ganayomera mairi-mairi. Dza mimea minji ya jamii hino, una kemikali nyinji za *alkaloid*.

where.en: It grows in the shade of coastal and lowland forest in Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Unaota kivulini katika misitu ya pwani na ya nyanda za chini nchini Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera pephoni kpwenye matsaka ga pwani na ga herera, Kenya na Tanzania.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. In Kenya the leaves are used in traditional medicine for skin conditions, and researchers have studied their alkaloids for antifungal activity.
uses.sw: Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Nchini Kenya majani yake hutumika katika dawa za asili kutibu matatizo ya ngozi, na watafiti wamechunguza alkaloidi zake kwa uwezo wake wa kupambana na fangasi.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Kenya makodzage nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji za makongo ga ngozi, na asayansi akahenda utafiti kpwa kemikali zao za *alkaloid* kulola kukala zinaweza kuolaga fangasi.

names.en: Pakia records *mpukuse* with no meaning, and no other language sharing it. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mpukuse* bila maana yake, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayotumia jina hili. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mpukuse* bila kulavya mana ya dzina hiri, na kaandika luga yanjina inayohumira dzina hiri. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: The 'perfume-root' tree: its roots are recognised by smell, though only by the oldest Digo now.
teaser.sw: Mti wa 'mzizi wa manukato': mizizi yake hutambuliwa kwa harufu, ingawa sasa ni wazee kabisa wa Kidigo tu wanaoijua.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa 'mizi ya arufu nono': miziye nkumanyikana kpwa arufu, ela sambi ni Adigo azehe kabisa tu ndio anaoimanya.

summary.en: Mrandze is a bush tree related to African blackwood, known for its fragrant roots. Pakia found that only elderly Digo still knew how to recognise it.
summary.sw: Mrandze ni mti wa vichakani, jamaa wa mpingo, unaojulikana kwa mizizi yake yenye harufu nzuri. Pakia aligundua kwamba ni wazee wa Kidigo tu waliokuwa bado wanajua kuutambua.
summary.dg: Mrandze ni muhi wa weruni, ndugu wa mphingo, unaomanyikana kpwa mizi yenye arufu nono. Pakia waona kukala ni Adigo azehe tu ambao bado kala anaweza kuumanya.

about.en:
*Mrandze* is a small to medium tree of the pea family, in the same genus as *mphingo*, African blackwood. It has compound leaves with many small leaflets, small whitish pea-like flowers in loose sprays, and flat, papery pods with one to a few seeds.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves and from the smell of its roots. He describes it as the 'perfume-root' plant, one of the few wild plants that Digo speakers identify from the root.
about.sw:
*Mrandze* ni mti mdogo hadi wa wastani wa jamii ya kunde, katika jenasi ileile ya *mphingo*, yaani mpingo. Una majani mchanganyiko yenye vijani vingi vidogo, maua madogo meupe-meupe yanayofanana na ya kunde katika vishada vilivyolegea, na maganda bapa yaliyo kama karatasi yenye mbegu moja hadi chache.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake na kwa harufu ya mizizi yake. Anaueleza kuwa mmea wa 'mzizi wa manukato', mojawapo ya mimea michache ya porini ambayo Wadigo huitambua kwa mzizi.
about.dg:
*Mrandze* ni muhi mdide hadi wa chiasi wa jamii ya kunde, wa jenasi mwenga na *mphingo*. Chila kodza rinaganyika kuhenda makodza madide manji; maruwage ni madide, ga rangi nyereru ngushu-ngushu dza ga kunde, na ganamera kpwa mafungu ganayotawanyika; makakayage ni ga bapa na membamba dza karatasi, genye tembe mwenga hadi tembe chache.

Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaumanya kpwa makodzage na kpwa arufu ya miziye. Pakia anauandika dza mmea wa 'mizi ya arufu nono', mwenga kahi ya mimea michache ya weruni ambayo Adigo anaimanya kpwa mizi.

where.en: It grows in woodland and bushland in eastern and south-eastern Africa, including the bush of the Kenya coast.
where.sw: Unaota katika mapori ya miti na vichaka mashariki na kusini-mashariki mwa Afrika, ikiwemo vichaka vya pwani ya Kenya.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga wazi na weruni, Afrika Mashariki na kusini-mlairo wa dzuwa wa Afrika, phamwenga na weruni wa pwani ya Kenya.

uses.en: The fragrant root was valued for its scent, but Pakia found that this use is no longer practised.
uses.sw: Mzizi wake wenye harufu nzuri ulithaminiwa kwa harufu yake, lakini Pakia aligundua kwamba matumizi haya hayafanyiki tena.
uses.dg: Mizi yenye arufu nono kala inatogolwa kpwa arufuye, ela Pakia waona kukala matumizi higa tagahendwa tsona.

culture.en: Pakia reports that only elderly Digo could recognise *mrandze*, because its uses are no longer practised. It is an example of plant knowledge fading as the uses behind it disappear.
culture.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba ni wazee wa Kidigo tu walioweza kuutambua *mrandze*, kwa sababu matumizi yake hayafanyiki tena. Ni mfano wa maarifa ya mimea yanayofifia kadiri matumizi yaliyoyategemeza yanavyotoweka.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala ni Adigo azehe tu ambao kala anaweza kuumanya *mrandze*, kpwa sababu matumiziye tagahendwa tsona. Ni mfwano wa marifwa ga mimea kuyaya wakati mimea ichiricha kuhumirwa.

names.en: Pakia records *mrandze* and notes that Duruma shares the name. He gives no meaning. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mrandze* na anabainisha kwamba Kiduruma pia kinatumia jina hili. Hatoi maana yake. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mrandze* na anagomba kukala Aduruma nao anahumira dzina hiri. Kalavya mana ya dzina hiri. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

teaser.dg: Mriga wa weruni 'wa handzo': unahalana sana na *mriga* unaoriwa hata dzinare rinakuonya kukala sio mriga wa kpweli.

summary.en: Mriga yere is a wild yam that closely resembles mriga, the edible bitter yam. Its name marks it as the false one. The exact species has not been identified.
summary.sw: Mriga yere ni kiazi kikuu pori kinachofanana sana na mriga, kiazi kikuu chungu kinacholiwa. Jina lake linakionyesha kuwa ndicho cha bandia. Spishi yake kamili haijatambuliwa.
summary.dg: Mriga yere ni mriga wa weruni unaohalana sana na mriga, mriga wa utsungu unaoriwa. Dzinare rinauonyesa kukala ndio wa handzo. Ainaye kamili taidzangbwemanyikana.

about.en: *Mriga yere* is a wild yam, a twining vine that grows from an underground tuber and climbs through bushes each rainy season. Pakia identifies it only to genus, *Dioscorea*. It closely resembles *mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*), the three-leaved bitter yam, which Digo speakers dig as food.
about.sw: *Mriga yere* ni kiazi kikuu pori, mtambaa unaojizungusha ambao huota kutoka kwenye kiazi kilicho chini ya ardhi na hupanda juu ya vichaka kila msimu wa mvua. Pakia anakitambua hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, *Dioscorea*. Kinafanana sana na *mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*), kiazi kikuu chungu chenye majani ya sehemu tatu, ambacho Wadigo hukichimba kwa chakula.
about.dg: *Mriga yere* ni mriga wa weruni, mmea unaodzilinga-linga unaomera kula kpwa chiazi chiricho tsini, na chila wakati wa mvula unaambuka dzulu ya vitsaka. Pakia analavya jenasi tu, *Dioscorea*. Unahalana sana na *mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*), mriga wa utsungu wenye makodza madide mahahu kpwa chila kodza, ambao Adigo anautsimba kpwa chakurya.

where.en: Wild yams grow in coastal bush, thicket and forest edges, climbing over other plants.
where.sw: Viazi vikuu pori huota katika vichaka vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, vikipanda juu ya mimea mingine.
where.dg: Miriga ya weruni inamera weruni pwani, kpwenye vitsaka na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, ichiambuka dzulu ya mimea yanjina.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. Its name sets it apart from the edible *mriga*, and many wild yams are poisonous unless carefully prepared. Wild yams should only be dug and eaten by people who know them well.
uses.sw: Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote. Jina lake linakitenga na *mriga* unaoliwa, na viazi vikuu pori vingi vina sumu visipotayarishwa kwa uangalifu. Viazi vikuu pori vinapaswa kuchimbwa na kuliwa tu na watu wanaovijua vizuri.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi. Dzinare rinautafwautisha na *mriga* unaoriwa, na miriga minji ya weruni ina sumu ichikala taitengezwa kpwa makini. Miriga ya weruni ni lazima itsimbwe na kuriwa ni atu anaoimanya chikpweli-kpweli tu.

names.en: App. VI translates *mriga yere* as 'false *mriga*', a plant closely resembling the genuine edible *Dioscorea dumetorum*. In his main text, Pakia instead suggests that *mriga yeri* refers to a small type of *mriga*, and says this still needs to be confirmed. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Kiambatisho VI kinatafsiri *mriga yere* kuwa '*mriga* bandia', mmea unaofanana sana na *Dioscorea dumetorum* halisi unaoliwa. Katika maandishi yake makuu, Pakia badala yake anapendekeza kwamba *mriga yeri* inarejelea aina ndogo ya *mriga*, na anasema hili bado linahitaji kuthibitishwa. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: App. VI inatafasiri *mriga yere* dza '*mriga* wa handzo', mmea unaohalana sana na *Dioscorea dumetorum* wa kpweli unaoriwa. Ela kpwenye maandikoge makulu, Pakia anagomba kukala *mriga yeri* inaweza kukala ni aina ndide ya *mriga*, na kukala dzambo hiri bado rinahitaji kuhakikishwa. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

reason.dg: Mriga unaoriwa ambao unahalana nao

teaser.en: Its Digo name calls it the guardian of the water pond, and that is exactly where you find it standing.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linauita mlinzi wa bwawa la maji, na hapo ndipo hasa utakapoukuta ukiwa umesimama.
teaser.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo rinauiha 'mrindzi wa ziya ra madzi', na ziyani ndiko hasa unakouona uchiima.

summary.en: Mrinda ziya is a soft-wooded, aromatic shrub of pond edges and wet hollows. Its Digo name, 'water pond protector', describes where it grows.
summary.sw: Mrinda ziya ni kichaka chenye mbao laini na harufu nzuri, kinachoota kandokando ya mabwawa na kwenye mabonde yenye unyevu. Jina lake la Kidigo, 'mlinzi wa bwawa la maji', linaeleza mahali kinapoota.
summary.dg: Mrinda ziya ni chitsaka chenye nyama za muhi laini na arufu, chinachomera kanda-kanda ya maziya na kpwenye madimbwi. Dzinare ra Chidigo, 'mrindzi wa ziya ra madzi', rinaonyesa phatu unaphomera.

about.en: Mrinda ziya is a bushy shrub, usually head-high or a little more, with soft, slightly hairy grey-green leaves that smell strongly when crushed. At the ends of the branches it carries small, crowded flower heads in pink to mauve, typical of the daisy family but without obvious petals. Pakia notes that the Digo recognise it by the look of the whole plant rather than by any single part.
about.sw: Mrinda ziya ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi, kwa kawaida kimo cha mtu au zaidi kidogo, chenye majani laini ya kijivu-kijani yenye vinyweleo kidogo, yanayotoa harufu kali yakipondwa. Kwenye ncha za matawi huzaa vichwa vidogo vya maua vilivyosongamana, vya rangi ya waridi hadi zambarau hafifu, kama ilivyo kawaida katika familia ya Asteraceae (jamii ya daisy), ila bila petali zinazoonekana wazi. Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima badala ya sehemu moja moja.
about.dg: Mrinda ziya ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji, kpwa kawaida cha ure wa chimo cha mutu au zaidi chidide, chenye makodza laini ga chijani iriyotsanganyika na rangi ya ivu, genye nyere chache, ganayolavya arufu kali ganaphohopezwa. Kpwa ntsa za panda unalavya mafungu madide ga maruwa manji phamwenga, ga pinki hadi zambarau ngushu-ngushu, dza mimea ya jamii ya *daisy*, ela bila makodza ga ruwa ganayoonekana. Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya kpwa sura ya mmea wosi, si kpwa seemu mwenga tu.

where.en: It grows wherever water collects: around seasonal ponds (ziya), in wet hollows and along ditches and stream margins. It tolerates wet and somewhat salty ground, so it is often one of the few shrubs standing in a pond basin after the water has dried back.
where.sw: Huota popote maji yanapokusanyika: kuzunguka mabwawa ya msimu (ziya), kwenye mabonde yenye unyevu, kando ya mitaro na kingo za vijito. Huvumilia ardhi yenye maji na yenye chumvi kiasi, hivyo mara nyingi ni mojawapo ya vichaka vichache vinavyobaki vimesimama ndani ya bwawa baada ya maji kukauka.
where.dg: Unamera chila phatu ambapho madzi ganaima: kanda-kanda ya maziya ga wakati wa mvula (ziya), kpwenye madimbwi na kanda-kanda ya mitaru na miho. Unavumirira tsi ya madzi-madzi na yenye munyu chidide, kpwa hivyo mara nyinji ni mwenga kahi ya vitsaka vichache vinavyosala vichiima ndani ya ziya madzi gachiuma.

culture.en: The name is a small description of the landscape. Pakia uses it as an example of how Digo plant names mark habitat: species of freshwater ponds carry the affix ziya, as in Mrinda ziya and Ndago ziya, the nutgrass of wet places.
culture.sw: Jina hili ni maelezo mafupi ya mandhari. Pakia analitumia kama mfano wa jinsi majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanavyoonyesha makazi: spishi za mabwawa ya maji baridi hubeba kiambishi ziya, kama katika Mrinda ziya na Ndago ziya, ndago wa mahali penye maji.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri ni dza maelezo madide ga tsi phatu unaphomera. Pakia anarihumira dza mfwano wa vira madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganavyoonyesa phatu mmea unaphomera: aina za maziya ga madzi gasigo na munyu zina neno ziya kpwenye madzina gao, dza Mrinda ziya na Ndago ziya, nyasi ya phatu pha madzi-madzi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mrinda ziya and explains it as 'water pond protector', because the shrub is so commonly found near ponds. No other Mijikenda or Swahili name is recorded for it. In English it is called marsh fleabane; its scientific name is Pluchea dioscoridis.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mrinda ziya na kulifafanua kuwa 'mlinzi wa bwawa la maji', kwa sababu kichaka hiki hupatikana mara nyingi karibu na mabwawa. Hakuna jina jingine la Kimijikenda wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *marsh fleabane*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Pluchea dioscoridis.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mrinda ziya na anarieleza dza 'mrindzi wa ziya ra madzi', kpwa sababu chitsaka hichi nkuphahikana sana phephi na maziya. Takuna dzina ranjina ra Chimijikenda wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *marsh fleabane*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni Pluchea dioscoridis.

reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha jenasi Pluchea, kilichopewa jina kutokana na uvuvi
reason.dg: Chitsaka chanjina cha Pluchea, dzinare rinahusu kuvuwa ng'onda

reason.sw: Nao pia hubeba kiambishi cha 'bwawa', ziya
reason.dg: Nayo ina neno ziya ('ziya ra madzi') kpwenye dzinare

reason.en: Named for its liking for water
reason.sw: Umepewa jina kwa sababu ya kupenda maji
reason.dg: Dzinare rinaonyesa kukala unamendza madzi

reason.en: Another plant of ponds
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa mabwawani
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa maziya

teaser.en: A roadside weed with a long green whip of a flower spike, dotted each morning with a few small blue flowers.
teaser.sw: Gugu la kando ya barabara lenye shada refu la kijani la ua kama mjeledi, linalopambwa kila asubuhi na maua machache madogo ya buluu.
teaser.dg: Mbondo wa kanda-kanda ya njira wenye mlita mure wa chijani dza chikoto, ambao chila ligundzu unakala na maruwa machache madide ga samawati.

summary.en: Mruwa is the blue porterweed, a low shrubby weed of open ground with small blue flowers on long, stiff spikes. Pakia lists it among the few plants the Digo identify by their flowers, because it is valued as an ornament.
summary.sw: Mruwa ni *blue porterweed*, gugu fupi lenye umbo la kichaka la maeneo ya wazi, lenye maua madogo ya buluu kwenye mashada marefu yaliyo magumu. Pakia anauorodhesha miongoni mwa mimea michache ambayo Wadigo huitambua kwa maua yake, kwa sababu unathaminiwa kama pambo.
summary.dg: Mruwa (*blue porterweed*) ni mmea mfupi dza chitsaka unaomera dza mbondo kpwenye tsi ya wazi, wenye maruwa madide ga samawati kpwenye milita mire na migumu. Pakia anauika kahi ya mimea michache ambayo Adigo anaimanya kpwa maruwage, kpwa sababu unatogolwa dza pambo.

about.en: Mruwa is a low, branching, somewhat woody herb, usually knee- to waist-high, with toothed, slightly rough leaves in opposite pairs. Its flowers come on long, thin green spikes that stand up like whips. Only a few flowers open at a time, small and bright blue to violet, set into the spike, and they last a single day.
about.sw: Mruwa ni mmea mfupi wenye matawi, wenye ugumu wa kimti kiasi, kwa kawaida kimo cha goti hadi kiuno, wenye majani yenye meno na yanayokwaruza kidogo, yaliyopangwa jozi kwa jozi kukabiliana. Maua yake huja kwenye mashada marefu membamba ya kijani yanayosimama wima kama mijeledi. Maua machache tu hufunguka kwa wakati mmoja; ni madogo, ya buluu angavu hadi zambarau, yaliyopachikwa kwenye shada, na hudumu siku moja tu.
about.dg: Mruwa ni mmea mfupi wenye panda nyinji na wenye ugumu dza wa muhi chidide, kpwa kawaida wa ure wa goti hadi chunu, wenye makodza gana meno madide kanda-kanda, gasigo laini, ganayomera jozi-jozi. Maruwage ganamera kpwa milita mire, membamba na ya chijani, inayoima dzulu dza vikoto. Maruwa machache tu ndigo ganavuguka kpwa wakati mmwenga; ni madide, ga samawati inayong'ala hadi zambarau, ganakala ndani ya mlita, na ganakaa siku mwenga tu.

where.en: Originally from tropical America, it is now a common weed of roadsides, compounds, farm edges and waste ground along the coast. It is also grown in gardens, and butterflies visit it constantly.
where.sw: Asili yake ni Amerika ya kitropiki, lakini sasa ni gugu la kawaida kando ya barabara, katika viwanja vya nyumba, pembezoni mwa mashamba na kwenye ardhi isiyotumika katika pwani nzima. Pia hupandwa bustanini, na vipepeo huutembelea bila kukoma.
where.dg: Asiliye ni tsi za dzoho za Amerika, ela sambi ni mbondo wa kawaida kanda-kanda ya njira, mihalani, kanda-kanda ya minda na kpwenye tsi isiyohumirwa pwani. Piya nkuphandwa busitanini, na popho nkuuphiya chila wakati.

uses.en: Pakia records it among plants valued for ornament, alongside bougainvillea, yellow oleander and lantana.
uses.sw: Pakia anaurekodi miongoni mwa mimea inayothaminiwa kama pambo, pamoja na *bougainvillea*, mharita (yellow oleander) na mvuti (lantana).
uses.dg: Pakia anauandika kahi ya mimea inayotogolwa dza mapambo, phamwenga na mboganvila, mkode na mjasasa.

culture.en: Digo people seldom use flowers to tell plants apart; Pakia found they mostly look at leaves. The exceptions are plants whose flowers matter to people, such as perfume plants and ornamentals, and Mruwa is one of them. The name itself appears linked to the Digo word ruwa (flower) and to maruwa, the beautifying decorations Pakia describes, but Pakia does not give its meaning.
culture.sw: Wadigo mara chache hutumia maua kutofautisha mimea; Pakia aligundua kwamba mara nyingi wao huangalia majani. Isipokuwa ni mimea ambayo maua yake yana maana kwa watu, kama mimea ya manukato na ya mapambo, na Mruwa ni mmojawapo. Jina lenyewe linaonekana kuhusiana na neno la Kidigo ruwa (ua) na maruwa, mapambo ya urembo anayoyaeleza Pakia, lakini Pakia hatoi maana yake.
culture.dg: Adigo mara chache anahumira maruwa kutafwautisha mimea; Pakia waona kukala mara nyinji analola makodza. Mimea ambayo maruwage gana samani kpwa atu, dza mimea ya arufu nono na ya mapambo, ndiyo inayotafwautishwa kpwa maruwa, na Mruwa ni mwenga wao. Dzina hiri rinaoneka kuhusiana na neno ra Chidigo ruwa (ruwa ra mmea) na maruwa, mapambo ga kudzipamba ganayoelezwa ni Pakia, ela Pakia kalavya mana ya dzina hiri.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mruwa. In English it is blue porterweed or Jamaica vervain; its scientific name is Stachytarpheta jamaicensis. No Swahili name is given in the sources used here.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mruwa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *blue porterweed* au *Jamaica vervain*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Stachytarpheta jamaicensis. Vyanzo vilivyotumika hapa havitoi jina la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mruwa. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *blue porterweed* au *Jamaica vervain*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni Stachytarpheta jamaicensis. Maandiko garigohumirwa hipha tagana dzina ra Chiswahili.

teaser.en: The soap plant: its fruits were a homemade substitute for detergent.
teaser.sw: Mmea wa sabuni: matunda yake yalikuwa mbadala wa sabuni uliotengenezwa nyumbani.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa sabuni: matundage kala ganahumirwa dza sabuni ya kaya badala ya sabuni ya kugula.

summary.en: Msabuni is a Jatropha, a soft-stemmed plant whose fruits the Digo use in place of soap. Its name simply means 'soap'.
summary.sw: Msabuni ni mmea wa jenasi Jatropha, wenye shina laini, ambao matunda yake Wadigo huyatumia badala ya sabuni. Jina lake lina maana ya 'sabuni' tu.
summary.dg: Msabuni ni aina ya Jatropha, mmea wenye kolo laini ambao matundage Adigo anagahumira badala ya sabuni. Dzinare rina mana ya 'sabuni' tu.

about.en: Pakia identified Msabuni only to genus, as a species of Jatropha, and the Digo recognise it by the look of the whole plant. Jatrophas are soft-wooded shrubs or herbs with milky or watery sap, lobed leaves and small, often greenish or red flowers, followed by three-sided capsules holding oily seeds.
about.sw: Pakia aliutambua Msabuni hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, kama spishi ya Jatropha, na Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima. Mimea ya Jatropha ni vichaka au mimea ya mbao laini yenye utomvu wa maziwa au wa majimaji, majani yenye pindo, na maua madogo ambayo mara nyingi ni ya kijani au mekundu, yakifuatwa na vifuko vyenye pande tatu vilivyo na mbegu zenye mafuta.
about.dg: Pakia waumanya Msabuni hadi jenasi tu, dza aina ya Jatropha, na Adigo anaumanya kpwa sura ya mmea wosi. Mimea ya Jatropha ni vitsaka au mimea midide yenye nyama za muhi laini, yenye maziya au utomvu, makodza ganayoganyika kpwa seemu, na maruwa madide, mara nyinji ga chijani ngushu-ngushu au ga kundu; maruwa gachimala kunamera matunda makavu ga pembe tahu ganayokala na tembe zenye mafuha.

where.en: Pakia does not say where it was collected. Jatrophas on the coast grow in dry bushland, on farm edges and as hedges around homesteads.
where.sw: Pakia haelezi ulikusanywa wapi. Pwani, mimea ya Jatropha huota katika vichaka vikavu, pembezoni mwa mashamba na kama ua kuzunguka makazi.
where.dg: Pakia kagomba ni kuphi ambako mmea hinyu wahalwa. Pwani, Jatropha inamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu, kanda-kanda ya minda na dza lichigo kuzunguluka midzi.

uses.en: The fruits are used as an alternative to detergent, for washing. Jatropha seeds and sap are poisonous if eaten, so the plant is a washing aid, not a food.
uses.sw: Matunda yake hutumika kama mbadala wa sabuni kwa kufulia na kuoshea. Mbegu na utomvu wa Jatropha ni sumu vikiliwa, kwa hiyo mmea huu ni msaada wa kuoshea, si chakula.
uses.dg: Matunda nkuhumirwa badala ya sabuni, kpwa kusuwa vitu. Tembe na utomvu wa Jatropha vina sumu mutu achivirya, kpwa hivyo mmea uhu ni wa kusuwira, si wa kurya.

culture.en: Pakia lists Msabuni among Digo names that describe a plant's product: the plant is named after the thing it is used to make, like Msuwaki (toothbrush) and Msusu (bird trap).
culture.sw: Pakia anauorodhesha Msabuni miongoni mwa majina ya Kidigo yanayoeleza zao la mmea: mmea hupewa jina la kitu kinachotengenezwa kwa kuutumia, kama Msuwaki (mswaki) na Msusu (mtego wa ndege).
culture.dg: Pakia anauika Msabuni kahi ya madzina ga Chidigo ganayoonyesa chitu chinacholavywa ni mmea: mmea unaihwa kpwa dzina ra chitu unachohumirwa kuhenda, dza Msuwaki (msuwaki) na Msusu (muhambo wa ndege).

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Msabuni, meaning 'soap' (sabuni), shared with Duruma. The scientific name is Jatropha sp.; the species was not determined.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Msabuni, lenye maana ya 'sabuni', linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma. Jina la kisayansi ni Jatropha sp.; spishi yake haikubainishwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Msabuni, rina mana ya 'sabuni' (sabuni), na Aduruma nao anarihumira. Dzina ra chisayansi ni Jatropha sp.; aina hasa taidzangbwemanyikana.

teaser.en: A small ebony with wood so hard that botanists named it after iron.
teaser.sw: Mpingo mdogo wenye mbao ngumu kiasi kwamba wataalamu wa mimea waliupa jina la chuma.
teaser.dg: Muhi mdide wa jamii ya mbara wenye nyama za muhi ngumu sana hata asayansi a mimea akauiha dzina kula kpwa chuma.

summary.en: Mshipa is a small tree or shrub of the ebony family, Diospyros ferrea, found in coastal bush and forest. Pakia records only its name.
summary.sw: Mshipa ni mti mdogo au kichaka cha familia ya abunusi (ebony), Diospyros ferrea, kinachopatikana katika vichaka na misitu ya pwani. Pakia anarekodi jina lake tu.
summary.dg: Mshipa ni muhi mdide au chitsaka cha jamii ya mbara, Diospyros ferrea, unaophahikana weruni na matsakani ga pwani. Pakia anaandika dzinare tu.

about.en: Mshipa is a shrub or small tree with neat, leathery, glossy leaves arranged alternately along the twigs and dark bark. Like other ebonies it bears small, pale, bell-shaped flowers and small round fruits that ripen from orange to black. Its scientific name ferrea, 'of iron', refers to its very hard, heavy wood.
about.sw: Mshipa ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani nadhifu, magumu kama ngozi na yanayong'aa, yaliyopangwa kwa kupishana kwenye vitawi, na gome jeusi. Kama mipingo mingine, huzaa maua madogo, meupe hafifu, yenye umbo la kengele, na matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva kutoka rangi ya chungwa hadi meusi. Jina lake la kisayansi ferrea, 'wa chuma', linarejelea mbao zake ngumu na nzito sana.
about.dg: Mshipa ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza manono, magumu dza chingo na ganang'ala, ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana kanda-kanda ya maphungo, na gopha ra rangi ya giza. Dza mihi yanjina ya jamii ya mbara, unalavya maruwa madide ga rangi ngushu-ngushu ga umbo ra kengele, na matunda madide ga mviringo ganayoivwa kula rangi ya chungbwa hadi kukala maru. Dzinare ra chisayansi ferrea, 'wa chuma', rinahusu nyama za muhi uhu ngumu sana na nzito.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and dry forest, including coral-rag country, along the East African coast and across the Indian Ocean region.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka, vichaka-mwitu vizito na misitu mikavu ya pwani, ikiwemo maeneo ya mawe ya matumbawe, kando ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki na katika eneo lote la Bahari ya Hindi.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani, kpwenye vitsaka na matsaka makavu, phamwenga na tsi ya mawe ga bahari, kanda-kanda ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki na kosi eneo ra Bahari ya Hindi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mshipa but gives no meaning or shared names. In Mgombato, mshipa is the ordinary word for a vein or tendon, and also for certain pains and illnesses, but no link to the tree is recorded. Its scientific name is Diospyros ferrea.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mshipa lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Katika Mgombato, mshipa ni neno la kawaida la mshipa wa damu au kano, na pia la maumivu na magonjwa fulani, lakini hakuna uhusiano na mti huu uliorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Diospyros ferrea.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mshipa ela kalavya mana ya dzina hiri wala madzina ga luga zanjina. Kpwenye Mgombato, mshipa ni neno ra kawaida ra mshipa wa mwiri au kano, na piya ra utsungu na makongo ganjina, ela takuna uhusiano na muhi uhu uriondikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Diospyros ferrea.

teaser.en: A twining Grewia whose second name, Mbavubavu, points to a healer's remedy for convulsions of the ribs.
teaser.sw: Grewia inayojisokota, ambayo jina lake la pili, Mbavubavu, linaashiria dawa ya mganga kwa degedege la mbavu.
teaser.dg: Grewia unaodzilinga-linga ambao dzinare ra phiri, Mbavubavu, rinaonyesa dawa ya mganga ya nyuni za mbavu.

summary.en: Msokoto is a scrambling Grewia shrub of the coastal bush, named for the way it twines. Pakia also records it under Mbavubavu, the name of a remedy for nyuni wa mbavuni, convulsions affecting the rib cage.
summary.sw: Msokoto ni kichaka cha jenasi Grewia kinachotambaa juu ya vichaka vingine katika vichaka vya pwani, na kimepewa jina kutokana na jinsi kinavyojisokota. Pakia pia anakirekodi kwa jina Mbavubavu, jina la dawa ya nyuni wa mbavuni, degedege linaloathiri mbavu.
summary.dg: Msokoto ni chitsaka cha Grewia cha weruni pwani chinachotandazika dzulu ya mimea yanjina, na dzinare rinalavywa kpwa vira unavyodzilinga-linga. Pakia piya anauandika kpwa dzina Mbavubavu, dzina ra dawa ya nyuni wa mbavuni, nyuni zinazogbwira mbavu.

about.en: Msokoto is a scrambling or twining shrub with alternate, toothed leaves that have three main veins from the base, typical of Grewia. Its small star-shaped flowers are followed by small lobed fruits. Pakia notes that it grows in a twining form, and the name says the same.
about.sw: Msokoto ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kujisokota, chenye majani yanayopishana, yenye meno, na mishipa mitatu mikuu kutoka kwenye kitako, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa Grewia. Maua yake madogo yenye umbo la nyota hufuatwa na matunda madogo yenye pindo. Pakia anaeleza kwamba huota kwa umbo la kujisokota, na jina lake linasema hivyo hivyo.
about.dg: Msokoto ni chitsaka chinachotandazika au kudzilinga-linga, chenye makodza ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana, gana meno madide kanda-kanda na mishipa mikulu mihahu inayolavywa kula photsi ya kodza, dza irivyo kpwa Grewia. Maruwage madide ga umbo ra nyota gachimala kunamera matunda madide ganayoganyika kpwa seemu. Pakia anaandika kukala unamera kpwa kudzilinga-linga, na dzina piya rinagomba dzambo hiro.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and thicket, scrambling over other shrubs.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani, ukitambaa juu ya vichaka vingine.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani na vitsakani, uchitandazika dzulu ya vitsaka vyanjina.

uses.en: Under the name Mbavubavu, Pakia lists this Grewia among the plants used to treat nyuni wa mbavuni, convulsions affecting the rib cage. This is reported practice, not advice.
uses.sw: Kwa jina Mbavubavu, Pakia anaiorodhesha Grewia hii miongoni mwa mimea inayotumika kutibu nyuni wa mbavuni, degedege linaloathiri mbavu. Huu ni utaratibu ulioripotiwa, si ushauri.
uses.dg: Kpwa dzina Mbavubavu, Pakia anauika Grewia hinyu kahi ya mimea inayohumirwa kuphoza nyuni wa mbavuni, nyuni zinazogbwira mbavu. Hiri ni dzambo ririroandikpwa atu anavyohenda, si ushauri.

culture.en: Mbavubavu comes from mbavu (rib), and Pakia gives it as an example of a plant named after the illness it treats.
culture.sw: Mbavubavu linatokana na mbavu, na Pakia analitoa kama mfano wa mmea uliopewa jina la ugonjwa unaoutibu.
culture.dg: Mbavubavu rinalavywa kula neno mbavu (mbavu), na Pakia anarilavya dza mfwano wa mmea unaoihwa kpwa dzina ra ukongo unaouphoza.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names. Msokoto means 'twine', from sokota (to twist), because the plant grows twining; the word is shared with Swahili. Mbavubavu, 'rib', is shared with Duruma and Giriama. Both names are also used for Grewia holstii, and Mbavubavu is the root of Mbavubavu mkulu (Grewia forbesii) and Mbavubavu mdide (Premna resinosa).
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo. Msokoto lina maana ya 'kusokota', kutoka sokota, kwa sababu mmea huota ukijisokota; neno hili linatumika pia kwa Kiswahili. Mbavubavu, 'mbavu', linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Majina yote mawili hutumika pia kwa Grewia holstii, na Mbavubavu ndilo shina la Mbavubavu mkulu (Grewia forbesii) na Mbavubavu mdide (Premna resinosa).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo. Msokoto rina mana ya 'chitu chinachosokotwa', kula sokota (kusokota), kpwa sababu mmea unamera uchidzilinga-linga; neno hiri ni sawa na ra Chiswahili. Mbavubavu, 'mbavu', ni dzina ra Chiduruma na Chigiryama piya. Madzina gosi mairi piya ganahumirwa kpwa Grewia holstii, na Mbavubavu ndiro dzina ra msingi ra Mbavubavu mkulu (Grewia forbesii) na Mbavubavu mdide (Premna resinosa).
