teaser.en: One shrub, three Digo names: the twiner, Msuko, and the rib plant used against convulsions.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kimoja, majina matatu ya Kidigo: kinachojisokota, Msuko, na mmea wa mbavu unaotumika dhidi ya degedege.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chimwenga, madzina mahahu ga Chidigo: Msokoto, mmea unaodzilinga-linga; Msuko; na Mbavubavu, mmea wa mbavu unaohumirwa kpwa nyuni.

summary.en: This Msokoto is Grewia holstii, a scrambling shrub of coastal bush. Pakia records it as a remedy, under the name Mbavubavu, for convulsions affecting the rib cage.
summary.sw: Msokoto huu ni Grewia holstii, kichaka kinachotambaa katika vichaka vya pwani. Pakia anaurekodi kama dawa, kwa jina Mbavubavu, ya degedege linaloathiri mbavu.
summary.dg: Msokoto uhu ni Grewia holstii, chitsaka chinachotandazika weruni pwani. Pakia anauandika dza dawa, kpwa dzina Mbavubavu, ya nyuni zinazogbwira mbavu.

about.en: Grewia holstii is a scrambling shrub or liana-like bush with long, arching branches. Its leaves are alternate, toothed and three-veined from the base, and its small flowers are yellowish with five narrow petals. The fruits are small, two- to four-lobed and orange-brown when ripe.
about.sw: Grewia holstii ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kichaka kinachofanana na mtambaa, chenye matawi marefu yaliyopinda kama tao. Majani yake yanapishana, yana meno na mishipa mitatu kutoka kwenye kitako, na maua yake madogo ni ya manjano hafifu yenye petali tano nyembamba. Matunda ni madogo, yenye pindo mbili hadi nne, na ya rangi ya chungwa-kahawia yakiiva.
about.dg: Grewia holstii ni chitsaka chinachotandazika au chinachodzilinga-linga dza mmea wa kulinga-linga, chenye panda mire zinazoinama. Makodzage ganamera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana, gana meno madide kanda-kanda na mishipa mihahu kula photsi ya kodza, na maruwage madide ni ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu genye makodza ga ruwa tsano membamba. Matunda ni madide, ganaganyika kpwa seemu mbiri hadi nne, na ni ga rangi ya chungbwa na dongo ganaphoivwa.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal bushland and thicket, often climbing through other shrubs.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani, mara nyingi ukipanda kupitia vichaka vingine.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani kpwenye tsi kavu na vitsakani, mara nyinji uchiambuka kahi ya vitsaka vyanjina.

uses.en: Pakia's naming appendix lists Grewia holstii, with G. forbesii, as Mbavubavu, used to treat nyuni wa mbavuni, convulsions affecting the rib cage. This is reported practice, not advice.
uses.sw: Kiambatisho cha majina cha Pakia kinaorodhesha Grewia holstii, pamoja na G. forbesii, kama Mbavubavu, unaotumika kutibu nyuni wa mbavuni, degedege linaloathiri mbavu. Huu ni utaratibu ulioripotiwa, si ushauri.
uses.dg: Nyongeza ya madzina ya Pakia inaandika Grewia holstii, phamwenga na G. forbesii, dza Mbavubavu, inayohumirwa kuphoza nyuni wa mbavuni, nyuni zinazogbwira mbavu. Hiri ni dzambo ririroandikpwa atu anavyohenda, si ushauri.

culture.en: Pakia uses Mbavubavu to show how one Digo name can cover several scientific species: the Digo treat Grewia holstii and G. ectasicarpa as one kind of plant.
culture.sw: Pakia anatumia Mbavubavu kuonyesha jinsi jina moja la Kidigo linavyoweza kujumuisha spishi kadhaa za kisayansi: Wadigo huichukulia Grewia holstii na G. ectasicarpa kuwa aina moja ya mmea.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira Mbavubavu kuonyesa vira dzina rimwenga ra Chidigo rinavyoweza kuhusu aina nyinji za chisayansi: Adigo anaona Grewia holstii na G. ectasicarpa dza aina mwenga ya mmea.

names.en: Pakia records three Digo names. Msokoto, 'twine', from sokota (to twist), is shared with Swahili. Mbavubavu, 'rib', is shared with Duruma and Giriama. Msuko is also used for Colubrina asiatica, and no meaning is given for it. Msokoto and Mbavubavu are also used for Grewia ectasicarpa.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina matatu ya Kidigo. Msokoto, 'kusokota', kutoka sokota, linatumika pia kwa Kiswahili. Mbavubavu, 'mbavu', linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Msuko hutumika pia kwa Colubrina asiatica, na maana yake haitolewi. Msokoto na Mbavubavu hutumika pia kwa Grewia ectasicarpa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mahahu ga Chidigo. Msokoto, 'chitu chinachosokotwa', kula sokota (kusokota), ni sawa na ra Chiswahili. Mbavubavu, 'mbavu', ni dzina ra Chiduruma na Chigiryama piya. Dzina Msuko piya rinahumirwa kpwa Colubrina asiatica, na takuna mana iriyolavywa. Msokoto na Mbavubavu piya ganahumirwa kpwa Grewia ectasicarpa.

teaser.en: The wild kapok: a slippery-barked giant whose pods burst into red-brown fluff and whose roasted seeds taste like groundnuts.
teaser.sw: Msufi mwitu: jitu lenye gome linaloteleza, ambalo maganda yake hupasuka na kutoa sufi ya rangi nyekundu-kahawia, na mbegu zake zilizokaangwa zina ladha kama karanga.
teaser.dg: Msufi wa weruni: muhi mkulu wenye gopha ra kuhereza ambao makakayage ganaahuka kulavya sufi ya rangi ya dongo yenye kundu, na tembeze zichiochwa zina ladha dza njugu.

summary.en: Msufi mwitu, also called Mware, is the East African bombax, a tall forest tree whose capsules release seeds in fluffy kapok. It gives soft timber for canoes, drums and carving, and its seeds can be roasted and eaten.
summary.sw: Msufi mwitu, unaoitwa pia Mware, ni mti mrefu wa msituni ambao vifuko vyake hutoa mbegu ndani ya sufi laini. Hutoa mbao laini za kutengenezea mitumbwi, ngoma na vinyago, na mbegu zake zinaweza kukaangwa na kuliwa.
summary.dg: Msufi mwitu, unaoihwa piya Mware, ni muhi mure wa tsakani (*East African bombax*), ambao makakayage ganalavya tembe zirizozungulukwa ni sufi. Unalavya mbao laini za kuhendera ngarawa, ngoma na kutsonga vitu, na tembeze zinaweza kuochwa na kuriwa.

about.en: Mware is a tall tree, up to about 36 m, with a straight trunk and smooth yellow-green bark. Its leaves are divided like the fingers of a hand into three to seven leaflets. The flowers have five pale yellow, red or white petals and many red stamens. The fruit is a woody brown capsule about 6 cm long that splits to free many seeds wrapped in red-brown kapok. The Digo recognise it by its leaves and its stem, whose bark they call ereza, slippery.
about.sw: Mware ni mti mrefu, hadi takriban mita 36, wenye shina lililonyooka na gome laini la rangi ya manjano-kijani. Majani yake yamegawanyika kama vidole vya mkono katika vijani vitatu hadi saba. Maua yana petali tano za manjano hafifu, nyekundu au nyeupe, na stameni nyingi nyekundu. Tunda ni kifuko kigumu cha kahawia chenye urefu wa takriban sentimita 6, kinachopasuka na kuachilia mbegu nyingi zilizofunikwa kwa sufi ya rangi nyekundu-kahawia. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na shina lake, ambalo gome lake wanaliita ereza, linaloteleza.
about.dg: Mware ni muhi mure, hadi phephi mita 36, wenye kolo ra chocho na gopha laini ra chijani iriyotsanganyika na rangi ya mandano. Makodzage ganaganyika dza vyala vya mkpwono, kuhenda makodza madide mahahu hadi sabaa. Maruwa gana makodza ga ruwa tsano ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, ga kundu au ga rangi nyereru, na stameni nyinji za kundu. Tunda ni kakaya gumu dza muhi ra rangi ya dongo, ra ure wa phephi sentimita 6, rinaroahuka na kuricha tembe nyinji zirizozungulukwa ni sufi ya rangi ya dongo yenye kundu. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na kolore, ambaro gophare anariiha ereza, 'ra kuhereza'.

where.en: In Kenya it grows only near the coast, in evergreen forest, forest margins and remnants and coastal bushland, from sea level to about 350 m. It prefers clay but also grows on soils over coral, as in the kaya forests and Shimba Hills of Kwale.
where.sw: Nchini Kenya huota karibu na pwani tu, katika misitu ya kijani kibichi kwa mwaka mzima, pembezoni mwa misitu na mabaki ya misitu, na katika vichaka vya pwani, kutoka usawa wa bahari hadi takriban mita 350. Hupendelea udongo wa mfinyanzi lakini pia huota kwenye udongo ulio juu ya matumbawe, kama katika misitu ya kaya na Shimba Hills ya Kwale.
where.dg: Kenya unamera phephi na pwani tu, kpwenye matsaka ga mihi yenye makodza chila wakati, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye seemu za matsaka zirizosala, na weruni pwani, kula phatu pha bahari hadi phephi mita 350 dzulu. Unamendza tsi ya gandika ela piya unamera kpwenye ulongo uriokala dzulu ya sanoo, dza kpwenye matsaka ga kaya na Shimba Hills ya Kwale.

uses.en: ICRAF records soft timber used for carving, canoes and drums, and a bark fibre and red-brown dye. The kapok is used to stuff pillows and mattresses. The seeds can be roasted and eaten like groundnuts, or pounded and cooked with vegetables or meat, and hollows in the trunk are used to store dry food and honey. Bark and leaves are used in medicine, and the tree is planted for shade and as a boundary marker.
uses.sw: ICRAF inarekodi mbao laini zinazotumika kuchonga vinyago, kutengeneza mitumbwi na ngoma, pamoja na nyuzi za gome na rangi ya nyekundu-kahawia. Sufi hutumika kujaza mito na magodoro. Mbegu zinaweza kukaangwa na kuliwa kama karanga, au kutwangwa na kupikwa pamoja na mboga au nyama, na mashimo ya shina hutumika kuhifadhia chakula kikavu na asali. Gome na majani hutumika kama dawa, na mti hupandwa kwa ajili ya kivuli na kama alama ya mpaka.
uses.dg: ICRAF inaandika kukala mbaoze laini nkuhumirwa kutsonga vitu, kuhenda ngarawa na ngoma, na gopha rinalavya nyuzi na rangi ya dongo yenye kundu. Sufi nkutiywa ndani ya mito na magodoro. Tembe zinaweza kuochwa na kuriwa dza njugu, au kuphondwa na kujitwa phamwenga na mboga au nyama, na viphanga vya ndani ya kolo nkuhumirwa kuika chakurya chikavu na asali. Gopha na makodza nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa, na muhi uhu nkuphandwa kpwa pepho na dza alama ya mphaka.

culture.en: The name Msufi mwitu makes it the wild cousin of the cultivated kapok tree, Msufi. Pakia notes that sufi (kapok) and pamba (cotton) are names for woolly fruits, applied to both the grown plants and their wild relatives.
culture.sw: Jina Msufi mwitu linaufanya kuwa ndugu wa porini wa msufi unaopandwa, Msufi. Pakia anaeleza kwamba sufi na pamba ni majina ya matunda yenye nyuzi kama sufu, yanayotumika kwa mimea inayopandwa na kwa jamaa zao wa porini pia.
culture.dg: Dzina Msufi mwitu rinauhenda ukale ndugu wa weruni wa msufi unaophandwa, Msufi. Pakia anaandika kukala sufi na pamba ni madzina ga matunda genye nyuzi dza manyoya, ganayohumirwa kpwa mimea inayophandwa na piya kpwa mimea ya weruni ya jamii mwenga.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names: Msufi mwitu, 'wild kapok', and Mware, which is shared with Duruma and Giriama. In Swahili it is msufi mwitu or mkaranga mti. In English it is the East African bombax, wild kapok or East African cotton tree; its scientific name is Bombax rhodognaphalon.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo: Msufi mwitu, 'msufi wa porini', na Mware, linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa msufi mwitu au mkaranga mti. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *East African bombax*, *wild kapok* au *East African cotton tree*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Bombax rhodognaphalon.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo: Msufi mwitu, 'msufi wa weruni', na Mware, ambaro ni dzina ra Chiduruma na Chigiryama piya. Kpwa Chiswahili ni msufi mwitu au mkaranga mti. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *East African bombax*, *wild kapok* au *East African cotton tree*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni Bombax rhodognaphalon.

definition.en: The woolly fruit of kapok trees, both the planted kapok and the wild msufi mwitu. Probably borrowed from Arabic through Swahili.
definition.sw: Tunda lenye nyuzi kama sufu la misufi, msufi unaopandwa na msufi mwitu wa porini pia. Huenda limetoholewa kutoka Kiarabu kupitia Kiswahili.
definition.dg: Tunda renye nyuzi dza manyoya ra mihi ya msufi, msufi unaophandwa na msufi mwitu wa weruni. Neno hiri rinaweza kukala rikahalwa kula Chiarabu kpwa njira ya Chiswahili.

teaser.en: A sprawling seashore shrub whose glossy leaves lather like soap when rubbed in water.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha ufuoni kinachotambaa, ambacho majani yake yanayong'aa hutoa povu kama sabuni yakisuguliwa ndani ya maji.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha ufuwoni chinachotandazika, ambacho makodzage ganang'ala ganalavya povu dza sabuni ganaphosingbwa madzini.

summary.en: Msuko is Colubrina asiatica, a scrambling shrub of beach thickets and the edges of mangroves. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Msuko ni Colubrina asiatica, kichaka kinachotambaa katika vichaka vya ufuoni na pembezoni mwa mikoko. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: Msuko ni Colubrina asiatica, chitsaka chinachotandazika cha vitsaka vya ufuwoni na kanda-kanda ya mikoko. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Msuko is a sprawling or climbing shrub with long, flexible, zig-zag branches. Its leaves are alternate, egg-shaped, shiny bright green and finely toothed, with three main veins. The tiny greenish-yellow flowers are clustered in the leaf angles and are followed by small round capsules that split into three when dry.
about.sw: Msuko ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda, chenye matawi marefu, yanayopindika na kwenda kombo kombo. Majani yake yanapishana, yana umbo la yai, ni ya kijani angavu yanayong'aa na yana meno madogo, na mishipa mitatu mikuu. Maua madogo sana ya kijani-manjano yamesongamana kwenye pembe za majani na hufuatwa na vifuko vidogo vya mviringo vinavyopasuka sehemu tatu vikikauka.
about.dg: Msuko ni chitsaka chinachotandazika au chinachoambuka, chenye panda mire zinazonyembweka na zinazopinda-pinda. Makodzage ganamera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana, ni ga umbo ra tumbi, ga chijani inayong'ala sana, gana meno madide sana kanda-kanda, na mishipa mikulu mihahu. Maruwa madide sana ga chijani iriyotsanganyika na rangi ya mandano ganamera kpwa mafungu phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda, na gachimala kunamera matunda madide ga mviringo ganayoahuka kpwa seemu tahu ganaphouma.

where.en: It grows just behind the beach, in coastal thicket, on coral rock and on the landward edges of mangroves. Its seeds float, which is how it has spread along tropical coasts from Africa to the Pacific.
where.sw: Huota nyuma kidogo ya ufuo, katika vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani, kwenye miamba ya matumbawe na pembezoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu. Mbegu zake huelea, na kwa njia hiyo umeenea kando ya pwani za kitropiki kutoka Afrika hadi Pasifiki.
where.dg: Unamera nyuma ya ufuwo, kpwenye vitsaka vya pwani, dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo na kanda-kanda ya mikoko uphande wa bara. Tembeze zinaelea madzini, na ndivyo urivyoenea kanda-kanda ya pwani za tsi za dzoho kula Afrika hadi Bahari ya Pasifiki.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere around the Indian Ocean and Pacific the leaves, which are rich in saponins, are well known for lathering in water and are used as a soap substitute.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Kwingineko kuzunguka Bahari ya Hindi na Pasifiki, majani yake, yenye saponini nyingi, yanajulikana sana kwa kutoa povu ndani ya maji na hutumika badala ya sabuni.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Phatu phanjina kanda-kanda ya Bahari ya Hindi na Pasifiki, makodza, ganayokala na *saponin* nyinji, ganamanyikana sana kpwa kulavya povu madzini na nkuhumirwa badala ya sabuni.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Msuko but gives no meaning or shared names. The same name is used for Grewia holstii (also called Msokoto). In English it is Asian nakedwood or latherleaf; its scientific name is Colubrina asiatica.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Msuko lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina hilohilo hutumika kwa Grewia holstii (inayoitwa pia Msokoto). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *Asian nakedwood* au *latherleaf*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Colubrina asiatica.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Msuko ela kalavya mana ya dzina hiri wala madzina ga luga zanjina. Dzina hiri piya rinahumirwa kpwa Grewia holstii (unaoihwa piya Msokoto). Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *Asian nakedwood* au *latherleaf*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni Colubrina asiatica.

teaser.en: A wild cucumber of the bush, its small spiny fruits looking edible but carrying a name that warns otherwise.
teaser.sw: Tango la porini la vichakani; matunda yake madogo yenye miiba yanaonekana kuliwa, lakini jina lake linaonya vinginevyo.
teaser.dg: Mtango wa weruni, ambao matundage madide genye miya ganaonekana dza ganafwaha kuriwa, ela dzinare rinaonya kukala sivyo.

summary.en: Mtango koma is a wild Cucumis, a trailing relative of the cucumber and melon. Pakia records only its name and identifies it to genus.
summary.sw: Mtango koma ni mmea wa porini wa jenasi Cucumis, jamaa anayetambaa wa mtango na tikiti. Pakia anarekodi jina lake tu na anautambua hadi kiwango cha jenasi.
summary.dg: Mtango koma ni Cucumis wa weruni, mmea unaoambala photsi, ndugu wa matango na matigiti. Pakia anaandika dzinare tu, na anaumanya hadi jenasi bahi.

about.en: Pakia identified Mtango koma only as a Cucumis species. Wild cucumbers are trailing or climbing annual or perennial herbs with rough, hairy, lobed leaves, simple tendrils and small yellow flowers. The fruits are small, often spiny or warty, and usually bitter.
about.sw: Pakia aliutambua Mtango koma kama spishi ya Cucumis tu. Matango ya porini ni mimea inayotambaa au kupanda, ya msimu mmoja au ya kudumu, yenye majani yanayokwaruza, yenye vinyweleo na pindo, mikono-shikio sahili na maua madogo ya manjano. Matunda ni madogo, mara nyingi yenye miiba au vivimbe, na kwa kawaida ni machungu.
about.dg: Pakia waumanya Mtango koma dza aina ya Cucumis bahi. Mimea ya Cucumis ya weruni ni mimea midide inayoambala photsi au inayofyombera, ambayo inakala na moyo kpwa mwaka mmwenga tu au kpwa miaka minji. Ina makodza gasigo laini, genye nyere na ganayoganyika kpwa seemu; nyuzi za kugbwirira zisizoganyika; na maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano. Matunda ni madide, mara nyinji genye miya au gasigo laini, na kpwa kawaida ni ga utsungu.

where.en: Pakia does not record where it grows. Wild Cucumis species in coastal Kenya scramble over grass and shrubs in bushland, fallow fields and farm edges.
where.sw: Pakia harekodi mahali unapoota. Spishi za Cucumis za porini katika pwani ya Kenya hutambaa juu ya nyasi na vichaka katika maeneo ya vichaka, mashamba yaliyoachwa na pembezoni mwa mashamba.
where.dg: Pakia kaandika phatu unaphomera. Aina za Cucumis za weruni pwani ya Kenya zinaambala dzulu ya nyasi na vitsaka weruni, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa na kanda-kanda ya minda.

culture.en: Pakia does not explain the name. In other Digo plant names the ending koma marks a plant as 'wild', not for people: Mtunda koma (Sideroxylon inerme) is explained as 'wild fruit', fruiting but poisonous or inedible, and Mtungudza koma is the Sodom apple, a wild relative of the eggplant.
culture.sw: Pakia haelezi jina hili. Katika majina mengine ya mimea ya Kidigo, kiishio koma huonyesha kwamba mmea ni 'wa porini', si wa watu: Mtunda koma (Sideroxylon inerme) unafafanuliwa kuwa 'tunda la porini', lenye matunda lakini yenye sumu au yasiyolika, na Mtungudza koma ni mtunguja, jamaa wa porini wa biringanya.
culture.dg: Pakia kaeleza dzina hiri. Kpwa madzina ganjina ga mimea ga Chidigo, neno ra mwisho koma rinaonyesa kukala mmea ni 'wa weruni', si wa atu: Mtunda koma (Sideroxylon inerme) unaelezwa kukala ni 'tunda ra weruni', unalavya matunda ela ni ga sumu au tagariwa; na Mtungudza koma ni *Sodom apple*, ndugu wa weruni wa mtungudza.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtango koma. Mtango is the Swahili for the cucumber plant, so the name may mean something like 'wild cucumber', but Pakia does not give its meaning. The scientific name is Cucumis sp.; the species was not determined.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtango koma. Mtango ni neno la Kiswahili la mmea wa tango, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili lina maana kama 'tango la porini', lakini Pakia hatoi maana yake. Jina la kisayansi ni Cucumis sp.; spishi yake haikubainishwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mtango koma. Mtango ni dzina ra Chiswahili ra mmea wa tango, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinaweza kukala na mana dza 'mtango wa weruni', ela Pakia kalavya manage. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Cucumis sp.; aina hasa taidzangbwemanyikana.

teaser.en: A forest climber from a genus infamous for poisoning cattle.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wa msituni kutoka jenasi inayojulikana vibaya kwa kuwatia ng'ombe sumu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa tsakani wa kufyombera, wa jenasi inayomanyikana sana kpwa sumu inayolumiza ng'ombe.

summary.en: Mtobwe is Dichapetalum madagascariense, a climbing shrub of forest and thicket. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtobwe ni Dichapetalum madagascariense, kichaka kinachopanda cha misitu na vichaka-mwitu vizito. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: Mtobwe ni Dichapetalum madagascariense, chitsaka chinachofyombera cha matsaka na vitsaka. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Mtobwe is a scrambling or climbing shrub, sometimes a small tree, with alternate, smooth, elliptic leaves. Its small whitish flowers grow in clusters on short stalks that are joined to the leaf stalks, a peculiarity of the genus. The fruits are velvety yellow or orange and somewhat flattened.
about.sw: Mtobwe ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda, wakati mwingine mti mdogo, chenye majani yanayopishana, laini, yenye umbo la duaradufu. Maua yake madogo meupe hafifu huota katika vishada juu ya vikonyo vifupi vilivyoungana na vikonyo vya majani, jambo la kipekee la jenasi hii. Matunda ni ya manjano au rangi ya chungwa, yenye unyoya laini kama mahameli, na yamebapa kiasi.
about.dg: Mtobwe ni chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina au chinachofyombera, na wakati wanjina ni muhi mdide. Makodzage ni laini, ga umbo ra tumbi marefu chidide, na ganamera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana. Maruwage madide ga rangi nyereru ngushu-ngushu ganamera kpwa mabunda kpwenye milita mifupi iriyogbwirana na milita ya makodza; hino ni tabiya ya chipekee ya jenasi ihi. Matunda gana nyere laini, ni ga rangi ya mandano au ya chungbwa, na ni ga bapa chidide.

where.en: It grows in forest, forest edges and riverine thicket across tropical Africa and Madagascar, including the coastal forests of Kenya.
where.sw: Huota misituni, pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka-mwitu vizito vya kando ya mito kote katika Afrika ya kitropiki na Madagaska, ikiwemo misitu ya pwani ya Kenya.
where.dg: Unamera tsakani, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na vitsakani kanda-kanda ya miho, kosi kpwenye tsi za dzoho za Afrika na Madagascar, phamwenga na matsaka ga pwani ya Kenya.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtobwe but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Dichapetalum madagascariense.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtobwe lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Dichapetalum madagascariense.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mtobwe, ela kalavya manage wala luga zanjina zinazorihumira. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Dichapetalum madagascariense.

teaser.en: Named after safari ants, though no one can quite say why.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina la siafu, ingawa hakuna anayeweza kusema hasa kwa nini.
teaser.dg: Unaihwa kpwa dzina ra tsalafu, ela takuna mutu anayemanya hasa sababu.

summary.en: Mtsalafu is coffee senna, a common weed of farms and roadsides with yellow flowers and long thin pods. Its Digo name means 'safari ants', a link Pakia found no explanation for.
summary.sw: Mtsalafu ni *coffee senna*, gugu la kawaida la mashambani na kando ya barabara lenye maua ya manjano na maganda marefu membamba. Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'siafu', uhusiano ambao Pakia hakupata maelezo yake.
summary.dg: Mtsalafu ni *coffee senna*, mbondo ya kawaida ya minda na kanda-kanda ya njira, yenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano na makakaya marefu membamba. Mana ya dzinare ra Chidigo ni 'tsalafu', na Pakia kaphaha maelezo ga uhusiano uho.

about.en: Mtsalafu is an upright, rank-smelling herb or soft shrub, usually waist-high, with leaves divided into four to six pairs of pointed leaflets. It bears bright yellow flowers followed by long, thin, flattened pods packed with seeds. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mtsalafu ni mmea uliosimama wima, wenye harufu mbaya, au kichaka laini, kwa kawaida kimo cha kiuno, wenye majani yaliyogawanyika katika jozi nne hadi sita za vijani vilivyochongoka. Huzaa maua ya manjano angavu yanayofuatwa na maganda marefu, membamba na yaliyobapa, yaliyojaa mbegu. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: Mtsalafu ni mmea mdide unaoima chocho, au chitsaka laini, wenye arufu mbii, na kpwa kawaida ni wa ure wa chunu. Chila kodza rinaganyika kuhenda jozi nne hadi sita za makodza madide genye ntsa. Unalavya maruwa ga rangi ya mandano inayong'ala, na badaye kunatuluka makakaya marefu, membamba na ga bapa, genye tembe nyinji. Adigo nkuumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: Originally from tropical America, it is now a widespread weed of cultivated land, compounds, roadsides and waste ground.
where.sw: Asili yake ni Amerika ya kitropiki, lakini sasa ni gugu lililoenea katika ardhi inayolimwa, viwanja vya nyumba, kando ya barabara na ardhi isiyotumika.
where.dg: Asiliye ni tsi za dzoho za Amerika, ela sambi ni mbondo inayophahikana phatu phanji kpwenye minda, mihalani, kanda-kanda ya njira na kpwenye tsi isiyohumirwa.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere the roasted seeds have been used as a coffee substitute, hence its English name, but the raw seeds and plant are toxic to livestock.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Kwingineko mbegu zilizokaangwa zimetumika badala ya kahawa, ndiyo sababu ya jina lake la Kiingereza, lakini mbegu mbichi na mmea wenyewe ni sumu kwa mifugo.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Phatu phanjina tembe zichiochwa zahumirwa badala ya kahawa, na ndiyo sababu kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *coffee senna*; ela tembe zisizoochwa na mmea wosi ni sumu kpwa mifugo.

culture.en: Pakia gives it as an example of a plant named after an animal for reasons no one could explain.
culture.sw: Pakia anautoa kama mfano wa mmea uliopewa jina la mnyama kwa sababu ambazo hakuna aliyeweza kuzieleza.
culture.dg: Pakia anaulavya dza mfwano wa mmea uriohewa dzina ra nyama kpwa sababu ambazo takuna mutu ariyeweza kuzieleza.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsalafu and explains it as 'safari ants', though the connection between the plant and the ants is not clear. Mgombato confirms tsalafu as the safari ant. In English it is coffee senna or negro coffee; its scientific name is Senna occidentalis (formerly Cassia occidentalis).
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsalafu na kulifafanua kuwa 'siafu', ingawa uhusiano kati ya mmea na siafu haueleweki. Mgombato inathibitisha kwamba tsalafu ni siafu. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *coffee senna* au *negro coffee*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Senna occidentalis (zamani Cassia occidentalis).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mtsalafu na anarieleza kukala ni 'tsalafu', ela uhusiano kahi ya mmea uhu na tsalafu tauonekana waziwazi. Kamusi ya Mgombato nayo inaandika kukala tsalafu ni *safari ant*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *coffee senna* au *negro coffee*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni Senna occidentalis (kare uriihwa Cassia occidentalis).

teaser.en: A small coastal Grewia that shares its Digo name with a close cousin.
teaser.sw: Grewia ndogo ya pwani inayoshiriki jina lake la Kidigo na binamu yake wa karibu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chidide cha Grewia cha pwani, ambacho chinahumira dzina mwenga ra Chidigo na nduguye wa phephi.

summary.en: Mtsaye is Grewia glandulosa, a shrub of the coastal bushland. Pakia records the same Digo name for Grewia vaughanii.
summary.sw: Mtsaye ni Grewia glandulosa, kichaka cha maeneo ya vichaka ya pwani. Pakia anarekodi jina hilohilo la Kidigo kwa Grewia vaughanii.
summary.dg: Mtsaye ni Grewia glandulosa, chitsaka cha weruni wa pwani. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri piya kpwa Grewia vaughanii.

about.en: Mtsaye is a shrub with alternate, toothed leaves that have three prominent veins from the base, as in all Grewias. It has small star-shaped flowers with narrow petals, followed by small, lobed, berry-like fruits. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mtsaye ni kichaka chenye majani yanayopishana, yenye meno, na mishipa mitatu inayoonekana wazi kutoka kwenye kitako, kama ilivyo kwa Grewia zote. Kina maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota na petali nyembamba, yakifuatwa na matunda madogo yenye pindo yanayofanana na beri. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: Mtsaye ni chitsaka chenye makodza ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana, gana meno kanda-kanda, na mishipa mihahu inayoonekana waziwazi kula photsi ya kodza, dza irivyo kpwa Grewia zosi. Una maruwa madide ga umbo ra nyota genye makodza ga ruwa membamba, na badaye kunatuluka matunda madide ganayoganyika kpwa seemu, ganayohalana na matunda genye madzi manji. Adigo nkuumanya kpwa makodzage.

teaser.sw: Mtsaye wa pili: Grewia inayotambaa ya vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani.

summary.en: This Mtsaye is Grewia vaughanii, a scrambling shrub of the East African coast. Pakia gives it the same Digo name as Grewia glandulosa.
summary.sw: Mtsaye huu ni Grewia vaughanii, kichaka kinachotambaa cha pwani ya Afrika Mashariki. Pakia anaupa jina lilelile la Kidigo kama Grewia glandulosa.
summary.dg: *Mtsaye* uhu ni *Grewia vaughanii*, chitsaka chinachoambala cha pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki. Pakia anaupha dzina ra Chidigo sawa na ra *Grewia glandulosa*.

about.en: Grewia vaughanii is a shrub or scrambler with alternate, toothed leaves that have three main veins from the base. Its small flowers have five narrow petals, and its fruits are small and lobed, as in other Grewias.
about.sw: Grewia vaughanii ni kichaka au mmea unaotambaa, wenye majani yanayopishana, yenye meno, na mishipa mitatu mikuu kutoka kwenye kitako. Maua yake madogo yana petali tano nyembamba, na matunda yake ni madogo yenye pindo, kama ilivyo kwa Grewia nyingine.
about.dg: *Grewia vaughanii* ni chitsaka au mmea unaoambala, wenye makodza ganagomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana, genye meno kanda-kanda na mishipa mikulu mihahu inayoandzira photsi ya kodza. Maruwage ni madide, na makodza ga ruwa matsano membamba, na matundage ni madide na ganaganyika kpwa seemu, dza ga *Grewia* zanjina.

where.en: It grows in coastal thicket and bushland of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka-mwitu vizito na vichaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera vitsakani na weruni mwa pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsaye but gives no meaning or shared names. The same name is used for Grewia glandulosa, so the Digo appear to treat the two as one kind of plant. Its scientific name is Grewia vaughanii.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsaye lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina hilohilo hutumika kwa Grewia glandulosa, kwa hiyo inaonekana Wadigo huichukulia mimea hii miwili kuwa aina moja. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Grewia vaughanii.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsaye*, ela kalavya mana ya dzina hiri wala madzina ganagohumirwa ni luga zanjina. Dzina hiri hiri nkuhumirwa piya kpwa *Grewia glandulosa*, kpwa hivyo inaonekana Adigo anaiona mimea iyo miiri kukala ni aina mwenga. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Grewia vaughanii*.

teaser.en: The 'home digger': a creeping weed believed to dig out the peace of a homestead.
teaser.sw: 'Mchimbaji wa nyumbani': gugu linalotambaa linaloaminiwa kuchimbua amani ya boma.
teaser.dg: 'Anayetsimba kaya': mmea mdide unaoambala photsi, ambao atu anaamini unatsimba amani ya kaya.

summary.en: Mtsimbikaya is a small creeping herb, Boerhavia repens. Its name, 'home digger', comes from its use in magic to stir up quarrels inside a homestead.
summary.sw: Mtsimbikaya ni mmea mdogo unaotambaa, Boerhavia repens. Jina lake, 'mchimbaji wa nyumbani', linatokana na matumizi yake katika uchawi ili kuchochea ugomvi ndani ya boma.
summary.dg: *Mtsimbikaya* ni mmea mdide unaoambala photsi, *Boerhavia repens*. Dzinare, 'anayetsimba kaya', ni kpwa sababu nkuhumirwa kpwa utsai kureha kondo ndani ya kaya.

about.en: Mtsimbikaya is a low, sprawling herb with slender stems that spread over the ground from a woody rootstock. Its leaves come in unequal opposite pairs, roughly oval and often paler beneath. It bears tiny pink to purplish flowers in small clusters, followed by small, sticky, ribbed fruits that cling to passers-by.
about.sw: Mtsimbikaya ni mmea mfupi unaotambaa, wenye mashina membamba yanayoenea juu ya ardhi kutoka kwenye shina-mzizi gumu. Majani yake huja kwa jozi zinazokabiliana zisizo na ukubwa sawa, yana umbo la yai kwa kadiri, na mara nyingi upande wa chini una rangi hafifu zaidi. Huzaa maua madogo sana ya waridi hadi zambarau katika vishada vidogo, yakifuatwa na matunda madogo yanayonata, yenye mistari iliyoinuka, yanayoshika wapita njia.
about.dg: *Mtsimbikaya* ni mmea mdide unaotandazika photsi, wenye mihi myembamba inayoenea dzulu ya tsi kula kpwa muzi mgumu dza mbao. Makodzage ganamera mairi-mairi ganagolengana, ela rimwenga ni kulu kuriko ranjina; gana umbo ra tumbi, na mara nyinji uphande wa photsi ni ngushu-ngushu. Unalavya maruwa madide sana ga pinki hadi zambarau, kpwa mafungu madide, na badaye matunda madide ganagonyata, genye mistari, ganagogbwira atu anaotsupa.

where.en: It grows on open sandy ground, in compounds, along paths and on disturbed or overgrazed land.
where.sw: Huota kwenye ardhi ya wazi yenye mchanga, katika viwanja vya nyumba, kando ya njia na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa au iliyolishwa kupita kiasi.
where.dg: Unamera phatu pha kpwereru phenye mtsanga, mihalani, kanda-kanda ya njira, na kpwenye tsi iriyobanangika au iriyoriswa sana ni mifugo.

culture.en: Pakia records that the plant is used to magically destroy the peace of a homestead (kaya) by 'digging out' (tsimba) internal disputes. It is one of a group of Digo plant names tied to disputes, alongside Chivuundza kesi, the 'case terminator', and Mvundza jembe, the 'hoe breaker', which are used to end quarrels.
culture.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba mmea huu hutumika kiuchawi kuharibu amani ya boma (kaya) kwa 'kuchimbua' (tsimba) migogoro ya ndani. Ni mojawapo ya kundi la majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayohusiana na migogoro, pamoja na Chivuundza kesi, 'mmalizaji wa kesi', na Mvundza jembe, 'mvunjaji wa jembe', ambayo hutumika kumaliza ugomvi.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala mmea uhu nkuhumirwa kpwa utsai kubananga amani ya kaya (*kaya*) kpwa 'kutsimba' (*tsimba*) kondo za ndani. Ni mwenga wa kundi ra madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganagohusu kondo, phamwenga na *Chivuundza kesi*, 'chinachovundza kesi', na *Mvundza jembe*, 'anayevundza jembe', ambayo nkuhumirwa kumala kondo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsimbikaya, also written Mtsimbi kaya, meaning 'home digger'. No shared names are recorded. In English the genus is called spiderling; its scientific name is Boerhavia repens.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsimbikaya, linaloandikwa pia Mtsimbi kaya, lenye maana ya 'mchimbaji wa nyumbani'. Hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza jenasi hii inaitwa *spiderling*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Boerhavia repens.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsimbikaya*, ririroandikpwa piya *Mtsimbi kaya*, ririro na mana ya 'anayetsimba kaya'. Takuna madzina ga luga zanjina garigoandikpwa. Kpwa Chingereza jenasi hino inaihwa *spiderling*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Boerhavia repens*.

teaser.en: Its thorns are the Digo tool for picking the kernel out of a marula nut.
teaser.sw: Miiba yake ndiyo chombo cha Wadigo cha kutolea kiini ndani ya kokwa la mng'ong'o.
teaser.dg: Adigo anahumira miyaye kutsokola chitsa kula ndani ya *ng’ongo*, tembe ngumu ya tunda ra *Mng’ongo*.

summary.en: Mtsokola ng’ongo is a spiny shrub whose name means 'extractor of the marula nut'. Pakia's appendices disagree on whether the name belongs to Maytenus heterophylla or to Rytigynia celastroides.
summary.sw: Mtsokola ng’ongo ni kichaka chenye miiba ambacho jina lake lina maana ya 'mtoaji wa kokwa la mng'ong'o'. Viambatisho vya Pakia vinatofautiana kuhusu kama jina hili ni la Maytenus heterophylla au la Rytigynia celastroides.
summary.dg: *Mtsokola ng’ongo* ni chitsaka cha miya, ambacho dzinare rina mana ya 'anayetsokola *ng’ongo*'. Nyongeza za Pakia tazilengana kuhusu dzina hiri: kala ni ra *Maytenus heterophylla* au ra *Rytigynia celastroides*.

about.en: Maytenus heterophylla, the spike thorn, is a much-branched shrub or small tree armed with straight spines, often bearing leaves or flowers on them. The leaves are small, leathery and finely toothed, clustered on short side shoots. It bears masses of small white, unpleasant-smelling flowers and small capsules that split to show seeds with an orange-red aril.
about.sw: Maytenus heterophylla, *spike thorn*, ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye matawi mengi, uliojihami kwa miiba iliyonyooka, ambayo mara nyingi huzaa majani au maua juu yake. Majani ni madogo, magumu kama ngozi na yenye meno madogo, yamesongamana kwenye vichipukizi vifupi vya pembeni. Huzaa maua mengi madogo meupe yenye harufu isiyopendeza, na vifuko vidogo vinavyopasuka kuonyesha mbegu zenye ganda-nyama la rangi ya chungwa-nyekundu.
about.dg: *Maytenus heterophylla*, *spike thorn*, ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye panda nyinji na miya ya kugoloka, ambayo mara nyinji ina makodza au maruwa dzuluye. Makodzage ni madide, mafu dza chingo na genye meno madide kanda-kanda, na ganamera mafungu kpwenye maphungo mafupi ga kanda-kanda. Unalavya maruwa madide mereru manji sana, genye arufu mbii, na makakaya madide ganagoahuka kuonyesa tembe zenye gada ra nyama ra kundu na rangi ya chungbwa (*aril*).

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, thicket and wooded grassland.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu, vichaka-mwitu vizito na nyika zenye miti.
where.dg: Unamera weruni mwa tsi kavu, vitsakani na nyasini phenye mihi.

uses.en: Pakia records that the thorns are used to extract the kernel from inside the nut of the marula fruit (Sclerocarya birrea, Mng’ongo), which is otherwise hard to reach.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba miiba yake hutumika kutolea kiini kilicho ndani ya kokwa la tunda la mng'ong'o (Sclerocarya birrea, Mng’ongo), ambacho vinginevyo ni vigumu kukifikia.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala miyaye nkuhumirwa kutsokola chitsa kula ndani ya *ng’ongo*, tembe ngumu ya tunda ra *Mng’ongo* (*Sclerocarya birrea*); bila ya miya hino, chitsa hicho ni chigumu kuchiphaha.

culture.en: The name records a small piece of everyday food knowledge: ng’ongo is the hard nut inside the marula fruit, and tsokola means to extract or poke out.
culture.sw: Jina hili linahifadhi kipande kidogo cha maarifa ya kila siku kuhusu chakula: ng’ongo ni kokwa gumu lililo ndani ya tunda la mng'ong'o, na tsokola maana yake ni kutoa au kuchokoa.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinaonyesa chitu chidide atu anachochimanya chila siku kuhusu vyakurya: *ng’ongo* ni tembe ngumu iriyo ndani ya tunda ra *mng’ongo*, na *tsokola* ni kutuluza chitu kula ndani.

names.en: Pakia's Appendix III gives Mtsokola ng’ongo for Maytenus heterophylla, explained in Appendix VI as 'extractor of Sclerocarya fruit', from tsokola (to extract) and ng’ongo (the marula nut). Mgombato agrees that tsokola means to poke or pick out with a stick. However, Appendices V and VI give this name to Rytigynia celastroides and call Maytenus heterophylla Mtsokola wongo instead. In English Maytenus heterophylla is the common spike thorn.
names.sw: Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinatoa Mtsokola ng’ongo kwa Maytenus heterophylla, na Kiambatisho VI kinalifafanua kuwa 'mtoaji wa tunda la Sclerocarya', kutoka tsokola (kutoa) na ng’ongo (kokwa la mng'ong'o). Mgombato inakubali kwamba tsokola maana yake ni kuchokoa au kutoa kwa kijiti. Hata hivyo, Viambatisho V na VI vinalipa jina hili Rytigynia celastroides na kuiita Maytenus heterophylla Mtsokola wongo badala yake. Kwa Kiingereza Maytenus heterophylla inaitwa *common spike thorn*.
names.dg: Nyongeza III ya Pakia inapha *Mtsokola ng’ongo* kpwa *Maytenus heterophylla*, na Nyongeza VI inaeleza dzina hiri kukala ni 'anayetsokola tunda ra *Sclerocarya*', kula *tsokola* (kutuluza) na *ng’ongo* (tembe ya *mng’ongo*). Mgombato nao unagomba kukala *tsokola* ni kutuluza chitu kula kobo kpwa chigongo. Ela Nyongeza V na VI zinapha dzina hiri *Rytigynia celastroides*, na *Maytenus heterophylla* zinauiha *Mtsokola wongo*. Kpwa Chingereza *Maytenus heterophylla* ni *common spike thorn*.

teaser.en: A hunter's name: its thorns were used to pick the brains out of a gazelle's skull.
teaser.sw: Jina la mwindaji: miiba yake ilitumika kuchokoa ubongo kutoka kwenye fuvu la swala.
teaser.dg: Dzina ra aindza: miyaye kala inahumirwa kutsokola *wongo* kula ndani ya zekeya ra chitswa cha swala.

summary.en: Mtsokola wongo, 'extractor of brain', is a spiny bush shrub whose thorns hunters used on the skulls of prey such as gazelle. Pakia's appendices disagree on whether the name belongs to Rytigynia celastroides or to Maytenus heterophylla.
summary.sw: Mtsokola wongo, 'mtoaji wa ubongo', ni kichaka chenye miiba cha porini ambacho miiba yake ilitumiwa na wawindaji kwenye mafuvu ya wanyama waliowinda kama swala. Viambatisho vya Pakia vinatofautiana kuhusu kama jina hili ni la Rytigynia celastroides au la Maytenus heterophylla.
summary.dg: *Mtsokola wongo*, 'anayetsokola *wongo*', ni chitsaka cha miya cha weruni, ambacho miyaye kala inahumirwa ni aindza kpwenye zekeya za maingo dza swala. Nyongeza za Pakia tazilengana kuhusu dzina hiri: kala ni ra *Rytigynia celastroides* au ra *Maytenus heterophylla*.

about.en: Rytigynia celastroides is a shrub of the coffee family with opposite, smallish, glossy leaves, small greenish-white flowers in the leaf angles and small round fruits that ripen black. Some forms carry short paired spines. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Rytigynia celastroides ni kichaka cha familia ya mibuni (kahawa) chenye majani yanayokabiliana, madogo kiasi na yanayong'aa, maua madogo ya kijani-nyeupe kwenye pembe za majani, na matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa meusi. Baadhi ya aina zake zina miiba mifupi iliyo jozi jozi. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Rytigynia celastroides* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya kahawa, chenye makodza madide chidide ganagolengana na ganang'ala, maruwa madide ga chijani na nyereru phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na panda, na matunda madide ga mviringo ganagokala maru gachikala maivu. Aina zanjina zina miya mifupi, mairi-mairi. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and dry forest of East Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka, vichaka-mwitu vizito na misitu mikavu ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, vitsakani na matsaka makavu ga pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki.

uses.en: Pakia records that the thorns are used to extract the brain matter (wongo) from the skull of a prey animal such as a gazelle.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba miiba yake hutumika kutoa ubongo (wongo) kutoka kwenye fuvu la mnyama aliyewindwa kama swala.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala miyaye nkuhumirwa kutsokola *wongo* (wuongo) kula ndani ya zekeya ra chitswa cha nyama wa maingo, dza swala.

culture.en: The name belongs to the Digo hunting tradition, like Muoza nyama, the 'meat spoiler', which carries a message to the hunter.
culture.sw: Jina hili ni sehemu ya mapokeo ya uwindaji ya Wadigo, kama Muoza nyama, 'mharibu nyama', ambao hubeba ujumbe kwa mwindaji.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri ni ra mila ya Adigo ya kuindza, dza *Muoza nyama*, 'anayebananga nyama', ambao unamreha muindza ujumbe.

names.en: Pakia's Appendix III gives Mtsokola wongo for Rytigynia celastroides. Appendix VI explains it as 'extractor of brain', from tsokola (to extract) and wongo (brain). However, Appendices V and VI give this name to Maytenus heterophylla and call Rytigynia celastroides Mtsokola ng’ongo instead. Mgombato confirms tsokola as to poke or pick out with a stick.
names.sw: Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinatoa Mtsokola wongo kwa Rytigynia celastroides. Kiambatisho VI kinalifafanua kuwa 'mtoaji wa ubongo', kutoka tsokola (kutoa) na wongo (ubongo). Hata hivyo, Viambatisho V na VI vinalipa jina hili Maytenus heterophylla na kuiita Rytigynia celastroides Mtsokola ng’ongo badala yake. Mgombato inathibitisha kwamba tsokola maana yake ni kuchokoa au kutoa kwa kijiti.
names.dg: Nyongeza III ya Pakia inapha *Mtsokola wongo* kpwa *Rytigynia celastroides*. Nyongeza VI inaeleza kukala ni 'anayetsokola *wongo*', kula *tsokola* (kutuluza) na *wongo* (wuongo). Ela Nyongeza V na VI zinapha dzina hiri *Maytenus heterophylla*, na *Rytigynia celastroides* zinauiha *Mtsokola ng’ongo*. Mgombato unakubali kukala *tsokola* ni kutuluza chitu kula kobo kpwa chigongo.

teaser.en: 'Bloom in a new field': a tree believed to flower almost as soon as land is cleared.
teaser.sw: 'Chanua katika shamba jipya': mti unaoaminiwa kutoa maua karibu mara tu ardhi inapofyekwa.
teaser.dg: 'Tuluza maruwa munda muphya': muhi ambao atu anaamini unatuluza maruwa mara tu munda uchitemwa.

summary.en: Mtsomatsanje is Drypetes reticulata, a tree of coastal forest. Its name, 'bloom in a new field', reflects the belief that it flowers very quickly in newly cleared land.
summary.sw: Mtsomatsanje ni Drypetes reticulata, mti wa misitu ya pwani. Jina lake, 'chanua katika shamba jipya', linaakisi imani kwamba hutoa maua haraka sana katika ardhi iliyofyekwa karibuni.
summary.dg: *Mtsomatsanje* ni *Drypetes reticulata*, muhi wa matsaka ga pwani. Dzinare, 'tuluza maruwa munda muphya', rinaonyesa vira atu anavyoamini kukala unatuluza maruwa upesi sana kpwenye munda muphya uriotemwa.

about.en: Mtsomatsanje is a small to medium evergreen tree with alternate, leathery leaves, often with a slightly toothed margin and a fine net of veins (hence reticulata). Male and female flowers are on separate trees, small and greenish, and the fruits are small, round and fleshy. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mtsomatsanje ni mti mdogo hadi wa wastani wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima, majani yanayopishana, magumu kama ngozi, mara nyingi yenye ukingo wenye meno kidogo na mtandao mwembamba wa mishipa (ndiyo maana ya reticulata). Maua ya kiume na ya kike huwa kwenye miti tofauti, ni madogo na ya kijani, na matunda ni madogo, ya mviringo na yenye nyama. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Mtsomatsanje* ni muhi mdide hadi wa chiasi, wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganamera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kuphisana, ni mafu dza chingo, mara nyinji genye meno madide sana kanda-kanda, na mishipa midide iriyotsanganyika dza chimiya (ndiyo sababu ya dzina *reticulata*). Maruwa ga chilume na ga chichetu ganamera kpwenye mihi tafwauti; ni madide na ga chijani-chijani, na matunda ni madide, ga mviringo na genye nyama. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani na vitsakani pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

culture.en: Pakia records the belief that the species blooms (tsoma) very quickly in a new field (tsanje), and the name records that belief. Pakia groups it with Mkula usiku, the 'grow by night' plant.
culture.sw: Pakia anarekodi imani kwamba spishi hii huchanua (tsoma) haraka sana katika shamba jipya (tsanje), na jina lake linahifadhi imani hiyo. Pakia anaiweka katika kundi moja na Mkula usiku, mmea wa 'kukua usiku'.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala atu anaamini aina hino inatuluza maruwa (*tsoma*) upesi sana kpwenye munda muphya (*tsanje*), na dzina hiri rinahifadhi imani hino. Pakia anauika phamwenga na *Mkula usiku*, mmea 'unaokula usiku'.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsomatsanje, also written Mtsoma tsanje, meaning 'bloom in new field'. No shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Drypetes reticulata.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsomatsanje, linaloandikwa pia Mtsoma tsanje, lenye maana ya 'chanua katika shamba jipya'. Hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Drypetes reticulata.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsomatsanje*, ririroandikpwa piya *Mtsoma tsanje*, ririro na mana ya 'tuluza maruwa munda muphya'. Takuna madzina ga luga zanjina garigoandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Drypetes reticulata*.

teaser.en: The only member of its genus: a glossy-leaved, sweet-scented shrub of the dry coastal country.
teaser.sw: Spishi pekee katika jenasi yake: kichaka chenye majani yanayong'aa na harufu tamu, cha maeneo makavu ya pwani.
teaser.dg: Ndiyo aina mwenga tu ya jenasiye: chitsaka cha tsi kavu ya pwani, chenye makodza ganang'ala na arufu nono.

summary.en: Mtsome is Lamprothamnus zanguebaricus, an evergreen shrub or small tree of the coffee family found only from southern Somalia to Tanzania. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtsome ni Lamprothamnus zanguebaricus, kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima, wa familia ya mibuni (kahawa), unaopatikana tu kuanzia kusini mwa Somalia hadi Tanzania. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: *Mtsome* ni *Lamprothamnus zanguebaricus*, chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, wa jamii ya kahawa, unaophahikana tu kula Somalia ya kusini hadi Tanzania. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Mtsome is an evergreen shrub or tree up to about 9 m tall, with fissured or corrugated bark. Its leaves are oblong, glossy and rather leathery, with raised veins and often a slightly heart-shaped base. The flowers are sweetly scented. It is the only species in its genus.
about.sw: Mtsome ni kichaka au mti wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima, wenye kimo cha hadi takriban mita 9, na gome lenye nyufa au mikunjo. Majani yake ni marefu ya mstatili, yanayong'aa na magumu kiasi kama ngozi, yenye mishipa iliyoinuka na mara nyingi kitako chenye umbo la moyo kidogo. Maua yana harufu tamu. Ndiyo spishi pekee katika jenasi yake.
about.dg: *Mtsome* ni chitsaka au muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, unaofika hadi phephi mita 9, na gophare rina mihalo au mistari. Makodzage ni mare, ganang'ala na ni mafu chidide dza chingo, genye mishipa iriyotuluka dzulu, na mara nyinji photsi ya kodza ina umbo ra moyo chidide. Maruwage gana arufu nono. Ndiyo aina mwenga tu ya jenasiye.

where.en: It grows in the seasonally dry coastal bushland and forest of southern Somalia, Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na misitu ya pwani yenye ukame wa msimu, kusini mwa Somalia, Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na matsakani pwani, phatu ambapho ni kavu wakati wa kazikazi, kula Somalia ya kusini, Kenya hadi Tanzania.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsome but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Lamprothamnus zanguebaricus; zanguebaricus refers to Zanguebar, the old name for the Zanzibar coast.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsome lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Lamprothamnus zanguebaricus; zanguebaricus linarejelea Zanguebar, jina la zamani la pwani ya Zanzibar.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsome*, ela kalavya mana ya dzina hiri wala madzina ganagohumirwa ni luga zanjina. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Lamprothamnus zanguebaricus*; *zanguebaricus* rinalavywa kula *Zanguebar*, dzina ra kare ra pwani ya Zanzibar.

teaser.en: Yellow flowers, then black fruits sitting on a bright red cushion like beads on a button.
teaser.sw: Maua ya manjano, kisha matunda meusi yaliyokaa juu ya mto mwekundu angavu kama shanga juu ya kifungo.
teaser.dg: Maruwa ga rangi ya mandano, na badaye matunda maru ganagokala dzulu ya nyama-nyama ya kundu inayong'ala, dza ushanga dzulu ya chifungo.

summary.en: Mtsometsome is Ochna mossambicensis, a shrub or small tree of coastal bush and forest. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtsometsome ni Ochna mossambicensis, kichaka au mti mdogo wa vichaka na misitu ya pwani. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: *Mtsometsome* ni *Ochna mossambicensis*, chitsaka au muhi mdide wa weruni na matsaka ga pwani. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Mtsometsome is a shrub or small tree with glossy, finely toothed leaves. Like other Ochnas, it has bright yellow flowers that fall quickly, after which the sepals turn red and enlarge. The fruits are shiny black, one-seeded segments set on a fleshy red base, a striking combination that makes Ochnas easy to spot. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mtsometsome ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani yanayong'aa na meno madogo. Kama Ochna nyingine, una maua ya manjano angavu yanayopukutika haraka, na baadaye sepali hugeuka nyekundu na kuongezeka ukubwa. Matunda ni vipande vyeusi vinavyong'aa, kila kimoja na mbegu moja, vilivyokaa juu ya kitako chekundu chenye nyama; mchanganyiko huu wa kuvutia hufanya Ochna kuwa rahisi kuzitambua. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Mtsometsome* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ganang'ala, genye meno madide sana kanda-kanda. Dza *Ochna* zanjina, una maruwa ga rangi ya mandano inayong'ala ganagogbwa upesi, na badaye makodza madide ga photsi ya ruwa (*sepals*) ganagaluka ga kundu na ganakula. Matunda ni maru ganang'ala; chila seemu ina tembe mwenga, na seemu zosi zinakala dzulu ya nyama-nyama ya kundu. Rangi hizi mbiri phamwenga ni za ajabu, na zinahenda *Ochna* zikale rahisi kumanyikana. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

summary.en: Mtsophe is Agelaea pentagyna, a woody climber of forest and thicket. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtsophe ni Agelaea pentagyna, mtambaa mgumu wa misitu na vichaka-mwitu vizito. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: *Mtsophe* ni *Agelaea pentagyna*, mmea wa mbao unaofyombera, wa matsakani na vitsakani. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Mtsophe is a woody climber or scrambling shrub. Its leaves are divided into three leaflets, the side ones lopsided. It bears sprays of small white, fragrant flowers, followed by small, hairy, red to orange pods that split along one side to show a black seed partly wrapped in a fleshy aril.
about.sw: Mtsophe ni mtambaa mgumu au kichaka kinachotambaa. Majani yake yamegawanyika katika vijani vitatu, vile vya pembeni vikiwa vimeegemea upande mmoja. Huzaa mashada ya maua madogo meupe yenye harufu nzuri, yanayofuatwa na maganda madogo yenye vinyweleo, mekundu hadi rangi ya chungwa, yanayopasuka upande mmoja kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi iliyofunikwa sehemu na ganda-nyama.
about.dg: *Mtsophe* ni mmea wa mbao unaofyombera, au chitsaka chinachoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Chila kodza rinaganyika kukala makodza madide mahahu, na makodza madide ga kanda-kanda ni mapana zaidi uphande mmwenga kuriko wanjina. Unalavya mafungu ga maruwa madide mereru ga arufu nono, na badaye makakaya madide genye nyere, ga kundu hadi rangi ya chungbwa, ganagoahuka uphande mmwenga kuonyesa tembe nyiru iriyozungulukwa chidide ni nyama-nyama (*aril*).

summary.en: Mtsotsone is Adenia kirkii, a climber of the passion-flower family. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtsotsone ni Adenia kirkii, mtambaa wa familia ya mkarakara. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: *Mtsotsone* ni *Adenia kirkii*, mmea unaofyombera wa jamii ya *mtunda*. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Mtsotsone is a climber that holds on with coiled tendrils, often from a swollen tuberous base. Like other Adenias it has small greenish flowers and egg-shaped fruits that split open to show seeds in a fleshy covering. Many Adenia species are poisonous.
about.sw: Mtsotsone ni mtambaa unaoshikilia kwa mikono-shikio iliyojikunja, mara nyingi ukitoka kwenye kitako kilichovimba kama kiazi. Kama Adenia nyingine, una maua madogo ya kijani na matunda yenye umbo la yai yanayopasuka kuonyesha mbegu ndani ya ganda lenye nyama. Spishi nyingi za Adenia ni za sumu.
about.dg: *Mtsotsone* ni mmea unaofyombera unaogbwira kpwa vigongo vyembamba vinavyodzizunguluka, na mara nyinji unamera kula kpwa kolo ririrofutuka photsi dza chiazi. Dza *Adenia* zanjina, una maruwa madide ga chijani-chijani na matunda ga umbo ra tumbi ganagoahuka kuonyesa tembe ziriziozungulukwa ni nyama-nyama. Aina nyinji za *Adenia* zina sumu.

teaser.sw: Kijani juu, fedha chini: Wadigo huijua Croton hii kwa rangi mbili za majani yake.
teaser.dg: Chijani dzulu, rangi ya feza photsi: Adigo anaumanya *Croton* uhu kpwa rangi mbiri za makodzage.

summary.en: Mtsunduzi is Croton megalocarpoides, a shrub or small tree of the dry coastal country. Pakia gives it as one of the few plants the Digo identify by leaf colour.
summary.sw: Mtsunduzi ni Croton megalocarpoides, kichaka au mti mdogo wa maeneo makavu ya pwani. Pakia anautoa kama mojawapo ya mimea michache ambayo Wadigo huitambua kwa rangi ya majani.
summary.dg: *Mtsunduzi* ni *Croton megalocarpoides*, chitsaka au muhi mdide wa tsi kavu ya pwani. Pakia anauandika dza mwenga wa mimea michache ambayo Adigo anaimanya kpwa rangi ya makodza.

about.en: Mtsunduzi is a shrub or small tree up to about 8 m, with grey bark that cracks into rectangular scales. Its leaves are green above and silvery beneath. Digo people describe this as 'ndani n’maru, konze n’mereru', green on the upper surface and whitish on the lower. Its fruits are three-lobed capsules, as in other crotons.
about.sw: Mtsunduzi ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye kimo cha hadi takriban mita 8, wenye gome la kijivu linalopasuka katika magamba ya mstatili. Majani yake ni ya kijani upande wa juu na ya rangi ya fedha upande wa chini. Wadigo hueleza hali hii kwa kusema 'ndani n’maru, konze n’mereru', kijani upande wa juu na weupe hafifu upande wa chini. Matunda yake ni vifuko vyenye pindo tatu, kama ilivyo kwa Croton nyingine.
about.dg: *Mtsunduzi* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaofika hadi phephi mita 8, wenye gopha ra rangi ya ivu rinaroahuka vipande-vipande vya pembe nne. Makodzage ni ga chijani dzulu na ga rangi ya feza photsi. Adigo anaeleza hivi: '*ndani n’maru, konze n’mereru*', yani chijani uphande wa dzulu na nyereru-nyereru uphande wa photsi. Matundage ni matunda makavu genye seemu tahu, dza ga *Croton* zanjina.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal bushland and forest from southern Somalia to Mozambique, in Kenya from near sea level to about 275 m.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu na misitu ya pwani kuanzia kusini mwa Somalia hadi Msumbiji; nchini Kenya kutoka karibu na usawa wa bahari hadi takriban mita 275.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na matsakani mwa tsi kavu ya pwani, kula Somalia ya kusini hadi Mozambique. Kenya unaphahikana kula phephi na bahari hadi phephi mita 275 dzulu ya bahari.

culture.en: Pakia notes that Digo plant description uses only three basic colour words, nyiru, nyereru and kundu, so colour seldom separates species. Mtsunduzi is one of the exceptions: its two-toned leaves make it identifiable on sight.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba maelezo ya mimea ya Kidigo hutumia maneno matatu tu ya msingi ya rangi, nyiru, nyereru na kundu, kwa hiyo rangi mara chache hutenganisha spishi. Mtsunduzi ni mojawapo ya mimea isiyofuata kanuni hiyo: majani yake ya rangi mbili huufanya utambulike kwa kuuona tu.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo achieleza mimea anahumira maneno mahahu tu ga rangi, *nyiru*, *nyereru* na *kundu*, kpwa hivyo mara nyinji rangi taitafwautisha aina. Ela *Mtsunduzi* ni tafwauti: makodzage ga rangi mbiri ganahenda umanyikane mara mwenga uchiuona.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsunduzi but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Croton megalocarpoides.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsunduzi lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Croton megalocarpoides.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsunduzi*, ela kalavya mana ya dzina hiri wala madzina ganagohumirwa ni luga zanjina. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Croton megalocarpoides*.

teaser.en: The 'cattle herder': a small wild hibiscus of the grazing grounds.
teaser.sw: 'Mchungaji wa ng'ombe': hibiskasi ndogo ya porini ya malishoni.
teaser.dg: 'Mutu anayetsunga ng’ombe': *hibiscus* mdide wa weruni unaomera marisani.

summary.en: Mtsunga ng’ombe is Hibiscus micranthus, a small, wiry wild hibiscus. Its Digo name means 'cattle herder', and Pakia also records it as Mtsunga mbuzi.
summary.sw: Mtsunga ng’ombe ni Hibiscus micranthus, hibiskasi ndogo ya porini yenye mashina membamba magumu. Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'mchungaji wa ng'ombe', na Pakia pia anaurekodi kama Mtsunga mbuzi.
summary.dg: *Mtsunga ng’ombe* ni *Hibiscus micranthus*, *hibiscus* mdide na mwembamba wa weruni. Dzinare ra Chidigo rina mana ya 'mutu anayetsunga ng’ombe', na Pakia piya anauandika dza *Mtsunga mbuzi*.

about.en: Mtsunga ng’ombe is a small, wiry, much-branched shrubby herb, usually less than a metre tall, with rough, small, toothed leaves. It bears tiny white to pinkish hibiscus flowers on slender stalks, often opening in the afternoon. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mtsunga ng’ombe ni mmea mdogo wenye umbo la kichaka, mashina membamba magumu na matawi mengi, kwa kawaida chini ya mita moja kwa urefu, wenye majani madogo yanayokwaruza na yenye meno. Huzaa maua madogo sana ya hibiskasi, meupe hadi waridi hafifu, juu ya vikonyo vyembamba, ambayo mara nyingi hufunguka alasiri. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Mtsunga ng’ombe* ni mmea mdide dza chitsaka, mwembamba, wenye panda nyinji, na kpwa kawaida taufika mita mwenga. Una makodza madide genye meno kanda-kanda, ganagokaraza. Unalavya maruwa madide sana ga *hibiscus*, mereru hadi pinki, dzulu ya milita myembamba, na mara nyinji ganavuguka wakati wa dzuwa ra kuphunga. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It is widespread in dry bushland and grassland, on roadsides and in grazing land, across Africa and into Asia.
where.sw: Umeenea katika vichaka vikavu na nyika, kando ya barabara na katika maeneo ya malisho, kote Afrika hadi Asia.
where.dg: Unaphahikana sana weruni na nyasini mwa tsi kavu, kanda-kanda ya njira na marisani, kahi ya Afrika hadi Asia.

culture.en: Pakia lists Mtsunga ng’ombe as an 'object-phrase' name, built from a verb and its object, like Mtsonga nyomba, the 'arrow shaft maker'.
culture.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha Mtsunga ng’ombe kama jina la 'kirai cha kitenzi na shamirisho', lililoundwa kwa kitenzi na shamirisho lake, kama Mtsonga nyomba, 'mchongaji wa mishale'.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika *Mtsunga ng’ombe* dza dzina ra 'chihendo na chitu': dzina rinarodzengbwa kula kpwa chihendo na chitu chinachohendwa, dza *Mtsonga nyomba*, 'anayehenda mabura ga mivi'.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names: Mtsunga ng’ombe, translated as 'cattle herder', and Mtsunga mbuzi, which uses the word for goat (mbuzi). No meaning is given for the second, and no shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Hibiscus micranthus.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo: Mtsunga ng’ombe, linalotafsiriwa kuwa 'mchungaji wa ng'ombe', na Mtsunga mbuzi, linalotumia neno la mbuzi. Maana ya jina la pili haitolewi, na hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Hibiscus micranthus.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo: *Mtsunga ng’ombe*, ririrogaluzwa 'mutu anayetsunga ng’ombe', na *Mtsunga mbuzi*, ririrohumira neno ra mbuzi (*mbuzi*). Kalavya mana ya dzina ra phiri, na takuna madzina ga luga zanjina garigoandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Hibiscus micranthus*.

teaser.en: Named after the hare, for reasons nobody can explain.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina la sungura, kwa sababu ambazo hakuna anayeweza kuzieleza.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ni ra tsungula, ela takuna mutu anayeweza kueleza sababu.

summary.en: Mtsungula is Stylosanthes fruticosa, a small perennial legume of grassland. Its Digo name means 'hare', though Pakia found no one who could say why.
summary.sw: Mtsungula ni Stylosanthes fruticosa, mmea mdogo wa kudumu wa jamii ya kunde unaoota nyikani. Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'sungura', ingawa Pakia hakumpata mtu yeyote aliyeweza kusema kwa nini.
summary.dg: *Mtsungula* ni *Stylosanthes fruticosa*, mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde unaokala kpwa miaka minji, wa nyasini. Dzinare ra Chidigo rina mana ya 'tsungula', ela Pakia kaphaha mutu wa kueleza sababu.

about.en: Mtsungula is a low, bushy, somewhat woody herb with sticky-hairy stems. Its leaves are divided into three narrow, pointed leaflets. It bears small yellow pea-flowers tucked among bristly bracts, followed by tiny, hooked, one- or two-seeded pods.
about.sw: Mtsungula ni mmea mfupi, wenye matawi mengi kama kichaka na ugumu wa kimti kiasi, wenye mashina yenye vinyweleo vinavyonata. Majani yake yamegawanyika katika vijani vitatu vyembamba vilivyochongoka. Huzaa maua madogo ya manjano kama ya njegere, yaliyojificha kati ya vikapu-jani vyenye manyoya magumu, yakifuatwa na maganda madogo sana yenye ndoano, yenye mbegu moja au mbili.
about.dg: *Mtsungula* ni mmea mfupi dza chitsaka, wenye mbao chidide, na mihi yenye nyere zinazonyata. Chila kodza rinaganyika kukala makodza madide mahahu membamba genye ntsa. Unalavya maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano dza ga kunde, ganagofwitsika kahi ya makodza madide genye nyere ziriziokaraza (*bracts*), na badaye makakaya madide sana genye chiloo, chila kakaya na tembe mwenga au mbiri.

where.en: It grows in dry grassland, bushland and on sandy or rocky open ground across tropical Africa and Asia.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika kavu, vichaka na kwenye ardhi ya wazi yenye mchanga au mawe kote katika Afrika na Asia ya kitropiki.
where.dg: Unamera nyasini na weruni mwa tsi kavu, na phatu pha kpwereru phenye mtsanga au mawe, kahi ya tsi za dzoho za Afrika na Asia.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Stylosanthes species are well known as nutritious grazing for livestock.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Spishi za Stylosanthes zinajulikana sana kama malisho yenye lishe bora kwa mifugo.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Chidigo. Aina za *Stylosanthes* zinamanyikana sana dza chakurya chinono cha mifugo.

culture.en: Pakia gives it as one of several plants named after animals where the reason is not clear, alongside Mtsalafu, 'safari ants', and Mgongolo, 'millipede'.
culture.sw: Pakia anautoa kama mojawapo ya mimea kadhaa iliyopewa majina ya wanyama bila sababu iliyo wazi, pamoja na Mtsalafu, 'siafu', na Mgongolo, 'jongoo'.
culture.dg: Pakia anauandika dza mwenga wa mimea minji yenye madzina ga nyama ambapho sababu taimanyikana, phamwenga na *Mtsalafu*, 'tsalafu', na *Mgongolo*, 'gongolo'.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsungula, named after the hare (tsungula), though the link between the two is unclear. Mgombato confirms tsungula as hare. In English it is sometimes called shrubby stylo; its scientific name is Stylosanthes fruticosa.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsungula, lililotokana na sungura (tsungula), ingawa uhusiano kati ya viwili hivi haueleweki. Mgombato inathibitisha kwamba tsungula ni sungura. Kwa Kiingereza wakati mwingine huitwa *shrubby stylo*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Stylosanthes fruticosa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsungula*, ririrohalwa kula kpwa tsungula (*tsungula*), ela mana ya kuuiha hivyo taimanyikana. Mgombato nao unaandika kukala *tsungula* ni 'hare' (*sungura*). Kpwa Chingereza mara zanjina unaihwa *shrubby stylo*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Stylosanthes fruticosa*.

teaser.en: A bitter-leaved bush with fluffy white flower heads, a close cousin of the famous bitter leaf.
teaser.sw: Kichaka chenye majani machungu na vichwa vya maua meupe laini kama pamba, binamu wa karibu wa *bitter leaf* maarufu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha makodza ga utsungu chenye vitswa vya maruwa vyereru, laini dza pamba, ndugu wa phephi wa *bitter leaf* inayomanyikana sana.

summary.en: Mtsungutsungu is Vernonia colorata, a shrub of the daisy family with bitter leaves. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtsungutsungu ni Vernonia colorata, kichaka cha familia ya Asteraceae (jamii ya daisy) chenye majani machungu. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: *Mtsungutsungu* ni *Vernonia colorata*, chitsaka cha jamii ya *daisy* chenye makodza ga utsungu. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Mtsungutsungu is a soft-wooded shrub or small tree, usually 2 to 5 m tall. Its leaves are fairly large, oval and finely toothed, and taste very bitter. At the ends of the branches it carries broad, flat-topped clusters of small white or pale mauve, fluffy flower heads, followed by tiny seeds with tufts of bristles that blow away in the wind.
about.sw: Mtsungutsungu ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye mbao laini, kwa kawaida wenye kimo cha mita 2 hadi 5. Majani yake ni makubwa kiasi, yenye umbo la yai na meno madogo, na yana ladha chungu sana. Kwenye ncha za matawi huzaa vishada vipana vyenye vilele bapa vya vichwa vidogo vya maua laini kama pamba, meupe au ya zambarau hafifu, yakifuatwa na mbegu ndogo sana zenye vishungi vya manyoya magumu vinavyopeperushwa na upepo.
about.dg: *Mtsungutsungu* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa mbao laini, kpwa kawaida wa mita 2 hadi 5. Makodzage ni makulu chidide, ga umbo ra tumbi, genye meno madide kanda-kanda, na gana utsungu sana. Kpwenye ntsa za panda unalavya mafungu mapana ga dzulu sawa-sawa ga vitswa vidide vya maruwa vyereru au zambarau ngushu-ngushu, laini dza pamba, na badaye tembe ndide sana zenye nyere zinazophepheruka na phepho.

where.en: It grows in bushland, forest edges, fallow land and riverine thicket across tropical Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka, pembezoni mwa misitu, mashamba yaliyoachwa na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya kando ya mito kote katika Afrika ya kitropiki.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, kanda-kanda ya matsaka, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa na vitsakani kanda-kanda ya miho, kahi ya tsi za dzoho za Afrika.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere in Africa the bitter leaves are widely used in traditional medicine and sometimes eaten like the related bitter leaf, Vernonia amygdalina.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Kwingineko barani Afrika majani yake machungu hutumika sana katika tiba asilia, na wakati mwingine huliwa kama mmea wa jamii yake, *bitter leaf*, Vernonia amygdalina.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Chidigo. Kpwenye seemu zanjina za Afrika, makodza higa ga utsungu nkuhumirwa sana kpwa dawa za chienyeji, na mara zanjina nkuriwa dza ndugu yao, *bitter leaf*, *Vernonia amygdalina*.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsungutsungu but gives no meaning or shared names. In Mgombato tsungutsungu is a very small black ant, but no link to the plant is recorded. Its scientific name is Vernonia colorata (also Gymnanthemum coloratum).
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsungutsungu lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Katika Mgombato, tsungutsungu ni sisimizi mdogo sana mweusi, lakini hakuna uhusiano na mmea huu uliorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Vernonia colorata (pia Gymnanthemum coloratum).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsungutsungu*, ela kalavya mana ya dzina hiri wala madzina ganagohumirwa ni luga zanjina. Kpwenye Mgombato, *tsungutsungu* ni sisimizi mdide sana mwiru, ela takuna ariyeandika kukala dzina ra mmea uhu rinalavywa kula kpwa sisimizi uyu. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Vernonia colorata* (piya *Gymnanthemum coloratum*).

teaser.en: To the Digo, the passion fruit vine is simply 'the fruit plant'.
teaser.sw: Kwa Wadigo, mkarakara ni 'mmea wa tunda' tu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa Adigo, mmea hinyu unaofyombera wa *passion fruit* ni 'mmea wa matunda' tu.

summary.en: Mtunda is the passion fruit, a climbing vine from South America grown in coastal homesteads for its tangy, seedy fruit. Its Digo name is built from tunda, fruit.
summary.sw: Mtunda ni mkarakara, mtambaa kutoka Amerika Kusini unaopandwa katika makazi ya pwani kwa ajili ya matunda yake yenye ladha ya uchachu na mbegu nyingi. Jina lake la Kidigo limejengwa kutokana na tunda.
summary.dg: *Mtunda* ni *passion fruit*, mmea unaofyombera wa kula Amerika ya Kusini, unaophandwa midzini pwani kpwa sababu ya matundage ga ngbwadu-ngbwadu genye tembe nyinji. Dzinare ra Chidigo rikahendwa kula neno *tunda*.

about.en: Mtunda is a vigorous woody climber that holds on with coiled tendrils. Its leaves are glossy and deeply three-lobed. The flowers are intricate and beautiful, white with a crown of wavy purple-and-white filaments. The round fruit, about the size of a hen's egg, ripens purple or yellow and is filled with juicy, aromatic pulp around small black seeds.
about.sw: Mtunda ni mtambaa wenye nguvu na shina gumu, unaoshika kwa vikonyo vilivyojikunja. Majani yake yanang'aa na yana mapengo matatu marefu. Maua yake ni tata na mazuri, meupe yakiwa na taji la nyuzi zilizopindapinda za zambarau na nyeupe. Tunda la mviringo, lenye ukubwa wa yai la kuku, huiva likiwa la zambarau au la manjano na limejaa nyama yenye maji mengi na harufu nzuri inayozunguka mbegu ndogo nyeusi.
about.dg: *Mtunda* ni mmea unaofyombera wenye nguvu na wa mbao, unaogbwira kpwa vigongo vyembamba vinavyodzizunguluka. Makodzage ganang'arira na gana mala mahahu. Maruwa ni ga ajabu na manono, mereru na ganakala na taji ya nyuzi za zambarau na nyereru, dza mawimbi. Tunda ra duara, sawa na tumbi ra kuku, rinaivwa richikala ra zambarau au ra rangi ya mandano, na ndani rinaodzala nyama-nyama ya madzi-madzi yenye arufu nono, iriyozunguluka tembe ndide nyiru.

where.en: It is native to South America and is now grown across the tropics. On the coast it is trained over fences, trees and frames around homesteads and on small farms.
where.sw: Asili yake ni Amerika Kusini na sasa hupandwa kote katika nchi za tropiki. Pwani, hutambazwa juu ya ua, miti na fremu kuzunguka makazi na kwenye mashamba madogo.
where.dg: Asiliye ni Amerika ya Kusini, na sambi unaphandwa kosi kpwenye tsi za dzoho. Pwani nkukpwezwa dzulu ya chigo, mihi na vibao kanda-kanda ya midzi na kpwenye minda midide.

uses.en: The pulp is eaten fresh and made into juice. Passion fruit is a popular fruit for drinks on the Kenyan coast and is also sold in local markets.
uses.sw: Nyama yake huliwa kama ilivyo na hutengenezwa sharubati. Karakara ni tunda linalopendwa kwa vinywaji pwani ya Kenya na pia huuzwa katika masoko ya mitaani.
uses.dg: Nyama-nyama nkuriwa dza irivyo na nkuhendwa madzi ga matunda. *Passion fruit* ni tunda rinaromendzwa sana kpwa vinwadzi pwani ya Kenya, na piya nkuguzwa kpwenye masoko ga kahi ya tsi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtunda for the passion fruit. Pakia's appendices use tunda as the Digo word for fruit, so the name means something like 'fruit plant'. In Swahili the plant is mkarakara and the fruit karakara or pasheni. Its scientific name is Passiflora edulis.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtunda kwa mkarakara. Viambatisho vya Pakia vinatumia tunda kama neno la Kidigo la tunda, hivyo jina hili lina maana kama 'mmea wa tunda'. Kwa Kiswahili mmea huu ni mkarakara na tunda ni karakara au pasheni. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Passiflora edulis.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtunda* kpwa *passion fruit*. Nyongeza za Pakia zinahumira *tunda* dza neno ra Chidigo ra 'tunda', kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rina mana dza 'mmea wa matunda'. Kpwa Chiswahili mmea unaihwa *mkarakara* na tunda *karakara* au *pasheni*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Passiflora edulis*.

reason.dg: *Adenia*, ndugu wa weruni wa jamii ya *passion flower*
