digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. V, App. VI

teaser.en: The forest's own jasmine: the wild cousin of the scented flowers women wear in their hair.
teaser.sw: Asmini ya msituni yenyewe: binamu wa porini wa maua yenye harufu nzuri ambayo wanawake huvaa nywele zao.
teaser.dg: Asmini ya tsakani: ndugu wa weruni wa maruwa ga arufu nono ganagovwalwa ni achetu nyereni.

summary.en: Mtunda hofu is a wild jasmine of the coastal bush, also called Muasumini wa tsakani, 'jasmine of the forest'. It is the wild form of the cultivated jasmine whose flowers are used for decoration.
summary.sw: Mtunda hofu ni asmini ya porini ya vichaka vya pwani, inayoitwa pia Muasumini wa tsakani, 'asmini ya msituni'. Ni aina ya porini ya mwasmini unaopandwa, ambao maua yake hutumika kama mapambo.
summary.dg: *Mtunda hofu* ni asmini ya weruni ya pwani, inayoihwa piya *Muasumini wa tsakani*, 'asmini ya tsakani'. Ndiyo aina ya weruni ya asmini inayophandwa, ambayo maruwage nkuhumirwa kupambira.

about.en: Mtunda hofu is a scrambling or climbing shrub with opposite leaves, each made of three leaflets, the end one larger. It produces starry white, sweetly scented flowers with a long, narrow tube and five to nine spreading lobes, followed by small, shiny black berries, often in pairs. The Digo identify it by its leaves and flowers.
about.sw: Mtunda hofu ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda, chenye majani yanayokabiliana, kila jani likiwa na vijani vitatu, kile cha mwisho kikiwa kikubwa zaidi. Hutoa maua meupe kama nyota yenye harufu tamu, yenye mrija mrefu mwembamba na pindo tano hadi tisa zilizotandaa, yakifuatwa na beri ndogo nyeusi zinazong'aa, mara nyingi jozi jozi. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na maua yake.
about.dg: *Mtunda hofu* ni chitsaka chinachoambala au chinachofyombera, chenye makodza ganagolengana; chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu, na kodza ridide ra mwisho ni kulu kuriko ganjina. Unalavya maruwa mereru dza nyota, ga arufu nono, genye mrija mure na mwembamba na seemu tsano hadi tisiya zinazotandazika, na badaye matunda madide maru ganang'ala, mara nyinji mairi-mairi. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na maruwage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and forest edges, scrambling over other shrubs.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka, vichaka-mwitu vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani, ukitambaa juu ya vichaka vingine.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani, na unaambala dzulu ya vitsaka vyanjina.

culture.en: Its second name links it to the cultivated jasmine, asmini or muasumini, whose flower rosettes Pakia records as decorations worn on clothes and heads or laid on beds, for their beauty and fragrance. Such adornments belong to the Digo idea of maruwa, beauty. Pakia also notes that muasumini is a word borrowed from Swahili.
culture.sw: Jina lake la pili linauhusisha na asmini inayopandwa, asmini au muasumini, ambayo vishada vya maua yake Pakia anavirekodi kama mapambo yanayovaliwa kwenye nguo na vichwani au kutandazwa vitandani, kwa uzuri na harufu yake. Mapambo kama haya ni sehemu ya dhana ya Kidigo ya maruwa, urembo. Pakia pia anaeleza kwamba muasumini ni neno lililotoholewa kutoka Kiswahili.
culture.dg: Dzinare ra phiri rinauunga na asmini inayophandwa, *asmini* au *muasumini*, ambayo Pakia anaandika kukala mafungu ga maruwage nkuvwalwa nguwoni na chitswani dza vitu vya kupambira, au nkuikpwa dzulu ya vitanda, kpwa uzuri na arufu yao nono. Vitu vya kudzipamba dza vino ni seemu ya *maruwa*, uzuri kpwa Chidigo. Pakia piya anaandika kukala *muasumini* ni neno ririrohalwa kula Chiswahili.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names. Mtunda hofu is given without a meaning. Muasumini wa tsakani, written Muasmini wa tsakani in Appendix VI, means 'jasmine in the forest', the wild form of the grown perfume plant Muasumini. No shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Jasminum meyeri-johannis.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo. Mtunda hofu limetolewa bila maana. Muasumini wa tsakani, linaloandikwa Muasmini wa tsakani katika Kiambatisho VI, lina maana ya 'asmini msituni', aina ya porini ya mmea wa manukato unaopandwa, Muasumini. Hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Jasminum meyeri-johannis.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo. Kalavya mana ya *Mtunda hofu*. *Muasumini wa tsakani*, ririroandikpwa *Muasmini wa tsakani* kpwenye Nyongeza VI, rina mana ya 'asmini ya tsakani', aina ya weruni ya mmea wa arufu nono unaophandwa, *Muasumini*. Takuna madzina ga luga zanjina garigoandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Jasminum meyeri-johannis*.

teaser.en: The only plant the Digo identify by ear: listen for the wind whistling through its hollow thorns.
teaser.sw: Mmea pekee ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa sikio: sikiliza upepo ukipiga mluzi kupitia miiba yake yenye uwazi ndani.
teaser.dg: Mmea mwenga tu ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa kusikira: sikira phepho richipiga milozi kahi ya miyaye mihuphu.

summary.en: Muhega kululu is the coast whistling thorn, an acacia whose swollen, ant-hollowed thorns whistle in the wind. Pakia found it is the only plant the Digo identify by sound.
summary.sw: Muhega kululu ni *coast whistling thorn*, mgunga ambao miiba yake iliyovimba, iliyotobolewa na sisimizi, hupiga mluzi upepo unapovuma. Pakia aligundua kwamba ndio mmea pekee ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa sauti.
summary.dg: *Muhega kululu* ni *coast whistling thorn*, muhi wa miya wa jamii ya *acacia*, ambao miyaye iriyofutuka, iriyohendwa mihuphu ni sisimizi, inapiga milozi phepho richipiga. Pakia waona kukala ndio mmea mwenga tu ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa sauti.

about.en: Muhega kululu is a small, flat-topped thorn tree, usually 3 to 9 m tall, with feathery, finely divided leaves. Its long straight white thorns are paired, and some swell at the base into hollow, ball-like galls. Ants live in the galls and chew small holes in them, and when the wind blows across the holes they whistle. It has fluffy, round white flower heads and flat, curved pods.
about.sw: Muhega kululu ni mti mdogo wa miiba wenye kilele bapa, kwa kawaida wenye kimo cha mita 3 hadi 9, na majani laini kama manyoya yaliyogawanyika katika vijani vidogo. Miiba yake mirefu, iliyonyooka na myeupe iko jozi jozi, na baadhi huvimba kwenye kitako na kuwa vivimbe vyenye uwazi ndani kama mipira. Sisimizi huishi ndani ya vivimbe hivyo na kutafuna vitundu vidogo, na upepo unapovuma juu ya vitundu hivyo hupiga mluzi. Una vichwa vya maua meupe ya mviringo laini kama pamba, na maganda bapa yaliyopinda.
about.dg: *Muhega kululu* ni muhi mdide wa miya, wenye dzulu sawa-sawa, kpwa kawaida wa mita 3 hadi 9, na makodza ga manyoya ganagoganyika kukala makodza madide sana. Miyaye ni mire, mireru na ya kugoloka, na inamera mairi-mairi; yanjina inafutuka photsi ichikala dza mipira mihuphu. Sisimizi anakala mumo na anahenda makobo madide kpwa kuluma, na phepho richitsupa dzulu ya makobo higa, ganapiga milozi. Una vitswa vya maruwa vyereru vya mviringo, laini dza pamba, na makakaya mapana membamba ganagootyoka.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and wooded grassland, often on black-cotton or seasonally waterlogged clay soils, along the coast of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na nyika zenye miti za pwani, mara nyingi kwenye udongo wa mbuga (black cotton) au udongo wa mfinyanzi unaotuama maji kwa msimu, kando ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na nyasini phenye mihi pwani, mara nyinji kpwenye ulongo uriru au gandika inayodzala madzi wakati wa mvula, kanda-kanda ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

culture.en: Pakia notes that hearing is not a method scientific botanists use to identify plants, but a Digo can identify this tree from the noise the wind makes in it, and it is the only species identified this way. Appendix V lists the wind sound, together with the leaves, as how it is recognised.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba kusikia si njia wanayoitumia wataalamu wa mimea kutambua mimea, lakini Mdigo anaweza kuutambua mti huu kwa sauti ya upepo ndani yake, na ndio spishi pekee inayotambuliwa kwa njia hii. Kiambatisho V kinaorodhesha sauti ya upepo, pamoja na majani, kama njia ya kuutambua.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala kusikira si njira inayohumirwa ni asayansi a mimea kumanya mimea, ela Mdigo anaweza kuumanya muhi uhu kpwa kululu phepho rinarohenda mwakpwe ndani, na ndiyo aina mwenga tu inayomanyikana hivyo. Nyongeza V inaandika kululu ra phepho, phamwenga na makodza, dza njira ya kuumanya.

names.en: Pakia's Appendix III gives Muhega kululu; Appendix V writes it Mpiga kululu. Pakia gives no meaning, but in Mgombato kululu means noise, which fits the tree's whistling. In English it is the coast whistling thorn; its scientific name is Acacia zanzibarica (now often Vachellia zanzibarica).
names.sw: Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinatoa Muhega kululu; Kiambatisho V kinaliandika Mpiga kululu. Pakia hatoi maana yake, lakini katika Mgombato kululu maana yake ni kelele, jambo linalolingana na mluzi wa mti huu. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *coast whistling thorn*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Acacia zanzibarica (siku hizi mara nyingi Vachellia zanzibarica).
names.dg: Nyongeza III ya Pakia inapha *Muhega kululu*; Nyongeza V inaandika *Mpiga kululu*. Pakia kalavya mana, ela kpwenye Mgombato *kululu* ni 'noise' (kelele), na mana hino ni sawa na milozi ya muhi uhu. Kpwa Chingereza ni *coast whistling thorn*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Acacia zanzibarica* (sambi mara nyinji *Vachellia zanzibarica*).

teaser.en: 'The forest banana': a rare, sweet-scented coastal tree whose fruits look like little bunches of bananas.
teaser.sw: 'Ndizi ya msituni': mti adimu wa pwani wenye harufu tamu, ambao matunda yake yanafanana na vichane vidogo vya ndizi.
teaser.dg: 'Izu ra tsakani': muhi adimu wa pwani wa arufu nono, ambao matundage ganahalana na mafungu madide ga mazu.

summary.en: Muizu wa tsakani is Ophrypetalum odoratum, a small, rare tree of coastal forest. Its Digo name means 'banana of the forest' because its fruits look like bananas.
summary.sw: Muizu wa tsakani ni Ophrypetalum odoratum, mti mdogo adimu wa misitu ya pwani. Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'ndizi ya msituni' kwa sababu matunda yake yanafanana na ndizi.
summary.dg: *Muizu wa tsakani* ni *Ophrypetalum odoratum*, muhi mdide adimu wa matsaka ga pwani. Dzinare ra Chidigo rina mana ya 'izu ra tsakani', kpwa sababu matundage ganahalana na mazu.

about.en: Muizu wa tsakani is a shrub or small tree, about 4 to 5 m tall, of the custard-apple family. Its flowers are strongly perfumed, which gives the species its scientific name, odoratum. Its fruits are clusters of elongated segments that resemble small bananas. The Digo recognise it by the look of the whole plant.
about.sw: Muizu wa tsakani ni kichaka au mti mdogo, wenye kimo cha takriban mita 4 hadi 5, wa familia ya mitopetope (custard apple). Maua yake yana harufu kali ya manukato, ndiyo inayoipa spishi hii jina lake la kisayansi, odoratum. Matunda yake ni vishada vya vipande virefu vinavyofanana na ndizi ndogo. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg: *Muizu wa tsakani* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa phephi mita 4 hadi 5, wa jamii ya *mbokwe*. Maruwage gana arufu nono sana, na ndiyo sababu ya dzina ra chisayansi ra aina hino, *odoratum*. Matundage ni mafungu ga vipande vire ganagohalana na mazu madide. Adigo anaumanya kpwa sura ya mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows only in the coastal forests of south-east Kenya and eastern Tanzania, and has been collected in Kwale and Kilifi districts, south and north of Mombasa.
where.sw: Huota tu katika misitu ya pwani ya kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na mashariki mwa Tanzania, na umekusanywa katika wilaya za Kwale na Kilifi, kusini na kaskazini mwa Mombasa.
where.dg: Unamera tu kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ga kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na mashariki mwa Tanzania, na ukahalwa kula wilaya za Kwale na Kilifi, kusini na kazikazini mwa Mombasa.

culture.en: Pakia uses this name to explain the affixes tsaka and tsakani, both meaning 'of the forest'; the only difference is that tsakani is joined with the linking word wa.
culture.sw: Pakia anatumia jina hili kueleza viambishi tsaka na tsakani, vyote vikiwa na maana ya 'wa msituni'; tofauti pekee ni kwamba tsakani huunganishwa na neno-kiunganishi wa.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira dzina hiri kueleza seemu za madzina *tsaka* na *tsakani*, ambazo zosi mbiri zina mana ya 'ya tsakani'; tafwauti tu ni kukala *tsakani* nkuandikpwa phamwenga na neno ra kuunganya *wa*.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Muizu wa tsakani, 'banana in the forest', because its fruits resemble mazu, bananas, but it is recognised as a forest kind. No shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Ophrypetalum odoratum.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Muizu wa tsakani, 'ndizi msituni', kwa sababu matunda yake yanafanana na mazu, ndizi, lakini unatambuliwa kama aina ya msituni. Hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Ophrypetalum odoratum.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Muizu wa tsakani*, 'izu ra tsakani', kpwa sababu matundage ganahalana na *mazu*, ela unamanyikana kukala ni aina ya tsakani. Takuna madzina ga luga zanjina garigoandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Ophrypetalum odoratum*.

conservation.en: Ophrypetalum odoratum is listed as Near Threatened on the IUCN Red List. Its whole range is a narrow strip of coastal forest that is being cleared for farms and building.
conservation.sw: Ophrypetalum odoratum imeorodheshwa kama Karibu Kuwa Hatarini (Near Threatened) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN. Eneo lake lote la kuenea ni ukanda mwembamba wa misitu ya pwani unaofyekwa kwa ajili ya mashamba na ujenzi.
conservation.dg: *Ophrypetalum odoratum* ikaandikpwa kpwenye orodha ya IUCN (*Red List*) dza aina iriyo phephi na hatari (*Near Threatened*). Phatu phosi phanaphomera ni seemu nyembamba ya matsaka ga pwani ambayo inatemwa ili kuhenda minda na kudzenga nyumba.

teaser.en: The forest double of a grassland shrub, though botanists put the two in different families.
teaser.sw: Pacha wa msituni wa kichaka cha nyikani, ingawa wataalamu wa mimea wamewaweka katika familia tofauti.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa tsakani unaohalana na chitsaka cha nyasini, ela asayansi a mimea anaika mimea iyo miiri kpwenye jamii mbiri tafwauti.

summary.en: Mvamva wa tsakani is Memecylon sansibaricum, a shrub or small tree of coastal forest. The Digo see it as the forest form of Mvamva, a Millettia of the bushed grassland.
summary.sw: Mvamva wa tsakani ni Memecylon sansibaricum, kichaka au mti mdogo wa misitu ya pwani. Wadigo wanauona kama aina ya msituni ya Mvamva, Millettia ya nyika zenye vichaka.
summary.dg: *Mvamva wa tsakani* ni *Memecylon sansibaricum*, chitsaka au muhi mdide wa matsaka ga pwani. Adigo anauona kukala ni aina ya tsakani ya *Mvamva*, *Millettia* ya nyasini yenye vitsaka.

about.en: Mvamva wa tsakani is an evergreen shrub or small tree with opposite, leathery, glossy leaves whose side veins are almost invisible. Like other Memecylons it bears clusters of small blue to purple flowers on the older twigs, followed by small round berries that ripen dark purple or black.
about.sw: Mvamva wa tsakani ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima, majani yanayokabiliana, magumu kama ngozi na yanayong'aa, ambayo mishipa yake ya pembeni karibu haionekani. Kama Memecylon nyingine, huzaa vishada vya maua madogo ya buluu hadi zambarau kwenye vitawi vikongwe, yakifuatwa na beri ndogo za mviringo zinazoiva zikawa za zambarau iliyokolea au nyeusi.
about.dg: *Mvamva wa tsakani* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganagolengana, ni mafu dza chingo na ganang'ala, na mishipa yao ya kanda-kanda phephi taionekana. Dza *Memecylon* zanjina, unalavya mafungu ga maruwa madide ga samawati hadi zambarau kpwenye maphungo ga kare, na badaye matunda madide ga mviringo ganagokala ga zambarau-nyiru au maru gachikala maivu.

where.en: It grows in the coastal forests and thickets of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani na vitsakani pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

culture.en: The name shows how Digo naming pairs plants by habitat: a forest plant is named after a look-alike from the open country and marked tsaka or wa tsakani, 'of the forest'.
culture.sw: Jina hili linaonyesha jinsi utaratibu wa kutoa majina wa Kidigo unavyooanisha mimea kwa makazi: mmea wa msituni hupewa jina la mmea unaofanana nao wa maeneo ya wazi na kutiwa alama tsaka au wa tsakani, 'wa msituni'.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinaonyesa vira Adigo anavyounga mimea mairi-mairi kpwa phatu inaphomera: mmea wa tsakani nkuihwa kula kpwa dzina ra mmea wa weruni unaohalana nao, na nkutiywa alama *tsaka* au *wa tsakani*, 'ya tsakani'.

names.en: Pakia's Appendix III gives Mvamva wa tsakani; Appendix VI writes it Mphvamva tsaka and explains it as 'forest Millettia', the forest type of Mphamva (Millettia usaramensis), which grows in bushed grassland. No shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Memecylon sansibaricum.
names.sw: Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinatoa Mvamva wa tsakani; Kiambatisho VI kinaliandika Mphvamva tsaka na kulifafanua kuwa 'Millettia ya msituni', aina ya msituni ya Mphamva (Millettia usaramensis), unaoota katika nyika zenye vichaka. Hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Memecylon sansibaricum.
names.dg: Nyongeza III ya Pakia inapha *Mvamva wa tsakani*; Nyongeza VI inaandika *Mphvamva tsaka* na inaeleza kukala ni '*Millettia* ya tsakani', aina ya tsakani ya *Mphamva* (*Millettia usaramensis*), unaomera nyasini yenye vitsaka. Takuna madzina ga luga zanjina garigoandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Memecylon sansibaricum*.

teaser.en: A fisherman's shrub: its sticks are used to catch koe, a small sea creature.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha wavuvi: vijiti vyake hutumika kuvua koe, kiumbe mdogo wa baharini.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha avuvi: vigongovye nkuhumirwa kuvuwa *koe*, nyama mdide wa bahari.

summary.en: Mvua koe is Pluchea sordida, a coastal shrub of the daisy family. Its name means 'fisher of koe', because its sticks are used to fish for koe, a crustacean of the sea.
summary.sw: Mvua koe ni Pluchea sordida, kichaka cha pwani cha familia ya alizeti. Jina lake lina maana ya 'mvuvi wa koe', kwa sababu vijiti vyake hutumika kuvua koe, mnyama wa jamii ya kaa wa baharini.
summary.dg: *Mvua koe* ni *Pluchea sordida*, chitsaka cha pwani cha jamii ya *daisy*. Dzinare rina mana ya 'mvuvi wa koe', kpwa sababu vigongovye nkuhumirwa kuvuwa *koe*, nyama wa bahari wa jamii ya tande.

about.en: Mvua koe is a soft, much-branched shrub with grey-green, softly hairy, often slightly sticky and aromatic leaves. Its small purplish or whitish flower heads grow in clusters at the branch ends, as in other Pluchea species.
about.sw: Mvua koe ni kichaka laini chenye matawi mengi, na majani ya rangi ya kijivu-kijani yenye manyoya laini, mara nyingi yanayonata kidogo na yenye harufu. Vichwa vyake vidogo vya maua, vya rangi ya zambarau au nyeupe-nyeupe, huota kwa mafungu kwenye ncha za matawi, kama ilivyo kwa spishi nyingine za Pluchea.
about.dg: *Mvua koe* ni chitsaka laini chenye panda nyinji, na makodza ga rangi ya ivu na chijani, genye nyere laini; mara nyinji ganagonyata chidide na gana arufu. Vitswa vidide vya maruwa, vya zambarau-zambarau au vyereru-vyereru, vinamera mafungu kpwenye ntsa za panda, dza kpwa aina zanjina za *Pluchea*.

where.en: It grows near the coast, in bushland and on sandy ground close to the shore.
where.sw: Huota karibu na pwani, vichakani na kwenye ardhi ya mchanga karibu na ufuo.
where.dg: Unamera phephi na bahari, weruni na kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga phephi na kanda ya bahari.

uses.en: Pakia records that its sticks are used for fishing koe, a kind of crustacean in the sea.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba vijiti vyake hutumika kuvua koe, aina ya mnyama wa jamii ya kaa anayeishi baharini.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala vigongovye nkuhumirwa kuvuwa *koe*, aina ya nyama wa bahari wa jamii ya tande.

culture.en: Pakia pairs it with Mvua pweza, 'fisher of octopus' (Ochna thomasiana), as plants named for their part in Digo fishing.
culture.sw: Pakia anauweka pamoja na Mvua pweza, 'mvuvi wa pweza' (Ochna thomasiana), kama mimea iliyopewa majina kutokana na nafasi yake katika uvuvi wa Wadigo.
culture.dg: Pakia anauunga na *Mvua pweza*, 'mvuvi wa pweza' (*Ochna thomasiana*), dza mimea iriyoihwa madzina kpwa sababu nkuhumirwa ni Adigo kuvuwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mvua koe, 'fisher of koe'. No shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Pluchea sordida.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mvua koe, 'mvuvi wa koe'. Hakuna majina ya pamoja na lugha nyingine yaliyoripotiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Pluchea sordida.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mvua koe*, 'mvuvi wa koe'. Takuna madzina ga luga zanjina garigoandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Pluchea sordida*.

teaser.sw: Kivumbasi kinachotuliza maji ndooni: majani yake huelea juu ili maji yasimrukie mbebaji kichwani.
teaser.dg: *Fern* inayorinda madzi ndooni: makodzage nkuikpwa dzulu ya madzi ili gasimwagike dzulu ya chitswa cha mutu anayedzihika ndoo.

summary.en: Mvwiko is Davallia chaerophylloides, a lacy fern. Its fronds are laid on the water in a bucket carried on the head, as floaters that stop it spilling.
summary.sw: Mvwiko ni Davallia chaerophylloides, kivumbasi chenye majani maridadi kama lesi. Majani yake hutandazwa juu ya maji ndani ya ndoo inayobebwa kichwani, yakielea ili maji yasimwagike.
summary.dg: *Mvwiko* ni *Davallia chaerophylloides*, *fern* yenye makodza ganagoganyika sana kukala vipande vidide. Makodzage nkuikpwa dzulu ya madzi ga ndoo inayodzihikwa chitswani, dza *mivwiko* inayoelea, ili madzi gasimwagike.

about.en: Mvwiko is a fern with a thick, creeping rhizome covered in brown scales, from which finely divided, lacy, triangular fronds arise. The tiny spore cases sit in small cups near the edges of the leaflets. The Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mvwiko ni kivumbasi chenye kiazi (shina la chini ya ardhi) kinene kinachotambaa na kufunikwa na magamba ya kahawia, ambacho huchipuza majani yaliyogawanyika kwa unyoofu, maridadi kama lesi, yenye umbo la pembetatu. Vifuko vidogo sana vya vijimbegu (spora) hukaa ndani ya vikombe vidogo karibu na kingo za vijani. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Mvwiko* ni *fern* yenye seemu kulu inayoambala (*rhizome*), iriyofwinikpwa ni vipande vidide vya rangi ya dongo, na kula phapho kunatuluka makodza (*fronds*) ganagoganyika sana kukala vipande vidide, ga umbo ra pembe tahu. Mbeyu ndide sana (*spores*) zinakala kpwenye vikombe vidide phephi na kanda za makodza madide. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows on tree trunks, rocks and shaded banks in moist forest and thicket.
where.sw: Huota juu ya vigogo vya miti, miambani na kwenye kingo zenye kivuli katika misitu na vichaka vyenye unyevunyevu.
where.dg: Unamera dzulu ya makolo ga mihi, mawe na kanda-kanda zenye chivuri, kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vyenye chinemi.

uses.en: Pakia records that the leaves are put into a bucket of water as floaters (mivwiko) to keep the water from spilling onto the person carrying it on her head.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba majani yake huwekwa ndani ya ndoo ya maji kama vielea (mivwiko) ili maji yasimwagikie mtu anayeibeba kichwani.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala makodza nkutiywa ndooni ya madzi dza *mivwiko* (vitu vinavyoelea) ili madzi gasimwagike dzulu ya mutu anayeidzihika chitswani.

culture.en: Pakia lists Mvwiko among names that describe a plant's product, alongside Msabuni (soap) and Msuwaki (toothbrush).
culture.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha Mvwiko miongoni mwa majina yanayoeleza kitu kinachotokana na mmea, pamoja na Msabuni (sabuni) na Msuwaki (mswaki).
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika *Mvwiko* kahi ya madzina ganagoeleza chitu chinacholavywa ni mmea, phamwenga na *Msabuni* (sabuni) na *Msuwaki* (msuwaki).

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mvwiko, meaning 'floaters', after the mivwiko placed in water buckets. The same name is used for bracken, Pteridium aquilinum. Pakia's English name is simply 'fern'; its scientific name is Davallia chaerophylloides.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mvwiko, lenye maana ya 'vielea', kutokana na mivwiko inayowekwa kwenye ndoo za maji. Jina hilohilo hutumika kwa *bracken*, Pteridium aquilinum. Jina la Kiingereza analotoa Pakia ni *fern* tu; jina lake la kisayansi ni Davallia chaerophylloides.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mvwiko*, ririro na mana ya 'vitu vinavyoelea', kula kpwa *mivwiko* inayoikpwa ndooni. Dzina hiri hiri nkuhumirwa piya kpwa *bracken*, *Pteridium aquilinum*. Dzina ra Chingereza ra Pakia ni *fern* tu; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Davallia chaerophylloides*.

teaser.en: One of the world's most widespread plants, and one of its more poisonous ferns.
teaser.sw: Mmoja wa mimea iliyoenea zaidi duniani, na mojawapo ya vivumbasi vyenye sumu zaidi.
teaser.dg: Mwenga wa mimea inayomera phatu phanji zaidi duniani, na mwenga wa *fern* zenye sumu zaidi.

summary.en: This Mvwiko is bracken, a tall, tough fern that forms dense stands on open and burnt ground. Pakia gives it the same Digo name as the lacy fern Davallia.
summary.sw: Mvwiko huu ni *bracken*, kivumbasi kirefu na kigumu kinachoota kwa wingi kama kichaka kwenye ardhi wazi na iliyochomwa moto. Pakia anaupa jina lile lile la Kidigo kama kivumbasi maridadi Davallia.
summary.dg: *Mvwiko* uhu ni *bracken*, *fern* ndefu yenye nguvu inayomera kpwa makundi manji phatu pha kpwereru na phatu phariphotsomwa moho. Pakia anaupha dzina ra Chidigo sawa na ra *fern* ya makodza ganagoganyika sana, *Davallia*.

about.en: Bracken grows from deep, spreading underground stems, sending up single, tall, stiff fronds that can reach head height. Each frond is broad and triangular, divided two or three times into many small leaflets, and the young fronds uncurl like fiddle heads. The spores form along the rolled-under leaf edges.
about.sw: Bracken huota kutoka mashina ya chini ya ardhi yaliyo ndani na yanayoenea, ukichipuza jani moja moja refu na gumu linaloweza kufikia kimo cha kichwa cha mtu. Kila jani ni pana lenye umbo la pembetatu, limegawanyika mara mbili au tatu kuwa vijani vingi vidogo, na majani machanga hujikunjua kama kichwa cha fidla. Vijimbegu (spora) hutokea kando ya kingo za majani zilizojikunja kwa chini.
about.dg: *Bracken* inamera kula kpwa seemu za tsini zinazotandazika tsini sana (*rhizomes*), na inalavya makodza (*fronds*) mire na magumu, chila rimwenga macheye, ganagoweza kufika urefu wa chitswa cha mutu. Chila kodza ni pana na ra umbo ra pembe tahu, na rinaganyika mara mbiri au tahu kukala makodza madide manji; makodza maphya ganavuguka pore-pore kula kpwa umbo ra kudzizunguluka. Mbeyu ndide sana (*spores*) zinamera kanda-kanda ya makodza, phatu kanda zinaphogaluka photsi.

where.en: It is found almost worldwide. In Kenya it forms thickets on open, burnt or cleared land, forest edges and higher, wetter ground, often on acid soils.
where.sw: Hupatikana karibu kila mahali duniani. Nchini Kenya huunda vichaka kwenye ardhi wazi, iliyochomwa moto au iliyosafishwa, pembezoni mwa misitu na kwenye nyanda za juu zenye unyevu zaidi, mara nyingi kwenye udongo wenye asidi.
where.dg: Inaphahikana phephi kpwa chila phatu duniani. Kenya inahenda vitsaka kpwenye tsi ya kpwereru, iriyotsomwa moho au iriyotemwa, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye tsi ya dzulu yenye mvula nyinji, mara nyinji kpwenye ulongo wa ngbwadu.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Bracken contains compounds that are poisonous to livestock and are linked to cancer, so it is not a safe plant to eat, even though young fronds are eaten in some parts of the world.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Bracken ina viambato vyenye sumu kwa mifugo na vinavyohusishwa na saratani, kwa hiyo si mmea salama kuliwa, ingawa majani yake machanga huliwa katika baadhi ya sehemu za dunia.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Chidigo. *Bracken* ina kemikali zenye sumu kpwa mifugo, na zinahusiana na ukongo wa saratani (*cancer*), kpwa hivyo si mmea salama wa kurya, dzagbwe makodza maphya nkuriwa kpwenye seemu zanjina za dunia.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mvwiko, 'floaters'. The meaning and the use as bucket floaters are recorded for the lacy fern Davallia chaerophylloides, which shares the name. In English it is bracken; its scientific name is Pteridium aquilinum.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mvwiko, 'vielea'. Maana hiyo na matumizi ya kuelea ndooni yameripotiwa kwa kivumbasi maridadi Davallia chaerophylloides, kinachoshiriki jina hilo. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *bracken*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Pteridium aquilinum.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mvwiko*, 'vitu vinavyoelea'. Pakia anaandika mana hino na kuhumirwa dza vitu vya kuelea ndooni kpwa *fern* ya makodza ganagoganyika sana, *Davallia chaerophylloides*, ambayo ina dzina hiri hiri. Kpwa Chingereza ni *bracken*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Pteridium aquilinum*.

teaser.en: A fat-stemmed succulent with showy pink trumpets, and sap poisonous enough to tip an arrow.
teaser.sw: Mmea wenye shina nene, maua ya waridi yenye umbo la tarumbeta, na utomvu wenye sumu kali ya kutosha kupaka mshale.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha madzi-madzi chenye kolo ra kufutuka na maruwa manono ga pinki ga umbo ra ndzumari, na maziya ga sumu kali hata ganaweza kutiywa kpwenye ntsa za mivi.

summary.en: Mwadiga is the desert rose, a succulent shrub with a swollen base and showy pink flowers, grown in gardens and found wild on dry rocky ground. Its latex is very poisonous and has been used in arrow poison.
summary.sw: Mwadiga ni mmea wenye shina lililovimba chini na maua ya waridi ya kuvutia, unaopandwa bustanini na pia kupatikana porini kwenye ardhi kavu yenye miamba. Utomvu wake una sumu kali sana na umewahi kutumiwa katika sumu ya mishale.
summary.dg: Mwadiga (kpwa Chingereza *desert rose*) ni chitsaka cha madzi-madzi chenye kolo ra kufutuka photsi na maruwa manono ga pinki. Nkuphandwa busitanini, na piya unaphahikana weruni kpwenye tsi kavu ya mawe. Maziyage ni sumu kali sana, na gakahumirwa kuhenda sumu ya mivi.

about.en: Mwadiga is a succulent shrub, usually under 2 m, whose stem base may swell into a bulbous trunk up to a metre across. Its fleshy, glossy leaves crowd at the branch tips, and white latex drips out at once when they are cut. The flowers are trumpet-shaped, about 5 cm across, white or pale pink to deep rose with darker edges, and are most striking on the bare stems. Paired, horn-like capsules split to free seeds with tufts of silky hair at each end. The Digo recognise it by the look of the whole plant.
about.sw: Mwadiga ni kichaka chenye majimaji, kwa kawaida chini ya m 2, ambacho sehemu ya chini ya shina lake huweza kuvimba na kuwa gogo la mviringo lenye upana wa hadi mita moja. Majani yake manene yanayong'aa hujikusanya kwenye ncha za matawi, na utomvu mweupe hutiririka papo hapo yanapokatwa. Maua yana umbo la tarumbeta, upana wa takriban sm 5, meupe au ya waridi hafifu hadi waridi iliyokolea yenye kingo za rangi nzito zaidi, na hupendeza zaidi yakiwa kwenye mashina yasiyo na majani. Matunda yake ni maganda mawili mawili yenye umbo la pembe, ambayo hupasuka kuachilia mbegu zenye vishungi vya manyoya laini kama hariri kila upande. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg: Mwadiga ni chitsaka cha madzi-madzi, kpwa kawaida taufika mita 2. Photsi kolore rinaweza kufutuka na kukala dza chiazi chikulu, ambacho upanawe unaweza kufika mita mwenga. Makodzage ganona na ganang'ala, ganamera phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za panda, na gachikatwa maziya mereru ganadoda mara mwenga. Maruwage ni ga umbo ra ndzumari, upanawe sentimita 5 hivi; ni mereru, au ga pinki ngushu-ngushu hadi pinki sana, na kanda-kanda zao ni za rangi ya jiza zaidi. Ganaonekana manono zaidi gachimera dzulu ya panda zisizo na makodza. Makakaya mairi-mairi, dza pembe, ganaahuka na kuricha tembe zenye mafungu ga nyere laini kpwenye ntsa zosi mbiri. Adigo anaumanya kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows wild in hot, dry bushland and coastal hinterland woodland, often on rocky or gravelly ground, and does not tolerate waterlogging. It is also a popular garden and hedge plant.
where.sw: Huota porini katika vichaka vya joto na ukame na misitu ya bara karibu na pwani, mara nyingi kwenye ardhi yenye miamba au changarawe, na hauvumilii maji yaliyotuama. Pia ni mmea maarufu wa bustani na ua.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu yenye dzoho, na phatu phenye mihi kanda ya bara ya pwani, mara nyinji kpwenye tsi ya mawe au mtsanga wa mawe, na tauvumirira tsi inayoodzala madzi. Piya ni mmea unaomendzwa sana wa busitani na wa lichigo.

uses.en: ICRAF records the latex and roots as medicine, including for boils and venereal disease, with the warning that great caution is needed because the latex is very poisonous. The sap has been used as a component of arrow poison, pounded roots as a fish poison and pounded seeds or roots as rat poison. It is also planted as an ornamental and a live fence, and bees visit the flowers.
uses.sw: ICRAF inaripoti kwamba utomvu na mizizi hutumika kama dawa, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutibu majipu na magonjwa ya zinaa, kwa onyo kwamba tahadhari kubwa inahitajika kwa sababu utomvu wake una sumu kali sana. Utomvu umewahi kutumiwa kama kiambato cha sumu ya mishale, mizizi iliyopondwa kama sumu ya samaki, na mbegu au mizizi iliyopondwa kama sumu ya panya. Pia hupandwa kama mmea wa mapambo na ua hai, na nyuki hutembelea maua yake.
uses.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika kukala maziya na mizi nkuhumirwa dza dawa, kahi yao dawa ya maiphu na ya makongo ga zinaa, ela chinaonya kukala ni lazima atu akale makini sana, kpwa sababu maziya ni sumu kali sana. Maziya gakahumirwa dza seemu ya sumu ya mivi, mizi iriyobundugwa dza sumu ya kuolagira ng'onda, na tembe au mizi iriyobundugwa dza sumu ya kotso. Piya nkuphandwa dza mmea wa kupambira na dza lichigo, na nyuchi nkuphiya kpwenye maruwage.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwadiga, shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili; ICRAF confirms the same name in all four. The same Digo name is also given to the climber Rhynchosia congensis. In English it is the desert rose; its scientific name is Adenium obesum.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwadiga, linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili; ICRAF inathibitisha jina hilohilo katika lugha zote nne. Jina hilohilo la Kidigo pia hupewa mmea unaotambaa Rhynchosia congensis. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *desert rose*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Adenium obesum.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mwadiga, rinarohumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili; chitabu cha ICRAF chinaonyesa dzina hiri hiri kpwa luga zosi nne. Libugu Rhynchosia congensis piya nkuihwa kpwa dzina hiri ra Chidigo. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *desert rose*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni Adenium obesum.

conservation.en: ICRAF warns that it is easily dug up by collectors for the ornamental trade and needs protection in the wild.
conservation.sw: ICRAF inaonya kwamba hung'olewa kwa urahisi na wakusanyaji kwa ajili ya biashara ya mimea ya mapambo, na unahitaji kulindwa porini.
conservation.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaonya kukala atu anaohala mimea kpwa biashara ya mimea ya kupambira nkuufukula upesi, kpwa hivyo unahitaji kurindwa weruni.

teaser.en: A small twining bean of the bush, filed by the Digo among the 'female' climbers.
teaser.sw: Mmea mdogo wa jamii ya kunde unaojizungusha porini, ambao Wadigo huuweka miongoni mwa mimea inayotambaa ya 'kike'.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde unaodzilinga-linga, ambao Adigo anauika kahi ya mbugu za 'chichetu'.

summary.en: This Mwadiga is Rhynchosia congensis, a twining wild bean. Pakia's appendices also record it as Chibugu chichetu, the 'female' small climber.
summary.sw: Mwadiga huu ni Rhynchosia congensis, mmea pori wa jamii ya kunde unaojizungusha. Viambatisho vya Pakia pia vinauorodhesha kama Chibugu chichetu, mmea mdogo unaotambaa wa 'kike'.
summary.dg: Mwadiga uhu ni Rhynchosia congensis, mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde unaodzilinga-linga. Viambatisho vya Pakia piya vinauandika dza Chibugu chichetu, 'libugu dide ra chichetu'.

about.en: Rhynchosia congensis is a slender twining herb of the bean family. Its leaves have three leaflets, often dotted with tiny resin glands beneath, and it bears small yellow pea-flowers in short sprays, followed by small, flattened pods holding one or two seeds. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Rhynchosia congensis ni mmea mwembamba wa jamii ya kunde unaojizungusha. Majani yake yana vijani vitatu, mara nyingi vyenye vitone vidogo vya tezi za utomvu upande wa chini, na huzaa maua madogo ya manjano kama ya mbaazi kwenye vishada vifupi, yakifuatwa na maganda madogo bapa yenye mbegu moja au mbili. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: Rhynchosia congensis ni mmea mwembamba wa jamii ya kunde unaodzilinga-linga. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu, ambago mara nyinji gana matone madide sana ga ulimbo uphande wa photsi. Unalavya maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano dza ga kunde, ganayomera kpwa mafungu mafupi, na badaye kunatuluka makakaya madide sambamba genye tembe mwenga au mbiri. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in grassland, bushland and thicket, twining over grasses and low shrubs.
where.sw: Huota nyikani, vichakani na kwenye vichaka vizito, ukijizungusha juu ya nyasi na vichaka vifupi.
where.dg: Unamera nyasini, weruni na vitsakani, uchidzilinga-linga dzulu ya nyasi na vitsaka vifupi.

culture.en: Pakia explains that climbers are named with the root bugu, and that the prefix chi- marks small forms. Chibugu chichetu belongs with Chibugu (Rhynchosia velutina) and Chibugu chilume, the 'male' Chibugu (Indigofera trita).
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba mimea inayotambaa hupewa majina kwa kutumia mzizi bugu, na kwamba kiambishi chi- huonyesha aina ndogo. Chibugu chichetu kinakwenda pamoja na Chibugu (Rhynchosia velutina) na Chibugu chilume, Chibugu cha 'kiume' (Indigofera trita).
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala mbugu nkuihwa kpwa madzina genye *bugu*, na kukala *chi-* mwandzoni inaonyesa aina ndide. Chibugu chichetu ni cha kundi mwenga na Chibugu (Rhynchosia velutina) na Chibugu chilume, Chibugu 'cha chilume' (Indigofera trita).

names.en: Pakia's Appendix III gives the Digo name Mwadiga, the same name used for the desert rose, Adenium obesum. Appendix V instead lists it as Chibugu chichetu. Chichetu appears to mark it as the female form, in the same way Pakia explains chilume as male, but Pakia gives no meaning for this name. Its scientific name is Rhynchosia congensis.
names.sw: Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinatoa jina la Kidigo Mwadiga, jina lile lile linalotumika kwa Adenium obesum (mwadiga). Kiambatisho V badala yake kinauorodhesha kama Chibugu chichetu. Inaonekana chichetu kinauonyesha kuwa aina ya kike, kwa namna ileile Pakia anavyoeleza chilume kuwa ni wa kiume, lakini Pakia hatoi maana ya jina hili. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Rhynchosia congensis.
names.dg: Chiambatisho cha III cha Pakia chinapha dzina ra Chidigo Mwadiga, dzina mwenga na ra *desert rose*, Adenium obesum. Chiambatisho cha V badalaye chinauandika dza Chibugu chichetu. Neno *chichetu* rinaonekana kuonyesa kukala ni aina ya chichetu, dza Pakia anavyogomba kukala *chilume* ni ya chilume, ela Pakia kalavya mana ga dzina hiri. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Rhynchosia congensis.

teaser.en: A wild grape vine the Digo know by its stem rather than its leaves.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu pori ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa shina lake badala ya majani.
teaser.dg: Mzabibu wa weruni ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa muhiwe, si kpwa makodzage.

summary.en: Mwamchitophyo is an unidentified Cissus, a wild climber of the grape family. Pakia records that the Digo recognise it by its stem.
summary.sw: Mwamchitophyo ni Cissus ambayo spishi yake haijatambuliwa, mmea pori unaotambaa wa familia ya mizabibu. Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa shina lake.
summary.dg: Mwamchitophyo ni Cissus ambayo ainaye taidzangbwemanyikana, libugu ra weruni ra jamii ya mzabibu. Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya kpwa muhiwe.

about.en: Pakia identified Mwamchitophyo only to genus, as a species of Cissus, a climber of the grape family. Cissus vines climb with tendrils that grow opposite the leaves, and many coastal species have fleshy, angled or winged stems. The flowers are tiny and greenish, followed by small berries. The Digo identify this one by its stem.
about.sw: Pakia aliutambua Mwamchitophyo hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, kama spishi ya Cissus, mmea unaotambaa wa familia ya mizabibu. Mimea ya Cissus hupanda kwa kutumia vikonyo vinavyoota upande wa pili wa majani, na spishi nyingi za pwani zina mashina yenye majimaji, yenye pembe au mabawa. Maua ni madogo sana na ya rangi ya kijani-kijani, yakifuatwa na matunda madogo ya beri. Wadigo huutambua huu kwa shina lake.
about.dg: Pakia waumanya Mwamchitophyo hadi jenasi tu, dza aina ya Cissus, libugu ra jamii ya mzabibu. Mbugu za Cissus zinadzilinga-linga dzulu kpwa nyuzi zinazomera zichilengana na makodza, na aina nyinji za pwani zina mihi inayonona, yenye pembe au yenye mapha. Maruwa ni madide sana na ga chijani ngushu-ngushu, na badaye kunatuluka matunda madide. Adigo anaumanya uhu kpwa muhiwe.

where.en: Pakia does not record where it grows. Cissus vines on the coast climb through bushland, thicket and forest edges.
where.sw: Pakia haripoti mahali unapoota. Mimea ya Cissus ya pwani hupanda katikati ya vichaka, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu.
where.dg: Pakia kaandika phatu unaphomera. Pwani, mbugu za Cissus zinadzilinga-linga weruni, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

culture.en: Pakia notes that Cissus species are among the few plants the Digo cannot tell apart by their leaves alone, so they look at the stem instead.
culture.sw: Pakia anabainisha kwamba spishi za Cissus ni miongoni mwa mimea michache ambayo Wadigo hawawezi kuitofautisha kwa majani pekee, kwa hiyo huangalia shina badala yake.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala aina za Cissus ni kahi ya mimea michache ambayo Adigo taaweza kumanya tafwauti kahi yao kpwa kulola makodza tu, kpwa hivyo analola muhi badalaye.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwamchitophyo but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Cissus sp.; the species was not determined.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwamchitophyo lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina ya pamoja na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Cissus sp.; spishi yake haikubainishwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mwamchitophyo, ela kalavya manage wala madzina ga luga zanjina. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Cissus sp.; ainaye hasa taidzangbwemanyikana.

summary.en: Mwamchiviza is Cyphostemma buchananii, a climber of the grape family. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mwamchiviza ni Cyphostemma buchananii, mmea unaotambaa wa familia ya mizabibu. Pakia anaripoti jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: Mwamchiviza ni Cyphostemma buchananii, libugu ra jamii ya mzabibu. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Mwamchiviza is a climbing or trailing herb of the grape family, with tendrils opposite the leaves. Like other Cyphostemmas it has leaves divided like a hand into several toothed leaflets, flat-topped clusters of tiny greenish-yellow flowers and small, juicy berries that ripen red.
about.sw: Mwamchiviza ni mmea unaopanda au kutambaa wa familia ya mizabibu, wenye vikonyo upande wa pili wa majani. Kama Cyphostemma nyingine, una majani yaliyogawanyika kama kiganja cha mkono kuwa vijani kadhaa vyenye meno, mafungu yenye juu bapa ya maua madogo sana ya rangi ya kijani-manjano, na matunda madogo ya beri yenye majimaji yanayoiva na kuwa mekundu.
about.dg: Mwamchiviza ni mmea wa jamii ya mzabibu unaodzilinga-linga dzulu au unaoambala photsi, wenye nyuzi zinazomera zichilengana na makodza. Dza Cyphostemma zanjina, una makodza ganayoganywa dza mkpwono kukala makodza madide machache genye meno, mafungu ga maruwa madide sana ga chijani na rangi ya mandano genye dzulu sambamba, na matunda madide genye madzi manji ganayoivwa kukala ga kundu.

where.en: It grows in bushland and thicket, scrambling over shrubs.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na kwenye vichaka vizito, ukitambaa juu ya vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na vitsakani, uchiambala dzulu ya vitsaka.

names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mwamchiviza, ela kalavya manage wala madzina ga luga zanjina. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Cyphostemma buchananii.

teaser.en: Touch it once and you will never forget its name: its hairy leaves leave the skin itching.
teaser.sw: Ukiugusa mara moja hutalisahau jina lake kamwe: majani yake yenye manyoya huacha ngozi ikiwasha.
teaser.dg: Uchiuguta mara mwenga tu, kundariyala dzinare: makodzage genye nyere ganaawisa ngozi.

summary.en: Mwamdzavi is Tragia furialis, a hairy, twining herb whose leaves make the skin itch on contact. Its name also serves as a general Digo term for itchy plants.
summary.sw: Mwamdzavi ni Tragia furialis, mmea wenye manyoya unaojizungusha, ambao majani yake huwasha ngozi yanapoigusa. Jina lake pia hutumika kama neno la jumla la Kidigo kwa mimea inayowasha.
summary.dg: Mwamdzavi ni Tragia furialis, mmea wenye nyere unaodzilinga-linga, ambao makodzage ganaawisa ngozi gachiiguta. Dzinare piya nkuhumirwa ni Adigo kpwa mimea yosi inayoawisa.

about.en: Mwamdzavi is a slender, twining or sprawling herb covered in stinging hairs. Its leaves are heart-shaped, toothed and hairy. The flowers are tiny and greenish, and the fruits are small, hairy, three-lobed capsules. Mgombato describes it as a plant with hairy, heart-shaped leaves that irritates when it touches the skin, and Pakia records that the Digo recognise it both by sight and by the itching it causes.
about.sw: Mwamdzavi ni mmea mwembamba unaojizungusha au kutambaa, uliofunikwa na manyoya yanayouma. Majani yake yana umbo la moyo, yenye meno na manyoya. Maua ni madogo sana na ya rangi ya kijani-kijani, na matunda ni vifuko vidogo vyenye manyoya na sehemu tatu. Mgombato unaueleza kuwa mmea wenye majani ya umbo la moyo yenye manyoya, unaowasha unapogusa ngozi, na Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa kuuona na pia kwa mwasho unaosababisha.
about.dg: Mwamdzavi ni mmea mwembamba unaodzilinga-linga au unaoambala photsi, uriofwinikpwa ni nyere zinazoawisa. Makodzage ni ga umbo ra moyo, gana meno kanda-kanda na gana nyere. Maruwa ni madide sana na ga chijani ngushu-ngushu, na matunda ni makakaya madide genye nyere na seemu tahu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inauandika dza mmea wenye makodza ga umbo ra moyo genye nyere, unaoawisa uchiguta ngozi, na Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya kpwa kuuona na kpwa vira unavyoawisa.

where.en: It grows in bushland, thicket and along forest edges, scrambling through other plants.
where.sw: Huota vichakani, kwenye vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, ukitambaa katikati ya mimea mingine.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, uchiambala kahi ya mimea yanjina.

culture.en: Pakia notes that Mwamdzavi is also a collective word for itchy plants, covering both Tragia furialis and Laportea lanceolata, a nettle. Pakia adds that identifying a plant by its itch, as here or with the velvet bean Uphupu, is usually accidental rather than intended.
culture.sw: Pakia anabainisha kwamba Mwamdzavi pia ni neno la jumla kwa mimea inayowasha, likijumuisha Tragia furialis na Laportea lanceolata, aina ya kiwavi. Pakia anaongeza kwamba kutambua mmea kwa mwasho wake, kama hapa au kwa upupu (Uphupu), kwa kawaida hutokea kwa bahati mbaya badala ya kukusudiwa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Mwamdzavi piya ni neno ra kuihira mimea yosi inayoawisa, kahi yao Tragia furialis na Laportea lanceolata, mmea wa jamii ya *nettle*. Pakia anaenjereza kukala kuumanya mmea kpwa vira unavyoawisa, dza hipha au dza Uphupu (*velvet bean*), kpwa kawaida ni kpwa bahati, si kpwa kusudi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwamdzavi, shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. Mgombato lists mwamdzavi with the variant mwamlavi. The genus is known in English as noseburn; its scientific name is Tragia furialis, spelled Tragea in Pakia.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwamdzavi, linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Mgombato unaorodhesha mwamdzavi pamoja na tofauti yake mwamlavi. Kwa Kiingereza jenasi hii inajulikana kama *noseburn*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Tragia furialis, linaloandikwa Tragea katika Pakia.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mwamdzavi, rinarohumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *mwamdzavi*, na piya *mwamlavi*. Kpwa Chingereza jenasi ihi inaihwa *noseburn*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni Tragia furialis, ambaro Pakia anariandika *Tragea*.

teaser.en: The 'female spirit-being': one of a family of aromatic-rooted shrubs named after the spirits they are used against.
teaser.sw: 'Kiumbe-roho wa kike': mmoja wa kundi la vichaka vyenye mizizi yenye harufu, vilivyopewa majina ya pepo ambao hutumika dhidi yao.
teaser.dg: 'Pepho wa chichetu': mmwenga wa kundi ra vitsaka vyenye mizi ya arufu nono, vinavyoihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho ambao vinahumirwa kuazuwiya.

summary.en: Mwangajine mchetu is Polyalthia stuhlmannii, a coastal forest shrub of the custard-apple family. It is the 'female' member of the Mwangajine group, plants named after spirits and valued in treating spiritual ailments.
summary.sw: Mwangajine mchetu ni Polyalthia stuhlmannii, kichaka cha misitu ya pwani cha familia ya mitopetope. Ni mwanachama wa 'kike' wa kundi la Mwangajine, mimea iliyopewa majina ya pepo na inayothaminiwa katika kutibu maradhi ya kiroho.
summary.dg: Mwangajine mchetu ni Polyalthia stuhlmannii, chitsaka cha matsaka ga pwani cha jamii ya *custard apple*. Ni 'mchetu' wa kundi ra Mwangajine, mimea iriyoihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho na yenye samani kpwa kuphoza makongo ga pepho.

about.en: Mwangajine mchetu is a shrub or small tree of the custard-apple family, with alternate, smooth, elliptic leaves in two neat rows along the twigs. The Digo identify it by its leaves and its roots, especially the smell of the root. Pakia suggests it is called female because its leaves are smaller than those of the other Mwangajine plants.
about.sw: Mwangajine mchetu ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya mitopetope, wenye majani laini ya umbo la duaradufu yanayopishana, yaliyopangwa safu mbili nadhifu kando ya vitawi. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na mizizi yake, hasa harufu ya mzizi. Pakia anapendekeza kwamba unaitwa wa kike kwa sababu majani yake ni madogo kuliko yale ya mimea mingine ya Mwangajine.
about.dg: Mwangajine mchetu ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya *custard apple*. Makodzage ni laini na ga mviringo, na ganamera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kubadilishana uphande, mistari miiri sawa-sawa kanda-kanda ya maphungo. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na miziye, zaidi arufu ya muzi. Pakia anagomba kukala anji phahi unaihwa mchetu kpwa sababu makodzage ni madide kuriko ga mimea yanjina ya Mwangajine.

where.en: It grows in the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

uses.en: Pakia does not record a separate use for this species. The unmarked Mwangajine (Isolona cauliflora) is named for its importance as a medicine for spiritual ailments, and Mwangajine mchetu is also identified with that name.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi tofauti ya spishi hii. Mwangajine usio na kivumishi (Isolona cauliflora) umepewa jina kutokana na umuhimu wake kama dawa ya maradhi ya kiroho, na Mwangajine mchetu pia hutambulishwa kwa jina hilo.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga tafwauti ga aina ihi. Mwangajine bila neno ranjina (Isolona cauliflora) ukaihwa dzina hiro kpwa sababu ya samaniye dza dawa ya makongo ga pepho, na Mwangajine mchetu piya nkuihwa kpwa dzina hiro.

culture.en: Mwanga and jine are both names of spirits. Pakia explains that the Mwangajine plants are named after these spirits because they are used against the ailments the spirits cause, and takes such names as evidence of how strongly Digo life involves belief in spirits and magico-medicine.
culture.sw: Mwanga na jine yote ni majina ya pepo. Pakia anaeleza kwamba mimea ya Mwangajine imepewa majina ya pepo hawa kwa sababu hutumika dhidi ya maradhi wanayoyasababisha, na anayachukulia majina kama hayo kuwa ushahidi wa jinsi imani ya pepo na tiba za kiuchawi zilivyokita mizizi katika maisha ya Wadigo.
culture.dg: Mwanga na jine gosi mairi ni madzina ga pepho. Pakia anagomba kukala mimea ya Mwangajine ikaihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho hao kpwa sababu nkuhumirwa kuphoza makongo ganayorehwa ni pepho hao. Anahala madzina dza higa dza ushahidi wa vira imani ya pepho na dawa za uganga vinavyoinjira sana maisha ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwangajine mchetu, 'female spirit-being'. It is the female partner of Mwangajine mlume, the 'male spirit-being' (Uvariodendron kirkii), and is also sometimes simply called Mwangajine, the name of Isolona cauliflora. Its scientific name is Polyalthia stuhlmannii.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwangajine mchetu, 'kiumbe-roho wa kike'. Ni mwenzi wa kike wa Mwangajine mlume, 'kiumbe-roho wa kiume' (Uvariodendron kirkii), na wakati mwingine huitwa tu Mwangajine, jina la Isolona cauliflora. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Polyalthia stuhlmannii.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mwangajine mchetu, 'pepho wa chichetu'. Myawe wa chilume ni Mwangajine mlume, 'pepho wa chilume' (Uvariodendron kirkii). Wakati wanjina piya nkuihwa Mwangajine tu, dzina ra Isolona cauliflora. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Polyalthia stuhlmannii.

teaser.en: A thorny-twigged terminalia with wood so tough it was used for the keels of dhows.
teaser.sw: Mwangati wenye vitawi vya miiba na mbao ngumu kiasi kwamba zilitumika kutengeneza mataruma ya majahazi.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa jenasi ya *Terminalia* wenye maphungo ga miya, na nyama za muhi huno ni nyifu sana hata kare zahumirwa kuhendera mikuku ya majahazi.

summary.en: Mwarambe is the purple-pod terminalia, a small tree of dry bush with winged purple-red fruits. Its hard, termite-resistant wood is used for building and once went into dhow keels.
summary.sw: Mwarambe ni mwangati, mti mdogo wa vichaka vikavu wenye matunda yenye mabawa ya rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu. Mbao zake ngumu zisizoliwa na mchwa hutumika katika ujenzi, na zamani zilitumika kutengeneza mataruma ya majahazi.
summary.dg: *Mwarambe* ni *purple-pod terminalia*, muhi mdide wa weruni kukavu wenye matunda genye mapha, ga rangi ya zambarau na kundu. Nyama za muhi huno ni nyifu na taziriwa ni malutswa; nkuhumirwa kudzengera, na kare zahumirwa kuhendera mikuku ya majahazi.

about.en: Mwarambe is a shrubby tree, 3 to 10 m tall, with a dense, rounded and often layered crown and long, drooping branches. The bark is grey and grooved. Its small leaves are clustered on short, spiky side twigs. Red buds open into spikes of cream, unpleasant-smelling, nectar-rich flowers, followed by eye-catching flat, winged, purple-red to brown fruits that stay on the tree.
about.sw: Mwarambe ni mti wa kichaka, wenye urefu wa m 3 hadi 10, wenye taji nzito ya mviringo ambayo mara nyingi huwa na matabaka, na matawi marefu yanayoning'inia. Gome lake ni la kijivu lenye mifereji. Majani yake madogo hujikusanya kwenye vitawi vifupi vyenye ncha kali vya pembeni. Vichipukizi vyekundu hufunguka kuwa vishada virefu vya maua ya rangi ya krimu, yenye harufu mbaya na yaliyojaa mbochi, yakifuatwa na matunda bapa yenye mabawa yanayovutia macho, ya rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu hadi kahawia, yanayobaki mtini.
about.dg: *Mwarambe* ni muhi dza chitsaka, wa urefu wa mita 3 hadi 10. Dzuluye kuna makodza manji ganarundikana dza mviringo, mara nyinji ngazi-ngazi, na pandaze ni nyire na zinabwadzika photsi. Gophare ni ra rangi ya ivu na rina mifuo. Makodzage ni madide, na ganamera phamwenga dzulu ya maphungo mafupi ga kanda genye ntsa dza miya. Vimea vya kundu vinavuguka na kulavya maruwa ga rangi ya maziya ganayomera phamwenga dzulu ya mlita mure; maruwa higo gana arufu mbii na madzi manji ga mtswano. Bada ya phapho kunakpwedza matunda manono ga kulola, ga sambamba, genye mapha, ga rangi ya zambarau na kundu hadi rangi ya dongo, na ganasala muhini.

where.en: It grows in dry forest and bushland, often near rivers or seasonal watercourses, and on the coast also on saline soils.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu mikavu na vichakani, mara nyingi karibu na mito au mikondo ya maji ya msimu, na pwani pia kwenye udongo wenye chumvi.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani makavu na weruni, mara nyinji phephi na miho au njira za madzi ganayokpwedza wakati wa mvula tu, na pwani piya unamera kpwenye ulongo wenye munyu.

uses.en: ICRAF records hard, tough, termite-resistant wood, heavier than many terminalias, used for house construction, poles, posts, tool handles, furniture and dhow keels, because it resists salt water and borers. It also gives firewood and charcoal, fodder from the fruit, mulch and medicine. Beehives are often hung in its branches.
uses.sw: ICRAF inaripoti mbao ngumu na imara zisizoliwa na mchwa, nzito kuliko za Terminalia nyingi, zinazotumika kujenga nyumba, kwa nguzo, milingoti, mipini ya zana, samani na mataruma ya majahazi, kwa sababu zinastahimili maji ya chumvi na wadudu watobozi. Pia hutoa kuni na mkaa, lishe ya mifugo kutokana na matunda, matandazo na dawa. Mizinga ya nyuki mara nyingi huning'inizwa kwenye matawi yake.
uses.dg: ICRAF inaandika kukala nyama za muhi huno ni nyifu sana na taziriwa ni malutswa, na piya ni ndziho kuriko za mihi minji ya *Terminalia*. Nkuhumirwa kudzengera nyumba, kuhendera nguzo, miphini ya vyombo vya kazi, fanicha na mikuku ya majahazi, kpwa sababu tazibanangwa ni madzi ga munyu wala ni adudu anaokobola mbao. Piya unalavya kuni na makala, matundage ni chakurya cha mifugo, unalavya vitu vya kubwiningiza ulongo munda, na ni muhaso. Mizinga ya nyuchi mara nyinji nkubwadzikpwa pandazeni.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwarambe but gives no meaning or shared names. ICRAF gives the Swahili name as mwangati or mwangati punda, and the Giriama name as Mwanga, which in Digo is a different tree, the river terminalia (Terminalia sambesiaca). In English it is the purple-pod terminalia; its scientific name is Terminalia prunioides.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwarambe lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina ya pamoja na lugha nyingine. ICRAF inatoa jina la Kiswahili kama mwangati au mwangati punda, na jina la Kigiriama kama Mwanga, ambalo kwa Kidigo ni mti mwingine, *river terminalia* (Terminalia sambesiaca). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *purple-pod terminalia*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Terminalia prunioides.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mwarambe*, ela kalavya manage, wala madzina ganayohumirwa piya ni luga zanjina. ICRAF inalavya dzina ra Chiswahili kukala *mwangati* au *mwangati punda*, na dzina ra Chigiryama kukala *Mwanga*, ambaro kpwa Chidigo ni dzina ra muhi wanjina, *river terminalia* (*Terminalia sambesiaca*). Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *purple-pod terminalia*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Terminalia prunioides*.

teaser.en: A wild hibiscus with vine-shaped leaves and yellow flowers with a dark heart.
teaser.sw: Hibiscus pori wenye majani ya umbo la majani ya mzabibu na maua ya manjano yenye kiini cheusi.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa *Hibiscus* wa weruni wenye makodza dza ga mzabibu, na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano genye kahi-kahi nyiru.

summary.en: Mwejenje is a wild hibiscus close to Hibiscus vitifolius, the tropical rose mallow. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mwejenje ni hibiscus pori anayekaribiana na Hibiscus vitifolius (*tropical rose mallow*). Pakia anaripoti jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: *Mwejenje* ni *Hibiscus* ya weruni inayohalana sana na *Hibiscus vitifolius*, ambayo kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *tropical rose mallow*. Pakia kaandika chitu chanjina kuriko dzinare ra Chidigo.

about.en: Pakia identified Mwejenje as a Hibiscus similar to H. vitifolius, but not certainly that species. Hibiscus vitifolius is a hairy, shrubby herb, usually 1 to 2 m tall, with leaves lobed like a grapevine's (hence vitifolius). Its large flowers are pale yellow with a deep maroon centre, and its fruits are five-winged, hairy capsules.
about.sw: Pakia aliutambua Mwejenje kama Hibiscus inayofanana na H. vitifolius, ingawa si kwa uhakika kuwa ni spishi hiyo. Hibiscus vitifolius ni mmea wa kichaka wenye manyoya, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa m 1 hadi 2, na majani yenye ndewe kama ya mzabibu (ndiyo maana ya vitifolius). Maua yake makubwa ni ya manjano hafifu yenye kiini cha rangi ya maruni iliyokolea, na matunda yake ni vifuko vyenye manyoya na mabawa matano.
about.dg: Pakia wagomba kukala *Mwejenje* ni *Hibiscus* inayohalana na *H. vitifolius*, ela kaweza kugomba kpwa hakika kukala ni aina ihiyo hasa. *Hibiscus vitifolius* ni mmea wenye nyere, dza chitsaka chidide, kpwa kawaida wa urefu wa mita 1 hadi 2. Makodzage gana mala dza makodza ga mzabibu (ndiyo mana unaihwa *vitifolius*). Maruwage ni makulu, ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, na kahi-kahi yakpwe ni ya rangi ya kundu-nyiru; matundage ni makakaya genye nyere na mapha matsano.

where.en: Plants of this kind grow in bushland, grassland, forest edges and old farmland.
where.sw: Mimea ya aina hii huota vichakani, nyikani, pembezoni mwa misitu na kwenye mashamba ya zamani.
where.dg: Mimea ya aina ihi inamera weruni, phatu pha nyasi, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye minda ya kare.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwejenje but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is given as Hibiscus sp. aff. vitifolius, meaning a Hibiscus close to H. vitifolius.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwejenje lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina ya pamoja na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi limetolewa kama Hibiscus sp. aff. vitifolius, yaani Hibiscus inayokaribiana na H. vitifolius.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mwejenje*, ela kalavya manage, wala madzina ganayohumirwa piya ni luga zanjina. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Hibiscus* sp. aff. *vitifolius*, ichimaanisha *Hibiscus* inayohalana na *H. vitifolius*.

teaser.en: Turn a leaf over: green on top, pale beneath. That two-tone leaf is how the Digo pick out mweza.
teaser.sw: Geuza jani: juu ni kijani, chini ni jeupe-jeupe. Jani hilo la rangi mbili ndilo Wadigo hutumia kuutambua *mweza*.
teaser.dg: Penduza kodza: dzulu ni ra chijani, photsi ni ngushu-ngushu. Kodza hiri ra rangi mbiri ndiro Adigo anarihumira kumanya *mweza*.

summary.en: Mweza is a small herb of the amaranth family that Digo plant users recognise from its two-coloured leaves. Pakia records it as one of the few plants identified mainly by leaf colour.
summary.sw: Mweza ni mmea mdogo wa familia ya michicha ambao Wadigo wanaotumia mimea huutambua kwa majani yake ya rangi mbili. Pakia anauripoti kama mmoja wa mimea michache inayotambulika hasa kwa rangi ya majani.
summary.dg: *Mweza* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya mchicha, ambao Adigo anaohumira mimea anaumanya kpwa makodzage ga rangi mbiri. Pakia anauandika dza mwenga wa mimea michache inayomanyikana hasa kpwa rangi ya makodza.

about.en:
*Mweza* is a herb of the amaranth family, a relative of the chaff-flowers (*Achyranthes*). Plants in this genus usually carry their tiny flowers in long, thin spikes, with the flowers bending back against the stem as they age.

The Digo know *mweza* by its leaves. The upper side is green and the underside is distinctly whitish, and people describe it with the phrase *ndani n'maru, konze n'mereru*: green on the upper surface, whitish below.
about.sw:
*Mweza* ni mmea wa familia ya michicha, ndugu wa jenasi *Achyranthes*. Mimea ya jenasi hii kwa kawaida huzaa maua yake madogo sana kwenye vishada virefu vyembamba, na maua hujipinda kurudi nyuma kuelekea shina yanapozeeka.

Wadigo huutambua *mweza* kwa majani yake. Upande wa juu ni wa kijani na upande wa chini ni mweupe-mweupe waziwazi, na watu huueleza kwa msemo *ndani n'maru, konze n'mereru*: kijani upande wa juu, mweupe-mweupe chini.
about.dg:
*Mweza* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya mchicha, wa jenasi mwenga na *Achyranthes* (*chaff-flowers*). Mimea ya jenasi ihi kpwa kawaida ina maruwa madide sana ganayomera phamwenga dzulu ya milita mire na myembamba, na maruwa gachikala makare ganafyuka nyuma hadi kuguta muhi wa mmea.

Adigo anamanya *mweza* kpwa makodzage. Uphande wa dzulu wa kodza ni wa chijani, na uphande wa photsi una rangi nyereru hasa, na atu anaugomba kpwa maneno *ndani n'maru, konze n'mereru*: wa chijani dzulu, mwereru photsi.

where.en: Pakia collected it in Digo country on the south coast. No more detail on its habitat is recorded, but its relatives are common in bush, field edges and disturbed ground.
where.sw: Pakia aliukusanya katika nchi ya Wadigo, pwani ya kusini. Hakuna maelezo zaidi kuhusu mazingira yake yaliyoripotiwa, lakini mimea ya jamii yake ni ya kawaida vichakani, pembezoni mwa mashamba na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa.
where.dg: Pakia wauphaha tsi ya Adigo, pwani ya kusini. Takuna maelezo ganjina ga phatu unaphomera, ela mimea ya jamii yakpwe inaphahikana sana weruni, kanda-kanda ya minda na phatu ambapho ulongo ukatsimbwa au kubanangwa.

culture.en: Digo colour words are few, mostly black, white and red, so colour rarely separates one plant from another. *Mweza* is an exception, together with *mtsunduzi* (*Croton megalocarpoides*): both are told apart by the contrast between the two sides of the leaf.
culture.sw: Maneno ya rangi katika Kidigo ni machache, hasa nyeusi, nyeupe na nyekundu, kwa hiyo rangi mara chache hutofautisha mmea mmoja na mwingine. *Mweza* ni tofauti, pamoja na *mtsunduzi* (*Croton megalocarpoides*): yote miwili hutambulika kwa tofauti ya rangi kati ya pande mbili za jani.
culture.dg: Maneno ga Chidigo ga rangi ni machache, hasa nyiru, nyereru na ya kundu, kpwa hivyo ni mara chache rangi kuonyesa tafwauti ya mmea mwenga na wanjina. *Mweza* ni tafwauti, phamwenga na *mtsunduzi* (*Croton megalocarpoides*): yosi miri inamanyikana kpwa tafwauti ya rangi kahi ya uphande wa dzulu na wa photsi wa kodza.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mweza*; its meaning is not explained. No English or Swahili name is recorded. Pakia gives the scientific name as *Achyranthus emerginatus*, a spelling that does not match a currently accepted species, so its exact identity needs checking. A better-known relative, *Achyranthes aspera*, is *mphulula mbuzi* in Digo.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo *mweza*; maana yake haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa. Pakia anatoa jina la kisayansi kama *Achyranthus emerginatus*, tahajia isiyolingana na spishi yoyote inayokubalika kwa sasa, kwa hiyo utambulisho wake halisi unahitaji kuthibitishwa. Ndugu yake anayejulikana zaidi, *Achyranthes aspera*, kwa Kidigo ni *mphulula mbuzi*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mweza*; manage tagaelezwa. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Pakia analavya dzina ra chisayansi *Achyranthus emerginatus*, ela uandishi uhu tauphahikana kahi ya aina zinazokubaliwa sambi, kpwa hivyo ni lazima kulola tsona ni aina ipi hasa. Mmea wa jenasi mwenga unaomanyikana zaidi, *Achyranthes aspera*, kpwa Chidigo ni *mphulula mbuzi*.

teaser.en: A wild asparagus whose name boasts that its medicine could bring down a kingfish.
teaser.sw: Asparagasi pori ambao jina lake linajigamba kwamba dawa yake inaweza kumwangusha nguru.
teaser.dg: *Mwinika* wa weruni ambao dzinare rinadzivuna kukala muhasowe unaweza kugbwaga ngulu.

summary.en: Mwinika ngulu is one of the Digo wild asparaguses, a spiny, wiry plant of the bush. Its name, 'kingfish mwinika', speaks of a medicine strong enough to fell a big fish.
summary.sw: Mwinika ngulu ni mmoja wa asparagasi pori wa Wadigo, mmea wenye miiba na mashina membamba magumu kama waya, unaoota vichakani. Jina lake, 'mwinika wa nguru', linazungumzia dawa yenye nguvu ya kutosha kumwangusha samaki mkubwa.
summary.dg: *Mwinika ngulu* ni mwenga wa mimea ya *mwinika* ya Chidigo (*asparagus* za weruni), mmea wa weruni wenye miya na mihi myembamba na mifu. Dzinare, '*mwinika* wa ngulu', rinagomba kpwa muhaso wenye nguvu hata unaweza kugbwaga ng'onda mkulu.

about.en:
*Mwinika ngulu* is a wild asparagus. Like its relatives it has thin, wiry stems, and what look like leaves are really tiny flattened or needle-like green shoots. Most of the wild asparaguses of the coast are spiny scramblers or small bushes with small white flowers and little round berries.

The Digo recognise it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Mwinika ngulu* ni asparagasi pori. Kama mimea ya jamii yake, una mashina membamba magumu kama waya, na kinachoonekana kama majani kwa kweli ni vichipukizi vidogo sana vya kijani, bapa au kama sindano. Asparagasi pori wengi wa pwani ni mimea yenye miiba inayotambaa au vichaka vidogo vyenye maua madogo meupe na matunda madogo ya mviringo.

Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg:
*Mwinika ngulu* ni *asparagus* ya weruni. Dza mimea ya jamii yakpwe, una mihi myembamba na mifu, na vira vinavyoonekana dza makodza kpwa kpweli ni vitawi vidide sana vya chijani, vya sambamba au dza sindano. *Asparagus* nyinji za weruni za pwani ni mimea ya miya inayoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, au ni vitsaka vidide, vyenye maruwa madide mereru na matunda madide ga mviringo.

Adigo anaumanya kpwa kulola mmea wosi.

where.en: Wild asparaguses grow in coastal bush, thicket and forest edges, scrambling over other shrubs. Pakia recorded *mwinika ngulu* among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Asparagasi pori huota katika vichaka vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, wakitambaa juu ya vichaka vingine. Pakia aliripoti *mwinika ngulu* miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: *Asparagus* za weruni zinamera weruni pwani, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, zichiambala dzulu ya vitsaka vyanjina. Pakia waandika *mwinika ngulu* kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: Pakia notes that this asparagus is regarded as a strong medicine, with great curative power. The particular illnesses it treats are not recorded.
uses.sw: Pakia anabainisha kwamba asparagasi huyu huchukuliwa kuwa dawa yenye nguvu, yenye uwezo mkubwa wa kuponya. Magonjwa mahususi unayotumika kutibu hayajaripotiwa.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala *asparagus* ihi inaonwa kukala muhaso wenye nguvu, wenye uwezo mkulu wa kuhenda akongo apone. Makongo hasa ganayohumirirwa muhaso uhu tagaandikpwa.

culture.en: *Mwinika* is the Digo collective name for the asparaguses, and Pakia records that it means 'to crouch down'. It is one of the few true folk genera in Digo, with *mwinika ngulu* and *mwinika ndzovu* as its two kinds. The second word works as a boast: *ngulu*, the kingfish, for this one, and *ndzovu*, the elephant, for the other, each said to be brought down by the plant's medicinal strength.
culture.sw: *Mwinika* ni jina la jumla la Kidigo kwa asparagasi, na Pakia anaripoti kwamba lina maana ya 'kuinama/kuchuchumaa'. Ni mojawapo ya jenasi chache za kweli za kijadi katika Kidigo, zenye aina mbili: *mwinika ngulu* na *mwinika ndzovu*. Neno la pili hufanya kazi ya kujigamba: *ngulu*, yaani nguru, kwa huu, na *ndzovu*, yaani tembo, kwa mwingine, kila mmoja akisemekana kuangushwa na nguvu ya dawa ya mmea huo.
culture.dg: *Mwinika* ni dzina ra Chidigo ra *asparagus* zosi phamwenga, na Pakia anaandika kukala manage ni 'kutatama'. Ni mwenga wa makundi machache ga mimea ganayoweza kuihwa jenasi za kpweli za chienyeji kpwa Chidigo, na *mwinika ngulu* na *mwinika ndzovu* ndizo ainaze mbiri. Neno ra phiri rinahenda kazi dza kudzivuna: *ngulu*, ng'onda mkulu, kpwa uhu, na *ndzovu* kpwa uyu wanjina; chila mmwenga nkugombwa anagbwagwa ni nguvu za muhaso wa mmea.

names.en: Pakia records *mwinika ngulu*, 'kingfish *mwinika*', a name shared with Duruma and Swahili. No English name is recorded. Pakia's appendices disagree on which asparagus it is: one list gives an unnamed *Asparagus* species, and another gives *Asparagus falcatus*, the species otherwise called *mwinika ndzovu*.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *mwinika ngulu*, '*mwinika* wa nguru', jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililoripotiwa. Viambatisho vya Pakia vinatofautiana kuhusu ni asparagasi yupi: orodha moja inatoa spishi ya *Asparagus* isiyotajwa jina, na nyingine inatoa *Asparagus falcatus*, spishi ambayo vinginevyo huitwa *mwinika ndzovu*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mwinika ngulu*, '*mwinika* wa ngulu', dzina ambaro piya nkuhumirwa kpwa Chiduruma na Chiswahili. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Orodha za Pakia za mwisho wa chitabu tazikubaliana kuhusu ni *asparagus* ipi: orodha mwenga inalavya aina ya *Asparagus* isiyo na dzina, na yanjina inalavya *Asparagus falcatus*, aina ambayo kpwa kawaida inaihwa *mwinika ndzovu*.

teaser.en: The seaside cousin of a poison shrub, at least in Digo eyes: a hairy coastal bush with white, woolly flowers.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa pwani wa kichaka chenye sumu, angalau machoni pa Wadigo: kichaka cha pwani chenye manyoya na maua meupe yenye sufu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa matso ga Adigo, ni nduguye wa pwani wa chitsaka cha sumu: chitsaka cha pwani chenye nyere, na maruwa mereru genye nyere nyinji.

summary.en: Mzigande wa pwani is a soft-wooded shrub that grows right on the coast, from southern Kenya to Mozambique. The Digo see it as the seashore form of mzigande, a name that warns of poison.
summary.sw: Mzigande wa pwani ni kichaka chenye mbao laini kinachoota ufuoni kabisa, kutoka kusini mwa Kenya hadi Msumbiji. Wadigo hukiona kama aina ya ufuoni ya mzigande, jina linalotahadharisha kuhusu sumu.
summary.dg: *Mzigande wa pwani* ni chitsaka chenye nyama za muhi laini, chinachomera kanda-kanda ya bahari hasa, kula kusini mwa Kenya hadi Mozambique. Adigo anauona kukala ni *mzigande* wa pwani, dzina rinaloonya kukala mmea ni wa sumu.

about.en:
*Mzigande wa pwani* is a weak, straggling shrub, sometimes a small tree up to about 6 metres. Its young branches are covered in dense white hairs, and the pointed leaves are velvety underneath, especially along the veins.

The flowers come in flat-topped clusters at the branch tips. They are white, yellowish or tinged red, tubular, woolly on the outside and bearded with white hairs in the throat.
about.sw:
*Mzigande wa pwani* ni kichaka dhaifu kinachotawanyika ovyo, wakati mwingine mti mdogo wenye urefu wa hadi takriban mita 6. Matawi yake machanga yamefunikwa na manyoya meupe mengi, na majani yenye ncha kali ni laini kama mahameli upande wa chini, hasa kando ya mishipa.

Maua huja kwa mafungu yenye juu bapa kwenye ncha za matawi. Ni meupe, ya manjano-manjano au yenye rangi ya wekundu kidogo, yenye umbo la mrija, yenye sufu nje na ndevu za manyoya meupe kooni.
about.dg:
*Mzigande wa pwani* ni chitsaka chenye mihi myembamba inayoenea-enea, na wakati wanjina ni muhi mdide wa urefu wa hadi mita 6 hivi. Pandaze nyiphya zina nyere nyinji nyereru, na makodzage genye ntsa ni laini na gana nyere photsi, hasa kanda-kanda ya mishipa ya kodza.

Maruwa ganamera phamwenga dzulu ya ntsa za panda, chila chifungu chiri sambamba dzulu. Ni mereru, ga rangi ya mandano chidide au genye kundu chidide; gana umbo ra bombolibo, gana nyere nyinji kondze, na mromoni mwao gana nyere nyereru dza cheru.

where.en: It is a true shoreline plant, found in coastal bush and thicket just behind the beach, from south-east Kenya to Mozambique and the western Indian Ocean islands. On the Digo coast it grows on the sea front, which is what its name says.
where.sw: Ni mmea halisi wa ufuoni, unaopatikana katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani nyuma kidogo ya ufukwe, kutoka kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya hadi Msumbiji na visiwa vya magharibi mwa Bahari Hindi. Katika pwani ya Wadigo huota mbele ya bahari, ndivyo jina lake linavyosema.
where.dg: Ni mmea wa pwani kpwa kpweli, unaophahikana weruni na vitsakani nyuma ya ufuwo, kula uphande wa kusini na mlairo wa dzuwa wa Kenya hadi Mozambique na visiwa vya Bahari ya Hindi vya uphande wa mtswerero wa dzuwa. Pwani ya Adigo unamera kanda-kanda ya bahari, ndivyo dzinare rinavyogomba.

culture.en: Pakia notes that *mzigande* is a name with no known etymology that nonetheless tags a plant as poisonous, a warning not to use it. *Mzigande wa pwani* inherits that name as 'the sea-side *mzigande*', even though it belongs to the coffee family and is not related to the true *mzigande*, *Rauvolfia mombasiana*.
culture.sw: Pakia anabainisha kwamba *mzigande* ni jina lisilo na asili inayojulikana, lakini hata hivyo humtambulisha mmea kuwa wenye sumu, onyo la kutoutumia. *Mzigande wa pwani* unarithi jina hilo kama '*mzigande* wa pwani', ingawa ni wa familia ya mibuni na hauna uhusiano na *mzigande* halisi, *Rauvolfia mombasiana*.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala *mzigande* ni dzina ambaro taimanyikana rinakpwedza phi, ela rinaonyesa kukala mmea ni wa sumu, kuonya atu asiuhumire. *Mzigande wa pwani* unahala dzina hiri dza '*mzigande* wa pwani', ela ni wa jamii ya kahawa, na si ndugu wa *mzigande* wa kpweli, *Rauvolfia mombasiana*.

names.en: Pakia records *mzigande wa pwani*, 'the *mzigande* of the sea side', the seaside counterpart of *mzigande* (*Rauvolfia mombasiana*). *Pwani* names plants of the sea front, as in *futswe ra pwani*. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *mzigande wa pwani*, '*mzigande* wa upande wa bahari', mwenzi wa ufuoni wa *mzigande* (*Rauvolfia mombasiana*). *Pwani* hutaja mimea ya mbele ya bahari, kama katika *futswe ra pwani*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mzigande wa pwani*, '*mzigande* wa uphande wa bahari', nduguye wa pwani wa *mzigande* (*Rauvolfia mombasiana*). *Pwani* nkuhumirwa kuiha mimea ya kanda-kanda ya bahari, dza *futswe ra pwani*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.
