teaser.en: A wild relative of the clove tree whose Digo name carries a feminine prefix.
teaser.sw: Ndugu pori wa mkarafuu ambao jina lake la Kidigo lina kiambishi cha kike.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa weruni wa jamii mwenga na karafuu, ambao dzinare ra Chidigo rinaandza na mwandzo wa 'chichetu'.

summary.en: Nchibandu is a wild Eugenia, a member of the myrtle family that also gives the clove and the water berry. Pakia records only its name, one of a handful of Digo plant names with a 'female' prefix.
summary.sw: Nchibandu ni Eugenia pori, mwanachama wa familia ya mihadasi, ambayo pia hutupa karafuu na *water berry*. Pakia anaripoti jina lake tu, mojawapo ya majina machache ya mimea ya Kidigo yenye kiambishi cha 'kike'.
summary.dg: *Nchibandu* ni *Eugenia* ya weruni, ya jamii ya mzambarau (*myrtle*), jamii ambayo piya ina karafuu na *water berry*. Pakia kaandika chitu chanjina kuriko dzinare, ambaro ni mwenga wa madzina machache ga mimea ga Chidigo genye mwandzo wa 'chichetu'.

about.en:
*Nchibandu* is a species of *Eugenia*, a large genus of the myrtle family. The *Eugenia* of the East African coast are evergreen shrubs and small trees with opposite, glossy, often leathery leaves that smell faintly aromatic when crushed, small white flowers with many stamens, and fleshy berries.

The exact species was not identified.
about.sw:
*Nchibandu* ni spishi ya *Eugenia*, jenasi kubwa ya familia ya mihadasi. *Eugenia* za pwani ya Afrika Mashariki ni vichaka na miti midogo isiyopukutisha majani, yenye majani yanayoelekeana, yanayong'aa, mara nyingi magumu kama ngozi, yenye harufu nzuri hafifu yanapopondwa, maua madogo meupe yenye stameni nyingi, na matunda ya beri yenye nyama.

Spishi yake halisi haikutambuliwa.
about.dg:
*Nchibandu* ni aina ya *Eugenia*, jenasi kulu ya jamii ya mzambarau (*myrtle*). *Eugenia* za pwani ya Afrika Mashariki ni vitsaka na mihi midide yenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganamera mairi mairi ganalengana, ganang'ala, mara nyinji ni mafu dza chingo, na gachifikitswa ganalavya arufu nono chidide. Maruwa ni madide mereru genye stameni nyinji, na matunda ni madide genye nyama.

Taimanyikana ni aina ipi hasa.

where.en: *Eugenia* species grow in coastal forest, thicket and dune bush on the south coast. Pakia recorded *nchibandu* among the Digo but gives no habitat.
where.sw: Spishi za *Eugenia* huota katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka vizito na vichaka vya matuta ya mchanga katika pwani ya kusini. Pakia aliripoti *nchibandu* miongoni mwa Wadigo lakini hatoi mazingira yake.
where.dg: Aina za *Eugenia* zinamera matsakani ga pwani, vitsakani na weruni phatu pha mtsanga wa pwani, pwani ya kusini. Pakia waandika *nchibandu* kahi ya Adigo, ela kagomba unamera kuphi.

culture.en: Pakia points out that some Digo plant names start with a prefix that, in personal names, marks a woman. *Nchibandu* is one of them, with *nchikoma*, *nchivuri* and *nchidoka*. Digo has no grammatical gender, so the prefix seems to carry a borrowed sense of 'female' rather than a rule of grammar.
culture.sw: Pakia anaonyesha kwamba baadhi ya majina ya mimea ya Kidigo huanza na kiambishi ambacho, katika majina ya watu, huonyesha mwanamke. *Nchibandu* ni mojawapo, pamoja na *nchikoma*, *nchivuri* na *nchidoka*. Kidigo hakina jinsia ya kisarufi, kwa hiyo kiambishi hicho kinaonekana kubeba maana iliyoazimwa ya 'kike' badala ya kanuni ya sarufi.
culture.dg: Pakia anaonyesa kukala madzina ganjina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganaandza na mwandzo ambao, kpwa madzina ga atu, unaonyesa kukala ni mchetu. *Nchibandu* ni mwenga wa madzina higo, phamwenga na *nchikoma*, *nchivuri* na *nchidoka*. Chidigo tachina jinsia ya chisarufi, kpwa hivyo mwandzo uhu unaonekana kuhala mana ya 'chichetu' iriyoaphaswa, sio shariya ya sarufi.

names.en: Pakia records *nchibandu*; the meaning of the name is not explained. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nchibandu*; maana ya jina haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nchibandu*; mana ya dzina hiri taielezwa. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: One Digo name, four different trees and shrubs. This is the Diphasia, a citrus-family tree known by its leaves.
teaser.sw: Jina moja la Kidigo, miti na vichaka vinne tofauti. Huu ni Diphasia, mti wa familia ya michungwa unaotambulika kwa majani yake.
teaser.dg: Dzina mwenga ra Chidigo, mihi na vitsaka vinne tafwauti. Uhu ni *Diphasia*, muhi wa jamii ya michungbwa unaomanyikana kpwa makodzage.

summary.en: Nchikoma is a forest tree of the citrus family, a Diphasia that botanists had not yet formally named. The same Digo name covers three other plants as well.
summary.sw: Nchikoma ni mti wa msituni wa familia ya michungwa, Diphasia ambayo wataalamu wa mimea walikuwa bado hawajaipa jina rasmi. Jina hilohilo la Kidigo linajumuisha mimea mingine mitatu pia.
summary.dg: *Nchikoma* ni muhi wa tsakani wa jamii ya michungbwa, *Diphasia* ambayo asayansi a mimea kala taadzangbweipha dzina ra chisayansi. Dzina hiri ra Chidigo piya nkuhumirwa kpwa mimea yanjina mihahu.

about.en:
This *nchikoma* is a *Diphasia*, a tree of the citrus family. Like its relatives it has compound leaves of three leaflets, dotted with tiny oil glands that give a citrus-like scent when crushed, and small white flowers.

The Digo pick it out by its leaves. Botanists listed it in the *Flora of Tropical East Africa* only as '*Diphasia* sp. A', a species still waiting for a formal name.
about.sw:
*Nchikoma* huu ni *Diphasia*, mti wa familia ya michungwa. Kama mimea ya jamii yake, una majani mchanganyiko yenye vijani vitatu, yenye vitone vidogo sana vya tezi za mafuta vinavyotoa harufu kama ya chungwa yanapopondwa, na maua madogo meupe.

Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake. Wataalamu wa mimea waliuorodhesha katika *Flora of Tropical East Africa* kama '*Diphasia* sp. A' tu, spishi ambayo bado inasubiri jina rasmi.
about.dg:
*Nchikoma* uhu ni *Diphasia*, muhi wa jamii ya michungbwa. Dza mimea ya jamii yakpwe, chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu, genye vibara vidide sana vya mafuha ganayolavya arufu dza ya ndimu gachifikitswa, na una maruwa madide mereru.

Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage. Asayansi a mimea auandika kpwenye *Flora of Tropical East Africa* dza '*Diphasia* sp. A' tu, aina ambayo taidzangbwehewa dzina ra chisayansi.

where.en: *Diphasia* trees grow in the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania. Pakia recorded *nchikoma* among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Miti ya *Diphasia* huota katika misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania. Pakia aliripoti *nchikoma* miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Mihi ya *Diphasia* inamera matsakani ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania. Pakia waandika *nchikoma* kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

culture.en: Its name begins with the prefix that Pakia reads as carrying a 'female' sense, as in *nchibandu* and *nchivuri*.
culture.sw: Jina lake linaanza na kiambishi ambacho Pakia anakisoma kuwa na maana ya 'kike', kama katika *nchibandu* na *nchivuri*.
culture.dg: Dzinare rinaandza na mwandzo ambao Pakia anaona una mana ya 'chichetu', dza *nchibandu* na *nchivuri*.

names.en: Pakia records *nchikoma* for this *Diphasia* and gives the same name to three other plants: *Ehretia amoena*, *Ehretia bakeri* and *Vepris eugeniifolia*. *Vepris* is in the same citrus family as *Diphasia*, but the two *Ehretia* are unrelated. The meaning of the name is not explained. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nchikoma* kwa *Diphasia* hii na anatoa jina hilohilo kwa mimea mingine mitatu: *Ehretia amoena*, *Ehretia bakeri* na *Vepris eugeniifolia*. *Vepris* ni ya familia ileile ya michungwa kama *Diphasia*, lakini *Ehretia* mbili hazina uhusiano nayo. Maana ya jina haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nchikoma* kpwa *Diphasia* ihi, na dzina hiri piya anarilavya kpwa mimea yanjina mihahu: *Ehretia amoena*, *Ehretia bakeri* na *Vepris eugeniifolia*. *Vepris* i jamii mwenga ya michungbwa na *Diphasia*, ela *Ehretia* mbiri si ndugu zao. Mana ya dzina taielezwa. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: A rough-leaved bush with small sweet-scented flowers and orange berries, sharing its Digo name with three other plants.
teaser.sw: Kichaka chenye majani makwaruzu, maua madogo yenye harufu nzuri na matunda ya rangi ya chungwa, kinachoshiriki jina lake la Kidigo na mimea mingine mitatu.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chenye makodza ganayokaraza, maruwa madide ga arufu nono na matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa; dzinare ra Chidigo nkuhumirwa piya kpwa mimea yanjina mihahu.

summary.en: This nchikoma is Ehretia amoena, a deciduous shrub or small tree of dry bush with rough leaves and small orange to red fruits. The Digo use the same name for three other species.
summary.sw: Nchikoma huu ni Ehretia amoena, kichaka au mti mdogo unaopukutisha majani, wa vichaka vikavu, wenye majani makwaruzu na matunda madogo ya rangi ya chungwa hadi nyekundu. Wadigo hutumia jina hilohilo kwa spishi nyingine tatu.
summary.dg: *Nchikoma* uhu ni *Ehretia amoena*, chitsaka au muhi mdide wa weruni kukavu ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wenye makodza ganayokaraza na matunda madide ga rangi ya chungbwa hadi ya kundu. Adigo anahumira dzina hiri piya kpwa aina zanjina zihahu.

about.en:
*Ehretia amoena* is a shrub or small tree, usually a few metres tall, often losing its leaves in the dry season. The leaves are oval and rough, sometimes hairy, and the small white to pale mauve flowers come in loose clusters and are sweetly scented.

The fruits are small round berries that ripen orange to red.
about.sw:
*Ehretia amoena* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa mita chache, mara nyingi hupukutisha majani wakati wa kiangazi. Majani ni ya umbo la yai na makwaruzu, wakati mwingine yenye manyoya, na maua madogo meupe hadi ya zambarau hafifu huja kwa mafungu yaliyolegea na yana harufu nzuri.

Matunda ni beri ndogo za mviringo zinazoiva na kuwa za rangi ya chungwa hadi nyekundu.
about.dg:
*Ehretia amoena* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, kpwa kawaida wa urefu wa mita chache, na mara nyinji makodzage nkugbwa wakati wa kazikazi. Makodza ni ga umbo ra tumbi na ganakaraza, wakati wanjina gana nyere, na maruwa madide, mereru hadi zambarau ngushu-ngushu, ganamera phamwenga ganayoenea-enea na gana arufu nono.

Matunda ni madide ga mviringo, na gachiivwa ganakala ga rangi ya chungbwa hadi ya kundu.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, wooded grassland and thicket across eastern and southern Africa. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu, nyika zenye miti na vichaka vizito kote mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika. Pakia aliuripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kukavu, phatu pha nyasi phenye mihi na vitsakani, Afrika Mashariki na Afrika ya Kusini. Pakia waandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: No Digo use is recorded. Elsewhere in eastern and southern Africa the small fruits are eaten, and the roots and bark are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi ya Kidigo yaliyoripotiwa. Kwingineko mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika, matunda yake madogo huliwa, na mizizi na gome hutumika katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo ganayoandikpwa. Phatu phanjina pha Afrika Mashariki na Afrika ya Kusini, matunda madide nkuriwa, na mizi na gopha nkuhumirwa dza muhaso wa chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records *nchikoma* for this plant, and the same name for *Ehretia bakeri*, *Diphasia* sp. A and *Vepris eugeniifolia*. The meaning of the name is not explained, and how speakers tell the four apart is not recorded. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nchikoma* kwa mmea huu, na jina hilohilo kwa *Ehretia bakeri*, *Diphasia* sp. A na *Vepris eugeniifolia*. Maana ya jina haielezwi, na jinsi wazungumzaji wanavyoitofautisha mimea hii minne haijaripotiwa. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nchikoma* kpwa mmea uhu, na dzina hiri piya kpwa *Ehretia bakeri*, *Diphasia* sp. A na *Vepris eugeniifolia*. Mana ya dzina taielezwa, na Pakia kaandika atu anavyomanya chila mwenga kahi ya mimea hino mine. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

summary.en: Ehretia bakeri is a shrub or small tree of the East African coastal bush. Pakia records it under the Digo name nchikoma, which also covers three other species.

summary.dg: Ehretia bakeri ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa weruni wa pwani ya Afrika ya Mlairo. Pakia anauandika kpwa dzina ra Chidigo nchikoma, ambaro piya nkuhumirwa kpwa aina zanjina tahu.

about.en:
*Ehretia bakeri* is a shrub or small tree with simple, alternate leaves and loose clusters of small white flowers. Like other *Ehretia*, it bears small round fleshy fruits.

It looks much like its cousin *Ehretia amoena*, which the Digo give the same name.
about.sw:
*Ehretia bakeri* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani sahili yanayopishana na mafungu yaliyolegea ya maua madogo meupe. Kama *Ehretia* nyingine, huzaa matunda madogo ya mviringo yenye nyama.

Unafanana sana na binamu yake *Ehretia amoena*, ambao Wadigo huupa jina hilohilo.
about.dg:
*Ehretia bakeri* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide. Chila kodza ni kodza mwenga tu, si makodza madide, na makodza ganamera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kubadilishana uphande. Una mafungu ga maruwa madide mereru garigotawanyika. Dza *Ehretia* zanjina, unavyala matunda madide ga mviringo genye nyama.

teaser.en: A citrus-family tree with single, Eugenia-like leaves, and one of four plants sharing the Digo name nchikoma.
teaser.sw: Mti wa familia ya michungwa wenye majani mamoja kama ya Eugenia, na mmoja wa mimea minne inayoshiriki jina la Kidigo nchikoma.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa jamii ya machungbwa wenye makodza ga kodza mwenga dza ga Eugenia, na ni mmwenga wa mimea mine yenye dzina ra Chidigo nchikoma.

summary.en: Vepris eugeniifolia is a shrub or tree of the citrus family found from southern Ethiopia to Tanzania. The Digo call it nchikoma, the same name as the Diphasia tree and two Ehretias.
summary.sw: Vepris eugeniifolia ni kichaka au mti wa familia ya michungwa unaopatikana kutoka kusini mwa Ethiopia hadi Tanzania. Wadigo huuita nchikoma, jina lilelile la mti wa Diphasia na Ehretia mbili.
summary.dg: Vepris eugeniifolia ni chitsaka au muhi wa jamii ya machungbwa unaophahikana kula Ethiopia ya kusini hadi Tanzania. Adigo anauiha nchikoma, dzina mwenga na ra muhi wa Diphasia na Ehretia mbiri.

about.en: *Vepris eugeniifolia* is a shrub or small tree of the citrus family. Unlike most of its relatives, which have leaves of three leaflets, it has single leaves, and the botanical name says they look like those of a *Eugenia*. The leaves are dotted with oil glands and smell aromatic when crushed, and the flowers are small and greenish-white.
about.sw: *Vepris eugeniifolia* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya michungwa. Tofauti na mimea mingi ya jamii yake, ambayo ina majani yenye vijani vitatu, huu una majani mamoja, na jina lake la kisayansi linasema yanafanana na yale ya *Eugenia*. Majani yana vitone vya tezi za mafuta na hutoa harufu nzuri yanapopondwa, na maua ni madogo, ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe.
about.dg: *Vepris eugeniifolia* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya machungbwa. Nduguze anji ana makodza ganayoganywa kukala makodza madide mahahu, ela uhu chila kodza ni mwenga tu, si makodza madide, na dzina ra chisayansi rinagomba kukala ganahalana na ga *Eugenia*. Makodza gana matone madide sana ga mafuha, na gachifikitswa ganalavya arufu nono. Maruwa ni madide, ga rangi nyereru yenye chijani chidide.

where.en: It grows in dry forest, thicket and bushland from southern Ethiopia and Somalia through Kenya to Tanzania. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu mikavu, vichaka vizito na vichakani kutoka kusini mwa Ethiopia na Somalia kupitia Kenya hadi Tanzania. Pakia aliuripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga tsi kavu, vitsakani na weruni, kula Ethiopia ya kusini na Somalia, kutsupa Kenya, hadi Tanzania. Pakia wauandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

names.en: Pakia records *nchikoma* for this tree, and also for *Diphasia* sp. A, *Ehretia amoena* and *Ehretia bakeri*. *Diphasia* is in the same family, which may explain part of the overlap. The name's meaning is not explained. No English or Swahili name is recorded. Pakia spells the species '*euginiifolia*'.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nchikoma* kwa mti huu, na pia kwa *Diphasia* sp. A, *Ehretia amoena* na *Ehretia bakeri*. *Diphasia* ni ya familia ileile, jambo linaloweza kueleza sehemu ya mwingiliano huu. Maana ya jina haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa. Pakia anaiandika spishi hii '*euginiifolia*'.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nchikoma* kpwa muhi uhu, na piya kpwa *Diphasia* sp. A, *Ehretia amoena* na *Ehretia bakeri*. *Diphasia* ni ya jamii mwenga na muhi uhu, na anji phahi hiyo ndiyo seemu ya sababu ya kuhumira dzina mwenga. Pakia kalavya mana ga dzina hiri. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Pakia anaandika dzina ra aina dza '*euginiifolia*'.

teaser.en: The 'male' of the shade tree nchivuri: a smaller forest-floor cousin from the same family.
teaser.sw: 'Dume' wa mti wa kivuli nchivuri: binamu mdogo wa sakafu ya msitu, wa familia ileile.
teaser.dg: 'Mlume' wa *nchivuri*, muhi wa chivuri: ndugu mdide zaidi wa jamii mwenga, unaomera photsi kahi ya tsaka.

summary.en: Nchivuri mlume is a shrub of the coastal forest understorey, which the Digo regard as the male form of the shade tree nchivuri. Both belong to the litchi family.
summary.sw: Nchivuri mlume ni kichaka cha sehemu ya chini ya misitu ya pwani, ambacho Wadigo hukichukulia kuwa aina ya kiume ya mti wa kivuli nchivuri. Yote miwili ni ya familia ya litchi.
summary.dg: Nchivuri mlume ni chitsaka cha photsi ya mihi mire ya matsaka ga pwani. Adigo anauona dza aina ya chilume ya *nchivuri*, muhi wa chivuri. Mimea yosi miiri ni ya jamii ya *litchi*.

about.en:
*Nchivuri mlume* is a shrub or small tree of the forest understorey. Like *nchivuri* it has compound leaves with several pairs of leaflets, and the Digo tell it apart by its leaves.

In the genus *Chytranthus* the flowers and fruits often grow directly from the trunk and older branches rather than among the leaves.
about.sw:
*Nchivuri mlume* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa sehemu ya chini ya msitu. Kama *nchivuri*, una majani mchanganyiko yenye jozi kadhaa za vijani, na Wadigo huutofautisha kwa majani yake.

Katika jenasi *Chytranthus* maua na matunda mara nyingi huota moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina na matawi ya zamani badala ya kati ya majani.
about.dg:
*Nchivuri mlume* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaomera photsi ya mihi mire ya tsaka. Dza *nchivuri*, chila kodza rina makodza madide manji ganayomera mairi-mairi, na Adigo anaumanya tafwautiye kpwa makodzage.

Kpwa jenasi *Chytranthus*, maruwa na matunda mara nyinji ganamera dzulu ya kolo na panda za kare kabisa, si kahi ya makodza.

where.en: It grows in the shade of coastal forest in Kenya and Tanzania. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota kivulini katika misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania. Pakia aliuripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unamera chivurini kahi ya matsaka ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania. Pakia wauandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

culture.en: Digo plant names often pair a plant with a 'male' (*mlume*) or 'female' partner. Pakia notes that this species is treated as the male form of *nchivuri* (*Blighia unijugata*), but the basis for the gender is not clear. The two plants are in fact related, both members of the soapberry and litchi family.
culture.sw: Majina ya mimea ya Kidigo mara nyingi huunganisha mmea na mwenzi wa 'kiume' (*mlume*) au wa 'kike'. Pakia anabainisha kwamba spishi hii huchukuliwa kuwa aina ya kiume ya *nchivuri* (*Blighia unijugata*), lakini msingi wa jinsia hiyo haueleweki. Kwa kweli mimea hii miwili ina uhusiano, yote ikiwa ya familia ya *soapberry* na litchi.
culture.dg: Madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo mara nyinji ganaika mmea phamwenga na myawe wa 'chilume' (*mlume*) au wa 'chichetu'. Pakia anaandika kukala aina ihi inaonwa dza aina ya chilume ya *nchivuri* (*Blighia unijugata*), ela sababu ya kuiona ya chilume taimanyikana. Kpwa kpweli mimea ihi miiri ni ndugu: yosi ni ya jamii ya *soapberry* na *litchi*.

names.en: Pakia records *nchivuri mlume*, 'male *nchivuri*'. *Nchivuri* means 'shade', from *chivurivuri*, after the broad, shady crown of *Blighia unijugata*. In northern Digo it is *nchivuri* and in southern Digo *nchivuli*, from the regular swap of *r* and *l*. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nchivuri mlume*, '*nchivuri* dume'. *Nchivuri* lina maana ya 'kivuli', kutoka *chivurivuri*, kutokana na taji pana lenye kivuli la *Blighia unijugata*. Katika Kidigo cha kaskazini ni *nchivuri* na katika Kidigo cha kusini *nchivuli*, kutokana na ubadilishanaji wa kawaida wa *r* na *l*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nchivuri mlume*, '*nchivuri* wa chilume'. *Nchivuri* manage ni 'chivuri', kula *chivurivuri*, kpwa sababu ya chitswa chipana cha *Blighia unijugata* chenye chivuri. Kpwa Chidigo cha kazikazini ni *nchivuri*, na kpwa Chidigo cha kusini ni *nchivuli*, kpwa sababu kpwa kawaida *r* na *l* nkubadilishana.

teaser.en: The 'male sedge': short spikelets make it the husband of the longer-flowered ndago chetu.
teaser.sw: 'Ndago dume': vishada vyake vifupi vya maua vinaufanya kuwa mume wa ndago chetu, wenye maua marefu zaidi.
teaser.dg: 'Ndago ya chilume': vitswavye vya maruwa ni vifupi, kpwa hivyo ni mlume wa ndago chetu, ambayo maruwage ni mare zaidi.

summary.en: Ndago lume is the Digo 'male sedge', a name for Mariscus sedges with short spikelets. The Digo pair it with ndago chetu, the 'female sedge', whose spikelets are longer.
summary.sw: Ndago lume ni 'ndago dume' wa Wadigo, jina la ndago za jenasi Mariscus zenye vishada vifupi vya maua. Wadigo huuunganisha na ndago chetu, 'ndago jike', ambao vishada vyake ni virefu zaidi.
summary.dg: Ndago lume ni 'ndago ya chilume' ya Chidigo, dzina ra ndago za Mariscus zenye vitswa vifupi vya maruwa. Adigo anaiika phamwenga na ndago chetu, 'ndago ya chichetu', ambayo vitswavye vya maruwa ni vire zaidi.

about.en:
*Ndago lume* covers the *Mariscus* sedges, grass-like plants with solid, three-sided stems and leaves arranged in three ranks. At the top of the stem a ring of leafy bracts surrounds a head of small, short, crowded spikelets.

The Digo recognise it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Ndago lume* hujumuisha ndago za jenasi *Mariscus*, mimea inayofanana na nyasi yenye mashina imara ya pembe tatu na majani yaliyopangwa kwa safu tatu. Juu ya shina, duara la vikombe-jani humzunguka kichwa cha vishada vidogo vifupi vya maua vilivyosongamana.

Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg:
*Ndago lume* ni dzina ra ndago za *Mariscus*, mimea inayohalana na nyasi, yenye mihi ya pembe tahu isiyokala mihuphu, na makodza ganayomera kpwa mistari mihahu. Dzulu ya muhi, makodza mafupi ganazunguluka chitswa cha vitswa vidide vya maruwa, vifupi na vinavyobanana.

Adigo anaimanya kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: *Mariscus* sedges grow in grassland, bush clearings, farms and along paths on the coastal plain.
where.sw: Ndago za *Mariscus* huota nyikani, kwenye maeneo yaliyosafishwa vichakani, mashambani na kando ya njia katika nyanda za pwani.
where.dg: Ndago za *Mariscus* zinamera nyasini, phatu pha weruni phariphotemwa, mindani na kanda-kanda ya njira kpwenye tsi sambamba ya pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records that the Digo use the root nodules of *ndago* sedges (*Kyllinga* or *Cyperus*) to make a charm that gives magical strength in times of danger. He does not say whether *ndago lume* itself is used.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo hutumia vinundu vya mizizi ya ndago (*Kyllinga* au *Cyperus*) kutengeneza hirizi inayotoa nguvu za kimiujiza wakati wa hatari. Hasemi kama *ndago lume* wenyewe hutumika.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo nkuhumira vitu vidide vinavyofutuka kpwenye mizi ya ndago (*Kyllinga* au *Cyperus*) kuhenda hirizi inayopha mutu nguvu za uganga wakati wa hatari. Kagomba kukala *ndago lume* nkuhumirwa piya au taihumirwa.

culture.en: *Ndago* is the Digo word for sedges as a group, one of the few true folk genera in the language. Within it, the sexes are assigned by flower size: *ndago chetu*, the 'female', has longer spikelets, and *ndago lume*, the 'male', has shorter ones.
culture.sw: *Ndago* ni neno la Kidigo kwa jamii nzima ya ndago, mojawapo ya jenasi chache za kweli za kijadi katika lugha hiyo. Ndani yake, jinsia hupangwa kwa ukubwa wa maua: *ndago chetu*, wa 'kike', ana vishada virefu zaidi, na *ndago lume*, wa 'kiume', ana vifupi zaidi.
culture.dg: *Ndago* ni neno ra Chidigo ra ndago zosi phamwenga (*sedges*), na ni kahi ya madzina machache ga kpweli ga makundi ga mimea (*folk genera*) ga luga ihi. Kahi ya ndago, chilume na chichetu nkuikpwa kulunga ukulu wa maruwa: *ndago chetu*, ya 'chichetu', ina vitswa vire vya maruwa, na *ndago lume*, ya 'chilume', ina vitswa vifupi.

names.en: Pakia records *ndago lume*, 'male sedge', shared with Duruma and Swahili. *Ndago* itself is used in Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. No English name is recorded. Pakia's folk-genus table instead links *Mariscus* to *ndago munda*, so the match between names and sedges needs checking.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *ndago lume*, 'ndago dume', jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. *Ndago* lenyewe hutumika kwa Kidigo, Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililoripotiwa. Jedwali la jenasi za kijadi la Pakia badala yake linahusisha *Mariscus* na *ndago munda*, kwa hiyo ulinganifu kati ya majina na ndago unahitaji kuthibitishwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *ndago lume*, 'ndago ya chilume', dzina rinarohumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma na Chiswahili. Neno *ndago* rinahumirwa kpwa Chidigo, Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Ela orodha ya Pakia ya makundi ga mimea inaika *Mariscus* phamwenga na *ndago munda*, kpwa hivyo ni lazima kulola tsona ni dzina riphi ra ndago iphi.

teaser.en: The farm sedge: a creeping weed with a little green-white pompom on each stem.
teaser.sw: Ndago wa shambani: gugu linalotambaa lenye kishungi kidogo cha kijani-cheupe juu ya kila shina.
teaser.dg: Ndago ya munda: mbondo inayoambala photsi, yenye chitswa chidide cha mviringo cha chijani na nyereru dzulu ya chila muhi.

summary.en: Ndago munda, the 'farmland sedge', is a small creeping sedge of fields and gardens. Its single round flower head on a three-sided stem makes it easy to spot among the crops.
summary.sw: Ndago munda, 'ndago wa shambani', ni ndago mdogo anayetambaa mashambani na bustanini. Kichwa chake kimoja cha maua cha mviringo juu ya shina la pembe tatu hukifanya kuwa rahisi kuonekana kati ya mazao.
summary.dg: Ndago munda, 'ndago ya munda', ni ndago ndide inayoambala photsi minda na busitanini. Chitswache chimwenga cha maruwa cha mviringo chiri dzulu ya muhi wa pembe tahu, kpwa hivyo inaonekana upesi kahi ya mimea iriyophandwa.

about.en:
*Ndago munda* is a low perennial sedge that spreads by creeping underground stems, sending up rows of slender, three-sided stems. Each stem ends in a small round head of tightly packed greenish-white spikelets, with two or three leafy bracts spreading out beneath it.

The Digo recognise it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Ndago munda* ni ndago mfupi wa kudumu anayeenea kwa mashina ya chini ya ardhi yanayotambaa, akichipuza safu za mashina membamba ya pembe tatu. Kila shina huishia kwa kichwa kidogo cha mviringo cha vishada vya maua vya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe vilivyosongamana, na vikombe-jani viwili au vitatu vikitandaa chini yake.

Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg:
*Ndago munda* ni ndago fupi inayokala na moyo kpwa miaka minji. Inaenea kpwa mihi inayoambala tsini, na inalavya mistari ya mihi myembamba ya pembe tahu. Chila muhi unamala na chitswa chidide cha mviringo cha vitswa vidide vya maruwa vinavyobanana sana, vya chijani na nyereru, na photsiche kuna makodza mairi au mahahu ganayotanda.

Adigo anaimanya kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: As its name says, it is at home in the *munda*, the farm. It is a common weed of cultivated fields, gardens and damp, grassy places.
where.sw: Kama jina lake linavyosema, makazi yake ni *munda*, shamba. Ni gugu la kawaida katika mashamba yanayolimwa, bustani na maeneo yenye nyasi na unyevu.
where.dg: Dza dzinare rinavyogomba, inakala *munda*, mindani. Ni mbondo ya kawaida ya minda iriyorimwa, busitani na phatu pha nyasi pha madzi-madzi.

uses.en: Pakia records that the Digo use the root nodules of *ndago* sedges (*Kyllinga* or *Cyperus*) to make a charm that gives magical strength in times of danger. The charm and the root nodules share a name, *pingu*.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo hutumia vinundu vya mizizi ya ndago (*Kyllinga* au *Cyperus*) kutengeneza hirizi inayotoa nguvu za kimiujiza wakati wa hatari. Hirizi hiyo na vinundu vya mizizi hushiriki jina moja, *pingu*.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo nkuhumira vitu vidide vinavyofutuka kpwenye mizi ya ndago (*Kyllinga* au *Cyperus*) kuhenda hirizi inayopha mutu nguvu za uganga wakati wa hatari. Hirizi ihi na vitu hivi vya mizi vina dzina mwenga, *pingu*.

culture.en: *Ndago* is the Digo word for sedges as a group. Pakia counts it as one of the few true folk genera in Digo, with *ndago munda*, *ndago ziya*, *ndago kulu* and others as its members, each named by size, habitat or flower.
culture.sw: *Ndago* ni neno la Kidigo kwa jamii nzima ya ndago. Pakia anaihesabu kuwa mojawapo ya jenasi chache za kweli za kijadi katika Kidigo, ikiwa na *ndago munda*, *ndago ziya*, *ndago kulu* na wengine kama wanachama wake, kila mmoja akipewa jina kwa ukubwa, mazingira au maua yake.
culture.dg: *Ndago* ni neno ra Chidigo ra ndago zosi phamwenga (*sedges*). Pakia anaiolanga kahi ya madzina machache ga kpweli ga makundi ga mimea (*folk genera*) ga Chidigo, na kahi ya kundi hiri kuna *ndago munda*, *ndago ziya*, *ndago kulu* na zanjina, chila mwenga ikaihwa kulunga ukulu, phatu inaphomera au maruwage.

names.en: Pakia records *ndago munda*, 'farmland sedge', a name shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is called creeping sedge or watergrass. Pakia's sources disagree on the species: the plant list gives *Kyllinga erecta*, the name-meaning list a *Cyperus*, and the folk-genus table *Mariscus*.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *ndago munda*, 'ndago wa shambani', jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *creeping sedge* au *watergrass*. Vyanzo vya Pakia vinatofautiana kuhusu spishi: orodha ya mimea inatoa *Kyllinga erecta*, orodha ya maana za majina inatoa *Cyperus*, na jedwali la jenasi za kijadi linatoa *Mariscus*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *ndago munda*, 'ndago ya munda', dzina rinarohumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *creeping sedge* au *watergrass*. Orodha za Pakia zinapha aina za tafwauti: orodha ya mimea inapha *Kyllinga erecta*, orodha ya mana ga madzina inapha *Cyperus*, na orodha ya makundi ga mimea inapha *Mariscus*.

summary.en: Ndago ziya is nutgrass, a sedge with reddish-brown flower spikes and underground chains of small tubers, notorious as one of the world's worst weeds. The Digo name ties it to water.
summary.sw: Ndago ziya ni ndago (*nutgrass*), mmea wenye vishada vya maua vya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu na minyororo ya viazi vidogo chini ya ardhi, unaojulikana sana kama mojawapo ya magugu mabaya zaidi duniani. Jina lake la Kidigo linauhusisha na maji.
summary.dg: Ndago ziya (kpwa Chingereza *nutgrass*) ni ndago yenye vitswa vya maruwa vya rangi ya kundu na dongo, na tsini ina minyororo ya viazi vidide. Inamanyikana duniani kosi dza mmwenga wa mbondo mbii zaidi. Dzina ra Chidigo rinaiika phamwenga na madzi.

about.en:
*Ndago ziya* is a low sedge with shiny, grass-like leaves and smooth three-sided stems. At the top, a spray of narrow reddish-brown to purplish spikelets sits above a few leafy bracts.

The secret is underground. Thin runners link chains of small, hard, dark tubers, each able to sprout a new plant, which is why weeding rarely gets rid of it. The Digo recognise it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Ndago ziya* ni ndago mfupi mwenye majani yanayong'aa yanayofanana na nyasi na mashina laini ya pembe tatu. Juu kabisa, kishada cha vishada vyembamba vya maua vya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu hadi zambarau hukaa juu ya vikombe-jani vichache.

Siri yake iko chini ya ardhi. Mashina membamba yanayotambaa huunganisha minyororo ya viazi vidogo, vigumu na vyeusi, kila kimoja kikiweza kuchipuza mmea mpya, ndiyo sababu kupalilia mara chache humwondoa. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg:
*Ndago ziya* ni ndago fupi yenye makodza ganayong'ala dza ga nyasi na mihi laini ya pembe tahu. Dzulu, vitswa vidide vyembamba vya maruwa, vya rangi ya kundu na dongo hadi zambarau, vinamera dzulu ya makodza mafupi machache.

Siriye iri tsini. Mihi myembamba inayoambala tsini ndiyo inayogbwira minyororo ya viazi vidide, vigumu na vya rangi ya jiza, na chila chiazi chinaweza kulavya mmea muphya. Ndiyo mana uchiiburuga mara nyinji taimala. Adigo anaimanya kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It is common in farms, gardens, roadsides and open ground all along the coast, and does well in damp places.
where.sw: Ni wa kawaida mashambani, bustanini, kando ya barabara na kwenye ardhi wazi kote pwani, na hustawi vizuri sehemu zenye unyevu.
where.dg: Ni ya kawaida mindani, busitanini, kanda-kanda ya njira na phatu pha weruni pwani yosi, na inamera vinono phatu pha madzi-madzi.

uses.en: Pakia records that the Digo use the root nodules of *ndago* sedges (*Kyllinga* or *Cyperus*) to make a charm that gives magical strength in times of danger. Across Africa and Asia the fragrant tubers of nutgrass are also widely used in traditional medicine and perfumery, though no such use is recorded for the Digo.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo hutumia vinundu vya mizizi ya ndago (*Kyllinga* au *Cyperus*) kutengeneza hirizi inayotoa nguvu za kimiujiza wakati wa hatari. Kote Afrika na Asia, viazi vyake vyenye harufu nzuri pia hutumika sana katika tiba za jadi na utengenezaji wa manukato, ingawa hakuna matumizi kama hayo yaliyoripotiwa kwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo nkuhumira vitu vidide vinavyofutuka kpwenye mizi ya ndago (*Kyllinga* au *Cyperus*) kuhenda hirizi inayopha mutu nguvu za uganga wakati wa hatari. Kpwenye Afrika na Asia viazi vyenye arufu nono vya ndago ihi piya nkuhumirwa sana kpwa dawa za chienyeji na kuhenda marashi, ela takuna matumizi dza higa garigoandikpwa kpwa Adigo.

culture.en: Pakia explains that plants of fresh water and ponds carry the label *ziya*, as in *ndago ziya* and *mrinda ziya*, and glosses the name as 'aquatic sedge'. In the Mgombato dictionary *ziya* is 'lake'.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba mimea ya maji baridi na madimbwi hubeba kiambishi *ziya*, kama katika *ndago ziya* na *mrinda ziya*, na analifafanua jina hili kama 'ndago wa majini'. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *ziya* ni 'ziwa'.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala mimea ya madzi gasigo na munyu na ya madimbwi inaikpwa neno *ziya*, dza *ndago ziya* na *mrinda ziya*, na anagomba mana ga dzina hiri ni 'ndago ya madzini'. Kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, *ziya* ni 'ziwa' (*lake*).

names.en: Pakia records *ndago ziya*, the 'water' or 'pond' sedge. *Ndago*, the word for sedges, is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is nutgrass or watergrass. Pakia's folk-genus table places *ndago ziya* in *Fimbristylis*, another sedge genus, rather than *Cyperus rotundus*, so the identification needs checking.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *ndago ziya*, ndago wa 'maji' au wa 'dimbwi'. *Ndago*, neno la jamii ya ndago, hutumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *nutgrass* au *watergrass*. Jedwali la jenasi za kijadi la Pakia linamweka *ndago ziya* katika *Fimbristylis*, jenasi nyingine ya ndago, badala ya *Cyperus rotundus*, kwa hiyo utambulisho wake unahitaji kuthibitishwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *ndago ziya*, ndago ya 'madzini' au ya 'ziya'. *Ndago*, neno ra ndago zosi, rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *nutgrass* au *watergrass*. Orodha ya Pakia ya makundi ga mimea inaika *ndago ziya* kahi ya *Fimbristylis*, jenasi yanjina ya ndago, si *Cyperus rotundus*, kpwa hivyo ni lazima kulola tsona ni aina iphi hasa.

teaser.en: Its seeds twist into tangles and drill into socks and skin; its stems thatch Digo houses.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake hujisokota kuwa mafundo na kutoboa soksi na ngozi; mashina yake huezeka nyumba za Wadigo.
teaser.dg: Tembeze zinadzisokota na kutsanganyikana, na zinainjira ndani ya soksi na ngozi; mihiye nkuhumirwa kuezeka nyumba za Adigo.

summary.en: Nguji is spear grass, a tufted grass whose dark, twisted awns knot together and whose sharp seeds stick in clothing. Pakia lists it among the grasses the Digo use in house building.
summary.sw: Nguji ni *spear grass*, nyasi inayoota kwa vishungi ambayo vikonyo vyake virefu vyeusi vilivyosokotwa hujifunga pamoja na mbegu zake kali hunasa kwenye nguo. Pakia anaiorodhesha miongoni mwa nyasi ambazo Wadigo hutumia katika ujenzi wa nyumba.
summary.dg: Nguji (kpwa Chingereza *spear grass*) ni nyasi inayomera mabunda, yenye nyere nyire za rangi ya jiza zinazodzisokota na kufungana, na tembe zenye ntsa kali zinazogbwira nguwo. Pakia anaiandika kahi ya nyasi ambazo Adigo nkuzihumira kudzengera nyumba.

about.en:
*Nguji* is a tufted perennial grass, usually knee- to waist-high, with flattened leaf sheaths and narrow leaves. Its flower spikes end in long, dark brown awns that twist together when dry, so a ripe clump looks matted and tangled.

Each seed has a sharp, hard point and a spiralling awn that coils and uncoils with moisture, screwing the seed into the ground, or into socks, wool and skin.
about.sw:
*Nguji* ni nyasi ya kudumu inayoota kwa vishungi, kwa kawaida ya kimo cha goti hadi kiuno, yenye ala za majani zilizobapa na majani membamba. Vishada vyake vya maua huishia kwa vikonyo virefu vya rangi ya kahawia iliyokolea vinavyojisokota pamoja vikikauka, kwa hiyo kishungi kilichokomaa huonekana kimesongamana na kutatanika.

Kila mbegu ina ncha kali na ngumu na kikonyo kinachojizungusha, ambacho hujikunja na kujikunjua kwa unyevu, kikiisokota mbegu ardhini, au ndani ya soksi, sufu na ngozi.
about.dg:
*Nguji* ni nyasi inayomera mabunda na inakala na moyo kpwa miaka minji. Kpwa kawaida urewe ni kula magotini hadi chununi. Seemu za photsi za makodza, zinazozunguluka muhi, ni sambamba, na makodza ni membamba. Vitswavye vya maruwa vinamala na nyere nyire za rangi ya dongo ya jiza, zinazodzisokota phamwenga zichiuma, kpwa hivyo bunda ririroivwa rinaonekana dza rikafungana na kutsanganyikana.

Chila tembe ina ntsa kali ngumu na nyere inayodzizunguluka, inayodzilinga na kudzikundzula kulunga jeke-jeke. Kpwa njira ihi tembe inadziinjiza tsini dza skrubu, au ndani ya soksi, nyoya za ng'ondzi na ngozi.

where.en: It grows on open grassland, bush clearings, roadsides and dry, stony slopes across the tropics, and is common on the coastal plain.
where.sw: Huota nyikani wazi, kwenye maeneo yaliyosafishwa vichakani, kando ya barabara na kwenye miteremko mikavu yenye mawe kote katika nchi za joto, na ni ya kawaida katika nyanda za pwani.
where.dg: Inamera nyasini, phatu pha weruni phariphotemwa, kanda-kanda ya njira na kpwenye miteremuko mikavu ya mawe, kpwenye tsi za dzoho za dunia yosi; ni ya kawaida kpwenye tsi sambamba ya pwani.

uses.en: Pakia names *Heteropogon contortus* among the grasses the Digo use for house building, alongside *Hyparrhenia* and *Cyperus exaltatus*; the stems serve as thatch. Young growth is good grazing before the seeds form.
uses.sw: Pakia anataja *Heteropogon contortus* miongoni mwa nyasi ambazo Wadigo hutumia kujenga nyumba, pamoja na *Hyparrhenia* na *Cyperus exaltatus*; mashina yake hutumika kuezekea. Machipukizi machanga ni malisho mazuri kabla mbegu hazijatokea.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika *Heteropogon contortus* kahi ya nyasi ambazo Adigo nkuzihumira kudzengera nyumba, phamwenga na *Hyparrhenia* na *Cyperus exaltatus*; mihiye nkuhumirwa kuezeka. Ichiri mphya, kabla ya tembe kutuluka, ni chakurya chinono cha mifugo.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *nguji* and *todza*; *todza* is shared with Duruma and Swahili. *Todza* is also the name of blackjack (*Bidens pilosa*), another plant with clinging seeds. Pakia's name-prefix table lists both *nguji* and *todza* under blackjack, so which plant each name belongs to needs checking. In English it is spear grass or tanglehead.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti majina mawili ya Kidigo, *nguji* na *todza*; *todza* linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. *Todza* pia ni jina la kishonanguo (*Bidens pilosa*), mmea mwingine wenye mbegu zinazonata. Jedwali la viambishi vya majina la Pakia linaorodhesha *nguji* na *todza* yote chini ya kishonanguo, kwa hiyo jina lipi ni la mmea upi linahitaji kuthibitishwa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *spear grass* au *tanglehead*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *nguji* na *todza*; *todza* rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma na Chiswahili. *Todza* piya ni dzina ra mmea wanjina (*Bidens pilosa*, kpwa Chingereza *blackjack*) wenye tembe zinazogbwira. Orodha ya Pakia ya *prefix* za madzina inaika *nguji* na *todza* vyosi photsi ya *Bidens pilosa*, kpwa hivyo ni lazima kulola tsona ni dzina riphi ra mmea uphi. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *spear grass* au *tanglehead*.

teaser.en: A forked-thorn bush seen as the wild, outdoor twin of a spirit medicine bought in Indian shops.
teaser.sw: Kichaka chenye miiba yenye panda kinachochukuliwa kuwa pacha wa porini wa dawa ya pepo inayonunuliwa madukani mwa Wahindi.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chenye miya ya panda, chinachoonwa dza patsa wa weruni wa dawa ya pepho inayogulwa madukani ga Ahindi.

summary.en: Nvuje ya nze is a spiny num-num bush with white, starry flowers and red berries. The Digo regard it as the wild form of nvuje, a spirit-related medicine sold in shops.
summary.sw: Nvuje ya nze ni kichaka chenye miiba cha jamii ya *num-num*, chenye maua meupe kama nyota na matunda mekundu. Wadigo hukichukulia kuwa aina ya porini ya nvuje, dawa inayohusiana na pepo inayouzwa madukani.
summary.dg: Nvuje ya nze ni chitsaka cha *num-num* chenye miya, maruwa mereru ga umbo ra nyota na matunda madide ga kundu. Adigo anachiona dza aina ya weruni ya *nvuje*, dawa ya pepho inayoguzwa madukani.

about.en:
*Nvuje ya nze* is a dense, evergreen shrub with glossy, leathery, oval leaves in opposite pairs. Its stems carry sharp spines that are usually forked into two, and broken twigs bleed a white latex.

The white flowers are small, starry and sweetly scented, and are followed by oval berries that ripen bright red. The Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw:
*Nvuje ya nze* ni kichaka kizito kisichopukutisha majani, chenye majani yanayong'aa, magumu kama ngozi, ya umbo la yai, yaliyopangwa kwa jozi zinazoelekeana. Mashina yake yana miiba mikali ambayo kwa kawaida imegawanyika kuwa panda mbili, na vitawi vilivyovunjika hutoa utomvu mweupe.

Maua meupe ni madogo, kama nyota na yenye harufu nzuri, yakifuatwa na matunda ya beri ya umbo la yai yanayoiva na kuwa mekundu angavu. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Nvuje ya nze* ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji zinazobanana, chenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganang'ala, ni magumu dza chingo na ga mviringo, na ganamera mairi-mairi ganalengana. Mihiye ina miya mikali, ambayo kpwa kawaida inaganyika kukala ntsa mbiri, na maphungo gachivundzika ganalavya maziya mereru.

Maruwa mereru ni madide, ga umbo ra nyota na genye arufu nono, na badaye kunatuluka matunda ga mviringo ganayoivwa kukala ga kundu sana. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush, thicket and forest margins in eastern and southern Africa. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika. Pakia alikiripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni pwani, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, Afrika ya Mlairo na ya Kusini. Pakia wachiandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: No Digo use is recorded. Elsewhere in Africa the ripe red berries of *Carissa bispinosa* are eaten.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi ya Kidigo yaliyoripotiwa. Kwingineko barani Afrika, matunda mekundu yaliyoiva ya *Carissa bispinosa* huliwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa. Phatu phanjina Afrika, matunda maivu ga kundu ga *Carissa bispinosa* nkuriwa.

culture.en: Pakia explains that *nvuje* is an Indian medicine, used against spirits, that is sold in shops. This plant is seen as the wild form of the same thing, the *nvuje* of outside.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba *nvuje* ni dawa ya Kihindi, inayotumika dhidi ya pepo, inayouzwa madukani. Mmea huu huchukuliwa kuwa aina ya porini ya kitu hichohicho, *nvuje* ya nje.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala *nvuje* ni dawa ya Ahindi, inayohumirwa kuzuwiya pepho, na inaguzwa madukani. Chitsaka chichi chinaonwa dza aina ya weruni ya dawa ihi ihi, *nvuje* ya kondze.

names.en: Pakia records *nvuje ya nze*, '*nvuje* of outside', the wild counterpart of the shop-bought *nvuje*. No Swahili name is recorded. In English it is called forest num-num or hedge thorn. Its relative *Carissa spinarum* is *mtambuu* in Digo.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nvuje ya nze*, '*nvuje* ya nje', mwenzi wa porini wa *nvuje* inayonunuliwa dukani. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *forest num-num* au *hedge thorn*. Ndugu yake *Carissa spinarum* kwa Kidigo ni *mtambuu*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nvuje ya nze*, '*nvuje* ya kondze', aina ya weruni ya *nvuje* inayogulwa dukani. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *forest num-num* au *hedge thorn*. Nduguye *Carissa spinarum* kpwa Chidigo ni *mtambuu*.

teaser.en: Named for the way it spreads over the ground like a roof.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina kutokana na jinsi unavyotandaa juu ya ardhi kama paa.

summary.en: Phatsa is a coastal Vernonia, a shrub of the daisy family whose name means 'covering'. It is the 'female' to Lantana viburnoides, which the Digo call the male chiphatsa.
summary.sw: Phatsa ni Vernonia ya pwani, kichaka cha familia ya alizeti ambacho jina lake lina maana ya 'kifuniko'. Ni wa 'kike' kwa Lantana viburnoides, ambao Wadigo huuita chiphatsa dume.
summary.dg: Phatsa ni Vernonia ya pwani, chitsaka cha jamii ya *daisy*, na dzinare manage ni 'chifwiniko'. Ni 'mchetu' wa Lantana viburnoides, ambacho Adigo anachiiha chiphatsa cha chilume.

about.en:
*Phatsa* is a shrub of the daisy family, a relative of the bitter-leaf. *Vernonia* shrubs carry their small flowers in fluffy heads, usually mauve to purple, clustered at the branch tips, followed by seeds with tufts of bristly hairs.

What the Digo notice is its growth. It spreads low and wide, roofing over the ground, and they identify it by its leaves.
about.sw:
*Phatsa* ni kichaka cha familia ya alizeti, ndugu wa *bitter-leaf*. Vichaka vya *Vernonia* huzaa maua yao madogo katika vichwa laini kama pamba, kwa kawaida vya rangi ya zambarau hafifu hadi zambarau, vilivyosongamana kwenye ncha za matawi, vikifuatwa na mbegu zenye vishungi vya manyoya magumu.

Kinachowavutia Wadigo ni jinsi unavyokua. Hutandaa chini na kwa upana, ukiifunika ardhi kama paa, na huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Phatsa* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya *daisy*, ndugu wa *bitter-leaf*. Vitsaka vya *Vernonia* vina maruwa madide ganayomera kpwa vitswa laini dza sufi, kpwa kawaida ga zambarau ngushu-ngushu hadi zambarau, ganayomera phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za panda, na badaye kunatuluka tembe zenye mafungu ga nyere ngumu.

Chitu ambacho Adigo anachilola ni vira chinavyomera. Chinaenea photsi na kpwa upana, chichifwinika tsi dza makuti, na Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and thicket. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani na vichaka vizito. Pakia aliuripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni pwani na vitsakani. Pakia wachiandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

culture.en: Pakia records that *phatsa* means 'covering', because the plant spreads over the ground like a roofing structure, from *kuphatsa*. *Lantana viburnoides* is seen as its male counterpart and is called *chiphatsa chilume*.
culture.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba *phatsa* lina maana ya 'kifuniko', kwa sababu mmea huu hutandaa juu ya ardhi kama muundo wa paa, kutoka *kuphatsa*. *Lantana viburnoides* huchukuliwa kuwa mwenzi wake wa kiume na huitwa *chiphatsa chilume*.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala *phatsa* manage ni 'chifwiniko', kpwa sababu mmea uhu unaenea dzulu ya tsi dza makuti ganavyofwinika nyumba, kula *kuphatsa*. *Lantana viburnoides* inaonwa dza myawe wa chilume, na inaihwa *chiphatsa chilume*.

names.en: Pakia records both *phatsa* and *chiphatsa* for this plant; the diminutive *chi-* seems to be interchangeable here. The name is shared with Swahili. A note in Pakia's text also links the root *-phatsa* to *Vernonia zanzibarensis*, and *mphatsa* is the Digo name of *Acalypha fruticosa*. No English name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *phatsa* na *chiphatsa* kwa mmea huu; kiambishi cha udogo *chi-* kinaonekana kubadilishana bila tofauti hapa. Jina hili linatumika pia kwa Kiswahili. Dokezo katika maandishi ya Pakia pia linahusisha mzizi *-phatsa* na *Vernonia zanzibarensis*, na *mphatsa* ni jina la Kidigo la *Acalypha fruticosa*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *phatsa* na *chiphatsa* vyosi kpwa mmea uhu; *chi-*, inayoonyesa udide, inaonekana kukala inaweza kuikpwa au kuusiwa bila kugaluza mana. Dzina rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiswahili. Kpwenye chitabu cha Pakia, maneno ganjina ganaika *-phatsa* phamwenga na *Vernonia zanzibarensis*, na *mphatsa* ni dzina ra Chidigo ra *Acalypha fruticosa*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: Its name simply means 'heal': a woolly, scrambling herb used against spirit-caused illness.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'ponya' tu: mmea wenye sufu unaotambaa, unaotumika dhidi ya maradhi yanayosababishwa na pepo.
teaser.dg: Dzinare manage ni 'kuphoza' tu: mmea unaoambala, wenye nyere nyereru dza sufi, unaohumirwa kuphoza makongo ganayorehwa ni pepho.

summary.en: Phoza is a scrambling, white-woolly herb of the daisy family, a common Digo medicine for healing spiritual ailments. Its name means 'heal'.
summary.sw: Phoza ni mmea unaotambaa wenye sufu nyeupe, wa familia ya alizeti, dawa ya kawaida ya Wadigo ya kuponya maradhi ya kiroho. Jina lake lina maana ya 'ponya'.
summary.dg: Phoza ni mmea wa jamii ya *daisy* unaoambala, wenye nyere nyereru dza sufi, na ni dawa ya kawaida ya Adigo ya kuphoza makongo ga pepho. Dzinare manage ni 'kuphoza'.

about.en:
*Phoza* is a big, semi-succulent herb that grows as a bushy clump or scrambles over other plants, 1 to 5 metres long. Its fleshy stems are densely covered in white wool, and its large oval leaves carry cobweb-like white hairs, with stalks that wrap around the stem. The plant has an unpleasant smell.

The flowers form dense rounded masses of small yellow heads without petals, and the seeds float away on tufts of white hair. The Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw:
*Phoza* ni mmea mkubwa wenye majimaji kiasi unaoota kama kichaka kizito au kutambaa juu ya mimea mingine, wenye urefu wa mita 1 hadi 5. Mashina yake yenye nyama yamefunikwa kwa wingi na sufu nyeupe, na majani yake makubwa ya umbo la yai yana manyoya meupe kama utando wa buibui, na vikonyo vinavyozunguka shina. Mmea una harufu mbaya.

Maua hufanya mafungu mazito ya mviringo ya vichwa vidogo vya manjano visivyo na petali, na mbegu huelea mbali kwa vishungi vya manyoya meupe. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Phoza* ni mmea mkulu wa madzi-madzi chidide, unaomera dza bunda ra chitsaka au unaoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, na urewe ni kula mita 1 hadi 5. Mihiye inayonona ikafwinikpwa sana ni nyere nyereru dza sufi, na makodzage makulu ga mviringo gana nyere nyereru dza nyumba ya dzwidzwidzwi, na militaye inazunguluka muhi. Mmea una arufu mbii.

Maruwa ganamera mabunda ga mviringo ganayobanana, ga vitswa vidide vinji vya rangi ya mandano, bila vipande vya ruwa (*petals*), na tembe zinatsukulwa ni phepho kpwa mafungu ga nyere nyereru. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in thickets, forest edges and shaded bush. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vizito, pembezoni mwa misitu na vichaka vyenye kivuli. Pakia aliuripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unamera vitsakani, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na weruni phatu phenye chivuri. Pakia wauandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: Pakia records *phoza* as a common medicine for healing spiritual ailments. In Uganda the same species is used for malaria and children's teething problems, and as a hedge.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti *phoza* kama dawa ya kawaida ya kuponya maradhi ya kiroho. Nchini Uganda spishi hiyohiyo hutumika kutibu malaria na matatizo ya watoto wanapoota meno, na pia kama ua.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika *phoza* dza dawa ya kawaida ya kuphoza makongo ga pepho. Uganda aina ihi ihi nkuhumirwa kpwa homa na shida za ana anaomera meno, na dza lichigo.

culture.en: The name is the use. *Phoza* means 'heal', and Pakia places it among names that announce the hoped-for outcome of the medicine, together with *reza*, 'neutralizer'.
culture.sw: Jina ndilo matumizi. *Phoza* lina maana ya 'ponya', na Pakia analiweka miongoni mwa majina yanayotangaza matokeo yanayotarajiwa ya dawa, pamoja na *reza*, 'kizuia/kiondoa nguvu'.
culture.dg: Dzina ndiro matumizige. *Phoza* manage ni 'kuphoza', na Pakia anariika kahi ya madzina ganayogomba vira dawa inavyotazamiwa kuhenda, phamwenga na *reza*, 'chitu cha kureza'.

names.en: Pakia records *phoza*, meaning 'heal', and gives the scientific name as *Senecio cydoniifolius*, now *Solanecio cydoniifolius*. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *phoza*, lenye maana ya 'ponya', na anatoa jina la kisayansi kama *Senecio cydoniifolius*, ambalo sasa ni *Solanecio cydoniifolius*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *phoza*, manage 'kuphoza', na analavya dzina ra chisayansi dza *Senecio cydoniifolius*, ambaro sambi ni *Solanecio cydoniifolius*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: A strong-smelling roadside mint named after the spirit it is used against.
teaser.sw: Mmea wa jamii ya mnanaa wenye harufu kali unaoota kando ya barabara, uliopewa jina la pepo unaotumika dhidi yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa jamii ya *mint* wenye arufu kali, unaomera kanda-kanda ya njira, na unaihwa kpwa dzina ra pepho ambaye nkuhumirwa kumzuwiya.

summary.en: Pungahewa is a tall, hairy, strongly scented weed of the mint family, originally from tropical America. The Digo use it as a medicine against a particular spirit, punga hewa, which gives the plant its name.
summary.sw: Pungahewa ni gugu refu lenye manyoya na harufu kali, la familia ya minanaa, asili yake ikiwa Amerika ya kitropiki. Wadigo hulitumia kama dawa dhidi ya pepo maalumu, punga hewa, ambaye ndiye aliyeupa mmea jina lake.
summary.dg: Pungahewa ni mbondo, mmea mure wa jamii ya *mint* wenye nyere na arufu kali, ambao ni wa kula Amerika ya tsi za dzoho. Adigo nkuuhumira dza dawa ya kuzuwiya pepho mmwenga hasa, *punga hewa*, ambaye ndiye ariyeupha mmea uhu dzinare.

about.en:
*Pungahewa* is a coarse, upright herb up to about 2 metres tall, with square, hairy stems and soft, toothed leaves. Brush past it and it gives off a strong minty, resinous smell.

The small blue to purple flowers sit in the leaf angles. Each develops in a hairy, ribbed, bell-shaped calyx with bristly teeth that dries around the seeds. The Digo identify it by its leaves and fruits.
about.sw:
*Pungahewa* ni mmea mgumu uliosimama wima, wenye urefu wa hadi takriban mita 2, wenye mashina ya pembe nne yenye manyoya na majani laini yenye meno. Ukiupitia na kuugusa, hutoa harufu kali kama ya mnanaa na utomvu.

Maua madogo ya rangi ya buluu hadi zambarau hukaa kwenye pembe za majani. Kila moja hukua ndani ya kikombe cha ua chenye manyoya, chenye mistari na umbo la kengele, chenye meno kama nywele ngumu, kinachokauka kuzunguka mbegu. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg:
*Pungahewa* ni mmea mgumu unaoima chocho, hadi mita 2 hivi dzulu, wenye mihi ya pembe nne yenye nyere, na makodza laini genye meno. Uchiutsupa na kuuguta, unalavya arufu kali dza ya *mint* na ya ulimbo.

Maruwa madide ga samawati hadi zambarau ganamera phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na muhi. Chila ruwa rinakula ndani ya chikombe cha umbo ra kengele, chenye nyere na mistari, na meno ga nyere ngumu, ambacho chinauma chichizunguluka tembe. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na matundage.

where.en: It came from tropical America and is now a common weed of roadsides, abandoned fields, village edges and disturbed bush along the coast, often in dense stands.
where.sw: Ulitoka Amerika ya kitropiki na sasa ni gugu la kawaida kando ya barabara, kwenye mashamba yaliyotelekezwa, pembezoni mwa vijiji na vichaka vilivyovurugwa kote pwani, mara nyingi ukiota kwa wingi.
where.dg: Mmea uhu ni wa kula Amerika ya tsi za dzoho, na sambi ni mbondo ya kawaida kanda-kanda ya njira, mindani iriyorichwa, kanda-kanda ya vidzidzi na weruni phatu phariphobanangwa pwani yosi. Mara nyinji unamera kpwa mabunda manji ganayobanana.

uses.en: Pakia records that it is used as a spiritual medicine against a specific spirit, *punga hewa*. Elsewhere in the tropics the pungent leaves are widely burned or hung up to keep mosquitoes and other insects away.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba hutumika kama dawa ya kiroho dhidi ya pepo maalumu, *punga hewa*. Kwingineko katika nchi za joto, majani yake yenye harufu kali huchomwa au kutundikwa sana ili kufukuza mbu na wadudu wengine.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya pepho, kuzuwiya pepho mmwenga hasa, *punga hewa*. Phatu phanjina pha tsi za dzoho, makodzage genye arufu kali nkuochwa au nkudeleswa sana ili imbu na adudu anjina asifike.

culture.en: Pakia lists *punga hewa* among the spirits that bring on illnesses, alongside *mwanga*, *mwanga jine* and *chirehani*. Plants used to cure those illnesses are named after the spirit, so the plant and the spirit share one name.
culture.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *punga hewa* miongoni mwa pepo wanaoleta maradhi, pamoja na *mwanga*, *mwanga jine* na *chirehani*. Mimea inayotumika kuponya maradhi hayo hupewa jina la pepo husika, kwa hiyo mmea na pepo hushiriki jina moja.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika *punga hewa* kahi ya pepho anaoreha makongo, phamwenga na *mwanga*, *mwanga jine* na *chirehani*. Mimea inayohumirwa kuphoza makongo higo nkuihwa kpwa dzina ra pepho, kpwa hivyo dzina ra mmea na ra pepho ni mwenga.

names.en: Pakia records *pungahewa*, named after the spirit *punga hewa*. In English it is pignut, bush mint or wild spikenard. No Swahili name is recorded. Botanists now often call it *Mesosphaerum suaveolens*.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *pungahewa*, uliopewa jina la pepo *punga hewa*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *pignut*, *bush mint* au *wild spikenard*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa. Wataalamu wa mimea sasa mara nyingi huuita *Mesosphaerum suaveolens*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *pungahewa*, dzina ra kula kpwa pepho *punga hewa*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pignut*, *bush mint* au *wild spikenard*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Sambi asayansi a mimea mara nyinji anauiha *Mesosphaerum suaveolens*.

conservation.en: It is an invasive weed in much of Africa and Asia.
conservation.sw: Ni gugu vamizi katika sehemu kubwa ya Afrika na Asia.
conservation.dg: Ni mbondo inayovamira tsi kpwenye seemu nyinji za Afrika na Asia.

teaser.en: A fleshy-leaved scrambler whose name means 'neutralizer': it is used to undo witchcraft.
teaser.sw: Mmea unaotambaa wenye majani manene ambao jina lake lina maana ya 'kiondoa nguvu': hutumika kutangua uchawi.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaoambala wenye makodza ganayonona, ambao dzinare manage ni 'chitu cha kureza': nkuhumirwa kuusa utsai.

summary.en: Reza is a succulent, scrambling herb of the daisy family with angled stems and yellow flower heads. The Digo use it to neutralise the effects of witchcraft.
summary.sw: Reza ni mmea wenye majimaji unaotambaa, wa familia ya alizeti, wenye mashina ya pembe na vichwa vya maua vya manjano. Wadigo huutumia kuondoa nguvu za athari za uchawi.
summary.dg: Reza ni mmea wa madzi-madzi wa jamii ya *daisy*, unaoambala, wenye mihi ya pembe na vitswa vya maruwa vya rangi ya mandano. Adigo nkuuhumira kureza matokeo ga utsai.

about.en:
*Reza* is a fleshy herb that sprawls or climbs over bushes, with angular, often purplish stems and thick, smooth, toothed leaves. Its small yellow flower heads come in loose clusters and are followed by seeds with white parachute hairs.

The Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw:
*Reza* ni mmea wenye nyama unaotawanyika ardhini au kupanda juu ya vichaka, wenye mashina yenye pembe, mara nyingi ya rangi ya zambarau, na majani manene, laini yenye meno. Vichwa vyake vidogo vya maua ya manjano huja kwa mafungu yaliyolegea, na hufuatwa na mbegu zenye manyoya meupe kama mwavuli.

Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Reza* ni mmea wa madzi-madzi unaoambala photsi au unaodzilinga-linga dzulu ya vitsaka. Una mihi ya pembe, mara nyinji ya zambarau chidide, na makodza ganayonona, laini na genye meno. Vitswavye vidide vya maruwa vya rangi ya mandano vinamera kpwa mafungu garigotawanyika, na badaye kunatuluka tembe zenye nyere nyereru, zinazotsukulwa ni phepho.

Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush, thicket and forest edges, scrambling through other vegetation. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, ukitambaa katikati ya mimea mingine. Pakia aliuripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unamera weruni pwani, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, uchiambala kahi ya mimea yanjina. Pakia wauandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

culture.dg: Dzina ndiro kusudire. *Reza* manage ni 'chitu cha kureza', kula *reza*, 'kureza', na Pakia anariika phamwenga na *phoza*, 'kuphoza', kahi ya madzina ganayogomba matokeo ganayotazamiwa kurehwa ni dawa.

teaser.en: The little black needles that cling to your trousers after a walk through any field.
teaser.sw: Vile vijiti vidogo vyeusi vinavyonasa kwenye suruali yako baada ya kutembea katika shamba lolote.
teaser.dg: Tembe ndide nyiru dza sindano, zinazogbwira suruwaleyo uchinyendeka kahi ya munda wowosi.

summary.en: Todza is blackjack, a common weed whose barbed black seeds hitch rides on clothing and animal fur. The Digo recognise it by its leaves and its seeds.
summary.sw: Todza ni kishonanguo, gugu la kawaida ambalo mbegu zake nyeusi zenye ndoano hujishikiza kwenye nguo na manyoya ya wanyama na kusafiri nazo. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na mbegu zake.
summary.dg: Todza (kpwa Chingereza *blackjack*) ni mbondo ya kawaida, ambayo tembeze nyiru zenye viloo zinagbwira nguwo na nyere za nyama, na kutsukulwa phatu phanjina. Adigo anaimanya kpwa makodzage na tembeze.

about.en:
*Todza* is an upright annual herb, usually knee-high, with square stems and leaves divided into three to five toothed leaflets. The small flower heads have a yellow centre and sometimes a few short white petals.

The flower heads ripen into a spiky ball of narrow black seeds. Each one ends in two to four barbed prongs that hook into socks, trousers and fur. Pakia notes that it is one of the plants the Digo identify from its fruits, as well as its leaves.
about.sw:
*Todza* ni mmea wa msimu mmoja uliosimama wima, kwa kawaida hufika usawa wa goti, wenye mashina ya pembe nne na majani yaliyogawanyika kuwa vijani vitatu hadi vitano vyenye meno. Vichwa vidogo vya maua vina kiini cha manjano na wakati mwingine petali chache fupi nyeupe.

Vichwa vya maua hukomaa na kuwa mpira wenye miiba wa mbegu nyembamba nyeusi. Kila mbegu huishia kwa ncha mbili hadi nne zenye ndoano zinazonasa kwenye soksi, suruali na manyoya. Pakia anaeleza kuwa ni mmoja wa mimea ambayo Wadigo huitambua kwa matunda yake, pamoja na majani yake.
about.dg:
*Todza* ni mmea unaoima chocho, unaokala na moyo kpwa mwaka mmwenga tu, na kpwa kawaida urewe ni hadi magotini. Una mihi ya pembe nne na makodza ganayoganywa kukala makodza madide mahahu hadi matsano genye meno. Vitswa vidide vya maruwa vina kahi ya rangi ya mandano, na wakati wanjina vipande vichache vifupi vyereru vya ruwa.

Vitswa vya maruwa vichiivwa vinakala chitswa cha mviringo chenye miya, cha tembe nyiru nyembamba. Chila tembe inamala na ntsa mbiri hadi nne zenye viloo, zinazogbwira soksi, suruwale na nyere za nyama. Pakia anaandika kukala ni kahi ya mimea ambayo Adigo nkuimanya kpwa matundage, phamwenga na makodzage.

where.en: It is a weed of farms, gardens, roadsides and any disturbed ground throughout the coast and much of the tropics.
where.sw: Ni gugu la mashamba, bustani, kando ya barabara na ardhi yoyote iliyochimbuliwa kote pwani na katika sehemu kubwa ya ukanda wa tropiki.
where.dg: Ni mbondo ya mindani, busitanini, kanda-kanda ya njira na chila phatu ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa, pwani yosi na kpwenye tsi nyinji za dzoho za dunia.

uses.en: No Digo use is recorded. In much of East Africa the young leaves are cooked as a vegetable, and the plant is widely used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Katika sehemu nyingi za Afrika Mashariki, majani machanga hupikwa kama mboga, na mmea huu hutumika sana katika tiba asilia.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa. Kpwenye seemu nyinji za Afrika ya Mlairo, makodza maphya nkujitwa dza mtsunga, na mmea uhu nkuhumirwa sana kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records *todza* for blackjack, and the same name for spear grass (*Heteropogon contortus*), whose seeds also stick to clothing; for spear grass the name is shared with Duruma and Swahili. Pakia's name-prefix table also gives *nguji* for blackjack, though his plant list gives *nguji* for spear grass. In English it is blackjack or beggar's tick.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *todza* kwa kishonanguo, na jina hilohilo kwa nyasi-mkuki (*Heteropogon contortus*), ambayo mbegu zake pia hunata kwenye nguo; kwa nyasi-mkuki jina hili linatumika pia katika Kiduruma na Kiswahili. Jedwali la Pakia la viambishi vya majina pia linatoa *nguji* kwa kishonanguo, ingawa orodha yake ya mimea inatoa *nguji* kwa nyasi-mkuki. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *blackjack* au *beggar's tick*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *todza* kpwa mmea uhu, na dzina hiri hiri kpwa *nguji* (*Heteropogon contortus*, kpwa Chingereza *spear grass*), ambayo tembeze piya zinagbwira nguwo; kpwa *nguji*, dzina *todza* rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma na Chiswahili. Orodha ya Pakia ya *prefix* za madzina piya inapha *nguji* kpwa mmea uhu, ela orodhaye ya mimea inapha *nguji* kpwa *Heteropogon contortus*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *blackjack* au *beggar's tick*.

teaser.en: A floating pond plant with fringed yellow flowers, whose blooms are used in spiritual healing.
teaser.sw: Mmea wa bwawani unaoelea, wenye maua ya manjano yenye pindo, ambayo hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaoelea dzulu ya madzi ga ziya, wenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano genye mapindo, na maruwa higo nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga wa pepho.

summary.en: Toro is a floating-heart, a water plant with round floating leaves and small fringed yellow flowers. It is the Digo 'water lily', and its flowers are used in spiritual healing.
summary.sw: Toro ni mmea wa majini wenye majani ya mviringo yanayoelea na maua madogo ya manjano yenye pindo. Ndilo 'yungiyungi' la Wadigo, na maua yake hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.
summary.dg: *Toro* ni mmea wa madzini wenye makodza ga mviringo ganagoelea dzulu ya madzi, na maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano genye mapindo; kpwa Chingereza mimea ya aina hino inaihwa *floating-heart*. *Toro* ndiyo *water lily* ya Adigo, na maruwaye nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga wa pepho.

about.en:
*Toro* is an aquatic herb rooted in the mud, with round, heart-based leaves that float flat on the water like small lily pads. The flowers stand just above the surface in clusters of ten to twenty on long stalks. Each is yellow, about 1.5 cm across, with five lobes delicately fringed along their edges.

The Digo identify it by the whole plant and its flowers.
about.sw:
*Toro* ni mmea wa majini uliotia mizizi matopeni, wenye majani ya mviringo yenye kitako cha umbo la moyo yanayoelea bapa juu ya maji kama majani madogo ya yungiyungi. Maua husimama juu kidogo ya uso wa maji katika vishada vya maua kumi hadi ishirini juu ya vikonyo virefu. Kila ua ni la manjano, upana wa takriban sentimita 1.5, na lina ndewe tano zenye pindo laini pembezoni.

Wadigo huutambua kwa mmea mzima na maua yake.
about.dg:
*Toro* ni mmea wa madzini, na miziye i ndani ya matope. Makodzage ni ga mviringo na photsi gana umbo ra moyo; ganaelea sawa na madzi, dza makodza madide ga *water lily*. Maruwa ganaima dzulu chidide ya madzi, kpwa mafungu ga maruwa kumi hadi ishirini dzulu ya milita mire. Chila ruwa ni ra rangi ya mandano, ni phephi sentimita 1.5 kpwa upana, na rina mala tsano genye mapindo membamba kanda-kanda.

Adigo anaimanya *toro* kpwa kulola mmea wosi na maruwage.

where.en: It grows in ponds, seasonal pools and slow, shallow fresh water, across tropical and southern Africa, including Kenya.
where.sw: Hukua katika mabwawa, vidimbwi vya msimu na maji baridi yasiyo na kina yanayotiririka polepole, katika maeneo ya tropiki na kusini mwa Afrika, ikiwemo Kenya.
where.dg: *Toro* inamera kpwenye maziya madide, maziya ga wakati wa mvula, na madzi gasigo na munyu ganagotsapa pore-pore na gasigo chilindi. Inaphahikana Afrika ya dzoho na Afrika ya kusini, phamwenga na Kenya.

uses.en: Pakia records that the flowers of *toro* and of *toro ndide* are used in spiritual healing. He notes that this is unusual, as the Digo seldom pay attention to flowers.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kuwa maua ya *toro* na ya *toro ndide* hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho. Anaeleza kuwa jambo hili si la kawaida, kwa kuwa Wadigo mara chache huyazingatia maua.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala maruwa ga *toro* na ga *toro ndide* nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga wa pepho. Anagomba kukala dzambo hiri si ra kawaida, kpwa sababu mara nyinji Adigo taalola sana maruwa.

culture.en: Most Digo plant identification relies on leaves, bark and fruit, not flowers. Pakia lists *toro* among the few exceptions, plants whose flowers matter because of how they are used.
culture.sw: Utambuzi mwingi wa mimea kwa Wadigo hutegemea majani, magome na matunda, si maua. Pakia anaitaja *toro* miongoni mwa mimea michache isiyofuata kanuni hii, mimea ambayo maua yake yana umuhimu kwa sababu ya jinsi yanavyotumika.
culture.dg: Mara nyinji Adigo anamanya mimea kpwa makodza, gopha na matunda, si kpwa maruwa. Pakia anaandika *toro* kahi ya mimea michache ambayo maruwa gao ni ga samani kpwa sababu ya vira ganavyohumirwa.

names.en: Pakia records *toro* as the Digo name for the water lily in general, with this species as the plain, unmarked *toro*. The smaller *toro ndide* (*Nymphaea* sp.) is named in relation to it. No English or Swahili name is recorded; botanists call the genus floating-hearts.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *toro* kama jina la Kidigo la yungiyungi kwa jumla, na spishi hii ndiyo *toro* ya kawaida isiyo na kivumishi. *Toro ndide* (*Nymphaea* sp.), iliyo ndogo zaidi, imepewa jina kwa kulinganishwa nayo. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea huita jenasi hii *floating-hearts*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *toro* kukala dzina ra Chidigo ra *water lily* zosi, na aina hino ndiyo *toro* tu, bila neno ranjina. *Toro ndide* (*Nymphaea* sp.), iriyo ndide, inaihwa kpwa kuringanishwa na hino. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa; asayansi anaiha jenasi hino *floating-hearts*.

teaser.en: A true water lily, called 'small toro', whose flowers are used in spiritual healing.
teaser.sw: Yungiyungi halisi, linaloitwa 'toro ndogo', ambalo maua yake hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.
teaser.dg: *Water lily* ya kpweli, inayoihwa '*toro* ndide', ambayo maruwaye nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga wa pepho.

summary.en: Toro ndide is a true water lily, a Nymphaea of ponds and pools with round floating leaves and showy flowers. The Digo use its flowers in spiritual healing.
summary.sw: Toro ndide ni yungiyungi halisi, *Nymphaea* wa mabwawa na vidimbwi, wenye majani ya mviringo yanayoelea na maua ya kuvutia. Wadigo hutumia maua yake katika uponyaji wa kiroho.
summary.dg: *Toro ndide* ni *water lily* ya kpweli, *Nymphaea* ya maziya madide na madzi ganagokaa, yenye makodza ga mviringo ganagoelea na maruwa manono ganagoonekana phatu kure. Adigo anahumira maruwaye kpwa uganga wa pepho.

about.en:
*Toro ndide* is a water lily, rooted in pond mud by a fleshy rhizome. Its round leaves, split at the base, float flat on the water, and its many-petalled flowers open on the surface or just above it.

The exact species was not identified. On the Kenya coast the common water lilies have blue or white flowers. The Digo recognise it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Toro ndide* ni yungiyungi, lililotia mizizi katika matope ya bwawa kwa kiazi (shina la chini ya ardhi) chenye nyama. Majani yake ya mviringo, yaliyopasuka kwenye kitako, huelea bapa juu ya maji, na maua yake yenye petali nyingi huchanua juu ya uso wa maji au juu kidogo yake.

Spishi kamili haikutambuliwa. Katika pwani ya Kenya, mayungiyungi ya kawaida yana maua ya buluu au meupe. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg:
*Toro ndide* ni *water lily*, na ina *rhizome* nono ndani ya matope ga ziya. Makodzage ni ga mviringo, ganaahuka photsi, na ganaelea sawa na madzi. Maruwage genye mapindo manji ganatuluka dzulu ya madzi au dzulu chidide ya madzi.

Aina hasa ya mmea huno taidzangbwemanyikana. Pwani ya Kenya, *water lily* zinazomanyikana sana zina maruwa ga samawati au maruwa mereru. Adigo anaimanya kpwa kulola umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows in ponds, seasonal pools and still fresh water on the coastal plain.
where.sw: Hukua katika mabwawa, vidimbwi vya msimu na maji baridi yaliyotulia katika tambarare ya pwani.
where.dg: Inamera kpwenye maziya madide na kpwenye madzi gasigo na munyu ganagokaa bila kutsapa, kpwenye herera ya pwani.

uses.en: Pakia records that the flowers of *toro ndide* and *toro* are used in spiritual healing.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kuwa maua ya *toro ndide* na *toro* hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala maruwa ga *toro ndide* na ga *toro* nkuhumirwa kpwa uganga wa pepho.

culture.en: Water-lily flowers are among the few flowers the Digo use in identifying plants, because of their part in healing.
culture.sw: Maua ya yungiyungi ni miongoni mwa maua machache ambayo Wadigo huyatumia kutambua mimea, kwa sababu ya nafasi yake katika uponyaji.
culture.dg: Maruwa ga *water lily* ni kahi ya maruwa machache ambago Adigo anagahumira kumanya mimea, kpwa sababu ya kazi yao kpwenye uganga.

names.en: Pakia records *toro ndide*, 'small *toro*'. *Toro* is the water lily, and this one is named as the smaller form, with smaller leaves and flowers than the unmarked *toro*, *Nymphoides forbesiana*. No Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *toro ndide*, 'toro ndogo'. *Toro* ni yungiyungi, na hili limepewa jina kama aina ndogo zaidi, yenye majani na maua madogo kuliko *toro* ya kawaida, *Nymphoides forbesiana*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *toro ndide*, '*toro* ndide'. *Toro* ni *water lily*, na hino inaihwa dza aina ndide, yenye makodza madide na maruwa madide kuriko *toro* tu, *Nymphoides forbesiana*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.
