teaser.en: The incense of the sea side: a coastal Vitex whose fragrant gum is burned like ubani.
teaser.sw: Ubani wa ufukweni: *Vitex* wa pwani ambaye utomvu wake wenye harufu nzuri huchomwa kama ubani.
teaser.dg: 'Ubani wa pwani': *Vitex* ya pwani ambayo ulimbowe wenye arufu nono nkufukizwa dza ubani.

summary.en: Ubani wa pwani is a seashore Vitex, a shrub or small tree with hand-shaped leaves. Its aromatic exudate is burned as incense, which gives it the name 'incense of the sea side'.
summary.sw: Ubani wa pwani ni *Vitex* wa ufukweni, kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani yenye umbo la kiganja. Utomvu wake wenye harufu huchomwa kama ubani, na hivyo ndivyo ulivyopata jina 'ubani wa pwani'.
summary.dg: *Ubani wa pwani* ni *Vitex* ya kanda-kanda ya bahari, chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ga umbo ra mkpwono. Gamuye yenye arufu nono nkufukizwa dza ubani, na ndiyo sababu unaihwa 'ubani wa pwani'.

about.en:
*Ubani wa pwani* is a shrub or small tree of the *Vitex* genus. Like its relatives it has digitate leaves, with several leaflets spreading from the tip of a long stalk like the fingers of a hand, which Pakia notes is how the Digo describe *Vitex* leaves.

When the bark is wounded it gives an aromatic gum.
about.sw:
*Ubani wa pwani* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa jenasi *Vitex*. Kama jamaa zake, una majani ya vidole, yenye vijani kadhaa vinavyotawanyika kutoka ncha ya kikonyo kirefu kama vidole vya mkono; Pakia anaeleza kuwa hivi ndivyo Wadigo wanavyoyaeleza majani ya *Vitex*.

Gome likijeruhiwa hutoa utomvu wenye harufu nzuri.
about.dg:
*Ubani wa pwani* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jenasi ya *Vitex*. Dza nduguze, una makodza ga umbo ra mkpwono: makodza madide kadhaa ganatuluka kula ntsa ya mlita mure, ganaahukana dza vyala vya mkpwono. Pakia anaandika kukala ndivyo Adigo anavyogomba makodza ga *Vitex*.

Gopha richilumizwa, rinalavya ulimbo wenye arufu nono.

where.en: It grows near the sea, in coastal bush and thicket behind the shore, which is what *wa pwani*, 'of the sea side', refers to.
where.sw: Hukua karibu na bahari, katika vichaka vya pwani na vichaka vizito vilivyo nyuma ya ufuo, na hilo ndilo linalomaanishwa na *wa pwani*, 'wa ufukweni'.
where.dg: Unamera phephi na bahari, kpwenye vitsaka vya pwani virivyo nyuma ya kanda-kanda ya bahari; ndiyo mana ya *wa pwani*, 'wa kanda-kanda ya bahari'.

uses.en: Pakia records that its exudate, an aromatic gum, is used as incense.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kuwa utomvu wake, gundi yenye harufu nzuri, hutumika kama ubani.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala ulimbowe wenye arufu nono nkuhumirwa dza ubani.

culture.en: *Ubani* is incense, burned to scent the house and in ritual. This shrub is named as the local seaside source of it.
culture.sw: *Ubani* ni uvumba unaochomwa ili kunukisha nyumba na katika matambiko. Kichaka hiki kimepewa jina kama chanzo chake cha hapa ufukweni.
culture.dg: *Ubani* nkufukizwa ili nyumba ikale na arufu nono, na piya kpwenye mila. Dzina ra chitsaka hichi rinaonyesa kukala ndicho chinachopha atu a phapha pwani ubani.

names.en: Pakia records *ubani wa pwani*, 'incense of the sea side', because it grows by the sea and its gum is used as incense. The Mgombato dictionary uses *ubani* both for incense and for the Mexican weeping pine, whose gum is burned in the same way. Other Digo *Vitex* are *mfudu*, *mfudu madzi* and *mfudu unga*. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *ubani wa pwani*, 'ubani wa ufukweni', kwa sababu hukua kando ya bahari na utomvu wake hutumika kama ubani. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia *ubani* kwa ubani wenyewe na pia kwa msindano wa Mexico (*Mexican weeping pine*), ambao utomvu wake huchomwa kwa namna hiyohiyo. *Vitex* wengine wa Kidigo ni *mfudu*, *mfudu madzi* na *mfudu unga*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *ubani wa pwani*, 'ubani wa kanda-kanda ya bahari', kpwa sababu unamera phephi na bahari na ulimbowe nkuhumirwa dza ubani. Kamusi ya Mgombato inahumira *ubani* kpwa ubani wenye na kpwa muhi wa *Mexican weeping pine*, ambao ulimbowe nkufukizwa vivyo. *Vitex* zanjina za Chidigo ni *mfudu*, *mfudu madzi* na *mfudu unga*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: So new to Digo farms that it never got a name of its own: it is simply 'tubers'.
teaser.sw: Ni zao geni mno katika mashamba ya Wadigo kiasi kwamba halikupata jina lake lenyewe: huitwa tu 'viazi'.
teaser.dg: Ni viphya sana kpwenye minda ya Adigo hata taviphaha dzina ravyo: vinaihwa tu 'viazi'.

summary.en: Viazi, the Irish potato, is a recent arrival in Digo farming. It is known by the general word for root tubers, because it came too late to earn a name of its own.
summary.sw: Viazi, au viazi mviringo, ni zao lililoingia karibuni katika kilimo cha Wadigo. Hujulikana kwa neno la jumla la viazi vya mizizi, kwa sababu lilifika kuchelewa mno kupata jina lake lenyewe.
summary.dg: *Viazi*, ambavyo kpwa Chingereza ni *Irish potato*, ni mmea mphya kpwenye chirimo cha Adigo. Vinaihwa kpwa neno ra kawaida ra viazi vya mizi, kpwa sababu vyedza bada ya mimea yanjina, na taviphaha dzina ravyo.

about.en: The Irish potato is a soft-stemmed, leafy plant of the tomato family, with leaves divided into leaflets and white to purple flowers. Its food is the tuber, a swollen underground stem with 'eyes' from which new shoots grow.
about.sw: Kiazi mviringo ni mmea wenye shina laini na majani mengi wa familia ya mnyanya, wenye majani yaliyogawanyika kuwa vijani na maua meupe hadi ya zambarau. Chakula chake ni kiazi, shina lililovimba lililo chini ya ardhi lenye 'macho' ambamo machipukizi mapya huota.
about.dg: Viazi ni mmea wenye milita milaini na makodza manji, wa jamii ya nyanya. Makodzage ganaganyika kukala makodza madide, na maruwage ni ga rangi nyereru hadi zambarau. Seemu inayoriwa ni chiazi, muhi wa tsini uriofutuka, wenye 'matso' (*dzitso*) ambago mitse miphya inamera kula kpwago.

where.en: Potatoes do best in the cool highlands, and most of those eaten on the coast come from upcountry. Pakia notes that Digo farmers grow some tuber crops, including potatoes, on terraces and in home gardens.
where.sw: Viazi mviringo hustawi vizuri zaidi katika nyanda za juu zenye baridi, na vingi vinavyoliwa pwani hutoka bara. Pakia anabainisha kwamba wakulima Wadigo hupanda baadhi ya mazao ya viazi, ikiwemo viazi mviringo, kwenye matuta na katika bustani za nyumbani.
where.dg: Viazi vinamera vinono zaidi kpwenye tsi za dzulu za bara zenye mnyevu, na vinji kahi ya viazi vinavyoriwa pwani vinarehwa kula bara. Pakia anaandika kukala akurima a Adigo anaphanda mimea yanjina ya viazi, phamwenga na viazi hivi, kpwenye matuta na minda ya kaya.

uses.en: The tubers are boiled, fried and cooked in stews, and are a common part of coastal meals, from chips to *biriani*.
uses.sw: Viazi huchemshwa, hukaangwa na hupikwa katika michuzi, na ni sehemu ya kawaida ya milo ya pwani, kuanzia chipsi hadi *biriani*.
uses.dg: Viazi nkuchemushwa, nkukalangwa na nkujitwa kpwa mtsuzi, na ni seemu ya kawaida ya chakurya cha pwani, kula *chips* hadi *biriani*.

culture.en: Pakia explains that the Digo name root tubers by species: *manga* for cassava, *myogwe* for sweet potato, *nduma* for arrowroot. The Irish potato came later and had no name, so it took the general word for tubers. The eyes on a potato are called *dzitso*, the same word as the scar on a bean and the marks on a coconut.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huvipa viazi vya mizizi majina kulingana na spishi: *manga* kwa muhogo, *myogwe* kwa kiazi kitamu, *nduma* kwa nduma. Kiazi mviringo kilikuja baadaye na hakikuwa na jina, kwa hivyo kilichukua neno la jumla la viazi. Macho ya kiazi huitwa *dzitso*, neno lilelile linalotumika kwa kovu la harage na alama zilizo kwenye nazi.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala Adigo nkuiha viazi vya mizi kpwa aina zao: *manga* (muhogo), *myogwe* (viazi vitamu) na *nduma* (arrowroot). Viazi vya Chizungu vyedza bada na kala taviphaha dzina, kpwa hivyo vikahala neno ra kawaida ra viazi. Matso ga chiazi nkuihwa *dzitso*, neno ririro sawa na ra alama iriyo kpwenye tembe ya kunde na alama za nazi.

names.en: Pakia records *viazi*, a plural, for the Irish potato; the same word also covers wild root tubers in general. The singular *chiazi* is a collective term for root tubers, and the Mgombato dictionary gives *chiazi* simply as 'potato'. In Swahili it is *kiazi*, plural *viazi*, often *viazi mviringo* to tell it from the sweet potato.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *viazi*, neno la wingi, kwa kiazi mviringo; neno hilohilo pia hujumuisha viazi vya mizizi vya porini kwa jumla. Umoja wake *chiazi* ni neno la jumla la viazi vya mizizi, na kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *chiazi* tu kama 'potato'. Kwa Kiswahili ni *kiazi*, wingi *viazi*, mara nyingi *viazi mviringo* ili kukitofautisha na kiazi kitamu.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *viazi*, neno ra unji, kpwa viazi vya Chizungu; neno ihi ihi nkuhumirwa piya kpwa viazi vyosi vya mizi vya tsaka. *Chiazi* (umwenga) ni neno ra kawaida ra viazi vya mizi, na Mgombato unalavya *chiazi* kukala 'potato' tu. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *kiazi*, unji *viazi*, mara nyinji *viazi mviringo* kuvitafwautisha na viazi vitamu.

teaser.en: The 'wild vwivwi': a yam whose name itself is a warning not to eat it.
teaser.sw: 'Vwivwi wa porini': kiazi kikuu ambacho jina lake lenyewe ni onyo kwamba kisiliwe.
teaser.dg: '*Vwivwi* ya weruni': *yam* ambayo dzinare renye ni onyo kukala taifwaha kuriwa.

summary.en: Vwivwi koma is the Zanzibar yam, a large climbing yam with heart-shaped leaves. The Digo label it 'wild', koma, a word that marks a plant as poisonous or not for eating.
summary.sw: Vwivwi koma ni kiazi kikuu cha Zanzibar, mtambaa mkubwa wa jamii ya viazi vikuu wenye majani ya umbo la moyo. Wadigo huuita 'wa porini', koma, neno linaloashiria kuwa mmea ni sumu au haufai kuliwa.
summary.dg: *Vwivwi koma* ni *Zanzibar yam*, *yam* kulu inayofyombera, yenye makodza ga umbo ra moyo. Adigo anaiha 'ya weruni', *koma*, neno rinaroonyesa kukala mmea ni wa sumu au taufwaha kuriwa.

about.en:
*Vwivwi koma* is a vigorous twining climber that grows each year from a large underground tuber. Its big, glossy, heart-shaped leaves end in a long drip tip, and the vines carry round aerial bulbils in the leaf angles.

The tubers and bulbils of this species are known to be highly poisonous.
about.sw:
*Vwivwi koma* ni mtambaa wenye nguvu unaojizungusha, unaochipuka kila mwaka kutoka kiazi kikubwa kilicho chini ya ardhi. Majani yake makubwa, yanayong'aa, yenye umbo la moyo huishia kwa ncha ndefu ya kudondoshea maji, na mitambaa huzaa vitunguu-hewa vya mviringo kwenye pembe za majani.

Viazi na vitunguu-hewa vya spishi hii vinajulikana kuwa na sumu kali.
about.dg:
*Vwivwi koma* ni mmea wenye nguvu unaofyombera kpwa kudzilinga-linga kpwenye mimea yanjina, na chila mwaka unamera kula chiazi chikulu cha tsini. Makodzage ni makulu, ganang'ala, ga umbo ra moyo, na ganamala kpwa ntsa ndire. Dzulu ya mmea, phatu makodza ganaphotuluka, kunamera viazi vidide vya mviringo.

Viazi vya tsini na viazi vidide vya dzulu vya aina hino vinamanyikana kukala ni vya sumu kali sana.

where.en: It climbs through coastal forest, thicket and bush edges along the East African coast and inland.
where.sw: Hutambaa katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka vizito na kingo za vichaka kando ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki na bara.
where.dg: Inafyombera kpwenye matsaka, vitsaka na kanda-kanda za vitsaka, pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki na bara.

culture.en: Pakia explains that the word *koma*, 'wild', is one of the Digo labels that warns a plant is poisonous or should not be eaten, as in *mtungudza koma* for the wild relative of the eggplant. *Vwivwi koma* is the wild, poisonous *vwivwi*, which implies there is an edible *vwivwi* too, though Pakia did not collect it.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa neno *koma*, 'wa porini', ni mojawapo ya lebo za Kidigo zinazoonya kuwa mmea ni sumu au haupaswi kuliwa, kama katika *mtungudza koma* kwa jamaa wa porini wa mbilingani. *Vwivwi koma* ni *vwivwi* wa porini mwenye sumu, jambo linaloashiria kuwa kuna pia *vwivwi* unaoliwa, ingawa Pakia hakuukusanya.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala neno *koma*, 'ya weruni', ni kahi ya maneno ga Chidigo ganagoonya kukala mmea ni wa sumu au taufwaha kuriwa, dza *mtungudza koma*, mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya mtungudza (*eggplant*). *Vwivwi koma* ni *vwivwi* ya weruni, ya sumu, na dzambo hiri rinaonyesa kukala kuna *vwivwi* inayoriwa piya, ela vwivwi hiyo si kahi ya mimea ariyotsola Pakia.

names.en: Pakia records *vwivwi koma*, 'wild *vwivwi*'. In English it is the Zanzibar yam, after its scientific name. No Swahili name is recorded. The edible *mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*) is another Digo yam.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *vwivwi koma*, '*vwivwi* wa porini'. Kwa Kiingereza ni *Zanzibar yam*, kutokana na jina lake la kisayansi. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. *Mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*) unaoliwa ni kiazi kikuu kingine cha Kidigo.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *vwivwi koma*, '*vwivwi* ya weruni'. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *Zanzibar yam*, kula dzinare ra chisayansi. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. *Mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*), inayoriwa, ni *yam* yanjina ya Chidigo.

teaser.en: A silvery wild bean that sprawls across the ground just like a sweet-potato vine.
teaser.sw: Kunde-pori wa rangi ya fedha anayetambaa ardhini kama mtambaa wa kiazi kitamu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde, wa rangi ya feza, unaoambala photsi dza vira muyogbwe unavyoambala.

summary.en: Yogweyogwe is a trailing wild bean of coastal grassland and farmland, with leaves silvery underneath. Its name compares the way it spreads to a sweet potato.
summary.sw: Yogweyogwe ni kunde-pori anayetambaa katika nyika na mashamba ya pwani, mwenye majani yenye rangi ya fedha upande wa chini. Jina lake linalinganisha jinsi unavyoenea na kiazi kitamu.
summary.dg: *Yogweyogwe* ni mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde unaoambala photsi, unaomera phatu phenye nyasi na kpwenye minda ya pwani, na makodzage ni ga rangi ya feza photsi. Dzinare rinaringanisha vira unavyoambala na muyogbwe.

about.en:
*Yogweyogwe* is a perennial herb of the bean family that trails along the ground or scrambles up other plants. Its leaves have three broad, sometimes three-lobed leaflets, sparsely hairy above and densely silvery-hairy underneath, and the stems are rough with rusty hairs.

The pea-shaped flowers are white or pink, followed by short, oblong pods covered in dark brown bristly hairs.
about.sw:
*Yogweyogwe* ni mmea wa kudumu wa jamii ya kunde unaotambaa ardhini au kupanda juu ya mimea mingine. Majani yake yana vijani vitatu vipana, wakati mwingine vyenye ndewe tatu, vyenye manyoya machache upande wa juu na manyoya mengi ya rangi ya fedha upande wa chini, na mashina ni makwaruzo kwa manyoya ya rangi ya kutu.

Maua yenye umbo la ua la njegere ni meupe au ya waridi, yakifuatwa na maganda mafupi marefu kiasi yaliyofunikwa na manyoya magumu ya kahawia iliyokolea.
about.dg:
*Yogweyogwe* ni mmea wa jamii ya kunde unaokala miaka minji, unaoambala photsi au unaofyombera dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu mapana, na wakati wanjina chila kodza dide rina mala mahahu; dzulu gana nyere chache, na photsi gana nyere nyinji za rangi ya feza. Mihiye ni ya kukaraza, na ina nyere za rangi ya dongo na kundu.

Maruwa, ga umbo dza maruwa ga kunde, ni mereru au ga pinki, na badaye kunatuluka makakaya mafupi ga mviringo mure, genye nyere ngumu za rangi ya dongo iriyo phephi na nyiru.

where.en: It grows in coastal grassland and farmland close to sea level, from south-east Kenya to Mozambique, with a separate population in West Africa.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika na mashamba ya pwani karibu na usawa wa bahari, kutoka kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya hadi Msumbiji, na kundi jingine tofauti Afrika Magharibi.
where.dg: Unamera phatu phenye nyasi na kpwenye minda ya pwani, phatu phasiphokala dzulu kula bahari, kula kusini-mashariki ya Kenya hadi Mozambique, na kuna mimea yanjina ya aina hino kure, Afrika ya Magharibi.

names.en: Pakia records *yogweyogwe*, named after the sweet potato, *myogwe*, because it spreads across the ground the same way. The repetition in the name means 'in the manner of': a plant that behaves like a sweet potato. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *yogweyogwe*, lililopewa jina kutokana na kiazi kitamu, *myogwe*, kwa sababu huenea ardhini kwa njia ileile. Kurudiwa kwa neno katika jina kunamaanisha 'kwa namna ya': mmea unaotenda kama kiazi kitamu. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *yogweyogwe*, dzina ririrohalwa kula muyogbwe, *myogwe*, kpwa sababu unaambala photsi vivyo. Neno *yogwe* kugombwa mara mbiri kpwenye dzina kunamaanisha 'kpwa njira ya': mmea unaohenda dza muyogbwe. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

teaser.en: The pale nimakoba: one of a pair of brittle woodland mushrooms told apart by the colour of their caps.
teaser.sw: Nimakoba mweupe: mmoja wa jozi ya uyoga wa msituni unaovunjika kwa urahisi, inayotofautishwa kwa rangi ya kofia zake.
teaser.dg: *Nimakoba* mwereru: aina mwenga kahi ya aina mbiri za uoga wa matsakani unaovundzika rahisi, zinazotafwautishwa kpwa rangi ya kofiya zao.

summary.en: Nimakoba mwereru, the 'white nimakoba', is a brittlegill mushroom collected by Digo women. It is told apart from its red twin, nimakoba wa kundu, by the colour of its cap.
summary.sw: Nimakoba mwereru, 'nimakoba mweupe', ni uyoga wa jenasi *Russula* unaokusanywa na wanawake wa Kidigo. Hutofautishwa na pacha wake mwekundu, nimakoba wa kundu, kwa rangi ya kofia yake.
summary.dg: *Nimakoba mwereru*, '*nimakoba* mwereru', ni *Russula*, uoga unaovundzika rahisi, ambao achetu a Chidigo anautsola. Unatafwautishwa na nduguye wa kundu, *nimakoba wa kundu*, kpwa rangi ya kofiyaye.

about.en:
*Nimakoba mwereru* is a *Russula*, a brittlegill. These mushrooms have a firm, smooth cap on a short white stem, white to cream gills, and flesh that snaps cleanly like chalk rather than tearing. Unlike the milk caps, they give no milky juice when broken.

Digo mushroom collectors name their mushrooms mainly by cap colour, and this is the pale one.
about.sw:
*Nimakoba mwereru* ni *Russula*, uyoga unaovunjika kwa urahisi (kwa Kiingereza *brittlegill*). Uyoga huu una kofia ngumu laini juu ya shina fupi jeupe, matamvua meupe hadi ya rangi ya krimu, na nyama inayokatika safi kama chaki badala ya kuchanika. Tofauti na uyoga wa maziwa, haitoi utomvu kama maziwa unapovunjwa.

Wakusanyaji wa uyoga wa Kidigo huita uyoga wao hasa kwa rangi ya kofia, na huu ndio uliofifia.
about.dg:
*Nimakoba mwereru* ni *Russula*, uoga unaovundzika rahisi (kpwa Chingereza *brittlegill*). Uoga wa aina hino una kofiya ngumu na laini dzulu ya muhi mfupi mwereru, miraba (*gills*) mereru au ya rangi ya maziya, na nyama zinazovundzika sawa-sawa dza chokaa, si kuahuka. Tauna dza *milk caps*, kpwa sababu taulavya maziya uchivundzika.

Adigo anaotsola uoga anaupha madzina hasa kpwa rangi ya kofiya, na huno ndio *nimakoba* mwereru.

where.en: Brittlegills grow on the ground in woodland, in partnership with the roots of trees. Digo collectors know three mushroom habitats: *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*), farmland (*mdani*) and termite mounds (*tsuluni*), and look for each kind in its place.
where.sw: Uyoga wa aina hii huota ardhini msituni, ukishirikiana na mizizi ya miti. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo wanatambua makazi matatu ya uyoga: msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), mashamba (*mdani*) na vichuguu (*tsuluni*), na hutafuta kila aina mahali pake.
where.dg: Uoga wa *Russula* unamera photsi matsakani, phamwenga na mizi ya mihi. Adigo anaotsola uoga anamanya aina hahu za phatu phanaphomera uoga: phatu phenye mirihi (*mirihini*), minda (*mdani*) na tsulu (*tsuluni*), na anaendza chila aina phahaliphe.

uses.en: Local people collect and eat it. Pakia notes that collectors prefer young mushrooms whose caps are still closed (*fundula*), because open caps (*bumula*) are usually infested by worms. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Wenyeji huukusanya na kuula. Pakia anaeleza kuwa wakusanyaji hupendelea uyoga mchanga ambao kofia zake bado zimefunga (*fundula*), kwa sababu kofia zilizofunguka (*bumula*) kwa kawaida huwa zimevamiwa na funza. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Atu a phapha anautsola na kuurya. Pakia anaandika kukala anaotsola uoga anamendza uoga uchere mdide, kofiyaye ichikala bado ikafungbwa (*fundula*), kpwa sababu kofiya ichivugulika (*bumula*) mara nyinji uoga unakala na minyololo. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

culture.en: Mushroom collecting is women's work among the Digo. Pakia found that only about ten kinds, the ones learnt from elders as edible, are eaten. All others are lumped together as *uoga koma*, 'wild' or poisonous mushrooms.
culture.sw: Kukusanya uyoga ni kazi ya wanawake miongoni mwa Wadigo. Pakia aligundua kuwa ni aina takriban kumi tu zinazoliwa, zile ambazo wazee walifundisha kuwa zinalika. Nyingine zote hujumuishwa pamoja kama *uoga koma*, uyoga 'wa porini' au wenye sumu.
culture.dg: Kutsola uoga ni kazi ya achetu kahi ya Adigo. Pakia waona kukala ni aina phephi kumi tu za uoga zinazoriwa, zira ambazo anadzifundza kula kpwa azehe kukala zinariwa. Uoga wanjina wosi unaihwa phamwenga *uoga koma*, uoga 'wa weruni' au wa sumu.

names.en: Pakia records *nimakoba mwereru*, 'white *nimakoba*', as one of two folk species of *nimakoba*, the other being *nimakoba wa kundu*, 'red *nimakoba*'. *Mwereru* is one of the three basic Digo colour words, for white and pale shades. The prefix *nima-* is one Pakia reads as carrying a 'female' sense. *Uoga* (Mgombato: *woga*) is the general word for mushroom.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nimakoba mwereru*, '*nimakoba* mweupe', kama mojawapo ya spishi mbili za kienyeji za *nimakoba*, nyingine ikiwa *nimakoba wa kundu*, '*nimakoba* mwekundu'. *Mwereru* ni mojawapo ya maneno matatu ya msingi ya rangi katika Kidigo, kwa rangi nyeupe na rangi zilizofifia. Pakia anakisoma kiambishi *nima-* kuwa kinabeba maana ya 'kike'. *Uoga* (Mgombato: *woga*) ndilo neno la jumla la uyoga.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nimakoba mwereru*, '*nimakoba* mwereru', kukala ni aina mwenga kahi ya aina mbiri za *nimakoba*; yanjina ni *nimakoba wa kundu*, '*nimakoba* wa kundu'. *Mwereru* ni mwenga wa maneno mahahu ga msingi ga rangi kpwa Chidigo, na ni rangi nyereru na rangi za ngushu-ngushu. Pakia anaona chiambishi *nima-* china mana ya 'mchetu'. *Uoga* (Mgombato: *woga*) ni neno ra chila uoga.

summary.en: Nimakoba wa kundu, the 'red nimakoba', is a red-capped brittlegill mushroom. Digo collectors tell it from the pale nimakoba mwereru by cap colour alone.
summary.sw: Nimakoba wa kundu, 'nimakoba mwekundu', ni uyoga wa jenasi *Russula* wenye kofia nyekundu. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo huutofautisha na nimakoba mwereru uliofifia kwa rangi ya kofia peke yake.
summary.dg: *Nimakoba wa kundu*, '*nimakoba* wa kundu', ni uoga wa *Russula* wenye kofiya ya kundu. Adigo anaotsola uoga anautafwautisha na *nimakoba mwereru* kpwa rangi ya kofiya tu.

about.en:
*Nimakoba wa kundu* is a *Russula*, a brittlegill with a red to pinkish cap, pale gills and a white stem. The flesh is crumbly and snaps like chalk, and gives no milk.

Like all mushrooms it appears suddenly after rain and lasts only a few days.
about.sw:
*Nimakoba wa kundu* ni *Russula*, uyoga unaovunjika kwa urahisi wenye kofia nyekundu hadi ya waridi, matamvua yaliyofifia na shina jeupe. Nyama yake hubomoka na kukatika kama chaki, na haitoi maziwa.

Kama uyoga wote, huibuka ghafla baada ya mvua na hudumu siku chache tu.
about.dg:
*Nimakoba wa kundu* ni *Russula*, uoga unaovundzika rahisi, wenye kofiya ya kundu hadi pinki, miraba ya rangi ngushu-ngushu na muhi mwereru. Nyamaze zinavundzika-vundzika na kutika-tika dza chokaa, na taulavya maziya.

Dza uoga wosi, unatuluka gafula bada ya mvula na unakaa siku chache tu.

where.en: Brittlegills grow from the ground in woodland, linked to the roots of trees. Digo collectors know the *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*), farmland (*mdani*) and termite mounds (*tsuluni*) as different mushroom grounds.
where.sw: Uyoga wa aina hii huota kutoka ardhini msituni, ukiungana na mizizi ya miti. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo wanaujua msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), mashamba (*mdani*) na vichuguu (*tsuluni*) kama maeneo tofauti ya uyoga.
where.dg: Uoga wa *Russula* unamera kula photsi matsakani, phamwenga na mizi ya mihi. Adigo anaotsola uoga anamanya phatu phenye mirihi (*mirihini*), minda (*mdani*) na tsulu (*tsuluni*) kukala ni phatu phatafwauti pha kuphaha uoga.

uses.en: Local people collect and eat it, preferring young mushrooms with closed caps. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Wenyeji huukusanya na kuula, wakipendelea uyoga mchanga wenye kofia zilizofunga. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Atu a phapha anautsola na kuurya, na anamendza uoga uchere mdide, wenye kofiya iriyofungbwa. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

culture.en: Pakia found that Digo women, the mushroom gatherers, name and collect only the mushrooms their elders taught them were edible. Their knowledge of mushrooms follows the same pattern as their knowledge of vegetables: what can be eaten gets a name.
culture.sw: Pakia aligundua kuwa wanawake wa Kidigo, ambao ndio wakusanyaji wa uyoga, huipa majina na kukusanya uyoga tu ambao wazee wao waliwafundisha kuwa unalika. Ujuzi wao wa uyoga unafuata mtindo uleule wa ujuzi wao wa mboga: kinacholika hupewa jina.
culture.dg: Pakia waona kukala achetu a Chidigo, ambao ndio anaotsola uoga, anapha madzina na kutsola uoga tu ambao azehe ao anaafundza kukala unariwa. Ujuzi wao wa uoga unalunga njira iyo mwenga na ujuzi wao wa mboga: chitu chinachoriwa ndicho chinachophewa dzina.

names.en: Pakia records *nimakoba wa kundu*, 'red *nimakoba*'. *Kundu* is the Digo word for red. Its partner is *nimakoba mwereru*, the white one.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nimakoba wa kundu*, '*nimakoba* mwekundu'. *Kundu* ni neno la Kidigo la rangi nyekundu. Mwenzake ni *nimakoba mwereru*, yule mweupe.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nimakoba wa kundu*, '*nimakoba* wa kundu'. *Kundu* ni neno ra Chidigo ra rangi ya kundu. Nduguye ni *nimakoba mwereru*, ariye mwereru.

summary.en: Hako ra nyani is a brittlegill mushroom with a shiny red to orange cap. It is one of the small number of named mushrooms that Digo collectors gather.
summary.sw: Hako ra nyani ni uyoga wa jenasi *Russula* wenye kofia inayong'aa ya rangi nyekundu hadi ya chungwa. Ni miongoni mwa aina chache za uyoga zenye majina ambazo wakusanyaji wa Kidigo huzikusanya.
summary.dg: *Hako ra nyani* ni uoga wa *Russula* wenye kofiya inayong'ala, ya kundu hadi rangi ya chungbwa. Ni kahi ya aina chache za uoga zenye madzina ambazo Adigo anaotsola uoga anazitsola.

about.en:
*Hako ra nyani* is a *Russula*, a brittlegill with a smooth, glossy cap that is red to orange-red, cream gills and a stout white stem that may be flushed pink. The flesh is firm but crumbles cleanly when broken.

It is one of three Digo-named brittlegills, with the white and red *nimakoba*.
about.sw:
*Hako ra nyani* ni *Russula*, uyoga unaovunjika kwa urahisi wenye kofia laini inayong'aa ya rangi nyekundu hadi nyekundu-machungwa, matamvua ya rangi ya krimu na shina nene jeupe ambalo linaweza kuwa na wekundu wa waridi. Nyama yake ni ngumu lakini hubomoka safi inapovunjwa.

Ni mmoja wa *Russula* watatu wenye majina ya Kidigo, pamoja na *nimakoba* mweupe na mwekundu.
about.dg:
*Hako ra nyani* ni *Russula*, uoga unaovundzika rahisi, wenye kofiya laini inayong'ala ya kundu hadi rangi ya chungbwa na kundu, miraba ya rangi ya maziya, na muhi mfupi, mkulu na mwereru ambao wakati wanjina una rangi ya pinki. Nyamaze ni ngumu, ela zichivundzwa zinavundzika sawa-sawa.

Ni mwenga wa uoga mahahu wa *Russula* wenye madzina ga Chidigo, phamwenga na *nimakoba* mwereru na *nimakoba* wa kundu.

where.en: Brittlegills grow on the ground in woodland, connected to the roots of trees.
where.sw: Uyoga wa aina hii huota ardhini msituni, ukiunganishwa na mizizi ya miti.
where.dg: Uoga wa *Russula* unamera photsi matsakani, phamwenga na mizi ya mihi.

uses.en: Pakia notes that Digo collectors only name the mushrooms they know as edible, so this one is very likely collected and eaten. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa wakusanyaji wa Kidigo huipa majina uyoga tu wanaoujua kuwa unalika, kwa hiyo huenda sana huu hukusanywa na kuliwa. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala Adigo anaotsola uoga ana madzina tu ga uoga ambao anaumanya kukala unariwa, kpwa hivyo kuna dalili nyinji kukala uoga huno nkutsolwa na kuriwa. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

names.en: Pakia records *hako ra nyani* but does not explain it. In the Mgombato dictionary *hako* is 'buttock' and *nyani* is 'baboon', so the name may read 'baboon's buttock', perhaps for the bright red cap.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *hako ra nyani* lakini haelezi maana yake. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *hako* ni 'tako' na *nyani* ni 'nyani', kwa hiyo jina hili linaweza kusomeka 'tako la nyani', pengine kwa sababu ya kofia yake nyekundu angavu.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *hako ra nyani* ela kaeleza manaye. Kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, *hako* ni 'tako' na *nyani* ni nyani, kpwa hivyo dzina rinaweza kumaanisha 'hako ra nyani', chahi kpwa sababu ya kofiya ya kundu inayong'ala.

teaser.en: Mushrooms farmed by termites: nkuvi push up from the nest after rain, and the Digo know at least three kinds.
teaser.sw: Uyoga unaolimwa na mchwa: nkuvi huchipuka kutoka kwenye kichuguu baada ya mvua, na Wadigo wanajua angalau aina tatu.
teaser.dg: *Uoga* unaorimwa ni malutswa: nkuvi zinatuluka kula nyumba za malutswa bada ya mvula, na Adigo anamanya aina tahu au zaidi.

summary.en: Nkuvi are termite mushrooms, Termitomyces, which grow from the fungus gardens inside termite nests. The Digo name several kinds by their size and where they grow.
summary.sw: Nkuvi ni uyoga wa mchwa, *Termitomyces*, unaoota kutoka kwenye bustani za kuvu ndani ya vichuguu vya mchwa. Wadigo huzipa majina aina kadhaa kulingana na ukubwa wake na mahali zinapoota.
summary.dg: Nkuvi ni *uoga* wa malutswa, Termitomyces, unaomera kula minda ya *uoga* iriyo ndani ya nyumba za malutswa. Adigo anaiha aina nyinji kulunga ukulu wao na phatu zinaphomera.

about.en:
*Nkuvi* are termite mushrooms. Underground, fungus-growing termites tend gardens of this fungus inside their nests. After good rains it sends up mushrooms with a long, tough 'root' that runs down into the nest, a stout stem, and a cap that often has a pointed nipple at the centre and splits at the edge as it opens.

The Digo recognise several folk kinds: *nkuvi mdide*, the small *nkuvi*; *nkuvi wa mdani*, the farmland *nkuvi*; and *nkuvi wa mirihini*, the *Brachystegia* woodland *nkuvi*. Pakia found each to be a different *Termitomyces* species.
about.sw:
*Nkuvi* ni uyoga wa mchwa. Chini ya ardhi, mchwa wanaolima kuvu hutunza bustani za kuvu hiki ndani ya viota vyao. Baada ya mvua nzuri, huchipuza uyoga wenye 'mzizi' mrefu mgumu unaoshuka hadi ndani ya kiota, shina nene, na kofia ambayo mara nyingi ina chuchu iliyochongoka katikati na hupasuka pembezoni inapofunguka.

Wadigo wanatambua aina kadhaa za kienyeji: *nkuvi mdide*, *nkuvi* mdogo; *nkuvi wa mdani*, *nkuvi* wa shambani; na *nkuvi wa mirihini*, *nkuvi* wa msitu wa *Brachystegia*. Pakia aligundua kuwa kila mmoja ni spishi tofauti ya *Termitomyces*.
about.dg:
*Nkuvi* ni *uoga* wa malutswa. Tsini, malutswa anarima *uoga* hinyu ndani ya nyumba zao, dza munda. Bada ya mvula nono, unatuluka *uoga* wenye 'muzi' mure na mgumu unaotserera hadi ndani ya nyumba ya malutswa, *muhi wa uoga* mpana, na kofiya ambayo mara nyinji ina ntsa dide kahi-kahi, na inaahuka kanda-kandaye ichivuguka.

Adigo anamanya aina nyinji za chienyeji: *nkuvi mdide*, ambaye ni mdide; *nkuvi wa mdani*, wa mindani; na *nkuvi wa mirihini*, wa kahi ya mihi ya *Brachystegia*. Pakia waona kukala chila mmwenga ni aina ya tafwauti ya *Termitomyces*.

where.en: They appear on and around termite mounds (*tsuluni*), in farmland (*mdani*) and in *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*), the three mushroom habitats that Digo collectors recognise.
where.sw: Huibuka juu na kuzunguka vichuguu (*tsuluni*), mashambani (*mdani*) na katika msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), makazi matatu ya uyoga yanayotambuliwa na wakusanyaji wa Kidigo.
where.dg: Zinatuluka dzulu na kanda-kanda ya tsulu (*tsuluni*), mindani (*mdani*) na kahi ya mihi ya *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*): phatu phahahu ambapho Adigo anaotsola *uoga* anaphamanya dza makalo ga *uoga*.

uses.en: Local people collect and eat them. Across Africa, termite mushrooms are among the most prized of all wild foods. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Wenyeji huukusanya na kuula. Kote barani Afrika, uyoga wa mchwa ni miongoni mwa vyakula vya porini vinavyothaminiwa zaidi. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Atu a hipha nkuzitsola na kuzirya. Afrika yosi, *uoga* wa malutswa ni kahi ya vyakurya vya weruni vinavyomendzwa zaidi. *Uoga* wa weruni usiriwe ela umanywe kpwandza ni mutu wa hipha mwenye marifwa manji.

culture.en: *Nkuvi* is one of only two mushroom 'folk genera' in Digo, alongside *nimakoba*: a name with several named kinds beneath it. Collectors pick young mushrooms with the cap still closed (*fundula*), as open caps are often worm-ridden.
culture.sw: *Nkuvi* ni mojawapo ya 'jenasi za kienyeji' mbili tu za uyoga katika Kidigo, pamoja na *nimakoba*: jina lenye aina kadhaa zenye majina chini yake. Wakusanyaji huchuma uyoga mchanga ambao kofia bado imefunga (*fundula*), kwa kuwa kofia zilizofunguka mara nyingi zimejaa funza.
culture.dg: *Nkuvi* ni kundi mwenga kahi ya makundi mairi tu ga *uoga* ga chienyeji (*folk genera*) kpwa Chidigo, phamwenga na *nimakoba*: dzina renye aina nyinji zenye madzina photsire. Atu anaotsola *uoga* anatsambula *uoga* uchiri mphya, ambao kofiyaye taidzangbwevuguka (*fundula*), kpwa sababu kofiya ziriyovuguka mara nyinji zina minyololo.

names.en: Pakia records *nkuvi*, also written *N'kuvi*; its meaning is not explained. Its *N-* prefix is one Pakia reads as carrying a 'female' sense. The meaty *choga nyama* is another *Termitomyces*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nkuvi*, pia huandikwa *N'kuvi*; maana yake haielezwi. Pakia anakisoma kiambishi chake *N-* kuwa kinabeba maana ya 'kike'. *Choga nyama*, wenye nyama nyingi, ni *Termitomyces* mwingine.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nkuvi*, piya inaandikpwa *N'kuvi*; Pakia kalavya manage. Pakia anaona kukala *N-* ya mwandzoni ina mana ya 'chichetu'. *Choga nyama*, wenye nyama nyinji, ni *Termitomyces* yanjina.

teaser.en: The 'meat mushroom', said to be as tasty as beef.
teaser.sw: 'Uyoga wa nyama', unaosemekana kuwa mtamu kama nyama ya ng'ombe.
teaser.dg: 'Uoga wa nyama', ambao nkugombwa kukala una mtswano dza nyama ya ng'ombe.

summary.en: Choga nyama is a termite mushroom whose name means 'meat mushroom'. Digo collectors told Pakia it was as tasty as beef.
summary.sw: Choga nyama ni uyoga wa mchwa ambao jina lake linamaanisha 'uyoga wa nyama'. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo walimwambia Pakia kuwa ni mtamu kama nyama ya ng'ombe.
summary.dg: *Choga nyama* ni uoga wa lutswa, na dzinare rina mana ya 'uoga wa nyama'. Adigo anaotsola uoga akamuambira Pakia kukala una mtswano dza nyama ya ng'ombe.

about.en:
*Choga nyama* is a *Termitomyces*, a termite mushroom. These grow from the fungus gardens of termite nests and have a fleshy cap, often with a pointed centre, on a firm stem with a long root reaching down into the nest.

Its flesh is what it is known for.
about.sw:
*Choga nyama* ni *Termitomyces*, uyoga wa mchwa. Uyoga huu huota kutoka kwenye bustani za kuvu za vichuguu vya mchwa, na una kofia yenye nyama, mara nyingi yenye katikati iliyochongoka, juu ya shina gumu lenye mzizi mrefu unaoshuka hadi ndani ya kiota.

Nyama yake ndiyo inayoufanya ujulikane.
about.dg:
*Choga nyama* ni *Termitomyces*, uoga wa lutswa. Uoga wa aina hino unamera kula minda ya uoga iriyo ndani ya nyumba za lutswa, na una kofiya yenye nyama nyinji, mara nyinji yenye ntsa kahi-kahi, dzulu ya muhi mgumu wenye muzi mure unaotserera tsini hadi ndani ya nyumba ya lutswa.

Unamanyikana hasa kpwa nyamaze.

where.en: Termite mushrooms come up after rain on and around termite mounds, in farmland and in woodland.
where.sw: Uyoga wa mchwa huibuka baada ya mvua juu na kuzunguka vichuguu, mashambani na msituni.
where.dg: Uoga wa lutswa unatuluka bada ya mvula, dzulu na kanda-kanda ya tsulu, kpwenye minda na phatu phenye mihi.

uses.en: Local people collect and eat it, and value it for its rich, meaty taste. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Wenyeji huukusanya na kuula, na huuthamini kwa ladha yake nzito kama ya nyama. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Atu a phapha anautsola na kuurya, na anauona kukala ni wa samani kpwa ladhaye nono ya dza nyama. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

culture.en: The Digo call the fleshy, edible parts of any mushroom, the cap and stem, *nyama za uoga*, 'mushroom meat', for their fleshiness and taste. In the strict sense, Pakia found, *nyama* is reserved for this one mushroom, said to be as tasty as beef.
culture.sw: Wadigo huziita sehemu zenye nyama zinazolika za uyoga wowote, yaani kofia na shina, *nyama za uoga*, 'nyama ya uyoga', kwa sababu ya unene na ladha yake. Kwa maana halisi, Pakia aligundua, *nyama* imehifadhiwa kwa uyoga huu mmoja, unaosemekana kuwa mtamu kama nyama ya ng'ombe.
culture.dg: Adigo anaziiha seemu zinazoriwa za chila uoga, kofiya na muhi, *nyama za uoga*, kpwa sababu zina nyama nyinji na ladha nono. Ela Pakia waona kukala, kpwa mana hasa, dzina *nyama* ni ra uoga huno mwenga tu, ambao nkugombwa kukala una mtswano dza nyama ya ng'ombe.

names.en: Pakia records *choga nyama*, 'meat mushroom'. *Choga* relates to *uoga*, plural *vyoga*, the Digo word for mushroom; the Mgombato dictionary has *choga* pointing to *vyoga*. The plain *nkuvi* are other *Termitomyces*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *choga nyama*, 'uyoga wa nyama'. *Choga* linahusiana na *uoga*, wingi *vyoga*, neno la Kidigo la uyoga; kamusi ya Mgombato ina *choga* ikielekeza kwa *vyoga*. *Nkuvi* wa kawaida ni *Termitomyces* wengine.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *choga nyama*, 'uoga wa nyama'. Neno *choga* rina asili mwenga na *uoga*, ambao unji wakpwe ni *vyoga*, neno ra Chidigo ra uoga; kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *choga* na kumuambira msomaji alole *vyoga*. Uoga unaoihwa *nkuvi* tu, bila neno ranjina, ni *Termitomyces* zanjina.

teaser.en: Break it and it bleeds milk: the Digo group this mushroom with milky plants like asthma weed.
teaser.sw: Uvunje na unatoa maziwa: Wadigo huuweka uyoga huu pamoja na mimea yenye maziwa kama mziwaziwa.
teaser.dg: Uchiuvundza unalavya maziya: Adigo anauika uoga huno fungu mwenga na mimea yenye maziya dza *chiziyaziya*.

summary.en: Nimaziya are the milk caps, Lactarius mushrooms that ooze a milky juice when the gills are cut. The Digo name places them with the milk-latex plants.
summary.sw: Nimaziya ni uyoga wa maziwa, uyoga wa jenasi *Lactarius* unaotoa utomvu kama maziwa matamvua yanapokatwa. Jina la Kidigo linauweka pamoja na mimea yenye utomvu wa maziwa.
summary.dg: *Nimaziya* ni uoga wa *Lactarius* (kpwa Chingereza *milk caps*), unaolavya maziya miraba ichikatwa. Dzina ra Chidigo rinauika fungu mwenga na mimea yenye maziya.

about.en: *Nimaziya* are milk caps. They look much like the brittlegills, with a firm cap, often funnel-shaped when mature, and crowded gills running a little down the stem. Their giveaway is the milk: cut or break the gills and drops of white or coloured latex appear.
about.sw: *Nimaziya* ni uyoga wa maziwa. Unafanana sana na uyoga wa jenasi *Russula*, wenye kofia ngumu, ambayo mara nyingi huwa na umbo la faneli ukikomaa, na matamvua yaliyosongamana yanayoshuka kidogo kwenye shina. Kinachoutambulisha ni maziwa: kata au vunja matamvua na matone ya utomvu mweupe au wenye rangi hutokea.
about.dg: *Nimaziya* ni uoga wa *milk caps*. Unahalana sana na *nimakoba* (*Russula*): una kofiya ngumu, ambayo mara nyinji ichikula inakala na umbo dza chifumbu, na miraba minji iriyo phephi na phephi, inayotserera chidide kpwenye muhi. Unamanyikana kpwa maziyage: uchikata au uchivundza miraba, kunatuluka matone ga maziya mereru au ga rangi.

where.en: Milk caps grow from the ground in woodland, linked to the roots of trees. In eastern and southern Africa many grow with *Brachystegia* trees, and Digo collectors treat *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*) as a mushroom ground.
where.sw: Uyoga wa maziwa huota kutoka ardhini msituni, ukiungana na mizizi ya miti. Mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika, mingi huota pamoja na miti ya *Brachystegia*, na wakusanyaji wa Kidigo huuchukulia msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*) kuwa eneo la uyoga.
where.dg: Uoga wa *Lactarius* unamera kula photsi matsakani, phamwenga na mizi ya mihi. Afrika ya Mashariki na ya Kusini, aina nyinji zinamera phamwenga na mirihi (*Brachystegia*), na Adigo anaotsola uoga anaona phatu phenye mirihi (*mirihini*) kukala ni phatu pha uoga.

uses.en: Pakia lists *nimaziya* among the named mushrooms, which are those collected for food. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Pakia anaiorodhesha *nimaziya* miongoni mwa uyoga wenye majina, ambao ndio unaokusanywa kwa chakula. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika *nimaziya* kahi ya aina za uoga zenye madzina, ambazo ndizo zinazotsolwa kpwa chakurya. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

culture.en: The Digo group plants by their secretions as well as their uses. Pakia records a group called *m*/*chiziya*, 'milk', for plants that produce milky latex: *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*), *chiziyaziya* (*Euphorbia hirta*) and the mushroom *nimaziya*.
culture.sw: Wadigo hupanga mimea katika makundi kwa vitu inavyotoa pamoja na matumizi yake. Pakia anarekodi kundi liitwalo *m*/*chiziya*, 'maziwa', kwa mimea inayotoa utomvu kama maziwa: *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*), *chiziyaziya* (*Euphorbia hirta*) na uyoga *nimaziya*.
culture.dg: Adigo anaika mimea mafungu kpwa vitu inavyolavya, na piya kpwa vira inavyohumirwa. Pakia anaandika fungu rinaroihwa *m*/*chiziya*, 'maziya', ra mimea inayolavya maziya: *mziyaziya* (*Hunteria zeylanica*), *chiziyaziya* (*Euphorbia hirta*) na uoga *nimaziya*.

names.en: Pakia records *nimaziya*, grouped with the milk-latex plants; *maziya* is the Digo word for milk. The prefix *nima-* is one Pakia reads as carrying a 'female' sense. In English they are milk caps.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nimaziya*, uliowekwa pamoja na mimea yenye utomvu wa maziwa; *maziya* ni neno la Kidigo la maziwa. Pakia anakisoma kiambishi *nima-* kuwa kinabeba maana ya 'kike'. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *milk caps*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nimaziya*, uoga unaoikpwa fungu mwenga na mimea yenye maziya; *maziya* ni neno ra Chidigo, na kpwa Chingereza ni *milk*. Pakia anaona kukala mwandzo wa dzina hiri, *nima-*, una mana ya chichetu. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *milk caps*.

teaser.en: Squeeze a ripe one and it puffs out brown dust: to the Digo, a hyena's tobacco.
teaser.sw: Ukiubana ulioiva hutoa vumbi la kahawia: kwa Wadigo, ni tumbaku ya fisi.
teaser.dg: Uchiminya iriyoivwa, inalavya vumbi ra rangi ya dongo: kpwa Adigo, ni tumbaku ya fisi.

summary.en: Tumbaku ya fisi are puffballs, round fungi with no cap or gills that release clouds of brown spores when ripe. The Digo do not count them as true mushrooms.
summary.sw: Tumbaku ya fisi ni kuvu za mviringo zisizo na kofia wala matamvua, ambazo zikiiva hutoa wingu la vijimbegu vya kahawia (kwa Kiingereza *puffballs*). Wadigo hawazihesabu kuwa uyoga halisi.
summary.dg: *Tumbaku ya fisi* ni *puffballs*: ni ya mviringo, taina kofiya wala miraba, na ichiivwa inalavya vumbi ra rangi ya dongo (*spores*) dza mosi. Adigo taaitala kukala ni uoga wa kpweli.

about.en: Puffballs are round or pear-shaped fungi that sit on the ground without a cap or gills. Young ones are white and solid inside. As they ripen the inside turns into a mass of olive-brown powder, and the skin either opens at a small hole on top or cracks apart. A tap or a raindrop sends out a puff of spores like smoke.
about.sw: Kuvu hizi (*puffballs*) ni za mviringo au umbo la peasi, na hukaa ardhini bila kofia wala matamvua. Zikiwa changa huwa nyeupe na ngumu ndani. Zinapoiva, ndani hugeuka kuwa unga mwingi wa rangi ya kahawia-zeituni, na ngozi ama hufunguka kwa tundu dogo juu au hupasuka. Kuguswa kidogo au tone la mvua hutoa mpulizo wa vijimbegu kama moshi.
about.dg: *Tumbaku ya fisi* ni ya mviringo au ya umbo dza pera, na inakala photsi bila kofiya wala miraba. Ichikala ichere ndide, ndani ni nyereru na ngumu. Ichiivwa, ndani kunagaluka kukala unga wa rangi ya dongo na chijani, na gadaye ama inavuguka kpwa tundu ridide dzulu, ama inaahuka. Uchiiguta chidide, au tone ra mvula richiigbwera, inalavya vumbi dza mosi.

where.en: Puffballs grow on the ground in grassland, woodland and old fields, often after rain.
where.sw: Kuvu hizi huota ardhini katika nyika, misitu na mashamba ya zamani, mara nyingi baada ya mvua.
where.dg: *Tumbaku ya fisi* inamera photsi phatu phenye nyasi, phatu phenye mihi na kpwenye minda ya kare, mara nyinji bada ya mvula.

uses.en: No use is recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi garigoandikpwa.

culture.en: The Digo word *uoga* means the fleshy, edible mushrooms. Pakia found that puffballs, earth stars and the bracket fungi on tree trunks are not counted as true *uoga* and are not put in any other category either.
culture.sw: Neno la Kidigo *uoga* linamaanisha uyoga wenye nyama unaolika. Pakia aligundua kuwa kuvu hizi, kuvu-nyota (*earth stars*) na kuvu-rafu zinazoota kwenye vigogo vya miti hazihesabiwi kuwa *uoga* halisi, na wala haziwekwi katika kundi jingine lolote.
culture.dg: Kpwa Chidigo, neno *uoga* rina mana ya uoga wenye nyama, unaoriwa. Pakia waona kukala *tumbaku ya fisi*, *earth stars* na *dzogalele* (*bracket fungi*) zinazomera dzulu ya makolo ga mihi, tavitalwa kukala ni *uoga* wa kpweli, na piya taviikpwa kahi ya fungu ranjina.

names.en: Pakia records *tumbaku ya fisi* for the puffballs. In the Mgombato dictionary *tumbaku* is 'tobacco' or 'snuff' and *fisi* is 'hyena', so the name reads 'hyena's tobacco', perhaps after the snuff-like puff of spores.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *tumbaku ya fisi* kwa kuvu hizi. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *tumbaku* ni 'tumbaku' au 'ugoro' na *fisi* ni 'fisi', kwa hiyo jina hili linasomeka 'tumbaku ya fisi', pengine kwa sababu ya mpulizo wa vijimbegu unaofanana na ugoro.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *tumbaku ya fisi* kpwa *puffballs*. Kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, *tumbaku* ni tumbaku ya kunusa au ya kuvuta, na *fisi* ni nyama wa weruni (*hyena*), kpwa hivyo dzina rina mana ya 'tumbaku ya fisi', chahi kpwa sababu vumbi rinarolavya rinahalana na tumbaku ya kunusa.

teaser.en: The hard, shelf-like fungus on old tree trunks, named by the Digo but not counted as a mushroom.
teaser.sw: Kuvu ngumu yenye umbo la rafu kwenye vigogo vya miti mizee, iliyopewa jina na Wadigo lakini isiyohesabiwa kuwa uyoga.
teaser.dg: Chitu chigumu dza chibao chinachotuluka kpwenye makolo ga mihi ya kare; Adigo anachiiha dzina, ela taachitala kukala ni uoga.

summary.en: Dzogalele are Ganoderma bracket fungi, tough woody shelves that grow out of tree trunks and stumps. The Digo name them but do not class them as uoga, the true mushrooms.
summary.sw: Dzogalele ni kuvu-rafu za jenasi *Ganoderma*, rafu ngumu kama mbao zinazoota kutoka kwenye vigogo na visiki vya miti. Wadigo huzipa jina lakini hawaziweki katika kundi la uoga, uyoga halisi.
summary.dg: *Dzogalele* ni *Ganoderma* (kpwa Chingereza *bracket fungi*): vitu vigumu dza mbao vinavyotuluka kpwenye makolo ga mihi na kpwenye magutu. Adigo anaviiha dzina, ela taavitala kukala ni *uoga*, uoga wa kpweli.

about.en: *Dzogalele* are bracket fungi. They grow out of living or dead tree trunks as hard, woody shelves or hoof shapes, with a ridged, brown to reddish top that can look varnished in some species, and a pale underside full of tiny pores. They grow larger year by year, and the pores release a fine brown spore dust that often coats the bark below.
about.sw: *Dzogalele* ni kuvu-rafu (*bracket fungi*). Huota kutoka kwenye vigogo vya miti hai au iliyokufa kama rafu ngumu kama mbao au maumbo ya kwato, zikiwa na sehemu ya juu yenye mikunjo, ya kahawia hadi nyekundu-kahawia, ambayo kwa spishi nyingine huonekana kama imepakwa varnishi, na upande wa chini uliofifia uliojaa vitundu vidogo sana. Hukua kubwa zaidi mwaka hadi mwaka, na vitundu hutoa vumbi laini la vijimbegu vya kahawia ambalo mara nyingi hufunika gome lililo chini yake.
about.dg: *Dzogalele* ni *bracket fungi*. Zinatuluka kpwenye makolo ga mihi iriyo hai au mifu, dza vibao vigumu dza mbao au dza umbo ra kpwatsa. Dzulu zina mbavu, na ni za rangi ya dongo hadi ya kundu; kpwa aina zanjina zinang'ala dza zikapakpwa rangi. Photsi ni ngushu-ngushu, na zina mianya midide sana minji. Zinakula chila mwaka, na mianya hiyo inalavya vumbi laini ra rangi ya dongo, ambaro mara nyinji rinaonekana dzulu ya gopha photsize.

where.en: They grow on trunks, stumps and roots of trees in forest, woodland and farmland, and can rot the wood of their host.
where.sw: Huota kwenye vigogo, visiki na mizizi ya miti msituni, katika misitu na mashambani, na zinaweza kuoza mbao za mti unaozibeba.
where.dg: Zinamera kpwenye makolo, magutu na mizi ya mihi matsakani, phatu phenye mihi na mindani, na zinaweza kuhenda nyama za muhi unaozimeresa ziole.

uses.en: No Digo use is recorded. In East Asia some *Ganoderma*, known as reishi or lingzhi, are prized in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Katika Asia Mashariki, baadhi ya *Ganoderma*, zinazojulikana kama *reishi* au *lingzhi*, huthaminiwa sana katika tiba asilia.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga *dzogalele* kpwa Adigo garigoandikpwa. Asia ya Mashariki, aina zanjina za *Ganoderma*, zinazomanyikana dza *reishi* au *lingzhi*, zinamendzwa sana kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: Pakia found that bracket fungi like *Ganoderma*, puffballs and earth stars are not counted as true *uoga*, the fleshy mushrooms, and are not put in any other plant category.
culture.sw: Pakia aligundua kuwa kuvu-rafu kama *Ganoderma*, *puffballs* na kuvu-nyota hazihesabiwi kuwa *uoga* halisi, yaani uyoga wenye nyama, na wala haziwekwi katika kundi jingine lolote la mimea.
culture.dg: Pakia waona kukala *bracket fungi* dza *Ganoderma*, *tumbaku ya fisi* (*puffballs*) na *earth stars* tavitalwa kukala ni *uoga* wa kpweli, uoga wenye nyama, na taviikpwa kahi ya fungu ranjina ra mimea.

names.en: Pakia records *dzogalele*; its meaning is not explained. No Swahili name is recorded. In English they are bracket fungi or shelf fungi.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *dzogalele*; maana yake haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *bracket fungi* au *shelf fungi*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *dzogalele*; manaye taielezwa. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Kpwa Chingereza zinaihwa *bracket fungi* au *shelf fungi*.

teaser.en: A named but still unidentified Digo mushroom, one of several whose names carry a 'female' prefix.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa Kidigo wenye jina lakini bado haujatambuliwa, mmoja wa kadhaa ambao majina yao yana kiambishi cha 'kike'.
teaser.dg: Uoga wa Chidigo wenye dzina, ela ambao bado taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi; ni mwenga wa uoga kadhaa ambao madzinage ganaandza na mwandzo wenye mana ya chichetu.

summary.en: Nimahembo is a mushroom known to Digo collectors that has not yet been scientifically identified. Pakia notes its name among those with a prefix carrying a 'female' sense.
summary.sw: Nimahembo ni uyoga unaojulikana na wakusanyaji wa Kidigo ambao bado haujatambuliwa kisayansi. Pakia analitaja jina lake miongoni mwa yale yenye kiambishi kinachobeba maana ya 'kike'.
summary.dg: *Nimahembo* ni uoga unaomanyikana ni Adigo anaotsola uoga, ela taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi. Pakia anaandika dzinare kahi ya madzina genye mwandzo wenye mana ya chichetu.

about.en: *Nimahembo* is a mushroom that Digo collectors know by name but that has not yet been scientifically identified. Pakia notes that some of the mushrooms he collected were still awaiting identification when his study was written. Digo collectors tell mushrooms apart mainly by the colour of the cap, but no description of *nimahembo* is recorded.
about.sw: *nimahembo* ni uyoga ambao wakusanyaji wa Kidigo wanaujua kwa jina lakini bado haujatambuliwa kisayansi. Pakia anaeleza kuwa baadhi ya uyoga aliokusanya ulikuwa bado unasubiri kutambuliwa wakati utafiti wake ulipoandikwa. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo hutofautisha uyoga hasa kwa rangi ya kofia, lakini hakuna maelezo ya *nimahembo* yaliyorekodiwa.
about.dg: *Nimahembo* ni uoga ambao Adigo anaotsola uoga anaumanya kpwa dzina, ela taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi. Pakia anaandika kukala wakati achiandika kaziye, aina zanjina za uoga arizozitsola kala bado tazidzangbwemanyikana. Adigo anaotsola uoga anatafwautisha aina za uoga hasa kpwa rangi ya kofiya, ela takuna chitu chirichoandikpwa cha vira *nimahembo* unavyoonekana.

where.en: Digo mushroom collectors recognise three mushroom grounds: *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*), farmland (*mdani*) and termite mounds (*tsuluni*). Which of these this mushroom favours is not recorded.
where.sw: Wakusanyaji wa uyoga wa Kidigo wanatambua maeneo matatu ya uyoga: msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), mashamba (*mdani*) na vichuguu (*tsuluni*). Haijarekodiwa ni lipi kati ya haya ambalo uyoga huu hupendelea.
where.dg: Adigo anaotsola uoga anamanya aina hahu za phatu ambapho uoga unamera: phatu phenye mirihi, *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), minda (*mdani*) na tsulu (*tsuluni*). Ela takuna chitu chirichoandikpwa cha kuonyesa kukala uoga huno unamendza zaidi kumera kuphi kahi ya aina hizo hahu.

uses.en: Pakia notes that the Digo give names only to mushrooms they know as edible, so *nimahembo* is very likely one that local people collect and eat. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa Wadigo huipa majina uyoga tu wanaoujua kuwa unalika, kwa hiyo huenda sana *nimahembo* ni mmoja wa uyoga ambao wenyeji hukusanya na kula. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anazipha madzina aina za uoga ambazo anazimanya kukala zinariwa tu, kpwa hivyo kuna dalili nyinji kukala *nimahembo* ni uoga ambao atu a phapha anautsola na kuurya. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

culture.en: Pakia notes that several Digo mushroom names, *nkuvi*, *nimaziya*, *nimakoba* and *nimahembo*, begin with a prefix that in personal names marks a woman. Digo has no grammatical gender, so this seems to be a borrowed sense rather than a grammar rule. Mushroom collecting is women's work among the Digo. Pakia found that only about ten kinds, those learnt from the elders as edible, are eaten, and that collectors pick them young, with the cap still closed (*fundula*), because open caps (*bumula*) are usually full of worms.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa majina kadhaa ya uyoga ya Kidigo, *nkuvi*, *nimaziya*, *nimakoba* na *nimahembo*, huanza kwa kiambishi ambacho katika majina ya watu huashiria mwanamke. Kidigo hakina jinsia ya kisarufi, kwa hiyo hii inaonekana kuwa maana iliyoazimwa badala ya kanuni ya kisarufi. Kukusanya uyoga ni kazi ya wanawake miongoni mwa Wadigo. Pakia aligundua kuwa ni aina takriban kumi tu zinazoliwa, zile ambazo wazee walifundisha kuwa zinalika, na kwamba wakusanyaji huzichuma zikiwa changa, kofia ikiwa bado imefunga (*fundula*), kwa sababu kofia zilizofunguka (*bumula*) kwa kawaida hujaa funza.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala madzina kadhaa ga uoga kpwa Chidigo, *nkuvi*, *nimaziya*, *nimakoba* na *nimahembo*, ganaandza na mwandzo ambao kpwenye madzina ga atu unaonyesa kukala ni mchetu. Chidigo tachina tafwauti ya chilume na chichetu kpwa sarufi, kpwa hivyo mana hino inaonekana kukala ni ya kukopwa kula madzina ga atu, si kanuni ya sarufi. Kahi ya Adigo, kutsola uoga ni kazi ya achetu. Pakia waona kukala ni aina kama kumi tu za uoga zinazoriwa, zira ambazo anaotsola akadzifundza kula kpwa azehe kukala zinariwa, na kukala anautsola uoga uchere mdide, kofiyaye ichikala bado taidzangbwevuguka (*fundula*), kpwa sababu kofiya ichivuguka (*bumula*), mara nyinji uoga unakala na mabulu manji.

names.en: Pakia records *nimahembo*; the meaning is not explained. It shares the *nima-* beginning with *nimakoba* and *nimaziya*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nimahembo*; maana yake haielezwi. Linashiriki mwanzo wa *nima-* na *nimakoba* na *nimaziya*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nimahembo*; manaye taielezwa. Dzina hiri rinaandza na *nima-*, dza *nimakoba* na *nimaziya*.

names.en: Pakia records *nimarondo*; the meaning is not explained. It begins with *nima-*, like *nimakoba*, *nimaziya* and *nimahembo*. In the Mgombato dictionary *rondo* is the leg of an animal or a joint of meat, which may hint at a fleshy mushroom, but this is not recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nimarondo*; maana yake haielezwi. Linaanza kwa *nima-*, kama *nimakoba*, *nimaziya* na *nimahembo*. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *rondo* ni mguu wa mnyama au kipande cha nyama chenye kiungo, jambo linaloweza kuashiria uyoga wenye nyama nyingi, lakini hili halijarekodiwa.
